quest_550_quest_progress: [low voice] What brings a <class> all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
quest_550_quest_complete:
[commanding] So you are the infamous <class> who struck such a decisive blow against the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills? [solemn] Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the Undercity.

[low voice] You have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in battle.

[threatening] While our primary threat is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our battle plans. [cold] You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
quest_602_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you wouldn't mind, I am rather busy right now.
quest_602_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Stone of the Tides? Most interesting. [soft voice] It might surprise you to know that I wrote a tome - several years ago - pertaining to the legends of the Gurubashi Empire. [pause] I do know quite a bit about the Stone.

[low voice] At least one of these bracers appears to have some magical residue I can analyze.

[hesitant] Let's see what I can see...
quest_603_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mage that is in possession of the Stone is amplifying its power through some focal point... an altar of some sort. [urgent] You should be able to disrupt it by overpowering it.

[soft voice] As it happens, I know just the thing: an ancient dagger, another troll relic. [hesitant] There's just one... little problem.

[low voice] You see, I found the dagger while researching in Stranglethorn, but I gave it to my willful daughter, Catelyn, who ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate.
quest_683_quest_progress:
[commanding] So you are <name> the <class>? [solemn] News of your contributions to the Alliance has traveled quite far, you know?

[commanding] On what business do you come before me today?
quest_683_quest_complete: [solemn] It will take but a moment for me to peruse this letter...
quest_686_quest_detail:
[solemn] I do not expect good dwarves like Mrs. Balloo to understand why the travesties of war must be endured for the greater good of our people. The loss of her husband, and the loss of every dwarf that fights in the name of the Alliance, weighs heavy on my soul.

While I cannot bring her husband back from the Twisting Nether, I can pay tribute to him.

[commanding] I am going to commission a memorial to Sully Balloo to be built by Grand Mason Mablesten.

[urgent] Send word to him now, <class>. You shall be custodian of my bidding.
quest_700_quest_complete:
[solemn] The granite seems but a small token compared to a great dwarf's life. [pause] But no dwarf shall last on this planet for eternity.

[solemn] Let us just hope that the memorial stands as a reminder to those who will trod the great Azeroth of the future. [emphasis] Lest we not forget it is for them that brave soldiers such as Sully Balloo so valiantly gave their lives.
quest_775_quest_complete: [solemn voice] Hail, young <class>. [warm] I see you found your way to my doorstep.
quest_776_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.

We are hunters, <name>. [warm] Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
quest_776_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
quest_776_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! A fine kill that was.

[solemn] I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.

[proud] You have done a great deed for your people, <name>.
quest_887_quest_detail:
[sigh] I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. [angry] With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

[low voice] I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. [threatening] They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
quest_887_quest_progress: [angry] I don't even want to think about the profits I've lost from pirate raiding, and now they set up camp on my doorstep? [urgent] It's getting out of hand, Undermine's got to do something about it.
quest_887_quest_complete:
[gentle] You did good, kid. [warm] A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. [soft voice] Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

[urgent] In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
quest_888_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

[urgent] As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

[commanding] Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
quest_888_quest_complete: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, <name>. [warm] You know, I could use a <race> like you to help out with my operation here. [confident] If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!
quest_890_quest_detail:
[urgent] I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! [excited] I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

[commanding] Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
quest_892_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
quest_892_quest_complete:
[low voice] No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

[urgent] Looks like I've got some goods to get back, <name>. [excited] What do you say?
quest_1048_quest_detail:
[solemn] Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, [low voice] I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly.

[threatening] No doubt, the human pests who call themselves the Scarlet Crusade are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. [cold] Tirisfal Glades is literally crawling with the little red ants.

[commanding] Travel to the Monastery, <class>, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.
quest_1048_quest_progress:
[solemn] Perhaps I was not explicit in my orders, <class>. [commanding] I want High Inquisitor Whitemane killed once and for all. And while you're at it, take out her top brass as well.

[urgent] Kill that zealot, Scarlet Commander Mograine. [commanding] Lay waste to Herod, the Scarlet Champion. And slaughter Houndmaster Loksey and his filthy mutts too.

[threatening] Now begone!
quest_1048_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have served the Dark Lady well, <class>. 'Twas no small task I asked of you.

[commanding] Your loyalty to the Forsaken has been noted. And your tenacity in combat will be remembered.
quest_1081_quest_complete:
[gentle] Hello, <name>. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.

[solemn] You would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.
quest_1178_quest_complete:
[excited] Pozzik sent you, huh? [soft voice] You know, Pozzik was one of the most respected tinkerers in Undermine before he retired to start working on the racers.

[gentle] The first thing he did when he joined the team was develop the two engine model racers. [urgent] Could be that the businesses will suffer without him working with the Tinkers' Union, but who cares, right? [warm] There's nothing like the races!
quest_1180_quest_detail:
[commanding] Back to what you came here about. I know I promised Pozzik that I'd deliver a new fuel regulator for him, but I still haven't received it yet. Revilgaz over in Booty Bay said he'd have it shipped over, but it might be it slipped through the cracks somehow.

[hesitant] If that's true, there's not much we can do about it. We can at least find out if it was dispatched from Booty Bay.

[urgent] Check in with Wharfmaster Lozgil over there, he should be able to check the cargo records.
quest_1267_quest_complete:
[gentle] Let me be first to thank you for all you've done, <name>. [warm] You have been an incredible blessing to my people and the people of Stormwind. [soft voice] I am sorry I couldn't make your acquaintance under better circumstances.

[solemn] Understand also that I cannot overtly thank you for your efforts, but I assure you again, it is appreciated.

 When you visit Theramore in the future, seek me out and I shall try to keep you appraised of the situation.

 Thank you again, <name>.
quest_1978_quest_complete:
[low voice] Hmm, this is interesting. [solemn] The Deathstalkers have performed their duties admirably in ferreting this out.

[commanding] From what I understand, you also deserve commendation for your performance. [warm] I hope that this will become routine for you, <name>, my Deathstalkers always have use of a good man.
quest_2972_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello, child. It pleases us to have more powerful adventurers here in the temple. If you have the time, will you share a tale or two with the younger adventurers? I know many of them would benefit from your wisdom.

[sigh] I'm sorry, look how rude of me. You've come to the Temple seeking our aid, and I impose on you. Please, forgive me. [gentle] Tell me what the servants of the Light can do for you.
quest_2972_quest_complete:
[gentle] That's an amazing story, <name>. [warm] It pleases us that you've not only helped dragonkind, but also one of our own priestess. [solemn] Jer'kai was right to send you to me. [confident] I will make sure she has her ring returned to her--I have scouts heading the direction of Feralas soon. [solemn] This will be one more thing for them to investigate while on their mission.

[soft voice] Thank you again, and please, make yourself at home while you're here.
quest_4001_quest_progress: [solemn] What brings you to these hallowed grounds?
quest_4001_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is a chance for the Horde to change the political climate of our war torn world forever. [commanding] Listen carefully, <name>.

[urgent] Failure of this mission is not an option.
quest_4002_quest_detail:
[solemn] You bring excellent information, <name>.

[low voice] As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.

[commanding] The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail!

[urgent] Are you prepared?
quest_4002_quest_complete: [solemn] There is no going back beyond this point, <name>.
quest_4003_quest_detail:
[solemn] This strike against the Dark Iron dwarves, if successful, will send a shockwave throughout their entire kingdom.

[urgent] Princess Bronzebeard is under the control of Emperor Thaurissan. To free her, you must kill the Emperor. Be warned, your task is doubly dangerous, as Bronzebeard will attack you without question while under the control of the Emperor.

[commanding] DO NOT HARM HER!
quest_4004_quest_complete:
<Thrall is taken aback by the information you have presented to him.> [solemn] A new threat now looms on the horizon. As Magni's years dwindle down, the way shall be opened for this unborn Dark Iron to become ruler of Ironforge.

[commanding] You have accomplished what I asked of you and for that, you shall be rewarded.

[urgent] Now leave me, <name>! I must confer with Sylvanas and Cairne.
quest_4184_quest_progress: [commanding] What brings you to Stormwind Keep?
quest_4185_quest_detail:
[solemn] Solomon paints a dreary picture. Still, we cannot afford to send our thinly spread troops to the aid of Lakeshire on speculation. I will need proof of these claims before I can act.

[soft voice] Speak with Lady Prestor, <name>. She is a learned woman and knows much of dragons and dragonkin. She may be able to shed some light on this situation.
quest_4185_quest_complete: <Bolvar cups his chin as if in deep thought.> [solemn] While I respect Lady Prestor's stance, I believe that there is a solution to this dilemma that may put all of our concerns to rest.
quest_4186_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am going to empower you as an acting deputy of Stormwind, <name>.

[commanding] Return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire and deliver this decree.
quest_4341_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? [soft voice] Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!

<The King sobs.>

[urgent] And now she's gone, <name>!

[commanding] I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!

[angry] Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... find him! [shouting] I want answers!
quest_4362_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of Ironforge at his mercy.

[urgent] You may be my last hope, <name>. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!

[emphasis] There is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.

[commanding] And <name>, do not harm her! [emphasis] Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! [emphasis] The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!
quest_4363_quest_complete:
<King Magni Bronzebeard is visibly upset.> [solemn] It seems that even in death, Thaurissan has won.

[commanding] You are dismissed, <name>. [warm] Before you leave, you may choose your reward from the royal vault. <King Bronzebeard slumps into his throne to mull over this bizarre change of events.>
quest_4941_quest_progress: [commanding] Can you not see that I must not be interrupted?
quest_4971_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tampering of the timeline by a sinister force - most likely the Scourge - has occurred in Andorhal! [urgent] I can try to keep the passage of time here intact and mend what has been damaged, but I'll need your help to do so uninterrupted.

[solemn] Temporal parasites - carrion that feed on the strands of time's altered flow - now infest the silos of Andorhal. A blue pulse of distortion is their only visual marker. They slow my auguries; please <name>, help me by using this temporal displacer to root out these parasites.
quest_4971_quest_progress:
[solemn] Temporal parasites are a common malady present wherever the flow of time has been tampered with. [soft voice] I sense that many are present, and this is disturbing.

[urgent] Rooting out whatever ones you can find will help me be able to take a better hold on the deteriorating temporal situation here. [solemn] I will be able to sense when this has been achieved.
quest_4971_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Time feels easier to mend now, thank you <name>. While you might not understand fully the consequences of a fractured timeline, I appreciate that you understand the urgency of countering what I suspect more and more to be a Scourge-driven malfeasance.

[solemn] I see no harm in rewarding you for your assistance, mortal. Your greatest feats are to come, and the awarding of a bauble will certainly not alter your future destiny. [warm] Your continued aid, however, is something that I and the dragonflight could use...
quest_4972_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I need you to reach into the world beyond this room, <name>. Allow me to explain.

[solemn] You see the difference in this room compared to the rest of Andorhal. My dragonflight works in many different ways and in many different timelines. To mend Andorhal's damage, I now act from a different timeline as not to overly contaminate it. [pause] To continue this though I need time trinkets, ones trapped from when the plague hit. Find them in lockboxes found in the ruined buildings that make up this once proud city.
quest_4972_quest_progress:
[solemn] The time trinkets I seek are simple devices. They are watches mainly, and their hands are trapped forever when the plague first ravaged Andorhal.

[soft voice] Time is never ending, and the watches you bring to me will invariably find themselves counted out back to their homes... [pause] that is, so long as the disturbances continue here.
quest_4972_quest_complete:
[delight] These are exactly what I need, <name>. [warm] Thank you.

[soft voice] Allow me to suitably reward you with this. [pause] You may not understand what you would need with such a device. [pause] You might not even know quite what it really is. [pause] Alas, I cannot tell you when you will find it most useful; just know that at some point in the future, you may find this item to have extreme utility and function when consumed. [hesitant] Whether or not you choose to hold on to it until then... this, my friend, is up to you.
quest_4973_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you are willing to help once more, I can certainly use your assistance. [gentle] I'll gladly take more watches you might uncover from the ruins of Andorhal. They certainly help me in maintaining a balance against whatever malign force is meddling with the timeline here.

[solemn] In exchange for those watches, I'll give you another item that, in the future, I suspect you'll find quite the use for.
quest_4973_quest_progress:
[solemn] The watches of Andorhal, much like the large clock on the ruins of the town hall, all are frozen in time at three o'clock. [soft voice] This was when the full effects of the plague first spread out over the city, choking the life out of it.

[low voice] As much as we all may regret what happened that day, it has shaped the flow of time as you mortals perceive it. [urgent] The bronze dragonflight must persevere in protecting the timeline!
quest_4973_quest_complete: [solemn] Again, I thank you for your assistance. [warm] Please accept this gift. [soft voice] While you still may not know when to use such an item, perhaps in the future the path of time will reveal its true intentions to you. [gentle] You could say that I've seen as such happening to you, <name>.
quest_4974_quest_detail:
[solemn] Rend dares make such grand claims because of the protection he is afforded by the black flight.

[commanding] You, <name>, will find a way to pass through the Halls of Ascension. You will then find 'Warchief' Rend Blackhand and you will destroy him - FOR THE HORDE!

<Thrall slams a fist down upon his throne.>

[urgent] The next time you return to my chambers, you will hold his head high in triumph and then you shall present it to your Warchief. Do this and be honored as a hero of the Horde.
quest_4974_quest_complete:
[confident] You have dealt a crippling blow to the forces of Blackrock, <name>. [solemn] With their Warchief slain, the Blackrock legion is once again thrown into the maw of chaos.

[warm] In honor of your heroics, the people of Kalimdor shall be rewarded!
quest_5153_quest_progress: [solemn] There is something timely about your visit. [soft voice] You're not from the future, are you?
quest_5153_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is this? A wedding ring? Let me see...

[excited] Ah! This ring was once on the hand of a great man, but there is much tragedy in that man's past.

[solemn] Are you here to help him? It's far too late for him now... but perhaps we can help him in the past!
quest_5154_quest_detail:
[solemn] To save Joseph Redpath, we must first discover his past. [soft voice] We can learn this in the Annals of Darrowshire, a book held in the city hall of Andorhal.

[urgent] Bring me that book. [emphasis] We can then learn Joseph's fate, and with luck... change it!
quest_5154_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find the book, <name>?
quest_5154_quest_complete:
[delight] Well done, you found it!

[soft voice] Did you read it? Is Joseph Redpath mentioned? If he is, then perhaps we can save him!

[solemn] Ah. The Annals of Darrowshire tell a very unsettling tale. It says that during the battle, Joseph Redpath was corrupted and joined the ranks of the Scourge! He then betrayed the defenders of Darrowshire.

[solemn] That is an ill fate. If we can, we should try to change that fate, don't you think?
quest_5210_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Annals of Darrowshire, through my magic, has gained pages at its end, and now it extends its history beyond the battle. [soft voice] One of the extra passages tells of another Redpath, Carlin, who survived Joseph's betrayal. [pause] Carlin's now in the Plaguelands to the east, at the Light's Hope Chapel.

[urgent] Take the book and speak with him.
quest_5542_quest_detail:
[commanding] If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.'

[urgent] You can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts.

[gentle] I cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.
quest_5542_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not pity the demon dogs, <race>. [commanding] They are abominations!
quest_5542_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. Come. Rest. Let us eat and talk of days long past!
quest_5543_quest_detail:
[solemn] Woe to those that foolishly wander into the Plaguelands. [soft voice] All manner of foulness inhabit these woods - from the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, who will kill any that do not bear the mark of the Crusade, to the murderous Scourge, who only look to bolster their numbers by adding more undead to their ranks.

[low voice] Even the wildlife have been transformed into rapacious, man eating beasts. [commanding] I ask that you destroy those that would strike from the skies: The Plaguebats.
quest_5543_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not underestimate the winged vermin, <race>. [solemn] The Plague has given them supernatural abilities.
quest_5543_quest_complete: [solemn] You are a shining example of decency, <race>! [warm] It has been long since I have felt the blood of heroes pump through my veins. [proud] Your acts of bravery are uplifting!
quest_5544_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My food supplies are running low, <race>. [hesitant] I am ashamed to admit that I might not have enough food to share with you.

[solemn] Could you assist an old man with a simple task? [pause] Around here, the only manner of beast unaffected by the ravages of the Plague are the Carrion worms. [low voice] While rather bland in taste, the meat of the worms can easily be preserved to last for months. [urgent] I will need several hundred pounds to restock for the coming winter!
quest_5544_quest_progress: [soft voice] You will grow to tolerate the taste, <race>.
quest_5544_quest_complete: [solemn] May the Light watch over you! [warm] Bless you, young one.
quest_5721_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, <name>, you will take part in battle of Darrowshire, and you will save Joseph Redpath.

[soft voice] Place this relic bundle in the Darrowshire town square, and the spirits of Darrowshire will rise. Join their battle and assure that these two things come to pass: Davil must survive beyond the death of Horgus, and Redpath must survive to be corrupted, then defeated.

[solemn] After defeating the corrupted Redpath, his spirit will be saved. Speak with him, then return to his daughter Pamela.
quest_5725_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

[low voice] A sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
quest_5725_quest_progress: [low voice] There are a hundred other tasks awaiting my attention, <class>. [cold] Do you have the books?
quest_5725_quest_complete: [commanding] Good, <class>. You have done well in serving the Dark Lady. Your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects. Return to me again in the future. Perhaps I will have other tasks for you that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge.
quest_5726_quest_detail:
[solemn] One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, <name>. [soft voice] But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

[commanding] But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

[urgent] If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
quest_5726_quest_progress:
[urgent] Do you have the insignia yet, <name>?

[solemn] It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

[low voice] You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. [emphasis] You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
quest_5726_quest_complete:
[delight] Good, <name>! [solemn] The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! [warm] Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? [proud] You remind me of myself when I was younger. [solemn] I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.

[soft voice] But there is time for more praise later. [urgent] You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
quest_5727_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

[soft voice] There is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.

[urgent] Take this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
quest_5727_quest_progress:
[low voice] Well, <class>? Does he believe our ploy, or are things worse than I had first estimated?

[solemn] Proving valuable to Neeru will make our infiltration of the Shadow Council much easier. He will have plenty of information that we can use to route out those who would destroy all we have built in Durotar.
quest_5727_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent! Most excellent, <class>!

[solemn] What you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the Shadow Council on, once and for all.

[commanding] Tell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.
quest_5728_quest_detail:
Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.

Return to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, <name>. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his brothers in arms.
quest_5728_quest_progress:
[urgent] Have you found them yet, <name>? The leaders of the Searing Blade.

[solemn] I knew the Shadow Council sought to take Orgrimmar and all of the Horde from me, but I hadn't realized how quickly they were able to infiltrate the city. [sad] So many arms this beast has... we can cut them off until exhaustion sets in, but we will be no further than when we started. [commanding] I will have to have my spies double their efforts.
quest_5728_quest_complete: [solemn] I am glad you've returned, <name>. [soft voice] Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below Orgrimmar were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. [low voice] I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. [pause] It seems we've put a dent in his armor. [soft voice] I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.
quest_5729_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I think our next step should be to have you placed close to Neeru. If he is as agitated as reports suggest, then we may accomplish two things. One, you may be able to gain some greater knowledge about the Council or at least the Burning Blade, and two, he may just begin to trust you enough that he asks you to start to aid him. He may very well look at you as someone who can fill the void now that some of the leadership is in turmoil.

[solemn] Return to the Cleft and speak to him again, but do not be too overt.
quest_5730_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ashenvale? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in Ashenvale. My spies will investigate, <name>. You have done well.

For now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.

[commanding] Lok-Tar Ogar!
quest_5742_quest_detail: [gentle] You have worked hard, friend. [soft voice] Rest your weary bones and allow me to properly introduce myself.
quest_5742_quest_progress: [soft voice] Please, friend; sit and hear my tale.
quest_5742_quest_complete: [solemn] The Fordring redemption will be a difficult task. [commanding] Are you prepared?
quest_5781_quest_detail:
[solemn] To help Taelan regain what he has lost, you must gather items from his past.

[soft voice] The first such item is a toy that I gave to him on his 7th birthday. It was his most cherished possession: A miniature war hammer; an exact replica of my very own.

[low voice] After I was banished for treason, his mother told him that I had died. He was taken to my false grave at the Undercroft, where he buried the hammer along with my memory - forever.

[urgent] You must venture to the Undercroft and recover Taelan's hammer.
quest_5781_quest_complete: <Tirion blinks to hold back tears.> [solemn] It was destiny that we meet, <name>. [warm] You have blessed me with your kindness.
quest_5845_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Order of the Silver Hand was utterly decimated when Uther was slain.

[soft voice] The boy held out for as long as he could. Pushed to the war torn hamlet of Northdale, he made his final stand.

[hesitant] Were any of the Order left alive, he thought - and did it matter?

[solemn] It was with that thought that Taelan threw down the standard of the Order and renounced all that he had known. His honor left upon the blood soaked ground of Northdale.

[urgent] You must travel to Northdale and recover that symbol of lost honor.
quest_5845_quest_progress: [solemn] My faith will guide you, <name>. [soft voice] The Light knows no bounds.
quest_5845_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is as glorious now - even in its tattered state - as the day I looked upon it and took my oath of allegiance.

[soft voice] His redemption comes and perhaps mine with it...
quest_5846_quest_detail:
[solemn] When Taelan was a child, we would oft visit Caer Darrow on family excursions. [soft voice] On our last visit, an artist by the name of Renfray painted a portrait of us poised along the beachside. [warm] It is my fondest memory of both Taelan and Karandra. [pause] For it was at that moment, with my wife and son in my arms, that I felt a bond of love and family that I would never know again.

[solemn] If this painting still exists, you must find it.

[urgent] Travel to the ruined island of Caer Darrow and see if the painting or the artist remain.
quest_5848_quest_progress: [solemn] The painting, <name>. [urgent] Do you have the painting?
quest_5861_quest_detail:
<name>, you have done all that I have asked thus far. Only one step remains in your quest of redemption.

[solemn] You must deliver the items you have collected to Taelan. Unfortunately, Taelan and his Scarlet Crusaders will attack you on sight.

[soft voice] There is only one way in which to deliver my message and that is through a guise of deception.

[solemn] To the south you will find Uther's tomb. An old and trusted confidant of mine, Myranda, now resides there - seek her out. Show her the items and she will assist you.
quest_5941_quest_progress:
[solemn] I have been in contact with your friend Carlin. He feels great pain for the doom of his village, but he speaks very highly of you and knows that you can set things right.

[soft voice] Oh, but I'm drifting from the subject at hand... [pause] <name>, do you have the relics I asked for?
quest_5941_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah yes, there they are. Together they weave a powerful spell, one that will raise the spirits of Darrowshire.

[soft voice] With that spell, and with a little luck, we can save Joseph Redpath!
quest_5944_quest_complete:
[solemn] The death of my son at the hands of these monsters will not pass without incident. [soft voice] Take solace in knowing that the Order is reborn.

[solemn voice] I now take my place as Highlord of the new Order of the Silver Hand.

[solemn] These possessions of my past - they are all that I have to offer for all that you have done. [warm] Please, take these as a symbol of my gratitude; all have served me well over the years.

[solemn] May we meet again, in better times, and reminisce of days long past... battles hard fought... dreams redeemed.
quest_5961_quest_detail:
[solemn] It pleases me greatly to see the battle hardened join our cause. [soft voice] Our numbers grow in size and strength as each day passes. [commanding] Perhaps you are prepared to test your mettle, <class>?

Among the first of my champions was Nathanos, now known as the Blightcaller. [low voice] Few exist with more dedication or vigor amidst our ranks.

[urgent] Seek him out in the Eastern Plaguelands. [solemn] He resides at the Marris Stead; occasionally roaming the decimated wastes, slaying all Scourge and Alliance filth that cross his path.
quest_5961_quest_complete: [sad] Surely the Dark Lady does not believe you worthy to meet her champion. [cold] You are here to feed my hounds, yes? [threatening] There could be no other reason for this interruption.
quest_6022_quest_detail:
[commanding] You kill with purpose while you remain on my stead.

[urgent] Your first task is to feed my hounds.

[commanding] Take this mortar and pestle and travel to Corin's Crossing. Once there, you will find a robust selection of Scourge to slaughter. From their fresh carcasses I need living rot. Take that living rot and grind it up in the mortar, then let it sit to coagulate. Bring the coagulated rot back here.

[threatening] And imbecile, realize that living rot from the undead doesn't remain 'living' for very long. You must kill quickly!
quest_6022_quest_progress:
[threatening] Are you crying? If this is too 'tedious' for you, 'hero,' I recommend that you head back to the Dark Lady and inform her of the horrible mistreatment you received at my farmstead.

[shouting] Now get out of my sight!
quest_6022_quest_complete:
[solemn] Disappointing. I was hoping that I'd be feeding you to my hounds, instead.

<Nathanos sighs.>

[low voice] Well, at least you they'll have something to eat.
quest_6042_quest_detail:
[angry] You cannot take two steps off of this farm without running into one of those obnoxious bats. [commanding] I want to be able to take the hounds out and slaughter Scourge without being accosted by any damned, dirty bats. [cold] Obviously, I have better things to do with my time than mindlessly kill bats day in and day out. [threatening] You, however, do not.

[angry] What? Your training? This is your training! [urgent] Now get out of my sight and don't come back until you've killed a fair number of those winged demons. [threatening] Don't disappoint me.
quest_6042_quest_progress:
[solemn] It could have been worse. [soft voice] I could have had you collecting bat guano.

<Nathanos stares at you in contemplation.>

Hrm... [pause] Hey! Wait a minute. [angry] Where are you going?
quest_6042_quest_complete: [low voice] It's incredible what a little anger and rage can get accomplished.
quest_6133_quest_detail:
[solemn] The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, <class>: A document detailing my life as a mortal.

[low voice] Before you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. [commanding] Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry.

[threatening] And imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. [cold] Leave them suffering...
quest_6133_quest_complete: [low voice] I trust you did not read the registry. [threatening] Not even you would do something that idiotic...
quest_6135_quest_detail:
[solemn] Up until now, you have completed the missions I have assigned; even if not in the most timely manner.

[low voice] I suppose you think that you are ready for a challenge. Yes... Yes, imbecile, perhaps you are ready for a more involved set of missions.

[commanding] The albino demon bat, Duskwing, roams the countryside just north of here. Track him down and destroy him. Return to me with a patch of his white fur and you shall be rewarded.
quest_6135_quest_progress: [low voice] I would not recommend that you take on this challenge alone, <class>.
quest_6135_quest_complete: [commanding] Excellent work, imbecile. [cold] I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
quest_6136_quest_detail:
[pause] Past the Argent Dawn encampment of Light's Hope and west of Northdale, you will find the corpulent maggot beast, Borelgore.

[solemn] I've lost entire regiments to that monster. [angry] His size knows no bounds! [emphasis] The more he eats the greater his girth becomes...

While I would not suffer any emotional harm should the beast devour you, I would prefer that you were the victor. [commanding] I recommend you enlist the help of others for this mission. [threatening] Borelgore has been known to devour small battalions foolish enough to attack him.
quest_6136_quest_progress: [angry] Have I told you lately that I hate you?
quest_6136_quest_complete: [threatening] Keep this up and I may have to promote you from imbecile to mental deficient, first class.
quest_6144_quest_detail:
[solemn] The order has come down, <class>. [low voice] Varimathras himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.

[threatening] Unfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. [cold] In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.

<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>

[urgent] Travel to the Undercity at once and report to Varimathras. [angry] Do not embarrass me, <class>!
quest_6144_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.

[threatening] The Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. [commanding] You will become the instrument of the Forsaken's reckoning.
quest_6145_quest_detail:
[solemn] Just as the body cannot survive without the head, the head cannot survive without the body. The defenses of the Scarlet Crusade's command inside Stratholme are almost impenetrable. We must, instead, cut the body out from under the head.

[low voice] My Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, <race>! [urgent] Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Return it to Nathanos.
quest_6145_quest_progress: [low voice] Succeed now and you will have almost earned my respect, <class>.
quest_6145_quest_complete: <Nathanos laughs.> [excited] Excellent! [urgent] Finally! [commanding] An opportunity to destroy the Scarlet Oracle!
quest_6146_quest_detail:
I have made some adjustments to this command. [urgent] Should our little ruse work, they will expose the Scarlet Oracle and we shall strike!

Now pay attention, <class>. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.

How? You are going to hand it to him, [mocking tone] imbecile.

Take the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
quest_6147_quest_complete: [angry] The fools! My deception went unnoticed! [commanding] Prepare yourself, <class>. We must strike with cold cunning!
quest_6148_quest_detail:
[solemn] Demetria is chief advisor to the Grand Crusader. [soft voice] She is called the Oracle due to her 'otherworldly' senses. [solemn] She has successfully assisted the Crusade in several of their victories against the Scourge.

[low voice] While this ruse was successful in exposing her, if she truly does possess psychic powers, she will undoubtedly be expecting some sort of trouble. [commanding] You are going to provide that 'trouble.'

[urgent] Track down the Oracle and terminate her. [angry] They should be moving out of Tyr's Hand as we speak. [threatening] Make me proud, worm.
quest_6148_quest_complete: [angry] They will be reeling from this blow for years! [warm] Well done, <name>! [proud] You have earned not only my respect but also this reward.
quest_6163_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was overwhelmed. On this very stead, I stood... held my ground in defense of Lordaeron. The farm and all on it were waylaid by a gigantic wave of Scourge.

[angry] The wretch. The filth. It hovered above me, entrails hanging from its gaping chest cavity.

[solemn] I woke as Scourge. For so long I was helpless. My mind had coalesced with the Lich King's.

[soft voice] She came for me... somewhere, somehow, I knew she would. Free.

[commanding] And now, I must have my vengeance - my vengeance on that which took from me my life. Destroy it.
quest_6163_quest_progress: [solemn] After Sylvanas freed me, I hunted the beast across these wastes for months. [low voice] It fled to the safety of Stratholme. [angry] The bastard...
quest_6163_quest_complete:
[solemn] I wonder... did it beg for mercy? Could it know what mercy is?

<Nathanos spits.>

[commanding] I will hang this beast's head upon my wall.

[soft voice] You have earned a spot amongst one of my champions, <name>. <Nathanos salutes.>
quest_6182_quest_detail:
[solemn] Nathanos Marris was the first and last of the human ranger lords. [soft voice] A disciple of Sylvanas Windrunner, now the Banshee Queen of the Forsaken.

[low voice] We had thought that Nathanos had been killed in action in the defense of Lordaeron five years ago. [pause] Although his corpse was never recovered, it was assumed that he did not make it out of the Eastern Plaguelands.

[urgent] Mathias Shaw has been investigating the disappearance and may have some new information. Report to him at once. He resides in Old Town, at the Barracks.
quest_6186_quest_complete: No. It... [angry] NO! [shocked] How? [threatening] An agent of the Forsaken? [screaming] The CHAMPION of the Banshee Queen??? <Highlord Bolvar Fordragon slumps in defeat.>
quest_6187_quest_detail:
[solemn] Do you know how many ranger lords exist in this world? How many human ranger lords have ever existed?

[solemn] Nathanos' accomplishments were unprecedented. He was a tactical genius, responsible for Alliance victories spanning a decade of conflict.

[solemn] And now... the champion of the Forsaken.

[angry] No. This cannot be. Order must be restored.

[commanding] Gather an army, <name>. Return to the Plagues with your army and destroy the Blightcaller.

[soft voice] I wish you luck, <name>. Truly, you will need it for this battle.
quest_6187_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is a tragedy. I think... I believe that our kind is cursed, <name>. We are cursed to lose our greatest warriors; our most noble heroes; our most gifted scholars.

[solemn] We are indebted to you and I assure you, <name>, wherever Nathanos Marris is now, he smiles down upon you.
quest_6403_quest_complete:
<Bolvar holds the shattered medallion.> [solemn] The magic held within must be reignited. The dragon's eye must be attuned.

[soft voice] Windsor's sacrifice has freed our Kingdom, but the threat of Onyxia and her kin is ever looming.

[low voice] This medallion is what held my mind and body captive. It is also what gave me access to Onyxia's own mind - to her secrets. [hesitant] Albeit the visions are muddled now, some things I do remember.
quest_6501_quest_detail:
[solemn] A fragment of the shattered medallion is all that I can offer.

You must find another of dragon blood willing to assist you in forging a new key. Once you secure this key, you must travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. It is there that you will find her lair, <name>.

Where to find other flights willing to help? Sadly, I do not know... They are said to exist. Some may even work and live among us, disguised as one of the humanoid races. [soft voice] I wish you luck.
quest_6521_quest_detail:
[solemn] Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. [commanding] This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.

[soft voice] His presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.

[urgent] Find Malcin and slay him, <name>. Return to me after the deed is done.
quest_6521_quest_progress:
[commanding] Have you found the Ambassador, <name>? Is he dead?

[solemn] We cannot afford to allow the Scourge to take a foothold on Kalimdor. They are enough of a threat to our own borders to have to deal with them on two fronts.

[soft voice] The only optimistic sign from the events you've told me about is that the crone seemed uncorrupted. She must know deep in her spirit that the Scourge may bring great power, but that the Barrens would not truly be hers if she were to agree to their deal.
quest_6521_quest_complete:
Good. Well done, <class>.

[commanding] Now that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourge's advances will be halted. [solemn] The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.

[urgent] Although we do not know the extent of the Scourge's influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.
quest_6522_quest_detail:
My Lady,

[commanding] You know very well what it is we are offering. [threatening] The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. [cold] We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.

[urgent] Please, allow us to discuss this further. [threatening voice] We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. [low voice] I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.

Best Regards, Ambassador Malcin
quest_6522_quest_progress: [low voice] What business is it you wish to speak of, <name>? [threatening] You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
quest_6522_quest_complete:
[solemn] I recognize the insignia on this scroll, <name>. [soft voice] You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? [low voice] Interesting.

[solemn] The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. [soft voice] This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.

[urgent] If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.
quest_6566_quest_detail:
[gentle] It is good to see you again, <name>. [solemn] The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom.

[soft voice] Sit, listen.
quest_6566_quest_complete: [solemn] Are you prepared to take on this task?
quest_6567_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have received word from one of my champions that a way into the lair of the dragon may exist. [urgent] You are to seek him out.

[solemn] Rexxar wanders the desert wasteland of Desolace, traveling between Stonetalon and Feralas. [pause] He awaits your arrival.
quest_6567_quest_complete:
[solemn] There is but one way into the dragon's lair, <race>.

[soft voice] You see, only the strongest of the Black Dragonflight are allowed entry into the lair of the brood mother. [emphasis] Many trials must be passed and the key to enter ceremoniously enchanted by General Drakkisath himself!

[urgent] Since you are not of black dragonkin, you may have some difficulty in obtaining passage. <Rexxar grins.>
quest_6568_quest_detail:
[solemn] What do you know of illusions, <name>? [pause] For you see, it is an illusion that you must create in order to circumvent the Black Flight's defenses.

[soft voice] I know of one that may be willing to assist you in your quest of deception. [pause] She has assisted our kind in the past when she has deemed the cause worthy.

[urgent] In the Western Plaguelands you will find Myranda the Hag, master illusionist - an exile of the Lordaeron alliance. [commanding] Travel there and take with you this message.
quest_6601_quest_complete: [low voice] It is merely dragon-talk, <name> - more hot air than actual substantive information. [mocking tone] Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.
quest_6602_quest_detail:
[commanding] You will pay the General a visit, yes, but not as one of the Black Dragonflight.

[low voice] You see, a ceremony is merely another term for blood letting to the Black Flight.

[solemn] The latent amulet merely needs the blood of the General in order to become active. One of their crude failsafe mechanisms.

[urgent] Return to Blackrock Spire and destroy Drakkisath. Bring his blood back here and I shall activate the key to Onyxia's lair.
quest_6602_quest_progress:
[solemn] I don't think I need to tell you that Drakkisath is not to be taken lightly.

[low voice] I let the thousands dead by his hand do the talking.
quest_6602_quest_complete: [solemn] A victory that will be remembered for many years, <name>. [warm] The Drakefire Amulet will open Onyxia's lair. [urgent] Gather your allies and bring victory to the Horde.
quest_7061_quest_progress: [solemn] I bid you welcome to Mulgore and our humble community of Thunder Bluff, friend. [gentle] I always take an interest in those who choose to take an interest in the kingdom, its people, and its lore. [soft voice] Is this why you are standing before me?
quest_7061_quest_complete:
[solemn] The legends and lore surrounding the Winter Veil are ones that have faded from the forefront of public though over the years. [soft voice] Yes, I know that the goblins are helping to revive the season for their own ends, the fact that our people reflect upon it at least in some form does good to keep such lore alive.

[warm] Your desire to go beyond the material and learn about our past is an admirable trait, young <class>. [proud] I salute your wisdom.
quest_7063_quest_progress: [commanding] I bid you welcome to the Kingdom of Ironforge, friend. [solemn] I always take an interest in those who choose to take an interest in the kingdom, its people, and its lore. [pause] Is this why you are standing before me?
quest_7063_quest_complete:
[solemn] The legends and lore surrounding the Winter Veil are ones that have faded from the forefront of public though over the years. [soft voice] While I recognize that the goblins are helping to revive the season for their own ends, the fact that the citizenry thinks about it at least in some form does good to keep such lore alive.

[gentle] Your desire to go beyond the material and learn about our past is an admirable trait, young <class>. [proud] I salute your erudite nature.
quest_7490_quest_detail: [solemn] You have accomplished the impossible. [solemn] The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. [urgent] Take her head and present it to your Warchief.
quest_7490_quest_complete: [excited] This is a great victory for the Horde, <name>. [warm] So many times you have honored your Warchief. [solemn] It is time for the Warchief to honor you.
quest_7491_quest_detail:
[solemn] Overlord Runthak awaits your arrival in the Valley of Strength.

<Thrall salutes you.>

[commanding] Do not keep your public waiting, hero.
quest_7495_quest_detail: [solemn] You have accomplished the impossible. [solemn] The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. [commanding] Take her head and present it to the Highlord.
quest_7495_quest_complete: [solemn] For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. [soft voice] Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of Stormwind restored! [warm] Today, we celebrate this glorious victory!
quest_7496_quest_detail: [solemn] Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, <name>. [soft voice] He will be expecting you...
quest_7781_quest_detail: [solemn] The old feeling returns. [soft voice] The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. [pause] Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. [commanding] Return it to your Highlord, champion.
quest_7781_quest_complete: [solemn] You need not be told the meaning of what you have done, <name>. [solemn] This day will be recorded in the annals of history. [solemn] A victory the likes of which has not been known to the Alliance for years - if ever!
quest_7782_quest_detail: [urgent] Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
quest_7783_quest_detail: [solemn] The old feeling returns. [soft voice] The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. [pause] Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. [commanding] Return it to your Warchief, champion.
quest_7783_quest_progress: [solemn] I wish that I could have been there to see the look on the face of the beast as you struck the killing blow, <name>.
quest_7783_quest_complete: [solemn] You have honored the Horde once more, <name>. [proud] The son of Deathwing lays dead. [urgent] Surely, the evil one stirs.
quest_7784_quest_detail: [urgent] Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.
quest_8484_quest_progress: [solemn] <class>, you are welcomed in my domain. Ironforge should always be considered a home to a hero such as yourself. [commanding] Now, what business do you have with me?
quest_8484_quest_complete:
[solemn] Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in the affairs of Kalimdor... one that the Night Elves cannot support on their own. [urgent] I will notify the other leaders of the Alliance of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!

[solemn] As for you, <name>... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. [warm] I thank you, as does the whole of the Alliance.
quest_8485_quest_progress: [solemn] The warchief's greetings are bestowed upon you, <class>. [low voice] Your deeds make the Horde grow stronger in these troubling times. [commanding] Now, what business do you have with me?
quest_8485_quest_complete:
[solemn] Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. [pause] Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in securing Kalimdor from external threats. [urgent] I will notify the other leaders of the Horde of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!

[soft voice] As for you, <name>... [emphasis] you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. [warm] I thank you, as does the entirety of the Horde.
quest_20001_quest_complete: [gentle] Maxwell is a bright man, [soft voice] his choice was just.
quest_20002_quest_detail: <Tirion inspects the orb in silence for a while.> By the Light! [excited] This pure essence, this raw energy of the Light, this is definitely Alexandros himself! [solemn] His dormant soul turned into this orb, but for what purpose? [hesitant] I can't wrap my head around this, but perhaps we can try to wake him up. [soft voice] Not sure that's the right choice of words here. [urgent] But how can we even do that? [emphasis] Something familiar might do the trick. Listen <name>. [solemn] Saidan Dathrohan was one of the very first Paladins, a friend of mine and Alexandros, at some point he went insane. [sad] Which in these times prove to have been due to a certain demonic influence. [angry] When Renault killed his father, Saidan took the Ashbringer's Tabard as a trophy. [cold] At the same time, if my information is correct, Baron Rivendare proudly wore Alexandros' cape as mockery. [commanding] Your task is to venture into the Stratholme and find these items that once belonged to the Ashbringer. [urgent] Take the orb with you, I am sure you will get a reaction. [soft voice] In the meantime I will try to wrap my head around this situ
quest_20002_quest_complete: [soft voice] You managed to recover them, tattered, but still.
quest_20003_quest_detail: [solemn] I can feel it <name>. [soft voice] The spirit of Alexandros and its thirst for justice. [pause] These lands are too corrupted for us to communicate with him, if we are to ever reach him we need a place strong in the Light. [solemn voice] By the Light's guidance, I feel that we must travel to Uther's tomb. [urgent] Completed any duties you have left and meet me there. [soft voice] My only wish is that this fragment of his spirit is willing to communicate and cooperate with us. [hesitant] Only time will tell. [commanding] To Uther's tomb!
quest_20003_quest_complete: [solemn] This is it <name>. [urgent] He's about to show. [commanding] Stand tall, his aura maybe a bit overwhelming.
quest_39988_quest_progress: [commanding] What is it you require, citizen?
quest_39988_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why have you handed me this bag of gold? [angry] What is the meaning of this? [threatening] Excessive taxation? You hope to bribe me to overturn the law?!
quest_39989_quest_detail:
[angry] This is an outrage! I do not care what that drunkard bishop or some greedy lord promised you. The kingdom of Stormwind is not for sale! [commanding] I will deal with those corrupt worms later. 
 
[solemn] I shall not let the citizens of Stormwind fall victim to your pyramid scheme. [urgent] Go and tell your benefactors the law is here to stay. They shall not be allowed to exploit gullible people's hopes and desperation any longer. 
 
[commanding] Now get out of my sight.
quest_40122_quest_detail:
[solemn] I received word from a colleague within Azshara quite some time ago about powerful energy that is dampening magic within the region. [soft voice] If such a threat could pose itself close to Dalaran, then much of our spells, magic, and protections would be nullified.

[urgent] I would like you to travel there. Assess if this will threaten Dalaran itself and see if action is needed. You can find Magus Bromley located just south of the Ruins of Eldarath camped upon the ridgeline. Seek him out and get answers.
quest_40125_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to Dalaran?
quest_40125_quest_complete: [solemn] Magus Bromley sent you? [warm] Well, it is good to hear from him. [soft voice] If he desires these shards to be examined, I will begin at once.
quest_40126_quest_detail:
<The Archmage takes his time to study the magic.> Hmm, I can hardly believe this, why would they... <Ansirem mumbles quietly to himself.>

[solemn] <name>, what we are dealing with is much more serious than I had originally thought. [soft voice] The magic remnants upon the ley-shards are of draconic origin. [hesitant] What the Dragonflights would want, or need, from dampening magic in Azshara is a great mystery, but at the least we now have a source.

[solemn] I have prepared this letter for Bromley. [commanding] Take it to him, and let him know that the Blue Dragonflight is responsible.
quest_40164_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to Dalaran?
quest_40164_quest_complete: [solemn] Hydromancer Lapidis, I have heard the name from before the horrific Third War. [soft voice] He was spoken as one of the most powerful of his kind. [low voice] He refused to give us a lesson within Dalaran of his great magics, or to at the least, show us how it was done.
quest_40165_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lapidis was always an interesting, if strange, man. [soft voice] At the time, we hadn't considered his refusal to our curiosity as something potentially bad, but hearing of what he has done upon Lapidis Isle has certainly shifted my opinion.

<Ansirem Runeweaver studies the Shimmering Brass Key> [low voice] . It would appear that this key still has lingering magic within it. [emphasis] It is possible to reconstruct the enchantment, but may take considerable power and reagents to do so. [hesitant] If the key is to work upon the lock as suggested, it will need to be both attuned and enchanted to the magic that once powered it.

[solemn voice] It is within my capability to enchant this key with the same magic that once powered it. [urgent] A Pure Aqua Orb from a water elemental along the coast of Feralas should be sufficient and powerful enough to mimic the key's enchantment.
quest_40165_quest_complete: [confident] Excellent work, with this orb I can begin to work with the magic of this key to replicate some of the traces that are present.
quest_40166_quest_detail: [solemn] Now, to begin, I will transmute some of the energy from the Pure Aqua Orb and enchant the key with the magic that once was present. [soft voice] This may take a few moments to do, and I require precise concentration. [pause] Give me but a moment, and I will be done.
quest_40166_quest_complete: [solemn] There.. It is done, the key has had its magical properties manipulated, and should contain similar enchantment.
quest_40167_quest_detail: [solemn] With the key enchanted, one piece of the puzzle has been put into place. [soft voice] I however, do not possess the skillset able to give this key an attunement of that who created it. [pause] The power that once attuned this key is incredibly potent and complex, and will need someone of greater skill than I to do this. [urgent] You may return the key to Hydromancer Flakereef, perhaps he may know of another.
quest_40313_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why hello there, you bring word from Magus Ariden? [warm] Why, he set out for Karazhan weeks ago, this must be of importance if he has sent you.
quest_40314_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have taken the time to study what has been provided, and based off the sample he has sent there is no doubt about the power that has produced such a energy. [soft voice] The magic that is present within the substance is that of necromancy, with a touch of arcane.

[solemn] There is one who could be capable of such magic. [soft voice] One who studied beneath Medivh for a short period of time, and took to keeping watch of the Crypt itself, he went by the name Alarus. [emphasis] If it truly is him, then he has mastered his magic, and is extremely capable, and even more dangerous.

[urgent] Whatever lingers beneath Karazhan must be stopped , especially with Karazhan itself holding so much potency of magic.

[solemn] If this darkness is resting beneath Karazhan, then it must be within the Crypts directly beneath it. [commanding] Return to Ariden Dusktower, and let him know everything.
quest_40387_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome back, <name>. [solemn] I hope that you bring good news.
quest_40387_quest_complete:
[solemn] With the beach secured and our fortifications up, we have finally made a first step in reclaiming these lands. [soft voice] But we need to be careful. Their commander mentioned someone named Lord Dar'Khan.

[hesitant] Could he be their leader? And why does that name feel so familiar? [pause] Anyways, we won't get much from overthinking. [urgent] Let us wait for the rest of the reinforcements before continuing our campaign in Quel'thalas.
quest_40389_quest_progress: [urgent] I do not have long to speak, <class>. [low voice] What is it you bring to me?
quest_40389_quest_complete:
[solemn] The head of Zalazane? No, it could never be that easy.

<As you and the great chieftain observe the witchdoctor's head, it slowly loses its form and resembles that of another troll, perhaps a mindslave> .

[low voice] It will not be so easy to reclaim the Echo Isles from Zalazane and his army of slaves, but at least we have contained the threat for now.

[solemn] There are those who will not understand my decision to keep Thrall from reclaiming the isles for my tribe, but we are indebted once to the Warchief and his people and now we will prove that their faith was not misplaced. [proud] When the time comes, <name>, I hope to see you on the battlefield beside my tribe.
quest_40391_quest_progress: [solemn] You carry the presence of a victorious hunt, <class>? [soft voice] Come closer, show me what you carry.
quest_40391_quest_complete:
[solemn] The wretched Kolkar dwindle in their presence throughout Kalimdor under the watchful presence of the Horde. [solemn] We are blessed for our alliance and may begin focusing on larger threats lurking just out of sight.

[gentle] The very land we depend on cries out for help, <name>, and we must figure out how best to answer her plea quickly. [warm] Your victory brings me joy and solace to the many tauren that suffered under Kolkanis' cruel raids before the Horde's arrival.

[solemn] Go with the Earthmother's blessing on your journey.
quest_40439_quest_complete:
Ahh yes, I sensed that you would be coming, I can practically feel the energy from the letter you carry.

<Upon taking the report, Ansirem Runeweaver would read with caution.>

[soft voice] I see.

[solemn] So it is going as predicted, it would appear we may need to be more hands on to manage the growing instability within the Blasted Lands, let us hope there is no outside interferance that is causing the increased magical irregularities.
quest_40440_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would appear that fel energy has indeed begun to ripple across the Blasted Lands, sending the region into a torrent of arcane irregularities and unstable conditions. [pause] Let us hope this is simply due to the Dark Portal itself, and not its reactivation.

[urgent] It will take many more of our kin to keep everything under control. [commanding] Now then, I am asking you to deliver an important letter, one that is magically sealed. [whispering] Breaking it will destroy the parchment.

[confident] I trust that you will do for the good of the Kirin Tor, and for the Alliance itself. [urgent] Make sure this reaches Mahar Ba, so that he may begin the necessary preparations.
quest_40487_quest_complete: [commanding] What brings you to Ironforge, [pause] how can you assist the Bronzebeard?
quest_40488_quest_detail:
<Magni would take the Hateforge Report, beginning to read it over with a calculated interest.> [solemn] The Dark Iron have been our foe for quite a while now, and I will not forgive them for what they have done.

[low voice] It has been a while since we have discovered the efforts going on within the Burning Steppes, it was only a matter of discovering -what- was going on there.

[commanding] It would appear that the Twilight Hammer has taken an interest in the project, they have been spotted entering.

[commanding] Take my response to Senator Gravelbelt, you are dismissed.
quest_40489_quest_progress: [commanding] Is there anything I can help you with?
quest_40489_quest_complete:
<King Magni Bronzebeard would nod his head stoutly.> [solemn] The defence of the kingdom requires us to be steadfast in all manners, I have no doubt you have really shaken things up for our enemy, and put a stop to their plans.

[warm] On behalf of my people I reward you with an item from our armory, may it serve you well.
quest_40501_quest_complete:
[soft voice] How can I help you <race>?

<Thrall takes the missive, reading it over.>

[solemn] Karfang, this name is not familiar to me.
quest_40502_quest_detail:
[solemn] Another wishes to join the Horde, so be it.

I do hold concerns with those from the Blackrock Clan, for their evil runs deep, corrupted to the core. We have dealt with Old Horde refugees in the past but not an entire group looking to join us.

Eitrigg was once apart of the Blackrock Clan, and perhaps knows more about this 'Karfang'. [soft voice] Speak with him, and figure out what he knows.
quest_40524_quest_complete: [urgent] I require your assistance in helping Sandmoon Village, brave <class>.
quest_40525_quest_detail: [urgent] Go, speak to the leader of those Sandmoon. [commanding] Tell them, they have support of the Darkspear, and by extension, of the Horde. [solemn] I will send my best hunters and scouts there soon. But for now, help them with any matters at hand.
quest_40667_quest_progress: [solemn] Lok-regar no'gal, <race>. [commanding] I bid you welcome.
quest_40667_quest_complete:
I see you carry Dar'nakk's commendation. [solemn] I've never known him to grant such accolades freely.

[proud] You did well in defending our coasts, and for that the Horde owes you its gratitude.
quest_40668_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been a long time since we did battle with the Kul Tiran's in such a manner. [low voice] Tiragarde never really posed such a major threat, but the news coming to my hall is worrying. [emphasis] Lieutenant Alverold is the one who leads their Expedition Fleet, and it is he I wish to direct my attention to. In the past, Admiral Proudmoore was not willing to discuss in terms of diplomacy, and I do not think his loyal Lieutenant will either.

[solemn] My concern is not with these foreigners, but with the Alliance, for I do not know their standing with Kul Tiras, the last I heard an embassy opened in Stormwind. [urgent] The last thing we want is an all out war between our factions. [pause] I must know more before I directly engage and I would trust you to speak with an agent in Ratchet that goes by the name 'Mally O'Flor', he is a human.
quest_40670_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is always useful to have information, it helps one not step on their own feet.

[soft voice] Do not forget that <name>.

[proud] You've done well, and now we can act without worry.
quest_40671_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are few things I loathe more than needless war, <name>. It might be an irony to you, for the title I bear, but I saw what horrors wake in men and women when ashes and bloodshed are all that is left of their lives.

[soft voice] I led my people to Kalimdor because I wished to give our children a better world to grow into. I believe that world is still within reach: Woe betide anyone that would threaten it!

[urgent] I have sent envoys to treat peace with Alverold, to make him see sense. Return to Dar'nakk, and if Alverold refuses... it can only be victory or death.
quest_40675_quest_complete:
[solemn] I feel sorrow in having to be forced to violence a second time in so few years.

[soft voice] But I feel no shame in ordering the deaths of our enemies when our sovereignty is infringed. A war in the defense of our people is a just war.

[solemn] Take pride in your bravery, <name>! [warm] For I now name you Champion of the Horde and give you this mighty signet as recognition of your triumphs! [proud] Bear it with honor!
quest_40810_quest_progress: Greetings, <class>. [soft voice] What brings you to our Temple?
quest_40810_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, so our southern forests are finally free of the Horde? [warm] This is music to my ears.
quest_40811_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You claim how many Horde kills to your name? [emphasis] Very impressive indeed, <name>. [pause] There is one thing that concerns me, though, even during what should be a jubilant period. [solemn] This Brolthan Ironglade, the one coordinating the druids in the area, the report states he refused to help at all? [sad] Cowardice it claims in here, but I worry there is something far worse than cowardice involved here.

[low voice] You see, that druid is staunchly loyal to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. [hesitant] And we do not exactly see eye to eye. [commanding] He would not have acted this way without some assurance or support from Darnassus, I imagine. [angry] Which means he knowingly endangered Kaldorei lives in order to, what, prove a political point?

[urgent] Please, deliver this message to him. [solemn] Frankly I think it is better than he deserves, but I will leave his fate to Elune to decide., [warm] And <name>, do not forget to ask the commander for a reward afterwards!
quest_40997_quest_progress: [commanding] I speak for the Dark Lady.
quest_40997_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, behold, the Scepter in your grasp, delivered as expected.

<Varimathras gazes at you with his piercing, demonic eyes>

[low voice] Truly, the latent darkness contained within shall prove indispensable to our grand cause. While it may take time for our adept warlocks to fully harness its potential, the rewards shall be manifold.

[threatening] It amuses me greatly to witness the irony that the very forces that once shaped the foundation of Gilneas are now scorned and reviled by the feeble humans. It appears that wisdom has waned in their fledgling race over time.

[commanding] But enough about them. I have not forgotten your contributions. Our meticulous Apothecaries have prepared a reward for your endeavors. Choose from this assortment, and claim your well-deserved prize.
quest_41136_quest_detail:
[solemn] Yes, yes, Archmage Vandol was truly one of the greatest minds of the Kirin Tor. [soft voice] He was a dear friend of Medivh, if you can believe such a thing. [hesitant] Although, some might argue that Medivh had no true friends.

[low voice] Alas, I fear I cannot be of much assistance to you. [sad] After the devastation of Dalaran at the hands of Archimonde, Vandol suffered injuries that took a great toll on him. [pause] He spent many moons in recovery and eventually retired as one of the most accomplished mages of our time.

[solemn] I seem to recall him expressing a desire to settle in or around Theramore. [soft voice] If he still lives, I suggest asking for him in the city itself. [pause] One of our apprentices, Magus Halister, might know of his whereabouts.
quest_41195_quest_progress: [solemn] Another one of our kin finds a way into Alah'Thalas. [warm] Welcome.
quest_41195_quest_complete:
<Vereesa gracefully accepts the letter from your hand, her keen eyes perusing its contents with a measured intensity.> [solemn] Thank you, <class>, for your diligence in bringing this matter to my attention. [soft voice] The urgency of the situation is apparent, further corroborating my apprehensions. [emphasis] It appears that the once understandable discontent has evolved into blatant mutiny.

<She pauses, her demeanor reflecting a mix of concern and determination.>

[commanding] Not all within our midst remain loyal to our shared cause. [urgent] We must swiftly identify these agents still aligned with Kael'thas and promptly expel them from our city.
quest_41236_quest_detail:
I would spare you the intricacies of Quel'dorei politics. [solemn] Nevertheless, it is imperative that you are informed. Our once-united nation has fractured into smaller factions, engaged in a regrettable bickering over influence and power. [sad] Witnessing this discord within our own ranks pains my heart, but it is a tempest we must weather.

<She pauses, a sense of resignation in her eyes.>

However, amidst this turmoil, there are those loyal to the broader vision. [warm] They have rallied beneath the banner of the Silver Covenant, their camp positioned beyond the city to the west. [urgent] I implore you to venture there and seek out Commander Braedin, my esteemed right hand. [confident] He has been diligently investigating the matter, and your assistance will be met with gratitude.
quest_41238_quest_complete: <Vereesa's countenance pales as you explain the situation to her.> [soft voice] I... I didn't anticipate that it would be someone from the Regency Council, even in my darkest dreams. [sad] Who else is conspiring against us? [solemn] Voren'thal? Astalor? [solemn] This is profoundly grave news, <name>.
quest_41239_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the current situation in the Regency Council, my hands are bound. No one but Lor'themar would believe me, even with the letter in our possession. They would undoubtedly perceive my actions as an attempt to usurp the title.

[soft voice] However, all is not lost. If you can convince Rommath that you are, indeed, a delegation from Felstrider Retreat, he may inadvertently reveal more about his plans. The letter is exceedingly vague, and this approach may unveil additional details. Go, but exercise caution to avoid exposing your true identity. Rommath is unpredictable, and he could dispose of you in the blink of an eye.

[urgent] He is on the top of the tower.
quest_41251_quest_complete:
[solemn] Kael, alive and well in Outland, still concerned about our people? Are you absolutely certain?

<Vereesa's expression shifts as she delves into deep thought, her brows furrowing and her eyes gazing into the distance.>

[soft voice] There is much to weigh and consider in the wake of this information. The implications are far-reaching, and I must carefully deliberate on the best course of action for our people. [warm] Your delivery of this news has been invaluable, <name>, and I am profoundly grateful for the service you have rendered to both me and the entirety of Quel'dorei.
quest_41795_quest_detail:
[solemn] A terrible darkness emerged from our past, young one. [solemn] A darkness threatening not only the Horde, but all life on Azeroth. [low voice] Not long ago, we received a mysterious letter from an unknown sender, written in pitch black ink. [whispering] It warned us of a relic from the Second War, reborn to spread its seed of chaos throughout the world. [solemn] The Stormreaver Clan, Gul'dan's puppet clan, returned and joined forces with its old allies, the Shadow Council. [sad] Their warlocks have committed innumerable atrocities in the past, and if we do not stop them, I fear we may be facing a new age of terror. [urgent] I ordered one of my advisors and chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow Clan, Kilrogg Deadeye, to quell their uprising. [pause] He departed to the island of Balor, their former base of operation countless years ago.
