<name>, [commanding] I want you to follow suit and assist the Bleeding Hollow Clan. [urgent] Take the zeppelin to Grom'gol Base Camp and speak to the local Wind Rider Master. [soft voice] She can bring you to the island west of Stormwind.
quest_41820_quest_progress: [solemn] There is little time to spare. [urgent] Speak.
quest_41820_quest_complete: [solemn] O'jin is on the right path; he has done well to send you instead of coming himself. [solemn] A chieftain must know how to make the proper choice. [solemn] This is valuable information, and for your trouble, a reward is due. [warm] There may come a time when I will seek your aid in dealing with this issue. [solemn] I will return to my duties and soon speak with the Warchief. [urgent] Beware of the shadows, <name>, especially where they dance freely.
quest_41834_quest_complete:
[solemn] Though it is not bound to be the last time we see the embers of the Shadow Council, a great victory was won. [warm] While we wish nothing from the land of Balor, it has given me the greatest gift.

[low voice] Kilrogg was spiteful in the beginning, jealous of Grommash's celebration as a hero—while he himself seemed forgotten. [solemn] But he was wrong to envy Grommash. My older brother merely set the foundation. [confident] It is you, and I, and Kilrogg who will build our future. [proud] I am glad he sees it that way now.
quest_41841_quest_progress: [urgent] Speak quickly. I don’t intend to waste my time with vermin.
quest_41841_quest_complete:
[low voice] Look what the cat dragged in. [sad] I was assuming Wordeen had atleast a smidgeon of competency left in his body, but I was sorely mistaken, it seems. [solemn] To think one of my artifacts escaped those irritating mages and ended up in the clutches of the Shadow Council. [soft voice] Curious, indeed…

<name>, with the return of the pendant, I am closing the book on this unfortunate circumstance among my subordinates. [cold] The traitors have been dealt with, my relics are secured and you… [proud] You shall be rewarded for delivering a decisive strike against those misusing my possessions.
quest_41928_quest_progress:
[shouting] By the Light! What is that decrepit miasma coming from you? <class>, whatever you have on you, hand it over, quickly!

<The tablet is given to Tirion, who promptly casts a holy spell on the cobweb-ridden surface.>

[solemn] It is as I feared, the protective curse upon this tablet is too strong to be broken. We need to consecrate it with holy might. For that, sacred crosses from the fanatical Scarlet Crusade should be sufficient. These holy relics are not suitable for their sullied hands regardless. [urgent] <name>, deliver them to me as soon as possible!
quest_41928_quest_complete:
[urgent] The crosses, you have them! Their holy radiance can be felt even from here. [solemn] <class>, it is imperative for us to cleanse this tablet. [soft voice] You may not know it, but these are used by the vile Crypt Lords of the Scourge to command their Nerubian hordes under a tantalizing spell, enhancing their abilities. [urgent] It must be rid of this world, immediately. [commanding] Regardless, stay alert. [commanding] I am certain they will retaliate, as we are destroying one of their precious relics.

[urgent] Brace yourselves!
quest_41979_quest_complete: <Cairne takes the letter, gazing it over with a stern, an serious gaze.> [solemn] Longhorn was right to send you, [pause] this matter could bring dire consequence.
quest_41980_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Deathtotem, I am sure this is the first time you have heard of them. Their very existance is secretive, and shrouded in mystery. [soft voice] I desire you to speak with Rahauro. He is an adjutant to Magatha Grimtotem.

[commanding] You will find him at Elder Rise. Bring him my directive, and inform him you require all the possible information on the Deathtotem, and where it is that they operate.
quest_41981_quest_complete: <Cairne takes a moment to process the information, his hand rubbing against his jaw.> [solemn] Windhorn Canyon. [pause] I did hear about trouble there from the Windhorn Tribe who were expelled.
quest_41982_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would appear that evil once again knocks at our door, and has threatened the balance of peace between the tribes. [commanding] I must ask you to destroy this Deathtotem, and bring their evil to an end.

[solemn] The Windhorn Canyon is located within the Thousand Needles, and it is there you will find the leader of this cult. [urgent] Prophet Stormhide should be slain so that his schemes may be brought to an end. [commanding] Do this for the unity of the tribes, and on my behalf.

[solemn] Go with the strength of the spirits and bring glory to the Horde young one.
quest_41982_quest_progress: [solemn] Take heart, and be careful in your task. [soft voice] I am certain that the Deathtotem are aided by dark magic. [urgent] Bring what company you can, and be swift in your actions.
quest_41982_quest_complete: <Cairne gazes upon you with a look of approval.> [solemn] You have done well, and have brought peace to the Tauren. The Deathtotem shall trouble us no longer young blood. [warm] Please, be bestowed by an item that shall bring you fortune in the days to come.
quest_42071_quest_progress: [solemn] Come forth. [solemn] This elder will listen.
quest_42071_quest_complete: [solemn] You bring news from the Moonwhisper Coast and a favor from both the heir of the Moonhoof and mine? [pause] Sit, then, share this pipe with me and speak.
quest_42072_quest_detail:
[solemn] Riverhorn, the Grove of the Moon, An’she’s Respite lost. The elementals rose and wreaked havoc. Dragons, wildlife, naga, furbolgs, and draenei. Atop it all, members of the tribe who chose to leave and seek their own justice were ordered to be slain by the one meant to protect them, and by your hand no less.

[soft voice] Yes, the younger Moonhoof was right to send for aid. His stubborn father was always like this. He treasures the Sun more than anything and believes himself to be the closest tauren to it. Thus his indifference to the cries of his own people, of his own son.

[commanding] Return to the younger Moonhoof and tell him Thunder Bluff stands by his side. I would have sent Baine, but I would rather spare him the trouble and the danger. So you will have to do. Go, but take this. This totem represents my tribe, and while you hold it, you speak for us. Do not disappoint me, young one. Otherwise, trusting you would be a foolish plan.
quest_42091_quest_complete:
[loud voice] Lady Serpentia and Ta’jax are dead?

[solemn] Those names were spoken often during the war against Illidan. Their warbands left scars along this coast that have not yet faded. If they have truly fallen, then one of the last shadows from that time has finally been lifted.

[soft voice] Nendis has been silent for far too long. With the naga driven out, the ruins may finally be reclaimed. Not quickly. Wounds like these take time to heal. But in time… our people will return. Homes will be rebuilt. Temples restored. The forests will hear our voices again.

[solemn] Moonwhisper Coast was once a place where the kaldorei lived in peace beneath Elune’s light. Perhaps, slowly, it may become so again.

[warm] You have helped make that future possible, <class>. Know that the sentinels of Narvalis Point have my gratitude… and so do you.
quest_55039_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kingdom of Alterac fell to ruin after their betrayal of the Alliance. [solemn] I find it fitting that a nation of traitors soon after became a roving band of brigands, pilferers and cut-throats.

[soft voice] It is those who lay ruin to the lands and take which is not truly theirs in the first place.

[solemn] The Syndicate have stolen from Dalaran a tome of great importance that the Kirin Tor require back. [emphasis] It is the third part of the rock elemental compendiums.

[low voice] There are many building projects being done in and around Dalaran, and such a book is needed to keep our control over the Elementals around us.

[urgent] Syndicate Wizards have taken the book to the small town of Strahnbrad in the Alterac Mountains.

[commanding] Take back that which was taken from us, and dispense justice to the uncivil curs.
quest_55039_quest_progress: [solemn] The tome is of great importance, do act quickly master <race>.
quest_55039_quest_complete: [solemn] Dalaran thanks you greatly for your efforts, [warm] it is the effort of adventurers like you that not all seems lost in this new world.
quest_55040_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many a great tome, book, and archive has been lost during the third war from the libraries of Dalaran.

[soft voice] Our places of knowledge were destroyed and scattered across the world, and are now in the hands of rogue wizards and necromancers alike.

[solemn] One such book of power is located not too far from here, up the shoreline. The Vishas family had taken a book from our library before the third war for their son who was an upstart in magic.

[hesitant] I do believe they are now entangled within the depravity of the Scarlet Crusade in the ruins of Lordaeron.

[urgent] I have tried a few times to retrieve it, but things have only gotten violent. Do your best to reason with these people, and if reasoning cannot be achieved, retrieve it for us by other means.
quest_55040_quest_progress: [solemn] The book is of great importance to Dalaran and must be retrieved.
quest_55040_quest_complete: [solemn] The Library of Dalaran gets one step closer to what it once was, [warm] we thank you greatly for your efforts, hero.
quest_80390_quest_detail:
[urgent] A group of former Venture Co. Goblins have joined the Horde.

[soft voice] Some of them chose to settle in Dustwallow Marsh in a town they now call Mudsprocket, while not yet forgiven for their past sins, the boss wants me to send whoever is willing to get some coin to deliver this letter to whoever is in charge.

[hesitant] No idea how the Undermine is gonna take this and frankly not my business to think of, anyway, you will find them in South Dustwallow Marsh, careful not to mistake the place for the Dragon's lair instead though.

[commanding] Take care, kid.
quest_80409_quest_complete:
[solemn] The person you've been helping has been working to change history. Not only that, but the crystal you've been using is no simple invention, it is a time crystal, and it has been somehow corrupted and twisted!

[soft voice] I first took notice of this in when time was altered in the Barrens and I intended to observe, but now? I can't ignore this. [urgent] I'll be taking this corrupt time crystal and I will find that gnome and take her into custody.

[confident] I will do my best to investigate this entire affair and I may ask for your help later. [commanding] Do not work for her anymore or I'll have to punish you. Also I found this in a crate by the crystal, it was supposed to be your reward I guess. [warm] Normally I'd confiscate it, but I'll look the other way if you help me capture her the next time she shows up.
quest_80410_quest_progress: [urgent] There you are, <name>! [excited] You're late! Or early. Well, it doesn't matter, at least you came.
quest_80410_quest_complete: [soft voice] Remember back in Tanaris when I told you I'd call for you when the time came? [pause] Well, that time has come. [excited] I've found her!
quest_80411_quest_detail: [soft voice] I have been hunting her for a while now, but she is extremely elusive! [urgent] Every time we get close, she escapes. [solemn] However, she intends to contact you again. [urgent] This time we'll set a trap. [commanding] Go to Seradane, avoid the Emerald Portal and proceed to the largest temple. [urgent] You'll find another of her corrupted time crystals. [emphasis] Use it and summon her. [excited] Then I will appear and we will defeat her together!
quest_80411_quest_progress: [soft voice] There you are. I have been given much to ponder on.
quest_80411_quest_complete: [solemn] It seems that this mysterious dragon seeks to corrupt the timeways. I have my disagreements with Kheyna over her disruptive actions, but I've put them aside now because of this greater threat. It seems that this dragon she was hunting has caused a major disruption at a specific point in time. She also mentioned a master so there may be more of them. [confident] I hope I can count on you when the time comes. For now, we will do our best to keep things stable as we figure out how to move ahead from here. [soft voice] Kheyna will cooperate with us under strict supervision. Her fate will be decided after this is dealt with. [warm] We have prepared this replica sword as your reward.
quest_80604_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our enemy is no longer in this time, but I have reason to believe they are in the past. [whispering] I will tell you more but not here, you never know who might be listening.

[soft voice] Travel to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

[soft voice] I have given you authorization to enter since you are involved in this matter.

[urgent] Once you arrive talk to me again.
quest_80604_quest_progress: [soft voice] There you are... [pause] Try not to step into the time streams, and whatever you do never try to enter the hourglass.
quest_80604_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Do not mind the weirdness here too much, it's all timey wimey.

[hesitant] You'll get used to it... Maybe. Anyway. [warm] Thank you for coming and welcome to the Caverns of Time!

[solemn] This is where the Bronze Dragonflight lives, and it is also where the time ways to different periods in history are.

[soft voice] The corridors that you can see here are ever changing and shifting.

[emphasis] From one moment to the next a corridor before you can be replaced with another.

[solemn] Alas you can never truly experience the timeways with your limited perception of time.

[soft voice] But I digress, we have a job to do!
quest_80605_quest_detail:
[solemn] Roughly seventeen years ago, Medivh the last guardian under the control of Sargeras opened the Dark Portal, and let the Orcish Horde into this world. We have detected a temporal anomaly in the area consistent with the same energy that Kheyna and Antnormi had.

Kheyna is all but certain that Antnormi is behind this, [urgent] please enter the southern timeway and stop Antnormi before she damages history, I will oversee the situation from here. Before you doubt whether this is a bad thing, the Orcs were instrumental in defeating the Legion, I assure you, the outcome if they didn't arrive is catastrophic!
quest_80721_quest_detail:
Word has come to me of strange occurrences on the frontlines.

Some of our Queen's finest servants have gone missing. Too many, too swiftly and with conspicuous precision to be mere ill luck in warfare.

My Deathstalkers are preoccupied with far direr tasks, hence I would have you travel to Brill, the Sepulcher and Tarren Mill to collect the accounts of the local executors in their stead.

Return to me, and if I am pleased, I might just reward you.
quest_80721_quest_progress: [threatening voice] I will empty your veins if you dare dawdle before me for one more fruitless instant.
quest_80721_quest_complete:
[solemn] The fanatics of the Scarlet Crusade are behind this?

[low voice] Here I thought such cunning to be bereaved of their agitable little brains.
quest_80722_quest_detail:
[solemn] If we truly want to unravel the truth of this ploy, we will have to spur the Scarlets to play their cards into our hands.

For this purpose, I have pressed a Deathguard into your service. His name is Maverin, or Moverish — human names are a blight to my tongue.

[low voice] You will find him in the graveyard near the path to the Monastery in the north. Have him play the bait, he is not a valuable asset, then slay the Scarlets and seize whatever you can find of this curious new weapon in their arsenal.

[threatening] Do not disappoint me.
quest_80722_quest_progress:
[urgent] You return already.

[soft voice] How is Meverius? Not too tarnished, I hope?
quest_80722_quest_complete:
[low voice] I can smell the sweet stench of man-blood on you, <name>. [cold] Good, very good.

[commanding voice] As for Deathguard Mavonius there, the Undertakers and Apothecaries can tend to him, and I expect that to be the last of your concerns.
quest_80723_quest_detail:
[solemn] So this potion is the crux of the Scarlet schemes. Dull, crude and yet irritatingly potent.

[low voice] I myself do not dabble in the low craft of alchemy. Fortunately, our Queen's Royal Apothecaries favor the art of pondering alembics and grinding grass.

[urgent] Venture to the Apothecarium, find Apothecary Zwinker and show her what you have found. She is a creature of mine.

[commanding] Go, be quick and be discreet.
quest_80726_quest_progress:
[solemn] My loyal <race> returns.

[commanding] Go on, speak.
quest_80726_quest_complete:
[low voice] Bah, draughts, potions and stones. Could there be anything more tedious?

[soft voice] At least that so-called 'lich' made himself useful. As did you.

[commanding] You have pleased me once more.
quest_80727_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have prepared a report of our findings to be delivered to the Dark Lady.

[low voice] She will little like what she shall read, and it would be a shame if her wrath were to be your end.

[commanding] So kneel before her, appease her, serve her as loyally as you served me...but do not forget to whom you belong.
quest_80727_quest_complete: [low voice] Do you think me a fool, <name>? [threatening] Did you think I would be unaware of what occurs within my own realm, within my own throne room? <Sylvanas shreds the report with her hands.>
quest_80728_quest_detail:
[solemn] I know all of the draught that clouds the minds of my warriors, your collusion with my dreadlord and the deathguard you've squandered at his behest.

[threatening] But perhaps you have grown fond of Varimathras. Would you like to be one of his playthings? One word and I will make sure you are his. Forever.

[low voice] No? You yet value your soul? Pity.

[commanding] Then you will do as I say and go to Tyr's Hand, in the Eastern Plaguelands. Fetch a Scarlet uniform from those zealous fools and bring it to Gunther. He will know the rest.

[urgent] Go now, begone from my sight.
quest_149_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Oh please, don't look at me! [sad] I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

[sobbing] I'm hideous! Hideous! [urgent] Please, look away!!
quest_149_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is this? A comb? It's lovely! And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.

[hesitant] Oh, if only I had a mirror...
quest_154_quest_detail:
[shouting] NO!!!!!

 Take it, take this comb away from me!

[sad] I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
quest_175_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.
quest_177_quest_detail: [solemn] The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident. [sad] After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn. [whispering] There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there. [hesitant] Perhaps he picked it up. [soft voice] Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
quest_495_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mug'Thol and his ogre warband was sent to Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Lady Sylvanas. [sad] Unfortunately, instead of returning it, the idiot decided to try it on... I suppose ogres can't resist anything bright and shiny.

[low voice] His bumbling actions have become something of a problem, however. The Crown of Will enabled him to resist the possession placed upon him to serve Lady Sylvanas.

[urgent] The Dark Lady wants an example made, travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad and report to Melisara, my lieutenant.
quest_495_quest_complete:
[solemn] You were sent by Shalindra? Very well then, you'll find I don't waste much time with idle chatter.

[commanding] Mug'Thol is an irritant, and we will deal with him quickly, thoroughly, and without incident.
quest_518_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.

[soft voice] After softening them up, we'll proceed.

[commanding] Understood? Good. Now go.
quest_518_quest_progress: [solemn] I note that your task is unfinished, <name>. [cold] Shall I inform Sharlindra of your ineptitude?
quest_518_quest_complete: [solemn] The snow blooms red with the blood of the ogres, but we cannot cease our efforts until the spirit and numbers of the Crushridge have been crushed and ground into the dirt and snow.
quest_519_quest_detail:
Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. [solemn] They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.

[commanding] Bring me their heads, <name>, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
quest_519_quest_progress: [angry] I want their heads, <name>, not excuses.
quest_519_quest_complete:
...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.

[threatening] When you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. [cold] A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
quest_520_quest_detail:
[solemn] With Mug'Thol's lieutenants dead, all that remains is to kill Mug'Thol and retrieve the Crown of Will. [soft voice] I have no doubt he'll be reluctant to part with it. [hesitant] Most likely expecting you, too, given the... departure... of his fellows.

[urgent] Find Mug'Thol, and deliver his head and the Crown to me. [solemn] The Crushridge resistance will be at an end.
quest_520_quest_progress: [solemn] Three heads I have, a fourth I need. [threatening] It will be Mug'Thol's, or it will be yours, <name>. [low voice] That I promise.
quest_520_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done your duty well, <name>. [commanding] Mug'Thol's head shall adorn the highest peak of the ruins of Alterac, and the Deathguard will sweep the remnants of the Crushridge into the ground.
quest_521_quest_detail: [solemn] All that remains is to deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity. [soft voice] She will see that it is delivered to Lady Sylvanas. I would warn you against thinking to use it for your own purposes, <name>, [threatening] Mug'Thol's fate should be illustration enough.
quest_521_quest_progress: [low voice] Yes? [pause] Do you have something to report?
quest_521_quest_complete:
[solemn] So this is the relic the ogre used to duck the will of the Dark Lady...

[soft voice] Strange that something so simple could wield so great a power. And to fall into as clumsy hands as those. [warm] Well done, <name>, I will deliver the crown to Lady Sylvanas, and see that she hears of your accomplishment.
quest_5252_quest_detail:
The... the crystal...

[solemn] The highborne here are clouded by their own misssery...

[sad] I am sorrrrrowful, but I realize the errorrrr of what happened so long ago. Even though there is no waaaay to change the past, I am now at peacccce knowing that you have recovered the crystal of Zin-Malor...

[soft voice] Youuu must return it...

[low voice] It muuuussst be returrrned.
quest_5643_quest_detail: [solemn] Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. [soft voice] These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. [pause] I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. [urgent] You must return to the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar and speak to Ur'kyo. [solemn] What he teaches you might be very important for the future.
quest_5644_quest_complete: [solemn] I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, <name>. [soft voice] A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. [pause] Practice with it--there will be tests later.
quest_5646_quest_complete: [solemn] Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. [soft voice] We have great things to discuss, <name>. [commanding] Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.
quest_5658_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, young <class>, I am glad you have returned here. [soft voice] I would teach you a lesson you would do well to not forget. [commanding] Are you prepared?
quest_5660_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, good, another has arrived. [soft voice] Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. [solemn] There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. [commanding] You simply must prove your worth. [urgent] Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
quest_5661_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You be far from home out here in the Bloodhoof Village, <name>. [low voice] I be sent here to find priests of my own tribe to send back to speak to our leaders, but that not mean I cannot help you too.

I hear word that your head priestess spirit want all Forsaken to come to her--there are things you must learn.

[solemn] Go to meet Aelthalyste in the War Quarter in that city of yours.
quest_5661_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, good, another has arrived. [soft voice] Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. [pause] There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. [solemn] You simply must prove your worth. [commanding] Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
quest_5662_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, good, another has arrived. [pause] Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. [soft voice] There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. [commanding] You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
quest_5663_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, good, another has arrived. [pause] Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. [soft voice] There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. [commanding] You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
quest_5679_quest_complete: [solemn] I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, <name>. [soft voice] A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. [pause] Practice with it--there will be tests later.
quest_7028_quest_detail:
[solemn] The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, <class>. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.

If you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.

[urgent] Once I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. [whispering] These powers have been too long at rest...
quest_7028_quest_progress:
[angry] Don't ask questions!

[low voice] You have my request.
quest_7028_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.

<Willow mutters>

[whispering] ...So easy to convince.

[soft voice] ...Will do anything for the right price. [mocking tone] Heh heh heh...
quest_42058_quest_detail: [solemn] Your journey has been adventurous so far. [soft voice] A wonderful thing to behold. But now you need to return to Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] Artahla Starstrider wishes to see you, to further the teachings of the Celestial Siblings. [solemn] She awaits on the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.
quest_42060_quest_detail: [solemn] The wisdom of your travels can be seen clearly. [soft voice] I think it is time to speak with Artahla Starstrider once more and dive deeper into the lore of your people. [gentle] She will be able to teach you new spells to help you on your quest. [urgent] Meet her on the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.
quest_1367_quest_progress:
[commanding] Leave! The Magram do not speak with the weak. We kill them!

[threatening] If you want to speak with me, then show me you are strong. [urgent] Return after you slay many Gelkis.
quest_1367_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Gelkis cry when they hear your name, <name>. [angry] They fear you and they hate you. [shouting] They hate you like they hate the Magram!

[hesitant] Maybe you are strong like the Magram. We will see...
quest_1368_quest_progress:
[solemn] Your two feet step on Gelkis earth. [angry] You are not welcome here!

[commanding] Prove you seek friendship with the Gelkis. [urgent] Kill Magram centaur. [solemn] Return when the ground is wet with Magram blood.
quest_1368_quest_complete:
[solemn] The earth speaks to me. [soft voice] And it says you have killed many Magram. [warm] This is good.

[gentle] If you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. [warm] I have more tasks for you.
quest_1369_quest_detail:
[angry] The Gelkis think our centaur mother, Theradras, protects us. [commanding] They are stupid. [angry] No one protects the centaur. The Magram do not need protection! [proud] We are the strongest!

[commanding] Show the Gelkis they are stupid. Go to the cave in their village. [solemn] They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of Theradras. [urgent] Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
quest_1369_quest_progress: [commanding] If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
quest_1369_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the tears! Now the Gelkis will know that Theradras will not help them. [angry] She will not cry when we crush them! [commanding] The Magram will rule!

[warm] You are smart to help us, <name>. [proud] We are the strongest.
quest_1370_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones.

[soft voice] It is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. [commanding] If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.
quest_1370_quest_progress: [urgent] Return after you further prove your worth to the Gelkis!
quest_1370_quest_complete:
[commanding] Good. I can hear the loud Magram bellies grumble from their village, far away!

[solemn] I will give this meat to the Gelkis. And we will fight for many days without rest.

[warm] What you did is good for the Gelkis, <name>.
quest_1371_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, a little gnome came to Desolace. He had horses and a cart, and the cart held strange things. Funny things. Things that burned different colors. Things that moved and weren't alive. [angry] I killed the little gnome, but before that... he made me laugh.

I kept my favorite thing from his cart. It was a human made of wood and it waved at me until I hit it and broke it.

[commanding] I want a new one. Get me a new one!
quest_1371_quest_progress: [commanding] If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
quest_1371_quest_complete: [delight] Yes, this is what I had! [excited] I will make it move again. [laughing] It makes me laugh!
quest_1373_quest_detail:
[urgent] You have more to prove, and your next task will take you far, so for now the Gelkis will fight the Magram without you.

[solemn] The earth whispers many secrets to those who listen. One secret I hear is of a red crystal. It is called draenethyst, and it is new to our earth. It comes from a place where mountains fly, and where demons rule.

[excited] Bring me a shard of draenethyst, and it will make my magic strong! The shard is in a place called the Swamp of Sorrows, held by the lost one Ongeku.
quest_1373_quest_progress: [solemn] Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, <name>.
quest_1373_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, this is the shard of which the earth whispered. [soft voice] I can feel strong magic in it! [excited] I will use this magic against the enemies of the Gelkis.

[warm] You have done one more task for us, <name>. [pause] Maybe soon, we will call you friend.
quest_1374_quest_detail:
[solemn] The earth speaks to me, and it says that the Magram grow weak. [urgent] Now it is time to kill their Khan!

[commanding] Bring me the head of the Magram Khan, Jehn!
quest_1374_quest_progress: [solemn] Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, <name>.
quest_1374_quest_complete: [solemn] Khan Jehn was strong, but stupid. [mocking tone] He thought his own strength was great. [cold] He did not see that earth magic is stronger. [urgent] The Magram centaur will now fall without their leader, and the Gelkis will one day rule!
quest_1375_quest_detail: [urgent] You help the Magram, and I like you. [commanding] Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis! He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head! [mocking tone] I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!
quest_1375_quest_progress: [urgent] Do tasks for the Magram, and I will help you.
quest_1375_quest_complete: [angry] Khan Shaka is dead! [commanding] I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!
quest_1380_quest_detail:
<name>, you helped us against the Magram. Now, help us beat the Maraudine! [urgent] Kill the head of their clan, Khan Hratha!

To face him, blow the Maraudine War Horn. It is atop a high bluff in the Valley of Spears.

But to blow the horn, you must gain a warhorn mouthpiece. These are rare, carried only by trusted Maraudine centaur.

[solemn] After the horn is blown, centaur will come. [commanding] Kill them until Hratha appears.

Khan Hratha holds the piece of... a key. [soft voice] Bring it to me...
quest_1380_quest_progress: [solemn] Is Khan Hratha dead? [urgent] Do you have the key fragment?
quest_1380_quest_complete: [excited] He is dead! [proud] Khan Hratha is dead! [urgent] And now the Maraudine will fall! [solemn] When the Gelkis rule this land, <name>, we will remember you. [warm] And the spirits of the earth will sing your name for all time.
quest_1381_quest_detail:
[commanding] The Gelkis Khan is dead, and now the Maraudine will fall! [urgent] Kill the Maraudine Khan, Hratha!

To face him, blow the horn on the high bluff in the Valley of Spears. But to blow the horn, you need a mouthpiece. To get a mouthpiece, kill Maraudine centaur. Keep killing until you find a mouthpiece. Then blow the horn.

Do this and Maraudine centaur will come to the tower. Kill them until Khan Hratha appears. Hratha holds the piece of a key. [hesitant] Give this piece to me...
quest_1381_quest_progress: [commanding] Do what I ask. [urgent] Prove to me that you are an ally of the Magram!
quest_1381_quest_complete:
[excited] Khan Hratha is dead! Now the Magram are the strongest of the centaur! [commanding] We will crush the others, and rule Desolace!

[solemn] We will remember, you, <name>, and you will be spared our hooves when all others are trampled.
quest_1382_quest_progress: [angry] Be gone! The Gelkis do not want you here. Leave now!! [commanding] Return after killing many Magram, and then I will speak with you.
quest_1382_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your name is whispered among the Gelkis. [low voice] You have much Magram blood on your hands. [solemn] This is good.

[soft voice] Maybe it is also good if we speak. [soft voice] Speak of what you can do for the Gelkis, and what we can do for you.
quest_1384_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. [angry] They do not know magic! [mocking tone] They would not know magic if it bit them!

[commanding] You will show them their magic is weak. [urgent] Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. [emphasis] Take their charms. [warm] Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
quest_1384_quest_progress: [urgent] You have the charms? [soft voice] You showed the Kolkar they are weak?
quest_1384_quest_complete:
[solemn] You do a good thing for the Gelkis. [angry] The Kolkar are weak and will die. [cold] Their magic is pathetic and will not save them. [commanding] You showed them this, and their fear will make them even more feeble!

[low voice] And in our lands, the feeble soon die.
quest_1385_quest_progress: [commanding] You will go now, or the Magram will crush you! [angry] To be our friend, you must kill Gelkis.
quest_1385_quest_complete: [commanding] Many Gelkis fall to you. [mocking tone] I like that. [mocking tone] Maybe you can do more things I like. [mocking tone] Maybe you and the Magram can be friends.
quest_1386_quest_detail: [commanding] The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them! [laughing] We laugh and we kill them! [urgent] You kill them too. Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!
quest_1386_quest_progress: [commanding] Are you afraid of the Kolkar? [angry] Why do you not kill them? [mocking tone] Maybe you forgot how to kill. [urgent] Hurry and kill Kolkar before they are dead!
quest_1386_quest_complete: [commanding] The Kolkar fear you now! [warm] I hope you laughed when you killed them. [solemn] It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.
quest_7067_quest_detail:
[solemn] Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. [soft voice] But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.

[solemn] The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.

[urgent] If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. [pause] Read it over and consider my words.
quest_7067_quest_progress: [hesitant] What did you decide, <name>? [soft voice] Can you help me? [urgent] Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?
quest_7067_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is it, <race>! [solemn] This is it! [solemn] Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. [solemn] Thank you.

[gentle] Take this for your efforts, please. [solemn] I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.
quest_40176_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we first came to this island, we were greeted by hostility from all who were around us. We were seen as pirates still, and had yet to make a mark for ourselves. [soft voice] It was the Seer Jang'zo from the Razzari tribe who helped bring peace between us and them. [pause] For quite a while we kept a rather peaceful bond with one another. We traded and assisted with tasks of both a spiritual nature and physical.

[solemn] Though all seems to have fallen apart within the last weeks. [sad] The Razzari have began to show hostilities toward us, and have even gone so far as to attack. [urgent] There are rumors of them speaking with the Hazzuri trolls and being influenced by their dark magics.

[hesitant] I fear for Jang'zo and wish to assist him, as he did us. [solemn] I require materials from around the island to create a spell that could lift such a curse. [commanding] First, I need 6 Junglepaw Fangs from the local panthers, 3 Creeper Roots from the ruins creepers in the Ruins of Zul'Razu, and a single Jungle Venom Gland from the jungle serpents.
quest_40176_quest_progress: [solemn] These materials will be the only thing to help Jang'zo. [soft voice] If I am correct, the dark magic could be influencing the trolls of the Razzari and driving them further into madness.
quest_40176_quest_complete: <Eudokia looks toward the materials curiously.> [solemn] This should do, I will begin to prepare the spell now.
quest_40191_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time when we could roam freely around the island... a time when the Kalkor and the Razzari lived at peace and even cooperated. During those times, I would often venture up and down the Silver Strand to admire and explore the beauty of this island.

[soft voice] On my last trip to the beaches, I had found ships torn apart upon the sand and was shocked at the whispers of humanoid figures. It grasped upon my neck and pulled free the charm I had bound there, taking it from my body as I raced back here.

[sad] That charm is one of the only things I have left of the place we once came from, and I would ask you to get it back. You can find these wrecked ships to the north west, along the Silver Strand. My charm must still be held by one of the ghosts there.
quest_40191_quest_progress: [solemn] The Silver Strand can be a dangerous place now. Be careful when you go find my charm.
quest_40191_quest_complete: [solemn] This is my charm, but, [hesitant] something doesn't seem right about it, [soft voice] too much time within the hands of a ghost may have, [shocked] cursed it!
quest_40196_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been a long time since our people last saw the sands of Kalimdor. [soft voice] We left our tribe in pursuit of riches, and now, the man who led us here has betrayed us for his own prosperity. The riches we fought and worked so hard to gain were taken, and we were left to rot.

A centaur named Lykourgos is the one who orchestrated this betrayal with the Southseas Pirates. [hesitant] I had my suspicions about him, but I hadn't expected his honor to be so cheap. [angry] Everyone within this camp wants revenge, but we have no means to kill him. [sad] I hate to speak anything good of such a snake, but he is undoubtedly a ruthless murderer with great skill in arms.

[commanding] He is known as 'The Reaver' due to his brutality, and you should not underestimate him. [urgent] Find him, kill him, for all of us here and for his betrayal. [pause] I do not know where he is, but he is still a pirate through and through, so he should be found around fellow Southsea Freebooters.
quest_40196_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any success in finding Lykourgos?
quest_40196_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, you have gotten revenge for each and every one of us. [warm] I cannot thank you enough for smiting him down, if only the fates had been different, if only he acted with honor and kept his word, perhaps we would be back home.

[solemn] It is not something to dwell on, but we Kalkor will find our place in the world. [proud] You have earned esteem within our community, and restored our spirits, I wish you the best in your future.
quest_40363_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Do not be alarmed, I am an exile of the Galak that seeks refuge and mean you no harm. I accompanied my brethren here with the intent to raid, but upon seeing the tauren and their peaceful life free from the pains of our clan life - I began to yearn for their freedom.

[hesitant] If we weaken the Galak's attack on the tauren, perhaps I can earn their trust.
quest_40363_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done, <class>? [soft voice] As an exile, this is my only chance to find acceptance in amongst others.
quest_40363_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Your kindness surprises me, <class>. [solemn] With the Galak's raid crippled, the tauren will be free to continue their peaceful lives.

 There is still yet work to do if I am to earn their favor.
quest_40364_quest_detail: [solemn] As the immediate threat of the Galak has been addressed, perhaps you can seek out a member of the nearby village and speak on my behalf.
quest_40365_quest_progress: [solemn] You've returned and yet it seems as if there is more for us to work toward.
quest_40365_quest_complete:
[solemn] She had you retrieve the pelts of prairie wolves and did not tell you what I would need to do with them to earn their favor.

[soft voice] Although I am not the most gifted in the ways of magic, I believe I have just the idea to solve their trial.
quest_40366_quest_detail: [soft voice] Through a few simple enchantments, I have turned the pelts into blankets that will protect the tauren's young from the coming elements. [solemn] Please take this to Gennia as my offering to her village.
quest_40609_quest_detail:
Hah! Who is this puny <race>? You dare speak to Warug?

[angry] I spit on your words! You come back after you show strength and allegiance. [commanding] Kill Gelkis until you are soaked with their blood. [threatening] Only then will you speak to Warug.
quest_40609_quest_complete: [low voice] You are red. Is that Gelkis blood? [threatening] You smell of death. [commanding] Perhaps you can speak with Warug after all.
quest_40610_quest_detail:
[commanding] You want me to sing your name to the tribe? Then excite me. Fight against the scariest creatures of Mashan'she.

[urgent] Best fights are with multiple enemies! To the death! Seek the Bonepaw of the north. They hunt in packs. They rip apart their foes. They pull organs out of bellies and fight over your scraps when you fall. <She swishes her tail and paces with her hooves in excitement while thinking about it.>
quest_40610_quest_progress: [solemn] You are still alive, then you have not done as I asked.
quest_40610_quest_complete: [solemn] You have bested them, very good. [sad] But they were wasting away, weak. [urgent] You have more yet to fight.
quest_40611_quest_detail:
[excited] There is something else that excites me. [urgent] Fighting when the enemy is so much larger than you! [laughing] Hah! The satisfaction when they fall!

If you do as I ask, then seek the giant lizards to the north. You can see some from Magram Village even! [threatening] They will leave you a charred corpse trampled underfoot.
quest_40611_quest_complete: [excited] Scouts say they see you bringing down mighty lizards. [warm] I am impressed. [solemn] But there are bigger ones out there yet.
quest_40612_quest_detail: [solemn] You have done strong deeds already. [commanding] Continue to prove yourself to me, to us! [warm] When we talk your name at our campfires, I will tell you of the greatest challenges we set to mightiest Magram.
quest_40612_quest_complete: [confident] You have the heart of a Magram. [sad] It is a shame you were not born with four hooves, hah!
quest_40613_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time when we would do anything for power. Shamans, dark arts, rituals and sacrifices. But when we rejected the protections of Theradras, we also rejected many weak magics!

<She growls deeply.>

[commanding] We are Magram! We are strong! We do not need tricks, we do not need mothering! [shouting] We smash what we can smash and burn what we cannot. See the burning forests north! Puny elven lands are proof!

[threatening] We cast out those who would not drop dark arts. But they threaten us with risen dead thanks to our foolish mercy at not killing our own. Find our outcast sisters nearby. Show them no mercy, for we never should have to them.
quest_40613_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have done as I asked? [pause] Yes? [pause] No?
quest_40613_quest_complete: [soft voice] And did you laugh as you cut them down, <name>?
quest_40614_quest_detail:
<name>, it is good you are here this day. Come, sit, listen.

[solemn] When we returned from the northern mountain forests, we were glorious, high spirits, sharing stories of our kills! But many of us did not make it back to village. Something vengeful sought us out...

We named the beast Almaudrak. He is a bringer of death. He circles the dark skies still. [soft voice] Rarely do I tell anyone of Almaudrak. Many think he is legend. Whoever seeks him out is never seen again. But I know his lair. It is far to the north, near the path to the mountain forests, near ruined elven tower.

[commanding] If you wish to be a true name among us. Find and kill Almaudrak.
quest_40614_quest_complete: [soft voice] I cannot believe my eyes. [solemn] This is his heart. It is bigger than my head! [warm] You are always welcome now, in Magram Village. [excited] I will tell of your tales!
quest_40615_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is but one more thing in these lands I dare not tell of the tribes, <name>.

[angry] Magram would never claim to be scared of anything! We are strong! We are the rightful conquerors of Mashan'she! But... even we do not war with demons to the west. Foul magic, fire, death and decay.

<She tenses her hands into fists for a long moment.>

[soft voice] There is something I have seen there. Giant, green fire, pure anger and destruction. I do not believe anything could bring it down. [proud] I respect you already, <name>, and you are liked among us. [urgent] If you wish to become legend... find and kill Baelfyr.
quest_40615_quest_progress: [gentle] You do not need to do this, <name>.
quest_40616_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are a hero among our tribe. [commanding] When we crush our enemies underhoof, you will be at our side, yes?

<She lets out another loud war cry, and for a moment, something approaching a smile appears on her savage face.>

[urgent] Go! Speak to true Khan! He has heard of your victories. [warm] It is time to join us, <name>.
quest_40616_quest_complete: [commanding] From now, you are <name> the Fearless! [proud] Walk among us with pride. [warm] We share with you, now.
quest_40617_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Maraudine are the strongest in the region, and could pose a more significant threat if their leadership ever had the desire to spread influence.

[angry] They hold our most sacred site, Maraudon as home, for this alone, they should be wiped off the map.

[urgent] If you truly wish to become an ally of the Magram, then you will need to prove yourself. Gather ten Maraudine Bracers, and bring them to me as proof of your loyalty.
quest_40617_quest_progress: [commanding] Ride into battle with swiftness, it is the only way to victory.
quest_40617_quest_complete:
[confident] You have checked their arrogance, and weakened their position, this is good.

[solemn] I will spread word of your accomplishments outsider.
quest_40618_quest_detail:
[solemn] Desolace is filled with the weak, those that should be culled so the strong can rise to dominate. [commanding] I speak of the lesser tribes that hide in our mighty shadow, those that tremble in fear of our wrath.

[urgent] The lesser tribes of the Gelkis and Kolkar need to be raided, and reminded of their place, and you will enact our fury.

[commanding] Travel to the Kolkar Village to the north, cut down their battle lords. To the west, head to Gelkis Village, slaughter their stampers, earthcallers, and windchasers.

[threatening] Make sure they learn their place in the natural order.
quest_40618_quest_progress: [commanding] Unleash our dominance upon the lands, [angry] trample them to dust!
quest_40618_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is only a matter of time until the Magram rise to their destiny.

[warm] Your actions are worthy of praise, and I will let the others know of your deeds.
quest_40619_quest_progress:
[solemn] If we've learned anything in our campaign of war, it is that food is more important even than the deadliest of weapons. [pause] Without energy, one cannot fight. In such a desolate landscape with such scarcity, we are far from achieving our true ambitions. [soft voice] I ask that you remedy this situation.

[commanding] All across Desolace you will find the mighty kodo, full of thick, heavy, abundant meat. [warm] It would make for the perfect meal for any warrior. [urgent] Ride out and collect this Heavy Kodo Meat for the Magram clan. [threatening] Do not disappoint me.
quest_40619_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Did you have trouble downing such a large beast?

<Warcaller Dekshar smirks at you.>

[solemn] This food will fill the stomachs of our warriors, and they shall regard you with newfound respect for your contributions to our efforts.
quest_40620_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are not Gelkis. You are not even centaur at all. Leave now!

[low voice] We have no reason to speak. Little will prove your friendship or worth to me. Except perhaps the conquering of the Magram, hah!

[commanding] I am wise enough to know you would never wage war on our behalf, and you are not even strong enough to do so anyway.
quest_40620_quest_progress: [angry] Did I not tell you to leave?
quest_40621_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Perhaps there is more to you than meets the eye, <race>. You have shown yourself willing to be an enemy of the Magram, but that does not make you a friend of the Gelkis.

[solemn] But, you may be in time. That is not for me to decide. In the tents nearby, seek out the oldest among us. He has even more stories to his name than I do. His name is Yesu'gei.
quest_40621_quest_complete: [solemn] You are the one the scouts spoke of, hmm? [commanding] The one who slaughtered Magram?
quest_40622_quest_detail:
[solemn] You may think that a death is simply a death, <race>. But that would be a foolish thought, a foolish thought indeed. [solemn] To die in glorious combat, received back into the earth, this is a good death.

[soft voice] Hmm, I remember friends, good Gelkis, falling down as they trotted, poisoned by stings from Scorpashi. [sad] I have seen those laid to rest, picked apart by giant carrion birds. [angry] This is disgraceful, and I will not have it happen to any more of my tribe.

[commanding] Prove yourself useful. Go out and kill as many of these creatures to the north as you can find.
quest_40622_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you avenged those disrespected Gelkis?
quest_40622_quest_complete: [solemn] This brings me some solace, <race>, and I am sure the fallen would cheer if they could.
quest_40623_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is a mistake to ignore nature. [soft voice] We, Gelkis, can learn a lot from a troubling breeze, a red sky, a lightning air.

[pause] Hmm. [sad] Recently the land has been scoured, even the rocks themselves, by roving air elementals. [angry] I cannot tell why they are so agitated! [urgent] Ignoring their presence is a danger to us, and also ignoring omens of things to come.

[commanding] Disperse any that you see, <race>, and bring me their cores. [solemn] We may give these to our shamans, and we may learn from them. [proud] We will bolster our magic directly with the elements!
quest_40623_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you bring good news?
quest_40623_quest_complete: [soft voice] These are far lighter than I imagined, hmm.
quest_40624_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done well so far, but there are bigger predators yet that must be felled. To the north there are the remains of mighty kodo. Majestic creatures, and in death they nourish the earth with their bodies. [soft voice] However, they have made the carrion birds greedy, and they attack weakened centaur too.

[commanding] Go. Kill the venomous creatures you find, and any carrion birds that may threaten Gelkis Village. [proud] You will earn my respect if you do this.
quest_40624_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you brought some protection to the village yet?
quest_40624_quest_complete: [soft voice] I am beginning to like you, hmm.
quest_40625_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hmm. One day, you may walk among us as an esteemed visitor, <race>. You should be thankful some of our kind already respect you.

[solemn] When we think you have helped us enough to be truly accepted, I will have further words with you. There are some matters that I cannot entrust with many in the tribe, let alone an outsider. <He continues rambling quietly to himself for some time after his business with you is finished.>
quest_40625_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is your name, <race>? <name>? [pause] Very well... [pause] You have earned our trust enough.

[solemn] Listen to what I have to say next...
quest_40626_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our mother, Theradras, provides and protects even in this harsh land, <name>. [soft voice] Perhaps you do not fully understand it. But know one thing: she cannot abide those who desecrate the dead.

The Gelkis would never stoop to such dark magic as to manipulate the dead for strength and personal benefit. The thought alone is enough to make my hooves itch.

<He shakes himself and a few grey hairs fall to the ground.>

Hmm, I do not know which of the tribes have been practicing necromancy, but recently there have been sightings of centaur doing just that to the East. [urgent] Do not bother trying to converse... simply remove their wretched lives from their bodies. And make it slow, if you can, a merciful death is too good for those who deny souls their proper rest.
quest_40626_quest_complete: [solemn] Do not feel any remorse, this goes far beyond a petty tribal war. [soft voice] I imagine any sane centaur would have wanted them dead.
quest_40627_quest_detail:
I do not believe in coincidences, I do not. [solemn] Hmm... [emphasis] I firmly believe in our desecration of the Northern vales, the centaur provoked a being of vengeance to menace us. Do you know of what I speak? [hesitant] Hopefully not, if you had seen or heard him, you would likely not be alive.

I hardly expect you to do this, <name>, but if you are equally brave and foolish, then seek Almaudrak to the north, just before the path opens to the fiery woodland vale. [commanding] The winged horror stalks the road and makes nest in the western mountains.

You will truly be an honored name amongst the Gelkis if you can bring me his heart.
quest_40627_quest_progress: [soft voice] I do not blame you for not wanting to seek him out.
quest_40627_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, you are a special sort, <name>. [warm] This heart will make a fantastic feast, and all will know you were the one to provide the Gelkis their strength this night!
quest_40628_quest_detail:
I have kept one bit of information from all the tribe, save the Khan himself, <name>. Even Uthek, for all her wisdom, I do not trust to not act rashly upon this.

[solemn] While we do not fish much, the seas provide life and nourishment to surrounding creatures... which we may in turn eat. We rely on her as much as the land, this suffering land, despite what others may think. Which is what it pains me to say, something has angered the elements of the deeps too. I can feel it, <name>.

[urgent] I sense, far to the north, where the mountains overlook the sea. There is something roiling, raging, ready to enact vengeance for the suffering land, or perhaps some transgressions I am not aware of. This is something we cannot ignore, and it will panic the Gelkis if it becomes common knowledge! Our village is not miles from the sea after all. We are not great swimmers.

[commanding] Find a way to quell this being, and I promise, you will become an honored visitor in this village. Perhaps more.
quest_40628_quest_progress: [hesitant] Dare I ask if you have news?
quest_40628_quest_complete: [shouting] That! That is a core! [urgent] Is it over? [soft voice] Yes... I can feel peace dawning once more...
quest_40629_quest_detail:
[solemn] I may be respected for my age, <name>, but I cannot offer the proper thanks you deserve. Khan Shaka, our leader, wishes to meet with you directly now. He never meets with outsiders so this must be important.

[soft voice] He is communing with the earthen spirits within the cave at the centre of our village. Do not delay. And, <name>? [warm] I am glad you came and listened to this old centaur. <He retires to his tent with a loud sigh, old bones creaking the entire way.>
quest_40629_quest_progress: [hesitant] I am unsure how to speak to outsider.
quest_40629_quest_complete: [solemn] You are Gelkis now. <name> the Earthstrider! [excited] Yes! [proud] You feel strong, can feel the earth spirits whisper your name? [hesitant] Yes? [hesitant] No? [solemn] In time.
quest_40630_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time when the Maraudine were picked from the most loyal of the tribes, gathered to honor and protect our ancestors at a place of great worship.

[low voice] Such times are gone, lost to the drifting winds, spat upon, and dishonored.

[angry] The Maraudine are now just a glorified tribe who have claimed the Valley of Spears as their own, they do not respect Maraudon as a holy place as it once was. We are not allowed to visit the tombs of ancestors, or pay respect to the fallen.

[commanding] They are our enemy, and they must be destroyed. Travel to the Valley of Spears to the north, and slay them, bring me 10 of their bracers as proof.
quest_40630_quest_complete:
[solemn] To think, there was a time that being Maraudine was an honor, something to strive for.

[angry] These bracers once meant the world, and now, they only anger me. [warm] I thank you for the work, [proud] I will spread word of your valiant deeds.
quest_40631_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Gelkis are unlike many of the other tribes in that our connection with the elements is powerful and deeply entrenched in our culture. It is a connection we value above all else in this world. Yet our irreverence and brutish abuse of this gift in the past has strained our relationship with the spirits.

[commanding] If we are to make a future for our clan and repair the damage we have caused to our spiritual strength, we must commune with the elements and plead our case and offer deference to them. To this end, we will need a great deal of elemental energy.

[urgent] All around this region are swirling vortexes of wind and air. From them, I would have you gather 12 Elemental Air.
quest_40631_quest_progress:
[solemn] We Gelkis are unlike many of the other tribes in that our connection with the elements is powerful and deeply entrenched in our culture. It is a connection we value above all else in this world. Yet our irreverenc and ebrutish abuse of this gift in the past has strained our relationship with the spirits.

[solemn] If we are to make a future for our clan and repair the damage we have caused to our spiritual strength, we must commune with the elements and plead our case and offer deference to them. To this end, we will need a great deal of elemental energy.

[commanding] All around this region are swirling vortexes of wind and air. From them, I would have you gather 12 Elemental Air.
quest_40631_quest_complete:
[solemn] I see you have returned from chasing the storms, at last. Did the spirits prove to be as torrid and unforgiving as the rest of this land?

[proud] You have done us a great service, <name>, I will make sure that these materials go to good use.
quest_40632_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been since the Magram and Gelkis fought, warred for territory. We have been on the defensive for far too long, fighting back raiding parties that thrusted into our lands, and killed our kin.

[commanding] It is about time we did our best to fight them back, and cull their ranks to end this bloodthirsty aggression.

[solemn] I would have you fight on our behalf, to rid us of our enemies so that we may find a higher calling.

[urgent] Magram Village is located to the east, travel there, and slay them.
quest_40632_quest_progress: [solemn] Has the dust settled? [urgent] Have our foes been weakened?
quest_40632_quest_complete:
[solemn] We may yet survive this conflict, and we may yet remove our mortal enemy from this world.

[commanding] Your efforts have not gone without notice <name>.
quest_40633_quest_detail: [commanding] You start to impress me, <race>. [urgent] If you want name to be more known amongst the tribe, walk into our village. [solemn] Find Jochi, smartest and most beautiful Magram! [soft voice] She will task you.
quest_40633_quest_complete: <name>, very well... [solemn] I hear you are stained with the blood of Gelkis. [commanding] Perhaps I have use of you.
quest_2521_quest_detail:
<race>, can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst? [solemn] Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

[low voice] So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, <race>... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
quest_2521_quest_progress: [solemn] I have dedicated my life to the search of flawless draenethyst spheres. [emphasis] A lifetime, <race>!
quest_2521_quest_complete:
[excited] Do my eyes deceive me? [shouting] Impossible! [surprised] Where did you... [hesitant] How...

[solemn] Perhaps now a rift can be opened, [pause] returning us to our homeland.
quest_2522_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even though the portal conjuration was a failure, I remain hopeful that my next attempt will be successful.

[soft voice] The hope of the Draenei is as fervent as your greed for trinkets, <race>. [urgent] Go back out into these cursed lands and recover another flawless draenethyst sphere.

[gentle] Of course, the choice to take on this task is completely left to you *grin*.
quest_2522_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found another flawless draenethyst sphere?
quest_2522_quest_complete:
[delight] Simply amazing. I had doubted that you could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands.

[soft voice] Well done, <name>!

[solemn] Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.
quest_3501_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although you may never find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, you will undoubtedly uncover various imperfect fragments of the draenethyst in your exploration of these lands.

[soft voice] While it is doubtful that Kum'isha will be able to use the flawed fragments to return home, the pieces may serve other, useful purposes for the draenei.

[urgent] Return any piece of flawed draenethyst fragments that you may find and I shall reward you.
quest_3501_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck in your exploration?
quest_3501_quest_complete: [threatening] You truly disgust me, <race>. [angry] A grown man drooling over a pile of junk? [threatening] Pitiful! [commanding] Take your reward and get out of my sight.
quest_3502_quest_detail:
[solemn] Well, after that display of voracious greed, I feel nauseous.

Regardless, I shall not dwell too long on your material addiction.

For each imperfect draenethyst fragment you turn in, I shall reward you with more junk. My junk heap gets smaller while your junk heap gets larger. On Draenor we call this a 'win-win' situation.
quest_3502_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Well? Draenethyst? Remember?

<Kum'isha clenches his fist and knocks on your head.>

[hesitant] Is anybody home?
quest_3502_quest_complete:
[threatening] You truly disgust me, <race>. [angry] A grown $gman:woman drooling over a pile of junk? [shouting] Pitiful! [commanding] Take your reward and get out of my sight.

[low voice] Sounds familiar? It should, because I say it a thousand times per day.

[sad] Oh how I loathe this world.
quest_41296_quest_detail:
[solemn] My people have been divided. [soft voice] We've endured much on the escape from our home, in search of security and a place to survive. [pause] While my brethren in the Harborage remained resilient and clung to hope, I cannot say the same about the lost ones. [sad] Their madness has taken a deep hold in their minds, and its roots cannot be cut anymore. [low voice] In a fruitless endeveour to return to the hellscape that is Draenor, they gather the Draenethyst crystals, potent gems from said world, without knowing they won't be able to utilize them properly. [solemn] This was, however, not always the case.

[solemn] Among them was a powerful rift walker, under the name of Kum'isha, who parted ways with the maddened draenei of Fallow Sanctuary. [hesitant] He now roams the hostile plains of the lands to the south, in search of myths and legends. [urgent] What I seek is his knowledge about our sacred crystals - but should you be able to convince him to join us; please, do not hesitate.
quest_41296_quest_complete: You reek, <race>, horribly. [threatening] I can smell the despicable stench of naivety and senseless hope on you. [low voice] Let me take a guess, Sanv K'la and his wretched followers sent you to pry knowledge from my great mind. [cold] If that is the case, then I cannot wait to see the disappointment in your face.
quest_41297_quest_detail:
[solemn] I left the lost ones behind, their leaders have become bumbling fools drooling over the sacred Draenethyst, forgetting their true potential. [threatening] Sanv K'la is no different, hope poisoned him and his acolytes' heart, neglecting the fact he is trapped in a world of avarice. That goes for you too. For what other reason are you standing before me, Kum'isha the Collector, if not to tear from me what you desire? But I know you and your kind, and your greed is what will further my ambitions.

[angry] Roaming these cursed lands are mindless draenei, wielders of rift walking magic without the means to do so. In their endless search for Draenethyst, they have lost their mind, scouring the sand like the vermin that they are. Rabid beasts, all of them! They have raided my camp, stealing a valuable cache of crystals. [commanding] Slaughter them, retrieve my belongings and I may reward your usefulness.
quest_41297_quest_progress: [angry] Have your abilities forsaken you? [threatening] Useless dreg, I shouldn't have wasted my time with you.
quest_41297_quest_complete: [solemn] Damaged, as to be expected. [sad] Savage brute. [soft voice] Atleast its contents are intact. [warm] You can consider yourself fortunate, then. [hesitant] Still, this scroll... could it be...? [threatening] Filthy one, your greed has been of great service to me, but your price is not yet ready to be claimed.
quest_41298_quest_detail:
<Kum'isha is studying the foreign scroll, his shifting body fading in and out of view. After finishing reading, he furiously rips the parchment into bits.> Karak-tokal! [angry] What are they thinking? [solemn] This is heresy to all draenei, heresy! [sad] Them roaming these lands of death like drones was concerning, albeit not dangerous. [urgent] What they are aiming for, however, is very much so. [solemn] According to this scripture, the seekers you've encountered are gathering Draenethyst for a vile creature, a rift walker named Mato'gar. [threatening] That alone is an affront to my ambitions, his true goal however is revolting and must be stopped. [urgent] Should he be able to take the crystals with him to Draenor, the only way for us to return will be gone - condemning us to rot and decay, jailed to never see our home ever again.

[commanding] You will not let that happen, for Kum'isha will bestow upon you what you wish; in exchange for his head. [urgent] He awaits his seekers to the northwest of my camp.
quest_41298_quest_progress: [solemn] To relocate the Draenethyst crystals to Draenor would mean the death for all draenei stranded in his forlorn and sickening world. [urgent] Kum'isha cannot let this happen.
quest_41298_quest_complete: <The broken draenei grabs the decapitated head with unexpected force. Spitting on the bloodied skin of Mato'gar's head, he throws it unto the ground before stomping it violently into the red sand.> Pathetic wretch, ambassador of ruin and desolation. May your ancestors tear your soul to shreds, for betraying your people, your kin! Taking away our - taking away MY means of escape - it sickens me to my core.
quest_41299_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here, take this scroll. On it you and the naive Sanv K'la will find my knowledge of Draenethyst and its uses. May he do whatever he intends to do with it, as long as it does not interfere with my plans. It is in his best interest to heed my warning, lest he ends like Mato'gar.

[commanding] To you, I say the following: unless you wish to aid me further, I do not want to lay my eyes upon you again. Begone if it is so.
quest_41299_quest_progress: [solemn] You are back, from the accursed wastes; and alone. [soft voice] Please tell me what happened.
quest_41299_quest_complete:
[solemn] Tragic and harrowing to hear. Both the intervention of draenei from our homeworld, and Kum'isha's desperate desire to return to said place. [soft voice] I have led my people to this place in search of a haven, a sanctuary they can someday call home again. [warm] With the wisdom on this scroll and the magic of the Draenethyst, we may achieve this - together.

[solemn] Be rest assured, your deeds for my people will not be forgotten. [warm] Let me share insight on these scriptures, as you cannot read its pages yourself.
quest_5160_quest_detail:
[solemn] Travel to Kalimdor, <race>. [soft voice] Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of Winterspring. Once you reach Winterspring, find the caves of Mazthoril.

[solemn] Upon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. [soft voice] Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.

[solemn] Give her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
quest_6570_quest_complete: [angry] Have we run so low on able soldiers that Nefarian is sending me whelps? [threatening] You will never pass my tests, broodling.
quest_6582_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are Deathwing's children, whelp. [commanding] Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.

[commanding] If you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.

[urgent] Find their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!

[urgent] Travel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. [threatening] Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. [threatening] Tear out his skull and return it to me.
quest_6583_quest_detail:
[solemn] Just as our Father crushes the Aspects themselves, so too must we strive to bring chaos and destruction to their children.

[commanding] You must test your battle prowess against the sleepless dreamers: The children of the Green Flight.

[urgent] Travel to the Swamp of Sorrows and track down Somnus, drake champion of the Green Flight. [threatening] Let flow your hatred; dominate the insect... [emphasis] Return to me with his skull...
quest_6583_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not return here until you have bathed in the blood of our enemies and drank in their suffering.
quest_6584_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...

[soft voice] It is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.

[commanding] Ssstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
quest_6584_quest_progress: [low voice] Ironically, whelp, time is of the essencccce.
quest_6585_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was over the mountains of Grim Batol that our Father raged against the combined might of the Aspects. The cowardly act of the betrayer, Alexstrasza, bought the other Aspects enough time to escape from Father's wrath.

[sad] Sssuch a shameful act...

[commanding] The Red Flight now guards Grim Batol, their lieutenant, Axtroz, must be destroyed. Return the skull of Axtroz to me. For Father, whelp!
quest_6585_quest_progress: Changesss... [solemn] I sense them taking place in you, whelp. [commanding] Pass this test and only ceremony remains.
quest_6585_quest_complete:
[solemn] I had doubted your dedication, whelp. [soft voice] You persisted, dominating our enemies, bringing honor to our flight.

[solemn] I must now prepare the skulls for your ascension.
quest_6601_quest_detail:
[solemn] From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. [soft voice] You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.

[commanding] Take it, whelp. [urgent] Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.

[solemn] You will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.

[shouting] Go!
quest_8303_quest_complete: [solemn] You are the hope of Kalimdor, <name>.
quest_8305_quest_detail: [solemn] In the southern desert of Silithus, near the sacred barrier, exists a single crystalline tear. [soft voice] This tear serves as a symbol of the great losses beset upon us during the War of the Shifting Sands. [pause] Locate this tear and gaze into its depths to gain enlightenment.
quest_8305_quest_complete: [solemn] You can feel a great sorrow revolving around this crystal. [soft voice] The force is so powerful that you feel as if you might collapse and die of sadness.
quest_8519_quest_detail: [solemn] As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. [soft voice] Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
quest_8519_quest_complete: [solemn] After Staghelm's betrayal, I gathered the shattered pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and returned here. [pause] I had every intention of protecting the scepter from those that would seek to use it to cause harm to our world - [emphasis] thus was born the charge of the Dragonflights.
quest_8555_quest_complete:
[solemn] Eranikus, Vaelastrasz, and Azuregos... No doubt you know of these dragons, mortal. [soft voice] It is no coincidence, then, that they have played such influential roles as watchers of our world.

[low voice] Unfortunately (and my own naivety is partially to blame) whether by agents of the Old Gods or betrayal by those that would call them friend, each guardian has fallen to tragedy. [pause] The extent of which has fueled my own distrust towards your kind.

[urgent] Seek them out... And <race>, prepare yourself for the worst.
quest_8729_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] I will be able to reform the Scepter of the Shifting Sands soon.
quest_8730_quest_detail:
Champion, is it you? [solemn] A thousand years it has been since I was entrusted the shard and it is at my darkest hour that one should rise to relieve me of it... [sad] But what would tragedy be without cruelty?

<Vaelastrasz coughs weakly.>

[whispering] Ne... Nefarius now holds the scepter shard.

[urgent] Time is of the essence. [urgent] Nefarius plans to destroy the shard. [urgent] You must hurry!
quest_8730_quest_progress: [solemn] Another of our heroes lost to the spawn of Deathwing. [sad] We will be cursed with this suffering forever...
quest_8730_quest_complete:
[solemn] Vaelastrasz's soul is at ease, champion. [solemn] The Aspects all watch your progress with great interest. [solemn] Know that you have powerful allies.

[solemn] I was commanded to grant you something to aid you in this struggle. [solemn] Use it well...
quest_8742_quest_progress:
[solemn] A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. [solemn] One who shall lead their people to a new age.

[threatening] The Old God trembles, <name>. [whispering] Oh yes, it fears your faith. [commanding] Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.

[solemn] It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. [warm] You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
quest_8742_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, <name>.

[solemn] It must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people.

[solemn] You must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong.
quest_8748_quest_progress: [solemn] Your continued defense of the children of Kalimdor has been acknowledged. [soft voice] Hand me your signet ring so that I may enhance its powers. [pause] Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight
quest_8749_quest_progress:
[solemn] You honor my kind, <name>. [commanding] Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! [urgent] Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight.

[solemn] You have earned another enhancement. [gentle] Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power. Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight
quest_8750_quest_progress:
