[solemn] Dedication of this magnitude is a rarity. [solemn] You have shown that your will is unfaltering, <name>. [solemn] You shall be greatly rewarded for your stalwart watch over our world.

[commanding] Hand me your signet ring so that I may strengthen its enchantment. [emphasis] Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight
quest_8751_quest_detail:

quest_8802_quest_complete: [solemn] The Master has left these for you, champion. [warm] From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
quest_9250_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. [soft voice] There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.

[urgent] Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
quest_9250_quest_complete:
[solemn] The archmages have died.

[soft voice] Do not mourn their passing, <name>. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...
quest_9251_quest_detail:
[solemn] You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, <name>. [soft voice] I only do as I must.

Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... [threatening] He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.

[solemn] As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. [pause] He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.

[commanding] Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
quest_9251_quest_progress: [solemn] In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.
quest_9251_quest_complete: [solemn] There is a being within... [whispering] a being not of this world.
quest_9257_quest_detail:
[solemn] This final task will be the most difficult of all, <name>. [solemn] You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

[urgent] Take the staff to Stratholme. [soft voice] It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. [emphasis] Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... [urgent] Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
quest_9257_quest_complete: [solemn] The magnitude of this accomplishment must not be understated, <name>. [warm] You have done what most would have thought to be impossible. [pause] Alas, it was fated. [solemn] The staff has made its choice.

quest_40648_quest_detail:
<The small whelpling flutters his wings and tries to escape as you approach.> [angry] No! No hurt!

<It pauses and looks up with wide eyes.>

[urgent] No ogre. No dark dwarf. You good? You help? Yes? Please! Up ramp. Family, brood family. Mind control! Tyrant. Cave. Teleport, crystal, cave! Jewel control. Jewel mind control, jewel mind control!

<It hops up and down in a panic.>

[commanding] Kill! Get jewel! [proud] Asza reward. [proud] Asza reward!
quest_40648_quest_complete: <The whelpling flaps its wings excitedly and bounces around.> [urgent] Hero! Hero <class>! [surprised] You not kill many brood family? [sad] No? [sad] Only tyrant?
quest_40870_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there! Yes you, mortal! [commanding] I am in need of assistance. My friend has begun falling ill from the madness of the emerald dream and I require a cure before he is lost forever.

[solemn] I have heard from the Wardens of Nordrassil of a herb called Hyjalroot that can only be found around this region: it is somewhat scarce, but I require eight bundles of it in order to ease the pain of Paranus. [urgent] I bid you to be quick and act with haste, or else I will lose my friend forever. <The whelp lets out a sad mewl of distress.>
quest_40870_quest_progress: [solemn] Paranus has a strong will, but it is only a matter of time before his strength is eroded.
quest_40870_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done it. With this Hyjalroot I will be able to bring Paranus back from the edge, and guide him away from the dream. [soft voice] I must thank you <class>. Without you, I would have been lost in grief.

[warm] Take this Small Dream Shard, as thanks for everything you've done.
quest_40871_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am eternally thankful for your efforts in saving Paranus, but I have been thinking. [pause] When this conflict is all over and the Emerald Dream is restored, there will be many that require Hyjalroot in order to be brought back into the fold.

[soft voice] I believe it is time to begin stockpiling Hyjalroot now in order to save those affected. [urgent] If you so happen to collect eight Hyjalroot, return to me, and I will bestow upon you a Small Dream Shard for your efforts.
quest_40871_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you returned with the Hyjalroot?
quest_40871_quest_complete: [excited] More for my stockpile! [warm] Thank you again for your efforts <class>. [warm] Please, once again, take this Small Dream Shard as a token of my thanks.
quest_41090_quest_detail:
[solemn] The foul demons are mustering their strength, performing obscene rituals for some dark purpose I shudder to imagine. I am certain these Succubi are receiving some form of direction from their commanders, so it stands to reason that documented orders must be among them.

[urgent] It is imperative that we acquire whatever plans we can find, and so I rely upon you, <name>. [commanding] Slay those vile temptresses until you find their orders, then return them to me promptly!
quest_41090_quest_complete: [excited] Well done! [warm] I knew something was up. [urgent] How did they receive this? [solemn] It's in the demon language, so we will need help to translate this. [warm] But for now you have done well!
quest_41091_quest_detail:
[solemn] Translating this missive is not only important to discover what the enemy is up to, but it is also necessary to figure out how they are receiving this missive.

[soft voice] I believe one most qualified to assist us is a Demon Hunter. They are Night elves that have taken up fel and sworn an oath to fight demons. They are not welcome here, but nonetheless, they are committed to the cause in spite of the scorn they may receive.

[urgent] I have heard one called Niremius Darkwind has been spotted in northern Felwood recently. Find him and show this missive to him.
quest_41096_quest_complete: [urgent] That's horrible news! [solemn] I know what cave you speak of, it is connected to the Barrow Deeps below Hyjal. [soft voice] I believe I can cast a ward that will prevent them from breaking through for a while.
quest_41097_quest_detail:
[solemn] Travel to the summit of Mount Hyjal and find my superior, Annesastrasza. [soft voice] She needs to know every pertinent detail about what happened.

[solemn] Leaving those demons lurking in the Barrow Deeps would have endangered us all. [commanding] I will make sure to seal the cave while you deliver the news.

[warm] You have done us a great service, <name>.
quest_41106_quest_complete: [angry] Fel in the soil?! [solemn] I knew those brutes were up to something. [soft voice] They have been acting a bit too organized recently. [urgent] I need your help!
quest_41935_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tablet you find emanates with ancient power. [soft voice] Drenched in an imposing aura, you surmise it must be a relic from bygone times that somehow found its way into the clutches of Majordomo Executus. Reading its contents, runes and markings can be found describing a powerful resurrection spell for ageless beings. [pause] All that is needed is the recital of its lines and the essence of whatever being you wish to anchor once more into the mortal world.

[hesitant] Still driven by the thrill of adventure and pillaging, you wonder if you could use this artifact for your own personal gains…
quest_41935_quest_progress:
[angry] What is it, mortal? What desire drives you to pester me in my ghostly state, peacefully roaming these lands? Spare it, I know the answer already; riches and baubles are the fool’s only errand. You are too late then, I can and will not assist you in your absurd quest for treasure. How is a ghost supposed to do that, idiot?

<You tell the dragon spirit about the relic you possess.>

[soft voice] Oh, a relic of resurrection, you say? Perhaps you aren’t such a simpleton after all. Listen carefully, mortal! I won’t repeat myself twice. I am offering you a deal: Resurrect me with that artifact and the riches you so desperately seek shall be yours. [solemn] Gather the essence of my lesser brethren, the greater good demands their noble sacrifice. It may be grand, but it is a sacrifice I am willing to make. Only then will you be able to invoke the scroll’s latent power.
quest_41935_quest_complete: <With the essences at hand, you read the runes out aloud. Benevolent rays of warmth encompass the spirit of Azuregos, before his corporeal body begins manifesting on the leaf laced ground. After finishing the incantation, the mighty dragon bellows a mighty roar.> [threatening] What a gullible fool you are. [cold] Did you really expect me to hand a mere mortal the powerful treasures of my flight? [angry] Ridiculous! [mocking tone] My treasures are mine and mine alone. [threatening voice] As reward for your naivete, let me demonstrate how hospitable the Blue Dragonflight can be!
quest_4022_quest_detail:
[solemn] The flight is aware of your work in the Searing Gorge.

[commanding] Show it to me, <race>. The molt, imbecile.
quest_4022_quest_complete: <Cyrus examines the molt.> [low voice] You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
quest_4023_quest_detail: [solemn] You seek out the Flight? [commanding] Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
quest_4023_quest_complete: <Cyrus examines the molt.> [solemn] You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
quest_4024_quest_detail:
[solemn] I wish to taste the searing flames of the mountain of fire. To let the molten fires of Blackrock cascade across my being. That essence, that searing heat, it is what I crave.

[solemn] Bael'Gar resides in the Depths of Blackrock: A being of pure flame, born of the fires of Ragnaros. Slay Bael'Gar and from his smoldering remains bring for me a piece of his inner fire.

[urgent] Use the molt on his remains to safely extract the inner flame.

[commanding] Succeed and be rewarded.
quest_4024_quest_complete:
<Cyrus snatches the fiery essence from your hands.> [excited] YES!

[commanding] Take your prize and be gone. [threatening] Leave my sight at once!
quest_8995_quest_complete:
[solemn] How fortunate for you that I know you're not part of the original group that stole this from me.

[threatening] I'll take back what is mine now, mortal! Give the amulet to me!
quest_8996_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will ignore your impertinence this time, <class>, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. [low voice] Despite your obviously weak nature, <race>, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!

[threatening] Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. [soft voice] Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
quest_40957_quest_detail:
I am Ralathius, a servant of the Green Dragonflight. [solemn] It is unusual to find me outside of the Dream, but there is a pressing reason for my presence here.

[solemn] Our sacred realm has been tainted by an unknown darkness. [urgent] This corruption emerged suddenly and without warning, spreading its foul touch throughout the Dream. [sad] Druids, dragons, and all denizens of the Dream are engaged in a valiant struggle against this insidious force, but we are facing significant losses.

[solemn] Among those lost is Solnius the Awakener, a noble soul and one of Ysera's most cherished children. [sad] Solnius carried the responsibility of safeguarding our most sacred ritual, known as the Awakening. [whispering] Yet, he has succumbed to the alluring whispers of the Nightmare, and now this sacred power rests in the hands of darkness.

[soft voice] Please, listen to my tale. [urgent] He must be stopped at any cost.
quest_40957_quest_progress: [solemn] The Emerald Dream is in danger.
quest_40957_quest_complete: [solemn] So now you know. [urgent] Solnius must be stopped.
quest_40958_quest_detail:
[sad] The Nightmare could be everywhere.

[solemn] Even those who appear as noble heroes may harbor a hidden allegiance to this malevolent force. [hesitant] I cannot afford to trust blindly. Thus, I require tangible proof of your loyalty.

[low voice] In the depths of these enchanted forests, dwell the wretched satyrs, vile creatures who have embraced the darkness. [threatening] These fiends possess Nightmare Effigies, artifacts imbued with the corrupting power. [emphasis] While these effigies may lack the strength to unleash the full might of the Nightmare upon our world, they still pose a significant threat when wielded by the enemy.

[solemn] Yet, their significance transcends their immediate danger. [urgent] These nefarious effigies serve as conduits, linking the realms of the Dream and the mortal world. [commanding] By bringing these fiendish artifacts to me, we can harness their unique properties to expose any agent of the Nightmare who dares to wield them. [emphasis] Three will be enough.
quest_40958_quest_progress: [solemn] While it is with a heavy heart that I bear this burden of caution and mistrust, [low voice] the threat of the enemy lurks in every shadow, ready to exploit any weakness or vulnerability.
quest_40958_quest_complete:
[solemn] You bear the effigies in your hands, yet I see no signs of corruption within you.

<Ralathius exhales, relieved.>

[soft voice] I see the enemy in every shadow, and it's taking a toll on me. [sad] I am sorry for my initial distrust, but I have to take these steps. [urgent] Now, please, hand these effigies to me.
quest_40959_quest_detail:
[solemn] We will need more materials to attune you to the Dream. Your physical form could become trapped there, and you would surely fall prey to the Nightmare. [urgent] To ensure your safe passage through the Dreamway, I require the following items: first, a Binding Fragment of Cliffbreaker Giants. This powerful relic will bind your spirit to Azeroth, offering protection in the event of any failures along the way.

[solemn] Next, an Overloaded Arcane Prism from Dire Maul shall serve as your shield against the magical tempests that permeate the Dream.

[solemn] Additionally, acquire a Slumberer's Shard, retrieved from our fallen brethren in the depths of the Sunken Temple. This shard possesses the ability to cloak your presence from the defenders of the Dream.

[solemn] Once you have gathered these items, seek out Itharius, brother of Eranikus, in the Swamp of Sorrows. We need his blessing to grant you access to the Dream, as this decision is not mine to make.
quest_40960_quest_complete: [solemn] You have my deepest gratitude for gathering the materials I've asked you for. [warm] With the collected items and Itharius's benevolent blessing, we are now ready to peer into the realm of the Dream and attune you to its potent energies.
quest_40961_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the gathered items in my possession and the profound knowledge bestowed upon me, I shall now initiate a sacred ritual that will serve as a conduit to the mystical energies of the Emerald Dream. [solemn] Through this ancient ceremony, we shall establish a harmonious connection, ensuring your safe passage into our revered realm.

[soft voice] As I invoke the ancient incantations and channel the essence of the Dream, the veils between our worlds shall part, revealing a pathway of tranquility and wisdom. The ethereal mists of the Dream will embrace you, shielding you from harm and guiding you through its verdant landscapes.

[solemn] Embrace the majesty of the Emerald Dream!
quest_40961_quest_progress: [solemn] The Emerald Dream is in danger.
quest_40961_quest_complete: [solemn] Lady Ysera... we will not fail you. [solemn] We will not fail the Emerald Dream.
quest_40962_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your safe passage into the Dream is impossible while Latharius attempts to sever the Dreamway. [urgent] If you were to proceed, you would risk becoming trapped and succumbing to the clutches of the Nightmare.

[soft voice] Seek out Larannikus and put an end to his suffering. [sad] As confirmation of this act, retrieve a gemstone bestowed upon him by Ysera. [threatening] He is likely still in possession of it, a Nightmare’s mockery of our legacy.

[commanding] You will find Larannikus somewhere within Hyjal, end him.
quest_40962_quest_complete: Larannikus has met his demise, and you have successfully retrieved the Charge of Ysera. [solemn] With this significant accomplishment, you are now prepared to undergo the attunement process to the Emerald Dream. [soft voice] Remain still, mortal, as I bestow upon you the Gift of Ysera.
quest_40963_quest_detail:
[solemn] You hold in your hands the severed head of Solnius, once a noble and revered dragon, now corrupted by the insidious Nightmare. The sight is both awe-inspiring and unsettling, as the twisted patterns and symbols on his scales exude an eerie darkness. It is a testament to the power and malevolence of the Nightmare that even a mighty dragon could be so thoroughly corrupted.

[soft voice] With Solnius vanquished, the news of his demise will bring both relief and satisfaction to Ralathius in Nordanaar. The green dragonkin will rejoice in knowing that a formidable threat has been eliminated, and the Emerald Dream can rest a little easier.
quest_40963_quest_progress: [low voice] What is it, mortal? [urgent] You return from the Dream?
quest_40963_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done it. [solemn] The Awakening has been stopped.

[urgent] I will contact Ysera now. [urgent] She must know.

[gentle] Please, take this item as a token of gratitude from the Green Dragonflight.
quest_41006_quest_detail:
I, Slumbnaz am a master of deceptive magic.

[solemn] My draconic powers can be attuned to transform the look of myself and those around me, to bend the very visual reality of Azeroth itself. [soft voice] If you desire a taste of such magic, I can reward you for your efforts in helping my kin.

[commanding] Bring me twenty-five Bright Dream Shards and I will offer you this illusion.
quest_41006_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you acquired the magical shards?
quest_41006_quest_complete: [soft voice] A taste of draconic magic can be intense for those not adept at it. [solemn] Be careful in your use of this illusion.
quest_41038_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Claw of Erennius.

[solemn] It pains me to see the fall of a once noble hero to our cause. It would seem even the great Erennius was not safe from the lure and draw of the awakening. I take it the corruption sank deep into his heart, and turned him into an agent of evil.

Erennius is put to rest now, free from torment. [warm] I must thank you for what you've done. Take one of these relics, as a tribute for your heroism.
quest_41751_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mortal, the plight of submission is once more cast upon my flight. [solemn] Once again, the horrors of the past shroud the Dragon Queen's noble flight. [threatening] The orcish Dragonmaw Clan continues to exert their heinous acts of subjugation upon my kind, forcing them to follow their bidding. [urgent] While the Red Dragonflight is occupied with the everlasting vigil of safekeeping Grim Batol, it falls upon me to release my fallen brother Searistrasz and his brood.

[solemn] I can hear his painful cries echoing from within the ancient dwarven mines to the south, those which the Dragonmaw now have laid claim upon. [solemn] Mortal, venture into the Dragonmaw Retreat and absolve my brother and his children from this sin which was cast upon them.
quest_41751_quest_progress: [solemn] Even years later, the foul shadow of the Demon Soul haunts our flight.
quest_41751_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done. Life and death is a cycle that has to be maintained, and tainted life must be given the chance to bloom once more. The pain in my heart will continue to ache, yet I can be assured that Searistrasz is no longer in torment. [soft voice] Go in peace, mortal, and may your travels be without tragedy.
quest_41785_quest_complete:
<Nydiszanz recoils and hisses in pain at the sight of the Demon Soul shard. Just being near it causes a visceral reaction by him.> [angry] Impossible, you retrieved it and dare bring it to us?! I don’t know if you are reckless, cruel, gullible or all of the above. But... [solemn] you being here... with it... It means the Dragonmaw are no more. Their warchief returned to the cycle, their machinations thwarted. And the Demon Soul returned to us. Even through all its taint, I can sense the Queen’s benevolence somewhere hidden within, reaching out...

<name>, hand me the shard and I will deliver it to our Queen. Only she is capable of destroying the last remnants from this dark hour of our past. [warm] For you, I present these. A just reward for your sacrifice in stopping the Dragonmaw and ending the terror of the Demon Soul. Use it well, mortal.
quest_41801_quest_progress: [low voice] A mortal? Here? [urgent] Speak your mind quickly.
quest_41801_quest_complete:
[solemn] Who am I? Ah, you mortals and your curiosity. I have been known by many names across the ages, but you may address me as Sarthyss Scaleheart. [low voice] It is not by mere chance that you have wandered into my domain—no, this meeting reeks of fate's design.

And as it happens, mortal, I find myself in need of assistance that only hands such as yours can provide. [cold] Strange times, indeed, when a dragon must turn to the fleeting for aid.
quest_41802_quest_detail:
[solemn] Only the blind could fail to see the corruption that has taken hold of these swamps, its foul tendrils seeping into every root and shadow. [soft voice] I was sent here to uncover the truth of what plagues the Grim Hollow, yet my task has been far from easy. The swamps are patrolled by red dragonkin, their minds ensnared by the same corruption that poisons this land.

[solemn] We dragons share a bond, a sense of our kin, and they sense me as surely as I sense them. [pause] Each time I've sought to approach the Tomb of Ancestors, they have intercepted me, driven not by reason but by the darkness that clouds their minds. [sad] And so, I remain here, sheltered beneath this ancient oak, but unable to fulfill the purpose that brought me to this cursed place.

[urgent] You, however, are unbound by the ties of dragonkind. [commanding] You must venture into the depths of the Tomb of Ancestors and uncover the source of this corruption. [solemn] I am certain it lies within, festering and spreading its taint. [solemn] The fate of these lands may rest upon your mortal courage.
quest_41802_quest_progress: [solemn] I cannot say what horrors await you in the depths of the Tomb of Ancestors. [soft voice] The corruption that festers there is ancient and powerful, far beyond the reckoning of most mortals. [urgent] Prepare yourself well before you venture forth, and heed this warning—do not let foolish heroics guide your actions. [commanding] Caution and wisdom will serve you far better than reckless bravery.
quest_41802_quest_complete:
[solemn] A dark ritual? A cursed dwarven sorcerer? Mortal, you speak of things beyond your understanding. That is no mere dwarf—it is a skardyn, a twisted and vile abomination, once kin to dwarves but long since fallen into darkness.

[solemn] And if the skardyn walk these lands once more, it can mean only one thing—the gates of Grim Batol have been opened again.

[solemn] The noble draconic defenders who once stood vigil over that cursed place have succumbed to madness, their minds broken by the lingering corruption of Modgud. Her shadow stretches forth once more, reaching to taint the world anew. [solemn] This is no mere threat, mortal—this is calamity given form.
quest_41803_quest_detail: [solemn] Now, mortal, listen well. [low voice] If you are to grasp the gravity of what we face, you must first understand the skardyn and the vile origin that birthed them. Their story is one of betrayal, corruption, and a darkness that should have remained buried. [emphasis] Pay heed, for this knowledge is as dangerous as it is necessary.
quest_41803_quest_complete:
[solemn] Now you see the truth, mortal—clear as the moon over the frozen peaks. [urgent] This skardyn sorcerer must be struck down before his vile work can seep further into the heart of this land. [solemn] His very presence here is no accident; it is the herald of greater darkness, the echo of a curse long thought buried beneath stone and time.

[threatening] Whatever foul purpose brought him to Grim Hollow, it festers like a wound—and if left unchecked, its rot will spread. [solemn] These swamps, already choked with corruption, are but the beginning. [commanding] Mark my words: the magic he weaves will not stop here. [urgent] It will slither beyond the Hollow... to Dun Kithas, and perhaps even farther, poisoning the land, the skies, the very soul of Khaz Modan.
quest_41804_quest_detail:
[solemn] Skardyn... beings of terrible might and shadowed fury. Far stronger than you, mortal—and stronger still than any common band of adventurers. To face them directly would be folly. Their flesh is shielded by scales steeped in foul sorcery, their forms protected by curses woven deep into their essence.

[low voice] If we are to stand a chance, we'll need to forge a weapon—one imbued with the power to pierce their dark enchantments. But I must confess, mortal... even with all my knowledge, I know not what such a weapon would be. The secrets of their unmaking lie beyond my grasp.

[hesitant] Yet there may be another path. The skardyn were once Dark Iron dwarves—twisted by shadow, yes, but once kin to those who still walk the surface. Perhaps their descendants have kept records of what befell their cursed kin.

[urgent] You must go to Angor Fortress in the Badlands. There, the Dark Irons still linger—reclusive, secretive, and dangerous. But if any among them remember the truth of what transpired beneath Grim Batol, it is there you'll find
quest_41804_quest_progress: [solemn] While you seek their knowledge, I shall reach out to my dragonflight. [soft voice] Perhaps among our ancient scrolls and hidden memories, we can uncover some forgotten truth. [urgent] But hurry. The shadows grow bold, and time is not our ally.
quest_41804_quest_complete:
Ahhh... [soft voice] Of course it would be the searing kiss of the Red Flight that could sunder such foul sorceries.

The Skardyn's wards are woven with the brittle cunning of earth and shadow—strong against conventional magic, yes... but against the raw, devouring fury of my crimson cousins?

I should have seen it sooner—[solemn] fire has ever been the answer to vermin who burrow too deep.
quest_41805_quest_detail:
Now, listen mortal.

[solemn] The Red kin who stalk these festering marshes... their minds are no longer their own. [low voice] The Skardyn's filthy sorcery has wormed into their thoughts, twisting proud drakes into snarling puppets. [sad] A disgrace... but not without use.

[commanding] Their fire glands—untouched by corruption—still burn hot. Harvest them. Let their last embers serve a purpose greater than madness. With these, we will scorch the Skardyn's defenses to ash.

[threatening] Do not mistake this for mercy. It is necessity. Their suffering ends... and so will the Skardyn.

[urgent] Now go. And do not waste their fire.
quest_41805_quest_progress: [urgent] The whelps are no use to us- [commanding] you must find the adult kin.
quest_41805_quest_complete:
Mmh... [solemn] You have done what was necessary, mortal.

[soft voice] Their minds are finally still. No more Skardyn whispers. No more chains of twisted magic. Only silence... and the long sleep they were denied.

[commanding] Do not mourn them. Their fire now fuels our purpose—their last act will burn brighter than their madness ever did.
quest_41806_quest_detail:
[solemn] Fire glands alone will not suffice to breach the skardyn's defenses—no, not by far. Their twisted flesh has been hardened by shadow, warded against mere flame. [whispering] What we require is a catalyst... a focused conduit through which the fury of dragonfire may be properly channeled.

[commanding] There is a gnome, curious and cunning—Oglethorpe Obnoticus by name—residing in that chaotic cesspit the mortals call Booty Bay. [low voice] In his younger years, he toiled with volatile flame in an attempt to cleanse the blight of Gnomeregan. His methods were... unorthodox, and not without controversy. The Tinkmaster himself opposed them.

Yet, if there exists a mind capable of forging a dragonfire device potent enough to break through the skardyn's shadow-wrought hide, it is his.

[urgent] Seek him. Time is not on our side.
quest_41808_quest_progress: [solemn] You have finally returned, mortal. [soft voice] I hope you bear good tidings.
quest_41808_quest_complete:
[solemn] In your absence, there has been much disturbance. Strange lights, flickering with unnatural hues, have danced from the depths of that cursed crypt. The air itself trembles with arcane dissonance. Whatever stirs beneath... it grows stronger.

[urgent] It is good that you have returned. We are running out of time.

[solemn] May the gnome's contraption—chaotic though it may be—combined with the sacred fire of my kin, be enough to quell the abomination that waits below. If it is not... then the consequences will echo far beyond these hills.
quest_41809_quest_detail:
[commanding] Enough waiting, mortal.

[solemn] That Skardyn filth cowers below, his claws sunk deep into the earth's veins, poisoning all he touches. His wards may be strong—but not against the fire you now carry. [emphasis] Let my fallen kin's fury be the spark that burns his defenses to cinders.

[urgent] Then take his head. Cleanly. Let his blood be the last corruption he spills.

[threatening] But do not be a fool. Walk in alone, and you will be just another corpse in his collection. [emphasis] Bring warriors. Bring steel. Bring enough rage to match his treachery.

[commanding] Now go. And do not disappoint me.
quest_41809_quest_complete:
At last... the taint lifts.

<His wings flex slightly as the oppressive weight of dark magic dissipates, the air itself seeming to sigh in relief. The swamp's murky waters ripple as if awakening from a long nightmare.>

[solemn] Grim Hollow will mend. The earth remembers how to heal... given time.

[urgent] Yet this victory is but one ember plucked from a wildfire. The Skardyn do not act alone—they are rats fleeing a sinking nest. Grim Batol has spat out more of their kind, scattered like rot across Khaz Modan.

[threatening] And worst of all... they scurry with purpose. This was no mere exile. They serve something. Something old. Something hungry.

[commanding] Mark my words, mortal—this is not over. Whatever they plan... we must find it before it finds us.

[solemn] And next time... the fire we bring may not be enough.
quest_7623_quest_complete: [solemn] My patience spans the millenia, <class>. [threatening] But do not think that allows you more than an instant of my time...
quest_7624_quest_detail:
[commanding] You wish to enter my good graces? Then kill for me.

[low voice] My servant, Ulathek, is pathetic how he grovels before me, all the while plotting with Lord Hel'nurath on Xoroth. [threatening] Hel'nurath plans to usurp my power here, and Ulathek is his spy...

[urgent] Prove that you serve me and not my rivals. Confront Ulathek in his quarters, in the Shadow Hold to the west. Tell him that I know his secret and watch as fear grips him. Then, bring me the traitor's heart!
quest_7624_quest_progress: [soft voice] I can already taste the heart of Ulathek on my lips. [whispering] So sweet is the flesh of a traitor...
quest_7624_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, how splendid! [excited] After rotting a week, this heart will prove a succulent treat! [mocking tone] Perhaps I will send for Ulathek's head and place it before me as I eat...

[solemn] You have done me a service, <class>, and so my patience for you has grown. [cold] Marginally.
quest_7625_quest_detail:
[commanding] So you come to me seeking Xorothian stardust? [threatening] You wish to open a portal to Xoroth, the domain of Hel'nurath my rival? [mocking tone] Perhaps you plan to steal from him one of his precious dreadsteeds?

[low voice] Very well. [pause] My servant Ur'dan has a supply of Xorothian stardust. You may obtain it from him... [emphasis] if you can pay the price.
quest_40238_quest_complete: [low voice] Heh... So that is why you have come, it is not often that I am intrigued by your kind, not many would be so bold as to approach me willingly, knowing what I am capable of. [cold] Very well then, perhaps you may be of use for me, and should you prove a good asset, I will grant you what you desire.
quest_40239_quest_detail:
[solemn] My time here within Shadowbreak Ravine has been a period of thought, and research. I desire to gain knowledge within the fields of magic of the various factions on Azeroth, and see just how far they have come.

[commanding voice] As much as I could infiltrate, and spend effort to gain access to each through time, to sow desent, and chaos, I would much rather recruit you, to do as such for me. If you truly desire to gain knowledge to temper this Runeblade, I will grant it to you temporarily.

[urgent] First, travel to the Upper Blackrock Spire, and from the Rage Talon Fire Tongues, gather me a Rage Talon Charm, Secondly, travel to Dire Maul, from the Ogre Mage-Lords bring me a set Gordok Beads. Finally, from the pits of the Blackrock Depths, gather from a Doomforge Arcanasmith their Doomforge Rod.
quest_40239_quest_progress: [commanding] Do my bidding mortal, and dispatch my enemies. [solemn] It is for the greater good of this world for these magics to be taken from the hands of lesser beings.
quest_40239_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, incredibly well, much more then I had originally expected, [warm] If you wish to learn how to create a Tempered Runeblade, I shall grant you such knowledge.
quest_40240_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now then, mortal, it is time that we bid eachother goodbye. Once you let the magic I have given you flow from your hands, into the hammer that you will temper, it will no longer be of knowledge to you. [soft voice] I suggest you be careful in what you craft.

[low voice] I have felt a purpose about you ever since you first came, return to the one who sent you on this path. [commanding] Inform him of your newfound ability, and you will be instructed of what to do next.
quest_458_quest_complete: [soft voice] I see you found me, young <race>. [warm] Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you.
quest_459_quest_detail:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil. [solemn] Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell. [sad] They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation. [solemn] The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.

[urgent] Engage these grells and grellkin, <name>, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
quest_459_quest_progress: Satisfy my suspicions, <name>. [soft voice] Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
quest_459_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, <name>.

[soft voice] You confirmed my fears, however. If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

[solemn] Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able <class>, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle. He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
quest_945_quest_detail:
[urgent] Help!

I was wandering around the Master's Glaive, and these dirty cultists surrounded me. Lucky I'm good at hiding!!

[urgent] Can you help me out of here? And I need to send word to my sister Therysil that I'm all right. She's in Ashenvale to the south, at the Shrine of Aessina.
quest_945_quest_complete:
[shocked] My sister was where?? Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still! That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...

[soft voice] Well thank you, <name>. [warm] It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
quest_1021_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. [sad] My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!

<name>, [urgent] you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northeast. [hesitant] I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
quest_1021_quest_complete: [solemn] Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.
quest_1024_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello. [soft voice] How are you?
quest_1024_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, Raene sent you? [solemn] It must be serious indeed. [pause] What can I help you with?
quest_1026_quest_detail:
I wish your tidings were better.

[solemn] Raene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.

If your goal is to find the next piece of the rod, then you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.

The wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here, near Felwood. Once you have it, look for a small glade west of the road near the Felwood border... the chest should be hidden around there.
quest_1026_quest_progress: [solemn] It upsets me so that the treants have become corrupt. [sad] I wish I could do more to help them.
quest_1026_quest_complete: [warm] I'm pleased to see you're back, <name>.
quest_1027_quest_detail:
[solemn] The final piece of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil for safekeeping. [hesitant] I have no idea where they hid it. [sad] I'm sorry I can't help you more than that.

[soft voice] All I can tell you is to follow the road that leads towards the Barrens. [solemn] The druids took shelter to the east of that road, but they won't be of much help to you: [sad] they were killed recently... it's something I don't like to think about much.

[solemn] When you find the final piece, bring it to me and I will help you reconstruct the rod.
quest_1027_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find the final piece of the rod, <name>?
quest_1027_quest_complete:
[delight] You found the final piece? Wonderful for you... and for Raene.

[hesitant] I guess we'll have to see about repairing it, won't we?
quest_1028_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here is the completed rod, <name>. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.

[solemn] With some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.

[urgent] Head southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.

[whispering] Once there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. [chuckling] Hehe.
quest_1028_quest_progress:
You can sense a subtle yet powerful force within the shrine and surrounding trees.

[soft voice] You begin placing the rod within the shrine and a soft thrumming noise emits from around you as the shrine begins to glow...
quest_1028_quest_complete: [solemn] After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.
quest_1029_quest_detail:
I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. [soft voice] I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.

[soft voice] Good luck, <name>.
quest_1031_quest_detail: [soft voice] Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. [gasp] Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. [sad] "He has taken it... Geltharis..." [pause] You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.
quest_1031_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found them? [hesitant] What did Anilia say? [urgent] Where is she?
quest_1031_quest_complete:
[shocked] Anilia died? No... that can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.

[sad] I guess those days are over...
quest_1032_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. [sad] I almost feel... sad.

[solemn] I know something that might make me feel better. [commanding] Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! [warm] Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
quest_1032_quest_progress: [soft voice] Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.
quest_1032_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, kind <race>. [warm] My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
quest_1055_quest_detail: [solemn] The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. [soft voice] Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.
quest_7044_quest_detail:
[solemn] A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.

[solemn] Vyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.

[urgent] You must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.
quest_7064_quest_detail: [solemn] Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. [soft voice] Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. [solemn] The offspring of their time together became known to the people of Kalimdor as centaur. [pause] Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. [urgent] My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
quest_7064_quest_progress:
I would prefer to fight this battle on our own, but we are left with no other options--we need those more powerful, and the races of Azeroth have proven without a doubt they can overcome such things when they work together. [solemn] So it is to you we turn for help.

I only hope it is enough.

Zaetar, brother to Remulos, brought many pains to this world, and ultimately it caused his own death. [hesitant] I just hope I have not caused more death by asking you to aid us.
quest_7064_quest_complete:
[delight] This is most wonderful news, <name>! [warm] Thank you!

[solemn] I will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.

[confident] I was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. [warm] I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.
quest_40584_quest_progress: [excited] Oh hello! [urgent] It's urgent, [urgent] it's really bad!
quest_40584_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh? Wait, that is my leaf! Did someone send you to find me? [warm] I appreciate it! My name is Melyndella. I have no time to chat though, things are bad! [urgent] Kaylee was poisoned by Centaurs.
quest_40585_quest_detail: Kaylee and I were coming to Mulgore, for... Stuff! [urgent] I'll tell you later, but she was poisoned by one of their arrows. [solemn] It's taking all my concentration and power to slow the poison down and not let her die. [soft voice] Please find someone that can help wherever you came from! [urgent] I need an antidote!
quest_40587_quest_progress: [excited] Oh it's you! [urgent] Did you get it? [emphasis] Did you?
quest_40587_quest_complete: [excited] Yay! [excited] This is amazing! [urgent] Stand back, [urgent] I will heal her to speed up the antidote's effect!
quest_40588_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Thank you so much, <name>! [pause] I should properly explain why I came. [solemn] A long time ago, my great grandfather taught the Tauren people the ways of Druidism. [soft voice] These teachings have since been lost but have recently been rediscovered.

[solemn] My grandfather Remulos even helped the Tauren rejoin the Cenarion Circle. [sad] In spite of that though, many Tauren know very little about my people, and we in turn know little of them.

[gentle] I've come here to live in Mulgore so we can learn about each other. [warm] Kaylee is my friend and a druid student. [urgent] I will help her recover then join you, please return to whoever sent you and inform them that we're coming!
quest_40676_quest_detail:
Greetings! You're a long way from home! Are you looking for me?

I'm Selendra. [soft voice] I'm desperately trying to right the wrongs of the past here in Mashan'she! [hesitant] You do know that is this place's name, yes? Not Desolace, no! [sad] That's a horrible name for it, just because the life has been sucked out and... never mind.

[urgent] Look, there are signs of life, I'm sure of it. [confident] I just need someone to help prove it, convince the world that this land is still worth saving, for the flora and fauna that can still survive!

[solemn] I would like to see how far the life-leeching has gone. Theradras may have stripped life from the land, but what about the seas?

[solemn] The Kaldorei ruins of Ethel Rethor are mostly underwater now. But there used to be beautiful blooms of Alor'el, the lovers' leaf, which grew there. [warm] They can survive underwater though, <race>! [excited] This is known! Please, search the sunken depths and bring me back some of those flowers as proof, if they still exist.
quest_40676_quest_complete: <She swishes her fawn tail and small flowers drop from her hair in her visible excitement> [excited] Oh, fantastic, simply fantastic!
quest_40677_quest_detail:
I have one more test to prove my theory, and redirect some attention here from the Cenarion Circle!

[solemn] If the loss of life did not reach far out to sea, perhaps it did not reach far into the mountains either?

[soft voice] There is a beautiful bloom native to here, Mashan'she Silversage. It grows high up, but where there is a sea breeze too. I would start on the northwestern shore, <race>. Search whichever hills and mountains you can climb, and try to find some of those blooms! [urgent] It matters so much to me, I would be eternally grateful.
quest_40677_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes? [urgent] Yes? [urgent] Do you have it?
quest_40677_quest_complete: [excited] Fantastic! Oh, I could kiss you! You probably… wouldn't like that though, right? Right. Oh, [warm] Thank you so much! I will report this immediately to the Circle.
quest_41088_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh hello traveller! [soft voice] Are you ascending to the summit? [soft voice] You must have been very brave to sneak past the demons. [hesitant] I am sorry, but is it okay if I ask you to help me a bit? [soft voice] Please?

[soft voice] I have felt the plants cry out in distress, something is wrong with them. [soft voice] Can you pick me a few samples in the area for me to look at while I try to speak to the trees?

[gentle] Grab them delicately from the ground, roots and all. [warm] I will return them to their home later!
quest_41088_quest_progress: [urgent] Well? Did you succeed? [soft voice] Please! It is important.
quest_41088_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you! Let's see…[pause] Oh no! Some of these plants are fel tainted, but the taint comes from the root!

[urgent] This is bad, I hope I can count on your help! [warm] Here, take these shinies. [excited] I will get you more if you help!
quest_41106_quest_detail:
[solemn] If Fel is in the soil, then it means the demons are up to something. Travel up the road until you arrive near a scorched land. It was one of the sites of the battle of Mount Hyjal.

[angry] The evil ugly demonlord Archimonde himself arrived and destroyed everything that was once there! Demons still remain in Hyjal to this day.

[soft voice] When I made my way here I ran into a young pretty red Dragon that was investigating the demons. [urgent] Seek her out!
quest_41232_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have allowed this poor soul to rest at the roots of the Sleeping Tree. [soft voice] While it will not heal them, it will stop the effects of withering, at least for now. [solemn] As guardians of these lands, all life here is valuable and must be nurtured by us.

However, you were not sent here to learn of our values. [urgent] I know what the Highborne wants, and while I am not sure it will work, my sisters and I will do our best to aid. [hesitant] Gather a few leaves from the bushes and the heart of a hawkstrider. [sad] It pains me to have you send and do this, but sometimes, to receive something, you must offer something in return.
quest_41232_quest_complete: [solemn] Allow us to briefly unite your hands with ours, so that we may perform this ritual.
quest_41233_quest_detail:
[solemn] You will find what you seek underwater, in the ruins not so far from here; it is there that the heart lays dormant. [soft voice] I hope you will find it, and I hope it will help you achieve your goal.

<Rine pats your head and tilts hers.>

[solemn] Long have you struggled, I see it in your eyes. [gentle] Remember also to find rest, child. [warm] If you seek a glimpse of comfort, return to us. You will find none better than at the roots of the Sleeping Tree.

[urgent] After your task is done, return to Viz'neya; she will know what is to be done.
quest_41250_quest_complete: Greetings, I am Rine, and you are in the presence of the Sisters of Autumn.
quest_41256_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Some time ago, my sisters and I felt a disturbance from across the sea, and so some of us left our starlit home to investigate. Our search led us here, to what we call the Sleeping Tree. While it's not quite what the Quel'dorei had hoped for, it's still quite lovely, isn't it?

[solemn] To help guard the tree we used its seeds to grow Ancient Protectors. Alas! As the tree's creation was flawed, so too was its offspring. The Ancients are steadfast, true companions that walk the ages with us...but it was not to be so with these Autumn Ancients. They only lived a mere few thousand years before withering and returning to the earth.

[gentle] However, recently I've noticed some new saplings have sprouted from the resting places of these Ancients. [delight] This gives me hope! Would you be good enough to search for these saplings and retrieve a few acorns for me? Perhaps then... <Marrondra trails off, losing herself in thought.>
quest_41256_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ahhh, Autumn! [pause] Sometimes I miss the twilight shores of Kalimdor, but there really is something very cozy about this place, cursed history notwithstanding. [gentle] Do you have the acorns?
quest_41256_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you found them! [delight] Wonderful, thank you. [soft voice] I'm sure in no time at all we shall have these children nurtured and cultivated into beautiful new sprouts.

<She pauses to think for a moment.>

[sigh] Oh. [hesitant] You may not wish to wait around for it- I forget that mortals have a different sense of time than we do. [soft voice] It may be a few years.
quest_42095_quest_complete:
The Grove of the Moon has fallen to them as well?

I had feared as much.

[solemn] The forest has been restless for many nights now. Roots twist where they should grow straight. Dreams drift through the groves where none should linger.

[soft voice] The corruption runs deeper than a single grove.
quest_42096_quest_detail:
[solemn] The corruption you saw in the Grove of the Moon is only the beginning.

To the north lies Elun’aran, a sacred village once tended by druids who honored both the forest and the moon.

[soft voice] Now it festers.

[solemn] The same druids who abandoned Cenarius’ teachings have spread their influence there. Their rituals twist the land, and creatures of rot now roam beneath the ancient trees.

[hesitant] Even some of my own kin have fallen.

[whispering] Dryads corrupted by their magic now call themselves the Sisters of Rot. Satyrs whisper in the shadows, feeding the madness that spreads through the groves.

[solemn] And the ancients… the great guardians of the forest… they have begun to decay while still walking.

[urgent] This cannot continue.

[commanding] Travel to Elun’aran and cleanse the grove. Slay ten Sisters of Rot, ten Whispering Satyrs, and five Rotting Ancients.
quest_42096_quest_progress:
[solemn] Do not linger too long in Elun’aran.

[whispering] The forest there no longer dreams peacefully. [low voice] Something darker watches through its roots.
quest_42096_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done what was necessary.

[soft voice] The forest breathes a little easier already.

[urgent] But the druids who began this corruption still remain… and one of them leads the others.
quest_42097_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druids behind this corruption do not act alone. Their leader is a keeper of the grove named Krothis.

[soft voice] Once he was respected among the druids of these lands. A guardian of the forest, patient and wise. Many sought his counsel when the wilds fell out of balance.

[low voice] Now he serves another. The druids you fought speak of a figure they call Mothshroud.

[solemn] Long ago, before many of these groves fell silent, an archdruid guided the druids of this region. A teacher of dreams, of night, of the hidden places between waking and the Emerald Dream. He walked paths few druids dared to study.

[soft voice] In time, those paths carried him somewhere… we could no longer follow. He vanished, and the groves slowly returned to simpler teachings.

[solemn] But it seems his shadow has returned. Krothis now serves Mothshroud, carrying out his will across the groves.

[urgent] If the forest is to heal, Krothis must fall.
quest_42097_quest_progress: [solemn] Krothis was once a keeper of the grove. [sad] Creatures like that do not fall easily and [threatening] those who follow Mothshroud rarely fight alone.
quest_42097_quest_complete:
Krothis has fallen…

[solemn] The forest mourns when a keeper dies, even one who lost his way.

[soft voice] Without Krothis guiding them, the corrupted druids will scatter. Some may yet remember the teachings they abandoned.

[low voice] Others will follow Mothshroud deeper into shadow.

[solemn] This is not the end of the matter. If Mothshroud truly walks these lands again, then the groves face a danger older than most remember.

[gentle] But for now, the forest breathes a little easier.

[warm] You have done well.
quest_96_quest_detail:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

 Give life and understand. Understand water is life... [solemn] corruption stops life.

 You protect and give life with water's power.
quest_100_quest_detail: [excited] Light explodes as you finish the incantation. [solemn] The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
quest_100_quest_complete: [solemn] Thanks to you. [soft voice] Thanks to the shamans.
quest_1517_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah... <name>... pleased is the earth to have you here.

Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. [soft voice] But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
quest_1518_quest_detail:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Canaga Earthcaller as proof of our meeting. [solemn] He will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. [soft voice] As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

[gentle] Be patient, <name>. [solemn] Remain strong. And seek wisdom. [solemn] This is what earth asks of you. [pause] In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
quest_1520_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah... <name>... pleased is the earth to have you here.

Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

[solemn] Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
quest_1521_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. [solemn] She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. [emphasis] As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.

[soft voice] Be patient, <name>. [pause] Remain strong. And seek wisdom. [solemn] This is what earth asks of you. [pause] In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
quest_2844_quest_detail:
I am no good, <name>. I was 'spose to be watchin' over my little friend, Shay, and somehow, she got away from me. I'm not all that sure what happened, really, but last time I saw her, we was walkin' through the ruins just north of here.

[solemn] Everythin' was goin' fine, but then I turned around, and... she was gone.

Now I jus can't quite figure out what I should do here. Got any ideas, <name>? I'm awful worried.

[gentle] Hey, how 'bout you go look fer Shay? Yer legs can travel much faster 'n mine.
quest_2845_quest_progress: [excited] I was gettin' worried 'bout ya! [warm] Thank you so much for bringin' Shay home, <name>.
quest_2845_quest_complete:
[shocked] What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!

[delight] Since you did so much fer me, here ya go, <name>.
quest_2954_quest_detail:
[solemn] "Salutations - I am a guardian of entry. Unless you have the Plates of Uldum already integrated with your disc set, I will not allow for entry into the Uldum compound."

[solemn] The appearance of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon must be the reaction that was hoped for in sending you out to the Tanaris desert with the platinum discs. As instructed, you will need to find out what the story behind the Stone Watcher is before continuing on.
quest_2954_quest_progress: [solemn] The purpose of the stone watcher must be learned before continuing on...
quest_2954_quest_complete:
[solemn] The stone watcher's voice resonates with power and authority:

"[commanding] Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal. When you have obtained the Plates of Uldum and incorporated them into your existing disc set, you may then enter the complex."
quest_2967_quest_detail: [solemn] You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
quest_2977_quest_detail: [solemn] You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
quest_6393_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. [soft voice] Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

<name>, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
quest_6393_quest_progress: [solemn] The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. [pause] They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. [soft voice] My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. [urgent] Have you the Incendrites that I require?
quest_6393_quest_complete: [excited] The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. [warm] <name>, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
quest_6562_quest_detail: [solemn] Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. [soft voice] The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. [urgent] Be careful, <name>. [threatening] There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
quest_6804_quest_detail:
[solemn] A force of elemental scouts was sent to the eastern plaguelands of Lordaeron, and the disease of that place twisted and infected them. [angry] The Waterlords cannot allow this affront to our purity!

[soft voice] Take this vial. In it is a quantity of one aspect of Neptulon. [urgent] If used on the plagued elementals it will fight the poison within their bodies and cure them! But their inner conflict will drive them into a surging madness.

[commanding] Defeat the discordant surges and bring me their bracers of binding.
quest_6804_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, <class>. [warm] The corrupted elementals you cured were an outrage to all bodies of water. [soft voice] Our strength lies in our purity and if we are to win our war with the others, we must remain strong.
quest_6805_quest_detail:
[solemn] We, the elementals of water, wage war with those beings of the lesser elements. [commanding] If you are truly our ally in this conflict, then show me your conviction!

[soft voice] Far to the south, in the desert land of Silithus, the servants of air and earth scurry in a corner of rock named the Crystal Vale. [hesitant] They protect items of power from smaller beings, mortals, and although I do not know why they do this, I wish to foil their efforts.

[urgent] Go to the Crystal Vale in Silithus and defeat our enemies, then return to me.
quest_6805_quest_progress: [solemn] Cowardice is not a thing we hold in regard, <class>. [commanding] Go to Silithus and prove your bravery.
quest_6805_quest_complete: [solemn] Your bravery is proven, as is your worth to us. [warm] Perhaps I may have future tasks for you, tasks more befitting a valued ally of the Waterlords.
quest_6821_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have shown me that you can defeat our enemies and perform missions to further the cause of the Waterlords. [soft voice] But until now you have only faced lesser foes... if pitted against a powerful enemy, can you prevail?

[commanding] That is your new task.

[urgent] High up in Blackrock Spire the orcs have captured a servant of fire, the Pyroguard Emberseer. Find his place of imprisonment, slay his captors, and then slay the emberseer. Bring me his eye and it will show me your worth.
quest_6821_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Eye, <class>? [commanding] Do you have the strength to enter Blackrock Spire?
quest_6821_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, so you do have the strength. [soft voice] And you have the cunning as well, for Blackrock Spire is more than a match for brute strength alone.

[solemn] Indeed <name>, you may yet prove a valued ally to us...
quest_6822_quest_detail:
<name>, perhaps it is time to give you a real test. [commanding] Are you ready?

At the bottom of Blackrock Depths is a passage to the Molten Core. [solemn] This is a stronghold of our enemy, held by the most powerful servants of fire on this world.

Go to the Molten Core, <name>. [urgent] Show me you have the strength and the will to defeat what you find there.

And if you have allies among your people, then rally them. [threatening] Nothing short of an army can hope to enter the Molten Core and live.
quest_6822_quest_progress: [solemn] Your success in the Molten Core awaits, <name>.
quest_6822_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done what most of your kind would think impossible. [proud] You have faced the beings of the Molten Core, and triumphed!

[soft voice] For so small a creature, you have displayed great resource.

[solemn] Some day, perhaps we might strike a true allegiance between your kind and the Waterlords.
quest_6823_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you truly wish an allegiance with us, then I invite you to wage war on our foes, the servants of air and earth and fire. Each defeat you heap upon them will weaken their foothold here, and further prove your adherence to our cause.

[solemn] The campaign will be long, but if you persevere then your glory and honor will be great.
quest_6823_quest_progress: [solemn] Your campaign is not yet done, <name>. [commanding] Go out and defeat our enemies, the servants of air and earth and fire, and one day perhaps you will earn a place in the hall of the Waterlords.
quest_6823_quest_complete: [solemn] Your exploits against our enemies ring through the chambers of the Waterlords, <name>. [soft voice] It was thought by some that your form is too small and fragile to fight in our war, but you have made great gains. [warm] You have earned respect among us, an unbelievable feat.
quest_6824_quest_detail:
<name>, your service is of great value to us, so we are reluctant to send you on this last mission for we do not want to lose such a useful agent.

[solemn] But its success would further our war efforts tremendously and... it was deemed worth risking you.

[urgent] We want these captains in the Molten Core destroyed: Lucifron, Sulfuron, and Shazzrah. Kill them and bring me their hands!

[commanding] This task will take every resource you possess, <name>, but if can do it then the Firelords will be dealt a terrible blow.
quest_6824_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you defeated Lucifron and the others, <name>? [commanding] Do you have the hands of the enemy?
quest_6824_quest_complete:
[excited] You have the hands! You defeated the fire captains! [solemn] I would not have thought it possible, had I not known you and what you are capable of.

<name>, your exploits are without number, but word of this last feat will send waves among the Waterlords. [warm] Your name may one day be legend to us.

Speak with me again, <name>. [hesitant] I may have yet another task...
quest_7486_quest_detail:
<name>, your services to the Warlords surpassed all we could expect from the denizens of this world.

[solemn] We do not understand your people's notions of gratitude, or rewarding good works, but in this case... perhaps a reward is warranted.

[soft voice] Under the surf at the southern base of this island, you will find a coffer. In it you will find your... reward.

[urgent] Go, <name>. Claim your reward.
quest_7486_quest_complete:
Hydraxis' voice descends from the waters' surface...

"[solemn] Choose that which best suits you, <name>. [warm] May it protect you against the foes of the Waterlords."
quest_40023_quest_complete: [solemn] You desire to aid the realm of rock? [soft voice] There is much to do. [commanding] Let us begin.
quest_40024_quest_detail:
[solemn] My kind have become disconnected from the Elemental Plane here within the Arathi Highlands. [sad] Foreign disturbances and the death of our leaders have left us disillusioned and waning in our powers. [low voice] I have no control over the elementals that I was charged with, and I believe there is more at play here.

[solemn] To the southwest is the Circle of Inner Binding. [soft voice] It is where my followers are scattered. [commanding] Go there, and take from them the Inner Binding Bracers they possess. [threatening] They will not give them to you willingly, so you must destroy them.
quest_40024_quest_progress: [low voice] Is it done, mortal? Have you gathered the bracers?
quest_40024_quest_complete: [solemn] There is something foul here—a magic that is not native to my kind.
quest_40025_quest_detail:
[solemn] With Ganz'ih's remark, it would appear these bracers have become corrupted. [angry] Someone is taking advantage of our weakened status and turning my kind to nefarious means. [solemn] We must cleanse these bracers of their taint, and to do so, I require natural materials.

[urgent] You can find them in this world, and they should do well in purifying the taint. [commanding] Bring Speaker Ganz'ih five Life Roots, ten Solid Stones, and three Wild Steelblooms. [soft voice] He will be preparing the materials for me.
quest_40026_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done your duty well. [warm] You exemplify the values of my kind. [soft voice] Without you, I would be unable to continue my work. [solemn] Take this signet as a symbol of gratitude, mortal. [warm] May the blessings of the Elemental Plane help you in your future battles.
quest_42049_quest_progress: [commanding] Boldly, you have sought an audience.
quest_42049_quest_complete: [solemn] Those of the Earthen Circle have deemed the shrines of Moonwhisper restless. [soft voice] And my aid is required to soothe them?
quest_42050_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Earthen Ring is a valued mortal friend of the Hydraxian Waterlords. Place those beads beneath one of my binding bracers and let my flowing waters do the rest. I share the concern of your troll friend; the corruption within them is indeed potent. Fret not, it is not potent enough to bring an elemental Duke such as I to his knees, though it has surely done a number on the furbolgs.

[soft voice] As for the shrines of my brethren, I too sense more than one conflict in Moonwhisper Coast. Their guardians have risen to protect their places of worship, yet perhaps this is a time for mortals, not elementals. I have come to consider that the day may arrive when I must rely upon your kind, perhaps even you. If the mortal children of this world wish to stand tall in adversity, how could I deny you this duty? Retrieve your beads, mortal, return to your troll friend, soothe my brethren’s unrest, and stand resolute in your choice.
quest_1030_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, yes... you are one of my kind, but still whole. Still clean.

[soft voice] I am unsure how you have escaped the atrocities the night elves have visited upon our people, but I am glad to know that I am no longer alone.

[solemn] Corruption now runs through the veins of our kin, young one, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe.

[whispering] At night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.
quest_1045_quest_detail:
[solemn] The night elves are as old as time, but their arrogance destroys their very world. [sad] And now it destroys our lives too. [pause] But that can no longer be controlled...

[soft voice] I blame the elves for much, but we are still responsible for our actions. [solemn] Even beyond the corruption, we are capable of great evil.

[low voice] Ran Bloodtooth is one such evil. [angry] Power hungry, lusting... the corruption has only made him stronger. [pause] My hatred for the elves burns, but I do not wish ill upon their children, so we must police our own.
quest_1045_quest_progress:
[urgent] Have you slain Ran yet, my friend?

[solemn] Even the Night elves do not truly deserve his wrath. [sad] His hatred burns even brighter than my own, but his mind is no longer his own. [threatening] He is a threat to all the natural creatures of this forest.
quest_1045_quest_complete:
[gentle] You have done well, my friend.

[solemn] The forest is still tainted, but at least we know we have done a small part to return it to its former glory. [soft voice] If you wish to return to me again, I would enjoy the company of my own kind.

[soft voice] Be well. [soft voice] Perhaps our tribes will meet again under less violent times.
quest_1046_quest_detail:
[solemn] Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.

[solemn] Show them your trophy, and bask in the glory...
quest_6031_quest_detail:
[solemn] In Timbermaw, we are content. [soft voice] We do not like strangers. [solemn] This is good for us, but it is bad for trade.

[soft voice] Not long ago, a rare night elf friend came to Timbermaw and she wore a runecloth cloak. [soft voice] Runecloth is rare among us, but the cloak was so fine my people want me to make more runecloth clothing.

[gentle] Will you bring me runecloth? [urgent] If you bring me enough, then I will give you something in trade.
quest_6031_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the runecloth? [excited] My people are eager for more items of runecloth!
quest_6031_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, you brought the cloth. Such fine material it is!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You are a true friend. Please accept this in exchange.
quest_6032_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. [soft voice] But mooncloth is sacred.

[commanding] Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
quest_6032_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the mooncloth, <name>?
quest_6032_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Now I will train you.
quest_6241_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, <name>. While we do allow safe passage to those that have proven they can be trusted, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.

[soft voice] Lately I have noticed that the Winterfall tribe has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.

[urgent] If you could reduce their numbers this would help us greatly, <name>.
quest_6241_quest_progress: [soft voice] We very much appreciate what you have done for the Timbermaw, <name>. [solemn] Your continued efforts will surely earn my tribe's trust and respect.
quest_6241_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you for what you have done. [warm] Please continue to help us, <name>. We have very few allies on which to call upon.
quest_8153_quest_detail:
[solemn] The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands. Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points. Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.

[soft voice] To hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.

[commanding] Hunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
quest_8153_quest_complete: [solemn] You must possess keen sight and great patience to have obtained these. [warm] Well done.
quest_8231_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in Azshara. [soft voice] They are powerful and resilient.

The tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.

[urgent] Track and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of Azshara, and bring me their scales.
quest_8231_quest_complete:
[solemn] The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.

[confident] You have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.
quest_8232_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now I set you on a dangerous hunt to slay the green drake, Morphaz, and bring his tooth to me. Morphaz dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in Swamp of Sorrows.

[soft voice] If you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. This drake is an enemy of many -- seek others who wish to destroy him.

[solemn] The drake's tooth represents the power a hunter will find in the company of others. Bring it to me and you will have learned much.
quest_8232_quest_progress: [solemn] I see wisdom in your eyes, <name>. [soft voice] Has your hunt ended?
quest_8232_quest_complete: [solemn] You have learned the old ways, <name>, and for that I offer you a gift from my days as a <class>.
quest_8255_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mosshoof coursers of Azshara are magnificent animals who once lived in Felwood. They naturally resist disease and poison, and were unaffected by the corruption there. In their ancestral wisdom, they simply chose to leave that sickened place.

[sad] It saddens my heart, but I must ask you to hunt these mighty beasts for me. Gather four courser glands as the first ingredient for a restorative salve -- a salve we will use to heal Felwood.
quest_8255_quest_progress: [solemn] You have returned. [hesitant] Were you successful?
quest_8255_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is good the divine path has led you to us, <name>. [soft voice] Your beliefs do not interfere with the tasks involved in creating this salve.

[solemn] You see, the courser is sacred to the Cenarion Circle, and killing them for any reason, no matter how necessary, weakens their spirit.
quest_8256_quest_detail:
[solemn] For this restorative salve, you must use a simple formula: one part poison, two parts cure. You have acquired one cure, now you must gather the poison.

[soft voice] Powerful undead, such as the lingering highborne who wander the Ruins of Eldarath, are sometimes so infused with evil that it coalesces into a sickly greenish goo. To the living, this substance is known as ichor of undeath.

[urgent] Due to the potency of this vile element, I require only a single ichor.
quest_8256_quest_progress: [urgent] We must obtain the ichor quickly. [soft voice] Have you found it?
quest_8256_quest_complete: [solemn] I cannot say I'm pleased to receive such a wretched substance, but it is a necessary evil. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_8257_quest_detail:
[urgent] Now the last part, the second cure.

[solemn] The green drake Morphaz is known to be immune to all forms of poison and disease -- many druids died to bring us this information. [pause] There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.

[urgent] A courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last. [commanding] Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar. [warm] Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
quest_8460_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. [soft voice] However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. [hesitant] For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.

[gentle] Are you interested in proving yourself? [commanding] Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. [urgent] You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.
quest_8460_quest_progress: [commanding] Keep at it, <name>. [solemn] If you are to earn our trust, you will need to prove yourself to us.
