quest_8460_quest_complete: [solemn] We suffer much from the events of the past. [soft voice] Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw. [warm] As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.
quest_8461_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.

The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. [sad] It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.

Please, <name> - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
quest_8461_quest_progress: [solemn] Once you gain the trust of the Timbermaw, I am confident there will be something we will be able to do for you. [solemn voice] The Timbermaw do not forget their allies, especially in dark times such as these.
quest_8461_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sense that you have achieved victory. Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done. Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust.

[soft voice] It may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold. Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you. So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.
quest_8462_quest_detail:
[solemn] Perhaps you are capable of handling a larger threat that we Timbermaw face. You certainly have shown yourself capable here...

[soft voice] Another of my kind stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold, along this road far to the north. His name is Nafien; while he may appear to be a feral and unsavory beast, fear him not. He only seeks aid against the malign forces that threaten our home.
quest_8462_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah... I have heard the word on the wind about those not of our tribe who seek to ally themselves with the Timbermaw furbolgs. [gentle] I welcome you, but you must be warned that my tribe reacts poorly to strangers.

[low voice] These are trying times, and we can only trust those who choose to fight the corruption of the land along side of us... and have proven themselves to us accordingly. [threatening] Those who have not done so will be met with open hostility should they enter the Hold.
quest_8464_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, <name>. While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.

[soft voice] The Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.

[commanding] I must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us. Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
quest_8464_quest_progress: [soft voice] We very much appreciate what you have done for the Timbermaw, <name>. [solemn] Your continued efforts will surely earn my tribe's trust and respect.
quest_8464_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is. [warm] Accept this as a token of thanks.

[solemn] I would ask of you to please continue helping us, <name>. [hesitant] We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.
quest_8465_quest_detail:
[solemn] The threat of corruption comes not only from the Deadwood furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of Winterspring. [soft voice] If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the Winterspring entrance. [pause] Follow the path to the left to reach it.

 Be warned - if my kind inside considers you hostile or hated, they will attack. [urgent] Travel as quick as you can, avoiding conflict. [solemn] To kill a Timbermaw - even in self defense - will only alienate you further.
quest_8465_quest_complete:
Greetings, <class> - I stand guard here as both a speaker for the Timbermaw here in Winterspring and as a defender of the tribe.

[solemn] Our Winterfall brethren here in this frigid land have fallen under the same corruptive sway as the furbolg of Felwood. [soft voice] If you've come here offering the Timbermaw furbolgs aid, then we are ready to accept such an offer.
quest_8466_quest_progress:
[solemn] While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe. [soft voice] To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.

[commanding] Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. [urgent] Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw. Deadwood Headdress Feather(5)
quest_8466_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>! [proud] I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind.

[gentle] Remember to bring any of the feathers you find to me. [soft voice] I will continue to accept them as long as necessary.
quest_8467_quest_progress:
[solemn] While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe. [soft voice] To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.

[commanding] Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. [urgent] Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw. Deadwood Headdress Feather(5)
quest_8467_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done, <name>! [warm] I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind.

[gentle] Remember to bring any of the feathers you find to me. [soft voice] I will continue to accept them as long as necessary.
quest_8469_quest_progress:
[gentle] You've certainly earned my trust, <name>, but you may need to continue to earn the trust of my untrusting tribe. [solemn] There is something you can do to earn that trust.

[soft voice] The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. [sad] These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. [commanding] Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw. Winterfall Spirit Beads(5)
quest_8469_quest_complete:
[excited] Once again, you prove your honor to us! [warm] I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind.

[solemn] Remember to bring any of the Winterfall's beads you find to me. [solemn] For each set you continue to bring to me, I will speak on your behalf to the tribe.
quest_8470_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have found one of the Deadwood furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it. If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the Deadwood furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.

[soft voice] One of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.
quest_8470_quest_progress: [gentle] Yes <class>, what can I assist you with? [soft voice] You walk among us peacefully, though there is assuredly something amiss. [solemn] I sense something... [pause] something troubling...
quest_8470_quest_complete:
[solemn] This totem... I recognize it as one of the Deadwood's, but it is thick with the stench of decay. [sad] Whatever foulness has turned our brethren against us is surely present in this object.

[gentle] You were wise to bring this to us, <name>. [solemn] Perhaps through study and ritual, we can uncover what it is that pollutes the minds of our brethren. [warm] Thank you, friend - please accept these offerings in exchange for your find.
quest_8471_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have found one of the Winterfall furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but it seems to emanate an almost tangible sense of dread and despair. If many of the Winterfall furbolgs do indeed carry these, it certainly would go a long way in explaining their current condition.

[soft voice] One of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.
quest_8471_quest_progress: [solemn] <class> - you approach us in a peaceful manner, but I sense that you are here on matters that are grave and severe... for both furbolg and <race> alike. [soft voice] What have you come to tell us?
quest_8471_quest_complete:
[solemn] This thing... it is in the shape of a Winterfall Ritual Totem, but it has been twisted by forces I cannot begin to comprehend. Whatever taint that has set the Winterfall against us is surely present in this object.

[soft voice] Divine wisdom has brought both this and you to us, <name>. We will study this object intently; perhaps one day, the Winterfall will rage against us no longer.

[warm] Thank you, friend - please accept these offerings in exchange for your benevolence.
quest_8481_quest_detail:
<name>, thanks to you we have devised a way to summon forth the root of all evil for the Winterfall tribe - the corrupting demon that dominates them!

[commanding] Take this torch to the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's personal cave and plant it there. Doing so will force the demon to reveal itself and investigate. [urgent] This is when you and your allies must strike it down! [solemn] Only the essence of the fallen demon will begin the lengthy healing process of the Winterfall tribe... and the salvation of Timbermaw Hold.
quest_8481_quest_progress: [solemn] You have returned to us, <name>... [soft voice] does this mean that the demon has been slain?
quest_8481_quest_complete:
[excited] You've... you've saved us! [warm] Your defeat of the demon Xandivious has ensured the safety of Timbermaw Hold for years to come. [proud] You are truly a hero amongst our kind.

[gentle] Please, accept this with our blessing. [solemn] Though the healing process will be slow amongst the furbolgs - and the conflict will still go on - you have given the Winterfall something they never had before this day.

[delight] They have a chance at survival.
quest_8484_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, <name>. [soft voice] If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge. [solemn] In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance. [solemn] It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
quest_8485_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, <name>. [soft voice] If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

[solemn] Please - take this offering to the orcish warchief that resides in the lands of Durotar; I believe you call this city Orgrimmar. [solemn] In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Horde. [solemn] It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Horde's efforts in brokering peace.
quest_40089_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Foulweald have long since lost their minds, set into a state of delusion and ferocity. [pause] When the tribe began to lose itself, many set out toward the Crescent Grove to the south in hopes of escaping the madness. [sad] I placed my hopes in my people, but still, I lost them to insanity.

The furbolg who traveled to Crescent Grove may have sought refuge and a new place to call home, but they did not escape that which sent the Foulweald into madness. [solemn] They, too, have become aggressive, irrational, and uncaring for the world around them. [sad] Many of those I called friends, those I called family, went to the Groveweald, and they are nothing how I remember them.

[commanding] The Groveweald must be stopped. [urgent] Gather what mercenaries or fellow adventurers you can, and brave to the Crescent Grove. [emphasis] Slay them and gather their Groveweald Badges as proof of the deed. [solemn] You must do it for the good of the forest, and for the good of my people.
quest_40089_quest_progress: [hesitant] It pains me to ask, but have you gotten the badges?
quest_40089_quest_complete: [solemn] So... It is done then. [soft voice] I hope in peace they may finally be let free from their delusions.
quest_40090_quest_detail:
[solemn] The elders of the Foulweald were smart enough to leave once things had taken a turn for the worse. [soft voice] They helped lead the fleeing tribes of Furbolg into the Crescent Grove to the south. [pause] It is there that they slipped into madness and further drove the tribes under their watchful gaze into a deep craze. [solemn] They are seen as spiritual leaders, the word of truth, and a guide for the furbolgs there.

[low voice] Their delusions and madness have only spurred the Groveweald to become an ever-greater threat to those around them and have led to even more misery to nature in Ashenvale. [urgent] If the Groveweald is to be stopped, the Elders must cease their whisperings into the Grovetenders' ears. [hesitant] I doubt he will let you stop them, and he will also need to be destroyed. [commanding] Bring me the paw of Elder 'One Eye' and Elder Blackmaw as proof of their demise, and you shall be rewarded for ending this cycle of destruction.
quest_40090_quest_progress: [solemn] Have they been silenced? [soft voice] Have the whisperings of the elders ceased?
quest_40090_quest_complete: [solemn] It is a relief to know that the delusions these once wise elders spread have been halted. [soft voice] I hope they will find a better place in the afterlife.
quest_40743_quest_detail:
Winter. A time to eat, and eat well! [excited] I always love to try new foods and exchange cultural foods of my people with others.

[soft voice] Perhaps we can make a trade, yes? [soft voice] I would like to sample some of the foods of other races. You find some, and I will offer you a special dish in return.

[commanding] Gather for me a variety that my people and I may enjoy a feast, and I will make sure you are well rewarded for your seasonal spirit!
quest_40743_quest_progress: [soft voice] I sure am hungry, you find an assortment of food?
quest_40743_quest_complete:
<Chieftain Icepaw looks on with astonishment.> [warm] You really are a festive individual, I prepared some things for you upon the fire, a tray of our famous cookies here in Icepaw Village, I hope you enjoy them, they are fresh and right off the pan!

[excited] I will share these goods with the others in the village!
quest_40744_quest_detail:
[solemn] The year has come to an end, and with it, our celebrations. [soft voice] Our celebrations are met with exchanging gifts, for there is no better way to rejoice and share in one anothers company.

This year we are a bit light on wrapping paper, a very cheerful gnome delivered the last batch. It did last a few years, but we will need more before long, lest our holidays be ruined!

[excited] Maybe you know a place to retrieve wrapping paper?
quest_40744_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you got any wrapping paper for us?
quest_40744_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, the young ones will be pleased. I may be old, but celebrating the holiday is always the highlight of my year, and to wrap gifts for others is always a favorite past time.

[gentle] Here, take this, as a thanks from myself.
quest_40797_quest_detail: [solemn] The carving of a Furbolg has been riddled with sharp thorns and splinters of metal. They are gouged into its face, neck, and body. [soft voice] And yet, the carving can clearly be made out to have an almost childlike appearance. [hesitant] Was this someone's toy once? [pause] What were the Satyr doing with it?
quest_40797_quest_complete:
<He peaks his ears and snatches the effigy away. He is silent for several seconds, before mewling quietly.> [solemn] This was given to me when I was a mere cub, by my parents. We bless them to protect us, always. They are deeply personal, you only ever get one in life. [sad] I sensed something I was barely able to see snatch it away as I came to Forest Song for refuge! I have no idea what they were doing to it, or why. Sometimes it is best not to ask.

<Picking out the thorns, he hugs it to his chest and nods.>

[soft voice] You cannot know how much this means to me. I have very little, but I would have given everything away to keep this. [hesitant] So please, take... take.
quest_40891_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Barkskin Tribe was ruled by two elders. Myself, and Elder Growlheart, a rather seasoned and old warrior who rose to prominence from his aggressive nature and impactful speeches.

I do not blame the corruption of the Barkskin Tribe on any of its warriors, gardeners, or ursa. I blame it solely on Elder Growlheart. During his reign, he grew more and more hostile, leading to a culling of many I would have called dearest friends.

[urgent] Elder Growlheart must be killed if there is even a minor chance the Barkskin tribe can be recovered.[emphasis] You will notice him by his discolored fur. He acquired this look from his addiction to a tainted sap him and his most loyal consume.

You can find Barkskin village to the southwest, near the bottom of the Hyjal itself.
quest_40891_quest_progress: [solemn] I would advise caution, [soft voice] Barkskin Village is a place of great hostility and skilled ursa.
quest_40891_quest_complete:
[solemn] I can feel a weight leaving my shoulders knowing justice has been brought after so much horror. I have no doubt in my mind his most loyal allies fought and died alongside him.

[warm] Words enough cannot express my thanks to you. Please, take these items as a token of appreciation from myself.
quest_40892_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Barkskin Ursa were a group of the most loyal and fearsome warriors within the Tribe. It is they who gravitated to Growlheart and did his bidding.

The purge led to many deaths, and much suffering. All at the actions of the ursa, who carried out the desires of their master with little care for repercussions.

I bid you to travel to Barkskin Village, and hunt those that dispensed mindless murder. You can find Barkskin Village far to the south, near the foot of Hyjal.

[urgent] Bring me four Ursa Battlehammers as proof of your deed, and you will be rewarded.
quest_40892_quest_progress: [solemn] The ursa should not be taken easily <class>. [gentle] Take your time, and prepare for the coming battle with diligence.
quest_40892_quest_complete: [solemn] It eases an old mind to know such murderers have met their end, and paid for their actions. [soft voice] I wish I could have seen it myself. [warm] For your efforts, I offer you one Bright Dream Shard, once highly valued amongst my kind. [gentle] May you find some use for it.
quest_40893_quest_detail:
Nargg seeks vengeance upon other Barkskin for evil deeds. [angry] Barkskin slay many friends of Nargg, including father.

Tribe no longer what it was, it angry, and it evil. [solemn] Nargg asks you to do what Nargg cannot do. [commanding] Slay Barkskin and reclaim Barkskin Pendants, they can be found on any Barkskin Furbolg.
quest_40893_quest_progress: [urgent] You do what Nargg ask, you bring death to evil Barkskin?
quest_40893_quest_complete:
Nargg is pleased, Nargg is happy.

[angry] A fire still burns deep within, anger not sated. [warm] Take this, as thanks from Nargg.
quest_40894_quest_progress:
Nargg still seeks vengeance upon the Barkskin for what they have done. [angry] Barkskin slayed many friends of Nargg, and must pay!

[solemn] Tribe no longer what it was, it angry, and it evil. [commanding] Nargg ask you to do what Nargg cannot do. [urgent] Slay Barkskin and reclaim Barkskin Pendants, they can be found on any Barkskin Furbolg. Barkskin Pendant(10)
quest_40894_quest_complete:
Nargg is pleased, Nargg is happy.

[angry] A fire still burns deep within, anger not sated. [warm] Take this, as thanks from Nargg.
quest_40909_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Winterfall and Deadwood Tribes have already been lost to madness. [sad] Their hatred burns deep and already they have sent speakers to discuss an allegiance with the corrupt Barkskin. [solemn] I have no doubt in my mind it will only be a matter of time before they conspire against us.

[urgent] The Timbermaw cannot stand idle whilst corruption ties hostile factions together in unison. [commanding] I beseech you to travel deep into Barkskin Village to the southwest of here, near the bottom of the summit.

[commanding] Find and slay the Winterfall and Deadwood envoys both.
quest_40909_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you killed my corrupt brethren?
quest_40909_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am impressed, you have returned from the depths of Barkskin Village and done as I asked.

[gentle] Here, as thanks, please take this Bright Dream Shard, as well as this armor.
quest_41898_quest_detail:
[solemn] These verdant hills were once a friendly place where the Timbermaw and our allies the Blackroot conducted trade, and held great ceremonies.

[solemn] Ever since the Burning Legion returned to Azeroth, our former allies have been driven into madness, and now stalk the hills and fields. They have lost themselves to madness and can no longer be reasoned with.

[urgent] I must ask you to do what is necessary for our kind to continue, to cull the corruption that lingers here to keep safe the Timbermaw. Find their leader Grawlsh and slay him, as well as his twisted kin.
quest_41898_quest_progress: [solemn] Has the corruption been rooted out?
quest_41898_quest_complete: [solemn] It pains me to ask of such things... The Blackroot were once our friends and dearest allies. As much as it hurts to look upon familiar faces and see friends, it is good to know they are now free from the evil that gripped their hearts. [warm] You have done the Timbermaw proud, and for that, you shall be rewarded friend.
quest_41899_quest_detail: [solemn] I am here to give you quest, me big quest giver, me furbolg.
quest_41899_quest_progress: [solemn] There can be no peace with the Blackroot, they have sought our destruction ever since they have turned to madness. [soft voice] If you wish to get into the good graces of the Timbermaw, perhaps you can fight them on our behalf. [commanding] Gather ten of the totems they hold sacred, it is how I will track your deeds.
quest_41899_quest_complete: [solemn] More of the corruption has been cleansed. [soft voice] Each Blackroot that is slain is another step closer to having our race be pure of the vile taint that has cursed us so gravely. [warm] The Timbermaw is thankful for your efforts.
quest_41900_quest_detail: [solemn] Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. [soft voice] If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
quest_41900_quest_progress: [solemn] You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. [gentle] Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
quest_41900_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Tranquility. Able to guide ones movements with speed and grace. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

[warm] Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
quest_41901_quest_detail: [solemn] Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. [commanding] If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
quest_41901_quest_progress: [solemn] You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. [gentle] Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
quest_41901_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Communion. [soft voice] It can empower ones resistance to the natural world in order to seek guidance. [solemn] The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

[solemn] Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
quest_41902_quest_detail: [solemn] Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. [soft voice] If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
quest_41902_quest_progress: [solemn] You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. [gentle] Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
quest_41902_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Harmony. [soft voice] It can empower and embolden the roots of nature itself. [pause] The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

[warm] Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
quest_41903_quest_detail: [solemn] Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. [soft voice] If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
quest_41903_quest_progress: [solemn] You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. [warm] Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
quest_41903_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Kinship. [soft voice] It can revitalize the most broken of spirits, and raise morale. [solemn] The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

[proud] Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
quest_41904_quest_detail: [solemn] Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. [soft voice] If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
quest_41904_quest_progress: [solemn] You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. [gentle] Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
quest_41904_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Resilience. [soft voice] It can offer protection against the corruption and poison that dwells deep in the forests. [solemn] The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

[warm] Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.
quest_41930_quest_detail:
[solemn] You stand before Narkogg the Dark, speaker of the remaining Timbermaw of Ursolan. [sad] My brethren and I are splintered and on the brink of extinction. [solemn] Darkness has befallen Timbermaw Hold and we are powerless in front of the wave of corruption seeping out of its gates. [urgent] If we ever wish to rid it off its muck, then allies are what we desperately need. [hesitant] Will you and your kind be the ones to aid us in our endeavour? For that I need proof.

[commanding] Enter the tunnels of our old home and break through the gateway. [angry] Slay Karrsh the Sentinel; once a proud defender, now a maddened savage seeking nothing but blood. [urgent] His rampage needs to be stopped.
quest_41930_quest_progress: [solemn] It may not have been long since we escaped Timbermaw Hold, but the horrors inside evolve with rapid speed. [soft voice] Who knows what abhorrent creatures you will face inside?
quest_41930_quest_complete: [solemn] You have returned, with Karrsh’s pendant. [sad] His death is regrettable and saddens me deeply. [soft voice] To see a beacon of resilience and strength rot away in such a short amount of time is terrible. [warm] Thank you for releasing him of his pain.
quest_41931_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our vigil over the Wilds was always ancient, but ever since the second invasion of the Burning Legion, a foul sickness has been germinating within our most hallowed sanctum. [sad] Our tribesmen succumbed to the vile influence, one after another. [solemn] Now only we remain and it falls to us to liberate Timbermaw Hold from the clutches of evil. [urgent] Before we can cleanse our home for good, we first need to understand what we are dealing with. Studying it inside the caverns is far too dangerous, so we need a substitute instead.

[commanding] Return to Timbermaw Hold and gather the totems of the misguided shaman, with them we can find a way to battle the ailment plaguing my people.
quest_41931_quest_progress: [solemn] Unforeseen strength gathered within the Withermaw; their newfound power being too much for their bodies, causing them to tear apart.
quest_41931_quest_complete: [solemn] These totems are worse than I expected. [sad] The fumes they release are unbearable and simply touching them leaves burning marks upon my paws. [urgent] I will have to seal them away before we can deal with them properly.
quest_41932_quest_detail:
[solemn] Over the millennia that we have lived on Kalimdor, my people developed countless concoctions and salves for medicinal and spiritual healing. [soft voice] However, to cleanse these wicked totems, a wholly new mixture has to be created.

[gentle] In the lands blessed by the wilds, the place your kind calls Un’goro Crater, a beast by the name of Nemasra, laden with natural energies and powerful dew, resides. [emphasis] Rumor has it the river’s end in the northwest is its home. [commanding] Bring me its dewladen heart.

[solemn] On the southern shores of the Isle of Dread in Feralas you will find a primordial being, a sea giant from olden times. [sad] He held watch over the tides of the Veiled Sea, but has reached a point where his mind can’t discern between friend or foe anymore. [solemn] Lay him to rest and deliver me his tongue.

[urgent] The Vials of Purification lay with Tidelord Rrurgaz. [solemn] Once a relic of the night elves on ancient Kalimdor, it fell into the hands of the Shahraz naga who scheme on Alcaz Island, northeast of the shores of Dustwallow Marsh.
quest_41932_quest_progress: [urgent] My seal will not hold for long, <name>. [solemn] Please hasten your efforts.
quest_41932_quest_complete: [solemn] I am in awe at the power of these items. [urgent] With the beast’s heart, we will break the foul barrier around the totems. [soft voice] Grammon’s tongue will let them speak true and the waters of purification will wash away all impurities.
quest_41933_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems I underestimated the Withermaw. Whatever has taken hold in these totems is not only of demonic origin. [sad] I fear what we have is not enough to break the curse put on them.

<name>, if we want to succeed, we need to venture into Timbermaw Hold once more. [urgent] Deep within Timbermaw Village, the Grotto of Dreams lies. [whispering] Formerly used by our spiritualists for communion with the Emerald Dream, it now houses a sinister miasma. [sad] When we fled our old home, I abandonded my medicine pouch there. [hesitant] I need the implement found within to conjure a more fitting spell. [urgent] Furthermore, a sample of the defilement found within Timbermaw Hold. [whispering] Mixed into the salve, it will act as an antidote to the malediction inside the totems, if you will. [soft voice] Certainly you will find such a sample inside the many crevices found along the waterways inside.
quest_41933_quest_progress: [solemn] Timbermaw Village will be heavily guarded. Be best prepared, for the Withermaw have abandoned all morality.
quest_41933_quest_complete:
[solemn] What a hideous creation. Further proof that the life inside our great sanctum is rotting by the minute. [low voice] Yet still, it serves a purpose. It shall pave the way for the Timbermaw to reclaim what has been torn from us by cruel malefactors. [commanding] Now I can concoct a salve powerful enough to cleanse our sacred totems.

[solemn] <name>, this humble coven expresses its gratitude towards you. [warm] Through your courage, we have made the first step in purifying Timbermaw Hold. [urgent] Take this essence and use it on your delves into this den of evil. [confident] With enough of it, you may break the barrier inside and finally come to the root of it all.
quest_41934_quest_detail:
<name>, your loyalty and determination to our cause knows no bounds. With remarkable bravery have you faced the twisted Withermaw and stopped their machinations. The strength and willpower you and your allies displayed is exactly why it is you that I will ask of the impossible.

[solemn] As I explained to you before, Timbermaw Hold is a sacred site for all Furbolgs. It is where we venerate the remains of the Wild God Ursol, which we have guarded for millenia since his fall at the hands of the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancient. I was not present at his resting place when the Withermaw took over, yet I fear the body of the ancient guardian fell victim to the corruption.

[solemn] Courageous ally of ours, please return to Timbermaw Hold and see what has become of our great god. Should the foulness have taken control of his carcass, then… [pause] Gather your might and let him return to the Emerald Dream once more.
quest_41934_quest_complete:
[solemn] In our ancient teachings, there is a legend that connects all furbolg tribes. It speaks of our creation, as it is said the twin gods have brought us into the world as it was still young. [soft voice] As juvenile cubs they frolicked through the untouched wilds of Kalimdor, rolling around in the dewladen grass of the early mornings. Laughter filled the air and their unbound energy floated all around them. Bursting with their power, the droplets of the wet grass fell onto the roots of gigantic trees, seeping through the bark and becoming one with the land. Over time, these droplets grew and took the semblance of the young ursine gods.

[solemn] To us furbolgs there is nothing more important than aiding our progenitors in protecting the wild. [sad] Seeing Ursol die for a second time fills my heart with anguish and pain, a being as noble as him did not deserve this fate. [warm] <name>, the Timbermaw are forever in your debt. [urgent] Please take this powerful salve and cleanse the remaining corruption in Timbermaw Hold.
quest_41956_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greetings, <class>. My name is Nathok of the Timbermaw Tribe. Or atleast what’s left of it. [sad] We have been expelled from our ancestral home, Timbermaw Hold, by our fallen brethren, the Withermaw. [solemn] They befell a terrible darkness, one that crawled throughout northern Kalimdor for an insurmountable time now. [soft voice] Many have succumbed to it already, yet others still continue to fight against it. [pause] Long beforehand, the furbolg tribes were in steady communication with one another. [hesitant] However, now they’ve gone silent and we suspect the worst.

[urgent] We need to know which tribes are still yet free, and I would appreciate your aid. [solemn] From the ones we know of, we place the last of our hope on the Winterfall of Winterspring, the Greenpaw of Ashenvale and a small enclave of other Timbermaw furbolgs in the tunnels south of Moonglade. [commanding] Seek them out and let them know that the Timbermaw still stand as proud defenders of nature.
quest_41956_quest_progress: [solemn] Us Furbolg once roamed the enchanted forests of Kalimdor, tending to the wildlife and flora and maintaining their balance. [sad] But since the Legion’s second invasion, almost all of our brethren heed to call of darkness that those demons have left festering on our sacred Land of Stars.
quest_41956_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Greenpaw are beyond salvation? And our brothers’ enclave fights to free the Winterfall tribe from their dark shackles? [urgent] Time is truy running out. We have to make haste and reconcile with the other Timbermaw as quickly as possible.

<name>, [warm] thank you for showing us this ray of hope. [solemn] I will hold a discussion with the others and hopefully send a small envoy to our brothers and sisters up north soon. [proud] They shall not be left alone in this everlasting night.
quest_41957_quest_detail:
[solemn] We’re working tirelessly on ridding Timbermaw of the corruption, and your efforts are no doubt invaluable, yet still there is little progress in our mission. Instead of removing the dark influence, we are merely halting it spreading further through the hold. [hesitant] There has to be something we are missing, a crucial component we need to address if we want Timbermaw Hold to return to the welcoming home it once was.

[solemn] The Timbermaw of the Timbermaw Tunnels between Moonglade, Felwood and Winterspring told us how you were instrumental in eliminating the source of the Winterfall’s corruption, a demon named Xandivious. [soft voice] Let us convide in them and hope they have a clue on what could plague Timbermaw Hold still.
quest_41957_quest_complete: [solemn] It has been long, <name>. We have heard of your exploits inside Timbermaw Hold and are showing eternal gratitude for the sacrifices you have made for our people. [gentle] What you accomplished is not a natural given, others would have not shown such compassion to a race that isnt their own. [warm] Now tell me, what brings you to me?
quest_41958_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our brothers of Ursolan shared their findings with us not long ago, creating a holy salve to cleanse the corruption inside Timbermaw Hold is a wise decision. [pause] But it is not enough. Hidden deep inside is the true cause for the miasma taking hold over Kalimdor, yet we do not know what exactly it may be. The demon Xandivious was responsible for the Winterfall’s corruption, yet Narkogg described the sensation coming from the corruption as something not entirely demonic. [hesitant] I have a hunch on how we could get closer to the solution to this enigma, but for that, we need help.

<class>, consult Ysera’s Dragonflight. Not many of them are friendly to us, but some of them are willing to lend an ear to a mortal in need. Past the Great Sea, in the Swamp of Sorrows, a powerful green dragon has awoken from their Dream and awaits mortals like you and me. Perhaps it is for a different reason, but it very well may be for this purpose. [urgent] Seek them out and ask them about the Flute of Spirits.
quest_41961_quest_progress: [solemn] I have waited for your timely return. [soft voice] Tell me, has the Green Dragonflight been able to aid you in your quest?
quest_41961_quest_complete: [solemn] The myths were true. [soft voice] Such a powerful relic, thought to be lost in time. [emphasis] With it in my hand, I… I am certain we can discover what evil is behind all this misery befalling my people. [warm] <name>, thank you for your continued help, but don’t rest yet. [urgent] We still have much to do.
quest_41962_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were gone looking for the flute, I did my own research. I convened with Narkogg in the Maw of Ursoc and we devised a plan on how to unfold the corruption’s secrets.

On the island on which the Kaldorei planted the World Tree Teldrassil, an Ancient of remarkable age has rooted himself into the earth of Azeroth, Fangorn, Lord of Eternity. He stood there for eons on his everlasting watch over nature, even after the Night Elves planted the seed of Teldrassil. Someone as old and wise as him will hopefully be able to tell us what darkness resides within Timbermaw Hold.

Take this sealed totem with you. Awaken the Ancient with the Flute of Spirits and show him the totem. Before you go, there is one thing you should know. An ancient being such as him speaks a language long forgotten. You will surely not understand his words. I suggest you speak to the druids of Moonglade to learn his language.
quest_41964_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome back, <name>. [hesitant] Did you have any success with old Fangorn?
quest_41964_quest_complete: <Gorn trembles at the news you bring him. An angered growl bares his sharp fangs as he tries to compose himself.> Peroth’arn. Second hand of Xavius, the Satyr Lord. [solemn] There is no mistaking it. [low voice] This horn fragment and the Withermaw totems share the same kind of malignant energy. [soft voice] A vile mixture of demonic essences and… an unknown dread. [pause] Such a crushing presence, it is incredibly profane to even look at.
quest_41965_quest_detail:
[solemn] Do you remember the torch I crafted to expunge the demon Xandivious out of the Winterfall Chieftain’s cave? [urgent] If we want to draw out that despicable monster Peroth’arn out of hiding, then we will need such a torch again, but immensely more powerful. [commanding] For that, a purging flame is required.

[solemn] Deep beneath the earth’s crust lies the Molten Core. [low voice] Magma rivers and scalding stone fill the caverns, while fiery elementals spread chaos among themselves. [emphasis] In this place, a flame of greatest purity can be found. [solemn] Only a blaze of that intensity will be enough to ensure our plan is a success.

[commanding] Bring it and twenty logs of Star Wood to me. [urgent] Both are necessary to create a strong enough torch.
quest_41965_quest_progress: [solemn] Please remain cautious. The Molten Core is a treacherous place, and your allies cannot be prepared enough for the dangers inside.
quest_41965_quest_complete:
Marvelous! [delight] The purest of blazes, a primordial heartbeat resonates within this inconspicuous ball of flame. [solemn] No evil in this world or any other can hide from its revealing light.

<name>, it is time. [commanding] We will erase the darkness from within Timbermaw Hold once and for all.
quest_41966_quest_detail: [urgent] Quickly, there is little time to lose. Take the torch, gather your strongest allies and return to Timbermaw Hold. In the innermost sanctum of our god Ursol, place the illuminating beacon in the middle and ready yourself. [solemn] This demon possesses power beyond your imagination and you should respect his cruelty and cunning. [commanding] Obliterate this evil from Azeroth and the Emerald Dream! [defiant] This world does not belong to a vile monster such as him!
quest_41966_quest_progress: [urgent] You are back! Tell me, quickly! Were our plans successful? [excited] Are my people finally free?
quest_41966_quest_complete: <A torn look spreads across Narkogg’s face. At first you cannot discern it properly, but the wailing and sobbing coming from him affirm your suspicion: He is crying.> [solemn] After all these years of suffering and torment, my people can finally release a sigh of relief. [solemn] The corruption befalling most of our kind and one of our sacred gods has finally been quelled. [warm] All thanks to the valiant efforts of brave protectors like you. [warm] My words cannot properly convey the gratitude we have towards you and your kin. [warm] You will forever be welcome with the Timbermaw, as the cherished hero of the Furbolg.
quest_41991_quest_detail:
[low voice] Bah, this is taking longer than I expected. [sad] I had hoped I would be completed with my den by now, but there have been many holdups. [sad] I have been unable to build a stockpile of food, and I am familiar with the gnawing hunger of the hibernation season.

[hesitant] I cannot hunt or forage without risking precious time, and so I must ask you for assistance. [urgent] Venture out into the wild, and gather for me eight Moonwhisper Berry. [soft voice] They can be found from the local wildlife, or from the bushes beneath trees.
quest_41991_quest_progress: [solemn] So many things to do. [pause] Time always marching on.
quest_41991_quest_complete:
<Kralt lets out a huff of breath, a sigh of relief, his features easing from their aged stress.> [solemn] You have eased my burdens outsider, and for that I must thank you. [soft voice] My stockpile grows for the coming hibernation.

[gentle] Please, take this, as a sign to show you not all furbolg are lost in rage.
quest_42021_quest_progress: <name>, I have heard of your continued assault on the darkness dwelling within Timbermaw Hold. [solemn] It seems the salve I had created for you was not enough to quell the miasma. [soft voice] But fret not, as I am able to recreate the salve with a few ingredients. [commanding] Bring them to me, and we shall resume our fight against evil. Timbermaw SapEssence of Earth(2)Living Essence(2)
quest_42021_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done. [soft voice] While not as powerful as the original, this essence should be potent enough to douse the braziers spreading the Withermaw’s corruption throughout our sacred tunnels. [warm] If you require more, you know where to find me, brave adventurer.
quest_42022_quest_detail: [solemn] The fetid hide of Ursol is all you could rescue of the fallen god’s carcass. [soft voice] Torn and ridden with maggots, you decide to bring it to the furbolg of Ursolan, so that they may cleanse the only remains of their progenitor god.
quest_42022_quest_progress:
[solemn] Is this what they have done to our great god? Rotted him from the inside out, defiling his magnificent pelt and body? [sad] I dare not think about the agony he must’ve endured during his torment. [warm] A relief to hear you have dealt with the traitors and have punished them justly.

[solemn] The pelt of Ursol may be tainted, but with the purification salve Narkogg is brewing, we can cleanse it from the impurities. [urgent] Bring it to me, and it shall be done.
quest_42022_quest_complete: [solemn] For your acts for furbolgkind, you shall be rewarded honorably: A piece of armor to your liking handcrafted with the cleansed hide, so that you may walk the wilds under Ursol’s blessing, continuing his legacy in fighting for the world he loved so much. [warm] Your presence here will remain welcoming in our retreat, as long as you remain true to our cause. [gentle] Tread safely, <name>.
quest_42023_quest_detail:
[solemn] For many years have we furbolgs revered the gods of nature, with the Twin Gods Ursol and Ursoc at the center of our worship. [soft voice] To honor their sacrifices to our world, the greatest shaman of our tribe wore a spiritual garment, spirited armor said to be in tune with the Wild Gods. [solemn] Now they’re lost in the tunnels of Timbermaw, either in possession of the Withermaw or their corrupted fiends.

[solemn] The ritualistic headdress grants a link to the wisdom of the natural spirits, enlightening those wearing it to make the right decisions to the betterment of all. [warm] Bring me the headdress and some materials, and I will fashion it anew so that it may aid you in your quest to liberate Timbermaw Hold.
quest_42023_quest_progress: [solemn] Your contributions will be rewarded tenfold.
quest_42023_quest_complete: [solemn] There you have it, friend. [soft voice] Can you feel the spiritual energy coursing through? [emphasis] Those inexperienced will tremble at its might. [warm] So please, make good use of it against the foes of darkness.
quest_42024_quest_detail:
[solemn] For many years have we furbolgs revered the gods of nature, with the Twin Gods Ursol and Ursoc at the center of our worship. [soft voice] To honor their sacrifices to our world, the greatest shaman of our tribe wore a spiritual garment, spirited armor said to be in tune with the Wild Gods. [solemn] Now they’re lost in the tunnels of Timbermaw, either in possession of the Withermaw or their corrupted fiends.

[solemn] The ritualistic mantle is adorned with lanterns and heavy drapes hanging over the shoulders of our spiritualists. [soft voice] With them, they symbolically carry the burdens of our forefathers, as well as the uncertainties of the future. [commanding] Bring me the mantle and some materials, and I will fashion it anew so that it may aid you in your quest to liberate Timbermaw Hold.
quest_42024_quest_progress: [solemn] Your contributions will be rewarded tenfold.

[soft voice] To honor their sacrifices to our world, the greatest shaman of our tribe wore a spiritual garment, spirited armor said to be in tune with the Wild Gods. [solemn] Now they’re lost in the tunnels of Timbermaw, either in possession of the Withermaw or their corrupted fiends.

[gentle] The ritualistic tunic wraps itself around its wearer like a mother’s warm cradle. [soft voice] Just as nature offers its plentiful bounties to those cherishing and preserving it. [gentle] With it, the shaman becomes one with the breath of life whispering throughout nature’s forests. [urgent] Bring me the tunic and some materials, and I will fashion it anew so that it may aid you in your quest to liberate Timbermaw Hold.
