quest_50326_quest_detail:
Grizzlore - me! [angry] I want more booze! <hick!>

Thunder… <hick!> …brew! Lager… <hick!>

Grimbooze brews it well. You go there. [urgent] Westfall! <hick!>
quest_50326_quest_progress: [solemn] Westfallen Dagger Hills is where Grimmbooze brews his lager… [hesitant] hey, you have it?
quest_55032_quest_detail:
[solemn] My people have been reduced to madness, insanity and a bloodlust for riddled fever dreams of nothingness.

[soft voice] It is like a shadow clouds their minds, and blocks all clarity from being perceived.

[hesitant] Do you know the pain of not knowing those you once knew? To look upon the face of a friend and recognize nothing from them but utter savagery as if they were speaking a foreign language?

[sad] My kin are lost, and it hurts me greatly to admit that I no longer have a home within these forests. [pause] Something must be done to stop the madness, and to end it all.

[commanding] Travel to the Greenpaw Village just south of here, and rid my once home of the Foulweald Shamans that lurk there. [threatening] They are nothing of what they once were, and perpetuate the horrors.
quest_55032_quest_progress: [solemn] If nothing is done, my friends and kin will slay the innocent senselessly. [urgent] It must be done...
quest_55032_quest_complete: [solemn] It pains my soul to imagine it has come to this, [pause] it feels as if there is no light left within this once beautiful forest. [soft voice] I thank you for easing the troubled minds, [pause] maybe they can find clarity in the afterlife. [warm] Take this, [pause] I will need it no longer.
quest_80369_quest_detail:
[gentle] Ah, you have made your way back once more, <name>. [warm] That is simply splendid, for I may have another task for you.

[soft voice] Nestled far in the south lies a coven of supremely ferocious creatures known as Owlbeasts. [solemn] The place of their dwelling, known as Owl Wing Thicket, is renowned for being the home of a particularly bizarre herb.

[hesitant] Might I trouble you to kindly gather me around twenty of these precious plants? [urgent] The Owlbeasts should have them on their person as a light snack.
quest_80369_quest_progress: [soft voice] Has your hunt gone well?
quest_80369_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, excellent. Give me but a moment to concoct a brew. [gentle] Give it a taste.
quest_40532_quest_complete: [solemn] Another comes to speak with me, [soft voice] you wish to prove yourself, do you think you're strong enough? [pause] These are all questions one must ask themselves before they approach me, for I am not one that you should dissappoint.
quest_40533_quest_detail: [solemn] If you wish to truly grow, orc, you must heed my advice as many before have. [soft voice] When you are ready to listen to my tale, speak with me, and I will tell you what I know, so that maybe you may learn a thing or two in your journies.
quest_40533_quest_complete: [solemn] Another comes to speak with me, [soft voice] you wish to prove yourself, do you think you're strong enough? [pause] These are all questions one must ask themselves before they approach me, for I am not one that you should dissappoint.
quest_40534_quest_detail:
[solemn] You listen, and listen well, perhaps you are worthy after all. [solemn] I have one final challenge for you, one to prove that you are truly worthy of my power. [commanding] I challenge you to combat, show me your abilities, and show me your strength.

[low voice] If you truly have the strength to defeat me, and can take my advice in heed, you will truly embody my spirit, and I will grant you my gift.

[urgent] If you think you are worthy enough to challenge me, speak with me once more. [emphasis] Make sure you are ready, for I will not hold back.
quest_40534_quest_progress: [solemn] Do you truly think you are ready?
quest_40534_quest_complete: [solemn] Well orc, you are stronger then I had anticipated, and carry all the traits of the wolf, I am honored to bless you with my power. [warm] May it bring you great power in the hunt, and strike terror into your enemies.
quest_40975_quest_detail:
<The phantom begins to phase into reality, a howling of wind heard as it begins to speak.> [solemn] In life my name was Karl Glaymore, my family was one of prominence within Gilneas. [sad] Now, we are nothing, all of us removed from the world of the living.

We were tried for conspiracy, all of us, for claims that held no merit. [angry] My children were butchered one by one by that cruel Judge Sutherland. [threatening] His judgements passing with each swing of the gavel.

We were set to be examples, and now I am here to haunt this existence, to fester in anger...

[urgent] Bring me peace. Find Judge Sutherland in Gilneas City, and end his life. [low voice] I will know when the deed is done.
quest_40975_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, I am at peace, once and for all.

[soft voice] I can feel the nether claiming the lingering essence of my spirit. It is my time to go, and rest.

[warm] I have left an item for you, as thanks for everything you have done. <The phantom begins to fade.>
quest_5481_quest_detail:
[commanding] Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

[soft voice] When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
quest_41681_quest_detail:
Wiggles smells master on fleshy–fleshy help Wiggles? Wiggles find smelly orc, uerk! [groan] UERGH! Very smelly orc.

Smelly orc hide under tent next to catapult. [shouting] WOOSH–DONK–BONK! Big stone crash, destroy Wiggles. [sad] Wiggles sad. No more Wiggles if big stone crash! [sobbing] BONK BONK WIGGLES GONE!

Fleshy go, Wiggles stay?
quest_41681_quest_complete: [solemn] Fleshy return with smelly orc. [commanding] Wiggles carry back to master. [urgent] Smelly lost this, fleshy keep. [sad] Bye fleshy.
quest_40679_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mosshide was once strong tribe, ruled strong, was strong!

[angry] No longer, mosshide fight with no purpose, bicker, fight-fight. [sad] I was once Mosshide pack leader, then they kick me out, send me away! [urgent] I here again, but I become leader, I reunite tribe-tribe, you help yes? [commanding] Bring me Mosshide Armband from gnolls, twelve, yes yes!
quest_40679_quest_complete: [solemn] Gowlfang is rightful leader, [proud] Gowlfang strong, [excited] you help Gowlfang!
quest_40680_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many alpha Mosshide run many smaller groups, these groups fight eachother, and cause problem-problem.

[commanding] These Mosshide leader must be killed so that Gowlfang can rule! [urgent] You can find alpha Mosshide to the west near place called Saltspray Glen, go there, track alpha, kill Alpha! [proud] After, only one alpha left, Gowlfang!
quest_40680_quest_progress: [angry] They killed-killed? [urgent] You slay alpha for Gowlfang?
quest_40680_quest_complete: [solemn] Gowlfang is one true alpha, [commanding] Gowlfang lead-lead soon!
quest_40681_quest_detail:
[solemn] Cursed Sagepaw, he was one who exiled me, sent me away, let me rot in small goblin town called Sparkwater, now I come back, and I get last laugh-laugh!

<Gowlfang cackles wickedly and begins to snarl.>

[angry] You find Sagepaw, you kill-kill him, kill-kill Sagepaw good!

[commanding] When Sagepaw dead, no one stand between me and lead-lead Mosshide, me become strong!

[urgent] You find Sagepaw south, near big waterfall, go and kill-kill!
quest_40681_quest_complete: [delight] Gowlfang happy, you kill enemy, Gowlfang now able to lead!
quest_40682_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My job keep gnolls safe, I defend, I fight, and I watch-watch!

[solemn] Long ago raptor almost made Mosshide extinct, now raptor growing in number, many raptor nearby, could be end of Mosshide tribe if not careful, Dagdag can not fight against that.

[urgent] Raptor Ridge is where they breed-breed, they are strong there, but maybe you stronger?

[commanding] Travel east to Raptor Ridge, and fight Razormaw raptors, bring me Razormaw Talon as proof you kill-kill to keep us safe, yes?
quest_40682_quest_progress: [commanding] Razormaw strong, they kill-kill quick, you must be quick-quick too!
quest_40682_quest_complete: [excited] Razormaw no match for <name>, you strong-strong, and quick-quick, one day Dagdag be like you.
quest_40683_quest_detail:
[urgent] Always problem-problem for Mosshide, first with Raptor, now with dragon! Every day-day more and more dragon whelps roam the countryside, so many that it is hard to properly walk the land without worrying about dragon fire!

[angry] Bogpaw need valuable herb-herb, and many of my good spots are now crowded with dragon!

[commanding] Go kill whelp-whelp for Bogpaw, let Bogpaw get good spot again. You find dragon whelp to southeast, now go-go!
quest_40683_quest_complete: [excited] Bogpaw Truthsay thank you for work-work, less dragon means more good spot for herb!
quest_41750_quest_detail: <The gnoll is slobbering in unbridled rage, his fangs bared and the air coming out of his nuzzle is visible in the humid air of the swamp.> Betrayer! Gowlfang big betrayer! [angry] Left with shaman Bogpaw. Is now leading the Mosshides, without us! [urgent] Helped Gowlfang, were loyal. Now we here to die, all alone! [threatening] Betrayer went with powerful green-skinned warriors. To the southeast, entered the mountains into a cave, a big cave! [commanding] Grimbite wants the head of Betrayer! [urgent] Follow them, into the home of green warriors who command fire-breathing lizards!
quest_41750_quest_progress: [urgent] Where is the head?! [angry] Head of Betrayer?!
quest_41750_quest_complete: <You don't have much time to react as you hand Grimbite the head of Gowlfang. With untamed wrath and hate, the gnoll tears the head out of your hand, before viciously biting into it, ravaging it into an unrecognizable state. After he is done, he tosses what is left into the near bog, letting it sink to the ground of the swamp. A yowling scream escapes Grimbite's jaw, the other gnolls follow suit. The howling persists for a few moments, echoing throughout all of the Wetlands.> [excited] Gowlfang is dead! [warm] Mosshide now truly free! [proud] You member of Mosshide, forever. [warm] Take this, for killing Betrayer.
quest_55035_quest_detail:
[excited] You did Gowlfang good-good, no other gnoll ever do for me like that before! [warm] I give you gift show that Mosshide good gnoll, strong gnolls!

[soft voice] I bury-bury chest in hollowed out tree at bottom of dam, should be still there unless someone steal, you find, treasure for you, Gowlfang no need what inside, all for you.
quest_55035_quest_progress: [soft voice] Within the hollowed out tree you see a small pile of muck that is oddly formed.
quest_55035_quest_complete: [soft voice] You notice something glinting within the muck, this must be what Gowlfang had spoken of. [warm] Upon searching further, you claim your reward.
quest_40201_quest_progress: [solemn] It is not often I have visitors. [soft voice] What can I assist you with?
quest_40201_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, Malos and I have spoken on occasion. He has been studying the corruption of nature for some time now, and has even offered his assistance in understanding and, perhaps someday, reversing the corruption of my kind.

[soft voice] He is a good and kind soul, and if he needs my help, then I will do whatever is in my power.
quest_40202_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a shadow that lurks unseen in the forests of Teldrassil, a tainted air that hangs like an acrid pall over the seemingly pristine glades. It has twisted and corrupted my sisters, making them distempered and aggressive. [soft voice] Malos assures me his research may lead to a cure for my sisters.

The treant Malos speaks of I have seen meandering the forests below here, withered, twisted, and enraged. [solemn] A haunting visage it possesses, its mind tainted by the very darkness that has touched my sisters. [commanding] You should be able to find it walking along the eastern edge of the Wellspring Lake.

Go and bring this news to Malos. [soft voice] I hope that I have been of aid to him in return for his kindness.
quest_397_quest_complete: [soft voice] Master says give gift to <name>. [hesitant] Zggi wants to keep nice gift but Zggi knows better than to betray Master.
quest_7601_quest_complete: [excited] Oh boy, here we go again.
quest_7602_quest_detail:
[urgent] If you're going to reanimate Kroshius, you're going to need Fel fire. [soft voice] I can make Fel fire but it's going to require some components.

You need to bring me flawless Fel essences from three distinct regions of the world.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara will have the first essence type; the Jaedenar legionnaires of Jaedenar the second type and the felguard sentries of the Blasted Lands the third.

[commanding] Bring me back one of each essence type and I will create the Fel fire, allowing you to reanimate Kroshius.
quest_7602_quest_progress: [whispering] Don't tell anyone this but Niby is daft.
quest_7602_quest_complete: [urgent] Give me a minute and I'll combine the essences into Fel fire.
quest_7603_quest_detail:
[solemn] Kroshius lays in a heap to the northeast, in the Shatter Scar Vale. [urgent] Take this Fel fire and use it on his remains. The fire should reanimate the fallen infernal.

[threatening] At this point, I fully expect him to kill you and any friends that you may have brought along - and trust me, you will want to bring along some friends.

[soft voice] If by some miracle you happen to kill Kroshius, take his infernal core and return it to Niby.
quest_8420_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Maybe this sounds strange coming from an imp, but I'd like a pet of my own. I really would. [sad] It's just not fair that Niby gets me and I get nothing!

In fact, it doesn't even need to be a living pet. I'd need something to start making it with, like some felcloth. The satyrs here in Felwood sometimes have felcloth, so you'd just have to kill enough of them until you find some. [hesitant] That doesn't sound so bad, does it?
quest_8420_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow! You are too kind. Especially for a <class>!

<Impsy holds the felcloth to his face.>

[soft voice] Oh how I love the feel of it, the way it burns your skin and weaves evil thoughts through the mind...
quest_8421_quest_detail:
Now that I have my felcloth, I can really begin making *my* pet.

[soft voice] It's going to need some eyes though. Perhaps you could rip some rotting wood from the irontree folk for me, so I can carve out some lovely eyes. They're up north in the Irontree Woods.

[urgent] I'll also need some bloodvenom essence to give it that new demon smell. The tainted oozes carry the essence, and they hang out right here near Niby and me.
quest_8421_quest_complete: [excited] This will work so very well.
quest_8422_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My pet is almost done. [whispering] Now I just need something to stuff it with.

[solemn] Only the voodoo feathers from the trolls in the sunken temple will do. They go by the names Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. [angry] Kill them. Kill them all.

[commanding] This is no trivial task <name>, so I'll make it worth your while by giving you something of Niby's -- he probably doesn't need it anyhow.
quest_8422_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you bring the feathers? [soft voice] This doll needs stuffed!
quest_8422_quest_complete:
[warm] Wonderful, now my pet is complete!

<Impsy quickly stuffs the doll and gives it a demonic hug.>

[soft voice] Oh, what an odd side effect these voodoo feathers have...
quest_1056_quest_complete: [solemn] Alas, you arrive. [soft voice] I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits...
quest_1057_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.

[soft voice] You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.

[solemn voice] The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.

[urgent] Drive the wretched harpies out, <name>!
quest_1057_quest_progress:
[solemn] There is much work to be done before the Charred Vale can be restored to the lush forest it once was.

[urgent] Clear the area of those foul menaces, <name>! [commanding] Only then can we begin to reclaim what belongs to nature.
quest_1057_quest_complete: [solemn] Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, [soft voice] perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
quest_1059_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Bloodfuries have been subdued. [pause] But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.

[soft voice] Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. [pause] If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.

[solemn voice] This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.

[urgent] Send word of our need! [urgent] Seek him out at once!
quest_7044_quest_progress: [solemn] I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...
quest_7044_quest_complete: [solemn] Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.
quest_7046_quest_detail:
[solemn] My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.

[soft voice] For the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.

[excited] Together, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!
quest_7046_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you wish to restart the ritual, please abandon our first attempt and then speak to me again.
quest_7046_quest_complete:
[solemn] Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. [gentle] Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. [urgent] Much danger awaits you, <name>.

[solemn] Speak with me again should the need arise.
quest_7065_quest_detail: [solemn] In the depths of Maraudon lives a creature of chaos and evil, <name>. [soft voice] Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related somehow to the Old Gods. [pause] Ages ago, she was sought out by Zaetar, first son of Cenarius. [pause] The offspring of their... relationship are the creatures known as centaur. [hesitant] Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now Theradras keeps his remains. [solemn] My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
quest_7065_quest_progress:
[solemn] I feel the weight of imposing my plea on the mortal races, but we are left with no other options. The races of Azeroth have proven without a doubt they can overcome such things when they work together, so it is to them I ask for help.

[soft voice] I only hope it is enough.

[solemn] Zaetar, brother to Remulos, brought many pains to this world, and ultimately it caused his own death. There is a lesson there to all of us if we are wise enough to see it.
quest_7065_quest_complete:
[delight] This is most wonderful news, <name>! [warm] Thank you!

[solemn] Although it concerns me that you were not able to bring back Zaetar's remains, who am I to question the will of Cenarius' first born. [soft voice] Perhaps now the will of the centaur will break and their thirst for blood will lesson--we can only hope.

[confident] If successful in our mission, I was given these items to reward any who aided us. [warm] You may choose one as a token of thanks.
quest_7066_quest_detail:
[solemn] The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.

Look around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.

But there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. [soft voice] I am sure he will understand.
quest_7066_quest_progress:
[solemn] You have the scent of corruption on you, <name>... much like many adventurers these days. [soft voice] But something about you is different. Is there something you've come to speak to me about? You have an aura about you that seems familiar, but I cannot place it.

[gentle] Please, I implore you, tell me why you've sought an audience with me.
quest_7066_quest_complete:
[solemn] So my brother has finally found peace? [proud] I am proud to have lived to see this day. In all his arrogance and anger, I truly thought he was lost to us, but this... [soft voice] this symbol of his sacrifice only proves that he is not lost--he has only been reborn. [solemn] He takes his place in nature as was his duty.

[gentle] Thank you, <name>. [warm] By bringing this to me, you have secured a small amount of hope that I thought I had once lost. [soft voice] This seed will be important to the people of this war-torn land some day... [solemn] I can sense it.
quest_8446_quest_detail:
[solemn] Corruption seeps from this object.

[soft voice] There may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. [pause] You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. [hesitant] Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.
quest_8446_quest_complete: [solemn] I must remove the taint from this object. [soft voice] This may shed some light on my recent failures to delve into the Dream. [commanding] Give it to me.
quest_8447_quest_detail: [solemn] The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. [soft voice] Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, <name>.
quest_8447_quest_complete: [solemn] Take his ring, <name>. [soft voice] It has served its purpose for Malfurion. [solemn] It shall now serve a new purpose for you...
quest_8734_quest_complete: [solemn] It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. [soft voice] His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. [solemn] He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. [emphasis] To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. [pause] The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...
quest_8735_quest_detail: [solemn] You must travel to the four dream portals of Azeroth. [soft voice] From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. [urgent] The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. [commanding] Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
quest_8735_quest_complete: [solemn] Are you prepared? [solemn] Is the world prepared for what we are about to invoke? [hesitant] I do not know... [solemn] I am bound by duty to Malfurion. [solemn] Duty and honor...
quest_8736_quest_detail:
[solemn] We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.

Tyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.

[urgent] Be on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.
quest_8736_quest_complete:
[solemn] He is redeemed, <name>. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father.

[warm] These armaments are for you, <name>; given to me by Ysera herself. [commanding] You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.
quest_8741_quest_detail: [solemn] The keeper awaits your return, <name>. [soft voice] Take the green scepter shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
quest_41340_quest_progress: <name>! [solemn] Arch Druid Dreamwind informed me about what transpired on Mount Hyjal. [soft voice] Do you have the dream shards with you?
quest_41340_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <class>. [soft voice] Seeing you complete this task so quickly reassures me to not be doubtful of what I will be asking of you. [pause] You may be unaware, but my brethren and I are Malorne's scions. [solemn] It was his union with the Moon Goddess Elune that bore life to our father Cenarius - and he in turn created us. [solemn] This is not only a concern for the safety of Mount Hyjal or even to my family, but also to all of Azeroth.
quest_41341_quest_detail:
[solemn] Malorne cannot fall to the Nightmare. Luckily for us, it appears only a fragment of himself split from his spirit in the Emerald Dream, which is what the Nightmare took control of. Yet even a fraction of the Waywatcher is enough for it to gain an insurmountable advantage in this war already stacked against us. To cleanse grandfather of this taint, we require relics reminding him of his kin.

[soft voice] The Bough of Cenarius is a piece of my father's antlers. After his fall in Ashenvale, we brought his body to Bough Shadow, before returning him to the Moonglade for burial. Perhaps you can find it amongst the dragonkin there.

[solemn] Ysera is a dear friend of Malorne and foster mother to our father. A scale of her jade skin would certainly help our cause. Her most favored children all possess one. Unfortunately, most if not all of them dwell in the Emerald Dream.

[solemn] Lastly, a remembrance of Elune. Her chosen guardians, the Moonkin, hold many of her artifacts in Winterspring, search for them there.
quest_41341_quest_progress: [solemn] A noble being like Malorne, whose love and care for nature precedes anything we know, must be protected.
quest_41341_quest_complete: [solemn] Setting eyes upon these powerful trinkets reminds mortals like you of the forces present in this world. [soft voice] While they may be beyond one's comprehension, do not underestimate your role in all of this. [warm] Mortals have proven themselves time and time again to be vital in the alteration of fate on Azeroth. [solemn] Everything you do has its consequences, either immediate or eventually.
quest_41342_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here, young one, take this Scepter of Remembrance, conjured from the relics and dream shards you have brought to me. With it, you will be able to withstand the Nightmare long enough to pry Malorne's fragment from its grasp.

[soft voice] Nevertheless, be cautious. It is doubtful the Nightmare will let go of its prey so easily. Gather allies and like minded individuals and save my grandfather's spirit.

[urgent] Make haste, lest he manages to manifest himself in our world.
quest_41342_quest_progress: [solemn] Don't fret, use all your might to vanquish the Nightmare's influence.
quest_41342_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is finished. The fear weighing heavy on my heart is fading after hearing from your valiant deeds. Using my ability to gaze into the Emerald Dream, I will return this fragment back to my grandfather. Simply holding it makes me feel his radiant and powerful aura once more.

[soft voice] It will take a considerable amount of time for him to regain his full strength, however Ysera and his fellow Wild Gods are at his side, protecting their beloved friend and mentor.

[solemn] Your devotion to the White Stag and his legacy is commendable. To honor your heroic and selfless nature, let me offer you the teachings to shift into Malorne's stag form itself.
quest_41396_quest_detail:
<name>, please halt for a moment. [solemn] Just now, I felt a surge of energy from my grandfather's spirit fragment. [soft voice] A welcoming warmth, one I missed for many millennia. [pause] That is not all, though. [hesitant] It is difficult to understand, but I feel the great Malorne is trying to communicate with us - with you. [urgent] I can feel the urgency in his presence. [solemn] It can't be any other way: Malorne wishes to put his blessing on you, I am certain of it.

To receive grandfather's blessing, it is imperative you are in tune with the Emerald Dream, just as I am. [solemn] However, aligning yourself with Ysera's realm is a task only veteran druids succeed in after years of meditation. [pause] Yet still, there is another way. [gentle] For that, preparation is required. [warm] Aid me, <name>, and I shall pave the way for you to gain Dreamsight.

First, we need a dreamveil, woven from dreamhide and dreamthread. [emphasis] Furthermore, viridian mushrooms, drenched in Dream energy. [soft voice] Find these at Jademir Lake in Feralas. [commanding] Lastly, bring me plentiful potions of dreamless rest.
quest_41396_quest_progress: [solemn] It may be within my abilities to peer into the Emerald Dream, but those boons only affect myself - it cannot sadly be used for others. [soft voice] Fret not, however. [warm] I will assist you wherever I can.
quest_41396_quest_complete: [soft voice] These will do just fine. [soft voice] Alongside these potent mushrooms, I can create an exceptionally powerful dreamveil for you. [solemn] Without it I fear you may be pulled into the Dream prematurely, without ever being able to return. [urgent] Now brace yourself, <name>. [solemn] For you to be granted Dreamsight, you will be seeking an audience with one of the oldest green dragons known to Azeroth.
quest_41397_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the gift of Dreamsight, an ancient ability of the green dragons, you may be able to see through the Dream's curtain and commune with grandfather directly. Among the Green Dragonflight was once a kind paragon, Vithekus, who was particularly fond of the mortal races. Known as the Eternal Sleeper, he entered an endless meditation and eventually left his physical body behind before anchoring his spirit to the Dream. He is the one you need to speak with. Find his remains and light this incense I created with the leftover mushrooms, it should allow you to summon his spirit.

[soft voice] The last time I saw Vithekus was well before the Sundering, so I do not know where his remains lie in the current age. Yet the woods whisper a name - Seradane. Seek this place and I am certain you shall find Vithekus. Do not forget to wear the Dreamveil! Its protection might not be strong, but it should suffice for your conversation with Vithekus.
quest_41397_quest_progress: [solemn] It concerns me to not have heard of Vithekus for so long. [soft voice] I wish for his safety, the Dream is no longer the sanctuary that it used to be.
quest_41397_quest_complete:
I see. [solemn] As solemn as it is, Vithekus' disdain is understandable. [soft voice] An ancient being like himself can all so easily be swayed from his benevolence after witnessing the misdeeds of mortals throughout the eons. [pause] Still I had hoped he would continue to see the potential your people hold.

[solemn] Nevertheless, knowing he can be reasoned with and did not fall victim to the Nightmare lifts a burdening worry from my heart.
quest_41398_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time, friend. Now that you are able to gaze into the Dream itself, you may pay reverence to my grandfather - and receive the boon he intends to place upon you. While you were gone, I returned Malorne's spirit fragment back to him. He is complete once more, albeit still weak. Under much strain he informed me about the place he plans to meet you. I implore you, do not let him wait. We may have weakened the Nightmare's influence, but it would be unlikely for such a force to give up its prey that easily.

[solemn] <name>, stand proud, as your deeds and commitment to this world's balance are exceptional. Being a chosen recipient of the Waywatcher's blessing is an honor like no other. Now venture into the Twilight Grove yonder the Great Sea. Peer into the Dreamsight Gem atop the stone ramp and bask in the White Stag's radiant grace.
quest_42042_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our brothers and sisters of the Grove of the Moon have begun treading a misguided path towards destruction. [soft voice] They have abandoned Cenarius' teachings, desecrated his enclaves and endangered countless other peaceful druids. [solemn] As a warden of nature, I cannot let this transgression pass.

<name>, [urgent] the intruders have laid claim to Elun'aran and the temple above, pillaging its sacred ruins for powerful artifacts. [commanding] Stop them and return to me afterwards.
quest_42042_quest_progress: [solemn] Whatever they hold in higher regard than my father Cenarius, it must be immensely powerful.
quest_42042_quest_complete: [solemn] It pains me it had to come to this, but their delusions have brought them too far away from redemption. [soft voice] For the sake of nature and its inhabitants, they had to return to the cycle.
quest_60135_quest_detail:
[solemn] While my mission here is focused on the centaur, it is my duty as a Keeper to heal the world wherever it may suffer.

[soft voice] Southwest of here, there is a spirit in this land that cries out in pain. She had no name in life, but the Tauren know her spirit as Palkeote - “grey mother”, in their tongue.

[solemn] Palkeote lost one of her sons in this land long ago, before the sundering of the world. Yet she would not leave his side. She remained here for many long years, as the trees grew and the world changed around her, until at last she too passed at the side of her beloved child.

[solemn] She remains here as a restless spirit. The long years of her life and her dedication to her single task make her mighty, but she has long passed from the warmth of love for kin. [urgent] You will need many allies to lay her to rest, hero, but that is what I ask you to do.
quest_60135_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you found the grey mother?
quest_60135_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <race>! [solemn] At long last, Palkeote is at peace. You have done a great service today, and the beasts of this land know it in their own way.

[gentle] Such an effort should be rewarded.
quest_41343_quest_detail:
<race>, here? Please, no kill. No kill Big Whiskers! [shouting] Big Whiskers here by mistake. Big Whiskers called by weird see through human. Big Whiskers just want leave. But Big Whiskers can’t leave. No. Big Whiskers first needs BIG CANDLE!

Big candle very important to Big Whiserks and his friends. Yes, yes. [soft voice] Big Whiskers give reward, reward, yes! Bring Big Whiskers big candle. Please?

Ask Doorman, Doorman must know!
quest_41344_quest_complete: [excited] Big candle for Big Whiskers! [solemn] My mission in this scary place is finished. [warm] Big Whiskers gives you this as thanks. [delight] Very fun book, look!
quest_40162_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello! My name is Smallgill. I was once among the murlocs, up until we came here, and they allied with the slithery naga! [threatening] They go by the name Deeptide now, and attack any who come near. [angry] They even stole my necklaces!

[angry] Those were mine, that I made, and that I gave to friends, and they stole each and every one of them! [sad] I tried to ask nicely but they attacked me, and now I want them back by any means.

[hesitant] Could you please, oh very please get me my necklaces back? I don't need all of them, just a few! Maybe six? [soft voice] I know that the other murlocs around here have them, so make sure you ask nicely.
quest_40162_quest_progress: [hesitant] Any luck with getting back my Shell Necklace's?
quest_40162_quest_complete: [angry] They had it coming for stealing all of my stuff and being so mean to me! [warm] Thanks for getting some of them back, it means a lot, here, for the hard work, one for you!
quest_40540_quest_detail: [solemn] As you walk across the shore, you notice something out of the ordinary. [soft voice] A murloc tadpole, left alone in the reeds. [sad] It looks malnourished. [gentle] You should feed it. [soft voice] It probably likes turtle meat.
quest_40540_quest_complete: You pass the meat to the murloc. [soft voice] Let's see if it really was that hungry.
quest_40541_quest_detail: [soft voice] The murloc tadpole stares at you, like it still wants something. But what? More food? No, it's impossible. Maybe it got lost and is looking for its parents? [hesitant] You should look on the shore, they must be somewhere around here.
quest_40541_quest_complete: [soft voice] Poor little murloc. [pause] The search yielded no results. [hesitant] Maybe the locals would know what happened to the murloc family?
quest_40542_quest_detail: [solemn] If anyone here could know anything about the murloc family, it would be the gryphon riders of Aerie Peak. [soft voice] Maybe they have noticed something unusual during one of their flights? [urgent] You should ask.
quest_40543_quest_detail: [solemn] If anyone here could know anything about the murloc family, it would be the Revantusk trolls. [soft voice] Maybe they have noticed something? [urgent] You should ask.
quest_40546_quest_complete:
[soft voice] The tadpole is waiting for you. [warm] You are the only one who can save him now. [gentle] You will become his new family, his new friend.

[pause] But wait, it needs a name. [delight] Gurky! [warm] Gurky is perfect.

<Gurky hops into your pocket.>

[excited] Oh, the adventures you will have together!
quest_40547_quest_complete:
[soft voice] The tadpole is waiting for you. [warm] You are the only one who can save him now. [warm] You will become his new family, his new friend.

[gentle] But wait, it needs a name. [delight] Gurky! [delight] Gurky is perfect.

<Gurky hops into your pocket.>

[excited] Oh, the adventures you will have together!
quest_8599_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.

<Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.>

[soft voice] Do you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? [excited] Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. [soft voice] I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!

[soft voice] Could you possibly deliver a message to Narain? [warm] I would be forever indebted to you!
quest_40034_quest_detail:
[commanding] What business do you have here at the Rethress Sanctum? [angry] You are lucky our strength is not what it used to be. [solemn] We are on trying times. [commanding] If anyone wishes to visit with the Tide Mistress, then they first must speak to me. [low voice] We Rethress come from the very depths of this world in places your kind have never seen, nor will ever see.

[threatening] ... As much as I distrust you, interloper, we require aid from any that can offer it. [commanding] Speak with Tide Mistress Rashal. [warm] You have my blessing in order to see her.
quest_40034_quest_progress: [low voice] Yes? [threatening] What could it be that you want from me, <race>?
quest_40034_quest_complete: I see. Hashaz has sent you? [urgent] If that is the case, then perhaps you may be of use. [commanding] I am Tide Mistress Rashal, and this is the Rethress Sanctum. [solemn] Speak with my followers here and make yourself useful.
quest_40035_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before we left for the great depths, the Rethress spent some time within Stranglethorn. [low voice] We butted heads with other Naga there, but otherwise kept low and to ourselves. Tide Mistress Rashal had something of a personal mission far in the east, and we made the island of Jaguero into a temporary base.

[solemn] It wasn't long before we returned to the great depths in order to begin our mission here. [urgent] In our haste, we left behind a small trunk that contains spoils of great importance to us for our future. [commanding] Go there and gather our spoils!
quest_40035_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you collected what I asked for?
quest_40035_quest_complete: [solemn] Many battles were fought for this. [soft voice] It is good to hear lives were not wasted for nothing. [warm] You are proving to be a good ally, interloper.
quest_40036_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Myrmidons of Rethress swore a sacred oath upon the stones of the Temple Rethress beneath the deep waves. Their word was their bond, but they broke the word of their sharp tongues and the oath they promised to keep. We were tasked with protecting Tide Mistress Rashal and carrying out her whims and deeds for the greater depths of all Naga.

[solemn] When the Spitelash were created, and the division began, all of the Myrmidons changed sides. They betrayed those loyal to the Rethress on orders from Naszharr and slew many of my most trusted brothers upon The Shattered Strand.

[angry] I want them dead, interloper. I want their corpses to be feasted on by the depths. From their bodies, take their Myrmidon Signet's—a ring given to them upon swearing their oath.
quest_40036_quest_complete: [solemn] The Spitelash Myrmidon are an abomination to the great depths. [sad] They deserved death for breaking our most sacred bonds. [proud] I am pleased.
quest_40037_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was sent to Azshara from the great depths of the world to claim ownership over these lands. [proud] I am royalty—royalty of the naga—and with my army, I could have been as strong as Queen Azshara!

Yet, here I am, ruling over a small band of my loyal followers with no sway or power in the world. [angry] I was betrayed by the naga that followed me, and you will help me get revenge. [low voice] The Storm Bay Murlocs were that of my family's servants. [threatening] Their betrayal is most foul to me. [commanding] The creatures think they are above the will of Tide Mistress Rashal?

[urgent] You can find these spineless followers all along the coastline of Azshara. [commanding] Perhaps showing strength may help to get them back in line.
quest_40037_quest_progress: [low voice] Have the servants been dealt with, <race>?
quest_40037_quest_complete: [solemn] Even just crippling their numbers is enough to please me. [low voice] My kind would never stand for such an aberration of the tide's rules, and if I had the numbers, I would be sure to make them suffer.
quest_40038_quest_detail:
[low voice] The leader of the Storm Bay is a murloc with a brain the size of a small oyster. Mmrmglul is his name. [threatening] He should be punished, and brutally, for rallying the Storm Bay Murlocs into an open revolt.

[commanding] You'll find that slimy eel to the north through the pathways and along the coastline on the Southridge Beach. [emphasis] Bring his head to me as a showing to the rest of his lackeys that Tide Mistress Rashal commands the Storm Bay Murlocs.
quest_40038_quest_progress: [low voice] Have you got his head, interloper?
quest_40038_quest_complete: [solemn] Even just crippling their numbers is enough to please me. [low voice] My kind would never stand for such an aberration of the tides rules, and if I had the numbers, I would be sure to make them suffer.
quest_40039_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Rethress Tide Scepter holds power for me within the great depths of the world, and especially within Nazjatar. It is the birthright of the Rethress, and it gives us dominion over many others. [low voice] I had suspected they would try to steal it when the Spitelash was formed to get this dominion.

[soft voice] You may wonder why I am telling you this. It would never concern a land-creature like yourself. Well, I buried the Scepter in a secretive location so that they could never claim power legitimately. [pause] Now that the Rethress Sanctum is founded, and we are not in immediate danger, I would like it returned to me.

[commanding] There is a place called the Tower of Eldara, held by some Highborne Keeper. It is located at the very far northeastern tip of the peninsula. To the west of it, along the coast, are four rocks. Buried around those rocks is the Rethress Tide Scepter. [urgent] Get it and bring it to me, interloper, to help me reclaim my birthright.
quest_40039_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you found the Scepter? [threatening] Can you even follow instructions, <race>?
quest_40039_quest_complete: [solemn] You have found it... [soft voice] Well done, land-walker. [pause] There is still one final task I must ask of you to ensure the Rethress survive.
quest_40061_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is one thing left for you to do, outsider, if you truly wish to assist the Rethress. The one who claimed dominion over these lands and betrayed me is Tide Lord Naszharr. He is a vile traitor who must be vanquished from this world.

[threatening] I want him to suffer—and suffer greatly. He resides near the Ravencrest Monument up to the northeast. Go there and rip the heart from him, then bring it to me. Make sure he regrets everything he has done to us.
quest_40061_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you killed him? [commanding] Have you stopped this insurrection?
quest_40061_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, it is done. [pause] It will take some time to bring all of the others into the fold, but I would not be a step closer without you. [warm] When I return to the great depths, I will have your name placed in honor. [commanding] When we naga conquer the world, you will be spared to do as you please.

[solemn] Take this as a token of my gratitude, land-walker.
quest_41308_quest_progress: [low voice] What is it you desire, landwalker?
quest_41308_quest_complete: [low voice] I dare not call that tiny being a partner, but we share much valuable knowledge between us, so I tolerate her presence and requests. [soft voice] Tell me, what does she require today?
quest_41309_quest_detail: <Zalashji squeezes the oily glands into the vial. Muttering unintelligible words under his raspy breath, he casts foreign magic, making the concoction glow in a vibrant light.> [soft voice] Take it, stranger. This oil should seal the cracks in the gems' surfaces, while still allowing for accurate cuts. [urgent] Now go, while I permit her to frequent me, I cannot say the same about you. I may be more hospitable than my brethren, but that does not mean my patience is endless.
quest_663_quest_detail:
Lolo sees a tiny <race>! [excited] Always on the lookout, Lolo is!

[warm] Welcome to Faldir's Cove. [soft voice] Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours. [low voice] Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.

[sad] But Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that. [solemn] We lost the other two ships from our formation. [sad] Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly. [solemn] On the bottom of the sea they rest now!

[commanding] Lolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.
quest_1166_quest_detail:
[commanding] Bow before Overlord Mok'Morokk!

[angry] Rexxar make me mighty leader of Stonemaul Clan!

[low voice] Me good leader. Me keep clan safe.

[urgent] Big dragons come and make fire at old home. [commanding] Me smart ogre. Find new home for clan here.

[shouting] Leave old home so fast, me forget stuff. [commanding] Tiny <race>, go get my things. [urgent] Go south and find my yummy grog, my snuff and my strongbox. [threatening] Me like you after you do that. [soft voice] You look in Den of Flame and Stonemaul Ruins... they be there, me sure!
quest_1166_quest_progress:
[low voice] Me thirsty for grog. Me miss snuff too. Where is strongbox? You go get for Overlord Mok'Morokk.

[commanding] Go find south in old home. Me too busy leading ogres to get.
quest_1166_quest_complete: [soft voice] You good <race>. Me miss things very much. [warm] Me like you now.
quest_1168_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. [angry] He care more for power than he care for ogres.

[sad] Black dragons kill many ogre. [angry] Kill Tharg's wife. [threatening] Mok'Morokk tell us to run. [commanding] Make us come here.

[urgent] Ogre should fight. [sad] Ogres not good at running. [threatening] Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.

[warm] Me call Stonemaul Ruins home. [soft voice] Me like it in the south. [sad] This place not home.

[urgent] Help ogres fight army of the black dragon. [angry] Me want revenge. [sad] Me want to go home.
quest_1168_quest_progress:
Mok'Morokk tell all ogres to stay and keep this place safe. [commanding] Me think ogres need to kill black dragon army and get old home back.

[urgent] You help ogres get home back. [urgent] Help ogres get revenge.
quest_1169_quest_detail:
[solemn] Whilst that craven fool, Mok'Morokk, wallows in power and Tharg wrestles the demons of sorrow and vengeance and vies for leadership of the clan, I seem to be the only one concerned with identifying the source of aggression on our old home.

[soft voice] Why the puzzled stare, <name>? [mocking tone] Expecting me to speak like an uncouth ruffian merely because I am an ogre?

[commanding] Now back to business, bring to me the hearts and tongues from the whelps and hatchlings. [solemn] I shall trace the root of this evil...
quest_1169_quest_progress:
[solemn] With the hearts and tongues of scorched offspring of the black dragon army, I can decipher what wretched beast introduced her spawn into our home. [urgent] Perhaps with a greater knowledge of our aggressors, we can seek to destroy them once and for all and reclaim Stonemaul Village from ruin.

[hesitant] Of course, convincing Mok'Morokk to move his lethargic, fat mass out of this muck hole is going to be an epic quest in and of itself...
quest_1169_quest_complete: 'Twas a perilous affair, no doubt, collecting all of these hearts and tongues. [solemn] I shall delve into the depths of the arcane to trace the origin of the black menace which has descended upon our former home.
quest_1170_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. [sad] But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands?

[hesitant] This is most troubling. [urgent] Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.

[commanding] Notify Mok'Morokk at once! [urgent] Action must be taken.
quest_1170_quest_complete: [angry] Why you tell me 'bout dragons? [sad] Me no like dragons. [low voice] Me like it here. [sad] No dragons here.
quest_1171_quest_detail: [solemn] You leave me alone now. [low voice] Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. [threatening] No black dragon here.
quest_1171_quest_complete:
[angry] That lazy coward!

[solemn] Mok'Morokk displayed strength when Rexxar was our leader. [sad] But soon after Rexxar's departure Mok'Morokk fell prey to temptations of power. [threatening] Rather than lead, he demanded. [angry] He does not serve his people but rather expects us to serve him.

[urgent] Something must be done.
quest_1172_quest_detail:
[solemn] Onyxia's brood has been scattered across the Dragonmurk. It is imperative that no more whelps be permitted to hatch.

[urgent] Make haste to Wyrmbog in the south of Dustwallow Marsh. [solemn] Surely, she has made her lair there. [commanding] Track down the evil dragon's eggs and destroy them.

[solemn] We will never reclaim Stonemaul Village if the surrounding area remains a breeding ground.

[low voice] As for Mok'Morokk... I have other plans for the sod.
quest_1172_quest_progress:
[urgent] You must hurry to the Dragonmurk, <name>. With Onyxia's eggs riddled around the Wyrmbog, we face overwhelming numbers unless something is done quickly.

[commanding] Destroy her eggs! [angry] Don't let the black dragon plague spread across our homeland!
quest_1172_quest_complete:
Splendid! [solemn] It will be sometime before Onyxia can produce more eggs.

[warm] On behalf of my people, I thank you, <name>.

[soft voice] I have asked much of you so far. [hesitant] Perhaps you can do the Stonemaul Clan one last service.

[commanding] Mok'Morokk is not fit to lead us. [solemn] Tharg would make an excellent leader but is hindered by his injuries and age. [urgent] Drive Mok'Morokk from this place by force. [solemn] Only then can we appoint a new leader to return us to our proper home in the south.
quest_1173_quest_detail:
[angry] You dare challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk?

Haw! Me crush tiny <race>!

[threatening] You tell me when ready for good beating.
quest_1173_quest_progress: [angry] I thought you were going to attempt to drive Mok'Morokk out of the village. [sigh] Instead you have come to me to chat?
quest_1173_quest_complete:
[delight] That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. [warm] You have done a great service, <name>.

quest_40199_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Maul'ogg be in a great war, a war for our very survival! [angry] We be pushed back to this refuge as if we are not stronger anymore. [defiant] This not be the truth, and honestly we will fight back until we are destroyed.

[solemn] We once controlled most of this island, and only when the Razzari defeated us, and the wildlife posed a big threat did we come back here! [proud] Maul'ogg destined to rule all of Gillijim, and it shall be rightfully ours.

[commanding] We must retake land if we are to hold more power, and The Tangled Wood lies between us and them. [urgent] Kill the animals there, those panthers that stalk, kill those creepers that lurk within the vines, it should be just north of here, go!

[solemn] War must continue, it is the only way we can go forward.
quest_40200_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we battled with the Razzari we were able to deal quite a lot of damage to Zul'Razar, and even occupied part of the city. Until a large lot of Creepers came in, led by a massive beast named Tanglemoss, who drove us out.

[threatening] Tanglemoss is a lurking, horrific beast that patrols the ruins of Zul'Razar and has slain many ogres. [soft voice] We have always thought of him in stories, and rumors as a beast that lingered within the shadows and made those that traveled alone dissapear. [hesitant] I think I speak for many of us when I say that I prefer the story of Tanglemoss to be just that, a story.

[urgent] Travel to the Ruins of Zul'Razar to the west, and slay Tanglemoss, bring its foul heart to me.
quest_40200_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found Tanglemoss? [solemn] It may require more then just yourself for this to be done.
quest_40200_quest_complete: [solemn] So, you actually are stronger then I first thought. [low voice] So many big ogres think they are tough just because they think they are and then they get smashed. [warm] You are tough, and strong, and you prove it, maybe you are a real orc. [commanding] We must continue, it is the only way we can go forward.
quest_40217_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Maul'ogg used to rule over much of the island, but such times have changed, and we now are working to keep ourselves intact. [soft voice] Our other place of operation was called Maul'ogg Post, it was led by Embergut, a rather powerful magi of an ogre.

[hesitant] Deep down, I still think he's alive, and I want you to check on him, he was adamant about staying, even when we were leaving due to the problems with basilisks.

[urgent] Go and check to see if he's there, a trace of him atleast.
quest_40217_quest_progress: [low voice] Yes, you need something, or just here to talk?

quest_40218_quest_detail:
[solemn] Beneath Maul'ogg lies a cavern system filled with basilisk, called Deepneck Cove, its entrance laying at the beach just to the north east. [soft voice] I have been having long nightmares of a great magical power during my sleep, as if something is calling out to me. [sad] A basilisk with an eye of glass and a mind of power, I have recognized its horrible appearance before.

[solemn] It is this very magic that I search for now, and bid that you obtain. [soft voice] The magical gaze of a beast named Glasseye is the one responsible for my dreams, and the energy seeping beneath Maul'ogg. [urgent] Travel into the caverns and slay the beast, collect its eye, and bring it to me, perhaps its magical potency will bring me some gaze into the future.
quest_40218_quest_progress: [solemn] Glasseye may have strong, magical powers, be sure to keep your wits about you.
quest_40218_quest_complete: [solemn] We meet again Glasseye, this is the eye that stared back at me in my dreams, and now I hold it within my fingers. [confident] I sense that I may be able to make great strides with this, and I thank you greatly. [warm] No longer will my dreams be haunted, you've done me a great service.
quest_40219_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Maul'ogg used to hold many great riches, [solemn] we were in the process of setting up a great mine of jade that is present upon Gillijim! [angry] Those dirty pirates came and stole all of our hard work and should be smashed! [angry] Those rich jades are ours, and that gold they make should be our gold!

[solemn] On some of our first digs we uncovered a very large 'Star Emerald', of course, in the chaos it wasn't taken to me! [angry] Now some Foreman named Darkskull has it, and I want it back! [commanding] He oversee's The Jade Mine up to the north west along the coast, go there, kill him, and bring me my prize, maybe they will learn a lesson from this too.

quest_40258_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Maul Orb was once a powerful artifact to our tribe, but we lost it a long time ago.

[soft voice] In olden days we were once part of the larger Gor'dosh tribe and dominated both Gillijim and Lapidis. [solemn] The Maul Orb was created in those days, and since the tribes split, it has been lost in their hands.

[urgent] There is no doubt that the Maul Orb still exists, tucked away within the Gor'dosh Heights located on the northwestern edge of Lapidis Isle, far to the north. [commanding] Go there and recover it.

<A grin would spread from ear to ear across Emberguts face> [solemn] So long it has been gone, and here it is!

[warm] You've done well, I never thought I would see it again and it is in my hands. [excited] Maybe now Embergut can be the strongest ogre!
quest_40264_quest_detail:
[solemn] Hello, and welcome to Maul'ogg Refuge. We are a battered people, stuck in a constant fight for dominance. I am Haz'gorg, and I am the head of the seers.

[soft voice] Long have I seen the destruction of my people, foretold in long fever dreams and visions within the dark hours of twilight. [sad] I fear that the constant state of warfare we are engulfed in will do naught but bring our end.

[urgent] I ask of you to speak with Lord Cruk'Zogg on my behalf, tell him that I believe this foolhardy Aggression will bring naught but ruin.
quest_40264_quest_progress: [hesitant] So, have you spoken with him?
quest_40264_quest_complete: I see. [solemn] Lord Cruk'Zogg will bring us into ruin, [sad] I must come up with a new way to convince him.
quest_40265_quest_detail:
[solemn] If there is to be a chance for my people then I must conjure a great vision, to do as such will require materials from across the island. [commanding] I ask of you to gather me the following items. [emphasis] 10 Basilisk Eyes from the Basilisks, 6 Crawler Pincers from the Crawlers, and 3 Deepsnap Tails from the crocolisks.

[soft voice] Once you have gotten these materials for me, I can begin to see what must be done.
quest_40265_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you had the opportunity to collect what it is I asked?
quest_40265_quest_complete: [solemn] I see a great future in you, [warm] you have done well, now, let us begin.
quest_40266_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have seen, a great many things, a great darkness that has enveloped not just this island, but all around us. [sad] My people did the bidding of a greater power, and followed it into the darkness willingly. [low voice] We were nothing more then pawns until our demise.

[pause] I did, however, see more than just misery, I saw the Seer of the Gor'dosh ogres, a once old friend of mine. [soft voice] Perhaps it is he that can offer some wisdom, or suggestion on how to continue, maybe it is he, who has the answers.

[solemn voice] Seer Bol'ukk resides within the Gor'dosh Heights amongst the rest of his tribe, you should find him on Lapidis Isle far to the north, the Gor'dosh Heights rest at its north western side.
quest_40266_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you spoken with Seer Bol'ukk?
quest_40266_quest_complete: [solemn] A bold plan he has come up with, I would not have suspected Bol'ukk to speak such words. [soft voice] But perhaps there is no other option, I will begin to work on an elixir.
quest_40267_quest_detail:

[low voice] I do, however know of a powerful being that potentially could be of assistance to me. [solemn] There is a troll of mystique located on Kazon Island to the north, nestled between Gillijim and Lapidis. [soft voice] He is one of considerable power of which I met long ago, and spoke of in fever dreams of the night.

[solemn] His powers were once strong enough to do battle with a great sea beast and destroy it with ease. [solemn] If there is any that could make such a spell, it would be him.
quest_40271_quest_progress: I see.. [solemn] Then let us finish what we have set out to do.
quest_40272_quest_detail:

[solemn] If there is to be a future for the Maul'ogg then it must be a future of reasoning, we cannot secure ourselves a place within the Horde if we are constantly engaged in self destructive warfare.

[urgent] Bring the Elixir of Insom'ni to Lord Cruk'zogg, inform him that it is a potion of great power that I created for him. [solemn] When all is done, return to me.

quest_5045_quest_progress:
[solemn] Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. [solemn] This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

[warm] Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort> Blood Shard(4)
quest_5045_quest_complete:
[solemn] Our greatest warriors, and our greatest <snort> shamans would envy your will, <race>.

[urgent] Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you! <snort>
quest_5046_quest_progress:
[solemn] All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> [solemn voice] My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

[solemn] Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection. Blood Shard(4)
quest_5052_quest_detail:
[solemn] Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>

[low voice] I know the secrets of that magic.

Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. [urgent] Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
quest_5052_quest_progress:
[solemn] Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
quest_5052_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you do understand. <snort> [low voice] My words were not lost on your ears, <race>. [commanding] Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! <snort>

[soft voice] The touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, <race>.

Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?

But, that is a tale for another time. [solemn] I promised you information. [solemn] I promised you Agamaggan's power. [sad] My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. [sad] Now, I lose you upon them. <snort>
quest_40575_quest_detail:
[urgent] You need Mangletooth to translate you a <snort> tablet?

Mangletooth will do so for a special treat! <snort> [low voice] Mangletooth craves for basilisk eyes, down in Thousand Needles you will find <snort> Saltstone Basilisks, at the Shimmering Flats!

Bring about <snort> 20 of them and Mangletooth translates, favor for a <snort> favor!
quest_40575_quest_progress: Mangletooth could <snort>. really <snort.> <snort.> [angry] REALLY enjoy some <snort.> eyes right now.
quest_40575_quest_complete: [delight] Mangletooth happy, give Mangletooth eyes! <Mangletooth snorts loudly as he munches the eyes with gluttony, a real pig in your eyes.>
quest_40576_quest_detail:
<Snorts happily.> [excited] A feast! A feast for Mangletooth! Now about that <snort.> tablet. It was meant to <snort.> reach the leader of the Kraul as report that the quilboar did indeed <snort.> wish to attack the inn but when they reached it, it was already <snort.> burnt!

Not sure which <snort.> inn they are talking about <snort.>, but seems like you do.

[warm] Mangletooth happy to <snort.> help, the Tauren are really nice to Mangletooth.

Even this cage is <snort.> now open, but I choose to <snort.> stay.
quest_488_quest_detail:
Eager for work, I see. Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling <class> to perform my bidding.

You see, <name>, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having. But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents. [urgent] Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

[whispering] Let's keep this our little secret, <race>.
quest_488_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been a busy little bee, <name>? [whispering] I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
quest_488_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ha ha! [warm] Well, done indeed.

[mocking tone] Who would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a <race> to do my bidding? [excited] Certainly not me! [solemn] But so it goes... [warm] this beloved world of ours is full of surprises.

[delight] Three cheers for the naive and gullible!
quest_489_quest_progress: [commanding] What do you have for me, <name>? [threatening] A lovely snack I presume?
quest_489_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, what a sweet <race>! [excited] I knew you would come in handy!
quest_5126_quest_detail: [solemn] The Satyr paces about and talks to himself. [soft voice] Do you wish to question him?
quest_5127_quest_detail:
Lorax makes deals, he does not accept them from insignificant mortals.

[commanding] A deal I shall make with you, however... take this pike, it is imbued with powerful Fel energies. [solemn] When you find Goraluk Anvilcrack, slay him and drive this pike through his dying heart. [threatening] His soul he bartered, his soul I shall have. [urgent] Return the pike and return the breastplate that the thief stole and I shall teach you what it is that he was to learn.
quest_5127_quest_complete: [solemn] Our pact you did not break. [solemn] The soul I did take. [solemn] The reward I shall make.
quest_4201_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh, the pains of love! [sad] My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms. [angry] I am spurned! [shouting] It's maddening! [urgent] You must help me! [soft voice] We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart. [commanding] To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of Azshara, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro. [gentle] You can place the water in this vial.

[warm] Please, <name>, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
quest_4201_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the ingredients? [sad] The hole in my heart threatens to consume me!
quest_4201_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you've done it! I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot. Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You are a champion of love!
quest_944_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore. But stranger still...[pause] are the Twilight's Hammer. That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth. Lords defeated long ago.

[solemn] The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.

[urgent] Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.

Take this phial of scrying. Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive. Then speak to me through the bowl.
quest_944_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Master's Glaive, <name>.

[urgent] Go there, then speak with me again.
quest_944_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer is at the Master's Glaive?

Unfortunate. The old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.

[urgent] The Twilight's Hammer must be seeking this power.
quest_948_quest_complete:
<name>. [solemn] You are here.

Good. [pause] We have matters...to discuss. [solemn] You and I.
quest_950_quest_detail: [solemn] Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
quest_951_quest_detail:
[solemn] The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves! [sad] It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.

[urgent] Travel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones. [solemn] Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's Hammer intends to exploit the magic of the elves.
quest_951_quest_progress: <name>. [solemn] Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
quest_951_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you. [solemn] These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone. [soft voice] That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain. [pause] Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...

[urgent] Be vigilant, <name>.
quest_952_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah. <class>. How may Onu assist you?
quest_952_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah. Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. [pause] The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. [solemn] Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
quest_961_quest_complete:
[solemn] The finding of Twilight's Hammer cultists is troubling. I must meditate on their intentions...

[pause] When you have more information, speak to me through a scrying bowl. If you require a phial of scrying in order to create a bowl, then... [soft voice] here is another.
quest_4261_quest_detail:
[solemn] Felwood was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. [sad] The infernals, destruction, chaos...

The skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.

Even now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. [soft voice] Help me find my way home. [hesitant] Please, <name>, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.

[solemn] Once I am free, seek out Kayneth Stillwind, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.
quest_7632_quest_detail:
[solemn] The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.

[soft voice] If you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.

[hesitant] Maybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?
quest_7632_quest_complete:
[solemn] Of course I recognize my own leaves. [emphasis] Look at that! [delight] It's in perfect condition.

[warm] How good of you to return it, <class>.

[gentle] Perhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.
quest_7633_quest_complete:
Your diligence and integrity has been noted, <class>.

[solemn] We are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. [soft voice] Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the Burning Legion marched upon Hyjal. [pause] Our spirits, however, remain intact.

[solemn] There are tasks that we can offer. [emphasis] Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.

[solemn] Know this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.
quest_7634_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>. [solemn] I am Hastat, Ancient of Lore. [soft voice] I hold knowledge lost eons ago.

[solemn] With the proper binding, one of my leaves can serve as a quiver the likes of which has not been seen in 10,000 years. [emphasis] A quiver that when accompanied by a bow of Ancients, could grant untold powers.

[urgent] Return here with sinew from an adult blue dragon and this quiver shall be yours.
quest_7634_quest_complete: [solemn] May my leaves provide your arrows protection from harm. [soft voice] May your arrows strike true. [solemn] May the enemies of our world be smitten.
quest_7635_quest_detail:
[solemn] Vartrus may offer you the stave to create a bow of Ancients but only I can enchant the string required to complete the bow.

[low voice] It is a simple task, puny one. [threatening] Slay a mature black dragon and remove the sinew from its bones. [commanding] Return that sinew to me and I shall enchant the material into an almost indestructible bow string.
quest_7635_quest_progress: [solemn] I am certain that you will have little difficulty in finding and slaying a black dragon, <name>. [commanding] Do not waste my time with idle chatter.
quest_7635_quest_complete:
[solemn] A most foul dragon this one was. [low voice] The sinew reeks of evil.

[pause] Give me a moment to cleanse the filth from this flesh and apply the proper enchantments.
quest_7636_quest_detail:
[solemn] Agents of the Burning Legion are still active in our world, <class>. [solemn] These agents corrupt all that they touch. Nature wilts and weeps in their presence.

[commanding] You must track down these demonic corrupters and destroy them, <name>. [urgent] Be warned, you must engage them by yourself or they will flee. [threatening] As long as you are alone, they will try and destroy you. [commanding] You must strike at them, turning their arrogance into misery.

[solemn] I grant you a piece of my bark, the inscriptions shall lead you to your targets. [cold] Retrieve their heads.
quest_7636_quest_progress: [urgent] Do not be fooled by their disguises!
quest_7636_quest_complete: [solemn] You have served us well, <name>! [warm] Take this stave and combine it with the bow string that Stoma is able to create. [gentle] Together, they form a most formidable weapon.
quest_40989_quest_complete: <Glanthas the Ancient offers a long, and silent stare.> [solemn] The Runestone?
quest_40990_quest_detail:
<The creaking ancient lets out a grumble.> [solemn] It would appear Buthok has proven successful in re-energizing the Runestone of Cenarius. [pause] Though, there is one last problem that still offers trouble.

[soft voice] You see, I once charged a druid named Enthelar Valebranch with overseeing the Runestones some years ago. [solemn] The Runestone Scepter, which activates the magic was in his possession when he succumbed to the whim of corruption.

[sad] Last I heard, Enthelar Valebranch was seen wandering Winterspring, his mind addled, and lost. [urgent] Recover the Runestone Scepter, and I will grant you access to the Runestones of Hyjal.
quest_40990_quest_complete:
<Glanthas the Ancient lets out a creaking exhale of approval.> [solemn] You have done well in finding this. [soft voice] It eases my mind to know you have brought peace to Enthelar. He suffered great hardships, and I am sure he was relieved by your actions.

[warm] As I promised, you can now access the Runestones of Hyjal, offering transport between them. [commanding] Use this power wisely, <class>.

[warm] For your considerable efforts in restoring the Runestones I have prepared a suitable commendation.
quest_41023_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, can I help you?
quest_41023_quest_complete:
[solemn] Farana Leafblade has sent you? [soft voice] Such a fine warrior, she is as dedicated to this land as I am.

<Glanthas takes the sample, studying it carefully.>

[solemn] Such a foul material, contaminated with magical energies.
quest_41024_quest_detail:
[solemn] A druid named Canos Clearwood tasked himself with the inquiry into such monstrosities within Azshara some years ago. His research, however, has led him on a trip to the once human realm of Eastern Plaguelands.

From what I hear, he is currently investigating there to find a link between the sludge-like monsters.

[soft voice] Bring him this sample, and perhaps you may both learn what is causing this new phenomenon here in Hyjal.
quest_41810_quest_progress: [solemn] With the Runestones restored, we can utilize their Dream energy to aid us in this war against the Nightmare. [soft voice] In times immemorial, the keepers of the wild and their protectors used powerful runes, much like the Runestones you had just brought back to life. [low voice] With them, they could attune their spirit to a point and travel there posthaste via the Emerald Dream. [gentle] If you wish, I can carve such a rune into a small dream shard, so that you may heed our call for help wherever you may be on Azeroth. [pause] Small Dream Shard
quest_41810_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done. [soft voice] This Verdant Rune is tethered to the essence of the World Tree in conjunction with the Runestones. Focus your mind on its potent magic, and your spirit will find itself anew here, at the foot of Nordrassil.
quest_41962_quest_progress: [solemn] The ancient does not move. Like an immovable object, he just stares into the horizon.
quest_41962_quest_complete: [solemn] The conversation ends and Fangorn returns back to his eternal vigil.
quest_41964_quest_detail: [solemn] Fangorn’s words still ring inside your head. The ruined city of Elun’aran on Tyrandas, and the cavern system below its temple. [soft voice] You can feel the conclusion to this journey drawing closer.
quest_80315_quest_detail: [solemn] I've only experienced a few blooms in my time, but this season, things are different. [soft voice] At the ends of my leaves, there are usually pink petals sprouting by now, but instead, my branches are barren! [sad] I don't think this is normal. [hesitant] Maybe a druid might know what's wrong with me? They're much older and wiser anyhow.
quest_80315_quest_progress: [urgent] Please hurry, <race>. [sad] I don't know how much longer my leaves have before they completely fall away.
quest_80315_quest_complete: [soft voice] I can feel the life flowing back into my leaves, <race>. [warm] That druid really worked some magic with that salve. [hesitant] I wonder what's inside? [confident] I'll study it closely until I find out so that other trees like me don't get sick, too!
quest_40321_quest_detail:
[gentle] You have been incredibly helpful, and for that I am grateful. [solemn] This land I have found myself on seems to be full of dangers, those that I am not ready to encounter just yet.
