[low voice] I have done some repairs upon the canoe, and should be ready to set off soon, back to where I am from.

[solemn] The Northeast Passage is quite trecherous, many jagged icebergs are out there which makes sailing quite difficult! [urgent] I know a way through though, if you'd like to come with me, I need to be stopping at Kaneq'nuun, and I wouldn't mind showing you.

[soft voice] When you're ready to go, let me know.
quest_40321_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, I take it you must be ready to go, yes?
quest_40321_quest_complete: [exhale] Ahh, that took a bit, I told you I knew the way through. [warm] Welcome to Kaneq'nuun!
quest_40322_quest_detail:
[solemn] Kaneq'nuun is a large rock floating out at sea, some of my people live here. [soft voice] It is a required stop both on the way south, and on the way north. [gentle] If you wish to truly be welcomed, you must speak with the village elder, for they have much knowledge!

[warm] They can be found just up the road, their name is Panukuki.
quest_40322_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, hello there, so it was Inunquaq who brought you here? [solemn] I must say, I worried for him when he did not return from his journey to the southlands, but I am pleased that he has returned.
quest_40323_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Inunquaq has always been intrigued by the southlands, such a mysterious place, with many different peoples. [solemn] In my long life, I have always wondered what lay beneath the shawl of wind and snow, perhaps you can tell me stories some time.

[warm] If you wish to truly be welcomed, you must make an offering to Kaneq'nuun. [low voice] Many of our strong hunters have headed north to Tarq'un to search for larger beasts, and as a consequence, we have been rationing our food.

[commanding] All along the coast are Ice Crawlers, they can be quite nasty if angered. [urgent] Bring me 6 Ice Crawler Claws, they will go well with the food we have.
quest_40323_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're back, have you gotten the claws, or are you just seeking shelter from the cold?
quest_40323_quest_complete: [soft voice] My, these look tasty, they will go well with the food that we already have. [warm] You've done a kindness for us in bringing this offering before my people, [solemn] I welcome you to Kaneq'nuun as family outsider.
quest_40324_quest_detail:
[solemn] When my people first came to this island, we met a being named Tarqsiku. He was made of pure ice, and assisted us in our times of great need. Tarqsiku has long since fallen into a dark place, rumbling deep beneath the the ground, and sending the Whiteclaw into frenzy.

[threatening] An evil has clouded his judgement, and his mind, already he has attacked our kind. [solemn] Tarqsiku was a legend to my ancestors, but to me, [urgent] Tarqsiku is a threat, and one that has me wondering what to do.

[gentle] I ask of you to venture deep into the earth, to find Tarqsiku, and to free him for his torment.
quest_40324_quest_progress: [solemn] Tarqsiku should not be underestimated, be cautious.
quest_40324_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it? [soft voice] Well, I do hope I made the correct decision, perhaps now he will watch over us favorably from wherever he is. [warm] For everything you've done, I offer you this, as a thanks for my people, for freeing a most beloved spirit.
quest_40325_quest_detail:
[solemn] With our hunters gone away to gather food for the long winter, we have seen a growing amount of Whiteclaw Bears beginning to stalk the outside of their cave. [urgent] Something has begun to stir them from hibernation, and we have seen them around.

[solemn] We have lived in harmony with the Whiteclaw for some time, but now we must act to reduce their numbers. [commanding] To the north is a deep cave the burrows into the mountain, go there, and gather 5 Whiteclaw Pelts.
quest_40325_quest_progress: [solemn] They are a ferocious beast, be careful when you are out there!
quest_40325_quest_complete: [solemn] I must say, a southlander like yourself certainly is quite resourceful. [warm] These pelts you have gathered will be put to use, thanks again for keeping us safe.
quest_41983_quest_detail:
Greetings, freezing stranger! How are your adventures? Do you enjoy your stay in Kaneq’nuun? We may have not much to offer, but what we do have is shared with most heartfelt hospitality. Are you by chance interested in sharing stories, us Tuskarr have many legends and folklore to share. Have you come to Kaneq’nuun to hone your fishing skills, perhaps? Then let me share with you the story of Iqa’quluk, the Moonfish!

Many, many moons ago, when my belly was not as round yet, the elder encountered a mysterious fish out in the North Sea while out fishing. He was sitting in his fishing boat, during a calm moonlit night, when something glowing had emerged from within the ocean’s depth! A massive fish, flat as an ice floe and clad in beautiful white scales. The moonlight reflected on his scales in a shimmering light. As quickly as he appeared, he vanished, leaving the befuddled behind.

Isn’t this such an exciting story?
quest_41983_quest_complete: [shocked] Is that Iqa’quluk?! [solemn] Never would I have thought that a stranger would be the one to fish the great Moonfish. [soft voice] I can just imagine the look on Panukuki’s face when he hears about this, [chuckling] how amusing! <name>, you truly made my day, [warm] perhaps even my whole week with your visit. [proud] I want to reward you with a prized secret of mine. [gentle] Since you are an avid fisher, let me show you how to craft your own fishing pack, the perfect companion for those very long days out on the ocean. [solemn voice] A staple in Tuskarr culture!
quest_80391_quest_detail:
Greetings! Your company is welcome. [soft voice] I am Inunquaq of Moa'ki Harbor. [pause] I find myself in this strange land after weeks of sailing.

[solemn] My tale began when a Winter Tauren friend of mine known as Buniq visited my settlement in her canoe, she invited me to accompany her to the village of Taunka'le. [shocked] But as I entered the canoe, a strong icy gust blew the rope out of Buniq's hands. [urgent] Within moments a strong current had taken me out to the open sea!

[panting] Buniq had the oars so all I could do was to desperately cling to the canoe and hope for the best.

[solemn] Eventually the current took me here to this warm land that looks nothing like my home. [gentle] Listen friend, the canoe had some provisions but I have finished them days ago. [hesitant] Would you please collect some meat from these shelled creatures nearby?

[solemn] We have similar creatures in the far north, but I am without the tools and the knowledge I need to try and approach them, as far as I can guess they are edible. [warm] If you do so, I will be forever in your debt.
quest_80391_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get the meat? [soft voice] I feel my strength wane...
quest_80391_quest_complete:
[solemn] My hunger has finally been sated, and my belly feels overjoyed!

[warm] You can have these odd objects I found while scavenging for tools as well as my friendship and gratitude. [soft voice] Hopefully in time I can find my way back to my homeland.

[warm] Thank you so much friend. [proud] I have the strength and soon I will have the tools to hunt for myself now as I seek a way home, you need not worry for me anymore, may our paths unite again one day.
quest_8733_quest_complete: [soft voice] The wisp is silent except for a low humming sound. [pause] Oddly enough, it is able to communicate with you through thoughts.
quest_8734_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tyrande will be notified, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.

[pause] Now you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. [soft voice] He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.

[gentle] We all wish you great luck.
quest_2_quest_detail: [solemn] The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. [warm] Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
quest_2_quest_progress: [solemn] Yes, mighty <class>, I sensed your arrival. [soft voice] I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
quest_2_quest_complete:
[solemn] Most impressive, <name>... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! [warm] The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

[solemn] Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. [warm] No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
quest_5_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! [urgent] I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

[soft voice] Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

[whispering] I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
quest_5_quest_progress: [excited] Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! [delight] Fortune truly shines on me today!
quest_5_quest_complete: [soft voice] You need some Crab Cakes, do you? [warm] Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
quest_6_quest_detail:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge. [urgent] Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, <name>. Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him. [commanding] He will not be an easy man to reach.
quest_6_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find Garrick's shack? [solemn] Are we finally free of that villain?
quest_6_quest_complete: Hah - you caught him! [warm] You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
quest_7_quest_detail: [solemn] Your first task is one of cleansing, <name>. [soft voice] A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north. [commanding] Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find. [urgent] Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
quest_7_quest_progress: [commanding] How goes the hunting, <name>? [urgent] Have you found and defeated those vermin?
quest_7_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, citizen. [solemn] Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. [commanding] And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

[proud] For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
quest_8_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?

I got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

Anyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. [pause] You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
quest_8_quest_progress:
[urgent] Yes? Yes? What is it?

[soft voice] The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. [gentle] Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. [warm] My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
quest_8_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.

[sad] What? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?

Well, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. [mocking tone] Go on! Get lost!

Come back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.

[sigh] Next thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
quest_9_quest_detail:
[angry] Look at what has happened to this place! [solemn] These lands were once occupied by good farm folk. But the damned thieves have driven them all off. [defiant] Not me, though! But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

[commanding] If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them. Come back when you're done for your pay. [urgent] If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
quest_9_quest_progress: [excited] Ah, I see you're back! [warm] I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers. [urgent] Have you killed twenty yet?
quest_9_quest_complete: [gentle] Good work, friend. [warm] You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
quest_10_quest_detail:
[urgent] Oh, this is just terrible! I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here. That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm. Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was. Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?

I need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please! That... or at least find his surveying equipment. [sad] I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
quest_10_quest_progress: [urgent] Well, what news do you have? [soft voice] You look like you've been in quite the fight... [hesitant] is Scrimshank alive?
quest_10_quest_complete:
[solemn] He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank. [pause] Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.

[urgent] It seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs. [angry] They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party! [solemn] If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!
quest_11_quest_detail:
[solemn] Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest. [urgent] A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder. [urgent] Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

[commanding] The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them. [soft voice] Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
quest_11_quest_progress: Hail, <name>. [hesitant] Have you been killing Gnolls...?
quest_11_quest_complete: [excited] I see you've been busy! [warm] You have our thanks, <name>.
quest_12_quest_detail:
[solemn] The People's Militia has but one goal: To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings. [soft voice] Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood.

[urgent] One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby. [low voice] I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. [commanding] If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
quest_12_quest_progress: [commanding] Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge. [solemn] In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
quest_12_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] My scout witnessed your valiant acts. [confident] You are proving yourself quite well so far.
quest_13_quest_detail:
[solemn] A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead. The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior. [commanding] Dispatch immediately, <name>, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

[soft voice] The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower. [solemn] As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
quest_13_quest_progress: [urgent] We have not time to talk, <name>. The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve. [commanding] Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed. [emphasis] That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
quest_13_quest_complete: [solemn] Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
quest_14_quest_detail: [solemn] Some Defias have eluded us. My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall. We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move. [commanding] Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
quest_14_quest_progress: <name>, [commanding] now is no time for idle chatter. [urgent] If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier. [commanding] Return to me when you have completed your duty.
quest_14_quest_complete: [solemn] When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. [soft voice] But there is hope for Westfall yet. [solemn] As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. [warm] It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia. [warm] May the Light shine upon you.
quest_15_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. [urgent] A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them. [commanding] We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
quest_15_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been to the mines? [commanding] Are you ready to report?
quest_15_quest_complete: [solemn] I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. [sad] No good can come of this. [warm] Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. [hesitant] I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
quest_16_quest_progress:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

[soft voice] If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade. [soft voice] Refreshing Spring Water
quest_16_quest_complete: [excited] Thanks, <name>! [warm] And come back if you want to trade again.
quest_17_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. [pause] They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at. [commanding] I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.

[urgent] Find the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.

[warm] Do this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
quest_17_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? [angry] No caps - no reward!
quest_17_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done <name>, you've proven your worth once again! [warm] The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!

[delight] And now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...

[gentle] If you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
quest_18_quest_detail:
[solemn] Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

[hesitant] I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good! [urgent] Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
quest_18_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
quest_18_quest_complete: [commanding] Back with some bandanas, I see. [warm] The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
quest_19_quest_detail: [commanding] Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc. [urgent] Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
quest_19_quest_progress: [solemn] Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
quest_19_quest_complete: [solemn] Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. [warm] Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. [proud] Here is your reward, <name>.
quest_20_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north. [urgent] From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

[commanding] Help rid Lakeshire of this menace. [urgent] Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.

[solemn] And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge. [commanding] If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
quest_20_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you been slaying orcs, <name>? [urgent] If so, then show me...
quest_20_quest_complete: [soft voice] That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
quest_21_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging. [urgent] Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

[commanding] Waste no time, <name>. [solemn] The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
quest_21_quest_progress: [solemn] I know it's bloody work, <name>, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire. [commanding] Are you ready to report?
quest_21_quest_complete: [solemn] Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army. [commanding] There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. [urgent] We have further tasks for you.
quest_22_quest_detail: [soft voice] The onions are peeled. The garlic is minced. The rosemary is crushed. The crust has been baked. The dill weed is chopped. The gravy is simmering. [urgent] Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
quest_22_quest_progress: [excited] All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
quest_22_quest_complete: [delight] These are just perfect, <name>! [warm] Thank you so much. [excited] Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. [warm] You didn't think I was going to let a <class> like you go hungry, did you?
quest_23_quest_detail:
[solemn] The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt. [soft voice] On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.

[pause] The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.
quest_23_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah - <name> - I was just thinking about you! [warm] How goes your hunting?
quest_23_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, the paw of Ursangous! [warm] Your skill is impressive, <class>; he is credited with numerous kills. [soft voice] The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale. [solemn] Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. [proud] To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.

[excited] Your ancestors would be proud!
quest_24_quest_detail: [solemn] The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it. The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt. [soft voice] Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
quest_24_quest_progress: Greetings once again, <name>! [soft voice] Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
quest_24_quest_complete:
[excited] A victory for <name> in the Ashenvale Hunt! [warm] Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.

[solemn] Shadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. [soft voice] Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. [warm] Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
quest_25_quest_detail:
[urgent] If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path. [commanding] What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

[urgent] You up for being useful?
quest_25_quest_progress: [urgent] You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?
quest_25_quest_complete:
Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. [soft voice] From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. [hesitant] Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

[warm] Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. [proud] Take this - you've earned it.
quest_26_quest_detail:
<name>, I have been following your progress with much delight. [solemn] You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

[soft voice] The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water. [pause] For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there. [gentle] He will guide you further.
quest_26_quest_complete:
[solemn] Salutations, young <class>; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.

You will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.

[commanding] Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
quest_27_quest_detail:
<name>, [delight] I have been following your progress with much delight. You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you [commanding] command and mastery of the water. For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there. He will guide you further.
quest_27_quest_complete:
[solemn] Salutations, young <class>; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.

You will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.

[commanding] Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
quest_28_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble. [urgent] It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste. [emphasis] Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

[solemn] You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves. [solemn] Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.

[warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_28_quest_progress: [solemn] To complete the Trial of the Lake, you must use the Shrine Bauble within the boundaries of this shrine. [pause] Until you do so, your trial remains unfinished and it is at risk of failure.
quest_28_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well now. it looks like yet another druid has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! [warm] Well done. my young friend - well done.

[soft voice] As I've said. my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade. and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance. and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. [pause] By using the bauble here. it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
quest_29_quest_detail:
[solemn] For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble. [urgent] It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste. [soft voice] Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

[urgent] You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves. [solemn] Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.

[warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_29_quest_progress: [solemn] To complete the Trial of the Lake, you must use the Shrine Bauble within the boundaries of this shrine. [pause] Until you do so, your trial remains unfinished and it is at risk of failure.
quest_29_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well now. it looks like yet another druid has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! [warm] Well done. my young friend - well done.

[soft voice] As I've said, my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. [gentle] By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
quest_30_quest_detail:
[solemn] For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion. One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect. [soft voice] Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.

[pause] Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together. [urgent] Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
quest_30_quest_progress: [gentle] Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, <name>? [soft voice] If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. [solemn] Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
quest_30_quest_complete:
[warm] You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, <name> - congratulations.

[solemn] Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. [soft voice] Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.

[solemn] Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
quest_31_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. [soft voice] Go now back to your trainer, Turak Runetotem, in Thunder Bluff. [warm] Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. [solemn] He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.

[warm] Goodbye, young druid. [soft voice] We shall speak again.
quest_31_quest_progress:
[solemn] Your return to Thunder Bluff is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

[soft voice] Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
quest_31_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very impressive, <name>. [warm] Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! [excited] You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.

[warm] Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. [warm] I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.
quest_32_quest_detail:
Here's your report. [urgent] I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.

[soft voice] I know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore. [excited] He's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; [proud] he's a historian to boot! [commanding] If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is and how to stop it, give this report to him. [urgent] We're going to need all the help we can get.

[solemn] Zil lives in a house on the second tier of the Drag in Orgrimmar.
quest_32_quest_progress: [sad] I'm sorry, I don't know you... but from the look of things you have at least heard something of me. [commanding] Now, what can I help you with? [urgent] Do you have something for me?
quest_32_quest_complete:
[solemn] This report... I've dealt with these beasts before. [low voice] Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me.

[solemn] These creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. [emphasis] Familiarize yourself with this name, <name>: silithid. [soft voice] The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.

[sad] If only we were smart enough to see that before.
quest_33_quest_detail:
[angry] I hate those nasty timber wolves! [soft voice] But I sure like eating wolf steaks... [commanding] Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

[solemn] Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
quest_33_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hey <name>. I'm getting hungry...[pause] did you get that tough wolf meat?
quest_33_quest_complete:
[excited] You've been busy! [warm] I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
quest_34_quest_detail:
[solemn] Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged. [sad] And I know the brute who is doing it. [soft voice] It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

[sad] I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now. [angry] Ruined! [angry] All ruined by that one menacing boar. [commanding] Put an end to that pest! [warm] Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you. [low voice] He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
quest_34_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
quest_34_quest_complete: [excited] Finally the menace is laid to rest! [warm] Thank you, <name>, you have done me a great service. [delight] The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
quest_35_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas. [urgent] He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

[commanding] Bring me his report.
quest_35_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. [soft voice] We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
quest_36_quest_detail: I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm. [sad] But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now. As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way. [soft voice] Maybe you could do me a favor? Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew. [gentle] Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder. The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
quest_36_quest_progress: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much. [sad] I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
quest_36_quest_complete: [soft voice] That Verna was always such a sweet lass. [pause] We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine. [warm] But enough gossip! [excited] Now we can make Westfall Stew!
quest_37_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned. [urgent] To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

[soft voice] Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
quest_37_quest_complete: [solemn] Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
quest_38_quest_detail: [excited] Help me make some Westfall Stew! Come back with the following ingredients: 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 3 Goretusk Snouts 3 Murloc Eyes 3 Okra
quest_38_quest_progress: [soft voice] Come back with the following ingredients: 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 3 Goretusk Snouts 3 Murloc Eyes 3 Okra
quest_38_quest_complete: [excited] That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely! [warm] Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts. [delight] And we're done! [warm] For all your help, <name>, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
quest_39_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

[hesitant] I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
quest_39_quest_complete:
[solemn] Hmm, this news is troubling. [sad] Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.

[urgent] If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
quest_40_quest_detail:
<name>, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest! [urgent] Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

[soft voice] I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. [hesitant] He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

[commanding] Please, <name>, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
quest_40_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

[urgent] Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
quest_46_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn. [urgent] Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

[soft voice] The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
quest_46_quest_complete:
[excited] You have the fins? Great! [warm] Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.

[proud] Your actions have helped realize that.
quest_47_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them. [low voice] I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...[emphasis] best price in town!

[commanding] You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
quest_47_quest_progress: [whispering] Psst! [urgent] You have that Gold Dust for me...[pause] for me?
quest_47_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thanks for the dust, <name>. [warm] Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. [hesitant] You might find it useful...useful.
quest_48_quest_detail: [solemn] In the land to the south where vines twist and creep [soft voice] Lies a hidden well where the water runs deep [solemn] Pure as the Light's sacred Daughter [urgent] Bring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
quest_48_quest_progress:
Hiccup! Ho ho! [excited] You want an encore?

[soft voice] In the land to the south where vines twist and creep Lies a hidden well where the water runs deep [solemn] Pure as the Light's sacred Daughter [urgent] Bring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
quest_49_quest_detail: [solemn] Amber is the hue of my life's longest love Like the last embers of dusk in the sky above [soft voice] Retrieve for me so that my love shall be born One sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
quest_49_quest_progress:
[excited] Encore? Well, sure!

[soft voice] Amber is the hue of my life's longest love [soft voice] Like the last embers of dusk in the sky above [urgent] Retrieve for me so that my love shall be born [commanding] One sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
quest_50_quest_detail: [commanding] I'll mix and mix till we have a mash [pause] For this will be our own private stash [solemn] A still must be fashioned of metal strong [urgent] Bring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.
quest_50_quest_progress:
[commanding] An encore for you? Well sure friend!

I'll mix and mix till we have a mash [excited] For this will be our own private stash [urgent] A still must be fashioned of metal strong [commanding] Bring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.
quest_51_quest_detail: [soft voice] Not yet filtered but freshly distilled [pause] Like unseeded land waiting there tilled. Next I will fashion our pile of charcoal [commanding] Deliver a sycamore branch, that is your next goal.
quest_51_quest_progress:
[excited] An encore? Why for you, anything!

[laughing] Not yet filtered but freshly distilled [pause] Like unseeded land waiting there tilled. Next I will fashion our pile of charcoal [commanding] Deliver a sycamore branch, that is your next goal.
quest_52_quest_detail:
Hail, <name>. [solemn] Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

[urgent] We could use your help out here.
quest_52_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you killed those wolves and bears?
quest_52_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thanks a lot for the help, <name>. [low voice] Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.

[hesitant] Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
quest_53_quest_detail: [soft voice] Mellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears Turns a lovely deep amber over the years [pause] But before we proceed to get lit to the hilt A barrel of charred oak must be built.
quest_53_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Sure, I'll sing it again for you, friend!

Mellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears Turns a lovely deep amber over the years But before we proceed to get lit to the hilt [pause] A barrel of charred oak must be built.
quest_53_quest_complete: [solemn] Aged in the barrel, filtered through coal [soft voice] It passes your lips and right through your soul. [warm] So lets us drink now, a toast to you [pause] And me while we're at it, [excited] Grimbooze Thunderbrew!
quest_54_quest_detail:
<name>, you are a <class> with proven interest in the security of Northshire. [solemn] You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

[soft voice] If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. [commanding] Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
quest_54_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You have word from McBride? Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
quest_54_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals. [warm] Congratulations. And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

[sigh] It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
quest_55_quest_detail:
Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery. [solemn] His time in this land is drawing to an end...

[pause] Use Morbent's Bane against him. It will render his protective magics powerless.

[commanding] Slay him. [urgent] Slay him, and save us from his wickedness. [proud] Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!
quest_55_quest_complete:
Morbent Fel has been defeated. [solemn] The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.

[warm] You have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.

[commanding] Go, <name>. [soft voice] And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
quest_56_quest_detail:
[solemn] As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire. [soft voice] Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

[urgent] If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! [commanding] Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages. [angry] The undead threat must be thwarted!
quest_56_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you killed those warriors and mages?
quest_56_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid, <name>. [warm] For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
quest_57_quest_detail: <name>, [urgent] I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest! [commanding] If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. [solemn] There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. [angry] The undead must be driven from Duskwood!
quest_57_quest_progress: [commanding] Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, <name>.
quest_57_quest_complete: [warm] The people of Darkshire thank you, <name>. [proud] You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
quest_58_quest_detail: [solemn] The situation in Raven Hill is still grim. [urgent] The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, <name>. [sad] I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe. [commanding] We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
quest_58_quest_progress:
[commanding] I need your assistance, <name>. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.

[urgent] Return to me when your task is complete.
quest_58_quest_complete: [solemn] On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, <name>, for your bravery and dedication. [warm] May the Light shine upon your ways.
quest_59_quest_detail:
[solemn] For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor. [soft voice] I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you. And after you receive it, <name>, use it in the defense of Elwynn.

[urgent] The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
quest_59_quest_progress:
[solemn] I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

[soft voice] If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
quest_59_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, thank you for the marker. [warm] Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.

[warm] Luck to you, brave <class>. [warm] And may this armor serve you well.
quest_60_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hello, good sir! Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax. Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east. I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
quest_60_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you gather those candles yet?
quest_60_quest_complete: [soft voice] You were busy hunting kobolds, were you? [warm] Thanks for the candles, <name>, and here's your reward...
quest_61_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles. [hesitant] I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

[solemn] I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
quest_61_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, a shipment from my brother? [excited] Splendid! [delight] Fortune truly shines on me today!
quest_61_quest_complete: [warm] Here is your payment ... [soft voice] and while you're here, take a look around! [excited] I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
quest_62_quest_detail:
[urgent] The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems! [solemn] I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me. [commanding] The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
quest_62_quest_progress: [commanding] What do you have to report, <name>? [urgent] Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
quest_62_quest_complete: [solemn] This is bad news. [urgent] What's next, dragons?!? [commanding] We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. [warm] Thanks for your efforts, <name>. [pause] And hold a moment... [soft voice] I might have another task for you.
quest_63_quest_detail:
[solemn] Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. [soft voice] The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.

[urgent] Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. [solemn] The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.

[warm] Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
quest_63_quest_progress:
[solemn] The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the area, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.

The corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.
quest_63_quest_complete: [solemn] You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....
quest_64_quest_detail: [angry] It was horrible! [urgent] Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields. [solemn] The fields were full of hooligans. [urgent] We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch. [sad] Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it. [solemn] I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse. [soft voice] Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it. [warm] If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
quest_64_quest_progress: [hesitant] Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
quest_64_quest_complete:
[excited] My watch! [warm] Thank you so much, kind sir!

[soft voice] We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but [warm] please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
quest_65_quest_detail:
[solemn] The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood. [commanding] I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs. We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out. [soft voice] In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

[urgent] Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
quest_65_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, Stoutmantle sent you? [warm] Well, I owe him.
quest_66_quest_detail:
[solemn] Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. [soft voice] I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. [solemn] I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

[pause] After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. [solemn] A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

[urgent] Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. [sad] I fear for us all.
quest_66_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
quest_67_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see. [emphasis] Ah, here we go! [excited] I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. [mocking tone] My, talk about outdated!

[gentle] Do me a favor will you, friend? [soft voice] If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. [solemn] I like to keep the records clean.
quest_68_quest_detail: [soft voice] You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
quest_68_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, I remember you. [soft voice] You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. [hesitant] Did you ever find what you were looking for?
quest_68_quest_complete: [soft voice] Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. [solemn] Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
quest_69_quest_detail: [soft voice] Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. [pause] In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. [whispering] Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. [urgent] Might want to check there, <name>.
quest_70_quest_detail:
[solemn] The name Stalvan rings a bell. I remember now.

[soft voice] Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night. [pause] Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear. [shocked] Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.

[sad] In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs. [pause] He never returned for them. [solemn] One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind. [gentle] Help yourself to it.
quest_70_quest_progress: [soft voice] What have ya got there? [soft voice] Let me take a look at that. . .
quest_70_quest_complete: [angry] You've got some nerve bringing this here.
quest_71_quest_detail: [solemn] Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
quest_71_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
quest_71_quest_complete: [solemn] You have confirmed my fears, <name>. [urgent] The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
quest_72_quest_detail:
[solemn] My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. [soft voice] But that's neither here nor there.

[low voice] The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. [urgent] Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. [cold] Blame the tax vultures. [hesitant] I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. [soft voice] Who knows what you might find.
quest_72_quest_complete: [soft voice] You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .
quest_74_quest_detail: [soft voice] Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. [pause] Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover [solemn] A Torn Journal Page.
quest_74_quest_progress: [soft voice] What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. [pause] Put it in my hands.
quest_74_quest_complete: [soft voice] I can barely make out those letters. [hesitant] But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
quest_75_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place. [soft voice] I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers.

[pause] Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character. [hesitant] I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you. [urgent] Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
quest_75_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find that page I mentioned, <name>?
quest_76_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds. [commanding] Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

[urgent] Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence. [soft voice] To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora. [low voice] From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
quest_76_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, <name>. [pause] What do you have to report? [pause] Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
quest_76_quest_complete:
[angry] Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say? [shouting] Curses! The situation is worsening by the minute!

[solemn] Thank you for the report, <name>. [sad] But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
quest_77_quest_detail:
[solemn] I possess original packaging materials for the ripple Dran Droffers seeks. [soft voice] I will assist you in packaging the ripple for Malton's abrasive father... for a fee of two additional bottles of said ripple. [urgent] They are located in crates found in the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.

[low voice] It will be an arduous task, to wit; foul slimes and oozes will be found sticking to the ruins; rumor has it they are led by some sort of master ooze. [solemn] Regardless, procure the ripple and return to me here for packaging.
quest_77_quest_progress: [solemn] I trust that your arrival here at our camp is to deliver the bottles of ripple that are integral to the task at hand, yes?
quest_77_quest_complete:
[solemn] Finely executed, <name>. [soft voice] I am glad you had enough foresight not to bruise the delicacy of the ripple. [sad] There is nothing worse than the bouquet of ripple that has been jostled about needlessly.

[pause] It will take a moment for the magic to be wrought over this precious cargo. [whispering] Actually, no magic is involved; I merely have some empty packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. [commanding] Our chicanery shall turn these bottles into an alcoholic treasure of the ages.

[excited] Onward - for great booze!
quest_78_quest_detail: [solemn] I know of someone who might be able to assist you. [soft voice] Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. [low voice] The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore. [commanding] Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
quest_78_quest_progress:
[commanding] Marshal Haggard sent you? [excited] Why didn't you say so?

[soft voice] Ah, good ol' Haggard. [sad] Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long. [pause] Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
quest_78_quest_complete: [excited] By the Light! [warm] You bet I recognize that handwriting.
quest_79_quest_detail: [solemn] I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. [soft voice] When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. [pause] I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. [urgent] Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. [commanding] Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
quest_79_quest_progress: [angry] This better be good, <class>. [soft voice] Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. [urgent] Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. [low voice] I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
quest_79_quest_complete: [delight] My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, <class>.
quest_80_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. [soft voice] But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.

[low voice] In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. [pause] Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
quest_80_quest_progress: [soft voice] Back again, <name>? [urgent] What do you have this time?
quest_80_quest_complete: [excited] Why yes! [solemn] The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.
quest_81_quest_detail: I have taken the extra step of securing not only Dran's packaged ripple in the barrel, but also the extra bottles of ripple he is purloining. [solemn] While I may not hold Dran very highly, there is nothing worse than jostled ripple. [soft voice] You're welcome. [urgent] Now, deliver yon barrel to Dran Droffers in his salvage emporium in Orgrimmar. [gentle] Pray tell, please extend my warmest greetings to Malton; let him know that should he ever thirst for fine drink and finer drinking companions, we would be honored with his visit.
quest_81_quest_progress: [angry] If you're not here to buy anything, and you're not here to deliver anything, then you're wasting my time! [urgent] You better have that ripple!
quest_81_quest_complete:
[excited] Well, let's see what's in this barrel!

[delight] Yes, yes, it looks as though it is all here. [warm] Here's your fee for the package, good job on that. [confident] I stand to make five times that fee when I sell it to the tavern! [laughing] Har har! [excited] These extra bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are going to be set for a special occasion. [excited] I think I'll drink some with champagne. [mocking tone] I'll call it... champipple.
quest_82_quest_detail:
All right now, [soft voice] these reports about the bugs... what we know is that they are draining the water pools that used to be where the Noxious Lair is. [pause] What we DON'T know is, well, everything else.

[urgent] Let's figure out who our enemy is first! [commanding] I want you to head into the Noxious Lair and get some parts off of those critters. [urgent] Get five from the Centipaar there and bring them to Alchemist Pestlezugg for him to dink with. [excited] With him on the case, we'll figure out what they are!
quest_82_quest_progress: [urgent] You're Junior Surveyor <name>, yes? [commanding] Quickly now, there is a dire situation at hand! [angry] Do you have the insect parts that Fizzledowser said you would?!
quest_82_quest_complete:
[excited] Good work - I'll start my analysis on these now! [warm] I can tell you right from the start though... [soft voice] these are nothing like any insect form I have ever seen. [urgent] It's almost as if these bugs are being controlled by an outside force or something.

[urgent] You need to go talk to Fizzledowser right away; apparently there is an emergency that he needs your help with on the double! [excited] I'm not sure, but I think it involves more of the bugs in the Tanaris desert!
quest_83_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

[commanding] Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

[urgent] Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
quest_83_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm running low on linen, <name>. [soft voice] Do you have any for me?
quest_83_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...

[warm] Here you are!
quest_84_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here you go. And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
quest_84_quest_progress: [exhale] Ugh... I'm starving! [urgent] Do you have that pie for me, <name>?
quest_84_quest_complete:
Mm, yum! [excited] This pie is the best!

[warm] I think my memory is coming back to me...
quest_85_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it! [angry] He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here.

[warm] Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
quest_85_quest_complete:
You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

[angry] I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
quest_86_quest_detail:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace. [soft voice] And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies...

[soft voice] Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
quest_86_quest_progress:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

[urgent] Do you have that boar meat?
quest_86_quest_complete: [soft voice] Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
quest_87_quest_detail:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, [hesitant] the old lady's necklace. [shocked] Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

[soft voice] Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine. [urgent] Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
quest_87_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Have you found my necklace?
quest_87_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you found it! [warm] Thank you, thank you dear!

[gentle] Here, take this. [soft voice] It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. [sad] If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! [sobbing] *sniff*
quest_88_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. [angry] The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...[urgent] Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

[warm] Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. [urgent] Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
quest_88_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you see her yet? [urgent] Did you get her?
quest_88_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! [warm] Thank you, <name>.

[excited] Now, do either of these suit you?
quest_89_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor. [soft voice] We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.

[urgent] Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt. [commanding] If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, <name>, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

[excited] Now let's get to work!
quest_89_quest_progress: [urgent] This bridge isn't going to build itself! [commanding] Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
quest_89_quest_complete: [warm] Great work, <name>. [soft voice] These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. [proud] We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
quest_90_quest_detail: [excited] Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! [warm] Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. [commanding] Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks as well as some Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. [soft voice] There are so many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. [gentle] For the herbs, seek out Felicia Gump in her canal district flower shop in Stormwind.
quest_90_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? [soft voice] How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?
quest_90_quest_complete: [warm] Very nice work, <name>! [excited] Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
quest_91_quest_detail:
[solemn] An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. [low voice] This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

[solemn] Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. [commanding] As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

[angry] These vile gnolls must be killed!

[urgent] Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_91_quest_progress: [commanding] Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_91_quest_complete: [solemn] The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, <name>. [warm] By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
quest_92_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. [pause] But there's a slight problem. [sad] During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. [warm] But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

[commanding] Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
quest_92_quest_progress: [urgent] I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
quest_92_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
quest_93_quest_detail:
[whispering] I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs! [shocked] I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks! [commanding] Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

[urgent] I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
quest_93_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, <name>. [urgent] Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
quest_93_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there! [warm] Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

[soft voice] And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
quest_94_quest_detail:
[solemn] My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge. [soft voice] I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.

[hesitant] But to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.

[commanding] If you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar. [emphasis] Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.

[solemn] When this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
quest_94_quest_progress:
[solemn] This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

[soft voice] There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
quest_94_quest_complete:
You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone. It adheres itself... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:

[solemn] You have my gratitude, young <name>. [warm] You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
quest_95_quest_detail:
[solemn] I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

[angry] When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something. He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders. So I never discovered what was hidden.

[soft voice] If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful. The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
quest_95_quest_complete: [solemn] A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
quest_96_quest_progress:
[solemn] You've returned. [delight] Splendid! [soft voice] How went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?

[pause] It is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. [sad] Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. [gentle] But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. [warm] Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
quest_96_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is the proof I asked for. [warm] You've done well, <name>.

[proud] I am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.

[gentle] Use it well, and good luck.

[pause] Your next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. [soft voice] Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. [hesitant] I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. [soft voice] They might have other spells for you to learn.
quest_97_quest_detail: [urgent] Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, <name>! [excited] Her suspicions were correct!
quest_98_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity. Innocent victims died by his hand. Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes. Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire. The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting. [urgent] Travel to his cottage just north of town, <class>, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.

When the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring. After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery. But Darkshire is safer because of her.
quest_98_quest_complete: I know, <name>: [solemn] Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. [sad] My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. [warm] Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning <class>.
quest_99_quest_detail:
[solemn] As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool. [soft voice] I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.

[pause] My knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village. [emphasis] By day, the peasants appear to be Human. [cold] But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.

[urgent] I need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them. [commanding] Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, <name>.
quest_99_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, <name>?
quest_99_quest_complete: [solemn] Your persistence is commendable. With the knowledge you helped me gather, Arugal will fall and his reckless magic shall be undone. [warm] Cheers to you, <name>.
quest_101_quest_detail:
[solemn] As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, <name>. The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

[soft voice] If you wish to protect yourself, noble <class>, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. [warm] For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
quest_101_quest_progress: [commanding] Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. [warm] For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
quest_101_quest_complete: [solemn] Very wise of you, <name>. [warm] This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond. [gentle] When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. [solemn] Be brave, fair <class>. [urgent] You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
quest_102_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stormwind has abandoned us. [sad] A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall. [solemn] This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here. [commanding] We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

[urgent] Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall. [emphasis] Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. [commanding] Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
quest_102_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
quest_102_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was. [warm] Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
quest_103_quest_detail:
[solemn] The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. [sad] I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.
