[low voice] But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. [pause] With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.

[urgent] Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
quest_103_quest_progress: [solemn] The flame will not burn for long without oil, <name>.
quest_103_quest_complete:
[solemn] Praise you, brave <class>. [soft voice] The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. [pause] Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.

[sad] I died needlessly on this very shore. [solemn] My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
quest_104_quest_detail:
[solemn] When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me. [solemn] The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off. [solemn] They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again. [solemn] The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.

[commanding] Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
quest_104_quest_progress:
[commanding] Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? [urgent] He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

[commanding] Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
quest_104_quest_complete: [solemn] So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. [solemn] The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
quest_105_quest_detail:
[solemn] Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!

Inside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion. [low voice] He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable. [commanding] You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.

Destroy Araj, <name>, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
quest_105_quest_progress: [commanding] Your task has been given to you, <name>. Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
quest_105_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [shouting] Araj... the lich is finally defeated!

[warm] You've done a tremendous service to the Horde on this day, <name>. [proud] Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. [commanding] Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Horde a victory for the ages!
quest_106_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, I'm cursed! [sad] My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies. [hesitant] So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

[urgent] Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe. [commanding] He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
quest_106_quest_progress: You have what?? [angry] Maybell is the light of my dull life. [urgent] Hurry, let me see her letter!
quest_106_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! I can't stand us being apart. [urgent] I have to see her!!
quest_107_quest_detail:
[excited] I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

[soft voice] Here, take this note to William. [commanding] He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
quest_107_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? [excited] I haven't seen Mildred in years! [hesitant] I wonder what she has to say...
quest_107_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. [warm] I remember being young and in love, once.

[urgent] There must be something I can do to help them! [pause] Let me think...
quest_109_quest_detail: [soft voice] Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, <class>. [pause] If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle. [solemn] He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall. [gentle] I bet he could use your help. [pause] You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
quest_109_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, so my friend sent you here? [warm] How kind. [solemn] Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause. [commanding] Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. [confident] If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
quest_110_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order. [hesitant] I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.

[urgent] I'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him. If they're ready, bring them to me.
quest_110_quest_complete:
Yes, I have the results right here. [soft voice] They are... unsettling, to say the least

[pause] Our initial suspicion that the bugs are being controlled by an outside force, we believe, is correct. [solemn] If this is the case, then we are dealing with not only a very powerful unknown force, but also a malignant one. [low voice] These bugs have been changed to be pure ravagers. [pause] I've never seen anything quite like it.
quest_111_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Please, <name>, talk with my Gramma. [solemn] If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

[gentle] She's inside our house east of here.
quest_111_quest_progress:
[excited] I can't wait to hear how my friends react!

[soft voice] They'll never expect it
quest_111_quest_complete:
[soft voice] While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... [hesitant] maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
quest_112_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe. But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... [hesitant] sometimes murlocs collect it. [commanding] See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any. Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
quest_112_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have that crystal kelp? [soft voice] I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
quest_112_quest_complete: [confident] You got them. [warm] Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
quest_113_quest_detail:
[urgent] Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser needs to see this report immediately. [soft voice] Actually... everyone who can read needs to see this report. [solemn] We are facing a grave and serious threat to not only Tanaris and Gadgetzan, but if left unchecked, the entirety of southern Kalimdor. [shouting] Heck, even quite possible the whole of Azeroth; this thing has given no indication it will subside.

[commanding] Have Fizzledowser make a duplicate of the report for you to distribute freely to your allegiance. [excited] Everyone must know about this threat!
quest_113_quest_progress: [urgent] Well Junior Surveyor <name>, has ol' Pestlezugg got that report ready yet?
quest_113_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for delivering the report, Junior Surveyor <name>; [warm] here is your pay for your diligent service to the Gadgetzan Water Company.

[low voice] While I am usually not thrilled about handing out our valuable information carte blanche to those who would otherwise pay good coin for it, [pause] I've known Pestlezugg for a number of years now. [hesitant] If he recommends letting everyone know about it, then so be it. [urgent] Give me a moment and I'll make you a copy.
quest_114_quest_detail: [urgent] Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell. [soft voice] It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
quest_114_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? [shocked] What did he say??
quest_114_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh...my! [sad] I feel guilty deceiving my family, but [hesitant] my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [urgent] I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

[gentle] And for you... please take this.
quest_115_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs. [urgent] These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

[commanding] Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters. [solemn] I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
quest_115_quest_progress: [solemn] How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters? [soft voice] Did you find the midnight orbs?
quest_115_quest_complete: Thank you, <name>. [urgent] I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
quest_116_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I find myself in quite a pinch here, <name>. The bottles are close to running dry. The latest booze shipment is long overdue. The orc invasion has been hell.

[urgent] Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. [commanding] Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
quest_116_quest_progress: [urgent] I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. [commanding] Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
quest_116_quest_complete:
[warm] A job well done, <name>! [soft voice] I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again!

[warm] My wife is quite a seamstress. [gentle] Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
quest_117_quest_detail: Hurry, my friend, move with haste [pause] In order for our rich lager to taste [emphasis] More like beer and less like stew, [soft voice] Hops are needed to make the brew.
quest_117_quest_progress: [urgent] Hurry, my friend, move with haste [emphasis] In order for our rich lager to taste [soft voice] More like beer and less like stew, [emphasis] Hops are needed to make the brew.
quest_117_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hops and Barley, yeast and malt [pause] The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, [warm] No need to plead, no need to beg [delight] For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
quest_118_quest_detail:
[low voice] I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

[urgent] Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire. [soft voice] It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
quest_118_quest_progress: [soft voice] What's that? Verner sent you, you say? Well give me his note. [shouting] And SPEAK UP!
quest_118_quest_complete: [laughing] Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
quest_119_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

[emphasis] Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go! [warm] Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
quest_119_quest_progress: [excited] Great, you're back! [urgent] Did you get the shoes?
quest_119_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, this really helps me out.

[surprised] But what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...[shocked] What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? [angry] Bah! [warm] Well, <name>, thank you for your help.
quest_120_quest_detail:
[solemn] These are trying times, <class>. [solemn] The township is under constant siege. [solemn] Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat. [solemn] The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance. [urgent] Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately. [urgent] Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad.

[urgent] Now make haste!
quest_120_quest_complete:
At ease, <class>.

[solemn] Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader. [soft voice] His words carry great weight with me. [commanding] I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him. [warm] Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support. [urgent] Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
quest_121_quest_detail:
[solemn] While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon.

[commanding] Dismissed, <class>!
quest_121_quest_progress: [urgent] Did the General send news? [urgent] Are reinforcements on the way?
quest_121_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for your time, <class>. [solemn] For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

[pause] Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. [solemn] Something is amiss in our Kingdom. [sad] I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
quest_122_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire. [urgent] If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

[solemn] Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander. [hesitant] You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
quest_122_quest_progress: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon. [urgent] Have you found those scales yet?
quest_122_quest_complete: [excited] Thanks! [warm] These will get me out of debt to Argus...
quest_123_quest_detail:
[solemn] This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.

From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.

[urgent] This sounds important. You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
quest_123_quest_progress:
[angry] What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

[urgent] Let me see that note you have...
quest_123_quest_complete: Hm... [hesitant] I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. [solemn] Thank you for the schedule. [confident] It will help us solve this mystery.
quest_124_quest_detail:
[angry] As if the attacking orcs weren't enough! [urgent] Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

[soft voice] If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
quest_124_quest_progress: [commanding] Yes? [urgent] Is there something I can do for you?
quest_124_quest_complete: [warm] Thank you for all your help, <name>.
quest_125_quest_detail:
I could really use a hand here, <name>. [urgent] With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies. [sad] My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out. [sad] We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult. [angry] Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

[sad] Retrieve my toolbox, <name>, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest_125_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to find my tools?
quest_125_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent recovery, <name>! [warm] I never thought I'd see these tools again.
quest_126_quest_detail:
<name>, the gnolls are still out there. [urgent] I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire. [emphasis] And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler, their leader.

[commanding] Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering! [emphasis] Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason. [low voice] He is no Mongrel...
quest_126_quest_progress: [solemn] Yowler is a dangerous creature, <name>. [soft voice] If you're not ready for him, I understand.
quest_126_quest_complete: [warm] Again, thank you for your help. [soft voice] The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
quest_127_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish. [soft voice] There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

[urgent] Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them. [hesitant] If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
quest_127_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have some sunfish for me, eh?
quest_127_quest_complete: [delight] Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
quest_128_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. [solemn] The Enemy has invaded our lands. [commanding] These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. [soft voice] Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. [urgent] You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

[commanding] Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. [commanding] Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
quest_128_quest_progress: [urgent] Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
quest_128_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, <class>. [warm] Your service to our township is great indeed.
quest_129_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Can you do me a favor? I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol... he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

[hesitant] So if you deliver his lunch for me and come back here, I'll give you a free lunch! [warm] Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
quest_129_quest_progress: [soft voice] Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? [warm] Such a kind heart she has. [pause] Well...let's have it!
quest_129_quest_complete: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
quest_130_quest_detail:
[gentle] Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me? [soft voice] You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

[hesitant] But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
quest_130_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

[hesitant] I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
quest_131_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here is your bouquet. [soft voice] I chose Daffodils for you. [excited] They're my favorite!
quest_131_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [gentle] Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
quest_131_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, those are lovely! [excited] I can't wait to put them in some water!

[hesitant] But...these are Martie's favorite flowers. [soft voice] Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he? [hesitant] You didn't tell her who they were for, did you? [sad] If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

[warm] Oh, but it's not your fault. [warm] Thank you, and here's your meal.
quest_132_quest_detail:
[solemn] What I am about to tell you could cost me my life. [urgent] The Defias gang is up to something big. [soft voice] Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

[commanding] Take this note to Stoutmantle. [solemn] It explains as much as I know on the subject.
quest_132_quest_progress: [commanding] Good to see you back, <name>. [urgent] What did Wiley have to say for himself?
quest_132_quest_complete: [angry] Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. [solemn] But this information is crucial. [warm] Good work.
quest_133_quest_detail:
[solemn] I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! [angry] In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

[urgent] I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

[soft voice] Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
quest_133_quest_progress: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - [urgent] I better put that effigy up quick! [commanding] Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
quest_133_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, thanks. [warm] These will do just the trick!
quest_134_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! [urgent] I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

[gentle] Please, <name>, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
quest_134_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my crate? [hesitant] If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
quest_134_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, <name>! [warm] You have more than earned your reward.

[delight] Aha! Happy! Happy nights ahead!!
quest_135_quest_detail: [hesitant] I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. [soft voice] Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? [urgent] Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. [commanding] Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. [urgent] If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
quest_135_quest_progress: [commanding] What business do you have with me? [low voice] I am a very busy man. . .
quest_135_quest_complete: [solemn] This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
quest_141_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef. [low voice] VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War. [soft voice] Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete. [emphasis] That just might explain a thing or two.

[urgent] I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall. [commanding] Take this to him at once!
quest_141_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
quest_141_quest_complete: [solemn] Edwin VanCleef. . .I know the name well. [sad] To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. [hesitant] I'll need further proof before I believe this.
quest_142_quest_detail: [solemn] We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout. <name>, [urgent] my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine. [commanding] I want you to capture him. If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
quest_142_quest_progress: <name>, [urgent] were you able to gather any information? [urgent] Did you locate the messenger?
quest_142_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge. [urgent] Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.

[pause] We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone. [urgent] We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon. [hesitant] He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life. [commanding] I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout. [solemn] Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
quest_143_quest_detail:
[solemn] Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army. [urgent] They should have been here in force by now. [pause] Time is a luxury we don't have, however. [commanding] I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help. [soft voice] I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

[emphasis] Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle. [solemn] Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
quest_143_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, <class>. [urgent] What business do you have with The People's Militia?
quest_143_quest_complete: [solemn] Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
quest_144_quest_detail:
[solemn] Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read. But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia. [sad] If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, <class>. [soft voice] And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
quest_144_quest_progress: [soft voice] Shall we expect the People's Militia soon? [hesitant] Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
quest_144_quest_complete:
[solemn] I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people? [pause] Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. [warm] I might call upon you again.
quest_145_quest_detail: [solemn] I require your assistance once again. [soft voice] I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense. [urgent] It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly. [commanding] You must exercise extreme caution. [solemn] Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood. [urgent] Do not stray from the roads.
quest_145_quest_progress: [solemn] You appear to have traveled from afar, <class>. [soft voice] What business do you have here in Darkshire?
quest_145_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you for making the long journey here. [warm] This is indeed important information.
quest_146_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad. [angry] Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid? The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land. [urgent] If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

[commanding] Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
quest_146_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, good to see you back, messenger. [solemn] Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
quest_146_quest_complete:
[commanding] By the Light! The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so?

Oh I forgot to reward your service, <class>. [warm] Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
quest_147_quest_detail:
[commanding] If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom! [urgent] Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me. It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...

[solemn] That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. [urgent] You should search for him there.
quest_147_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the Collector? [commanding] Did you discover whom he's working for?
quest_147_quest_complete:
[excited] You found him? Well done, <name>. [proud] He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again!

[warm] And this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in Stormwind. [solemn] Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?

Difficult questions. [solemn] I hope one day we'll have answers.
quest_148_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, what is a poor old man to do? [sad] I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...[pause] I would never make the trip.

[hesitant] Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread? [gentle] You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
quest_148_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? [hesitant] I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
quest_149_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.

[soft voice] Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair. [pause] Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.

[urgent] And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
quest_150_quest_detail:
[solemn] Murlocs are becoming a problem. [urgent] Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm! [angry] We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!

[commanding] Hunt murlocs! Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
quest_150_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those fins? [commanding] Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
quest_150_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

[hesitant] It's strange seeing them so far from the sea. [pause] I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
quest_151_quest_detail:
[excited] Poor Old Blanchy! [soft voice] Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. [sad] I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. [warm] If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

[urgent] I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. [solemn] There are several farms southwest of here.
quest_151_quest_progress: [soft voice] Old Blanchy is on her last leg. [hesitant] Did you happen to find any oats for her?
quest_151_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you so much, <name>! [warm] Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
quest_152_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. [solemn] The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. [commanding] The Murlocs are trouble though.

Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
quest_152_quest_progress: [commanding] Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners [emphasis] and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
quest_152_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] You have quite a knack for combat. [warm] Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
quest_153_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Defias Front is constantly shifting. [soft voice] I've been following their movements for quite some time now. [pause] On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

[commanding] Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
quest_153_quest_progress: [urgent] Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
quest_153_quest_complete: [warm] Nice work, <race>. [warm] Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
quest_154_quest_progress: [soft voice] I sense that you have seen Blind Mary. [hesitant] You have my Comb...?
quest_154_quest_complete: [soft voice] I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare. [warm] Here are some coins for those extra strands.
quest_155_quest_detail:
[threatening] So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny <race> like you to protect me? [mocking tone] Guess you'll have to do. [urgent] Better bring some friends too.

You know the deal, right? [commanding] You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout. [low voice] But you better be close by my side. [angry] The Defias gang wants my head now. [urgent] If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.

[commanding] Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
quest_155_quest_progress: [angry] What business do you have with me? [low voice] I am a very busy man...
quest_155_quest_complete: [excited] Most excellent, <name>! [proud] VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
quest_156_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.

[low voice] Rot blossoms grow in strange places. In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... [hesitant] not that I've gotten close enough to look!

[urgent] The Raven Hill Cemetery and the Tranquil Gardens are both lousy with those skeletons. [commanding] You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms. [warm] The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
quest_156_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hi, <name>. [urgent] You have that rot blossoms for me yet?
quest_156_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Good, you got the rot blossoms. [warm] And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons.

[solemn] Keeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in Duskwood is welcome news indeed.
quest_157_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here is your thread, <name>. [solemn] It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
quest_157_quest_progress: [soft voice] I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits. [hesitant] Did you get it for me?
quest_157_quest_complete:
[delight] Delightful! This will do splendidly...

[warm] Here, good <name>, take this as payment for your honorable deed.
quest_158_quest_detail:
I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. [urgent] Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.

And please hurry, <name>. [soft voice] These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
quest_158_quest_complete: [soft voice] You need some Zombie Juice, do you? [pause] Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
quest_159_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here's your Zombie Juice...

...and be careful with this stuff. [urgent] It's strong enough to raise the dead!
quest_159_quest_progress: [low voice] I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights. [hesitant] Did you get it for me?
quest_159_quest_complete:
[solemn] A thousand thanks, <name>. [warm] You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!

[warm] Here you are, friend. [proud] Take this as a token of my gratitude.
quest_160_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.

He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am! [laughing] Hahahaha!
quest_160_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Abercrombie...? I don't know a person of that name. [hesitant] You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

[commanding] Well let's have it then...
quest_160_quest_complete: <Ello looks at the letter...> [solemn] What language is this? [soft voice] It looks ancient...I can't read it.
quest_161_quest_detail:
If my suspicions are correct, [solemn] this is some type of explosive powder. [low voice] This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. [urgent] I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, <name>.

Travel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the Wetlands and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr. [commanding] Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!
quest_161_quest_progress: [soft voice] You say somethin', sonny? Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears. [pause] Say, what's that you got there?
quest_161_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.
quest_162_quest_detail:
[solemn] I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.

[soft voice] I know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight. [excited] She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot! [urgent] If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report. [solemn] We'll need the help.

[pause] Last I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.
quest_162_quest_progress: [soft voice] Peace and tranquility be on to you, stranger. [solemn] Why have you sought me out this day?
quest_162_quest_complete:
[solemn] This report... we night elves know of the terror mentioned here. [soft voice] Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me.

[urgent] These creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. [emphasis] Familiarize yourself with this name, <name>: silithid. [solemn] The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.

[sad] If only we were smart enough to see that before.
quest_163_quest_detail:
[solemn] Something's amiss at Raven Hill, <name>. [soft voice] Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. [hesitant] Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

[urgent] If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
quest_163_quest_progress:
[excited] Ah, <name>! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...[hesitant] You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
quest_163_quest_complete: [shouting] No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! [sobbing] They're everywhere... I can't escape them! [hesitant] Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.
quest_164_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! [solemn] He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

[pause] Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. [gentle] Will you deliver these supplies to him?
quest_164_quest_progress: [commanding] You look a sturdy type, <class>. [urgent] Have you come to join our fight?
quest_164_quest_complete: [solemn] These supplies will be most useful. [soft voice] The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. [warm] Here is a little something for your trouble.
quest_165_quest_detail: [soft voice] There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. [hesitant] Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
quest_165_quest_complete:
[laughing] Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.

[sad] No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. [hesitant] Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
quest_166_quest_detail: [solemn] There is but one task left for you to complete. [commanding] Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated. While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all. [urgent] Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
quest_166_quest_progress: [commanding] How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
quest_166_quest_complete:
<name>, [warm] your bravery is remarkable. [solemn] The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall. [proud] With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood. [soft voice] Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

[excited] I salute you, Lord!
quest_167_quest_detail:
[solemn] We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. [sad] No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. [pause] Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. [sad] I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

[soft voice] You look like you might have better luck in there. [hesitant] If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful. [sad] He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. [sad] If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
quest_167_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find any sign of my brother? [hesitant] Is there any hope after all this time?
quest_167_quest_complete: [solemn] My suspicions were correct. [sad] My poor brother.... [soft voice] Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
quest_168_quest_detail: [solemn] Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in. [soft voice] If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them. [gentle] If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
quest_168_quest_progress: [hesitant] Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
quest_168_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for collecting these, <name>. [solemn] Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. [pause] I will see to it that the families are notified.
quest_169_quest_detail: Wanted! [urgent] Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire.
quest_170_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I hope you're here to lend us a hand, <class>. [solemn] After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

[urgent] I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. [urgent] They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

[angry] And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west!

[urgent] We're a bit shorthanded here, lad , and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
quest_170_quest_complete: [solemn] If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, [urgent] we have some troubles ahead of us! [soft voice] I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
quest_171_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have been so very kind to me, <name>. I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week. Thank you. I don't wanna be sad about what's happened to me and all - my folks always told me to rise above anything bad that happens. You know, when I grow up I wanna be a hero... just like you.

[sad] I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home. [warm] Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!
quest_171_quest_progress: [soft voice] It is a pleasure to see you again, <name>. [gentle] Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?
quest_171_quest_complete:
[solemn] May the heavens bless you, <name>. [warm] You've done more for Randis than most would ever think of doing for him. [delight] Thank you - you're a shining star in the skies of the Alliance.

[gentle] Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. [soft voice] I know that Randis would like that, as would I.
quest_172_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You're willing to help us here at the orphanage? [warm] Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.

[commanding] Take this whistle. [solemn] You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself. [urgent] When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after. [commanding] Using it again will dismiss the child.

[warm] By all means <name> - use the whistle and meet your ward! [excited] I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.
quest_172_quest_complete:
[excited] Zug zug! My name is Grunth, and I guess you're looking after me? You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were. [soft voice] My matron says that they died with honor in battle. I'm happy to meet you.

[excited] I hope we'll do plenty of things together. [soft voice] I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big brother to me during this week. [warm] I'd like that a whole bunch.
quest_173_quest_detail:
[solemn] Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. [solemn] Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. [soft voice] Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

[commanding] You believe yourself worthy to join us?

[soft voice] I once thought as you. [sad] Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. [urgent] If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

[emphasis] Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
quest_173_quest_complete:
[commanding] Impressive, <name>. [commanding] It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.

[solemn] It is curious though... [solemn] The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. [solemn] But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
quest_174_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. [solemn] A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

[urgent] Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer. [emphasis] That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
quest_174_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
quest_174_quest_complete: [delight] This is perfect, <name>. [excited] The first step is complete!
quest_175_quest_detail: [soft voice] According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light. I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass. [hesitant] Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project? [solemn] I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
quest_177_quest_progress: [soft voice] I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. [soft voice] He was impressed. [soft voice] Did you happen to find a reflective device?
quest_177_quest_complete: [delight] Most superb! [excited] This will work perfectly. [warm] Many thanks!
quest_178_quest_detail:
<You hear a disembodied voice...> [solemn] Do not be alarmed. I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest. The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.

[soft voice] Through months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants. [emphasis] If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.

[urgent] Bring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
quest_178_quest_progress: [solemn] I spoke to you through a pendant, you say? Hmm...[pause] give it to me, so that I might study it.
quest_178_quest_complete:
You have my gratitude, <name>. [solemn] I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure. [soft voice] But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.

[solemn] In time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.

[hesitant] But before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.
quest_179_quest_detail:
[commanding] What do we have here? [soft voice] You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

[warm voice] I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. [pause] I've one condition, however.

[urgent] I need you to go get me some wolf meat. [mocking tone] Nice arrangement, hm? [threatening] You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. [pause] Well, what do you say?
quest_179_quest_progress: [commanding] Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? [urgent] You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
quest_179_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. [warm] Oh, don't worry, <name>, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. [proud] Here, one of these should fit you.
quest_181_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device. [soft voice] Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort. The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.

[pause] There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood. [urgent] If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
quest_181_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
quest_181_quest_complete: [excited] At last! The stargazing device is complete! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Now I can continue my research. . .
quest_182_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. [soft voice] The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

[low voice] From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. [emphasis] I'd say that the army will not be necessary. [confident] A few strong arms should be more than enough.

[gentle] Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? [warm] I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
quest_182_quest_progress: [solemn] From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. [soft voice] I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, <name>.
quest_182_quest_complete: [angry] Argh! [angry] Those Light-blasted trolls! <He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.> [angry] A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! [sad] I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
quest_183_quest_detail:
[excited] Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

[soft voice] Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. [urgent] No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. [sad] In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

[solemn] Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
quest_183_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_184_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. [pause] And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed. Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.

The Furlbrows won't give us trouble. Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."

[soft voice] You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
quest_184_quest_progress:
[urgent] You have the deed to my farm?? [excited] That's good news! [sad] Some ruffians stole it days ago... [sigh] I thought it was gone for good!

[hesitant] Please, let me have it. [solemn] We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
quest_184_quest_complete:
[warm] Loads of thanks, <name>! [solemn] As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.

[soft voice] I don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
quest_185_quest_detail:
[soft voice] When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.

[commanding] You'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay. [warm] For this reason, we'll start you out easy. [solemn] One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.

[urgent] Test your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.
quest_185_quest_progress: [hesitant] I don't feel confident in training you further, <name>, [pause] until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.
quest_185_quest_complete: [delight] Nicely done, <name>. [warm] You are ready to move on.
quest_186_quest_detail: [soft voice] You are learning, <class>. [commanding] Let us test your skills with the mature cats now. [urgent] Kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers this time out.
quest_186_quest_progress: [solemn] If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. [soft voice] Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
quest_186_quest_complete: [solemn] I am impressed, <class>. [warm] You are progressing quite well.
quest_187_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now I'm going to up the stakes on you and truly test your skill. [urgent] Prove to me you can kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers. [solemn] If you can do that, you will be ready for your final challenge before I declare you a master tiger hunter in Master Nesingwary's presence.

[cold] Elder Stranglethorn Tigers are not only the most difficult to find, they are also the fiercest to defeat.
quest_187_quest_progress: [urgent] You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.
quest_187_quest_complete: [solemn] Most impressive. [soft voice] I believe you are almost ready.
quest_188_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here is the final challenge that I will put forth. [soft voice] We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks. We call the beast Sin'Dall. [commanding] See if you can do what no <race> has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall. [urgent] Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.

[low voice] Tracking her down will be no easy task.
quest_188_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the hunt for Sin'Dall?
quest_188_quest_complete: [delight] Most impressive, I do say! [warm] You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, <name>!
quest_189_quest_detail:
[angry] Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! [urgent] I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! [hesitant] How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?

[emphasis] Decisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... [excited] I've got it! You... <name>, is it? [commanding] You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!

[low voice] Here's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
quest_189_quest_progress:
[urgent] You've had success I hope? All over the place, those trolls. Filthy devils.

[excited] Oh yes, that reminds me! Be sure to tell your friends, yes? We could use much assistance!
quest_189_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh excellent, excellent. That'll help a little, for the present...

<He trails off, grumbling about profit margins and costs...>

[hesitant] What? You're still here? [excited] Reward? Oh, right... of course, here, take this... [warm] it should be more than enough.
quest_190_quest_detail:
[commanding] If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group Hemet has assembled, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter. [soft voice] We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry. [emphasis] Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.

[solemn] Tracking them down is only half the challenge...
quest_190_quest_progress: [solemn] A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. [commanding] Show some commitment to your goal, <class>, and get back out there.
quest_191_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now you're ready to turn it up a notch. [soft voice] If you want to prove yourself worthy of socializing with the likes of these big game hunters, you'll need to prove that you can kill 10 panthers.

[emphasis] Those big boys are tougher. [low voice] They're not as easy as the young ones you were killing earlier.
quest_191_quest_progress: [commanding] Go kill 10 panthers! [excited] Show us what you've got!
quest_192_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now the hard part. [solemn] A true panther hunter can show skill by dropping Shadowmaw Panthers, the deadliest in Stranglethorn. [urgent] Prove to us that you can slay 10 of these beasts.

[hesitant] If you think they are hard to track, wait until you attempt to slay one....
quest_192_quest_progress: [angry] What are you doing here, <name>! [commanding] You should be crawling through the brush, trying to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers. [mocking tone] I thought you fancied yourself a big game hunter?
quest_193_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers. [urgent] A panther by the name of Bhag'thera has been prowling the jungle. So far he's eluded our party. [commanding] See if you can use your skills to kill the great Bhag'thera.

[warm] Bring me the Fang of Bhag'thera and you'll have earned my respect!
quest_193_quest_progress: [solemn] Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. [soft voice] How fairs the hunt?
quest_194_quest_detail:
[commanding] So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape? [urgent] I can put them to the test in a jiffy. Head out into that jungle and kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors. [emphasis] We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.

[threatening] And no, I won't tell you where you can find them! [mocking tone] Locating the beasts is half the challenge.
quest_194_quest_progress: [commanding] I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire. [angry] Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
quest_195_quest_detail: [commanding] Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it. [urgent] Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors. [excited] Let's see what you've got!
quest_195_quest_progress: [commanding] A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.
quest_195_quest_complete: [excited] Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth! [warm] Nice killing, <name>!
quest_196_quest_detail: [commanding] Let's see how you handle this next challenge. [solemn] There is a cagey breed of raptor out there. We call them Jungle Stalkers. [soft voice] They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at. [urgent] Kill 10 Jungle Stalkers and I'll tip you off to the best hunting yet.
quest_196_quest_progress: [angry] Bah! What are you doing standing around, <name>! [commanding] A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. [low voice] Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. [mocking tone] Silly bloke .
quest_196_quest_complete: [excited] Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer! [warm] Nicely done, old chap!
quest_197_quest_detail:
[commanding] Because you proved yourself to be such a go-getter in the jungle, let me tell you about a ferocious raptor that even I have failed to kill. [soft voice] Ajeck here calls this wily raptor Tethis.

[urgent] If you want to prove yourself a true master, kill Tethis and bring me his talon. [proud] It would be a feat that no other big game hunter has accomplished.
quest_197_quest_progress: [commanding] How goes the hunt for Tethis? [urgent] Tracked her all the way back to camp, did you?
quest_197_quest_complete:
[excited] Master <name>, the raptor slayer!

[chuckling] Has a nice ring to it, eh?
quest_198_quest_detail:
[commanding] Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.

They haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.

[threatening] Mind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.
quest_198_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes? What do you want? [soft voice] Oh, supplies from the goblins. [hesitant] Strange seeing a <race> delivering them, usually they send their own. [low voice] No matter... you didn't touch them did you? [whispering] Good good... we wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.
quest_198_quest_complete: [solemn] These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. [warm] Thank you for bringing them. [confident] If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
quest_199_quest_detail: [soft voice] You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
quest_199_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you happen to discover any clues, <name>?
quest_199_quest_complete: [solemn] This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!
quest_200_quest_detail:
[solemn] If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst. [urgent] We must determine how the secret was leaked!

Thorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod. [low voice] Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound. [soft voice] If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.

[solemn] When we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house. [pause] His records are probably still there.
quest_200_quest_complete:
[solemn] These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.

[soft voice] Among them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.
quest_201_quest_detail:
[urgent] I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. [low voice] Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there? [whispering] He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.

[commanding] Why don't you go check out the camp, <name>, see what they're about?
quest_201_quest_progress: [urgent] Well? [urgent] Did you have any luck in locating the camp?
quest_201_quest_complete: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual. [soft voice] Interesting. [low voice] Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but [hesitant] perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products. [inhale] Hmmm...
quest_202_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself. [urgent] You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!

[commanding] He commands his men from deep within the Stockpile. [urgent] You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.

[soft voice] Farewell, <name>. [solemn] My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.
quest_202_quest_progress: [solemn] Dare I hope that Kurzen and his defenders are dead, <name>?
quest_202_quest_complete:
[solemn] I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that... [urgent] Kurzen and his leaders are defeated. [warm] You have saved us!

[solemn] These jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen. We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
quest_203_quest_detail:
[solemn] We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen. [angry] Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1! [urgent] To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.

[commanding] Enter his camp to the east and kill his men. Lots of them. And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
quest_203_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope you've been successful in your hunting, <name>. [urgent] We won't last long against him without your help.
quest_203_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done. The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.

[soft voice] But now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
quest_204_quest_detail:
[urgent] To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized. He has gathered around him a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts.

[solemn] We need those remedies to cure our own people, and we need a sample of those extracts to study so we can make our own remedies. [commanding] Search the Kurzen Compound for both - his Medicine Men will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
quest_204_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, <name>.
quest_204_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape. [gentle] And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
quest_205_quest_detail: [solemn] While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic. [urgent] Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
quest_205_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those fetishes, <name>? [whispering] They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...[emphasis] I must know!
quest_205_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you. [solemn] I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
quest_206_quest_detail:
Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives! [solemn] Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn. He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.

[urgent] If Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.

[commanding] Kill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
quest_206_quest_progress: [solemn] I give you my blessing. [low voice] Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.
quest_206_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! You've done it! [warm] You are a great force for good, <name>, and may your strength never fade!

[solemn] I will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. [threatening] If not... then it must be destroyed.
quest_207_quest_detail:
[solemn] Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity! [urgent] He may be under the sway of troll magic. To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.

[soft voice] There are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn. [emphasis] I must see what is written on these tablets! [commanding] Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.

[solemn] The first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.
quest_207_quest_progress: <name>! [urgent] Do you have the troll legends? [excited] I must know their secrets!
quest_207_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.
quest_208_quest_detail:
<name>, you are a hunter worthy of our company. [solemn] From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.

[proud] You have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis. [emphasis] But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash. [urgent] That white tiger is the reason I am here. [emphasis] I've had my sights on him for quite some time now. [commanding] Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
quest_208_quest_progress: [commanding] I see you're back, old bloke. [angry] King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times. [urgent] Hang in there.
quest_208_quest_complete:
[excited] Bloody well done! Right-o! [warm] Congratulations, <name>, for succeeding where others have failed.

[proud] I am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. [loud voice] No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!

[excited] Cheers to you, I say! Cheers!
quest_209_quest_detail:
[low voice] It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. [soft voice] Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.

[solemn] The closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.

[mocking tone] Hey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? [urgent] Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!
quest_209_quest_progress: Tough buggers, aren't they? Well, have you had any luck? Sorry to seem impatient, but this has been a huge thorn in my side! Well?
quest_209_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, good work, good work! [groan] Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! [warm] My thanks to you, <name>, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! [chuckling] Good good, now, onto other matters...
quest_210_quest_detail: [soft voice] I do most of the cooking at the camp. And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay. [delight] The pot is a wonder! It saved me countless hours...[sad] until it broke! [urgent] Can you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it? His name is Krazek.
quest_210_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot! [soft voice] An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then. [hesitant] Let me see what's wrong with this one...

[emphasis] Aha! Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth. [surprised] I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state!

[urgent] Can I fix it? [confident] Of course I can fix it!

[whispering] But there's a price. [low voice] Oh yes, there is always a price...
quest_211_quest_detail:
[solemn] Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!

[urgent] Inside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion. [commanding] He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable. [commanding] You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.

[urgent] Destroy Araj, <name>, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
quest_211_quest_progress: [commanding] Your task has been given to you, <name>. Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
quest_211_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [proud] Araj... the lich is finally defeated!

[warm] You've done a tremendous service to the Alliance on this day, <name>. [solemn] Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. [urgent] Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Alliance a victory for the ages!
quest_212_quest_detail:
[soft voice] One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette. [hesitant] But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!

[urgent] So if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!

[commanding] Cold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do. [emphasis] And be swift!
quest_212_quest_progress: <name>! Do you have that haunch? [urgent] I must begin preparing it soon, or the banquet will be ruined!
quest_212_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, this will do nicely! [warm] Many, many thanks!

[urgent] Now if you'll excuse me, I must get the haunch chopped, marinated and garnished for the banquet.
quest_213_quest_detail:
[angry] He's done it this time! [sad] Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!

[urgent] Revilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.

[mocking tone] My way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. [commanding] Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.
quest_213_quest_progress:
[urgent] I need those stones, <name>. [angry] By whatever means necessary! [commanding] Just do it, don't give me the details!

[urgent] It's about results, <name>, nothing more, nothing less.
quest_213_quest_complete: [solemn] Fascinating. That the crystals have been tumbled using this process can only indicate that they are planning to use them as some sort of fuel or other catalyst. [soft voice] I don't know much more than that. [urgent] Samples will have to be dispatched to Head Chemist Gigglefont.
quest_214_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas. [solemn] But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

[commanding] That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can. [urgent] The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout. [soft voice] When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_214_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang? [soft voice] If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
quest_214_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>! [proud] On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts. [solemn] Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
quest_215_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Thank you for saving me, <name>. [hesitant] I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.

[solemn] I was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels. [sad] You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound. [sad] I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.

[urgent] This was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one. [soft voice] But if you speak with Doren he will explain.
quest_215_quest_complete:
Yes, what Thorsen told you is true. [whispering] You must be discrete with this. At one time, we rebels were fiercely loyal to Colonel Kurzen. But such was Kurzen's corruption, [sad] our passion twisted into rage. If it was made known that Private Thorsen has had recent dealings with Kurzen's men, then one night he would find himself with a slit throat.

To my knowledge, only Sergeant Yohwa, Thorsen and I were privy to Thorsen's mission. [solemn] But there must be another. [threatening] A traitor.
quest_216_quest_detail:
[commanding] The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! [urgent] Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

[solemn] <name>, we must not allow... [emphasis] an expansion path gap!

[commanding] Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. [warm] You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
quest_216_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you taken the fight to the Thistlefur? [urgent] With a clear path between our bases, our chances of claiming the whole of Ashenvale increase dramatically.
quest_216_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done <class>, well done! [warm] I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements. [proud] The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

[warm] You've earned your pay this day, hero. [proud] I salute you!
quest_217_quest_detail:
