<name>, [solemn] our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion. It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. [low voice] Grawmug is heavily guarded, however. Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

[commanding] If you feel yourself worthy, <name>, [urgent] I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs. [solemn] With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
quest_217_quest_progress: [solemn] Grawmug and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, are still alive. [urgent] Your mission is not complete until all 3 have been brought to death. [commanding] The Dwarven empire is counting on you, <name>.
quest_217_quest_complete: [excited] Most excellent, <name>! [warm] You have brought hope to Loch Modan. [proud] With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
quest_218_quest_detail:
[urgent] My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

[hesitant] You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
quest_218_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful, <name>! [warm] Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. [soft voice] Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

[solemn] After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
quest_219_quest_detail:
[urgent] At last, friends of the Alliance!

Help... please... The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. [sad] Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly.

I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
quest_219_quest_complete: [solemn] You have served the Kingdom well, <class>. [warm] Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. [proud] You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
quest_220_quest_detail:
[solemn] Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. [soft voice] The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.

[urgent] Go now and find her. [solemn] We shall meet again some day.
quest_220_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [warm] You're looking well.

[gentle] What brings you back to me so soon?
quest_220_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, a vial of water created and blessed by Brine, and gathered by you, no less.

The liquid in this vial will be key in creating a sapta for you, but also used in one other task.

The sapta I create for you should be used to see the water spirits at the shrine in Silverpine Forest, south of the Undercity. The remaining drops, well, the remaining drops I will tell you about if you feel you are ready.

[warm] Are you prepared for one more journey, <name>?
quest_221_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. [solemn] These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

[commanding] Be on your guard.
quest_221_quest_progress: [hesitant] Back so soon, <name>? [soft voice] I hope you haven't come to tell me you've given up.
quest_221_quest_complete:
[solemn] You performed well against the Dark Runners, <name>. But it seems as though their numbers are inexhaustible. Every time we make progress, more spring up to refill their ranks.

[soft voice] What is the evil power that draws them here? [sad] Why have they come to disturb our unhappy realm...

[pause] I will put my faith in Master Carevin. [confident] No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
quest_222_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.

Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.

[soft voice] From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
quest_222_quest_progress: Intimidating beasts aren't they? [soft voice] But have no fear, <name>, [commanding] those who stand for the Light will never fall!
quest_222_quest_complete: <name>, [solemn] to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly a <class> to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, [warm] I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
quest_223_quest_detail:
[gentle] Here you go, <name>. [urgent] Bring this message to Master Carevin.

<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>

[excited] A few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! [solemn] Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.
quest_223_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes, what is it? [urgent] Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
quest_223_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Excuse me for my cold reception, <name>, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. [solemn] I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat--and that he has given his recommendation.

[commanding] There are unsavory types afoot, <name>, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. [urgent] We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. [emphasis] Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.

[solemn] Glory under the Light.
quest_224_quest_detail:
[urgent] We need to protect the Loch, <name>! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. [solemn] Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge. [commanding] These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

[urgent] We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat. Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
quest_224_quest_progress: [urgent] Loch Modan is under siege, <name>! We need every able-bodied member of the Alliance to aid our cause. [commanding] Have you killed 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts yet?
quest_224_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>! [proud] You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield. [solemn] Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours. [proud] You have served King Magni well.

[gentle] If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw. [commanding] The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with. [urgent] Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
quest_225_quest_detail: [solemn] The weathered grave marker reads simply:
quest_226_quest_detail:
[solemn] Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all. [soft voice] And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food. [hesitant] It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite. [urgent] It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!

[warm] But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it. [commanding] They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
quest_226_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh good. You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.

[warm] Here, take some of these Flash Bundles. They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
quest_227_quest_detail: <He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.> [soft voice] If you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
quest_227_quest_complete:
Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of...

Oh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?

Well, I'll give you the short version. [solemn] A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. [soft voice] He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people.

<She sizes you up.>

[urgent] You seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.
quest_228_quest_detail:
[solemn] From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. [soft voice] We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?

[hesitant] There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
quest_228_quest_progress: [soft voice] I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, <name>. [solemn] Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
quest_228_quest_complete:
[excited] You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, <name>! [warm] On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you.

[soft voice] Ah... there is one small matter, however...
quest_229_quest_detail:
I should have told you this earlier...

[hesitant] How do I put this...

Morgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter Sarah Ladimore is now a Watcher. [solemn] She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. [soft voice] Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.
quest_229_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes? My father...

<Her eyes become downcast.>

I wish... there was something I could have done for him... [sad] If only I had talked to him before he...
quest_230_quest_detail: [soft voice] Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.
quest_231_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here, take this and lay it on his grave. [hesitant] Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.

<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>

[pause] And... [sad] thank you, <name>.
quest_231_quest_complete:
<A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...> [solemn] This is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...

<name>. [warm] Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it.

[soft voice] Lys, my love...
quest_232_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance. [whispering] Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.

Apothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher. [soft voice] Fortunately, I am such a researcher. [urgent] I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit. [commanding] When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
quest_232_quest_progress: [commanding] Yes, and what may I assist you with? [solemn] Are you here on business for the Royal Apothecary Society, or have you arrived here merely to brighten my day?
quest_232_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she? [sad] It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.

[solemn] Very well, let me procure a kit for you.
quest_233_quest_detail:
[low voice] Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad ? [soft voice] A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

[solemn] They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. [soft voice] You can find him to the west down the road. [pause] He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

[gentle] What do you say?
quest_233_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes? [commanding] Do you have something for me?
quest_233_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

[pause] Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. [emphasis] This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. [warm] He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
quest_234_quest_detail: [soft voice] If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. [urgent] No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
quest_234_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something I can help you with?
quest_234_quest_complete: [delight] Ahh, excellent. [warm] It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge.
quest_235_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, young adventurers! [excited] The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

[solemn] The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens. [proud] Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde! [urgent] Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there. [emphasis] Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
quest_235_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome to the new frontier, <name>. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young <class> like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

[warm] Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
quest_237_quest_detail:
Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, <race>. [solemn] For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance. [urgent] We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the Alliance front.

[commanding] Set forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers. [emphasis] Your attacks will buy us some time. [solemn] Report back when your mission is complete.
quest_237_quest_progress: [urgent] We need more time, <race>. [commanding] Your orders are to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers. [commanding] Keep the enemy under pressure until we are granted reinforcements. [angry] This is no time for idle behavior.
quest_237_quest_complete:
[solemn] You accomplished your mission well, <race>. The King himself would be proud.

[sad] The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however. [cold] Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren. [sad] The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth. [solemn] But we must not let their deaths go for naught. [urgent] We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

[commanding] Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment. [urgent] You're needed now more than ever.
quest_238_quest_detail:
[solemn] The kit is ready, <name>. [urgent] No doubt that Apothecary Zinge will want this as soon as possible. Take it to her without delay, and let her know that I will add the cost of the kit to the Society's tab. [soft voice] Also, please extend to her my warmest salutations.

[commanding] Well, don't just stand there. [hesitant] Such is the life of a simple courier, yes?
quest_238_quest_progress:
Yes, I think Luca is as disturbing as you do. [solemn] It matters not - hand me the field sampling kit. [urgent] I will need to make some adjustments to it in order to survey for the proper base materials.

[low voice] You have the kit, don't you?
quest_238_quest_complete:
[solemn] Good - it pleases me to be working with someone who takes pride in not wasting my time.

[soft voice] After I make some adjustments to this kit, you'll be ready to head out into the field. You'll be using it to collect some vital data to the task at hand.

It will take just a moment for me to finish the modifications. While you are waiting, you should probably start thinking about what you'd like to bring to the desert with you.

[cold] Yes, I said the desert.
quest_239_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity. [urgent] They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

[hesitant] If you can help, we could use it. [commanding] Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

[soft voice] The Garrison is down the road to the west. [pause] After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
quest_239_quest_complete:
[commanding voice] Marshall Dughan sent you, eh? Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!

[urgent] Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one. [hesitant] I hope you can give us a hand.
quest_240_quest_detail: [excited] And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
quest_240_quest_progress: <name>, you're here! [excited] Do you have my food?!?
quest_240_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [excited] Those really hit the spot!

[warm] And here, please let me pay you for these!
quest_243_quest_detail:
[solemn] You will be headed to the Tanaris desert, testing the tissue consistency of the basilisks, scorpids, and hyena native there. Obtain tissue samples and use them with the testing kit in tow; expect a chunk of the samples to fail. I need eight acceptable samples of each creature type.

In addition, the goblins of Gadgetzan have a power source that must be used with this kind of modified kit. [urgent] Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle and acquire one for the kit.

[commanding] Return to me only when you are successful.
quest_243_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, our model 4711-FTZ power sources! We normally use them to power the water wells, but [angry] THANKS TO THE VILE NOMADS, we have an over abundance of power sources right now.

Sure, I can get you a power source for whatever nefarious science experiment you think you're trying to hide from me. It ain't gonna be free though, <race>. [cold] Nothing's free in Gadgetzan.
quest_244_quest_detail:
Hail, <class>. [commanding] I am charged to patrol this stretch of road. Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

[urgent] Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force! Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls. Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

[warm] Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
quest_244_quest_complete:
[urgent] There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn?? [solemn] They may be poised to advance into our homeland. [urgent] Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

[warm] Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news. [sad] And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
quest_245_quest_detail:
Hail, <class>. [soft voice] Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? [solemn] The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

[hesitant] I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. [low voice] I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

[warm] Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
quest_245_quest_progress:
[commanding] You'd best be careful when dealing with the spiders, [sad] I've lost a few of my men to them, and trust me, it isn't a pleasant sight to see a man hanging upside down in their webs after the venom has started to soften them up.

[threatening] I wouldn't want to see one of the bugs having you for lunch.
quest_245_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! You're back. [warm] And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. [gentle] Of course, <name>, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
quest_246_quest_detail:
[solemn] We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

[urgent] Scout southern Redridge for gnolls. [commanding] Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present. [soft voice] You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

[warm] Do this for the Stormwind Army, <name>, and you will be rewarded.
quest_246_quest_progress: [urgent] Excuse me, <name>, but we have a lot to keep our hands tied here. [soft voice] If you have nothing to report, then I must put my mind to other matters.
quest_246_quest_complete:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...> [solemn] There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones. [soft voice] It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

[warm] Here you are, <name>. [proud] We are grateful for your aid.

[urgent] And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire. [solemn] Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
quest_247_quest_complete:
<name>, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt. [warm] You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. [proud] The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!

[excited] Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. [solemn] May your ancestors watch over you!
quest_250_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam. First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr! [angry] I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat. [low voice] Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.

That's why I need you, <name>. [urgent] I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam. Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
quest_250_quest_complete: [soft voice] The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
quest_251_quest_detail: [urgent] Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. [soft voice] He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
quest_251_quest_progress: [soft voice] A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh? [hesitant] I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
quest_252_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh my! If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.

[urgent] You better bring the translated note back to Ello.

And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
quest_252_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, is the note translated? [hesitant] Please, let me see it...
quest_252_quest_complete: <Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white. He then looks at you...> [solemn] Although the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town. <Ello becomes lost in his thoughts...>
quest_253_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories. [soft voice] He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza. [sad] To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.

[pause] This revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.

[solemn] His heart is his power. [urgent] Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats. [commanding] Do this and his power will be broken.
quest_253_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you yet found Eliza's grave? [urgent] Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
quest_253_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [warm] The magic within his heart will be proof against the Embalmer's evil, and a powerful aegis over the town of Darkshire.

[proud] You have done a great thing for our people, <name>. [solemn] Your name will remain in our annals forever.
quest_255_quest_detail:
[angry] Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

[urgent] I've no choice then, it seems. [commanding] I'll need hired arms.

How about you? [soft voice] You seem a likely sort, <class>. [solemn] A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. [commanding] Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
quest_255_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, this is excellent news! [warm] Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. [solemn] Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
quest_256_quest_detail: [solemn] By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:
quest_257_quest_detail:
[commanding] Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? [angry] I should think not! [soft voice] Of course, you're more than welcome to try. [emphasis] Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

[urgent] A flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. [soft voice] Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? [warm] Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.

<He looks you over dismissively.>

[mocking tone] It seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
quest_257_quest_progress:
[low voice] No luck? [chuckling] Don't feel too bad, <name>...

[mocking tone] Not everyone can be me.
quest_257_quest_complete:
[shocked] What? Success?

[soft voice] Take it from me, <name>ama, you don't let it get to your head. [hesitant] I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. [mocking tone] And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? [solemn] We wouldn't want them to become extinct.

Well, err... [pause] Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
quest_258_quest_detail:
<name>ath, is it? [mocking tone] I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? [low voice] As I told you before, it's no large feat.

[commanding] You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. [urgent] I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

[soft voice] Don't feel bad if you fail. [warm] I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

[solemn] Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? [sad] No? [pause] It was two years ago...
quest_258_quest_progress:
[soft voice] It's only natural to feel sorry for yourself when shown up by someone so new to this world. [gentle] You shouldn't feel bad, <name>.

[hesitant] Hm? Did I get your name wrong?
quest_258_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.

[surprised] Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! [hesitant] Any child could have--bet?

What bet?
quest_261_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will be frank. [solemn] We are at war with the Scourge. [solemn] It is an evil that corrupts our people and infects our land. [solemn] It must be stopped before it overwhelms us and drags our world into shadow. [commanding] We of the Scarlet Crusade have sworn to fight the Scourge with body and soul.

[urgent] If you are with us, then gather your courage and prove your allegiance--destroy the undead ravagers of Desolace, in the Valley of Bones to the south.

[warm] Do this, and the Crusade will embrace you.
quest_261_quest_progress: [solemn] The Scourge grows in power with the passing of each day. [soft voice] If you truly wish to halt its advances, then show me.
quest_261_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have proven your resolve, and the Scarlet Crusade commends you.

[soft voice] If you do not shy from righteous slaughter, then perhaps your path lies with us...
quest_262_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!

[urgent] Please, <name>, you have shown your resourcefulness. [urgent] Please find that shadowy figure. [solemn] I must learn what secrets he holds!

[soft voice] I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm. [gentle] Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.
quest_262_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it. [solemn] I may be able to divine something of its owner.
quest_262_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge. But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.

[hesitant] I can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
quest_263_quest_detail:
[commanding] The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, <name>. We need a <race> like you around here. The Trogg problem isn't getting any better. The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here. [urgent] But now that we have a seasoned <class> here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers. [mocking tone] Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
quest_263_quest_progress: [urgent] Back so soon? In case I didn't make myself clear we need you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers, <name>. [commanding] Now go get 'em, Trogg-Slayer!
quest_263_quest_complete:
[solemn] I knew the second I laid eyes on you, <name>, that you would make Ironforge proud. [warm] You have served King Magni well. [proud] Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.

[warm] I salute you, <name>.
quest_264_quest_detail:
[angry] Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! [shouting] Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, <name>! [cold] He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

[sad] Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
quest_264_quest_progress:
[solemn] The stone is cold to the touch, but has obviously been abused. [sad] Trash litters the area; nicks and gashes decorate the relief atop the coffin; and the foliage around the grave has started to grow over the site.

[soft voice] No one cares for whoever is buried here, especially not any victims of the plague.
quest_264_quest_complete:
[solemn] You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.

[soft voice] As you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. [pause] Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. [pause] For a moment everything around you is silent.
quest_265_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here is your book back, <name>, and I bid you fortune with your search. [pause] If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.

[solemn] And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
quest_265_quest_progress:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

[hesitant] I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
quest_265_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. I sold this book a month ago to a shady person. He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.

[hesitant] I hope that helps you...
quest_266_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.

[gentle] You might want to expand your search to the inn. If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
quest_266_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

[soft voice] If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
quest_266_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh yeah, I remember this book. Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.

[hesitant] He left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something. [pause] Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.

[solemn] The first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...
quest_267_quest_detail:
<class>, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands. [solemn] With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe. [commanding] My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

[urgent] But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills. [emphasis] If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs. [commanding] Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
quest_267_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me? [urgent] If not, there is still work to be done, <name>.
quest_267_quest_complete: [confident] I am quite impressed, <name>. [warm] You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands. [proud] King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
quest_268_quest_detail:
[solemn] The book you found was only half finished. [pause] I had to leave it at Sven's farm when I fled there...

[soft voice] Here. Take my completed journal to Sven. It describes more fully what happened at his farm.

[hesitant] Although this journal has been my only company these past weeks, [emphasis] if giving it up keeps me from having to face Sven and his wrath, then I do it willingly!
quest_268_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
quest_268_quest_complete: [solemn] This journal explains much to me, and sets me on the path against the dark riders! [urgent] I have seen these riders in Duskwood, and have seen them speak with the wizard Morbent Fel, at the Forlorn Rowe.
quest_269_quest_detail:
[solemn] Go to the city of Stormwind and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light. Give him Jitters' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel.

[soft voice] Although Stormwind has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise. [warm] He may help you on your quest to save us.

[urgent] Your mission is perilous, but hurry, <name>. [pause] With each passing hour, the shadows of Duskwood grow ever darker.
quest_269_quest_progress: [soft voice] Rest, brother. I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden. [solemn] Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
quest_269_quest_complete:
<After reading the journal and hearing your intent...> [solemn] An evil taint has gained a foothold within the already beleaguered Duskwood. [warm] I thank the Light we have a hero such as you to face it.

[soft voice] But you must first prepare yourself for the coming trial...for the Necromancer Morbent Fel is immensely powerful, and has cast dark enchantments about himself to protect him from physical assaults. [urgent] If you are to defeat him, you will need a weapon that is proof against these protections.
quest_270_quest_detail:
[solemn] Years ago, the Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras sunk along the coasts of The Wetlands, an expanse of marsh north of the Dwarven kingdom of Ironforge. [soft voice] Aboard one ship was a load of Lightforge Iron.

[solemn] This metal is precious to us, for items crafted from it strike with holy truth. [urgent] If you are to face Morbent Fel, then you will need such a weapon.

[commanding] Go to Menethil Harbor and speak with my dwarven colleague Glorin Steelbrow. [soft voice] If that lost metal can be found, he'll know where to look.
quest_270_quest_complete:
[solemn] Lightforge Iron is a precious metal, but it sounds like your quest is a dire one. [warm] You've come a long way, Brother. With luck, you might just find what you seek!

[excited] And if you do get the iron, I know who can fashion it into a weapon against this Necromancer you speak of in Duskwood.
quest_271_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? [sad] Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.

[solemn] A year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. [hesitant] So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. [sad] All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.

[commanding] Kill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.

[urgent] The bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
quest_271_quest_progress:
[gentle] Ah, <name>! [soft voice] Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? [hesitant] Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

... [whispering] You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
quest_271_quest_complete:
[hesitant] Er... what's this? [soft voice] A bear's head, by the looks at it.

<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>

[warm] Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. [hesitant] Couldn't be that bear from back then...

<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>

[urgent] Oh, take that away take it away! [shouting] Get that grisly thing out of here!
quest_272_quest_detail:
[solemn] For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion. One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect. Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.

[soft voice] Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together. [urgent] Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
quest_272_quest_progress: [gentle] Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, <name>? [soft voice] If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. [solemn] Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
quest_272_quest_complete:
[warm] You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, <name> - congratulations.

[solemn] Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. [soft voice] Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.

[solemn] Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
quest_273_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. [pause] He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.

[emphasis] They're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.

[hesitant] Shouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
quest_273_quest_complete:
Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!

[angry] But Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. [sad] We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.

[hesitant] Well, I'll consider that later.
quest_274_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This ain't no ordinary blast powder. [emphasis] Look at the tiny silver crystals. And the distinct smell! [urgent] Why it's clear as daylight that this is Seaforium Powder. [solemn] Seaforium is harmless enough. But once it's wet it could blow Ironforge out of the mountain.

[commanding] The chemical reaction can be defused by mixing four components: lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, a crocolisk tear and this disarming colloid. [urgent] Now tell Hinderweir before it's too late!
quest_274_quest_progress: [urgent] What is that you bring from Ashlan?
quest_274_quest_complete: [shocked] A disarming colloid? For Seaforium? [excited] Oh heavens!
quest_278_quest_detail:
[urgent] Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, <name>. [soft voice] Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan. [soft voice] Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. [commanding] The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.

[urgent] We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! [warm] Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
quest_278_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the needed items? [emphasis] Time is of the essence!!
quest_279_quest_detail:
[solemn] Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline. [urgent] They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

[low voice] One of these murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other bluegill murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby murloc hovels. [commanding] Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

[urgent] Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here. Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
quest_279_quest_progress: [urgent] Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
quest_279_quest_complete:
[warm] Ah, well done <name>.

[proud] Accept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
quest_280_quest_detail:
[urgent] Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. [angry] No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! [shouting] I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! [low voice] Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture. [pause] There we go.

[urgent] Now I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! [shouting] Hurry!
quest_280_quest_progress: [soft voice] The top of the keg slowly twists off.
quest_280_quest_complete: [soft voice] The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.
quest_281_quest_detail:
[solemn] Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by Murlocs. [soft voice] Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil. [solemn] We want that statuette recovered.

[urgent] Search the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo. [emphasis] Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
quest_281_quest_complete:
[solemn] This crate is covered with clawed scratches, and the marks of water damage. [soft voice] Prying it open reveals soggy and rotted straw, as if something of value was stored in the crate. [pause] You search through the straw...

[pause] ...and find a an armload of red-colored bottles.
quest_282_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. [hesitant] That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... [pause] you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

[urgent] Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. [angry] It's completely infested with troggs now.

[commanding] Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
quest_282_quest_progress:
Hail! [commanding] Have a care, <name>, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

[urgent] If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
quest_282_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

[pause] At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
quest_283_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you so much, <name>!! [warm] You have saved the Stonewrought Dam! [solemn] Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise. [proud] You have made the Kingdom and the Alliance proud, brave <class>.
quest_286_quest_detail: [soft voice] After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw. [solemn] It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.
quest_287_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, <name>. [hesitant] I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.

[pause] Here's what I need... [commanding] Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

[urgent] Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. [solemn] The Hold is southwest of the village.
quest_287_quest_progress: [angry] You can't find it? My directions were very clear! [urgent] We don't have much time, you've got to hurry! [commanding] Don't come back until you've found the cave.
quest_287_quest_complete:
[gentle] Ah, <name>! [soft voice] I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

[pause] Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! [laughing] Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... [hesitant] I don't suppose, <name>, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
quest_288_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. [solemn] The Doomed Fleet. [angry] Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. [shouting] Dragons controlled by Orcs!

[sad] We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. [sad] I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...[sigh] Oh, my head hammers and pounds! [urgent] I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
quest_288_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
quest_288_quest_complete: [delight] Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. [warm] Thanks, mate!
quest_289_quest_detail:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...> [solemn] I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. [soft voice] But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! [pause] For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

[sad] But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
quest_289_quest_progress: [soft voice] In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! [sad] Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
quest_289_quest_complete: [soft voice] My thanks to you, <name>. [warm] And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
quest_290_quest_detail:
[urgent] To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! [sad] I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.

[solemn] My old captain is still in my dreams. [solemn] I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. [commanding] Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.

Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
quest_290_quest_progress: [low voice] This chest is securely locked.
quest_290_quest_complete: [solemn] The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
quest_291_quest_detail:
[excited] Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. [soft voice] He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. [solemn] He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

[urgent] Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

[hesitant] By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? [whispering] Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
quest_291_quest_progress: [low voice] Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. [angry] Well, what do you want? [urgent] Make it quick.
quest_291_quest_complete:
<He quickly peruses the report.> [angry] Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... [threatening] Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

[commanding] What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
quest_292_quest_detail: [solemn] Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light. [soft voice] It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth.
quest_293_quest_detail:
[solemn] I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you. [urgent] Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. [soft voice] He can help.

[hesitant] I hope, for your sake.
quest_293_quest_progress: [commanding] What is that orb you have? [soft voice] It looks...soiled.
quest_293_quest_complete:
[solemn] An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.

[soft voice] Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
quest_294_quest_detail:
[solemn] The situation is severe, that much is for sure. [pause] When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. [angry] These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

[urgent] Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, <name>. [emphasis] Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. [commanding] Kill 10 of each, if you can.

[cold] That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
quest_294_quest_progress: [commanding] Kill 10 Mottled Raptors and 10 Mottled Screechers, <name>. [solemn] My co-workers did not deserve the fate that was brought upon them. [angry] It's time to even the score.
quest_294_quest_complete: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, <name>. [warm] If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
quest_295_quest_detail: [commanding] Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. [urgent] Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. [emphasis] Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
quest_295_quest_progress: [angry] I want to make those Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws pay for what they did. [commanding] Have you killed 10 of each yet?
quest_295_quest_complete: [excited] You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, <name>!
quest_296_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. [emphasis] He was bigger and more menacing. [solemn] I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

[commanding] I ask of you now one final task, <name>. [urgent] See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. [solemn] And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! [emphasis] Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
quest_296_quest_progress: [urgent] Is Sarltooth dead? [solemn] Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
quest_296_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Your efforts here will not be forgotten. [sad] Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. [proud] The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
quest_297_quest_detail:
[solemn] Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols. [pause] But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins! [urgent] And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs. [angry] It makes them go berserk!

[commanding] Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands! [urgent] You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
quest_297_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those Idols? [commanding] We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
quest_297_quest_complete:
[excited] You got them! [warm] Nicely done, <name>!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about. [proud] I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
quest_298_quest_detail:
[urgent] I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder! [emphasis] Here's the report. Take it to Jern Hornhelm. He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

[commanding] It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
quest_298_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, a progress report from the site? [excited] Very good!
quest_298_quest_complete:
Bah! Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs. I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago. I wonder where it went...
quest_299_quest_detail:
[solemn] Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

[sad] I fear we are running out of time. [hesitant] I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. [warm] But you are strong.

[commanding] Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. [urgent] Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. [excited] Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
quest_299_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, <name>? [solemn] Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
quest_299_quest_complete: [excited] Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! [warm] Fine work, <name>. [warm] Fine work indeed. [solemn] Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. [excited] I can make out new words already! [hesitant] Hmm. . .it says here, "Old Gods. . .Chained Beneath the Land." [solemn] This is the beginning of something epic.
quest_301_quest_detail:
[urgent] We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
quest_301_quest_progress: [angry] We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, <class>. [low voice] I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
quest_301_quest_complete:
[angry] Curse that Ironband! [sad] I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

[urgent] So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
quest_302_quest_detail:
[commanding] If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it! [urgent] I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar. [solemn] He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

[emphasis] And one more thing: [commanding] I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination. [angry] The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
quest_302_quest_complete:
[shocked] What? Stormpike wants you to personally see the shipment to Ironband?

[hesitant] I... suppose that's fine, the only problem is, I've already sent Huldar with the porters, Miran and Saean. [sad] You just missed them, they left just a short while ago.
quest_303_quest_detail:
[solemn] War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves. [sad] They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.

[urgent] We need you to gather force and push the front back. If you can kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

[commanding] Now make haste!
quest_303_quest_progress: Roggo has been unable to contact the reserve forces. [urgent] We need offensive pressure on that Dark Iron encampment, <class>. [commanding] Now get back out there and serve your duty to King Magni!
quest_303_quest_complete: [solemn] You upheld your orders well, <class>. [proud] You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! [warm] With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .
quest_304_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr. [sad] My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed. [low voice] Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed. [soft voice] From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of this band of thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul. [angry] He is quite a coward however. [commanding] He sends his soldiers to do his bidding but stays elusive, avoiding danger.

[urgent] If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear. [warm] I will reward you, <class>.
quest_304_quest_progress: [solemn] Were you able to locate Balgaras the Foul yet, <class>? [low voice] He has been evading us for quite some time.
quest_304_quest_complete:
[solemn] Balgaras the Foul is finally dead. [soft voice] While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived. [urgent] With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage. [commanding] Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.

[proud] You have done well, <class>.
quest_305_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh my, you must be the scout Longbraid said he would send! You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

[sad] My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. [urgent] Surely something is wrong!

[commanding] Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. [hesitant] I assume that scout is you, <name>. [urgent] Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
quest_305_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
quest_306_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

[sad] Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
quest_306_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to find Merrin? [soft voice] Did she send word?
quest_306_quest_complete: [sad] Such horrible news! [solemn] At least 3 of them survived. [urgent] But when will the killing end? [solemn] I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
quest_307_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

[angry] We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things. [commanding] It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine. Good luck.
quest_307_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have that Miners' Gear, <name>?
quest_307_quest_complete: [soft voice] Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there? [urgent] I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine. [angry] The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
quest_308_quest_progress: Hmph! [soft voice] There is all this booze down here. [pause] but I have strict orders not to touch it. [hesitant] If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale... [emphasis] that would sharpen my wits, no lying! [delight] Thunder Ale
quest_308_quest_complete: [delight] For me? [warm] You're a true hero, <name>!
quest_309_quest_detail:
[urgent] Ready to go, <name>?

First, we need to get this powder to Ironband. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.

[hesitant] I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
quest_309_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. [solemn] But it is troubling news that you bring as well. [sad] To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.

[pause] That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. [urgent] I must put this powder to good use.
quest_310_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. [low voice] But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! [excited] Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

[warm] Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. [commanding] Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. [urgent] Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

[threatening] And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard ...
quest_310_quest_progress: [soft voice] The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
quest_310_quest_complete: [urgent] You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
quest_311_quest_detail: [solemn] Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
quest_311_quest_complete: [delight] Not bad, <name>! [warm] Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?
quest_312_quest_detail:
[solemn] I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! [angry] But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. [low voice] He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. [sad] But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.

[hesitant] You seem a bit more stealthy than me. [urgent] Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? [sad] I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
quest_312_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to get into my meat locker, <name>?
quest_312_quest_complete: [warm] What a kind soul you are, <name>! [delight] Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
quest_313_quest_detail:
[commanding] Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone. It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both! [excited] How about you? How's your mettle? Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy. [warm] How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos. [delight] Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
quest_313_quest_progress: [urgent] Hey, <name>. [pause] Been to the Grizzled Den yet? Those Wendigos can be fierce.
quest_313_quest_complete: [excited] Ah yes, these manes will work great! [warm] You show a lot of grit, <class> - I wager we'll see great things from you.
quest_314_quest_detail:
[solemn] We heard the cries in the middle of the night. Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams. [angry] That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood. [soft voice] With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

[hesitant] Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him. [urgent] Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you. [commanding] Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
quest_314_quest_progress: [angry] Vagash still terrorizes the herd! [urgent] Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
quest_314_quest_complete: [excited] Very well done! [warm] Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news. [proud] To kill Vagash is no easy task. [confident] I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
quest_315_quest_detail:
[excited] I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout. [confident] I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood. [hesitant] I just need to find the right recipe...

[solemn] The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east. [soft voice] They use it in their strange, tribal rituals. [warm] We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and [delight] I want to experiment with it in my brews!

[urgent] Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.
quest_315_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have that Shimmerweed? [soft voice] I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
quest_315_quest_complete: [delight] Great! I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes. [warm] There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
quest_317_quest_detail:
[urgent] I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade. It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies. So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food. You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... [pause] you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
quest_317_quest_progress: [low voice] Preparations are going well. [soft voice] How goes your hunting?
quest_317_quest_complete: [excited] By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!! [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_318_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews. Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.

[solemn] He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want. [warm] It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.

And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power! [confident] That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
quest_318_quest_complete: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine? Hm...all right.
quest_319_quest_detail:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...[hesitant] can you do me a favor? Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows. Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
quest_319_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you taken care of those wild animals?
quest_319_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
quest_320_quest_detail: [gentle] Here's your cask of Evershine, <name>. [warm] And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
quest_320_quest_complete: [excited] Yes, this will do just fine. [warm] I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
quest_321_quest_detail:
[solemn] The shipwrecks off the shore here are the doomed Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras, burned and sunk by Red Dragons during the last Great War.

The Fleet hailed from Lordaeron, but one ship, an Elvish Destroyer: Flying Osprey, was with it. It was shipping a load of Lightforge Iron and joined the Third Fleet for protection. [sad] Ironic that it sunk to the same dragons...

[pause] Enough history. The Flying Osprey is wrecked to the south of Menethil Harbor. If you find the Lightforge Iron there, bring it to me.
quest_321_quest_complete:
[solemn] This chest is waterlogged, and its siding broken. [sad] Many claw marks mar both the inside and outside of the chest...as if Murlocs have searched through it and stolen its treasure.

[soft voice] But tucked deep within the chest is a single Lightforge Ingot. [hesitant] Unfortunately, many more will be needed if enough metal to fashion a weapon is to be gained.
quest_322_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a dwarven weaponsmith in the Dwarven District of Stormwind who can craft with lightforge iron. His name is Grimand Elmore.

I've packed the iron you found into a crate. Take it to Grimand and tell him your tale. I'm sure he'll oblige someone on a quest such as yours, and craft for you a weapon - [emphasis] a weapon to give even Morbent Fel worry!
quest_322_quest_progress: [gentle] How might I ply my craft for you, <class>?
quest_322_quest_complete:
[solemn] That is quite a tale you have. [excited] And lightforge iron! [warm] Not for years have I worked with such a metal. [gentle] It will be an honor to craft with it again. [commanding] And you must return to me later with the story of your battle against the Necromancer.

[pause] But we get ahead of ourselves. [solemn] First, your weapon against Morbent Fel...
quest_323_quest_detail:
Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. [solemn] I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.

[soft voice] You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
quest_323_quest_progress: [commanding] Battle hard, <name>. [solemn] And do not despair, for despair is evil's greatest weapon.
quest_323_quest_complete: [solemn] Your skill in combat, <name>, can not be doubted. [proud] Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
quest_324_quest_detail: [solemn] Having grabbed the single lightforge ingot from the waterlogged chest, it is clear that murlocs have stolen the rest. [urgent] Hunt the murloc raiders near the Flying Osprey wreckage for the lost lightforge iron.
quest_324_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
quest_324_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, you found them! [warm] Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
quest_325_quest_detail: [solemn] Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke. [soft voice] You're all ready, <name>. [warm] Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!
quest_325_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [pause] You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
quest_325_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel! [excited] Well done! You are ready. [proud] Morbent Fel will fall.
quest_329_quest_detail: [solemn] Among the valuables of the strongbox is a muddy, scribbled note. [soft voice] Although barely legible, it looks to be an itinerary for Private Thorsen. [low voice] It details his patrol routes, who he speaks with and how he spends his time with the rebels. [emphasis] It's signed with only one letter: -M.
quest_330_quest_detail:
The note you gave me is signed with an "-M"...[hesitant] I don't know what that could mean.

But...the note also says this person shared patrol routes with Thorsen last week. So whoever shared patrol with Thorsen last week must be the traitor!

[urgent] Go to Corporal Sethman. He handles the patrol schedules and can tell you who was with Thorsen.
quest_330_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, yes I can check that for you. Let's see...last week it was...

...why, it was [proud] Private Merle scheduled with Thorsen. They had the same patrol times all of last week.
quest_331_quest_detail: [soft voice] Did Lieutenant Doren want you to report back to him with that patrol information?
quest_331_quest_complete: [solemn] It pains me to find out it was Merle who betrayed us. He has always been a brave soldier, and I had thought his heart was true. [sad] But it is a great relief to have found him out - with a spy like him among us...we would not last long against Colonel Kurzen.
quest_332_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind. [warm] And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.

[gentle] Here, take this pamphlet. [warm] Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir. [excited] You won't regret it!
quest_332_quest_progress: [gentle] Greetings and welcome, <name>. [soft voice] Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
quest_332_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, so you've seen Renato? Well here you are, sir. [warm] A bottle of our special pinot noir. [excited] You'll not find its equal in all of Azeroth!
quest_333_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We've been doing a lot of business lately. It seems like everyone is buying armor and sturdy clothes. Almost like they expect a cold, harsh season ahead...

But those are future worries. [pause] My worry today is that I'm running out of knitted clothing to sell. I need another load from our supplier.

[urgent] If you can take this request to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, I'd be most grateful.
quest_333_quest_progress: [urgent] You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
quest_333_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It says here that Harlan's business is booming. [warm] That's good news, but I wonder why people have need of all that armor. [hesitant] I've heard nothing of open war...is there something the nobles aren't telling us?

[pause] Well, thank you for bringing the request. [warm] Here's your payment, and I'll see to it that Harlan gets his supplies.
quest_334_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter. He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles. I know a great <class> like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

[urgent] Please, <name>. Can you take my son's sewing kit to him? [solemn] Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
quest_334_quest_progress: [soft voice] Are you here to buy clothes?
quest_334_quest_complete:
[angry] Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. [sad] Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...

[soft voice] Oh, well. [hesitant] Fun will come later I guess.
quest_335_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lord Wishock is causing quite a stir amongst the House of Nobles. [low voice] He was made aware of our little "establishment" down here and is lobbying for a full investigation. [urgent] I have a plan to keep Wishock "preoccupied," but I'll need your help.

[soft voice] There is a flower growing in the Garden of Stalvan on the outskirts of Darkshire. [whispering] This small white flower is known as the Tear of Tilloa. [commanding] I will also need a Musquash Root, found only at the very base of the falls far beneath the Stonewrought Dam in the Wetlands.
quest_335_quest_progress: [sad] Wishock will soon garner enough support to cause us much grief. [hesitant] Were you able to obtain the Tear of Tilloa or Musquash Root yet?
quest_335_quest_complete: [delight] Most excellent! [excited] These are fine samples indeed!
quest_336_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lord Wishock, like all men, has his weaknesses. His happens to be a fondness for liquor. [angry] The hypocrisy is astounding. The trite fool spends his days trying to shut down our little "tavern" while his nights are spent upstairs, running up a bill he never pays. [mocking tone] Well, let's see how Wishock likes this special brew I have prepared for him: Black Claw stout. [soft voice] It's got quite a kick, <name>.

[urgent] Take it to him and see how he likes it. Most likely the old fool is milling about the Hall of Petitioners.
quest_336_quest_progress:
[angry] Can you not see that I am busy? [shouting] My words must be heard! [commanding] I am very important to the future of this Kingdom!
