[pause] Oh... what have you there? [soft voice] Why it looks like a refreshing drink...
quest_336_quest_complete: [gentle] Ah, thank you for bringing me this fine looking stout, servant. [warm] Here's a copper for you. [commanding] Now, out of sight with you and let me enjoy my drink!
quest_337_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine. [soft voice] Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.

[hesitant] It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
quest_337_quest_progress: [excited] Ooh! [soft voice] What's that old book you have there? [excited] Can I see it??
quest_337_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh my! This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago. It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
quest_338_quest_detail:
[angry] Master Nesingwary will be so upset if he finds out!

[solemn] He trusted me to proofread the manuscript of his novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. [hesitant] Everything was going well, but a large gust of wind blew through the camp and scattered the pages everywhere!

[urgent] I was able to gather most of the pages but many are still strewn about the jungle. [soft voice] Collect the pages to complete each of the four chapters.

[solemn] I will help you organize them. [warm] Return the chapters to me once you have all four.
quest_338_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you assembled the chapters yet, <name>?
quest_338_quest_complete: [excited] You've certainly saved me a heap of trouble, <name>! [warm] I can't thank you enough. [proud] It shouldn't be long now until we see Master Nesingwary's book in libraries throughout the world!
quest_339_quest_detail:
[solemn] Chapter I was quite riveting! [excited] Master Nesingwary sets the backdrop for the story and makes mention of his hunting companions, including me!

[soft voice] But that's besides the point. [hesitant] Let me see which pages are still missing. [urgent] It seems pages 1, 4, 6 and 8 are still out there somewhere in the jungle!
quest_339_quest_progress: [hesitant] I don't suppose you were able to track down pages 1, 4, 6 and 8? [soft voice] Those four are all we need to piece Chapter I back together.
quest_339_quest_complete: [excited] At last! [proud] Chapter I is complete!
quest_340_quest_detail:
[solemn] Chapter II was chock full of exciting tales of panther and tiger hunting. [sad] I could just kick myself for letting the pages blow away!

[urgent] It seems I was able to recover all of the pages with the exception of pages 10, 11, 14, and 16.
quest_340_quest_progress: [urgent] We still need pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 to complete Chapter II, <name>.
quest_340_quest_complete: [excited] Chapter II is finally complete! [warm] Well done!
quest_341_quest_detail:
[solemn] Chapter III was my favorite. It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle. And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!

[excited] Looks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter. [hesitant] Those pages are out there somewhere. . .
quest_341_quest_progress: [hesitant] Any luck with pages 18, 20, 21 or 24? [soft voice] Those are the only ones we need to piece together Chapter III.
quest_341_quest_complete: [exhale] Phew! [warm] Good work, <name>. [excited] Chapter III is now back together in one piece!
quest_342_quest_detail:
[excited] Ah Chapter IV; the big finale! [shouting] And what an ending it was!

[solemn] We are only missing three pages for this chapter. [urgent] We need pages 25, 26 and 27 to put Chapter IV back together.
quest_342_quest_progress: [urgent] We just need three pages to finish off Chapter IV, <name>. [soft voice] Do you have pages 25, 26 or 27 yet?
quest_342_quest_complete: [excited] Superb! [warm] We now have Chapter IV ready to go!
quest_343_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron." [solemn] A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep. [urgent] Can you retrieve it for me? If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

[warm] The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son. [gentle] Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
quest_343_quest_complete: [soft voice] Metallurgy? Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech! [pause] Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
quest_344_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Stresses of Iron? Yes, I know the book. [soft voice] Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago. [soft voice] He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore. [soft voice] Smart fellow! [pause] But where was I? [soft voice] Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron! [hesitant] I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey. [soft voice] The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

[hesitant] But that was months ago. [hesitant] I wonder why it's taking him so long...
quest_344_quest_complete: [soft voice] Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is? [hesitant] Well this is a tad embarrassing. [pause] I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!
quest_345_quest_detail:
I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

[hesitant] Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy. It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly [emphasis] Unfortunately, it dries too quickly! My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!

[urgent] To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains. Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.
quest_345_quest_complete: [angry] You need what?? [angry] Maybe you haven't noticed, but we're busy fortifying Lakeshire's defenses and repairing damage from recent orc attacks. [angry] If you need Rethban Iron Ore, you'll have to get it yourself!
quest_346_quest_detail: [solemn] Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron. [soft voice] Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
quest_346_quest_progress: [soft voice] Were you able to find the book?
quest_346_quest_complete: [excited] That's the one! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
quest_347_quest_detail:
[solemn] Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban. When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes. [soft voice] It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

[pause] We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any. [hesitant] And besides... [pause] Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

[urgent] So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
quest_347_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Rethban Ore?
quest_347_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, splendid! I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

[warm] Thank you, <name>!
quest_348_quest_detail:
[sigh] Sick...so...very s-s-sick....

...have contracted Stranglethorn Fever...deadly v-v-virus...

...only cure...is...is...to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage...elusive white beast...

...Witch doctor Unbagwa...only one who can s-s-summon....

...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape...

...hurry...dying...dying....
quest_348_quest_progress:
....mother?

...so cold... ...heading into the Twisting Nether...h-h-h-hold me mother....
quest_348_quest_complete:
[soft voice] ...feel strength returning....

Where might be? Booty Bay? Oh my! I had the strangest dream...

[pause] ...the weakness has not completely left me....
quest_349_quest_progress:
[solemn] Witch Doctor Unbagwa knows what Mokk the Savage like. [excited] Yes, yes! Me speak with spirits and make he come, I do.

[urgent] But other Gorilla-beast like spirit talkin' too. [commanding] You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa and I make he come to you.

[soft voice] Witch Doctor Unbagwa want something first. [urgent] You bring a Gorilla Fang and me start spirit talking!
quest_349_quest_complete:
[excited] Witch Doctor Unbagwa like Gorilla Fangs! [solemn] For you I talk to spirits. [urgent] Make Mokk the Savage come.

[threatening] You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa from other Gorilla-beast through or no Mokk for you!
quest_350_quest_detail:
[solemn] That Marzon would be contacting a member of the Defias and have ties to Lescovar...

Having killed VanCleef and Thredd, it would be hard to see Lescovar brought to proper justice, as your evidence is nothing without their testimonies. [sad] That is not even considering the fact that Lescovar is a noble and well connected. [urgent] It effectively makes him above the law.

[hesitant] You'll need other help. [sad] I loathe to do so, but there is someone I know that will aid us. [urgent] You'll find Trias in the Trade District of the city.
quest_350_quest_complete:
[shocked] You're kidding? Shaw wants my help again? Of all the nerve...

The Defias Brotherhood, you say? Well, you're certainly the bearer of wonderful news, aren't you? Next you're going to tell me that Deathwing is still alive and attacking the city.

[urgent] All right, tell me everything from the beginning. And don't leave out something you think might not be important. I need to know it all.
quest_353_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes. [soft voice] So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

[hesitant] The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan. [urgent] If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

[emphasis] My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
quest_353_quest_progress: [soft voice] You come all the way from Stormwind? [low voice] I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about. [warm] A perfect place for a <class> to prove his worth!
quest_353_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! So Grimand finally finished my axe! [urgent] I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

[warm] Many thanks, <name>. [soft voice] It was a long distance to travel for this delivery. [warm] Here are some coins for your efforts.
quest_354_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades. [low voice] I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. [sad] We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

[solemn] The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. [angry] And now they are minions of the Scourge!

[commanding] Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. [urgent] Serve me by bringing me their remains.
quest_354_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the remains of the Agamands? [solemn] Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
quest_354_quest_complete:
[commanding] Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? [solemn] I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

[sad] It is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
quest_355_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. [soft voice] But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

[pause] I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
quest_355_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Coleman speaks well of you, <name>, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

[solemn] The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
quest_356_quest_detail:
[solemn] The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. [urgent] But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

[solemn] Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

[commanding] Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. [urgent] Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. [solemn] It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
quest_356_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have a report of your patrol?
quest_356_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. [warm] A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
quest_357_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north. [soft voice] Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other Undead are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

[urgent] But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him. And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

[emphasis] To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook. [commanding] Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
quest_357_quest_progress: <name>, [soft voice] have you acquired the book?
quest_357_quest_complete:
Very good, <name>. [solemn] I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich. [warm] You have served your Queen well.

<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>

[delight] Astonishing! The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!

[solemn] Gunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague. And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.

[urgent] His skills would be a great boon to us.
quest_358_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.

[soft voice] The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies. [angry] This cannot be allowed!

[commanding] Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
quest_358_quest_progress: [solemn] Is your task complete? [urgent] Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
quest_358_quest_complete:
[solemn] Expertly done, <name>. The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries. It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, [warm] well done. But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
quest_359_quest_detail:
[solemn] I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

[urgent] I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. [commanding] Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

[urgent] Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. [soft voice] She has the information I need.
quest_359_quest_complete:
[solemn] Magistrate Sevren wants a report? Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

[urgent] We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
quest_360_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. [urgent] He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

[commanding] And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
quest_360_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

[low voice] But we will not give in. [defiant] He will not take us again!
quest_361_quest_detail: [solemn] This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. [soft voice] It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
quest_361_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh...my poor Thurman! I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong! And I knew it! I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!! [angry] Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!

<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>

[solemn] But regrets are for the weak. As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them. [cold] I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.

[sad] But that life is over. Forever.
quest_362_quest_detail:
[solemn] Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different. Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb. His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

[soft voice] I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin. [commanding] Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
quest_362_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you. Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

[warm] If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed. [solemn] They failed me and my family when the Plague came - [angry] now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
quest_363_quest_detail:
[low voice] About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

[solemn] Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
quest_363_quest_complete:
[solemn] Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

[soft voice] I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
quest_364_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the undead, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

[pause] The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. [commanding] Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. [cold] The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
quest_364_quest_progress: [commanding] You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, <name>. [urgent] Do not return until you have success to report.
quest_364_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

[soft voice] But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
quest_365_quest_detail:
[low voice] What have we here? You look like a fledgling <class>. [threatening] If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

[cold] To the west you'll find a farm. Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse. And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower. [commanding] Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.

[urgent] Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
quest_365_quest_progress: [solemn] Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents. [soft voice] Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, <name>?
quest_365_quest_complete: [solemn] You have performed your bidding well, young <class>. [warm] You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
quest_366_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.

[sad] Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. [soft voice] It is good to know he is free.

[urgent] We must have him. [whispering] I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King. [solemn] After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
quest_366_quest_progress: [threatening] Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
quest_366_quest_complete:
[angry] My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!

[hesitant] But...what is this new enchantment upon it... [solemn] Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
quest_367_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. [solemn] The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise. [urgent] She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. [solemn] This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

[soft voice] My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. [commanding] Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
quest_367_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, <name>? [commanding] Time is fleeting!
quest_367_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, <name> and I thank you for your efforts.
quest_368_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. [low voice] Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. [commanding] Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

[urgent] I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
quest_368_quest_progress: [urgent] <name>, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
quest_368_quest_complete: [solemn] The scales are perfect, <name>. [soft voice] Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
quest_369_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims. [soft voice] Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

[commanding] Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment. [urgent] I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction. [whispering] Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
quest_369_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, <name>? [soft voice] It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
quest_369_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, this venom will do perfectly, <name>. [soft voice] Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down. [urgent] Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
quest_370_quest_detail:
[solemn] The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands. [low voice] According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

[commanding] Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
quest_370_quest_progress: [solemn] Young <class>, you shouldn't be wasting your time here in Brill when your people need you fighting for their cause. [commanding] Now, take up arms and travel to the southwest, to the ruined tower, and slay Captain Perrine along with 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries. [threatening] We shall herd the Scarlet Crusade like cattle to their demise.
quest_370_quest_complete: [solemn] Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady. [cold] You have performed your duty well, <class>.
quest_371_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

[urgent] Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. [commanding] It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
quest_371_quest_progress: [solemn] I see you have returned but your task is not complete. [low voice] Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan? [threatening] Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of Scarlet Friars!
quest_371_quest_complete: [solemn] Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. [urgent] But other threats loom.
quest_372_quest_detail:
[solemn] Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest. According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

[commanding] I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission. Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
quest_372_quest_progress: [commanding] You have not yet performed your duty, <class>. [solemn] We cannot expect to carry out The Dark Lady's plan with the Scarlet Crusade pestering our soldiers. [urgent] Bring about their deaths and perform your duty to Sylvanas!
quest_372_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done extremely well, <class>. With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The Forsaken our race is one step closer to defeating Arthas once and for all. [warm] I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
quest_373_quest_detail:
[solemn] Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. [soft voice] It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

[emphasis] It appears to be recently written and sealed.
quest_373_quest_progress: [commanding] Yes? [urgent] Is there something I can help you with?
quest_373_quest_complete:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? [solemn] I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? [surprised] Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... [soft voice] I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. [sad] He doesn't care who he hurts, <name>. Revenge has consumed him. [hesitant] But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
quest_374_quest_detail:
[solemn] Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. [low voice] Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

[commanding] Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. [urgent] Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

[commanding] Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, <class>. [commanding] Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
quest_374_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, <class>?
quest_374_quest_complete: [solemn] Varimathras would be proud. [warm] You serve your leaders well, <class>.
quest_375_quest_detail:
It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill. [hesitant] If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket. [soft voice] Help me, <name>, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
quest_375_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, <name>?
quest_375_quest_complete: [solemn] I appreciate your efforts, <name>. [warm] May Slyvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
quest_376_quest_detail:
[solemn] My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. [hesitant] Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
quest_376_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
quest_376_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you, <name>. [warm] This armor should help you out.

[soft voice] Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
quest_377_quest_detail:
[solemn] As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

[angry] Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death. [cold] Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

[urgent] Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
quest_377_quest_progress: [solemn] So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed. Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward. [solemn] We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in Stormwind.
quest_377_quest_complete: [solemn] So Dextren Ward finally paid for his crimes against humanity? [angry] Good riddance to the scum I say. [warm] And cheers to you, my friend! [proud] Not only have you given the families of the dead the peace of mind they deserve, you sent a poignant message to those corrupt bureaucrats in the House of Nobles. [urgent] Stormwind must rise to the needs of the people of Duskwood or we will break free from their tyranny.
quest_378_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, <class>. [angry] And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

[soft voice] There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid. [urgent] But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span. [solemn] It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.

[commanding] Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade. [angry] I want him dead, <name>. [emphasis] For Longbraid! [shouting] Bring me his head!
quest_378_quest_progress: [angry] I won't let foolish Human bureaucracy interfere with Dwarven matters, <name>. Kam Deepfury is a proven conspirator in the Thandol Span attack. King Magni's good people lost their lives because of Deepfury's deceit. The Humans might be content to let Deepfury rot in The Stockade but [solemn] I will not sleep soundly at night until Deepfury is slain.
quest_378_quest_complete: [angry] So Kam Deepfury finally got to feel what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death? Good. Serves the cowardly Dark Iron scum right. [warm] You have done well, <class>. [solemn] The victims of the Thandol Span attack were but mere victims in a world torn with war and unrest. [soft voice] Their families will have the peace of knowing Deepfury got the punishment he deserved. [proud] Longbraid's brother's death has been avenged.
quest_379_quest_detail:
[urgent] You want a power source. I can help you with that. Know what I want? I want something to drink! Bring me five Wastewander Water Pouches, and I'll give you the 4711-FTZ.

Now... guess where you can find Wastewander Water Pouches! [excited] Why don't you walk up to one of the Wastewander nomads to the east of here and ask them for one. [commanding] Let me know how that works out for you.
quest_379_quest_progress: [commanding] Well, did the nomads 'volunteer' up those water pouches for you?
quest_379_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, the power source is yours. [commanding] Now, it isn't completely designed for use in a science kit like that, so you'll only have a limited amount of time before all the data you collect will go kablooey!

[urgent] When you collect everything you need for whatever it is you are doing, bring it to me and I'll shut it down properly. [urgent] You'll have at most two hours to get what you need to get done, done.

[mocking tone] If you don't get it done in time, I can always sell you another power source to try again. [shouting] You heard me - sell!
quest_380_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. [low voice] Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

[solemn] There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. [urgent] We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. [hesitant] I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.

[commanding] Get up there and see what you can do for us, <name>.
quest_380_quest_progress: Be wary of the spiders' venom, <name>. [hesitant] If you feel a sharp burning, you may want to have it looked at.
quest_380_quest_complete:
Hmm, well, it's a start. [solemn] It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. [soft voice] After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

[warm] You've done your duty well, <name>, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
quest_381_quest_detail:
[solemn] You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts. [commanding] We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. [angry] The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every undead--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. [urgent] We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
quest_381_quest_progress: [low voice] Those fools... [threatening] They happily send themselves to their own graves.
quest_381_quest_complete: [solemn] If only they listened to reason, eh, <name>? [soft voice] Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... [mocking tone] ha! [angry] Light-blinded fools.
quest_382_quest_detail:
[solemn] Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!

[urgent] You're the most qualified person I have to send, <name>. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
quest_382_quest_complete:
Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>

[low voice] Some news of their exploits against us... [angry] Worthless. Scouting reports... [low voice] New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... [pause] Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! [confident] We can use this.
quest_383_quest_detail:
[solemn] These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. [commanding] With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. [urgent] Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.

[commanding] Take the road north out of Deathknell. [solemn] Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. [emphasis] Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. [solemn] You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
quest_383_quest_progress: [low voice] Yes, what do you want?
quest_383_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, this is very good. [warm] You've done well in obtaining this information, <name>. [pause] Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

[commanding] Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
quest_384_quest_detail:
[excited] Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs! [solemn] Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front.

[warm] Maybe you can help me out? [confident] If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample! [emphasis] The secret's in the Malt!
quest_384_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, <name>.
quest_384_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead 
[soft voice] And before all is done and anything said 
[urgent] We will have to fight for first dibs 
[delight] On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
quest_385_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. [soft voice] But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

[hesitant] Why, this one time...
quest_385_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? [angry] Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. [hesitant] But I was lucky... [emphasis] Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. [pause] Still have the knife around here somewhere...
quest_385_quest_complete: [excited] Well now, [warm] these are excellent specimens you collected, <name>. [warm] Good money for high quality materials, [warm] that's for sure.
quest_386_quest_detail:
[solemn] Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner. His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards. Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim. Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die. [hesitant] Yet something is amiss. One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution. I am sure foul play is in the works.

[commanding] Put an end to Targorr the Dread, <name>. Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
quest_386_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade? [solemn] I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom. [angry] He was sentenced to die, <name>, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
quest_386_quest_complete: [solemn] Targorr the Dread has finally met his fate. [soft voice] I for one am glad to hear the beast now knows what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death's ruthless grip. [warm] You have done well, <name>. [gentle] Sometimes the truest justice can only be found outside the courtroom and beyond the clouded vision of politics.
quest_387_quest_detail:
[urgent] The uprising must be quelled! [commanding] I need your assistance. If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job! [angry] This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one. But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

[solemn] The punishment for insurgency is death. [commanding] Kill some of these deviants! [urgent] That ought to get things under control.
quest_387_quest_progress: [urgent] The Stockade is still overrun! [angry] These Defias Rats must be shown that their actions will not be tolerated. [commanding] Now get back down there and show some force!
quest_387_quest_complete: [solemn] Your efforts in The Stockade were valiant, <name>. [low voice] It's obvious this problem is bigger than the both of us. [warm] But you have performed well and for that I am thankful.
quest_388_quest_detail:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river. [sad] My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy. A mere 14 years old. When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city. He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up. Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang. [angry] For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

[angry] I want revenge. [commanding] Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas. [cold] They are the color of blood.
quest_388_quest_progress: [commanding] I see you are back, <class>. [urgent] Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
quest_388_quest_complete:
[angry] So these bandanas -- filthy tokens of corruption -- are what my Mac had to die for? [sad] Such a waste. [solemn] Such a tragic sacrifice.

[soft voice] But alas, I cannot return to the past. [solemn] Just know, <name>, that you have brought my family justice through your deeds.
quest_389_quest_detail:
[solemn] VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

[pause] When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. [sad] Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. [angry] He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

[soft voice] His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. [urgent] He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
quest_389_quest_complete:
[angry] What in the Light do you want? [urgent] Can't you see we have a crisis here?

[shocked] Bazil Thredd?! [angry] Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? [threatening] If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
quest_391_quest_detail:
[commanding] Let's get one thing straight, <name>: I don't trust you. [low voice] But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

[emphasis] So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. [threatening] If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. [cold] And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
quest_391_quest_progress: [threatening] Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, <name>?
quest_391_quest_complete:
Without Thredd to lead them, hopefully the riots will be more controllable. [solemn] We shall see.

I must say, after a half hour, I hardly expected you to come out, but it seems I misjudged you.

[soft voice] I'd guess, then, that you didn't get much useful information out of him? [pause] But I know a thing or two that might be of interest to you about Thredd's activities.
quest_392_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the first years of Thredd's imprisonment, he never had any visitors. [sad] I figured that he was no longer of use to the Brotherhood, so they abandoned him.

[pause] Anyway, a few months ago, that all changed; he started to get regular visits... once, maybe twice a week. [hesitant] It was a strange man--the quiet type. [soft voice] I had my suspicions, but all his papers checked out.

[solemn] His documents claimed his name was Maelik; here's his description. [urgent] I don't think he'll be coming to visit Thredd anymore.
quest_392_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, <name>? [hesitant] What have you found?
quest_392_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm. Maelik? No, the name doesn't sound familiar and neither does this description. [hesitant] But it could be anybody! A former Stonemason, one of the Defias Brotherhood... Though if he is as well connected as Thelwater suggests, perhaps someone else might recognize him. [pause] Let me think.
quest_393_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I really haven't a clue, <name>. [soft voice] There is someone else who might be able to help you, and it so happens that he owes me a favor for--well, let's not get into that. [solemn] Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 can be found in the barracks in Old Town. [low voice] Shaw has his thumb on most of the shady, or underhanded dealings of the city.

[emphasis] If anyone knows, it'd be him.
quest_393_quest_progress: Greetings. [soft voice] Of what service can I be to you, <class>?
quest_393_quest_complete:
What? What's this? [soft voice] Yes, I think I do know who this man is, but his name is not Maelik. [solemn] Assassins wear many names and many masks, discarding them as they lose their usefulness. [pause] Another alias known to be used by this man is Marzon; though even that is surely not his true name.

[low voice] Regardless, he is an assassin and I know a good deal about him.

[solemn] Marzon is currently under the employ of Lord Gregor Lescovar, a lord of shady reputation, even given the corruption of the nobility of Stormwind.
quest_394_quest_detail:
[urgent] Find Shaw in Old Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. [confident] I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among Stormwind's citizens.

He'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. [soft voice] Don't let it get to your head, <name>. [solemn] The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.
quest_394_quest_complete:
[solemn] He is dead, then? [commanding] Your justice was swift, <name>. [soft voice] I pray to the Light that I never become your quarry!

<He laughs and claps you on the shoulder.>

[hesitant] I mean no criticism, <name>. [soft voice] How could I, being the master of all assassins? [warm] But in truth, you have done the people of Stormwind a great service, and for that, I thank you.
quest_395_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. [solemn] No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.

[pause] A bit of advice, <name>: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. [commanding] Trust me. [hesitant] I am... acquainted... with the ways of such things.

[whispering] And as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... ever... if you can help it.
quest_395_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It's good to see you, <name>. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.

It would seem that you were successful in your mission. [warm] You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.
quest_396_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have prepared a report for the King. [soft voice] I believe you should be the one to deliver it to him, along with an account of your findings. [gentle] Do not worry, there is no doubt that he will commend you for doing your duty to the people of Stormwind.

[urgent] Your audience is scheduled soon, so you'd best hurry, it's a bit of a ways to Stormwind Keep.
quest_396_quest_progress: <name>, yes? [soft voice] I was informed by Baros Alexston that you would be coming. [solemn] I must say, I am most interested in what you have to say.
quest_396_quest_complete:
[solemn] You are to be commended for the service you have done for Stormwind, <name>. [soft voice] If VanCleef had been successful in his machinations, he would no doubt have done considerable harm to the kingdom - something we must obviously avoid.

[warm] Take this, <class>, as a token of the King's appreciation. [soft voice] I am only sorry he cannot present it to you himself, but he is away on a diplomatic mission and shall not return for some time.
quest_397_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I hear Lord Wishock enjoyed his beverage.

[warm] You have served us well, <name>. [solemn] The Warlocks of Stormwind will be able to practice our ways without disturbance, thanks to you. [warm] For your efforts, I have prepared a special gift for you. [commanding] Speak with my servant, Zggi, and claim your reward.
quest_399_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

[sad] I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. [hesitant] Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
quest_399_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, thank you, <name>! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... [warm] Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. [proud] You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
quest_400_quest_detail:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is! [excited] But he's not forgiving to his tools. [angry] I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

[urgent] We just filled his last order for tools. [soft voice] If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

[warm] His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos. [solemn] And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
quest_400_quest_progress:
Hm? [low voice] You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot. But no matter...[pause] do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable. I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

[hesitant] Or, were you here for something else...?
quest_400_quest_complete:
[excited] You have my tools? [warm] Well done, lad, well done! [proud] I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine. [warm] You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, <name>.

[warm] Here, take these coins for your help.
quest_401_quest_detail: [soft voice] I'm almost finished translating that note. [pause] If you come back in a few moments I should be done.
quest_401_quest_complete: [solemn] There we are. [soft voice] It's translated... <The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...>
quest_404_quest_detail:
[solemn] Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

[commanding] Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. [urgent] Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
quest_404_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you completed the task with which I have charged you? [low voice] Do you have those putrid claws?
quest_404_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. [urgent] I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!
quest_405_quest_detail:
[solemn] Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge. [urgent] You, <name>, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor. He will then instruct you on your mission. [hesitant] I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich. And it will be dangerous.

[commanding] So ready yourself, <class>. [cold] You must not fail.

[soft voice] You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
quest_405_quest_progress:
Greetings. [solemn] Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

[threatening] Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
quest_405_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
quest_407_quest_detail:
Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. [solemn] If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.

[soft voice] With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. [soft voice] This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.

[urgent] Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern. [commanding] Take this pumpkin to the fool.
quest_407_quest_progress:
[angry] Stay away, foul and unholy creature! [shouting] May the Light protect me! [solemn] The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait. [hesitant] Is that food for me? [sad] I am so hungry. . .
quest_407_quest_complete: [angry] By the Light! [excited] Finally some food! [delight] Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
quest_408_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

[urgent] This cannot pass, and you must stop it. Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
quest_408_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is not a luxury we have, <name>. [solemn] With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
quest_408_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. [warm] And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.

[commanding] Continue the struggle as we all do, <name>, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
quest_409_quest_detail:
[solemn] You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this. [hesitant] But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

[solemn] There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. [soft voice] it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

[commanding] Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here. [urgent] Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. [commanding] Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
quest_409_quest_progress: [solemn] I await proof of your allegiance, <class>.
quest_409_quest_complete: [solemn] You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge. [delight] Incredible. I had believed I was the only Undead with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
quest_411_quest_detail: [urgent] Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate ... [hesitant] and I have much to tell him.
quest_411_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you returned Gunther's book? [hesitant] Has he responded?
quest_411_quest_complete: [excited] You convinced him to join us! [warm] You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, <name>. [solemn] The Dark Lady will be informed.
quest_412_quest_detail:
[solemn] Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.

[soft voice] Ozzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator. [urgent] The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears. [commanding] Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
quest_412_quest_progress: [urgent] The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
quest_412_quest_complete: [soft voice] These Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs are in perfect accordance with Ozzie's schematics for the Recombobulation Device. [pause] Once I add some hyrdolubricant to the inner combustion pistons, adjust the crank-o-ratchet and increase of the viscosity of the electrogum gel, [emphasis] the gnomish race will be as good as new.
quest_413_quest_detail:
[gentle] I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout. He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

[soft voice] He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

[warm] Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
quest_413_quest_progress:
[gentle] Hello, <class>! And what business takes you all the way out here?

[excited] Something exciting, I hope. [angry] I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
quest_413_quest_complete: <Mountaineer Barleybrew tastes the Shimmer Stout...> [soft voice] Oh. [excited] Whoa! [delight] This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. [excited] I feel like I can see in the dark!
quest_414_quest_detail:
[excited] I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff! [warm] I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it. His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

[commanding] To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road. Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.

[warm] Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!
quest_414_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Now, let me have a taste...

[excited] Magni's Beard! [delight] This stuff gets your head turning! And it lightens the limbs, too.

[excited] I feel like I can fly!
quest_415_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.

[hesitant] He wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it. [warm] You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.

[low voice] There could be some free booze in it for you...
quest_415_quest_complete:
<name>! You know that Shimmerweed you brought me? [warm] Well I used it in a few recipes I've been working on, and one of them turned out great!

[excited] Here, try it out and tell me what you think...
quest_416_quest_detail:
[urgent] We have a real infestation problem to the west. [angry] Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

[commanding] We want them eliminated. Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

[solemn] You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
quest_416_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, <name>. [soft voice] How goes the rat catching?
quest_416_quest_complete:
[angry] Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

[warm] Here's your reward, <name>. [proud] Well done.
quest_418_quest_detail:
[soft voice] There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. [warm] We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

[pause] No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy <class>, you'll be any exception.

[commanding] I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. [excited] You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
quest_418_quest_progress: [soft voice] I'm all ready to start cooking, [urgent] do you have the ingredients for me?
quest_418_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. [warm] Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
quest_419_quest_detail:
[solemn] My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills. [soft voice] We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

[hesitant] Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

[pause] It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night. [sad] Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

[urgent] Please, <name>. Find him.
quest_419_quest_complete:
[solemn] Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers. [soft voice] Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve. [pause] And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.

[solemn voice] This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
quest_420_quest_detail:
[solemn] The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. [soft voice] You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

[commanding] Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

[urgent] Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
quest_420_quest_progress: [soft voice] How are you? [warm] Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? [pause] Not much else to do in the cold.
quest_420_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! [laughing] Hah! Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. [sigh] Bloody cold. I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
quest_421_quest_detail:
[sad] Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

[angry] But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

[commanding] I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess. [urgent] Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. [soft voice] The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
quest_421_quest_progress: [commanding] If you wish to prove yourself to me, you must kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. [solemn] Accomplish that task, and I will see to it your skill is put to more worthy assignments.
quest_421_quest_complete: [solemn] You have served me well, <class>. [warm] It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
quest_422_quest_detail:
[solemn] How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me. [soft voice] His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

[emphasis] What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

[pause] Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge. [low voice] One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them. [urgent] Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
quest_422_quest_progress: [solemn] Before I know what we are dealing with here, <class>, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal. [urgent] Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
quest_422_quest_complete: [solemn] This is precisely the spell I was in search of, <class>. [soft voice] If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
quest_423_quest_detail: [solemn] After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed. [angry] The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour. [angry] Fools! [urgent] Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic. [commanding] I need to examine these items first hand. [commanding] Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research. [solemn] The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
quest_423_quest_progress: [solemn] I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal. [commanding] Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
quest_423_quest_complete:
[solemn] I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample. [hesitant] Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.

[soft voice] Nonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, <class>.
quest_424_quest_detail:
[solemn] It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.

[pause] But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered. [urgent] It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.

[commanding] The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.

[commanding] I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale. [solemn] With his death, the mine shall be ours.
quest_424_quest_progress: [urgent] Has Grimson the Pale been slain? [solemn] Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
quest_424_quest_complete: [delight] Most excellent. The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into Azeroth.
quest_425_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec. [soft voice] But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

[urgent] We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn. [sad] He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

[commanding] Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal. [whispering] Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
quest_425_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you killed Ivar the Foul? [soft voice] If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
quest_425_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, thank you. [warm] You have my gratitude, <name>.

[solemn] And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
quest_426_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

[commanding] The orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

[urgent] Go to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

[low voice] To get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. [commanding] When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
quest_426_quest_progress: [solemn] Our battles with the Scourge wage on, <name>. [commanding] Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!
quest_426_quest_complete: [solemn] Your efforts in the war are felt among us, <name>. [low voice] I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
quest_427_quest_detail:
[solemn] The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade. We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

[urgent] But the Deathguard has larger concerns. The Lich King's army grows in number each night. We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

[commanding] Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
quest_427_quest_progress: [commanding] If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, <class>.
quest_427_quest_complete: [delight] Most excellent, <class>. [warm] Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
quest_428_quest_detail:
A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine. [solemn] We have not heard from them.

[sad] They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed. [commanding] Find these Deathstalkers.

[solemn] Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine. [urgent] You should begin your search there.
quest_428_quest_complete: [excited] You found us! [warm] And not a moment too soon...
quest_429_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without magical aid. [solemn] Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

[urgent] Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south. Then return here with the potion.

[urgent] You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
quest_429_quest_progress: [urgent] My time is short, <class>, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
quest_429_quest_complete:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.> [solemn] It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

[low voice] Let us hope that these failures are rare.

[urgent] I'll give you the potion in a moment, but here is its recipe - if those Deathstalkers find themselves in need of future aid, then perhaps you can give it yourself.
quest_430_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

[soft voice] Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
quest_430_quest_progress: [soft voice] My sister told me you were here to aid us. [hesitant] Is that true?
quest_430_quest_complete:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.> [solemn] Yes, I can feel it working. [soft voice] I will soon be able to travel.

[warm] You have done me a great favor, <name>.
quest_432_quest_detail:
[angry] Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! [shouting] Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

[angry] Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! [urgent] I want to kill them all!

[sigh] This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... [sad] What have they left me with? [angry] Nothing! [urgent] I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! [commanding] You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! [warm] I'll pay you! [urgent] Just hurt them, kill them!
quest_432_quest_progress: [angry] It makes me so mad! [low voice] Grrr...
quest_432_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well, that makes me feel a little better...

[angry] But I won't be happy until they're all dead! [shouting] All of them!
quest_433_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

[angry] They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. [solemn] As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. [commanding] There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

[warm] If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
quest_433_quest_progress: [solemn] If we can remove the troggs from Gol'Bolar quarry, it will be the first step of many that we will have to undertake to rid ourselves of this menace.
quest_433_quest_complete:
It is a start. [urgent] Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. [solemn] Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

[warm] Thank you for your assistance, <name>.
quest_434_quest_detail:
[soft voice] After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.

[low voice] While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. [whispering] I even dropped some false information.

[urgent] Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. [emphasis] After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. [commanding] You need to kill them both before the guards return! [urgent] When you're done, speak to Trias.
quest_434_quest_progress:
[urgent] Yes, <name>? Are things going well with Tyrion? He apprised me of the situation and I've helped him trick Marzon into going to the castle.

Marzon has been a thorn in the side of many people in Stormwind; many of which are close friends of mine. [threatening] No one messes with my friends... not if they know what's healthy for them.

[soft voice] It's just a shame I'm indirectly doing a favor for Shaw and SI:7 in the meantime. [sigh] Oh well, not every plan is perfect.
quest_434_quest_complete:
[solemn] So it is done? Good. [warm] Thank you greatly for your discretion, <name>. [proud] You've proven worthy on more than one count. [commanding] I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the Alliance.

[urgent] Be sure to keep your nose clean.
quest_435_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door. [low voice] They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

[urgent] I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick. [commanding] And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

[urgent] Please escort me! [hesitant] And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
quest_435_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for the aid, <name>. [solemn] I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. [warm] With your help, I see that he has not.
quest_436_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prospector Ironband is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake. His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.

Ironband's a stout, honest dwarf who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.

[urgent] Go to Ironband's Excavation and speak with Magmar Fellhew. He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.

To get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
quest_436_quest_complete:
[urgent] Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

[commanding] Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
quest_437_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields. [urgent] We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

[commanding] We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides. [urgent] If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

[solemn] Her essence will turn to dust. [cold] Bring me that dust as proof.
quest_437_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you defeated Nightlash, <name>? [commanding] Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
quest_437_quest_complete:
[solemn] I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, <name>, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

[commanding] The Scourge have lost ground this day. [warm] Your value to the Forsaken grows.
quest_438_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry. [low voice] The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

[urgent] There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area. [commanding] Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
quest_438_quest_complete:
[solemn] Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses. [soft voice] And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

[commanding] The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
