quest_439_quest_detail: [solemn] Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped. [soft voice] It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.
quest_440_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. [solemn] He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

[sad] But I wouldn't hope. [low voice] Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead. Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
quest_440_quest_progress: [solemn] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] What brings you back to Brill?
quest_440_quest_complete:
[solemn] A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago. [sad] She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

[angry] The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. [commanding] I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
quest_441_quest_detail:
[solemn] Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity. [soft voice] If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

[urgent] Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
quest_441_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, this ring was my wife's. Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times. I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

[cold] Such feelings have long since grown cold within me. [urgent] But desire does still burn in my dead heart, <name>.

[commanding] Desire for revenge.
quest_442_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.

[urgent] You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw. [angry] I want his head!

[commanding] This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, <name>. [commanding] You must not fail.
quest_442_quest_progress: [solemn] The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, <name>. [commanding] Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
quest_442_quest_complete:
[solemn] The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, <name>. [soft voice] Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

[solemn] Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken. [proud] Your value to us grows.
quest_443_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls. [soft voice] Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

[urgent] Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there. [commanding] Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
quest_443_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the rot hide ichor, <name>?
quest_443_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good. [solemn] This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...

...if they have one.
quest_444_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components. [soft voice] My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

[pause] While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity. [commanding] Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

[urgent] Go. You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
quest_444_quest_progress: [solemn] My studies require great concentration. [soft voice] So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
quest_444_quest_complete:
[solemn] This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...

[pause] One moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...
quest_445_quest_detail:
[solemn] Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.

[soft voice] As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

[commanding] Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. [urgent] Follow the roads to the south from Brill. [urgent] From the Undercity go southwest.
quest_445_quest_progress: [low voice] What business do you have with me, <class>?
quest_445_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades. [pause] Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

[low voice] But you must excuse my rambling. [warm] Extend your stay in Silverpine, <name>. [proud] We could use an able bodied <class> like you around here.
quest_446_quest_detail:
[solemn] This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw. [soft voice] He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.

[angry] I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!

[urgent] I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them. [commanding] Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel. [solemn] It has the incantations needed for the potion.
quest_446_quest_progress: [soft voice] Greetings, <name>. [whispering] What did Bethor have to say?
quest_446_quest_complete: [solemn] This scroll is laced with powerful magic. [hesitant] I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.
quest_447_quest_detail:
[solemn] Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

[low voice] My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. [urgent] Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. [commanding] Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
quest_447_quest_progress: [solemn] Hail, <class>. [commanding] What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
quest_447_quest_complete: [solemn] How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, <name>. [soft voice] These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause. [low voice] I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
quest_448_quest_detail: [solemn] Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. [low voice] He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
quest_448_quest_complete:
[solemn] If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.

[urgent] To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...
quest_449_quest_detail: [solemn] Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible. [urgent] It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
quest_449_quest_progress: [solemn] Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
quest_449_quest_complete:
[solemn] I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

[warm] Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, <name>. [proud] And you will be commended.
quest_450_quest_detail:
[solemn] You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, <name>.

[soft voice] When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard. [sad] Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us. But his findings might prove to be of worth. [low voice] He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

[urgent] Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
quest_450_quest_progress: [low voice] I see you are back, <name>.
quest_450_quest_complete: [excited] Apothecary Berard's journal! [warm] Why you are quite brave, <name>. [soft voice] Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .
quest_451_quest_detail:
[solemn] According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague. [soft voice] Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.

[pause] He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc. [whispering] Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.

[urgent] Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare hardened tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
quest_451_quest_progress: [solemn] What brings you back to the Undercity, <name>?
quest_451_quest_complete:
[sad] Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard. [solemn] But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

[solemn] We are on the cusp of something great here, <name>. [warm] If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
quest_452_quest_detail:
[urgent] You got here just in the nick of time, <name>!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment. Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep. He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control. [solemn] But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.

[commanding] I cannot handle them all by myself. I need you to help me. Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.
quest_452_quest_complete: [solemn] You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, <name>. [warm] With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. [proud] I salute you!
quest_453_quest_detail:
[gentle] Good luck, <name>. [soft voice] I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.

[hesitant] If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
quest_453_quest_progress: [urgent] Who are you?? [angry] Leave me be!
quest_453_quest_complete:
<Jitters sighs...> [soft voice] Yes, I'm the author of that book. [whispering] You finally found me, eh?

[low voice] Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
quest_454_quest_detail:
[solemn] We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. [low voice] Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.

[hesitant] I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. [urgent] When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
quest_454_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hello, <class>.

You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?

Anyways, let me just make some final checks. [commanding] Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
quest_455_quest_detail:
[solemn] Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands.

And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz! [urgent] We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands. [commanding] Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure! Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.

[confident] We're counting on you, <name>. [threatening] Do not fail.
quest_455_quest_progress: [urgent] You're coming from Loch Modan? [low voice] How is the orc situation at Algaz Gate?
quest_455_quest_complete:
[angry] Your report is full of bad news!

[urgent] I see the Dragonmaws are making a strong move into Algaz. [soft voice] Normally the Dragonmaws just hide up in the hills. [hesitant] What made them surge into Algaz is still a mystery...

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [commanding] And we'll probably want your help dealing with these orcs.
quest_456_quest_detail:
Greetings, <name>. [solemn] I am Conservator Ilthalaine. [soft voice] My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

[pause] The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

[sad] Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large. [solemn] Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts. [urgent] Journey forth, young <class>, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
quest_456_quest_progress: [solemn] There is still work to be done, <name>. [soft voice] Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber and thistle boar populations.
quest_457_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, <name>, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed. Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land. [urgent] Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
quest_457_quest_progress: [solemn] Your task is not yet complete, <name>. [pause] Return to me once 7 mangy nightsabers and 7 thistle boars have been killed.
quest_457_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven your dedication to nature well, <name>. [warm] A young <class> like yourself has a promising future.
quest_458_quest_detail:
[gentle] Thank goodness you are here, <class>. [solemn] Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

[soft voice] The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. [hesitant] Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

[urgent] Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. [emphasis] One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
quest_463_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've heard of the Greenwarden? [hesitant] You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. [whispering] He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

[commanding] And leave your money here. [low voice] You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
quest_464_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. [soft voice] The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. [pause] What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

[solemn] Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

[commanding] We want you to attack that encampment. [urgent] Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
quest_464_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you attacked the Dragonmaw encampment?
quest_464_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well fought, <name>. [solemn] The Dragonmaws are not the same threat they were when they had dragons, but they're still fierce opponents.

[solemn] The Dragonmaws are led by Nek'rosh, son of Nekros, who was the former head of the Dragonmaws years ago. [soft voice] Nekros used powerful magic to tame the Red Dragons, but when that magic failed him...[pause] the dragons were not happy.

[sad] Nekros was killed, and his son has vowed revenge against the dragons who slew his father.
quest_465_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were fighting the Dragonmaws, we discovered more of their plans.

[urgent] Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!

[commanding] You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.

Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.

And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. [low voice] We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.
quest_465_quest_progress: [solemn] The first catapult is before you. [urgent] Will you set it aflame?
quest_465_quest_complete:
[urgent] You place some of the tinder on the catapult then strike a spark onto it.

[excited] Flame erupts and quickly spreads!
quest_466_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate. [solemn] Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

[commanding] Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

[urgent] Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining. If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
quest_466_quest_complete: [excited] You got the ore! [warm] Well done, <name>! I'll get someone to work with this right away. [chuckling] Let's hope he doesn't blow himself up!
quest_467_quest_detail:
[excited] Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

[warm] He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. [urgent] If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
quest_467_quest_complete: [commanding] Hello <name>. You're here about the task I have, eh? [warm] It's good to see a young <race> like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
quest_468_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.

[soft voice] If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz. [low voice] Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
quest_468_quest_complete: [commanding] Hello, <class>! [urgent] You're here for the scouting mission, are you? [warm] Very good! [soft voice] I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
quest_469_quest_detail:
Greetings, traveler!

[soft voice] Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? [soft voice] If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

[soft voice] Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

[hesitant] I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
quest_469_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, <class>. [gentle] Could I interest you in a pair of boots? [warm] Perhaps some newly cured skins?
quest_469_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm, this is from Einar, right? [pause] Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. [sad] No doubt it's some differences with the wife!

[hesitant] Maybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...
quest_470_quest_detail:
[soft voice] On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! [shocked] Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... [sigh] Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

[sad] The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

[hesitant] I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! [solemn] Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. [warm] Thank you so much!
quest_470_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, thank you, <name>! [warm] I was afraid that it was lost for good!

<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>

[soft voice] Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
quest_471_quest_detail:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. [sad] When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

[urgent] ...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. [commanding] You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
quest_471_quest_progress:
[solemn] My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

[soft voice] Ah, <name>, how goes it? [urgent] Do you have my skins?
quest_471_quest_complete:
Hmm... [hesitant] Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

Hah! [chuckling] No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, [warm] these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
quest_472_quest_detail:
[urgent] Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

[sad] My wounds are grave, <class>. Most of the regiment was killed! The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

[solemn] Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn. As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back. All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers. Hope still burns within me. [excited] Perhaps Longbraid is still alive! [commanding] See if you can find him near Dun Modr, <race>!
quest_472_quest_complete:
[solemn] What brave <class> sends word from Menethil? Ah <name>, they call you.

[warm] You bring hope to a hopeless situation. [solemn] 'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived. [sad] While fleeing he received a grievous wound. [urgent] We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.

[solemn] But now we face a perilous situation. [sad] Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.
quest_473_quest_detail: <name>. [solemn] The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz. [commanding] Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs. [soft voice] He is inside the keep, in the war room.
quest_473_quest_complete:
<name>. [solemn] Valstag briefed me on your past success with the Dragonmaw Orcs at Dun Algaz. [warm] You're a <race> of worth.

[proud] And I have a task for you.
quest_475_quest_detail:
[solemn] A troubling breeze blows through the forest.

[soft voice] Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. [solemn] His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled.

[hesitant] But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous. [urgent] Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
quest_475_quest_complete: [excited] Thank the forest spirits you are here! [warm] I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
quest_476_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!

[angry] The once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest. [urgent] They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village. [cold] Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.

[sad] I am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news. [solemn] The task is left to you, young <class>. [urgent] We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
quest_476_quest_complete: [excited] By the stars! [solemn] This is quite disturbing indeed!
quest_477_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

[hesitant] I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. [soft voice] Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. [commanding] Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
quest_478_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you learned anything useful, <name>?
quest_478_quest_complete: [soft voice] Maps and this... pendant, hm? [hesitant] Interesting.
quest_479_quest_detail:
[solemn] Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. [pause] For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

[soft voice] The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. [urgent] Remove and retrieve them.

[commanding] Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
quest_479_quest_progress: [urgent] We must hurry, [solemn] their plans must not come to fruition, [low voice] or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.
quest_479_quest_complete:
[solemn] Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.

[soft voice] A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. [urgent] He must be stopped quickly.
quest_480_quest_detail:
[solemn] An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

[urgent] You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
quest_480_quest_complete:
[solemn] The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. [soft voice] Your efforts have been fruitful, <name>, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.

[urgent] We must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... [pause] Plans must be made for the future.
quest_481_quest_detail: [soft voice] Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, [pause] perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
quest_481_quest_complete:
[solemn] Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. [soft voice] This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

[low voice] That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

[urgent] I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
quest_482_quest_detail:
[excited] Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. [solemn] The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

[urgent] We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

[commanding] Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
quest_482_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ill news you bring, <name>. [urgent] If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

[low voice] I must confer with him on our plan of attack. [commanding] But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
quest_483_quest_detail:
[solemn] Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

[soft voice] The slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. [urgent] The delicate hibernation ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.

[emphasis] Journey to the Den and retrieve the Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. [solemn] The druids store them in sacred chests. [warm] Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.
quest_483_quest_progress:
<name>, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

[solemn] For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
quest_483_quest_complete: [excited] You have succeeded, young <class>! [warm] Well done. And just in time I might add.
quest_484_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm James Halloran, the tanner. [soft voice] My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

[soft voice] Met Einar? [soft voice] He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

[soft voice] I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

[soft voice] Being that I'm running low, [urgent] I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. [soft voice] You can find the young crocs in the marshes right outside of town.
quest_484_quest_progress: <name>, right? [urgent] Do you have my skins?
quest_484_quest_complete: Nice work you've done here, <name>. [warm] The quality of these skins is superb. [soft voice] I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. [pause] Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
quest_486_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, <name>, they will be forever lost in sleep.

[soft voice] I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. [urgent] For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.

[solemn] It was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. [commanding] Travel to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.
quest_486_quest_progress: [solemn] Our brethren cannot be awakened until [urgent] Ursal the Mauler has been slain, <name>.
quest_486_quest_complete:
<name> you have proven yourself a most worthy and able <class>. [solemn] A night elf who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.

[warm] May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
quest_487_quest_detail:
[solemn] The road to Darnassus must be kept safe. [soft voice] Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

[solemn] Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily. [commanding] We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.

[urgent] Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, <class>. [low voice] Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. [emphasis] Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
quest_487_quest_progress: [solemn] The road is still not safe, <class>. [urgent] Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.
quest_487_quest_complete: [solemn] You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave <class>. [warm] As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
quest_489_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. [angry] The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a <race>, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.

[urgent] You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil.

[commanding] Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. [soft voice] Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. [whispering] They billow with green smoke.

[gentle] Give some to Foulhoof. [mocking tone] He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
quest_491_quest_detail: [solemn] Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed. [soft voice] This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it. [threatening] So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.
quest_492_quest_detail:
[solemn] According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured. [low voice] The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

[soft voice] Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him? [whispering] It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
quest_492_quest_progress: [angry] Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, <class>. [urgent] Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
quest_492_quest_complete: [exhale] Ah, a drink at last. [soft voice] I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
quest_493_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague. [soft voice] We are working diligently and have made much progress. [solemn] It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.

[urgent] For that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills. [pause] The journey will be a long one.

[commanding] Head south and stick to the roads. [emphasis] Follow the signs closely!
quest_493_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, most excellent. Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect. [soft voice] I am anxious to study his work.
quest_494_quest_detail:
[commanding] Be silent and pay attention, <class>.

[solemn] I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. [solemn] My mission is one of reconnaissance. [urgent] It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. [urgent] Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:

"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."

[urgent] Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. [urgent] Now, hurry! [urgent] Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
quest_494_quest_complete:
[solemn] The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?

[urgent] Superb news! [commanding] Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. [confident] We can carry out our plan of destruction now. [warm] Varimathras will be pleased.
quest_496_quest_detail:
[low voice] Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, <name>.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

[urgent] If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
quest_496_quest_progress: [solemn] I see you are back. [soft voice] I hope you were able to gather the agents I need. [sad] Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
quest_496_quest_complete: [solemn] These specimens are perfect. [soft voice] Well, <name>, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. [warm] Your efforts are appreciated.
quest_499_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

[pause] There we go! [solemn] Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

[low voice] Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

[commanding] Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
quest_500_quest_detail:
[solemn] Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the Alterac Mountains near the ruined city of Alterac. [soft voice] And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.

[urgent] We can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!

[commanding] Go north to the Alterac Mountains and hunt ogres. Bring me the Dirty Knucklebones they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.
quest_500_quest_progress: <name>, [commanding] are you still hunting ogres? [urgent] Do you have the knucklebones I had you gather?
quest_500_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good, <name> You must have hacked through a whole mess of ogres to get all these knucklebones.

[warm] That should keep them out of our hair. At least, for a while.
quest_501_quest_detail:
[whispering] Oh, <name>. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk. [sad] I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all. [low voice] I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

[solemn] As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls. [urgent] Help me, would you? [cold] My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion. [threatening] Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
quest_501_quest_progress: [low voice] I remember you, <name>. [sad] You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir. [urgent] I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
quest_502_quest_detail:
[excited] Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

[whispering] Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! [soft voice] What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain. [solemn] If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. [commanding] But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. [mocking tone] Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
quest_503_quest_detail: [solemn] From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large Syndicate base to the north, most likely in the Alterac Mountains. [soft voice] He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.
quest_503_quest_progress: [commanding] Give me the key, <class>, I will undo the lock myself.
quest_503_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, <name>. I led the expedition from Durotar under the Warchief's orders, but as you can see, our plans went somewhat awry. They have held me captive here in this town, forcing me to work, hauling burdens, digging...

[sad] What I have suffered is unimportant, however. [solemn] There is important information you must deliver to whomever is leading our group now.
quest_504_quest_detail:
Now that you've had a taste of the Crushridge ogres, I want you to really bloody their noses...

[commanding] Go into the Ruins of Alterac and seek out the Crushridge Warmongers. [urgent] I want you to cut down a good number of them - that's the only way those brutes will learn to keep their distance from Alliance territory.
quest_504_quest_progress: [commanding] You have more Warmongers to slay, <name>. [urgent] You should be up on the mountains on your task, not down here with your weapon stowed.
quest_504_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good. Here is your reward.

[warm] And when you were hunting those Warmongers, how did Alterac city look? It's in bad shape I would guess. Ogres are not known for their cleanliness.

[solemn] Thankfully, your efforts will help keep them away from Southshore.
quest_505_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am the new magistrate of Southshore, recently assigned after the assassination of the previous magistrate. [sad] The assassins were never found, but through our investigations we're almost certain they were hired by the Syndicate - a group of thieves led by villainous nobles of the now fallen kingdom of Alterac.

[soft voice] The Syndicate has a camp north of the Horde-occupied Tarren Mill, and our last clues led to that camp. [commanding] Slay the Syndicate members you find there.
quest_505_quest_progress: [commanding] You have slain those Syndicate thugs, I trust?
quest_505_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Although they may still be lurking about, we hope that some of the thieves and footpads you slew were responsible for the last magistrate's death. [pause] But even if they weren't, the Syndicate is a taint on this land and a stain on the human race.

[solemn] Their deaths are welcome to Southshore.
quest_506_quest_detail:
[solemn] A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this Syndicate. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.

[soft voice] More important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.

[urgent] Now go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.
quest_506_quest_complete:
[angry] The nerve of those overbearing humans! [commanding] We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!

[proud] This will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. [solemn] It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
quest_507_quest_detail: [solemn] It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. [commanding] His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. [urgent] Do your duty, <name>, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.
quest_507_quest_complete: [sobbing] No, no please don't hurt me! [urgent] I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... spare me!
quest_508_quest_detail: [soft voice] The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! [sad] I want no memory of him... just please, please leave in peace...
quest_508_quest_complete: [solemn] It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. [soft voice] I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. [warm] You did well, <name>, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
quest_509_quest_detail:
[low voice] Another day, another elixir to be made. [sad] If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is.

[solemn] Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

[commanding] Here's the plan, <name>: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
quest_509_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms. [low voice] At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
quest_510_quest_detail: [solemn] Among these documents is a list of requested supplies. [soft voice] These include mundane items (food, weapons, clothing) as well as more exotic gear (masks, oil, poison).
quest_511_quest_detail: [solemn] One of the letters on this table is encrypted and inscrutable.
quest_511_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, <name>? Do you have some business with me?
quest_511_quest_complete: [solemn] What is this? [pause] Hold a moment... let me take a closer look.
quest_512_quest_detail:
I fear the leadership behind the Syndicate is bent on Southshore's ruin. [solemn] We must strike hard at these leaders before their plans are realized.

[commanding] Enter the ruins of Strahnbrad, in the Alterac Mountains to the north. [urgent] We think the Syndicate is using the area as a headquarters.

[low voice] We know this gang of cutthroats is run by former Alterac nobles. [soft voice] They may be hiding as normal Syndicate agents, but you'll know you've killed a noble by the signet ring he wears.

[emphasis] Bring me those signet rings.
quest_512_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you been hunting the Syndicate? [urgent] Do you have those rings?
quest_512_quest_complete:
[solemn] Stripping the Syndicate of its nobility will remove its ability to act decisively, and reduce it to nothing more than a gang of thugs.

[warm] You serve your Alliance well, <name>.
quest_513_quest_detail:
[delight] Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.

First I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!

[urgent] Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, <name>.
quest_513_quest_progress: [low voice] Can you not see I am busy, <class>? [urgent] The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us. And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity. [threatening] This better be important!
quest_513_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Apothecary Lydon sent you? Ah, why didn't you say so!

[warm] Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite! [urgent] I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now. And I like the way he thinks. [solemn] The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
quest_514_quest_detail: [soft voice] I have a colleague in Ironforge who may be able to help decrypt this letter. [pause] Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge and speak with Prospector Stormpike. [emphasis] Tell him I sent you and show him the letter. [solemn] If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.
quest_514_quest_progress: [low voice] Dibbs from Southshore sent you, did he? [soft voice] How is the old bookworm doing?
quest_514_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, encryption! A specialty of mine. [soft voice] Let me see here...
quest_515_quest_detail:
[excited] A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood potion, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. [soft voice] And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
quest_515_quest_progress:
[gentle] So glad to see you back, <name>. [soft voice] I was growing so terribly bored here. Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her. . .over and over and over again.

[low voice] How went the trip to the Undercity? [urgent] Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?
quest_515_quest_complete: [excited] The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! [warm] You have been such a great help, <name>. [commanding] Together we will spread death and disease to this land!
quest_516_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. [commanding] Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

[hesitant] Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. [soft voice] They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. [pause] The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

[solemn] I trust your resourcefulness. [urgent] Find them, and put them down.
quest_516_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you located their base yet, <name>? [urgent] Time is of the essence!
quest_516_quest_complete: [solemn] If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.
quest_517_quest_detail:
[solemn] This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? [mocking tone] Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

[commanding] Head down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. [urgent] Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. [low voice] Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, <name>.
quest_517_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air. Makes Umpi a little nervous though.

[hesitant] So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves? [angry] I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.
quest_517_quest_complete: [delight] Finally! [urgent] Now we are ready for action!
quest_522_quest_detail: [solemn] This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. [soft voice] It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
quest_522_quest_progress: [urgent] You look out of breath! [commanding] Do you have something to report?
quest_522_quest_complete: <Maleb inspects the contract.> [solemn] That explains the latest attack on Southshore. [urgent] The Syndicate must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!
quest_523_quest_detail:
[solemn] The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices. [soft voice] I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this.

[commanding] Find this man. Find him, and bring him to justice. [urgent] He must be among the Syndicate haunts - perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad, or perhaps within the valley north of them.
quest_523_quest_progress: [solemn] Baron Vardus cannot think Southshore will allow him to send his thugs against us with impunity. [angry] I want his head!
quest_523_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] My head rests a little easier, knowing that villain lost his.
quest_524_quest_detail:
[solemn] Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. [urgent] High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from Stormwind to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the Plaguelands last night. [soft voice] Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.

[mocking tone] I think it's time we threw those farmers a party. [excited] Sounds like a grand ol' time!

[commanding] Place this tainted keg on the rug in their room. [shouting] Plagued brew for all!
quest_524_quest_progress: [low voice] A musty smell emanates from the rug.
quest_524_quest_complete: [solemn] You rest the tainted keg on the dusty rug.
quest_525_quest_detail:
[solemn] I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it. [soft voice] You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills? Very strange...

[pause] You should take this to the magistrate of Southshore. [low voice] Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a threat is brewing, then he should know.
quest_525_quest_progress: <name>. [soft voice] Have you been traveling through the foothills and mountains again? [soft voice] What news do you bring?
quest_525_quest_complete:
<Maleb reads the letter.> [solemn] This is translated from a letter you found in a Syndicate encampment? [soft voice] This was not written by a thief, or even a noble of Alterac.

[pause] It appears The Syndicate has ties to another power, and I shudder to think what that might be.
quest_526_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You might have found one lightforge ingot in that chest, but that's not enough to craft anything decent!

[urgent] You should go back there and look for more. [hesitant] Maybe the murlocs around that wrecked ship have lightforge ingots on them.
quest_526_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
quest_526_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, you found them! [warm] Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
quest_527_quest_detail:
[commanding] Stand at attention while addressing me, <class>.

[solemn] I am under direct command of Varimathras. [urgent] We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

[soft voice] Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack. [commanding] Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

[commanding] Travel west. [commanding] Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields. [threatening] Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
quest_527_quest_progress:
[commanding] As High Executor of Tarren Mill, under the direct command of Varimathras and the Dark Lady, you are subject to follow my command.

[angry] Perhaps you take this war with the Alliance lightly? [threatening] If such is the case I should behead you right here and now. [urgent] Otherwise, travel west to the town of Hillsbrad and wage battle against the humans, as ordered.

[commanding] Dismissed.
quest_527_quest_complete: [commanding] At ease, <class>. [solemn] I see you have returned from battle. [soft voice] My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
quest_528_quest_detail:
[solemn] Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. [commanding] Most excellent. Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. [mocking tone] The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.

[urgent] Prove them wrong, <name>. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. [threatening] Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

[commanding] Dismissed!
quest_528_quest_progress: [commanding] You have your orders, <class>. [urgent] Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.
quest_528_quest_complete: [solemn] The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. [urgent] The battle goes well.
quest_529_quest_detail:
[solemn] The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance. [commanding] The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith. [urgent] We need to shut down all supply lines.

[commanding] Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan. [urgent] Slay his apprentices as well. [commanding] While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile. [cold] The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
quest_529_quest_progress: [commanding] Were you able to carry out your orders, <class>? [urgent] Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants? And where is that iron shipment?
quest_529_quest_complete: [commanding voice] Mission accomplished, <class>. [warm] And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
quest_530_quest_detail:
[solemn] Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer. [sad] Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge. [commanding] If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

[urgent] I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
quest_530_quest_progress: [low voice] Do you have those hands, <name>?
quest_530_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, good. These hands killed my wife, Deliah. [sad] Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

[low voice] Here, take the ring you returned earlier. [sad] Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep. [sad] Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.
quest_531_quest_detail:
[shocked] Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!

[urgent] Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
quest_531_quest_progress: [excited] Great job, <name>! [proud] We really showed him! [warm] Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
quest_531_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, <name>. [excited] I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! [warm] Here, have this, you've earned it.
quest_533_quest_detail:
[solemn] At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large Syndicate camp just north of here.

[urgent] Go there, <name>, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
quest_533_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found anything? [sad] I fear Gol'dir's prospects grow worse by the day...
quest_533_quest_complete: [solemn] Finally, we know where Gol'dir is being held. [soft voice] The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
quest_535_quest_detail:
[exhale] Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.

[hesitant] No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
quest_535_quest_progress: [low voice] Did you bring me something to drink or did you just come back to finish the job?
quest_535_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... [warm] Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.

[urgent] Well, get on with it!
quest_536_quest_detail:
[low voice] Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... [sigh] Smell of the harbor day and night.

Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha!

I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. [hesitant] If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
quest_536_quest_progress:
Another ale, please, the last one just seemed to have disappeared!

[angry] Light, how much longer am I going to be stuck out here?

[sigh] Oh, it's you, <name>. [urgent] Have you killed those murlocs yet?
quest_536_quest_complete: [confident] I hope this will be enough to convince Redpath that I've--ha!--been carrying out his orders and ridding Southshore of the terrible and horrible menace of the dreaded murlocs! [warm] For there could be no greater evil than the ravages of overgrown fish!
quest_537_quest_detail:
[solemn] The letter you brought me was written by a being who calls himself Nagaz, a member of the Argus Wake. [hesitant] I don't know what this Argus Wake is, but if they're in alliance with the Syndicate then they must be a threat.

[commanding] I want you to find Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages mentioned in that letter. [urgent] I want you to find them, and kill them.

[solemn] Search in the Uplands, where the Syndicate is strongest. [soft voice] It is north of Strahnbrad.

[solemn] With luck, you'll find these envoys of the Argus Wake there.
quest_537_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the envoys of The Argus Wake?
quest_537_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well done, <name>. [solemn] The Argus Wake does not sound like a group we want running the Syndicate.

[soft voice] And although you may have destroyed their leader here, Nagaz was merely the servant of another. [urgent] The Argus Wake might run deep through the continent of Azeroth.

[emphasis] Or even the world.
quest_538_quest_detail:
<name>. [soft voice] If you don't mind a long journey then I have a task for you, to again help Stormwind fill its library.

[solemn] The old kingdom of Alterac fell after the great war, and it had a large collection of books. [sad] It's a tragedy that the city is ruined, but even more tragic is all of their knowledge lost! [urgent] We must recover what we can.

[soft voice] Southshore is the closest town to the Ruins of Alterac. [commanding] Go there and speak with Loremaster Dibbs. [gentle] He can direct you to the ruins, and to what books may be found there.
quest_538_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah yes, I remember Milton. A bookworm, no doubt. Bless him.

And he's right. The Ruins of Alterac still hold stores of knowledge in danger of being lost!

[urgent] Ogres now dwell in Alterac, and they don't care much for higher learning.
quest_539_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azurelode Mine is under Alliance control. [low voice] Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.

[pause] Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azurelode Mine fervently.

[commanding] The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. [urgent] Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. [threatening] Kill his miners as well. [angry] That should send a clear message to the Alliance.
quest_539_quest_progress: [urgent] You were given direct orders to attack the Azureload Mine. [commanding] Your reasons for loafing about Tarren Mill better be good or I will behead you for treason.
quest_539_quest_complete: [solemn] The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
quest_540_quest_detail:
[solemn] Those beastly ogres now reside within Alterac's ruins, and I shudder to think what they're doing with the precious books still there. [urgent] You must recover what you can!

[commanding] Enter the Ruins of Alterac and search for tomes looted by the ogres. Get whatever you can find and bring them to me, but also seek out one book in particular: The Arm of Gri'lek. [soft voice] It contains ancient troll lore that I must learn, and the Ruins of Alterac was the last known location of an intact copy of this book.
quest_540_quest_progress: I wish I could search the ruins too, but I fear these bones wouldn't hold me during my climb up the mountains. [soft voice] However, how does your hunt for knowledge progress, <name>?
quest_540_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, you got them! [delight] Splendid! [urgent] I must begin studying the Arm of Gri'lek immediately!
quest_541_quest_detail:
[angry] Dwarves aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts.

[commanding] We shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance. [threatening] We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. [solemn] We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.

[soft voice] They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. [urgent] The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, <class>. [cold] Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
quest_541_quest_progress:
Dun Garok proves to be too much of an obstacle for you, <class>? [angry] And here I thought you had established yourself valiantly in Hillsbrad.

[threatening] If you're not up to handle the mission assigned to you, I will find another who can produce better results. [cold] As for you, well, I am sure the Dark Lady could always use more grave diggers back in Tirisfal Glades.
quest_541_quest_complete: [solemn] Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.
quest_542_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I need to spend some time studying the Arm of Gri'lek book you brought me, though I'm sure Milton is eager to get the other recovered books into Stormwind's collection.

[solemn] Here are the books you gathered from the Ruins of Alterac, packed and catalogued. [urgent] Take them back to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind and I'm sure he'll be grateful.
quest_542_quest_progress: <name>, you've returned! [excited] How did your foray into Alterac go? [soft voice] Did you bring anything back with you?
quest_542_quest_complete:
[excited] My oh my! Look at these! I can't believe they survived the ruination of Alterac. And all those ogres too!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Thank you so much! [proud] You have helped preserve human knowledge, and you add to the grandeur of the Royal Library of Stormwind.
quest_543_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Perenolde Tiara is an old heirloom of the Perenolde "nobles" - the ruling family of Alterac before that kingdom fell to ruin. [soft voice] It is said to have been crafted by master jewelers in Ironforge, and fitted with the finest of emeralds.

[pause] When Alterac was destroyed the Tiara was lost, but there are rumors that an Ogre Mage, Grel'borg the Miser, found the tiara and now wanders the Ruins of Alterac searching for more treasures.

[urgent] We would have you acquire the tiara for us.
quest_543_quest_progress: [gentle] Salutations, <name>. [soft voice] Do try to avoid stepping on my pant cuffs. [soft voice] This outfit is newly tailored.
quest_543_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, this is splendid. [warm] This will have to be cleaned of course, but you really outdid yourself, <name>. [proud] I will have someone prepare the tiara and place it within our collection posthaste.

[solemn] As I'm sure you will agree, our gratitude is as grand as our collection.
quest_544_quest_detail:
[solemn] I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. [soft voice] You see, four Forsaken fled the Undercity a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...[angry] they stole from the Dark Lady.

[commanding] These thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. [urgent] Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.

[solemn] The thieves fled the Undercity to Dalaran, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
quest_544_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the thieves? [emphasis] And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
quest_544_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done a great service for the Forsaken, <name>. [soft voice] These artifacts have been sorely missed.

[warm] And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.
quest_545_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wizards of Dalaran constructed a vast, magical dome around the heart of their city. [soft voice] Some believe it was for protection from the violence of these times, while others say they merely wanted solitude, to study and plot.

[low voice] I don't care what the reason was. [urgent] I do care that the ruined outskirts of their city, outside the dome, may hide valuable magical treasures.

[commanding] But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.

[emphasis] So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
quest_545_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you yet thinned the Dalaran patrols around their ruins?
quest_545_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good. [soft voice] Those ruins should now be safe enough to search, if one is careful.

[warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_546_quest_detail:
[low voice] I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad. [mocking tone] So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

[hesitant] Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself? [solemn] You see I am collecting human skulls. [commanding] And you will be fighting humans for quite some time. [urgent] Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
quest_546_quest_progress:
[low voice] So the lucky <name> returns? [angry] How many humans have you slaughtered today? [excited] Hundreds I do hope!

[commanding] Have you any skulls for me?
quest_546_quest_complete: [delight] Precious skulls! So beautiful! [warm] I owe you as promised, <name>!
quest_547_quest_detail:
[solemn] High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance. I had set up camp just out of sight. But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it. [urgent] I need my sword! If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful. [sad] So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
quest_547_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to retrieve my sword, <name>? [whispering] High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
quest_547_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it!

[warm] Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand. [warm] Many thanks to you!
quest_549_quest_detail: [solemn] By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. [commanding] Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. [urgent] They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.
quest_550_quest_detail:
[solemn] Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.

[urgent] Take this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity. [proud] Go with pride, <class>.
quest_551_quest_detail:
[solemn] This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable. [soft voice] But one word at the top of the paper can be read:

Nagaz
quest_551_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh. You have something you'd like me to look at? [pause] Some scrap of lore gathered from up in the mountains, I hope...
quest_551_quest_complete:
[solemn] More encrypted notes?

[hesitant] I wish I had the talents to decrypt all the strange bits of writing that trickle down from Alterac. But I'm afraid I lack the knowledge.
quest_552_quest_detail:
[solemn] Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him. [sad] To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.

[angry] Such disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable. [commanding] As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.

[urgent] We will need Helcular's Rod first. [hesitant] Yeti overtook his ritual lair. [sad] Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
quest_552_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet? [hesitant] There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate. [solemn] But we must have it in order to proceed.
quest_554_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prospector Stormpike is a master of decryption and deciphering. [soft voice] If you take the parchment you found to him, then with luck he can make sense of it. [pause] Stormpike is currently studying in the Prospector headquarters in Ironforge.

[warm] And when you see him tell him you spoke with me - I've been sending him quite a lot of business lately.
quest_554_quest_progress:
[low voice] More interruptions?

Ah, this parchment is covered with a very intricate, finely woven spell. [hesitant] I can untangle it, of course, but it's going to take time. And time is very valuable to me...

Perhaps I will just purchase it from you?
quest_554_quest_complete: [solemn] A wise decision. I don't believe there is a scholar other than myself with the skills to translate this scroll. [soft voice] And if its contents prove interesting, fear not. I will send for you.
quest_555_quest_detail:
[excited] If there's one thing you'll learn about Southshore it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of Stormwind!

[warm] Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl. [hesitant] Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. [sad] I used to head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. [commanding] If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!
quest_555_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck finding the ingredients? [soft voice] I'll tell you, this territory isn't the peaceful place it once was. [sad] Ah, if only this unrest never occurred...
quest_555_quest_complete: [excited] Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's Soothing Turtle Bisque is served once again!
quest_556_quest_detail:
[solemn] A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions. [soft voice] The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals. [urgent] Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.

Enter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.

[hesitant] You might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp. [whispering] It's safer than Dalaran itself.
quest_556_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, <name>? [solemn] The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
quest_556_quest_complete:
[solemn] These will do nicely. [soft voice] Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.

[warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_557_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding. [soft voice] These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.

[urgent] Hunt elementals in the ruins of Dalaran and gather their Bracers of Earth Binding, and the Magus will be pleased.
quest_557_quest_progress: [low voice] Hello, <name>. [solemn] Elementals are tough quarry, but I know you're up to the task. [urgent] Do you have those bracers of binding?
quest_557_quest_complete:
[solemn] You found them. I trust the elementals from which you removed these bracers were amenable?

Hm...death has not only stopped my heart, but robbed me of my comedic timing, it seems.

[warm] Well thank you, <name>. [proud] You serve the Magus, and hence the Dark Lady, well.
quest_558_quest_detail:
[solemn] They say that Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore is one of the greatest heroes the Alliance has ever had. [excited] When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Alliance too!

Do you know Jaina, <name>? [soft voice] Could you do me a favor, please? [soft voice] Could you get her autograph for me? [hesitant] I dunno how to ask her, and she'd probably be too busy for someone like me... but you! [excited] You're an adventurer just like she is! [confident] I bet she'd give you her autograph easy!

[soft voice] Please?
quest_558_quest_progress: Someday, I wanna be a hero just like Jaina... [soft voice] well, a boy hero that is.
quest_558_quest_complete:
[excited] WOW! You got Lady Jaina's autograph for me! [warm] Thank you very much! And wow... she wrote a personal message on here - to me! [delight] I knew she'd be totally cool, and maybe someday I'll thank her myself... when I become a hero of the Alliance!

[proud] You're the best, <name>. [warm] Thank you for being so nice to me.
quest_559_quest_detail: [soft voice] Would you believe it, <name>? [commanding] Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed--oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it. [urgent] Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.
quest_559_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get those heads for me, <name>?
quest_559_quest_complete:
[exhale] Oh for the Love of the Light... they're dripping on the ground.

Can't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around... Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in Southshore, that means you aren't eating much.
quest_560_quest_detail: [hesitant] You know, <name>, I'd really rather not take these heads... [soft voice] Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
quest_560_quest_progress: [commanding] Greetings, citizen. [soft voice] Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?
quest_560_quest_complete:
[commanding] Farren's errand boy, are you?

[warm] If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. [solemn] Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
quest_561_quest_detail: [solemn] Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand. [commanding] When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.
quest_561_quest_complete: [low voice] The naga, eh? Redpath must have just received the same information as me... [laughing] Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil. [solemn] Let me explain.
quest_562_quest_detail:
[solemn] My former mentor in the Stormwind city guard sent a message to me that Alliance High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.

[hesitant] There's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, <name>. [soft voice] Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. [urgent] You've got to help me, <name>!
