quest_562_quest_progress: [urgent] I've a letter ready to go to Major Samuelson in Stormwind. [emphasis] All I need are the results.
quest_562_quest_complete: [soft voice] With the naga put down in Southshore, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. [warm] I'll get to see Stormwind again... [pause] get away from this Light-forsaken port.
quest_563_quest_detail: [soft voice] It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in Stormwind. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. [urgent] I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.
quest_563_quest_progress: Greetings, citizen. [soft voice] May the Stormwind city guard be of assistance?
quest_563_quest_complete: [soft voice] What's this? Ah... so my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in Southshore. [warm] Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.
quest_564_quest_detail:
[angry] Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses. And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang Syndicate gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.

But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac. Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!

[commanding] You fancy yourself a hero? Go and do somethin' about it then!
quest_564_quest_progress:
[angry] Mountain Lions killin' off our horses left and right and here you are wantin' to jibber-jabber about the weather and what not.

Ought to go and find myself a real hero. [commanding] More killin' and less talkin'.
quest_564_quest_complete: [delight] Ain't that great news! [warm] Should-a gone and found me a regular ol' war hero from day one to take care of them beasts. [proud] You'd-a made your pappy proud, <name>.
quest_565_quest_detail:
[commanding] I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, Alliance renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak!

[shouting] Travel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. [soft voice] Oh wait, what is that, little <race>? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" [warm] Yes, yes! That, I have heard before.

[commanding] Bartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course! [excited] Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
quest_565_quest_progress: [solemn] So you have returned to the great Bartolo. [soft voice] Perhaps you have finished gathering the materials needed for your Yeti Fur Cloak? [mocking tone] Or maybe you just enjoy basking in the greatness of me, Bartolo!
quest_565_quest_complete: [excited] Now it is time for the great Bartolo to work his magic! [confident] I require no wizard's staff, no <class>'s rod. For I, the great Bartolo, work magic with a mere needle and thread!
quest_566_quest_detail: [solemn] By order of High Executor Darthalia, the human known as Baron Vardus is wanted for crimes against the Forsaken. [low voice] Vardus is known to be a high-ranking member of the organization known as the Syndicate.
quest_568_quest_detail:
[commanding] Throm'ka, <class>!

[solemn] Your arrival at Grom'gol is timely, indeed. [commanding] As commander of the Warchief's base camp here in the jungle I am bound by honor to ensure the safety of all members of the Horde. [urgent] Our mission to provide a safe chain of supply to Stonard is being hampered by some of the local inhabitants.

[commanding] I am putting you in charge of thinning out the raptor population outside of Grom'gol. [pause] Once you have made significant progress, report back to me for reassignment.
quest_568_quest_progress: [low voice] Our supply efforts are still being hampered by the indigenous raptor population, <class>.
quest_568_quest_complete: [solemn] Your duty was performed with honor, <class>.
quest_569_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes. [low voice] Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority. But complications have arisen. [urgent] A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol. Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.

[commanding] I am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.

Travel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area. At the very least it will send a firm message.
quest_569_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you made any progress with the ogres of the Mizjah Ruins yet, <class>?
quest_569_quest_complete: [commanding] Well done. [proud] You have served the Warchief with honor.
quest_570_quest_detail:
[solemn] The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde. [soft voice] My rituals have proven successful so far. [confident] I can cast very powerful enchantments. [warm] For you, brave <class>, I shall make a special item indeed.

[commanding] Bring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang. [emphasis] Not just any fang will do. [solemn] It must be in pristine condition.

[urgent] The beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.
quest_570_quest_complete: [solemn] Your knowledge of the jungle is strong, <name>. [warm] These specimens will be perfect. [proud] I will thank the spirits for sacrificing such fine beasts for the cause of the Horde.
quest_571_quest_detail:
[solemn] What I need from you now will be very difficult to obtain.

To hold all these feathers, claws and the pristine fang in place I require a magical tether. [low voice] Only an aged gorilla sinew will work.

You will only be able to find one on an Elder Mistvale Gorilla. [soft voice] They are known to forage to the east of Booty Bay.

[emphasis] The sinew must be perfect. It might take quite a few kills for you to find exactly what I need but it will be well worth the hunt.
quest_571_quest_progress: [solemn] Has fortune been on your side, <name>? [soft voice] Were you able to obtain an aged gorilla sinew?
quest_571_quest_complete: [solemn] A most ideal sinew, <name>. [warm] Your efforts will pay off soon.
quest_572_quest_detail:
[solemn] The items you gathered from the feline beasts of the Vale are only the first requirement for a powerful enchanted item. [soft voice] These jungle trinkets combined with my shamanistic ritual will provide you with a very useful tool in assisting the Horde and the Warchief.

[emphasis] But now you must gather for me some Jungle Stalker Feathers. [pause] The feathers are traditionally worn by the beasts on their armbands. [urgent] You will find a tribe of the raptors directly south of Grom'gol, not far from the great arena.
quest_572_quest_progress: [solemn] Did your gathering efforts prove fruitful?
quest_572_quest_complete: [delight] Most excellent. I will prepare these at once.
quest_573_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is but one final reagent needed to complete the enchantment.

[soft voice] In the south, towards the western coast, high above the bluffs, lies a Holy Spring. [pause] This spring is the subject of great conflict amongst religious and mystical scholars. [low voice] Every race in Azeroth claims that the spring waters were made divine for their people.

[commanding] My final request of you: bring to me Holy Spring Water. Be warned. [urgent] An expedition of naga explorers have advanced upon the spring. [threatening] They will need to be dealt with as well.
quest_573_quest_progress: [solemn] I am almost ready to complete the enchantment. [commanding] Have you performed my bidding?
quest_573_quest_complete:
[solemn] With this Holy Spring Water the ceremonial choker is ready for enchantment.

[warm] Wear this with pride, <name>, in the name of the Warchief and in defense of the mighty Horde.
quest_574_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that many of his regular troops are reduced, you must face his highly trained forces. When they're not in the wilderness slaughtering our rebel soldiers, they are found deep in the back of the Kurzen Compound, in a cave they call the Stockpile.

[soft voice] I know many of Kurzen's troops personally, and I know they are skilled, loyal, and cruel. [commanding] This is no easy task I set before you, <name>.

[urgent] After you defeat them, report to Lieutenant Doren, my commanding officer. He will want your report firsthand.
quest_574_quest_progress: [soft voice] Sergeant Yohwa tells me you are skilled and brave, <class>. [commanding] Do you have something to report?
quest_574_quest_complete:
<name>. [warm] Sergeant Yohwa trusted your abilities, and I trust her. [solemn] The defeat you brought to Kurzen's forces is almost too much to hope for. [soft voice] I had feared we rebels were alone, and alone we could never stand up against the Colonel's brilliance.

Perhaps hope of our survival yet remains.
quest_575_quest_detail:
"[solemn] The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." [soft voice] That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... [clears throat] Ahem. Well. [pause] My leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!

[excited] I've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.

[urgent] To start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in northern Stranglethorn.
quest_575_quest_progress:
[excited] My equipment is all ready to go, <name>, I just need those skins. [urgent] We don't want to keep Riddlevox waiting, that's for sure.

[low voice] It's not a good idea for anyone to keep the chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union unsatisfied.
quest_575_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These skins should do. Their quality isn't too important, given that they'll make up the inside layer of the boots, but it's still important that they're comfortable.

If they're a bit too rigid, I'll use some tiger blood to soften it up. [chuckling] Tricks o' the trade, you know?
quest_576_quest_detail:
[commanding] Avast! Who goes there?

[angry] Argh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. [sad] Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! [solemn] But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again.

[urgent] Last night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. [threatening] Took me eye, they did! [solemn] Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay.

[gentle] Help an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?
quest_576_quest_progress:
[excited] Ahoy, me bucko! Might not be able to see but I can smell ye from halfway across port.

[sad] Could really use me eye back. [angry] Captain's going to keelhaul me when he finds out me peeper is in the hands of them dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers.

[sad] What good is a lookout who can't see? [soft voice] The crow's nest used to be me home...without me deadlights I'd be lucky to scrub the bilge.
quest_576_quest_complete:
[excited] Shiver me timbers and timber me shivers! Ye found me beautiful eye! Let's see if she still fits.

[laughing] Shavas ho! [delight] Blimey, I can see!!
quest_577_quest_detail:
[excited] Well, I've got the basic shape of the boots worked out, and they're coming along fine, but the skins you brought aren't going to be quite enough for the inner layers.

"What are we going to do, Drizzlik?" No doubt the question on your lips, and well, isn't it lucky you're talking to Drizzlik, because he's going to tell you what we're going to do!

[urgent] The inner layers will never really be seen, so we'll just get some of the thicker, cheaper skins from the crocs around Lake Nazferiti to fill the boots out.
quest_577_quest_progress:
[excited] Drizzlik's Excelsior leather boots, finest workmanship, one-hundred percent high quality saltwater crocolisk skin boots. [loud voice] None finer! [mocking tone] Can't beat a glowing description like that, can you?

[urgent] Except, maybe, if you have those skins for me?
quest_577_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My boots... they're like sausages, <name>. [mocking tone] Look great, taste great. [chuckling] I tell you they're filled with nothing but the finest ingredients and meats, and you eat it, and you love it.

[whispering] It's safer--and more enjoyable--if you just trust me, and don't ask too carefully what's really inside.
quest_578_quest_detail:
[excited] If there is indeed a goblin mage and water elementals haunting the island, it could mean the Stone of the Tides can be mine!

[urgent] I want you to locate this haunted island... find out what's going on. [soft voice] Oh, and if you perhaps want to find out more about the Stone of the Tides, take this scrip to the Stormwind Library, they should be able to find you a copy of the book I first came across the legend in.

[hesitant] Could it be that Gazban actually discovered the Stone...?
quest_578_quest_progress: [soft voice] The trolls truly possessed some amazing magical objects, <name>. And now, perhaps, I have the opportunity to add one to my extensive collection. Did you have any luck finding the source of the rumor?
quest_578_quest_complete: [excited] So the stories were true! [delight] Incredible! [urgent] However, we will need to figure out a way to defeat the curse of the Stone of the Tides, if we are to retrieve it. [solemn] The curse is magical business, we'll need one of those wizards to help us out.
quest_579_quest_progress: [solemn] King Varian has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. [soft voice] It's very simple. [commanding] You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books. [emphasis] Library Scrip
quest_579_quest_complete: [soft voice] Do any of these titles interest you, <name>?
quest_580_quest_detail:
[excited] We was splicin' the mainbrace somethin' fierce off of the Overlook Cliffs, ol' Hinterlands just in the distance. [shocked] Thought the seas was goin' to swallow us whole.

Ol' Slim knows all about liquid courage! Cap'n had a crate of Pupellyverbos Port we commandeered from a privateer en route to Stormwind.

[urgent] So when that storm off of Hinterlands hit, I busted into the grog. [sad] Big wave hit and tossed them bottles overboard. [angry] Cap'n is goin' to give me a taste o' the cat if ye don't help me get 'em back though!
quest_580_quest_progress: [surprised] Sink me! [urgent] I'm almost outta booze here! [angry] Cap'n is goin' to weigh anchor and Ol' Slim will be caught dry as the Tanaris Desert. [shocked] And once he discovers his port is missing. . . blimey!
quest_580_quest_complete:
[excited] Shiver me timbers! Ye found the Cap'n's grog!

[warm] I owe ye big time, friend.

[hesitant] Seems like a storm is a brewin' outside. [soft voice] Maybe I'll just keep warm with one o' these here bottles while we wait for it to pass....
quest_581_quest_detail:
[solemn] A doom, there is. [solemn] A doom on my chief's youngest son, Yenniku. [solemn] As is a custom with our people, he was given to the Gurubashi Trolls of Zul'Gurub, but after my tribe, the Darkspear tribe, left with the orc Thrall, poor Yenniku was lost to us. [solemn] I was sent from distant Orgrimmar, back to Stranglethorn, to search for my chief's son.

And I believe the Bloodscalp tribe has him.

[urgent] If you would help me, then hunt the Bloodscalps. You may find them to the north. [commanding] Gather their tusks and return to me.
quest_581_quest_progress:
<class>. [commanding] Show me you have made prey of the Bloodscalp tribe.

[emphasis] Show me your trophies.
quest_581_quest_complete:
[delight] These are good tusks, <name>. [proud] You prove that you have the strength to hunt the Bloodscalps.

And that is good, because you are not done hunting them.
quest_582_quest_detail:
[solemn] We must find if Yenniku is dead.

Slay the Bloodscalp Headhunters and take from them their Shrunken Heads. You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.

[angry] And if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!

[urgent] Go, <name>. You may find many Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda, along the coast to the north.
quest_582_quest_progress: <name>. [solemn] I fear for our chief's son. [soft voice] Do you have the shrunken heads so I may inspect them?
quest_582_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] I will inspect these heads to ensure poor Yenniku was spared the headhunter's axe.
quest_583_quest_detail:
[excited] Welcome to Stranglethorn!

[soft voice] Perhaps you're not aware of this, but that dwarf over there is the one and only Hemet Nesingwary, renowned war hero of the Alliance and master big game hunter. [low voice] He's not one for welcoming strangers into his camp, but you look like you've seen quite a bit of action in your day, <class>.

[warm] Being a veteran of many battles himself, Master Nesingwary has a soft spot for fellow heroes.

[commanding] Go and speak with him. [gentle] Perhaps he can give you some hunting pointers.
quest_583_quest_complete:
Jolly nice to make your acquaintance, <name>. [soft voice] Haven't seen a <class> around these parts for some time.

[solemn] I situated myself with this expedition for one purpose: to hunt a great and elusive beast. [warm] Seeing that you're a hero of sorts I am willing to let you take part in the hunt, but you must first prove yourself.

[commanding] I shall teach the ways of raptor killing to you. [soft voice] Ajeck will train you with tiger hunting. And Sir Erlgadin is a master of panther tracking.

[urgent] Prove your skill and I'll let you in on the big hunt.
quest_584_quest_detail:
[solemn] Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it. [pause] But we are no closer to finding him.

[urgent] We must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it. [threatening] They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!

[commanding] Bring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.

[solemn] They are deep within Zul'Kunda. [emphasis] Bring their heads...[pause] we will then make them talk.
quest_584_quest_progress: [solemn] The greenish broth within the cauldron bubbles.
quest_584_quest_complete: [solemn] You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...
quest_587_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, the sea life. I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life.

[low voice] When I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff. [chuckling] Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right?

[sad] So you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff. [angry] Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders.

[confident] I bet a fearless <class> like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?
quest_587_quest_progress: [soft voice] Any luck finding the goods, matey?
quest_587_quest_complete: [excited] Good show, <name>! And just before I need to ship out too! [warm] Can't thank you enough, old friend.
quest_589_quest_detail:
[solemn] Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn. We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers. If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.

[soft voice] I will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye. While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks. The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.
quest_589_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the shards, <name>? [solemn] They are needed for my final ritual, after we have the Mind's Eye.
quest_589_quest_complete:
[gentle] You have done well, <name>. [soft voice] These shards are well formed. [solemn] Already I hear them sing to me.

[solemn] And while you were gone, I spoke with the spirits of the jungle. [solemn] I know where the Mind's Eye rests...

...And who guards it.
quest_590_quest_detail:
[angry] What?

What?! You want money? I don't owe you any money.

[surprised] Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? [urgent] All right, mate... let's do this! [hesitant] Owe you any money...
quest_590_quest_complete:
[excited] Incredible! [delight] What skill! [mocking tone] Thought you'd be easy prey, <name>. [sigh] Got me good, you did.

[warm] Here's the coin I promised... [hesitant] not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.
quest_591_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, east of here and deep within the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound. His name is Mai'Zoth. [soft voice] I know him from when the Darkspears dwelt in Stranglethorn - he is vicious, and his magic is strong.

[threatening] And if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.

[urgent] You must face Mai'Zoth and wrest from him the Mind's Eye. [solemn] It is a perilous task, but it is the only hope we have of saving Yenniku.
quest_591_quest_progress:
Greetings, <name>. [solemn] The spirits sing praise of your bravery, yet they tell me no tales of your quest against Mai'Zoth.

[hesitant] Do you have the Eye?
quest_591_quest_complete:
[excited] You retrieved the eye! [warm] Your might is the stuff of legends, <name>!

And in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether. [solemn] That is why the spirits would not mention him before.

[soft voice] It is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...[pause] I fear he will begin a new reign.

[hesitant] But that is a worry for another time. [urgent] Now, I must perform a ritual to bend the Mind's Eye to our needs...
quest_592_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem. Its purpose is twofold: [urgent] you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.

Then, bring the gem to Nimboya.

[soft voice] Yenniku dwells with Zanzil the Outcast, at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the distant Cape of Stranglethorn.
quest_592_quest_progress:
<name>. [solemn] Kin'weelay told me you set out to capture Yenniku.

[soft voice] Is it true? Do you have him?
quest_592_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [warm] You freed Yenniku from the will of Zanzil, and completed the mission I had thought was so desperate.

[proud] Our tribe will remember your name in songs, <name>, and we will etch your tale in stone so that it will live forever.
quest_593_quest_progress: Yenniku stands stunned before you, his mind in another place... [soft voice] Soul Gem
quest_593_quest_complete: [solemn] You place the Soul Gem upon his forehead. [soft voice] He shudders as his soul is sucked in, leaving his body, a mindless husk, behind.
quest_594_quest_detail:
The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:

[solemn] To any that can aid me-

[soft voice] Please, my need for help is dire. [urgent] A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.

[solemn] The stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild Shore to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.

[soft voice] I beg of you, my would-be savior, [sad] please help me.
quest_594_quest_complete: [urgent] Have you come to free me?
quest_595_quest_detail:
[excited] You sure seem eager to work, matey. [hesitant] Not sure why some land-loving <race> <class> is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.

[urgent] Our ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.

[mocking tone] All the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies! [commanding] What I need is a scout.

Check the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.
quest_595_quest_complete: [excited] Inside the skiff, you discover a map with some hastily written text on it along with some coins.
quest_596_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was sent to Grom'gol to aid Nimboya on his quest, but... I too have reasons for being here.

[commanding] The Bloodscalp tribe is enemy to our tribe. [emphasis] Collecting trophies of our enemies gives us power over them. [soft voice] You may aid our tribe by hunting our enemies.

[urgent] They dwell to the north. [commanding] Slay Bloodscalp trolls and take from them their bloody bone necklaces. [confident] Collect many, and your reward will be great.
quest_596_quest_progress: [commanding] The Bloodscalps will one day be crushed by the Darkspears! [urgent] Do you have the necklaces of our doomed foe?
quest_596_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, very good. I will boil these, and leech them, and the spirits of their owners will weaken as I render their necklaces to paste!

[low voice] Here, <name>. [warm] This will repay my debt to you.
quest_597_quest_detail: [solemn] The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.
quest_598_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you have gathered Bloodscalp trophies, I have another task for you. [soft voice] The Skullsplitter tribe of trolls live to the southeast, and for years we have warred with them. [solemn] Although the Darkspears no longer dwell in Stranglethorn, we are bound to our conflict with the Skullsplitters.

[commanding] So, hunt them. [urgent] Gather their Split Bone Necklaces and return to me. [warm] Aid us in our war, and you will earn the friendship of the Darkspears.
quest_598_quest_progress: [angry] The Skullsplitters will curse the day they brought us to war! [urgent] Is your task complete?
quest_598_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your strength is great to have gained these necklaces, <name>. [excited] The Skullsplitters fall to you like young saplings stomped to earth by a Basilisk!

[warm] Your deeds are a boon to us.
quest_599_quest_detail:
[shouting] Shiver me timbers! [urgent] So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay? [angry] Why, the nerve of those scoundrels. [commanding] Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders!

[emphasis] This is bigger than I thought. [commanding] Report what you have learned to Fleet Master Seahorn at once! [soft voice] The ol' sea dog is around town somewhere....
quest_599_quest_complete: [angry] Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay? They might as well throw themselves off the Overlook Cliffs. [solemn] Nonetheless, by bringing me this information you have done my fleet of swashbucklers a great service. [warm] The Blackwater Raiders thank you.
quest_600_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Venture Company has a string of operations through Stranglethorn which keeps hard-working goblins, like me, from making honest gold! Please, you must help me!

[commanding] The Venture Company is mining near the Crystalvein Mine to the north. [low voice] They can't get into the mine because of all the basilisks, but they're still able to dig up Singing Crystals from the surrounding hills.

[urgent] Take their crystals from them, and show them they don't have the run of the jungle.

[hesitant] And... um... bring me those crystals as proof!
quest_600_quest_progress:
[urgent] Do you have those crystals?? I need them!!

[emphasis] I mean...I need to know the evil Venture Company is losing ground in Stranglethorn. [excited] Because, you know, we honest folk have to make a living!
quest_600_quest_complete:
[excited] Great! Wonderful! I can get a bundle for these!!

[laughing] That Venture Company sure picked the wrong jungle to mine in, didn't they? [mocking tone] We'd all be in better shape if they moved out of here.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You've done a good deed this day.
quest_601_quest_detail:
[solemn] The water elementals were no doubt summoned by Gazban, the goblin wizard rumored to have discovered the Stone of the Tides. [soft voice] As you may know, the Stone of the Tides curses its bearer, causing him to fade in and out of existence...

[pause] Perhaps we can find a way to counteract the curse. [urgent] We can have a mage of Dalaran analyze the magical residue of one of the water elemental's bracers. [commanding] I need you to go back to the island and retrieve a few specimens.
quest_601_quest_complete:
Hm, I haven't the eye to examine these bracers to see if any of them will be of any use, but I'm sure at least one of them will be able to help. [soft voice] Take them to Dalaran and have a mage look at them.

[low voice] After all, I can't very well leave Booty Bay just to chat with those tiresome old mages.

[mocking tone] Not that I'm worried anyone would try to elbow their way into being the new baron. [threatening] No one crosses Revilgaz and lives to tell of it.
quest_602_quest_detail:
[low voice] From what I've heard, the mages of Dalaran are busy with the reconstruction of their destroyed city, I'm sure you can find one of them who will spare some time to look at the bracers. [soft voice] If there's anything I know about mages, they can't resist a magical puzzle.

[urgent] Take the bag of water elemental bracers and see if they can shed any light on the Stone's curse. [emphasis] Look for the Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in particular. [commanding] I've dealt with him before, and his knowledge is vast.
quest_603_quest_complete:
[angry] My dagger? What are you, some sort of comedian?

[sigh] What? Do you just want me to repeat the story of how I've gone from the best knife fighter in Booty Bay to the laughing stock of piratedom!

[sad] I lost a knife fight to one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers--bunch of right bastards they are!--and he took my blade as spoils.

[soft voice] It's not as though I can get by as a knife fighter with insults and a sharp tongue alone...
quest_604_quest_detail:
Crazz speaks highly of your dedication to the Blackwater Raiders. [solemn] I am going to trust you with a mission of extreme importance to the fleet.

[urgent] Infiltrate the so-called southern command post the Bloodsail Buccaneers have established on the Wild Shore. [commanding] Raid the encampment. [commanding] Bring me their charts along with their written orders. [commanding] We shall see exactly what those scum are up to.
quest_604_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ahoy, <name>. [urgent] What word do you bring of the Bloodsail encampment to the south?
quest_604_quest_complete:
Perfect, <name>. [proud] Now that we know their plan, it's just a matter of time.

[solemn] And to think the fools have dropped anchor just off the cape....
quest_605_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties. [urgent] I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!

[excited] I'd like to hire you.

[soft voice] The basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal. This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.

[commanding] You can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
quest_605_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those shards yet? [excited] I'll give you a decent cut from the profits!
quest_605_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! These will do nicely, <name>. [excited] Yes, quite nicely!

[warm] Here is your cut, and...it was a pleasure doing business with you.
quest_606_quest_detail:
[angry] If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts! And there are a lot of people who owe me. [commanding] Think you can help me collect?

First, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks. He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due! [threatening] But to get it, we'll have to scare him.

[urgent] Go out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas. Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky. [whispering] Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.
quest_606_quest_progress: [angry] Hey! [hesitant] I don't like the look you're giving me, mister.
quest_606_quest_complete:
[urgent] Ack! Where'd you get these? No, don't tell me. I don't want to know!

[shouting] Who sent you? Sea Wolf?
quest_607_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. [hesitant] And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!!

[hesitant] I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. [soft voice] He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
quest_607_quest_progress: [excited] Here here, <name>. [urgent] Did you get Shaky's payment?
quest_607_quest_complete:
[laughing] Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?

Hah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!

[warm] Thanks for your help, <name>. [confident] Now it's your turn to get paid...
quest_608_quest_detail:
[angry] Blast the nerve of Firallon! He couldn't sail a skiff through Crystal Lake let alone lead an entire fleet against us.

The Bloodsail Buccaneers will pay for their carelessness. [urgent] Now that we know their plan of attack, we can counter before they know what hit them.

But why send the entire fleet to do the work of one brave adventuring party? <name>, take some of your most skilled comrades out to Firallon's landing spot and assassinate the Bloodsail leadership. Their fleet will sink soon after....
quest_608_quest_progress: [urgent] What's the problem, <name>? [commanding] We need to attack before the Bloodsail Buccaneers do!
quest_608_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, what a great day for the Blackwater Raiders! [warm] Three cheers to you, <name>!
quest_609_quest_detail:
[low voice] My list is shortening, but there are still people who owe me.

Next, we have Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs."

[angry] These scurvy dogs' debts are months outstanding and I thought they skipped town to avoid paying up! [pause] Later, I heard they're cursed and bewitched and now wander the jungle ruins. [soft voice] But I don't care what their fate is - I want what's mine!

[commanding] They're at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal, northeast of here. Find them, and collect.
quest_609_quest_progress: <name>, did you find those three dogs? [urgent] Did you collect their valuables?
quest_609_quest_complete:
[delight] Great! I can get a good price for these, especially for what's inside Maury's foot! [warm] Thanks much, <name>!

[excited] I hope those three learned their lesson: don't bet something you can't afford to lose.

And maybe it's too late for them, but...[soft voice] they should be careful of who they gamble with.
quest_610_quest_detail:
[angry] My FATHER sent you? [sad] I'd have thought that old codger would have given up on me by now.

It wasn't really his fault I ran off, he just shouldn't have expected I'd be willing to live a boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages!

[soft voice] If you need my dagger, you'll have to get it back from "Pretty Boy" Duncan, one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. [commanding] Put something 'tween his shoulders and I'm sure he'll give it up.
quest_610_quest_progress:
I'd never been beat before, you know, <name>? Sure I'd been cut, can't get in a knife fight without that, but he just smacked me on the side of the head, blacked me out. [sad] When I came to my blade was gone.

[solemn] As much as my nickname might indicate, I still need a knife to fight, and for me, it has to be that one.
quest_610_quest_complete:
[delight] You beat Duncan? I guess you aren't as wet behind the ears as you looked at first glance.

[warm] I suppose that also means I shouldn't challenge you to a fight any time soon!
quest_611_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So you're looking for an altar of some sort? Well, I'm no expert on troll ruins like my father, but I have heard about a sunken troll city out near that island you're looking for. [hesitant] Maybe you should try there.

[warm] You got my knife back for me, so I guess you can borrow it... but I want it back when you're done!
quest_611_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you retrieved the Stone of the Tides for me, <name>? [excited] I've already cleared out a space and purchased a fine stand for it.
quest_611_quest_complete: [excited] Amazing! The Stone of Tides! It shall have a place of prominence in my collection of ancient troll artifacts. [soft voice] Did you see how it almost seems as though a tide is trapped within its surface? [delight] Magnificent!
quest_613_quest_detail:
[angry] Curses! That swab Maury put a lock on his foot, and I can't open it! His loot's inside the foot, and that's what he owes me!

[urgent] We need to find the key to open the lock. Maury was known to gamble with the Mosh'Ogg ogres, at their mound to the northeast. And he told me, when he was still alive, that the last time he went to the mound he was chased off after winning too much. Maybe the Ogres there have his key.

But if they do, you might have to kill a load of them to find the right one...
quest_613_quest_progress: [commanding] Ahoy, <name>! [urgent] Have you yet found Maury's Key?
quest_613_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] Thanks a million, <name>. [warm] You've been a big help to me!

[proud] Here you go - you earned this!
quest_614_quest_detail:
[solemn] I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.

[sad] Until... Those cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. [angry] And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. [mocking tone] He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. [angry] The nerve! [urgent] I hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! [warm] Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
quest_614_quest_progress: [excited] Ahoy, <name>! [warm] Did you find Gorlash? [pause] That chest was my favorite, and it has a hidden compartment that held my greatest treasures!
quest_614_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [delight] Oh happy day, this is! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [low voice] Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.

[threatening] But my revenge isn't complete...
quest_615_quest_detail:
[solemn] After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another. Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains. I found them, but...they beat me. They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.

[angry] This time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.

[commanding] Face Negolash and bring me my cutlass!

[urgent] Speak with Sprogger. [soft voice] He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack. [gentle] He can help you find the giant.
quest_615_quest_complete: [excited] Hello hello, <name>. [warm] Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?
quest_616_quest_detail:
[low voice] Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. [hesitant] I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. [emphasis] Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say.

[urgent] If you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?
quest_616_quest_complete:
[solemn] Interesting. Some time ago, I seem to remember reading a book once that suggested...

Ah, of course, a troll legend it was. If what Krazek reports is true, [excited] perhaps I will soon be able to add the Stone of the Tides to my collection of ancient artifacts and relics.
quest_617_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You looking fer work, <name>? [low voice] I might have some if you're up for a little challenge.

[soft voice] I got a friend named Groy who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. [soft voice] Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff.

[soft voice] Ya bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. [urgent] The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.
quest_617_quest_progress: [low voice] If ya got no business with me, then move along, <name>.
quest_617_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] 10 stalks of akiris reed wasn't too much a challenge after all, huh? [chuckling] No offense to the naga, but hey, everybody's gotta make a living.
quest_618_quest_detail:
[solemn] Negolash is a hungry giant.

When the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. [sad] He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. [excited] They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!

[urgent] If you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
quest_618_quest_complete:
[excited] You got my cutlass from Negolash! [delight] I can't believe my fortune, <name>! [warm] Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!

[proud] Thank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
quest_621_quest_detail:
[solemn] Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwai and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay. [soft voice] He is exiled from his tribe. Why? Well...

[hesitant] Zanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him. [low voice] He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.

[urgent] His mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.

[commanding] Bring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.
quest_621_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the samples of Zanzil's Mixture??
quest_621_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, very good! Here is your pay.

[warm] And here is a little something extra... [whispering] for your discretion.
quest_622_quest_detail:
[excited] While you were gone I fixed the pot you brought me. [soft voice] I even added an extra steam whistle, and look! [excited] There's a new chopper at the bottom that'll cut through leg bones!

[loud voice] Yes yes, Krazek's Crock Pot is a 100% cook pleaser! [warm] I'm sure its owner will be satisfied.
quest_622_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [urgent] Did you make it to Booty Bay? [angry] Did the goblin Krazek fix my pot??
quest_622_quest_complete:
[excited] It's fixed! [delight] This is great, now I can get dinner started! [warm] Thanks so much, <name>.

[hesitant] I hope you were okay in Booty Bay. [soft voice] That place can get pretty rough, and... [pause] I heard rumors that the goblins will sometimes drag drunk sailors to their slave boats and take them to who-knows-where... to do who-knows-what...
quest_623_quest_detail:
<name>, since I have you here, I got a message from Groy while you were gone. [soft voice] He mentioned bein' satisfied with the last shipment that arrived and has a client that wants some more of the stuff right away.

[urgent] I won't be headin' to Theramore for a week, but if you're willin' to make the journey, there's no reason you can't take the stuff for me.

[hesitant] Feeling adventurous? You do know where Dustwallow Marsh is, doncha? I'd be careful though, Theramore can be dangerous if you're the wrong kind of crowd.
quest_623_quest_complete:
[angry] What?! I got a lot better things to do then talk to the likes of you, <class>. Make it worth my while or get outta my face.

Huh? Bloads sent ya, huh? Well, whaddaya got for me?

<Privateer Groy looks over the bundle carefully.>

[soft voice] Not bad, not bad at all. Another bundle will make my client quite happy.

[soft voice] I suppose yer next question's gonna be about money, huh, <class>? [commanding] Of course it is!

Here, take this coin and some advice: get off my docks.
quest_627_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a mountain cave in Drywhisker Gorge, far to the north in the Arathi Highlands. In that cave is rare ore: bloodstone. [soft voice] The bloodstone in this cave is not of the highest grade, but even low-quality bloodstone is valuable... to those with the knowledge to use it.

[urgent] I would like some.

I will fix your crock pot, but while I work on it... bring me samples of bloodstone. [excited] Bring me enough, and I'll even give you a bonus.

[commanding] Oh, and if you don't have the skill to mine it... find someone who does!
quest_627_quest_progress: [gentle] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Did you have luck getting the bloodstone?
quest_627_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, splendid! [excited] That was a big favor you did for me.

[warm] Here is your payment...
quest_628_quest_detail:
[soft voice] With the inside finished, all that's left is to add the outer layer. For this, I use only the best elder croc skins. They are more durable and a better canvas--if you will--for adding the designs and accents that make Drizzlik's Excelsior line.

[hesitant] It's hard to find that perfect skin though, the only one that fits my plan is the skin of an elder saltwater crocolisk. [solemn] The elders only come out to defend the other saltwater crocs, so you might need to kill a few to draw one out.
quest_628_quest_progress:
[low voice] I read somewhere that the saltwater crocilisks are slowly dying out... [sad] bad news for my business, isn't it?

[chuckling] Anyways, I hope you have that elder saltwater crocolisk skin for me!
quest_628_quest_complete:
[excited] Great! Thanks to your help I'll have this order filled and sent off to Director Riddlevox on the next boat to Undermine. Ahead of schedule, even!

For all your hard work, here, I made some extras, so take a pair. It's on Drizzlik.

And remember, there's no boot so fine as one of Drizzlik's Excelsior line!
quest_629_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, a great shudder of the earth sunk an old troll city beneath the waters of the Savage Coast to the northwest. [soft voice] We call that place the Vile Reef, for murlocs now reside in the ruins of the city, attacking any who draw close.

[pause] There is an old tablet among those ruins that tells the ancient tale of Gri'lek, a hero of troll legends. [solemn] The tale is sacred to the Darkspear tribe, and although the tablet is too large to move, [urgent] I want a shard of it to enshrine in our new home in Orgrimmar.
quest_629_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is good. When I return to Orgrimmar I will place this shard in a sacred place. [solemn] It will remind us of the might and honor of Gri'lek.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Your deeds mark a growing friendship with the Darkspear tribe.
quest_630_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I put my faith in you and anyone you can muster to help free me. [soft voice] The great Skymane King Mukla is my captor. [low voice] He commands the beasts of this island, and they keep me here against my will with the aid of this chain. [urgent] If you can slay him and find the key to this shackle, I shall be indebted to you greatly.

[hesitant] I often hear him to the southeast side of the island, but please be careful: [whispering] he is not to be trifled with.
quest_630_quest_progress: [solemn] I thank my ancestors [pause] someone has come to aid me. [soft voice] Do you have the key that will free me?
quest_630_quest_complete: <name>, you have saved me from a great dishonor. [solemn] If it was within my power, I would offer you a place among my tribe. [warm] But for now, all I can only offer you is this token for the courage and nobility you have shown.
quest_631_quest_detail:
A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. [solemn] 'Twas horrible, I tell you!

[sad] Good soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. [urgent] Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.

[hesitant] We're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. [urgent] Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.

[sad] That was days ago. [solemn] We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.

[soft voice] Perhaps you can find him...
quest_631_quest_complete: [soft voice] You search the tiny, dwarven corpse. Engraved into the helmet you can clearly read: Ebenezer Rustlocke.
quest_632_quest_detail: [solemn] It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. [soft voice] You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
quest_633_quest_detail:
[shocked] Heavens no! Poor Rustlocke. 'Tis quite a tragedy indeed.

[solemn] We must not let his death pass in vain. [soft voice] This parchment you discovered indicates that Kam Deepfury, the mastermind behind the original attack, arranged for a cache of explosives to be stashed just across the Thandol Span, in Arathi Highlands.

[urgent] If those explosives make it to the bridge, our major supply line to the north will be severed! [commanding] The cache must be destroyed, <name>! Return to me when your mission is complete.

[warm] You're our only hope.
quest_633_quest_progress: [urgent] The cache of explosives must be destroyed!
quest_633_quest_complete:
[excited] The remaining bridge is saved! [warm] You have done a great service to King Magni and the people of Khaz Modan.

[urgent] Now if we can only hold out long enough for reinforcements to show...
quest_634_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I ask of you one more small favor, <class>. We await the reserves of Ironforge. However, Roggo has knowledge of an Alliance camp to the north in Arathi Highlands at Refuge Pointe.

Travel there and seek out Captain Nials. Ask the good Captain if the Alliance can spare some soldiers to help us reclaim Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.
quest_634_quest_complete:
[solemn] My condolences go out to Longbraid and his brave soldiers. [soft voice] The news of the Thandol Span tragedy and the fall of Dun Modr hangs heavy in my heart.

[sad] But Stromgarde has fallen! [urgent] Hence our presence here at Refuge Pointe. [solemn] We are faced with retaking our own great city.

[commanding] Honor and duty require that we do not leave the Highlands until Stromgarde raises the mighty banner of the King once again. [sad] I will send word to Longbraid that he is on his own...
quest_637_quest_detail:
[solemn] The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.

[soft voice] The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."
quest_637_quest_progress: [solemn] You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, <class>. [soft voice] These times we live in are trying on the soul. [pause] What news do you bring to me now?
quest_637_quest_complete:
[sad] You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? [shocked] Say it isn't so!

[soft voice] Let me read what he wrote....
quest_638_quest_detail:
[solemn] With Thoras Trollbane dead and Stromgarde in ruins, [low voice] Vol'jin has instructed that we make every effort to spirit the legendary sword Trol'kalar from the humans' hands, so that we might use it in our coming battles against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.

[pause] Zengu, one of our seasoned hunters, was dispatched to Hammerfall in northeastern Arathi Highlands to oversee its procurement.
quest_638_quest_complete: [soft voice] How you doing, <class>? [solemn] The task set before us by Vol'jin will be a difficult one, and any assistance you might provide will be appreciated and necessary.
quest_639_quest_detail:
[solemn] In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. [low voice] He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.

[solemn] But now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.

[urgent] The sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.

[urgent] The first was taken by the Syndicate, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.
quest_639_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you located the first sigil yet? [solemn] It is most likely carried on the person of one of the Syndicate agents in Stromgarde.
quest_639_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent, mon. [solemn] That's a good start to collecting the sigils we'll need to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
quest_640_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thoras Trollbane's tomb is protected by three sigils--the first of which you retrieved from the Syndicate. [soft voice] The other two will be harder to get, as they're held by the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia.

[pause] The sigil of Thoradin was divided into eleven pieces by Thoras' son, Galen, and dispersed among the Stromgarde defenders. [urgent] Retrieve the pieces and bring them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman, he will be able to bind them into the complete sigil.
quest_640_quest_progress: [commanding] Throm'ka, <class>. [soft voice] Zengu informed me that you required my assistance?
quest_640_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, you need me to reconstruct this sigil? [solemn] It shouldn't be too difficult... all the pieces seem to be here and the magical structure will be easy to reform.

[pause] You might want to close your eyes.
quest_641_quest_detail: [solemn] The reconstruction worked flawlessly. [soft voice] The sigil can now be used to unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb. [pause] Return it to Zengu, no doubt he has additional tasks for you to complete.
quest_641_quest_progress: [urgent] <name>! Do you have the second sigil?
quest_641_quest_complete: [confident] We're halfway to being able to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb. [solemn] We are not exactly sure where the third sigil is, as its holders seem to move around Arathi quite a bit, but I have faith that you'll be able to find it.
quest_643_quest_detail:
[solemn] Though they can barely be said to control Stromgarde, let alone the whole of Arathi Highlands, the human prince trots the remnants of his cavalry over the countryside. [hesitant] I can't understand why he does it, but who understands the way the humans think, hm?

Whatever his reasoning, more importantly, he has given one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, their cavalry leader. Locate him and bring his sigil back to me.
quest_643_quest_progress: [solemn] Valorcall will not be easy to track down, <name>. Mounted on horseback, he can cover ground quickly. Nonetheless, we must have his sigil.
quest_643_quest_complete: [solemn] Losing their cavalry leader will prove a large blow to the Stromgarde defenders. [soft voice] Better yet, it means that we are only one sigil from being able to have Trol'kalar for ourselves.
quest_644_quest_detail: [solemn] The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. [soft voice] He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. [commanding] Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.
quest_644_quest_progress: [solemn] You've returned, <name>. [low voice] Is the line of Ignaeus Trollbane broken?
quest_644_quest_complete: [solemn] Quite a day this is, <class>. [warm] The blood of Trollbane will no longer haunt my people, and the sigils needed to take Trol'kalar are in our possession. [proud] Soon, very soon, we will strike against the hated trolls of Zul'Gurub.
quest_645_quest_detail:
[soft voice] What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. [solemn] There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb.

[pause] Trollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. [urgent] Retrieve Trol'kalar.
quest_645_quest_progress: [solemn] Etchings in the stone upon the face of the tomb of Trollbane match the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus...
quest_645_quest_complete: [solemn] Matching the lines on the face of Trollbane's tomb with the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus, a flash of light consumes the Sigil, and the legendary sword Trol'kalar is released from the stone hands' grip.
quest_646_quest_detail: [solemn] The light slowly fades, the sword Trol'kalar, held within a stone sheath has been released.
quest_646_quest_complete: [solemn] For generations, the forces of Strom and Arathor ravaged the trolls. [commanding] Now their greatest weapon is in our hands. [solemn] Our inching progress in the steamy forests of Zul'Gurub will be no more.
quest_647_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night! [urgent] Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.

The noggin hurts something fierce. [groan] Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.

[shocked] Oh my, look at the time! [urgent] I promised Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.

[urgent] But there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue! [commanding] Take him this batch, would you please? [urgent] And hurry!
quest_647_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, nothing like Foggy MacKreel's Moonshine to warm you up on a brisk day! [chuckling] And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. [warm] Thank you, friend! [delight] Many thanks indeed!
quest_648_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-17/TN! [warm] I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more developing, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in rebinding costs!

[warm] Please, take your choice of any of these items I have. [warm] Hopefully, you will make good use of one of them. [warm] Thank you again for your generous assistance, my robots and I are in your debt!
quest_649_quest_detail:
[commanding] I've got some salvage work for you, and if you're an aficionado of fine ripple like I am, then you'll love this task. [soft voice] Ripple! It's a drink, you dummy.

[angry] An abandoned Horde outpost has a stash of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from when they were in business. [shouting] You can't get fine ripple like that anymore! [urgent] One of Malton's dummy associates knows the shot, so you'll go out there and bring me a case of packaged ripple, and two for my own collection! [soft voice] Talk to Malton, he'll fill you in on the details.
quest_649_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh yeah, about the ripple dad wants! [warm] He wants to sell the ripple to a tavern here in Orgrimmar, but we'll get more money if it is in its original packaging. [confident] I know someone who can do that, and he's in the Hinterlands where the ripple is. [hesitant] But he's, um, a high elf.

[soft voice] Well, he's a good high elf, as he's not a part of the Alliance. [chuckling] Well, he's not so much a good high elf as he is a drunken high elf. [laughing] He loves, and I mean LOVES the hooch.
quest_650_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The elf you will need to talk to is Gilveradin Sunchaser. [emphasis] He can name any wine, vintage and all, just by smell alone! [gentle] He can package up the ripple we need, so you'll need to talk with him. [pause] We need six bottles for packaging, two for dad, and how ever many he'll want... and believe me, he'll want some. [urgent] When you've packaged the ripple and got dad's two bottles, come back here!

[solemn] Gilveradin's camp is near some high elf lodge in the Hinterlands, and those high elves are not good. [threatening] Trust me.
quest_650_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, so you know Malton? He is an old drinking companion of mine. You see, I have found something that transcends the boundaries of artificial treaties and alliances - [delight] alcohol. Were we all to slake our thirsts on its blissful qualities, we all would be in a much better place spiritually.

Alas, something tells me that your visit here is not to learn of alcohol's redeeming values, now is it.
quest_654_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Activating the power source makes the field testing kit start to glow and vibrate. [solemn] It would seem to be working as planned.

According to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle, you now have two hours to collect the data you need in the Tanaris desert. [urgent] If you do not collect it within two hours, all the data will be lost and you will need to buy another power source from him.

[commanding] Return to him when you have completed the task.
quest_654_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Well, did you get everything you needed? [urgent] If you didn't and the power runs out, everything inside will be ruined and you'll have to start over.

[commanding] Hey, don't look to me for sympathy; [low voice] I'm all about the Gadgetzan Water Company making a profit, and if that means selling you power sources until we can afford to import water in from the icy springs of Dun Morogh, so be it!
quest_654_quest_complete: [urgent] All right then, it will take me just a second to remove the power source. [soft voice] After that, you can do with it whatever you like now without having to worry about losing the data inside.
quest_655_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is still clear to me, like yesterday... [pause] So many years without hope, with wood and steel to bind me to this terrible place. Then finally, finally! [emphasis] There was the Warchief. Doomhammer in his midnight plate, his warhammer held high.

It was... too terrible... That the blow of a coward would strike down our greatest hero. From behind he charged on his horse, and then his lance ran him through... I fell to my knees. [sad] What hope was there? What hope is there...
quest_655_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Gor'mul you speak of. [soft voice] Yes, from what he says, it seems he has never recovered from the death of Doomhammer.

Gor'mul was a captive here when Thrall and Orgrim fought to free the camp, but as the earth shook and our brethren escaped, he was left behind. [sad] He wandered alone and lost for years without direction or hope, until we returned to establish ourselves here in Hammerfall.
quest_656_quest_detail:
[solemn] You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength. [urgent] If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors! [angry] There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??

[mocking tone] Crazy logic, eh?

[solemn] To defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her. [commanding] Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.

[urgent] Do that, and she will again be trapped.
quest_656_quest_progress: [solemn] The Shards of Myzrael are now strangely quiet.
quest_656_quest_complete:
[solemn] As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.

The Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. [threatening] Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
quest_657_quest_detail:
<Quae begins to go through the folder.> [soft voice] This IS interesting. [solemn] Seems Apothecary Jorell has been working on some deadly experiments here at Go'Shek. [hesitant] Not sure what that has to do with Hillsbrad, but Phin wouldn't like it if we let it continue.

[sad] We had a run-in with some orcs while you were gone, and I'm not in good enough shape to help Kinelory. [urgent] If you're up for it, she's going to need some protection when she goes down to the farm to steal whatever research Jorell still hasn't sent to Tarren Mill.
quest_657_quest_complete:
[solemn] If it brings Phin peace, I'll destroy every single one of the Forsaken personally. [soft voice] He's done so much for us since the plague. [sad] We never thought we'd find friends or family again.

[urgent] When you're prepared, come let me know. [confident] We'll get started right away.
quest_658_quest_detail:
So, [hesitant] Phin sent you to check on us? Not surprised--he worries too much.

We've been watching the farm for days, and Kin claims she saw a courier come out of that small house to the south not long ago.

She talks a lot, but I can always trust her senses when we're in dangerous areas.

You wouldn't happen to be a skilled tracker, would you? We think the courier might be carrying notes to Tarren Mill. If we could get our hands on those documents, it might shed some light on what's happening in Hillsbrad.
quest_658_quest_progress:
[soft voice] We appreciate your help in looking for that courier, <name>.

While you were gone, Kin saw an apothecary come out of that same house to the south of here. [hesitant] I'm confident that they're up to no good--I just need proof of it before we go off and do something rash.

[urgent] Have you had any luck yet?
quest_658_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent!

[delight] Let's see what this is about...
quest_659_quest_detail:
Hail, and well met, <name>. [solemn] I lead a group of adventurers investigating odd happenings in this area.

[soft voice] My cousin in Hillsbrad recently put down his dog Stanley because the animal mystically grew to an immense size and savagely attacked anyone who came near him.

[urgent] I believe the undead are involved, and we're looking for signs to prove as much.

[pause] Two of my companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed to the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands, and haven't checked in for days. [hesitant] Find them for me? [hesitant] I grow concerned.
quest_659_quest_complete:
[whispering] Try and stay as quiet as possible, traveler.

[soft voice] Orcs don't take too well to being spied on, and there is more to this farm than meets the eye.
quest_660_quest_detail:
[soft voice] All right, <name>. [soft voice] I'm ready if you are.

[soft voice] Shall we?
quest_660_quest_complete: [warm] You've done a great service for us, <name>. [warm] Thank you. [soft voice] I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. [soft voice] She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
quest_661_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've seen Kinelory look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. [warm] You obviously did a good job protecting her.

[solemn] These items she brought back from the farm should at least let Phin get an idea of what's going on out here in Arathi. [pause] Just to make sure there's no retaliation after your attack, we're going to stay here for a bit longer. [urgent] Would you be willing to head back to Southshore and talk to Phin?
quest_661_quest_complete:
[gentle] So, the two troublemakers are all right after all? [laughing] Haha, I'm glad to hear it. [warm] I thank you for bringing me news of their whereabouts and status--it pleases me greatly that they are still alive; the two of them are irreplaceable as friends and traveling companions.

[solemn] But... it's more important I thank you properly for your help. Here. Take this along with my group's thanks.

[confident] With any luck, we'll figure out what the Forsaken are up to, and put an end to it.
quest_662_quest_detail:
O'Breen led the ships into the cove. We were certain this is where the treasure could be found. The Harbinger docked safely but as the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine approached the tides began to lower. Strangest thing I've ever seen!

[shocked] Those two ships ran aground into something... some sort of temple in the reef. They sank so quickly, was quite a tragedy.

We need to retrieve their Logs as well as their Charts before we leave. We can't leave that information behind for prying eyes!
quest_662_quest_progress:
[urgent] How goes the search and recovery mission, <name>? We really need to get those Logs and Charts back from the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine.

[commanding] If the information from those sources were to fall into enemy hands, Fleet Master Seahorn would force us down the plank.

[hesitant] That is if we ever get out of this mess...
quest_662_quest_complete: [solemn] Knowing this information is secure will bring some ease to the command in Booty Bay. [warm] Well done, <name>.
quest_663_quest_complete:
[urgent] Ahoy, matey.

'Twas a horrible mess. Seahorn will have my ship if he finds out what went down.

One of the Professor's contraptions indicated the lost treasure was near this cove. I brought the Harbinger in to dock and signaled for the Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly to follow suit.

Then the sea rumbled. The tides lowered and the two ships crashed into the reef.

It's not just a reef. Something's down there....

[warm] Help my crew out and you'll be rewarded handsomely.
quest_664_quest_detail:
[angry] Argh, 'tis a horrible life. I should be in a watery grave right now, not sittin' here by the fire, breathin' fresh air.

[sad] The crew tried so hard to save my beautiful Maiden's Folly. Bless the boys, bless their hearts.

[solemn] O'Breen made it to shore safely but we weren't so lucky. The seas just sank on us, I swear.

One second we're afloat and the next water is rushin' in. And those beasts! Killed all the survivors. [angry] Horrible naga scum. [solemn] I went black and ended up here, saved.

[angry] I want those beasts dead.
quest_664_quest_progress:
[angry] Bah, maybe I should go kill those naga scum myself. [low voice] It's obvious you're not goin' to do it.

[mocking tone] Maybe I can find some knitting needles so you can keep yourself busy.
quest_664_quest_complete:
Nice work out there, <name>.

[proud] Those scum deserved what they got. [solemn] While nothin' will ever bring me ship or me crew back, the death of those naga gives me some solace.
quest_665_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that we are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders it is our job to help Mr. O'Breen locate the lost elven treasure.

[soft voice] It is next to impossible to find the gems in the dark sea without aid. [soft voice] The doctor has constructed some goggles that will help. [urgent] He needs the goggles charged with the energy derived from the enchanted stone in the cave just up the hill.

[shocked] But the cave is cursed! [urgent] When we get close, we get ambushed. [commanding] Defend me and I can harness the energy from the stone into the goggles.
quest_665_quest_complete: [excited] The goggles work perfectly now! [warm] Well done, <name>.
quest_666_quest_detail:
[solemn] The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. [soft voice] But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.

[excited] A little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!

[commanding] So borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, <name>, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.

[hesitant] I'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
quest_666_quest_progress:
[soft voice] How did the goggles work? Did everything function properly? Adjustments can be made if necessary.

[commanding] Oh, and I'll need those goggles back when you're done. [solemn] I am sure Captain O'Breen will have many uses for them later on.
quest_666_quest_complete: [delight] Most superb, <name>! [excited] The Captain will be very pleased! [excited] And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!
quest_667_quest_detail:
[urgent] This is bad. [solemn] It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.

[low voice] Naga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. [sad] They will keep attacking until I am dead.

[hesitant] I don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. [solemn] The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.

[urgent] The naga will be coming from the sea. [commanding] I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. [commanding voice] Man the cannon and drive them back.

[urgent] Are you ready, <name>?
quest_667_quest_complete:
[excited] We survived the attack!

[warm] We could not have done it without you, <name>.

We'll be heading out as soon as the tide rises. [commanding] If you weren't such a promising hero I'd offer you a place on my crew. But I can tell you have bigger fish to fry.

[mocking tone] Even if you are a puny <race>....
quest_668_quest_detail:
[urgent] Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. [soft voice] He'll want to see these gems first hand. [excited] After all, that's why we're here!

[low voice] And after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.

[gentle] Here, <name>, take these to O'Breen.
quest_668_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ahoy, <class>. [commanding] What brings you to the bridge?
quest_668_quest_complete: [delight] So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? [warm] I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!
quest_669_quest_detail:
[urgent] Fleet Master Seahorn will want to hear about our find at once.

But as you can see, we're not in much of a position to get out of here. [angry] Not only is the tide too low, but those damned creatures we disrupted are keeping a close eye on our movements.

[soft voice] You can be of great service to the Blackwater Raiders if you can get word to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay that we discovered the treasure and are working on extracting more. [commanding] Take him this sample as proof.
quest_669_quest_progress: [commanding] What brings you to Booty Bay, <class>?
quest_669_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, leave it to good old Shakes O'Breen! [warm] I knew that he was the right Captain for the mission!
quest_670_quest_detail:
[gentle] Say, <name>, you seem to be an adventurous type. [low voice] My fleet is stuck in Booty Bay until we can restock.

[solemn] There are some heavy things brewing here and abroad and I need to get some top secret correspondence to Shakes O'Breen who is tied up off the Arathi coast.

[commanding] Can I trust you to deliver this message safely and in confidence?
quest_670_quest_progress: [soft voice] So was Seahorn impressed? [excited] I bet you his smile reached from Booty Bay to Ratchet.
quest_670_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you for making such a long and perilous journey. [warm] You have the gratitude of the Blackwater Raiders.
quest_671_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have felt a strangeness in the air... a feeling that simmers in my blood. I had my suspicions. I set off to find the source of my unease and discovered to the west, at Northfold Manor, the residual traces of demonic summoning. As I got close, my blood began to boil and the rage within me grew.

On the ground I spied an amulet of bloodstone, used to assist in demonic summoning. The one I found was depleted, however. I'll need another to examine, but I dare not return to the manor. Can you bring me some?
quest_671_quest_progress: [solemn] Once-cursed blood still runs through my veins, <name>. [hesitant] If someone... something is summoning demons, it must be stopped.
quest_671_quest_complete: [solemn] It will take some time for me to ascertain the true intentions of the Syndicate, but their obvious association with dark, demonic magic troubles me. [soft voice] I will tell you when I know more.
quest_672_quest_detail:
[solemn] We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at Orgrimmar in Kalimdor, but nothing would move him.

Tales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... but, perhaps... [emphasis] Perhaps! [urgent] A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!

[excited] A small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.
quest_672_quest_progress: I will create an amulet that will give Gor'mul some of the strength of the raptors. [solemn] Perhaps that will awaken some flame within him...
quest_672_quest_complete: [solemn] Excellent. [solemn] The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.
quest_673_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. [soft voice] From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. [urgent] We must remove the source of his energy.

Find the warlock and kill him. [commanding] Bring me whatever magical object you find on his person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.
quest_673_quest_progress: [low voice] The burning in my blood... it grows by the day. [urgent] The warlock must be stopped.
quest_673_quest_complete: [solemn] My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their curse.
quest_674_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.
quest_674_quest_progress: [angry] What hope is there when the hand of a coward can slay the mightiest of the mightiest? [shouting] What hope, I ask you!
quest_674_quest_complete: [solemn] What is this? Polished bone. [sad] What use have I for polished bone? [angry] Will a trinket restore the Horde to its glory?
quest_675_quest_detail: <Gor'mul tosses the amulet into the ground.> [low voice] Tor'gan sent you, didn't he? [angry] Pah! Why he feels some mercy towards me I would not understand. [sad] Mercy was denied me when I was not allowed to die with my Warchief in battle. [solemn] A cruel blow fate has dealt me...
quest_675_quest_complete: [solemn] It did not work, I see. [pause] Nonetheless, I feel that showing him the power of the shamans will eventually return Gor'mul to his once proud self. [soft voice] The amulet's power was not great enough to show him our newfound power.
quest_676_quest_detail:
[angry] Weaklings... all of them. [angry] You, <class>, what are you looking at? [mocking tone] Think you're something special, huh? [commanding] Why not prove it?

[urgent] The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.
