[commanding] But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. [soft voice] Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. [commanding] When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
quest_676_quest_progress:
I have not the time to sharpen my axe, let alone leave the outpost to slay those beasts that would try and slay my kin.

[angry] You do not seem to have the experience of a grunt let alone a full-fledged <class>, [threatening] what do you want, <name>?
quest_676_quest_complete:
[commanding] So, you think you're strong enough to help Hammerfall? [soft voice] So be it.

[soft voice] Tallow either sent you to that ogre mound in the hopes that you would kill yourself or he thinks you're strong enough to aid us. [urgent] Either way, you're here now and I am in need of more soldiers in our fight against the constant attacks.

[commanding] If you plan on staying in Hammerfall then get some rest, and come speak to me again when you're ready. [solemn] There's no shortage of fighting to be had.
quest_677_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. [commanding] We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here.

The trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.

[urgent] We start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. [shouting] Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.
quest_677_quest_progress: [solemn] If you have not yet completed my task, then perhaps you are a coward in heart as well as a tyro in war.
quest_677_quest_complete: [solemn] The signs of war are upon your garments, and sweat drips from your brow. [warm] Good, very good indeed.
quest_678_quest_detail:
[commanding] Your strength is evident, <name>. [solemn] Now to see how you fare against a real enemy.

[commanding] The Boulderfists have a lair to the southwest of here towards the dwarven bridge, and, if I'm not mistaken, the maulers and magi there shall present to you a greater challenge--they have done so to us thus far.

[urgent] Slay as many as you can and come to me in body when you are successful, or come to me in spirit when you fail. [proud] I shall give praise to your tenacity in battle either way.
quest_678_quest_progress: [hesitant] You hesitate. Why? You have shown great strength thus far, <name>. [commanding] Do not fail me now.
quest_678_quest_complete: [confident] You are as strong as a kodo, and [proud] your lust for battle does your people proud.
quest_679_quest_detail:
[solemn] The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, <name>. [commanding] You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. [low voice] The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.

[urgent] Find and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.
quest_679_quest_progress:
[low voice] I see your courage finally wanes. It seems my instincts were correct about you: your strength is nothing compared to your bravado.

[threatening] Return to me when the beast's head has been severed, or return never again.
quest_679_quest_complete: [solemn] You do your people proud, <name>. [warm] The threat has been greatly lessened, and I am sure we will begin to thrive here in the Highlands.
quest_680_quest_detail:
[solemn] You serve my husband well, <class>, but he does not know why Hammerfall is under attack.

[low voice] Or'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, has an intense hatred for my husband, and wishes nothing more than my husband's death for defeating him years ago.

[urgent] My auguries tell me that Or'Kalar has laid a trap for my husband, so I have hidden signs of the ogre's presence from him.

[soft voice] My husband will rush off foolishly if he learns of the ogre's whereabouts and I would ask for your help in slaying the creature.
quest_680_quest_progress:
Near the Tower of Arathor--that is where you will find Or'Kalar. [solemn] His death will stop the attacks on Hammerfall and protect my husband's life.

[sad] I see in your eyes that you think me weak--even dishonorable--for my silence. [soft voice] Some day you will learn what it is to love as I do. Perhaps then you will understand a different kind of strength and honor.

[commanding] In the meantime, do as I ask, and slay Or'Kalar.
quest_680_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done me a great service, <name>. [warm] Know that my husband's life and the safety of Hammerfall has been protected for another day because of your deeds. [warm] Please take this as a reward for your courage.
quest_681_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing. [sad] The ogres, the Syndicate and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.

[urgent] But our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.

[hesitant] We need help from the town of Southshore, but supplies are difficult to receive while the Syndicate holds territory between us.

[commanding] Go to the Syndicate base in Northfold Manor and slay them. [soft voice] Then, perhaps, pressure on our supply trains will lessen and more will get through.
quest_681_quest_progress: <name>, with each passing hour our hold on Stromgarde grows more tenuous. [urgent] You must make haste or our city will surely fall.
quest_681_quest_complete:
[commanding voice] Very good, <name>. [warm] With the deaths of those Syndicate members we should have an easier time receiving supplies from Southshore.

[solemn] Perhaps our cause yet has hope.
quest_682_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Syndicate in Stromgarde do battle with our contingent of militia there. In order to urge the rabble to fight our more disciplined troops, the Syndicate leaders have placed a bounty on our soldiers, awarding gold for each Stromgarde Badge gathered off killed militiamen.

[urgent] We want those badges retrieved - we cannot allow the cutthroats to take trophies from our brave fallen!

[commanding] Enter the Syndicate-controlled area of Stromgarde and hunt them for our badges.
quest_682_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you retrieved any Stromgarde Badges, <name>? [solemn] The Syndicate must learn they cannot profit from our dead.
quest_682_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] We will inform the families of these fallen soldiers that they were killed in battle.

[pause] It will be grim news to bear, but it is better than the uncertainty of a missing loved one.
quest_683_quest_detail:
<name>, [soft voice] I have but a small request to ask of you.

[pause] Take this note I have prepared to our great monarch of Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard. [solemn] 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the Alliance thus far.

[hesitant] For me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause. Surely you understand.
quest_684_quest_detail: [solemn] A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate. [soft voice] She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.
quest_685_quest_detail: [solemn] The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto. [urgent] Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.
quest_686_quest_complete:
[excited] So King Magni Bronzebeard himself sent ye?

[warm] My, my! [excited] This must be important!
quest_687_quest_detail: [solemn] Theldurin the Lost was once a member of our order, the Twilight's Hammer. [sad] But he lost his mind and scorned our teachings. [urgent] And before he fled from us, he stole the scroll of Myzrael! [low voice] We could not catch him, but rumors say he hides in the Badlands, gibbering and mad.
quest_689_quest_detail:
[solemn] So our good King would like a memorial built in honor of a soldier named Sully Balloo? And you say the poor chap died during the Thandol Span tragedy?

[sad] Bah, will there ever be peace on Azeroth?

Nonetheless, any commission from the King is of utmost importance. To build a truly epic and lasting piece I want to work with one of the finest stones available. [urgent] Travel to Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad and gather for me some Alterac Granite.
quest_689_quest_progress: <name>, <name>, <name>! [urgent] Tell me you have enough Alterac Granite for me to begin my masterpiece in honor of Sully Balloo.
quest_689_quest_complete:
[excited] Perfect! [delight] Better than I could have imagined!

[soft voice] And I have quite an imagination you know...
quest_690_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings, <name>. You have the look of an adventurer about you, and I have a task that needs some tending to.

Archmage Trelane, my original master, fled Stromgarde in the Arathi Highlands not too long ago, and he's asked me to help him in recovering some of the items he left behind.

The city fell under siege, and he attempted to defend the Tower of Arathor, but to no avail. [solemn] I have agents in the Highlands already, but they've requested I send more aid. [hesitant] Are you interested?
quest_690_quest_complete: [angry] So, Malin sent ye? I don't care if Muradin rose up from the dead and whisked ye here on a dragon. I'm busy! [urgent] Talk to Kryten if you need somethin'.
quest_691_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Archmage Malin sent Skuerto and I here to collect reagents for him. [hesitant] I was at a loss as to how I was going to collect the items, but now that you're here, I think my problem's solved.

[urgent] I need the following: Witherbark tusks, Witherbark medicine pouches and a shadow hunter knife.

[commanding] Could you find those for me? [solemn] The Witherbark live to the southeast of Arathi.
quest_691_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Have you had any luck so far, <name>?

<Kryten makes some notes in his journal as he reads.>

[pause] If my research is correct, the tusks should come from any Witherbark troll. [soft voice] The medicine pouches come from the Witherbark witch doctors, and the strongest of the Witherbark shadow hunters should carry the special knife given to them after they've completed their rites of passage. [urgent] There's no way to tell which shadow hunters will have the knife until you do battle.
quest_691_quest_complete:
[excited] Incredible! I can see why Malin asked you to come join us - very well done indeed!

[warm] At this rate, Skuerto and I will be headed back to Stormwind in no time at all.

[soft voice] I believe my dwarven companion is back from scouting Boulderfist Hall; go speak to him when you're ready.

[hesitant] It looked as though he might have had a bit of a scuffle with the ogres. [whispering] Don't mention that to him, though; he's very sensitive about criticisms to his skills at scouting.
quest_692_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Scroll of Myzrael...the Scroll of Myzrael?! [urgent] You don't want that! Its magic can pull Myzrael to the surface world and if you do that, we are in trouble!

[hesitant] Or...maybe it's too late. Maybe she already is free. Maybe she's just gathering strength before unleashing herself upon us. [urgent] If so, then you'll NEED the scroll!

[sad] ...too bad it's destroyed. [angry] Enraged elementals stole it and tore it up and now fight over the fragments.

But if you can gather those fragments, maybe we can fix it...
quest_692_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find those fragments?!?! [commanding] You'll need the Scroll of Myzrael if you want to trap her again, before it's too late!
quest_692_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, you found them! [warm] Good work, <name>! [solemn] These might be the only chance we have against the evil of Myzrael!

[urgent] Just let me find my scrap-ratchet and see if I can re-attach these fragments...
quest_693_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey, <name>. [hesitant] Sorry to be so short with ye earlier... and no, that ain't a pun.

I figured out where Trelane's first item ended up: Kor'gresh has it in Boulderfist Hall. An' by the way he was throwing down blasts of ice at his kin to keep them in line, he must be close to figurin' out how to use all of its powers.

[solemn] Boulderfist Hall's south of here an' then east of Thandol Span. Find the ogre an' get back that wand.

While you're gone, I'll figure out what we're gonna do about Stromgarde.
quest_693_quest_progress: [commanding] Our goal is the wand, <name>. [emphasis] Focus on that for now.
quest_693_quest_complete:
[excited] Brilliant, <name>. One item down an' three more to go, based on my list. The other three items are all in Stromgarde.

[commanding] Take a rest an' get your strength back--the next phase of my plan'll require a little more time an' effort. [warm] Come back to me after you've gotten a warm meal an' some rest.
quest_694_quest_detail:
[soft voice] All rested?

Here's our next step: there're ogres all around the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. [urgent] We're gonna need to activate the tower's defenses if you're gonna stand a chance against 'em an' still make it to the items alive. [pause] To do that, we're gonna need some gems the Boulderfist shaman have taken a liking to. [low voice] They took 'em from the tower, but they're not gonna stay in their possession for long.

[commanding] Get one of them gems an' bring 'em to Kryten--he knows the spell to enchant 'em so they'll work as a key.
quest_694_quest_progress: <name>, [soft voice] hello again. [soft voice] Have you found an azure agate yet?
quest_694_quest_complete:
[delight] You amaze me, <name>. [warm] Well done again.

[soft voice] Give me a moment to cast the proper spell to enchant the gem, an' you'll be ready.
quest_695_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here you are, <name>. The gem only needs to be pressed against one of the pedestals near the base of the tower to activate its defenses. [urgent] Use it when you're ready to enter the tower and find Trelane's remaining items.

[warm] Good luck to you. I'll be awaiting your return here at the camp. [pause] Oh, and speak to Skuerto before you leave. [gentle] He'll give you the rest of the details you'll need.
quest_695_quest_complete:
[commanding] Good, good.

[pause] If there are no other delays, how about we get started?
quest_696_quest_detail:
[commanding] Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate.

[urgent] All three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.

The tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.

Be careful, an' good luck.
quest_696_quest_progress: [soft voice] You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.
quest_696_quest_complete:
[solemn] Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, <name>. [warm] You've done a grand job!

[proud] He'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.
quest_697_quest_detail:
[urgent] Take this letter back to Stormwind and let Malin know that Kryten an' I'll be home soon. [warm] He'll reward you well for helping us here, <name>, of that I've no doubt.

[soft voice] Travel safely.
quest_697_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes? [hesitant] You look vaguely familiar. I do apologize, but have we met? I get so busy I lose track.
quest_697_quest_complete:
<Archmage Malin opens the letter, and his eyes grow wide.> [solemn] By the Light, you've done it. [warm] How wonderful. Trelane will be so pleased. I'm sure Kryten and Skuerto are just as excited as I am to have them on their way back to Stormwind.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Please, take this to help you in your journeys.
quest_698_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm working on getting some supplies together for our outpost near the beach to the east--Tok'kar does what he can, but between shifts of guard duty and cooking for his soldiers there's not much time left in the day.

[pause] They do enjoy cooking up some sawtooth meat when they can, but I haven't had time to get them another shipment. [hesitant] Would you mind helping them out?

The young sawtooths aren't as tasty as the older ones, so stay clear of those; give them a year or two to get to full size.
quest_698_quest_progress: Lok'tar, <class>. [solemn] Traveling through the swamps isn't a risk taken lightly. [soft voice] You're brave to test your mettle here.
quest_698_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah! Wonderful. Fresh meat for the fire tonight. [warm] Thank you, <name>.

You've helped make the coming nights more tolerable. The fire burns bright, and our stomachs will be full.

[gentle] Its a pleasant surprise to have you bring us a shipment; Dar's not the most attractive orc anyone's laid eyes upon, but at least his attitude reeks far less than his smell.
quest_699_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the threat of murlocs along the coast, we're stationed out here to protect--or warn if the force is too large--of any coming threats to Stonard. [low voice] It doesn't give us much time for relaxation, and we could use some more help if you're able.

[commanding] The sawtooth snappers' claws make for fine weapons when properly prepared. [warm] Bring me some of their claws and I'll see you're rewarded with one of our weapons in thanks for the fresh meat and the good company.
quest_699_quest_progress: [soft voice] Good mead, a warm fire, an army of orcs and an arsenal of weapons... that's all we really need out here along the coast. [hesitant] I don't regret my position out here safeguarding Stonard, but it would be nice if we could one day get a burrow, or at least a tower.
quest_699_quest_complete:
[gentle] Glad to see you're alive and well, <name>.

[warm] These claws should make do nicely. [solemn] The more weapons we have at the ready for attacks against us, the better off we'll be.

[confident] I'll get started on your weapon as soon as possible. [soft voice] It will only take a short time. [proud] I've become quite adept and quick at their production.
quest_700_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron. [soft voice] Such a shame the land is in such shambles.

But the Memorial came out quite well! [proud] I should think the King will be most pleased with it.

[commanding] Now if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.
quest_701_quest_detail:
[solemn] With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! [excited] With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!

[urgent] I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
quest_701_quest_progress: [solemn] My preparations are made, [whispering] all I require are the raptor hearts.
quest_701_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, these will work perfectly. [soft voice] I will transfer their power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. [emphasis] This orb will imbue Gor'mul with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor.
quest_702_quest_detail: [solemn] Take this orb and use its energy to give Gor'mul the essence of the raptor. [soft voice] Surely this will invigorate his spirit and give him new purpose in life. [urgent] With him returned to normal, we can explain to him the current state of the Horde, and we will have a great warrior's assistance in our unceasing battles.
quest_702_quest_progress:
[low voice] Returned again have you? [solemn] Indeed there is nothing more I could wish for now than more of Tor'gan's pity.

[angry] What have you for me this time? [mocking tone] Perhaps a piece of brightly colored string? [sad] Or a length of rope to end this misery of mine...
quest_702_quest_complete: [low voice] At least it is something interesting you bring to me this time. [solemn] A strange power it emits...
quest_703_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh yes, my barbecued buzzard wings are a favorite! The sauce is rich and the meat is tangy. And the smell will bring the hungry running from miles away!

I have everything I need to cook up a batch. Everything...except the buzzard wings!

[urgent] If you want some then get me the buzzard wings. Bring me enough, and I might even share the recipe with you!
quest_703_quest_progress: [urgent] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] Did you bring me my wings?
quest_703_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, I'll get started on those wings right away. [excited] I can almost taste them already!

[warm] And here's the recipe in case you want to make them yourself!
quest_704_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead! [sad] He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman. [low voice] I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.

[commanding] I need you to get those urns for our studies. [urgent] Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
quest_704_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find those urns, <name>? [commanding] We must find the link between them and the troggs!
quest_704_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.

[solemn] You have done a great deed for the Prospectors, <name>. [proud] Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
quest_705_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Badlands is a harsh place, filled with vicious predators and bold scavengers. [sad] Scary, especially for a short little goblin. [confident] To survive, I have to be tricky!

[excited] I know the recipe for flash bombs. [urgent] I use those to scare away wildlife. [hesitant] But I'm running low on one of the ingredients: crushed blue pearl powder. [warm] Get me some and I'll make it worth your efforts.

[chuckling] Heh, and I hope you have good boots on. [soft voice] The Blue Pearls I need are found from clams at the Vile Reef.

[excited] Yep, the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn!
quest_705_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get my pearls? [urgent] I'm almost out of flash bombs!
quest_705_quest_complete:
[excited] These will work great! [urgent] I just need to smash them into powder...then mix them with a little of this and a little of that.

[shouting] Watch out, scavengers! [commanding] Prepare to be flashed!
quest_706_quest_detail:
[solemn] As an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, I learned his special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments. [pause] Last I heard of him, he was working at a smithy with a hunting party up in Lordaeron.

[soft voice] I can't tell you too many of the details about the process, but I can tell you it requires blood from a rare, still-beating black drake whelp's heart. [low voice] I don't have much to do waiting for word from Ironforge. [urgent] If you bring me a heart from the whelps in Lethlor Ravine, I'll show you my skill!
quest_706_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah yes, this will do excellently. [warm] This will enable your weapons to strike with searing heat!
quest_707_quest_detail:
<name>. [solemn] I received reports from Prospector Ironband at his excavation site in Loch Modan--he needs some legwork done concerning another of our excavations.

[soft voice] I don't have more details than that, but if you want to stretch your legs then go speak with Ironband.
quest_707_quest_complete: [commanding] So Stormpike sent you, did he? [low voice] Good. [pause] I have a big task for you...
quest_708_quest_detail:
[solemn] The surface of this metallic black box is heavily pitted, as if it had been immersed in acid - it must have been sitting in the giant condor's stomach for a long time.

[soft voice] Turning the box over, a symbol is found stamped on its bottom. [emphasis] Below the symbol are the words:

"Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade"
quest_708_quest_complete:
Och, where'd ye say ye found it?

[solemn] The pilot of this plane has been missing for weeks, always knew but still held hope.

[proud] I will hammer this into our walls along with his name. [warm] Thank ye, <name>.
quest_709_quest_detail:
[shocked] Oh my! Oh my! [solemn] There is a doom approaching. Mark me! A doom!

[urgent] No, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me! [hesitant] But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!

Maybe. [commanding] Go into Uldaman. [angry] No! I said it! You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh. [soft voice] Yes, find it! And don't make me speak that name again!

[whispering] It is deep in that place, in an ancient chest. [solemn] That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.
quest_709_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the tablet? [emphasis] It must hold secrets! [excited] Secrets to save us!
quest_709_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, fortune is with us! [warm] Thank you! [delight] We may yet be saved!
quest_710_quest_detail:
[low voice] Here in the Badlands I've stopped to work on my latest project: my shackles of elemental binding.

[solemn] When complete, they will allow mages to summon even more powerful elementals for use in even greater capacities. [urgent] To start things off, I need small stone shards to test some of my newest offensive spells along with a few gizmos I've pieced together.

[soft voice] The shards are easily collected from the lesser rock elementals to the west of here. [hesitant] Could you bring me some?
quest_710_quest_progress: This area's perfect for-- [pause] Could you hold these in place for a moment? Yes, just like that, along the vector normal. [soft voice] Now, what was I... Right. Perfect for testing my latest project. [solemn] The raw materials, the open space... [delight] what more could an intelligent and enlightened practitioner of the arts ask for?
quest_710_quest_complete: [soft voice] These shall do nicely, <name>. [warm] Thank you. [hesitant] Hmm, a bit more sand than I'd anticipated. Have to adjust the coefficient of friction. [urgent] No, wait; it should still be negligible with the frost oil. <Mumbling to himself, Lotwil puts one fist into the palm of his other hand and stares at them as if fascinated.>
quest_711_quest_detail:
<name>, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.

[solemn] The next parts I need require a little more strength. [commanding] Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. [soft voice] Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. [soft voice] You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.

[pause] Take your time; [soft voice] I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.
quest_711_quest_progress: [gentle] I'm most pleased, <name>. [soft voice] My spells affected the smaller pieces just as I predicted. [solemn] If this experiment is as successful as I foresee, then the elementals I'll be able to control will put anything summoned prior to this to shame.
quest_711_quest_complete: <name>, simply amazing! [excited] I would have thought it'd take half a dozen tauren to bring all these to me.
quest_712_quest_detail:
<name>, there's one more part I need from the elementals here in the Badlands: the bracers of rock binding from the greater rock elementals. [solemn] By my calculations, those bracers should be enough to gauge the strength of my own shackles.

[soft voice] My attempts at scrying the greater rock elementals showed a group of them southwest of here, near some ogres if I recall.

[hesitant] Bring me 5 of their bracers just so I have extras. [sigh] Servo's notorious for misplacing my reagents and research.
quest_712_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The stone slabs you found were ideal, <name>. Lucien will be taking the extra ones back to Kharanos when we're done here. [solemn] After all, they could prove useful again.

[gentle] For instance, they'd be a nice basis for a handy little shelter once I start looking into a multidisciplinary approach to high-yield explosives...
quest_712_quest_complete: <name>, [gentle] have you ever considered becoming a research assistant? [soft voice] No? [hesitant] I'm not sure what I'll do without your abilities here. [warm] Intelligence, curiosity, and strength--all combined into one package.
quest_713_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Let me tell you something about Frost Oil: nothing can keep an engine or gears from overheating quite like it.

Its cooling properties are extraordinary, and its longevity as a lubricant without equal. That's not all: it also aids in retaining enchantments on magical items.

[urgent] I need a vial of it to increase the magical capacity of my shackles and make them powerful enough to stop our summoned friend from killing us all.

[pause] Bro'kin, a goblin friend of mine, can teach you to make it. He's in Alterac.
quest_713_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the oil I need? [soft voice] It would be so helpful if you were able to find some.
quest_713_quest_complete:
[excited] Stupendous! This should be the perfect coolant for my new bracers. If the enchantments don't last a century, then I'll give all my belongings to Servo.

All the mages of the Assembly will be in such awe after I finish this, <name>. [proud] You just wait and see.
quest_714_quest_detail:
<name>, you've done your job well beyond all standards.

<Lotwil's obviously distracted by his work.>

[warm] If we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work.

[chuckling] Whoops! [urgent] Quick, grab the... yes, that. Thanks.

Now I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom.

[soft voice] If you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.
quest_714_quest_progress: [excited] Yes, yes, yes. [urgent] Just a moment.
quest_714_quest_complete:
[laughing] HA!

<Lotwil grabs the gyrochronatom from you.>

Perfect... just about done. No, really. [excited] I AM almost done now. [solemn] This project is my top priority... at the moment. [urgent] Let me pop this into place, and you can see for yourself what you've helped me create. [hesitant] It'll just take me a few more minutes... maybe... possibly longer. [sigh] Well, maybe a lot longer. [pause] We'll see...
quest_715_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm thinking those items you acquired for Lotwil are going to be the least of our worries, <name>. [hesitant] On the other hand, you've proven more than adept at the sciences Lotwil holds sacred, so how about helping me out?

[urgent] I need an invisibility potion and a healing potion; both might come in handy real soon if he pulls this off.

[warm] In return, I'll give you this recipe for a potion I've been developing while learning from Lotwil. [solemn] It's based on some of the research he's been doing here in the Badlands.
quest_715_quest_progress: [urgent] He's getting closer to finishing. [soft voice] How are things going on your end?
quest_715_quest_complete:
[excited] YES!

I mean, thank you, <name>. [warm] These will be helpful while traveling through the Badlands.
quest_716_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I know how cheap Lotwil can be, <name>, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention.

[hesitant] I've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course.

[urgent] I'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.
quest_716_quest_progress:
[urgent] I wouldn't wait too long to get that bracer, <name>.

[hesitant] Who knows what's going to happen next?
quest_716_quest_complete: [gentle] Here you go, <name>. [warm] Try these on.
quest_717_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has become obvious that we cannot ensure that Blacklash and Hematus will remain imprisoned in Lethlor. [soft voice] That black dragons have taken up residence there, and that the ogres managed to steal the Sign indicates that more drastic measures will have to be taken.

[low voice] The drakes' prison is maintained by three runestones that may only be retrieved using the Sign of the Earth. [pause] Those runestones can then be used to break the seal which imprisons them.

[whispering] <name>... assure that their dreams are eternal.
quest_717_quest_progress: [solemn] Strong magics and powers held the drakes' prison for so long, but we cannot allow any possibility that Blacklash and Hematus may be released.
quest_717_quest_complete: [solemn] No longer will the Kirin Tor need to worry over the prisoners of Lethlor. [confident] I will return to report success to my master. [warm] Krasus will no doubt be pleased.
quest_718_quest_detail:
[solemn] In our hurry to leave the Uldaman excavation site, we were forced to abandon many wagons and crates of supplies along the way. The local ogres from Camp Kosh have been on our abandoned equipment like vultures on a rotting corpse. [low voice] Don't smell much better, either. Than the corpses, I mean.

[pause] Anyways, they took the cart that was carrying all our weapons and such... so--well, this is a bit embarrassing--we haven't been able to get any food.

[hesitant] We're in a bit of a pickle here, suppose you could help us out?
quest_718_quest_progress:
[low voice] The desert's a bad place to be hungry, my friend, let me tell you that.

[pause] Hey... [surprised] what's that over there...
quest_718_quest_complete:
[delight] Thanks so much, <name>. [soft voice] While you were gone, I... er... swallowed a mouthful of sand. It...

Well, enough of that, we'll go out and get some food tonight. [excited] Eat like kings!
quest_719_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, <name>. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.

They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. [sad] I barely escaped with me life.

The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.

[hesitant] Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? [angry] One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! [threatening] Could be anyone of them.
quest_719_quest_progress: Not sure what the Shadowforge were lookin' for, but they definitely had a purpose.
quest_719_quest_complete: [excited] Ye're me savior, <class>. [warm] I'm glad someone could teach those Shadowforge a lesson or two. [proud] Thanks for yer help.
quest_721_quest_detail:
<name>, can ye find him? Can you find Hammertoe in Uldaman?

[urgent] If those dirty Shadowforge are holdin' him hostage to figure out what he knows about the titan excavations, then all of Ironforge could be in huge trouble.

[solemn] For a long time now those Dark Irons have been lookin' for magics to make more powerful golems. Hammertoe was doin' the same, of course, but only to stop them.

[soft voice] They're probably keepin' him alive until they learn what he knows. [commanding] Ye've got to hurry if you're gonna save him!
quest_721_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes? Ah'm sorry... <cough> Feel so weak. Can ye come closer, <class>?

[warm] Ryedol sent ye? Muradin be praised, that boy's not as slow in the head as I once thought. <cough>
quest_722_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ye're brave... <cough>... to come into Uldaman fer me, <class>.

If ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... <cough>... you'll need to find... me amulet.

Deepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... <cough>... right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, <name>. [urgent] Please... get that amulet.

The scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. [solemn] I just know it. [solemn] I can feel it in me bones.
quest_722_quest_progress: [solemn] The Shadowforge clan... is dangerous. Be careful. [urgent] You must find the amulet.
quest_722_quest_complete:
[excited] Ha! <cough cough>

Ah knew you'd find me amulet, <name>.

<weeze> [warm] Well done indeed, <name>. <cough>
quest_723_quest_detail: <Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.> [urgent] Find Ryedol, <name>. Bring 'im me amulet. <cough cough> He'll... <cough> figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he... <cough>... knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. [solemn] They must not be allowed to find the scrolls... <cough>
quest_723_quest_progress: [low voice] I'd say it was a bad day, but this is the Badlands: every day's a bad day.
quest_723_quest_complete: [solemn] Hammertoe's amulet? I think my spirits were higher when I thought he was dead. Knowin' fer sure only makes the pain worse. [sad] This amulet was his life's work. I can't let his death be in vain.
quest_724_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Okay, okay... who would know what to do?

[urgent] Historian Karnik! That's it!

He's in Ironforge. [solemn] He'll be able to help. He and Hammertoe were workin' together to find the lost artifacts in Uldaman.

[sad] Guess the Shadowforge found out the two of them knew more than they were lettin' on.

[commanding] Tell Karnik what's happened to Hammertoe and give him the amulet--he'll tell you what needs to be done next.
quest_724_quest_progress:
[solemn] Ah, yes. [low voice] Another traveler seeking something from the dwarves.

Sir, I'm truly sorry, but I've no time to answer meaningless questions right now.
quest_724_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh! Well, this is a different matter entirely. [solemn] You probably don't realize the gravity of this matter yet, do you?

[soft voice] I care deeply about Hammertoe's demise, but if he sent you here with his amulet, then he understood what's at stake.

[pause] We will have to take time to mourn his death later.

[warm] Let me show you one of the reasons this amulet is so valuable.
quest_725_quest_detail:
<name>, [urgent] run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. [commanding] Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. [soft voice] This note will explain more to him.

[pause] In the meantime, [solemn] I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. [soft voice] Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the Badlands. [pause] We can only pray.
quest_725_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, word from Historian Karnik. [warm] Excellent. [solemn] I always have time for his business. <Advisor Belgrum opens the note and begins to read.>
quest_726_quest_detail:
<Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.> [solemn] Och, these are evil tidings.

[urgent] <name>, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. [commanding] He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.
quest_726_quest_complete:
[commanding] You're treating this matter with an urgency I'd expect from the king himself, <name>.

[pause] All right, then. [solemn] I know what'll bring the Shadowforge down.

[emphasis] Their presence in Uldaman can be slowed if we strike them at their base of operations: Angor Fortress.
quest_727_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Tablet tells much. But not enough! [angry] Not nearly enough!

[soft voice] There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. [hesitant] The ... people I fled ... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. [solemn] It holds vast knowledge. [urgent] Knowledge to protect us!

[commanding] Go to Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in a shop in Ironforge, in the Forlorn Cavern. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. [soft voice] Ask him for Yagyin's Digest ... and bring it to me!
quest_727_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello. [commanding] Welcome to my shop, but watch what you touch.

[solemn] Knowledge can be deadly.
quest_727_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh. [warm] Greetings, brother. And praise to the dwellers beneath.
quest_728_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tablet tells much. But not enough! [urgent] Not nearly enough!

[solemn] There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. [hesitant] The... people I fled from... they keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. [solemn] It holds vast knowledge. [urgent] Knowledge to protect us!

[commanding] Go to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. [commanding] Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!
quest_728_quest_progress:
[solemn] Ah, we have an eager <class>, I see. Are you here to learn from my collection? Good!

But be warned: just as knowledge gives power to the strong...it will drive the weak mad.
quest_728_quest_complete:
[whispering] Be discrete with your signs, <class>. There are those who do not believe the righteousness of our pledge.

And there are those who would see us fail if they knew of us.

We must always be careful. And watchful. And patient.
quest_729_quest_detail:
[soft voice] What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in Ironforge everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.

But the prospector is rather... um... oblivious ...to his surroundings.

We had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. [urgent] I ran back to Auberdine for help.

[warm] Please travel south and see if the prospector is ok!
quest_729_quest_complete:
Hollee. is that you? [soft voice] I need some help chiseling this stone. Hand me my stone brush, I think I see something.

[surprised] Hey, you're not Hollee! Don't suppose you've seen my stone brush?

[sigh] Never mind that now! [urgent] I promised the League I'd send the mysterious fossil I found. Where did Hollee go?

[proud] So much work to be done! [hesitant] Now where is that mysterious fossil... and my brush... and Hollee...

[shocked] And who are you... 'tis no matter, so long as you're here to help.

[warm] Let me know when you're ready to start looking.
quest_730_quest_detail:
[solemn] How nice it is to see a <class> interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.

[soft voice] Oftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the Alliance. [pause] But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of Azeroth, from Lordaeron to Kalimdor.

[sad] I am most worried about my crew that I sent to Darkshore. [pause] They haven't sent word in weeks.

[urgent] Travel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.
quest_730_quest_complete: [delight] I'm so glad Chief Archeologist Greywhisker sent for us....
quest_731_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So then, Hollee... oh that's right, you are not Hollee. Where's Hollee?

[pause] Bah, that's beside the point. We must find that stone brush... I mean the mysterious fossil! We must find that fossil. [solemn] The Explorers' League in Darnassus will want some indication as to what I've been doing.

Let me know when you are ready and we will hunt down that brush.... I mean fossil! We shall find something in writing to satisfy the League.

[hesitant] So are you ready yet?
quest_731_quest_complete: [excited] Thank the stars Prospector Remtravel is safe! [warm] I told you he was absent minded. [chuckling] I can't believe he insisted on staying there with all of those horrible creatures lurking about.
quest_732_quest_detail:
I heard from Sigrun that you have been a great help to him. [soft voice] Perhaps I might enlist your help. [solemn] I was sent here by my master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, to put an end to the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.

[commanding] I cannot divulge the exact nature of my assignment here or the tasks that I must undertake, but be assured it is of vital importance.

[urgent] A band of wandering ogres, sometimes seen near Camp Boff, stole an object called the Sign of the Earth; I must have it. [emphasis] Bring it to me, and I will tell you more.
quest_732_quest_progress: [solemn] The nomadic band of ogres travels between their camps across the Badlands; heat rising from the dry earth and the swirling winds will make it difficult to track their progress. [soft voice] I have heard that sometimes they travel through Camp Boff. [hesitant] If you are lost, you might try your search there.
quest_732_quest_complete: [solemn] Good tidings you bring bearing the Sign, <name>. [soft voice] The Sign of the Earth was created by the Dark Iron dwarves of Angor Fortress to bind two of Deathwing's ruthless lieutenants, the twins Blacklash and Hematus.
quest_733_quest_detail:
[low voice] It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the Badlands weren't so far off after all...

[pause] Anyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can.

The main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.
quest_733_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, I've made do with what I could, but... it's not much. [hesitant] Have you found any more supplies?
quest_733_quest_complete:
[solemn] It's a start, <name>, and it'll have to do until we hear word from Ironforge or the Explorers' League.

[soft voice] Now, if only I could find some salt somewhere for my quenching barrel...
quest_734_quest_detail:
[excited] Wonderful, wonderful.

<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>

[urgent] Go speak to Lucien, <name>. [commanding] I need a cog #5. [urgent] Bring it to me, will you?
quest_734_quest_complete: [cold] Cog #5, huh? [hesitant] Yeah, this isn't going to be good.
quest_735_quest_detail:
Yagyin's Digest, eh? [soft voice] Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere? Never mind, it is not my place to ask.

[solemn] I will help you, for I have an extra copy. We must aid each other, yes? That is how we flourish.

[commanding] I require three items of power. Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.

[whispering] I will not speak their names. Ears may be on us. But here, I will write them down.
quest_735_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the relics for which I asked?
quest_735_quest_complete: [solemn] You are resourceful, <class>. [warm] If it truly is your charge to begin a new chapter of our order, then I believe you will run it well.
quest_736_quest_detail:
[solemn] You need Yagyin's Digest? [soft voice] Your plan, then, is to gather another flock? Of course it is...and of course I will help you, brother.

But you must help me too.

I require three items of power. Bring me these and the digest will be yours.

I cannot utter the names of these items, but I will write them down.

Get me the items on this list. [commanding] If you can do that, then you are truly worthy of opening your own chapter of our order.
quest_736_quest_complete: [solemn] I am impressed! [warm] You possess great skill, or great fortune, to have gained these relics. [proud] Either way, you are an asset to us.
quest_737_quest_detail: [solemn] I have the digest for you, <name>. [soft voice] I need not tell you to take great care with it. And to keep it far from unfriendly hands.
quest_738_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prospector Agmond was in charge of our excavation sites in the Badlands, to the southwest. I say "was" because...well, I haven't heard from him in weeks. [hesitant] I need you to find Agmond so I can get his report.

Last I heard Agmond was at the southernmost dig site in the Badlands--a tiny operation past the Angor Fortress. [urgent] I'd start your search for him there.
quest_738_quest_complete: [solemn] This skeleton must be the unfortunate remains of Agmond. [soft voice] His body is broken and battered, and his bones picked clean.
quest_741_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the prospector wants to send the mysterious fossil to the Explorers' League in Darnassus? [hesitant] I don't feel right leaving Darkshore without him.

[warm] Here, <name>, deliver the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.
quest_741_quest_progress: [soft voice] What can I do for you, <race>?
quest_741_quest_complete: [delight] Oh my! [excited] Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
quest_742_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, young adventurers! [excited] The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

[solemn] The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens. [proud] Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde! [warm] Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there. [soft voice] Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
quest_742_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome to the new frontier, <name>. [warm] Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young <class> like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. [gentle] Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

[warm] Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. [soft voice] Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
quest_743_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, <name>. [solemn] I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

[gentle] You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

[pause] If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. [emphasis] They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

[solemn] They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
quest_743_quest_progress: [solemn] The Windfuries are deadly foes. [soft voice] Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
quest_743_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, <name>. [warm] You seem well prepared to travel onward. [gentle] Let the wind always be at your back.
quest_744_quest_detail:
<name>, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

[solemn] I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

[soft voice] You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. [gentle] I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
quest_744_quest_progress: [soft voice] This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
quest_744_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for your help, <name>.

[solemn] My part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
quest_745_quest_detail:
<name>, there are many conflicts that wound this land. [solemn] It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. [soft voice] Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. [pause] It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

[emphasis] Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. [low voice] They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

[commanding] Words are no longer the answer.
quest_745_quest_progress: [solemn] If the Palemanes had respected the land and its inhabitants more, this conflict would have never occurred.
quest_745_quest_complete: <name>, it is good you've taken my task seriously. [solemn] Respect of the land and its creatures is important. [soft voice] Death and life are a circle... a necessity. [pause] One cannot exist without the other. [solemn] Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
quest_746_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

[commanding] Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

[urgent] You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
quest_746_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. Do you have the Broken Tools? [solemn] The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore. [urgent] This defilement must be stopped!
quest_746_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] This will calm the beasts of Mulgore. [pause] And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
quest_747_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. [warm] Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

[solemn] Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. [low voice] Tauren hunt out of necessity and for sport. [solemn] Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. [urgent] Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
quest_747_quest_progress: [solemn] Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
quest_747_quest_complete: [solemn] The tauren of Narache thank you, <name>. [warm] You show much promise.
quest_748_quest_detail:
[angry] Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! [solemn] We cannot allow this.

[solemn] To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

[solemn] First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. [solemn] To do this, the land must offer its aid. [urgent] Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. [solemn] They are to the southwest.

[commanding] Return to me with the paws and talons, <name>.
quest_748_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the paws and talons, <name>?
quest_748_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, <name>. [warm] I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
quest_749_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. [sad] We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

[urgent] We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

[hesitant] Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
quest_749_quest_complete: [solemn] All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. [soft voice] Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
quest_750_quest_detail:
[solemn] A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. [soft voice] The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. [warm] You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. [urgent] You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

[gentle] Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
quest_750_quest_progress: [gentle] If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
quest_750_quest_complete: [solemn] The tauren of Narache thank you for these provisions, <name>. [warm] With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
quest_751_quest_detail: [solemn] Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.
quest_752_quest_detail:
[solemn] All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. [soft voice] We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. [pause] I ask of you now a humble task.

[gentle] My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. [pause] It has been quite some time now. [hesitant] Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
quest_752_quest_complete: [soft voice] You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? [warm] My my, aren't you a keeper?
quest_753_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

[warm] But you look like an eager <class>. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

[gentle] Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
quest_753_quest_progress: [soft voice] You look as though you have returned from the plains. [solemn] Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
quest_753_quest_complete:
[solemn] You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

[warm] Your willingness to help others and provide for the tauren of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
quest_754_quest_detail:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. [solemn] Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. [urgent] You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!

[angry] This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

[confident] Fortune to you, <name>.
quest_754_quest_complete:
[solemn] News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

[warm] You have done a great thing for the land, <name>. [proud] And you have done a great thing for the Tauren people.
quest_755_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, <name>. [warm] I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a <class> of greatness.

[pause] Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

[emphasis] The first test is the Rite of Strength. [urgent] Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

[soft voice] You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
quest_755_quest_complete: [solemn] Chief Hawkwind sent you? [pause] Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
quest_756_quest_detail:
[solemn] To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. [urgent] Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

[commanding] You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
quest_756_quest_progress: <name>, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? [urgent] The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
quest_756_quest_complete:
[gentle] Thank you, <name>. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

[solemn] The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
quest_757_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

[urgent] Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

[commanding] Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
quest_757_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you completed the Rite of Strength, <name>? [commanding] I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
quest_757_quest_complete: [solemn] You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. [warm] The tribe will be proud.
quest_758_quest_detail:
[solemn] The totem is ready, <name>. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

[commanding] Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

[soft voice] May the spirits guide you.
quest_758_quest_progress: [solemn] The Thunderhorn Water Well is still tainted, <name>. [urgent] Please, you must perform the ritual!
quest_758_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

[warm] For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
quest_759_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. [urgent] Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.

[soft voice] Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
quest_759_quest_progress: <name>. [urgent] Do you have the teeth I asked for?
quest_759_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good, <name>. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and [sad] my spirit swells with sadness, and [proud] pride.
quest_760_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young <name>. [solemn] The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

[solemn] The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. [commanding] Perform the ritual! [urgent] Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! [excited] Let clean water flow once again!
quest_760_quest_progress: [solemn] The last water well remains fetid and poisonous, <name>. [urgent] You must not delay!
quest_760_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've done it. [warm] You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. [warm] Bloodhoof village is grateful, <name>.

[solemn] May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
quest_761_quest_detail:
[solemn] The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. [soft voice] A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

[urgent] If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

[warm] Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

[solemn] The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
quest_761_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the swoops, <name>. [soft voice] Do you have their quills?
quest_761_quest_complete: [solemn] I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, <name>. [warm] In doing this, you prove that you are a <class> of merit. [proud] It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
quest_762_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ambassador Infernus was sent to Angor Fortress by Ragnaros himself to mind the Shadowforge seeking lost artifacts in Uldaman.

It has already meant tremendous casualties for our people, but it has obviously grown worse. [hesitant] I hesitate to guess how many artifacts they would be able to find and use against Ironforge.

Our goal is simple, <class>. [urgent] Return to the Badlands and destroy Ambassador Infernus. Once the threat is eliminated, return to Advisor Belgrum with proof of your victory.

[confident] It is in your hands now.
quest_762_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is of the essence, <name>. [commanding] Ragnaros will not wait for us to prepare.
quest_762_quest_complete:
<name>, your dedication to Ironforge and to the dwarven people cannot be refuted. [solemn] I thank you for your help in this matter.

[solemn] I shall send word to Historian Karnik informing him that you have succeeded, and I shall also have aid sent to the Badlands as soon as possible to help recover the excavation site. [warm] Thank you again.

[pause] Before you go, there is one more thing I would ask of you in the name of King Bronzebeard.
quest_763_quest_detail:
[solemn] For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. [soft voice] It is time for you to broaden your experience, <name>.

[solemn] Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. [solemn] There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

[commanding] Take this totem to Baine. [solemn] He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

[urgent] Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. [commanding] Do not stray or you will lose your way.
quest_763_quest_progress: [gentle] What brings you to my village, <class>?
quest_763_quest_complete: [excited] Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! [warm] Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
quest_764_quest_detail:
[solemn] This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. [low voice] Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. [mocking tone] It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

[angry] Greedy little things, they are. [solemn] Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. [commanding] Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
quest_764_quest_progress: [solemn] The Venture Co. was refused mining rights here in Mulgore, but it would seem that they do not take no for an answer. [commanding] We tauren are not ones to mince words, however, and we have other ways of getting our message across.
quest_764_quest_complete: [solemn] I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? [commanding] The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
quest_765_quest_detail:
[solemn] According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.

[angry] The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. [commanding] I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. [urgent] Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
quest_765_quest_progress: [angry] I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
quest_765_quest_complete: [solemn] My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. [soft voice] I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. [warm] Thank you for your efforts, <name>.
quest_766_quest_detail:
[solemn] My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

[urgent] As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

[urgent] Hurry, time is of the essence.
quest_766_quest_progress:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... [sad] I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? [hesitant] I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
quest_766_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, thank you, <name>. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. [solemn] I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

[hesitant] Be wary on your travels.
quest_767_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

[soft voice] Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. [pause] In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
quest_767_quest_complete: [solemn] I sensed you would be coming to me, <class>. [soft voice] I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
quest_768_quest_detail:
Greetings, young one. [soft voice] You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt. [solemn] May you bring honor to your clan!

[warm voice] I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

[gentle] If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
quest_768_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again. [pause] Have you been hunting? [pause] Do you have skins for me?
quest_768_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, these are very nice pieces. [warm] They'll make fine leather goods.

[warm] Here, <name>. [warm] Take this in trade...
quest_769_quest_detail:
[solemn] The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us. [soft voice] If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

[commanding] Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
quest_769_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, good. Thank you, <name>. [warm] My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
quest_770_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.

[soft voice] Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
quest_770_quest_complete:
[excited] I can barely believe my old eyes! [warm] You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? [proud] I look upon you with new respect, young <class>. [proud] You are a <class> of extreme skills!

[gentle] Let me offer you something. [solemn] My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.

[solemn] May it strike true, and bring you renown.

[soft voice] And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
quest_771_quest_detail:
[solemn] In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

[soft voice] I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

[solemn] These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. [pause] Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
quest_771_quest_progress: [solemn] Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, [pause] I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
quest_771_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, <name>. [warm] It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
quest_772_quest_detail:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

[solemn] When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. [soft voice] Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

[pause] At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
quest_772_quest_complete: [solemn] Be not afraid, <name>. [warm] You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
quest_773_quest_detail:
[solemn] To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

[soft voice] Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. [pause] Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

[urgent] Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, <name>.
quest_773_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, <name>.

[solemn] We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. [solemn] I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.

[warm] You have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young <class>. [proud] Enter Thunder Bluff with pride.
quest_775_quest_detail:
[solemn] You will now be revered within our great city. [solemn] Any <race> worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.

[soft voice] For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
quest_777_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Okay, here you go.

[hesitant] I'm going to be over here... behind cover.

[whispering] Feel free to join me.
quest_777_quest_progress: <Without looking up from the shackles, Lotwil holds out a hand and waggles his fingers impatiently.> [urgent] The cog, <name>, the cog!
quest_777_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, perfect. [excited] Stand back while I prepare to make more history! <Lotwil continues to work feverishly.>
quest_778_quest_detail:
[laughing] Haha! Done! The shackles are done!

[excited] It's time, Lucien. It's time, Servo!

Are you ready to bear witness to the perfect blend of alchemy, engineering, and the arcane, <name>?

[solemn] I shall summon forth a powerful elemental now. [solemn] This is a groundbreaking day for all of us.
quest_778_quest_progress: [solemn] Not quite the outcome I was expecting. [hesitant] Could you get my shackles back?
quest_778_quest_complete:
[gentle] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] That was quite an ordeal, wasn't it?

[hesitant] I'm not sure what could have gone wrong. [warm] It was a good thing my magics were here to help send the creature back to its home plane.

[warm] Perhaps a little token of appreciation for all your hard work...
quest_780_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. [soft voice] They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

[commanding] Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
quest_780_quest_progress: [solemn] The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. [commanding] Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
quest_780_quest_complete: [excited] Most excellent. [warm] These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
quest_781_quest_detail:
[solemn] After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.

[urgent] Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
quest_781_quest_progress: [solemn] You have a look of concern about you, <name>. [soft voice] What news do you bring?
quest_781_quest_complete: [urgent] This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. [warm] You have saved the lives of many tauren, <name>.
quest_782_quest_detail:
[solemn] From the Horde's alliance with the dragon Deathwing during the Second War, we know that two of his lieutenants, Blacklash and Hematus, were imprisoned within Lethlor Ravine far to the east. [angry] We must silence our depraved allies of old to restore honor to the Horde!

[urgent] We hired Tho'grun and his band of ogre mercenaries to help us obtain the Sign of the Earth, a key needed to unlock the drakes' prison. Tho'grun betrayed us though, overwhelming us and taking it for himself. [commanding] Go to Camp Boff and take it back!
quest_782_quest_progress:
[solemn] Tho'grun's betrayal... is there any wonder why the ogres are part of the Horde no longer? [angry] I will be glad to see him dead, and the Sign of the Earth returned.

[urgent] If you've not dispatched him yet, then waste no time going to Camp Boff. It is to the southeast of Kargath.
quest_782_quest_complete:
[solemn] With Tho'grun dead, his corpse picked clean by the desert winds and scavenging buzzards, the ogres will be put into disarray. [solemn] Though a small victory, this will lead to a much larger one

[emphasis] The Sign of the Earth is now in our possession, and we can open the black drakes' prison in Lethlor. [urgent] We shall free them from endless imprisonment, albeit to their doom!
quest_783_quest_detail:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young <class>, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

[urgent] And I don't mean farming.

[solemn] The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close. [commanding] And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home. [emphasis] And their alliance.

[soft voice] If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride. [soft voice] He's inside the abbey behind me.
quest_783_quest_complete:
[commanding] Ah, good. Another volunteer. We're getting a lot of you these days.

[urgent] I hope it's enough.
