The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad. [solemn] This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

[solemn voice] It is a many-fronted battle we wage, <name>. [emphasis] Gird yourself for a long campaign.
quest_784_quest_detail:
[solemn] Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. [urgent] But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. [angry] These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

[commanding] Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
quest_784_quest_progress:
[commanding] You have your orders, <name>. [solemn] The safety of Durotar is in question. [urgent] Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.

[threatening] Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.
quest_784_quest_complete: [excited] Word of your bravery travels fast, <class>. [warm] Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
quest_786_quest_detail:
[whispering] Lower your voice, <class>. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

[urgent] We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
quest_786_quest_progress: [solemn] The centaurs have proven to be a consistent nuisance to the Horde. [urgent] Their intentions to lay siege to our homeland cannot be tolerated.
quest_786_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack.

But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

[warm] You have served your people well, <class>.
quest_788_quest_detail:
[commanding] The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. [low voice] I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

[soft voice] I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
quest_788_quest_progress: [angry] I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, <name>? [low voice] No, of course not. [threatening] I would think better of you.
quest_788_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmmm, not bad, <name>. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

[solemn] Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
quest_789_quest_detail:
[solemn] Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. [commanding] Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.

The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...

[threatening] But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
quest_789_quest_progress: [solemn] The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined <class> will be deterred. [commanding] Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
quest_789_quest_complete:
[solemn] There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. [emphasis] The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. [emphasis] In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

[pause] I have no more to teach you, <name>. [warm] You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
quest_790_quest_detail:
<class>! [sad] I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. [soft voice] While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. [urgent] Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.

[sad] I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood.

Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! [angry] My honor must be upheld! [urgent] I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
quest_790_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.

[sad] At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
quest_790_quest_complete: [solemn] My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. [sad] That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
quest_791_quest_detail:
[solemn] Age has rendered me useless in battle. Now I make myself useful in other ways.

From this vantage point I watch for invaders. As our strength here grows, I find myself blowing the signal horn less and less.

To pass the time I fashion goods to help younger, more able warriors defend our homeland.

[warm] For you, I can fashion you a bag for your belongings. If such an item would be of use to you, bring me some canvas, a material common to the humans and centaurs.
quest_791_quest_progress:
[solemn] I fought proudly alongside the Warchief when these lands were pioneered. The scars of battle mark my skin.

[proud] The honor of the Horde has been upheld with the help of my axe and battlecry during the defeat of Archimonde, when the unholy alliance was made with the humans and elves, wrought from necessity.

[low voice] But my position as watchman and provider has given me a new sense of worth.
quest_791_quest_complete:
[delight] Most excellent, <name>. [warm] Any good <class> will surely find a use for this bag on the battlefield.

[proud] I salute your vigor and willingness to die in the name of the Horde!
quest_792_quest_detail:
[solemn] I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young <class>.

[soft voice] I was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...

[pause] A group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials. [commanding] They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.

[urgent] As your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. [emphasis] Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
quest_792_quest_progress: [solemn] To prove yourself against the Burning Blade, you must first defeat its Vile Familiars. [urgent] Return to me when you have done this.
quest_792_quest_complete:
[warm] You have done well, <name>.

[solemn] Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, [emphasis] your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
quest_793_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Seal of the Earth is held by three runestones, held in the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst in Lethlor Ravine. [soft voice] Using the Sign of the Earth, you will be able to remove the runestones and unlock the Seal of the Earth.

[urgent] Be wary though, <name>, the black drakes Blacklash and Hematus are not to be trifled with. [commanding] See them dead and return their bindings to me.

[pause] To reach the ravine, travel to the far eastern part of the Badlands. Be careful though, for the ravine is home to countless drakes.
quest_793_quest_progress: [solemn] There are few enemies more deadly than dragonkind, and there were few dragons that fought as ferociously as Blacklash and Hematus.
quest_793_quest_complete: [solemn] The black dragonflight continues to ally with the renegade Blackrock orcs, and both must be brought into line, or removed. [commanding] With Blacklash and Hematus dead, we can turn our attentions westwards, towards Blackrock Spire.
quest_794_quest_detail:
[solemn] Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.

[soft voice] It is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.

[urgent] But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.

[commanding] Go, <name>. [solemn] You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
quest_794_quest_progress: [solemn] Is your task complete, <name>? [soft voice] Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?
quest_794_quest_complete:
[excited] You retrieved it! [warm] Well done! [proud] Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials. [solemn] But I fear they have further aims in our land.

[solemn] We have not seen the end of them.
quest_804_quest_detail:
[solemn] Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. [commanding] I cannot fall so easily! [urgent] I must endure!

But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. [soft voice] Please, <name>, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. [hesitant] Perhaps he can help me.
quest_804_quest_complete:
[solemn] From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! [soft voice] It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. [urgent] Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

[warm] However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. [proud] It is a feat to be proud of, <name>. [solemn] And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
quest_805_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley. [soft voice] But I want you to report your findings.

[urgent] Go to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin. Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.

[commanding] Tell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials. [hesitant] Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.

[urgent] Go, <name>, and be swift. [low voice] I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
quest_805_quest_complete:
Hm... your report comes at a bad time. [solemn] The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.

[soft voice] The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls. [solemn] Honorable friends. [hesitant] We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.
quest_806_quest_detail:
[commanding] We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar! [urgent] We must destroy them before their evil festers!

[solemn] I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest. [low voice] There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

[commanding] Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
quest_806_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find Fizzle, <name>? [angry] He, and rest of the Burning Blade, must be scoured from our lands!
quest_806_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! You got him!

[proud] You do your clan proud, <name>. [warm] And because of you, Durotar is free of one more agent of evil.
quest_808_quest_detail:
[solemn] I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

[sad] He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

[pause] But death is not freedom for my brother. [soft voice] Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. [solemn] In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. [urgent] As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

[hesitant] Please, <name>. [commanding] Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

[urgent] Free him!
quest_808_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my brother's skull, <name>? [solemn] Is he finally free?
quest_808_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you, <name>. [warm] You have saved Minshina. [proud] You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
quest_809_quest_detail:
[solemn] Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society. [angry] The collar you brought me confirms my fears.

It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power. [urgent] It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak. [commanding] It must be destroyed!

[urgent] Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth. [solemn] He will direct you further.
quest_809_quest_complete: [low voice] Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, does he? [sad] Strange... Very well. [solemn] If he wishes the seed gone, then I will tell you how to remove it.
quest_812_quest_detail:
<name>... [soft voice] your timing is perfect. I just hope I can compliment your haste as well.

I was careless while fighting a few of the venomtails nearby, and one of them stung me deeply. I can feel its poison weakening me even as we speak. At this rate, I got maybe an hour left to live. But I'll need your help if I'm to do so...

[urgent] Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar knows how to make the antidote. Find him... and hurry, <name>. I won't be able to last much longer. He should be in the Cleft of Shadow.
quest_812_quest_progress: [solemn] I'm almost glad I can't return to Sen'jin as I am now. [sad] My weakness and stupidity would surely be mocked.
quest_812_quest_complete: <name>, you've saved my life. [warm] Thank you. [soft voice] Please take this; I hope it can at least help you in your travels, if not bring you some coin. [sad] From what you say, I won't be usin' it anytime soon. [low voice] Kor'ghan is gonna march me through more of his rituals until I prove myself. [sad] More killin' boars, more gatherin' scorpid tails... <sigh>
quest_813_quest_detail:
Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. [solemn] It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.

[urgent] Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.

[commanding] Make haste, <name>. [solemn] One of our own needs your help.
quest_813_quest_progress: [solemn] Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. [soft voice] That knowledge could save your life.
quest_813_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here is the antidote, <name>. [urgent] Take it to Rhinag as soon as you can, and be cautious.
quest_814_quest_detail:
[angry] Cook and clean--that's all I do!

[shouting] You want to eat, you get me some more meat! [angry] I don't have all day to hunt and prepare food for all these louses. [commanding] You got to learn to pull your own weight around here if you wanna be treated equal.

[urgent] Get me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful... [threatening] or you don't want to starve to death.
quest_814_quest_progress: [urgent] You want to eat, you get me some more meat!
quest_814_quest_complete: [commanding] Get me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful...
quest_815_quest_detail:
Bah! [urgent] I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

<name>, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
quest_815_quest_progress: [excited] Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? [commanding] It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
quest_815_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, <name>.

[warm] Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
quest_816_quest_detail:
<name>, please, can you help me? [sad] My son Kron went hunting days ago, and he still hasn't returned. He went west towards the Barrens to hunt crocolisks along Southfury River. [hesitant] I fear the worst.

As strong as he was, his stubborn pride has always drawn him into trouble. [soft voice] I warned him that the crocolisks were powerful and vicious. [angry] He grew angry and stormed off.

[urgent] If you can't find him, at least bring me a sign of his fate... even if you have to open up the stomach of every crocolisk along the Southfury's banks.
quest_816_quest_progress: [solemn] I pray that Kron will return to me, but I'm almost certain I know his fate already.
quest_816_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, my son... my beautiful son.

[sad] Uncertain of my son's fate, I have tormented myself since he left. [solemn] Now that I know what's happened, perhaps I can finally begin to mourn.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [gentle] Please take this. [sad] I was going to give it to Kron as a gift when he returned successful. [sad] Now that I know he is dead, I cannot bear to look at it.
quest_817_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, <name>. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

[solemn] The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. [urgent] I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
quest_817_quest_progress: [solemn] I remember my first tiger hunt, <name>. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... [pause] watching... waiting. My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.
quest_817_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am pleased, <name>. [warm] Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.

[warm] Thank you.
quest_818_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. [soft voice] More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. [sad] But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.

[commanding] Are you worthy? [hesitant] Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

[urgent] I need a few things. [commanding] Will you get them for me?

[commanding] I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. [urgent] You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. [solemn] We shall speak again soon.
quest_818_quest_progress: [solemn] Time is the true test of your strength and will. [pause] Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
quest_818_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well done, young one... [warm] well done indeed.
quest_819_quest_detail:
[solemn] A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout- May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
quest_819_quest_complete:
[delight] Well, I'll be...

[solemn] This was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. [soft voice] He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. [pause] I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. [warm] I appreciate you bringing this to me, <name>.
quest_820_quest_detail:
[solemn] Truly a spirit of strength resides in your body, willing to help an old man brew his potions.

The generosity found in our new home and the strength of relying on our allies is what sets us apart from others, <class>.

[soft voice] I need one more thing to begin brewing a batch of my potion, eight shimmerweed.

You can find the herbs northwest of Razor Hill in Thunder Ridge, and be careful, <name>.
quest_820_quest_complete: [warm] You've done me a great kindness this day, <name>. [soft voice] With my vision restored, I will be able to help out more around the village. [solemn] More than strength, you've a spirit of honor.
quest_821_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Would you like a taste of Chen's namesake? [soft voice] Ahh, the stormstout is a mighty brew. [solemn] Chen taught the recipe to my mentor, and my mentor passed it on to me. [commanding] I'll need you to get me a few things, but I can tell you this: the kick is worth it.

[urgent] Bring me 5 savannah lion tusks from any savannah lion, 5 plainstrider kidneys from any plainstrider, and 1 thunder lizard horn from any species of thunder lizard. [confident] That should do the trick nicely.

[warm] You can find these ingredients throughout the Barrens.
quest_822_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?

[excited] I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.

[commanding] Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.

[pause] Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.
quest_822_quest_progress: [soft voice] You working hard at finding those ingredients, <name>?
quest_822_quest_complete: [laughing] Haha! I knew you couldn't resist some of this brew. [warm] Come back again anytime you want some more, <name>. [commanding] Just bring me more of the ingredients I had you collect.
quest_823_quest_detail:
[solemn] We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. [soft voice] But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

[urgent] There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade! [commanding] Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. [emphasis] He will want to know these things.

[low voice] Razor Hill lies to the north.
quest_823_quest_complete: [urgent] Yes? [urgent] You have something to report? [commanding] Well then, let's have it!
quest_824_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Earthen Ring is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. [soft voice] They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.

[warm] Lucky for you, I know someone in the Earthen Ring here in Ashenvale. [urgent] Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. [confident] If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.
quest_824_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ah, hello there. [soft voice] I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.

[soft voice] Is there something I can help you with?
quest_824_quest_complete:
[solemn] This globe... it is most disturbing. [solemn] Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices. [solemn] To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.

[solemn] I will see that this globe is studied properly by the Earthen Ring. [solemn] Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements. [warm] Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the Earthen Ring.
quest_825_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

[soft voice] It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

[commanding] Swim through the wreckage, <name>, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.
quest_825_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once we learn how the humans operate their strange machinery, we will stand a greater chance of defeating them in future battles.

[commanding] With our new gained knowledge, the Horde only stands to grow in strength.
quest_825_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your recovery mission was a success, <class>. [warm] I will see to it that these tools get to Orgrimmar with the next caravan.

[proud] Nicely done.
quest_826_quest_detail:
[solemn] The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east. [soft voice] They are the isles we once called home.

[low voice] From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

[urgent] He must be stopped.

[commanding] Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us. [solemn] Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
quest_826_quest_complete:
[solemn] With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. The Darkspear tribe owes you much. [gentle] If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me. [soft voice] His voodoo is strong...
quest_827_quest_detail:
<name>. [solemn] The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock. [soft voice] Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.

[low voice] By wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power. [pause] But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.

[urgent] Go to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there. [commanding] Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.
quest_827_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you yet entered Skull Rock, <name>? [urgent] Do you have the Searing Collars?
quest_827_quest_complete: [solemn] Good. Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade. [commanding] And I will uncover that secret...
quest_828_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption. He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.

[pause] Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz. He is wise and his council is valued.

He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.

[commanding] Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, <name>, I still want you to crush those cultists!
quest_828_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome, <name>. [solemn] Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in Durotar.

[solemn] You are a <class> of growing skill and renown.

[solemn] Stay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.
quest_829_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements. Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman. [pause] We will need a warlock to study them.

Take a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade. Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign. Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.

[urgent] You may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.
quest_829_quest_progress: [soft voice] My most humble greetings, <class>. [warm] How might I help my <race> brother today?
quest_829_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, and where did you get this? [commanding] Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?

[pause] Well, let me take a closer look...
quest_830_quest_detail:
[solemn] You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. [soft voice] You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.

[emphasis] This looks important. [hesitant] Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
quest_830_quest_progress: [soft voice] There is a look of concern on your face, <class>. [hesitant] What have you there?
quest_830_quest_complete: [solemn] This does not bode well at all. [soft voice] You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
quest_831_quest_detail:
[angry] Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.

Admiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.

His reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.

[urgent] We need to get these orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.
quest_831_quest_progress: [angry] Can you not see that I am busy? [urgent] This had better be pressing....
quest_831_quest_complete:
[solemn] Countless times I urged the Warchief not to trust the humans, but personal pride is not what is at stake here.

[warm] You have served the Horde honorably, young <class>.

[urgent] Now excuse me, I must counsel Thrall on these matters at once....
quest_832_quest_detail:
<Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.> Gazz'uz?

Gazz'uz... report! There is word of your discovery in Skull Rock. [urgent] You must prepare for an attack!

Gazz'uz, I order you to speak!

[threatening] Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.

[cold] Do not test your skills against Neeru...

...Gazz'uz, are you there...?
quest_832_quest_progress: [commanding] You have something vital to report. [low voice] I can sense it behind your eyes.
quest_832_quest_complete:
<Examines the Eye of Burning Shadow> [solemn] Intriguing. The voice you heard mentioned my name? I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out. Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.

I must study this pendant. I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.

[warm] Thank you for bringing this to my attention, <name>. [proud] You have done your people a great service.
quest_833_quest_detail:
[solemn] Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. [soft voice] It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend Thunder Bluff and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.

[pause] But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. [sad] A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.

[commanding] They must be driven off with force, <name>.
quest_833_quest_progress: [solemn] The Bristleback Interlopers must be driven away from our sacred burial ground, <name>.
quest_833_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. You have sent those foul Bristlebacks a clear message. [warm] They will think twice before attempting to meddle in this holy spot again.
quest_834_quest_detail:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. [urgent] Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. [angry] Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

[urgent] I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
quest_834_quest_progress: [confident] I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! [angry] What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
quest_834_quest_complete: [excited] Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. [warm] I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.
quest_835_quest_detail:
Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."

[low voice] I can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. [urgent] If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.

Of course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." [soft voice] So, going to help me out, <name>?
quest_835_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You wouldn't think it from a guy like my boss Gazlowe, but he always seemed to know the score. "Don't be afraid to take that big step," he said.

[urgent] Harpies won't stop bothering us and the caravans won't stop being attacked unless we do something about it, eh?
quest_835_quest_complete:
I think I can breathe easy now, knowing that the harpies won't be bothering our supply caravans anymore. And not one moment too soon, either. I hear I'm being sent some fun little toys with the next shipment!

[excited] You're pretty good at what you do, <name>, you ought to track down my boss in Ratchet. I'll bet he could find some work for you.

[warm] Oh, and don't worry, I wouldn't forget to pay you for the service you provided me.
quest_836_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-09/HL! [warm] I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! [soft voice] My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!

[warm] Please, take your choice of any of these items I have. [proud] Thank you again for your generous assistance <name>, my robots and I are in your debt!
quest_837_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. [commanding] Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

[urgent] It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. [emphasis] Their camps can be found to the west of here. [emphasis] Look for the brambles and you will find them. [proud] Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.
quest_837_quest_progress: [soft voice] Though they do possess some intelligence and some organization, I find it constantly amazing that the quilboars were able to capture and hold so much territory in Kalimdor. [solemn] Perhaps they are more crafty an enemy than I give them credit for...
quest_837_quest_complete: [solemn] I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. [proud] The removal of the Razormane from Durotar brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
quest_838_quest_detail:
[solemn] On the island of Caer Darrow lies Scholomance - a school that serves as a stronghold for the Scourge. [low voice] Our enemy dwells within, safely allowed to pursue research that strengthens their power. [pause] A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.

Apothecary Dithers is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. [urgent] You have proved your value to me as someone who can get things done; I now entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
quest_838_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, <class>, the High Executor mentioned you might be the one to trust in the matter of they key. [soft voice] I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the Scholomance, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire one that will let you past the front door at will.

[low voice] This task will not be easy, but such tasks seldom are. [solemn] You most assuredly look like the type to know this as fact.
quest_840_quest_detail:
[commanding] Hmm, you look pretty strong.

[urgent] Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. [solemn] I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. [warm] Well, this is your chance.

[urgent] Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
quest_840_quest_progress: [angry] What do you want, pup? [threatening] If you're not here for recruitment, I don't have time for you.
quest_840_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, so Takrin sent you? [solemn] He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.

[warm] I'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.
quest_841_quest_detail:
[commanding] Let me guess - you didn't get whatever world-ending, nefarious deed you were doing done in time. No wait, better still... you dropped it in the sand! Well, whatever the reason, I do have additional power sources I will sell to you. [urgent] This time, however, it will cost you ten, YES TEN Wastewander Water Pouches!

[laughing] Times are tough all around, <name>, and power sources don't grow on trees! [mocking tone] Hrm, but what if they did. Maybe we could MAKE a power source tree...
quest_841_quest_progress: [urgent] Well, have you got the ten water pouches?
quest_841_quest_complete: [commanding] Very well, here is another power source. [urgent] I highly recommend you using it properly this time, unless you are eager to spend ten more water pouches for another water source.
quest_842_quest_detail:
[commanding] Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

[low voice] Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. [threatening] She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. [hesitant] Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.

[mocking tone] You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
quest_842_quest_progress: [laughing] Well well well, what do we have here? [mocking tone] Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?
quest_842_quest_complete:
[commanding] Alright, <name>. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? [urgent] Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

[threatening] I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. [cold] Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. [threatening voice] Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.
quest_843_quest_detail:
[solemn] In solitude I wander these roads.

[angry] The dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. [angry] Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. [sad] Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.

[hesitant] Attempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. [commanding] Now is the time for decisive action.

[urgent] Drive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
quest_843_quest_progress: [solemn] Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. [angry] My land must be reclaimed!
quest_843_quest_complete:
[solemn] Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands.

May his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life.

[pause] Now let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
quest_844_quest_detail:
[commanding] Your first prey will be easy.

[solemn] The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

[urgent] Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
quest_844_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
quest_844_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good, <name>. [warm] With the plainstriders gone we'll have an easier time keeping our supply chains intact. [soft voice] And I hope you learned a few tricks out there in the Barrens, for your next prey has a little more fire in its blood than the plainstriders...
quest_845_quest_detail:
[solemn] The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders. [soft voice] Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.

[urgent] Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves. [warm] Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
quest_845_quest_progress: [solemn] How many zhevra have you slain?
quest_845_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Not bad, <name>. [low voice] Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. [emphasis] A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!

[warm] It looks like you have some strength in you too. [urgent] Are you ready for a real challenge?
quest_846_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. [pause] We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.

[angry] I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. [soft voice] According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. [urgent] The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.

Collect these items and bring them to me. [commanding] I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
quest_846_quest_progress:
[solemn] I see you are back, <name>.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

[solemn] The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. [commanding] Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

[urgent] If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
quest_846_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I see you are quite industrious, <class>.

[warm] No doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
quest_847_quest_detail: [hesitant] This... this power.... Is this the power of the shamans that Tor'gan tried to show me? [soft voice] I must say, it is interesting. [emphasis] Tell Tor'gan that he has convinced me... for the time being. [solemn] I will listen to what he has to say.
quest_847_quest_complete: [solemn] When the enchantment wears off, I will speak with Gor'mul. [warm] My thanks to you for your help in returning Gor'mul to the land of the living. [proud] I have no doubt he thanks you greatly as well.
quest_848_quest_detail:
[solemn] The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. [soft voice] Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

[soft voice] Invigorating, and altering.

[solemn] There is a mushroom that grows near these oases. [soft voice] Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

[commanding] Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
quest_848_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the spores, <name>? [soft voice] There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
quest_848_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. [cold] Here is your reward, <name>.
quest_850_quest_detail:
[solemn] The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years. [soft voice] And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat. [low voice] Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. [commanding] Rallying them. [solemn] To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.

[urgent] Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane. [soft voice] He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.

[commanding] Defeat him, then return to me.
quest_850_quest_progress: [commanding] Hello, <name>. [urgent] Do you have Barak's Head for me?
quest_850_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.

Barak was such a centaur. [solemn] It is good that he is dead.
quest_851_quest_detail:
[solemn] The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find. [soft voice] But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. [urgent] It may be possible to draw him to you.

Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent. [commanding] It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm. [emphasis] And Verog will come.

[solemn] Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
quest_851_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- [urgent] our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.

[warm] You should be proud of your deed, <name>. [solemn] There is much bravery in you.
quest_852_quest_detail:
[solemn] Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.

[commanding] So kill him. As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.

He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
quest_852_quest_complete: [solemn] I commend you, <name>. [low voice] These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. [proud] In defeating them, your valor is proven.
quest_853_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion. [urgent] I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah. [soft voice] If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.

[solemn] She is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff. [whispering] The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.

[urgent] Do hurry. [solemn] This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
quest_853_quest_progress: [urgent] You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
quest_853_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering. He garnered your aid in delivering them? Good.

And the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery. [warm] Well done, <class>.
quest_854_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have foreseen your arrival, young <class>. [soft voice] Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.

[gentle] I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. [warm] I can sense that you are destined for great things.

[solemn] It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. [commanding] Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. [warm] Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
quest_854_quest_complete: [solemn] It is good to see that more of our <race> allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. [warm] Again, I welcome you.
quest_855_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; [urgent] we must reduce the numbers of their troops. And so, I have a bounty task for you.

While in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers. [commanding] Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.
quest_855_quest_complete:
[commanding voice] Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, <name>. [soft voice] If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.

[threatening] But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.

[pause] Unfortunate...for them.
quest_857_quest_detail:
[commanding] The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! [angry] Back I say!

Those dirty excavators uncovered it... [solemn] so beautiful it was. [solemn] Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.

[angry] It should have been mine! Mine I say!

General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. [threatening] He locked it away in the Keep. [mocking tone] Called it cursed, he did! [angry] The fool! [urgent] Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! [angry] That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.

[commanding] Now I want it back. [angry] Back I say!
quest_857_quest_progress: [urgent] Where is the Tear of the Moons? [shouting] I need it now! [angry] Need I say!
quest_857_quest_complete: [excited] At last, the power is mine again! [shouting] Mine I say!
quest_858_quest_detail:
I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? [hesitant] I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! [urgent] Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.

We need to get out of here on the double! [urgent] Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.

[urgent] Help me out here!
quest_858_quest_progress: [urgent] Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
quest_858_quest_complete:
[excited] Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

Hmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! [delight] I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. [urgent] I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
quest_860_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens. [soft voice] Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce. [solemn] You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.

[urgent] Speak with Sergra Darkthorn. [soft voice] She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

[solemn] Sergra is at the Crossroads. [commanding] To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks. [soft voice] And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
quest_860_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You want to hunt in the Barrens?

Your eyes are eager, and young. They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.

[solemn] But worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind. And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.

[commanding] Prepare yourself. [emphasis] Your journey begins. [pause] Now.
quest_861_quest_detail:
[gentle] You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.

[solemn] If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path. He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

[commanding] And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young <class> on the hunter's path.
quest_861_quest_progress: [solemn] Greetings. [soft voice] There is an air about you that tells me much. [pause] Do we have business, you and I?
quest_861_quest_complete:
[solemn] Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. [soft voice] He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. [warm] We are honored to have him with us.

[gentle] If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.

[proud] Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
quest_862_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A <class> like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

[warm] Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. [commanding] Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! [laughing] Haw!
quest_862_quest_complete:
[low voice] Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. [pause] Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. [soft voice] But you look so hungry.

[warm voice] Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. [soft voice] Ah, there we go.

[warm] Here you go!
quest_863_quest_detail: [hesitant] I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... [excited] Well, are you ready to go?
quest_863_quest_complete:
[urgent] Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... [exhale] my time's running out! [urgent] I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.

[warm] Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
quest_864_quest_detail:
[soft voice] "Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved. [pause] Well, safe journeys and all that. [hesitant] Hope the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."

The goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company. You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the Undercity. Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
quest_864_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome back. At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit. Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.
quest_864_quest_complete:
[solemn] I will analyze this data immediately. [soft voice] Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.

[cold] As for you... you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful. [warm] Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.

[urgent] Check back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.
quest_865_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. [emphasis] And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns! [excited] If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." [excited] I could sell them for a fortune!!!

[urgent] And you can help me. Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws. They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
quest_865_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get the horns, <name>? [excited] Those things are going to make me a fortune!
quest_865_quest_complete: [excited] Great, you got them! [urgent] Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
quest_866_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands. Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.

[hesitant] I want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!

[urgent] If you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens. Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
quest_866_quest_progress: [urgent] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] Did you get those root samples?
quest_866_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes yes, these are very nice! [soft voice] I will grow specimens from these roots and study them. [soft voice] I hope to find new properties from them. [whispering] Hidden, valuable properties...!

[warm] And don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know. [urgent] Because I'll need someone to gather more!
quest_867_quest_detail:
[solemn] The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. [angry] It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

[low voice] I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. [commanding] The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

[urgent] I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. [hesitant] That should be a good start...
quest_867_quest_progress: [urgent] Cut up enough of them yet? [commanding] Keep slicing and taking trophies. [commanding] I want 8 Witchwing talons.
quest_867_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, these are nice. Real nice... [warm] Good job, <name>. [proud] I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
quest_868_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey, <name>. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

[solemn] One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. [pause] We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. [low voice] They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

[commanding] Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
quest_868_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be careful with the eggs you find, <name>. [hesitant] If they break, they be no good to me.
quest_868_quest_complete:
[solemn] You please me, <name>. [warm] The eggs and the tool. Well done.

[proud] And for your reward...
quest_869_quest_detail:
[solemn] Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower. It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

[soft voice] The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft. And... it was a raptor! [shocked] Unbelievable! [hesitant] I don't know what raptors would want with silver. But I don't care -- [angry] I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

[urgent] Hunt raptors in the Barrens. Collect for me their heads!
quest_869_quest_complete:
[excited] You got rid of the raptors!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You are a <class> of worth.
quest_870_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, the Barrens was a lush place, teeming with life. But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk. [sad] Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.

[pause] But within the past few years, new oases have formed in the Barrens, and life stirs. And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.

[urgent] We must find its source. Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads. Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
quest_870_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been to the Forgotten Pools, <name>? [hesitant] Did you find anything?
quest_870_quest_complete:
[solemn] You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it? [soft voice] Strange. This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

[pause] But it is a clue. [warm] And I am grateful that you found it.
quest_871_quest_detail:
[solemn] All the quilboars are our enemies, <name>. [soft voice] Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

[solemn] The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. [low voice] I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

[urgent] Start in the northeast towards Durotar. [soft voice] You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. [commanding] Seek them out, and slay them.
quest_871_quest_progress: [solemn] The longer it takes to stop these attacks, the harder it will be to provide supplies for the people of the Crossroads.
quest_871_quest_complete: [warm] You have done well, <name>. [proud] Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
quest_872_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, <name>. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. [urgent] He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

[commanding] To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
quest_872_quest_progress:
[commanding] Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, <name>. [solemn] Learn this lesson well. [soft voice] It will aid you in the future.

[urgent] The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
quest_872_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.

[proud] Your people should be proud to count you among them.
quest_873_quest_detail:
[solemn] The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters. Great is his strength, and solemn his pride. The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.

[soft voice] But I do not fear him. [warm] I am grateful he is here. [proud] He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.

[urgent] If you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.

[low voice] His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
quest_873_quest_complete:
[solemn] You now are one with Isha Awak, <name>. [soft voice] His spirit is with you. [whispering] He lurks in your eyes...

Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.
quest_874_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens. Your spirit is strong. [soft voice] But a hunter must always be prepared. [emphasis] A true hunter can stalk prey down any path. [pause] Mountains and swamps will not sway him.

[emphasis] Not even the sea.

[pause] Find my sister, Mahren. [urgent] She hunts the great water beasts along the coast. [warm] She will be your teacher in their ways.

But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
quest_874_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My brother sent you, did he? [solemn] Then you must have proven yourself to him. [warm] If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.

[solemn] Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?
quest_875_quest_detail:
Hahaha, <name>. [angry] Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

[commanding] This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. [solemn] Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. [threatening] They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. [urgent] Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

[cold] Make sure they die painfully, <name>. [threatening] We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
quest_875_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? [angry] Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
quest_875_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work my friend. [proud] I think you'll go far within the Horde.
quest_876_quest_detail:
[solemn] You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

[soft voice] Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. [pause] Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

[commanding] I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. [cold] I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... [threatening] Give those harpies something to think about.
quest_876_quest_progress: [commanding] You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
quest_876_quest_complete: [laughing] HA! Well done, <name>! [warm] Very well done... [hesitant] I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. [solemn] Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. [proud] Here is your reward, use it well.
quest_880_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your findings are incredible, <name>. [soft voice] These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source. Or perhaps an inside one.

[pause] I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

[commanding] Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases. Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
quest_880_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes your collection? [pause] Did you get the shells?
quest_880_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, <name>. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.

[warm] Please accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
quest_881_quest_detail:
[solemn] Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats. [soft voice] He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth. And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

[solemn] The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.

[urgent] You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee. His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo.

Go. [commanding] Blow this horn when you reach his lair. [emphasis] Blow the horn, and he will come.
quest_881_quest_progress: [solemn] The great cat calls to you, <name>.
quest_881_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... [soft voice] his spirit is with you. [solemn] He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

[warm] Your path is still long, <class>. [proud] Let's hope you stride it well.
quest_882_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens. He does not hunt for sport, nor for food. He hunts because hunting is his passion. He kills because it is his nature to kill.

And you will learn of his nature, <name>, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.

Begin the hunt. Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet. [soft voice] Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.

[urgent] Be ready when he comes.
quest_882_quest_complete:
[solemn] This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.

[soft voice] Ishamuhale's strength is in you, <name>. [warm] May you use it with temperance. [solemn] That is your burden.

[proud] That is your honor.
quest_883_quest_detail: [solemn] The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.
quest_883_quest_progress: <name>, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride. [solemn] Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
quest_883_quest_complete:
[solemn] Lakota'mani is called "Earthshaker" in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder. [warm] He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours. [proud] Together there is no conflict you cannot face.

[gentle] Walk tall, <name>. [proud] Walk tall, Earthshaker.
quest_884_quest_detail: [solemn] When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
quest_884_quest_progress: <name>, [excited] there is a new power behind your eyes! [solemn] You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
quest_884_quest_complete:
[solemn] The thunder lizard Owatanka is called "Bluebolt" by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size. It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.

[warm] May his energy flow through you, <name>. [proud] For you now keep pace with Owatanka.
quest_885_quest_detail: [solemn] The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
quest_885_quest_progress:
[solemn] There is new resolve within you, <name>. [soft voice] A resolve born from pain...

[pause] Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
quest_885_quest_complete:
[solemn] The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.

[soft voice] But Washte Pawne, called "Spirit Biter" in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both.

[pause] The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs. [sad] The sting you felt is the pain of regret.

[solemn] But I can see you have conquered this. [warm] You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.

[proud] You have learned much, <name>.
quest_886_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

[soft voice] Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

[urgent] Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga. He will be at the Crossroads. [pause] To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village. [emphasis] Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks. [commanding] Continue north and you will find the Crossroads.

[solemn] And do not leave the road, <name>, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
quest_886_quest_complete:
[solemn] My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young <class>. For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel.

With your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.
quest_890_quest_progress: [urgent] Wares to send on the next ship, <name>?
quest_890_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? [soft voice] Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

[chuckling] Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
quest_891_quest_detail:
[angry] Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

[commanding] Those bastards must be dealt with. [solemn] Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. [urgent] Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

[commanding] Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. [commanding] Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. [angry] And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
quest_891_quest_progress: [urgent] My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. [commanding] I want her soldiers to pay as well. [cold] Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
quest_891_quest_complete:
[solemn] Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. [warm] You shall be rewarded for your aid, <name>.

[low voice] Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
quest_892_quest_detail:
[low voice] Everything looks square from my records, <name>. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. [hesitant] I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. [sigh] Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
quest_893_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. [soft voice] I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

[commanding] If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. [excited] That should do nicely!
quest_893_quest_progress:
[low voice] I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

[solemn] I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
quest_893_quest_complete:
[solemn] Excellent, excellent specimens indeed.

The quilboar are further along than I had expected.

[urgent] Here, <class>, take this and get out of my way. [low voice] I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. [solemn] We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
quest_894_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. [hesitant] I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? [soft voice] Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

[urgent] I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
quest_894_quest_complete: [soft voice] A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. [pause] A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. [solemn] There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
quest_896_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. [low voice] I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

[emphasis] The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. [excited] One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. [urgent] I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
quest_896_quest_progress: [hesitant] If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
quest_896_quest_complete:
[excited] Look at the size of that thing, <name>! [excited] We're going to be rich! [soft voice] Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

[urgent] Now let's see... [emphasis] I think this should do about right. [warm] Pleasure doing business with you, <name>.
quest_897_quest_detail: [solemn] This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
quest_897_quest_progress: [soft voice] You seemed troubled, <name>. [pause] How go your lessons in the Barrens? [hesitant] Did you find something that disturbs you?
quest_897_quest_complete:
[solemn] I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. [soft voice] But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. [hesitant] I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...

[pause] But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.
quest_898_quest_detail:
[excited] Finally! Someone to rescue me!

[surprised] I can't believe you got past the guards. [angry] These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. [solemn] They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. [sad] I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

[mocking tone] Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? [soft voice] I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

[urgent] Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? [urgent] Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
quest_898_quest_complete:
[delight] And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!

[warm] Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, <name>.
quest_899_quest_detail:
[solemn] Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, <class>. But know this: [low voice] I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. [hesitant] Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, <class>--[urgent] you could help me.

[commanding] Kill them. Kill as many as you can. [solemn] Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
quest_899_quest_progress: [angry] The quilboar will pay for this, <name>. [angry] I swear it.
quest_899_quest_complete:
<class>, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.

[warm] Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
quest_902_quest_detail: [soft voice] Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. [pause] Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. [emphasis] A tug removes it from its housing.
quest_902_quest_progress: [excited] Oh, you're back, <name>! Do you have the samophlange?
quest_902_quest_complete: [soft voice] This is... er... interesting... yes. [low voice] I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. [solemn] I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.
quest_903_quest_detail:
[urgent] Now it's time to go after something that really bites. [solemn] The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed. Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly. [soft voice] You'll find them among the tall grasses. [emphasis] You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

[commanding] Be wary as you hunt them, <name>, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
