quest_903_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes your hunt, <name>? [hesitant] Have you found the prowlers?
quest_903_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. [solemn] Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
quest_906_quest_complete:
[excited] You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, <name>? [warm] Amazing. [soft voice] I am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. [solemn] The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.

[hesitant] I must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. [delight] Thank you again, <name>.
quest_907_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, <name>, you must face the great thunder lizards. [soft voice] So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains. [urgent] Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.

[solemn] You will find the thunder lizards in the southern Barrens. [soft voice] They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads. [commanding] Return to me after you have bested them.
quest_907_quest_complete: [solemn] It is good to see you return with proof of victory. [warm] And it is good to know you have done so with your bones unbroken.
quest_909_quest_detail:
[solemn] The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. [soft voice] He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
quest_909_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, hello again <name>. [pause] I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do. [hesitant] What brings you to the outpost?
quest_909_quest_complete:
[solemn] This... this is quite the find, <name>.

[soft voice] You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say? [solemn] Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; [emphasis] this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him. [soft voice] While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, [pause] our studies will also show how they did it as well.

[warm] You did well in bringing this to me. [warm] Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
quest_910_quest_detail:
[excited] I have heard tales of the mighty ships that sail between Ratchet and Booty Bay! [delight] That would be so cool to sail on the ocean and fight in many great sea battles. [excited] Maybe I will be a mighty Horde sailor when I grow up! Yeah!

[soft voice] Would you take me to see the Ratchet docks, please? [hesitant] I promise I won't get into the water or cause any trouble - I just want to see the big boats and smell the salty sea water! Yeah!
quest_910_quest_complete: [excited] Wow, the ocean is HUGE! [excited] There were a lot of seagulls and stuff too - [excited] It's just as noisy and as bustling as I thought it would be. [excited] There are pirates near by too - [delight] so cool! [warm] Thank you for taking me to Ratchet, <name>. [excited] That was so awesome!
quest_911_quest_detail:
[soft voice] They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it. [excited] That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds! [solemn] They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there <name>!

[urgent] Would you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please? I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!
quest_911_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, Ashenvale is where real adventure happens! [soft voice] Have you ever fought in Ashenvale, <name>? [proud] When I become a hero when I grow up, I wanna come to Ashenvale and fight for the glory Horde!

[warm] Thank you for taking me to the frontier, <name>. [delight] You're the best!
quest_913_quest_detail:
[solemn] The thunderhawk, <name>, is a fierce beast. [urgent] It is time for you to face them. [commanding] You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.

[soft voice] Do this, and your time with me will near its end.
quest_913_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [commanding] Have you slain the thunderhawk?
quest_913_quest_complete:
[solemn] You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. [warm] You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.

[soft voice] But your path, <name>, continues. [pause] In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.

[solemn] Now, it is time to move on.
quest_914_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration. [soft voice] They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

[sad] The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem. [emphasis] Even now their faces haunt me! [urgent] Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

[warm] Go, <name>. [commanding] You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
quest_914_quest_progress: [solemn] Memories of my nightmares haunt me, <name>. [soft voice] Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
quest_914_quest_complete:
[excited] You have done it, <name>. [warm] You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. [solemn] My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.

[warm] I thank you, <name>. [proud] I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.
quest_915_quest_detail:
[excited] ICE CREAM! Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?! Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream! It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!
quest_915_quest_progress: [soft voice] I wish they'd make more flavors of ice cream other than strawberry, but I guess I'm lucky that strawberry is my favorite!
quest_915_quest_complete:
[excited] Mmmmmmmmm! I love their strawberry ice cream! If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!

[delight] Thank you very much <name> - this is the best treat ever!
quest_916_quest_detail:
[solemn] I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave. They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

[soft voice] First, I would like some of their venom. Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north. I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
quest_916_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you gather the venom sacs, <name>?
quest_916_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders. [pause] It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
quest_917_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study. [hesitant] Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young <class>. And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

[urgent] There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave. [soft voice] Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
quest_917_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, <name>? [soft voice] Did you find a spider egg?
quest_917_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, very good. I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here. I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, <name>. [warm] You have been a great help to me.
quest_918_quest_detail:
[solemn] The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature. In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.

[soft voice] So it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.

[hesitant] I believe it has something to do with the soil. [pause] I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds. [gentle] Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
quest_918_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the seeds? [soft voice] I am eager to plant them.
quest_918_quest_complete:
[excited] You got them. This is good!

[warm] I will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared. I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile. Perhaps later you can see the results!
quest_919_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth. [solemn] I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them. [urgent] Help keep our land clean!
quest_919_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
quest_919_quest_complete:
[urgent] That's a lot! [hesitant] I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate. [solemn] I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.

[warm] Thank you for your help, <name>. [proud] The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
quest_920_quest_detail:
<name>, is it? [solemn] I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. [soft voice] You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

[pause] We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
quest_920_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, <name>. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. [soft voice] I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
quest_921_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, <name>. [soft voice] But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

[solemn] Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. [low voice] Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

[pause] There is a task you must perform. [commanding] Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
quest_921_quest_progress:
[solemn] The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

[soft voice] The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
quest_921_quest_complete: [solemn] So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. [soft voice] There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
quest_922_quest_detail:
<name>, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre? [soft voice] He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings. He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You have been a great help to me. [solemn] I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarian Enclave in Darnassus.
quest_922_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello...

And how may I help you?
quest_922_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, a timberling seed? I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.

[sad] But I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint. [hesitant] They are beyond my talents to repair.

[solemn] Denalan is very skilled with things that grow. [emphasis] He may find a cure for future timberlings. [solemn] He may be their only hope.
quest_923_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings. [soft voice] We are trying to find the source, but until we do... [pause] in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help. [urgent] Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted. [threatening] They must be removed!

[commanding] Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them. [solemn] Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
quest_923_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been to Wellspring Lake, <name>? [urgent] Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
quest_923_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [solemn] These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease. [soft voice] They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

[solemn] I will dispose of these tumors. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_924_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the Burning Legion. [soft voice] It rests in a cave on Dreadmist Peak, above a demonic altar of fire.

[pause] I have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.

[commanding] Take a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop Dreadmist Peak. [urgent] Travel west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.

[urgent] And hurry--the stone's power will consume itself in time.
quest_924_quest_progress: [solemn] The Demon Seed still exists. [low voice] I can sense its power...
quest_924_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your task is complete. [warm] You have destroyed the Demon Seed as Neeru bid. [solemn] But this is not the end...

[solemn] The destruction of the Demon Seed sent waves of power through the ether, waves of staggering force. [solemn] I felt them, and I am sure other beings did as well. [threatening] Others who will wonder why their toy was broken...

[warm] But regardless of future troubles, I have something for you. [warm] Neeru sent it as payment. [warm] And he bid me thank you.

[warm] So, thank you.
quest_925_quest_detail:
[solemn] They say that Cairne Bloodhoof is one of the greatest heroes the Horde has ever seen. [excited] When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Horde too!

Do you know Cairne, <name>? [soft voice] Could you do me a favor, please? [soft voice] Could you get his hoofprint for me? [hesitant] I dunno how to ask him, and he'd probably be too busy for someone like me... [excited] but you! [excited] You're an adventurer just like he is! [excited] I bet he'd give you his hoofprint easy!

[soft voice] Please?
quest_925_quest_progress: [solemn] When the orcs were alone and without friends, the tauren welcomed them to a strange land and shared with them without asking anything in return. [soft voice] That's honor, <name>.
quest_925_quest_complete:
[excited] WOW! You got Cairne's hoofprint for me! [warm] Thank you very much! [excited] And wow... he wrote a personal message on here - to me! [proud] I knew he'd be totally cool, I just did! [soft voice] Maybe someday I'll thank him myself... when I become a hero of the Horde!

[warm] You're the best, <name>. [warm] Thank you for being so nice to me.
quest_927_quest_detail:
[solemn] The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. [soft voice] In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... [pause] A beat that continues even now.

[hesitant] Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
quest_927_quest_complete:
[shocked] ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!

[warm] Thank you for bringing this to me, <name>. [solemn] I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
quest_928_quest_detail:
[solemn] While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. [commanding] Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. [solemn] I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

[urgent] Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. [soft voice] Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, <name>. [sad] There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
quest_928_quest_progress: [solemn] Greetings, <class>. [soft voice] For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
quest_928_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. [warm] Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.

[urgent] I think we'd best get started.
quest_929_quest_detail:
[solemn] First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in Darnassus use the water of the moonwells of Teldrassil, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.

Take this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. [soft voice] When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...
quest_929_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [hesitant] Have you completed your task?
quest_929_quest_complete:
[solemn] After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. [pause] Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.

[sad] It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. [solemn] A dark time for all.
quest_930_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.
quest_931_quest_detail: [soft voice] The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.
quest_932_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must warn you, <name>, this matter must stay between us. [soft voice] The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.

[solemn] He is called Lord Melenas. [low voice] He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. [solemn] His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.

[urgent] You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
quest_932_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? [solemn] It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, <name>. [sad] His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
quest_932_quest_complete: [solemn] With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_933_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. [soft voice] The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.

[urgent] Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
quest_933_quest_progress: [solemn] At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? [sad] Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
quest_933_quest_complete:
[solemn] Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. [soft voice] With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.

[solemn] With the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew Teldrassil, the new World Tree.
quest_934_quest_detail:
[solemn] All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

[soft voice] However, I will not get into that yet. [urgent] You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. [pause] Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. [commanding] Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
quest_934_quest_progress: [solemn] Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. [pause] But though we have a new home, [sad] our immortal lives have not been restored.
quest_934_quest_complete:
[solemn] To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. [soft voice] Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. [sad] But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. [sad] In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
quest_935_quest_detail:
[solemn] Without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and Nozdormu the Timeless, Teldrassil's growth has not been without flaw. [soft voice] Strange beasts have been reported arising from the very ground of the tree, and [hesitant] crazed furbolgs attack passing travelers.

[pause] I can only hope that the solution the Arch Druid is looking for will be found quickly. [urgent] I will pour all the phials you brought into this vessel, for you to deliver to Darnassus.

[commanding] Bring it to Fandral Staghelm, you will find him in the druid grove.
quest_935_quest_progress:
[solemn] I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

[urgent] Whatever it is, please make it quick.
quest_935_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah yes, the water I had requested. [low voice] Tenaron and Corithras certainly took their time in having it delivered... perhaps not choosing the most reliable of messengers... hmm.

[pause] Nonetheless, I can finally get back to my work then. [solemn] The weight of Teldrassil's problems fall upon my shoulders. [sad] A yoke I would wish to soon be rid of.

[warm] Take this, you may find some use for it.
quest_936_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me <class>, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

[solemn] The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. [pause] While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.

[gentle] Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
quest_936_quest_complete: [solemn] Greetings, <class>; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. [soft voice] There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. [hesitant] Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.
quest_937_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. [soft voice] Little by little we are trying to push them back.

[pause] When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.

[urgent] If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
quest_937_quest_progress: [solemn] Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, <name>, but [soft voice] I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
quest_937_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, <name>. [soft voice] Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

[warm] I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. [pause] No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. [gentle] You should speak with it.
quest_938_quest_progress: Mist... [sad] It was my fault! [sad] The witches caught me off guard... [sad] I should not have let them take you...
quest_938_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, thank you, <name>! [sad] I feared I would never see Mist again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. [warm] I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.
quest_939_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You study the simple wooden flute you picked up after defeating Xavaric.

The knotted wood feels solid, but it seems as if the spirals and patterns in the surface begin to spin and move as you turn it over in your hands. [pause] Suddenly, you feel a sense of dread...

[hesitant] You shake your head, sure that your mind is playing tricks on you.

[solemn] It's possible that other satyrs carry clues as to what you have found. [urgent] Bring your findings to the druid, Eridan Bluewind, that lives in southern Felwood.
quest_939_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it, <class>? [soft voice] You look concerned.
quest_939_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sense the suffering of ancient ones, <name>...

[soft voice] Holding these items is almost unbearable...
quest_940_quest_detail:
[solemn] The forest whispers of your feats of valor, <name>. [soft voice] As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. [hesitant] I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.

[warm] Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
quest_940_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hmm... [soft voice] You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, <class>. [solemn] What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
quest_940_quest_complete:
[solemn] I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.

[sad] I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.

[warm] Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
quest_941_quest_detail:
I have removed that foul moss from the heart, but it remains tainted...

[solemn] Try placing the heart in my planter. It is filled with a nutritive soil that may cleanse and heal the heart.
quest_941_quest_progress: [soft voice] This planter is filled with soil, specially prepared by Denalan.
quest_941_quest_complete:
[solemn] You place the heart within the planter, and it quickly digs itself in!

[soft voice] A few seconds later it wriggles back out, cleansed. [pause] It pulses slightly... beckoning for you to take it.
quest_942_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This fossil bears a striking resemblance to one I once saw in Ironforge. An archaeologist by the name of Flagongut brought it to our annual Explorers' League conference. He believed the fossil had a power which could be unlocked somehow.

[solemn] Last I heard Flagongut had holed up in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, awaiting escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. [urgent] Seek him out and show him Remtravel's fossil. Perhaps he can reveal the secrets of the past.

[pause] The ship to Menethil departs from Theramore.
quest_942_quest_progress: [soft voice] What ya got there, friend?
quest_942_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh my! You say this came from the distant lands of Kalimdor?

[delight] Amazing! Simply amazing!
quest_943_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. [soft voice] When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.

[hesitant] While I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. [sad] I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but [urgent] if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.

[warm] Bring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.
quest_943_quest_progress: [solemn] With the Stone of Relu I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore, <name>.
quest_943_quest_complete:
[excited] Most excellent, <name>!

[soft voice] Now to see if I can use the stone to decipher the powers of the fossils.
quest_947_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am devising a potion that requires rare mushrooms, mushrooms that grow only in a certain cave. The cave lies behind Cliffspring Falls, to the east and slightly north along the mountains.

[hesitant] I would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place. [soft voice] Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in Darkshore.

[urgent] Please, <name>, gather the mushrooms for me. And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
quest_947_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my mushrooms, <name>? [hesitant] Have you been to the cave?
quest_947_quest_complete:
[gentle] Many thanks, <name>. [excited] These mushrooms are fine specimens!

[soft voice] And when you were at Cliffspring Falls, did you find anything to confirm the warnings of the Ancients?

[solemn] The Ancients are wise, but I had hoped that, this time, they were wrong.
quest_948_quest_detail:
[solemn] Onu, an Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients, knows of your journey to Cliffwater Falls and wishes to speak with you. The grove lies to the south, nestled near the mountains.

The Ancients are patient and wise, <name>. [soft voice] But if Onu seeks your counsel concerning what you saw in the falls, then I fear it is urgent.
quest_952_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

[soft voice] You will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. [solemn] Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. [solemn] He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
quest_953_quest_detail:
[solemn] To the east you will find the ruins of Ameth'Aran. [soft voice] It is now inhabited by the restless spirits of the Highborne that once dwelt within its walls, but once it was a place where the servants of Azshara freely practiced their powerful magics.

[pause] I was sent to explore the ruins and came across two large tablets, scrawled with the stories of Ameth'Aran and its fall. [hesitant] While I read the runes, I was accosted by the spirits, and fled.

[urgent] Please, if you can, venture to the ruins and decipher the tablets in my place.
quest_953_quest_progress: [solemn] When you have studied the tablets and learned of Ameth'Aran's fall, [soft voice] I will take the knowledge on to Auberdine, and inform the Circle of Ancients.
quest_953_quest_complete:
[solemn] We have few records from the time around the War of the Ancients, especially near the destruction of the Well of Eternity. Given the upheaval and cataclysmic events that were taking place, it is no big surprise.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] With your help, my work here is finished, and I will be able to deliver a full report to the Circle.
quest_954_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

Even with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.

[soft voice] I would like you to investigate it.
quest_954_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a <race> such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

[hesitant] But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
quest_955_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. [soft voice] Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

[low voice] I am held here by the means of magic. [hesitant] Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. [solemn] A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
quest_955_quest_progress: [solemn] Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. [soft voice] For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... [sad] Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
quest_955_quest_complete: [solemn] Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... however they have come into contact with it recently. [pause] Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. [soft voice] Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
quest_956_quest_detail:
[solemn] If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. [low voice] No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

[solemn] I feel strongly that this must be true, <name>. [solemn] One of the satyr must surely possess it. [soft voice] If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
quest_956_quest_progress:
[solemn] The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, <name>. [soft voice] No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

[pause] For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? [hesitant] Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
quest_956_quest_complete: [solemn] It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. [soft voice] Let us waste no time, <name>. [solemn] When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
quest_957_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. [soft voice] In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. [emphasis] In this flame this seal could be destroyed.

[urgent] Be wary in the ruins, <name>...
quest_957_quest_progress: [solemn] In truth, <name>, I am afraid... [sad] Afraid that your coming--all of this--is merely a figment of a deranged mind. Can you know the torture that this is? I... [hesitant] Please, you must go quickly.
quest_957_quest_complete:
[excited] I am freed, <name>! I can now see with my own eyes the changes that have come to our world... [solemn] Only bits and pieces have I known. To think that when I last walked freely, the Well still stood and the Highborne held court with Azshara, our beloved queen.

[sad] I sense that my jailor, my former master, Athrikus, still lives... [urgent] Already my feelings of hopelessness will give way into thoughts of vengeance.
quest_958_quest_detail:
<class>. A task I would ask of you.

[solemn] Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. [soft voice] Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.

[solemn] I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. [commanding] Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
quest_958_quest_progress: [solemn] If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... [soft voice] Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
quest_958_quest_complete: [solemn] Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. [commanding] I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
quest_959_quest_detail:
[shouting] Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! [excited] The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! [laughing] Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. [sad] That's when everything came tumbling down.

[urgent] Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. [angry] Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. [hesitant] No way I was going in there.

[soft voice] Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
quest_959_quest_progress:
[angry] The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. [soft voice] I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

[commanding] If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
quest_959_quest_complete:
[excited] Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! [urgent] I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [delight] Nicely done, I say!
quest_962_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, <name>. [soft voice] Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

[solemn] Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. [solemn] I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

[soft voice] Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
quest_962_quest_progress: [urgent] I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. [solemn] I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
quest_962_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, splendid specimens. [warm] You have done well, <name>.
quest_963_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.

[sad] I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. [soft voice] Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

[hesitant] She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. [cold] Her spirit must be destroyed.
quest_963_quest_progress: [solemn] With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
quest_963_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, <name>. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.

[sad] Please, I would be alone with my grief...
quest_964_quest_detail:
[solemn] The key to Scholomance is called a Skeleton Key. It must be forged from the remains of a skeleton - several actually - and hardened by only the strongest of metals within a suitable mold. A signet of power from a being who naturally can open the portal to Scholomance will make the key ultimately function.

[soft voice] First thing's first though, <name>. [urgent] We'll need skeletal fragments for the key's forging. Skeletons inside Andorhal should yield what we need, but the ones outside the walls might work too.
quest_964_quest_progress: [commanding] Kill many and kill often, <class> - we'll need a decent supply of suitable skeletal fragments to make up the outer layer of the key. [mocking tone] They don't call it a Skeleton Key for nothing, you know.
quest_964_quest_complete:
[commanding] This'll work, <name>! [urgent] My turn now - I will imbue these with a suitable temper that will allow them to survive the intense forging process they will eventually go through.

[solemn] The next step will be to get an appropriate mold for the key. [soft voice] I know a goblin blacksmith in Tanaris that has in the past made molds for similarly macabre items. [mocking tone] He works for whom goblins usually work for - the highest bidder.
quest_965_quest_detail:
Hail, young <race>. [soft voice] I am Elissa Starbreeze, and it is my charge to protect Auberdine from harm.

[solemn] To this end, I sent Balthule Shadowstrike to observe the strange happenings around the Tower of Althalaxx to the northeast.

[pause] It is past time that he should have returned. [sad] I worry that he has encountered some unforeseen danger in the forest. [gentle] I would be most appreciative if you would find him and see that he is doing well.
quest_965_quest_complete: [solemn] Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. [soft voice] I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
quest_966_quest_detail:
A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. [solemn] I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.

[hesitant] Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.

[soft voice] A few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
quest_966_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found any more of their scrolls? [solemn] I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
quest_966_quest_complete:
[warm] Many thanks, <name>. [soft voice] This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...

[pause] Hmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.

[urgent] There is no more time to delay. [commanding] Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
quest_967_quest_detail:
[solemn] My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. [soft voice] He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.

[urgent] Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.

[soft voice] You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. [urgent] Be swift, [hesitant] I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
quest_967_quest_progress: [commanding] You have some business with me, <class>?
quest_967_quest_complete:
[soft voice] If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? [soft voice] I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. [soft voice] Let's see what he has to say...

[solemn] This is disturbing news. [solemn] When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.

[soft voice] At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
quest_968_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although terribly worn and scratched, the title of this book can still be read upon its cover:

The Powers Below

[soft voice] Inside the book is a listing of unpronounceable names with foreboding titles, methods of worship, and preferred sacrifices...many of which include living, humanoid creatures.

[solemn] On the inside cover of the book are the words: "Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, The Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge. Proprietor: Gerrig Bonegrip."

If Bonegrip sells books like this, perhaps he'll buy this one back.
quest_968_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello, sir.

May I interest you in one of my tomes?
quest_968_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, a copy of The Powers Below. [solemn] An interesting text, this is. And some might find it useful...

But this one's in sad shape. And look here! There are notes in the margin of almost every page!

Hm...I know this copy. I sold it to Bolgar last year. Are you...a friend of his? Yes, I thought you were. You have that same fire behind your eyes!

[warm] Well, by definition, a friend of Bolgar's is a friend of mine. And we take care of our own, yes?
quest_969_quest_detail:
[excited] Ah, I can tell just by lookin' at ya -- you be wantin' to make a lucky charm. [solemn] Mau'ari always knows!

[commanding] To da south. you'll find a canyon, an' giants made a' solid ice. [urgent] The giants sometimes be carryin' dem, but ya can always gather da shards yerself from da canyon. [soft voice] These shards have a powerful reflective quality.

[warm] Bring back 10 frostmaul shards, and my lucky charm will be yours.
quest_969_quest_progress: [urgent] Bring back da shards, and I be tellin' you more!
quest_969_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, yes... I will make da charm for ya now. [excited] Just you wait!
quest_970_quest_detail:
[solemn] Balthule's letter is dire. [soft voice] This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. [commanding] I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. [urgent] One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.

[confident] Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
quest_970_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you acquired that soul gem?
quest_970_quest_complete: [solemn] Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. [soft voice] Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
quest_971_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As you might know, I collect lore. [whispering] Old lore. [whispering] Powerful lore. [whispering] Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

[solemn] There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. [solemn] That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves. [solemn] Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

[urgent] Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript. [warm] Do this, and I will not forget it. [sad] Not even after ... the end days.
quest_971_quest_progress: [solemn] The journey to Ashenvale is long, and your task is not easy. [soft voice] But if you get me the manuscript, <name>...then your reward will be great.
quest_971_quest_complete:
[excited] You found the manuscript! [delight] What a joyous day this is! Copies will be made and distributed, and the ancient knowledge of Lorgalis will finally be known to my brothers and sisters!

[warm] Your service to us is more than you know, <name>. [warm] But I hope that this gift shows you the gratitude we extend to our allies.
quest_972_quest_complete: [urgent] Take the water sapta and find the corrupted pool of water in Silverpine, <name>. [solemn] I have great faith in your abilities.
quest_973_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine, a place of great evil in southwestern Ashenvale.

[low voice] He had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
quest_973_quest_progress: [gentle] You look a bit shaken up, <name>. [soft voice] Are you well?
quest_973_quest_complete:
[solemn] It was a grand thing you did today, <name>. [warm] You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.

[soft voice] Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
quest_974_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The hot springs here are a source of mystery to me. [hesitant] Where does the heat come from?

Looking at how close the pools are to Fire Plume Ridge, I really wonder if the volcano might have something to do with it. [urgent] I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest part. [excited] It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!

[warm] Here, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!
quest_974_quest_progress: [urgent] I'd go there myself, but... [hesitant] I'm a little scared of the fire elementals there!
quest_974_quest_complete: [excited] Yes, I definitely see the correlation here between the temperature of the volcano and the hot springs. I'll have to double-check my equations for accuracy, but it seems like the distance and the rate that the heat is transferred... [pause] Hmm...
quest_975_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now, before I give ya dis charm, I better explain how ta use it.

If you carry da charm with ya, you'll find dat certain items will drop from creatures ya fight. If you don't have da charm with you, you won't find them. Understand?

You'll know these special items by the name -- they be called E'ko. If you find any of these items, just bring dem to ol' Mau'ari, and she help ya out.

[pause] Wait here while I fix your charm.
quest_975_quest_complete: [solemn] Here it is, <name>. [warm] Remember, ya have ta carry it with you. [soft voice] Why don't ya head back to Winterspring, an' see what ya be findin' there?
quest_976_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Delgren has asked me to deliver messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine, but I am loathe to leave on my own. [hesitant] Dangerous foes operate in the forest, and I do not wish to risk letting these supplies and information fall into the wrong hands.

[urgent] If you and others could act as my guards, I could leave now. [confident] With your protection, I have no doubt that we can see these goods safely to Auberdine.
quest_976_quest_progress: [solemn] The Sentinels have a great need for supplies to reinforce themselves in Darkshore.
quest_976_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well today, <class>. [warm] The items we sent to aid Auberdine will be of immediate use in dealing with the dark threats that infest the forest.

[gentle] Take these with my heartfelt thanks.
quest_977_quest_detail:
[urgent] Now that I have what I need to cover the mechanical moving parts, I only need one other thing. [soft voice] Well, actually two. [excited] Two horns! The ice thistle patriarchs and matriarchs have the largest horns, so of course, those are the ones I want. [commanding] That type of yeti inhabits a cave to the southeast. [urgent] There are plenty of them there; you shouldn't have any problem finding them.

[emphasis] Remember, I only want the best looking ones -- no beat up or broken horns, please!
quest_977_quest_progress: [urgent] I've just about finished attaching the fur, <name>. [commanding] Please, hurry back with those horns!
quest_977_quest_complete:
[excited] I can't wait to show my friends! [soft voice] Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...

[delight] Perfect!
quest_978_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Wildkin feathers from the Hinterlands appear to contain traces of magical qualities. [pause] These powers... they don't seem to be wielded by the creatures, it's more like they are simply inherent to the species -- part of their very essence.

[solemn] During my studies, I heard that a large population of wildkin inhabit the snowy lands of Winterspring. [hesitant] Could these creatures have the same powers? [gentle] Please help me find an answer, <name>. [commanding] Go to Winterspring and gather feathers that have dropped to the ground, then return to me.
quest_978_quest_progress: [soft voice] Where could these powers have originated from? [hesitant] I think we are on the right track to find the answer, <name>.
quest_978_quest_complete: [soft voice] Now I can compare the feathers... [pause] Let's see...
quest_979_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Yes, yes, these feathers seem to hold the same magical enchantment that I noticed previously... [pause] While I am not certain what we might find, I urge you to continue searching for answers, <name>.

[solemn] A colleague of mine recently traveled into Winterspring to observe the wildkin there, in their own habitat. [gentle] Why don't you catch up with her and see what she has found?
quest_979_quest_complete: [excited] Hi! Erelas sent you? [warm] Great, I was just preparing to travel up to the caves now, and I wouldn't mind company.
quest_980_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now, I've heard about other hot springs in a place called Winterspring, far to the north of here. The strange thing is, there are no volcanoes anywhere near them. [solemn] Interesting, I know.

Well, if you want to find out more, you should head to Winterspring and speak to a friend of mine. Her name is Donova Snowden, and she is currently staying by the hot springs there.

[warm] Thanks again for helping me with my thermometer! [excited] See you later!
quest_980_quest_complete: [gentle] Hi there, <name>. [warm] Yes, what Krakle told you is true...
quest_981_quest_detail: [solemn] For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. [warm] Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
quest_981_quest_complete:
[solemn] I knew you would be up to the task, <name>.

[warm] I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. [proud] Bear my blessings, <name>, as well as this gift.
quest_982_quest_detail:
[solemn] Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. [pause] Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. [sad] They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.

[solemn] Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. [warm] I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
quest_982_quest_progress: [solemn] The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. [soft voice] Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
quest_982_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've done us here in Auberdine a great service, lad. [warm] We'll make sure that their effects are properly taken care of.

[proud] As for you, please have this. [warm] It is the least I can do for someone with the bravery to set things right.
quest_983_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!

Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. [hesitant] The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. [proud] I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. [urgent] Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. [soft voice] I'll pay ya...
quest_983_quest_progress: [solemn] Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. [soft voice] A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
quest_983_quest_complete:
[soft voice] As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. [low voice] Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. [pause] Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.

[excited] "Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! [warm] This is Wizbang by the way! [soft voice] Thanks a lot... [hesitant] Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
quest_984_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

[soft voice] I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. [hesitant] I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. [commanding] Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
quest_984_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is terrible news indeed, <name>.

With the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.

[urgent] Thank you, <name>.
quest_985_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, <name>. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?

Not all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.

[solemn] If you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. [commanding] Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
quest_985_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not stay your hand from what must be done, child. [soft voice] I know how repulsive the idea of killing the creatures of the forest must be, but in this case it is necessary. [low voice] No cure has been discovered for the corruption let loose upon the forest, and we must do what we can to halt its progress until one is found.
quest_985_quest_complete: [solemn] Wash the blood from your garments, <name>, and do not mourn what you had to do. [soft voice] Instead, give thanks. [warm] You have lessened the threat to our people here in Auberdine, even if Darkshore is still in jeopardy from the effects of fel moss.
quest_986_quest_detail:
<name>, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. [solemn] Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? [gentle] In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him.

[soft voice] To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. [pause] The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.
quest_986_quest_progress: [solemn] I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
quest_986_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These will do nicely, <name>. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.

Give me a few moments, then return to me.

[hesitant] Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
quest_990_quest_detail:
<name>, [soft voice] my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

[solemn] Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
quest_990_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, a <class> from Darkshore. [warm] Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, <name>. [hesitant] I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. [gentle] Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.

[solemn] I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. [warm] Some could surely use your aid.
quest_991_quest_detail:
<name>, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in Ashenvale, but he has yet to return.

[solemn] He had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.

[soft voice] Before he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.

[hesitant] He mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. [solemn] The gem was being held there before it was overrun.

[urgent] Find my friend, <name>, please.
quest_991_quest_complete:
[solemn] Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. [pause] For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.

[soft voice] The deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.
quest_992_quest_detail:
[urgent] We've got a position open for a temporary junior-grade surveyor in the Gadgetzan Water Company, if you're interested!

[excited] With the nomads seizing all our wells, we need to exploit more free sources of water! [solemn] There is water to be had in the desert, but only to those smart enough to survey them first.

[commanding] Take this dowsing widget and tap a sample of the water by the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. [whispering] It's right in sight of the trolls around there. [urgent] Bring the tapped widget back to me when you're done!
quest_992_quest_progress: [urgent] Welcome back, Junior Surveyor <name>! [commanding] Have you completed your assignment yet?
quest_992_quest_complete:
[shocked] What's this? You were ambushed by some sort of bad mojo creepy-crawly? [sad] Oh, this does not bode well for the Gadgetzan Water Company, no indeed...

[sigh] I guess I should have told you about the reports coming in on some crazy bug-creatures that appear to be sucking up all the water in the desert. [hesitant] At first, I thought it was just a crock. We have enough trouble with the nomads as is; I thought it was just more of their shenanigans. [urgent] Well, now we know at least!
quest_993_quest_detail:
[solemn] The cloak is complete, <name>. [soft voice] The time has come to find Volcor. [hesitant] I can only hope we are in time.

The cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. [emphasis] It will be up to you to know when to use it: [soft voice] I would suggest waiting until you find Grimclaw.

[solemn] If what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. [urgent] Grimclaw will be alongside the road waiting for you. [commanding] Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
quest_993_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful! [excited] Terenthis found someone to help me.

And look. [pause] a moonstalker cloak...<cough> [sigh] Oh... that hurts. [soft voice] Thank you, <name>.

[solemn] The furbolgs wounded me before I managed to evade them. [hesitant] Give me a moment, and I should be fine to talk some more.
quest_994_quest_detail:
[commanding] All right, <name>, force it is. [urgent] Let's get out of here as soon as you're ready. We'll fight our way down to the road--Grimclaw should still be there. Once there, we can part ways.

[solemn] Terenthis will want to hear your version of the story immediately, so head to Auberdine after we make it out of here.
quest_994_quest_complete: <name>! [warm] I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. [proud] Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.
quest_995_quest_detail:
[soft voice] All right then... if you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. [whispering] Let us leave when you're ready.

[solemn] Remember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. [urgent] I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.
quest_995_quest_complete: <name>! [warm] I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. [soft voice] Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.
quest_997_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Are you heading to the south? To Lake Al'Ameth? If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

[pause] My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil. [gentle] He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

[soft voice] Can you take the package to him?
quest_997_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have something for me?
quest_997_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, it's here! [solemn] I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. [hesitant] I hope it's still fresh...

[warm] Thank you for bringing it to me, <name>. [gentle] You are a <race> who is generous with their time.
quest_1000_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [solemn] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[soft voice] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [urgent] Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
quest_1000_quest_complete:
[solemn] Greetings, <class>.

I am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. [warm] Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.

[soft voice] Our connection with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade transcends racial and political divides. [solemn] Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.
quest_1004_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, heroes!

[solemn] The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [soft voice] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[solemn] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [urgent] Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
quest_1007_quest_detail:
[solemn] I would charge you with a task, <name>.

I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! [urgent] I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.

But when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost.

[sad] Please, <name>, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. [solemn] It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
quest_1007_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you found the statuette, <name>?
quest_1007_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] Thank you, <name>!

[solemn] The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
quest_1008_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas. It has been lost to the night elves for ages. Lost, and nearly forgotten.

[urgent] Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!

[commanding] Return to me when your mission is complete.
quest_1008_quest_progress: [solemn] We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, <name>. [urgent] It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
quest_1008_quest_complete:
[warm] Very well done, <name>. [soft voice] Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.

[solemn] I know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. [pause] We know this, for we share a history with them.

[solemn] It is a history I care not to repeat.
quest_1009_quest_detail:
[solemn] I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.

[soft voice] That key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.

[pause] For years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.

[urgent] Their leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram. [warm] Please, <name>, retrieve the ring for me!
quest_1009_quest_progress: [solemn] It is said that the Ring of Zoram is the key to any lock within the city. [soft voice] Do you have it, <name>?
quest_1009_quest_complete: [excited] You found the ring! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
quest_1010_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

[soft voice] There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. [hesitant] Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair? [soft voice] I may need it to properly treat the child.

[solemn] Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
quest_1010_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, <name>? [soft voice] The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
quest_1010_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, you have the hair! [warm] Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.

[hesitant] And... [sad] Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt? [solemn] Very troubling to hear, that is. [sad] Very troubling indeed...
quest_1011_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Forsaken, the undead arm of the Horde, have crept into Ashenvale, lurking at our ruins and our barrows. We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves. We must confirm this!

[urgent] The Forsaken have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles. Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease. Return with such a bottle. I will test it and find its purpose.
quest_1011_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the camp, <name>? [soft voice] Do you have a bottle of disease?
quest_1011_quest_complete: [commanding] Very good, <name>. [solemn] Now... by testing the contents of this bottle, the goals of the Forsaken will be revealed!
quest_1012_quest_detail:
[solemn] When I struggled with the Forsaken's poisons, I had a vision. [soft voice] I had a vision of the druids in the Dor'danil Barrow Den, poisoned... murdered by the undead! [sad] They are now errant ghosts, severed from their bodies and driven mad.

[solemn] So that the druids' spirits might some day find peace, you must enter the Dor'danil Barrow Den and destroy its once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.

[commanding] Do this, then return to me.
quest_1012_quest_progress: [solemn] The anguish of the Dor'danil druids still haunt my dreams, <name>. [urgent] You must destroy their leaders!
quest_1012_quest_complete:
[solemn] I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew you had completed your task.

[soft voice] It was grim work you did, <name>, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the Forsaken's evil. [gentle] But with their destruction, let us hope the other maddened spirits find peace.
quest_1013_quest_detail:
<name>, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection. [solemn] Ur was a great mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the Forsaken.

[urgent] Enter Shadowfang Keep and find the book. Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
quest_1013_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good. [soft voice] This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur. [low voice] His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power. [pause] And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

[urgent] We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
quest_1014_quest_detail:
[solemn] Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, <name>. [commanding] But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. [urgent] Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
quest_1014_quest_progress: [solemn] With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
quest_1014_quest_complete: [solemn] Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. [warm] You have done the Dark Lady a great service, <name>. [proud] Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
quest_1015_quest_detail:
[urgent] Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [solemn] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[commanding] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [soft voice] Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
quest_1015_quest_complete:
[angry] What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, <class>? [pause] Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. [cold] By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.

[threatening] The fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?
quest_1016_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take this divining scroll--it can determine the creator of these elementals. But you will need something from them to use as a reagent to focus scroll's magic--their bracers should do nicely.

[soft voice] A few intact bracers from the creatures should be enough. The other bracers will be useless for our purposes, but they may be worth something to a merchant if you wish to sell them. [urgent] Once you have the intact bracers attempt to use the scroll. Return to me with the results and we shall proceed from there.
quest_1016_quest_progress: [solemn] Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. [soft voice] You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
quest_1016_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <name>, this should give us the information we need to have the culprit discovered. [urgent] How would you feel about taking out the mage who fills our pools with corrupt elementals? The corruption of Ashenvale and beyond makes my stomach turn on its own--to have a wizard actively attempting to destroy it further sickens me to no end. [angry] We shall make him pay.
quest_1017_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's only one undead mage in the Barrens capable of defiling this many water elementals. He's also the only one foolish enough to try. Sarilus Foulborne is probably sitting at the top of Dreadmist Peak, [angry] laughing at me.

<name>, you must go into enemy territory and destroy this miscreant. [urgent] I have had enough of his idiocy and we must show him what happens to those who annoy the Sentinels.

Destroy him and bring me his head. Be wary though, the Horde may be watching for you.
quest_1017_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [urgent] Is Sarilus Foulborne dead?
quest_1017_quest_complete: [solemn] Now I can see that repugnant smile wiped from his face forever. [warm] You have done very well, <name>. Take this, the Light of Elune, drink of it when all seems lost and death is near. [soft voice] It may save you, Goddess willing.
quest_1018_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [solemn] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[urgent] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [warm] Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
quest_1018_quest_complete:
[solemn] Greetings, <class>.

[soft voice] I am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. [warm] Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.

[solemn] Our connection with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade transcends racial and political divides. [solemn] Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.
quest_1019_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, heroes!
