[solemn] The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [urgent] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[soft voice] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [warm] Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
quest_1019_quest_complete:
[angry] What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, <class>? [pause] Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. [cold] By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.

[threatening] The fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?
quest_1020_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child. [soft voice] Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.

[pause] To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
quest_1020_quest_progress: [solemn] I must apologize, for I have no time to speak. [urgent] My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
quest_1020_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is from Orendil?

[solemn] His skill with herbs and healing is great. [warm] This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
quest_1022_quest_detail:
[solemn] Though we have put many resources and much effort into driving the remaining demons from the Felwood to the north, our successes have been few. [soft voice] We have been able to keep much of the demonic presence from Ashenvale.

[solemn] To the north, near the Felwood border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their chilling calls have led the area to be known as the Howling Vale. [soft voice] The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept at the shrine may shed some light on why these wolf-men have come.
quest_1022_quest_progress:
[solemn] The tome of the shrine is a mysterious object. [soft voice] It is not a book in the traditional sense. [pause] The leaves of the tome were blessed by Mel'Thandris herself, and records events of import in its pages.

[hesitant] It is hard for me to explain. [urgent] If you go to the shrine, you will understand.
quest_1022_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in strange ways. [soft voice] The events it records, the events it shows... [pause] No one truly understands why it does what it does.

[low voice] Nonetheless, it is clear that what Priestess Starsong received--this Scythe of Elune--bears further investigation.
quest_1023_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.

You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.

[solemn] The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. [hesitant] Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
quest_1023_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is terrible, <name>. [shocked] Teronis is dead?!

The time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. [soft voice] I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.

[warm] You have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. [confident] Do you think you're capable of completing his task? [warm] I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.
quest_1024_quest_detail:
You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. [soft voice] I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. [pause] When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.

[gentle] A dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. [commanding] Seek her out.

[urgent] Keep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
quest_1025_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Before you travel to the moonwell I have another task that will aid the people of Ashenvale if you would like to test your skills.

[urgent] Along the road heading east before the Falfarren River, furbolgs have been attacking travelers. [solemn] Their tortured minds feeding upon fear, and their appetites satiated by the blood of innocents.

[commanding] Aid the Sentinels in protecting the lands by showing those monsters the same mercy they have shown our kind.

[hesitant] I believe their camps are south of the road... be careful.
quest_1025_quest_progress: [solemn] The furbolg were not always our enemy, <name>. [soft voice] But times change, and it is no longer a time of peace here in these dark woods.
quest_1025_quest_complete: [soft voice] You have done well, <name>. [warm] Thank you.
quest_1029_quest_complete:
[delight] You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? [warm] That's wonderful to hear.

[solemn] Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
quest_1030_quest_detail:
[solemn] Alas, I'm not completely certain what he had in mind next.

[soft voice] If what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another form altogether. Which form, I do not know.

[hesitant] Perhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to the tainted furbolgs, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. [solemn] Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was safe from the effects of Fel Moss.

[low voice] I would start your search southeast of Mystral Lake.
quest_1033_quest_detail:
I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. [urgent] We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

[solemn] Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. [soft voice] Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, <name>, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
quest_1033_quest_progress: <name>, did you find Iris Lake? [soft voice] Do you have the Tear?
quest_1033_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you found it! [soft voice] I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.

[warm] Thank you! [warm] Thank you, <name>!
quest_1034_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. [pause] But ... fever still rages within her.

[sad] Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. [solemn] Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.

[solemn] The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, <name>. [soft voice] May Elune speed your journey.
quest_1034_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you yet have the Stardust, <name>?
quest_1034_quest_complete:
[excited] You gathered the dust! [warm] I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.

Thank you again, <name>. [solemn] Without your help, my child would surely perish.
quest_1035_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak. [solemn] I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost. [solemn] I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

[pause] We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

[sad] Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them. [urgent] Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

[hesitant] And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
quest_1035_quest_progress: [solemn] Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, <name>? [urgent] If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. [soft voice] Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
quest_1035_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, <name>, you have saved my daughter! [warm] I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!

[soft voice] I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. [solemn] Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
quest_1036_quest_detail:
<name>... yeah, I've heard of you. [soft voice] I've heard that you're no friend of Booty Bay - just like us Bloodsail Buccaneers. [commanding] Fleet Master Firallon is looking for hale and hearty men just like you for a special mission.

[urgent] If you're interested, head on out to the Crimson Veil and speak with him below decks. [solemn] She's anchored off the Wild Coast east of here, next to the Riptide and the Damsel's Luck.
quest_1036_quest_complete:
[commanding voice] Avast ye, scallywag. I hears that ye be the type for a bit o' the skullduggery. Well, if yer no friend of Booty Bay, then ye might have a special place with the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

[laughing] Arrrrr...
quest_1037_quest_detail:
[solemn] Velinde Starsong was my predecessor here in Ashenvale Forest. [soft voice] At first it seemed she had the situation in Felwood under control, but little by little her efforts faltered. [pause] One day, she simply disappeared.

[solemn] I was sent here to continue her work. [hesitant] I'm afraid I know nothing of the priestess, however. [soft voice] Perhaps Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows further details of her disappearance that I was not a party to.

[solemn] Surely she will understand the import of such information.
quest_1037_quest_complete: [solemn] Velinde Starsong? That the priestess disappeared some time ago is almost certainly common knowledge. [soft voice] As to further details about the events that surrounded her departure... [pause] it would take good reason for me to divulge such information.
quest_1038_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Tome of Mel'Thandris showed you this? I suppose there would be little harm in allowing you to examine her belongings. [soft voice] This key will allow you to open the chest where we stored her things in the Sentinels' bunkhouse. She kept a journal of her duties, if there is anything to be learned, it will be from that.

[pause] I should tell you, the Sentinels believe that she had her own reasons for leaving, and expect that she could return at any time. The priestess has done much in the past to earn our trust.
quest_1038_quest_complete:
[solemn] It seems that Velinde's disappearance is more troubling than it originally appeared. [sad] Even still, I cannot believe that she has come to a bad end. [soft voice] Perhaps it would be beneficial for us to make contact with her.

<name>, since you have shown a vested interest in this matter, [warm] I would like to enlist your aid.
quest_1039_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ratchet is the only port in the Barrens. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in Azeroth. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers.

[soft voice] Follow the road southeast through Ashenvale and you will find yourself in the Barrens. [urgent] Watch your step, <name>, warriors of the Horde patrol the land. [warm] You will be safe at the port, though.
quest_1039_quest_complete:
<race>, eh? [soft voice] Must admit, we don't get much of your type out here. [hesitant] Looking for someone, eh? [pause] Just give me a moment, I'm sure I have it written in one of my ledgers.

[soft voice] Lot of people travel through here, though, so just give me a moment.
quest_1040_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah yes, finally found it. [sigh] Should have told me she passed through here that long ago. Let's see.

Velinde. Booked passage to Booty Bay on the Black Osprey. I don't have anything here saying otherwise, so I'd assume it arrived in port safely.

[low voice] Not much more help I can be to you, but she asked about overland travel over on that side of the world, and I mentioned Ruzzgot, a caravan driver based out of Booty Bay. [hesitant] Might be that this Velinde traveled with him.

[commanding] Move along, now. [shouting] I haven't all day for you.
quest_1040_quest_complete:
[commanding] Yes? Now, it doesn't look to me like you're the sort with goods that need shipping, so either you're looking for a job with my caravan--and there's no jobs to be had now--or you're probably talking to the wrong goblin.

[urgent] So which one is it?
quest_1041_quest_detail:
[commanding] Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday.

[pause] It just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. [mocking tone] Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old--but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own.

[soft voice] We split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. [solemn] The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. [urgent] Might know something useful.

Be careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.
quest_1041_quest_complete: [solemn] With all the strange happenings of the last few years, I keep as good records of strangers as I can. [soft voice] Never know when it might come in handy... though it's usually not pleasant business when it does. [hesitant] Not to suggest anything about this Velinde you're looking for.
quest_1042_quest_detail:
[soft voice] No, I don't have any records of a Velinde Starsong staying in Darkshire... though, if you don't mind me saying, I can hardly imagine a night elf priestess taking a room in the inn, if you get my meaning?

[hesitant] These wolf-men you mentioned though, that's something I've heard about. [emphasis] Just the other day, Calor came into town with a string of their heads. He works with the Carevin family. Hunters of demons, undead, and other monstrosities. [solemn] Speak with Jonathan, he's the head of the household.
quest_1042_quest_complete:
[solemn] Dark times these are. [soft voice] Ill news is whispered from every swaying branch, and evil can be found under every rock.

[solemn] And in such times an unknown stranger enters my home and asks of worgen... [hesitant] I'll ask no forgiveness for my suspicions, only answers.

[confident] And answers, I will have.
quest_1043_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your story rings true... I do not entirely understand your motives, but if your business here in Duskwood involves ridding the forest of worgen in any number, then I can forgo understanding for results.

[soft voice] There is a mine to the south that has been overrun with worgen... [hesitant] They appeared out of nowhere, but from what we know, that is where they first were found.

Go about your business, but I would ask that if you find anything of import, you share it with me. [solemn] We will accept any aid in our war against evil.
quest_1043_quest_progress: [solemn] The woods are perilous for the unprepared. [soft voice] Keep your weapons close at hand and your wits even closer, [emphasis] or your next journey into the haunted forest may be your last.
quest_1043_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is an interesting story you tell, <name>. Though the Carevin family's influence is not large enough that we might find the root of these troubles and finish them once and for all, we will do what we can to contain the worgens' numbers in Duskwood.

Already I have instructed Calor to make this his first priority.
quest_1044_quest_detail:
[commanding] We shall rein in the worgen problem, have no worry of that. [solemn] This evil that your friend introduced to our woods will be contained, and I bear her no ill will for her actions. [soft voice] Strange events are afoot in these times, <name>, and the darkness knows no respite.

[urgent] I will keep you no longer. [urgent] I suspect that there are others that should hear of what you have found in the mines of Duskwood.
quest_1044_quest_complete:
[solemn] So this is the fate of Velinde, is it? [soft voice] The high priestess will be disappointed to hear of this, they were good friends before her disappearance. [pause] Still, the Scythe of Elune was surely granted to her as a boon by our goddess, and it is unsettling to me that it has fallen out of her servants' hands.

[pause] Another matter for another time, however. [warm] I owe you my thanks in no small amount for what you have accomplished.
quest_1046_quest_progress: [solemn] The Sentinels do what they can here in Ashenvale, but it's thanks to <race>s like you that we have gained the ground we have.
quest_1046_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in Ashenvale?

[warm] I am more than pleased with your abilities, <name>. [warm] The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. [warm] I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.

[solemn] I shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.

[proud] Teronis would be proud. [warm] Thank you again.
quest_1047_quest_detail:
[urgent] Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! [solemn] A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

[soft voice] All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. [commanding] Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
quest_1049_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. [hesitant] But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?

[sad] The Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.

[urgent] Deep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. [low voice] Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.
quest_1049_quest_progress:
[solemn] Cairne is a brave and noble leader and I would trust him with my own life. [hesitant] But it is others that I do not trust in this political climate.

[soft voice] Once I have a chance to gather all the knowledge available I can provide sound council to the Chieftain.

[pause] Have you had a chance to travel to Tirisfal Glades? [emphasis] To the Scarlet Monastery? [solemn] The Compendium of the Fallen is just one piece in this complicated puzzle...
quest_1049_quest_complete:
[excited] The Compendium of the Fallen! [delight] I was beginning to wonder if the very book existed!

[warm] You have served the tauren of Thunder Bluff well, <name>. [proud] Your dedication shall not be forgotten.
quest_1050_quest_detail:
[solemn] The future is inevitable! We hurl ourselves towards it like falling raindrops to the Great Sea.

[soft voice] But perhaps, by studying the past, we can know what to expect and be better prepared for the unknown.

[pause] Before dire troubles fell upon Lordaeron, there was a bastion of knowledge tucked away in the Tirisfal Glades. [solemn] It is rumored that a book called Mythology of the Titans was housed in the library of the old Monastery.

[urgent] Bring it to me and perhaps together we can unlock the secrets of the past!
quest_1050_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Monastery was a seminary for Paladins-in-training. [solemn] Once a stronghold of the Light, it fell into the hands of the crazed zealots of the Scarlet Crusade.

[sad] The Crusade believed their goal a noble one: to purify the land of the undead plague. [sad] But insanity tainted their plight and now they stand enemies to all.

[soft voice] Bring Mythology of the Titans to me so I can study it and house it here in Ironforge.

[solemn] The corrupt halls of the Monastery are no place for such a historical treasure.
quest_1050_quest_complete:
[excited] You have rescued the sacred text!

[warm] Your journey was long and acquiring the book was undoubtedly no easy task. [proud] But the dwarves of Ironforge stand to benefit from your success.

[delight] Thank you, <name>, on behalf of the Explorers' League.
quest_1051_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even though my will is free, I can serve the Dark Lady no more. [sad] I feel my time on Azeroth has come to an end. [sad] My life force is shattered.

[angry] Interrogator Vishas did this to me! [angry] Tortured me for weeks! [angry] Took my wedding ring and gave it to his wife. [angry] The bastard! [angry] Revenge... [angry] I want revenge!

[angry] The pompous fool bragged about his precious wife, Nancy, who lived along Lake Lordamere. [urgent] Track the wench down, slay her and return my wedding ring to my wife, Monika in Tarren Mill.

[solemn] Heed my last wishes....
quest_1051_quest_progress: [low voice] What do you want, stranger?
quest_1051_quest_complete:
[solemn] Vorrel led such a troubled existence. And what a good mate he was...

[angry] Damn those filthy humans!

[sad] Vorrel is gone, never to enjoy undeath again. [warm] At least I can take solace in the revenge you took in his name. [proud] For that I thank you.

[soft voice] Now let me be to mourn....
quest_1052_quest_detail:
[solemn] We of the Scarlet Crusade lay claim to strongholds from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades. [proud] We are quite proud of our bastions of cleansing throughout Lordaeron.

[solemn] You have proven yourself against the undead in Desolace. [urgent] But the true threat of the plague lies in Lordaeron.

[commanding] Travel to the town of Southshore, in the Eastern Kingdoms. [soft voice] Seek out a crusader named Raleigh the Devout. [gentle] Give him this letter of commendation bearing my seal and he will escort you to a place of honor in our Scarlet Monastery.
quest_1052_quest_progress: [pause] Who goes there? [angry] What do you want from me?
quest_1052_quest_complete: [shocked] Brother Anton still spreads the word of the Scarlet Crusade? [soft voice] Oh my....
quest_1053_quest_detail:
[solemn] I once served the Scarlet Crusade with honor, loyalty and pride. I believed their cause to be a noble one: to rid Azeroth of the undead.

[sad] But as I spent time at the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades I realized that their grasp on reality was slipping. [angry] They now think everyone is plagued who doesn't wear the tabard of the Crusade. [sad] Innocent men and women were tortured because they were supposedly plagued.

[commanding] The Scarlet Crusade must be crushed in the name of the Light. [urgent] You, <name>, must destroy the deranged regime.
quest_1053_quest_progress:
[solemn] The corruption in the Monastery will not end until the highest ranking officials have been removed.

[commanding] In the name of the Light, slay High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey. [soft voice] Once they have fallen, perhaps the true cause can be rekindled. [urgent] Until then, anyone who crosses the path of the Crusade lies in peril.

[commanding] Venture forth from Southshore and make it so!
quest_1053_quest_complete:
[solemn] While disciples of the Light never revel in the loss of life, we must accept that on occasion, such sacrifices must happen for the greater good of the Kingdom and the planet.

[warm] Through your deeds in the Monastery you have spared many innocent lives, <name>. [proud] I salute your tenacity.
quest_1054_quest_detail:
[solemn] Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. [soft voice] My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. [urgent] If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.

[commanding] Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.

[low voice] I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. [gentle] Elune be with you.
quest_1054_quest_progress: [solemn] The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
quest_1054_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>.

[solemn] We are under constant threat from the furbolg. [soft voice] Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
quest_1056_quest_detail:
[solemn] The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

[soft voice] To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. [solemn] Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. [urgent] Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

[solemn] There awaits Keeper Albagorm. [commanding] Heed his bidding, <race>.

[solemn] The journey will be perilous.
quest_1058_quest_detail:
[excited] So excited I am!

Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.

[urgent] Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, <name>, so I can brew some forest magic!
quest_1058_quest_progress:
[solemn] Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!

[urgent] Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?

And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!
quest_1058_quest_complete: [excited] Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! [warm] We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!
quest_1059_quest_complete:
[solemn] Keeper Albagorm was wise to send you with such urgency.

[soft voice] Let us see if we cannot call forth aid from the great forest to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
quest_1060_quest_detail:
[gentle] You've done so well for me, <name>. [warm] You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

[solemn] The harpies are not from around the Barrens. [soft voice] They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. [hesitant] Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

[solemn] He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
quest_1060_quest_progress: [soft voice] You seem a shady character. [hesitant] You have something for me to see?
quest_1060_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ahh, a letter from Darsok. [pause] I have not heard from him in many years.

[sad] So the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? [warm] That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. [soft voice] Ah, to be young again, like you.
quest_1061_quest_detail:
[solemn] The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land. [soft voice] So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

[solemn] Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon. [urgent] She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon. To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads. [soft voice] She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
quest_1061_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, a <class>. [warm] Very good. [urgent] We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
quest_1062_quest_detail:
[solemn] The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest. The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage. [urgent] We must stop the Venture Company!

[commanding] Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag. You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon. [threatening] Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
quest_1062_quest_progress: [solemn] The Greatwood Vale lies to the northwest, <name>. [urgent] Go. [angry] Strike fear into those who would pillage this land!
quest_1062_quest_complete:
[solemn] Bravely done, <name>.

We may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...

[soft voice] Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
quest_1063_quest_detail:
[solemn] To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.

[hesitant] I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha. [soft voice] I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much. [confident] If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.

[solemn] Magatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff. [urgent] Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
quest_1063_quest_complete: [solemn] I bid you greetings. [soft voice] You are here seeking counsel?
quest_1064_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight. But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

[soft voice] Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us? They know much of disease. [confident] I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

[urgent] Speak with Apothecary Zamah. She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken. [soft voice] You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
quest_1064_quest_complete:
[solemn] Magatha sent word of your coming, <name>. [soft voice] Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

[warm] The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
quest_1065_quest_detail:
[solemn] To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures. Extreme, but without bloodshed.

[soft voice] A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need. His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

[low voice] To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity. Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

[urgent] Seek Lydon and bring him this note. [solemn] It details our needs to him.
quest_1065_quest_progress: [low voice] Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
quest_1065_quest_complete:
[soft voice] A note from Zamah? Her needs must be great to send word from so far. Let us see what she says...

[delight] Ah, splendid! [excited] I know exactly what to do!
quest_1066_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile. [low voice] That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

[hesitant] But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

[urgent] Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

[commanding] You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
quest_1066_quest_progress: [low voice] Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
quest_1066_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good! I trust the Syndicate gave you little trouble?

[solemn] As I mentioned, the blood of innocents is not an easy thing to obtain. [low voice] We are lucky the Syndicate shadow mages did the difficult work for us.

[pause] Now hold a moment while I create my concoction...
quest_1067_quest_detail:
Here is the toxin. [soft voice] If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. [excited] I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

[solemn] But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. [urgent] She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
quest_1067_quest_progress: [solemn] You have returned, <name>. [soft voice] Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
quest_1067_quest_complete: [solemn] A toxin from Apothecary Lydon? Very good. [soft voice] If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
quest_1068_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids. [soft voice] This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon. [pause] Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...

[emphasis] I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed. [urgent] These metal beasts must be stopped!

[emphasis] In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:

XT:4 and XT:9.
quest_1068_quest_progress: [solemn] The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, <name>. [urgent] You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.
quest_1068_quest_complete:
[solemn] The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, <name>. [soft voice] With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

[urgent] For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
quest_1069_quest_detail:
[excited] Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
quest_1069_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get the eggs, <name>? [excited] I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
quest_1069_quest_complete:
[excited] You got them! [warm] Thank you! [excited] I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. [excited] I can already taste the profits!

[warm] Here is your cut, <name>. [proud] I couldn't have made this deal without you.
quest_1070_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello, <name>.

You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.

[solemn] Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... [hesitant] a sign of trouble for sure.

[commanding] Would you find her and report back to me?
quest_1070_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, you've come from Ashenvale at the behest of Thenysil -- how I miss her, my homeland and friends. [solemn] She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. [proud] I'm proud of her.

[warm] It is a pleasure to meet you, <name>.
quest_1071_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You see, <name>, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! [angry] to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.

[sad] But it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. [exhale] I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!

[urgent] I need some time to plan and organize. [commanding] But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
quest_1071_quest_progress: [urgent] How goes the battle on your end, <name>?
quest_1071_quest_complete:
[excited] Thanks so much for your help, <name>. You're actually back just in time.

I think I've got the perfect plan. Explosives. No, that's not the plan, but it's part of the plan.

See, I've been using high explosives--don't worry, they're not as dangerous as everyone thinks--to scare the goblins back a bit. I can herd 'em pretty good with a few key detonations along the mountains' edges, but I've been low on supplies now for a few days.
quest_1072_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. [pause] But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. [hesitant] I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.

[urgent] And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.

[solemn] The only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. [commanding] Look for him in the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility.

[confident] You talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
quest_1072_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahhh. Gaxim sent you, huh? [angry] How do I know you're not lying to me?! [pause] Hmm? [pause] Hmm?
quest_1073_quest_detail:
Hahaha... you need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!

I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... [mocking tone] I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.

There's a problem though: I'm all out.

But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.

The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.
quest_1073_quest_progress: [hesitant] I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... [pause] they're vital to its creation.
quest_1073_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This'll do nicely.

If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. [warm] Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
quest_1074_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here you go, stranger. [emphasis] Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.

[pause] If you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. [mocking tone] If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
quest_1074_quest_complete:
[confident] Your task has been done flawlessly, <name>.

NG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.

[excited] What? Yes, dynamite... wagons of it. [warm] It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... just wait and see.
quest_1075_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Okay, now for the remote detonation part of my plan... [hesitant] oh, I haven't explained that yet, have I?

[soft voice] Okay, so the short of it is this: [emphasis] with a little magic, I can make it so the explosives go off while you're not around. [excited] I'm putting together a device that'll allow you to push just one button and have the NG-5 explode when you're ready.

[urgent] But I need a spell from a friend in Stormwind--Collin Mauren is his name. [soft voice] You can find him in the mage quarter there. [gentle] He's human, so he shouldn't be hard to miss.
quest_1075_quest_complete: [commanding] Now, this spell you need; [whispering] one that will allow you detonate explosives from a distance... [pause] hmmm.
quest_1076_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for.

[commanding] I'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. [urgent] To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil.

While I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to Westfall and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments.

[solemn] I'll be here when you return.
quest_1076_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Have you found the component I need?
quest_1076_quest_complete: [gentle] Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
quest_1077_quest_detail:
[gentle] Here you are, <name>. [soft voice] This should do nicely.

[gentle] Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. [soft voice] I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.

[gentle] Fare well.
quest_1077_quest_progress: [laughing] Haha! [excited] you're back! [urgent] Do you have it? [urgent] Do you have the spell?
quest_1077_quest_complete:
[delight] This is perfect, <name>! [warm] Well done. [excited] This spell, mixed with the NG-5, shall make the perfect remote explosive.

[urgent] We'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.

[solemn] That will surely slow down their deforestation acts.
quest_1078_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

[solemn] Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

[gentle] If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
quest_1078_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello again, <name>.

[hesitant] Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?
quest_1078_quest_complete:
[delight] This is perfect, <name>. [warm] Thank you greatly.

[soft voice] Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
quest_1079_quest_detail:
[commanding] This is it, <name>. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.

Take these pages--they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

Remember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.
quest_1079_quest_complete:
[excited] Truly amazing! [warm] This is a huge blow to the Venture Co.

[proud] We'll be able to find weaknesses in their machines and also incorporate their designs into our own creations. [delight] This is a wonderful day, indeed.
quest_1080_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, <name>.

[urgent] We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.

[emphasis] The key is to get their letters... remember that.

[whispering] The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. [urgent] Just get back here alive and with those letters....
quest_1080_quest_complete: [excited] Incredible, <name>! [warm] Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. [proud] With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
quest_1081_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I am sure Tyrande Whisperwind herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.

[soft voice] It may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the Stonetalon Mountains.

[gentle] If you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
quest_1082_quest_detail:
<name>, you have done a great deed by lending a hand here.

[solemn] The Sentinels of Ashenvale will reward you well if you informed them that Gaxim and I are alive. [soft voice] Tell them we are well on our way to stopping the Venture Co. and healing the lands.

[warm] Find Tara Thenysil in Astranaar; she will be pleased to see you've returned with good news.
quest_1082_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. You have done a service to the Sentinels.

[solemn] I'm glad to see Kaela... and even Gaxim, are doing well.

[warm] You've earned our appreciation.
quest_1083_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I'm unsure what the Venture Co. did to the Vale, but it's obvious they were overpowered by the creatures there.

[solemn] They set the forest aflame, and used their inventions of destruction to decimate as much of the Vale as possible.

[sad] But in their ignorance they also released something else: burning spirits, elementals of flame, stone and rage.

[solemn] The land has no chance to see Elune's smile while these creatures roam free.

[urgent] Bring me their smoldering embers to show you've reduced their numbers.
quest_1083_quest_progress: [solemn] The first time I saw the Charred Vale I almost wept, <name>.
quest_1083_quest_complete: [solemn] The remains of our enemy... [warm] your strength serves us well, <name>. [warm] Thank you.
quest_1084_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale--the treants--had something to do with the Venture Co. being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.

Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.

[hesitant] I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded treant and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.

[soft voice] Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...
quest_1084_quest_progress: I have a feeling Gaxim will find a use for the shrapnel regardless of how the Venture Co. has used it in the past.
quest_1084_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>.

[solemn] This should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. [urgent] I shall give this to him right away.
quest_1085_quest_detail:
[solemn] The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.

[solemn] The Venture Co. has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.

[gentle] Do not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.

[urgent] If you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.

[sad] I'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. [soft voice] Perhaps soon.
quest_1085_quest_complete:
[solemn] Treacherous...treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.

[soft voice] But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.

[confident] See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves -- they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. [excited] The possibilities are endless.
quest_1086_quest_detail:
[solemn] The toxin is ready. [commanding] All that remains is its delivery. [commanding] You, <name>, must make that delivery.

[solemn] The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon. [soft voice] It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine. [urgent] You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists. [urgent] If you find it, then place the toxin there.

[urgent] Place it, and run.
quest_1086_quest_progress: [urgent] You must find the Venture Company airport if it exists, <name>.
quest_1086_quest_complete:
[excited] You found the port? Well done, <name>! [warm] I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery! [solemn] Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.

[proud] You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company. [cold] They are deserving of far worse.

[soft voice] And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:

Do not shy from dark paths... if those paths lead to victory.
quest_1087_quest_detail:
[solemn] You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

[sad] Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

[angry] I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. [commanding] Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
quest_1087_quest_progress: [soft voice] Here, channeling magic is like drawing water from a well with a bucket full of holes.
quest_1087_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. [solemn] The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

[threatening] What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
quest_1088_quest_detail:
[solemn] They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. [solemn] They were mistaken. [angry] They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

[soft voice] Magic grants me true sight. [pause] Yes... there he is. [whispering] A crossroads... [whispering] At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. [whispering] A name... Raynewood. [solemn] One of the eldest sons of the forest god. [sad] They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

[warm] Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
quest_1088_quest_progress: [solemn] When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... [sad] but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
quest_1088_quest_complete:
[solemn] I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.

His head does not rise so high now, does it, <name>?

[warm] I promised you a reward, and you shall have it. [commanding] Attend to me.
quest_1089_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druids built the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, where they keep many powerful items.

[soft voice] They devised a complex scheme to keep them from falling into the wrong hands.

[pause] Luckily, I managed to... extract some details from one of them.

[whispering] Hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, you will find the Gatekeeper's Key--with it you will be able to open caches around the Den. [urgent] The items from these caches will allow you to open their hoard, located in one of the central areas.
quest_1089_quest_progress: [solemn] Three keyholes are carved into the stone.
quest_1089_quest_complete: [soft voice] As the three keys are slid into their matching openings, [pause] in the middle of the glowing light a number of items appear.
quest_1090_quest_detail:
[low voice] You know, I was once the second most important person here at this site. [sad] That all changed when Gerenzo took over. [angry] Fired my boss, Ziz Fizziks, and sent me down to work in the mines. [whispering] Ziz told me to stay here and gather information, though. [urgent] His new boss will pay us well if we can find out what Gerenzo's plans are.

[soft voice] Anyways, what I do know is that Gerenzo has ordered large amounts of this gold-green ore to be mined. [soft voice] I can get you a sample to bring to Ziz, but you'll have to watch for patrols while I get it.
quest_1090_quest_complete:
[excited] Thanks, <name>. [urgent] It was looking a little dicey there for a second and we've probably drawn far too much attention to ourselves.

[urgent] The important part is that we have the ore sample, though, and we should get it to Ziz as soon as possible.
quest_1091_quest_detail:
<name>, take these letters to Kaela. [soft voice] I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.

[commanding] Make sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.
quest_1091_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, <name>? [pause] What can I do for you?
quest_1091_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is interesting indeed.

[warm] You and Gaxim have done very well, <name>. [warm] Thank you.
quest_1092_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.

[urgent] I'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!

[soft voice] I'll try and clean up this mess a little, but you should take the ore sample to Ziz right away. He told me that he'd set up camp somewhere on the western side of Windshear Crag. Good luck.
quest_1092_quest_progress: [urgent] Something I can help you with?
quest_1092_quest_complete:
[delight] Ahhh, I knew that I did the right thing by telling Piznik to stay behind. [soft voice] I'm sure the engineers in Undermine will be most interested to look at this...

[chuckling] Of course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?
quest_1093_quest_detail:
[solemn] Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? [angry] What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

[excited] Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. [chuckling] Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

[urgent] Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. [sad] Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... [hesitant] maybe you could steal the plans for me? [soft voice] You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
quest_1093_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... [mocking tone] goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
quest_1093_quest_complete: [excited] Hey, is that what I think it is? [delight] Great! Now, let's see. [sigh] Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. [mocking tone] Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
quest_1094_quest_detail:
[whispering] This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... [low voice] Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... [excited] Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.

[pause] Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. [soft voice] Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
quest_1094_quest_progress: [excited] Hello there! [urgent] How can I help you?
quest_1094_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.

They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
quest_1095_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. [solemn] The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

[urgent] Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. [hesitant] Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. [whispering] Let's just say I have a hunch.

[commanding] Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
quest_1095_quest_complete:
[excited] Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

[angry] Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. [soft voice] Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. [solemn] It was a failure. [shocked] Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
quest_1096_quest_detail:
I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

[low voice] Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. [hesitant] There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.

[excited] If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
quest_1096_quest_progress: [sigh] Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. [urgent] I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
quest_1096_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. [chuckling] I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!

[mocking tone] Gnomes, I tell you...

[pause] At least Gerenzo's out of commission. [excited] Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
quest_1097_quest_detail:
[soft voice] There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery. I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

[commanding] You have a sturdy pair on you! So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand. We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

[solemn] You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
quest_1097_quest_complete: [soft voice] You're here to help with my delivery? [warm] Very good!
quest_1098_quest_detail:
[solemn] In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence. [urgent] It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

[commanding] So here is your task, <name>. [urgent] Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent. [commanding] Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

[commanding] This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, <name>. [threatening] Do not fail.
quest_1098_quest_complete:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

[solemn] Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

[whispering] But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
quest_1100_quest_detail: [soft voice] You slowly open the weathered journal of Henrig Lonebrow....
quest_1100_quest_progress: [soft voice] From your look of concern, I can tell that something is amiss....
quest_1100_quest_complete: [solemn] You say you found this journal on a deceased dwarf? [soft voice] Give me but a moment to peruse the pages...
quest_1101_quest_detail:
Poor Heralath! And this dwarf... Lonebrow. [solemn] What a brave soul he was.

[solemn] We must not let their valiance go for naught. [urgent] This crone... Charlga Razorflank ... must be stopped.

[commanding] Surely, infiltrating the Kraul will be perilous. [urgent] There isn't time to send word to Darnassus. [urgent] <name>, [commanding] assemble a party to slay the crone.

[commanding] Bring me Razorflank's Medallion as proof of demise.
quest_1101_quest_progress: [solemn] So long as Charlga Razorflank is mustering a force in Razorfen Kraul, these lands are in great danger.
quest_1101_quest_complete:
[solemn] The crone has been laid to rest. [warm] This is fantastic news, <name>.

[soft voice] In these times of peril, it is refreshing to see one as brave as yourself.

[solemn] With Razorflank's minions taken care of, our studies in the area can continue. [solemn] Perhaps now we can gain further knowledge of exactly what happened to corrupt the resting place of Agamaggan.

[hesitant] However, I fear the answer to that question lies in treachery as well...
quest_1102_quest_detail:
[solemn] Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. [sad] My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

[urgent] A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

[solemn] Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, <name>.
quest_1102_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

[urgent] Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? [soft voice] Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
quest_1102_quest_complete:
[solemn] I see the nasty tribe of Razorfen Kraul now knows the pain of my people. [angry] Serves the foul beasts right.

[solemn] To drive one from a holy land is a sin worthy of the most severe revenge.

[warm] Thank you, <name>, for aiding me in my plight.
quest_1103_quest_detail:
Greetin's, brotha! Have you too come to purify the waters here and prove your understandin' to Islen?

I've just defeated the corrupt water spirit meself, and I'm just 'bout to put da bracers and remaining drops o' water on the brazier.

What's dat? Ahhh. [sigh] Tiev understan' all too well when somethin' goes wrong. Well, Tiev can help you plenty if you be needin' to see the pure water spirit again.

[soft voice] Bring me a water sapta from Islen as proof that you be ready, an' I'll wait to turn in me parts.
quest_1103_quest_progress:
[commanding] Ya have the sapta, brotha?

I know another that had trouble after defeating da corrupt water spirit--seems he waited too long and he came out of the spirit world too quick fer his taste. Hate to see dat happen to another, so I'll just wait here fer a bit to make sure no one else be needin' me help.
quest_1103_quest_complete:
Ahhh, den yur ready...

[soft voice] I'll put me items in the brazier den, and you c'n talk wit' da spirit too.

An' dontchu worry none 'bout seein' into da spirit world wit' da sapta... ol' Tiev know a trick or two 'bout how da sapta magic works.

[warm] Come now, head down wit' me to the shrine and let's speak to da spirits together, brotha.
quest_1104_quest_detail:
[excited] I have so many designs for our rocket car! So many! And I must try them all!!

[urgent] I'm working on a new type of fuel. One that burns really really really hot!! [hesitant] I haven't gotten the mixture perfect, but I think I know what I need...

[soft voice] The scorpids who wander the Shimmering Flats have a venom with lots and lots of salt in it. It's very unique! And it's just what I need!

[commanding] Bring me venom and trust me -- our car will fly!!
quest_1104_quest_progress: [excited] Hi hi hi! [urgent] Did you get that venom??
quest_1104_quest_complete: [excited] All right! [excited] This venom is going to work great! [warm] Thanks, <name>! [urgent] Now I just need to boil it down, apply skipper-otomer, add a nega-catalyst, and... Drat! Where are my notes!?
quest_1105_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My brother is working on a new fuel for his rocket car. He's brilliant, he really is. So brilliant that... [emphasis] I think that new fuel he's designing is strong enough to eat right through the car's chassis!

[urgent] I want to reinforce its fuel tanks before that happens.

The tortoises out on the flats have very hard shells. [solemn] I want to use them to create new tanks for our rocket car. Tanks that can hold my brother's new fuel.

[gentle] You look responsible enough. [commanding] Will you get me those shells?
quest_1105_quest_progress:
[soft voice] My brother is making progress with his new fuel design, and that has me worried. [urgent] I need to start work on a tortoise shell fuel tank as soon as possible!

[hesitant] <name>, do you have those shells yet?
quest_1105_quest_complete:
[excited] You got them! Thanks, <name>!

[delight] Wow, these shells are harder than I thought! [laughing] Heh, when I work with them I'll probably bend a whole box full of tools!
quest_1106_quest_detail:
[excited] I'm developing a new engine that'll make the car go so fast! [excited] Fast enough to fly, I know it! [urgent] I just need to make pistons that can handle very very heavy stress. [angry] All my trials have failed because I can't make pistons hard enough!

[hesitant] But there is someone who might know how.

[solemn] His name is Martek the Exiled. [solemn] He is a great smith and knows more about metal than anyone. [warm] Take him this letter, I know he can help!

[urgent] But he's far far away -- in Azeroth, in the Badlands, in a camp, with a goblin!

[commanding] Find him!
quest_1106_quest_progress:
[low voice] Well, you found me. [soft voice] Good for you.

[commanding] Are you here about that axe I made for Gath'Ilzogg? [threatening] Or are you here to reclaim Duchess Pamay's honor?

[cold] Actually, I don't care which it is. [urgent] If you're here to fight, then let's get it over with...
quest_1106_quest_complete:
[excited] Fizzle sent you? Well that changes things! [warm] Of course I'll help you. Fizzle and his brother are two of the few people who don't want me dead!

[chuckling] So Fizzle wants to make pistons, eh? Pistons strong enough to take whatever stresses he has planned, and if I know Fizzle, then this new car of his is a volcano on wheels!
quest_1107_quest_detail:
[excited] Our rocket car is the fastest thing on the flats! So fast that ... I'm afraid friction is going to tear it apart!

[urgent] To prevent that I need to create a composite to coat the car's moving parts. It must be hard but not brittle, and must be resistant to salt corrosion, or time spent on the Shimmering Flats will eat it away.

[hesitant] Have you heard of the Vile Reef, <name>? It's off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Saltscale murlocs live there, and their tail fins are a crucial ingredient of my composite.
quest_1107_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the tail fins? [low voice] If I can't protect our car from its own speed, then it won't last long in these races.
quest_1107_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you, <name>! [warm] After I grind these down and fuse them with a few other ingredients, the composite will be ready. And after that, the car will be safe from its own speed.

[hesitant] Safe, as long as it doesn't hit anything...
quest_1108_quest_detail:
[solemn] I'm not out here just to stay away from people. [urgent] There is a wealth of metal in the Badlands, <name>, if you have the guts to get it.

[soft voice] The metal's called indurium and as luck would have it, it is rumored to possess high resistance to heat and stress. [low voice] It might work for Fizzle's car.

[hesitant] But let's make sure. [commanding] Get me samples of indurium and I'll test its properties.

[solemn] True indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman, but the Stonevault troggs of the Badlands sometimes have flakes of it on them. [urgent] Bring me those flakes.
quest_1108_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find any indurium flakes, <name>. [low voice] I have my forge heated up and ready to test them.
quest_1108_quest_complete: [commanding] Ah yes, these will do fine. [urgent] Now let's put them in some heat and see how they fare...
quest_1109_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you can see, <name>, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

[soft voice] As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. [urgent] So much work and so little time!

[warm] You look well traveled for a <class>. [gentle] Perhaps you can aid me.

[low voice] I'm in need of a rare substance. [threatening] It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. [commanding] Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
quest_1109_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, I see you have returned. [hesitant] Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?
quest_1109_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid! [warm] This is just the start we needed, <name>.
quest_1110_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Heh heh, with all the races they're running here, it's no surprise that a few mishaps happen along the way. If you look around the Shimmering Flats then you'll see evidence of past crashes -- scraps of rocket car parts are littered everywhere!

[excited] And those parts are worth money to the gnomes and goblins. [commanding] They're always looking for more contraptions to slap onto their cars.

[urgent] So go out and get me parts. [warm] Bring me a heap and I'll pay you well.
quest_1110_quest_progress: <name>, have you been out into the Flats? [urgent] Did you bring back that load of parts I wanted?
quest_1110_quest_complete:
[excited] Whoa, look at all that! [soft voice] There's some good stuff in that heap of junk. [low voice] I'm sure I can pawn it off for a hefty sum.

[hesitant] And... is that an ear I see squashed between those two sheets of metal?? [shocked] Ouch! [laughing] Heh, I sure wouldn't want to be that pilot!

[warm] Thanks, <name>. [commanding] Here's your pay. [whispering] And here's some advice, free of charge...

[soft voice] If you look hard enough, you can always find profit in someone else's tragedy.
quest_1111_quest_detail:
[commanding] I make it my job to get people what they need, and the gnomes over there need a parts order filled. Their parts were shipped to Ratchet a week ago, but I haven't been able to make the trip.

[pause] So, are you ready for some legwork? Go to Ratchet and give this parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig -- he'll probably be at the docks.

Do this for me, and I'll have more jobs for you.

[warm] Jobs, my friend, with serious profit potential...
quest_1111_quest_progress: [urgent] Speak up! Tell me, are you dropping off or picking up?
quest_1111_quest_complete: [excited] Oh yes. Parts for Kravel. [warm] I'm glad you're here. [delight] These things have been sitting out here for days, and I was afraid they'd rust!
quest_1112_quest_detail: [urgent] Here's Kravel's package, <name>. [soft voice] And when you deliver it, tell him... if he wants more special orders, then he'll have to pay his tab!
quest_1112_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you make it to Ratchet and get those parts?
quest_1112_quest_complete: [delight] Great, you got them! [urgent] Now we need to get them to the gnomes. [pause] But first... [hesitant] Let's take out one small item...
quest_1113_quest_detail:
[low voice] Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. [whispering] Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... [whispering] ghastly results. [solemn] In the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. [solemn] There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. [commanding] Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts.

[low voice] Our concoction will be most wicked!
quest_1113_quest_progress:
[urgent] Have you returned from the Scarlet Monastery? [delight] I'll need many hearts for this delightful experiment!

[cold] No doubt, Varimathras and the Dark Lady will be pleased to be rid of the Scarlet Scum as well...
quest_1113_quest_complete: [soft voice] My what an abundance of gore you have brought me, <name>! [warm] Your efforts have been most excellent!
quest_1114_quest_detail:
[low voice] Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts. He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...

[whispering] And I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him. It was small and worthless.

[mocking tone] Trust me.
quest_1114_quest_progress: [urgent] You have something for me? [excited] That's great! [commanding] let's see it!
quest_1114_quest_complete: [excited] There they are! [delight] My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! [proud] These will do just fine. [warm] Thank you!
quest_1115_quest_detail:
[excited] Now that we've done a service for the gnomes, it's time to do the goblins a favor!

[whispering] I hear that the goblin racer pilot, Nazz Steamboil, didn't always use that name. [hesitant] I wonder why he changed it. [soft voice] I wonder if it's a secret, and... [pause] I wonder if he values that secret.

[urgent] If anyone knows the truth, then it's Krazek of Booty Bay, on the southern tip of Stranglethorn. [commanding] Speak with Krazek and ask him about our goblin pilot.

[confident] If you can get useful information from him, then we might just turn a profit from it.
quest_1115_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You want to know about Nazz Steamboil? He's a racer pilot out in the Shimmering Flats, isn't he?

[hesitant] Yeah, I might be able to find something out about him... [pause] but it won't be easy. [low voice] Or fast. [cold] Or cheap.
quest_1116_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Getting the information on Nazz is quite a favor, <name>. [emphasis] Yes, quite a favor. But you've come all the way from the Shimmering Flats to get it... are you willing to travel some more?

[pause] While I contact my sources, why don't you gather something for me, eh?

Hm... what will it be? [excited] How about dream dust, from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows. [warm] Yes, I'd love some dream dust for my snuff pouch!

[urgent] Get it for me, <name>, and I'll give you the information you seek.
quest_1116_quest_progress: [urgent] Back so soon? Do you have my dream dust?
quest_1116_quest_complete:
[delight] Well, look at that. You found the dream dust!

[excited] And how did you like the swamp, <name>? [chuckling] It's not easy to get a hot meal there, is it?
quest_1117_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself! [excited] But I found the information you seek.

[whispering] Here, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil. [urgent] Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.

[commanding] Just don't tell anyone where you got it!
quest_1117_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get anything on Nazz Steamboil? [whispering] Anything he might want to keep a secret??
quest_1117_quest_complete:
[excited] Well well! [pause] This is interesting... very interesting. [chuckling] Heh, perhaps I should bow to the goblin pilot the next time I see him.

[warm] This is worth plenty, <name>. [soft voice] I'm sure Nazz will pay a small fortune to keep his secret... a secret.
quest_1118_quest_detail:
<name>, you're a <class> I can trust, both to get the job done and to keep your mouth shut while doing it.

[excited] I've been brewing up a new scheme. It's risky, but if it works then we could both make a bundle! And I think you're just the person to see it through.

To start, you must go back to Booty Bay. I apologize, good <name>. I know my last task took you there. But this time, speak with Crank Fizzlebub.

Give him this letter. And if he requires aid, do your best to help him. It will be worth the effort.
quest_1118_quest_progress: [excited] Hello hello. And what brings a noble <race> such as you down to Booty Bay?
quest_1118_quest_complete:
I see. Kravel has a big scheme planned. [solemn] He has a sinister mind -- I like that about him.

[soft voice] So you'll need something to addle wits, eh? Something powerful...

I wonder if the mixture Zanzil feeds his zombies could be used...
quest_1119_quest_detail:
[excited] I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation. [whispering] A Fool's Stout. [hesitant] I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.

[urgent] And <name>, don't keep this stuff too long without using it. [low voice] Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear. [sad] So it won't stay fresh forever.
quest_1119_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [urgent] Was Fizzlebub able to help us?
quest_1119_quest_complete:
[excited] Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.

And thank you, <name>. [warm] You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...
quest_1120_quest_detail:
[urgent] We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the gnomes, then here -- take the stout and give it to the gnome pit boss.

And don't wait too long. [solemn] This stout will go bad eventually.
quest_1120_quest_progress: [excited] Hi! [urgent] You have something for me?
quest_1120_quest_complete:
[delight] Stout? How considerate! Thank you!

[hesitant] We shouldn't be drinking with the race coming up, but... maybe my boys could do with just a little. Besides, it can't be that strong, can it?
quest_1121_quest_detail:
[commanding] We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. [urgent] If you want to try it on the goblins, then here -- take the stout and give it to the goblin pit boss.

[urgent] And don't wait too long. [solemn] This stout will go bad eventually.
quest_1121_quest_complete: [commanding] What do we have here? [excited] Booze, eh? [warm] Well, I don't mind if we have just a little...
quest_1122_quest_detail:
[excited] That Fool's Stout worked great! [laughing] I placed a bet on the next race, and... let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!

[urgent] There's only one more task for you -- take this note back to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. [soft voice] He'll want to know of the successful test.

[warm] And hopefully we can get more of that Fool's Stout for future races!
quest_1122_quest_progress: [urgent] Hello <name>. [excited] How'd that stout work out? [chuckling] It's strong stuff, isn't it?
quest_1122_quest_complete:
It says here that the fool's stout was a success. [excited] That's good news!

[warm] If you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of Zanzil's Mixture.
quest_1123_quest_detail:
[solemn] For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris and Un'Goro. He is located in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.

[soft voice] I want to impart on you the importance of your presence. There are growing tensions between the night elves of Darnassus and the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade. Look beyond racial boundaries and tap into the wisdom of your ancestors in dealings with the Circle there, <name>. [warm] Good luck.
quest_1123_quest_complete:
