[solemn] I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.

[soft voice] I appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. [solemn] The tauren have shown an incredible propensity to the tenets of Cenarius, and by their proxy the Horde is welcomed within the safety of this glade. [warm] The preservation of Azeroth is a common goal we both share.

[warm] You are among friends here, <name>.
quest_1124_quest_detail: [solemn] West of Un'Goro Crater, via the northwestern ridge, is a harsh wasteland - Silithus. Few know that an ancient war was waged there between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... [whispering] unspeakable horror. [pause] Seek out Layo Starstrike, one of our agents in Silithus; look for him at Valor's Rest, the final resting spot for the fallen of the wastes. Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.
quest_1124_quest_progress: [commanding] This is a dangerous land to be so casual, <class>. [solemn] What brings you to the wastes of Silithus?
quest_1124_quest_complete:
Rabine sent you, did he? [commanding] Well, consider yourself welcomed here... as much as this desolate and forsaken land can welcome someone.

[solemn] I wasn't alive during the time of the great tribulations that took place here, but there are parts of this desert that might as well be eerie pictures of that forgotten past. [soft voice] With your help, the Cenarion Circle might be able to bring finality to a threat that was supposed to have died generations ago.
quest_1125_quest_detail:
[solemn] To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village. [soft voice] This is where our work should begin, <name>.

From what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus. It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes. [pause] I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...

The tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly. Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.
quest_1125_quest_progress: [solemn] Alliance or Horde, it doesn't matter - no being deserves to be trapped on this world as a tortured spirit. [soft voice] The freeing of these souls will make things right, <name>.
quest_1125_quest_complete:
[solemn] I had thought that maybe the huge swirling hive near the ruins of the village had played a part in its demise. [soft voice] It would seem that your work has proven this to be correct; the proximity of the hive poses a threat to any future work we may do here.

[warm] I thank you for your benevolence in freeing the souls of the fallen; [pause] such work is never easy, I know. [hesitant] When you're ready, however, I'd like to ask for your assistance once more...
quest_1126_quest_detail:
[solemn] The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them. [soft voice] It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; [emphasis] this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits.

[urgent] The silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it. [commanding] Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity. [soft voice] Report back what you learn, but be careful! [urgent] If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me.
quest_1126_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, did it work? [hesitant] You're still in one piece, which is good news. [soft voice] Did you find anything?
quest_1126_quest_complete:
[shocked] What the... what is it?

It has the shape of a... box, maybe? It's encrusted over something fierce. [pause] Wait, there a portion here that's exposed... is that a book underneath all this gunk?

[excited] I think you've stumbled across quite the find here, <name>... well, at least I hope it is. [soft voice] Perhaps it is a journal or a log from ancient times, preserved in this shell.

[solemn] I think I know a way to find out what this is.
quest_1127_quest_detail:
[excited] So you want some Fool's Stout, eh? [hesitant] Thinking of heading back to the races...?

[urgent] All right, bring me more of Zanzil's mixture and I'll make some more stout for you.
quest_1127_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those Zanzil mixtures yet, <name>?
quest_1127_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, very good! [warm] Here is your pay.

And here is a little something extra... [whispering] for your discretion.
quest_1130_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

[soft voice] If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. [urgent] You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
quest_1130_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, <name>, you have come. [pause] Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

[gentle] If so, young <class>, then listen on...
quest_1131_quest_detail:
[solemn] At times we hunt for food. At times we hunt for honor. And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

[pause] But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things. It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

[commanding] The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens. He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

[urgent] Find Steelsnap, <name>. Find him, and defeat him.
quest_1131_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, <name>?
quest_1131_quest_complete:
[solemn] In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

[warm] And that, <name>, is your lesson this day.
quest_1132_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh, to be at sea once again! To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!

Oh, [warm] I wish I had your fortune, good <class>, for I see the sea in your future!

[commanding] It's my job to tell eager souls of the land of Kalimdor, the land of opportunity! If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of Theramore. Speak there with my partner, the elf, Fiora Longears.

[soft voice] She'll start you on your Kalimdor adventure!
quest_1132_quest_complete: [delight] Good day to you! [warm] You were sent by Mr. Flint in Menethil Harbor? [warm] Well Mr. Flint is a strong judge of character. [warm] If he sent you, then there's no doubt you belong here in Kalimdor!
quest_1133_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... go to Astranaar. [warm] I'm sure an eager member of the Alliance such as you can do some real good there. [commanding] Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.

But don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...
quest_1133_quest_complete: [soft voice] You are here to offer your services to the Alliance, <name>? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... [solemn] Ashenvale Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
quest_1134_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile. [soft voice] We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

[solemn] One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south. [urgent] Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!

[commanding] If this is true, then we must stop them, <name>. [urgent] We must deny them their source of venom.
quest_1134_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, <name>? [commanding] We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
quest_1134_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.

[warm] Your heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
quest_1135_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As you may know, wyverns are often tamed by orcs for use as mounts. [solemn] But what is less known is that the venom of a wyvern, in some circles, is more valuable than the beast itself. [urgent] So if you're not afraid to do a little wyvern hunting, then... [pause] I have a job for you.

[commanding] There is a place called Highperch in the land of a Thousand Needles, west of here. [emphasis] The Highperch wyverns have a potent venom. [emphasis] Potent, and valuable.
quest_1135_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find Highperch, <name>? [urgent] Any luck with the wyverns there?
quest_1135_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, most of these are nearly bursting with venom, <name>. [solemn] Such are normally only gathered from young wyverns, or fertile females. [shocked] It must have been quite a slaughter up there in Highperch!
quest_1136_quest_detail:
<name>, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands. [solemn] You are ready.

You now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains. [soft voice] He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home. [pause] He rarely shows himself.

But I will show you how to entice a creature such as he. Here, take this scroll. [solemn] On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.

Now go, <name>. [urgent] Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting. [solemn] When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.
quest_1136_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, <name>? [urgent] Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?
quest_1136_quest_complete:
[solemn] Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, <name>. [warm] You have both.

[solemn] Your path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac. [solemn] It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.
quest_1137_quest_detail:
[excited] Indurium has an amazing resistance to heat! [soft voice] I'm sure it will work for Fizzle's pistons. But he'll need true indurium ore, not just the flakes.

[solemn] To get the ore, it must be mined from deep within Uldaman, on the northern borders of the Badlands. [solemn] That is the true source of indurium.

[warm] Send Fizzle Brassbolts my regards, and tell him what I told you.

[urgent] Safe travels, <name>. [soft voice] And it won't surprise me if we meet again -- once Fizzle learns of indurium he'll probably send you to Uldaman to acquire it!
quest_1137_quest_complete:
<name>, you're back! [excited] You found Martek? You spoke with him? What did he say? Can he help??

[urgent] Tell me, tell me, tell me!!
quest_1138_quest_detail:
[excited] I love crab. Crabs are the fruit of the sea! [warm] You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it. They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried. [pause] There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab. [hesitant] That's... that's about it.

[sad] I'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks. [urgent] You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers. [confident] You can make a lot with it. [soft voice] You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
quest_1138_quest_progress:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab. That's about it.

Oh, hello there <name>. [urgent] Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
quest_1138_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need. [warm] Thanks <name>! [delight] I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it. [soft voice] Maybe you can do something with it. [sad] It sure don't make any good crab dishes.

[chuckling] I told you all about crabs, right?
quest_1139_quest_detail:
[solemn] We've slowed the Shadowforge clan by cutting them off from Blackrock Spire, but Hammertoe's quest is still unfulfilled. [urgent] His death must not be in vain. [soft voice] He dreamt of finding the Tablet of Will: a stone shard inscribed with magic by the titans themselves to help imbue their creations with life--making them have a will of their own, or so the legends say.

[solemn] We must still recover the Tablet before the Shadowforge clan finds it.

[commanding] Return to Uldaman, find the tablet, and return here immediately.
quest_1139_quest_progress:
[solemn] Hammertoe's quest must be actualized, <name>. [low voice] I owe him that much.

[urgent] Your return to Uldaman is imperative not only to that goal, but also to the safety of all dwarven kind. [threatening] With the tablet in the hands of the Dark Irons who knows how powerful their army of golems would become.
quest_1139_quest_complete: <Advisor Belgrum shakes his head in disbelief as you hand him the stone shard.> <name>, [excited] this is amazing. [solemn] I shall have this brought to the king's mages as soon as possible. [soft voice] They will want to study it to find out if the legends are true. [pause] But that is a discussion for another time: you have aided our people more than I would have ever expected--[warm] thank you.
quest_1140_quest_detail:
[solemn] The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. [soft voice] Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my enemies.

[emphasis] From Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast Ashenvale.

[urgent] Be careful out there, <name>, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned <class> such as yourself.
quest_1140_quest_progress: [soft voice] I heard whisper once that the satyrs' history is somehow related to that of the night elves, but I have found my esteemed hosts reticent to speak of the matter.
quest_1140_quest_complete:
[solemn] Perhaps the satyrs have been allowed to persist in the forest for too long. [soft voice] I will speak with Elissa about it when next I travel to Auberdine.

[emphasis] Nonetheless, with the soulgems destroyed, Athrikus' power will be greatly diminished. [urgent] We must seize on this opportunity to eliminate him and his cult.
quest_1141_quest_detail:
I love fishing. [soft voice] The Blump family is known for fishing. My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper. I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in. [angry] I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.

Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper? [excited] I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did! It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
quest_1141_quest_progress:
[soft voice] There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for. [pause] They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

[excited] You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
quest_1141_quest_complete:
[excited] Them's some real nice groupers, <name>! [warm] Thanks for helping me out!

[proud] You're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump. [chuckling] She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing. [confident] I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.
quest_1142_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have not long to live... so... so... weak.

...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...

But before I... d-d-die...

...my wife, Treshala... her pendant of bonding to me... stolen... by one of the f-f-foul aggressors...

Find it p-p-please... and return it to Treshala in Darnassus...

...along with w-w-word of my lonely... death.
quest_1142_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to my home, <race>?
quest_1142_quest_complete:
No!

'Tis not fair. [sad] Oh, cruel and intolerable world!

[solemn] I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.

[soft voice] You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, <name>. [gentle] But please leave me now.

In solitude I shall mourn.
quest_1143_quest_detail: [solemn] I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. [commanding] I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
quest_1143_quest_progress: [solemn] Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. [soft voice] Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.
quest_1143_quest_complete: With the death of Athrikus, [solemn] I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. [soft voice] I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.
quest_1144_quest_detail:
[excited] At last, help has arrived!

[urgent] You have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. [sad] I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.

[soft voice] You see, I am an entrepreneur. [low voice] Always out for a copper, as they say. [urgent] I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Redleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. [hesitant] I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. [angry] As you can see, I was a bit wrong!

[soft voice] Anyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
quest_1144_quest_complete: [excited] Thanks again, friend! [warm] I told you I'd make it worth your while.
quest_1145_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. [soft voice] I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.

[urgent] I need a courier to travel to Orgrimmar to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. [low voice] It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.

[commanding] Belgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.
quest_1145_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I envy you, <class>. You have the look of someone who's been outside the walls of Orgrimmar for a while.

[low voice] I myself would travel in the name of the Warchief if Thrall didn't have need of my skills here in the city. But he leads us well, and I trust his judgement--I remain here for as long as he needs me.
quest_1145_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, a note from Korran. [soft voice] He has been a loyal servant for some time now. [pause] I was wondering how his duties were going in the Crossroads.
quest_1146_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.

[soft voice] A few days ago a hunter returned to me from Thousand Needles nearly dead. [low voice] He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. [solemn] During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.

[urgent] They were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. [commanding] Bring him this note.
quest_1146_quest_progress: [commanding] War brings my group and I to the Shimmering Flats, <class>. [soft voice] What brings you here?
quest_1146_quest_complete:
[solemn] Don't mind the thundering echoes off the mountains' walls. [urgent] The goblins and gnomes are out among the Flats racing one another in atrocities created by what they call science. [solemn] There are bigger threats here in Thousand Needles, one of which killed more than half my war party.

[pause] But we remain here until we hear word from Belgrom in Orgrimmar. [commanding] Until then, we hold our position here, and stay vigilant.
quest_1147_quest_detail:
Hmm. [sigh] Seems Belgrom thinks those monsters are a threat. He wants them pushed back into whatever depths they crawled up out of.

I guess killing the dwarves sent by the Explorers' League wasn't enough--now I have to send a half-dead war party into another battle. [angry] We won't be able to do it ourselves; not while we're in this condition. The dig site's to the south of here. There shouldn't be anymore dwarves to deal with. [low voice] Feel up to wielding a blade or staff and doing your part to aid us?
quest_1147_quest_progress: [urgent] With the amount of travelers heading out to the Flats for those races, I'm sure we can convince enough adventure seekers to help push back those insects. [commanding] My party and I won't be able to leave until we do.
quest_1147_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ha! That ichor you're covered in actually makes you prettier, <name>! It certainly does make you reek at the same time though. Don't stand too close to the kodo; you'll either start a stampede or cause them to go into heat.

I think my companions would agree that your smell alone is proof you've done your part to help us against those insect creatures. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_1148_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You inspect the carapace carefully. [pause] As you turn it over in your hands you realize that the chitinous plating is interlaced in such a way that makes it incredibly strong. [solemn] It's unlike anything you've ever seen. [pause] You inspect the rest of the corpse further and realize that these creatures are very powerful and highly evolved.

[pause] Looking down at the carapace again, you think that Korran would enjoy studying more of these creatures. [warm] It could help him figure out what these creatures are, and where they come from.
quest_1148_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, it been a long time since you've come to see me, <name>. [soft voice] What can I do for you today? [low voice] You be looking like you've seen the face of battle recently. [pause] Good... good for the Horde and good for you. [emphasis] The more battle you've seen, the more helpful you'll be; stronger, too.
quest_1148_quest_complete:
Ahh, you've seen Moktar recently? He always be lookin' out for me. [soft voice] I'm sorry to hear he spends his time watching over his little war band instead of seeing battle, but I'm sure he be takin' great joy in killing members of the Explorers' League.

[warm] You be smart to bring me these specimens, <name>. [solemn] Along with the eggs we be findin' in the Field of Giants, these should give me a good start in figuring out what these insects are, and what they be wantin'.
quest_1149_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.

Many facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. [soft voice] If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.

If you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.

The first is a Test of Faith.
quest_1149_quest_progress:
[solemn] Faith. It is far more important than some realize.

[soft voice] It does not matter what you believe sometimes. It is just important that you believe in something.
quest_1149_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. [soft voice] You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. [warm] Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.

[proud] If you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.
quest_1150_quest_detail:
[solemn] I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. [commanding] Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
quest_1150_quest_progress:
[solemn] You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

[pause] Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. [soft voice] I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.
quest_1150_quest_complete:
Grenka was powerful, even by troll standards. [proud] You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.

[solemn] During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
quest_1151_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. [pause] When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.

[soft voice] There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. [solemn] One such elemental is Rok'Alim.

[commanding] To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
quest_1151_quest_progress: [solemn] Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.
quest_1151_quest_complete: [solemn] The Test of Strength is done. [warm] You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
quest_1152_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. [soft voice] There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.

[pause] If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. [emphasis] He will test you further, so heed his words, <name>.

[pause] When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, <name>, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
quest_1152_quest_complete:
[solemn] The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.

Now you stand before Braug.
quest_1153_quest_detail:
<class>, you have done well in helping me in the past. [solemn] The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. [proud] My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

[urgent] Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. [soft voice] There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. [commanding] I want a sample of that ore to examine.
quest_1153_quest_progress:
[angry] I saw the travelers again - the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. [low voice] I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

[threatening] May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
quest_1153_quest_complete:
[commanding] A good sample, <name>. [commanding] A good sample indeed.

[solemn] Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

[urgent] I shall get to work on it immediately. [confident] If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

[warm] I shall not forget your help, <class>.
quest_1154_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. [solemn] Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. [soft voice] It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.

[pause] I shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.

[emphasis] What book, you must be asking? [soft voice] The Legacy of the Aspects. [pause] It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
quest_1154_quest_progress: [solemn] Bring me the book after you've studied it. [pause] I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.
quest_1154_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is the book I named. [soft voice] There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.

[pause] When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
quest_1159_quest_detail:
[gentle] Well done, <name>. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. [solemn] But that question is not mine to ask.

[urgent] Seek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. [soft voice] He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. [solemn] Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.

[warm] He will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.
quest_1159_quest_complete:
[solemn] Braug sent you? Impossible.

<Parqual looks you up and down.>

[solemn] Braved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! [angry] You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... <class>.
quest_1160_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. [low voice] Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.

[urgent] Go to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.

[commanding] Bring it to me.
quest_1160_quest_progress:
I hope you made the Scarlet Crusade suffer some before stealing the book from them.

[angry] My views of their kind are not unwarranted. [solemn] The Crusade may have been followers of the Light at one time, but now, they seek to destroy any creatures that have not sided with their religion. [cold] They believe all undead, Forsaken or otherwise, must be cleansed, and those traveling in their lands must either be insane, or subject to the undead's powerful magics. [low voice] Idiots. [angry] Idiots and fools; all of them.
quest_1160_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is the book I sent you to search for.

<Parqual slowly caresses his hand over the top of the book as he stares down at it.>

[soft voice] So now you wish a question to prove your mind is as powerful as your body and spirit. [urgent] If you have studied the book long enough, then I shall ask you your question and you can be done with these tests!
quest_1164_quest_detail:
[angry] The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. [sad] Forsaken indeed! My family is gone, taken by the plague. [solemn] Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. [angry] And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

[low voice] I don't care about the things they stole any more. [commanding] What I want now are their heads!

[urgent] Kill them for me! [commanding] Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
quest_1164_quest_progress: [commanding] Kill them all and bring me their heads!
quest_1164_quest_complete:
[solemn] You stand before me as a figure of vengeance, and I bow down before you in thanks.

[warm] With that cow's death, and knowing that their seed will no longer spread over the face of Azeroth, I can put my energy into something more lucrative. [excited] I hope you looted their farmstead after you finished them off.
quest_1167_quest_detail: [solemn] Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. [soft voice] I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.
quest_1167_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, it's good to see you again, <name>! [warm] The strangest things have been happening around here, I'm glad you showed up!

[soft voice] It was very strange, <name>. Everything seemed normal--well, as normal as things get around here--and then suddenly there was a blinding flash of light from the upper room of the tower. [solemn] Then came the screams. [solemn] The cries split the air, and lightning struck the ground from time to time. [urgent] What's going on?
quest_1175_quest_detail:
[solemn] After the big crash with the goblins' Red Thunder racer and a basilisk, Kronkrider hired me on to take care of the track. I don't know what all the animals out on the flats are feeding on to grow so big, but we have to be careful to thin them out so they won't wander onto the track when a race is going on.

[soft voice] Tell you what. [urgent] If you want to go out and make a little profit, go out and remove the basilisks from the area.
quest_1175_quest_progress: [angry] It's bad enough having to clear out the wreckage of the racers without having to pick them out of burnt animal parts.
quest_1175_quest_complete: [soft voice] I hope you didn't kill any of the basilisks on the tracks themselves! [pause] It takes a long time for the carcasses to decay in the sun, and I'd rather not have to take a shovel out to clean up.
quest_1176_quest_detail:
[excited] When it comes to racing, every bit counts! Whether it's a minor tweaking on the power output, a slight slackening on the tension coils, or lightening the weight of the frame, you have to take everything into account.

We use vulture bones for a lot of the minor structural tweaks we make to our racers, which offer the perfect balance of strength and weight. Even better, it's easy for us to get more, as the salt flats are littered with vultures.

[urgent] Bring me some and I'll give you a good price on them.
quest_1176_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have those bones for me? [low voice] I was just about to start working on lightening the steering rig, but I don't want to open her up without all the parts I need.
quest_1176_quest_complete: [excited] Great! [urgent] I can get the crew working on this right away. [warm] Thanks, <name>!
quest_1178_quest_detail:
[excited] Our racing team is the pride of goblins everywhere. [soft voice] You'd be surprised at some of the people who contribute in one way or another to our team.

You know Gazlowe? He tracks down parts from around the world for us. He even came down to work on one of our rigs once!

[urgent] A few weeks ago, he said he'd send us a new prototype fuel regulator but it hasn't come yet. [hesitant] He's usually very prompt... [urgent] Maybe you wouldn't mind going to Ratchet to ask him about it? [urgent] I wouldn't be so pushy, but the gnomes are gaining on us!
quest_1179_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You ever heard of the Shimmering Flats? It's a stretch of salt flats way over in Kalimdor, just south of the Thousand Needles canyon. [solemn] It's a great place for racing because, well, it's so flat!

[excited] A couple of gnome brothers are out there, friends of mine, trying out their new rocket car, and from what I hear it's fast! [laughing] Heh, so fast that their pilots keep crashing. [sad] Giving themselves concussions.

[urgent] So they asked me for some Siege Engine helmets, but I have duties here. [hesitant] I can't make the trip!

[commanding] Can you?
quest_1179_quest_progress: [urgent] Watch where you're stepping! [urgent] Watch watch watch!! [soft voice] This is delicate stuff you see here, and if we're to win then it must all work perfectly!
quest_1179_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! Longbeard sent you with a load of helmets! [delight] Hooray! [excited] Now maybe we can talk a pilot into driving our car...
quest_1180_quest_complete:
[urgent] Shipments to Ratchet? Let me just check the logbooks...

[pause] No, the most recent shipment I have on record of going out to Ratchet were boots from Drizzlik. [low voice] Hasn't been much else, other than building supplies and tools. [angry] Definitely no race parts.
quest_1181_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm afraid I can't be of much more help to you, <name>. [pause] If you'd like to follow up on it more, I'd suggest you go hit up the Baron himself. [low voice] If there's anyone who knows Revilgaz's business, it's Revilgaz.

[pause] You'll find him at the tavern across the harbor, top floor.
quest_1181_quest_complete: [commanding] Oh, sure of course I know what you're talking about. [sad] Nope, can't help you though. Some of my men were supposed to go track down the blueprints for the fuel regulator, but they came back empty-handed.
quest_1182_quest_detail:
[soft voice] See, the Venture Company shredders out in Lake Nazferiti (in northern Stranglethorn) have been equipped with a new model fuel regulator. [low voice] I was thinking that Pozzik would be able to take advantage of it, if he could get some details. [hesitant] Unfortunately, Cozzle, the foreman out there, appears to be a little more clever than I gave him credit for.

[urgent] You seem like you might have more luck finding the blueprints though. [solemn] I know he keeps them in his house, but they're almost certainly under lock and key.
quest_1182_quest_progress: [hesitant] Much as I hate to admit it, [commanding] that gnome team they have out there is pretty good. [urgent] Our boys need every edge they can get.
quest_1182_quest_complete: [soft voice] Now, let me just get a copy of these blueprints for my own notes and you can bring these straight to Pozzik. [pause] Wouldn't want him to think that one of his sponsors was abandoning him.
quest_1183_quest_detail: [soft voice] You should be all set to go. [gentle] Give Pozzik my regards and tell him that if he ever needs anything, not to hesitate to ask. [excited] I'll be waiting for the news that he breaks the track record soon!
quest_1183_quest_progress: <name>! [urgent] Did you manage to track down the fuel regulator?
quest_1183_quest_complete: [soft voice] I was hoping that it would be already assembled, but this does present the unique opportunity to improve on the design from the ground up. [warm] Thanks, <name>. [excited] I'll be able to sketch up some improved schematics, build the thing, and have it installed real soon.
quest_1184_quest_detail: [urgent] Head back to Belgrom in Orgrimmar and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the Thousand Needles. [soft voice] Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. [solemn] That should please him greatly.
quest_1184_quest_complete:
[solemn] I'm appreciative of your efforts, <class>. [warm] The warchief will enjoy hearing how tenacious you have been in your duties.

[soft voice] Oh, of course I will mention your name to him. [confident] He speaks to me often and values my opinions greatly.

[commanding] Go now, I have much to do. [urgent] And if you speak to Korran soon, and he has news of these creatures, then return to me--I would think they are a threat that must be taken seriously.
quest_1185_quest_complete:
[excited] Hey, it's you again! [warm] Well, I mean you - as in the you that is <name>! [excited] Yes - that you!

[laughing] Hey, let me start over!

[solemn] That object you found in Silithus - it was in fact a book. [soft voice] It was a journal written in a very ancient dialect of what we now call the Darnassian tongue. [pause] It'll take a while, but I'm going to go over it very thoroughly. [warm] I thought you should know that what you found was extremely valuable for the Circle.

[excited] The den mother's all excited and everything!
quest_1186_quest_detail:
[urgent] I'm going to be busy with working on integrating this new fuel regulator to our racer designs, but if you'd like to help out the team some more, talk to Razzeric. He's our pilot--well, our eighteenth pilot, to be exact--and he likes to add his own little modifications to the racers.

[mocking tone] He's a little off his rocker, though, so try not to act too surprised.
quest_1186_quest_complete:
[gentle] You're the <race> that's been helping Pozzik out, right? [soft voice] I was like you once, running around the pit area, helping with whatever work the mechanics would let me do.

[excited] Now look at me! [proud] The goblin racing team's pilot extraordinaire!
quest_1187_quest_detail:
Pozzik's a great mechanic, I know that, but he's afraid to just load on the firepower and grab on for the ride. Not me, though.

After Pozzik finishes with a racer, I take a little time to put my own modifications on--you know, loosening up the controls, removing parts of the frame, and adding more juice!

[urgent] I ordered a seaforium booster from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan, but apparently the zeppelin it was being sent on crashed in Dustwallow Marsh! I gotta have it, <name>!
quest_1187_quest_progress: [urgent] How'm I supposed to show my face around the track without a little extra kick to get me going? [sad] It's a travesty, I tell you.
quest_1187_quest_complete: [excited] Just take a look at this beauty! Fifteen pounds of solid seaforium power! [proud] Once I get this strapped on to the side of my racer, I'll be around the track so fast I'll beat the gnomes twice!
quest_1188_quest_detail:
[urgent] But wait, what's this? [angry] Shreev left the safety on. That will limit the amount of power I can draw from the booster at any time. [angry] I told him I wanted it off! [groan] This is no good.

[commanding] You have to take this to the Gadgetzan Gizmorium in the Tanaris Desert and have Shreev remove this.
quest_1188_quest_progress: [excited] As I'm sure you know, the Gizmorium can service all of your tinkering needs! [soft voice] How can I help you?
quest_1188_quest_complete: [low voice] Only Razzeric would take a look at this and say that I'd somehow put some sort of safety lock on it. [sigh] This booster is almost completely seaforium explosives. [urgent] I already modified it so that more of its payload would be delivered upon use, but Razzeric is never content unless he goes to eleven!
quest_1189_quest_detail:
[low voice] There, I did what Razzeric wanted. [whispering] Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.

[sigh] Would be a shame, too, if that happened. [mocking tone] Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?
quest_1189_quest_progress: [angry] Can you believe Pozzik put a bucket of sand on the racer? How am I supposed to hit my maximum speed with a bucket of sand under the seat?
quest_1189_quest_complete:
[excited] Now that's more like it! [laughing] I wish I could see the look on the gnomes' eyes when they see me set this baby off.

[mocking tone] Too bad I'll be too busy pulling off a new course record!
quest_1190_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Brassbolts brothers have discovered a new building material, that's the only explanation that makes sense. [low voice] Their cars have been operating faster than before, but their designs, and all the other data we've gathered from their runs is identical.

[pause] What we do know, is that Rizzle Brassbolts has been focused on the plans for this new discovery almost constantly.

[commanding] Zamek can create a diversion for you, so that you can steal those plans from them.
quest_1190_quest_complete: [urgent] Scribbled in a hasty, hurried hand, a scroll of notes and designs for the refinement of some raw material.
quest_1192_quest_progress:
[urgent] I'd like to integrate indurium into different parts of our racers, but I need large amounts of raw indurium to create these parts.

You can find indurium ore in the Uldaman excavation in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan.

The gnomes are getting their own supply of it, so it's important we get our own to keep pace with them. [commanding] Indurium Ore(4)
quest_1192_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [urgent] I'll get the crew to work right away on the parts we'll need for the next race.
quest_1194_quest_detail: [solemn] Rizzle's schematics describe the process of the refinement of indurium ore. [soft voice] From his scrawls, it is apparent that indurium ore is being obtained from the dwarven excavation site of Uldaman in the Badlands.
quest_1195_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

[soft voice] We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

[pause] To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. [emphasis] There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
quest_1195_quest_progress: [solemn] Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. [soft voice] He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
quest_1195_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. [warm] Could you deliver this to him? [soft voice] You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
quest_1196_quest_detail:
[solemn] Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. [soft voice] You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

[hesitant] I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
quest_1196_quest_progress: [hesitant] I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
quest_1196_quest_complete: [solemn] Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. [soft voice] Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.
quest_1197_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. [pause] It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

[urgent] You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. [solemn] The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
quest_1197_quest_progress: [excited] I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. [urgent] Have you taken it yet?
quest_1197_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.

[warm] My thanks, <name>. [solemn] Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.
quest_1198_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's Hammer and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of Ashenvale.

[soft voice] My role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.

[pause] It has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. [low voice] Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.

My other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.

[urgent] Seek out and aid Thaelrid for me, <name>.
quest_1198_quest_complete: [solemn] Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. [soft voice] There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.
quest_1199_quest_detail:
[solemn] Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods the members of the Twilight's Hammer strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.

[soft voice] We believe that the Twilight's Hammer has allied with the naga and are amassing in Blackfathom Deeps on the coast of Ashenvale.

[urgent] Whatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.

[commanding] Wage war on the Hammer and bring back proof of your deeds. [warm] Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.
quest_1199_quest_progress:
[solemn] Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. [whispering] Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.

[urgent] Have you made any progress in ridding their presence?
quest_1199_quest_complete: [solemn] You are no doubt of brave and noble blood, <name>. [warm] The Argent Dawn commends you for your efforts against evil.
quest_1200_quest_detail:
[low voice] Strength has left me. [urgent] Your help is needed!

[solemn] Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

[threatening] Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

[commanding] The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. [solemn] The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

[urgent] Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, <name>, please.
quest_1200_quest_progress:
[solemn] Time is a precious commodity, <class>.

[soft voice] My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

[commanding] State your business quickly or be on your way.
quest_1200_quest_complete:
[sad] Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.

[solemn] It seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. [pause] For some time we considered him dead or missing.

[solemn] But this makes perfect sense. [warm] By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.

[shocked] By the light! [angry] To sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!

[proud] You have done a great deed, <name>. [warm] I salute you on behalf of the Argent Dawn.
quest_1201_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Horde and Alliance hold an uneasy truce. [urgent] Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the Horde is on top!

[commanding] Now is the chance to do just that.

[urgent] Alliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village. [solemn] They spy on the village and report our movements to Theramore, which we cannot allow.

[commanding] Hunt down the infiltrators and slay them. [shouting] Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!
quest_1201_quest_complete: [commanding] Good work. [proud] Their infiltrators are skilled, but they're not good enough to escape the watchful eye of the Horde!
quest_1202_quest_detail:
<name>, two of our spies were sent to steal documents from a ship at the Theramore docks. [solemn] They gained the papers but were discovered, and were forced to throw the documents into the sea.

[sad] One spy later escaped, but was unable to recover the prize. [low voice] He reported his failure to me, and I now charge the task to you.

[commanding] The documents are in a footlocker, in the waters somewhere beneath the Theramore docks. [urgent] Find those documents, <name>, and bring them to me.
quest_1202_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the documents, <name>? [solemn] They hold information vital to the stability of the Alliance and, hence, vital to the security of the Horde.
quest_1202_quest_complete: [solemn] I commend you, <name>. [soft voice] This was not an easy mission. [warm] But the documents you gained are valued greatly by our superiors.
quest_1203_quest_detail:
[low voice] I have cutting to do. I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade. [emphasis] A certain blade...

Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword. I call it a swing blade.

You help me? Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.

[urgent] But don't sleep on this. [whispering] What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
quest_1203_quest_complete:
[soft voice] That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. [warm] Thank you. [warm] Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! [excited] Now I want to try it....

[pause] Later. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... [warm] thanks.
quest_1204_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm working on a dish I call "Mudrock Soup and Bugs." [hesitant] I still need the major ingredients, and... well, I don't think I'd last long trudging through Dustwallow Marsh!

So, <name>, can you do some hunting for me? First, I need the tongues of Mudrock turtles. You can find Mudrocks along the coast, mostly around the bay.

But I don't want just any tongues! [whispering] I hear that the tongues of some Mudrocks are forked...

They say the forked tongues have a distinct flavor, and I want that flavor in my dish...
quest_1204_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get the forked tongues?
quest_1204_quest_complete:
[excited] These will do fine! [warm] Thank you, <name>!

[soft voice] Now I'll try different cooking techniques on these tongues to find the best way to bring out their flavor.

[solemn] Eventually I'll have a dish worthy of serving at the Blue Recluse in Stormwind!
quest_1205_quest_detail:
[solemn] Deadmire is an ancient crocolisk in Dustwallow marsh. And it is his time to die.

Old bones grind as he pulls his huge body through the swamp, and although he still moves with the strength and speed of youth, his aging body tortures the great spirit within it, a spirit whose flame will not waver.

[sad] Yet now he lives in constant, maddening pain. [urgent] You must end the life of this noble creature, <name>. [soft voice] You must lead Deadmire to peace.
quest_1205_quest_progress: [solemn] Do you have the tooth of Deadmire, <name>? [soft voice] Have you ended the creature's suffering?
quest_1205_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good, <name>.

[warm] I am sure the hunt was not easy, but it is good to know the beast's pain has finally ended.
quest_1206_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Eye juice is good juice for drinking. [hesitant] Too bad most critters only have two eyes.

But spiders have lots of eyes. [emphasis] Lots and lots. And Darkmist eye juice is tasty. [warm] Smooth and salty! [excited] Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.

[solemn] Darkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern. [mocking tone] You figure the spiders are named after the cave... or is it the other way around?
quest_1206_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the eyes! You got the eyes! [delight] Tasty, tasty spider eyes!

[soft voice] Some eyes... when you stare at them they stare back. Eat those last. They keep you company... out in the swamp.

[warm] Hello, little spider eyes. [excited] Hello! [mocking tone] You taste like chicken. [laughing] Gooey, salty chicken!

[inhale] Mmmh.
quest_1218_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I like cooking. Good swamp cooking. Fried green frog legs and the like.

And for cooking, I need spice. [solemn] Soothing spice. Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.

[warm] Do you like stew?
quest_1218_quest_progress: [soft voice] Spice. We could all use some spice in our life. [hesitant] You agree?
quest_1218_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, that's the spice! [warm] Now here's some swampy good stew.
quest_1219_quest_detail: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. [solemn] And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. [soft voice] And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
quest_1220_quest_detail:
[commanding] Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, <name>. [solemn] He knows the orcish language better than most. [urgent] And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!

[soft voice] The captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.
quest_1220_quest_complete: [urgent] A report from an orc spy! [angry] How did you find this? [commanding] No matter -- let's see what it says...
quest_1221_quest_detail:
[excited] Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! [soft voice] But they're rare, very rare. [solemn] The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

[urgent] And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! [confident] That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. [soft voice] They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

[commanding] It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
quest_1221_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, you got them! [excited] I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!

[warm] Thanks for the delivery, <name>! [proud] You are a great partner.
quest_1222_quest_detail:
[excited] Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!

[urgent] I need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, buddy.

[soft voice] The cook Morgan Stern is researching a new recipe, and he sent me out here to gather bogbean leaves. I guess he thinks they're tasty.

Anyway, while looking for a bogbean plant... [shocked] I got myself surrounded! [urgent] Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for the bogbean?
quest_1222_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you seen Mr. Ignatz? [sad] I sent him into the swamp some time ago and he hasn't returned!
quest_1222_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Mr. Ignatz was just here with the bogbean leaves, and he told me you helped him out of some real trouble.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] I will ask my uncle to treat you to a feast the next time you visit the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.
quest_1238_quest_detail: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
quest_1239_quest_detail: [solemn] Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck. [sad] His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
quest_1239_quest_progress: [commanding] You have another matter to report, <name>?
quest_1239_quest_complete: [solemn] This is the head of Marg Nighteye! [sad] As I feared, he is dead.
quest_1240_quest_detail:
[urgent] We must know the events surrounding Marg's death! [solemn] And the only way to do that, <name>, is through the witch-magic of trolls.

[commanding] Bring Marg's head to Kin'weelay in Stranglethorn Vale, at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

[solemn] Kin'weelay is the most powerful witchdoctor of the Darkspear trolls. [soft voice] If anyone can speak to Marg Nighteye's spirit, it is he.
quest_1240_quest_progress: [solemn] There is an angry spirit about you, brother. [soft voice] What brings you to Kin'weelay?
quest_1240_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, I now see. The spirit of this orc is bound in our world, boiling with rage from a task yet undone.

[low voice] Well, let us have words with this angry orc...
quest_1241_quest_detail:
[solemn] Recently a diplomat was sent to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. [soft voice] That diplomat never arrived.

[hesitant] I believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. [pause] The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.

[urgent] Agents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.

[soft voice] In the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. [emphasis] Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
quest_1241_quest_progress: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. [angry] I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
quest_1241_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm... <Jorgen looks up at you through squinted eyes.>

All right. I'll help ya, but not because I want to, but because I'm obligated.

[commanding] And let's get one thing straight: you're knowin' far more than you should to begin with. [whispering] Let's keep this our little secret, and don't go blabbin' at any taverns about anything you find out. [urgent] Understand?
quest_1242_quest_detail:
Take this here note to Elling Trias. [commanding] Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.

[commanding] I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, <name>: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.

[low voice] Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. [soft voice] Good luck.
quest_1242_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
quest_1242_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I'm sorry, a letter for me? [warm] Well, I'll be... [pause] not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. [gentle] Let's see what this is about.

<Elling looks up at you while he opens the letter.>

[hesitant] You look a little tense, you okay, <name>?
quest_1243_quest_detail:
[angry] Jorgen, you ol' sonuva.... So, that's how it's going to be, huh?

[sigh] All right, I can deal with that. [urgent] I hope he finds the Twisting Nether that much sooner!

[commanding] Here's what's gonna happen, <name>. [low voice] I'll start using my contacts here, but you're doing most of the footwork so I save some coin.

[soft voice] Head to Darkshire in Duskwood and find Watcher Backus--he usually patrols the north road right outside of town. [solemn] Just tell him you're looking into any Defias activity for me and he'll help you out with any information he can.
quest_1243_quest_progress:
[low voice] Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, <name>. [soft voice] Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. [hesitant] Don't try and take anything on yourself. [solemn] We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

[mocking tone] But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? [laughing] Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
quest_1243_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, Trias sent you, huh? That's a little different.

Feel free to fight whatever monstrosities come at you from the darkness. I'm sure you'll be able to handle it pretty easily if you're the type to be hanging around with the likes of him.

[pause] So, what does my friend need of me on such a gloomy day as this?
quest_1244_quest_detail:
Defias activity? Well, there's always some activity; even if they keep to themselves we consider them a threat.

But now that I think about it, there was a recent sighting that seemed odd. [hesitant] It must have been a couple weeks ago, but some of their agents had gathered around Addle's Stead. From the report, I'd guessed something big went down.

[commanding] Why don't you check there first and bring me back anything you find?

[soft voice] The farmstead is south of the road from Westfall just as you enter Duskwood.
quest_1244_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be careful out there, <name>. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
quest_1244_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You're back safe and sound. Couldn't ask for much more than that, could you?

[pause] Now, let's see what we have here. [low voice] This looks pretty official as far as any Defias documents I've seen. [hesitant] But it could be a dupe just to throw you off track of whatever it is you're looking for.
quest_1245_quest_detail:
[whispering] Whoa, this looks way too complex to be something to just lead you astray. [hesitant] I shouldn't even be looking at this stuff. Take it to Trias--he'll be able to make sense of it. [urgent] And DON'T let anyone get in your way. [solemn] This is bigger than me. It might even be bigger than him, but we'll see.

And do me a favor, <name>, don't tell anyone I helped you. [sigh] If my superiors found out I knew about any of this and didn't share it with them they'd probably hang me.
quest_1245_quest_progress: [soft voice] I see you're back, and in one piece. [commanding] We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. [urgent] Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
quest_1245_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yeah... this is an interesting read. Jorgen and DeLavey were smart to bring me in on this.

[solemn] Seems the Defias have been trying pretty hard to complete this plan of theirs. [pause] Hmm... what's this? Fist? That's a familiar name.
quest_1246_quest_detail:
Yeah, now that I think about it... [hesitant] Dashel... Dashel something... What was his name? FIST! Dashel Stonefist. They call him Fist in some circles--probably on account that he likes to get in brawls.

You can find him in Old Town usually--right smack dab in the center of it. [commanding] Go talk to him. If you have to, use a sword or something heavy and blunt to persuade him to open up some. And don't hesitate. If he's in this as deep as these papers suggest, then he's not going to give you any information willingly.
quest_1246_quest_complete:
[angry] What?!

You come into me alley and ask questions about me personal business? Business which you obviously have nothing to do with.
quest_1247_quest_detail: [hesitant] So yeah... um... I might know something 'bout that meeting at Addle's Stead. Happened a few weeks back I think. [sad] I really didn't have any part in it. Me part was done when plan A failed... [angry] damn adventurers. [solemn] The guy we got on the inside for plan B came out of Menethil; guy called Slim. That's all I know regarding their backup plan.
quest_1247_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Good to see you're still alive, <name>. [warm] So, it went well with Dashel then, huh?

[solemn] I've been reading up more on this plan of theirs, and although it doesn't state the name of the diplomat they were after, it does talk about this plan B they enacted after failing on their first attempt to capture him.

[hesitant] This Slim that Dashel mentioned doesn't have any other name written here, but if you say he's in Menethil, then that's a start.
quest_1248_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A contact of mine retired in the Wetlands at the harbor city of Menethil. He should be willing to help on your word alone if you tell him you're working for me. His name is Mikhail. He mentioned becoming a bartender before leaving Stormwind a few years ago.

[urgent] Speak to him, find this Slim, and find out if there's anything else to know about this kidnapped diplomat. We need to find out where they've taken him, or at least who he is. The docket doesn't mention anything about their plans after he's captured.
quest_1248_quest_complete:
[excited] Welcome, welcome, welcome, <name>. [warm] Good of you to join us. [warm] Perhaps an ale today? Or some mutton?

[warm] Name your pleasure and I'll see to it that you're taken care of. [soft voice] My name is Mikhail, and I look forward to serving you.

[hesitant] Hmm? What's that? [whispering] Trias? [whispering] Keep your voice down, my friend. [whispering] This isn't something for the whole tavern to hear about.
quest_1249_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You say Elling sent you here? Well then, the hospitality I expressed is now tenfold. Anything you need, just ask. I will do my best to aid you.

Hmm, Slim, you say? Not sure the name sounds familiar, but I'll keep my eyes out for him.

[urgent] Don't look now, <name>, but the gentleman over by the exit is looking over here. He's listening to our conversation a little too intently if you catch my meaning? [commanding] If I were you, I'd do what you can to subdue him before he makes a break for the door.
quest_1249_quest_progress: [hesitant] Did he slip away? [low voice] He looked a little shady the way he was watching us.
quest_1249_quest_complete:
[excited] Caught him, huh? [warm] Good for you. [surprised] I'm surprised that was Slim.

[soft voice] I'll be honest, I never thought I'd miss the excitement of some of the more devious underground activities. [hesitant] I guess old habits die hard. [whispering] Don't mention that to Elling--he'd probably try and get me to come back to Stormwind if he heard I missed the action.

[gentle] I'm glad I could at least be of a little service to you while you were in Menethil. [confident] If you need anything else, just ask.
quest_1250_quest_detail:
[low voice] The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. [angry] They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. [emphasis] He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. [hesitant] But it's not just the Defias that are involved. [sigh] They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.

[soft voice] My part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was in the harbor. [sad] The guy's name was Hendel. [emphasis] That's all I know. [urgent] I swear!
quest_1250_quest_complete:
[shouting] THE KING?! [soft voice] I mean... the king? [excited] The real king? [surprised] Are you joking? [urgent] You didn't mention you were looking for the king's kidnappers. [hesitant] I didn't even hear he was missing--that would explain his son being crowned some.

[urgent] I'll send word to Elling right away. [solemn] He'll want to know you're on the trail.

[sad] I would never have guessed Jahn would sell out Stormwind for some lousy coin. [solemn] Even a rogue's got to have honor when it comes to some things.

[urgent] The key now is to find this Hendel. [confident] And I think I can help with that.
quest_1251_quest_detail: [solemn] An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.
quest_1252_quest_detail: [soft voice] A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.
quest_1253_quest_detail: [solemn] An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.
quest_1258_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Another component of my new recipe is the shelled leg of a giant crab. And the crabs they have in Dustwallow -- Muckshells they call them -- just won't do! [angry] I'm afraid the only suitable crabs live far away, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

The shell of the crab leg is a key element of the dish's presentation so I need pristine, unscarred legs. An adult crab might only have one or two such legs, and I need a lot in order to research my dish.

[hesitant] So, <name>... are you willing to travel?
quest_1258_quest_progress: [soft voice] My research with the Mudrock tongues is progressing nicely. [hesitant] I trust your crab hunt goes well?
quest_1258_quest_complete: [soft voice] These are wonderful specimens, <name>! [warm] The shells are in perfect condition, and the meat is pink and tender. [proud] The blood of a chef is in your veins, I'm sure of it!
quest_1259_quest_detail:
[solemn] I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. [soft voice] Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. [low voice] He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.

[gentle] He should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
quest_1259_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] You'd like information about a specific member of the Theramore guard? [soft voice] Reethe, was it?

[pause] Just give me a moment to find the right book.
quest_1260_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm developing a new menu for the restaurant. It will be filled with rural dishes with a "bayou" theme. [excited] I think my clientele at the Blue Recluse will love them!

[solemn] I sent my nephew Morgan to Theramore, a city on the edge of the Dustwallow Marsh. [urgent] He's there gathering recipes from the locals, and I must know what he found so far.

[sad] The trip to Theramore is long. Too long for me. [confident] But I bet a young <class> like yourself would jump at the chance to travel, yes?
quest_1260_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, my uncle sent you, did he?

[low voice] Well I've been researching recipes and I have some leads, but I need help.

[urgent] Help from someone willing to get his feet wet.
quest_1261_quest_detail: Cursed muckshell! [angry] You can't kill Marg! [sad] Ah, but I am dead. [solemn] So it must have slain me...
quest_1262_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is strange that the pendant Marg stole was in the hands of common soldiers. [hesitant] Perhaps its owner was in disguise, or perhaps the soldiers themselves stole it!

Regardless of which is true, this is a noble's pendant and we must discover its true owner if we are to unravel its mystery.

[urgent] Take the pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar. [solemn] He is well schooled in Alliance politics, and will know if this pendant has a history among the nobles of Stormwind.
quest_1262_quest_progress: [soft voice] You traveled from Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow? [pause] How fares Nazeer, and how fare his efforts in the marsh?
quest_1262_quest_complete:
[solemn] This pendant was crafted with great skill and precision, <name>. [sad] No orc would covet such a jewel...

But many humans would.

I will have this pendant studied. In time let us hope that its mysteries will be revealed to us.
quest_1264_quest_detail:
[solemn] The beginning of every month the Kul Tiras Marines all get paid and usually leave Theramore for somewhere else. [soft voice] A lot of them come here to womanize, carouse, and just have a good time. [pause] One of those groups I'd consider regulars here at the tavern, and I believe this Hendel is among them.

[urgent] Commander Samaul in Theramore would be able to help you find him if Hendel's still stationed there. [hesitant] He's completely loyal to Proudmoore, but if you drop Elling's name, he should help you out... discretely.
quest_1264_quest_complete:
[gentle] A pleasure to meet you, <name>. [commanding] I am Commander Samaul. I'm in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces here in Theramore.

[urgent] Although I'm quite busy, if you have any questions, please feel free to speak up. [soft voice] I might have to keep it short, but there's no reason for me to be rude if you need my help.

If you plan on traveling out of the city, I'd suggest you be careful. [solemn] Besides ogres, orcs and murlocs, the southern part of the swamp is filled with black dragons.
quest_1265_quest_detail:
Hendel? Yes, I know the man. But why would you need one of my soldiers?

Elling sent you to find him? Hmm, I don't like the sound of that. [commanding] Elling wouldn't have you come to me first if your business wasn't troubling. I understand if you can't tell me what this is about, but know this: I have a duty to protect these lands. If you're going to cause a disturbance, then I suggest you inform me of whatever you can.

I believe Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside of Theramore. [solemn] Be cautious.
quest_1265_quest_complete: [solemn] The man you seek, the one known as Hendel, is not here. [soft voice] Other sources have brought to the Lady Proudmoore information I believe you already know. [warm] She has asked me to find you, and give you aid in your venture. [gentle] If you would allow it, I will tell you where to find Private Hendel so we can bring him to justice.
quest_1266_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Private Hendel is to the west of here. He's currently on guard duty protecting some of Theramore's infiltrators while they rest. [solemn] They've been keeping tabs on the Horde base, Brackenwall, and looking for anything else that might threaten our borders.

[urgent] You should have no problem finding him; just look for the tents along the road.

[pause] I have another matter to attend to, but I shall catch up to you soon enough. [warm] You can always find me in the Lady Proudmoore's tower if you have any problems.
quest_1266_quest_complete:
Hello, citizen. [soft voice] This is a dangerous place to be wandering about. I wouldn't hang around too long if you value your life.

[urgent] If you keep your questions short, I'll see if I can help you. [commanding] Just keep your eyes open for any of those filthy ogres. [solemn] Rumor has it there's a Horde base somewhere in the swamps. [low voice] The infiltrators are doing what they can to find it, but the process has been slow going and we've had little progress.
quest_1268_quest_detail: [solemn] Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. [soft voice] There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
quest_1268_quest_complete: [solemn] Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. [soft voice] Or maybe even the centaur. [pause] Their presence in the Barrens is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act.
quest_1269_quest_detail: [soft voice] A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. [pause] Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.
quest_1270_quest_detail:
[excited] Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!!

[urgent] I need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, buddy.

[hesitant] A goblin from Ratchet named Mebok Mizzyrix needs some bogbean leaves for a potion, or something... I honestly don't care why -- his money was good and I know this swamp, so here I am.

[sad] Too bad I got myself surrounded before I found the bogbean! [urgent] Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for Mebok's plant?
quest_1270_quest_complete:
