[soft voice] Stinky was here with the herbs I ask of him, and he told me you helped him out of a bind. [excited] Good work! [warm] A friend of Stinky's is a friend of mine!

[pause] He asked me to give you this if I ever saw you, right before he walked back south toward the marsh.
quest_1271_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My nephew said you aided him with his research in Dustwallow, and that you helped his associate out of a tight spot. [warm] Well, we Sterns stick together and we don't ignore our friends!

[excited] So wash your hands, <name>, because we're about to throw a party in your honor!
quest_1273_quest_complete:
Hmph. [low voice] It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound.

[sad] It seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.
quest_1274_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, sir . Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.

[whispering] If you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. [whispering] Again, please be discreet. [solemn] It is a matter of some importance.
quest_1274_quest_complete:
[solemn] Hello, <name>. I am Bishop DeLavey.

No doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.

I'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... [urgent] and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
quest_1275_quest_detail:
[solemn] Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

[sad] I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. [solemn] Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

[soft voice] I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. [urgent] In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

[pause] 'Tis a long journey, <name>.
quest_1275_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. [soft voice] With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

[emphasis] Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
quest_1275_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have traveled far and undoubtedly faced great peril.

[soft voice] Your actions have been selfless. 'Tis for the good of all Azeroth that you help me with my research. [warm] I thank you, <name>, for all that you have done.

[pause] Now if you'll excuse me I have much work to do....
quest_1276_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before.

In thanks, the Earthen Ring awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. [warm] Very good work.

Perhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted.

[hesitant] It's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.
quest_1276_quest_progress: [gentle] Hello there, <class>. [soft voice] Something I can help you with?
quest_1276_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, you are certainly correct. [warm] This is a shield that I made.

[soft voice] I'm afraid there's not much more I can tell you though, <name>. [pause] I craft so many different shields and sets of armor, I can't keep track of them all.
quest_1282_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can't help it if I feel sorry for ol' Jim there. [hesitant] He wasn't always like that. [solemn] Ran an inn out in the marsh for a while, wonderful place.

[pause] Look, I don't really want to talk about it. [hesitant] Bring it up with Captain Vimes if you really have to.
quest_1282_quest_complete:
[solemn] James Hyal's his real name. [soft voice] He opened an inn at the edge of the Barrens. [soft voice] Wanted to make a nice place for travelers to stop over...

[soft voice] Might be he was thinking too big, but the inn did do well for a while. [sad] Then we lost control of the roads in the marsh, and the ogres took over.

[sad] James was too stubborn to give up his dream for safety within our walls, and the Shady Rest Inn was burnt to the ground. [solemn] We're investigating, but haven't had much luck. [urgent] If you want to help out, see what you can find in the rubble.
quest_1284_quest_detail: [solemn] Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. [soft voice] There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
quest_1284_quest_complete: [commanding] Hoofprints, eh? [solemn] It is true that there is an extraordinary amount of centaur activity in the lands near the Dustwallow Marsh. [soft voice] In brief excursions into the Barrens, we found their camps and holdings dotting the area.
quest_1285_quest_detail:
Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! [soft voice] Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

Joined the Theramore guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...

Listed as missing.
quest_1285_quest_complete:
[angry] Missing? That would be Tesoran's kind way of saying traitor.

[mocking tone] No doubt he's one of those fools so blindly loyal to Admiral Daelin that he turned traitor. [mocking tone] Isn't that a delicious irony? [cold] The deserters accuse us of betraying the Alliance.
quest_1286_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.

The latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.

The deserters' leader is a man named Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.

[commanding] Be warned, <name>. He may be a tough nut to crack.
quest_1286_quest_complete: [low voice] Did Vimes send you? [mocking tone] Couldn't do his dirty work himself, could he...
quest_1287_quest_detail:
[angry] Reethe? That coward?

[low voice] We threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. [solemn] We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.

[emphasis] He crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.

[urgent] Now, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?
quest_1287_quest_complete: [commanding] I will send Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point. [solemn] In addition, I will instruct him to find Reethe. [low voice] The marsh is not so big and trackless that he should be unable to find him.
quest_1288_quest_detail: [soft voice] You've done some good work, <name>, [warm] best I've seen from an amateur.
quest_1301_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before working here at the Blue Recluse, I was trained by one of the best chefs and innkeepers I'd ever met. His name was James Hyal. [soft voice] Everything I have and everywhere I've gotten in life is thanks to him.

[hesitant] I wonder how he's doing. His brother Vincent and he went to work in a tavern in Menethil Harbor, but I haven't heard from him recently.

[gentle] If you ever happen to be headed in that direction, maybe you could say hello to him for me?
quest_1301_quest_complete:
James? Oh, he left quite some time ago.

[solemn] Felt the second wind of patriotism, I suppose. [soft voice] Not hard to see why he would. [pause] With all the insanity in Lordaeron, many people joined up with Jaina Proudmoore when she went across the sea.
quest_1302_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. [warm] Damn fine cook he was.

I haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in Theramore could probably point you to him.
quest_1302_quest_complete:
[soft voice] James Hyal, James Hyal... Why does that name sound so familiar?

[solemn] Of course! The Shady Rest Inn incident. If you have any information about what happened there, I would urge you to speak with Captain Vimes about it. [commanding] He's handling the investigation.
quest_1319_quest_detail:
I'm sorry I can't be of much help, <name>, but I can refer you to someone who would be. [soft voice] Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.

[pause] Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
quest_1319_quest_progress: [soft voice] Something for me to look at?
quest_1319_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hm... interesting piece of iron you have here. [hesitant] Definitely not made by any of the blacksmiths I know over on this side of the sea, and it's certainly not my work.
quest_1320_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, I almost missed this... The leather strap on the back must have burned off, but it seems like it was made to fit a large person. [hesitant] I'd guess a tauren, actually.

That's about all I can tell you. [sad] Tell Captain Vimes I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.
quest_1320_quest_complete: [low voice] That's not much information to work on, but we'll have to keep it in mind. [pause] Hopefully some of the other pieces of this mystery will fall into place, and paint a more helpful picture of what happened.
quest_1321_quest_detail: Hmm... [hesitant] I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. [soft voice] We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...
quest_1323_quest_complete:
[hesitant] Mosarn? Sounds familiar... I can't put my finger on it. Maybe it'll come to me later.

It probably isn't important. [low voice] A shield can come from anywhere and not mean anything...
quest_1324_quest_detail: [angry] What?! You come here accusing me of allying with the Defias, and think I'll just stand here while you insult me?! [commanding] Something tells me you've had this coming for a long time.
quest_1324_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [hesitant] I hope you don't mind the assistance, but we couldn't have Hendel escaping, or worse, wind up dead.
quest_1324_quest_complete:
[solemn] I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to Theramore for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.

[warm] I'm sure my lady Proudmore would like to thank you for your help. [commanding] Speak to her when you have a moment.
quest_1338_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly. His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched. [urgent] I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind. [angry] In human lands! I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge. [mocking tone] The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

[soft voice] So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
quest_1338_quest_progress:
[soft voice] A letter from the dwarven lands? I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

[hesitant] Please, let me see the order.
quest_1338_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes. [warm] That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves. [warm] Rich ones, too.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [excited] I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
quest_1339_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner. Someone to do a little traveling for him. How about it? [commanding] Are you the <race> for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
quest_1339_quest_complete:
[commanding] That's right. [soft voice] I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. [solemn] In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

[excited] Your perfect chance for adventure!
quest_1358_quest_detail:
[solemn] A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor. [soft voice] He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

[low voice] Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads. [urgent] To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar. [commanding] Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
quest_1358_quest_progress: [urgent] You have a package for me?
quest_1358_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

[warm] This is a welcome delivery, <name>. [proud] Your reward is well earned.
quest_1359_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens. [low voice] There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

[emphasis] It's quite incredible, and we must study it further. [pause] I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired. [urgent] Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge. [commanding] You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
quest_1359_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have something for me?
quest_1359_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke. [low voice] I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
quest_1360_quest_detail:
[solemn] I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the Badlands... [sad] that is until those blasted troggs showed up. [urgent] I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else. [hesitant] In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession. [soft voice] It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.

[warm] I'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me! [commanding] A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall. [emphasis] That's the one you need to get in.
quest_1360_quest_progress: [commanding] Well now, we're you able to get slap around those troggs long enough to get into my chest and nab my treasure?
quest_1360_quest_complete:
[gentle] Ah, I feel complete again - thank you kindly.

[warm] Some dwarves may treasure the luster of metal, and some may treasure the glint of gems... but a Stoutarm without a treasured stein in hand is hardly a Stoutarm at all!
quest_1361_quest_detail:
[solemn] A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace. Speak with him if you wish to volunteer. [urgent] He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

[commanding] And sharpen your weapons. [low voice] Desolace is a place torn by war.
quest_1361_quest_progress: [low voice] I note that your task is unfinished, <name>. [mocking tone] Shall I inform Sharlindra of your ineptitude?
quest_1361_quest_complete: [commanding] Yes, I am recruiting. [solemn] This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there. [urgent] I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.
quest_1362_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens. [commanding] This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.

[low voice] But as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat. [urgent] It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.

[soft voice] Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. [solemn] He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur. [commanding] He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.
quest_1362_quest_complete:
[commanding] You are here on orders from Regthar? Then you are here to deal with the centaur. [urgent] Good. I hope you're rested. [solemn] I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.

[pause] Have a seat, and listen.
quest_1363_quest_detail:
[solemn] As caretaker of the works here in the library of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences, it is my responsibility to ensure all the magical tomes and scrolls are accounted for at all times. [soft voice] Who knows what folly would unfold if some of these enchanted texts were to fall into the wrong hands?

[pause] Which reminds me... my assistant, Dellis, made a horrible mistake last week. [sad] He's quite able in the library but incompetent when he leaves the gates of Stormwind. [warm] Be a hero, and help old Dellis out, would you?
quest_1363_quest_complete: [solemn] It wasn't my fault. [hesitant] Really it wasn't.
quest_1364_quest_detail:
[solemn] Master Mazen's directions were quite clear: [soft voice] Deliver a very important essay to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.

[excited] But I had never been to the Blasted Lands before! [urgent] The journey was frightening!

[shocked] When I got to the Swamp of Sorrows, I made a wrong turn and ended up surrounded by horrible plant-like swamp creatures. [panting] They lurched as if to attack me so I ran. [sad] But in my haste I dropped the essay. [sad] One of the beasts took it I am sure.

[gentle] Could you please try to retrieve it and deliver it to Mahar Ba?
quest_1364_quest_progress: [solemn] What brings you to Nethergarde Keep, <race>?
quest_1364_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, most splendid!

[warm] For some time I had feared my request for Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence had been overlooked by Master Mazen of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences.

[soft voice] He must be bogged down with requests considering the many strange happenings going on.

[urgent] Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to begin my research at once. [excited] To finally glimpse the insight of one as great as Khadgar excites me to no end.
quest_1365_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kolkar are not the only centaur of Desolace. [soft voice] Many clans wander these dry plains, fighting and dying against each other. [low voice] And it is good that they fight among themselves, for they are strong and brutal. [emphasis] If the centaur united against us, they would be a fierce foe.

[urgent] We must deal with them before they unite.

[commanding] Your first task is to disrupt the Kolkar clan. Do this by killing its leader, Khan Dez'hepah.

[solemn] The Kolkar Village is northeast of here. [soft voice] Go, and may fortune go with you.
quest_1365_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done. [soft voice] This swift act against the Kolkar is an effective show of strength, and strength is what the centaur understand best.

[emphasis] The death of the Kolkar leader will not only disrupt that clan, but give pause to the others.
quest_1366_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them. [urgent] When traveling Desolace, hunt centaur. [commanding] I don't care which clan you hunt. [emphasis] Just gather ears. [emphasis] A hoard of ears.

[solemn] By weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion.

[low voice] Good hunting, <name>.
quest_1366_quest_progress: [low voice] How is your collection of ears, <name>? [emphasis] Large?
quest_1366_quest_complete:
[solemn] By now, the centaur must know your name. [commanding] I'm sure they know it, and respect it, and fear it. [emphasis] And just as they know you, they know the banner under which you ride.

[proud] The banner of the Horde.
quest_1367_quest_detail:
[solemn] To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. [soft voice] We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

[emphasis] If you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis. [commanding] This will earn you respect among the Magram. [urgent] When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast Desolace.
quest_1368_quest_detail:
[solemn] To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. [soft voice] We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

[emphasis] If you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram. [urgent] After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.
quest_1372_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our expeditionary force was sent at Varimathras's behest to survey lower Azeroth.

[soft voice] While out scouting I noticed a human Infiltrator spying on Beggar's Haunt. [hesitant] Before I could apprehend him, some of our orcish... brethren... captured him and took him to Stonard, their stronghold in Swamp of Sorrows.

[pause] I want to... help... our orcish allies. [low voice] They did not see our camp here but nonetheless I want to lend a hand.

[urgent] Work with Faustin here to develop a... truth serum for our friend in Stonard.
quest_1372_quest_complete:
[sad] Zraedus was just telling me about the nosey little Infiltrator before you arrived.

[solemn] Quite a problem, indeed. [angry] The last thing we need is a busybody sniffing around Beggar's Haunt.

[soft voice] I am sure the orcs of Stonard would be quite anxious to hear what our friend has to say. [threatening] Seeing that they are our allies, ahem, we must help them to get any information they can from the human.

[commanding] Work with me, <name>, and we will deliver a truth serum to Stonard.

[excited] For the Horde!

...[hesitant] did I get that right?
quest_1382_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are fortunate the centaur clans fight among themselves, for if they joined into a single force then they would be unstoppable. [emphasis] Yes, we are fortunate, and we should press our advantage.

One of the centaur clans, the Gelkis clan, is in brutal war with the Magram clan. [urgent] If we attack the Magram, then perhaps an alliance may be struck with the Gelkis.

[soft voice] Speak with Uthek the Wise, in the outskirts of the Gelkis camps in southwestern Desolace. [solemn] Through her we might strike an alliance with the Gelkis.
quest_1383_quest_detail:
[commanding] I have just the right serum in mind. It will deal with the truth in precisely the way the truth should be dealt with.

For this concoction I will need several Shadow Panther hearts from the Swamp. I also require the enchanted fungus off of the Mire Lord who resides there. I am sure one as able as you, <name>, can persuade him to part with some.

[urgent] Now the hard part will be locating a Deepstrider tumor from far-off Desolace. Very rarely the giants there become ill and a tumor forms.

[solemn] Now, off you go!
quest_1383_quest_progress:
[whispering] That Infiltrator in Stonard will surely.... open up... after he drinks my special serum. Haha!

[solemn] The ingredients required are by no means easy to procure. Shadow Panthers are common in the Swamp but collecting enough hearts for our purpose can be daunting. And the Mire Lord can be such a fussy beast.

As for the Deepstrider tumor, they are terribly difficult to find. [confident] But the chemical reaction I can draw from it is second to none.
quest_1383_quest_complete:
[delight] Splendid, <name>! And just in time too. From what Zraedus tells me, the Infiltrator has recovered from his wounds and is ready to be questioned by the orcs.

[commanding] Give me but a moment to prepare the pois - I mean prepare the truth serum.
quest_1385_quest_detail:
[solemn] Desolace is a land at war. [urgent] The centaurs wage war with each other, and we believe the victor among them will spill out and threaten our strongholds. [commanding] That, we cannot allow.

[solemn] We must learn how to beat the centaurs, and to do that... [emphasis] we must ally with one of the clans. [urgent] The Magram centaurs war with the Gelkis. [commanding] If you fight the Gelkis then the Magram might consider an alliance.

[urgent] Earn the favor of the Magrams then speak with Warug, in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace.
quest_1387_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many clans make up the centaur race. Each has its own leader and agenda, but all the clans have one thing in common. [angry] Cruelty. [commanding] If we are to ever find peace, then the centaurs must be removed. And so I put you on the task to do just that.

[urgent] While wandering Desolace, hunt centaur and take their ears. [emphasis] Bring me many, many ears.

[solemn] Do this in service of the Alliance, <name>, and we will be one step closer to war's end.
quest_1387_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the ears. Well done.

[warm] Your service to the Alliance is unquestioned, <name>. [solemn] The blood you spilled in Desolace will, no doubt, save countless lives.
quest_1388_quest_detail: [low voice] Everything is proceeding according to plan, <name>. [whispering] I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... [mocking tone] properly. [laughing] Haha!
quest_1388_quest_progress: [solemn] I hope you have proven yourself of use to our dear friend, Apothecary Faustin.
quest_1388_quest_complete:
[excited] I knew old Faustin would come up with something good! [warm] You were a tremendous help, no doubt.

[commanding] Now let's get down to business, shall we?
quest_1391_quest_detail:
[low voice] We need to operate with a certain amount of discretion. [whispering] After all, it's not like you're going to waltz in there and convince the fool to drink Faustin's concoction here, right?

But if there's one thing those humans cannot deny it's the booze. [urgent] I'll take Faustin's serum and mix it into this ale. [confident] I guarantee the poor sap will show no reluctance when it comes to chug-a-lugging a brew.

[commanding] Make haste to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows, <name>. [whispering] And keep our little mission nice and quiet...
quest_1391_quest_progress: Please have mercy on me! [urgent] I have information that goes beyond alliance boundaries. [hesitant] While I am no sympathizer of the Horde, [solemn] there is political treachery going on that must be revealed!
quest_1391_quest_complete: [soft voice] A drink for me? How kind. It's been days since they've allowed me to drink. [pause] Let me drink this down and then I'll tell you what I've learned....
quest_1393_quest_detail:
[urgent] Please help! [shouting] These creatures are going to eat me!

[urgent] Help me out of here, and I'll give you a great treasure! [soft voice] It's in my camp in the swamp north of Stonard, but it's locked in a strongbox that can be opened through a trick that only I know.

[confident] If you help me escape, then I'll teach it to you.
quest_1393_quest_complete:
[solemn] The keyhole of this strongbox is filled with black resin. It is impossible to open.

[soft voice] But Galen told you of a hidden latch on the box's bottom...

[pause] ...After a quick search the latch is found. [emphasis] The latch is flipped, and the strongbox opens...
quest_1394_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [soft voice] You have passed my test, and the tests before mine. [commanding] Return to Dorn in Thousand Needles. [solemn] He will sense the change within you, and see that your mind, body and spirit are strong enough that you should be rewarded for your efforts.

[warm] Stay true to the balance you've shown throughout these trials, <name>. [solemn] Dorn will test you again in the future if you do.
quest_1394_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, <name>. It has been a long time since you have last stepped into my home. It seems like many moons have passed since you took your first leap that set you upon your path.

And now you return to me stronger than you once were... more enlightened. [warm] This pleases me. [proud] And you should be justly rewarded for seeing my tests to the end.
quest_1395_quest_detail:
[urgent] This crate of powerstones needs to go to Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands.

They won't hold their power for long, so we can't ship them with the next caravan.

You must take them, and you must take them quickly.

[commanding] Bring them to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep. To reach the keep, you must travel east through Deadwind Pass, then east through the Swamp of Sorrows, then south through the Blasted Lands. [solemn] Use caution, <name>. You will travel through dangerous lands, yet you must not fail.
quest_1395_quest_progress:
[commanding] Hello! [soft voice] Don't mind all the commotion, it's just business as usual at Nethergarde Keep.

[urgent] You have something for me?
quest_1395_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, the powerstones! The mages will be happy to see these!

[warm] Many thanks, <name>. [soft voice] I know your trip from Darkshire was not an easy one.
quest_1396_quest_detail:
[solemn] My caravan was destined for the eastern coast, but we did not reach our goal. [sad] Lost Ones attacked us, killing guards and dashing supplies.

[sad] I alone survived their assault. [urgent] I have sworn to protect what supplies remain, but wild creatures skulk near. [hesitant] Please, help me defend my camp from the beasts!
quest_1396_quest_progress: [urgent] The swamp creatures press close, <name>. Please, you must defend the camp!
quest_1396_quest_complete: [soft voice] The sounds of animals are now faint, more distant. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [excited] Now let's hope they don't return!
quest_1398_quest_detail:
I owe you greatly, <name>. [solemn] An honorable heart beats within you. [soft voice] And now I have another task for which I humbly ask your aid.

[hesitant] If I'm ever to reach Nethergarde, then I must fix this wagon. [commanding] And for that... I will need wood. [emphasis] Strong, dry wood--not the spongy, tangled wood of the swamp's trees.

[soft voice] <name>, go east to the coast and search for driftwood that has been dried by the sun. [urgent] Bring it to me.
quest_1398_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find any driftwood, <name>?
quest_1398_quest_complete: [soft voice] This wood is light, but tough. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] It will work nicely.
quest_1418_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.

[urgent] Prove yourself, <name>. Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost. [commanding] Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.
quest_1418_quest_complete:
[commanding] Helgrum wants a report, eh? [solemn] I sent an outrunner to Stonard not three days past. [angry] Did he fail his mission? [cold] If Stonard does not have my report, then it appears he did fail.

[urgent] Let's hope the next runner I send has more skill, or more luck.
quest_1419_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you spent many days in the Badlands, <class>? [soft voice] Have you felt its heat? [commanding] Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains? [urgent] It's time you did.

[angry] Crag coyotes are a tough breed. [threatening] Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies. [warm] Help rid the outpost of these thieves!

[commanding] Hunt crag coyotes, <name>. [emphasis] Hunt them and bring me their jawbones. [proud] Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the Badlands.
quest_1419_quest_complete:
[delight] That's a nice collection of jawbones, <name>. [warm] Now those coyotes won't be tearing through our supplies for scraps.

Well done. [solemn] The coyotes of the Badlands aren't easy prey. [proud] Your deed shows me that you might just survive here.
quest_1420_quest_detail:
[solemn] I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard. [urgent] Bring it to him.

[commanding] And if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way. [threatening] Or fall to an enemy.
quest_1420_quest_progress: [solemn] You returned. [urgent] You have a report?
quest_1420_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] From Neeka's report, I see the Alliance is not without its own problems. [pause] And we may find that some enemies are shared between us.
quest_1421_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was stunned during the attack by the Lost Ones, but before my sight went black I spied one of our wagons being dragged to the Fallow Sanctuary, the lost one village to the north.

[urgent] A caravan chest with valuable reagents was in that wagon, reagents vital to the studies of the wizards of Nethergarde Keep. [commanding] Find the chest and get those reagents, <name>. Get them and bring them to me.
quest_1421_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the wizard's reagents, <name>?
quest_1421_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, you found them! [warm] With these, the wizards in Nethergarde may continue their work. [solemn] I do not know what it is that they do, but it is linked to the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands, and is vital to the security of the Alliance.
quest_1422_quest_detail: [soft voice] While I begin work on your weapon, why don't you talk to Katar? He mentioned needing help with patrols along the beach, and I'd rather see you keep your wits and weapons prepared instead of getting drunk with some of the other louses I share this camp with.
quest_1422_quest_complete: [solemn] Be silent a moment, <class>. Even over the dull roar of the sea you can still hear those disgusting gurgles from the fish men.
quest_1423_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This barrel is small yet sturdy. Its seams are sealed with a yellow, pungent wax. [solemn] Stamped on the bottom of the barrel are the words:

QUARTERMASTER LUNGERTZ NETHERGARDE KEEP
quest_1423_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, thank you <name>! [warm] So many supplies are lost from Darkshire to here. [soft voice] It's good to see that some are recovered.
quest_1424_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Warchief sent us to investigate strange happenings at The Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

The Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters, known for practicing forbidden magic. [soft voice] You can imagine how astonished we were when we arrived here to discover the temple had been sunk.

The green dragons now guard the site, claiming to be protectors of Azeroth.

We need to discover what happened. [urgent] Explore around the Pool of Tears and gather Atal'ai artifacts. From those I can begin to piece together this puzzle.
quest_1424_quest_progress:
[solemn] No one knows what dark practices went on inside The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. [soft voice] But we do know that great and powerful forces of magic were used.

[solemn] We must learn as much as we can about such magic. [solemn] Perhaps the spells of the Atal'ai will prove of use to the Horde.

[urgent] Once you have gathered enough Atal'ai artifacts from around the Pool of Tears, I can begin to understand what the trolls were hoping to accomplish and what went so horribly wrong.
quest_1424_quest_complete: Your diligence in collecting the Atal'ai artifacts is worthy of praise, <class>.
quest_1425_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While I fix this wagon, <name>, I have one last task for you.

I have packed the most vital supplies saved from the ogre attacks. [solemn] Take them to Nethergarde Keep. The keep is nestled in the northern hills of the Blasted Lands, keeping watch over the Dark Portal.

[urgent] To reach Nethergard, follow the road east. When it branches head south into the Blasted Lands, then turn left at the next fork. Follow the road, <name>, and be wary.
quest_1425_quest_complete:
[shocked] What? A package from Biggs' caravan? We thought it, and he, were lost.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [confident] With luck, these supplies will carry the much needed reagent, Azoran Crystals. [solemn] Our stock is running low...
quest_1426_quest_detail:
[low voice] I have no love for the sea, nor any creature I've seen come from its depths. It is a powerful but blind mistress; callous and brutal. [threatening] It would bring me great pleasure to slay the fish men by the hundreds if it were within my power. But I garner some pleasure from watching their deaths at the hands of any who do the Horde's will.

[commanding] Which brings us to you, <class>. [urgent] How many can you slay? [emphasis] Would you test yourself against their most powerful kind?
quest_1426_quest_progress: [solemn] I am patient. [soft voice] Patient and everlasting like an old kank stone from Draenor. [angry] The fish men shall not make it past our borders--not while I still stand. [low voice] If we had an army at our disposal I would cleanse this world and all others of their presence. [threatening] I feel my hatred seethe just speaking about them.
quest_1426_quest_complete:
[solemn] The sea seems vast and relentless, but you have stained her with the blood of her own spawn. [angry] The fish men know pain. Their stupidity will force them to refortify their ranks from the devastation you've caused, and that is good.

[cold] Let their gurgling screams overshadow the sea's roar long into the night. [proud] I shall smile every time I hear one of them silenced.

Return to me if you wish to slay more of the fish men. [warm] I will gladly reward you again.
quest_1427_quest_detail: [soft voice] Before you take rest, speak to Tok'Kar again. [low voice] While you were gone I believe he finished a few weapons. [warm] For your help here, he would offer one of them to you. [commanding] You would do well to test its strength against the fish men when you are ready... but only to please me further.
quest_1427_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, <name>, you've returned. Good. I've finished crafting more weapons for our fight against the murlocs. [warm] For bringing us the fresh sawtooth meat, and for bringing a small smile to Katar's face, I offer one of them to you.
quest_1428_quest_detail:
[solemn] It pleases me to see your hatred for the fish men grows with mine.

[commanding] Find more of their kind along the beach, and when you've had your fill of combat, return to me. [warm] We shall speak then of a reward for your diligence.
quest_1428_quest_progress: [solemn] Not until the sea and all her children are silenced will I be pleased... [threatening] especially those disgusting fish men.
quest_1428_quest_complete: [commanding] Well done, <class>. [angry] I call for more of their blood. [threatening] Let all the fish men perish.
quest_1429_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were braving the dangers of the Pool of Tears, one of my scouts returned with a scroll written in blood on dried flesh. [soft voice] It seems to be a judicial sentence against a priest of the Atal'ai tribe.

[sad] This priest was sentenced to a fate worse than death amongst the Atal'ai.

[solemn] He was exiled to live far north in the Hinterlands, with the Witherbark trolls.

[urgent] I will bundle these artifacts. [commanding] You are to seek out the exile and discover their true use. [solemn] Return to me once your journey is complete.
quest_1429_quest_progress: [solemn] You are brave to come here. [hesitant] Brave or foolish...
quest_1429_quest_complete:
[solemn] You bring me the summoning artifacts of the Atail'ai?

[low voice] I see Jammal'an the Prophet is leading the disciples of the Chamber of Blood towards their chosen fate. [pause] Has Hakkar returned to the Temple I wonder? [sad] Has their fate been met?
quest_1430_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's a high demand for the succulent taste of crawler meat among my customers; especially the meat from the monstrous crawlers.

[soft voice] If you plan on heading to the coast, then I could easily make it worth your while to bring me back some of their legs to have transported back to Orgrimmar.

[commanding] The coast is to the east from here, and you should have no problem finding the creatures scurrying along the beaches and under the sea.
quest_1430_quest_progress: [commanding voice] I have a cask of wine waiting for your success, <name>. [soft voice] It's only right I taste the goods before I have it shipped back to my customers.
quest_1430_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, this should be perfect. [excited] I can't wait to taste these after they are prepared perfectly over an open fire. [warm] You should take a sample of it with you on your travels. [delight] It truly is delicious.
quest_1431_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Be still, <class>, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.

[solemn] We are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. [pause] You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.

[emphasis] If the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. [soft voice] His hovel is there.
quest_1431_quest_complete:
[solemn] Putanni, noble <class>. I am Keldran, student of magic... and other mystical arts.

The business Craven sent you here to speak to me about requires a touch more subtlety than you've previously needed, but that does not mean you can not still aid our cause.

[soft voice] Please, make yourself comfortable, and I shall tell you why the Warchief has need of my aid... and yours.

[solemn] It starts with appearances, <name>. How the Horde sees itself. How our allies see us. And most importantly, how our enemies see us.
quest_1432_quest_detail:
[solemn] As the Alliance progresses deeper and deeper into Kalimdor, incorrect conclusions may be drawn about the Horde making pacts with the Burning Legion. The Warchief cannot allow that to happen. And with his blessing, I am taking control of overseeing them removed.

[urgent] I have agents in the area of Desolace at the Ghost Walker Post north of the great Kodo Graveyard. Head south of the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains and you shall come across it. When you arrive, seek out Takata Steelblade.
quest_1432_quest_complete:
Greetings, <class>. [solemn] You bring news from Orgrimmar; that is good.

[low voice] The demon infestation overwhelms this area even more than the smell of centaur dung. [commanding] The horse-men claim this land as their own, but clearly there are influences out of their control that will crush them if not kept in check.

[sad] It does not please me that we aid the centaur indirectly, but it is for the good of the Horde, so I do my duty for the Warchief, even if it means helping the warlocks within the Horde.
quest_1433_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Burning Blade have many agendas, but know that they are evil to their core, their spirits corrupted, and their destruction is the only way to thwart their objectives.

[low voice] Keldran sent Maurin with me because of his knowledge of the Blade and their warlock ways.

[commanding] He has control of our plots against the Blade while I deal with the other demonic threats here in Desolace.

[urgent] Speak to him, and he will guide you in his designs.
quest_1433_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. [solemn] Aid from those loyal to the Warchief is always appreciated.

[low voice] My name is Maurin. [soft voice] I am here at the behest of Keldran and the Warchief cub Thrall. [solemn] It is my desire to aid the youngling leader against the evils that threaten his rule.

[commanding] Come, come closer, <class>. [solemn] I shall explain to you my plan for removing the festering boil that is the Burning Blade.
quest_1434_quest_detail:
[solemn] A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.

[soft voice] It may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. [pause] When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.

[commanding] Ties have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. [urgent] Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
quest_1434_quest_progress:
[solemn] I was warned by a tauren companion that the satyr are not all they appear to be. He believes there is something more to them, that their evil is a twisting of their true nature. But I have not seen such things.

[angry] I see only the ruthless slaughter of the weak and the corruption of those who seek dark power.

[commanding] I will continue in my duty of annihilating them until the Warchief directs me otherwise. [cold] Until then, I take no pity on them.
quest_1434_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <class>. [warm] You have shown honor and dedication.

[solemn] When our campaign in Desolace is done, the Warchief will know that you aided us in our actions here, and that you helped make his will manifest.

[warm] I thank you.
quest_1435_quest_detail:
[solemn] Death is most desirable for those despicable creatures that turn their back on their liege for such selfish reasons. [low voice] But death is not enough when dealing with those that have given themselves over to the darkness.

[commanding] Take this gem. [urgent] When one of the Burning Blade's near death, activate its magic. [soft voice] The spell shall pull the corrupted spirit out of its victim, leaving an infused gem behind.

[solemn] Bring me these infused gems so I may dispose of them properly.

[urgent] Go now, and may you elude death.
quest_1435_quest_progress: [solemn] I have tried to make the magics as simple as possible. Drawing the spirit of your victim out of its injured form should be child's play. [commanding] Do not rely on the gem's power to slay your foe completely. [urgent] You must only activate the gem when they are close to death, or it will be useless.
quest_1435_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you've returned successful. [warm] That is good. Give me the gems and I shall put them someplace safe....

[pause] My tasks for you are complete, <class>. Speak to Takata when you are rested. He may have other tasks for you, or perhaps needs you to return to Orgrimmar to inform Keldran of our progress here in Desolace.
quest_1436_quest_detail:
[commanding] The fight goes well, <name>. [solemn] Perhaps the Warchief will allow us to return to our homes before the seasons change if we continue to make such great strides in our battle against the demons and their underlings.

[urgent] Return to Keldran and let him know what we have done. [warm] I am sure he will reward you for your efforts here. [proud] His cause is important to him, and he will take pride in knowing that the Warchief respects his concerns.
quest_1436_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have returned from Desolace more than successful, <name>. [warm] Thank you. Thank you for your efforts, your time, and your understanding to my plea. [soft voice] Thrall understands and desires peace between the Horde and Alliance, and by taking measures to insure our appearance is acceptable, we will not provoke any further threats of unnecessary violence.

[proud] I am indebted to you.
quest_1437_quest_detail:
I am Vahlarriel, <name>. [solemn] I've come here to discover the whereabouts of two missing nobles of a Darnassian merchant family--House Malem. [soft voice] The father of the house fears the worst, and I am to do everything I can to find his missing children. [hesitant] I have yet to start my search for Tyranis or Dalinda, but I am hopeful I shall not be here long.

[solemn] Last word tells of them passing through the Stonetalon Mountains a few weeks ago.

[urgent] If you find their wagon, please, come find me immediately.
quest_1437_quest_complete:
[solemn] As you rummage around the remains of the wagon, it becomes obvious that it was attacked by both spells and weapons. [soft voice] The battle seemed one-sided and quick; there's no blood to be found, and no remains of any bodies.

[low voice] Whoever attacked the wagon was efficient and swift.
quest_1438_quest_detail:
[urgent] Find both Dalinda and Tyranis if you can and come back to me with your findings. Start your search at this fortress. [solemn] I will contact my superiors in Darnassus immediately and let them know the situation.

<name>, there is something else I wish to impress upon you. [soft voice] My superiors have shown some concern over Tyranis' and his motives for coming here. [emphasis] It is more important to them that Dalinda is found and brought back safely. [commanding] Tyranis is to be... gauged before he is taken home.
quest_1438_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank Elune someone has finally come to help. [urgent] Please, <class>, I need your help. [sad] My brother Tyranis and I were captured and brought here by the Burning Blade. I think they mean to sacrifice me to their demon masters!

[sigh] I knew coming to Desolace was a mistake, but Tyranis has recently begun craving knowledge of all things arcane--even against the wishes of our people. [solemn] He decided to make this trek even after hearing tales of this land's demon infestation.

[pause] I fear the worst for him.
quest_1439_quest_detail:
[solemn] We were brought here after the orcs slaughtered all our guards and servants. [sad] Oh, the terrible things they did to them! [soft voice] I thought surely they would kill us right there and then, but it became obvious they had other plans.

[hesitant] Tyranis attempted to speak to them. [soft voice] I think he wanted to impress them with his knowledge of the arcane... I'm not sure why.

[urgent] Please, I can't leave here until I know what's happened to my brother. [commanding] Find him, then come back for me when his fate is known.
quest_1439_quest_progress:
[solemn] I fear Tyranis will attempt to learn the Burning Blade's secrets and count himself among their kind if they allow it - he has always adored the power magic brings to those who are seduced by it.

[hesitant] I'm not sure I could endure returning home to my family with news of Tyranis' spirit flirting with such dangers. [sad] It's a terrible enough crime among my kind to pursue such things, but to become that which we attempt to protect ourselves from, well, that's apprehensible.
quest_1439_quest_complete:
[angry] This is terrible! [sad] But I suppose it was necessary. [solemn] If it wasn't by your hand, it would have surely been by that of my people's. [hesitant] I suppose I should thank you--please forgive me if it doesn't seem sincere. [sad] I mean no offense.

[solemn] With the knowledge of my brother's fate in hand, it seems the time for my escape has come. [urgent] If you are still willing, I will accept your aid in escaping this horrible place.

[warm] When you are ready, we can make our way to safety.
quest_1440_quest_detail: [soft voice] So, the time is now then? [pause] I appreciate your efforts, and if the situation does not lend itself, then allow me to thank you now for everything you've done for me and my family. [warm] If you're ready, then there is nothing else for me here--we can leave when you feel the time is right.
quest_1440_quest_complete:
[gentle] Thank you, <name>. Dalinda made it safely back here to Nijel's Point, and in much better condition than I could have asked for. The fact that she arrived here under her own power was a good sign. I hope you're well?

[solemn] It pains me to know that both Tyranis and Dalinda didn't return, but the embarrassment of Tyranis' decisions is hers to endure. It is something she will have to deal with when she returns to Darnassus.
quest_1442_quest_detail:
Greetings, <name>. What can I do for one who follows a holy path?

[solemn] Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time.

He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble.

[soft voice] If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. [solemn] You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. [urgent] The naga who still use the gems are down below. [commanding] Do not go alone, <class>.
quest_1442_quest_progress: [solemn] I would be less trustful of one not on a holy path if they came asking about a Kor gem. [soft voice] But I trust your kind more than some of my kin. [pause] I do not judge your entire order based on the actions of just one of your fallen kind.
quest_1442_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is indeed the gem Stilwell desires, but before I can allow you to bring it to him, it must be purified of corruption--the naga wenches imbue the gems with power, that much is true, but of their own, evil kind.

[warm] Let Stilwell know that its power is intact, and it should work well for whatever ritual he wishes it to be part of.

[hesitant] I hope you know what you're doing, <class>, this is no simple item you possess.
quest_1444_quest_detail:
[solemn] Jammal'an the Prophet sentenced me to exile from The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I once felt the high priest was a worthy leader.

[sad] His unyielding faith in his prophecy will bring about the destruction of the Atal'ai. If it hasn't already.

[hesitant] When I expressed my concerns, I was labeled an infidel and ousted from the temple.

[soft voice] Those artifacts you brought to me are harmless. [urgent] But if Jammal'an has found the proper fetish enchantment for the summoning ritual, the world lies in great peril....
quest_1444_quest_complete:
[solemn] It has been quite some time since we spoke, <class>. [soft voice] I hope your journey was successful.

[pause] What knowledge did you gain from the exiled Atal'ai in the Hinterlands?
quest_1445_quest_detail:
[solemn] So he spoke of Jammal'an's prophecy?

The Atal'ai spiritual leader believes once Hakkar returns to Azeroth from the Nether, the god will grant the Atal'ai tribe immortality.

[sad] Foolish trickery to bring about a premature doomsday if you ask me.

[hesitant] But you say the exile spoke of enchanted fetishes? [urgent] This concerns me greatly. If these are in fact the key to the Atal'ai ritual which caused this mess, we must understand their intrinsic powers.

[commanding] Venture into the Temple, and seize the fetishes!
quest_1445_quest_progress: [solemn] If the Atal'ai fetishes hold the power to summon Hakkar and fulfill Jammal'an's prophecy they must be seized. [urgent] Such powers must be understood by the Horde!
quest_1445_quest_complete:
[solemn] Brave <class>, you have proven yourself to be a great champion of the Horde.

[urgent] Now this collection of fetishes of Hakkar must be dealt with at once!
quest_1446_quest_detail:
[solemn] My Witherbark companions don't take kindly to strangers around their home.

Me? I don't have a home anymore. [sad] I was exiled from my people, the great Atal'ai tribe of the Swamp of Sorrows.

[soft voice] Our spiritual leader, Jammal'an, had what he called a prophecy. [hesitant] He believes the summoning of the god, Hakkar will bring the Atal'ai immortality.

[angry] But I urged caution. [threatening] What if the prophecy was nothing more than manipulation?

[urgent] I want revenge for my exile. [commanding] Bring me Jammal'an's head. [cold] Maybe then my people will be free.
quest_1446_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once Jammal'an has been removed, I stand a chance of returning to my people.

[solemn] With Jammal'an as their spiritual leader, the Atal'ai face certain destruction.
quest_1446_quest_complete:
[solemn] Jammal'an's reckless trust of false visions led my people to their eternal doom.

[sad] I thank you, <class>, for avenging my exile. [sad] I mourn for my people. [sad] I have no home to return to.
quest_1447_quest_detail:
[commanding] Yeah, you're obviously not the smartest <class> to come into Stormwind, but you're about to be one of the dumbest to never leave.

[mocking tone] Have you met me friends?
quest_1447_quest_progress: [hesitant] I didn't mean anything by the comment 'bout you being a stupid <class>. [soft voice] We're friends, right? [pause] No hard feelings?
quest_1447_quest_complete: [commanding] So, you came to me for a reason. [soft voice] What is it you need?
quest_1448_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time when I was young and full of vigor like you, <class>.

But now I'm old and unable to explore the world like I once did. Ah, the things I saw!

But there was one mystery that eluded me. For my final quest, the Explorers' League sent me in search of The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It was rumored to be located in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Because of my frail state, I traveled the skies by gryphon in search of it but never found it.

[hesitant] Help an old dwarf out? Perhaps you will have better luck on foot.
quest_1448_quest_progress:
[solemn] I have traveled the world from the jungles of Azeroth to the snowy peaks of Khaz Modan.

[soft voice] Never before have I asked for help in my adventures. [pause] But my old bones are tired.

[low voice] Nothing would leave me feeling more satisfied than knowing that I completed my final quest for the Explorers' League

[warm] If you'd be so kind as to help me search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, <class>, I'd greatly appreciate it.

[urgent] Scour the Swamp of Sorrows and report back with your findings!
quest_1448_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Temple of Atal'Hakkar has been sunk beneath the Pool of Tears? [shocked] And surrounded by the green dragonflight?

[delight] An amazing discovery, <class>. [urgent] But obviously something has gone terribly wrong.
quest_1449_quest_detail:
[solemn] As I mentioned earlier, I attempted to scout the temple on my own from the air. [soft voice] Well, I wasn't exactly alone.

[pause] I traveled to the renowned gryphon aviary at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands. [pause] There I enlisted the aid of one of their finest pilots. [sad] The pilot fell off his mount, down into the swamp...

[sigh] In my old age the poor fellow's name eludes me. [solemn] The master of the aviary would remember, no doubt.

[urgent] Journey there and seek out Falstad Wildhammer.

[commanding] We need to find out what happened to that pilot.
quest_1449_quest_complete:
[angry] What do you want, laddy? Can't you see I've got problems to take care of here? [angry] Who has time to stand around yapping with some <race> chatterbox?

[urgent] There are trolls coming out of the woodwork! [commanding] Make it snappy.
quest_1450_quest_detail:
[angry] So you're a glorified errand boy for some old Explorers' League geezer, eh?

[commanding] Well you listen to me, <class>. I don't know who your old buddy was flying around with down in Azeroth. Do I look like Gryphon Master Talonaxe to you? Do I?

If you're so interested in the flight assignments why don't you ask the gryphon master? [threatening] If I catch you idling around here for much longer, I'm going to put you to some real work.

[urgent] Now get a move on.
quest_1450_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. Of course I remember sending one of my gryphon riders to lend a hand to Brohann Caskbelly.

[warm] Always had a soft spot in my heart for the Explorers' League. [soft voice] My father helped with the initial excavation team that discovered Uldaman as a matter of fact.

[confident] I sent who I thought was my best gryphon rider at the time with Brohann. [proud] He was a chap by the name of Rhapsody Shindigger.

[excited] And what a gryphon jockey he was! [pause] Well until...
quest_1451_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Rhapsody took quite a liking to the booze. Now don't get me wrong -- all of us dwarves up here at the aviary love a good ale when the time is right.

But ol' Shindigger took to the liquor like a gryphon takes to the skies. [sad] And a damned shame it was, too. [solemn] No one could fly like Rhapsody.

First sign of trouble was when he came stumbling back from that mission with your buddy, Brohann. All went down hill quickly after that. [pause] Had to let him go.

[sad] Last I heard, he's set up a brew camp to the east of here...
quest_1451_quest_complete:
Hiccup!

I'm a-lookin' right at you but you keep bobbing up and down. Makin' me dizzy. Hoho!

Hiccup! Whoa! Did ya feel that? Ground is a-shakin', my friend. I need a drink.

Hiccup!
quest_1452_quest_detail:
[excited] Hiccup!

So that crazy fool Brohann sent ya? My we had quite an adventure...Hiccup!

[soft voice] If ya want me to tell ya what happened down in the swamp, I'm gonna need me something stiff to drink. It wasn't a pretty scene, ya see. Hiccup!

[commanding] Tell ya what... bring me what I need to whip up a Kalimdor Kocktail and I'll tell ya all about it.

Gonna need some Roc gizzards from Tanaris... and let's see... some Groddoc and Ironfur livers from Feralas...

A nice stiff Kalimdor Kocktail... that'll get me talking!
quest_1452_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ya ever had a Rhapsody Malt? One of my finest brews, if I do say so myself. Hiccup!

[gasp] But if I'm gonna relive the horrors of that fateful flight over... hiccup... the swamp, well I'm gonna need me something a wee bit stronger. Hiccup!

[hesitant] Don't suppose you found me those gizzards and livers I need to add that extra kick to my Kalimdor Kocktail?

Hiccup!
quest_1452_quest_complete:
[excited] I see ya had no trouble at all getting me what I need! [warm] Musta been quite a stint you had over there in far-off Kalimdor.

[low voice] It won't take but a moment for me to extract what I need from these gizzards and livers. [inhale] Hiccup! [urgent] Then I can distill me a fierce ol' drink and finally tell ya what ya wanna know.

[inhale] Hiccup! Getting shivers just thinking about that ol' swamp.

[inhale] Hiccup! [commanding] Lemme whip up a drink real fast.
quest_1453_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's work to be done in Desolace, <name>. [low voice] It's an atrocious place, befouled by centaur and other nasties. [urgent] But if you're looking for a good week's honest work, then head there, meet with Kreldig Ungor, and tell him I sentcha.

[soft voice] You can find him holed up at Nijel's Point--it's a little cozy camp hidden in the mountains of northern Desolace. [emphasis] Just head east if you enter from the Stonetalon Mountains. [hesitant] It's easy to miss, so be on the lookout.
quest_1453_quest_complete:
[excited] Glad to see the Reclaimers aren't in short supply of work, or adventurers willing to help out.

[warm] I'm Kreldig, <name>. [confident] You've made a smart move helpin' out the Reclaimers. [solemn] Everyone needs something these days: they've lost a family heirloom, a magic item, a loved one. [soft voice] You never can tell. But with the Reclaimers around, there's no reason, for the right price, [warm] everyone can't find what they've lost.
quest_1454_quest_detail:
[solemn] My first order of business is for the mage Karnitol--a noble of some sort in Stormwind. [soft voice] Seems his ship was attacked by sea giants while off the coast in the northwest of Desolace. He and his servants tried to bring one of his more valuable chests ashore, but when the sea giants attacked in droves, he chose to abandon it and teleport himself and his servants to safety.

[urgent] He wants us to find the chest and its contents, and return it to him in Stormwind.
quest_1454_quest_complete:
[solemn] You notice the chest does not seem to have any water damage.

[urgent] The second thing you notice is that the top has been forced open, and whatever magical traps were set to safeguard it have long been triggered--this much is obvious from the burn marks around its edges.
quest_1455_quest_detail: [solemn] You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. [soft voice] The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword.
quest_1456_quest_detail:
[solemn] Intriguing.

Well, we might not be without hope quite yet.

[soft voice] Along that same coast, but to the north near Ranazjar Isle, there're night elf ruins at the bottom of the ocean. A tribe of naga, the Slitherblade, make that their home. [commanding] I think that'd be our best bet.

[urgent] If a scouting party went that far south, then they must've been pretty powerful. [emphasis] If you're gonna find Karnitol's belongings, I'd start with the more powerful naga: the tidehunters or sea witches.
quest_1456_quest_progress: [low voice] No offense to whoever Nijel is, but this camp ain't the most comfortable place I've spent a night, if you know what I mean, <name>.
quest_1456_quest_complete:
[excited] This is great, <name>! You found Karnitol's belongings!

[angry] Those blasted naga, always causing trouble. [low voice] I think I'd rather spend my life at war with the Horde than have to go against their kind. [warm] You've done a great service to the Reclaimers.
quest_1457_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Take Karnitol's things back to Roetten in Ironforge and he'll pay you for a job well done.

[laughing] Haha, if you're not careful, he's gonna be so pleased with ya that he'll ask you to join us full time.

Again, great job, <name>.

[urgent] Be careful on your way back, and don't take too much time--Karnitol's not the most of patient of men, but he's very generous nonetheless.
quest_1457_quest_progress: [commanding] Business is booming, <name>, and I don't have a lot of time for questions. If you've got business with the Reclaimers, then let's hear it. If not, I'm gonna have to ask you to talk to one of me underlings - they're adept enough at taking care of things 'round here.
quest_1457_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Karnitol business in Desolace. Excellent!

So, the chest was destroyed, but the items are all here, huh? Well, I'll let him be the judge of that. One good part about this business I got going on here is that if they're not satisfied, I can tell 'em to shove it! They're relyin' on us to find their stuff... not make sure it's all pretty and in good shape when they get it back.

[warm] Good work, <name>. [proud] Let's see about gettin' you paid.
quest_1458_quest_detail:
[low voice] One of my tasks out here involves picking up some reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos . [soft voice] Roetten seems to think it's easy coin in the bank since we're out here already. [sad] He doesn't really care that we're short-handed as is.

[soft voice] The first few items on his list should be easy enough to get, and it'd be a good chunk of coin for anyone helping me out.

[urgent] I need some horns and claws from the Hatefury satyr to the east of here. [commanding] Bring 'em back to me and we'll get started on the rest of the list.
quest_1458_quest_progress:
[solemn] Despicable creatures, the satyr. [soft voice] Story says they're somehow tied to the night elves, but I'm not so sure I believe it.

[hesitant] I think they get that on account of that one elf that brought them into the war few years back. [pause] World's never been the same since. [low voice] Lot more dangerous, and a lot scarier.
quest_1458_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Good good, <name>. [hesitant] Not sure if these are of any good quality, but if Leftwitch wanted a specific type, he should have specified before sending the Reclaimers out here to begin with.

[urgent] What say you to getting on with the next item on his list?
quest_1459_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Next on Leftwitch's list is... let's see... hmm. [pause] Oh, here it is.

[emphasis] Simple enough, but pretty explicit in his directions. [low voice] He needs venom from the scorpashi, and hide from some kodo. [hesitant] The fine print says both are from specific creatures: the venom's got to come from any of the scorpashi, and the hide's got to come from an aged kodo, not the dying or ancient ones.

[angry] Mages, I tell ya, some of the stuff they want... it's just weird.
quest_1459_quest_progress: Sorry I couldn't tell you where to find the kodo or the scorpashi. [hesitant] I'm not terribly familiar with the area, and I haven't had time to explore.
quest_1459_quest_complete:
[warm] Your help here's a boon, <name>. You're cutting my time spent here in Desolace by half at least. I'll be back in Ironforge warming my feet in no time with your help.

When we get this list taken care of, and I'm back home, look me up, I'll buy you an ale for sure.

[excited] But until then, let's get the rest of these reagents gathered.
quest_1462_quest_complete: [solemn] I give you one in good faith. [warm] You already proved yourself once, but me thinkin' you should be more careful in the future.
quest_1463_quest_complete: [solemn] I give you one in good faith. [warm] You already proved yourself once, but me thinkin' you should be more careful in the future.
quest_1464_quest_progress: [soft voice] Speak to Telf Joolam for another Fire Sapta.
quest_1464_quest_complete:
[solemn] May fire burn within your heart, <name>.

[soft voice] The elements await you.
quest_1465_quest_detail: [soft voice] As you continue your search of the wagon you find not only a pendant, but also footprints leading off towards the south. [pause] In the distance you can see smoke rising from a large fort. [solemn] The smoke is from a kept fire, not the burning of buildings, and your instincts tell you that the Malems, if still alive, were taken that direction.
quest_1466_quest_detail:
[low voice] This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. [urgent] I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.

[commanding] So, enough with the warning, let's get this started. [emphasis] Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. [soft voice] Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. [pause] And... ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.

[confident] Simple enough, huh? [hesitant] Sheesh... if you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.
quest_1466_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I didn't even realize these demon things were in Desolace. [pause] Last I read, centaur pretty much owned the land after the night elves picked up and left years ago.

[hesitant] I wonder why they took up here, and how.
quest_1466_quest_complete: Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. [proud] You're amazing, <name>. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. [excited] Great job! [warm] I'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to Ironforge.
quest_1467_quest_detail:
[commanding] To get paid, you're gonna have to get back to Ironforge and speak to Roetten himself. [low voice] He'll love getting Leftwitch's package out of the way anyway. [urgent] Just give him this and it should be enough to get your booty.

[warm] And don't worry, I'm still going to put in a good word for you when I get back. [soft voice] I shouldn't be in Desolace much longer.
quest_1467_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well met, <name>. Business is booming, the sounds of anvils being struck rings throughout Ironforge, the bellows blow the fires hot, and me wife's making me a pie for dessert after tonight's dinner. [warm] Could life be any grander?
quest_1467_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, the package for Leftwitch from Desolace. [solemn] Excellent. I 'preciate the work, and your timeliness, <class>. [warm] Glad to have you aboard for at least this small bit of work.

[proud] I got your payment right here. [warm] Let it be known that Reclaimers Inc. always pays well for a hard week's work.
quest_1468_quest_detail:
[gentle] You're willing to help us here at the orphanage? [warm] Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.

Take this whistle. You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself. When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after. Using it again will dismiss the child.

By all means <name> - use the whistle and meet your ward! [excited] I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.
quest_1468_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Um... hi. My name is Randis, and I guess you're looking after me? You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were. [excited] I'm happy to meet you.

I hope we'll have a lot of fun together. [pause] I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big brother to me during this week. [warm] I'd like that a whole bunch, yes sir.
quest_1469_quest_detail: [soft voice] Before the flight, I drank me a whole keg of stout. [inhale] Hiccup! And what a flight it was. [excited] Zipping around with Brohann following me. [hesitant] Didn't see no temple though. [inhale] Hiccup! [laughing] Well, didn't see no temple till I got a little too tipsy and fell off my mount. [urgent] I plunged right into the water and was sucked down. [solemn] Found myself surrounded by a bunch of creepy trolls. [proud] Sure swam out of there fast! [delight] Even made off with this troll souvenir. [warm] Here, take it to Brohann and let him know his temple is down there, indeed. [inhale] Hiccup!
quest_1469_quest_progress:
[solemn] At long last you have returned, <name>. [soft voice] It has been quite some time since we last spoke. [hesitant] I thought perhaps you had forgotten about my quest.

[urgent] Did you locate that wily gryphon rider? [emphasis] Did he have anything to report?
quest_1469_quest_complete:
Rhapsody Shindigger! [excited] That's right... how could I forget such a name?

So he knew about the sinking of the temple all along? Well, that certainly would have saved you some leg work.

[delight] But this Atal'ai artifact! [delight] Why, it's quite a find!
quest_1470_quest_detail:
Greetings, child. [soft voice] I can see that you are still young in the ways of the warlock, power still eluding your grasp. [solemn] I can sense your eagerness to learn.

And you will learn.

[commanding] There is no strength in ignorance. [solemn] Knowledge is our greatest power. [emphasis] Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.

[commanding] I will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.
quest_1470_quest_progress:
[low voice] Your power is little now, though I suspect already you sense the possibilities.

[solemn] Even the dead might feel alive, with that power coursing through us.
quest_1470_quest_complete:
[solemn] Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. [gentle] Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.

[commanding] Attend me carefully, <name>, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.
quest_1471_quest_detail:
[solemn] Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? [soft voice] Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.

[commanding] Using these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.

[urgent] When it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. [low voice] Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.
quest_1471_quest_progress: [commanding] I expect to hear of your success, <name>. [threatening] Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.
quest_1471_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [warm] Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.

[soft voice] The power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. [solemn] Use it wisely.
quest_1472_quest_detail:
[solemn] A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. [solemn] A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.

[soft voice] It cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

[emphasis] Thus we use its own strength against it. [soft voice] With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. [emphasis] Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.

[commanding] Speak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. [urgent] He will help you find your bait.
quest_1472_quest_complete:
[solemn] You were sent by Carendin? Sithel, then.

Do not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.
quest_1473_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems the consensus that you are ready to learn to summon a voidwalker.

[soft voice] A being created of the chaos that lies beyond, if you summon one but cannot control it, you will be torn asunder.

[solemn] The first voidwalker was summoned by Egalin, and in his grimoire is the process explained.

[sad] Unfortunately, it was stolen from us by an agent of the Scarlet Crusade who has it secreted away in his base at a tower to the west. [commanding] Bring it to me, and I will impart the knowledge to you.
quest_1473_quest_progress:
[solemn] Egalin was the teacher that taught me. [soft voice] With hardly a look, he was able to command the voidwalker he had summoned.

[hesitant] When it came my turn to try, I was overconfident. Do not trifle with the powers that you wield, <name>, they can consume even the vigilant.
quest_1473_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, this is excellent. [soft voice] Like as not, Perrine was ignorant to the true power of the musty book he had stolen from us.

[commanding] It will not fall out of our hands again. [commanding voice] Observe, <name>, the structure of the spell, the manner in which your power must be channeled.
quest_1474_quest_detail:
[solemn] Using these hearts, cast a spell at the summoning circle to open a doorway for the succubus to come through. [commanding] Your powers are greater now, and you will need all of them to defeat the succubus.

Beware its charms, <name>, many a strong mind has been bound to its will. [pause] When overcome, the succubus will be returned to the void, and I will teach you the spell to summon it forth at your command.
quest_1474_quest_progress:
[solemn] Of the powers from beyond the void, the succubus is one of the most dangerous, as the weak are most easily wrapped around its fingers.

[emphasis] Remember that now and in the future.
quest_1474_quest_complete:
Again, you have done well, <name>. [warm] It has been quite some time since I have seen a young <class> with as much potential as you. [solemn] Be assured that I will continue to watch your progress, and prepare and assist you in your future trials.

[proud] For now, let me show you the summoning spell for your newly dominated succubus.
quest_1475_quest_detail:
[solemn] According to legend, The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is a holy shrine dedicated to the ancient god, Hakkar the Soulflayer. [low voice] Maintained by a vicious tribe of trolls named the Atal'ai, the temple is rumored to be impenetrable.
