[pause] Now sunk beneath the Pool of Tears, retrieving artifacts from the temple is even more difficult. [urgent] But that's what I need you to do, <name>.

[warm] Aid me by gathering the intact Atal'ai Tablets. Bring them to me and I will return to the Explorers' Guild a hero. [confident] Together we will share the glory.
quest_1475_quest_progress:
[solemn] As dusk slowly descends upon my career I turn to you, <name>, to help me in my final quest for the Explorers' League. [soft voice] If my old bones could muster the strength to brave the Swamp of Sorrows and the sunken temple I would be fighting right alongside you.

[sad] Pride makes it hard for me to ask for your help in collecting the Atal'ai Tablets. But old age forces the necessity.

[hesitant] Please help me, <name>. [solemn] I want to retire from the Explorers' League having completed their final bidding.
quest_1475_quest_complete:
[delight] The Atal'ai Tablets! [warm] Thank you, <name>!

[excited] Once I deliver these to the Explorers' League our names shall go down in history together. [proud] You have helped an old dwarf fulfill his final obligation in life. [warm] For that I am eternally grateful.
quest_1476_quest_detail:
[solemn] Men of honor and goodness? Does such a man exist?

[soft voice] It took much research, but through bits of overheard stories, I managed to find two men that should do.

[low voice] The first is Dalin Forgewright, who has dedicated himself to the care of the Lordaeron refugees, whom are refused by their kin at the Greymane Wall.

[solemn] The other is Comar Villard, a man who remains faithful to his lost love, wandering the Wetlands for a sign of his wife.

[urgent] Deliver their hearts to Carendin. [commanding] But first, let me show you your quarry.
quest_1476_quest_progress: [soft voice] I have been pleasantly surprised by the speed of your progress so far, <name>. [commanding] Bring me the hearts and you will impress me once again.
quest_1476_quest_complete:
[solemn] The heart of a goodly man seems much the same as any, when you see it like this, don't you think?

[soft voice] Perhaps we possess something of a... different... view on the subject. [pause] These will do, though. [low voice] I have no doubt that a succubus would be attracted by their purity.
quest_1477_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our mages are conducting research at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands, research vital to our understanding of the Dark Portals. [urgent] They require nearly constant supplies, but our supply line to Nethergarde is tenuous.

[commanding] You must help ensure the supplies make it to Nethergard. Report to Watchmaster Sorigal in Darkshire, and do as he asks. [urgent] This task will take you into hostile lands, <name>. [commanding] Prepare yourself.
quest_1477_quest_complete: [solemn] Andromath sent you? Very good. [soft voice] I have an important task for you...
quest_1478_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, <name>! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.

[warm] You should be proud of yourself, <name>. [soft voice] It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.

[gentle] You'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.
quest_1478_quest_complete: [solemn] Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, <name>. [commanding] Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. [urgent] There is still much you have to learn.
quest_1479_quest_detail:
I've heard stories about how the night elves have their bank in a tree - one that looks like a bear! [excited] That's so cool! [delight] Night elves are neat how they like nature and stuff, but bears are just totally awesome!

[excited] Would you take me to see the bear-tree in Darnassus, please? [soft voice] There's a boat that will take us close to there, and it shouldn't take very long. [hesitant] Please, please, please!
quest_1479_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, it was cooler than I even imagined - the Bough of the Eternals! [excited] I didn't think it'd be so big, but it was! [excited] Did you see the bird on top of it too?! [excited] I wonder how they got the branches to look like that!

[warm] Thanks for taking me to Darnassus, <name>. [proud] You're awesome!
quest_1480_quest_detail:
[solemn] The torn skin smells rotten, and is remarkably pliable for something that appears to be dry and fragile.

[soft voice] As you unroll it, you can clearly see the red markings of some kind of language on one side. [pause] At the bottom of the skin is a very clear symbol that you guess is a signature of some kind.

[hesitant] Perhaps it is something Maurin could tell you more about?
quest_1480_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Burning Blade begin to realize how weak they truly are. [low voice] Their magics are pathetic, their strength feeble.

[commanding] Their only power comes from those they serve, and not from any understanding of true power and knowledge.
quest_1480_quest_complete: [solemn] Hmm, these runes are indeed a language, <name>, an old language. They seem remotely similar to the Eredun language, but the differences are drastic. If I am not mistaken, this is a contract of some kind.... [pause] Here, yes, this symbol is the demon's signature: Lord Azrethoc.
quest_1481_quest_detail:
[solemn] I believe I can find this demon lord given the proper reagents.

[soft voice] If he is indeed as powerful as I suspect, I will need items gathered from deadly creatures. [commanding] But you act in the Warchief's name, so I am sure you will accept my task.

[pause] First, I will have to break any wards he has against scrying. [urgent] For this, I will need the scalp from a satyr--but not any satyr. [solemn] The scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker.

[soft voice] Search for them among the ancient ruins in the northeast of Desolace.
quest_1481_quest_progress:
[commanding] Do not bring me an incorrect scalp, <class>. [urgent] Using the incorrect reagents could cause our deaths. [solemn] The demon lord may have contingency spells on his person to slay those who would scry upon him.

[sad] Fate has already dealt me enough pain.
quest_1481_quest_complete:
[solemn] The shadowstalkers were unable to slay you, <class>. Impressive... most impressive.

[low voice] This scalp will do nicely for my spell. [pause] While you were away, I was able to gather some of the other reagents needed for the spell.

[solemn] I am almost ready. [urgent] I only need a focus for the spell--something to project an image of the demon lord and his whereabouts.
quest_1482_quest_detail:
[soft voice] An oracle crystal would do nicely. They are crafted by the naga for their oracles to use.

[pause] Northwest of here, along the coast, is a vast coral reef that the naga have taken as their home when this close to the shore. You can find their oracles there. [commanding] The Slitherblade are deadly and will not react kindly to your intrusions, so be careful and make haste.

[solemn] When you return, we shall see about finding this demon lord Azrethoc.
quest_1482_quest_progress: [urgent] I am ready for the oracle crystal, <class>. [commanding] Finding and destroying this Lord Azrethoc would garner a great deal of favor with the Warchief for both of us. [solemn] We would do well to work together and to do so swiftly so we may further our own ends and curry favor with the Warchief.
quest_1482_quest_complete:
[solemn] A precious oracle crystal... flawless... beautiful. Indeed.

We shall begin immediately. Finding this demon lord should be our primary concern, and its slaying demands our utmost attention.

[commanding] Take a step back, <class>, and let us see what this demon is, and where he may be found.
quest_1483_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
quest_1483_quest_complete:
[excited] I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!

[laughing] Ha! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. [urgent] If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
quest_1484_quest_detail:
[solemn] This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated. [low voice] No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.

[soft voice] Speak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. [hesitant] It is better if he thinks it his own idea.
quest_1484_quest_complete: [solemn] I witnessed what just occurred with Maurin and the demon lord. [sad] That creature, even as an apparition, seems to have more power than my warlock companion. [hesitant] I wonder if he's up to the task of defeating the monster? It would serve the Warchief better if I go myself, but with my responsibilities here, I would disgrace my clan if I turned my back on my duties here to battle this evil for my own honor.
quest_1485_quest_detail:
[solemn] Those warlocks who came before us have earned the distrust of the Horde, and while we are tolerated, we are not loved.

This has not brought the warlocks closer together, however, as many choose to live reclusively, dabbling in their magics alone. [soft voice] I will not seek to lead you down one path or the other, but only help you in your maturation.

[pause] Before I teach you the art of summoning, [commanding] bring me six heads of the vile familiars from the cave to the northeast.
quest_1485_quest_progress: [solemn] It is important that you can control the beings that you summon through your magic. [low voice] There are few enough interested in learning the ways of the <class> that I would risk throwing your life away by teaching you something before you are ready.
quest_1485_quest_complete:
[solemn] Throughout your training as a <class>, you will learn to call forth beings of many sorts. [soft voice] Some may not seem it, but all are useful tools.

Do not be fooled by the imp's small size. [emphasis] As you no doubt noticed, it is still a formidable adversary.
quest_1486_quest_detail:
[solemn] As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

[soft voice] These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. [solemn] While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. [soft voice] I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

[commanding] If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
quest_1486_quest_progress: [solemn] I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. [soft voice] Have you had any luck in collecting some, <class>?
quest_1486_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, <name>.

[warm] Thank you for your dedication.
quest_1487_quest_detail:
[solemn] Naralex had a noble goal.

[soft voice] Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. [sad] But something went terribly wrong.

[low voice] Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

[urgent] While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

[commanding] Brave the caverns, <name>, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
quest_1487_quest_progress:
<name>, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. [solemn] Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. [soft voice] We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.

[urgent] I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!
quest_1487_quest_complete:
[solemn] As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, <name>.

[warm] Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

[soft voice] Thank you and may you prosper.
quest_1488_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although I have no knowledge of this Lord Azrethoc, I agree with Maurin, he must be stopped; especially if he is attempting to gain influence over the Burning Blade to further his goals.

[commanding] You have already shown you wish to aid the Warchief, and I would trust you to gather a party to slay the demon lord and his warlock servant.

[urgent] When you are ready, head directly south, and return to me when the threat has been ended.
quest_1488_quest_progress:
[commanding] Glory to the Horde, and death to our enemies, <name>!

[solemn] The demons in Desolace pose a greater threat than ever before. [sad] My hope of returning to the Warchief dwindles as more and more of the foul creatures seem to appear.

[hesitant] I sometimes wish it was only the centaur we had to deal with.
quest_1488_quest_complete:
[excited] A mighty victory for us all, <name>. [warm] Let us rejoice in your success. [solemn] I trust now that our future here is not as bleak as I once thought.

[confident] The demons will be slain, the Burning Blade will fail in their efforts, and we may one day have a place we can safely call home again.
quest_1489_quest_detail:
[solemn] The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen. [sad] I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land. [soft voice] It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

[solemn] The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint. [pause] But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid. [solemn] I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens. [gentle] He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

[warm] You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
quest_1489_quest_complete: [solemn] I bid you greetings, <name>. [warm] You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength. [emphasis] For the task we now set before you ... [pause] is a dire one.
quest_1490_quest_detail:
[solemn] I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns. I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way. [sad] They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

[pause] I am old and my strength fails. I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids. [soft voice] But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce. [emphasis] She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

[commanding] Speak with Nara. [warm] She is in the tent, over yonder.
quest_1490_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, it is true. [soft voice] I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns. I have seen their twisted, scaled faces. I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

[urgent] You must stop them, <name>.
quest_1491_quest_detail:
[excited] Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well. But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try! And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

[pause] There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens. Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

[urgent] I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west. Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
quest_1491_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, you got it! [excited] I can't wait to try it out. [delight] This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [confident] Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
quest_1492_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. [pause] Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.

[urgent] If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.
quest_1492_quest_progress: [urgent] You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
quest_1492_quest_complete:
[soft voice] A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? [excited] Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.

All taken care of! [warm] Good day to you, <class>.
quest_1498_quest_detail:
As a warrior, one of our most crucial tasks is... [solemn] protection. We are the shield of the Horde, and we keep our weaker brethren safe. If you are to join in our ranks, then you must prove your mettle to me.

Go to Thunder Ridge in Durotar, where live the lightning hides and thunder lizards. Hunt the beasts! [commanding] Show me you are tougher than they! [urgent] Brave their assaults and bring me a stack of their singed scales as proof.

Do this, and then I will teach you.
quest_1498_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the scales, <name>? Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.
quest_1498_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah. I see you have defeated the thunder lizards, which proves you are tough. [commanding] Now I will show you how tough skin and shrewd movements can combine to form an impenetrable wall of defense.

[emphasis] Learn your lesson well, <name>. [soft voice] And be ready for future instruction.
quest_1499_quest_detail:
[solemn] Zureetha has been sending novices like yourself to help cull the numbers of the creatures in the cave near where you fought the vile familiars.

[soft voice] I think it would be good for you to gain experience by assisting her. [urgent] Be sure to tell her that you assisted with the imp problem, she'll probably have a reward for you.
quest_1499_quest_complete:
[warm] You have done well, <name>.

[solemn] Although the vile familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, [emphasis] your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
quest_1501_quest_detail:
[solemn] So few warlocks remain... We risk much, but the risks are warranted. [urgent] You must quickly reach maturity in your ability if you are to be of use to the Horde and to the Warchief.

[commanding] It is time that you learned a new summoning spell.

First, you must recover the Tablet of Verga, which was stolen by warlocks of the Burning Blade and is now kept at their lair in Skull Rock to the east of the city. [soft voice] With the tablet, I will show you the runes necessary to summoning a voidwalker.
quest_1501_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the Tablet of Verga, <name>? [angry] If not, I do not wish to speak with you until you do.
quest_1501_quest_complete:
Good. [commanding] I hope you inflicted some other losses on the Burning Blade when you went to retrieve this.

[solemn] They have been a source of great annoyance for the Warchief, and a great blight upon warlocks as a whole.
quest_1502_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is vital that a warrior's weapon is one of quality. And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze. [soft voice] He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.

[commanding] If you seek a weapon, warrior, then you should seek Thun'grim. [urgent] To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills. [emphasis] His camp is high on a hilltop.
quest_1502_quest_complete:
[low voice] My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame, but some things I can still see. [soft voice] I can see you want something.

And if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.
quest_1503_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will give you a weapon, <name>, but first you must aid me. [angry] The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past. They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me! [mocking tone] The cowards! They took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars. [urgent] If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.

[commanding] Search for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
quest_1503_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my steel bars?
quest_1503_quest_complete:
[excited] You found them! [warm] And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me. [soft voice] I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Here is your reward. [solemn] May it serve you well.
quest_1504_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, observe the Tablet of Verga, for it contains the glyphs you will need for the summoning. [soft voice] Take them to the circle in Neeru Fireblade's tent on the other side of the cavern. [urgent] There you will be able to call for the voidwalker.

[commanding] You must defeat it using whatever physical and magical means you have at your disposal. [solemn] When this is completed, return to me with the glyphs of summoning and I will demonstrate how you may bind the creature to your will.
quest_1504_quest_progress:
[solemn] The voidwalker is a powerful creature. [soft voice] I remember when it was I that was in your shoes, <name>. [low voice] Over the years, my own voidwalker has grown to fight me less, though I suspect that is only because it hopes I will let my guard down.

[emphasis] Remember that, <name>.
quest_1504_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [soft voice] I will show you how to summon the voidwalker similar to the one you just defeated.

[warm] You should know that we have high expectations for you, and you have, so far, matched them.

Do not let it go to your head, however, as the tasks that still lie before you will make this seem as simple as waking in the morning.
quest_1505_quest_detail: [solemn] The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned. [soft voice] But the truly great warriors are great students as well.
quest_1506_quest_detail:
You there. <name>, right?

[urgent] I hope your schedule isn't busy, because Gan'rul wants to see you right away. You'll find him with the senior warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow.

Based on my past dealings with Gan'rul, your summons is either a very good thing or a very bad thing.
quest_1506_quest_complete:
Good. I was afraid Ophek wouldn't reach you.

[solemn] It is time that I further your warlock training. [urgent] Any business you have currently will have to wait.

[commanding] I trust there will not be a problem with this?
quest_1507_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come for you to learn more of the summoning magics. [soft voice] You will learn to summon a succubus, a creature of incredible mental powers. It can lull those of weak minds into its servitude--but have no fear! [warm] I feel certain that you will be equal to the challenge.

[solemn] A succubus can only be summoned when baited with an item that represents great devotion and love. [soft voice] I leave it to you to find such an object.

[soft voice] A suggestion? Speak with Cazul... There seems to be little the ancient warlock does not know.
quest_1507_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hm... Zarm. You are still new to your path, but I sense the possibility for greatness in you.

[solemn] You were born with gifts, <name>. [warm] See that they do not go to waste.
quest_1508_quest_detail:
Hmm... [hesitant] But, of course, that is not why you have come to speak with me.

[soft voice] If Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, and need an object to use for enticement.

Hmm... [hesitant] If you trust a blind man to lead you, <name>, then listen. [solemn] In the bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. [soft voice] She waits for the return of her mate.

[solemn] Go to her.
quest_1508_quest_complete: [solemn] Have you come with news of Dogran? [sad] He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...
quest_1509_quest_detail:
[solemn] My mate, Dogran, was recently sent to the Crossroads for duty. It was a promotion, and he was very proud.

[sad] I was sad, of course, but I didn't let him know that. And worried, too. The Barrens is a more dangerous place than Orgrimmar, and I feared the worst.

[urgent] Now it's been a week after he should have returned, and I have received no word from him...

Perhaps you could go to the Crossroads and see if they have any news? He worked with Gazrog, who should still be stationed there.
quest_1509_quest_complete:
Zankaja? That's Dogran's mate, right?

[soft voice] Yeah, I've heard from him, but it's not the sort of news we should let get back to her...

No, he's not dead. But he is injured and a prisoner of the quilboar.
quest_1510_quest_detail:
[solemn] He was stationed at Camp Taurajo, where we've been trying to weed out the quilboar. He led a few grunts to one of their camps, where he was hurt bad. The others made it back and tried to rescue him. He was in bad shape, his wounds festered, so they were afraid to move him without patching him up first.

They sent a message here, requesting a healing draught from the trolls at the Malaka'jin at the base of the Stonetalon Mountains. [urgent] We sent someone to get it, but they haven't returned yet.
quest_1510_quest_complete:
[solemn] Another <race>, eh? [sad] I hope you haven't come for the other. [sad] He didn't make it. [sad] Those goblins did him in good.

[sad] He said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
quest_1511_quest_detail:
[solemn] I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.

[soft voice] Here you go, <name>. [urgent] Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! [emphasis] That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. [pause] Wait a night, then give him the other half.

[hesitant] Anyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. [solemn] From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.
quest_1511_quest_complete:
[urgent] Well, it's about time! [angry] Dogran has been dying out there, waiting for this.

We need to get this out to him right away, but most of the grunts stationed here are out on a foraging mission.
quest_1512_quest_detail:
[solemn] Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.

Leave me, <name>. And thank you. [soft voice] I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.

And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
quest_1512_quest_progress: [solemn] You have returned. [commanding] Are you ready to battle a succubus?
quest_1512_quest_complete: [solemn] If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, <name>. [soft voice] Allow me to clean it though... [whispering] Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
quest_1513_quest_detail:
[commanding] Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, <name>. [urgent] Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. [confident] I believe in the strength of your magic. [solemn] As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.

[pause] When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
quest_1513_quest_progress:
[solemn] When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

Be wary, my friend.
quest_1513_quest_complete:
[excited] Success! [commanding] Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

[warm] You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. [urgent] Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.

[solemn] Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
quest_1515_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. [low voice] I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.

Dogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. [urgent] He'll be heavily guarded--that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.

[soft voice] Good luck.
quest_1515_quest_complete:
Foul tasting brew...

[soft voice] I can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... [sad] But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. [sad] My arm, too.
quest_1516_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time is now, young <class>. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. [soft voice] Following the shaman's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.

[solemn] The element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. [pause] But you must stand before the earth itself. [solemn] If you are ready, then you will see things only shaman know of.

[urgent] Seek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. [warm] Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.
quest_1516_quest_progress:
[solemn] Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. [low voice] The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.

[urgent] The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. [warm] When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.

[threatening] Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
quest_1516_quest_complete:
[solemn] Excellent. Your success shows that you are prepared.

Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. [soft voice] It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. [emphasis] Earth will protect you, but only if shown the proper respect. [pause] Like the other elements, even earth can be fickle. [solemn] Earth is the basis for life, and by observing its laws, you will gain greater wisdom. [emphasis] Never forget the secrets earth shares with you.

[solemn] I shall make a sapta for you now, and by accepting it, you will realize your path.
quest_1517_quest_detail:
[solemn] A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. [soft voice] Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. [pause] Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

[solemn] The sapta is always drunk in a holy place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

[urgent] Seek out Spirit Rock southwest of here--it is found at the end of the Hidden Path. [soft voice] Drink your sapta there, and... well, you shall see.
quest_1518_quest_progress:
[solemn] I wish to be the first to welcome you fully to the first of four paths that will forever lead you in your destiny.

[soft voice] If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised.

[commanding] If not, then be gone with you until you have found your way.
quest_1518_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent!

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among <class>--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.

The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.

But for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
quest_1519_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come, young <class>. Your body ages and grows strong, and your spirit endures like the earth. I see it within you-you have wisdom already.

[soft voice] The earth guides our people, and it speaks to us, as it will to you in time. [pause] But you must be tested. If you are ready, then you shall see things only our kind know of.

[commanding] Seek out the Bristleback shamans in their ravine to the east, and take from them a salve they use in their rituals. Return to me only when you have enough for your own potion.
quest_1519_quest_progress:
[solemn] The earth is patient, and will wait for you until you are ready because she knows in time all things erode and are reborn. It is the cycle of things. Mountains become deserts. Rivers become canyons. [soft voice] The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements.

You must learn patience and stamina above all things. [solemn] The earth calls for you now because she feels you are ready. [solemn] Consider this your rebirth if you succeed. [solemn] You will never be able to go back to ignorance afterwards.
quest_1519_quest_complete:
Good, <name>. [solemn] Your return here signifies that you are indeed prepared for the next step.

Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. [soft voice] It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. The Earth Mother will protect you, but only if you show her proper respect. [warm] She is the basis for life, and by observing her laws, you will gain a greater wisdom. [pause] Never forget the secrets she shares with you.

[solemn] I shall make your sapta for you now, and by accepting it, a new path will open before you.
quest_1520_quest_detail:
[solemn] A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. [soft voice] Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. [pause] Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.

[solemn] The sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.

[commanding] Seek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.
quest_1521_quest_progress:
Greetings, <name>. [solemn] You would not return to me if you had not accomplished your task. [soft voice] May I be the first to welcome you fully to the first path of four that will forever rule your travels.

[emphasis] If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised. [sad] If not, then I pity you. [solemn] There is much pride to be had when you've fully dedicated yourself to the elements.
quest_1521_quest_complete:
Splendid.

[solemn] The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol--it has abilities beyond that. [solemn] One use of the totem is a focus for spells. [soft voice] Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. [pause] Trainers found throughout Kalimdor will know when you are ready for greater knowledge and will let you know as much when you visit them.

[warm] But for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
quest_1522_quest_detail:
[commanding] Fire be witcha, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of earth already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Kranal.

Kranal live north of da Crossroads in da Barrens. He be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of fire... if you tink you be ready.

[solemn] He be easy ta find, just don' go too far--ya go too far an' ya find yerself in da elves' lands.
quest_1522_quest_complete:
Hmmm, Searn sent you to me, did he?

Well then, Searn could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

[solemn] I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. [commanding] Patience, <name>. [soft voice] Remember what earth taught you. [pause] Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
quest_1523_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been since you were last tested, <name>. [soft voice] You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. [emphasis] The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. [solemn voice] The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.

[urgent] Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.
quest_1523_quest_complete:
[low voice] Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?

Well then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

[solemn] I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. [commanding] Patience, <name>. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
quest_1524_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are powerful enough to wield the totem of fire, but that does not mean you are ready.

[soft voice] Along the Southfury River in Durotar, before the Great Sea, lies a hidden trail to one of the highest peaks in the land. [pause] Find your way to the top and you shall find one of our holy shrines watched over by Telf Joolam--the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.

[commanding] Take this torch to him--it marks that you attempt to tame fire. [urgent] Return it to me aflame by the brazier at the shrine and I will see you are given the totem of fire.
quest_1524_quest_progress: Greetin's, <name>. [solemn] You've found yerself at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. [soft voice] Only those knowledgeable enough in the shamanistic arts will ever learn the secrets of this place and the power it holds. [sad] I'm sorry you made the trip all this way, only to be turned back now--the journey up here is far from safe after all--but [commanding] I am the keeper of the shrine, and I cannot allow just anyone to wander around here.
quest_1524_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, my mistake, <name>. [sad] I apologize. [sad] I did not realize you possessed the Torch. [solemn] I am pleased to make your acquaintance.

[solemn] Many adventurers find their way here while looking for lost treasure or the promise of mystical creatures to slay, only to be turned away from a seemingly empty shrine. [solemn] But we know the truth, do we not, <name>?

[solemn] This shrine holds a greater secret from the mundane members of the Horde. [solemn] To us, it is sacred.
quest_1525_quest_detail:
[commanding] But you did not come here for a history lesson, did you? [soft voice] You came for the Eternal Flame and fire totem.

The first step is to create a sapta and bind you to the flame.

[urgent] I can create the fire sapta for you if you bring me two items. The first is fire tar, a simple item usually carried by Razormane spellcasters in eastern Barrens.

The second item will be more dangerous: a reagent pouch from one of the cultists of the Burning Blade. [solemn] You can find them in a cave above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill.
quest_1525_quest_progress:
I have enough ingredients for a sapta of fire if you can find the reagent pouch and some fire tar. [urgent] The Burning Blade fanatics carry the proper components for most of their spells in those pouches, and usually have enough of the items I need that we will not have to search much farther for anything else.

[solemn] The saptas are always made from ingredients that are closely tied to their respective elements. [soft voice] It makes our work easier because of the warlocks' ties to fire.
quest_1525_quest_complete:
[solemn] These will do nicely, <name>.

[soft voice] Fire is more than chaos and destruction--do well to remember that. [pause] It is also about life, and creation. [pause] All things are tied together in such a way. [pause] Forces oppose one another, but at the same time, one cannot exist without the other. [pause] Both extinguish one another, but also give one another meaning. [pause] Always remember this.

[solemn] Using different types of magic in conjunction with one another will show not only true skill, but great wisdom.
quest_1526_quest_detail:
[solemn] The fire sapta is finished. [solemn] The time has come for you to face the flame. [urgent] Use the sapta at the shrine and head to the top of the mountain to face the manifestation there. [commanding] He will not attack until you are ready, but he will realize you are able to see him.

[commanding] Strike him down swiftly, <name>, for he shall only grow in power the longer you take to slay him. [solemn] Once he is defeated, place his glowing embers within the brazier and light the torch.
quest_1526_quest_progress: [solemn] The brazier stands about a third your height, and looks normal, save for the inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. [soft voice] The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.
quest_1526_quest_complete:
[solemn] A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. [soft voice] You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.

[warm] You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire.
quest_1527_quest_detail: [commanding] Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Durotar. [solemn] You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.
quest_1528_quest_detail:
[commanding] Water be in ya future, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of fire already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Islen.

Islen live along the coast of da Barrens. If ya head south along the Southfury River, ya canna miss her--look fer da big shark! She be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of water... if you tink you be ready.

[soft voice] She be easy ta find, just don' go too far south--she be jus' beyond Ratchet.
quest_1528_quest_complete:
[solemn] The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.

[warm] Your path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. [gentle] But the first step is yours to take.
quest_1529_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been since you were last tested, <name>. [soft voice] You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. [solemn] The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.

[urgent] Seek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. [soft voice] She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. [soft voice] You will find her there at her fishing hut. [warm] Good luck to you, <name>.
quest_1529_quest_complete:
[solemn] The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.

[warm] Your path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. [gentle] But the first step is yours to take.
quest_1530_quest_detail:
[solemn] If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.

[soft voice] Its power flows, erodes, and makes clean all manner of things. [emphasis] You will find its ability to heal and replenish incomparable, but only when it is pure.

[pause] When you understand that water, when polluted, can devastate all that it touches, you will appreciate how vital a resource it is.

[urgent] If you wish the water sapta, find Brine deep in Southern Barrens. [low voice] Her home is continually molested by the quilboar there.
quest_1530_quest_complete:
Yes?

Mmm. [soft voice] I have a feeling I know what you're going to ask me: what would possess someone to live out here in the deepest part of the Barrens, the threat of quilboar all around, and no protection? Well, we all have our reasons to justify why we act the way we do. [solemn] The real question is, what brings a lowly <race> to the deepest reaches of the Barrens to speak to a woman who obviously has no concern for her own well-being?

[low voice] I'm willing to bet we both know the answer to that.
quest_1531_quest_detail:
[commanding] You be makin' headway now, mon. [soft voice] Your be ready to prove yerself worthy of the air totem, but first, ya must fin' Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles. [gentle] She be willin' ta tell ya how to get yer air totem if ya treat her wit enough respect.

[urgent] Head south through the Barrens, and after ya reach Thousand Needles, head east. [mocking tone] You'll find her hiddin' in a hole wit' her boyfriend--haha, don' tell her I be dissin' her none--she not take it too kindly.
quest_1531_quest_complete: For the time being. [solemn] I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. [warm] Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
quest_1532_quest_detail:
[solemn] The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful brothers. [proud] I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.

[soft voice] The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.

[commanding] Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. [solemn] It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. [warm] She will teach you more.
quest_1532_quest_complete: [solemn] For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. [warm] Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
quest_1534_quest_detail:
[commanding] Take this waterskin and head deep into the lush forest the night elves call Ashenvale. It is to the far north of the Barrens.

[pause] Once you've entered the forest, travel west. Along the mountains that separate Stonetalon and Ashenvale, and beyond Lake Mystral, you will find a holy place: the Ruins of Stardust. [solemn] At the center of the lake you will find a small fountain.

[soft voice] Bring me a sample of the fountain's water. It will be the final component you'll need before I send you back to Islen.
quest_1534_quest_progress:
[urgent] Do you have the water yet, <name>? [solemn] Tales say the ruins were protected by large creatures of nature that do not care for visitors, but those could be myths to scare off the enemies of the night elves.

[hesitant] Regardless, be careful.
quest_1534_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful, <name>. With all three samples gathered, I can create for you a vial of the purest water any living creature will find. It will be used in the next steps of your rite of passage.

[proud] I am pleased to count you among our kind, <name>. You do all <class> proud, and I look forward to hearing about your exploits in the future.
quest_1535_quest_detail:
[solemn] To find understanding and gain the sapta from me, you must seek out only the purest forms of water. [soft voice] As you fetch the samples for me, take note of your surroundings. [hesitant] Be aware of the creatures that rely on the water, that protect it. [emphasis] See how it affects forests and deserts. [solemn] Witness how the very substance that sustains life will force creatures to take lives.

[pause] We shall start with a simple task: down below my hut there is a pond of the precious liquid. [commanding] Fill this skin with it and return to me.
quest_1535_quest_progress:
[commanding] I am just about prepared to send you on your other tasks. [soft voice] Have you filled the skin yet?

[solemn] I know how protective the quilboar can be. [solemn] Even such a small water source is a vast hoard of wealth to them. [solemn] They have great feasts when even the slightest rain comes to the Barrens. [solemn] Water is sacred to their kind because it is so scarce. [pause] Do you understand?
quest_1535_quest_complete:
[solemn] I thought some bloodshed might ensue if you tried to take water from the pool. It is a pity the quilboar do not realize that all living things are tied together; that their greed only perpetuates the pain and suffering of their people. [soft voice] How much could they accomplish if they were to put their differences aside and their clans came together.

Again, a pity, but more than likely a boon for the other races of the Barrens.
quest_1536_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.

It was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. [soft voice] I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.

[gentle] Bring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
quest_1536_quest_progress:
[solemn] The well remaining pure within the town reminds me of stories told to me when I was younger, <name>. [soft voice] Even in times of great pain and sorrow one can find a sliver of hope, a small symbol to rally around. [solemn] The orc people see Thrall this way. [low voice] He survived against great odds and rose up to lead our people through his strength and example.

[sad] I'm not sure any orc has suffered as much as he has, but at the same time, [hesitant] I'm not sure any orc is as strong as he is either.
quest_1536_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is good, <name>. [warm] You're dedicated to the task at hand and have the ability to seek out that which is needed.

[solemn] One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. [warm] Islen will be pleased as well.
quest_1558_quest_detail: [soft voice] Ironforge is where all the dwarves and gnomes live. [pause] Near there is a place called Loch Modan, and the dwarves built a HUGE dam there. [excited] They say it's one of the biggest things anyone's ever made. [excited] Wow! [soft voice] Could you take me to Loch Modan and see the dam there, please? [hesitant] I think it is the Stone... um... Stonewrench Dam? [hesitant] Stonewrought? [soft voice] It's big - that's for sure. [soft voice] I'd like to look out over the big waterfall. [soft voice] I promise I won't lean over too far!
quest_1558_quest_complete:
WOW - the dam was WAY bigger than I thought! [excited] I could barely hear myself talk from the sound of all the rushing water! [hesitant] Hey, do you think it would ever run out of water? [shocked] Man, what would happen if that dam ever broke! [shocked] WOW, that would be scary!

[warm] Thanks for taking me to see the dam. [soft voice] That was very kind of you. [proud] I told you I wouldn't lean over too far!
quest_1559_quest_complete:
[excited] So you're an engineer, eh? Well, for your help in getting me those pearls, here's the recipe for flash bombs.

[warm] Good luck, and try not to blind yourself!
quest_1578_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it! [urgent] They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

[soft voice] That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear. [commanding] So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged. [warm] He might even share his knowledge with you.

[solemn] Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
quest_1578_quest_progress: [urgent] I have no time to chat. [commanding] Do you have business with me?
quest_1578_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, apologies! I didn't realize you were here to help resupply our troops. [warm] The stuff you made will be a big help!

Here are plans for some armor. [proud] I hope you find them useful.
quest_1579_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I came to Auberdine because of the quiet. I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

[laughing] So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way. I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard! [urgent] I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
quest_1579_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find my gaffer jacks, <name>? Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
quest_1579_quest_complete: [excited] I can't believe you found them! [warm] You must be the luckiest <race> in Kalimdor!
quest_1580_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, <name>?

One night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore. [pause] I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine. My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone! [urgent] I must have dropped them in the water!

[urgent] I need those electropellers! [urgent] Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...
quest_1580_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find any electropellers? [soft voice] I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
quest_1580_quest_complete:
[excited] I can't believe it! [excited] You found them! [proud] You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. And here, take these. Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.
quest_1581_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.

[hesitant] Can you help us?

[soft voice] If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you. [warm] I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.
quest_1581_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [urgent] Do you have the elixirs to trade?
quest_1581_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These are nicely mixed. You take great care in your trade, <name>, and that is important for an alchemist.

[warm] Here are your herbs, freshly gathered. [solemn] May you use them well.
quest_1582_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We in Darnassus, especially we craftsman, are quite busy. [solemn] Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.

[warm] If you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.
quest_1582_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, these are good pieces. [warm] You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. [proud] Your future as a leatherworker is promising.

[gentle] Here, <name>. [warm voice] Let me show you the pattern to make the Moonglow Vest.
quest_1598_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there! <name>, right?

[hesitant] I hope you're sure about becoming a warlock, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.

[commanding] I'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.

[solemn] There was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. [sad] Why do I care? [soft voice] Well, he stole some important books.

[cold] One of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. [urgent] Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.
quest_1598_quest_progress: [soft voice] It was too conspicuous for me to steal the book myself. [mocking tone] What luck one of their own patsies did the dirty work for me.
quest_1598_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.

[warm] Well, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.
quest_1599_quest_detail:
[commanding] You must be the new warlock everyone's been whispering about. [low voice] Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.

[soft voice] Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.

The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. [solemn] Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.

[urgent] Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
quest_1599_quest_progress: [soft voice] Those feather charms the novices carry have some sort of magical power to them. It will be interesting to research them. [surprised] I wouldn't have expected it from the trolls.
quest_1599_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good, very good! [warm] You've done well, <name>. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.

That'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as a <class>.

[soft voice] A word about the imp, <name>. As a <race> knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.
quest_1618_quest_detail:
[solemn] We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting. [urgent] Our human allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low. [soft voice] If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.
quest_1618_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope you're here with good news from Ironforge. [urgent] Because I'm at my wit's end!
quest_1618_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] This will help me out tremendously. With the Blackrock orcs attacking from Stonewatch Keep and the Redridge gnolls lurking in the foothills to the north, I'm always fixing armor and making new weapons for our troops.

The supplies you brought will give me a moment's peace. [solemn] I will have enough time to teach you something...
quest_1638_quest_detail: [solemn] You've shown yourself to be a competent warrior, <name>. [soft voice] But you're still young and have a lot to learn.
quest_1639_quest_detail:
[excited] Yeah, I can teach you. But first I wanna see what moves you have already.

See that drunk over there at the end of the bar? Bartleby? I want you to get his mug.

[laughing] Hah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.
quest_1639_quest_complete: [angry] Hello, fancy boy! [mocking tone] What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle? [soft voice] Be careful, or you might break a nail...
quest_1640_quest_detail: [angry] You want what?? [angry] You're crazy! [threatening] The only way you'll get this mug is if you pry it from my cold, dead fingers...
quest_1640_quest_complete: [excited] You're a lot tougher than you look!
quest_1641_quest_complete:
[solemn] Here in Stormwind, I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

[soft voice] The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. [warm] If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. [gentle] In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. [confident] If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
quest_1642_quest_detail:
[solemn] In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. [soft voice] To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

[pause] Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. [gentle] Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.

[solemn] Know this well, and never forget it.
quest_1642_quest_complete:
Hello again, <name>. [soft voice] How goes your studies of the Tome of Divinity?

[pause] Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.

[solemn] By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
quest_1643_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your task then, <name>, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light.
quest_1643_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.

Oh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.

The increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in Ironforge trying to seek help from the citizens there.
quest_1644_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.

[sad] My husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. [hesitant] I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.

[pause] What's that? [surprised] You'd be willing to help? [warm] Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, <name>.

[excited] If you could bring me some linen cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.
quest_1644_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I hope my John is having better luck in Ironforge. He so dislikes his trips there because it leaves the kids and me alone, but he knows it must be done. [gentle] He's so kind-hearted.

Some years have been easier than others, but this one's been rougher by far. [solemn] It's almost as though something in the air is signaling a huge change. [hesitant] Who knows though?
quest_1644_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you, <name>, thank you so much!

[warm] The children will be so pleased, and you've saved me so much time. [soft voice] I'll now be able to focus on the children's other needs, and hopefully my John will be able to return home sooner than we thought.

[warm] Thank you again, <name>. [proud] I knew I could rely on the charity of others. [solemn] The Light be with you.
quest_1645_quest_complete:
[solemn] Here in Ironforge, I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

[soft voice] The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. [warm] If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. [gentle] In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. [confident] If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
quest_1646_quest_detail:
[solemn] In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. [soft voice] To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

[commanding] Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. [warm] Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.

[solemn] Know this well, and never forget it.
quest_1646_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome back, <name>. You've spent time reading the book, I hope?

Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. [commanding] There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.

[warm] By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
quest_1647_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your task then, <name>, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. [soft voice] Someone who is pure of heart and motive. [pause] Perhaps someone helping others. [pause] Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. [commanding] Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. [solemn voice] I will remain here in the temple for your return. [pause] Other paladins will need my guidance also.
quest_1647_quest_complete:
[solemn] THE ORPHANAGE OF STOR... oh, sorry, didn't mean to shout at you, sir.

My name is John Turner. How are you?

Good, good, glad to hear things go well for you. I've had a long day of work already, and I miss my wife terribly, but that's the price you have to pay when there are mouths to feed and backs to clothe.
quest_1648_quest_detail:
[solemn] My wife and I run an orphanage in Stormwind, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. [soft voice] I come to Ironforge every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.

[hesitant] This trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.

[urgent] If I could just get some more linen for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.
quest_1648_quest_progress:
[soft voice] What with the influx of tradesmen here and throughout Azeroth, there's a smaller supply of items we use to make clothes for the children of our orphanage. [warm] Helping me collect linen so my wife can make new clothes for them is very noble of you, <name>. Thank you.

Hopefully, I'll be able to return home to my wife soon.
quest_1648_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is so wonderful of you, <name>. [warm] Thank you again.

[warm] You're a noble man for doing this for me. [solemn] It's no wonder you've chosen to follow the Light. [hesitant] I wish there was some way I could repay you for all you've done... [surprised] what's that? [warm] It's the least you could do? [excited] See? [warm] That's what I'm talking about, <name>, noble to the end.

[soft voice] Be safe, and may the Light protect you in your travels.
quest_1649_quest_detail:
[solemn] Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... refine them. [emphasis] When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.

[soft voice] This strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. [pause] You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.
quest_1649_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you wish to petition me for a test of valor. [solemn] Splendid. There are many tasks throughout the city and surrounding lands that hold much challenge, and they could use a man with your skills.

[commanding] This test should not be taken lightly, <name>. [soft voice] This, like many things along our path, could take our lives. [solemn] The Church always wishes to bolster its ranks, but it understands the sacrifices needed to ensure the paladins serving it are worthy.

[urgent] Are you prepared?
quest_1650_quest_detail:
[excited] Good! [commanding] Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. [solemn] So be it.

[soft voice] At the very ends of Westfall's Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. [warm] There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. [soft voice] Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to Ironforge to meet with the dwarves for a while. [hesitant] But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.

[urgent] Reports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, [soft voice] Daphne may need some protection from the villains. [commanding] Go there.
quest_1650_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hello, <name>. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.

[warm] Well, let me introduce myself: I'm Daphne Stilwell. It's a pleasure.

[urgent] Now, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. [hesitant] They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.
quest_1651_quest_detail:
[urgent] Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.

I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.

I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.

Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... [shocked] did you hear that? I think they're coming.

[commanding] We make our stand near the house!
quest_1651_quest_progress: [urgent] We'll make our stand at the house!
quest_1651_quest_complete:
[excited] We've done it, <name>! [warm] Thank you for your help. [proud] You were truly amazing out there. [soft voice] I never thought a <class> could handle so many enemies at once.

[warm] You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
quest_1652_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. [warm] I have you and the Church to thank for that.

[solemn] He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.

[sad] Oh, how I miss my husband. [excited] I can't wait till he returns.
quest_1652_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, we meet again, <name>, and you are in high spirits, I see.

The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. [warm] Well done. Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.

[proud] For your valor, you will be rewarded.
quest_1653_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Actually, I have no doubt that Jordan himself would like to thank you, and seeing as I need a messenger to send word that his wife is safe, I think you'd be a perfect choice.

[solemn] Jordan was to be a paladin of the Light before his dedication to his father's craft took him on another path--he's intimately familiar with our way of life and is considered among our most faithful.

[pause] He should still be in Ironforge--he likes to work outside the gates during the day, something about the cool mountain air.
quest_1653_quest_complete:
[gentle] Good day, <name>. [warm] The Light is with you, I trust?

[surprised] What's that? You were sent by Duthorian!? [urgent] My wife, how is she? [sad] I knew there was going to be trouble if I left. [soft voice] Please tell me she's... oh, thank goodness. [warm] I'm so glad that she's safe. [solemn] The Defias were a threat long before these attacks, but now the King's advisors cannot deny it.

[soft voice] What else did Duthorian have to say?

[proud] You're the one that was sent to protect my wife? [warm] Then I thank you again, <name>. [proud] I couldn't think of a better test of valor than that.
quest_1654_quest_detail:
[gentle] I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? [commanding] Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.

[solemn] I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. [urgent] I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. [warm] What do you say, <class>?
quest_1654_quest_progress:
[solemn] The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.

[warm] It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.
quest_1654_quest_complete:
[delight] This is wonderful! You've gotten all the items.

[proud] I should have no problem forging you a grand weapon with these. [soft voice] I've actually had the plans for doing this for some time. [pause] I just never had the opportunity to gather the goods. [warm] Thank you, <name>.

[soft voice] It feels good to have my father's hammer again...and a Kor gem. [surprised] I never thought I'd see one of these myself.
quest_1655_quest_detail:
[angry] Ach, ya startled me, man! [soft voice] Can't ya see I was lost in thought?

[surprised] What's that? [solemn] Jordan's shipment... fer Ironforge. [sigh] Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. [sad] Mo'grosh ogres... dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. [solemn] Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. [sad] The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago--healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough.

[urgent] If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. [hesitant] It's got to be there somewhere.
quest_1655_quest_progress: [urgent] So, any luck yet? [laughing] Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?
quest_1655_quest_complete:
[excited] Yup yup, this is it. Ha! [warm] If I'd known you were really gonna head out there and fight some o' them ogres, I woulda given you a list of things to get instead of just this one thing. But, you're not here doin' business for me, are ya?.

A deal's a deal; Jordan wanted a shipment of me alloy, that's what he's gonna get.

Tell 'em hello fer me, and be safe, <class>.
quest_1656_quest_detail:
<name>, please, I beg of you, can you help me? [soft voice] I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

[hesitant] I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. [hesitant] Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. [warm] I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
quest_1656_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

[pause] The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. [solemn] Which is it for you, I wonder?
quest_1656_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, the furs I was expecting. [warm] Thank you. [warm] These came faster than I had expected. [warm] They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

[warm] Please feel free to stay as long as you like. [warm] My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. [warm] And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
quest_1657_quest_detail:
[solemn] Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

Take one of these specially crafted stink bombs. It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell. You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!

[urgent] When you've completed this task... [solemn] this tribute to our liberation, return to me!
quest_1657_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you delivered our "gift" to the people of Southshore? <Darkcaller Yanka laughs wickedly.>
quest_1657_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, well done! [threatening] I hope the Alliance chokes on the foul gift we've given them, much like we were forced to choke on the yoke of enslavement to the Scourge!

[warm] You've kept the ideas of Hallow's End true, <name>, and for that I salute you. [warm] As an extra bonus, let me share some of these Hallow's End treats I have with you. [excited] I think you might find them to be quite the enjoyable diversion!
quest_1658_quest_detail:
[commanding] I need brave individuals to head up to Tirisfal Glade and check out the Wickerman Festival. [low voice] I'm not going to lie - heading up there will be dangerous. The guards at the festival will be exceptionally vicious. [solemn] Still, we need to know how big the festival is this year, and how much trouble the Forsaken are going to cause us during Hallow's End.

[urgent] If you're up for it, head to Tirisfal and scout out the festival. Return to me with the information, and I'll make sure you're well compensated.
quest_1658_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you gone up to Tirisfal Glade and checked things out? [urgent] They usually hold the festival close to the Undercity...
quest_1658_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well done, <name>. [solemn] The Wickerman Festival will continue to be trouble so long as the abominable Forsaken are allowed to haunt the remnants of Lordaeron. [solemn voice] It is NOT a fitting tribute to that once proud kingdom, let me tell you...

[warm] Here's some coin for any repairs you might need, and in the spirit of the season I've also included some treats you might like. [excited] Happy Hallow's End - [commanding] let's keep it as safe as possible here in Southshore.
quest_1661_quest_detail:
I greet you once again, <name>. [proud] I am more proud to call you brother than ever before--your dedication is a tribute to us all.

[solemn] The time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. [soft voice] But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest.

[pause] Speak to me again and I shall grant you a great boon.
quest_1661_quest_complete: [warm] Congratulations, and may the Light protect you.
quest_1665_quest_detail: [soft voice] Ok, here's my mug. [pause] Wait! [emphasis] Let me finish what's in it first... there we go.
