quest_1665_quest_progress: [solemn] I saw your fight with Bartleby. [excited] Nicely done! [urgent] Did you get his mug?
quest_1665_quest_complete: [excited] There it is! [proud] He sure didn't want to part with it, but you were persuasive. [warm] Well done. [solemn] Now for your lesson...
quest_1666_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've learned a few moves, but you could still use a decent weapon. [low voice] I bet if you spoke with Marshal Haggard he could help you.

[pause] Marshal Haggard lives in a manor in Elwynn Forest, at the Eastvale Lumber Camp. [solemn] He's retired now but he collected a lot of gear during his career.

[warm] Let him know I sent you, and with luck he'll have a spare weapon to offer.
quest_1666_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Who's that?

Burlguard, is that you?

You'll have to step a little closer. My eyes aren't what they used to be.

[pause] Walking up like that, I thought you were a gnoll!
quest_1667_quest_detail:
Burlguard sent you, did he? Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...

[solemn] A while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth Jack tricked me. It was dark and he was wearing a Stormwind tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan. He said he needed my old Stormwind Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... and then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!

[angry] Get back my badge! [urgent] Dead-tooth Jack probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.
quest_1667_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my badge? [hesitant] I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
quest_1667_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, you found it! [warm] I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a Stormwind official. [solemn] Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.

[proud] Here are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal. [warm] I kept them in great shape--take your pick!
quest_1678_quest_detail:
[commanding] If you want to rise in the ranks of the warriors, then you better be tough. I can teach you new moves but before that, prove to me you can handle yourself against real foes.

Vejrek is the toughest troll you'll find in these parts, and he's who you have to beat. [solemn] He has a hut in the foothills just south of Frostmane Hold

[urgent] Bring me Vejrek's head and I'll know you have mettle.
quest_1678_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you been to Vejrek's hut, <name>? [angry] Is that <race> stink I smell on you?
quest_1678_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Vejrek sure was an ugly one, eh? [warm] Nicely done, <name>! [proud] You have what it takes, now let's start your lesson...

[pause] You may not know it, but a strong defense is very important to a <class>. [solemn] It keeps him standing against foes that'd fell others, and that's what your allies need.
quest_1679_quest_detail:
[excited] Hello, warrior! You show a lot of promise, but you still need to learn some tricks and Muren Stormpike is just the dwarf to teach you.

[soft voice] You can find Muren at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward of Ironforge. [commanding] Talk to him when you're ready to learn what it is to be a warrior.
quest_1679_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, <name>. [warm] I heard the warriors of Dun Morogh bouncing your name around. [warm] I hope you haven't spent all your time in the breweries!
quest_1680_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now that you've learned some moves, it's time to get you a decent weapon. [soft voice] Speak with Tormus Deepforge. He can make you a weapon I'm sure you'll like.

[warm] You'll find Tormus here in Ironforge, at the Great Forge.
quest_1680_quest_complete:
Muren sent you, did he? Yes, I can make you a nice weapon... [commanding] but before I do that, I have a favor to ask of you.

Don't worry. It's plenty dangerous and could mean your death; it's exactly the sort of job a <class> wants.
quest_1681_quest_detail:
[solemn] My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

But one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore. [urgent] Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... a band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound. [shocked] They killed everyone!

[commanding] Enter Ironband's compound, <name>, and avenge my master's death. And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.
quest_1681_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you entered Ironband's Compound? [commanding] Did you find the umbral ore?
quest_1681_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] Well done! [soft voice] I hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching. [solemn] I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.

[warm] But thank you for the ore, <name>. [confident] I'm eager to work it and find its properties.
quest_1682_quest_complete:
[excited] Here are some weapons, hot off the anvil and made with the new umbral ore you brought me!

[warm] Please, <name>, take your pick!
quest_1683_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before I can teach you, you must show me your resolve.

[urgent] The satyr Vorlus Vilehoof has found one of our remote moonwells, southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. He now splashes within it, defiling its pure waters with his filth.

Find Vorlus at the moonwell and destroy him. Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a warrior.

[soft voice] The path to the moonwell is hidden well, <name>, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.
quest_1683_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the horn, <name>? [soft voice] Is our moonwell free of the fiend Vorlus?
quest_1683_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] It is good to know Vorlus is defeated and our moonwell cleansed, and it is good to see young warriors eager to keep our beloved Teldrassil free of corruption.

[solemn] Now let us begin your training...
quest_1684_quest_detail: Greetings, warrior. [soft voice] Your skill grows, but there is more to your profession than you may believe. [solemn] To further progress, you must soon find a teacher.
quest_1685_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Isn't that how it always works? [soft voice] Was looking for you all day and couldn't find you, now when I'm not expecting it, you come and walk right up to me.

[urgent] I've wasted enough time trying to find you, so I won't delay you any longer. [commanding] Master Gakin's summoned you for additional training. [emphasis] Seems to me you should seek him out as soon as possible.

[solemn] You'll find him in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb tavern. [whispering] By the way, you might want to keep that particular location quiet. [threatening] Don't want word spreading about it.
quest_1685_quest_complete:
[urgent] About time you showed up. Though, perhaps I should have sent someone more capable than Remen to find you.

No matter. You've gone too long without training, and a warlock without training isn't like to keep his head on his shoulders for long.
quest_1686_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have learned much, <name>. [warm] Now we will craft you a weapon. [soft voice] A warrior's weapon.

[urgent] To do this, you must travel to Darkshore.

[solemn] Long ago a ship crashed upon the rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse, scattering many crates of elunite ore along the ocean floor.

[commanding] First, you must defeat the elunite's guardian, the Shade of Elura. [solemn] Once the ship's captain, she cursed herself to roam the deeps and protect her shipment for all time. [commanding] Defeat her, gain her medallion, and gather the crates of lost Elunite.
quest_1686_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you defeated the Shade of Elura, <name>? [soft voice] And do you have the lost elunite ore?
quest_1686_quest_complete:
[solemn] Bravely done, <name>.

[warm] You have given the Shade of Elura much deserved peace, and we will use the gathered elunite to make a fine weapon for you.
quest_1687_quest_detail: [soft voice] Sometimes late at night, our matrons at the orphanage will tell us spooky stories. [whispering] Those RULE! [whispering] There's one about a ghost that haunts a lighthouse in Westfall. [whispering] They say he was a pirate captain who had his ship taken from him by other pirates. [excited] Wow! [soft voice] Could you please take me to the lighthouse in Westfall? [soft voice] I wanna see if the ghost of that captain is there! [soft voice] I promise to stay close to you; I won't run off or anything!
quest_1687_quest_complete:
[excited] WOW, that was a real life ghost! [delight] That was so awesome - I can't wait to tell everyone back at the orphanage. [warm] Captain Grayson... he even looked like a pirate! [excited] When I grow up I wanna be a ghost pirate too!

[warm] Thanks for taking me to Westfall, <name>. [soft voice] I know there are scary things out there in the wilds of Westfall, and I hope I wasn't too much of a pain. [proud] You're awesome!
quest_1688_quest_detail:
[solemn] I had a student named Surena Caledon. [soft voice] She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of warlock magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. [warm] More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. [angry] Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!

[threatening] The thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. [low voice] While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.

[cold] Her life means nothing to me now. [urgent] You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.
quest_1688_quest_progress: [solemn] Even the older and wiser can be unmanned by the wiles of youth and beauty, <name>. [soft voice] A piece of advice you would do well to remember throughout your life.
quest_1688_quest_complete:
[solemn] Surena was talented, but not enough so to gain mastery of <class> magic on her own. [soft voice] It's a shame to see talent wasted, but sometimes it is necessary.

[pause] I hope my investment in you will bear different results.
quest_1689_quest_detail:
[solemn] By retrieving my choker and besting Surena, you've proven that you're at least as capable as she was.

[soft voice] With that said, I can tell you're direly in need of training. You can manage the flows of magic, yes, but being a warlock is much more than that.

[commanding] I will show you how to command a voidwalker, but before I can, you must call one forth at a summoning circle and subdue it using whatever weapons--physical and magical--you have at your disposal. [urgent] Use the magic of this choker at the summoning circle below.
quest_1689_quest_progress: [commanding] I cannot show you how to control a voidwalker until you have overtaken one.
quest_1689_quest_complete:
[solemn] You did better than I expected, <name>, but as well as I'd hoped. [soft voice] Now, you can learn to command your subjugated voidwalker, an ally you will find valuable in the trials that are sure to stand before you.

[pause] I have nothing more to teach you at the present, but [commanding] I am far from done with you, <name>.
quest_1690_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there! It's time for you to be a big helper to the Gadgetzan Water Company.

The Wastewander nomads out in the Tanaris desert have seized almost all the water wells! Without access to them, our water supply will dry up in no time. If you want to get in our good graces, then you'll help us bring justice to those nomads!

Head east of here and bring down ten Wastewander Bandits and Thieves, then report back to me on the double. [solemn] Justice waits for no man... goblin... bah, just get on it!
quest_1690_quest_progress: [urgent] Back so soon? [excited] I hope you were able to bring some goblin-style justice to those Wastewander Bandits and Thieves like I asked you to!
quest_1690_quest_complete:
[excited] Now that's what I call efficiency! [warm] You've helped thin out the nomad's numbers enough now that we can start to think about how we can win back those water wells.

[solemn] The Gadgetzan Water Company thanks you for your help, but we're far from done in dealing with those foul nomads. [urgent] Listen close - here's what we need next...
quest_1691_quest_detail:
[urgent] We need you to take on the stronger ranks of the Wastewander nomads now. [soft voice] You've done a good job thus far, but if we are to take back those water wells, then it only makes sense to do it against as few nomads as possible!

[commanding] This time around we need you to take down their rogues, assassins, and shadow mages. [urgent] You'll find them east and southeast of here.

[low voice] I'm not going to lie to you - they're a nasty lot. [warm] Do this for us though, and we'll be on our way to taking back what is rightfully ours!
quest_1691_quest_progress: [urgent] Well, were you able to take out those nomads like I asked? The Gadgetzan Water Company is developing plans based on your success here! [commanding] Don't let us down, now...
quest_1691_quest_complete:
[excited] Top notch work, <name>... top notch! [proud] You've thinned down the nomad population to a point where we can actually take the fight to them!

[urgent] If you haven't already, talk to Spigot Operator Luglunket here; he gives a bounty on any of the Wastewander water pouches you may have run across while bringing those nomads to justice!
quest_1692_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have placed the elunite you gathered into a case. [urgent] Take it to the blacksmith Mathiel, and he will craft for you an elunite weapon.

[commanding] Mathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.
quest_1692_quest_progress: Greetings, young <class>. [soft voice] How might my skills serve you?
quest_1692_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, elunite ore. [soft voice] This is a fine metal to work with, for it is blessed by the goddess Elune herself. [warm] It would be an honor to craft weapons with it.

[pause] Please wait while I work...
quest_1693_quest_complete:
<name>, [warm] I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me. [soft voice] Please, take whichever most suits you.

And I must thank you. [proud] Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.
quest_1698_quest_detail: [solemn] Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the Alliance. [soft voice] He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.
quest_1698_quest_complete:
Hah! [excited] So you heard of my challenge, did you?

[soft voice] Well sit down and listen. [warm] Have a drink, and savor it... [threatening] because it might be your last.
quest_1699_quest_detail:
[solemn] I call my challenge the Rethban Gauntlet. [soft voice] To pass the trial, all you must do is enter the Rethban Caverns, to the first fork, then return here. [excited] Easy! [hesitant] Except there are a few wrinkles...

[urgent] You have to return within an hour.

[angry] There are whole heaps of Redridge Gnolls in the way.

[warm] Before you start, you have to take a swig of my family's signature drink: Barleybrew Scalder!

[commanding] So what do you say? [solemn] The Rethban Caverns are in the foothills north of Lakeshire. [urgent] Are you ready to run the Rethban Gauntlet?
quest_1699_quest_complete: [excited] You made it! [warm] Well done! [excited] Three cheers for <name>!
quest_1700_quest_detail:
[solemn] I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and I need them sent to Grimand Elmore. [soft voice] He's here in the Dwarven District, in the weapon shop.

[urgent] And duck when you give these to him. [hesitant] He's fiercely proud of his skills, and won't like the idea of learning something from me...
quest_1700_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, and well met. [low voice] How might I be of service to you?
quest_1700_quest_complete: Furen wrote this? [angry] How dare he! Why, I taught him everything he knows! To think he could teach me something is outrageous! [shouting] Outrageous! [pause] Hm... but there is something in his notes that I'd like to try...
quest_1701_quest_detail:
[commanding] So I gave you a nice shield, but we don't have to stop there. [solemn] I know the secrets to make extremely hard mail armor. [urgent] It's not easy and it takes very rare materials, but if you're willing to do the legwork then I'll make a piece for you.

[warm] What do you say, <name>? [confident] If you're up for the challenge, then I'll give you a list of what to get and where to get them.
quest_1701_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the scavenger hunt, <name>? [urgent] Do you have the materials?
quest_1701_quest_complete:
[excited] You got it all? Amazing! [warm] I was afraid those chimaeras would eat you up for sure!

[commanding] Well let's get started on that armor...
quest_1702_quest_detail:
[excited] You really showed what you were made of when you ran the Rethban Gauntlet, <name>. And I'm true to my word. [warm] I'll get you the reward I promised...

Except it's in Stormwind.

Talk to my friend, Furen Longbeard, in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. [solemn] He's the best shieldsmith you'll ever meet, and he owes me a big favor.

[gentle] Here, take Furen this cask of Barleybrew Scalder and ask him for a shield. [proud] He'll give you a nice one.
quest_1702_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello! [low voice] Dry times, don't you think?
quest_1702_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Barleybrew Scalder. Great stuff! [warm] So you've been to see Yorus, eh?

I can get you a shield, yes sir! You won't find a better one, and that's no lying!
quest_1703_quest_detail: [soft voice] I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need them sent to the blacksmith Mathiel. [pause] He lives in Darnassus which is quite a long way off, but I'm sure he'll be very grateful to learn what I've learned.
quest_1703_quest_complete:
[solemn] These are interesting, very interesting indeed. [excited] My dwarven colleague Furen has made quite a grand discovery!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] It will be an honor to apply his new techniques to my own craftings.
quest_1704_quest_detail: [soft voice] I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need someone to take them to Klockmort Spannerspan. He's a gnomish blacksmith in the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility and when he learns what I've learned... [pause] I bet he'll pull off his own beard in excitement.
quest_1704_quest_progress: [soft voice] Good day, or morning or evening. I can't tell from way down here. [pause] So do you have business for me?
quest_1704_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh my! These notes are amazing! And what's more... they're incredible and they're stupendous and they make my knees go all a-wobbly!

[excited] Furen had a breakthrough! A real breakthrough! I can't wait to try out his new technique!
quest_1705_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I hate to admit that Furen might have really found something. [solemn] But to be sure I'll need to try his techniques on a new piece of armor. [warm] If you help me with the materials, <name>, then you can have the armor.

[commanding] To make this armor, I need samples of burning blood and a burning rock.

[urgent] The only place I know to get them is Duskwood. [solemn] The Nightbane worgen based in the Roland's Doom mine have burning blood, and their leader Gutspill will have the rock.

[solemn] May fortune grant you speed, <name>.
quest_1705_quest_progress: <name>, do you have the burning blood and rock? [urgent] I'll need them to complete the armor.
quest_1705_quest_complete: [delight] Nice work! [warm] Now if you'll excuse me, I have some work to do myself...
quest_1707_quest_detail: Greetings <name> - the name's Luglunket, and we've got an important job for you if you're up for it! [excited] Huzzah! [excited] Nothing would please me more as a seasoned spigot operator to take any Wastewander water pouches you might find out in the desert. [mocking tone] That's our water anyway - the nomads have just stolen it is all! [urgent] The Gadgetzan Water Company will offer you an official care package for every five you turn in. [warm] Most importantly though, you're helping Gadgetzan help itself!
quest_1707_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the five Wastewander water pouches we need? [excited] If you do, then the Gadgetzan Water Company Care Package, Model 103-XB, will be yours!
quest_1707_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be! [warm] Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.
quest_1708_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor. And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!

[urgent] To finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral. It grows in only one place--along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Bring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor. [excited] And hurry, <name>. I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!
quest_1708_quest_progress: [excited] Hello hello, <name>! Do you have the searing coral? [urgent] I can't wait to get to work!
quest_1708_quest_complete:
[delight] That's the stuff! [excited] Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!

[gasp] Oh my, oh my! [excited] I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
quest_1709_quest_complete: [gentle] Here's your armor, <name>. [excited] Furen's process worked brilliantly! [emphasis] Perfectly! [delight] Marvelously, truly! [confident] You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!
quest_1710_quest_detail:
[solemn] My colleague, Furen Longbeard, made a discovery which I am eager to test. [soft voice] I wish to try it on a new armor that I am researching, for I believe Furen's techniques will produce superior results.

[gentle] Will you help me? If you gather what I need to make the armor, then I will make an extra piece for you.

[urgent] I need the sunscorched egg shells of the Highperch Wyverns who dwell at Highperch, in Thousand Needles. [emphasis] Search for the shells below their nests, and return to me when you have a sufficient amount.
quest_1710_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have the shells, <name>? [emphasis] They are quite strong, and can be rendered into a lacquer I will use to coat the links of my new mail armor.
quest_1710_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, thank you. [warm] These will work splendidly!

[excited] I will begin fashioning the armor immediately...
quest_1711_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. [warm] Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [warm] And may this serve you well in future battles.
quest_1712_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have spent ages watching this site. I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall. But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.

Perhaps you are that champion.

[commanding] Prove it to me. Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior. Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.

If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.

[gentle] Here is a parchment with the items I need.
quest_1712_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the items, <name>? [solemn] Gathering them is the proof I need that you have the strength to face Cyclonian.
quest_1712_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning. [urgent] But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.

[hesitant] Let us hope your strength does not falter.
quest_1713_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am ready to perform the ritual to summon Cyclonian. [urgent] When he is summoned, you must defeat him and take his whirlwind heart. [commanding] This I will use to instill a weapon with Cyclonian's power.

[commanding voice] <name>, are you ready to face the wind lord?
quest_1713_quest_progress: [urgent] <name>, I must have the whirlwind heart!
quest_1713_quest_complete: [excited] You did it! [warm] You defeated Cyclonian and gained the Whirlwind Heart!
quest_1715_quest_detail:
Hmph. [solemn] Times past, all warlocks in Khaz Modan were trained under the auspices of the masters of Gnomeregan, but now that we've all been forced to relocate into this rat's hole in Ironforge, and Magni's decided to keep a careful watch on us, we're forced to send our novices to Stormwind for training.

[soft voice] Luckily, Gakin's no slouch, so you'll still learn what you need to know, but [angry] it burns my blood!

Anyways, you'll find Gakin in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind.
quest_1715_quest_complete: [commanding voice] Sent by Blackwrench, were you? [angry] Damn warlocks in Ironforge need to get things sorted out. [solemn] There's only so much room and so many teachers in Stormwind. [urgent] With all the increased traffic, we're sure to attract attention sooner or later.
quest_1716_quest_detail:
[solemn] A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, and dominator of minds. It knows nothing but evil.

[commanding] This will be the creature you will learn to summon and control, but it cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

[soft voice] With a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. [urgent] Then you can defeat it, and make it your tool.

[hesitant] It will be hard to find something of this nature, though. [soft voice] You should speak with Takar the Seer. [urgent] You will find him in the Barrens of Kalimdor near Camp Taurajo.
quest_1716_quest_complete: [soft voice] Was your crossing difficult, <name>? [pause] You have come a long way to speak with me. But fear not, I know why Gakin has sent you, and he was wise to, for I can help you in your search.
quest_1717_quest_detail:
<name>! [excited] Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.

[soft voice] It's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in Stormwind. [warm] He'll be waiting for you.
quest_1717_quest_complete:
[gentle] I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, <name>. [sad] I was beginning to fear the worst. [solemn] It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you.

[warm] We can talk later, though. [confident] Your training is the only important thing now.
quest_1718_quest_detail: [solemn] Your renown as a warrior grows, <name>. [commanding] Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.
quest_1719_quest_detail:
[commanding] If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray. [solemn] It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.

[urgent] To begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate. [emphasis] That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.

[commanding] Beat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will. [urgent] Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.
quest_1719_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] You have passed The Affray!

[warm] You are a worthy warrior, and I am honored to teach you...
quest_1738_quest_detail:
[solemn] In preparation for your coming, I used my sight to look over the world and through the mists of time. [soft voice] I have found what it is you seek.

In the War of the Ancients, two lovers fell together in battle. Where they took their last breaths, a tree known as the heartswood grew, a symbol of their undying love.

[low voice] That should be enough to tempt a succubus. [urgent] You will find it in the ruins of Ordil'Aran in the northwestern part of the forest of Ashenvale.
quest_1738_quest_progress: [soft voice] Was your search a success, <name>?
quest_1738_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, I can tell this will do nicely, let me just work with it for a moment...

Takar is a resourceful fellow to have around, isn't he? [sad] If only I could persuade him to move back to civilization.
quest_1739_quest_detail:
[solemn] Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.

[urgent] Be careful, <name>, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.

[pause] Once you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.
quest_1739_quest_progress: [soft voice] Sometimes I wonder if Surena was not a succubus in disguise, sent to warp and twist my mind... [sigh] Ha! I give her too much credit, I think.
quest_1739_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, well done, <name>. [proud] I see we've done right in deciding to train you. [confident] Your performance certainly does not disappoint.

[gentle] I've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. [solemn] Observe carefully.
quest_1740_quest_detail:
[solemn] When demons of the Legion fall out of favor, their spirits are imprisoned within orbs and distributed to their mages and warlocks.

[soft voice] Many were carried by their servants in Azeroth. [pause] Even fragmented, they still possess the powers of the demons trapped inside.

[solemn] The orb of Soran'ruk was broken into two pieces, one was further broken to be used by the acolytes of the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. [soft voice] The other, larger piece, was possessed by a wizard in Shadowfang Keep. [commanding] Find them and I can reform it.
quest_1740_quest_progress: [solemn] It took me many years to collect the pieces of the orb of Zargain, but it has served me well, as I am sure the orb of Soran'ruk will serve you.
quest_1740_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes... The orb was not greatly fragmented, and almost all of the pieces are here. [soft voice] It is a simple thing to recreate them, to make Soran'ruk whole again.

[pause] I have dedicated my life to the study of the Burning Legion's orbs and their recreation. [warm] You have done me a favor collecting these pieces to study, and I will give you them back - fully reconstructed - in a form of your choosing.
quest_1758_quest_detail:
[solemn] It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.

[commanding] My three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. [soft voice] You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. [solemn] It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.

[soft voice] Perhaps Krom Stoutarm can help you with this. [soft voice] An itinerant warlock these days, he spends his days hoarding ancient texts and skulking about the library in Ironforge.
quest_1758_quest_complete:
Tome of Cabal? Hmm...sounds familiar. I have never seen it here before, though--and believe me, I remember every book I read.

Hmm... Ah, yes!

I have seen reference to it in library cataloging books.
quest_1778_quest_detail: [soft voice] I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. [hesitant] Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. [excited] I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, <class>.
quest_1778_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So, you've returned so quickly, huh? [warm] And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?

[warm] Were you able to help a noble cause? [warm] Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. [warm] Tell me, who have you helped and how.... [proud] Impressive, <name>, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.

[solemn] Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
quest_1779_quest_detail:
I want you to take this, <name>. [solemn] It is called the Symbol of Life.

[soft voice] You've proven charitable and patient, and now I want you to prove just how adept you've become in both combat, and power.

[commanding] My husband Muiredon returned recently from an encounter with some Dark Iron dwarves, and he barely escaped with his life--he's over there having his wounds healed by one of our priests.

[urgent] Take the Symbol and speak to him. [warm] If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. [solemn] May the Light shine upon you.
quest_1779_quest_complete:
*cough*

[soft voice] Good day to ya, <class>. Don't mind me wounds, the good priest 'ere'll take care of ol' Muiredon in time. Not needin' the power of that Symbol of Life ya got there quite yet.

So, me wife sent ya o'er to speak to me, huh? Fair 'nough. [solemn] I'll take the time to talk to ya-I'll tell ya exactly wut happened to Muiredon and his best friend Narm, a <class> jus' like yerself.
quest_1780_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'll take these to the children this very day. [warm] Please be safe, good <class>. [solemn] It is not often men of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the paladins here in Stormwind shall never turn their backs on those in need.

[warm] Farewell.
quest_1780_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've returned so quickly, <name>. [solemn] And what have you accomplished in your time away from the Cathedral?

[gentle] Have you helped a noble cause? [soft voice] Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. [pause] Tell me, who have you helped and how... [warm] Well, I'm impressed, <name>, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light and values others above oneself.

[proud] Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
quest_1781_quest_detail:
[commanding] Take this, <name>. [solemn] It is called the Symbol of Life.

[soft voice] You've proven charitable and patient, and now the time has come to see if you're powerful enough to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts.

[pause] My friend Gazin returned recently from an encounter with some Defias in Elwynn near Heroes' Vigil--he barely escaped with his life. [urgent] He's near the altar having his wounds healed by our priests.

[commanding] Take the Symbol and speak to him. [solemn] If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. [warm] May you bask in the Light's glory.
quest_1781_quest_complete:
*cough*

[gentle] Pleasure to meet you, <race>. [soft voice] Don't mind my wounds, the good priest here can take care of ol' Gazin this time. [hesitant] I won't be needing the power of that Symbol of Life you've got there... not yet anyway.

[pause] So, Duthorian sent you to speak to me, huh? [solemn] Fair enough. [solemn] I'll tell you exactly what befell me and my friend Henze. [solemn] And with any luck, and some skill on your part, perhaps you can still help us all.
quest_1782_quest_complete:
Here's your armor, <name>. [proud] This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard!

[excited] And I have to thank you. [warm] I learned a lot while working with the materials you brought me. [confident] I think I'll have another breakthrough one day!

[warm] I'm going to send what I learned to other blacksmiths of the Alliance.

[warm] I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.
quest_1783_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We was spyin' on some of the Dark Iron dwarves that've bunkered down south of Helm's Bed Lake. [soft voice] We knew they was up to no good, so Narm an' me thought we'd take a closer look--got ta see their leader given orders to some o' his men.

[urgent] Narm an' me took the chance to kill a few of 'em, but they proved tougher than we thought, an' more of 'em got the jump on us. [urgent] Narm tol' me to run an' get support, so 'ere I am.

[solemn] Narm needs help, an' I'll not rest till he gets it.

[urgent] C'n ya help, <name>?
quest_1783_quest_complete:
[gentle] I can't thank you enough, brother.

[soft voice] I can only assume that Tiza and Muiredon sent you here to aid me if you carry the Symbol of Life.

[solemn] It's true, I fell to the Dark Iron while trying to attain one of the scripts: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Muiredon to escape, but the Light had almost embraced me fully when you came along. [warm] The fact that you were powerful enough to use the Symbol means great things for you, but there's time to speak of that later.
quest_1784_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. [soft voice] We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.

[low voice] Some of the council in Ironforge do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in Dun Morogh. [solemn] By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.

[urgent] Get one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, <name>.
quest_1784_quest_progress: [excited] Yer back! I'm glad to see it, <name>. [warm] My wounds are healed and I'm about ready to return to Helm's Bed lake as soon as I c'n convince me wife that I'll be fine.
quest_1784_quest_complete:
[laughing] Haha! You've done it! [warm] Ya saved Narm, and ya found the proof me wife needs to take to the council. [proud] Yer a blessin' o' the Light if I ever saw one... not includin' me wife o' course.

[warm] Thank ya again, <name>.
quest_1785_quest_detail:
I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. [warm] Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. [urgent] I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.

Light be witcha, mighty <class>. [confident] I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.
quest_1785_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done all of Ironforge a great favor today, <name>. [proud] I'm proud to count you among us, and if you feel you're ready, I would like to bless you with this scroll. The Symbol of Life would only have worked when used by a <class> who was ready for one of the Light's greatest blessings-the power to restore the dead back to life.

[solemn] I will teach you the ability to resurrect your companions. [gentle] Use it wisely, <name>, and thank you, on behalf of myself, my husband, and Ironforge.
quest_1786_quest_detail:
[solemn] Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.

We caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.

Henze held them off for me while I escaped... the daft fool, going and being brave.

He's out there now, Henze is. [urgent] Can you help us, <name>?
quest_1786_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, brother.

[soft voice] Seeing you wield the Symbol of Life, may I assume Duthorian or Gazin sent you?

[sad] I fell to the Defias spell casters while Gazin and I tried to get their plans from them: [pause] I was able to hold on long enough to allow Gazin to escape, but in the end, their magics overwhelmed me.

[solemn] But you were able to bring me back: the ability to use the Symbol doesn't come to just anyone, <name>. [warm] It bodes well for you that you were able to empower it with your own faith.
quest_1787_quest_detail:
[solemn] We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. [urgent] What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. [confident] If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.

[hesitant] I'm in no shape for battle as of now, <name>. [commanding] Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?

[warm] If you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.
quest_1787_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Is Henze safe, <name>? [urgent] Were you successful?

[confident] Between your skill with a weapon, and the power of the Light, I'd imagine Heroes' Vigil is safe from any Defias threat, but that's for the King and his advisors to say.
quest_1787_quest_complete: [warm] Wonderful! [excited] You made it, and saved Henze. The Light is with you for sure, <name>!
quest_1788_quest_detail:
[commanding] I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. [excited] He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!

[warm] Thank you again, <name>. [solemn] I hope we meet again. [proud] You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.
quest_1788_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've done well this day, <name>. [warm] You should take some pride in what you've accomplished.

[warm] Even more so, you should be proud of your abilities. [solemn] Not everyone can use the power of the Symbol of Life. [solemn] Calling upon the Light to bring back the dead means you're prepared for one of the <class>'s greatest honors: the power of resurrection.

[warm] You shall have the power to bring back fallen companions much like you did for Henze.

[gentle] Be well, <name>. [solemn] The Light shines upon you and you should welcome it wholly.
quest_1789_quest_complete:
[urgent] Make haste, <name>, more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail.

[solemn] If for some reason you fail to help Muiredon and Narm, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels.

[commanding] Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other <class> and continual failure may reflect upon you later.
quest_1790_quest_complete:
[urgent] Make haste, <name>, more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail.

[solemn] If for some reason you fail to help Gazin and Henze, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels.

[commanding] Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other <class> and continual failure may reflect upon you later.
quest_1791_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that you've learned your berserker's stance, you'll want a nice weapon to use it with.

[commanding] Talk to Bath'rah the Windwatcher, a troll hermit who lives between the Alterac Mountains and the Western Plaguelands. [solemn] He is a skilled weapon maker and a powerful shaman.

[urgent] To find Bath'rah, go to the river that flows along Tarren Mill's eastern flank. [emphasis] Follow it north--Bath'rah is camped near ruins that rest along the river's eastern bank.
quest_1791_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have traveled far, young warrior. [warm] I see fire in your eyes. [soft voice] You seek a weapon of great power, yes?

[gentle] I can help you with your quest. [confident] And you can help me with mine.
quest_1792_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.

[commanding] Choose your weapon, <name>, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.
quest_1793_quest_complete:
[solemn] It has been proven that the Light is with you, <name>, but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough?

[emphasis] Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. [gentle] Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.
quest_1794_quest_complete:
[solemn] It has been proven that the Light is with you, <name>, but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough?

[emphasis] Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. [warm] Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.
quest_1795_quest_detail:
[commanding] If you are sufficiently prepared, then we should begin. [soft voice] Let me explain the process to you.

I will begin by creating the basic summoning circle. When that is finished, my acolytes will use the rods of channeling to create the greater circle.

Once that is done, read the incantation from the Tome of the Cabal, and the felhunter will be pulled forth. Be careful, <name>. [threatening] A felhunter is a powerful foe, and I'd like to see you keep your head on your shoulders.
quest_1795_quest_progress: [solemn] Every <class> should have a felhunter at his command. [soft voice] Though it be difficult to tame, the powers it brings to its master far outweigh the cost.
quest_1795_quest_complete: [solemn] I must say I'm impressed, <name>. [soft voice] When I faced down my felhunter, I barely escaped with my life. [warm] I sense that you have the potential to become one of the most powerful warlocks of this era.
quest_1796_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes your search for the robes, <name>? [soft voice] Have you created them yourself? [soft voice] Such personal touches I find make the imbuing of magic that much sweeter. [soft voice] It gives you a greater sense of accomplishment. [hesitant] But I understand if you choose the quicker path and have it made for you - there's something to be said for such... ambition.
quest_1796_quest_complete:
[solemn] This will do nicely, <name>.

[soft voice] All magical items must begin with an item of high quality. [low voice] The more effort and skill put into an item, the greater the magics it can hold. [soft voice] Rare and more expensive components hold the magic better. [warm] You will not regret having the robes fashioned into the ones we will make for you later on.
quest_1798_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, <name>. [low voice] I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.

[urgent] He makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. [commanding] I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.
quest_1798_quest_complete:
<name>? Ah, of course. [solemn] Our latest prodigy. The real thing can not live up to the legend, I am afraid.

[soft voice] No matter, you have come here to learn, not to hear me make jokes to myself.
quest_1799_quest_detail:
[commanding] Good, then we shall begin.

[solemn] The first thing you must do is speak to my acolytes inside. Choose one of their paths to follow--they will explain more.

[urgent] Second, you must travel to Desolace and find an Infernal Orb from one of the warlocks of Mannoroc Coven. [soft voice] It is that orb that you will cleanse with the help of a mage named Tabetha deep in southern Dustwallow Marsh. [warm] She will aid you because of our history together.

[commanding] Again, do not come back until you have done both things I've asked.
quest_1799_quest_progress:
[hesitant] And obviously not being a mage, I wonder if I can trust you at all. I can smell the power of the arcane on you, but you seem to have eluded the stank of corruption that comes so willingly with your kind.

[solemn] Yes, a <class>... a <class> has come to ask for my help.

[commanding] Well, what is it I can do for you, <name>?
quest_1799_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, so Menara sent you. Fair enough... I suppose you may stay as my guest for the time being. But you must be on some pressing business - perhaps you're here seeking lost power? Maybe I'm mistaken. Maybe corruption isn't too far away from you after all.
quest_1800_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The orphan matrons at my home tell mighty stories of battle and lore at night if we are good and do our chores. [solemn] One story was about how Lordaeron fell, and about how the evil Arthas took his own father's life to become ruler.

[angry] He had no honor, <name>! [proud] When I grow up and become a mighty Horde warrior, my blade will be guided by honor - never evil!

[hesitant] Would you take me to see the throne room, please? [soft voice] It is just before where you would go down into the Undercity.
quest_1800_quest_complete:
[soft voice] That throne room was scary, <name>! Even though it was empty, it felt like a great evil had happened there. [sad] I felt mad... but I also felt sad too. [solemn] I understand why the matrons tell us such stories; I will never betray my people like that!

[warm] Thank you for taking me to the throne room, <name>. [proud] I learned a lot.
quest_1801_quest_detail:
[solemn] It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.

[commanding] My three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. [soft voice] You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. [pause] It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.

[hesitant] Perhaps Jorah Annison can help you with this. [soft voice] He's employed as a cartographer in the Undercity these days, but still knows more of ancient texts than any I know.
quest_1801_quest_complete:
[excited] Map making! Pictures, estimations of reality. I have no use for such things.

[solemn] In books, narrative, description! That is where truth lies. [proud] I would trade all the maps in this store for one book on the rise of necromancy, or a tale of the Dark Lady's triumph.
quest_1802_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was lost, but there's some idea as to where it might be found.

[soft voice] There was only one copy ever made and it was vandalized at some point, a large portion of it ripped from the binding. [pause] Rumor has it that it somehow passed into the hands of the centaur of Thousand Needles.

[low voice] The rest was lost off the coast west of Southshore, where it was to be transported to Menethil Harbor by boat. [sad] It never arrived.

[solemn] In exchange for this knowledge, all I ask is that if you find it, bring it to me to see.
quest_1802_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did the rumors prove true, <name>?
quest_1802_quest_complete:
[delight] Fantastic! Now I may join the ranks of the few that have spied its contents.

[excited] I can't wait to further peruse this text. [warm] This is a great day, <name>! [soft voice] If you will just allow me to glance at it before you leave. [confident] I'm sure that Strahad will be willing to send me a copy.
quest_1803_quest_detail:
[excited] Ah! I see that you are a warlock of similar tastes to mine. [solemn] Indeed, acquiring the Tome of the Cabal is a worthy aspiration. [soft voice] Did you know that it was once held within the walls of Lordaeron? [sad] It was vandalized though, almost half its pages removed. [angry] Who would commit such a heinous act?

[hesitant] That half is lost, though rumor says that it fell into the hands of the centaur of the Thousand Needles.

[urgent] The rest of the text was to be transferred to Ironforge, but was lost in transit on the coast west of Southshore.
quest_1803_quest_progress: [solemn] It may be that you are chasing after fairy tales, <name>, but [soft voice] truth can be found at the center of even the wildest rumors.
quest_1803_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well well well! [angry] What do we have here?

[soft voice] This is impressive, <name>. [solemn] I wouldn't have thought it possible, but here it is in my very hands, the complete Tome of the Cabal.

[pause] Allow me to leaf through its pages for just a moment before you are off again.
quest_1804_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well, ah, it's hard to let it go. But you found it, and you have more important things to do with it, of course. Just, please, be sure to mention to Strahad that I wanted a copy.

[pause] While you were out, he sent a message for you. He wanted me to tell you that for his acolytes to assist with the summoning, you'll have to acquire three rods of channeling.

He might not know where to find them, but I do! [emphasis] They were last used by the orcs of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. I'd check their spellcasters!
quest_1804_quest_progress: [low voice] Haven't seen you around these parts for a while. [urgent] Have you found the tome and the rods?
quest_1804_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [warm] The Tome of the Cabal and three pristine--slightly scratched, I suppose--rods of channeling.

[solemn] This will be interesting. [soft voice] It's been some time since a young <class> took on a felhunter to make his own.
quest_1805_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is one of the most interesting texts I have perused in the last few years. [soft voice] The selection here is sparse--mostly books on geography--and I have already read them all. [hesitant] I should hope that Strahad would send me a copy of this tome when he has the chance.

[pause] Speaking of him, he sent word to me while you were away. [urgent] For your task, you must obtain three rods of channeling.

[whispering] For allowing me to look at this text, I will share a secret: [emphasis] You can find the rods on orcs of the Dragonmaw Clan in the Wetlands.
quest_1805_quest_progress: [commanding] Yes, <name>? [soft voice] Of what service can I be to you?
quest_1805_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [warm] The Tome of the Cabal and three pristine--slightly scratched, I suppose--rods of channeling.

[solemn] This will be interesting. [soft voice] It's been some time since a young <class> took on a felhunter to make his own.
quest_1806_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? [low voice] I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.

[solemn] When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.

[hesitant] I'll be somewhat honest, <name>, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. [warm] But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.
quest_1806_quest_complete:
[solemn] Here it is, <name>. [warm] A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. [soft voice] I've named it after a great dwarven paladin who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan.

[gentle] Please take it on behalf of myself and my wife. [proud] We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.
quest_1818_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you. [commanding] If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.

[soft voice] Deathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of Brill, near the graveyard.
quest_1818_quest_complete: [urgent] You're here for a mission? Good. I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... [solemn] and your resolve in the defense of the Forsaken.
quest_1819_quest_detail:
[solemn] When the Scourge swept through Tirisfal Glades, we captured one to study. He had a free mind, and called himself Ulag the Cleaver. But, although his will was free, he was still enthralled by the Lich King.

We hoped to find a way to break the king's control over Ulag, but we failed. [urgent] Now, finally, it is time to free him.

Free him, and kill him.

Activate the skull stone trigger near the mausoleum to the north. This will lift the magical seal that binds him.

Then... be ready, <name>.
quest_1819_quest_progress: [commanding] Your task is yet undone, <name>. [low voice] It is not wise for a <class> to show fear...
quest_1819_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] Ulag was no minor agent of the Scourge. [proud] You have shown the Deathguards, and hence the Dark Lady, that you are a <class> of skill and resolve, and are worthy of further instruction.
quest_1820_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.

[soft voice] Coleman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the Forsaken's enemies.

[commanding] You will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern Brill.
quest_1820_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, it is true. [soft voice] I have need for your skills in combat. [low voice] My means are small, but my task aids both me and the Forsaken's cause. [urgent] Do it, and your reward will be twofold.
quest_1821_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Agamand family were my employers in life, and they were the cause of my death! [angry] It is fitting that the Agamands are now mindless minions of the Lich King.

[solemn] Now I would have their last vestiges of honor. [commanding] Go into their family crypt and rob them of their family heirlooms: a sword, an axe, a dagger and a mace. [urgent] Bring them to me!

[solemn] The Agamand family crypt is at the north end of the Agamand mills, protected by lurking scourge and dead Agamands.
quest_1821_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! You retrieved them! [solemn] Now the last semblance of honor and memory is stripped from the cursed Agamand lands. [sad] The family truly is no more!
quest_1822_quest_complete:
[solemn] I will keep three of the weapons you returned to me, as mementos of my pain and loss. [gentle] But please, <name>, choose your favorite of the heirlooms and keep it for yourself.

[warm] May it serve you greater than it served its cursed, former owners.
quest_1823_quest_detail: [solemn] You are a warrior of skill and growing renown. [soft voice] Perhaps you are ready for Ruga Ragetotem's trial? [pause] If so, then find Ruga in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
quest_1824_quest_detail:
[solemn] To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants. [soft voice] There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures. They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.

[urgent] Bring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, <name>, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long. [commanding] Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.
quest_1824_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the antennae? [emphasis] If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...
quest_1824_quest_complete: [warm] Nicely done, <name>! [proud] In passing the trial at the Field of Giants, you take one more step down the <class>'s path.
quest_1825_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc blacksmith of renown, has heard of your continued deeds of valor in service of the Horde. [commanding] He would like to fashion for you a suit of armor, and bids you speak with him immediately.

[urgent] Thun'grim is camped east of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
quest_1825_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, you have come. [warm] This is good, for we have much to discuss, you and I.
quest_1838_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have heard tales of your strength and valor, and wish to make for you a suit of armor, a companion to aid you as tales of your great deeds grow.

But the fashioning of this armor will be a quest unto itself, <name>. [commanding] I will need your help, and the help of other smiths of the Horde.

Here, take this scroll. [soft voice] I spent many nights, struggling with near-blind eyes, writing that which I need for the armor. [urgent] Bring me the items on this scroll and I will create for you the first piece of the suit.
quest_1838_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the items on my scroll, <name>?
quest_1838_quest_complete: [commanding] You brought all that I asked. [solemn] Now, I will do my part...
quest_1839_quest_detail: [solemn] The troll smith Ula'elek will craft for you the brutal gauntlets. [soft voice] He dwells in Durotar, in Sen'jin Village with his Darkspear brethren, and he awaits your coming.
quest_1839_quest_complete:
[solemn] Greetings, <name>. [low voice] Old Thun'grim sent word to me of your coming, but had he kept silent your presence here would not have surprised me.

[soft voice] The spirits follow your progress, young <class>, and they tell me that many foes have fallen before you.
quest_1840_quest_detail:
[solemn] Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill. [soft voice] He will make for you the brutal helm.

[urgent] Seek him out in Thunder Bluff, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.
quest_1840_quest_complete: Greetings, <class>. [soft voice] I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?
quest_1841_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said that, before her death, Velora Nitely was one of the finest armorsmiths in Lordaeron. [soft voice] Death, it seems, has not decreased her talents. [commanding] Speak with Velora--she will make your brutal legguards.

[urgent] Velora plies her trade in the Undercity of Lordaeron, in the trade quarter.
quest_1841_quest_complete:
[excited] You are here for leg armor? Great!

[hesitant] Um... am I making the armor for you, or are you making it for me?

[mocking tone] That was joke. Was it funny? [sad] I can't tell... I lost my sense of humor the same time I lost my sense of smell. [cold] Which was about the same time I stopped breathing.
quest_1842_quest_detail:
[solemn] I can make you a pair of brutal gauntlets, and great magic will they hold. But first, you must collect this magic and bring it to me.

The satyrs dwell in northeastern Ashenvale because of the forest's power. [soft voice] They feed off its purity, leeching and corrupting. You can tell which satyrs have drawn the most of Ashenvale's magic by their swollen, uncloven hooves.

[emphasis] These hooves hold great power. [commanding] I will need them for your gauntlets' crafting.
quest_1842_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the hooves, <name>? [solemn] The magic within them is strong.
quest_1842_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, you have them! Now, just as the Satyrs leeched the strength of Ashenvale, I will leech the power held within these hooves and harness it into my crafting...
quest_1843_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you, <name>. [warm] These gauntlets are my best work. [proud] Take them. [solemn] In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.
quest_1844_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will make you the helm, but you must show me you are worthy of it.

[soft voice] Nestled in the northwestern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains there lies the Charred Vale. [pause] It was once a verdant place, but is now defiled and ashen, and what creatures remain there are mad with pain and despair.

[solemn] That place is where I send you, <name>.

[urgent] You must go to the Charred Vale and find a chimaera matriarch. [commanding] Slay her, free her of her misery. [solemn] Bring me her galvanized horn as proof, and I shall make for you the helm.
quest_1844_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the horn? [soft voice] Is the matriarch free of pain?
quest_1844_quest_complete: [solemn] You have completed your task, <name>, and shown me your worth and resolve. [warm] The helm will be yours...
quest_1845_quest_complete:
[solemn] I give this helm to you.

[warm] Great deeds brought you to me, <name>, and Earthmother willing... [solemn] even greater deeds lie before you.
quest_1846_quest_detail:
[solemn] To make the brutal leg guards, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones. [soft voice] The Dragonmaw orcs of the Wetlands have nice, thick shinbones. I'll need theirs.

[emphasis] But they must be sturdy. [urgent] Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them. [commanding] If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.
quest_1846_quest_progress: [low voice] I'm waiting for those shinbones, <name>. [threatening] They'll make a nice frame for your leg guards.
quest_1846_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [warm] These all look strong. I think they'll do quite nicely. [soft voice] How did those orcs mind you taking their shins, <name>? [mocking tone] Complain much? That was another joke. You're not laughing.

[sad] I'm not very funny these days, am I...
quest_1847_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Here are your legguards, <name>. Let me know how they fit or if you need any modifications. [warm] I aim to please! At least I used to.

These days I don't care much for my craft. [sad] But it beats being a mindless minion of the Scourge!

[hesitant] I guess.
quest_1848_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, <name>. [warm] Here is the product of your toil.

[solemn] May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.
quest_1858_quest_detail:
[commanding] I'll leave it to you to get Tazan's satchel open, and return to me with its contents. The locking mechanism is complex, so it would probably be easiest if you obtained the key.

As you didn't find it on Tazan's body, I can only assume that he left the key in the care of another... [pause] Ah, yes, that's right. He had an assistant named Gamon. A drunkard, you'll most likely find him at the tavern. [whispering] Perhaps you could quietly relieve him of the key.
quest_1858_quest_progress: [low voice] Is it not vexing to have the subject of your desire within your grasp, but to have no way of getting to it?
quest_1858_quest_complete: Hmmm, [commanding] now this is interesting. [soft voice] You've more than proved your worth with this, Weir. [proud] I am quite impressed. [warm] Consider yourself the newest member of the Shattered Hand. [urgent] And take this, it will be a great help to you in the future, I think.
quest_1859_quest_detail:
[low voice] Lower your voice, <name>. [whispering] Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an orc by your description.

From what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.

Am I right?

[emphasis] Anyways, you should go see Therzok in Orgrimmar. [soft voice] He's got an offer for you to hear.
quest_1859_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good, I'm glad Kaplak was able to get a hold of you.

[soft voice] We have some things to speak of, not the least of which is your future with the Hand.
quest_1860_quest_detail:
[solemn] We mages have a task that needs doing. One that is vital to the safety of Stormwind and Elwynn forest.

Jennea Cannon has the details. [soft voice] She studies in the wizard's sanctum, in the mage district of Stormwind. [urgent] You should make your way to her with haste.
quest_1860_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have been sent to aid me in my task, <name>? Good. It is heartening to see young mages eager to help in our cause...

[soft voice] What cause, you ask? In time, young one. You shall know... in time.
quest_1861_quest_detail:
[solemn] This world has been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels. We struggle to determine the effects these changes have caused, and some of us fear the worst!

[urgent] But I will reveal more of this later. Right now, we need you to gather information.

Here, take this flask. Go to the base of the waterfall at Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind gates, and retrieve a sample of the water there. Return it to me so that I might test it for magical taints.
quest_1861_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the sample, <name>? [solemn] The flow of magic in Stormwind and Elwynn has been altered, and I must know if it is seeping into the water.
quest_1861_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. I will test this water for magical properties. Let us hope that it contains none, or we may find that those who drink from Mirror Lake for too long will be adversely affected.

[solemn] Here, <name>. Take this orb or staff as a token of your service. [warm] May it serve you well.
quest_1878_quest_progress: [urgent] Back again, <name>? If you have five more Wastewander water pouches, then I have a care package with your name on it! [excited] Wastewander Water Pouch(5)
quest_1878_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be! [warm] Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.
quest_1879_quest_detail:
<name>! [urgent] Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word. She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it! [confident] Are you that mage, <name>?

If so, then speak with Bink. [soft voice] She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
quest_1879_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! [soft voice] But it takes more than promise to be a good mage. And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage. And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!

[giggle] Oops, I'm getting ahead of things. [pause] Let's begin at the start!
quest_1880_quest_detail:
[excited] We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks! [commanding] We control magic, the base fabric of our world! And that takes great care, and resolve. And knowledge... so much knowledge!

[proud] One of my devices, the mage-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts! [urgent] But it's lost! When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!

[warm] Please, <name>, retrieve my gizmonitor!
quest_1880_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the gizmonitor? [commanding] I must have it before its energy supply runs out!
quest_1880_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, splendid day! [warm] When I made the gizmonitor I never realized how dependent on it I would become. [soft voice] Now I can begin my studies anew!

[warm] Thank you, <name>! [warm] And here - these were my first tools as a <class>. [gentle] They're a little scratched but they're well tested. [warm] Take your pick - I'm sure you'll find either of them useful.
quest_1881_quest_detail: <name>, [solemn] Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents. [soft voice] Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.
quest_1881_quest_complete: Greetings, <name>. [warm] You were wise to answer my call, and [soft voice] wiser still if you heed what I next say...
quest_1882_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Plaguelands to the east are an aberration. [soft voice] Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live. [hesitant] Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the Forsaken, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.

[urgent] But first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal. [commanding] Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal. [gentle] In the garden are flowers--snapdragons. [soft voice] Gather these and return.
quest_1882_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have the snapdragons? [solemn] That breed of flower is highly receptive to magic energies, and studying the snapdragons so close to the Plaguelands can tell us if the plague has entered Tirisfal Glades.
quest_1882_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, a fine specimen this is. [soft voice] I will send it to be studied by our apothecaries to determine the extent of the Plagueland's taint.

[warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] For your services, I present to you this choice: an orb or staff. [gentle] Whichever you choose, you will find it quite useful.
quest_1883_quest_detail: [solemn] Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid. [soft voice] Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.
quest_1884_quest_detail:
[solemn] The warlock Zalazane of the Echo Isles has disrupted the normal flow of magic in Durotar. He does this through tainted fetishes, ju-ju heaps, which he has placed among his huts on the main Echo Isle.

[soft voice] These heaps corrupt our wildlife and give power to the warlocks and infernal creatures that lurk in the land's dark corners.

[urgent] You must destroy the ju-ju heaps, <name>, before the flow of magic is forever altered.
quest_1884_quest_progress: [urgent] You must hurry, <name>. [commanding] Destroy the ju-ju heaps!
quest_1884_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sense that Zalazane's ju-ju heaps were destroyed, and with time, and luck, the flow of magic in Durotar will return to normal.

[warm] A great deed you have done for your people, <name>. [proud] And you have shown your worth to us, the mages of the Horde.
quest_1885_quest_detail:
<name>? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. [soft voice] Looks can be deceiving though, right?

Either way, you should go see him as soon as possible. [urgent] You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.
quest_1885_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hm. [pause] No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? [pause] Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.
quest_1886_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, Lord Varimathras' elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.

[soft voice] I will not lie to you, <name>, this task could mean your death.

[pause] I have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.

[whispering] It will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. [commanding] Succeed and I shall tell you more.
quest_1886_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] You've passed the first part of this test. [hesitant] Hopefully Andron will not have caught wind of your activities, and we will be able to convince him that you are, in fact, the messenger he is expecting.
quest_1898_quest_detail:
[solemn] The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. [soft voice] I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.

[low voice] Lord Varimathras suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. [commanding] He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.

[urgent] I want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.
quest_1898_quest_progress: [low voice] Hello. [soft voice] Something I can do for you?
quest_1898_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes, I've been expecting you. [soft voice] I have no doubt our mutual acquaintances are pleased with the information that I have provided so far?

[pause] I suppose there's no point in asking you, I doubt they would burden you with this knowledge. [low voice] Why place so much trust in the messenger, hm?
quest_1899_quest_detail: [solemn] You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. [soft voice] Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.
quest_1899_quest_complete: [solemn] Well, this is certainly more information than I suspected to get out of Andron. [pause] Give me a moment to peruse it, before I set you to your next task.
quest_1918_quest_detail:
[solemn] The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water. [soft voice] The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting. [emphasis] It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.

[hesitant] It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, [commanding] Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.
quest_1918_quest_progress: [low voice] Yeah, what do you need?
quest_1918_quest_complete:
[angry] You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me? Who am I, the Earthen Ring or something?

Actually, that does give me an idea... perhaps you do need the Earthen Ring for this. [soft voice] I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.

[proud] You know who the Earthen Ring are, <name>?
quest_1919_quest_detail: [solemn] Your knowledge of the craft grows, young <name>. [soft voice] Are you now ready to begin your true lessons? [urgent] Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?
quest_1920_quest_detail:
[solemn] A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the Mage Quarter. [soft voice] Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

[urgent] I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures. Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them. [commanding] When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
quest_1920_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you captured the creatures, <name>? [solemn] They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
quest_1920_quest_complete:
[delight] Very well done! I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

[solemn] Your value to the society of mages grows, <name>.
quest_1921_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe. [soft voice] Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials

[pause] The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

[emphasis] Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the Mage District.
quest_1921_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. Jennea told me you would come. [hesitant] Do you have something for me?
quest_1921_quest_complete: [soft voice] Yes, these are great pieces of linen. [warm] I can make a fine robe with them. [excited] And after I weave the rift gems into it, we'll have a garment fit for a <class>!
quest_1938_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts. [sad] He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist. And so he was banished.

The fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.

[cold] We, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned. [urgent] Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.
quest_1938_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the book, <name>? [solemn] Its secrets are not meant for the untrained, and plumbing its depths can lead to doom and ruin.
quest_1938_quest_complete:
[solemn] I feared that Morganth had hidden the book elsewhere, or that he had found a way to open it and read its contents.

[soft voice] It is good to see that he did not, and that the seals we placed on Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic still hold.
