quest_1939_quest_detail: [solemn] High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, <name>. [soft voice] He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.
quest_1940_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your service has been unwavering, <name>. [soft voice] I think, perhaps, it is time you had a finer garment, one more suiting your station as an adept mage. [pause] If you gather the needed materials, then we will arrange the robe made.

[urgent] You must enter Duskwood and hunt carrion recluse spiders. [emphasis] Extract their silk, but only the finest, most pristine silk will do. [pause] When you have enough, take it to Wynne Larson, here in the mage district at the Larson Clothiers. [warm] She will craft your robe.
quest_1940_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, yes. The mages of the Wizard's Sanctum said you'd speak with me. [hesitant] Do you have the required silk?
quest_1940_quest_complete: [soft voice] Nice specimens, these. [excited] I'll get right to work!
quest_1941_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here is your robe. [excited] It's one of my best made yet! [warm] Wear it with pride, and when people ask... [laughing] tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
quest_1942_quest_complete:
[excited] Your garment is ready! [soft voice] And that silk you gathered was so nice... you don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some silk left over for me, do you?

[chuckling] I'm only joking. It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining. [warm] Enjoy!
quest_1943_quest_detail: [soft voice] The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, <name>. [solemn] She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.
quest_1943_quest_complete: [solemn] Good, you have come. [soft voice] My task is not an easy one, but vital to the society of mages. [warm] If you aid me, I am sure you will find it worthwhile.
quest_1944_quest_detail:
[solemn] The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned. [soft voice] It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.

[low voice] I would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

[urgent] Take this flask and go to Xavian. [soft voice] Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me. [commanding] And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.
quest_1944_quest_progress: [solemn] I am pleased you have returned with your skin intact, <name>. [soft voice] Do you have the water sample? [urgent] I am eager to study its properties.
quest_1944_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, very good. I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?

[warm] Thank you, <name>. I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.
quest_1945_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...

[pause] For these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.

[solemn] When you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens. [commanding] He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.
quest_1945_quest_progress: Greetings, <name>. [soft voice] Deino said you would come, and would bring the laughing sisters' hair. [hesitant] Do you have it?
quest_1945_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, this hair will weave into a fine robe, <name>. [solemn] It is a pity the laughing sisters had to die to part with it, though I do doubt they would ever give it willingly.

[sad] A pity, but only a small one.
quest_1946_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Here is your nether-lace, <name>. [warm] It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.

[gentle] Enjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. [hesitant] She is a mage on whose good side I wish to stay...
quest_1947_quest_detail: [solemn] Now it is time for you to earn your mage's wand. [soft voice] To begin this quest, speak with the human hermit Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh. [pause] You will find her shack deep in the marsh, west of Theramore.
quest_1948_quest_detail:
[solemn] The building of a mage's wand is not easy. [soft voice] Rare substances are required, and a vessel must be made that can store great quantities of magical energy. [commanding] You must gather these things and bring them to me.

[pause] I have written onto this parchment that which you need, and instructions on how to get it. [urgent] Bring me exactly what is on this list, and follow my written directions to the letter, for if you do not then when we make your wand things might go... [threatening] badly.
quest_1948_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Do you have the items I require?
quest_1948_quest_complete: [excited] Aha! You got the jade and made the bramble! [warm] Well done! Is that smoke I see rising from your ears? You might have gotten too close when the lightning struck the totem sticks, but don't worry. Being hit by lightning is good luck!
quest_1949_quest_detail:
[solemn] To make your wand, there are key passages in a certain book that I must read. The book is called Rituals of Power, written by the Magus Tirth.

[hesitant] I do not have a copy of his book, and none of the world's great libraries possess it. So you must speak with Tirth and gain it from him.

[soft voice] Good luck. [pause] Tirth used to be a great mage and scholar, but now he spends his time at the gnome and goblin races in the Shimmering Flats, drinking and gambling.
quest_1949_quest_complete:
[angry] What? Speak up! These old ears aren't as sharp as they used to be.

[warm] Well, I hope you're here with a fresh mug of ale or some hot tips on the next race! [threatening] If not, then you best keep walking... because I have a polymorph wand with your name on it!
quest_1950_quest_detail:
[urgent] I can help you with the book, but first you have to help me!

The tome you seek is in my magically locked strongbox. To open it a special phrase must be uttered, and I can't remember the phrase! Normally my assistant helps me remember these things but he's nowhere to be found.

[hesitant] If you want my book, then find my apprentice! Ask around the race track--if you're lucky then someone has seen him. Either drag him back here, or at least get my magic phrase from him so we can open my box!
quest_1950_quest_progress: [urgent] What are you waiting for? [excited] I need my magic phrase!
quest_1950_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, now I remember...

I had forgotten about that little curse I put on Johnson. [soft voice] I can't remember why I did it but I'm sure it served him right, the little ingrate!
quest_1951_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Hm... now that I think about it, I don't have my book! [soft voice] You see, I had some gambling debts and to pay them off I sold the last copy of Rituals of Power to a member of the clergy....

[sad] A member of the Scarlet Brotherhood. [solemn] He must have taken it to their library in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades!

[urgent] If you want that book, then you'll have to go to the monastery to find it. And sorry about all the trouble. [sigh] I'm not myself these days...
quest_1951_quest_progress: Greetings, <name>. [soft voice] Did you find the book, Rituals of Power?
quest_1951_quest_complete: [excited] That's it! It's just what I need to prepare for the ritual to create your wand! [warm] I hope it wasn't too much trouble to find...
quest_1952_quest_detail: [soft voice] I'll go make the wands now.
quest_1952_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here are the wands I made. [warm] Take your pick!
quest_1953_quest_detail: [solemn] It is time, <name>, for you to speak with Tabetha... the hermit of Dustwallow Marsh. [soft voice] She will instruct you on the creation of a powerful mage's implement.
quest_1954_quest_detail:
[solemn] The first step is to acquire an orb with power. The warlocks of the Burning Blade have nice, high quality orbs... [angry] it's too bad they've bound demons into them! But we can fix that, yes we can.

[urgent] Go to Desolace and snatch an infernal orb from a Burning Blade summoner. You'll find summoners at the Mannoroc Coven.

When you have the orb, return to me.
quest_1954_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have an infernal orb, <name>?
quest_1954_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, that's a nice one! [soft voice] No, I don't mean it's "nice" like cool juice is nice on a hot day.

[sad] In fact, it's very NOT nice now that I think about it. [urgent] Not the juice. The orb!

[commanding] Focus, <name>! We'll need you focused if we're ever to finish our task!
quest_1955_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that we have a summoner's orb, we must exorcise the demon within it. [soft voice] I can do that. That's the easy part.

[low voice] You're the one who has the hard job. [urgent] You're the one who has to kill the demon once it's out.

And you'll have to be quick. [angry] If you take too long then he'll jump back in the orb and we'll have to start over!

[commanding] So get yourself ready. [urgent] Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. [cold] Because this isn't going to be pretty.
quest_1955_quest_progress: [urgent] You'll have to kill that demon to remove its taint from the orb, <name>.
quest_1955_quest_complete:
[warm] Nicely done, <name>! [proud] You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget.

[threatening] He'll think twice before he sticks his ugly head back in this world, looking for the stupid mortal who beat him. [mocking tone] Probably with friends this time. [commanding] Big, scaly friends who'd want nothing more than to tear you into little <race> pieces.

[hesitant] I didn't scare you, did I...<name>?
quest_1956_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that the demon has been removed, we must gain a power source. [soft voice] Unfortunately, the best power sources are usually the oldest and the hardest to get. [chuckling] It's neat how fate likes to take a bite out of you sometimes, isn't it?

[urgent] So you're going to need to go to Uldaman and defeat the obsidian sentinel there. [emphasis] He's big, he's tough, and his power source packs a punch!

[warm] I wish you the best of luck, <name>. [hesitant] And if you don't get lucky then, well... it was nice knowing you.
quest_1956_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been to Uldaman, <name>? [urgent] Did you defeat the obsidian sentinel?
quest_1956_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it? Well done!

[warm] I was chatting with some of my colleagues and when your name came up they said, "You know that <name> sure works well under stress!"

But when I told them I sent you to Uldaman against the obsidian sentinel, they said I was crazy! They said, "[angry] Tabetha, you're crazy! There's no way <name> could take on that sentinel!"

And I said, "We'll see," and then they said "Yeah, we'll see..."

[proud] Well we sure showed them, didn't we!
quest_1957_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are almost finished, but this last step is the most perilous, <name>.

I have the empty summoner's orb and am ready to empower it. We will do this by harnessing the energy of a mana rift. I'll cast a spell that will temporarily open a rift, from which creatures, mana surges, will pour out. [urgent] You must defeat the mana surges and their power will be released, which I will then collect.

Kill enough mana surges before the rift closes and I will place all their collected energy in your orb.
quest_1957_quest_progress: [low voice] You have not killed the required amount of mana surges, <name>.
quest_1957_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! [warm] I never doubted you for a second! [chuckling] Ok, maybe for just a second, or two... but basically I didn't have much doubt.

[soft voice] Honest.
quest_1958_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You should be proud of yourself, <name>. [solemn] Many mages have fallen to the creatures you faced.

[warm] The Celestial Orb is ready. Or if you'd like I can mount it atop a staff. It's up to you. I'd prefer the orb, but who am I to judge?
quest_1959_quest_detail: [solemn] The mages of the Undercity have noted a magical disturbance within the city, and have sent word for mages of the Horde to investigate.
quest_1960_quest_detail:
[solemn] Algernon's alchemist shop in the Apothecarium is the locus of a strange disturbance. [soft voice] Invisible creatures, made solely of magic, wander the shop--there must be a reason, and we must find it!

[urgent] Investigate the disturbance and capture those creatures. Take a chest of coffers and a scroll from behind me. Use the scroll at the shop to make the creatures visible, subdue them with your spells, then throw down a coffer to capture them. Return with the filled coffers, the empty coffers and the cantation.
quest_1960_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you investigated the disturbance, <name>? [urgent] Have you captured the creatures?
quest_1960_quest_complete:
Very good, <name>. [solemn] The creatures within these containment coffers will be studied by our finest minds, and the reason behind their presence in the Undercity will be determined.

[soft voice] If their appearance is caused by a rift in the natural flow of magic, then we must determine if the rift was random. [urgent] If it was not random, but instead an attack by some magical force, then we must prepare for future, more serious disturbances.
quest_1961_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time for you to don your first mage's robes, <name>. [soft voice] They are a sign of your station, and a testament to your worth.

[urgent] To gain the robes, you must gather the mana gems from the Dalaran mages of Silverpine. [cold] Their beliefs are similar to ours and so killing them is somewhat distasteful, but if they lack the strength to resist us, then they do not deserve their lives.

[commanding] Bring the gems and a supply of linen to Josef Gregorian at the Magic Quarter's tailor shop.
quest_1961_quest_progress: [solemn] Anastasia said you would come to me, and I am prepared to fashion your robes. [soft voice] Do you have the gems and the linen?
quest_1961_quest_complete: [soft voice] This is very good material, and although I lack the talent to gauge the quality of these mana gems, we'll soon know if they possess the power needed to create spellfire robes...
quest_1962_quest_complete: [gentle] Here are your robes, <name>. [warm] Wear them well.
quest_1963_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Warchief is too subtle in his methods. [low voice] He is cautious to unleash the might of the Horde. [solemn] Once we were stronger, mighty conquerors all. [solemn] That pride we must regain, and the Shattered Hand will do so.

[commanding] We build strength from the shadows and strike at the exposed, secretly laying our enemies low. [commanding] A task you must complete for me, to prove your worth.

[urgent] The troll Tazan trades with the pirates near Ratchet. [commanding] He has information I must have. [angry] Kill him and bring me his satchel.
quest_1963_quest_progress: [solemn] It is a fool who believes a charge with axe drawn is more dangerous than a knife in the dark.
quest_1963_quest_complete:
[low voice] Hm, while I am glad to hear that Tazan is no longer with us, a locked satchel does us no good. [commanding] We need the information kept within.

[threatening] This should prove a worthy second challenge for one who wishes to join the Shattered Hand.
quest_1978_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.

Lord Varimathras will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.

[pause] Ah, and how could I forget?

[warm] Welcome to the Deathstalkers.
quest_1998_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the Forsaken that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest.

[urgent] Your name came to mind immediately, <name>. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.

[soft voice] The latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.
quest_1998_quest_progress: [solemn] I have placed the utmost faith in you to perform this service for Lord Varimathras.
quest_1998_quest_complete: [solemn] You've done well, <name>. [soft voice] It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
quest_1999_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. [soft voice] This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. [commanding] Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.

[urgent] This task falls to you, <name>. [low voice] You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. [gentle] Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
quest_1999_quest_complete:
[delight] Very good, <name>! [warm] You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.

[proud] I see that I was right to place my trust in you. [confident] Believe me, boy, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.
quest_2038_quest_detail:
[solemn] As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. [urgent] With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

[commanding] Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, <name>. [proud] For Gnomeregan!
quest_2038_quest_complete: [warm] You've done the movement a great service, <name>. [excited] The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
quest_2039_quest_detail:
[urgent] We've lost contact with Bingles! [sad] He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. [sad] I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

[sad] He was last seen flying over the Loch. [hesitant] Perhaps you can investigate, <name>.
quest_2039_quest_complete:
[angry] So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

[pause] Nevermind that, I need your assistance! [urgent] Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
quest_2040_quest_detail:
[angry] Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! [solemn] The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, <name>.

[urgent] Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. [confident] With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
quest_2040_quest_progress: [whispering] Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, <name>?
quest_2040_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
quest_2041_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.

[soft voice] In Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. [urgent] Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.

[soft voice] You will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind.

[warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_2041_quest_complete: [soft voice] Do you bring word from central command?
quest_2078_quest_detail:
[commanding] Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.

Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.

[urgent] Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
quest_2078_quest_progress: [urgent] Where be me first mate, <name>? Shackles n' sharks fer ye soon if ye don't hurry!
quest_2078_quest_complete:
[laughing] Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.

[mocking tone] The Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
quest_2098_quest_detail:
[solemn] A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! [angry] Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.

[urgent] What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!

[sad] When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of Darkshore. [soft voice] Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
quest_2098_quest_progress: [urgent] Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
quest_2098_quest_complete:
[excited] Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! [warm] Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what hit em!

[pause] Hrm, have ye seen me first mate?
quest_2118_quest_detail:
[solemn] A sickness spreads across the Darkshore, gripping the minds and bodies of all it touches.

[sad] The Thistle Bears have been hit the hardest by this plague. [solemn] The once noble beasts are now an instrument of destruction - rabid and frenzied. [soft voice] I may have a cure for this ailment.

[urgent] Take this trap to the forest and lay it on the ground. [commanding] Any Rabid Thistle Bear that crosses the light shall become docile for a short time. [commanding] Once the bear is docile, it shall follow you. [urgent] Lead it back here, <name>.
quest_2118_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Have you brought me the sick animal, <name>?

[commanding] Should you fail to spring the trap, do not fret - Tharnariun's Hope is eternal. [urgent] If you require another trap, abandon your task and report back to me.
quest_2118_quest_complete: [solemn] Our work has only just begun, <name>. [urgent] Are you prepared for your next task?
quest_2138_quest_detail:
[solemn] As I had feared, the cure does not work.

[sad] It saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.

[urgent] Return to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, <name>. [solemn] It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
quest_2138_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done Auberdine a great service, <name>, [warm] but your task is not yet complete.
quest_2139_quest_detail:
[solemn] The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, <name>.

[sad] You have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. [soft voice] The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased - even if only for a moment.

[pause] I have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. [hesitant] It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, <name>.

[solemn] In a cave to the northeast, near Bashal'Aran, resides the Den Mother. [commanding] Slay her.
quest_2139_quest_progress: [solemn] With the infected Den Mother slain, the population of Rabid Thistle Bears entering our land is lessened. [urgent] Waste no time, <name>.
quest_2139_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, <name>. [soft voice] In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. [sad] Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the Alliance.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
quest_2158_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

[warm] My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

[gentle] To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
quest_2158_quest_complete:
[excited] Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! [warm] Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

[soft voice] Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
quest_2159_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings, young <class>. Can you offer me aid? I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar. [hesitant] But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.

Can you deliver this package for me? It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn. It lies along the road, to the south.
quest_2159_quest_progress: [soft voice] How might I be of service to you, young one? [gentle] Are you here to rest in the inn? [warm] Do you require a hearthstone?
quest_2159_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from Shadowglen. [solemn] It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I. [warm] But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.

[gentle] While you are here, please, rest yourself. [solemn] Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may. [pause] For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.

[pause] So... rest.
quest_2160_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. [soft voice] If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

[urgent] Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. [sad] I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
quest_2160_quest_progress: [excited] Hi there! [warm] Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
quest_2160_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! [solemn] I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.

[warm] Thanks for bring this to me, <name>. And please, make yourself comfortable. [gentle] You must be tired after your journey.
quest_2161_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Excuse me? Can you help me?

I have a load of food here. I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse! I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out. But they don't need any food! Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me? I'm just a peon, but you're a hero. You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn. [delight] Thank you!
quest_2161_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials. Did they not need it? Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training. Builds spirit, they say!

[warm] Thank you for returning the food. I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!

And don't forget to rest here in the inn. You may be a brave <class> ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.
quest_2178_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, <name>--fresh strider stew. [delight] Delicious! Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

[warm] Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

[commanding] Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
quest_2178_quest_progress: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
quest_2178_quest_complete: [delight] Fantastic! [excited] Try it and tell me what you think, <name>!
quest_2198_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have found a tarnished necklace, though the tarnish belies intricate and magical craftsmanship. [solemn] The necklace has been shattered, as its setting appears to be missing three gems. [pause] On the underside of the necklace is the faint imprint of the city seal for Ironforge. [whispering] Below the seal are three tiny, engraved letters: "TdK".

[hesitant] If there is anything to be gleaned from the necklace, you will need to learn about its origins. [soft voice] Perhaps the seal and the initials are a start...
quest_2198_quest_progress:
[angry] You've got the wrong gnome, pal! I was never there! You can't prove anything!

[pause] Wait a second... who are you? [surprised] What the... where did you find this necklace at?
quest_2198_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... I am the jeweler who made this necklace. [low voice] I also am not in the business of handing out information as though it were free. [emphasis] Information is never free, friend. [commanding] If I am going to help you out, you need to help ME out first.
quest_2199_quest_detail:
[excited] I am a jeweler of great renown here in Ironforge! [sad] Well, former renown anyway... [angry] I have fallen onto hard times due to the chicanery of a competitor! [urgent] A bad reputation in this business spells financial disaster. [hesitant] As a result, I find myself without a copper to my good-though-currently-sullied name.

[soft voice] I want you to get me five silver bars to finish an order I received - the first in what seems like an eternity.

[confident] You get me those five silver bars, and I'll answer your questions on the necklace.
quest_2199_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got the five silver bars I asked for? [soft voice] I will share my sad tale of woe with you concerning the necklace you now possess... but only after I get those bars! [excited] Please, help a gnome out, won't ya?
quest_2199_quest_complete:
[gentle] You're all right in my book; I don't care what everyone else has been saying... [laughing] I kid, I kid! [warm] Seriously, thank you my friend.

Now, the necklace you have is one of my finest creations, but it is missing three gems that help bind magic power to it. I crafted it for a paladin some time ago. He was on a self-appointed quest to clear out the "evil taint" present at an excavation site in the Badlands called Uldaman.

[solemn] Well... that paladin died in Uldaman, and that was just the beginning of my woes.
quest_2200_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A competitor of mine started a rumor that my necklace cursed the paladin. Needless to say, no one wants to buy cursed items from a jeweler.

<name>, I'll make you a deal - find the gems and I'll reassemble the necklace, so long as you'll advertise that I do NOT make cursed items!

[urgent] Try looking for clues in Uldaman; maybe see if the paladin's body is down there, since he's the one who we know had it last! When you find the gems you should use this; it'll allow you to contact me here in Ironforge.
quest_2200_quest_complete:
[solemn] Remains of a paladin: Reading the journal reveals that after much effort, the paladin had identified the location of all three missing gems:

The Shadowforge dwarves hid the ruby in their barricaded area as they battled the Troggs for control of Uldaman.

[soft voice] The troggs stashed the topaz in an urn located near some unusual inhabitants of Uldaman - Alliance dwarves!

[solemn] Finally, the trogg elder himself took the sapphire as his own.
quest_2201_quest_detail:
[solemn] The paladin's journal has provided perhaps the only clues that Uldaman will yield as to the location of the necklace's gems. [soft voice] If the paladin's scribing remains accurate, then the Shadowforge dwarves and the troggs that vie for control of the dig site will need to be dealt with.

[urgent] Armed with this knowledge, the search for the gems begins in earnest. [solemn] When all the gems have been acquired, Talvash in Ironforge should be notified via the Phial of Scrying as per his instructions.
quest_2201_quest_progress:
Talvash's image comes into focus from the waters of the scrying bowl.

"[excited] Wow, you're still alive! [urgent] Did you manage to find the gems? [soft voice] Are you truly the savior of my reputation I have hoped for? [hesitant] Please tell me you didn't waste a charge on the phial just to chat; those things are NOT cheap, and I'm already in dire financial straits.
quest_2201_quest_complete:
[excited] Yep, those indeed are the three gems. [warm] Good job! [soft voice] Unfortunately, your work isn't quite over just yet.

[commanding] No, I'm not trying to pull a fast one here, silly <class>. [proud] This is about making magic jewelry - Talvash del Kissel quality-level jewelry! [urgent] You need a strong power source to give it some oomph. [sad] Well, that necklace has no more oomph to give.
quest_2202_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. [pause] They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at. [low voice] I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.

[urgent] Find the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.

[warm] Do this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
quest_2202_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? [angry] No caps - no reward!
quest_2202_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done <name>, you've proven your worth once again! [warm] The caps will be an interesting study, you betcha.

[gentle] And now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...

[confident] If you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
quest_2203_quest_detail:
You have been most helpful to me, <class>. I would reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier... but I would ask of you a task that is quite dangerous. Hear my request.

[solemn] This lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be warned. Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.

Do this, and the recipe will be yours.
quest_2203_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you used the vessels to get me the scorched guardian dragon blood I need? [soft voice] Yes, I know it is a dangerous task... [emphasis] but the recipe for my restorative brew awaits your success. [low voice] Risk and reward, my friend... [emphasis] risk and reward...
quest_2203_quest_complete: [solemn] From one alchemist to another, I salute you. [warm] Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. [solemn] May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years.
quest_2204_quest_detail: [soft voice] You are going to need to find some "oomph" for the necklace, and Uldaman is probably the best place for it, actually. [hesitant] I guess there are a lot of constructs running around in there, yeah? [urgent] Well, take out the biggest, baddest construct in that place and grab its power source! [confident] I am pretty sure I can fuse that source into the necklace.
quest_2205_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The badge? Oh, it's nothing, fish - nothing you could handle anyhow. [mocking tone] By the looks of you, I'd say Mathias is likely to mistake you for the cheese delivery boy instead of a proper rogue. [commanding] Regardless, I've been assigned a job and I've made a promise to deliver on that job.

[pause] Speaking of which, deliver this package to Mathias and he may give you a small task or two.

[urgent] Get cracking.
quest_2205_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You found me - and by looking at you, I'd say the run and subsequent search may have been a great strain on your system, both mentally and physically.

[warm] Would you like Renzik to show you the way to an inn or are you ready for some work?
quest_2206_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our operatives in the field are reporting heavy Defias activity south of Goldshire. The reports indicate that the Defias have taken over Jerod's Landing and are now using it as a way to smuggle large quantities of contraband from Redridge to Westfall.

[urgent] I need you to infiltrate the dock house and get me that shipping schedule, <name>. You will probably find it buried deep in the pockets of the Dockmaster.

...and <name>, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
quest_2206_quest_progress: [low voice] Your mortality wanes with every moment you waste loitering in the barracks, <class>.
quest_2206_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am astonished... [solemn] Astonished that Keryn finally found a recruit that could possibly have the makings of a proper <class>. [warm] Take this blade, <name>. [solemn] A day will come when you will be called upon again to serve the SI:7. [commanding] Hone your skills, keep your eyes open and that blade sharp.

[whispering] You won't see us coming but you'll feel it when we get there...
quest_2218_quest_detail:
[commanding] Another lost soul looking for guidance, eh? [commanding] I suppose you want to find a purpose - your purpose. [commanding] I've seen it a thousand times, another hero looking for work.

[warm] Well, today's your lucky day, friend. [commanding] Hogral's got the cure for your ailment.

[commanding] Here's what you do: Take this road here up to Ironforge and make your way to the Forlorn Cavern. [urgent] Once there, locate the thieves' guild and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard. [commanding] He'll put you on the road to salvation.
quest_2218_quest_complete:
[commanding] So ye think yer a right scoundrel? Destined to be one o' Blackbeard's chosen few - an officer o' the Hidden Circle?

[mocking tone] Only a good fer nothin' scallywag would think so highly o' hisself.

[excited] That's exactly what we be lookin' fer! [warm] Welcome aboard, <name>!
quest_2238_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ye see, the King be strip mining the quarry fer ore and gems. [emphasis] More riches than any one dwarf should see in ten lifetimes.

[soft voice] The Hidden Circle has values, <name>. [emphasis] We value valuables. Can ye understand?

[urgent] Now we feels the King should be sharing some of that booty, but we don't want ol' 'Stinkbeard' to know he's sharin' - if ye catch me drift.

[whispering] We needs ye to speak with Onin MacHammar over by Gnomeregan and bring back a report. The crafty dwarf has hidden hisself amongst the lepers. Be careful.
quest_2238_quest_complete: [whispering] Shhhh! Keep it down you daft fool. They'll hear us.
quest_2239_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Quarry? Yap, I see those monstrous armored steam tanks come by this post near every day.

My contacts to the east tell me that the tank starts off at Ironforge, makes a pickup at the Gol'Bolar Quarry, stops over at Kharanos to refuel and then for some blasted reason, it takes the long way around past Gnomeregan, before reaching Ironforge to drop off the shipment.

[solemn] It's all in the report, <race>. [commanding] Take it back to Hulfdan so he can plan the next step.
quest_2239_quest_progress:
[commanding] Did ye enjoy the stench of leper gnome? I only ask because ye got a crazy smile on yer face.

[urgent] What news do ye bring from Onin?
quest_2239_quest_complete:
[angry] Long route? In the name o' me own beard!

[warm] Ye done good, <name>. Take this dagger and be gone with ye. [commanding] The Circle will call upon ye again when step three be ready to be set into motion.

What's step three? It comes right after step two - me putting me boot up yer backside.

[mocking tone] Interested?
quest_2240_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now for the task at hand.

[soft voice] There is a secret chamber, the Chamber of Khaz'mul, that must be explored. [urgent] The problem is that the chamber's behind a huge, locked door! [excited] It's a lucky thing I know how to open it.

[pause] I've described everything in my journal, here on the table. [sad] My band and I are stuck here for now... [commanding] so you, <name>, must find the chamber of Khaz'mul for us!

[emphasis] Read my journal, explore the chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike at the Explorers' League in Ironforge.
quest_2240_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have something to report?
quest_2240_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have seen the Chamber of Khaz'mul? [excited] Amazing! [soft voice] Baelog was sure it existed, but I must admit that I had my doubts.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [confident] With luck your finding will incite our leaders to renew their efforts to retake Uldaman. [proud] And if it is ever again under Ironforge control, then the secrets of the Chamber of Khaz'mul will be ours!
quest_2241_quest_detail:
[soft voice] They say I'm 'lovestruck,' whatever that means.

[soft voice] Sure, I spend my every waking moment thinking about Syurna. [soft voice] Sure, my home is full of paintings and drawings of Syurna. [soft voice] Sure, I often go days without eating, sleeping, or drinking, while I lament about the love we could have had. [hesitant] Is that so wrong?

[angry] Now she won't see me! ME! [sad] I've tried sending her messages but she won't even talk to another person unless they are a rogue.

[gentle] Could you deliver this flower to her? [gentle] Don't forget to tell her it's from Jannok.
quest_2241_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, isn't this wonderful. [cold] You've brought flowers for your own funeral.
quest_2241_quest_complete: [solemn] Had I saved every flower that dolt, Jannok, had sent me, I would have had the means to open a shop. Regardless, it seems as if Jannok's latest courier may prove to be useful.[soft voice] Interested in some work, <class>?
quest_2242_quest_detail:
[solemn] We believe there is one being that may be able to help us understand what is happening to the forests of Teldrassil. [hesitant] Unfortunately, getting the creature to cooperate has proven disastrous.

He hides on a branch at the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. [threatening] All who have so far approached the satyr, whether through force or diplomacy, have met with doom. [whispering] Perhaps stealth is the answer, <name>.

[urgent] Find what Sethir the Ancient carries in his packs and report back to me.
quest_2242_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you anything to report from Sethir the Ancient, <name>?
quest_2242_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is grim news, <name>. [soft voice] It would seem that the sickness which has gripped the forests and rivers of Darkshore has begun to taint our home.

[warm] You have served us well, but there is nothing more you can do here. [proud] Take this blade as a reward for your service to Teldrassil.
quest_2258_quest_detail:
<name>, [soft voice] I could use your aid if you're up for it. [solemn] I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the Badlands.

[low voice] I need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. [commanding] Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.

[urgent] Acquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal. [hesitant] Watcha wanna do?
quest_2258_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten the things I need yet? [angry] You won't get paid unless you bring me those reagents.
quest_2258_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, well done! [warm] These should last me for a little while, at least. Here is your pay as promised.

[soft voice] If you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. [solemn] These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation. [urgent] They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.

[warm] Perhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?
quest_2259_quest_detail: [soft voice] Do not worry, <name>, I am not sending you to see Syurna. [urgent] Erion requires your presence at the Cenarion Enclave. [commanding] Make haste!
quest_2259_quest_complete: [solemn] It is time to branch out, <race> - the world awaits.
quest_2260_quest_detail:
[solemn] Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, <name>. [soft voice] So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.

[urgent] The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.

[warm] A new world awaits you, <name>. [commanding] Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.
quest_2260_quest_complete: [solemn] You have answered SI:7's calling, <name> and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, [soft voice] there is much for you to learn.
quest_2279_quest_detail: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle. [soft voice] This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.
quest_2280_quest_detail: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle. [soft voice] This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.
quest_2281_quest_detail:
[sad] Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead rogue on his hands. [soft voice] Don't fret, though, <name> - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.

[urgent] Make your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. [low voice] You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.
quest_2281_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? [warm] Don't worry, <name>, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
quest_2282_quest_detail:
[commanding] We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.

[pause] Up off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. [urgent] Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!
quest_2282_quest_progress:
[urgent] Did I forget to mention the orcs?

[low voice] I hear they have been nosing around up by the mill.
quest_2282_quest_complete:
[laughing] Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, <name>.

[mocking tone] If you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
quest_2283_quest_detail:
[commanding] We've got work for you, that is if you've got the guts to do it!

[urgent] Deep in the Badlands is the Uldaman dig site. We've heard a tale about some idiot paladin who died there recently. [soft voice] Why we even care is that he had a very valuable necklace on him. [emphasis] It's supposedly got three large gems: a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz.

[shouting] The shot: we want it, and we're payin' TOP SILVER to get it. [low voice] It may be damaged, but that's neither here nor there; we'll fix whatever scratches are on it.
quest_2283_quest_progress: [urgent] Well, do you have the necklace? [angry] You won't see a copper from us if you don't have that necklace!
quest_2283_quest_complete:
[excited] Mmmm salvage! I can smell the necklace from here. [soft voice] Now let's look at that beauty...

[angry] Hey, what do you think you're trying to do here? [commanding] This necklace is missing the gems! [angry] You think we wouldn't notice? [sad] Even Malton could see that the gems are gone.

[commanding] Well, maybe you didn't steal them... but this necklace is worthless without those gems! [urgent] Your job isn't done here yet, not by a long shot!
quest_2284_quest_detail:
As sure as Malton is a dummy, those gems are still in Uldaman somewhere. [urgent] You're going to have to go back there and look for them.

Like I said before, if the information we have is correct then there's a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz that go with the necklace. Find them and put them in the necklace.

[hesitant] As to where the gems are, who knows? Maybe you'll get lucky and find the corpse of the Paladin. If he's not been stripped clean already, then maybe he's got them on him still.
quest_2284_quest_complete:
[solemn] You seem to have found the remains of the paladin that Dran had mentioned from before. [soft voice] Searching the remains uncovers what would appear to be his journal. [pause] The book is in poor condition, as dried blood has stained most of the text in the book. [sad] What you can read, however, is gibberish; it is written in the native tongue of the humans, to the best of your knowledge.

[urgent] You will need the book translated if you are to glean any knowledge from it.
quest_2298_quest_detail:
[solemn] So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.

[angry] Well nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! [urgent] The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!

[commanding] Me advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' Ironforge and get to Stormwind. [soft voice] Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."
quest_2298_quest_complete: [excited] It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!
quest_2299_quest_detail:
[urgent] Where have you been, <name>? [urgent] Hulfdan's been looking all over the place for you. We thought the king may have put you in irons.

Get to Ironforge as soon as possible and speak with Hulfdan!
quest_2299_quest_complete: [whispering] Keep yer voice down, <name>, the guards may hear ye.
quest_2300_quest_detail:
[low voice] Renzik was looking for you, fish.

[threatening] I wouldn't keep Mathias's second in command waiting if I were you.
quest_2300_quest_complete: [urgent] Are you ready to get to work or do you need to take a nap before we get started?
quest_2318_quest_detail: [solemn] At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand. [soft voice] There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the Badlands. [pause] Perhaps that is a good place to start.
quest_2318_quest_complete:
Mighty <class>, I know what you are doing out here in the Badlands. [soft voice] I know you seek my gift of tongues. You're after the parts to that necklace you found in Uldaman.

[surprised] Surprised? Don't be - it's my job to know such things. Instead, let's discuss what you're going to do for a translated journal. [commanding] Trust me - I'm the only one you'll find that can translate it.

[warm] Better still, let me make you a better offer than Dran Droffers is, and it'll let you still complete your deal with them. [excited] Interested now, yes?
quest_2338_quest_detail:
Droffers and Son Salvage aren't smart enough to restore the magic in the necklace, but I am. [solemn] All I want to do is study the necklace so I can learn to make them myself. [urgent] To do that, I will need your necklace. [soft voice] Let me borrow it, and in exchange for the time I get to study it I will translate the journal for you. [pause] While you are searching for the gems, I should have enough time to learn what I need to.

[confident] It's a simple deal, and no one else will be the wiser. [soft voice] Whatcha wanna do?
quest_2338_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've thought about it, yes? [confident] You're a smart <class> if you take this deal - you and I will get what we both want, and Droffers and Son Salvage will think they're getting what they want.
quest_2338_quest_complete:
[confident] You know a good deal when you see one - I knew I could count on you.

[warm] It will be just a moment while I cast a spell to quickly translate the human tongue into a form you will understand. [solemn] I am a troll of my word; ask anyone in the Horde about Jarkal Mossmeld. [urgent] Now, let's get this started...
quest_2339_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here is the journal, translated for you to read on your own. The crux of it says dwarves hid the ruby, the troggs hid the topaz, and a trogg named Grimlok has the sapphire.

[soft voice] Look - you're going to need a power source to make the necklace work again. Dran Droffers doesn't know this. To find one, here's what I'd do: go as deep as you can in Uldaman and kill whatever construct there is the strongest. [urgent] No doubt whatever that is would have it.

[commanding] When you have everything collected, come back here!
quest_2339_quest_progress:
[urgent] You've got another trip into the depths of Uldaman in store for yourself if you don't have the gems and a power source capable of channeling magical power back into the necklace.

[soft voice] You'll be getting the gems back to deliver to the goons in Orgrimmar; [pause] I will be keeping the power source, since it will be the thing that will make the necklace work in the first place...
quest_2339_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very well done, <class>. Now the fruits of our redirection will pay themselves out handsomely. [confident] I'm finished with the necklace itself, and I am confident I can duplicate the construction process consistently.

But first, I will use a specially prepared incantation to quickly analyze those gems before you take them and the necklace back to Orgrimmar. [urgent] This will take just a brief moment to do.
quest_2340_quest_detail:
Any necklace setting and gem will work, so long as they are the same material. [soft voice] This power source, however, is what will bring the magic back to the necklace... I hope.

[hesitant] I'll gladly supply the gems needed for your version of the necklace, so long as the power source actually works.

[urgent] Head to Orgrimmar and keep your end of the bargain with Droffers and Son Salvage. [commanding] Just keep your mouth shut about our deal, and when you get back I might have a wonderful surprise for you.
quest_2340_quest_progress: [commanding] Well, look who it is! [angry] Took your sweet time getting here, I see. [threatening] Let's hope this isn't a waste of my time! [urgent] You'll not get paid unless you have everything I asked for. [threatening voice] And trust me on this - we'll be double and triple checking everything!
quest_2340_quest_complete:
[excited] Yep, it's all here. Say, mind if we keep the bag too? No? Thanks, appreciate it! Har!

[proud] This necklace will be our greatest haul yet! [soft voice] Don't feel too bad though; I'm sure the necklace wouldn't fit you anyway. Har again!

[commanding] A deal is a deal, so here's your fee for the salvage. [urgent] Our business is done here for now; check back later to see if we have more work. Until then, beat it!
quest_2341_quest_detail: [low voice] As Dran and Malton Droffers begin to squabble over their new salvage, half of the deal is now complete. [urgent] A trip to the Badlands is now in order to finish things up, as Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath might have a special reward waiting for you there.
quest_2341_quest_complete:
[solemn] The power source you gave me exceeded every expectation I had for it. [soft voice] I was able to make both you and me a necklace, and I have enough left over to make at least three more. [confident] They will fetch quite the fee, with Droffers and Son Salvage none the wiser.

[warm] Here you go, my friend. [proud] I give you my thanks on a splendid job... and something quite special for your trouble.
quest_2342_quest_detail:
[sigh] Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett! [angry] I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.

[low voice] The Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers. [sad] Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.

[urgent] Reclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me! [proud] Help me restore my birthright!
quest_2342_quest_progress: [solemn] The sweeping never ends... [sad] these bats are prolific in their mockery of me and my broom. [urgent] Please tell me you've reclaimed my family's treasure! I've offered you my silver - is that not enough?!
quest_2342_quest_complete:
[solemn] At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett. [warm] You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!

[commanding] Do you hear me, foul bats? [proud] I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice! [threatening] Tremble, bats, tremble!!
quest_2358_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many years ago, the Horns of Nez'ra were stolen from Ravenholdt manor. [soft voice] Across continents and oceans I have searched, only to discover that these insignificant beasts have had it in their possession all along.

[angry] Slay every Blackrock orc you cross until the Horns of Nez'ra are recovered. [urgent] Should you recover the horns, find me in Lakeshire.

[commanding] Do this for me and your name shall be known to Ravenholdt, <name>.
quest_2358_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the demon prince's horns?
quest_2358_quest_complete:
[solemn] To deny Ravenholdt the artifact, would be to deny one's own existence. [warm] Well done, rogue. You may yet walk among the assassins of Ravenholdt.

[soft voice] As a young rogue adventuring in Darkshore, I discovered a tea that replenishes energy in combat. It has served me well throughout the years and now I pass on a taste of the thistle tea to you. Drink of it when you tire, <name>, and fight with vigor once more!
quest_2359_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've been staking out this tower for weeks, <name>. [low voice] Recently a major shipment came through from Duskwood, and along with it came those guards.

[hesitant] What are they? Your guess is as good as mine. [solemn] I can tell you one thing - they aren't human.

[urgent] Anyhow, the shipment had a chest - which is what I assume those abominations are guarding. [commanding] The zombie with the spikes holds a key we'll need.

[confident] Get that key, get in the tower, and uncover whatever is in that chest. [warm] Take your findings back to Mathias.
quest_2359_quest_complete:
[solemn] This would explain the Defias drones you and Kearnen saw outside of the tower, <name>. [solemn] It would also explain the Venture Company's involvement with the Defias and the strange shipments out of Duskwood.

[soft voice] According to this book, the Zanzil trolls in Stranglethorn have discovered a way to raise the dead through potions... or to be more specific: poison.

[urgent] You'll be of no use to SI:7 without a firm understanding of poisons, <name> -- especially with the recipe to create undeath at our fingertips.
quest_2360_quest_detail:
[urgent] Not a moment too soon, <name>. SI:7 reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall.

[solemn] It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the Redridge supply route.

[commanding] Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.

[whispering] ...and <name>, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
quest_2360_quest_complete: [soft voice] Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? [urgent] Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.
quest_2361_quest_complete:
[delight] I gladly give you this necklace, mighty <class>. [warm] You have done me an invaluable service, and for that I thank you. [proud] Wear it with pride, and make sure you mention loudly and repeatedly who made it for you!

[chuckling] Also, if you could toss in the fact that it really isn't cursed, that would be great.
quest_2378_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have served the Deathstalkers well, <name>, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. [soft voice] While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.

[commanding] The Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. [urgent] Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in Orgrimmar.
quest_2378_quest_complete: [low voice] So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? [mocking tone] How uninspiring....
quest_2379_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your determination alone is not enough to overcome the obstacles that lay ahead of us.

[soft voice] Speak with Zando'zan to begin your training as an operative of the Shattered Hand.

[low voice] It is only when you have mastered the practices of stealth and thievery that you may take the next step towards your destiny.
quest_2379_quest_complete: [solemn] Perhaps Zando'zan was wrong. [sad] Zando'zan apologizes.
quest_2380_quest_detail:
[low voice] A master of stealth and deception you are not, however, all of that can and will change. [solemn] You've obviously impressed those in charge with your meager skills, as the great Shenthul has asked for you by name.

[urgent] Take the road north of here to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow.
quest_2380_quest_complete: [solemn] It is important that the Shattered Hand remains vigilant in the face of the changes Thrall wishes to bring about to the Horde. [commanding] Our numbers alone will not be enough to overcome his rule - stealth and deception must be mastered.
quest_2381_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I don't mean to scare you, <name>, but the last five thieves I sent to steal the southsea treasure came back to me in pieces.

[urgent] South along the coast you'll find Tide Razor, the southsea freebooter's ship. [solemn] Nestled in the hold is the payoff - the southsea treasure. [commanding] On the second level of that ship is the pirate's den, a place where they train all of their thieves.

[urgent] Board that ship, steal the treasure, and bring it back to me. [soft voice] Use the pirate's den if you need to practice your thievery, but be careful!
quest_2381_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, at least you still have all of your body parts. [urgent] Did you find the treasure?
quest_2381_quest_complete:
Incredible! Improbable! [excited] Simply amazing! [warm] You've got talent, <name>. [excited] Either that or you're the luckiest man alive!

[warm] Here's your cut of the action. [gentle] I'm sure you would make better use of this stuff than I could.
quest_2382_quest_detail:
[commanding] Zando'zan has seen it! [excited] Yes, the day comes! [solemn] Thrall's death... the dagger in his back, poison seeping through to his every vein... [hesitant] Zando'zan has said too much.

<name>! [urgent] Zando'zan has a task for <name>! [commanding] <name> must travel to Ratchet, east of the Crossroads, and speak with Wrenix the Wretched. [shouting] Go!
quest_2382_quest_complete: [angry] Another one? [sad] The last five that crazy troll sent me ended up as shark food. [hesitant] Let's hope you fare a little better, eh?
quest_2383_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. [solemn] If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
quest_2383_quest_progress: [soft voice] What's that you have there? A parchment? [hesitant] You're not a scholar, I hope...
quest_2383_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, that's my parchment. [warm] I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, <name>. [warm] I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. [solemn] Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the <class>.

[warm] Good luck, <name>, and return to me whenever you feel ready.
quest_2398_quest_detail:
[solemn] The dig site at Uldaman wasn't always overrun. [soft voice] We Ironforge dwarves used to control the area, but... that was before the troggs came. [angry] They came so fast and in such numbers that not even dwarven might could stop them!

[urgent] In fact, their attack was so sudden that I fear some of our people may be trapped behind enemy lines.

[pause] My friend Baelog led a small band of dwarves deep within the site just before the troggs showed up. [commanding] If he and his company live, then I want you to find them.
quest_2398_quest_complete:
[excited] It's about time you showed up! [laughing] I was in danger of losing a bet with Olaf!

He wagered that his beard would grow to his knees before he saw another living <race>. Well here you are, and as you can see Olaf's beard has a few more inches to go.

[warm] Thanks, <name>. [proud] I'll split the winnings with you.
quest_2418_quest_detail:
[solemn] A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. [soft voice] They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman. [low voice] I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. [excited] It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!

[pause] Anyway, [urgent] after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.

[angry] I want those stones for myself! [warm] Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
quest_2418_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the power stones, <name>? [hesitant] I have a robotic rodent that needs a power supply...
quest_2418_quest_complete:
[excited] That's great, you found some! [warm] Thanks a lot, <name>. [proud] You're the most dependable <race> I've met!

[urgent] I can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with. [confident] I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...
quest_2438_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. [soft voice] This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

[sad] Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... [pause] Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.

[gentle] Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, <class>?
quest_2438_quest_progress:
[urgent] Please move swiftly. [solemn] I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

[hesitant] Have you recovered it yet, <name>?
quest_2438_quest_complete: [solemn] My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. [warm] Thank you for returning it, <name>.
quest_2439_quest_detail:
[solemn] This object is an incredible find. The ancient Titans, or the Creators as these discs refer to them as, are the link to our enchanted creation, if the lore stored in here is correct! [urgent] We'll need to invest as much research time into this as possible.

As for you, heroic <class>, take this voucher to Dinita Stonemantle at the vault. It grants you what I think is a fitting for such a tremendous find!

[warm] Return to me directly when you are ready; there is much more to do for the Explorers' League!
quest_2439_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome to the Vault of Ironforge, <name>. [soft voice] What may I do for you today?
quest_2439_quest_complete:
[soft voice] As yes, a voucher from the Explorers' League... and quite the valuable one, might I add.

[solemn] The Explorers' League lends me the authority to offer you a choice in your compensation directly from their vault. [warm] You are to receive this item, and you may choose between five superior healing potions or five greater mana potions as your reward.
quest_2440_quest_detail:
[solemn] I shall focus my energies on these discs; they will reveal their true workings to me in due time.

[soft voice] As for you <name>, I will now reward you for your diligence in bringing this to my attention. [warm] Take this voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer for Thunder Bluff. [warm] She will give you a special item I believe you will find appealing, and she will supply you with a choice of potions from my personal stock.

[solemn] Return to me soon, as I sense there is much more at hand for us to do regarding this find.
quest_2440_quest_progress: [gentle] Greetings, <class>! [soft voice] Are you here for alchemy training, or perhaps something else?
quest_2440_quest_complete: [solemn] Well <name>, you must have pleased Sage Truthseeker greatly for him to give you this item. [warm] You are also to be granted a gift from his cache of potions; you may choose between 5 superior healing potions or 5 greater mana potions as your reward.
quest_2458_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Venture Company... Perhaps you have heard of them?

[soft voice] For one year we have worked on planting an agent deep within their ranks. Through much hard work and careful planning, we succeeded.

[urgent] Recently we received word that the Venture Co. are planning something on a grand scale. Go north of the Sludge Fen to the Venture Co. tower and contact our undercover agent, Taskmaster Fizzule.

When you find the tower, use this flare gun, then approach Fizzule and show him the salute of the Shattered Hand.
quest_2458_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It's good to see another agent of the Shattered Hand in these parts, however, the flare may have been a little too much!

[warm] Next time you need to speak with me, blow into this whistle twice and I'll know you are an ally.
quest_2459_quest_detail:
[urgent] The emerald... It is missing! [sad] My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

[solemn] There is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. [solemn] I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. [soft voice] Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... [cold] He would never realize that its power is useless to him.

[commanding] Find this missing jewel, <name>. [urgent] And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
quest_2459_quest_progress: [solemn] Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine Mystics must return what is mine. [soft voice] Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
quest_2459_quest_complete: [solemn] Now I can repair my dreamcatcher. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_2460_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a rogue of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. [soft voice] It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.

[commanding] Watch, learn, repeat.
quest_2460_quest_complete: [excited] Well done, <name>. [warm] You are now ready to proceed.
quest_2478_quest_detail:
[commanding] You will need to steal the tower key from Foreman Silixiz, <name>. [urgent] Once you've got the key in your possession, hold on to it - I may need it later.

[solemn] Remember, the poison has weakened everything in this tower. [urgent] Use your abilities to bring chaos and destruction to its inhabitants. [angry] Slay them all -- show no mercy!

[urgent] Once everything inside lays in a bloodied heap, pick Gallywix's lockbox and steal the cache of Zanzil's mixture held inside. [urgent] Take both the head of Gallywix and the mixture to Shenthul in Orgrimmar.
quest_2478_quest_complete:
[solemn] Poor Fizzule, he was a good agent -- one of our best. [sad] Alas, it is the price we pay, <name>. [low voice] Being a field agent of the Shattered Hand is dangerous work.

[commanding] You have performed your duty well, <class>. [cold] It would be a shame if you did not live to serve us again.
quest_2479_quest_detail:
[urgent] Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.

[soft voice] If anyone can cure you, it's Serge. [solemn] Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.
quest_2479_quest_complete: [soft voice] You look deliciously pale, <class>. [mocking tone] And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? [urgent] I must know!
quest_2480_quest_detail:
[excited] I have never seen such wondrous results from a poison! Zanzil you say? Never heard of him, however, I must commend him on the creation of this concoction.

So, I am to cure you of this and then teach you how to make use of the poison?

[urgent] Give me a few moments to examine the toxin, <name>.
quest_2480_quest_complete: [urgent] The cure is ready! [warm] Drink this anti-toxin and the creeping madness will stop, however, [hesitant] I will not be able to do anything about the smell.
quest_2498_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have just received word that Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. [soft voice] Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

[urgent] Make haste, <name>; he needs our help.
quest_2498_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. [solemn] I am glad you arrived here so soon.

[solemn] I have discovered something quite disturbing!
quest_2499_quest_detail:
[solemn] In a cave along the southern bank of the lake, a timberling named Oakenscowl is spreading corruption to all the creatures that make Lake Al'Ameth their home.

[hesitant] I dared not get too close, but even from a distance, it is obvious: Oakenscowl is being poisoned by the largest tumor I have ever seen... I would call it gargantuan, even.

[soft voice] <name>, you have already done much to aid my efforts, but I ask of you one more task. [urgent] Hunt down Oakenscowl and collect the tumor; remove this source of corruption from my home.
quest_2499_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you located Oakenscowl yet, <race>?
quest_2499_quest_complete:
I knew you were more than capable of ridding the lake of that horrible beast.

[solemn] It is a distressing situation; Oakenscowl was once a grand leader amongst his kind... but corruption does not discriminate between the lowly and the noble.

[soft voice] The size of this tumor is quite disturbing, but I must study it to learn more about the disease that upsets the timberling population.

[warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_2500_quest_detail:
<class>, I would make use of your services. [commanding] I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the Badlands.

I need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. [urgent] Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.

Acquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal.

[soft voice] Well, what say ye?
quest_2500_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten the things I need yet? [commanding] You won't get paid unless you bring me those reagents.
quest_2500_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, well done <name>. [warm] These should last me for a little while at least. [warm] Here is your pay, as promised.

[warm] If you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. [warm] These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation. [warm] They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.

[warm] Perhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?
quest_2501_quest_detail:
You have been most helpful to me, <name>. [warm] I would like to reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier, but I must ask of you a favor that is quite dangerous.

[solemn] This lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be careful. [urgent] Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.

[commanding] Do this, and the recipe will be yours.
quest_2501_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you used the vessels to get me the scorched guardian dragon blood I need? [hesitant] Yes, I know it is a dangerous task... [solemn] but the recipe for my restorative brew awaits your success. [emphasis] Risk and reward, my friend... [emphasis] risk and reward...
quest_2501_quest_complete: [solemn] From one alchemist to another, I salute you. [warm] Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. [proud] May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years!
quest_2518_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

[urgent] Find Lady Sathrah, <name>, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. [soft voice] Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
quest_2518_quest_progress:
[solemn] I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

[soft voice] It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. [pause] With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
quest_2518_quest_complete:
[solemn] The forest mourns for Lady Sathrah, but it was something that had to be done.

[warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_2519_quest_detail:
[solemn] A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, <race>.

[soft voice] There is a difficult task that must be done.

[pause] Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. [low voice] Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
quest_2519_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, Sister Aquinne sent you?
quest_2520_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. [soft voice] Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.

[pause] Inside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice. [gentle] The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.

[solemn] When you have completed this, return to me.
quest_2520_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you placed the sacrifice at the fountain, <name>?
quest_2520_quest_complete:
[solemn] The loss of Lady Sathrah is distressing, but in this way only may she be reborn with a renewed spirit.

[soft voice] May Elune willingly accept the sacrifice that you have offered her.
quest_2541_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. [sad] The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.
