[urgent] I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.

[commanding] You must help me. [soft voice] The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. [gentle] Please, <name>, bring one to me.
quest_2541_quest_progress: [soft voice] If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. [hesitant] Have you found one?
quest_2541_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>.

[warm] What an odd trinket this is... [solemn] I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; [emphasis] this is a very powerful enchantment.
quest_2561_quest_detail:
[solemn] After examining this charm, <name>, I see now what must be done. [soft voice] Please take it, and do as I ask.

[urgent] You are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. [pause] There, you will find my soulless body... [sad] Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine.

[commanding] In order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form. [emphasis] Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. [solemn] After you have completed this task, please return to me.
quest_2561_quest_progress: <name>, [solemn] be wary when approaching my physical form; the enchantment it is under is quite powerful.
quest_2561_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am finally free of the control of the Gnarlpine. [warm] Thank you, <name>.

My spirit may now rest peacefully forever in the Emerald Dream.

[soft voice] Perhaps one day we may meet again, young <class>. [pause] But, for now, please accept this reward as a symbol of my gratitude.
quest_2581_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is a well known fact that hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls, but the strength to snap through three inches of thorium steel? Impossible, improbable, and yet I have seen this demonstrated with my own eyes.

[commanding] Venture forth, into the Blasted Lands, and bring me three snickerfang jowls. As you search for the snickerfang, be on the lookout for boars and scorpoks: The initial assay also requires two blasted boar lungs and one scorpok pincer to complete.
quest_2581_quest_progress: [low voice] You smell foul, <name>. [angry] Have you been traipsing in sulfur fields? And where are my components?!
quest_2581_quest_complete:
[soft voice] How do you feel, <name>? [warm] You radiate with the aura of the snickerfang--your strength, unmatched by mortals!

[solemn] Unfortunately, with the components you brought to me, I could only make enough of the assay for one tablet. [urgent] I will require more components, should you require another tablet.
quest_2582_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, <name>, welcome back. It seems you enjoyed the effect of the robust, operational imbue, derived from snickerfang. [solemn] Be warned, while the immediate effect is a titanic burst of strength, the long term effects on your spirit and intelligence could be hazardous.

[commanding] With that said, do you require more? If so, bring me another three snickerfang jowls, two blasted boar lungs, and one scorpok pincer.
quest_2582_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the beast organs?
quest_2582_quest_complete: [excited] There you go! [warm] Remember, use it sparingly. [soft voice] If you require another, come see me after you finish the one you currently have in your possession.
quest_2583_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within these blasted lands exists two species of boar: the ash-mane boar and the helboar.

[soft voice] It would appear that the stamina of these beasts renders them nearly immune to harm, as the other animals find them too difficult to kill and consequently, not worth the effort.

[urgent] We need to perform further analysis, <name>. [commanding] Should you bring me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain, I shall create a divine elixir from the residue of the assay. [excited] You will be my first test subject!
quest_2583_quest_complete: [solemn] The spirit of the boar illuminates your being, <name>! [soft voice] I wonder, do you believe yourself to be as invulnerable as these beasts?
quest_2584_quest_detail:
[solemn] When I first administered the elixir, <name>, I could tell that one or two applications would not satiate your appetite. [soft voice] Even now, I can see the hunger in your eyes. The concoction has addictive properties of which, seemingly, the most strong of will cannot resist.

[angry] So be it! [urgent] Should you require more of the lung juice cocktail, venture back into the wasteland and find for me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain.
quest_2584_quest_complete: [solemn] I must warn you, <name>, do not attempt to mix the formulas I have created. [low voice] The chemical properties of the formula you most recently ingested will always take precedence over former enchantments; thus, rendering the other formulation null.
quest_2585_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ever watched them in battle, <name>? The scorpoks, I mean. [soft voice] Have you ever seen the grace and agility with which they move? The decisiveness of their strikes?

[hesitant] If only we could somehow isolate that agility and encapsulate it, we would be wealthy beyond our... I mean... it would be a boon for the scientific community.

[urgent] Assist me, <name>, and I shall allow you a sampling of the assay.

In order to create a stable sample, I will need three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.
quest_2585_quest_complete:
[solemn] Fascinating. This has been the most difficult of all assays to analyze.

[soft voice] Take a pinch of this residual salt and place it under your tongue. [gentle] You should experience a slight feeling of euphoria followed by a state of unprecedented agility and quickness.
quest_2586_quest_detail:
[excited] You live! This is good news, indeed. [solemn] I assume you are back for more of the scorpok assay?

[commanding] Very well, <name>, back to the wasteland with you and do not return until you have collected three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.
quest_2586_quest_complete:
[solemn] Fine work, <name>. Here is one sample of the assay for you and the remaining nine will be used in my research.

[soft voice] Anytime you require more of the ground scorpok assay, return to me and we shall work out a deal.
quest_2601_quest_detail:
[solemn] These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, <name>. [soft voice] These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.

[pause] I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.

[urgent] I must study their brains!

Retrieve four of their brains for me, <name>. [commanding] The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.
quest_2601_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you returned with the requested organs?
quest_2601_quest_complete:
[delight] This is wondrous, <name>! [warm] My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.

[soft voice] Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... for a price.
quest_2602_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? [angry] More research must be done!

[whispering] Oh yes, the price remains the same, <name>. [urgent] Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with four brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.
quest_2602_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you returned with the requested organs?
quest_2602_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, <name>.

[urgent] Take it... and <name>, do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. [solemn] The results could be disastrous.
quest_2603_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done!

[soft voice] Oh yes, the price remains the same, <name>. [urgent] Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains four the redstone and two vulture gizzards.
quest_2603_quest_progress: [angry] Do not waste my time, <name>. [cold] We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
quest_2603_quest_complete:
[delight] Most excellent! I shall get to work immediately. Perhaps a cure for many of the ailments of the world is to be found!

[excited] Ah yes, your reward - of course, should you require more of the gum, return to me and another task you shall be given.
quest_2604_quest_detail:
[solemn] I see that the inner fire has dwindled. [soft voice] Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour?

[low voice] If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. [commanding] Back to the wastelands, <name>. [urgent] Do not return until you have recovered four gizzards and two jowls.
quest_2604_quest_progress: [angry] Do not waste my time, <name>. [cold] We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
quest_2604_quest_complete: [soft voice] Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. [sad] Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. [pause] Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.
quest_2605_quest_detail:
[excited] I've got an idea, see. I've heard of some strange creatures called dew collectors that live to the southwest... and that they are able to store water in special glands.

I think that if I could get one of these glands, I could create a drink that would quench my terrible thirst! Do you think you could help me, <name>?

[urgent] Look for the cactus garden, <name>; that's where you'll find the dew collectors.
quest_2605_quest_progress: [urgent] Please, tell me you found the dew collectors?
quest_2605_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, wonderful! [delight] Give it here -- let me drink it!
quest_2606_quest_detail:
Blech! [angry] This stuff tastes terrible! [sad] So much for that idea...

[surprised] Wait, what's that? [excited] Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. [hesitant] Well, okay then.

[pause] Uhhhh, I have an idea! [delight] Brilliant! [urgent] Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. [soft voice] Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.

[whispering] I mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... [sad] And I'm just not feeling it...
quest_2606_quest_progress: [low voice] So old Marin's up to it again, eh? What's this concoction made from?
quest_2606_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... eccentric, I'd say.

[hesitant] And of course he needs my help, yet again.
quest_2607_quest_detail:
[solemn] It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. [soft voice] This certainly is a strange turn of events, <name>.

[hesitant] A cure? Hrm... [urgent] Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
quest_2607_quest_complete: [excited] It's about time! [urgent] Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. [warm] Osborne will pay you on the way out.
quest_2608_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh my, you look like death. [mocking tone] Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. [commanding] You, sir, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.

[excited] Hah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!

[sigh] *Cough* Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. [urgent] Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, <name>.
quest_2608_quest_progress: [soft voice] When you're ready for the examination, /lay down on the ground and I'll begin the phlebotomy.
quest_2608_quest_complete: [soft voice] Give me a moment to confer with my colleagues, <name>. [commanding voice] Dr. Montgomery, Mr. Noarm, let us conference!
quest_2609_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It's unanimous, <name>. You've got the 'itis.'

Luckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'

[commanding] Here's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse silk thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.

[urgent] Hurry along now, <name>, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. [gentle] Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.
quest_2609_quest_progress: [commanding] If you want the 'itis' cured, you're going to have to try harder than that, <name>. [urgent] Where are the reagents for the cure?
quest_2609_quest_complete:
[hesitant] What am I doing? [soft voice] What does it look like I'm doing? [excited] I'm devising a cure for your 'itis!' [commanding] Don't get indignant with me now, <name>!

[urgent] Just a few more seconds. [pause] There! [warm] Just spray this, um, fantastic smelling medicine on yourself and you'll be as good as new.
quest_2621_quest_detail:
[solemn] Regret. It is all I have now. [sad] One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. [hesitant] If only I had waited for those orders. [soft voice] Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! [hesitant] Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? [sad] Ultimately, it was my fault.

[sad] All of it was my fault. [solemn] So here I stand, awaiting orders. [urgent] I must know. [urgent] I must have those orders.

[commanding] Dispatch Commander Ruag resides in Stonard. [urgent] Find him and find out what became of the orders.
quest_2621_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thrall's Grasp... The story is still fresh in my mind.

<Commander Ruag shakes his head>

[sad] Terrible thing that happened to that regiment. [low voice] The horde lost some of its best soldiers when that battalion was destroyed.
quest_2622_quest_detail:
[angry] The orders? What could you possibly want with the orders?

[threatening] What are you implying, <name>? [commanding] Of course I relayed those orders! [sad] The soldiers I sent the orders with were ambushed and brutally beaten by murlocs. [sigh] Only one survived, if you can call that surviving. [soft voice] He can hardly speak, cannot walk, and must be fed through a tube. [urgent] If you want to know what happened to those orders, speak with Bengor. [hesitant] I'm sure he is around here somewhere... and, <name>, [threatening] be mindful of what you stick your nose into - it may get bitten off.
quest_2623_quest_detail:
[solemn] Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... took orders. [urgent] On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.

Murlocs... Many murlocs... [angry] One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. [panting] East... cave.... <Bengor passes out.>
quest_2623_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is worse than I imagined. Nineteen of my men could have been spared from the agony which they faced. [sad] If only I had not acted so irrationally.

[urgent] You must help them, <name>! [sad] I am powerless to act.
quest_2641_quest_detail:
[soft voice] When I was a kid, my sister used to do all the cooking. [angry] It was horrible! I could barely stomach some of her concoctions -- until I found what I like to call my "secret" ingredient! [excited] Add it to anything, and... WOW! [delight] It tastes great!

[pause] What is it, you ask? It's a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. [urgent] If you want me to help you turn this horrid-tasting brew into something edible, head to the Hinterlands, and look for a small lake there.

[whispering] Oh, and remember, the Violet Tragan can only be found underwater.
quest_2641_quest_progress: [soft voice] Under the waters of that lake -- it's the only place where the Violet Tragan can be found. [excited] Hope you're good at holding your breath!
quest_2641_quest_complete:
[delight] That's the stuff, <name>!

[excited] It looks so good, I might just... [laughing] Haha, gotcha!
quest_2661_quest_detail: [excited] Here's the Violet Powder, <name>. [urgent] Take it to Marin and tell him he owes me a favor!
quest_2661_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, <name>, you're finally back. What have you brought?
quest_2661_quest_complete: [excited] Violet Powder, eh? Let's give it a try -- it sure couldn't make it any worse, that's for sure!
quest_2662_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.

Come back and talk to me in a minute... after I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!
quest_2662_quest_complete:
[excited] Drink this! It's absolutely wonderful!!!

[proud] I knew I had it in me... [warm] Oh thanks again, <name> for your help, but please, stand a little to the side, will you? You're blocking my business! [loud voice] I'm going to make millions on the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir, millions!

[shocked] What's that? Sprinkle says I owe her a favor? [mocking tone] Oh, that Sprinkle, such a kidder!
quest_2681_quest_detail:
[solemn] It will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.

[urgent] Gather a suitable group of adventurers and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.

[commanding] Fight hard and die with honor, <name>.
quest_2681_quest_progress: [solemn] It is no easy task, <name>. [urgent] Do not give up!
quest_2681_quest_complete:
[excited] You have done it, <name>! [solemn] The poor, tortured souls can finally rest.

[urgent] Our work is not yet over, <name>. [commanding] We have much to discuss and much more to accomplish.
quest_2701_quest_detail:
[solemn] Please, take from this a relic of old. [soft voice] We no longer have a use for the item.

[warm] May it serve you well in your fight against the legion.
quest_2701_quest_complete: [soft voice] You are temporarily blinded by the sparkle and gleam.
quest_2702_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have honored me with your nobility and heroism, <name>.

[soft voice] You have also honored them...
quest_2702_quest_complete: [solemn] Indeed, you have honored us all. [warm] Our thanks alone are not sufficient.
quest_2721_quest_detail:
[solemn] As one chapter of your adventure closes, another one begins, <name>.

[soft voice] One of my men is still unaccounted for, lost somewhere in the Blasted Lands. I am talking about Lieutenant Kirith, of course.

[sad] As I had mentioned earlier, we were both imprisoned and tortured by Allistarj, but poor Kirith, his strength of will faltered. [shocked] I could hear the experiments from my cage; the tortured screams rang through the halls of the cave. [pause] That was the last I saw or heard of Kirith.
quest_2742_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey <race>!

Rin'ji lost axe and was captured! Please, help Rin'ji escape. Me know that <race> like you don't like Rin'ji's kind, but Rin'ji begs! [urgent] Must get out of here!

[whispering] Got something for nice <race> if he helps Rin'ji out of here...

[solemn] Rin'ji is hiding something secret at the Overlook Cliffs.
quest_2742_quest_complete:
[solemn] This troll tablet must be the "secret" that Rin'ji was talking about.

Covered with strange markings, you can not decipher what the tablet says.

[soft voice] Oran Snakewrithe sent you to this area in the first place... Perhaps he might be able to tell you more about it.
quest_2743_quest_detail:
[solemn] Let us not mince words, <race>; [low voice] my time here is limited.

[urgent] You must destroy the triad of power which protects the demon lord, Razelikh. [commanding] Doing so will not be as simple a task as freeing a damned soul.

<Kirith grins.>

[soft voice] You see, each of Razelikh's underlings wears a third of an amulet of Razelikh's creation around their neck. [emphasis] The very same amulet you will need in order to summon the arch demon.

[commanding] Return to Trebor and tell him what is required to summon Razelikh. [solemn] He will be able to instruct you further.
quest_2743_quest_complete: [solemn] The demon lord displays a cunning almost as calculated as his brutality, <name>.
quest_2744_quest_detail:
[solemn] The triad is protected by Razelikh.

In exchange for their servitude, Razelikh granted each of them nearly unlimited power within the Blasted Lands. The amulet pieces are each attuned to the lifeforce of their owner, granting them immortality. As long as they remain within the Blasted Lands, they cannot be slain, their life spans extended until the end of days.

[soft voice] There is one who may be able to assist you further, <name>. [urgent] Travel to Azshara and find the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes. Search the islands.
quest_2744_quest_complete: [solemn] I will help you. [soft voice] Although, I do not think you fully understand what you are up against.
quest_2745_quest_detail:
Hmm, [solemn] an interesting tale, and not one to be taken lightly. Yeah, I can help you, but what you need to do is divvy out a form of justice that's not... legal, if you're to see this through to the end.

[urgent] Lescovar and Marzon need to be dealt with, and swiftly. Do you think you're capable of such a thing?

You decide. If so, then make haste to the castle and find an old friend of mine, a gnome named Tyrion. He's been watching Lescovar now for a couple weeks. [soft voice] He should be able to help you end this.
quest_2745_quest_complete:
[angry] What the...?! [shouting] Don't sneak up on me like that! [commanding] And keep your voice down! [angry] What in the name of the Shadow are doing sneakin' up on me for? [angry] Can't you see I'm busy, you daft fool?

[angry] What do you mean, what am I doing? [confident] I'm waiting for the next Dark Portal to open, what the heck do you think I'm doing? [commanding] Speak your peace and be off with you... [urgent] 'fore the guards notice the two of us hiding in the bushes together. [solemn] I have a reputation to maintain.
quest_2746_quest_detail:
[urgent] Trias wants the timetable pushed up some, huh? Okay, we can do that, but I'm not ready. And know this, I'm doing the hard part, but you're the one that's going to get his hands dirty, understand? Good.

Okay, I'll need you to get me a few things before I can put my plan into effect. I got the perfect disguise that'll get Spybot past those guards.

Bring me some silk and a couple apples. The silk's up to you, but Clara's little farm right outside the city has the perfect sized apples.
quest_2746_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. [hesitant] Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. [solemn] We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. [urgent] Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

[commanding] Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.
quest_2746_quest_complete:
[delight] These will do nicely, <name>. [warm] Great job. I have the rest of the gear I'll need in my pack... [soft voice] thank the Light I just got a tailor friend of mine to make me a silk bag. I was running out of room carrying all my gear around.

[commanding] Before Spybot heads in, let's get the details set so you know what you have to do.
quest_2747_quest_progress: [solemn] I have seen very few eggs retrieved from Feralas in extraordinary condition. [soft voice] These are eggs of the rarest sort... [emphasis] Extraordinary Egg
quest_2747_quest_complete:
[excited] Well now, you have one--amazing!

[warm] I hope you always remember the good you have done today.
quest_2748_quest_progress: [solemn] A fine egg is one that will, in ideal conditions, hatch free of the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres' incantations. [soft voice] Fine Egg
quest_2748_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Very good, <name>. [warm] I will be sending this egg to Darnassus where I hope it will soon hatch!

[excited] Please accept this as a symbol of my gratitude.
quest_2749_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch about half the time. We do our best to nurture them and with a little luck, they will hatch. [pause] Ordinary Egg
quest_2749_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So, you have found an ordinary egg, <name>? [hesitant] Please give it to me... [pause] And we can only hope for the best.

[warm] I don't have much, but please accept this reward. [warm] If you ever find yourself in Feralas again, know that I am always here to take the eggs you find there.
quest_2750_quest_progress: [solemn] These are the eggs that cannot be saved -- they will never hatch. [sad] Bad Egg
quest_2750_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I am afraid I have bad news for you, <name>. [sad] This egg is too far gone. [solemn] I can take it from you so that it may be disposed of properly.

[gentle] Please don't be discouraged; we cannot save them all. [warm] If you find yourself in Feralas again, please try again. [excited] Bring another egg for the Super Egg-O-Matic!
quest_2751_quest_detail:
[solemn] Twenty generations of Omosh have held this hammer, <name>. A hundred thousand tons of metal we have molded. [sad] Tragically, it all ends at Orokk, failure of the Omosh: Without kin and incapable of producing offspring.

[urgent] I cannot let the secret recipes of Omosh die with me! [angry] Someone must continue the legacy, Omosh or not!

[commanding] Prove to Orokk you are capable, <name>. [solemn] Bring for Orokk the following: Two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws. [warm] Bring them for Orokk and we shall continue.
quest_2751_quest_complete:
[solemn] The bloodline will fade but perhaps the legend of Omosh will continue!

[warm] You have proven that you are a blacksmith, <name>. [proud] For the blacksmith the reward is the satisfaction of seeing their weapons and armors coated in the blood of their enemies!

[commanding] May the breastplates you create for the generations ahead be drenched in the blood of your enemies!
quest_2752_quest_detail:
Orokk sees the eagerness in your eyes, <name>. [solemn] Like a sponge you soak in the wisdom of the Omosh.

[commanding] Three lessons I shall teach!

[urgent] Return to the anvil, soak in the heat of the forge, create for Orokk four bronze battleaxes and four bronze warhammers. [solemn] Only then will you learn of the iron pauldron.
quest_2752_quest_complete: [warm] You do Orokk proud, <name>. [solemn] Read, learn of iron shoulders!
quest_2753_quest_detail:
Only two more lessons Orokk will teach, <name>. [commanding] Your muscles ache, I know, but continue on for the Omosh!

[urgent] Bring to Orokk four green iron helms, four green iron bracers, and two green iron leggings - for this you learn and your enemies suffer!
quest_2753_quest_progress: [commanding] Their skulls will crack under the pressure of your boots!
quest_2753_quest_complete: [warm] You remind Orokk of his grandfather, Chief Gorokk of Omosh! [solemn] Read, learn of the iron boot.
quest_2754_quest_detail:
[solemn] The final lesson Orokk teaches you, <name>. [commanding] To the sacred anvil and forge you return! [urgent] Bring for Orokk two solid iron mauls, two silvered bronze boots, and two silvered bronze gauntlets.

[threatening] See the fear in their eyes as you approach!
quest_2754_quest_progress: [commanding] Show the iron who is in charge, <name>!
quest_2754_quest_complete: [delight] Astounding! You have learned the way of the Omosh, <name>!
quest_2755_quest_detail:
Orokk is not crying, <name>. [low voice] Soot is in eye.

<Orokk wipes a tear away.>

[pause] There is one last Omosh family secret Orokk will teach you. [solemn] Orokk will die happy, thanks to <name>.

[warm] Learn Omosh dance of joy and then you learn fist of iron!
quest_2755_quest_complete: <Orokk pants.> [solemn] It has been a very long time since Orokk has done the Omosh dance of joy. [excited] Learn now, <name>!
quest_2756_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the time of legends, Aturk would crush the skulls of his enemies and grind the bone into a fine powder for use in filament. [sad] Long gone are those days, <race>. [solemn] The Warchief calls for peace among the clans. [angry] Old enemies are now only watched with weary eyes!

[shocked] Unbelievable, I know, but such is the will of Thrall.

[commanding] Enough lamenting! [commanding] You are here to learn, and learn you will! [urgent] Bring me four steel breastplates and four steel helms and you will gain a taste of war!
quest_2756_quest_progress: [urgent] Aturk, like time, waits for no one! [angry] Hurry up fool!
quest_2756_quest_complete: [low voice] It seems you are but another complacent lemming of the Warchief, <name>. [sad] How disappointing. [solemn] How I long for a glorious death upon the battlefield. [angry] Instead, I am stuck here, by order of Thrall, to teach infants how to craft! [commanding] Watch and learn, child!
quest_2757_quest_detail:
[low voice] Listen, kid, you're not gonna learn anything hanging around here.

[urgent] I know a guy who knows a guy. He hangs around the smithy in Booty Bay. If you show him this insignia, he'll tell you all about mithril.

[commanding] So whadd'ya say? Leave this kid stuff to the babies in diapers, <name> -- it's time to move on.

[urgent] If you're interested, his name's McGavan. Show him this trinket and he'll recognize your commitment.
quest_2757_quest_progress: [solemn] A rare breed your kind be, matey. [commanding] Let me see that insignia.
quest_2757_quest_complete: [excited] By Blackhoof's back hair -- finally, one worthy of the Mithril Order!
quest_2758_quest_detail:
[solemn] When I was about your age, a dwarf by the name of Galvan took me under his wing and trained me in the ways of the armorsmith. [pause] Before he left for Booty Bay, he made me promise to train all those with the desire and determination to advance in the craft of blacksmithing -- so here I am -- all these years later.

[soft voice] So, now it's time for you to learn a little something. [warm] Make me six golden scale bracers and you will learn where smithing comes from, <name>.
quest_2758_quest_progress: [soft voice] Could you be the next Galvan protege?
quest_2758_quest_complete:
[excited] Very good, <name>! [commanding] Listen and learn.

[emphasis] Blacksmithing never comes from here! <Hank points to his heart.>

<Hank points to the anvil.>

<Hank points to his hammer.>

[emphasis] Blacksmithing never comes from here! [emphasis] Blacksmithing only comes from here! [solemn] And now you know the origin of blacksmithing.
quest_2759_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although Galvan left Booty Bay many years ago, members of the order still remain in town, hoping to one day find another worthy of Galvan's tutelage.

[soft voice] Take this insignia and present it to McGavan in Booty Bay.

[urgent] If you actually make it that far, he'll know that you are worthy. [warm] I have faith, <name>!
quest_2759_quest_progress: [soft voice] A rare breed your kind be, matey. [commanding] Let me see that insignia.
quest_2759_quest_complete: [excited] By Blackhoof's back hair -- finally, one worthy of the Mithril Order!
quest_2760_quest_detail:
[solemn] Most of our recruits never make it to Booty Bay, <name>. [soft voice] The shine of the insignia is enough to trigger the loot lust in even the staunchest of blacksmiths. [mocking tone] Fools they be, as the insignia is a drop in the bucket compared to the wealth of items you'll see!

[urgent] Find Galvan the Ancient and show him this pin. [soft voice] His residence is far to the north, between Zul Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.
quest_2760_quest_progress: Hail! Come closer; show Galvan what you have.
quest_2760_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, many years it has been since one has been worthy of the Mithril Order's initiation. [warm] We will start now!
quest_2761_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? [emphasis] Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! [commanding] The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.

[warm] Show Galvan that you are capable, <name>. [urgent] Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. [proud] For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!
quest_2761_quest_progress: [urgent] After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
quest_2761_quest_complete: [warm] Your work ethic is impeccable, <name>! [proud] You are starting to understand the ways of Galvan mineralogy! [excited] Take this and learn from it all that you can.
quest_2762_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said that truesilver is stronger and more durable than mithril. Galvan does not disagree with this assessment of the minerals, but contrary to its name, truesilver is not true! [proud] Mithril is a far nobler mineral! [shouting] HAH! Regardless, for this lesson you will need to find the great silver deceiver, <name>.

[commanding] Bring me forty bars of mithril and five bars of truesilver. In exchange, you will be taught the secret of ornate mithril gloves and more importantly, learn that truesilver is a liar!
quest_2762_quest_progress: [commanding] After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
quest_2762_quest_complete: She's a cruel mistress, is she not, <name>? [solemn] I'm speaking of truesilver, naturally. [soft voice] Aye, Galvan spent over a decade in the mountains of Alterac learning this lesson. [warm] Take this and learn from it all that you can!
quest_2763_quest_detail:
[solemn] The harvesting of precious gems is of utmost importance to our craft, <name>. [soft voice] Few gems are more precious than the citrine. [low voice] The magical properties we imbue into our goods are amplified greatly by the presence of citrine.

[pause] For this lesson, we will fortify forty bars of mithril with four citrines. [emphasis] The result will be a better understanding of magical gemology and the knowledge to create ornate mithril shoulders.
quest_2763_quest_progress: [commanding] After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
quest_2763_quest_complete:
[soft voice] One can barely keep their eyes from leaving its splendor, <name>. [warm] Aye, citrine is a glorious gem.

[commanding] Pay attention and learn what such a discovery may teach us!
quest_2764_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you are ready to conclude your training with Galvan, you should journey to Gadgetzan.

There, you will find my finest pupil: Trenton Lighthammer. [soft voice] He has much to teach you in the ways of ornate mithril. [commanding] Otherwise, remain here and learn!

[chuckling] Oh, Gadgetzan is in Tanaris, of course!
quest_2764_quest_complete:
[excited] Galvan the Ancient sent you??

<Trenton bows.>

[warm] It is a great honor to meet another of the master's pupils!
quest_2765_quest_detail:
[excited] When you first came to me, I knew that you would turn out to be one of my finest pupils! [warm] It was without hesitancy that you gave up a trinket of some power to McGavan. [proud] You did this only so that you could meet me. Such blind faith and devotion to the craft should be rewarded.

[proud] You have attained expertise over blacksmithing, <name>. [urgent] Reap the rewards!
quest_2765_quest_complete: [solemn] It is only fitting that you receive a trinket of far greater power than the one you sacrificed to get here. [warm] Use it in good health, <name>.
quest_2767_quest_progress: [excited] Yes, I'm Oglethorpe Obnoticus, master inventor at your service! [soft voice] Now, is there something I could assist you with?
quest_2767_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-22/FE! [warm] I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! [soft voice] My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!

[warm] Please, take your choice of any of these items I have. [warm] Thank you again for your generous assistance <name>, [proud] my robots and I are in your debt!
quest_2768_quest_detail:
[screaming] Sergeant Bly stole from me! [angry] He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!! [urgent] Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??

[commanding] Find Bly and bring me my rod! [soft voice] I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west. [solemn] I bet you'll find him there.

[hesitant] Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
quest_2768_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find Sergeant Bly? [urgent] Did you get my divino-matic rod?
quest_2768_quest_complete: [excited] You found it! [warm] Well done, <name>! [laughing] Did you have to fight Bly for it? [mocking tone] I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!
quest_2769_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you met the Brassbolts brothers? [excited] They're over in the Shimmering Flats, in Kalimdor, racing their rocket car against the goblins. [laughing] They usually win which is no surprise--the goblin car blows up so much it barely ever crosses the finish line!

[urgent] But even then, the Brassbolts brothers are always looking for new ways to make their car go faster, and Wizzle told me he needs a very rare component for his next experiment.

[hesitant] He probably needs help getting that part. Speak to him and find out.
quest_2769_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, you want to help me? Great!

[warm] There's a part I want for an experiment I'm working on, and I need a brave <class> like you to help me get it!
quest_2770_quest_detail:
[solemn] Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in Tanaris, there is a sacred pool. [excited] From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast! [angry] Gahz'rilla! [soft voice] He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy. [urgent] It's that energy I want to harness for my car!

[commanding] Bring me the electrified scale of Gahz'rilla!

[solemn] But the summoning of Gahz'rilla is a well-kept secret of the trolls. [urgent] To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.
quest_2770_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the scale? [excited] I can't wait to try different ways to harness its energy!
quest_2770_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, you got the scale! [warm] Thanks, <name>. [excited] I can't wait to get to work on this thing!

[pause] So you saw Gahz'rilla? Was he as big as they say??
quest_2771_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems as if master had this planned from the start. [hesitant] I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.

[solemn] The master is wise, <name>. [confident] We shall teach each other!

[commanding] Show me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.
quest_2771_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you completed the crafting of the items, <name>?
quest_2771_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [warm] A fair tradeoff, if I do say so myself. [commanding] Watch and learn, <name>!
quest_2772_quest_detail:
[solemn] At last year's All-Valley Blacksmithing Championship, all those who watched saw my leg get swept from under me by a cowardly dog from the Venture Co. Foundry. [soft voice] What they didn't know, however, was the reason I was able to continue and ultimately win the tournament: [excited] That's right, ornate mithril boots!

[urgent] I will need to learn how to craft ornate mithril pants for this year's tournament, however, as a Venture Co. shredder is an entrant! [commanding] Teach me the way of the pants and learn the way of the boot!
quest_2772_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you completed the crafting of the items, <name>?
quest_2772_quest_complete: [solemn] The world will be at your feet, <name>! [commanding] Let them all come at your legs, for you are now unsweepable!
quest_2773_quest_detail:
[solemn] Around these parts I am known as the Mithril Kid. [soft voice] I supply ornate mithril to adventurers from around the world.

<Trenton whispers.>

[whispering] Little do they know that I do not know the technique to fashion ornate mithril gloves. Shhhh! [hesitant] This will be our little secret.

[urgent] Teach me the technique to create ornate mithril gloves, <name>, and in exchange, I will show you the resultant of the culmination of my training under Galvan: the ornate mithril breastplate.
quest_2773_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you completed the crafting of the items, <name>?
quest_2773_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for all that you have taught me, <name>. [solemn] The master and commander of the ornate mithril set will soon be in your possession.

[delight] Behold!
quest_2782_quest_detail: [solemn] The tablet is covered with Witherbark troll markings. [soft voice] Rin'ji's secret truly is a mystery...
quest_2783_quest_detail:
[solemn] We fight the wrong enemy, <name>.

[low voice] The true power in these lands continues to grow in strength and number while we squabble over scorched earth with orcs.

[urgent] Do we continue to fight a war in these lands against the Horde, only to be routed one day by the armies of the Burning Legion? [sad] It is futile.

[commanding] Put your differences aside, <name>, speak with the fallen hero of the Horde. [solemn] He knows the truth behind the Blasted Lands.
quest_2783_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Alliance wishes to assist?

[pause] I thought to never see this day again. [soft voice] A day in which the Alliance fights side by side with the Horde against a common enemy.

[emphasis] It shall be... [pause] we will unite.
quest_2784_quest_progress: [solemn] Listen to what I have to say.
quest_2784_quest_complete: [solemn] As a spirit, I am powerless, <name>. [commanding] Assist me. [solemn] Allow me to regain my honor.
quest_2801_quest_detail: [solemn] Before we may continue, you must hear my story.
quest_2801_quest_progress: [solemn] Listen to what I have to say, <name>.
quest_2801_quest_complete: [urgent] The time to act is now, <name>.
quest_2821_quest_detail:
[solemn] My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises. [angry] Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in Dun Morogh!

In my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides. [soft voice] The Yeti are native to Feralas, with many found in Feral Scar Vale. [urgent] I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. [confident] If that sounds fair to you, then we're in business.
quest_2821_quest_progress:
A stack of ten thick yeti hides will net you a choice of one of my crafted items. [warm] Because I care about quality, I am able to ensure you'll get a good item!

[excited] If you can't seem to find yetis, I know where some might be. [soft voice] Try looking just inland of the Forgotten Coast, around Feral Scar Vale.
quest_2821_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Did you stop and examine the texture of these hides? [solemn] Properly treated, these hides could very well be stronger than iron. [low voice] Not many people know about these hides, and that in combination with the vast treating solutions I know will allow me to potentially make items with a true mark of quality... [warm] thanks to you, of course!

[excited] And now, please choose from what I am able to offer you for your service!
quest_2822_quest_detail:
[solemn] I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised. [commanding] Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!

[solemn] In my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides. [soft voice] Yetis are native to Feralas, often found west of here in Feral Scar Vale. [warm] I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. [confident] If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!
quest_2822_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Were you able to get a stack of ten thick yeti hides? [warm] My leather goods are second to none, and I'll share a sampling with you should you have the hides.

[gentle] If you can't seem to find yetis, I know where some might be. [pause] Try looking west of here, just inland of the Forgotten Coast around the Feral Scar Vale.
quest_2822_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, excellent! [warm] These hides, when given a special treatment, are as resilient as iron I tell you! [confident] It will take many tries in order to get the right mix down for the tanning, but I am confident they will bring my mark of quality to the next level.

[warm] As for you, <name>... [proud] your assistance has proven invaluable to me. [warm] Please take your choice from these items I have crafted.
quest_2841_quest_detail:
[urgent] Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, <name>!

[hesitant] Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

[commanding] Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, <name>. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
quest_2841_quest_progress: [angry] I don't see any blueprints. Did you hide them somewhere on your body or are you just standing around here to irritate me?
quest_2841_quest_complete:
[excited] I knew you could do it, <name>! [warm] Sovik on the other hand, he had his doubts.

<Nogg clears his throat.>

[commanding] Now that we have the blueprints in our possession, it is only a matter of time before we figure out all of the gnomish innovations that went into the creation of the rig and make them goblin innovations for our new shredder models.
quest_2842_quest_detail:
[urgent] As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.

[excited] It's finally ready for passengers to board, <name>. [commanding] If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. [urgent] To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.

[mocking tone] Of course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of Dun Morogh!
quest_2842_quest_complete:
[excited] She's a beauty, isn't she? [solemn] Pinnacle of goblin transport technology -- only exploded a dozen or so times.

[warm] Don't worry, <name>, I've got her all fixed up. [confident] She won't blow up on you - and if she does, it'll be quick and painless.
quest_2843_quest_detail:
[urgent] As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.

[hesitant] You may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.

[pause] I almost forgot the most important part - getting back. [urgent] When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!

[commanding] Now to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.
quest_2843_quest_complete: [excited] All done! [warm] When you're ready, just step on the pad.
quest_2844_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, I am so glad you found me! [soft voice] I must admit, I am a bit lost... [gentle] But isn't this a beautiful place?
quest_2845_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.

There is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.

Inside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. [warm] You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
quest_2846_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep. And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.

[soft voice] So when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it. [angry] She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away. [angry] The thieves! [urgent] I want my tiara back! [commanding] Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her. [warm] Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.
quest_2846_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the tiara, <name>? [commanding] Has Velratha learned the price of crossing me?
quest_2846_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful! You found it! And what's just as important--Velratha no longer has it! [warm] Thank you, <name>. I am forever in your debt!

And if I sounded a little... mean before, pay it no mind. You'll find me a much nicer person to those who haven't stolen from me.
quest_2847_quest_detail:
<name>, you're becoming quite skilled as a leatherworker! [soft voice] I know some patterns you might be interested in... Wild Leather armor! [solemn] Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there. [warm] The armor made using it is second to none for people of your skill, guaranteed.

[commanding] I'll teach this to you, but you'll be working for me for a while. [urgent] The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather. [pause] After this, we'll talk specifics.
quest_2847_quest_progress:
[commanding] Like I said, you'll be working for me while you learn about Wild Leather armor. Because wildvines are both potent and chaotic, it yields a random but strong benefit to the already strong armor you will be making. [solemn] This knowledge, however, was not easy for me to come by.

The initial cost to begin this process is ten pieces of thick leather.

[urgent] Once that is done, we'll get to the work you need to do in order to obtain the patterns.
quest_2847_quest_complete:
[warm] Well <name>, I'm glad to have you on board. [proud] You've made a smart decision as a leatherworker; those who wear leather armor will be clamoring to you once you learn how to make any of the Wild Leather armor pieces.

[excited] Let's get to work - where do you want to start?
quest_2848_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Wild Leather shoulders support the wearer's frame extremely well, offering top notch protection of the upper arms and the shoulders themselves. [solemn] As with all Wild Leather armor, a potent but random benefit is applied to the item as the wildvine is stitched in.

[low voice] For this pattern, I will require six thick armor kits and a wildvine. [hesitant] That shouldn't be too tall of an order for you to fill.
quest_2848_quest_progress:
[commanding] Do you have the six thick armor kits and the wildvine I require?

[low voice] Don't think of making armor kits as monotonous work; the steady fashioning method you develop as you ply your trade on these kits helps develop your skills for the intricate work needed to make Wild Leather armor.

[soft voice] See - there's a real reason behind what you're making for me...
quest_2848_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These armor kits are of solid quality, <name>. [solemn] If there is one thing I demand in not only my work, but the work of those in my employ, it is quality.

[warm] You've done well to earn this pattern; I hope it brings you the rewards it has brought me.
quest_2849_quest_detail:
[solemn] Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set. The frame of the vest blends with the wildvine to produce a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for the potent magic to work its way through the garment.

[soft voice] For this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine. [hesitant] It's a tall order, but one you should have little difficulty in filling for me.
quest_2849_quest_progress:
Do you have the two Turtle Scale breastplates and gloves I ordered? [urgent] Also, don't forget the wildvine!

[soft voice] Even with the earliest patterns, we learn that the fundamentals of shape translate well into more difficult garments. [solemn] Though different items, the shape of the Turtle Scale breastplates prepares you for the detailing needed to make a Wild Leather vest.

[commanding] And the gloves... well, they're just for my own benefit. [threatening] Remember, you're working for me!
quest_2849_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These are some very nice pieces here, <name>. [warm] The craftsmanship and care put in to making these alone would fetch several silver more than the average piece made.

[warm] You've filled my order, and with that comes your reward. [proud] The knowledge of making Wild Leather vests is now yours!
quest_2850_quest_detail:
[solemn] A Wild Leather helmet offers the wearer superior protection to the vital areas of the head without a sacrifice in comfort. [soft voice] As with all Wild Leather armor, the integrated wildvine yields a powerful but random enhancement to the frame of the helm. [confident] Leather wearers will definitely want this piece!

[urgent] For this pattern, I will need two Nightscape tunics, two Nightscape headbands, and a wildvine. [warm] Complete this order and the pattern will be yours!
quest_2850_quest_progress:
[urgent] I need those tunics and headbands made, and I also need that piece of wildvine before I will share with you the knowledge of Wild Leather helmets.

[solemn] Head gear is highly coveted amongst adventurers, whether it be a disarmingly simple headband or a full-covering helmet. [soft voice] The fundamentals of creating valued head gear remain constant, no matter what the cosmetic appearance of the gear is.
quest_2850_quest_complete:
[solemn] This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, <name>. [warm] I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.

[proud] You have definitely earned this pattern. [gentle] I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.
quest_2851_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've learned quite a bit now, <name>; still, there is more for you to learn. [solemn] Next are Wild Leather boots, the cornerstone of any set.

[gentle] These boots are crafted to cradle the foot in comfort while bracing it against the hazards of adventuring. [warm] The soft soles are a blessing to those seeking quiet movement in footwear.

[commanding] For this pattern, I need an order of two Nightscape pants and two Nightscape boots filled. [urgent] I also will require two wildvines... not just one. [emphasis] When you have all this, let me know.
quest_2851_quest_progress:
The order on the pants, boots, and wildvines needs to be filled before you get the pattern, <name>. [urgent] Are you finished?

From the earliest pair of boots we learn how to make, we start to understand that a quality boot needs to ride a razor's edge between comfort and function. With both, we are able to create items that allow the wearer to ignore fatigue that would cripple those wearing lower quality goods.
quest_2851_quest_complete: [confident] Once again, you've filled a complex order with the skill of a seasoned professional. [warm] You have earned this pattern, as well as my thanks.
quest_2852_quest_detail:
With the basics down, you are ready to master more complex fare, <name>. [soft voice] Wild Leather leggings are some of the sturdiest and powerful leather gear around. The waist, thighs, calves, and the vitals - all are given tremendous protection. Coupled with the enhancement that the wildvine provides, adventurers who own it will thank you each time they see you.

[solemn] For this pattern, I need an order of two Turtle Scale helms, two Turtle Scale bracers, and two wildvines filled.
quest_2852_quest_progress:
Do you have the Turtle Scale bracers and helms ready? [urgent] Don't forget the two wildvines I need!

[commanding] By now, you're starting to realize the potential power that lies in Wild Leather armor. [solemn] An armor that has no boundaries in application is nearly invaluable to a leatherworker. [soft voice] The limits are only in the quantities of resources to make the items - not the quality of the finished products!
quest_2852_quest_complete:
[solemn] Again, you've filled an order without flaw. [warm] Perhaps some day I will come to [emphasis] YOU seeking knowledge, eh <name>?
