quest_2861_quest_detail: [solemn] Rumor is that Tabetha, a mage colleague who lives deep in Dustwallow Marsh, has a bone to pick with a certain sand troll in Zul'Farrak. [soft voice] If you speak with Tabetha she can tell you more.
quest_2862_quest_detail:
[solemn] The gnolls... they are more than a nuisance. [angry] They are a constant threat to the existence of this very camp! [low voice] It is irrelevant whether they are indigenous to Feralas or not; if we do not strengthen our resolve against them, we will find ourselves driven out of the entire region.

[urgent] The gnoll attacks against the camp have become more fevered as of late. [commanding] We need your aid in thinning their numbers; bring to me ten of their manes, and I will reward you handsomely for your effort.

[warm] Go!
quest_2862_quest_progress: [commanding] We drive them back, and yet they still attack! [urgent] Someone or something must be driving them into a frenzy... [soft voice] oh, you have returned, eh <name>? [low voice] Do you have the manes I require for the bounty to be met?
quest_2862_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is proof of a good start, <name>. [proud] Your skills as a soldier are to be commended.

[soft voice] You are not the only one I ask that task of. [pause] Many before you have fought them, and in times past our efforts have kept them at bay. [urgent] Recently though, their attempts to push northward into our area of influence have increased dramatically. [emphasis] Their attacks have also become more savage... almost as if they were desperate.

[commanding] I have a plan though, <name>, that might settle things once and for all against them...
quest_2863_quest_detail:
[solemn] The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession. [urgent] If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks. [commanding] Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!

[commanding voice] I want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work <name>, or we'll remain at this impasse!
quest_2863_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is running out, <name>! [angry] If you're not here to report that you've taken out the Alphas, then you're wasting time!
quest_2863_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. [warm] Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, <name>.

[proud] With their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. [soft voice] This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...

[hesitant] There must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. [urgent] Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.
quest_2864_quest_detail:
[urgent] My cousin Tran'rek is in a tight spot. He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered. He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.

[hesitant] Can you speak to Tran'rek for me? Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?

[soft voice] Gadgetzan is in northern Tanaris, in Kalimdor.
quest_2864_quest_complete:
[excited] Hello!

Oh, you spoke to my cousin Krazek? How is he? I hope Booty Bay is treating him well...

[soft voice] Scarab shells, you say? Well... let me tell you a story...
quest_2865_quest_detail:
[excited] The scarabs of Tanaris have very hard shells! [emphasis] Hard enough to use as a building material for lots of things. [emphasis] So many things!

[hesitant] In fact, those shells are so useful... [shocked] the scarabs were hunted all to near extinction!

[urgent] I know where there are more scarabs, and if you promise to bring me their shells then I'll tell you where they are. [emphasis] Promise? [urgent] Ok, the scarabs have a colony in Zul'Farrak. [soft voice] I guess the trolls don't hunt them for their shells.

[commanding] But you can! [urgent] Go to Zul'Farrak and get me uncracked shells!
quest_2865_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the shells? [angry] My cousin in Booty Bay is waiting for a load of them, and he's getting impatient!
quest_2865_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, great! You got them!

[warm] Thanks, <name>. [delight] You're a real lifesaver!
quest_2866_quest_detail:
[solemn] To our south are the Ruins of Solarsal; this is an area that far pre-dates modern times. [soft voice] We explored the ruins initially and found nothing of note; as such, we left it in peace.

[urgent] Very recently, the Hatecrest naga have occupied these ruins in alarming numbers. [hesitant] At first, we considered it as the precursor for an attack. [solemn] Though that threat is still possible, we believe there might be something else going on.

[commanding] Go there, explore the ruins, and look for anything that stands out to you. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_2866_quest_complete:
[solemn] Examining the gazebo reveals some interesting and unusual things in contrast to the surrounding ruins.

First, the gazebo is clearly a more recent construction than the other objects in the ruins. Second, the gazebo has a small series of glyphs engraved into the sides of it; the glyphs repeat in their pattern, but it otherwise is unknown in origin and meaning. Third, the stone of the gazebo itself is warm to the touch.

[soft voice] This certainly quantifies as "standing out" in the search of the ruins!
quest_2867_quest_detail: [solemn] With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to Feathermoon Stronghold and report to General Shandris Feathermoon what has been discovered here.
quest_2867_quest_complete: [solemn] Welcome back, <name>. [soft voice] Your report on this gazebo is most... disturbing. [low voice] It would seem that even if the naga there were not planning on an attack, their continued presence bodes ill for our push into Feralas. [warm] At any rate, here is compensation for your investigation.
quest_2869_quest_detail:
[solemn] The best course of action at this point is to assume that, regardless of what the naga are up to, they will eventually move to secure the island for their own. [urgent] We need to take aggressive steps to counter that threat before it is too late.

[commanding] Bring me ten Hatecrest Scales that are in good condition; it should be obvious to you how to acquire them. [soft voice] You'll cut your teeth on the naga for the first time, and we'll have a weakened naga presence on Sardor Isle - both are prospects that play to our advantage.
quest_2869_quest_progress:
<name>, if you're here to verify the task given to you, then excellent - it is ten Hatecrest scales I seek. If you are here for chit-chat, then I am currently unavailable for such trivialities.

Know this - [solemn] we night elves are not warmongers. Our race is dedicated to the preservation of peace and harmony. This does not mean, however, that we will not proactively protect our own interests. This is my duty to General Feathermoon, and to the stronghold.
quest_2869_quest_complete:
Yes, yes, these scales are more than satisfactory. [solemn] Actually, I think I will send these down to Pratt for him to take a look at. Maybe he can craft something useful out of them.

[warm] As for you, I have another mission I want to send you on. But first, here is your bounty for the scales. [proud] Your continued service to the General and Feathermoon Stronghold at large is a blessing in the face of adversity.
quest_2870_quest_detail:
<name>, new scouting reports have given us a good idea on the naga chain of command. [solemn] Royalty is present amongst their rank and file, and they're the ones calling all the shots.

[commanding] Specifically, we've identified one of the crueler royals as Lord Shalzaru. [urgent] Scouts report that he himself has uncovered an odd relic during a recent naga excavation in a cave south of the main ruins, across the water on the Isle of Dread.

[emphasis] Put a stop to it by putting a stop to him, and bring me his relic so we can study it.
quest_2870_quest_progress:
[solemn] Bringing down Lord Shalzaru would certainly set their plans back weeks, if not months. [soft voice] On top of that, the relic he uncovered is of definite interest to us.

[commanding] Have you performed the mission given to you, <name>?
quest_2870_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well played, <name>! Lord Shalzaru's demise will throw the naga into disarray for some time, if not permanently. The threat they pose is now under more of our control than it has ever been, and we have you to thank for it.

[warm] Here is more bounty money from the stronghold treasury - you've earned every copper. [warm] You and yours are welcome in Feathermoon Stronghold anytime, my friend.

[soft voice] One more thing before you depart, <name>... if you could...
quest_2871_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you would be so kind as to deliver the relic to my wife Vestia, I would appreciate it. She's not only a fine priestess for our community, but she is one of the most well-versed scholars you'll find anywhere. [hesitant] I couldn't make heads or tails of this device even if there was a wager involved. [soft voice] My wife though, if anyone can figure out what this thing is, she could... and we need to know!

[urgent] She's just around the bend, no doubt studying. [warm] Thanks, <name>.
quest_2871_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Yes, may I assist you?

[pause] Hold on, you're the <class> that has been helping General Feathermoon and Latro out with the naga threat, yes? [soft voice] I'm Vestia, Latro's - erm, rather, Latronicus' wife. [warm] It is a pleasure to meet you!

[hesitant] I'm sorry, you're here on business, of course. [soft voice] Do you have something for me - from him, perchance?
quest_2871_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Interesting... this came from the Ruins of Solarsal, you say? Well, Latro's right that I need to look at this. At first glance, it seems non-indigenous to the ruins. Then again, this isn't of naga design... not something as alien as this.

[solemn] It is going to take some time to research this item. Once my research on it is done, maybe I will make use of your talents, should you be around.

[warm] Here, take one of these extra items we have; I hope you'll find some use for it!
quest_2872_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My old buddy Stoley owes me a very special bottle of rum. [low voice] He tends the bar at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris, Kalimdor, and he promised me that the rum there is stronger than anything we can find in Booty Bay. [excited] He's so confident that he says if I try that rum and don't agree with him, then he'll double the money he owes me!

[pause] Well, I think he's not as confident as he was when last we spoke, and now he's afraid to give me that rum. [commanding] But I don't back down from wagers, so why don't you talk to him for me...
quest_2872_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, so you've been speaking with MacKinley, have you?

[hesitant] It's not what he thinks! I'm not afraid to give him some Steamwheedle Bilge Rum...

[sigh] I just don't have any rum to give him!
quest_2873_quest_detail:
[urgent] I owe "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay some rum, to settle a bet, but I'm all out of rum! [angry] Captain Cuergo stole my last shipment, and he has it stowed in that walled pirate town to the south.

[confident] If you can find my shipment of rum and return it to me, then I can prove to MacKinley that Kalimdor's booze beats the dirt out of Booty Bay!
quest_2873_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find my shipment of rum, <name>?
quest_2873_quest_complete: [excited] Great, thanks for the shipment! [warm] Now MacKinley and I can finally settle our wager.
quest_2874_quest_detail: [gentle] Thanks again for your help, <name>. [warm] Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. [soft voice] Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.
quest_2874_quest_progress: [angry] Did Stoley cough up my booze?
quest_2874_quest_complete:
Hm, let's try this...

[pause] I can't believe it! [delight] This stuff is... [sad] terrible! [excited] That's great! [sigh] Well I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me. [solemn] He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum. [angry] That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!
quest_2875_quest_detail: [solemn] The vile pirate Andre Firebeard is wanted for crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan.
quest_2876_quest_detail:
[solemn] This scroll contains the schedules of shipments between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. [soft voice] Both past and future shipments are included, along with ship names, with large 'X's next to some ships' journeys, and annotations like "GREAT LOOT" and "HARD FIGHT" next to others.

[urgent] Someone at Steamwheedle Port would want to see this document.
quest_2876_quest_progress: [urgent] You look out of breath. [hesitant] You have something to tell me?
quest_2876_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh my, this looks to be a list of ship departures and arrivals, with accurate dates and times and everything! [urgent] If the captain of a pirate ship got his hands on this, he could have himself a field day!

[sad] You say you got this from a pirate? Well that's disturbing news...

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] I'm glad you took it from him, and I'm glad that pirate's eating dirt right now!
quest_2877_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Wildhammers remember the past, more than our brothers in Ironforge. [commanding] If you want to make friends here, then you get your hands dirty for us!

The Horde abandoned their positions in the Hinterlands around Skulk Rock; it's now overrun with nasty sludges and oozes. [soft voice] We've got plans on that area, but first we need a clean-up crew to make a hole for us.

[warm] That's where you come in, Sunshine! [urgent] Head down there and take out ten green sludges and ten jade oozes, then report back to me here. [shouting] Move out!
quest_2877_quest_progress: [commanding] Make no effort to negotiate the mission at hand, <race>! [angry] If the gods had wanted those oozes killed, they would have miracled it done by now, wouldn't they?!
quest_2877_quest_complete:
[excited] Well look at you, helping out the Wildhammers! You're a <class> of action, and action is what we respect around here.

[warm] Your little clean-up mission is a lot more important than you might think it is. With folks thinning out the oozes and sludges, we'll be able to extend our sphere of influence in no time. Here - have a little something in addition to just making new friends here in Aerie Peak!
quest_2879_quest_detail:
[excited] This stave might be the Stave of Equinex! [solemn] The Stave of Equinex is actually a key, used to unlock the Equinex Monolith in the Ruins of Ravenwind, on the mainland west of the Dream Bough.

[urgent] Find the four flames that still burn in those ruins: Samha, Imbel, Byltan, and Lahassa. [soft voice] Retrieve their essence and then while standing by the Equinex Monolith, use the essences to energize the stave. [solemn] If this is truly is the Stave of Equinex, you will be able to unlock the Monolith and gather a sacred artifact from it.
quest_2879_quest_progress: [solemn] The Equinex Monolith stands silently among the ruins. [soft voice] What could it be holding?
quest_2879_quest_complete:
[solemn] Holding the energized stave is almost impossible. [soft voice] Its power rumbles through your body.

[pause] You reach out to the cold surface of the Equinex Monolith...

[emphasis] A small door opens, allowing you to reach in and take the artifact inside.

[warm] Beams of light fill the area around the Equinex Monolith.
quest_2880_quest_detail:
[commanding] Get this straight, <race> - we are NOT part of the Alliance! [solemn] The Wildhammers are independent, relying on deeds and actions to prove one's worth, rather than the blather of those who use jibber-jabber to bolster their do-nothing attitudes!

[urgent] If you're looking for friends here, then prove your worth to us first! [commanding] The foul trolls that choke the hillsides of the Hinterlands sometimes carry tribal necklaces. Bring five of them to me, and we'll mark it down as a step in the right direction for you.
quest_2880_quest_progress:
[commanding] I want five of those tribal necklaces the trolls carry on them. [urgent] If you need it spelled out further, then killing one of them stands you a good chance of getting one!

[proud] Prove your worth to the Wildhammers!
quest_2880_quest_complete:
[excited] Now that's what I am talking about! [warm] See - these necklaces prove that you're willing to get your hands dirty. [proud] We Wildhammers value that in those we associate with.

[warm] You keep this up, and you'll be in our good graces yet.
quest_2881_quest_progress:
[commanding] I want five of those tribal necklaces the trolls carry on them. [urgent] If you need it spelled out further, then killing one of them stands you a good chance of getting one!

[proud] Prove your worth to the Wildhammers! Troll Tribal Necklace(5)
quest_2881_quest_complete:
[excited] Now that's what I am talking about! [warm] See - these necklaces prove that you're willing to get your hands dirty. [proud] We Wildhammers value that in those we associate with.

[warm] You keep this up, and you'll be in our good graces yet.
quest_2902_quest_detail:
Gnolls aren't the sharpest tools in the shed, but they will no doubt have some sort of documented strategy on their recent activity. [solemn] If we were to find those plans, then we'd have a clearer idea of what is making them so worked up.

[urgent] I want you to head back to the Woodpaw and find anything that might resemble their battle plans. [commanding] They have to have something; their attacks have been too coordinated to be done without them. [emphasis] Find them, and return to me when you have them.
quest_2902_quest_complete:
[solemn] Examining the map reveals it to be the battle plans that Hadoken Swiftstrider wants. Numerous arrows that perhaps represent troop movements are drawn on the map, though most seem to be headed toward the south rather than to the north where Camp Mojache lies.

[soft voice] Another section of the map has a picture of what you think is a large insect of some kind, with various tick marks under it. From the looks of the gnolls, it perhaps represents their losses against the unknown bugs...
quest_2903_quest_detail: [solemn] With the battle plans of the gnolls discovered, all that now remains is to bring the plans back to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache. [soft voice] Perhaps he or someone there can make further sense of what the gnolls are up to.
quest_2903_quest_progress: [gentle] Welcome back <name> - [soft voice] were you able to find some tangible evidence as to the plans of the gnolls?
quest_2903_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, this is exactly what we needed. [soft voice] While I am not so skilled at ciphering what most of the scrawling on this map is, I've seen enough battle plans in my day to understand what is happening with the gnolls. [emphasis] It looks like they are currently fighting a two front war. One is with us... but it seems that their main energy has been against a foe to their south.
quest_2904_quest_detail:
<Kernobee groans.> [urgent] Wha.. What happened?

The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.

[shouting] Get me out of here, <name>!

[urgent] Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.

[excited] Let's get going!
quest_2904_quest_complete: [soft voice] I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, <name>. [urgent] If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
quest_2922_quest_detail:
[solemn] When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot. [soft voice] It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized. [urgent] Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed. [shouting] It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

[hesitant] But perhaps it can be salvaged. [pause] Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
quest_2922_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find Techbot? [urgent] Did you retrieve its memory core??
quest_2922_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, this is wonderful! [warm] Thank you, <name>! I'll get to work immediately!!

[sad] Poor, poor Techbot... [gentle] Don't feel bad. We'll get you fixed.

[hesitant] Now, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...
quest_2923_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot. I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

[sad] Very sad. But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

[excited] Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility in Dun Morogh. [warm] He would welcome your help.
quest_2923_quest_complete: [urgent] Yes it's true. Techbot has gone <class>! [soft voice] Please, can you help me?
quest_2924_quest_detail:
[solemn] A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan. [soft voice] But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them! [urgent] And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.

[hesitant] Please, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials. [solemn] You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.

[warm] Thank you, <name>, and please hurry!
quest_2924_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the essential artificials?
quest_2924_quest_complete:
[excited] You got them! Now I can begin my new experiments!

[delight] I can't thank you enough, <name>! [proud] Your bravery has advanced gnomish research by a leap and a bound!
quest_2925_quest_detail:
[solemn] A gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan, sent word to me from Ironforge. He tells me he needs help on a dangerous, but essential, mission into Gnomeregan, the once great gnome city now contaminated and filled with mad gnomes and their devices.

[sad] I must stay here, but my heart aches to help my friend. [gentle] If you can go in my stead, then I would be much indebted to you.

[warm] You may find Klockmort at the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility, in Dun Morogh.
quest_2925_quest_complete: [excited] I do! I do need help with a mission into Gnomeregan. And you're just the <class> to do it!
quest_2926_quest_detail:
[solemn] Since the accident, all Gnoarn thinks about or talks about is cleansing Gnomeregan of the trogg infestation and finding a cure for the sickness that plagues it, <name>.

[soft voice] Luckily, Razzle and I are close to some kind of cure - either that or the recipe for a really powerful rum. [excited] We won't know until we test! [commanding] Naturally, in order to test our theory, we're going to need a few things; namely, fallout from the irradiated troggs in Gnomeregan. Fill up this phial with the green glow and bring it back!
quest_2926_quest_progress: [urgent] Can't you see we're trying to cure an entire species of gnomes here??! [emphasis] We need more of the green glow!
quest_2926_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work! The time has come to test the new formula. If this works, not only should that captured leper gnome be cured, but I should have a full head of hair! [proud] Stand back!
quest_2927_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You don't think I was always bald, do you? No sir! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.

<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>

[angry] Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!

[hesitant] Perhaps it's not too late, <name>. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! [urgent] Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
quest_2927_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I thought the loss of that outstanding head of hair would have been the end of him for sure, but he survived!

[excited] I was standing right next to him when he was hit by the radiation bolt. Those delightful brown locks of hair hit the floor in clumps! [shocked] Clusters! The horror of it all was only compounded when Gnoarn completely freaked out! [shouting] Oh yes, freaked out I say! [angry] Gnoarn touched his bald head in disbelief, the look in his eyes screamed revenge, <name>! Then he turned his anger towards the troggs! <Ozzie cringes.>
quest_2928_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's terrible, <name>. [sad] We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

[soft voice] What we need are spare parts, <name>. [solemn] What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? [soft voice] I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

[urgent] What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. [commanding] Bring me back their robot guts. [emphasis] Two dozen should be sufficient.
quest_2928_quest_progress: [low voice] If this were a race, you would have lost by now.
quest_2928_quest_complete: [commanding] This will do nicely, <name>. [urgent] One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.
quest_2929_quest_detail:
[solemn] I trusted Thermaplugg, <race>. Never did I expect that he would betray me and the entire gnomish people. And for what? Power? Wealth? All things that he would have had in time. [sad] Now we have been displaced from our home and that madman is in charge. The king of nothing....

[commanding] We will retake Gnomeregan, <name>. [confident] We will not stop until the city is back in our control. [urgent] If you wish to join in our fight, a simple task I ask of you: Kill the betrayer. [shouting] Destroy Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
quest_2929_quest_progress: [urgent] Is the task complete? [commanding] Did he beg for lenience? [threatening] For mercy??
quest_2929_quest_complete: [commanding] I like to think that the last thing that went through his head as he collapsed to the ground was your foot, <race>. [proud] With Thermaplugg dead, our plans to retake Gnomeregan are one step closer to becoming a reality.
quest_2930_quest_detail:
[urgent] When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind! [emphasis] Vitally important data!

[commanding] I need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan. [urgent] You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... and to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C. [emphasis] And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... and we left all the punch cards in the city.

[shocked] It's a catastrophe! [soft voice] Can you help?
quest_2930_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the prismatic punch card??
quest_2930_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! You found the prismatic punch card and recovered the lost data! [warm] Vitally, critically, immeasurably important data that we could not live another moment without!

[proud] Your service to the gnomes will be long remembered, <name>.
quest_2931_quest_detail:
[urgent] Master Mechanic Castpipe in the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility has need of adventurers! [excited] He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.

[soft voice] Castpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!

[emphasis] Those are good odds!
quest_2931_quest_complete: [urgent] I'm organizing data extraction missions into Gnomeregan. [soft voice] If you're here for that, then listen up!
quest_2932_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished!

[commanding] Here, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north. You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the Forsaken.

[urgent] When you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls. Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha.

Show them their vile actions are of consequence!
quest_2932_quest_progress: [angry] You have not completed my task, <name>.
quest_2932_quest_complete: [solemn] Word reached me of your deed. [soft voice] A grim deed, but one of honor. [pause] Let us hope the Witherbarks heed your message.
quest_2933_quest_detail: [low voice] These bottles hold a vile, green venom.
quest_2934_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me. The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me. You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

[urgent] Do not tarry, <name>, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.
quest_2934_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the undamaged venom sac, <name>? [soft voice] I yearn to run experiments with its fresh venom, and have ordered a collection of small, terribly cute animals on which to test it!
quest_2934_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, splendid! The venom is quite fresh and I'm sure very deadly. [warm] Thank you!
quest_2935_quest_detail:
[solemn] The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally. [soft voice] It must have come from a different spider.

[commanding] I want a fresh sample of that venom. [urgent] To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. [urgent] Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin. [soft voice] With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.
quest_2935_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, so you want fresh venom from the spider of the witherbarks, yes? [pause] Well, sit down... [hesitant] you're not going to like what I have to tell you.
quest_2936_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Witherbarks worship a spider god, and from her they collect their most potent venom. [urgent] So if you want the venom, then you must summon their god!

[commanding] To do that, you must know her true name, and that name is on a tablet buried in Tanaris, in the troll city of Zul'Farrak, in a tomb guarded by Theka the Martyr.

[solemn] Defeat Theka and find and read his tablet to discover the spider god's name. [pause] When you know it, return to me.
quest_2936_quest_progress: [solemn] Do you know the spider god's name?
quest_2936_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Elortha no Shadra... speak this name only in whispers, for its utterance carries much weight in the realms of the spirit.

[soft voice] I will put it to parchment and create for you a spell of summoning...
quest_2937_quest_detail: [solemn] Take his parchment, and read it at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the witherbark realm in the Hinterlands. [whispering] This will summon Shadra the spider god.
quest_2938_quest_detail:
[excited] The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find! [chuckling] I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff. Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful!

[urgent] I'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. [confident] I am positive he would want to test this himself.
quest_2938_quest_progress: Word was sent of your coming, <name>. [soft voice] You have a parcel for me?
quest_2938_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, very good. Lydon mentioned the poison in this parcel is the most potent he has come in contact with, and is busy working on new applications with it.

With luck, we will find many.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Your service to the Royal Apothecary Society is undeniable.
quest_2939_quest_detail:
[solemn] While the ruins of Feralas can be quite dangerous, they have much to tell of what has happened here.

[soft voice] Searching through the rubble to the south a few days ago, I discovered what appears to be a normal stave. [hesitant] However, I just can't shake the feeling that there is something more to it. [low voice] Angelas and I have been poring over our books here, but we can't find a thing about it.

[urgent] I have a colleague in Darnassus that may be able to tell us what this is, <name>. [commanding] Why don't you go talk to her and see if she can help us?
quest_2939_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, so Troyas Moonbreeze sent you?

<mutters>...always bothering me with his wild notions that he found something important...

Look, <name>, I'll be blunt. [sad] Troyas always thinks he has found something important in those ruins. The truth is, anything that was truly valuable was probably hoarded away long ago by the ogres or the harpies that now reside there.

You're welcome to take a look around, but I don't know if you'll find any books here that will help you.
quest_2940_quest_detail: [soft voice] This book looks as if no one has opened it for quite a long time. Its covers are quite worn, and its pages yellowed, but after examining it, you notice that it might be just what Troyas is looking for.
quest_2941_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have studied many subjects in my time, and my latest fascination is with the snapjaw that occupy the beach in the Hinterlands. [soft voice] There's one in particular I'd like to see, a giant snapjaw named Gammerita. [hesitant] I'd like to go myself, but my research keeps me here. [gentle] I think a picture of her would be the next best thing.

[urgent] Take this letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. [warm] She has created an invention for me that can capture a picture. [soft voice] She called it a "snapshot," I think...
quest_2941_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Are you another one of Daryn's interns? She's quite a knowledgeable historian, <name>. [warm] You should be grateful to be studying under her leadership.

[excited] Now, let me get the Super Snapper FX. [delight] You're gonna love it!
quest_2942_quest_detail: [solemn] The moment the artifact is removed from the Monolith, you feel the energy in the Stave of Equinex begin to fade.
quest_2942_quest_progress: [soft voice] I am glad you have returned, <name>. [gentle] I am eager to hear of your findings.
quest_2942_quest_complete: [solemn] I have been reading since you left, <name>. [soft voice] This stone you have found is called the Morrow Stone. [pause] While I am not entirely sure what its purpose is yet, you can be sure that it is something of great significance to be hidden away inside the Equinex Monolith the way it was.
quest_2943_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here it is, <name>. [gentle] Please, take care of my book.

[urgent] Now, hurry along. [soft voice] I'm sure Troyas is eager for your return.
quest_2943_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Have you been to Darnassus?
quest_2943_quest_complete: [soft voice] You have brought a book along. [delight] Excellent!
quest_2944_quest_detail:
[excited] Have the first look at my new invention, <name>. All you need to do is target whatever it is you'd like to take a picture of, and push the button.

What was that creature from the Hinterlands that you mentioned? Gammerita? Well, good luck finding her. I'm sure Daryn will be quite pleased with the snapshot you return to her.

In any case, here's the Super Snapper. [excited] Have fun!
quest_2944_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, you have finally returned, <name>. [warm] And you've brought the contraption that Curgle built for me -- perfect.
quest_2944_quest_complete:
[delight] Well! Curgle's invention lived up to its expectations.

[soft voice] Don't get too excited, but do know that I am pleased with your work, <name>.

[pause] Now, where did I leave that book...
quest_2946_quest_detail:
[solemn] We want you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. [hesitant] We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.

[soft voice] This sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. [pause] It might, however, do nothing. [pause] You might need to use the discs on something. Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. [urgent] Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.

[emphasis] When you've found out what happens, return to Ironforge. [excited] We'll have a lot to analyze when you're done!
quest_2946_quest_progress: [solemn] This familiar looking pedestal sticks out of the hot sand. [soft voice] Perhaps there is something to its presence here...
quest_2946_quest_complete:
[solemn] As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. [soft voice] A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.

[low voice] "Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."
quest_2947_quest_detail: [soft voice] Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals what you had suspected - a shiny ring! [excited] Wearing the ring, you feel magic power surge through you body.
quest_2948_quest_detail:
Listen <name>, that ring is yours, sure... but [excited] I can make you a better one! That design, like I said, is really simple. [confident] I am a lot more skilled now, and for the mere fee of thirty silver coins I'll spruce it up for you! Well, a little more than thirty, actually...

[hesitant] I'm in a tight spot right now; all my material stock is all dried up. [urgent] If you bring me a bar of silver and a moss agate, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will give it a little more pizzazz!

[commanding] Trust me!
quest_2948_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the materials I need? [hesitant] I wouldn't ask you for them if I wasn't down on my luck...
quest_2948_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, exactly what I needed! [warm] Someday, when I find myself out of this hole that I am unjustly in, I will make for you, for EVERYONE the finest trinkets in all of Azeroth! [proud] Until then, thanks for being a sport about the reagents. [confident] I'd normally charge ten times what I have charged you for a ring of this quality...

[delight] Speaking of rings, here's your new one!
quest_2949_quest_detail: [excited] Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals a shiny ring! [urgent] Donning the ring, you feel magic power surge through your body.
quest_2950_quest_detail:
[low voice] No, no, no - I'm not all of the sudden saying that the ring is mine. [hesitant] I normally don't do this, but your information about the Dark Irons was very useful. [commanding] I'll improve your ring for you, better than whomever made this simple little thing could have ever done. [sigh] Probably some gnome...

[urgent] If you bring me a bar of silver, a moss agate, and thirty silver coins for my trouble, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will strengthen the magic inside of it. [excited] Interested?
quest_2950_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the materials I need? [low voice] I can't improve on this design without everything I asked for.
quest_2950_quest_complete: [excited] Here's your ring, better than before. [warm] Thanks again for the information about those Dark Iron dwarves. [soft voice] This seems like a reasonable lead as to how those gnomes suddenly were struck with goblin-like inspiration.
quest_2962_quest_detail:
[solemn] Not only was your sample insufficient in quantity, it was also impure.

[commanding] What we require is more green glow. [urgent] The troggs are obviously not irradiated sufficiently to fulfill our needs. [commanding] You will have to go into Gnomeregan and bring back some radioactive fallout, straight from the tap. [soft voice] I am speaking of the irradiated slimes, lurkers and horrors. Be warned, the containment of this type of fallout is difficult. [hesitant] You may need to make several attempts with the phial until a suitable sampling is recovered.
quest_2962_quest_progress: Hrm, you're not glowing. [soft voice] That's a good sign.
quest_2962_quest_complete: <Ozzie examines you.> [commanding] Impressive, you still have all of your limbs. [excited] Now it's time to see what this stuff can do!
quest_2963_quest_detail:
[excited] Greetings once again, <name>! Your discovery inside Uldaman has set the Explorers' League abuzz with excitement. [warm] The League has been working to unlock the secrets of the miniature platinum discs you found. [urgent] Your fortuitous arrival here in the Hall allows me to share with you that we are quite possibly on to something!

[solemn] Historian Karnik has uncovered some important clues as to the true origins of the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. [urgent] He would like to speak with you as soon as possible!
quest_2963_quest_complete:
[excited] I am glad you're maintaining your interest in exploration, <name>! [warm] With your natural talent and moxie, we could crack open secrets that we never thought were possible!

[solemn] The Discs of Norgannon in Uldaman were a repository of vast information; you were only permitted to access the top layers, as it were, of the information stored there. [soft voice] The Creators were rumored to have more repositories located throughout Azeroth. [solemn] This now brings us to Uldum...
quest_2964_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well <name>... we seem to be at a temporary dead end here. [solemn] We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be. [low voice] We'll need to do quite a bit of research on this to come up with a solid plan of attack. [pause] I have a couple ideas where to start looking; [confident] I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to head out and recover them.

[warm] The High Explorer needs to be informed on this, <name>; [solemn] no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again aiding the League.
quest_2964_quest_complete:
[solemn] We're all in agreement then - the best plan of attack is putting this on hold until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. [proud] You've brought us this far <name>, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to unlock Uldum for us all!

[warm] Allow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. [soft voice] Be sure to check back with us soon... [excited] Uldum beckons!
quest_2965_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, <name>, it is fortuitous that you have come to me again. Your revelations at the Uldaman dig site have certainly given us sages much discuss. [soft voice] I was doing just that with one of the druids, Nara Wildmane, when it dawned on me that her past adventuring experiences may have some great importance as to the next step we need to take.

[gentle] I would like for you to speak with her concerning her travels to the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. [warm] She waits for you on the Elder Rise.
quest_2965_quest_complete:
[solemn] There is a place deep in the Tanaris desert called the Valley of the Watchers. The discs that you recovered... their translated glyphs make mention of a place called Uldum. Most think this place to be a myth.

[soft voice] I know this to be false; Uldum exists. I've been there. Well... outside, at any rate.

The crux is this, <name>: [urgent] we think there is a connection between the discs and Uldum, and we want you to go there.
quest_2966_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Sage Truthseeker and I would like you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. [hesitant] We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.

[low voice] This sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. [pause] It might, however, do nothing. [soft voice] You might need to use the discs on something. [soft voice] Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. [warm] Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.

[solemn] Learn what you can, then return to me. [solemn] We will have much to discuss.
quest_2966_quest_progress: [solemn] This familiar looking pedestal sticks out of the hot sand. [soft voice] Perhaps there is something to its presence here...
quest_2966_quest_complete:
[solemn] As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. [soft voice] A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.

[solemn] "Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."
quest_2968_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well <name>... we seem to be at an unfortunate impasse. [solemn] We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be. [pause] We will research this, and then devise a solid plan of attack. [warm] I have a couple ideas where to start looking; [confident] I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to rejoin our efforts to discover the truth.

[solemn] Sage Truthseeker needs to be informed on this, <name>; [soft voice] no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again heeding the call.
quest_2968_quest_complete:
[solemn] We're all in agreement then - the best course of action is to wait until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. [warm] You've brought us this far <name>, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to confront the secrets of Uldum.

[gentle] Allow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. [soft voice] Be sure to check back with us soon... [solemn] Uldum beckons us all, young one.
quest_2969_quest_detail:
[solemn] The filthy Grimtotem clan are capturing faerie dragons, <name>. [urgent] Jer'kai and I have no idea what they plan on doing with them, but they're obviously up to no good.

[hesitant] We're not powerful enough to fight our way into the camp and free the captured dragons, but perhaps with your help...

[soft voice] If you're willing, and you have some strong friends, release the creatures from their cage with this key and make sure they escape with their lives. [gentle] I'll be by your side the entire time. [sad] Jer'kai will remain here.
quest_2969_quest_progress: [solemn] We cannot allow the Grimtotem clan to destroy these beautiful creatures. [urgent] They must be released from captivity!
quest_2969_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank Elune, <name>! [warm] You are a great blessing to us and to the darters you saved. [solemn] Jer'kai and I would never have been able to help the dragons ourselves--your intervention in the Grimtotem's affairs will be remembered.

[urgent] Speak to Jer'kai now... [pause] I have to prepare for our retribution. [commanding] Just because the faerie dragons are free, it doesn't mean they will remain so. [commanding voice] Jer'kai and I will now go on the offensive.
quest_2970_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As she's already told you, Kindal and I will now take the fight to the Grimtotem. Together, we should still be able to pick off some of the tauren without much threat to ourselves, but we'd love some help if you're willing and able.

You've seen the camp below us, but there are more to the east. Using your own tactics, deal as much damage to the tauren as you can. We can all meet back here after they've felt the sting of Kindal's arrows and your own weapons.
quest_2970_quest_progress:
[urgent] Kindal needs time to prepare, but our kills already number in the dozens. [solemn] The Grimtotem clan is more than aware of our presence in the area, and they seek us out like vipers.

[threatening] They'll do everything in their power to take our heads from our bodies. [commanding] You should be alert... [urgent] they'll be coming for you too now that you've interfered.
quest_2970_quest_complete:
Kindal was right about you, <name>--you do have a knack for this. [proud] You are a more seasoned adventurer than the both of us, and for that we thank you.

[solemn] The Grimtotem clan is much more hostile than most tauren... I wonder if their own kind frowns upon their actions. [soft voice] I wouldn't be surprised. As you are probably aware, many races on Azeroth have ties to less kindly counterparts.

[gentle] But that is a discussion for another day.
quest_2972_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Out here in the wilderness, Kindal and I have meager means to reward your help, but we don't want you to feel unappreciated. [gentle] Take my signet ring. If you ever find yourself in the boughs of Teldrassil, go to the Temple of the Moon in the heart of Darnassus. [solemn] There you will find my High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. The ring will let her know that we are well and give credit to your story.

[warm] We both thank you, <name>.
quest_2973_quest_detail:
[commanding] Well met, <class>. [soft voice] I've traveled with my companions down to the Feralas on a mission for our Orgrimmar masters.

[soft voice] My life-mate Korrin finds great pleasure in new clothing, so I aim to make her a new cloak adorned with the gossamer wings of faerie dragons. [hesitant] Would you be able to help me? Sprite darters with gorgeous wings I want are west of Camp Mojache.
quest_2973_quest_progress:
[solemn] The sprite darters can be dangerous critters when provoked. Be careful when dealing with them, <class>. And be even more careful of any night elves in the area. The pestering fools tend to hold up in the forests also.

[urgent] When you've gotten enough of the wings, let me know, I'll be sure to reward you well!
quest_2973_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful, <class>! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! [warm] Thank you. I hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.

[warm] Thank you again, <class>.
quest_2974_quest_detail:
[angry] What!? You came across tauren in the area? [shouting] You're joking! What did they look like!?

The Grimtotem clan! You found some of them? Belgrom, one of our masters, has an interest in their kind... he's even put a bounty on them.

[commanding] You have to go back, <class>. Go back and bring me their horns... piles of them if you can. The Grimtotem are not to be trifled with or underestimated. [threatening] Go back and slay them; let the rivers in Feralas run red with their dark blood.
quest_2974_quest_progress: [commanding] Take my words seriously, <class>, the Grimtotem clan is evil. [urgent] If you've found their whereabouts, then it's up to you to return and strike the first blow against their clan... before they can come into our own lands and raze our own villages, or pilfer our lands.
quest_2974_quest_complete: [excited] These are good horns, <class>. Well done. I'll take these from you and be sure to tell Belgrom as soon as we return to Orgrimmar. [warm] You've helped me twice now, and for that, you have my mark. Perhaps in the future I can help you! [proud] Good luck to you.
quest_2975_quest_detail:
[solemn] The effects of the Gordunni Ogre tribe can hardly go unnoticed in this area. [soft voice] Look around, <name>; their very presence scars this land. [urgent] We must push them back before they expand even further into Feralas.

[commanding] Follow the river north, and you will find their outpost. [commanding] Decrease their numbers, <name>. [commanding] We must show them that their kind is not wanted here.
quest_2975_quest_progress: [urgent] Move swiftly, <name>. Or is the task I requested too difficult?
quest_2975_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent, <name>. [solemn] In time, the land will heal. [urgent] We must not give up.
quest_2976_quest_detail:
[angry] What?!

Ah, so I did mention a bounty, didn't I? Well, that'll teach me to open my mouth, won't it?

[sigh] You did the work, so I suppose it is only right you reap the greatest reward from it. Take the horns, I'll have them put in a crate for you. Find Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor, he'll want to know what you saw and he'll reward you for your hard work.

[warm] Be well, <class>, and thank you again for everything you've done.
quest_2976_quest_progress: [urgent] Be quick, <class>, I have much to complete today.
quest_2976_quest_complete:
[shocked] The Grimtotem!? [solemn] This is interesting. [soft voice] You say you came across them while hunting in Feralas? [surprised] Truly? [commanding] My peers will want to hear your news, <class>. [warm] Tell me more and I'll count out your coin while you do so.

[gentle] And before you go, know that I give you thanks for the information you've passed on to me this day.
quest_2978_quest_detail: [soft voice] Picking up the soiled scroll, you notice that it seems to be depicting some sort of meeting or ceremony. [solemn] Rok Orhan would be interested in this scroll, and what it might mean to the Gordunni.
quest_2978_quest_complete: [solemn] This scroll... [soft voice] You found this in the Gordunni Outpost?
quest_2979_quest_detail:
[solemn] These seem to be plans for some sort of dark ceremony, <name>. [soft voice] From what I can make out, this ritual is conducted by the Gordunni mage-lords.

[urgent] Find one of these mage-lords, and from him, gather an orb.

[solemn] The orb of a mage contains great power, and will help us discover more about this ceremony and the magic that the Gordunni wield.
quest_2979_quest_progress: [solemn] We must discover more about why the Gordunni are here, <name>.
quest_2979_quest_complete: [solemn] This orb will provide us with more information about the Gordunni... [commanding] which we will then use in planning their downfall, <name>.
quest_2980_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand.

[urgent] Travel to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. [commanding] Push them back.

[angry] These ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, <name>. Be aware.
quest_2980_quest_complete: [warm] You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, <name>.
quest_2981_quest_detail:
[solemn] Feralas is an ideal location for an accomplished <class> to prove himself. [low voice] A tribe of ogres called the Gordunni are the dominant military force there, and their numbers are growing. [urgent] They must be stopped before they threaten our presence in Feralas.

[pause] A warrior I know of named Rok Orhan resides at Camp Mojache in Feralas; go to her. [soft voice] She will tell you more of the situation when you arrive.
quest_2981_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, Belgrom sent you. [urgent] You are just in time, <race>.

[soft voice] Let me explain the situation, and then you can decide if you are up to the challenge... [warm] But if Belgrom sent you, I am sure your courage is unquestionable.
quest_2982_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although it is dangerous, Troyas and I have been investigating the ruins that cover the forests of Feralas.

[soft voice] Lately, though, Troyas has been going on his own to the High Wilderness, and I really worry about him. [sad] The Gordunni Ogres have taken over that area, and they don't take kindly to anyone that enters their territory.

[hesitant] I was hoping you might be willing to travel to the ruins to the southeast and clear out some of the ogres. [warm] Make it a little safer for my Troyas, and I will be extremely grateful.
quest_2982_quest_progress: [urgent] Be watchful around the Gordunni, <name>. Their magic seems to wreak havoc on the very land they stand on.
quest_2982_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I am very grateful you were able to do this for me.

[whispering] Now, please, don't mention a word to Troyas about this...
quest_2983_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's been some time since you were tested last, <name>. [soft voice] You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... [emphasis] it's time you learn real power. [commanding] The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.

[urgent] Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.
quest_2983_quest_complete:
[solemn] Hmmm, Swart sent you to me, did he?

Well then, Swart could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

[soft voice] I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. [low voice] You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. [pause] Patience, <name>. [solemn] Remember what earth taught you. [commanding] Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
quest_2984_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been since you were last tested, <name>. [soft voice] You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. [emphasis] The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. [solemn] The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.

[urgent] Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. [soft voice] He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.
quest_2984_quest_complete:
[solemn] Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?

Well then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

[soft voice] I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. [pause] Patience, <name>. [emphasis] Remember what earth taught you. [commanding] Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
quest_2985_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You look ready for your next test, <name>. [low voice] You've been patient in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. [solemn] The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.

[pause] Seek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. [soft voice] She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. [pause] You will find her there at her fishing hut. [warm] Good luck to you, <name>.
quest_2985_quest_complete:
[solemn] The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.

[warm] Your path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. [gentle] But the first step is yours to take.
quest_2987_quest_detail:
[urgent] I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! [low voice] They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.

[excited] If you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. [commanding] Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. [urgent] Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
quest_2987_quest_progress:
[urgent] Get on up there and start digging!

[excited] I've got places to go and people to see -- time is money!
quest_2987_quest_complete:
[excited] Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, <name>. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.

[warm] Here, take this for your trouble.
quest_2988_quest_detail:
[urgent] The son of our mightiest gryphon is gone! [angry] Swiftwing's heir, Sharpbeak, was lost while hunting with his parents a few days ago, and we believe it was the trolls who took him.

[commanding] You must aid us! [urgent] Search the cages in the two Witherbark troll villages to see if Sharpbeak is there.
quest_2988_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you searched the cages, <name>? [commanding] We must find Sharpbeak!
quest_2988_quest_complete: [solemn] Sharpbeak wasn't at the villages? Hm... [pause] this is grim news. [sad] That gryphon is destined to lead the next generation of gryphons. [solemn] If he is lost then the strength and spirit of our fleet will suffer immensely.
quest_2989_quest_detail: [solemn] Sharpbeak was not with the Witherbark trolls. Perhaps the Vilebranch trolls took him. [urgent] Go to the Altar of Zul on the western edge of Vilebranch territory and search for the gryphon child.
quest_2989_quest_progress: Hurry, <name>! [urgent] If the Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak, then who knows what they might be doing with him!
quest_2989_quest_complete:
[solemn] Sharpbeak wasn't there? That is bad news, but it is good news too...

It is good that he was not at the Altar of Zul for the Vilebranch trolls are known for performing sacrifices.

[warm] I thank you for all of your aid, but I'm afraid I have an even greater task ahead.
quest_2990_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take this feather to Thadius Grimshade, the diviner. [soft voice] He left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, but in his heart he is still a Wildhammer!

[emphasis] And perhaps his talents can help us find Sharpbeak.

[pause] This feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child sleeps. [urgent] If you give it to Thadius then, with luck, he can use his divining magics to find Sharpbeak.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. [commanding] You will find Thadius in the Blasted Lands, in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep.
quest_2990_quest_progress: [soft voice] <name>, you come bearing a gift?
quest_2990_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. [soft voice] This feather belongs to a fine gryphon. [pause] One destined for great things... if he can survive into adulthood undamaged.

[soft voice] You wish to find him? [urgent] Then listen close, brave <class>...
quest_2991_quest_detail:
[commanding] I'll find out where your gryphon is, but first you have to do something for me. [solemn] There's a troll in Zul'Farrak, Nekrum Gutchewer, who possesses a medallion I would very much like to study. [urgent] Bring me that Medallion and I'll use my powers to find Sharpbeak.

[soft voice] Zul'Farrak is across the ocean to the west, in the desert of Tanaris.
quest_2991_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have Nekrum's Medallion, <name>? [solemn] There are powers hidden within it that I am eager to discover.
quest_2991_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the medallion of Nekrum. It is rumored to have given the troll an unnatural long life, but at a cost. [soft voice] I hope to discover a way to reap the medallion's power while avoiding its... unpleasant side effects.

[warm] You have done me a service, <name>. [proud] I shall now uphold my end of our bargain.
quest_2992_quest_detail:
[commanding] Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination. [solemn] I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.

[hesitant] That is... I will if all goes according to plan. [urgent] If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.
quest_2992_quest_complete: [solemn] The ritual was a success. [soft voice] I have seen Sharpbeak and can tell you how to find him.
quest_2993_quest_detail:
[solemn] Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. [soft voice] The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.

[pause] There. [pause] I have done my part. [soft voice] I bid you fortune on your quest, <name>.
quest_2993_quest_complete:
[urgent] You've spoken with Grimshade? What did he say?

...What? The Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak? [angry] That's unbearable! [commanding] We must organize a force to get him back!
quest_2995_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Quel'Danil Lodge is a center of communication for the high elves of the Hinterlands. Their ambassadors are working to establish relationships with other races, with whom they share their knowledge of the Witherbark trolls that inhabit the area in the southern Hinterlands. All of the documents regarding the communications are kept at the lodge.

[whispering] We don't need the Highvale building alliances with others, <name>.

[commanding] Destroy the Highvale documents. [urgent] We need to burn their lines of communication... literally.
quest_2995_quest_progress: [commanding] Keeping the Highvale elves isolated is the key. [urgent] Have you found the lodge?
quest_2995_quest_complete: [delight] Perfect, <name>. [solemn] While the Highvale work to recover their lost information, we will be able to seal off the lines even further...
quest_2996_quest_detail: [solemn] I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. [soft voice] He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. [low voice] He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak. [emphasis] He is powerful even though he may be small. [solemn] He can teach you about more powerful summonings--I feel you are ready. [urgent] Go to him now. [emphasis] He is in Ratchet... above the port town next to his tower.
quest_2996_quest_complete:
[soft voice] A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? [low voice] How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. [solemn] So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.

[commanding] Is that hatred I see in your eyes, <name>? [warm] Good, we will put that to good use.
quest_2997_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hello, <name>. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should make your way up to Ironforge to speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. [solemn] I'll be here night or day.

[warm] The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with - help a <class> can give them. [warm] Good luck.
quest_3101_quest_detail: [solemn] I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. [pause] But until then, be patient... [solemn] Knight of the Silver Hand.
quest_3101_quest_complete:
[solemn] In the meantime, you should know one or two other things. [solemn] You are a symbol to many here in this land--act accordingly. [solemn] The Holy Light shines within you, and it will be obvious to both your allies and your enemies.

[solemn] Also, as you gain in wisdom and power, you will need to train to learn new abilities. [solemn] That's where I come in. [solemn] When you feel you've gained some experience here in Northshire, come back to me and I will teach you what I feel you are ready to learn. [warm] Good luck... <class>!
quest_3102_quest_detail: [solemn] I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. quest_3102_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. [whispering] Good enough for me. [hesitant] I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... nice and quiet. [soft voice] I'm sure you can understand.

[pause] Have any trouble yet? [urgent] I'm glad to hear not. [low voice] That'll change soon enough.
quest_3102_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You're gonna find that there a number of outfits that'll covet our skills, <name>. [urgent] Adventurers, SI:7... heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside Stormwind. [commanding] But you remember this, you're your own man. [angry] Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! [confident] Besides, we hold all the cards... at least, we do before the game's done. [emphasis] Know what I mean?

[warm] Anyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. [gentle] Come by anytime.
quest_3103_quest_detail: [solemn] I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. [urgent] I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
quest_3103_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, at last you've come. [solemn] I knew you would find your way to me. [warm] The Holy Light shines upon you, and the path you've chosen. [solemn] These times are harsh--the Burning Legion still has a presence upon Azeroth, the entirety of Kalimdor seeks new ways to defend itself from its own tribulations, and it is up to you to aid as many as you can.
quest_3103_quest_complete: [soft voice] As you grow in experience, return to me and I will do what I can to impart my knowledge upon you. Until then, go with compassion in your heart, and let wisdom be your guide. [solemn] Remember, the world only becomes a better place if you make it so.
quest_3104_quest_detail: [solemn] I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. quest_3104_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. I am Khelden. [soft voice] Is there something I can do for you?
quest_3104_quest_complete:
[laughing] Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. [soft voice] So, you're prepared then, are you? [commanding] Prepared to accept your fate? [commanding] Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?

[solemn] I will not lie, <name>, you will be feared as much as respected. [warm] But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. [gentle] Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.
quest_3105_quest_detail: [solemn] I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. [urgent] I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
quest_3105_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, <name>. [low voice] Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... [mocking tone] pathetic mundanes.
quest_3105_quest_complete:
[solemn] As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. [soft voice] I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the Twisting Nether. [pause] Be patient, and be prudent... but do not let that repress your ambition.

[solemn] As you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.
quest_3106_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. [soft voice] Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
quest_3106_quest_progress:
[whispering] Blast it's cold today, aint it? It's like the snow never goes away, <name>.

[soft voice] You've probably noticed already, but there are gnomes now living in our city. That's because they went and got themselves blown out of their own home. [hesitant] Don't go spreadin' this 'round, but I can hardly blame them--I think I woulda resorted to explosives too if Ironforge were infested with Dark Irons or the like.
quest_3106_quest_complete:
Other things you'll probably see too, just so yer in the know: [solemn] dwarves usin' magic in a fight 'stead of a rifle. [soft voice] Some of us takin' to worshippin' the Holy Light like some of the humans, and, last but not least, troggs. You'll learn more 'bout them later, but [pause] What you need to know now is that I'm here to help ya.

[warm] I be here to teach ya how to be a real <class>. [proud] Anytime ya think ya need more trainin', come back to me and I'll see what I can do.
quest_3107_quest_detail: [soft voice] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3107_quest_progress:
[excited] So, you've made it! [urgent] And not a second too soon. [solemn] There's much to be done in Coldridge Valley and beyond. [commanding] I'm gonna need your help as much as you're gonna need mine!

[proud] You're a Knight of the Silver Hand now, be ready to play the part.
quest_3107_quest_complete:
[solemn] The humans have taught us a great deal about the Holy Light and how important their order is to them... and to protecting all of Azeroth. [soft voice] We have a great respect for how steeped in tradition it is, and how just one figure, one sacrifice, can make the difference between pain and salvation.

[warm] The two of us are gonna be working together for a bit. [confident] Any time you think you're ready, come back to me and we'll see about getting you some training. [gentle] Can't have you go out into the world unprepared, now, can we?
quest_3108_quest_detail: [soft voice] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. [pause] Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3108_quest_progress:
[excited] Ya made it! Good to hear! Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. Haha!

[warm] Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, <name>. Learning the ways of the land. Learning to track a bear through the mountains. Even just surviving on wits alone takes a great deal of courage and cunning. [confident] Think you're capable?
quest_3108_quest_complete:
[solemn] One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. [soft voice] The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.

[pause] I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. [warm] Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. [soft voice] I'll train you when I can.
quest_3109_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. [soft voice] Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3109_quest_progress:
[excited] You made it! Great!

[solemn] We've got an influx of activity lately, so I'm glad to count another of the Ironforge clan among our numbers. [low voice] Too many of us are lookin' to the arcane, and divine for my own tastes. [soft voice] Nothin' against them and their beliefs, but there's nothing like a cold blade in your hand and a shadow to keep you from the light, know what I mean?
quest_3109_quest_complete:
Anyway, as you start peekin' around Coldridge you'll probably have need of training at some point. [soft voice] You just come back to me whenever you feel you need it and I'll teach you what I know--a trick here, a maneuver there. Keep an eye out on our gnomish friends too... [sad] they kinda got the short end of the stick what with Gnomeregan being... destroyed. [solemn] They'll need our help to feel welcome.
quest_3110_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3110_quest_progress: [excited] Ach! Ya made it, <name>! [delight] Wonderful! [laughing] I was gonna say, I was about to lose faith that ye'd arrive at all... get it, lose faith? It's a joke, lass... [sigh] aww, nevermind. Ya didn't come here for me bad jokes anyway.
quest_3110_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. [warm] When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.

[warm] Ya got the Light on yer side, along with all of Ironforge, <name>... [pause] no pressure on ya to become somethin' special.
quest_3111_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this glyph was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. [soft voice] I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marrek. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
quest_3111_quest_progress: [low voice] Yeah, what's that? [soft voice] Speak up, if you don't mind. [soft voice] I don't hear so good after a few ales.

quest_3112_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3112_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ah, well, another memorandum from a <race> on a mission... isn't this quaint.

[chuckling] No, no, I ain't teasin' ya, little one. [warm] Gotta respect your tenacity, that much is fer sure. [low voice] I'd be just as peeved if Ironforge was taken by Dark Iron dwarves, so don't be thinkin' I don't feel for your plight...
quest_3112_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... and that's just what I'm gonna do.

[warm] Any time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. [confident] There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. [warm] Good luck.
quest_3113_quest_detail: [soft voice] While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3113_quest_progress:
