[solemn] Not many think it's the best thing in the world to have your kind and my kind holed up in the same city, but I think we can work things out just fine. [warm] What do you think?
quest_3113_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I pretty much keep to myself around here so we don't get a bad wrap for things gone missing, but if you need anything, some training or somethin', just come back anytime.

[warm] You and me got an understandin'. [solemn] We know when it comes down to it you can only trust family... and that's just what we got going on here, isn't it? [solemn] Regardless of Gnomeregan being... overrun, and whatever else is thrown our way, we got one another to back each other up. [emphasis] Right?
quest_3114_quest_detail: [soft voice] While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. quest_3114_quest_progress: [excited] Yeah, what's that, <race>? [soft voice] Speak up, if you don't mind. [low voice] I don't hear so good after a few ales.
quest_3114_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, yeah! [soft voice] Arcane Arts... of course.

[warm] Here's what you need to know, <name>: [gentle] Don't get into too much trouble. [warm] Save some coin to buy me an ale... or any spells ya might want. And stay the heck away from Gnomeregan. [warm] Other than that, have a good day! [confident] I'll be here if you need me or want to train... or whatever.
quest_3115_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warlock trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

[hesitant] And watch yerself, <name>, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
quest_3115_quest_progress:
[excited] Wonderful! You got my memorandum obviously.

[commanding] Ignore the fools around you, <name>. [mocking tone] The Holy Light?! The sword and shield?! These aren't paths for ones as open minded as us. [sad] Look at what "normal" magic did to our home. [angry] Coupled with those damned tinkerers, our race almost became extinct. And now we have to rely on the dwarves-- they'd rather spend time allying with humans than help us rebuild our own home. [sad] We're like second-class citizens. [angry] Have you seen the way they look at us?
quest_3115_quest_complete:
But none of that matters. [solemn] What matters is that you've seen your own Holy Light! [excited] You know where power truly comes from. [soft voice] You realize that having our own allies is much more... prudent. [whispering] Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.

[commanding] And that's where I come in, <name>. [warm] I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. [gentle] Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
quest_3116_quest_detail: [soft voice] This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our warrior trainer, Alyissia. [solemn] It seems Alyissia would have words with you when you have a moment. [soft voice] Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
quest_3116_quest_progress:
You made it. [soft voice] I'm so glad.

[pause] Much has happened over the last few years, <name>: the creation of Teldrassil, the corruption of many of the forest creatures here and abroad, discovery of lands we thought lost to us like Feralas... [pause] so much, in so little time.

But those are just some of the reasons we are here, the most important being to protect our kind from further evil.
quest_3116_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Soon you will see others from different races in the boughs of our home--do not let it cause any prejudice within you. [solemn] They are welcome. They will aid us when they can. Not all of them will be altruistic, but they should be granted some amount of trust.

[pause] But none of this matters now. [solemn] Now we must focus on you, and how you can aid our people. [warm] I am here for that very purpose. [gentle] I will train you in the ways of a <class> as you become stronger. [warm] Return to me whenever you wish and I will do what I can to aid you.
quest_3117_quest_detail: [soft voice] This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our hunter trainer, Ayanna. [pause] It seems Ayanna would have words with you when you have a moment. [gentle] Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
quest_3117_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You've arrived, and none too soon, <name>. [warm] Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a <class>; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
quest_3117_quest_complete:
[soft voice] As you experience what Shadowglen has to teach you, come see me--I will be able to help you understand more about your role as a <class> and what you are capable of.

[solemn] These are dangerous times, <name>, do not take for granted the skill of your pets--there are things in this world more dangerous than you can imagine. [warm] Go with Elune and return to me again.
quest_3118_quest_detail: [soft voice] This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our rogue trainer, Frahun. [hesitant] It seems Frahun would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
quest_3118_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hello, <name>. [soft voice] I'm glad you found me. [soft voice] I was thinking that perhaps you got lost on the way here.

[soft voice] Nothing really new has happened in Shadowglen since I sent you my sigil, but I'll leave all the information gathering to you. [soft voice] Speak to the rest of the people around Aldrassil if you'd like.
quest_3118_quest_complete: [solemn] Until then, know that our kind are needed more than ever in this tenuous time. [soft voice] Peace with the other races can fail at any moment, and there is much talk about members of the Horde looking to sow even greater seeds of distrust. [emphasis] Remember that. As you gain in power and feel more prepared, come back to me here and I will see about getting you some training. [solemn] It's important that you know how to handle your weapon of choice, among other things.
quest_3119_quest_detail: [solemn] This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our priest trainer, Shanda. [soft voice] It seems Shanda would have words with you when you have a moment. [gentle] Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
quest_3119_quest_progress:
[soft voice] It pleases me to see you've arrived so quickly, Kaldorei. Welcome.

As you've probably heard, all of Teldrassil is stirring with the comings and goings of travelers. [solemn] Members of the Alliance have been allowed access onto Teldrassil's boughs in order to meet with other Kaldorei who prepare for the adventures ahead.
quest_3119_quest_complete: [solemn] Do not concern yourself with the world below Teldrassil for now. [soft voice] There will be time for that later. [urgent] Go now and speak to the others in Shadowglen--they can tell you more about what events have transpired. [warm] Help them in any way you can, and anytime you feel you need more training, come back to me and I will teach you what I can.
quest_3120_quest_detail: [solemn] This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our druid trainer, Mardant. [soft voice] It seems Mardant would have words with you when you have a moment. [pause] Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
quest_3120_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ah, young <class>. I see you're eager to continue your studies. Good.

I wonder, have you spent much time in the Emerald Dream already? Perhaps you're not prepared for that yet... [pause] In time, I'm sure.

But until then, we should discuss other matters.
quest_3120_quest_complete:
[solemn] I will be your mentor and guide for now. [soft voice] It is my duty to teach you how to interpret not only what the spirits communicate to us, but also the complexities and secrets of the Emerald Dream.

[pause] As you learn and grow in power, you will learn more of our sleeping trance. [gentle] But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.
quest_3121_quest_detail:
[urgent] Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has what I need to get started here! [excited] He has mixed up a concoction that I need for my... well, you'll see.

[commanding] Off with you now -- to Orgrimmar. Here, take this with you. [soft voice] It's a shrunken head that I promised Neeru in exchange for the herbs. [sad] It's the head of some poor dwarf I ventured across in the forest. [hesitant] I'm sure Neeru will be pleased.

[urgent] You'll find Neeru in the Cleft of Shadow.
quest_3121_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have been waiting for Uzer'i to deliver this...

[soft voice] Let me give you the herb mixture I prepared for his... well, experiments...
quest_3122_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here are the herbs, <name>. [urgent] Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.

[solemn] Please let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
quest_3122_quest_complete:
[excited] This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, <name>. [solemn] Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.

[soft voice] Please, a moment. [pause] I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.
quest_3123_quest_detail:
[solemn] This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. [commanding] Take this vessel, <name>. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.

Travel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. [solemn] The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, <name>. [urgent] Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
quest_3123_quest_progress:
[urgent] Were you able to capture the wildkin?

[soft voice] If you succeed, we will be ready to shrink and capture the muisek of creatures of Feralas.
quest_3123_quest_complete: [solemn] Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. [soft voice] Shrinking the creatures, as you did, <name>, prevents the muisek from escaping. [warm] Now we may use it as we please!
quest_3124_quest_detail:
[solemn] Since you have proven that you are both trustworthy and gifted with the ability to use the muisek vessel, I now wish you to capture another creature.

[soft voice] Hippogryphs have been loyal companions to the night elves for many years; their spirits are loyal and steadfast.

[urgent] Your task is to kill 10 frayfeather hippogryphs, and quickly, shrink and capture them with the vessel, so that their muisek may be preserved. [commanding] You will find the hippogryphs in the High Wilderness, to the south of here.
quest_3124_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to capture the hippogryphs?
quest_3124_quest_complete:
[solemn] After killing an animal, if we allowed the muisek to escape, it may take the form of an even greater creature. We would never be safe from its vengeance.

[commanding] This is a dangerous job I have given you, <name>. [warm] Again, you have completed it well.
quest_3125_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. [soft voice] The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. [commanding] We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.

[pause] Here is the muisek, <name>. [urgent] Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. [whispering] They may be found to the west of here.
quest_3125_quest_progress: [soft voice] Were you able to capture the muisek of the faerie dragons?
quest_3125_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] Now the spiritual powers of the faerie dragon will be available to us.

[hesitant] I hope you willing to perform another task for me.
quest_3126_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, <name>. [solemn] Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. [low voice] Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.

[urgent] Soon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.

[commanding] Find 3 wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.
quest_3126_quest_progress: [soft voice] Were you able to capture the wandering forest walkers?
quest_3126_quest_complete: [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Our muisek collection is almost complete.
quest_3127_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.

[solemn] The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. [urgent] You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.

[low voice] I am eager to harness power of that size. [commanding] Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
quest_3127_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to capture the mountain giants?
quest_3127_quest_complete: [solemn] Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, <name>. [warm] Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.
quest_3128_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... [soft voice] You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.

[pause] I'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. [emphasis] Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. [pause] Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. [emphasis] Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
quest_3128_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to collect the materials I need?
quest_3128_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [warm] These materials, combined with the muisek, should yield just the results we've been wanting.
quest_3129_quest_detail: [solemn] Imbuing the muisek into the weapons is a difficult process. [soft voice] Now that I have all of the required materials and the muisek of the creatures that you captured, I may begin. [pause] Please wait; I will return in a moment.
quest_3129_quest_complete:
[solemn] As promised, you have your choice, <name>. [warm] The muisek of the creatures has been forever sealed into the power of these weapons.

[solemn] You may now wield their energy as your own. [commanding] Use it well.
quest_3130_quest_detail:
[soft voice] At this point, I am going to direct you to my second, Latronicus. He's been keeping a close eye on the naga forces to date. [solemn] I'll assess the general situation here in regards to the naga; as much as I want to commit a full force to move against them, leaving the stronghold open to direct attack from the Horde - or worse - seems less than optimal.

Anyway, Latronicus awaits. [warm] Good work thus far, <name>. [commanding] Keep it up.

You're dismissed.
quest_3130_quest_complete:
[confident] Excellent, <name> - I value a "can do" attitude in those who I work with.

[solemn] I've been tasked by General Feathermoon to address the naga in a direct manner. My plans are two fold: one, we will weaken their forces both in number and in command, and two, we will uncover what they are up to in the ruins. [urgent] With your help, we'll counter the naga presence without sacrificing the general security of the stronghold.
quest_3141_quest_detail: [commanding] So you wish to battle demons? [solemn] You would do well to listen to my tale.
quest_3161_quest_detail:
<name>, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!

[excited] Long ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. [soft voice] These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian," after the hydra god.

[confident] I did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?

[urgent] I even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!
quest_3161_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Are you having any trouble?

[urgent] You can find Gahz'ridian just about anywhere in Tanaris, <name>, so keep looking!
quest_3161_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Perfect; these ornaments are perfect for my studies. [warm] Thanks so much for the help, <name>.

[excited] Oh, can I get my helmet back?
quest_3181_quest_detail:
[solemn] The gigantic horn has numerous scratches and cracks. [soft voice] An unusual metal object is lodged into the rough surface.

[pause] Upon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. [low voice] On the metal, the following words are etched:

Property of Mountaineer Pebblebitty.

[hesitant] When you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.

[gasp] Woops!
quest_3181_quest_progress: [commanding] No, I will not open the gate.
quest_3181_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What have you got there? [angry] A fake obviously!

I've been face to face with Margol and I know for a fact that her horn is at least eight times larger than the one you've got in your hands, <name>. You probably got that off of a stormsnout in the Barrens. [commanding] No ma'am, you can't fool Pebblebitty!
quest_3182_quest_detail:
You expect me to believe a story like that? The real horn would have had my broken axe head still lodged into its surface.

[commanding] Listen, take that obvious fake to Curator Thorius in Ironforge. If he can validate your claim, you will receive a proof of deed. Bring that proof back to me and I'll give you the key to the Searing Gorge.

[urgent] Get going!
quest_3182_quest_progress: [gentle] Why hello there young one. [soft voice] Would you like a tour of our museum?
quest_3182_quest_complete:
[excited] What's this?

Oh my, I don't believe it! [warm] Do you realize what you've got here, <race>? This is the horn of Margol the Rager! [solemn] Margol, the bane of every archaeologist that ever set foot in the Searing Gorge.

[hesitant] May I keep it?
quest_3201_quest_detail:
[solemn] I can't believe Pebblebitty doubted the authenticity of the horn. Between you and me, I think she's just jealous. [soft voice] I know she really wanted to kill that beast herself, what with the 'incident' and all.

[commanding] So you need a proof of deed? After the contribution you just made to the museum, it won't be a problem.

<Curator Thorius begins to fill out a large document.>

[excited] There we go! [warm] You can take that back to Pebblebitty.
quest_3201_quest_complete:
[solemn] I don't know how someone as weak as you overcame Margol, but a deal is a deal. [warm] Here is the key.

[threatening] If anything happens to you after this, it will be your own fault.
quest_3221_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons. [soft voice] He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
quest_3221_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, very good. [soft voice] There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
quest_3261_quest_detail: [solemn] Your time with me is over, <name>. [soft voice] To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer. [pause] He will continue your guidance.
quest_3261_quest_complete:
[solemn] Greetings, young one. [soft voice] You are here to walk the hunter's path?

[soft voice] Very good. [solemn] Let us begin.
quest_3281_quest_detail:
[urgent] You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered! [solemn] I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds. [soft voice] It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

[commanding] Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver. [urgent] When you find it, return it to me.
quest_3281_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair. It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver. Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
quest_3301_quest_detail:
[solemn] My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies. Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life. Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

Take a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine. She is staying at the Sepulcher. With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
quest_3301_quest_progress: [solemn] I can smell the dust of the Barrens on you, <class>. [soft voice] You have traveled far.
quest_3301_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, what is this? [delight] This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life. [excited] Amazing! [solemn] I must study it further.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.
quest_3321_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done much for the Order, <name>. The sheer dedication it takes to get this far would have turned away any ordinary person. [soft voice] There is no doubt in my mind, or in the mind of Galvan, that you are one of us.

[warm] Which is why I think you deserve a little reward. [gentle] It is nothing really, just a trinket. [soft voice] You may be familiar with its properties, as I do believe it is what brought you to us in the first place.
quest_3321_quest_progress: [solemn] Today we finalize our celebration of your commitment to the Order.
quest_3321_quest_complete: [solemn] Rise and be recognized, <name>, blacksmith of the Mithril Order.
quest_3341_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the Barrens lies a horrid mess of tangled vines called Razorfen Downs. [soft voice] While our first observations of this place revealed little threat, our recent findings are much more serious...

[urgent] The quilboar of Razorfen Downs have aligned themselves with the Scourge. [low voice] A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.

[commanding] Amnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, <name>. [solemn] An end must come to the Coldbringer.
quest_3341_quest_progress: [solemn] This matter is of utmost importance, <name>. [urgent] We must stop any attempt by the Scourge to bolster their ranks.
quest_3341_quest_complete: [solemn] The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, <name>. [cold] Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.
quest_3361_quest_detail:
[solemn] We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong! [sad] Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

[hesitant] In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools. [angry] It was the trolls that got them. They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts! [urgent] They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

[hesitant] I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
quest_3361_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Oh goodness <name>, this town is not well suited for the likes of me. There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

[hesitant] Do you have my belongings? [sad] If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
quest_3361_quest_complete: Huzzah, you've found them! [warm] You're an absolute savior, my friend. [gentle] Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through! [excited] Thank you!
quest_3362_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? [low voice] It's a mighty dangerous place, <name>.

[angry] Those strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! [hesitant] Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called...

[pause] Anyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. [urgent] But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. [soft voice] What do you think, <name>? [hesitant] Help me out?
quest_3362_quest_progress: [soft voice] I'd like to take a closer look at that cactus in the valley... [urgent] So leave some of it in one piece, will ya?
quest_3362_quest_complete:
[shocked] They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...

But you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.
quest_3364_quest_detail:
Gah! [urgent] I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first. I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

[excited] You look fast. Maybe you can make it. [urgent] This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going. [solemn] Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

[warm] Thanks, <name>, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
quest_3364_quest_progress: [commanding] Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter. [urgent] You have something for me?
quest_3364_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah good, now this will hit the spot. [pause] Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
quest_3365_quest_detail:
[excited] Now that hit the spot! [delight] Nothing like a piping hot - nay, [shouting] SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

[warm] Here ya go <name> - [gentle] be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
quest_3365_quest_progress: [commanding] I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time! [urgent] Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
quest_3365_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, <name>! [warm] You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug. [soft voice] Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

[warm] Here's a little something for the effort. [warm] Thanks again for your help.
quest_3366_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. [hesitant] You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

[hesitant] Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
quest_3367_quest_detail:
<Dorius groans.> I'm badly injured, <race>. Feel... light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... internally.

[urgent] I must get back to Ironforge. Help me, <name>.
quest_3367_quest_progress: [low voice] I'm not going to make it...
quest_3367_quest_complete: [soft voice] This letter was dropped by Dorius when he was shot.
quest_3369_quest_detail:
[solemn] This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. [soft voice] However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

[hesitant] I do not wish to alarm you, <name>, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

[urgent] Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. [commanding] Head to Thunder Bluff. [low voice] I cannot say more.
quest_3369_quest_progress: [soft voice] May I help you with something?
quest_3369_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

<name>, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
quest_3370_quest_detail:
[solemn] This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. [soft voice] However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

[hesitant] I do not wish to alarm you, <name>, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can...

[solemn] Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Circle is who you need to find. [urgent] Head to Darnassus. [commanding] I cannot say more.
quest_3370_quest_progress: [soft voice] May I help you with something?
quest_3370_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Mathrengyl peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

<name>, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that the Cenarion druids alone must attend to.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
quest_3371_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is an empty, vacuous hole, where my heart used to be, <name>. [sad] The loss of Dorius is not one that I will soon recover from. [urgent] I must see his final wish through - the perpetrators of this cold blooded murder must be brought to justice.

Return to the Searing Gorge and fulfill his last request: Free his men.
quest_3371_quest_complete: [soft voice] Forget about me, help the others.
quest_3372_quest_detail:
[solemn] Release them, <race>. Even after their bodies give out, the power of the Suntara forces them to complete their tasks.

[soft voice] The altar of Suntara is the key. [urgent] Go northwest; in the hills above the cave... Twilight's Hammer guard a relic. Retrieve it and place it on the altar of Suntara. <The dying archaeologist collapses.>
quest_3372_quest_complete: [solemn] You place the mysterious artifact on the altar of Suntara.
quest_3374_quest_detail:
[solemn] You engage the Oathstone, and Itharius speaks directly to your mind through the stone.

"By accepting the charge placed in this Oathstone, you agree to aid my cause and the cause of Ysera's Dragonflight in redeeming the corrupted soul of Eranikus. The first sacrifice, one of many you and I will no doubt make, will be to relinquish the gem to me that has chained what free-willed part of Eranikus' psyche remains."

[commanding] "Do this <name>, and we will work together to redeem a soul worthy of redemption."
quest_3374_quest_progress: [solemn] Here we are <name>, at yet another crossroads. [soft voice] The time has come to make another choice. [pause] What choice do you make, mortal?
quest_3374_quest_complete: [solemn] You have made your choice, and so it begins. [soft voice] Your choices have been, to date, what I would consider to be the correct ones; [pause] your actions and deeds henceforth will determine whether this is to continue.
quest_3375_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Um... you need another phial of scrying? [shocked] You're kidding, right? [angry] What did you do with the first one?! [urgent] We have a lot of work ahead of us here, <race>. [emphasis] Those phials don't grow on trees! [soft voice] Actually, I wish they did, because I'd go there and pick one off since I don't have another one!!

[commanding] in order to make you one, I need the following: a mana potion, a piece of coal, and some sweet nectar. [commanding] Don't ask why, just bring me what I ask and I'll make you a new one.
quest_3375_quest_progress:
[urgent] To make another phial I need a mana potion, a piece of coal, and some sweet nectar.

[hesitant] That, and a whole lotta patience apparently.
quest_3375_quest_complete:
[commanding] The mighty adventurer delivers. [excited] Hooray for me. [soft voice] By the way, I lied - I had another phial. [groan] Ungh, take it.

[urgent] Well, what did you expect?! [mocking tone] "Oh, here, have another one! I'm just some goofball who has nothing better to do than hand out magical communication devices to adventurers!" [solemn] Rest assured though, what you have given to me will be enough make you another phial when you lose that too.

[hesitant] Please prove me wrong and don't lose the new one, okay?
quest_3376_quest_detail:
<name> - [solemn] I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

[soft voice] We tauren have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. [commanding] The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. [urgent] I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

[emphasis] He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
quest_3376_quest_progress:
[solemn] Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death. [soft voice] It is his head that I seek, <name>.

[solemn] We tauren live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back. [pause] If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
quest_3376_quest_complete:
[solemn] Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, <name>. [warm] Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

[proud] You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young <class>.
quest_3377_quest_detail: [soft voice] Will you assist me, mortal? [solemn] Hear my tale.
quest_3377_quest_progress: [soft voice] Allow me to finish my story.
quest_3377_quest_complete: [solemn] I have accepted my fate here in this cage, but the prayer must be found.
quest_3378_quest_detail:
[solemn] Will you assist me, mortal? [hesitant] Will you find the prayer to Elune?

As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.

If you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. [sad] Absolution is the last thing I expect.
quest_3378_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to the Temple of the Moon, <name>?
quest_3378_quest_complete: [solemn] Elune smiles upon you this eve, <name>. [warm] You have returned a lost soul to her. [gentle] Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
quest_3379_quest_detail:
[solemn] The spiders of the Searing Gorge are an invaluable source of shadow silk. As you know, shadow silk is highly sought after by the artisans of our trade.

[sad] Recently, a group of poachers has encroached upon these lands, carelessly slaying spiders en masse without so much as a thought as to the long term effect of their actions. [commanding] The first task I ask of you, then, is a simple one: Find them... and end them.

[urgent] Begin your search to the north.

If you require assistance, speak with Raze.
quest_3379_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent work, <name>.

[warm] I am sure that this is a piece of shadoweave that you have not yet seen.
quest_3380_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are restless spirits in this world, <name>. There are spirits that have been tainted by their isolation, bound to an ancient evil...

I have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.

[soft voice] If you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. [low voice] He has studied many ancient areas of the world, and was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in Tanaris.
quest_3380_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. [soft voice] Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?

You look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...
quest_3381_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, a young <race> come to speak to Sanath. [excited] What a wonderful day! [warm] I am so honored to have you grace me with your presence. [delight] Thank you! [hesitant] Please... do not be so arrogant to assume my sarcasm was a compliment. [commanding] Let us get one thing straight: I don't like you. [solemn] But this little conversation doesn't have anything to do with us--it has to do with my master.

[urgent] Bring me a couple hippogryph feathers for my arrows and I'll give you leave to see him. [solemn] He's asked that I send adventurers to him if they proved worthy enough.
quest_3381_quest_progress:
[solemn] I remain here at my master's bidding. I've been given leave to ask any price I wish for transportation up to his tower. [soft voice] For now, I ask for only the two feathers from each traveler so I can continue to make my signature arrows.

[threatening] If you're not careful, I'll up the price. [low voice] How does half a dozen gold sound?

[chuckling] Yeah, I thought as much. [commanding] Just mind yourself and I'll keep the price where it is.
quest_3381_quest_complete:
Two feathers, just as I asked. And not bad ones at all.

[urgent] Ready then? Just say the word and you're on your way.

Oh, and once again, mind yourself... [threatening] my master doesn't take kindly to imbeciles, but he is very generous to those that please him.
quest_3382_quest_detail:
[solemn] We were just off the coast looking for a safe haven to make anchor. The sun hadn't been down for more than an hour when they attacked... those damned naga!

[angry] I'm not sure what they were looking for, but it's clear they didn't find it--they've already come back once. A couple of my scouts are on watch at the entrance of the valley to give us fair warning when the next attack comes.

[hesitant] I'm sorry you've come along now, <name>, but it's out of my hands.

[commanding] Are you ready for the fight of your life?
quest_3382_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you met with Andron yet? [hesitant] He rarely leaves Undercity, so I don't think it'd be too hard to find him.
quest_3382_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [warm] Thank you! [proud] Surely this was one of the most brutal battles I've ever taken part in. [soft voice] I can't thank you enough.

[sad] I only wish more of my crew could have lived through this trial.

[solemn] I would ask you to speak to any surviving passengers from the Horizon Scout. [gentle] Some of them had business in the area, and may have a request or two of you if you're willing. [warm] Again, thank you for all your help.
quest_3385_quest_detail:
[solemn] They call themselves the Undermarket: Cutthroat traders that will sell, move, trade and do just about anything for the right price.

[urgent] It gets worse, <name>. [commanding] They have set up a base of operations here in the Searing Gorge. [low voice] Trade Master Kovic is heading up the operation and has close ties with the Dark Iron dwarves of the region.

[angry] We must strike hard and send a message to their leadership. [commanding] Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. [urgent] Bring back his trader's satchel when the job is done.

[urgent] To the Cauldron!
quest_3385_quest_complete:
[confident] You have struck a decisive blow against the Undermarket. [solemn] Their leaders will think twice before sending more cronies into the gorge.

[soft voice] Oh, and I also found nothing of use in the trader's satchel. [warm] You may keep whatever you find inside.
quest_3402_quest_detail: [commanding] I want you to personally deliver the news of Kovic's defeat to Vizzklick in Gadgetzan. [warm] He will be so happy to hear that Kovic is dead that I'm certain he'll give you some grand reward.
quest_3402_quest_complete:
Kovic slain??! [excited] This is a glorious day, <name>! [warm] For years that scoundrel has been running shady undermarket trades, undercutting honest, hard working traders all over the world.

[proud] You deserve a fine reward for this accomplishment! [delight] And a fine reward you shall have!
quest_3421_quest_complete:
[urgent] I will return you to Sanath's camp now.

Do not mind his bad manners--he is rude to everyone save for the master. [soft voice] Perhaps he shall learn his lesson one day.
quest_3441_quest_complete: [solemn] Have you heard enough? [commanding] Are you prepared to act?
quest_3442_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have made the right decision, <name>.

We must strike where we will do the most damage: the four sentry towers.

With the four towers in flames, we can initiate an offensive before they have time to react.

[urgent] You will need the proper tool to set the towers ablaze. To make the tool requires some materials.

Bring me four hearts of flame and four golem oil and I shall craft the torch of flawless flame.

The golems and elementals in these lands should be your first target.
quest_3442_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] We are almost ready.
quest_3443_quest_detail:
[solemn] To hold the flawless flame, we will need a shaft and a casing. [commanding] You must first find a suitable shaft.

The Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers of the cauldron use weapons of enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy. [urgent] If you bring me eight thorium plated daggers, I can break the alloy down and reforge a shaft.
quest_3443_quest_complete: [gentle] You're an exceptional laborer, <name>. [soft voice] Have you ever considered a change of vocation? [soft voice] Perhaps a detective? [soft voice] Junk collector? [soft voice] Oh, I know, one of those silly gnomes that crawl across the beaches of Azeroth with their metal detecting contraptions, looking for lost treasure. [warm] Yes, that would be an ideal position for you.
quest_3444_quest_detail:
[solemn] I once entered the foreboding chambers of the Sunken Temple. [low voice] The evil in that place penetrates all that enter; I barely managed to find my way out, wading through the ooze that now covers the floors. [pause] All I can remember is stumbling through a large circular room, filled with serpent statues...

[soft voice] Recently, I discovered a round stone that appeared to have the same serpent symbol imprinted on it. [urgent] I had it packed up and shipped to my workshop in Ratchet. Retrieve it, and I might be able to tell you more.
quest_3444_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ratchet is not far from here, <name>. [low voice] The journey shouldn't take long.
quest_3444_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes... [emphasis] This is the stone.

[pause] It's all coming back to me now, <name>...
quest_3445_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.

[soft voice] If you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. [soft voice] Much like Troyas and I, he has studied many ancient areas of the world. [soft voice] He was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in Tanaris.

[soft voice] Good luck finding him; he hasn't been heard from in some time.
quest_3445_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. [soft voice] Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?

[gentle] You look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...
quest_3446_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Inside the temple, I found a circular room with six balconies, each one with a serpent statue on the edge. Curious, I pushed one of them to see what would happen, and it was a trap! [shocked] I nearly fell to my death from the explosion. [pause] Laying there on the ledge, I looked down and noticed that there was another statue at the base of the room; an altar of sorts... [solemn] Hakkar, I think it was called.

[urgent] I think that this altar is the secret -- you must bring this token to the altar in the Sunken Temple.
quest_3446_quest_progress: [soft voice] Upon examining the statue, you notice a depression in its side, just the size of the token that Marvon gave you...
quest_3446_quest_complete:
[urgent] You push the stone circle into the opening, and you hear it lock into place.

[solemn] Now that the stone is in place, you may continue... but what should you do next?

[hesitant] Perhaps you should examine this altar further...
quest_3448_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've recently been handed the responsibility of investigating Azshara--a once beautiful area the elves called home. [soft voice] This would be back when they practiced magic. [low voice] It's now a more dangerous place than it is beautiful, but that doesn't stop us from turning over every stone for answers to our past.

[pause] A companion of mine named Tymor offered to help me investigate the area since he takes a particular interest in such things.

[gentle] He owns a small place to the right of the Hall of Mysteries here in the city.
quest_3448_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, Karnik sent you, did he? I expected to hear from him soon. [solemn] I've discovered such wonderful things about Azshara.. I know night elves have incredible life spans, but everyone forgets some of the more... unfortunate events in their lives sometimes. That's not meant as a criticism, just an observation.

[pause] Long ago, there were cities created by the elves filled with knowledge about magic and other lost arts. [confident] Being a student of such things, I started my investigation. [excited] What I found was quite thrilling.
quest_3449_quest_detail:
[solemn] Magic was once as revered as Elune herself to some elves. [soft voice] Some of their most powerful mages created runes and tablets citing rules of the arcane and insights into their findings. [pause] They would leave these for all to ponder in public places.

[low voice] I would very much like rubbings of these runes from the Ruins of Eldarath. [pause] I have a kit for you to make the rubbings with, but it will be up to you to find them. [hesitant] Be careful though, the Explorer's League isn't the only one interested in Eldarath.
quest_3449_quest_progress:
[excited] Well, well, well, glad to see you made it out here, <name>. [soft voice] Did you get the rubbings for Tymor?

[low voice] As dangerous as this place is, there hasn't been too much action along the coast. [hesitant] That might be on account of the naga swimming underwater, but that's not my problem... [commanding voice] I patrol the skies.
quest_3449_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Good to see you safe and sound, <name>. [warm] I hope things weren't too tough for you.

[urgent] I'll get these to Tymor right away. [excited] He'll be thrilled to take a look at these things.

[warm] Go ahead and toss the flare gun... probably won't be any good to you anymore anyway, and I already got a new one.
quest_3450_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I want the rubbings delivered to my tower, but there's no need to have you go all the way there. I'll just have them air-lifted out of Azshara.

Xiggs Fuselighter owes me a favor or two and will be in the area soon--he's signed on to patrol the coast. Speak to him before you leave. He can give you a flare gun to signal him with. When you have the rubbings, just head to wherever he tells you and then give them to him so he can get them to my tower safely. [commanding] He should be in the hangar in the Military Ward.
quest_3450_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What can I do for you, <name>? [pause] Kinda busy at the moment preparing my ship for a long trip. I just came over to see some of the tank pilots--I need some wendigo manes to line my cockpit and they usually have extra.

[urgent] I can give you a minute if you're brief... one of the boys just took off to Steelgrill's Depot to see if the pilots down there have extra manes for me.
quest_3451_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, so Tymor sent you, huh? Yeah, I owe him a favor or two. [chuckling] What's that? Why, that little devil. Yeah, I can help him out with that. [urgent] So you'll need a flare gun and a location... easy enough.

[pause] There's a small island off the southern peninsula of Azshara that we've made a landing pad on. You take this flare gun, and use it there. I'll see your signal and come by to pick up this... whatever it is he wants.
quest_3451_quest_complete: [gentle] Here's my standard issue flare gun, and be patient after you fire off the gun--there are only a couple charges in one of these, and it might take me a minute to get to you depending on how far out to sea I am. [soft voice] Just look out to sea after you fire off the flare.
quest_3452_quest_detail:
We need one final piece to form the torch.

[solemn] In the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's Hammer. [soft voice] It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. [soft voice] These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. [urgent] Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.
quest_3452_quest_progress: [solemn] Without a suitable source of arcane energy, the torch of retribution cannot be completed.
quest_3452_quest_complete: [solemn] The symbol radiates foul magic; perfectly suited for our task.
quest_3453_quest_detail: [soft voice] Give me a moment to combine the pieces and apply the necessary enchantments.
quest_3453_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not interrupt the channeling process.
quest_3453_quest_complete: [solemn] There is one final task that you must complete.
quest_3454_quest_detail: [solemn] The torch must now be bound to its owner. [soft voice] Pick up the torch, <name>.
quest_3454_quest_complete: [urgent] You grab the torch with both hands; [solemn] waves of hatred and anger pulse through your being.
quest_3461_quest_detail:
Tymor didn't give me anything to pay you with, so I suggest you take it up with him when you get back to Ironforge. [commanding] I'm sure he'll still be in his place in the Mystic Ward. [urgent] Just go knockin' and make sure he pays you good. [sigh] This place ain't no picnic... that's for sure.

[warm] Thanks again for helping him out though, and good luck.

[soft voice] Oh, and I don't need the drawing kit. [hesitant] Why don't you just bring it back to Tymor when you go to see him?
quest_3461_quest_progress: [excited] You're back! [warm] Excellent. Do you have my drawing kit also?
quest_3461_quest_complete:
[excited] Wonderful! I'm so glad to hear it.

[warm] I'm really excited to get to my tower and go over those rubbings. [soft voice] I'm so envious of you... going to a place like Azshara. [solemn] That's any student of the arcane's dream, I would guess.

[warm] Well, we never spoke about any kind of reward since you were just working for the Explorer's League, but you deserve something.
quest_3462_quest_detail: [soft voice] Speak with my envoy, Squire Maltrake. [commanding] He will further instruct you as to the use of the Torch of Retribution.
quest_3462_quest_complete: [urgent] Are you prepared to make your strike?
quest_3463_quest_detail:
[commanding] Listen well, <name>. While the four towers can never be destroyed, you can use the torch of retribution to set them ablaze for a very long period of time: A fire that no element or force can subdue.

[solemn] While they are ablaze, no guard or sentry unit can inhabit the watch posts and thus, their first line of defense is nullified.

[urgent] You must enter each tower and use the Torch of Retribution within their fortifications. Beware the elite sentry units of the Dark Irons, <name>.
quest_3463_quest_complete: [excited] It is glorious! [excited] Is it not glorious master?
quest_3483_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, another flare gun, huh? [warm] That I can do.

[soft voice] And don't forget, southern tip of Azshara. [pause] It's a small little island that's been turned into a landing pad. [soft voice] You can't miss it if you're in the right spot.
quest_3503_quest_complete:
[solemn] There was a time when I could ask whatever I wished from those who sought out my master. [soft voice] But now, you need only ask and I will send you to him.

[sad] It is upsetting to me, but I do not question his orders. [mocking tone] I can only take enjoyment in making fun of the ridiculous clothes you wear or the pathetic look on your face. [sigh] Even that bores me...

[angry] Even this rambling bores me! [urgent] Do you wish to see my master or not?
quest_3504_quest_detail:
[angry] Betraying, thieving woman! [angry] That's what I call her--that's all she'll ever be!

[sad] I may have made a grave mistake, <name>. [sad] I trusted a blood elf. [angry] What's worse, I trusted a woman!

[low voice] She claimed Azshara would hold great riches... powerful items. [low voice] I simply send some warriors with her to protect her and I would be rewarded. [angry] Well, look who's the fool--she's killed them all.

[urgent] I want vengeance, <name>, but I can't afford to send anyone else. [commanding] Find Ag'tor at Valormok, north of the Haldarr Encampment. [solemn] He'll tell you more.
quest_3504_quest_progress:
[solemn] Ah, Belgrom wizened up and finally sent someone not in his ranks to aid us, did he?

[sad] This camp used to be a dozen warriors strong, <name>, but now they're all dead. [angry] That mage, Rimtori, has slain them all. [mocking tone] She played Belgrom like a lute... seduced him even. [soft voice] It's none of my business, but between you and I, she is quite the temptress. [hesitant] That's probably why I'm still out here helping Belgrom--I probably would have done the same thing.
quest_3504_quest_complete:
[solemn] We've sent everything we had at her and her workers, but they are strong in battle. [sad] None have bothered to return. [hesitant] I'm assuming some have died, but I'm sure others simply ran... cowards.

[urgent] But now that reinforcements have arrived, perhaps there's still something we can do. [commanding] Perhaps we can still punish her for lying and betraying Belgrom.

[confident] What do you say, are you in?
quest_3505_quest_detail:
I thought as much.

[solemn] We start our crusade against her workers along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula of Azshara. [commanding] Kill them with bloody rage--let them know they've betrayed the wrong allies.

Do not concern yourself with her yet--she spends most of her time with her bodyguards searching Azshara. [urgent] It would be prudent after you've slain her workers to find her personal camp. [solemn] Scouting out where we can attack her would be wise. Perhaps there is something there we can use to provoke her.
quest_3505_quest_progress:
[solemn] The title of the book is emblazoned on the black leather cover in gold leaf--Kaldorei Tome of Summoning. [soft voice] As you open the pages you can see that the book is very old but in superb condition.

[hesitant] You assume the text is of some ancient language... perhaps Kaldorei?

[commanding] Your instincts tell you that you should return here once you've finished doling out retribution on the blood elves for their betrayal.
quest_3505_quest_complete:
You begin to skim some of the pages until you come to a page that's marked by a thin, black strip of silk cloth.

[solemn] As you try to decipher the script, you see a diagram on the bottom of one of the pages. [emphasis] A quick look around at the scene before you and you realize that the crystals, the circle, and even some of the other components on the ground are set up in a similar pattern as the diagram.
quest_3506_quest_detail: A few more moments of thought brings a few ideas to mind, one of which brings a smile to your face: perhaps destroying the crystals would upset the blood elf responsible for the slaughter of so many orcs and the betrayal of Belgrom?
quest_3507_quest_detail:
[commanding] Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. [urgent] He will want to see her head for himself! [urgent] We'll return there shortly.

[solemn] Ah, this is indeed a good day. [warm] Thank you for your help, <name>.
quest_3507_quest_progress: [solemn] I remember you, <class>. [angry] I asked you to go to Azshara to destroy that wench that betrayed me! [pause] That seems like many moons ago. [urgent] Don't tell me that Ag'tor and the others are dead also!
quest_3507_quest_complete:
[laughing] HAHA! Look at you now, pathetic woman! [angry] I spit on your remains!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Thank you from the bottom of my heart! [excited] This is indeed a great day!

[excited] I would give you a kingdom if it were in my power! [mocking tone] But perhaps you will settle for this.

<Belgrom looks down at the head of the mage who had betrayed him.>

[laughing] Haha! [mocking tone] Stupid blood elf, look at you now... in a burlap sack and missing your body! [threatening] You should never have betrayed Belgrom!
quest_3508_quest_detail:
[commanding] You are foolhardy, <name>. [solemn] It is an admirable quality of your kind - to blindly enter battle when you have little to no chance of success. [low voice] I will assist you, if only to see just one of Razelikh's minions fall.

[solemn] To break the ward placed over Razelikh's subordinates will take time and require the acquisition of rare artifacts.

[soft voice] Be still, I must first perform the enlightenment ritual. [solemn] The information I gather will assist me in forging weapons of great power.
quest_3508_quest_complete: [solemn] The name of the beast must be found.
quest_3509_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one way to harm the demon lord and his minions. [soft voice] A weapon of power must be forged bearing his true name.

[solemn] When such a weapon is forged, the demon and all under his command are vulnerable.

[pause] A lesser deity resides in Azshara: Lord Arkkoroc. [urgent] You must seek him out but be warned, his minions will stop at nothing to destroy you if you are discovered.

[hesitant] Undoubtedly, you will have to pay a price for such information.
quest_3511_quest_progress: [urgent] You return! [excited] Astounding, <race>. [solemn] Did you discover the true name?
quest_3511_quest_complete: [solemn] The temper will add the necessary vitriol we require for the forging of the weapons. [pause] There is but one more step in their creation.
quest_3512_quest_detail:
<name>, our first step will be to devise a method to speak with Eranikus through the gem. [solemn] He lies in a precarious state between sleep and death now, twisted within a weave of nightmares. Though the essence you have given me is badly tainted, there is a chance we can reach him.

[urgent] Travel far to the icy lands of eastern Winterspring and seek one of our mortal allies, Umbranse the Spiritspeaker. He is a human medium who speaks for the dead. [soft voice] Though Eranikus is not truly dead, he may be of aid to us still.
quest_3512_quest_complete:
[solemn] Itharius was wise to send you to me. While he is not dead as you understand death, Eranikus will soon give us advice in his own words. For now though, I cannot directly help you... at least not yet.

[soft voice] I will lend my skill at death-speaking to you, but first I need the help of one who - unlike me - is not limited by the frailties of old age. [sad] My most potent augury device has been taken from me against my will, and unless I have it back we will be at a loss to help Eranikus.
quest_3513_quest_detail:
[solemn] The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. [soft voice] You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

[pause] There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
quest_3513_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well now... Where did you find this?
quest_3514_quest_detail:
[solemn] This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

[low voice] She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. [commanding] The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

<name>, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. [urgent] Take this Horde flag, <name>. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.
quest_3514_quest_progress: [commanding] We cannot allow the Alliance on our land, <name>. [urgent] Make this known.
quest_3514_quest_complete:
[excited] You're a tough one! [proud] Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, <name>. [confident] They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less Alliance runners in the Barrens. [confident] They will think again before sending another this way.

[warm] Thank you.
quest_3517_quest_detail:
[solemn] I admit, <name>, I've made the most of my situation in Azshara. [low voice] Belgrom's punishment has had its share of benefits.

[soft voice] Before I left, I did some research and you would be surprised how many valuable items are lying around.

[urgent] I'll tell you more about my deals, and even give you a cut of the profits, if you help me gather some of them.

[commanding] There are tablets throughout the Ruins of Eldarath to the east that I need. [emphasis] All four are named after Highborne wizards. [urgent] Get them for me and we'll talk some more.
quest_3517_quest_progress:
[low voice] The tablets I'm having you gather should bring in a pretty copper or two to the right parties. [commanding] I'll tell you who we need to deliver them to after you've found them. But I'm no fool... [threatening] you'll get your share after I have proof that they've been delivered.

So get to it--[urgent] we don't have all day. [cold] I might have to find someone else to help me.
quest_3517_quest_complete:
[excited] Perfect, <name>, and in good condition also. [warm] These should get us a good price from all the parties concerned.

[urgent] Let's not dawdle around here any longer than we have to. [confident] We have some money to make.
quest_3518_quest_detail:
[solemn] The first tablet goes to a tauren female... one called Magatha. [soft voice] She is among the elders in Thunder Bluff, and is one of the proponents of the alliance between the tauren and the Forsaken. [low voice] She, more than anyone among the elders, feels the tauren and their ways can help the Forsaken find a path back to being human.

[urgent] Bring her the Tablet of Beth'Amara. [hesitant] The tablet may be the link she needs in finding a way to help the Forsaken... or so she claims.
quest_3518_quest_progress: [solemn] Yes, <name>. [urgent] What can I do for you? I have many matters I must attend to, so please, be quick.
quest_3518_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, at long last, the Tablet of Beth'Amara. [soft voice] I was wondering if my partnership with Jediga had failed or if the poor orc had found her death in Azshara. [warm] I am glad she was successful.

[solemn] Beth'Amara was one of the Highborne's most influential alchemists. [soft voice] The wizard alone was said to have mastered transmuting metals among other things.
quest_3519_quest_detail:
[low voice] Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. [urgent] I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

[soft voice] Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

[urgent] Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
quest_3519_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh dear; [hesitant] I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. [sad] And I've always warned him about those spiders...
quest_3520_quest_detail:
[solemn] I seek the spirits of the vale screechers of Feralas. They are the cousins of an old, old god, and their spirits are linked to him.

[pause] Take this bramble wand and go to Feralas. Find and defeat vale screechers in southern and central Feralas, then wave my bramble over their fallen bodies. This will coax their spirit to reveal itself. Touch the spirit and collect its essence.

Return to me with my bramble and with the collected essence, and I will tell you more of the old god of which I spoke.
quest_3520_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you collected the essence of the screecher spirits, <name>?
quest_3520_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [pause] Perhaps now it is time to reveal more...

There is an ancient prophecy among the trolls, where the dead god Hakkar, the Soulflayer, will one day return to this earth. Some say the coming of Hakkar will bring joy and glory to trollkind, while others believe his resurrection marks the end of all things.

[soft voice] I do not believe this myth, but I do know the essence of Hakkar holds great power, and this power should be kept from those who would abuse it...
quest_3521_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. [pause] It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

[gentle] I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. [soft voice] I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

[solemn] The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. [urgent] From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
quest_3521_quest_progress: [urgent] Please, collect the ingredients, <name>. [solemn] Iverron needs our help.
quest_3521_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

[warm] In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
quest_3522_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The antidote is ready, <name>. [urgent] Please see that Iverron drinks it.

[solemn] There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. [urgent] You must get it to him in time.

[solemn] Speed be with you, <name>.
quest_3522_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh... <name>, I'm so glad you have returned.
quest_3522_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is this, <name>?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote>

[excited] I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

[warm] I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. [hesitant] Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
quest_3523_quest_detail:
[excited] Outstanding! My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me. [sad] I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin. [angry] Yes - I said Scourge all right; they've brokered some sort of deal with the Quilboar here, and this nightmare is a result.

[solemn] Listen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes. [soft voice] Would you be up to helping me out to that end? [hesitant] It's probably dangerous, but you seem to be the type not to worry about that too much.
quest_3523_quest_progress:
I'm not one for politics; I care not if your affiliations are for either Horde or Alliance. [solemn] I am more interested in squelching direct and dire threats to all the races... and we have quite a large one in here.

[urgent] If you're willing to be a true hero for all people, then hand me the oathstone I have given you as a sign of commitment. [hesitant] I'm... not from around these parts; an oathstone is important to people of my kind as a bond of agreement.
quest_3523_quest_complete:
[excited] Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type! [warm] We've got our work cut out for us <name>, I'm not going to lie to you. [confident] If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.

[soft voice] Now, let me bring you up to speed on what's been going on...
quest_3524_quest_detail:
[solemn] Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. [hesitant] Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers. [soft voice] I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.

[solemn] There is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs. [urgent] Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
quest_3524_quest_progress: [solemn] It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers. [hesitant] I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort. [urgent] Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
quest_3524_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us! I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to Darnassus. The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.

[warm] Your success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...
quest_3526_quest_detail:
Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. [solemn] Clearly, goblin engineering is the choice of all brilliant engineers. Learn to master the world through the judicious use of high explosives and fantastic gear!

<name>, read this manual. [commanding] If you want to learn about goblin engineering, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. [urgent] Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.
quest_3526_quest_progress: [commanding] I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. [excited] Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?
quest_3526_quest_complete:
[excited] Well <name>, you were wise to seek my tutelage! [warm] Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of Gnomeregan are proof of that. [commanding] It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of Goblin Engineering.

[urgent] Keep your ears perked <name>, and you might learn something.
quest_3527_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ancient prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of a way to contain the god Hakkar's essence. [soft voice] It was written on two tablets and taken to the troll city of Zul'Farrak, west of Gadgetzan.

[urgent] Bring me the Mosh'aru tablets!

[solemn] The first tablet is held by the long-dead troll Theka the Martyr. [soft voice] It is said his persecutors were cursed into scarabs and now scuttle about his shrine.

[solemn] The second tablet is held by the hydromancer Velratha, near the sacred pool of Gahz'rilla.

[commanding] When you have the tablets, bring them to me.
quest_3527_quest_progress:
[solemn] Do you have the tablets of the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, <name>?

[emphasis] When I gain the tablets, I will study them, and learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar!
quest_3527_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, this is good. I can fuse these ancient tablets together, and then study their hidden secrets.

[soft voice] My debt to you grows, <name>. [low voice] And it will grow further still.
quest_3528_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.

[urgent] Take the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth. [emphasis] Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.

He will send his minions against you. [commanding] Defeat his blood drinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit. [solemn] When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.

[commanding] Defeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
quest_3528_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you defeated the avatar of Hakkar, <name>? [soft voice] Has his essence yet empowered the egg I gave you?
quest_3528_quest_complete:
[solemn] The essence of Hakkar has been collected! [urgent] Even now the Egg stirs with life! [soft voice] Could the myths of Hakkar be true?

[sad] That must not be true, for it is then I fear what Hakkar may do if birthed again. [solemn] I will keep this egg safe and be sure it does not fall into evil hands.

[warm] Your labors with me are finished, <name>. [proud] You have touched a legend, and your actions may one day change the face of our world.
quest_3541_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have a fence in Orgrimmar. He resides in The Drag. [hesitant] He's difficult to nail down if you don't know where to look, but if you go looking in one of the highest buildings there you should have no problem finding him.

Do me a favor though, don't go shouting to all of Kalimdor that he's there and what his business is--it'd be bad for both of us.

He'll give us more than a fair price for the Tablet of Jin'yael. [soft voice] I'm not sure why, but you should have seen how excited he was to hear about its whereabouts.
quest_3541_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, what you be needin', mon? I got many tings to be takin' care of today, and you not be on me agenda as one of them. [threatening] Pester me, and I make sure that changes.
quest_3541_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ahhh, Jediga be sendin' her package all the way from Azshara. Good. I be waitin' on this.

Jediga, now that be a fine woman... deadly too. What could be better?

Look at this... the tablet be in perfect condition. [warm] You make a good messenger, <name>.
quest_3542_quest_detail:
[solemn] Andron Gant is my next contact. He usually holds himself up in the Undercity... right near the Apothecarium.

[whispering] He was a little more loose-lipped when it came to speaking about what he wanted the Tablet for. [soft voice] Apparently some of the mages of Undercity are looking to study some of the arcane spells the highborne used. [solemn] They think this tablet will help them. [low voice] Markri was adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals.

[urgent] Take the Tablet of Markri and return to me for your part of the reward.
quest_3542_quest_progress:
[hesitant] Well... ... isn't this a surprise? [surprised] An adventurererere... !

[soft voice] What c'n I do for you... ?
quest_3542_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Here, take some coin... get yerself... <hic>... some new armor or something....

[warm] This'll bring a shiny gold or two to the right... <hic> people.
quest_3561_quest_detail:
[solemn] This final tablet goes to someone very dangerous, <name>. [whispering] Heed me when I tell you that I trust this person far less than anyone else I've asked you to meet with.

Archmage Xylem has a tower up in the hills overlooking Azshara. He's human, but he acts like no human I've met... or killed. [low voice] He exudes power, and I dare not ask him what he plans on doing with the tablet.

[hesitant] He came to me, but told me that his bodyguard Sanath would help me get to the tower when I was ready to meet him. [urgent] Look north for Sanath.
quest_3561_quest_progress: [soft voice] What can I help you with, <name>?
quest_3561_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Tablet of Sael'hai... how long I've longed to study it.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You may tell Jediga that she has done well. [proud] This will definitely be worth the payment she asked for.
quest_3562_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take this note to Jediga. [soft voice] Tell her the payment will be here for her when she returns. [commanding] And tell her I am pleased with her work.

[urgent] Go swiftly, <name>. [solemn] Tell your master I will be awaiting her here.
quest_3562_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, what did Magatha say? [sad] The old crone... I bet she was less than polite.
quest_3562_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, good. She was much more reasonable than I expected... at least towards you. I half expected her to have you punished for my insolence in sending someone in my place. She must really want that tablet. [solemn] Interesting. Something to ponder another time.
quest_3563_quest_detail:
[urgent] Take this letter to Jediga. [solemn] Let her know that our deal has been beneficial and I be pleased with her work.

[commanding] You tell her she come back to Orgrimmar fast and Jes'rimon make sure he take good care of her.

[soft voice] Tell her that, and maybe in the future I have need of your services again, <name>.
quest_3563_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Have you spoken to Jes'rimon yet?

[angry] He's a boar among trolls, but his information is usually accurate and his jobs well paying.

[hesitant] If you can stand his attitude then you stand to make some good coin from his business endeavors.
quest_3563_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I can see he was more than pleased by the looks of his note.... [whispering] a little too pleased.

[hesitant] Perhaps some day I'll take time to make sure he knows how much I appreciate his advances also. [warm] Well, at least there's one reason to look forward to spending more time in Azshara.

[proud] Here's your share of our payment.
quest_3564_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here... take... <hic> this to Jediga. [excited] Good luck to ya!
quest_3564_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you met with Andron yet? [hesitant] He rarely leaves Undercity, so I don't think it'd be too hard to find him.
quest_3564_quest_complete:
Perfect... wait a minute.

[laughing] Haha! What'd you tell him when you delivered the tablet, <name>? He overpaid us way too much! Not that I'm complaining. Did you tell him the deal changed? Or was he drunk again?

Doesn't matter... here, take an extra share also.
quest_3565_quest_detail:
[urgent] What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course.

Take this and be off with you. [soft voice] I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.
quest_3565_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, what did Xylem have to say? [hesitant] He didn't do anything to you, did he? [hesitant] Cast a spell on you? [hesitant] Con you into doing work for him?
quest_3565_quest_complete:
No problems? None at all? Well, that's something to be said... I expected him to show some sort of reluctance or to at least betray our deal. Hmm, maybe he can be trusted after all.

Well, no need to dwell on it that much. Here's your share. [warm] Thank you for your help.
quest_3566_quest_detail:
[exhale] It... It... It was all a trap.

[sad] Forgive... me. [urgent] Kill the bastard... Kill him for us... for Thorius.
quest_3566_quest_progress: [angry] I don't believe you! [urgent] Show me proof!
quest_3566_quest_complete:
<Thorius' face turns white.> [shocked] This... this cannot be. [angry] My own brother? He set this all up?

<Thorius' face contorts in anger.>
