He betrayed me, he betrayed Ironforge! [solemn] It seems as if the influence of the Old Gods is still strong in these lands. [sad] I fear that if my brother - a once noble and honorable man - was so easily turned to the will of Ragnaros, no one is safe.
quest_3567_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Would you like to see the view atop one of the twin colossals? [warm] I can send you there, <race>.

[hesitant] Do consider how you will get down, though. [commanding] This is a one way trip only.
quest_3568_quest_detail:
[soft voice] See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.

After fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.

[solemn] I'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.
quest_3568_quest_progress: [solemn] You know where this is leading, don't you, <name>? [sad] There's no way she can survive... look at her. [soft voice] The best thing for her now is to aid us in finding a cure for the plague. [hesitant] This water she drank might have a clue that helps us figure out how. [sad] She's going to die anyway--she might as well die doing something noble for our people before she does. [pause] Don't you agree?
quest_3568_quest_complete:
Wonderful. [warm] You're back before she died. Good, good.

Let's get started on this then, shall we?

I've been studying her symptoms for some time now, and it's quite ugly. [sigh] I'm surprised she's still standing. She's vomited three or four times all over the place... quite a pleasant odor.

Give me just a moment to put something together to test on our... friend.
quest_3569_quest_detail: [soft voice] Give this to Thersa. [hesitant] Perhaps it will cure her... [hesitant] perhaps not. [hesitant] We really won't know until after she drinks it.
quest_3569_quest_progress:
[solemn] I've come to Undercity because I heard their alchemists have been studying long and hard on how to find a cure for their own illness. [soft voice] It was suggested that perhaps they could help me too.

[hesitant] Although this place makes me feel far from welcome, I had no choice--the sickness that found me is tearing me up inside and I needed their help immediately.
quest_3569_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Chemist Cuely has been very accommodating... disturbingly so. [hesitant] But if he says this will help me, then I have no other choice. [urgent] I don't have time to find any other solution. [solemn] I've already spoken to priests and shamans, none of which could help me.

[solemn] Let us hope that the Earthmother watches over my spirit.
quest_3570_quest_progress: [solemn] You know where this is leading, don't you, <name>? [sad] There's no way she can survive... look at her. The best thing for her now is to aid us in finding a cure for the plague. [hesitant] This water she drank might have a clue that helps us figure out how. [low voice] She's going to die anyway--she might as well die doing something noble for our people before she does. [pause] Don't you agree?
quest_3570_quest_complete: [soft voice] I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [urgent] I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. [confident] I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken soon enough.
quest_3578_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, I've been expecting my Rah'pawene, Samantha Swifthoof and she's yet to come! [hesitant] I'm confused... Can you help me and find her? [soft voice] Last time we spoke she was so much excited to see the new places and travel at her leisure from a port to some distant forests and northern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms, alas, the only port I know nearby is the Ratchet.

[sad] I'm most certain Samantha braved to the ferry and swam to the Booty Bay.

[pause] Where could she travel to from there I do not know. [gentle] Perhaps you could find her for me? Just to be sure she's fine...
quest_3578_quest_progress: [excited] There's so many places I'd love to see! [soft voice] Can you help?
quest_3578_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, traveller? Forgive me, but I'm so exhausted with my journey I can barely move my hoof...

[pause] But there's so many places I'd love to see! [excited] Can you help?
quest_3579_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Yes, I've travelled this far on my own hooves and yes I'm very tired, alas, my wanderlust is too strong to be ignored, I just can not stop and be idle even for a minute knowing that so many roads are to be discovered and forests traversed and plains to be run over... [excited] oh, the world is so vast, I could travel all my life!

[pause] However, as you can see, I'm falling down from all the hoofwork I've endured to the moment.

[sad] Oh, if only I could have our famous Compressing Bandage to aid my muscles to feel well again!
quest_3579_quest_progress:
[excited] Ah, so nice of you!

[warm] I'm glad you are so eager to help me, thank you!
quest_3579_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, I've been expecting you! Were you able to get those herbs and cloth for me? [warm] Thank you! With these I'll be able to make this Compressing Bandage and I will surely be able to travel even further!
quest_3580_quest_detail:
[excited] I feel so much better now! So invigorated and excited! Oh, this is wonderful!

[warm] Thank you, <name>, thank you so much.

[soft voice] Besides the strength of the will and very durable hooves you will need a Blessing of the Wind to help you run as fast as all of us Swifthoof do! [solemn] I know just a tauren who can guide you on this.

His name is Jorn Skyseer. Last time I spoke to him was at the Camp Taurajo in Southern Barrens. [sigh] Ahh, the Golden Road, so luring...
quest_3580_quest_progress: [urgent] Go swiftly, young one! [solemn] Saern will help you only with the Blessing holding on you! [urgent] Run!
quest_3580_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Winds led you to me I see. [soft voice] I've been expecting you.

[warm] Samantha Swifthoof sent you, of course. [soft voice] Girl did very well to travel further than Mulgore and Barrens. [solemn] I'm only glad she found help even at the continent so far from here in your actions, honorable deed should always be rewarded.

[solemn] There's an expert on Plainsrunning skill resides at the Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff you should see, her name is Saern Priderunner.

[soft voice] She can teach you on how you should handle your body for Plainsrunning only when you have your spirit high with the Blessing of the Wind.

[urgent] Reach her while the Blessing is still supporting your spirit and body!

[loud voice] The Blessing of the Wind be bestowed upon you! [solemn] Al'akir, hear my plea and grant this tauren swiftness of your gales and strength of your storms!
quest_3581_quest_detail:
[solemn] Imagine yourself racing across the plains, through forests and over mountains, the wind in your face... Traveling over unseen territory; the wonder of the road ahead, your destiny resting just over the horizon.

[soft voice] Always remember that on hoof, many things are achievable; as a Tauren, you will be granted the swiftness of Plainsrunning. [warm] There is no limit to the distances you might go.
quest_3581_quest_complete: [excited] There is no limit to the distances you might go!
quest_3601_quest_detail:
[commanding voice] Kim'jael indeed!! Do you know what Kim'jael means to the Blood elves, <name>? [sad] Little rat... or something like that. [angry] The big bullies!

They hired me to help them scout the area looking for some sort of lost treasures. Of course I jumped aboard the moment they said "treasure" and the amount they were willing to pay, but of course, they turned on me and tried to kill me... ME!

[shouting] Goes to show you, you can't trust a Blood elf.

The problem is, they still have my equipment and I can't get it back. [hesitant] Help me out?
quest_3601_quest_progress: [angry] Those stinkin' Blood elves. I tell ya, if I was as strong as you are, I'd go down there and teach them a thing or two myself! But I'll have to settle with payin' you to take care of 'em for me.
quest_3601_quest_complete:
[laughing] Haha! You got them good, didn't you?!

[excited] This is great! [angry] That'll teach those Blood elves to betray their partners... especially someone as loyal as a goblin merchant! [angry] Bah, Blood elves...!

[warm] Well, the least I can do for you is pay you for your time... just like I said I would.

[soft voice] Here you go... those should be useful.
quest_3602_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ancient cliff giants of the southern region of Azshara consume the rock and buildings of the land for sustenance. The excrement from their consumption is a highly malleable and extremely strong crystal known as Azsharite.

The formations litter the southern arc, but few are ever recovered due to the extremely violent nature of the giants.

[urgent] You are to venture south and recover enough of the Azsharite for the creation of the weapon's body. [commanding] My felhounds will aid in the recovery of the crystal.
quest_3602_quest_progress: [threatening] Evil does not sleep, fool. You will have time for rest when you are finally dead. [commanding] Now, bring me those crystals.
quest_3602_quest_complete: [solemn] Your tasks in Azshara are complete, mortal. [soft voice] I must now forge the necessary components for the next step in your adventure.
quest_3621_quest_detail:
[solemn] The weapons are ready to be forged. [soft voice] You must take the tempered azsharite to one with the ability to harness fel energy.

[solemn] In Stranglethorn Vale such a blacksmith exists. [solemn] Galvan the Ancient, leader of the Mithril Order, will craft the weapons to your specifications. [solemn] You will find his encampment between Zul'Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.

[solemn] May your determination and faith carry you through this ordeal. [threatening] Should you fail, know that your God smiles down upon you, mortal.
quest_3621_quest_progress: [solemn] Loramus, eh? [pause] It has been many years since I have heard that name.
quest_3621_quest_complete: [soft voice] My goodness, I can only imagine what you went through to get these materials. Few venture into Azshara and return alive, let alone those that face demi-gods and giants!
quest_3625_quest_detail:
<name>, the creation of each weapon will take some time.

Additionally, you may only use the power of the Felcurse once per three minutes. Its weakening properties against Razelikh the Defiler and his minions may be variable in duration. [solemn] This is why you must release the Felcurse only when the moment is right!

[commanding] Now give me a moment to craft your weapon, <name>.
quest_3625_quest_progress: [solemn] To interrupt the forging process could result in an imperfect weapon. [soft voice] Be patient, <name>.
quest_3625_quest_complete: <Galvan wipes the sweat from his brow.> [confident] A finer demon slayer has never existed, <name>.
quest_3626_quest_detail: [solemn] The hour of redemption is near, <name>. [urgent] You must return to the Blasted Lands with your new-found weaponry and speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde to receive your final objective.
quest_3626_quest_complete: [commanding] You look battle hardened, <name>. [urgent] Are you prepared to face Razelikh and his minions?
quest_3627_quest_detail:
[solemn] To reach the Defiler, you must first destroy the triad of power and recover the amulet pieces. [urgent] When you recover all three pieces, return to me and I shall give you further instruction.

[commanding] Go <name>! [urgent] To the Blasted Lands! [angry] Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol must fall!
quest_3627_quest_progress: [solemn] The three shall form the one, the one shall light the way.
quest_3627_quest_complete: [solemn] The amulet of Razelikh the Defiler is once again complete but he senses the disruption in his chain of command. [threatening] He knows you come for him...
quest_3628_quest_detail:
[solemn] Razelikh's lair is atop the highest mountain in the Blasted Lands. The only way to the lair is through the use of the teleport runes near the mountain. As long as you hold the amulet, you can freely transport up to the lair. Once you reach the lair, you must conjure the beast. The amulet is your key, <name>. [commanding] Use it on the Altar of the Defiler.

Should you defeat the Defiler, bring back his horn. [warm] It will become a symbol of hope for all that view it - proof that heroes do exist in this war torn world.
quest_3628_quest_progress: [solemn] There is nothing left to fear.
quest_3628_quest_complete: [solemn] Today is a day that will be remembered for all eternity. [excited] The demonic overlord of the Blasted Lands has finally fallen!
quest_3629_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. [low voice] I only bother to mention goblin engineering because I'm a fair trainer. [chuckling] They like to make things that blow up, and they rarely care what is in the way - even themselves.

[gentle] <name>, read this manual. [urgent] If you want to learn how to blow yourself up, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. [solemn] Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.
quest_3629_quest_progress: [commanding] I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. [soft voice] Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?
quest_3629_quest_complete:
[excited] Well <name>, you were wise to seek my tutelage! Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of Gnomeregan are proof of that. [commanding] It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of Goblin Engineering.

[urgent] Keep your ears perked <name>, and you might learn something.
quest_3630_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. [hesitant] While I think it is a waste, you should be aware of gnome specialization. [solemn] They make items and gadgets that claim to change the world, but rarely often work.

<name>, read this manual. [urgent] If you wish to learn how to make metal paper weights, then take that manual to Tinkmaster Overspark in the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task!
quest_3630_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes, yes, what needs of yours might I address today? [sigh] Clearly, I have the time to do such since all I do is stand here while our beloved city lies in a cloud of irradiated death.
quest_3630_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, a young engineer interested in pursuing the one, true discipline of engineering! [chuckling] Well forgive my melodrama, friend. While our situation remains dire, it still is always a good day to see another engineer respond to the clarion call of true engineering!
quest_3631_quest_detail:
Hmph. [commanding] I say you're not prepared, but that is not my decision. [low voice] Strahad feels otherwise, and it is his decision to make... this time.

[urgent] He wishes to speak to you, and quickly. [commanding] You'll find him still above Ratchet in the Barrens, at his little tower there with his acolytes.

[urgent] Do not dawdle long.
quest_3631_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you've decided to grace my presence again. [soft voice] How kind of you.

My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. [commanding] When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.

[commanding] <name>, read this manual. [commanding] If you want to learn about goblin engineering, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. [solemn] Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.

quest_3635_quest_progress: [excited] Hello there! [soft voice] If you've come about a homing robot that may have smashed through a wall of your domicile, then I will refer you to my barrister in advance. [hesitant] Otherwise, what can I do for you today?
quest_3635_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've come to learn about gnome engineering, eh? [warm] Well, you've come to the right gnome. [solemn] While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.

[proud] They and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. [confident] If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.
quest_3636_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Scourge is a persistent threat to the Alliance, a fact I am sure you know quite well. [soft voice] Recently, we have come across some very peculiar findings, <name>.

In the Barrens lies a horrid tangle of briars called Razorfen Downs. While once it was the home of simple quilboar, now it has become apparent that a pact was made with the Scourge, creating creatures far worse... They are now ruled by the lich, Amnennar the Coldbringer.

[commanding] Align yourself with the Light, <name>; put an end to this evil union.
quest_3636_quest_progress: [solemn] Amnennar must be eradicated. [urgent] Go, swiftly.
quest_3636_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you , <name>. [warm] The Scourge will now think twice before attempting to bolster its ranks again.

[solemn] May you be blessed by the Light.
quest_3637_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. [hesitant] While I think it is a waste, you should be aware of gnome specialization. [low voice] They make items and gadgets that claim to change the world, but rarely work.

<name>, read this manual. [urgent] If you wish to learn how to make metal paper weights, then take the manual to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay. [solemn] Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task.
quest_3637_quest_progress: [excited] Hello there! [soft voice] If you've come about a homing robot that may have smashed through a wall of your domicile, then I will refer you to my barrister in advance. [hesitant] Otherwise, what can I do for you today?
quest_3637_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've come to learn about gnome engineering, eh? [warm] Well, you've come to the right gnome. [solemn] While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.

[proud] They and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. [gentle] If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.
quest_3638_quest_detail:
[excited] Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power! [commanding] Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.

[soft voice] The manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. [urgent] Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that. [cold] There is no access to gnome engineering at all.

[urgent] If you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. [hesitant] Think about it carefully, <name>.
quest_3638_quest_progress: [urgent] If you've signed the document and are ready to hand it to me, then that is that. [solemn] You've been told that this is a one way trip. [excited] If you're ready, then hop on board!
quest_3638_quest_complete:
[excited] Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer <name>! [warm] You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

[soft voice] Now that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. [confident] From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!
quest_3639_quest_detail:
[commanding] As your mentor, I want samples of your work. You're a skilled engineer; there is no question of this, <name>. [urgent] What I hope to do though is analyze them for ways to emphasize goblin-oriented techniques in your future efforts. I need the following: twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep - and keep the safeties armed!

[excited] Submit these items to me and I will issue you your own Goblin Engineer Membership Card; it is required for access to all goblin engineering trainers!
quest_3639_quest_progress: [excited] Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, I will hand you a genuine Goblin Engineer Membership Card! [warm] So long as the card is valid, you will have unlimited access to any goblin engineer trainer anywhere in the world.
quest_3639_quest_complete:
[delight] Here is your first Goblin Engineer Membership Card!

[warm] This card has its dues paid for in advance for fourteen days; all cards expire after two weeks of activity. [commanding] When it does, pay your next set of dues to any goblin engineer trainer in order to get another card; without the card, your membership will temporarily lapse and you cannot access new schemata.

[solemn] This never affects what you already know; once a goblin engineer, always a goblin engineer.
quest_3640_quest_detail:
[excited] Gnome engineering is about engineering theory shaped to serve our needs! [soft voice] Our schemata allow us to make devices that control the world around us; the manual you read covered this.

[solemn] The manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. [commanding] Once you become a gnome engineer, that's that. [urgent] There is no access to goblin engineering at all.

[soft voice] If you still want to become a gnome engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. [hesitant] Think about it carefully, <name>.
quest_3640_quest_progress:
[soft voice] If you've signed the document and are ready to hand it to me, then that is that.

[solemn] The secrets I will share with you are of such a magnitude that the signing of the Pledge of Secrecy is absolutely critical. [low voice] I signed one, as did my brother and sister gnome engineers. [warm] You will be joining quite the auspicious fold, Engineer <name>!

quest_3661_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Wildkin are quite unpredictable creatures, <name>. Capable of incredible gentleness, these creatures will show extreme ferocity if something they deem important is threatened.

[solemn] These beasts are rumored to have been created by Elune, and I am interested in finding if this is really the truth.

[pause] Recently, I heard about a population of wildkin living in the Hinterlands -- Vicious, Primitive, and Savage Owlbeasts. They can be found amongst the wildlife there. [gentle] Will you gather some wildkin feathers for me?
quest_3661_quest_progress: [soft voice] Try to avoid them if you can, <name>. The Wildkin may misread your interest as an intent to do them harm...
quest_3661_quest_complete:
[gentle] Thank you for bringing these to me, <name>.

[soft voice] What did you learn of the Wildkin?

Perhaps these feathers will tell us more. [solemn] Ferocious monsters, or simply misguided pets? [pause] One day I'd like to know the truth...

[solemn] I am going to continue my research -- [soft voice] please come back and talk to me again after some time has passed.
quest_3681_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Sorry to interrupt your travels, <race>, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.

[solemn] If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.

[emphasis] Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.
quest_3681_quest_complete: [solemn] Welcome to the Cathedral of Light, <class>.
quest_3701_quest_detail:
Venture to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and gather as much information as possible.

[solemn] It is said that mysterious relics litter the ruins. [soft voice] Perhaps you should start your search there, <name>. [urgent] Beware the Thaurissan guardians: Assassins that guard the ruins, keeping whatever secrets may still be buried there protected.
quest_3701_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh my! [soft voice] This information explains quite a lot about Thaurissan.

[solemn] There is much more to learn!
quest_3702_quest_detail: [soft voice] Would you like to hear a brief history of the Dark Iron dwarves?
quest_3702_quest_progress: [solemn] Allow me to finish telling you the story of Thaurissan.
quest_3721_quest_complete:
[excited] You've recovered three of my OOX homing robots! [warm] You've gone above and beyond what you needed to, so I will give you something special for all your help. [proud] It is a miniature version of the very same robot that you have come to know and love, the OOX!

[soft voice] I normally wouldn't let anyone have such a potentially lethal device, but you've been a real help. [gentle] Besides - the combat mechanisms and the homing logic on this one have been disabled.

[delight] Other than that, it's an OOX by golly!
quest_3741_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it. [hesitant] We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already. The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake. [hesitant] Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.

[gentle] Could you find it for her, please?
quest_3741_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hi. [sad] I miss my necklace. My daddy got it for me. [sad] Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake. [hesitant] Did you beat up any monsters?
quest_3741_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for finding my necklace mister <class>... [warm] you are very kind! [gentle] My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
quest_3761_quest_detail:
[solemn] The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. [soft voice] The Cenarion Circle wants to study this soil in large quantities; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough of it for our continued research.

[pause] The rich soil will stick out in piles from time to time, and some of the beasts might have usable samples on their being. Take them all outside to Ghede; just look for the piles of dirt and the tauren barking orders. [gentle] He means well, just don't get him riled up though!
quest_3761_quest_progress: [commanding] At ease, Private. [urgent] If you're here to unload soil from Un'Goro - outstanding then! [angry] Otherwise, disappear.
quest_3761_quest_complete:
[commanding] Oh that's right Private <name>, don't make any effort to help me unload this soil up on to the piles! If the Great Spirits had wanted it done they would have miracled it up there, now wouldn't they?!

[solemn] Arch Druid Runetotem wants to speak with you again, but for his next task you find that a journeyman's understanding of Herbalism would be helpful. If you don't know it though, he'll still find a use for you.
quest_3762_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me <class>, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

[solemn] The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. [pause] While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.

[gentle] Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
quest_3762_quest_complete: [solemn] Greetings, <class>; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. [soft voice] There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. [hesitant] Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.
quest_3763_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me <class>, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

[solemn] The Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. [soft voice] While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.

[warm] Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within Darnassus proper.
quest_3763_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well now, <class>... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.

[commanding] Now that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
quest_3764_quest_detail:
[solemn] The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. [soft voice] I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.

[commanding] You may think that collection tasks are beneath you; that sort of attitude does not endear yourself to me or the Cenarion Circle. [urgent] Bring the samples to Jenal, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt. [low voice] He will handle the logistics - not I.
quest_3764_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah yes, the dirt. The Arch Druid wants twenty loads per adventurer, and twenty loads he shall get. [angry] Let those who conspire against us fall to the wayside!
quest_3764_quest_complete:
Unload your precious cargo here, noble <class>. [soft voice] It must have been quite the burden... not unlike the burden I carry being a visionary. [solemn] Here is an honorarium for your work, as dictated by the Arch Druid himself.

[warm] Arch Druid Staghelm wants to speak with you again <name>, but for his next task you will be aided if you have a journeyman's understanding of Herbalism. [gentle] If you don't know it though, you will still be able to aid the Circle!
quest_3765_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Stormwind -- such a bustling hub of activity.

[pause] I have traveled from afar to seek help. [hesitant] Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.

[solemn] My brother, Gershala, requires assistance in Darkshore. [soft voice] He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.

[solemn] The journey is a long and epic one. [solemn] It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned <class> such as yourself.
quest_3765_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, so my brother, Argos, sent you? [pause] I realize you must be weary from your travels. [gentle] But we have much to talk about.
quest_3781_quest_detail:
[solemn] With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater. [soft voice] These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs. [emphasis] One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.

[urgent] Take this to Mathrengyl downstairs, and he will give you some seeds so you can get started. [hesitant] If you run out, you will need to purchase more from him.
quest_3781_quest_progress: [solemn] Peace and serenity be yours, friend. [soft voice] You are here on business from the Arch Druid himself, yes?
quest_3781_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. [solemn] Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. [solemn] This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.

[warm] Those who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch Druid offers far makes up for the cost.
quest_3782_quest_detail:

[warm] Take this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.

quest_3783_quest_detail:
[excited] My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! [delight] I just drew up the plans for something great! [whispering] If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret...

[excited] I'm going to make a mechanical yeti! [laughing] Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!

[urgent] I need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti to start with. [soft voice] Will you help? You'll find them to the southeast.
quest_3783_quest_progress: [urgent] I've got lots to get started on here. [excited] Please get me those furs as soon as you can!
quest_3783_quest_complete: [delight] These furs are perfect, <name>. [excited] We're off to a great start here!

quest_3785_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with. You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds. Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.

[solemn] When you have enough morrowgrain, bring them here to me in the enclave. [gentle] Please don't bother the Arch Druid; he's a very busy man, and he doesn't need to be disturbed every time someone returns with another batch of morrowgrain!
quest_3785_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes <name>, have you grown some morrowgrain for the Arch Druid's important research? [solemn] The mysterious properties of Un'Goro Crater become clearer with each passing day, thanks to the help you are giving us.
quest_3785_quest_complete:
[gentle] Well done <name>, I will be sure to give these to the Arch Druid himself when he has need of them. [warm] Meanwhile, please accept this as a token of the Cenarion Circle's appreciation.

[solemn] Our need for morrowgrain, for now, is constant; if you wish to continue aiding us, then please return when you have cultivated more of it.

quest_3787_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, friend...

[pause] A colleague of mine would like to speak with you about the research you are doing in conjunction with the Cenarion Circle. He is a druid by the name of Quintis Jonespyre, and he resides in Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas. He would like to confer with you about morrowgrain... and he very much would like for you to keep our discussion from the ears of the Arch Druid.

If you're interested, speak with him; no doubt, all will be revealed once you do.
quest_3787_quest_complete:
[solemn] I thank you for coming, weary traveler! [soft voice] Allow me to introduce myself - I am Quintis Jonespyre, druid and humble servant of Malfurion and the Cenarion Circle. [pause] My colleagues (General Shandris Feathermoon and the Protectorate - mayhap you've heard of us) and I wanted to talk with you about the work you are doing for Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

[pause] Before we get much further, I'd like to ask that our discussion stay between just us. [soft voice] If you have no problem with this, then we may proceed.

[gentle] Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within Darnassus proper.
quest_3789_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well now, <class>... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.

[commanding] Now that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
quest_3790_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me <class>, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

[solemn] The Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. [pause] While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.

[gentle] Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within Darnassus proper.
quest_3790_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well now, <class>... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.

[solemn] Now that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
quest_3791_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Let me to be frank with you, <name>. [solemn] I'm interested - nay, concerned with why the Arch Druid in Darnassus is using the name of the Cenarion Circle as well as the Circle's resources to procure vast amounts of morrowgrain. [low voice] I'm a researcher - curses are my specialty. [hesitant] I've heard that morrowgrain, under the right conditions, exude qualities like other herbs used in primitive curses.

[solemn] I want to know more, and I ask for your help. [warm] Bring me ten morrowgrain, and I will be sure to take care of you.
quest_3791_quest_progress: [soft voice] I'm looking for ten morrowgrain - that should be enough to at least get my research started. [hesitant] I'll no doubt burn through a lot of those going down wrong paths, but such is the nature of research.
quest_3791_quest_complete:
[groan] Gah, these morrowgrain make me feel... weird. What in the name of Elune is Staghelm up to with these things?

[warm] Anyway, thank you again for your help. [soft voice] Here's a little something... you know, for the effort. [hesitant] My research on morrowgrain is going to take a while, and I no doubt am going to need more. While I'm at it, I suppose I could take the time to see if morrowgrain have some pertinent alchemical uses. [sad] Still, I feel uncomfortable even being around them.
quest_3792_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [soft voice] My research is progressing fairly well, but if you have five more Morrowgrain I'd be happy to take them off your hands. [hesitant] Well... happy is a figurative term in this case; the more I am around them, the more uncomfortable I feel. [solemn] Still, my research demands I buckle down and get through this. Morrowgrain(5)
quest_3792_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thanks <name>; I'll just store these out of the way for the time being. While I don't command the resources that Staghelm does, I am able to give you a little something for your trouble. [warm] Anyway, who knows what will happen if Staghelm keeps getting Morrowgrain after Morrowgrain. There's something fishy going on, mark my words.

[solemn] Remember that I'm always looking for more Morrowgrain. I'll take them in quantities of five at a time.
quest_3802_quest_detail: <The voice of Franclorn Forgewright speaks to you again.> [solemn] You will find Fineous Darkvire beyond the Ring of Law, in the Hall of Crafting. [angry] Kill the miserable cur and recover Ironfel.
quest_3803_quest_progress: [solemn] The Arch Druid is always looking for additional morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's continued research. [soft voice] We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful. [urgent] When you have ten, let me know and I will reward you accordingly. Morrowgrain(10)
quest_3803_quest_complete:
[delight] Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt please the Arch Druid. [soft voice] I must admit though... just being near them makes me feel a little uncomfortable. [hesitant] I can only imagine how difficult it is for the Arch Druid to tolerate them in such large numbers!

[warm] This is for you, <name>. [solemn] The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.
quest_3804_quest_progress: [solemn] The Arch Druid is always looking for more morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's research project on Un'Goro Crater. [soft voice] We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful. [warm] When you have ten, let me know and I will award you accordingly. Morrowgrain(10)
quest_3804_quest_complete:
[solemn] Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt help when the time comes. [soft voice] We know that the night elves are conducting similar research into these herbs, though it isn't clear to what end they will use them for if they discover anything. [solemn] The Arch Druid thinks that the need for morrowgrain will remain until we've figured out the mysteries behind this herb.

[warm] This is for you, <name>. [warm] The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.
quest_3821_quest_detail:
[solemn] Sha'ni was sent to investigate reports of strange ritualistic activity coming from the Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes over three weeks ago.

Goretooth tells me that he hasn't heard from anyone in that platoon and that it's best that I move on and focus on the task at hand. [angry] Can you believe it? That's my wife!

I can't leave my post, <name>, but I must know what became of Sha'ni. [urgent] Travel to the Burning Steppes and search for her.
quest_3821_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My poor Thal'trak.

[sad] We were planning on moving in with my mother and father in the Hinterlands after our tours were over. [angry] Now those plans are ruined!
quest_3822_quest_detail:
[solemn] My whole platoon was captured, <name>. All were slain - except me.

Their leader, Krom'Grul, wanted to save me for some sort of ritual.

I was chained to this altar and brutalized by the beast. My physical being ceased functioning after an hour of this torture. The beast then ripped my wedding nose-ring off of my face and stuck it on his finger. [angry] I had never seen such savagery!

[urgent] Find Krom'Grul and kill him! Take my ring back to Thal'trak.

And <name>, tell him that we will meet again... in another life.
quest_3822_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find Sha'ni? [soft voice] Is she ok?
quest_3822_quest_complete:
<Thal'trak collapses.> [solemn] We were going to move to the Hinterlands. Did she tell you? [sad] This was going to be her last mission.

<Thal'trak sobs.>

[angry] I don't want it, <name>. Keep it, throw it away, I don't care! [sad] The ring means nothing to me now. Not without her...
quest_3823_quest_detail:
[urgent] We must strike at our enemies before they strike at us!

[commanding] I'll make this brief, soldier.

[solemn] The Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes are allies of the Blackrock orcs. [low voice] They work closely with those vile orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times.

[commanding] Leave your mark, <name>. [urgent] Cripple their forces and return to me when the job is done.

<Oralius grabs at the air and makes a choking motion.>

[angry] I WILL KILL YOU, WINKY!
quest_3823_quest_progress: [angry] There is not nearly enough blood on your uniform, soldier!
quest_3823_quest_complete: [excited] Outstanding, soldier! [proud] The orcs and ogres will be reeling from this blow for minutes, maybe even hours!
quest_3824_quest_detail:
[urgent] They're reeling I tell you! [commanding] Our next strike must be decisive.

[solemn] The brute lord, Gor'tesh, must be slain. [soft voice] More importantly, his head must be returned to me so that I may prepare the third phase of our attack on the Firegut ogres.

Be warned, soldier, Gor'tesh rules not from Dreadmaul Rock but from a Blackrock orc structure to the west of Dreadmaul Rock.

[commanding] Your orders, then, are simple. [urgent] Find Gor'tesh and chop off his fat head. [soft voice] Return to me when the job is done.

[angry] SHUT UP, WINKY!
quest_3824_quest_progress: [excited] Oh glorious day! [urgent] Have you returned with the head?
quest_3824_quest_complete: [commanding] Just look at it, soldier. Disgusting! [excited] When the remaining Firegut ogres see this fat mug stuck on a pike sitting at the top of their mountain, mass hysteria will ensue! <Oralius cackles wildly.>
quest_3841_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, hello, <name>. [soft voice] I'm so glad to see you again. [soft voice] How was your trip to Darnassus?

[soft voice] Well, you'll be happy to know that we've made quite a bit of progress while you've been gone. [soft voice] We even saved a nest full of eggs. [sad] Unfortunately, the mother died before we got to her.

[soft voice] Say, would you want one for a pet? [soft voice] They look to hatch soon, so they'll need a good father. [soft voice] What do you say?

[soft voice] If you're really interested, take one of the eggs to Quentin at the race tracks in Shimmering Flats. [soft voice] He'll tell you more.
quest_3841_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Why hello, <class>.

[hesitant] Don't let my location fool you, I'm really not here for the races... as entertaining as they may be.

[solemn] I'm actually here in Thousand Needles investigating all I can to find out how salvageable the land is. [solemn voice] It has become my crusade of sorts to revitalize and replenish the area with new, fertile soil. [soft voice] Perhaps I'll find there's a water source nearby.

[soft voice] Tell me you haven't noticed how odd the transition between Feralas and Thousand Needles is. [solemn] Strange magic was afoot when that happened.
quest_3841_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, a sprite darter egg, and one near maturation, if I'm not mistaken. [solemn] Remarkable you've found one, let alone in this good a condition. [solemn] They're rarely seen in Feralas these days. [sad] I understand there were various poachers in the area trying to capture and kill them for many reasons. [sigh] Too bad really... such beautiful creatures when they reach adulthood.

[soft voice] How did you come across such a find?
quest_3842_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Moonweavers, huh? Most intriguing. I wish the sprite darters could truly appreciate what it means to have those two look after them. They are both quite capable.

So, they gave you the egg as a gift. Well, then you should be responsible for it for as long as you desire. [solemn] It appears it's almost ready to hatch, but we should ensure it's healthy and no damage has been done to it.

I only need two elixirs of fortitude for a small spell to protect the egg. I have the rest of the components here with me.
quest_3842_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The longer I stay here, the more tempted I am to partake in these races, <name>. [hesitant] Truly boggling... [urgent] Have you found the elixirs yet? [solemn] Once I can tell if the egg is going to be healthy or not, I'll return it to you to hold onto until it's prepared to hatch.

[commanding] Let me know.
quest_3842_quest_complete: Wonderful. [soft voice] These will do nicely. [pause] Give me a moment to mix together my components and we shall see how well this egg is going to do.
quest_3843_quest_detail:
[solemn] A magnificent specimen, <name>. [soft voice] If this creature survives gestation, then it'll be a healthy pet indeed!

[pause] There is one last thing I would suggest doing if you plan on following through with this--head to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. [commanding] Speak to a dwarf there named Agnar Beastamer, he's a master animal handler and should be able to guide you in the final steps of incubation.

[urgent] But hurry, <name>, this egg is fragile and will not last long without proper care.
quest_3843_quest_progress: Greetin's, <name>. How can I be of service to ya?
quest_3843_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well, well, well... [pause] I haven't seen one of these in a dragon's age. [soft voice] Faerie dragon, if I'm not mistaken... looks to be of the sprite darter variety. [delight] Excellent, excellent indeed.

[warm] Well, if this little fella's gonna hatch and live to be strong and healthy, then we should get some food for it. [proud] Good ya got it to me in time.
quest_3845_quest_detail: [soft voice] Grabbing onto it, you pull the pack back to the shore. [pause] Perhaps if you examine the items inside the pack, you might find out more about who it belongs to.
quest_3881_quest_detail:
[excited] I don't know how you made it here, but you're a sight for sore eyes! [soft voice] I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe. [solemn] Our latest and greatest endeavor has met with what seems like countless disasters, the most serious of which being that we underestimated the savagery of Un'Goro Crater!

[urgent] As we fled our base camps in the southwestern and northeastern parts of the crater, we left behind vital supplies. [warm] You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
quest_3881_quest_progress: [urgent] If we're going to have any chance of getting out of here alive, we'll need our big crate of foodstuffs. [solemn] Also, getting at least some of our research equipment back would be a blessing in a sea of misery.
quest_3881_quest_complete:
[excited] You got both our foodstuff AND our research equipment back! [warm] You've not only saved the expedition, you've also saved our lives. I and the rest of my team can't thank you enough; we just might make it here for a while now thanks to you.

[warm] While we don't have much, I'm certainly not going to leave you high and dry for the invaluable help you've given us. [proud] Thank you, <name> - you've got a friend in Marshal Expeditions!
quest_3882_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You'd think that being chief digger for Marshal Expeditions means I like digging. There might be worse things to do in this world... but none really leap to mind.

[pause] We were supposed to be digging in Terror Run - [mocking tone] FANTASTIC name by the way - for dead stegodons and diemetradons. Well, there are plenty of live ones there too! [urgent] Wil and Hol are still all about studying this death trap, so we need those dinosaur bones. [whispering] Between you and me though, bringing some from live ones will work out just as well.
quest_3882_quest_progress: [angry] Think whatever you want of me, but they're not going to care if the bones they get to research are from ones from ancient stegodons and diemetradons or the ones that almost devoured us wholesale when we were trying to set up our camps. [hesitant] I'll just be happy if we get out of here alive...
quest_3882_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, these should do the trick. And now, if you'll permit me...

[loud voice] THANKS FOR DIGGING ALL OF THESE BONES OUT OF THE GROUND FOR US AND NOT HURTING THE NATIVE BEASTS IN ANY WAY.

[whispering] Whether you really did or didn't, I don't want to know. Let's keep it that way, shall we? Here - maybe this will keep your lips shut on the whole thing. [urgent] Anything to get out of here alive, I say!
quest_3883_quest_detail:
[urgent] Just because we've suffered a setback doesn't mean that research must stop! [solemn] We were investigating the Gorishi insects in the southern part of the crater before winding up here. Their presence is alien to the ecology of Un'Goro, and we want to find out why.

[emphasis] In their hive network must be larval hatcheries. You can identify these places by their hanging larval spawns. [commanding] Use this vial to take a sample of the hive wall near any of the hatcheries. Bring it back to me for study, but be careful!
quest_3883_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have the sample of the Gorishi hive for me to study, <name>?
quest_3883_quest_complete: [soft voice] Yes, this will do nicely. [warm] You've been a great help... [hesitant] I wish I could give you more than this, but being virtually stranded in the middle of a savage land does limit what I can and cannot give. [solemn] Rest assured though - the research done here would not have been possible without your assistance!
quest_3884_quest_detail: [solemn] You have uncovered a mangled journal. [soft voice] Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein. [pause] If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; [emphasis] according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.
quest_3884_quest_progress: [excited] Hello there! [soft voice] I and my companions are happy to see some living beings here other than overgrown savage beasts! [urgent] What brings you into the Un'Goro Crater?
quest_3884_quest_complete: [excited] Well look at this - my journal! [warm] I thought it was lost, much like almost everything else we brought into Un'Goro. I thank you kindly for returning this to me!
quest_3901_quest_detail:
[commanding] You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances <name> - now let's see you under pressure.

[solemn] The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far. [urgent] Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken. [commanding] Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
quest_3901_quest_progress: [solemn] Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village. [soft voice] Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?
quest_3901_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am finished with you, <name> - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. [proud] Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.

[warm] Take these and be on your way. [urgent] You have much to accomplish, <class>.
quest_3902_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

[commanding] We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. [solemn] We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!

[angry] Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones! [threatening] I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
quest_3902_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us? [soft voice] There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside. [angry] No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
quest_3902_quest_complete: [commanding] Great work <name>, [warm] I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
quest_3903_quest_detail:
[commanding] You've shown yourself a dependable <class>, <name>. [emphasis] Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

[soft voice] I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble. [pause] She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable. [gentle] I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
quest_3903_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me? [warm] He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

[hesitant] Perhaps you can help me?
quest_3904_quest_detail:
[urgent] A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting! I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... [sad] I'm afraid for my crop of grapes! If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me! I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates! [excited] Save my harvest!
quest_3904_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh thank you, <name>! [excited] You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

[warm] We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
quest_3905_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals. [solemn] He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

[warm] You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
quest_3905_quest_progress: [excited] You look to be in fine spirits! Come! Have a seat, and have a drink!
quest_3905_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Let's see here...

[surprised] Oh my! [excited] Milly's grapes have been saved! [solemn] When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

[warm] And through your bravery, we now have grapes for more wine! [proud] May the Light bless you, <name>, and keep you safe!
quest_3906_quest_detail:
[solemn] The elders have felt a disturbance amongst the elements. [urgent] The Dark Iron dwarves have summoned a foul spirit into our world that threatens to plague our lands with an eternal draught. [solemn] This disharmony of flame must be investigated.

[commanding] Travel to Blackrock Mountain, through the Chasm of Flame, into the quarry. [solemn] It is there that you shall find this lord of fire: Overmaster Pyron.

[commanding] End the disruption and return to me.
quest_3906_quest_progress: [solemn] The elements are still in disarray, <name>.
quest_3906_quest_complete: [solemn] This cannot be... it must not be. [pause] The destruction of Pyron has merely lifted a veil. [solemn] Within the depths of Blackrock is a much more insidious source of corruption.
quest_3907_quest_detail:
[solemn] I can taste the foulness in the air that surrounds you, <name>. [soft voice] There is another, hidden in the depths of Blackrock, who does control this foulness.

[pause] The wind and earth cry his name: Lord Incendius... but someone... something... commands this being. [low voice] He is merely an emissary.

[urgent] Find him and discover where his master hides. [commanding] Return to me when you have collected this information.
quest_3907_quest_progress: [solemn] The flames will soon overtake these lands. [urgent] Make haste, <name>!
quest_3907_quest_complete:
<Thunderheart clutches the Tablet of Kurniya.> [solemn] Ragnaros... here...

The elders were right to fear the corruption emanating from Blackrock Mountain. [angry] A general of the Old Gods! [urgent] IN OUR WORLD! [commanding] We must reassess our position here in Kargath. [emphasis] We must decide on whether we stay and fight or run for fear of a new sundering.

Be weary of any further exploration in Blackrock Mountain, <name>. [cold] A far greater evil than anything that exists in this world resides in those fiery depths.
quest_3908_quest_detail:
[hesitant] You see, I have no idea how I ended up here. [sad] No one really knows -- it's a secret to everybody! [hesitant] I just can't seem to remember anything...

[soft voice] These items you brought to me, though... [confident] I am remembering something.

[hesitant] My sword. I am supposed to strengthen it somehow, but I'm really not sure why. Sorry I can't tell you more, but I just don't remember!

[soft voice] Anyhoo, I do know where you can take it -- [urgent] Donova Snowden in Winterspring. You'll find her by the hot springs. She can temper the sword by the pools there.
quest_3908_quest_progress: [soft voice] My, my... So Linken did finally get around to sending me his sword.
quest_3908_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, of course I can temper this sword. [pause] While I'm working, you can explain what took Linken so long to get this to me. [hesitant] He's not usually one to forget things...
quest_3909_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now, what's this? [pause] Linken... [sad] FORGOT? Oh, I see... Lost his memory...

Well, here is his sword. It's not complete, though. [solemn] I know of the one that can finish it, but... speaking with him may prove difficult.

Listen, [urgent] I know of someone that will be able to help you. It's too much to explain right now, but you must somehow acquire a Videre Elixir. The only one I know that can help you with that is Gregan Brewspewer. He's hard to track down, but last I knew he was camping in the wilds of Feralas.
quest_3909_quest_complete: [soft voice] I'll need one vial to make sure that this is truly the elixir... [pause] Yes... [emphasis] This is the stuff.
quest_3912_quest_detail:
[solemn] This elixir will allow you to speak with one that you would not normally even see...

[soft voice] Take the Videre elixir, along with Linken's sword, to the graveyard just outside Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Once there, drink the potion. You may be quite surprised at the results, but do not be alarmed.

In your "other" form, head due north until you reach the mountains. You'll find the one you need to speak with in one of the rocky crevices. His name is Gaeriyan.

[emphasis] Remember, he will only speak to you in that form...
quest_3912_quest_complete: [solemn] It has been long since any have come to talk with me...
quest_3913_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you return to the graveyard, <name>, you will find a gravestone there... [solemn] Not just any gravestone; this one will stand out from the others. [whispering] Secrets lie within it.

[emphasis] Push on the stone, and you will learn of these secrets...
quest_3913_quest_progress: [hesitant] This must be the gravestone that Gaeriyan mentioned...
quest_3913_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You push on the stone firmly, and it slides away, revealing a small depression underneath it.

[emphasis] Placing Linken's Sword into the depression, you realize that it fits perfectly...
quest_3914_quest_detail: [soft voice] After a strong flash of light, you are able to pick up the sword again. [excited] It has been transformed!
quest_3914_quest_progress: [excited] Oh! I remember you! [hesitant] You are... [pause] No, don't tell me!
quest_3921_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I think I might have broken that Samophlange. [sad] That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued. [urgent] We must find a way to fix it!

[excited] Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale. [warm] She is very clever and inquisitive. [confident] If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.
quest_3921_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm very busy with my work, <class>. Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
quest_3921_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, what's this? A samophlange, you say? What's a samophlange??

[pause] Ah... but look at the way it moves when you handle it. And there's the sound of intricate gears inside. [delight] Oh my! I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
quest_3922_quest_detail:
[urgent] I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies. [soft voice] I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.

[urgent] The closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east. [low voice] The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets. [commanding] Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.
quest_3922_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the nugget slugs, <name>? [excited] I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
quest_3922_quest_complete: [excited] Great, you got them! [warm] Now I can get to work...
quest_3923_quest_detail:
[low voice] Well, that didn't work. I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low. [hesitant] I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.

[urgent] You should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob. He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.

You can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.
quest_3923_quest_complete:
[excited] What's this? Why, it's a samophlange! [urgent] Where did you get this thing? Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?

[mocking tone] You must be very brave, or very stupid.
quest_3924_quest_detail:
I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first. [soft voice] When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted. [hesitant] I wasn't one of the trusted few...

Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens. [urgent] Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.
quest_3924_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the manual! I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange! [warm] I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

[proud] I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
quest_3941_quest_detail:
Thinking... Thinking... [soft voice] I know I came here for something important...

[hesitant] I have an idea, <name>. [soft voice] In the cave over there is a gnome named J.D. that was very kind to me when I first arrived here. [hesitant] Perhaps in my disoriented state, I might have mentioned something to her.

[hesitant] Why don't you go ask her if she knows anything? [urgent] Oh, but be careful -- [whispering] she's always messing with those crazy glowing crystals I've seen in the crater. [hesitant] I'm not quite sure what she's up to in there!
quest_3941_quest_complete: [soft voice] Stay where you are for just a moment... [pause] I am testing out a new combination of crystals...
quest_3942_quest_detail:
Oh... Linken? Yeah, he's a funny one. [soft voice] When he first got here, he was mumbling about all kinds of strange things. Probably got bumped on the head pretty hard, I imagine.

Something he said kinda stuck with me though -- [hesitant] that he was making some sort of totem; said he had to talk to someone named Eridan Bluewind... in a place called Felwood, I think?

I doubt he could tell you much now, though. [low voice] If you want to know more, maybe you should look for Eridan yourself?
quest_3942_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hello, <class>. Is there something I can help you with?
quest_3961_quest_detail:
[soft voice] To think all this time that the reason Linken came here was to rid us of Blazerunner... He seems like such an ordinary guy, but I did notice that he's not at all interested in any of my experiments or gadgets like most gnomes would be. He must be a true warrior at heart.

[pause] Bring the totem to him. See if that helps him remember why he came here.
quest_3961_quest_complete: [soft voice] Did J.D. help you at all?
quest_3962_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I finally remember now... [pause] I did come here to fight Blazerunner. [hesitant] I was on a journey, and this was to be the last step.

[sad] But I am no longer the hero... [pause] You are. [solemn] All that you have done -- you must finish this now, not me.

[urgent] Blazerunner guards an artifact called the Golden Flame. [solemn] It provides power more vast than anything else I have ever known, and it is dangerous in the hands of one with an evil heart.

[commanding] You will want to bring others with you -- it's dangerous to go alone. [gentle] Take this as my advice.
quest_3962_quest_progress: [solemn] Blazerunner is almost invincible behind the aura he has created by using the Golden Flame. [urgent] Only you have the power to remove it with the Silver Totem of Aquementas.
quest_3962_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>.

[solemn] The Golden Flame will now be returned back to my homeland, where it may be protected, never again to be used for evil.

[warm] Without you, I'd still have no idea who I am! [excited] Since you did so much for me, I'd like you to have something special...

[warm] Take any one you want!
quest_3981_quest_detail:
Poor Gargal... didn't even see it coming. [shouting] WHAM! The arrow landed dead center on the top of his head. He was no genius before but now...

<Galamav grimaces.>

When we dislodged the arrow, we noticed a rolled up note attached to the shaft. On the note was a crudely drawn picture of an orc behind bars with the signature of Commander Gor'shak attached.

[solemn] If he's still alive in the Depths, you'll have to find him.

[angry] A trap you say? Well no kidding, numb hooves! [urgent] That's why you're going!
quest_3981_quest_complete: [urgent] We haven't got much time. [commanding] Listen carefully, <race>. [low voice] What I have to tell you is classified and for your ears only.
quest_3982_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was sent here under the auspices of Thrall. [angry] Do you actually think these buffoons could capture me? [low voice] I allowed myself to be captured so that I could gather intelligence.

<Gor'shak whispers.>

[urgent] The Princess of Ironforge has been kidnapped by Emperor Thaurissan. [excited] Princess Bronzebeard is in this very city! [soft voice] I bet old Magni's heart almost stopped when he heard that news.

<Gor'shak laughs.>

[whispering] Shhh! Do you hear that? [urgent] Guards coming! [shouting] DEFEND YOURSELF!
quest_3982_quest_complete: [urgent] That was a close call. [solemn] They have been alerted to your presence... more will surely come.
quest_4001_quest_detail:
[solemn] So far, my communication with the dwarf, Kharan, in the cell across the hall, has been limited. [soft voice] I have, however, managed to convince him that I, rather -we- mean him no harm.

[commanding] Go speak with him and gather as much information about the Princess and her captors as possible. [urgent] Take that information back to the Warchief.

[solemn] Thrall does not want the Princess harmed, but instead, has some grand plan laid out, which includes her being safely returned to Ironforge. [pause] Kharan already knows all of this... [commanding] Go!
quest_4004_quest_detail:
[sad] You have slain my husband, <race>! [solemn] My child will be born into this world without a father.

<Princess Moira points directly at you.>

[cold] I assure you, this child will be the next ruler of the kingdom of Ironforge. [threatening] You and your kind shall be hunted down until the end of days for this wrongful act.

<You think that Princess Moira may be suffering from the residual effect of Thaurissan's spell.>

[commanding] Leave me be, <race>. [cold] I am certain your warchief will be eager to hear the results of his meddling.
quest_4005_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Take this bag of supplies with you to Tanaris. Travel to Lost Rigger Cove, and look for a circle of stones.

The eastmost peninsula is the secret...

From this circle only, read from the book of Aquor; summon the only creature that can transform the items you collected into a totem to fight Blazerunner.

[solemn] Aquementas will not be pleased to be awakened, but remember, you must remain in the circle for him to transform the items.
quest_4005_quest_progress: [soft voice] So you're back, eh? Hmm... [pause] Let me take a look at that, <name>.
quest_4005_quest_complete:
[solemn] Blazerunner, you say...

Yes, I am aware that a strong elemental resides in the charred center of the crater. [soft voice] We all just keep our distance; none have been able to penetrate the powerful aura that surrounds him. [sad] Many have been pushed from the rocky paths onto the ground below when trying to face him.
quest_4021_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened. [urgent] I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance. [solemn] My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!

[commanding] Face the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens. [urgent] Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears. [commanding] Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.

[warm] We're counting on you, <name>.
quest_4021_quest_complete:
[excited] You have done it! [proud] You have defeated the Kolkar!

[warm] I will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, <name>.

[solemn] Stand tall. [proud] You do yourself, and the Horde, proud.
quest_4041_quest_progress:
[commanding] Bring me an Evoroot, and sure, I can make ya that Videre Elixir.

[soft voice] I know all kinds of things about herbs and alchemy... [pause] Why, let me tell you the story about the time I transmuted gold from the cheese I was going to eat for lunch... [hesitant] hey... Where are you going? [urgent] Evoroot
quest_4041_quest_complete: [laughing] So, you pulled a fast one on ol' Miblon, eh?
quest_4061_quest_detail:
[solemn] The machines made themselves known to us during our initial forays into the Searing Gorge. Upon further investigation we discovered that they were being imported from Burning Steppes, possibly Blackrock Depths. [commanding] That is what we need you for, <name>.

[urgent] Your first task is to venture to the Burning Steppes and recover elemental shards from the rock automatons and lesser rock creations of the region. [soft voice] Once you have collected a sufficient amount, return to me and I shall determine their source of origin.
quest_4061_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not take this task lightly, <name>!
quest_4061_quest_complete: <Theodora carefully examines the fragments with an enormous monocle.> <Theodora lays the fragments out before her.> [soft voice] Interesting. Etched into the structural foundation of each of these fragments are... [pause] initials.
quest_4062_quest_detail:
G.L.A.

[solemn] Those are the 'initials' imprinted on the elemental shards. [soft voice] Below the initials are a rank marking of some sort. [low voice] The machinations you destroyed in the Burning Steppes were of 'Rank IV.' [hesitant] I assume that this is a lowly rank.

[urgent] Take this shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus in the camp to the east. [solemn] He is a scholar of some renown in the field of elemental sciences. [soft voice] He may be able to assist us in our search.
quest_4062_quest_progress: [soft voice] What have you got there, <race>?
quest_4062_quest_complete: <Lotwil's face turns white.> [hesitant] I... I know these markings.
quest_4063_quest_detail:
[shocked] This can't be Argelmach! [sad] Argelmach was killed ten years ago. How can I be sure? [hesitant] I was the one who killed him.

[solemn] He was a despicable dwarf, hell-bent on twisting my life's work to meet his diabolical needs. [sad] It seems that the wicked always find a way to escape justice.

[urgent] If this is Argelmach's handiwork then he must be destroyed. [urgent] I will need samplings of his latest creations. [confident] With the proper samples, I may be able to stop this uprising. [urgent] The creations guard Argelmach in Blackrock Depths.
quest_4063_quest_progress: [hesitant] Was it him? [pause] Was he really alive?
quest_4063_quest_complete: [shocked] What is this?!? This head is not flesh. [solemn] This is some sort of dark iron creation: A shadow of Argelmach - [urgent] ANOTHER machine! [hesitant] I suspect that your destruction of Argelmach will be short lived as another shall rise to take 'its' place soon.
quest_4084_quest_detail:
[solemn] I do not know the one you speak of, <name>.

[soft voice] But worry not; if your friend was on a journey to find me, I do know what it was he desired.

[emphasis] In the heart of Un'Goro Crater dwells evil of the purest form. [commanding] This evil takes the shape of an elemental called Blazerunner... protected by an aura that none can dispel...

[emphasis] None... except those with enough power to do so. [solemn] I can teach you of this power, <name>.

[urgent] First, do as I ask. Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart from the creatures in Felwood, then return.
quest_4084_quest_progress: [soft voice] I can tell you more of the power required to defeat Blazerunner, but first, you need to gather the things I require.
quest_4084_quest_complete: [solemn] Very well, <name>. [soft voice] I can see you are serious about helping your friend.
quest_4101_quest_detail:
[solemn] Plants give life to Felwood, yet even they suffer the taint of corruption. [soft voice] I know ways to cleanse them, but I cannot give out such knowledge to those I don't know or trust. [commanding] Prove to me that you will truly aid the cause of the Cenarion Circle!

[urgent] To the north lie the Irontree Caverns. The Warpwood elementals present there are now beyond hope of cleansing. [hesitant] I ask you to bring me their sap - blood amber it is called - so I may study it in the hopes of saving other forms of life here.
quest_4101_quest_progress:
[solemn] I know Felwood suffers, <name> - I suffer along with it! [soft voice] I must remain steadfast in my conviction; were the knowledge I possess to fall into the wrong hands, it would spell disaster for all of Felwood.

[urgent] Bring to me the blood amber drawn from the slain Warpwood elementals, and I will trust you enough to help me enact a means to fight the corruption.
quest_4101_quest_complete:
[solemn] This blood amber will be used to find a means of defeating the corruption present in Felwood. [warm] You've proven to me that you're willing to do whatever it takes for the Cenarion Circle. [gentle] I trust you now, friend.

[soft voice] It might seem odd that killing the elementals proved yourself to me, but the end of saving countless sentient beings must justify the means we take. [solemn] You and I can now focus on the preservation of life through the salves I can make.

[warm] <name>, the time has come to cleanse Felwood.
quest_4102_quest_detail:
[solemn] Plants give life to Felwood, yet even they suffer the taint of corruption. [soft voice] I know ways to cleanse them, but I cannot give out such knowledge to those I don't know or trust. [urgent] Prove to me that you will truly aid the cause of the Cenarion Circle!

[emphasis] To the north lie the Irontree Caverns. [sad] The Warpwood elementals present there are now beyond hope of cleansing. [hesitant] I ask you to bring me their sap - blood amber it is called - so I may study it in the hopes of saving other forms of life here.

[urgent] Bring to me the blood amber drawn from the slain Warpwood elementals, and I will trust you enough to help me enact a means to fight the corruption.
