[pause] It might seem odd that killing the elementals proved yourself to me, but the end of saving countless sentient beings must justify the means we take. [gentle] You and I can now focus on the preservation of life through the salves I can make.

[proud] <name>, the time has come to cleanse Felwood.
quest_4103_quest_progress:
[solemn] Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. [soft voice] I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. [solemn] We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again.

[warm] In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared. [urgent] Corrupted Soul Shard(6)
quest_4103_quest_complete: Very well then, [soft voice] here are your Cenarion plant salves. [commanding] Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, <name>! [urgent] Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.
quest_4104_quest_progress:
[solemn] If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. [soft voice] I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. [gentle] You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving.

[warm] If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared. Tainted Vitriol(4)
quest_4104_quest_complete: [soft voice] Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. [warm] If you find more vitriol when you mine in Felwood, remember to hold on to it for me! [gentle] The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.
quest_4105_quest_detail:
[solemn] There be something other than demons on my mind, mon. My tribe, my own people. Lost to the madness of bad, very bad voodoo. One day the Loa be seeking our Speaker in his slumber. The Loa asked for strong mojo to be made, the Mojo of Dreams.

A mojo that strong needed blessed water, blessed by the Dragons. So I be finding my way to the big green portal. There I found the demons and dirtied my hands with their blood as the Speaker ran away! [angry] When I be returning home, my own people sneered at me in hostility. Sent me away. No part of the Shadeflayers, they said.

Bad, bad voodoo took over their mind mon. But to fix bad voodoo, you be needing to pay blood and good mojo. Both price of blood and mojo can be paid in Zul'Hatha. Where you will find Gan'hota the Speaker with his Mojo of Dreams. Not far you be finding Warlord Hanzento, whose blood you need to spill. He be the reason for this foolishness and this be the right way to set things right!
quest_4105_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption. [soft voice] My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.

[pause] When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon. [warm] In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve. [emphasis] Fel Creep(4)
quest_4105_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work <name> - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back Felwood. [warm] Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. [solemn] The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no <race>!
quest_4106_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Cenarion beacon will allow a well-trained skinner to spot patches of tainted skin from bounty gathered in Felwood. [soft voice] I convert these seemingly useless patches into a thick paste that serves as a quickening agent for Cenarion plant salve. [urgent] When you skin your kills here in Felwood, be sure to have a beacon on you!

[warm] When you collect tainted patches, bring them to me and I will give you some Cenarion plant salves that I have already made. [pause] Patch of Tainted Skin(5)
quest_4106_quest_complete: [soft voice] This is exactly what I need. Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim Felwood from the corruption. [solemn] We must persevere, <name>!
quest_4107_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. [solemn] I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work.

[pause] I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. [emphasis] The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way! [whispering] Lesser Nether Essence
quest_4107_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, <name>. [solemn] Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. [warm] If you need more salve, then find me here!
quest_4108_quest_progress:
[solemn] Possessing a Cenarion Beacon allows one to sea a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. [soft voice] I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. [warm] We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again.

[excited] In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared. Corrupted Soul Shard(6)

quest_4120_quest_detail:
[solemn] Being a hunter, I strive to emulate the strengths I see in my opponents. [soft voice] It is possible to turn the battle in your favor by simply knowing your enemy well, <name>.

[pause] In a place called Felwood, north of Ashenvale, the creatures have been tainted by a substance called fel. [solemn] The bears and wolves have been driven mad by it, but I believe that they have also grown even stronger as well.

[urgent] Go, <name>. [emphasis] Travel to Felwood and face these beasts. [solemn] Learn for yourself if they are truly as strong as I believe.
quest_4120_quest_progress: [solemn] Everything touched by the fel emanates a strange green glow... [soft voice] I sense it is evil, but at the same time, very powerful.
quest_4120_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It sounds from your descriptions as if the creatures show a mindless ferocity...

[pause] Stay alert, <name>. [urgent] It would be in your best interest to learn more of the corruption. [solemn] Always know your enemy.
quest_4121_quest_detail:
[low voice] Do you truly believe that you will make it to your rendezvous point with me in custody? [threatening] You actually expected to break into a heavily fortified Blackrock fortress to capture a prized asset of theirs without alerting anyone or anything to your presence?

[angry] You will be destroyed!
quest_4121_quest_progress: [commanding] I will take this traitorous filth, <name>.
quest_4121_quest_complete: [solemn] Your heroics will not go unrecognized, <name>. [warm] You have earned this tribute. [commanding] The Warlord will speak with you now in regards to the final mission.
quest_4122_quest_detail:
[solemn] I tracked him across the Searing Gorge, through the mountain, and into the Burning Steppes. [angry] That traitor was caught red-handed giving the Blackrock orcs vital information about our day to day operations. [solemn] I'm speaking of Grark Lorkrub.

[low voice] He now sits in the Burning Steppes, safely under their protection - or so he thinks.

[commanding] Take these shackles, <name>. [urgent] Find Grark, place the shackles on him and lead him through Blackrock Mountain. [commanding] Do this and a tribute is yours.
quest_4122_quest_complete: [commanding] Can you not see the power we gain by joining the legion of Blackrock?
quest_4123_quest_detail:
[solemn] For years I have sought a certain gem. It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist! [angry] The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.

[urgent] So I must resort to force.

[commanding] Fight your way to the Lower Vault of Blackrock Depths, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart. [emphasis] To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!

[soft voice] Good luck.
quest_4123_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Heart of the Mountain? [low voice] To me, its value is without limit.
quest_4123_quest_complete:
[excited] You have the heart! [delight] Amazing! [excited] It is even more beautiful than I imagined!

[warm] Please, <name>, take this as payment!
quest_4124_quest_detail:
[solemn] An associate of mine, Ginro Hearthkindle, is looking for assistance concerning the location of a courier and the parcels he was carrying. It has been a week or so since the courier went missing; our own searches have proved fruitless, and we're at an impasse. [sad] Unfortunately, I have had to declare the courier as missing in action.

[soft voice] If you have the time and resources to spare, please speak with Ginro. He should be here in the Stronghold - perhaps in his quarters.
quest_4124_quest_complete: [solemn] Latro sent you to me, I presume. While I think it is a lost cause at this point, I'll take whatever assistance you can offer. I must admit... I'll be glad once I can put my mind to rest on this matter. [sad] Every day I set out into the wilds of Feralas looking for signs of Raschal, and every night I have come back with nothing to show for my work save gnoll teeth and disappointment.
quest_4125_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's been about a week since Raschal, the courier, set out for Thalanaar. [soft voice] He knows Feralas well; he's been with us since General Feathermoon led the expeditionary forces here. [hesitant] I know his plan was to take a row boat down the coast and try and traverse across southern Feralas to avoid the Horde camp.

[sad] I couldn't find his boat, but maybe you can. [pause] Maybe it is hidden, or maybe it was sunk. [solemn] Regardless, it might hold a clue as to where he is. [soft voice] If you uncover something, please let me know.
quest_4125_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have found what appears to be a wrecked row boat. [soft voice] Through the slightly muddy water you see gaping holes riddling the port side; the boat is nearly shredded down to its simple wooden frame. [low voice] Whatever broke this boat most likely tried to snap it in two. [solemn] A small crest of the Feathermoon Stronghold is painted on the starboard side.

[pause] In the mud at the base of the boat, a glint of something metallic catches your eye...
quest_4126_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dark Iron dwarves, led by the villain Hurley Blackbreath, stole one of the Thunderbrew's best recipes, Thunderbrew Lager. [angry] The villains! They don't deserve such a fine brew!

<name>, I have a tough task for you. [commanding] Go to the Blackrock Depths in the Burning Steppes, destroy any kegs of Thunderbrew Lager you find, and bring back our recipe for Thunderbrew Lager!

[urgent] Please, get that recipe back, even if you have to turn Blackrock Depths upside down to do it!
quest_4126_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the recipe, <name>? [angry] I can't stand the idea of those Dark Iron dwarves drinking my family's drink!
quest_4126_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [excited] Well done! And I hope you gave those Dark Irons, and Hurley Blackbreath, a good thumping!

[proud] The Thunderbrews are at your service, <name>. [proud] You are a hero of heroes!
quest_4127_quest_detail: [soft voice] Running your hand along the mud, your fingers graze the handle of a knife. [solemn] It looks well cared for, and it might be safe to assume that whoever was on the boat might have lost it. [pause] Perhaps the large chunk of the missing boat might have something to do with the loss.
quest_4128_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ho, <name>. I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale. [commanding] He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.

Talk to Ragnar if you're interested. [urgent] He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.
quest_4128_quest_complete: [angry] You're right I'm mad! [angry] I've been robbed! [angry] Robbed of one of our family recipes! [angry] How dare they! [angry] As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves! [urgent] Now, oh... [pause] now they're in for it!
quest_4129_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The Stronghold's resident druid, Quintis Jonespyre, has some... unusual skills. One of them involves psychometry - the ability to reveal an item's history by touch. Don't ask me how he does it; I chalk it up to magic I do not and choose not to understand. I do know, however, two things: one, I've seen it work and two, the bum owes me.

Take the knife up to Quint in his little tree-house here, and tell him for me that his Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt will be paid if he works his mojo on that knife.
quest_4129_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ginro sent you, eh?

My psychometric readings are fairly draining on the psyche... but so are my losses at Kalimdor Hold 'Em. They call me "King of the Bad Beats" here in the Stronghold. Unlucky at cards... lucky at mastering the secrets of nature, I guess.

[warm] Anyway, of course I'll do it. [solemn] This may be just the breakthrough we need to uncover Raschal's fate. [urgent] If you would hand me the knife, we can get started.
quest_4129_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>.

While psychometry isn't an exact art by any stretch of the imagination, I've used it in times past to give insight into situations that others have chalked up to lost causes. [solemn] I think using it on the knife you've uncovered will give us a glimpse into what happened to Raschal.

It will only take a moment to do, but it isn't what I'd call a caster-friendly task. [hesitant] Bear with me on this.
quest_4130_quest_detail:
I'm a little wobbly still, sorry. [soft voice] Anyway, I received some useful visions.

[solemn] Raschal takes two large leather backpacks from his boat and goes inland; he returns to the boat, however. [hesitant] I see gnoll scalps... he ran into some gnolls - Woodpaw I think they're called. [urgent] He's very worried - almost terrified - about something. [urgent] So much so, that he is not paying attention to water elementals forming behind him. [solemn] The images... stop there.

[pause] I need to rest, sorry <name>. [soft voice] Tell Gin what I've seen. [commanding] He needs to know.
quest_4130_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thanks for passing along Quint's visions to me, <name>. [warm] I'll try to remember to be a little easier on him the next time we play cards.

[solemn] Raschal can hold his own in a fight, and gnolls aren't anything that would get him worried - nay, terrified. [urgent] Still, maybe you and yours can act on this new information and make the breakthrough we desperately need.
quest_4131_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our "friends" the Woodpaw might have gotten Raschal in the end, but something tells me that's not what occurred. Still, they're the best place to start looking.

[hesitant] I wish I had clearer insight as to what to do, but all I have right now is 'Search the Woodpaw camps - go.' I do know that gnolls will keep items they scavenge and fight over them; maybe they ran across the backpacks Quint mentioned. [soft voice] I hadn't risked a head-on fight in past searches, but with Quint's vision on this I say rip into them.
quest_4131_quest_complete: [soft voice] Tacked up on a nearby tree are two large leather backpacks. Each bears a small insignia of the Feathermoon Stronghold on the front of the pack...
quest_4132_quest_detail:
[commanding] You have done an exemplary job, <name>. [solemn] It is now time to send you on your last mission.

General Angerforge, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. and the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice.

[urgent] This will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.
quest_4132_quest_progress: [solemn] Has the Butcher of Blackrock been disposed of?
quest_4132_quest_complete: [excited] Finally! The villain been brought to justice! [warm] You are a remarkable individual, <name>. [proud] Wear this medallion as a symbol of your stalwart dedication to the Horde and the K.E.F.
quest_4133_quest_detail:
[solemn] Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave is in need of your services. [soft voice] She is in the Badlands, in the orcish outpost of Kargath, pursuing rumors of a certain brew made by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.

[urgent] Speak with Vivian. [emphasis] She awaits you.
quest_4133_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for coming, <name>. [solemn] This place is not without a stark charm, but is lacks the amenities of the Apothecarium.

[commanding] Enough with the pleasantries. [urgent] To business, yes?
quest_4134_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is rumored that the Dark Iron Hurley Blackbreath has stolen a recipe for ale. This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage. [soft voice] We wish to study the drink. Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... applications more in line with Forsaken objectives.

[urgent] Delve into Blackrock Depths, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.

[threatening] And to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.
quest_4134_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have the recipe for the Thunderbrew Lager, <name>?
quest_4134_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good. I will send this recipe to the Apothecarium to be studied, and in time we will unlock its secrets. [cold] One day, the dwarves of the Alliance may find the virtues of this drink used against them!

[mocking tone] I find that terribly amusing. [soft voice] Perhaps death has an affect on one's sense of humor... do you think?
quest_4136_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother Ribbly has always been a drain to his family, taking our money and wasting it on one scheme after another.

[urgent] Well, his last scheme must have been his worst, because Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay just put a price on poor Ribbly's head. [excited] I can't tell you how happy this makes the Screwspigots! [proud] Our little Ribbly's finally worth something!

[urgent] But now he's hiding out, deep in Blackrock Depths. [hesitant] Please, find him and bring him to me!

[cold] Or, if he won't come, then that's ok... just bring me his head.
quest_4136_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have Ribbly? [hesitant] Or, at least a part of him?
quest_4136_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! You found him! And... it appears that my little brother didn't want to come quiety. [sad] It's a pity. [warm] I would have liked to see the look on his face when I told him our plans to turn him in to Revilgaz.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You've made my family very happy. [gentle] And Ribbly's never looked as peaceful as he does now.
quest_4141_quest_detail:
[soft voice] See Larion over there? [angry] It's HIS fault we're here!

[angry] I told him we were going the wrong way, but would he listen? [sad] And would you believe that he's the one that won't speak to me? [commanding] Well, until he changes his mind, let's have a bit of fun with him.

[soft voice] Have you noticed the strange plant-like creatures around here? [soft voice] They're nothing but trouble, really, but I think if trained properly, I could get them to obey commands.

[urgent] First thing though, I'll need some samples to study. [soft voice] Do you think you could collect some?
quest_4141_quest_progress: [angry] Larion's got something coming, that's for sure!
quest_4141_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I hope they didn't give you too much trouble, <name>. [hesitant] I try to steer clear of them -- they're wild!

[shocked] I tried jumping over one... I was attacked! [sad] Plants just shouldn't be acting that way!
quest_4142_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I'm not quite sure what to make of this, <name>. [soft voice] The plants... they seem to have some minimal intelligence.

[hesitant] I'm no expert, though. But, I do know someone that is!

[urgent] Head to northern Feralas, and look for a buddy of mine named Gregan Brewspewer. [warm] He's an expert on this sort of thing.

[confident] I'm sure Gregan can help us out here. [solemn] You'll find him out in the wilderness; he's not the type to live in a big city.
quest_4142_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I live out here in the forest... Peaceful.

[excited] Well, at least I thought it would be. [commanding] I get more visitors out here than I ever did when I lived in Ironforge!
quest_4142_quest_complete: [low voice] Bloodpetal, eh? Hmmm... Well, you better explain the plan, and then I'll tell you whether or not I can help you.
quest_4143_quest_detail:
[soft voice] To tell you the truth, <name>, I've never seen any plants like this in my travels. [pause] Perhaps I should take a trip to this crater...

At any rate, I think I know just the thing Muigin's looking for -- Atal'ai haze. [low voice] It's horrid stuff, hard to collect, but it's just what he needs to control the little monsters.

[commanding] You'll need to visit the temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows. [solemn] The Atal'ai Haze can be collected from the deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes found there. [warm] Good luck, <name>!
quest_4143_quest_progress: [angry] Larion's still not speaking to me! [soft voice] He sure knows how to hold a grudge.
quest_4143_quest_complete: [hesitant] I admit, I'm a bit hesitant to touch that stuff, <name>! [warm] But if Gregan says it'll work, then I'm willing to give it a try!
quest_4144_quest_progress:
Here's the plan, <name>: [commanding] Go out and collect some bloodpetal sprouts -- you know, the plants that haven't fully sprouted yet, and bring them here. Then I'll see what the Atal'ai haze can do.

[soft voice] You may think I'm vengeful... Actually, you'd be right about that!

[excited] Truth is, I know the way out of here, but until Larion will admit that I'm right, I'm staying right here!

[urgent] So off with you, find those bloodpetal sprouts and let's have some fun! Bloodpetal Sprout(3)
quest_4144_quest_complete: [urgent] Here goes nothing, <name>! [excited] This will get Larion's attention!
quest_4145_quest_detail:
[commanding] See Muigin over there? [angry] It's HIS fault we're lost!

[angry] I'm the one that knew the way, but he insisted he knew a shortcut, and we ended up here!

[angry] To make matters worse, now he keeps sending his crazy plant pests to annoy me. [angry] I'm so angry that I'm not planning on talking to him any time soon, but these pests are too much to handle.

[urgent] Why don't we try to limit his supply, first thing. [commanding] Go out and hunt some Bloodpetals, then return to me.
quest_4145_quest_progress: [angry] Muigin needs to apologize first before I'll talk to him again!
quest_4145_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thanks for your help, <name>, but I'm afraid I have some bad news...
quest_4146_quest_detail:
[excited] You're in luck, <name>! I've been working on some of my own experiments while Marvon's been gone, and one of them is a short range bug zapper. [soft voice] With just a few adjustments, it should be great for ridding yourself of those Bloodpetal pests.

[warm] I can let you have one of my zapper prototypes, but you'll still need to collect the fuel. [urgent] You can get the necessary Atal'ai haze that the zapper needs in the temple of Atal'Hakkar. [solemn] The deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes are the ones you'll need to get it from.
quest_4146_quest_progress: This is exhausting, <name>. [urgent] Those things just won't leave me alone!
quest_4146_quest_complete: [low voice] So, Marvon wasn't around? [urgent] Well, show me what you got, anyway.
quest_4147_quest_detail:
[excited] I managed to spy on what Muigin was doing, and he's actually growing the darn things over there!

[hesitant] I think the only solution here is to... no, not go talk to him... [urgent] What are you thinking? The solution is to fight back!

[confident] We'll need the help of my friend, Marvon, who has a workshop in Ratchet. [warm] I'm sure he'll be able to create some sort of gadget that will help us.
quest_4147_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Marvon's been gone quite a long time now, <name>. He went off to Tanaris to study some of the ancient troll ruins.

[hesitant] Now, what was it that you said you needed?
quest_4148_quest_progress:
[solemn] For the zapper to work, it needs a sample of the target creature. Head out into the crater and collect a Bloodpetal sprout. Then I can calibrate it to work on Muigin's little friends...

[sad] If he weren't so stubborn, we could be on our way home, already... But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all! [angry] Bloodpetal Sprout
quest_4148_quest_complete: [confident] Looks like this is going to work perfectly, <name>. [warm] Now remember, if you see any of those pests around, don't hesitate to use that zapper!
quest_4161_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." [soft voice] Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a <class>, <name>, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

[pause] The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. [gentle] This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. [warm] This balance has afforded us much, <name>.

[commanding] Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
quest_4161_quest_progress: [solemn] Remember the balance, <name>. [soft voice] I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
quest_4161_quest_complete: [solemn] Always remember what I have shown you today, <name>. [warm] You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
quest_4181_quest_detail:
[solemn] Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. [soft voice] I only bother to mention goblin engineering because I'm a fair trainer. [chuckling] They like to make things that blow up, and they rarely care what is in the way - even themselves.

<name>, read this manual. [urgent] If you want to learn how to blow yourself up, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. [emphasis] Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.
quest_4181_quest_progress: [commanding] I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. [excited] Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?
quest_4181_quest_complete:
[excited] Well <name>, you were wise to seek my tutelage! [warm] Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of Gnomeregan are proof of that. [commanding] It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of Goblin Engineering.

[urgent] Keep your ears perked <name>, and you might learn something.
quest_4182_quest_detail:
[solemn] Life in the Burning Steppes is rife with conflict.

[angry] Just look at this place! We know very little of what happened to these buildings, but we do know that at one time, before the great explosion, this was all part of the Redridge mountain range.

[urgent] Enough lamenting! We have a problem, <name>. You may have noticed the dragonkin below this ridge. We need assistance in pushing them back. Kill as many as you can and return to me. [commanding] Succeed and perhaps we can talk of other things.
quest_4182_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the dragon hunt?
quest_4182_quest_complete: [delight] Superb slaying, <name>. [warm] Now that we know you can handle yourself around dragonkin, we can talk of more pressing matters.
quest_4183_quest_detail:
[solemn] We had always assumed that the Blackrock orcs were a product of their savage upbringing. [soft voice] What we have found here, in their homeland, tells us another story.

[solemn] Indeed, it is bloodlust and thirst for conflict that empowers them, but the black dragonflight are the beings whom control the orcs of Blackrock. [urgent] We suspect that it is the black dragonflight that fuels them with rage and hostility.

[commanding] Take this letter to Magistrate Solomon. [commanding] He will know what must be done. <Helendis hands you a sealed letter.>
quest_4183_quest_progress: Greetings, <name>. [hesitant] Have we met before? [soft voice] You look vaguely familiar.
quest_4184_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is grim news, <name>. [solemn] To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. [low voice] There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. [urgent] Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? [urgent] Goldshire? Stormwind itself?

[commanding] You must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind at once! [urgent] If this does not merit the aid of Stormwind, nothing will and all is lost.
quest_4186_quest_complete:
It could have been worse, I suppose...

<Magistrate Solomon looks you over.>

[soft voice] It appears as if the fate of Lakeshire rests squarely on your shoulders. <You notice Magistrate Solomon blinking rapidly. He appears to be crying.>
quest_4223_quest_detail: <Magistrate Solomon sighs.> [urgent] You must return to the Burning Steppes, <name>. [commanding] As a deputy of Stormwind, you will be required to report to Marshal Maxwell. [warm] Good luck.
quest_4224_quest_detail:
[angry] What? You thought you were the first? How many soldiers must we lose before Stormwind acts?

[sigh] We had accumulated enormous amounts of intelligence pertaining to the Blackrock menace before we lost our commanding officer, Marshal Windsor. With Marshal Windsor went all of our precious information.

[urgent] What we need is that documentation. Speak with Ragged John, <name>. [solemn] He was with Windsor when they were attacked by a Blackrock raiding party. [low voice] He was last seen in a cave to the north.
quest_4224_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you spoken with John yet?
quest_4224_quest_complete: [low voice] I could have warned you, but what fun is that?
quest_4241_quest_detail:
[angry] So that good for nothing coward says that Windsor is alive, eh?

[commanding] Suit up, deputy, you are going in to find him. [commanding] If Windsor is alive, you are to bring him back. [commanding] If he's dead, I want proof.

<Maxwell laughs.>

[commanding] I bet you are getting tired of hearing that, aren't you?
quest_4241_quest_complete: [angry] Where is he! [shouting] I'll murder him!
quest_4242_quest_detail:
Bolvar is a fool. [angry] I was gathering his precious 'proof' so that I could shove it down his throat.

[low voice] He is a blind buffoon. [threatening] Proof stands two feet away from him and he does not see.

[sad] As for my data, it's lost. [sad] Gone. [sad] Unrecoverable. [cold] Should I ever find Ironfoe and make it out of this labyrinth, my first stop will be Stormwind, to place my hammer in between that reptile's eyes.

[threatening] Leave me, <name>.
quest_4242_quest_complete:
[solemn] He's gone mad, apparently.

<Maxwell lowers his head in mourning.>

It is unfortunate that a once proud and noble warrior would be turned into a blithering head case. [sad] I GUESS we've reached a dead end...

[pause] I must reward you for your efforts thus far, <name>.
quest_4243_quest_detail:
[solemn] Unfortunately, something's happened to one of my greatest inventions. [soft voice] You've seen mechanical squirrels, yes? Well, to get closer to the apes of Un'Goro Crater, I created a mechanical ape to blend in with their kind--I call her A-Me 01.

[emphasis] She has scrying gems for eyes so I could see everything she saw. [pause] She made it to Fungal Rock--the apes' lair--just east of here, and that's when I lost contact. [urgent] The last thing I saw was one of their alpha males rushing up to say hello to her!

[hesitant] Can you help me find her?
quest_4245_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been able to help A-Me? [pause] That mithril casing you mentioned being destroyed was a good guess at what was wrong. [gentle] I'm sure if you replace that, she'll reactivate and be able to come home.
quest_4245_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you've done it! [delight] Wonderful! [warm] Thank you, <name>.

[soft voice] Oh, my poor, A-Me. [sad] Look at all those dents. [warm] We'll get her up and running perfectly with just a little work.

[warm] Thank you again, <name>. [proud] I really appreciate it.
quest_4261_quest_progress: [solemn] What have you seen in this corrupted land?
quest_4261_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, <name>. [soft voice] Felwood has been through much hardship. [warm] Thank you for what you have done.

[solemn] One day, we may be able to reclaim Felwood from the corruption; [soft voice] every kind deed helps.
quest_4262_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last five of my mages that went snooping around in Blackrock Mountain came back extra crispy with a permanent orange gnomefro - or worse.

<Jalinda picks up some ashes from the ground and releases them into the air.>

[angry] One nasty bugger in particular, Overmaster Pyron, seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. [urgent] We need that elemental terminated so that our expedition crew can make its way into Blackrock Depths!

[commanding] He guards the entrance at the Blackrock Quarry.
quest_4263_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Are you sure Pyron said 'Incendius' when he died?

<Jalinda swallows hard.>

Lord Incendius is purported to be a minion of Ragnaros! [soft voice] Oh dear, oh dear... whatever will we do?

Do you think you can handle another mission? I don't have anybody else to send, <name>!

[urgent] We will never get a team in if Incendius continues to raise Pyron from the ashes.

[commanding] You'll have to find and destroy Lord Incendius!
quest_4263_quest_complete: [shocked] Oh dear! [hesitant] Are you sure Incendius said 'Ragnaros?' <Jalinda hands you something and pats you on the wrist as she fades deep into thought.>
quest_4264_quest_detail:
[solemn] The note has stains covering its surface. [soft voice] The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:

...sweet irony... ...the fall of the broken Alliance...

[low voice] ...if it were not for General Angerforge's diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...

[urgent] ...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.

[threatening] Our lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...

-Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
quest_4264_quest_progress: <Marshal Windsor eyes the note in your hand.> [soft voice] What do you have there, <name>?
quest_4266_quest_detail:
<name>, [soft voice] General Shandris Feathermoon would like to speak with you personally. [pause] No doubt she wants to thank you for your service to the Stronghold, but I do know that she also wants to talk to you about the insect creatures that you and Raschal faced in southern Feralas. [hesitant] The reports of those Zukk'ash insects are... [sad] frightening, to say the least.

[solemn] General Feathermoon is waiting for you in the main compound.
quest_4266_quest_complete:
<name>, [warm] I give you my warmest thanks for the aid you've given us. [proud] Your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds has warranted a reward worth a thousand times greater. [soft voice] Nevertheless, I hope you accept this on behalf of the entire Stronghold.

[pause] Now, if I may... I'd like to ask for your aid one more time. [solemn] In light of the discovery of the Zukk'ash hive here in Feralas, I think you're the best choice for this mission.
quest_4267_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am entrusting you with a copy of the report Raschal made on the infestation of southeastern Feralas. While the main report is being filed in Darnassus, I want you to give this copy to an associate of the Protectorate. Her name is Gracina Spiritmight; she is a priestess who dwells in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. [soft voice] She has broad knowledge on these kinds of creatures, and her receiving this report would benefit us all.

[commanding] You're dismissed - good luck, <name>; may Elune watch over us all.
quest_4267_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome to this blessed temple, friend. [soft voice] Your arrival here from Feathermoon Stronghold has been foretold to me. [solemn] Do you have the report Shandris Feathermoon asked you to bring?
quest_4267_quest_complete:
[solemn] We night elves know of the terror outlined in this report. [soft voice] Shandris was wise to send this, and you, to me.

[solemn] These creatures will consume Feralas rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face.

The insects you and the courier encountered are known as the silithid. [urgent] They are mere tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance will ever face. [hesitant] I pray we will have the resolve to defeat them before they destroy us.
quest_4281_quest_detail:
[solemn] This parcel of goods you found in the Woodpaw gnoll camps was supposed to be delivered to the small way-station of Thalanaar in southeastern Feralas. Regardless of the missing courier's fate, the task of delivering the parcel remains unfinished.

[soft voice] Examining the parcel in detail reveals a hand written name of "Falfindel Waywarder" on the outside of the packaging. [pause] Perhaps this is the parcel's ultimate recipient.
quest_4281_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to Thalanaar, <class>. [gentle] Do you need assistance of some sort?
quest_4281_quest_complete:
[solemn] Elune be praised, the delivery from Feathermoon Stronghold has finally arrived!

[soft voice] Your presence here indicates to me that perhaps some ill fate may have befallen Raschal, our usual courier. [hesitant] I hope that everything works out. [urgent] I know that recently, the Woodpaw have become highly agitated from some source to their south. Maybe he fell to the wilds there; I would be careful, friend.

[warm] Regardless, thank you again. [proud] Here is payment for this parcel's delivery.
quest_4282_quest_detail:
<Marshal Windsor shakes the note excitedly.> [solemn] Do you realize what this means, <name>?

[excited] Perhaps all is not lost! From what I can ascertain, the information is being held by two Dark Iron dwarves: General Angerforge and the golem lord, Argelmach. [commanding] I have a feeling that they won't just hand over the information if we ask nicely.

[urgent] I hope you are ready to battle.

Venture forth and find these two villains! [angry] Destroy them and return my lost information.
quest_4282_quest_progress: [solemn] Soon this grand subterfuge will be over.
quest_4282_quest_complete: <Marshal Windsor snatches the two tablets from your hands.> [urgent] We need to get out of here!
quest_4283_quest_detail:
[whispering] I'm going to let you in on a little secret, soldier. Come a little closer.

[shouting] I'M THE ONLY SANE ONE HERE!

Look at these people! Would you believe that they're all insane!? Well they are! [shouting] NUTS! [shouting] CRAZY!

<Oralius lowers his voice.>

Let's just keep that between me, you, and my pal Captain Winky.

<Oralius grabs at the air and squeezes.>

Anyhooooo... I'm collecting badges to go along with my ogre ear collection. Orc is the flavor of the day. Fifty. [urgent] GO!

<Oralius blows into a horn.>

[urgent] SHIP IT!
quest_4283_quest_progress: <Oralius is talking into a rather large, severed ogre ear.> [commanding] Burning Steppes to control, come in control.
quest_4283_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it! [warm] Your reward is: [commanding] RUB MY BELLY! [urgent] GO ON! [shouting] RUB IT!
quest_4284_quest_detail:
I'm sure you've noticed 'em, <name>. [excited] They're everywhere! [pause] What am I talking about? Why, the crystals, of course!

[emphasis] The crystals... They're all over the crater. [soft voice] Most people ignore them, but I have a strange feeling that they hold power within them. [hesitant] I've been doing experiments here with them for a while, but I can't seem to find anything. [pause] Well, I haven't yet, anyway.

[urgent] Say, I'm running a little low on the crystals I have here -- think you might be able to collect some more for me?
quest_4284_quest_progress: [excited] I just know I'm onto something here, <name>!
quest_4284_quest_complete: [excited] Now I will continue my experiments! [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_4285_quest_detail:
[soft voice] What could they be for? [urgent] I can't get the thought out of my head!

[hesitant] It's driving me crazy -- that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. [chuckling] Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me.

[pause] Anyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... [urgent] Please locate it, <name>. [excited] I just know they exist.
quest_4285_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you visited the pylon, <name>?
quest_4285_quest_complete: [soft voice] I know the stories are true, <name>.
quest_4286_quest_detail:
Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff.

[soft voice] Ain't that right, Winky?

<Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.>

[shouting] ARRR MATEY! [excited] IT BE RIGHT!

[emphasis] See what I'm saying? [urgent] You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff. [commanding] Get in there and shake your moneymaker!
quest_4286_quest_progress: [low voice] I can't be bothered right now, <name>. [urgent] Me and Winky got a meeting to attend.
quest_4286_quest_complete:
<Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.> [excited] OH WONDERFUL!

<Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.>

DELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!

[warm] Take one for yourself, <name>. There's plenty to go around.
quest_4287_quest_detail:
[soft voice] During my stay here, I have heard strange rumors about mysterious pylons existing out in the wilderness of the crater, <name>. I guess that they are quite large, with crystals lining their interiors.

Although I've never seen one, I can't help but think that the rumors are true -- and that the pylons have something to do with all the crystals we found

[pause] So why don't you help me put my curiosity to rest? Supposedly, there is one in the eastern area of the crater. [urgent] Do you think you can find it?
quest_4287_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you visited the pylon, <name>?
quest_4287_quest_complete: [soft voice] Un'Goro is such a strange place, <name>. [solemn] When you enter the crater, it's as if you are in a completely different world...
quest_4288_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My experiments so far have not yielded any positive results, <name>. [hesitant] I can't help but hope that you can find a solution by searching for one of the pylons that I have heard exist.

Perhaps if we combine certain colors at them... but I get ahead of myself. [urgent] Let's find them first!

[commanding] <name>, search the western area of the crater; a pylon is said to be somewhere in that area.
quest_4288_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you visited the pylon, <name>?
quest_4288_quest_complete: [soft voice] There are many hidden areas of the crater along the sides. [pause] Try exploring the winding paths if you can't think of anywhere else to look, <name>.
quest_4289_quest_detail:
[solemn] This crater has many strange creatures--they seem to be nobler versions of the creatures found throughout my homeland and beyond. [soft voice] I cannot explain it, but this place cries of the Earth Mother. [pause] I pay homage to her every time I track one of her beautiful creatures across its basin.

[gentle] If you too wish to feel the enlightenment that accompanies such a great feat, then head to the north. [commanding] There you'll find great apes who are a test for any mortal's strength. [urgent] Bring me their pelts... prove your strength.
quest_4289_quest_progress:
[low voice] Have the creatures here bested you already, <name>?

[commanding] Do not be dissuaded so easily. [solemn] Tracking and defeating the apes of Un'Goro is no simple task, even for a great hunter.
quest_4289_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you have proven strong, strong enough to best the great apes of Un'Goro--that is good. The challenge was small compared to Lar'korwi, but I will not take such a great victory away from you.

[warm] These pelts will make wonderful clothing for my tribe. You have helped me and proven worthy.

[solemn] Before you set off on another task, let us give praise to the Earth Mother and thank the spirits of those apes you killed--they must know their deaths will not be wasted.
quest_4290_quest_detail:
[solemn] Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. [threatening] Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. [sad] My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind.

[solemn] Lar'korwi killed him not far from this spot.

[urgent] If you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.

Return to me afterwards.
quest_4290_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not take my words lightly, <name>. [soft voice] If you truly wish to face this creature, then you must be careful... and smart. [low voice] It will take a great deal of strength and insight to draw out Lar'korwi and defeat him.
quest_4290_quest_complete: [soft voice] This will do nicely, <name>. [solemn] It seems Lar'korwi eats well these days. [hesitant] Although, I wonder where he found a threshadon in this area. [pause] Odd. Regardless, I will hold onto this until you are ready for your confrontation with the beast. [warm] Do not worry for my safety--I am sure you've angered Lar'korwi enough that he will not kill me until after he's tasted your flesh.
quest_4291_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm actually surprised he has not come for you yet, <name>. [solemn] But all is well, for I have a final plan that will bring the monster to us.

[low voice] Being the dominant male gives Lar'korwi rights to breed with any female he chooses--and he chooses many of them. [urgent] You'll find many ravasaur eggs to the west of here. Get close to them and you should provoke an attack by his mates. [whispering] The females produce an awful smell from a gland in their heads that allow males to know they are ready to breed. [commanding] Bring me two of those glands.
quest_4291_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be careful, <name>. Getting close to any of nest of eggs surely will provoke the mothers... even if you've already secured a gland from one. The mothers can be just as deadly as Lar'korwi himself when they fight to protect their young. But, if you are successful, then we shall have a definitive way of bringing Lar'korwi out from hiding.
quest_4291_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, fine specimens, <name>. The two pieces you've found should be perfect for baiting Lar'korwi into the open. [urgent] I cannot wait to see the outcome of your fight with the monster. [threatening] He is a massive thing with claws as sharp as the finest blades. [commanding] You will look into his eyes and you will know death.
quest_4292_quest_detail: [solemn] This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. [soft voice] To the north of here, you will find a small trail into the mountains. It was here I saw Lar'korwi last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby. [commanding] Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat. [solemn] If both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
quest_4292_quest_progress:
[solemn] Do not let fear overpower you, <name>. [soft voice] Fear is the great betrayer... [emphasis] you must remain strong!

[urgent] Take the meat, place it in the small valley, and then use the gland on it. [solemn] Only then will death come for you.
quest_4292_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Earth Mother be praised! [excited] You've done it! [warm] Fair play to you, <name>. [proud] You have proven to be a great hunter in your own right. [soft voice] Your spirit is strong. [solemn] Your bravery unmatched. [warm] And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills.

[solemn] Only the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. [warm] Congratulations.
quest_4293_quest_detail:
[solemn] Felwood is a forest far north of the Barrens, even farther than Ashenvale. There, slimes are found all around pools of water blessed by the touch of Fel. The Scourge decimated the area with attacks of Infernals and other demonic magics--the slimes supposedly crept up through the earth during these attacks.

[soft voice] Gather samples of Felwood slimes and we will use the testing equipment next to me to create a control group for our tests against other samples you gather.
quest_4293_quest_progress: I will need at least five corrupted samples for our control group, <name>. [urgent] Continue to gather Felwood slime samples until you're able to give me that which we'll need. [solemn] The Lady Sylvanas decrees it...
quest_4293_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, excellent. These samples will do nicely. [warm] I thank you for your help.

[solemn] Once we've gathered all the samples of slimes, we'll be able to determine more. [solemn] I am beginning to suspect that Lady Sylvanas' hunch was not only correct, but more insightful than even she could have predicted. [gentle] These samples are very interesting. [whispering] Just seeing how they've reacted with my compounds... hmm, yes, we'll definitely need to investigate further.
quest_4294_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you heard of the Un'Goro Crater, <name>? It is near the Tanaris desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life.

[solemn] It is there you must go. [pause] Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets.

[urgent] I would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.
quest_4294_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes, <name>? [soft voice] How goes your search?
quest_4294_quest_complete:
[excited] Truly amazing, <name>. [solemn] This Un'Goro Crater is holding many more secrets than I expected. [soft voice] I wonder what else we will discover as we test further.

[delight] Simply amazing... look at the purity of these samples. [hesitant] Hmm, I wonder what it could mean. [solemn] They seem to be elemental in nature, but... something more. [soft voice] They remind me of... of the Old Gods. [solemn] We've found traces of them throughout Azeroth, and now I wonder if these creatures aren't related to them somehow.

[solemn] We shall have to test further.
quest_4295_quest_progress: [excited] Oh, ale! I would kill for some Dark Iron ale!! [urgent] Quick, I'm getting sober! [low voice] I know this because sobriety blurs my vision... and it's making you look like the <race> I slew last week! [delight] Dark Iron Ale Mug(2)
quest_4295_quest_complete: [excited] What's this? Ah! It smells like Dark Iron Ale! Drink has blurred my sight, but I can tell that you, sir, are a real friend!
quest_4296_quest_detail:
[solemn] I came to the Burning Steppes, following the legends of the Seven. [soft voice] They were dwarves of great knowledge and power, and if you have knowledge and power, then wealth is sure to follow.

[urgent] That's what I want. [excited] Wealth! [urgent] If we can learn more of the Seven, then maybe we can get rich together. [solemn] The ruins of Thaurissan is rumored to keep the Tablet of the Seven, which holds knowledge of the ancient dwarves. [commanding] Find this tablet, copy its text and bring it to me. [excited] Let's discover its secrets together!
quest_4296_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the writings of the Seven, <name>? [soft voice] Have you learned the secrets from their tablet?
quest_4296_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, you found the tablet! [delight] And your transcription is superb! [warm] Are you sure you're a <class> and not a scribe?

[laughing] Here you are, <name>. [proud] Here is the payment I promised.
quest_4297_quest_detail:
Sprite darters are omnivores--that means they eat both meat and vegetation. [soft voice] If your egg here's gonna hatch, we best be prepared. [emphasis] Some good eats for these little guys are flanks of meat, raw and juicy, believe it or not. [hesitant] I was never able to find out why, but it has somethin' to do with Elune's plan for the elves... maybe they were to be protectors or somethin', I don't know.

[pause] I'll take care of the egg for now, why don't you get me some good Silvermane stalker flanks for 'em to eat when he's hatched.
quest_4297_quest_progress:
Find that meat yet, <name>? [urgent] Your little egg here's just about ready to hatch. If he don't have a good enough first meal, then he might not make it past his first week, and I'd hate for that to happen.

[hesitant] Can't much lie to ya, <name>. [sad] I'm jealous of you gettin' this egg to begin with. Don't make me regret helpin' ya out like this.
quest_4297_quest_complete: [soft voice] These'll do nicely, and if I'm not mistaken, your little egg's just about ready to hatch. [warm] How does it feel? You know, you about to be a father? [laughing] Haha, didn't think ya'd have to deal with such responsibility, now did ya?
quest_4298_quest_detail: [soft voice] Whoa, it was a lot more ready than I thought...
quest_4298_quest_complete:
[gentle] Here, take the egg... [soft voice] better you have it so it bonds to you and looks to you to be its dadda.

[warm] Congrats, <name>. [proud] You're a parent... kinda.
quest_4300_quest_detail:
Hmm, maybe there be somethin' you can do for the Hand now that me think 'bout it. [confident] Yes, Jes'rimon could use your help for sure.

[solemn] In Un'Goro Crater there be raptors with deadly claws. [emphasis] Some of those raptors sometimes have white claws instead of ones black like death. [low voice] The Hand have... clients... that like weapons crafted from these claws. [urgent] Bring me many of those white claws, and me pay you good coin. [commanding] Do it fast enough, and maybe me help you in other ways.
quest_4300_quest_progress: [low voice] Me clients are not so patient, <name>. [urgent] Have you gotten any of the claws yet?
quest_4300_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, these do nicely. [warm] Thank you, <name>. An' you be here long before they needed... that be good.

Maybe we have a weapon fashioned for you from the claws. [excited] What do you say?
quest_4301_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you have been exploring Un'Goro, I have seen other things that a mighty hunter such as yourself would relish in. [soft voice] One such sight was a huge ape among the other gorillas to the north. [pause] You have been to that cave before, but this time, I wonder if you'll survive the encounter if you accept my task.

[commanding] I call him U'cha, and he is one of the Earth Mother's greatest sons, of that you can be sure. [urgent] Defeat U'cha and bring me his pelt. [warm] Do this, and I will defend your right to call yourself a great hunter.
quest_4301_quest_progress: U'cha... the beast was magnificent. [solemn] Huge and red, with teeth the size of daggers. [soft voice] His arms as thick as tree trunks, and as fast as any mountain lion I have ever laid eyes upon. [pause] You should consider yourself lucky to find such a test of bravery--my people would go generations without seeing such a creature.
quest_4301_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. I am pleased. [proud] You have done a great thing here today.

[solemn] U'cha was one of the greatest apes I had ever seen. [emphasis] The fact that you have bested his strength speaks well of your own strength... and courage.

[gentle] It is only fitting that I give you this as a sign of respect. [warm] You have earned it.
quest_4321_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The information you have given me about the pylons is very interesting...

[pause] Give me a moment to do some calculations, <name>. [soft voice] Speak to me again in a moment and I should be able to give you the answer we have been looking for.
quest_4321_quest_complete:
[excited] Alright, <name>. This is fascinating... I can only hope that my diagrams are correct! [warm] I compiled everything into this manual, which you can have.

[proud] I believe I can answer any questions you have about the crystals now, <name>.
quest_4322_quest_detail: [urgent] We need to get out of here, <name>. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. [commanding] If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
quest_4322_quest_progress: [soft voice] You look exhausted, <name>. [pause] Perhaps you should have a seat by the fire and relax.
quest_4322_quest_complete: [delight] Amazing, <name>. [proud] Simply amazing. [solemn] Windsor stormed through here not five minutes ago. [low voice] He makes some grand claims but purports that they are supported by his evidence. [urgent] He is on his way to Stormwind now to confront Bolvar and ... Lady Prestor.
quest_4324_quest_detail:
[excited] Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value! [hesitant] But... we might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.

[soft voice] My sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the Burning Steppes. [urgent] She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.

[commanding] So, what do you say? [excited] Want to help? [urgent] If so, then speak with my sister. You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of Dreadmaul Rock.
quest_4324_quest_complete:
[urgent] Yes, I'm looking for my brother. [solemn] We must find him and retrieve him, bless his heart.

[threatening] But if we can't bring all of him... then his head will suffice.
quest_4342_quest_detail: [urgent] Please, hear me out before passing judgement!
quest_4342_quest_progress: [solemn] Allow me to finish telling my story.
quest_4342_quest_complete: [solemn] As you can see, there was nothing I could have done.
quest_4361_quest_detail: [urgent] You must take this information back to King Magni, <name>. [commanding] He will know what to do!
quest_4362_quest_complete: <Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.> [sad] Why???
quest_4363_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thaurissan was a great and honorable dwarf. [angry] You ruined my life and the life of my unborn child!

<You think that Princess Bronzebeard may still be suffering from the residual effect of the Emperor's spell.>

[urgent] Return to Ironforge and tell my father that the heir to the Kingdom of Ironforge will be a Dark Iron dwarf.

[defiant] Whether he approves or not, it shall be.
quest_4402_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

[pause] If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! [excited] Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

[warm] I'll tell you what, <name>. [confident] If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. [gentle] If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
quest_4402_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
quest_4402_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful, <name>! [warm] As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
quest_4421_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Not many seek adventure here... [solemn] Felwood's corruption is widespread and indiscriminate.

[pause] As part of the Emerald Circle, I seek to heal this land, but there are some that wish it to fester.

[threatening] The ones I speak of are the Jadefire satyrs that dwell to the northwest of here, at the Ruins of Constellas. [commanding] Led by a particularly cruel satyr named Xavathras, they continue to spread the disease to any creatures they encounter.

[urgent] We must defend this land that was once ours. [commanding] Defeat Xavathras and destroy his minions.
quest_4421_quest_progress: [solemn] The corruption here drives the creatures into madness...
quest_4421_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ridding Felwood of Xavathras is only the first step in a long process. It will take much work to repair the damage that has been done here.

[soft voice] I sense that there is something much larger than just the satyrs at work here, but we will only know the truth with time...
quest_4441_quest_detail:
[solemn] The flute you found was carved from an ancient protector, the treant allies that have faithfully protected the night elves.

[sad] The satyrs have been able to corrupt anything they come in contact with, which includes the ancients that made Felwood their home. [soft voice] By the use of the fel, the spirit of the ancient has been bound and tortured, never completely released. [urgent] The felbind you found is no doubt related.

[commanding] We must try to purify the flute, <name>. [soft voice] Bring me blessed water from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
quest_4441_quest_progress: [soft voice] The water will hopefully release the spirit of the ancient, and allow it to be at peace.
quest_4441_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Now, we must pray that we can undo the damage that has been done...
quest_4442_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Using the water of Elune, I will attempt to purify the flute. [solemn] We must end this suffering...

[soft voice] May Elune guide my hands and heart.

[pause] Speak with me again in a moment.
quest_4442_quest_complete:
[solemn] With the blessed water, I was able to break the link between the flute and the ancient spirit. [soft voice] I do believe though, that if you were to use this flute in a sacred spot, you may be able to summon the ancient spirits.

[warm] Perhaps you might try the ruins in the southern part of Irontree Woods. [solemn] Many corrupted treants inhabited this area at one time, and it is possible that they may still reside there, even in spirit form.
quest_4450_quest_detail: [excited] Oh, you know what? [pause] That reminds me.
quest_4463_quest_progress:
[commanding] Present the components, mortal.

I will also require payment in the form of thirty gold pieces for this creation. [low voice] Black DiamondBlack Blood of the TormentedGizzard GumLibram of Rumination
quest_4463_quest_complete: [angry] Take your trinket, fool. [solemn] Leave me to my studies!
quest_4481_quest_progress:
[solemn] There is a price to pay for all things in this world. [soft voice] The price for the specific item that you seek is thirty gold pieces.

[low voice] Naturally, I shall retain the majority of the components which you collected. [gentle] But worry not, you shall have your trinket. [emphasis] Black DiamondLung Juice CocktailLibram of ConstitutionNight Dragon's Breath(4)
quest_4481_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is disgrace to his memory... [sad] a mortal, such as yourself, finishing his life's work.

[angry] Take your amalgamation and be gone!
quest_4482_quest_progress: [urgent] Thirty gold, <race>. [low voice] Thirty gold and the required components. [soft voice] Black DiamondLibram of TenacityCrystal Ward(4)Eye of Kajal
quest_4482_quest_complete:
[solemn] It took Kariel what would amount to several of your lifetimes to complete the libram that you now hold, <race>. [sad] All for what? So that his disciple could stand in the Burning Steppes and bastardize his research in order to satiate a never ending arcane craving... [angry] Curse this foul addiction.

[angry] I am disgusted with your lack of compassion and insatiable greed. [commanding] Be gone!
quest_4483_quest_progress: [commanding] If it is resilience you desire, thirty gold I require. [urgent] Black DiamondCrystal Spire(4)Burning EssenceLibram of Resilience
quest_4483_quest_complete:
[solemn] Other librams are lost in this world. [soft voice] Lost in places you would not dare enter. [pause] Places you would pray did not exist.

[low voice] I will drink in the energies of these components. [commanding] You shall be given the residual waste...
quest_4484_quest_progress: [angry] Do not waste my time, <race>. Give me what I require. Thirty gold and the components. Black DiamondLibram of VoracityWhipper Root Tuber(4)Crystal Force(4)
quest_4484_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My head throbs... The energies of the vast expanses that makes up our universe... ARGGH!

[urgent] Take what you desire and leave!
quest_4485_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hello, <name>. I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith.

[solemn] I think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared.

[warm] Seek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and <name>, take these lessons seriously. [soft voice] You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant.

Be well.
quest_4485_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you've returned to the Cathedral, <name>. [warm] Good. [pause] A lot has happened recently, and I would seek your aid if you prove worthy.

[urgent] Many treacherous enemies are about. [commanding] I will need your help to stop them.
quest_4486_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well, well, well, look at the mighty paladin in all his regality.

Sorry, <name>, I meant no offense... I just get a little jealous sometimes when I see some of the feats you've accomplished. Tiza tells me it's my weakness, and I swore to her I'd work on it. It's just hard sometimes, you know?

But the reason I wanted to talk to you was because Duthorian Rall in Stormwind sent word for you to meet him in the Cathedral of Light when you're ready. [solemn] Sounded important. [solemn] Sounded like something's going on.
quest_4486_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you've returned to the Cathedral, <name>. [warm] Good. A lot has happened recently, and I would seek your aid if you prove worthy.

[urgent] Many treacherous enemies are about. [commanding] I will need your help to stop them.
quest_4487_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, good, you're here. [whispering] I sent a succubus after you to get your attention, but it seems you were able to get here before it found you. No matter.

[low voice] There has been some talk lately of your growing power--that is good for you, possibly bad for others. But those are irrelevant points. The point is, I feel you've proven yourself and therefore are deserving of... [chuckling] hehe... a blessing of sorts.

Above Ratchet in the Barrens you'll find a man named Strahad. I believe you've crossed paths before.
quest_4487_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you've decided to grace my presence again. [soft voice] How kind of you.

My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. [commanding] When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.
quest_4488_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, <name>, you've seen fit to grace us with your presence. How wonderful!

[gentle] I hope you do not expect us to wait on you hand and foot also. You may be growing quickly in power, but you still are a pup when it comes to true knowledge and understanding. If you're not careful, corruption will overwhelm you and your weak will.

[solemn] But I should get to the point: Strahad wishes to speak to you. He is still residing in his tower overlooking Ratchet in the Barrens. [urgent] I suggest not taking too long.
quest_4488_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you've decided to grace my presence again. [soft voice] How kind of you.

My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. [commanding] When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.
quest_4489_quest_detail:
You, <race>! [commanding] Come here! You're the one they call <name>, yes?

[low voice] I thought as much. I will keep this short: you're growing in power, and it has been acknowledged. And now, the time has come that you are rewarded for your efforts.

[urgent] Go to the Barrens. There, above Ratchet, you'll find Strahad Farsan--perhaps you remember him? He would have words with you. [threatening] I wouldn't take long.
quest_4489_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you've decided to grace my presence again. [soft voice] How kind of you.

My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. [emphasis] When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.
quest_4490_quest_detail:
[solemn] I would give you a reward for your patience and hard work. [commanding] But know this, the ability to summon a Felsteed will be much more difficult in the future. [urgent] You will have to earn it... and it will not be easy.

[warm] For now, go with the power to summon such a creature and use it as you see fit.
quest_4490_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good luck, <name>. [warm] I look forward to seeing you in the future.
quest_4491_quest_detail:
[low voice] Ugh... It's so hot...

I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. [sigh] I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.

[hesitant] Please, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Refuge. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.

[soft voice] I am feeling a little out of it, so if I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...
quest_4491_quest_progress: [soft voice] I've been so worried about Ringo...
quest_4491_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ringo's not in the best shape, <name>, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!

[warm] Thank you for finding him.
quest_4492_quest_detail:
[urgent] You've got to help me, <name>! [soft voice] My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the south of here, and he has been gone way too long. [sad] I am really worried about him.

Do you think you could find him? [warm] Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!
quest_4492_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh... I'm so glad someone found me...
quest_4493_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. [solemn] Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on Azeroth.

[soft voice] What we've seen to date is but the first stages. [hesitant] I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in Kalimdor: Un'Goro Crater. [urgent] Go to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg. [commanding] Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.
quest_4493_quest_complete: [low voice] Yes, I gathered that Gracina sent you to me. [urgent] Your experience in fighting these beasties is priceless; no one to my knowledge has ever dealt with their kind before. [hesitant] As for Gracina's idea that Un'Goro Crater is their heart... [pause] perhaps it is. [solemn] Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here. [soft voice] Perhaps it is also one step closer to figuring out what the silithid are all about.
quest_4494_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. [solemn] Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on Azeroth.

[pause] What we've seen to date is but the first stages. [hesitant] I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in Kalimdor: Un'Goro Crater. [urgent] Go to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg. [soft voice] Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.
quest_4494_quest_complete: [soft voice] Yes, I gathered that Zilzibin sent you to me. [low voice] Your experience in fighting these beasties is priceless; no one to my knowledge has ever dealt with their kind before. [hesitant] As for Zil's idea that Un'Goro Crater is their heart... perhaps it is. [solemn] Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here. [pause] Perhaps it is also one step closer to figuring out what the silithid are all about.
quest_4495_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. [hesitant] The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

[sad] I admit, I am a little worried, <name>. [soft voice] Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

[urgent] If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
quest_4495_quest_complete: [soft voice] I'm so glad you found me, <name>. [hesitant] How did you know I was here?
quest_4496_quest_detail:
[urgent] My research revealed to me that the silithid are like bees; destroy the queen of the hive, and the rest of should be thrown into disarray. [commanding] I'll brew a lure that we'll use to bring out the queen; once summoned, you'll take her down.

First though, we need some reagents; we don't want you bungling into the jungle unprepared. [urgent] Go west to find the silithid hive in Un'Goro Crater and obtain a scent gland from one of the bugs. [soft voice] I'll also need some samples of the native Un'Goro soil.
quest_4496_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Finding a suitable scent gland might take a bit - the gland can't be damaged, but the process of getting one certainly doesn't lend itself to it. [low voice] As for the soil, I'd assume it should be easy enough to find.

[hesitant] Anyway, do you have the items I need to make the lure?
quest_4496_quest_complete:
[soft voice] The scent gland, ah yes. The membrane appears intact - excellent. The soil, yes, this should work out perfectly. With my special additions, I should be able to grind all this up into the perfect lure.

Give me a moment to make the lure, <name>. [urgent] Once it's ready, we'll be able to enact the next step that may hopefully stop the silithid before they overrun Gadgetzan... and the rest of Kalimdor.
quest_4501_quest_detail: Wanted: A skilled fighter to deal with the threat of the Pterrordax that inhabit the Un'Goro Crater. [urgent] Their numbers are growing, and they are becoming a menace to travelers in the area.
quest_4502_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Being an apprentice to Marvon Rivetseeker, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.

[hesitant] I've been reading about Un'Goro Crater most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. [pause] I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.

Do you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?
quest_4502_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is it true that the volcano in Un'Goro is active? [hesitant] I'm sure I could learn a lot with some ash from the volcano, <name>.
quest_4502_quest_complete: [excited] These samples will be perfect for my studies! [warm] Thank you, <name>! [delight] I promise, you'll be the first one I will tell about my findings.
quest_4503_quest_detail:
[excited] I'm making a flying machine!

[gasp] I got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. [hesitant] I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.

[soft voice] So, will you help me? [urgent] All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax and diemetradon would be perfect. [sad] There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. [confident] Why don't you give it a try?
quest_4503_quest_progress: [soft voice] Every great vehicle needs a name... [emphasis] I was thinking I'd call it... [excited] Pwned!
quest_4503_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, these scales are perfect. [urgent] I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!

[warm] Thanks!
quest_4504_quest_detail:
[excited] I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, <name>. [gentle] If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. [soft voice] How does that sound to you?

[excited] I thought so!

[urgent] Head to the tar pits in northern Un'Goro Crater, and collect me some tar. [commanding] Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. [soft voice] Regular tar just simply isn't sticky enough.

[solemn] The plant-like creatures contain chlorophyll in their skin, and mixed with the tar, it's super sticky!
quest_4504_quest_progress: [excited] Tran'rek's done it again -- this super sticky glue will be all the rage!
quest_4504_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, this tar is just the stuff...

[hesitant] Hey, wait a minute, my hands... I can't seem to get them apart...

[sad] Maybe this wasn't such a good idea. [delight] Oh, but wait! [excited] Super sticky tar remover! That's where the real money is!
quest_4505_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some may say that I am exceptionally cruel... But truly, it is only a strong desire to see the Horde gain an advantage against the Alliance, in any way possible.

[soft voice] My newest interest is a moonwell at the Ruins of Constellas, south of here, tended by the Jadefire satyrs. [solemn] The moonwell, once a symbol of renewal for the insufferable night elves, is now corrupted, and used to bring forth more satyrs.

[urgent] I have an idea, <name>, and I'd like a sample of the water... for my little feline friend here.
quest_4505_quest_progress: [solemn] This is of utmost importance. [urgent] Be on your way, now.
quest_4505_quest_complete: [solemn] Very well. [commanding] We must find a way to use this corruption against our enemies...
quest_4506_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, <name>. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... somehow. [hesitant] These cats may prove useful...

Here, <name>. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moon well in the Ruins of Constellas. [chuckling] Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!

[warm] Return the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.
quest_4506_quest_progress: [angry] Don't tell me that you can't go back there! [urgent] Get going!
quest_4506_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent!

[angry] The forsaken will resort to any means necessary to crush the alliance! [solemn] The use of the corrupted water will surely prove useful in our future efforts...
