quest_4507_quest_detail:
Here's the lure. Inside the hive network should be a crystal of some sort. [solemn] We think the silithid use the crystal as some sort of hive-wide attunement device. [soft voice] As for where this crystal might be, I'd say try the hatcheries inside the hive.

[urgent] Using the lure on the crystal should roust out the queen, but be warned - she will probably be protected by several guards. [commanding] Take out the queen and remove her brain. [hesitant] As icky as that sounds, we desperately need to study it. [warm] Good luck, <name>!
quest_4507_quest_progress: [urgent] Acquiring the queen's brain for our research is absolutely imperative. [solemn] From what we have learned, we believe that these silithid are quite possibly being controlled by a malign intelligence. [hesitant] I shudder to think what could control something as insidious as the silithid, <name>.
quest_4507_quest_complete:
[excited] Fantastic, <name>! We've won quite the victory here today. [warm] It will take some time for us to fully understand what we have here; we'll put it to good use though, don't you worry about that.

[solemn] As for the silithid, I genuinely doubt that this was the full extent of their presence. [low voice] This is much too clean of a resolution, I'm sorry to say.
quest_4508_quest_detail:
[urgent] My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. [soft voice] As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone.

[commanding] Take my latest report back to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus; she's still at the Temple of the Moon, is she not? [urgent] She's got friends who are Alliance bigwigs; if we can get them involved in this <name>, then we just might make it out of this alive.
quest_4508_quest_progress:
[angry] They are fools, <name>! [angry] They cannot even think to look around them for a greater threat; their irrational hatred of the Horde will be the end of us all. [solemn] I do not know how much more proof I can give them of the silithid threat short of dropping them in one of the hives so they can see for themselves!

[sad] I'm sorry, you bring news for my attention?
quest_4508_quest_complete:
[soft voice] While I genuinely appreciate this, I am not sure what good it will do us. [solemn] The Alliance ignores threats from any source other than the Horde, and even our own leaders here in Darnassus cannot agree on what exactly this threat is. [sad] Fools like Fandral Staghelm theorize that the silithid are nothing like the threat from the ancient past I claim them to be. [angry] His ignorance is only surpassed by his arrogance.

[solemn] You have seen the threat yourself, <name>. [urgent] We must remain committed to defeating the silithid!
quest_4509_quest_detail:
[urgent] My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. [soft voice] As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone.

[commanding] Take my latest report back to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar; he's still in his place on the upper part of the Drag, is he not? [urgent] He's got friends who are high within the Horde; if we can get them involved in this <name>, then we just might make it out of this alive.
quest_4509_quest_progress:
[angry] They are fools, <name>! They cannot even think to look around them for a greater threat; their irrational hatred of the Alliance will be our undoing. [low voice] I do not know how much more proof I can give them of the silithid threat short of dropping them in one of the hives so they can see for themselves!

[pause] I'm sorry, you bring news for my attention?
quest_4509_quest_complete:
[solemn] While I genuinely appreciate this, I am not sure what good it will do us. The Horde ignores threats from any source other than the Alliance. While Thrall himself might take action were the facts presented to him, he is beset on all sides by conflicting advice. [urgent] These fools would have us chase our own imaginary tails were they to think it might catch the Alliance unawares!

[solemn] You have seen the threat yourself, <name>. [commanding] We must remain committed to defeating the silithid!
quest_4510_quest_detail:
<name>, your help has been immeasurable. [solemn] The time will come, no doubt, when I'll ask for your assistance against the silithid once more. [soft voice] We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... [hesitant] that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.

Take this note to Idriana at the bank. She'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. [warm] Thank you for your assistance, brave <class>.
quest_4510_quest_progress: [soft voice] Elune'adore, <class>. [gentle] What may I do for you today?
quest_4510_quest_complete: [solemn] This bank voucher authorizes me to withdraw an item from Gracina Spiritmight's account with us and present it to you. [warm] Congratulations would seem to be in order!
quest_4511_quest_detail:
<name>, we could not have gotten this far without you. [solemn] The time will come soon, no doubt, when I'll ask for your help against the silithid once more. We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.

[urgent] Take this note to Karus at the bank. He'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. [warm] Thank you for your assistance, mighty <class>.
quest_4511_quest_progress: [commanding] Zug zug! [soft voice] What may I help you with today, <class>?
quest_4511_quest_complete: [solemn] This bank voucher authorizes me to withdraw an item from Zilzibin Drumlore's account with us and present it to you. [warm] Congratulations would seem to be in order!
quest_4512_quest_detail:
[soft voice] But the thing I've studied most is ooze. [soft voice] I know it sounds odd, but they're all over!

[soft voice] I helped a lady in Menethil find her bag not too long ago--it was eaten by oozes. [soft voice] I've seen members of the Royal Apothecary Society from Undercity collecting samples of the stuff. [urgent] I want to know why! [urgent] Where does it come from?

[urgent] I've heard of more in Felwood. [urgent] What I need are samples of the oozes there so I can further my research. [commanding] I'll give you containers, you use them to collect a sample from the deceased creatures.
quest_4512_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Some of the experiments I've done are fascinating. [hesitant] I think with a little more work, I'll be able to figure out the nature of these creatures and how they play into how life developed on Azeroth... if they even have anything to do with it to begin with.

[pause] One of my biggest theories that isn't well liked is the idea that oozes and slimes are tied to the creation of this planet... almost like they're a secretion of it.

[sigh] But I can't prove or disprove it until I get more samples.
quest_4512_quest_complete:
[excited] Amazing results, <name>! You got close enough to take a sample of the corrupted things, and managed to look no worse for wear! [warm] Thank you. Oh, these samples will be perfect. [excited] I can't wait to start testing on them.

[confident] If I'm right, I could be one of the Explorers' Leagues greatest scientists!

[proud] That'll prove to all the dwarves that it wasn't a mistake to allow us gnomes into Ironforge after the Gnomeregan incident.
quest_4513_quest_detail:
I'm going to need more samples, <name>. [pause] But--and I don't know how to put this--they have to be pure samples. I know, I know. "What does 'pure' mean, Laris?" I'm not sure. I do know that these are corrupt... just like Felwood. [solemn] Which is what makes my realization so important. The oozes seem to adapt... to take on the aspects of the area they're in. [urgent] I'll need to find samples that haven't been polluted. But where? Where?!

[angry] Bah! <name>, take these containers just in case you find any on your own.
quest_4513_quest_progress: [solemn] So many things to consider. [pause] But what does it mean? [soft voice] And how does it affect the lives of the people of Azeroth?
quest_4513_quest_complete:
[excited] You've found it? <name>, you are a treasure unto yourself. [warm] Your dedication and aid has been magnificent and I could not possibly thank you enough.

[warm] Please, take this for your troubles. [soft voice] I have some work to do, but I'm sure, if you come back at a later time, I'll have need of your services again.

[warm] Thank you. [warm] Thank you so much.
quest_4521_quest_detail:
[solemn] Winterspring lies just beyond Timbermaw, northeast of Felwood. [soft voice] Have you been there?

I have heard that the area is laden with creatures called wildkin. [emphasis] These beasts have been known to guard secrets; secrets of the Night elves.

[pause] We must figure out what may be hidden in Winterspring.

[soft voice] I have heard the ragged owlbeasts can be found just south of the road, and that there are others called raging owlbeasts that may be found in the center of Winterspring. [commanding] Clear them out, and gain access to the land.
quest_4521_quest_progress: [commanding] Report back to me after you have completed the task I gave you.
quest_4521_quest_complete: [delight] This is excellent news, <name>. [solemn] With these beasts out of the way, we can begin to adventure further into Winterspring. [excited] Are you ready for more?
quest_4542_quest_detail:
[solemn] Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. [urgent] Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.

Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
quest_4542_quest_progress: [angry] What do you want, <class>? [urgent] An urgent message - for me?
quest_4542_quest_complete: [angry] More bad news! [angry] These centaurs have gone too far! [shouting] They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. [solemn] This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!
quest_4581_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druid Kayneth Stillwind sent word to me. [soft voice] He would like a report of the happenings along our coast and in the forests surrounding Astranaar. [hesitant] He fears there is a corruption moving through Ashenvale... and he may be right.

[warm] Here, take my report to him. [urgent] You will find him in the shrine of Forest Song, in the Nightsong Woods to the east.
quest_4581_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you have something for me?
quest_4581_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, Shindrell's report! [warm] Many thanks, <name>. [solemn] Shindrell is a fine sentinel, brave and keen. [low voice] I must read this for clues of a wickedness I fear is moving through Ashenvale.
quest_4621_quest_detail:
[commanding] Listen close, sea dawg... the powers of Booty Bay is what keeps us Bloodsail from sailing wheres we like and taking whats we want as rights o' plunder. [urgent] Were ye to put a knife to Fleet Master Seahorn, we'd ne'er run afoul of a Booty Bay's vessel. [urgent] Were ye to put a knife to Baron Revilgaz, we'd ne'er face the law on their terms.

[commanding] If ye are to be an honorary admiral amongst us - yes, ADMIRAL, you'll puts a knife to both of 'em as I've says. [urgent] Go now lad , and return to me once ye does the deeds.
quest_4621_quest_progress:
[angry] Yer back already, ya blasted tar! [commanding] Haves ye done as I've ordered? Fail us, and ye will be walkin' the plank.

[low voice] Arrrrr...
quest_4621_quest_complete:
[excited] Avast ye... Admiral <name>! [warm] Yer a pirate of pirates, lass!

[warm] It warms the cackles of me heart to give ye this hat. [warm] Ye will ne'er find one like it anywheres, and all that gazes upon ye will see that yer an Admiral of the Bloodsail Navy!
quest_4641_quest_detail:
[solemn] Finally, you are of age, <name>... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. [commanding] To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

[hesitant] Yes... <Kaltunk looks you over.> [commanding] You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

[urgent] Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young <class>. [commanding] You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
quest_4641_quest_complete:
[low voice] Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

[sad] A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. [commanding] No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud <class> of the Horde.
quest_4642_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here is some encased ooze created from the Felwood samples you recovered. Take the case to Un'Goro Crater and find a pure ooze... the primal variety will do nicely. [urgent] When you get close enough, release the ooze in the case, and let us see what the two think of one another.

[solemn] After the experiment concludes, bring me a sample of whatever is left over. [commanding] I will await you here in the Apothecarium.
quest_4642_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the experiment, <name>? [pause] I will continue to study the samples you've recovered for me--I am starting to see why Lady Sylvanas is so interested in these creatures. [solemn] If they are truly part of the Old Gods, then who knows how it can be used to our benefit.
quest_4642_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, most excellent, <name>. [delight] This is most excellent.

[solemn] Such a tale. [soft voice] Who would have thought the two would interact with one another in such a way... [soft voice] I will have to spend more time looking at the environmental issues that cause changes in these creatures.

[soft voice] I will continue my research for now. [soft voice] Perhaps we will speak again soon. [warm] Until then, I wish you well.
quest_4681_quest_detail:
[solemn] That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in Darkshore. [solemn] There are more along the coastline and even in the water. [soft voice] I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel. [urgent] Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.

[gentle] Also, in your travels you may find other creatures. [commanding] By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
quest_4681_quest_progress: [solemn] Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. [soft voice] Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
quest_4681_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the coast of Darkshore. [soft voice] The idea that they might be fleeing the area around Teldrassil is disturbing. Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know. [pause] Our research here is but in its infancy.

[warm] On behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given. [warm] Thank you, <name>
quest_4701_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have no doubt seen the worgs which the Blackrock orcs command.

[soft voice] It is curious - no matter how many we destroy, their numbers never dwindle. [low voice] My scouts have reported that the worgs are bred, trained, and ultimately exported from Blackrock Spire: capital city of the Blackrock orcs. [urgent] You must travel to Blackrock Spire and discover the source of this menace. [emphasis] Discover... and destroy.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. [solemn] May Cenarius protect you...
quest_4701_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you discovered and dealt with the source of the worg menace?
quest_4701_quest_complete: [solemn] Do not dwell upon her suffering, <name>. The beast was corrupt - a product of dark magic. [warm] You have done the Alliance a great service and you shall be rewarded.
quest_4721_quest_detail:
[solemn] Runners have returned from Winterspring with reports that there is a series of small caves in the southern area of Winterspring. [soft voice] It seems that there are wildkin situated in the area around these caves. If there is something valuable that they are guarding, I believe that this is the place we will find it.

[urgent] You will find these to be more of a challenge than the previous types, <name>. [low voice] The creatures seem to have gone mad from exposure to the very thing that they strive to protect.
quest_4721_quest_complete: [solemn] Hard work is something I have great respect for, <name>. [warm] Now we can move forward with our plans for Winterspring.
quest_4722_quest_detail: [solemn] You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago. It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
quest_4722_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello <name> - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?
quest_4722_quest_complete: [solemn] Another discovery for us to research - well done <name>! [warm] These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus. [gentle] Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
quest_4723_quest_detail: [solemn] The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge. [soft voice] How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast.
quest_4724_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some say the worg controlled by the Blackrock orcs are the creation of a supernatural force. [soft voice] Others say they are not true worg but instead a breed of demon dog, granted to the orcs by a fallen pit lord.

[solemn] The truth is far less contrived but every bit as frightening. [low voice] The worg of Blackrock come from Halycon and her mate. [pause] Halycon is the gigantic den mother of the worg. [whispering] Her mate? Nobody has ever lived to tell the tale of that one.

[commanding] Strike at the heart of the worg. [threatening] Destroy Halycon... and <name>, watch your back.
quest_4724_quest_progress: [solemn] With the pack mistress slain, we can begin to thin out the worg sentries of the Spire and eventually make some headway into the city.
quest_4724_quest_complete: [shocked] Rabid pups? Gizrul the Slavener? And you live to tell the tale?! [excited] Incredible! [warm] A tribute well earned!
quest_4725_quest_detail: [solemn] More sea turtle remains lie beached along the coastline. [soft voice] This particular set has an abandoned carriage attached to the turtle's shell. [hesitant] Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. [sad] Greymist murlocs now make the remains of this creature their home, feasting off the carrion.
quest_4726_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have been studying the dragonkin of the Burning Steppes for weeks, and I think I've finally had a breakthrough! [excited] I created a device--I call it the Draco Incarcinatrix 900. It can capture the essence of dragon whelp broodlings!

[hesitant] Or, at least I think it can.

[commanding] Here, take the device and zap a broodling in the Burning Steppes with it. [urgent] While it's under the device's effects, defeat the broodling and its essence should be released.

[delight] If it is, then splendid! [warm] Bring me back samples so I can study them!
quest_4726_quest_progress:
[urgent] Do you have the broodling essence, <name>? [excited] I can't wait to study it.

And besides that... [low voice] my patron is not the type of person you want to disappoint.
quest_4726_quest_complete:
[excited] It worked! You got the essence! [warm] Well done, <name>! [warm] Well done! [solemn] This essence will be invaluable in my research. [soft voice] I hope to one day learn how to capture living dragons whelps, or perhaps capture their eggs. [confident] If I could find a way to do that, then I would be the envy of dragon scholars around the world!

[urgent] My employer would also be happy, and as I said before, he's someone you want to keep happy...
quest_4727_quest_detail: [solemn] The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches. [soft voice] The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason. Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
quest_4727_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>! [gentle] Are you here to report on another discovery?
quest_4727_quest_complete: [solemn] The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil. [soft voice] They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. [hesitant] Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? [pause] Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
quest_4728_quest_detail: [solemn] The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach. [soft voice] A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously. [pause] Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
quest_4728_quest_progress: [soft voice] Greetings once again, <name>! [warm] What brings you back to Auberdine? [hesitant] Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
quest_4728_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League. They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs. [soft voice] You appear to have succeeded where we both have not. [warm] Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
quest_4729_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You're probably wondering what I'm doing out here. [excited] Look at the cages! [commanding] Ain't it obvious?

[gentle] I'm an animal lover, first and foremost, but a salesman by trade. [urgent] I track down exotic animals for the rich and famous and domesticate the beasts so they behave as proper pets.

[hesitant] Now you're probably wondering, "What can I do for you, Kibler." [confident] The answer is simple: Take this here beast cage and find me some worg pups. [delight] For that, I'll domesticate a worg for you!
quest_4729_quest_complete: [excited] You got 'em at the perfect time, <name>. Any later and they'd be untrainable! [urgent] Gimmie a minute and I'll have the little fella ready for you to take home.
quest_4730_quest_detail: [solemn] The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach. [urgent] A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature. [soft voice] Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
quest_4730_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>! [excited] Are you here to report on another discovery?
quest_4730_quest_complete: [soft voice] The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil. They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. [hesitant] Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? [solemn] Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
quest_4731_quest_detail: [solemn] Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline. [soft voice] This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell. [hesitant] Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. [urgent] Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.
quest_4732_quest_detail: [solemn] You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago. It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
quest_4732_quest_progress: [soft voice] Greetings once again <name> - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
quest_4732_quest_complete: [soft voice] You've found even more beached creatures, <name>? Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed. With the birth of Teldrassil, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers. Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.
quest_4733_quest_detail: [solemn] The remains of what appear to be a giant thresher have washed ashore on the rocky inlet of the Twilight Shore. [soft voice] The thresher is several times larger than any of the other threshers spotted in these parts. [pause] Wherever it came from, this creature would not seem to have been native to Darkshore.
quest_4734_quest_detail:
<name>, [excited] I've been working hard on a new device, the eggscilloscope! [soft voice] It's designed to project a burst of cold energy at the egg of a black dragon... and freeze it solid! [urgent] Can you test it for me?

[soft voice] I heard that high up in Blackrock Spire, the dragons have a rookery where they hatch their eggs. [pause] That's where you'll have to go to test the eggscilloscope, and then let me know how it worked!

[warm] And don't worry. [soft voice] Frozen dragon eggs should be harmless. [mocking tone] It's the unfrozen ones you have to worry about!
quest_4734_quest_complete:
[excited] It worked? Splendid! I knew it would!

[warm] While you were gone I was working on a new version of the eggscilloscope. [proud] This one has a much longer range.

Here, you can have one in case you go back to Blackrock Spire.
quest_4735_quest_detail:
<name>, [excited] I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs! Here, take this collectronic module. It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport. Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.

And don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!

[urgent] When you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
quest_4735_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the eggs, <name>? [excited] My patron heard you were collecting them for me, and is very eager to get his hands on them!
quest_4735_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...
quest_4736_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, hello, <name>. [soft voice] You're progressing well in your training. [soft voice] So well in fact that I think you should be rewarded for your hard work--and for not becoming corrupted by the arcane yet.

[soft voice] If you're interested, seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. [soft voice] She is currently staying at Strahad Farsan's tower overlooking the town.

[low voice] She's not very friendly, <name>, so don't expect any praise. [warm] But if you work hard, she'll make sure you're taken care of.
quest_4736_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Briarthorn sent you. [soft voice] Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. [warm] This pleases me.

[soft voice] It is typical of our kind, <name>, to band together, regardless of race. [solemn] It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.

[solemn] I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
quest_4737_quest_detail:
Hmph, still you strive to become more powerful. [commanding] I say it's only time before the corruption and addiction takes hold of you and you become a slave to that which you seek to gain power over.

[mocking tone] Pfah! A fool you are! [solemn] Time will prove me right--nothing else... just time.

[pause] But it seems that not all agree with Zevrost. [low voice] It seems Menara would create tools for you to become more powerful and to harness your strength. [urgent] If you're interested, then go to Ratchet in the Barrens. [soft voice] She is there overlooking the town.
quest_4737_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Zevrost sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. [warm] This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, <name>, to band together, regardless of race. [soft voice] It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.

[solemn] I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
quest_4738_quest_detail:
[solemn] Let us be clear about one thing, <name>: I don't feel you are ready for such responsibilities. [soft voice] I don't think aiding in the creation of any item of power is something a novice should ever be involved in; especially one so untested.

[pause] But that's not my decision. [low voice] The powers that be, or at least the ones that do wish to impart such gifts upon you get to decide that.

[urgent] If you're interested in learning more, I suggest you seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. [soft voice] She usually resides in the tower above the port town.
quest_4738_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, Demisette sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. [solemn] This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, <name>, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.

[warm] I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
quest_4739_quest_detail:
<class>! [commanding] Yes, you! You don't have all the accoutrements, but it's plain to see you're ready--the air around you exudes greater confidence. [solemn] Yes, I see it now.

Menara Voidrender would teach you a few things if you feel you're ready. She spends her time tutoring younger students in the arcane. She even gives gifts to those who pass her tests.

[urgent] Go to Ratchet in the Barrens if you're interested. She's above the city in Strahad's tower.
quest_4739_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, Kaal sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. [warm] This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, <name>, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.

[soft voice] I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
quest_4741_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the northern areas of Winterspring, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. [commanding] We must continue our measures there.

Hunt the moontouched owlbeasts in Winterspring, and explore the area they inhabit.

[urgent] This is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. [confident] Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
quest_4741_quest_progress: [angry] Don't tell me that you're too scared! [urgent] Get going!
quest_4741_quest_complete: [solemn] I sense that you are enjoying your work. [soft voice] And I believe that we are onto something here.
quest_4742_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As you can see, the unadorned seal has three empty sockets. Each of those sockets must be filled with a gemstone representing the leadership's command. Finally, Overlord Wyrmthalak, master of the lower citadel, must forge the seal in the flames of the Black Dragonflight.

[solemn] Understand this, mortal: the chance that one of the three generals of the lower citadel would carry a gemstone at any given time is rare. You must be vigilant in your quest. [urgent] Remain determined!
quest_4742_quest_progress: [solemn] Courage and patience above all else, <name>!
quest_4742_quest_complete: <The pieces that you had collected have disappeared.> <Vaelan's image blurs for a moment.> [solemn] The Unforged Seal of Ascension is now ready. [urgent] It is time for the final step.
quest_4743_quest_detail:
[solemn] Few of the black dragonkin, outside of those in the upper citadel, have the ability to forge the seal with their own flaming breath. [low voice] Wyrmthalak is one such dragonkin, but his will is unbreakable.

[urgent] You must travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. [soft voice] It is there that you will find an ancient drake known as Emberstrife. [commanding] You must break his will, <name>. [emphasis] Break it and use this orb on his weakened form. [urgent] You will have scant seconds to control his mind and fan the flames that will forge the seal.
quest_4743_quest_progress: [urgent] Waste no time, <name>. [solemn] Nefarian works feverishly to unleash his evil upon our world.
quest_4743_quest_complete:
[solemn] Stand steady while I cast the final invocation of protection.

<Vaelan's eyes turn to twin orbs of flame.>

[soft voice] The Seal of Ascension is complete...

[pause] Know this, I have imbued the artifact with some powerful protective wards. [warm] In your darkest hour, when all appears to be lost, the might of the red flight will be at your disposal.
quest_4761_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your scouting of the furbolg camp is information that Thundris Windweaver should be made aware of. [soft voice] He graciously serves as the elder of Auberdine, offering sage and just stewardship of the day to day affairs of the village. [pause] Please - share with him your findings to date on the furbolg situation.

[emphasis] I believe he has some ideas of his own on the reasons behind their corruption. [urgent] Perhaps you can work with him to enact a plan to restore the balance of nature here!
quest_4761_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well met, <class>. [solemn] Your scouting of the furbolg situation comes at a fortuitous time for us in Auberdine. [low voice] For some time we have dealt with not only forest dwellers who are now openly hostile to our presence, but also the outright corruption of the forest itself. [gentle] Hopefully you might be able to lend Auberdine aid during these troubling times.
quest_4762_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Cliffspring River has begun turning foul and corrupted. It empties into the Mist's Edge, and I fear the wash will affect Auberdine soon. [hesitant] I suspect the Blackwood furbolgs up-river are the cause of the taint, but I also suspect that they aren't the true root of it.

[commanding] Take this sampling tube and go to the mouth of the river to our north. [urgent] Proceed inland to the first waterfall and draw a sample from the pool there. You'll see a bridge overhead. [confident] Once you have a sample, return to me in Auberdine.
quest_4762_quest_progress: [solemn] The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore. [soft voice] The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... [emphasis] a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
quest_4762_quest_complete:
[solemn] It's no surprise how tainted this water is, but just look at how putrid it is becoming! [urgent] It would seem that action is needed sooner than later, eh <name>?

To our east is Felwood; it is the real source of this corruption, one that I have seen in times past. [solemn] I predict this sample will confirm this. [soft voice] We might be able to enact a cure for it here, but in order to even try we will need assistance. [warm] When that time comes <name>, I hope you will be able to give the aid we need.
quest_4763_quest_detail:
[solemn] We've learned that a source of furbolg corruption is from the satyr. [soft voice] They hold sway via talismans that they channel magic through. [urgent] If the furbolg have a chance at salvation, we must lure out the satyr corruptor and take that talisman!

[commanding] Fill this bowl at our moonwell and take samples of the furbolgs' food from their northern camp. [emphasis] Mix them and place it near the bonfire by the river; any furbolgs who eat will be cleansed just long enough to lure out the satyr corruptor... [whispering] who then you must slay!
quest_4763_quest_progress: [solemn] The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature. [soft voice] When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, [urgent] we will have won a great victory this day!
quest_4763_quest_complete: [solemn] We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won! [warm] <name>, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid. Please accept this along with our thanks. [solemn] What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
quest_4764_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a chamber, high in Blackrock Spire, that was once called the Hall of Fortune. [soft voice] It was where the Dark Iron dwarves kept their relics, trophies and objects of art.

[pause] That was long ago. [soft voice] It is said the hall has collapsed and is now used for... less savory tasks. [hesitant] But I believe some old dwarven relics may still be found there.

[emphasis] One such relic is Doomrigger's clasp, with a surface so encrusted with rare gems that it was said to make weep any dwarf who gazes upon it.

[solemn] That clasp, <name>, is your goal.
quest_4764_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the clasp, <name>? [soft voice] My patron will pay very handsomely for it.
quest_4764_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [excited] So the rumors were true!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] My patron, Count Remington Ridgewell, will be quite pleased to see this addition to this collection.
quest_4765_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to Stormwind. <name>, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor?

[gentle] Deliver the crate to Count Remington Ridgewell. You will find him in the Keep of Stormwind. [warm] I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.
quest_4765_quest_progress:
[solemn] I was told a messenger would come. [soft voice] One with a gift from Blackrock Spire.

[urgent] Are you he?
quest_4765_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, so you are he! [warm] You have my thanks, <name>. [soft voice] And... if you didn't already know... [solemn] the gratitude of a noble in the house of Ridgewell is nigh worth a king's ransom.
quest_4766_quest_detail:
[solemn] An agent of mine, Mayara Brightwing, was sent to the Burning Steppes to scout the ruined city of Thaurissan. [soft voice] That destroyed city of the Dark Iron dwarves may hide objects of great value... objects that would fit nicely into our family museum.

[low voice] Mayara says she found something and will need aid in retrieving it, but it is not in Thaurissan. [urgent] Instead, a foray into Blackrock Spire will be required.

[hesitant] I do not know the details, but if interested then speak with Mayara in the Burning Steppes.
quest_4766_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You came from Stormwind? Wonderful -- I know of an object of art that Remington would kill to have in his museum, but extracting it won't be easy.

[commanding] That's where you come in.
quest_4767_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. [soft voice] Perhaps you can help me, <name>.

[urgent] I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
quest_4767_quest_progress: <name>, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? [excited] I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
quest_4767_quest_complete: [excited] Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. [warm] Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, <class>.
quest_4768_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Darkstone Tablet holds the writings of the long-dead dwarf Urheld Darkstone. [soft voice] An alchemist of great skill, he was thought insane by his contemporaries and, hence, did not share his research.

But he did etch it onto tablets, and I believe one such tablet lies in Blackrock Spire, in a chamber once named the Hall of Fortune. [hesitant] I know not what it is now called, for few enter Blackrock and return.

[urgent] But if you are willing to brave its dangers and return to me with the tablet, your reward will be great.
quest_4768_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the Tablet, <name>? [solemn] I yearn to delve into its secrets.
quest_4768_quest_complete:
[solemn] Excellent. The formulae etched into this tablet will consume days of research, but I am confident such research will bear sweet fruit.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You have been invaluable to us.
quest_4769_quest_detail:
[solemn] Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the Badlands. [soft voice] Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research. [urgent] To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire. [low voice] No easy task.

[commanding] If interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.
quest_4769_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is true. I believe there is a tablet held within Blackrock Spire, a tablet that contains old alchemical recipes. [soft voice] I am glad you are here, for I need help in retrieving the tablet.

[warm] Make yourself comfortable, and I will explain further.
quest_4770_quest_detail:
[urgent] Please help me, <class>! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.

I need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.

[hesitant] Whitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!
quest_4770_quest_complete:
[angry] What!? If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! [sad] His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to Thousand Needles. [solemn] We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.

[warm] I appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. [proud] I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.
quest_4771_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've placed Dawn's Gambit in the container you brought to us, the one that held the dragon eggs. [urgent] Your job is to bring it deep within the Scholomance.

The undead mage Vectus leads a team of scourge scholars... place Dawn's Gambit in their chamber, called the "viewing room." [solemn] It will then react with the undead found there and, with a little luck, destroy them!

[confident] After that, defeating Vectus shouldn't be a problem. [hesitant] Right?
quest_4771_quest_progress: [urgent] Remember, <name> - we must be tolerant yet rigid in our beliefs!
quest_4771_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! [excited] Vectus is defeated! And Dawn's Gambit... did it work?

[hesitant] Hm... maybe my device wasn't the success I had hoped, but I'm glad you were able to handle things anyway. [warm] Well done, <name>!

[proud] The Argent Dawn, and the good people of Azeroth, are in your debt.
quest_4781_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your next task is as simple as your first, but will require you to seek out aid.

[solemn] I require gold thread for the embroidery of the cloak, but gold thread is not easy to come by, and very few know how to make it. [warm] Fortunately, one who is loyal to our cause knows its secrets and is willing to help those rising in our ranks.

[commanding] Bring a gold bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Booty Bay. [gentle] He is a master tailor and will be happy to spin the thread for you. [urgent] Gold bars are smelted by skilled miners. Ask a miner for help.
quest_4781_quest_progress: Gold bars, yes... yes. [whispering] Bring me one and we'll see what we can do about spinning some thread for you. [low voice] Until then, I would suggest you focus your efforts on becoming more powerful. [commanding] Your toughest trials are still ahead. [soft voice] And trust me... you'll wish you were more prepared, regardless of how powerful you think you might be.
quest_4781_quest_complete:
Perfect, <name>. [excited] I'm glad you could find a miner to help you out so quickly. Or did you do this work yourself? Either way, you've done well. [warm] This will be perfect for the thread.

It will take some time to create the stuff, so you'll have to come back--I actually send it off to some princess who we have locked in a tower who's only job is to spin gold thread... no, seriously. [chuckling] I mean it... okay, not really.
quest_4782_quest_detail:
[urgent] Return to Menara, tell her it'll take some time, but I'll make sure to come through for her... and you. Tell her to have you finish gathering the rest of your components--I should have the thread done by then. You can return and pick it up then.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. [soft voice] Oh, and say hello to Strahad for me while you're there. [mocking tone] That old coot... putting a tower right there next to Ratchet... [laughing] crazy.
quest_4782_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Good, you've returned, <name>. [pause] And where is the thread?

[pause] Ah, I understand. [pause] That is acceptable. [solemn] The goblin and his brother have not failed us yet--I suppose it is understandable that he did not have it prepared right then. [pause] So be it... [soft voice] we have other things we can attend to in the meantime.

[pause] Are you prepared for the next step?
quest_4783_quest_detail:
[solemn] The next components are found in Desolace, far to the west of the Barrens and even the Stonetalon Mountains.

There, chaos still reigns after the Sundering. [urgent] Both your strength and cunning will be tested there--you will face creatures of hatred and also of the Burning Legion.

[commanding] From the Hatefury satyr in the northeast, bring me their blood. [urgent] From the lesser infernals in Mannoroc Coven, bring me a lesser infernal stone.

[solemn] We will use both in the construction of your robe.
quest_4783_quest_progress:
[solemn] Desolace is not a kind area: naga, giants, satyr, the Burning Legion... all of those and warring centaur clans all make the land dangerous if you're not careful.

[low voice] Like I said before, it will not only test your strength and cunning, but also your patience. [urgent] Be wary in those lands, <name>.
quest_4783_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent, <name>. [warm] These will do nicely. [soft voice] I will prepare them now while you move on to your last two components. [pause] Are you ready?
quest_4784_quest_detail:
I need only three things now, <name>, then we can finish your robe.

[commanding] First, the fine gold thread Xizk is making for you. Return to him in Booty Bay and get it.

[urgent] Second, bring me two smoldering coals from the fire elementals in the Arathi Highlands. [solemn] If I recall correctly, they are to the west, near Thoradin's Wall.

[soft voice] Finally, a soul shard created by you.

[commanding] After you have all the components, return here to the tower and I will complete the robe for you.
quest_4784_quest_progress: [soft voice] Soon, <name>. [emphasis] I promise you. [solemn] The robe will be more than adequate for your needs and certainly give you an edge over your opponents.
quest_4784_quest_complete:
[delight] Excellent, <name>! The components are gathered and we are ready.

[warm] I trust you will be pleased.
quest_4785_quest_complete:
[gentle] Here you go, <name>. [warm] And please tell Menara we say hello.

[proud] We expect great things of you. [solemn] Perhaps when the Legion falls to its knees, your name will be spoken aloud and in praise of your power. [excited] I can't wait!
quest_4786_quest_detail: [soft voice] I will put the robe together for you now. [pause] It will take but a few moments. [soft voice] Do not go far.
quest_4786_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, <name>. [warm] Here you are. Wear it with pride.

[proud] You've worked hard and I see great things in your future. [soft voice] Remember, to defy the corruption that comes with our path takes great will and fortitude. [solemn] As long as your will is your own, then you shall have great success.
quest_4787_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg. [soft voice] It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar. [urgent] It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.

[commanding] Bring me the ancient egg, <name>. [solemn] It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.
quest_4787_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the ancient egg? [solemn] I sense great forces stirring, and I fear that time grows short.
quest_4787_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, you have the egg! [warm] I bow to you, <name>. [proud] Your strength and bravery will be long remembered.
quest_4788_quest_detail:
[solemn] While I look over the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru, you must find the fifth and sixth! [urgent] It will not be easy, for they are held by the Smolderthorn trolls within Blackrock Spire. [low voice] The spire is a dark mountain of fire between the Burning Steppes and the Searing Gorge.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. [sad] Blackrock Spire is no place for decent folk...
quest_4788_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been to the spire, <name>? [commanding] Do you have the fifth and sixth tables?
quest_4788_quest_complete:
[excited] Unbelievable! You found them! You truly are a hero, <name>!

[warm] That's a good thing, because I've been reading the tablets you brought me before, and from what I gathered... [solemn] we're going to need a hero to stop what's coming...
quest_4801_quest_progress:

quest_4808_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have another favor to ask of you.

My initial study of the essence you collected shows that it might be possible to freeze dragon whelp eggs and preserve them! [excited] I want to test this theory, but first I need specially made engineering components. My colleague, Felnok Steelspring, can make them.

Here, take this letter to Felnok. It tells him what I need. You'll find Felnok in Winterspring, in the town of Everlook.
quest_4808_quest_progress: [urgent] It's cold up here! [shouting] I hope you brought me a blanket!
quest_4808_quest_complete:
That's no blanket! [excited] But what have we here? [soft voice] I letter from Tinkee? [hesitant] I wonder what she has to say...

[pause] Ah, she's studying in the Burning Steppes. [solemn] That makes sense--that's a good source for dragonkin. [warm] Oh, but look! [delight] It says here that she needs some parts for a device she wants to build. [confident] I guess that's where I come in, eh?
quest_4809_quest_detail:
[urgent] I have most of what Tinkee needs, but I'm missing one important component, and that's chillwind horns. The horns of the chillwind chimaera in Winterspring are a concentrated source of cold, but only pristine, uncracked horns will do! [emphasis] I'll need a supply of those to complete Tinkee's order.

[commanding] Bring me the uncracked chillwind horns, and I'll prepare a package for Tinkee.
quest_4809_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the chillwind horns, <name>?
quest_4809_quest_complete: [delight] These are good specimens. [excited] They're packed with cold! [soft voice] Let me get some gloves on, then pack them along with the other things Tinkee needs...
quest_4810_quest_detail: [urgent] Ok, everything is prepared and packed and ready for transport! [excited] Good luck in your journey, and make sure you tell Tinkee that she owes me!
quest_4810_quest_progress: <name>! [urgent] Did you talk to Felnok? [urgent] Did you bring the components I need?
quest_4810_quest_complete:
[excited] You brought them! Great! I'll get to work right away! [warm] Thanks a ton, <name>!

[proud] You've been so helpful to me, I might need you for even more important tasks later...
quest_4811_quest_detail:
[solemn] Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east. They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures. While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.

[soft voice] I've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. [hesitant] No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists. [urgent] I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
quest_4811_quest_progress: [solemn] What do you have to report on that red crystal? [hesitant] Does it even really exist?
quest_4811_quest_complete:
[solemn] So the crystal exists, <name>? Fascinating... [soft voice] anyway, your task has been well executed; good work!

[urgent] What exactly is this crystal? [pause] This is but a single question in a sea of questions. [hesitant] Another question that comes to mind is why the moonkin would be drawn to this object? Is the crystal benign in nature, or does it hold a more sinister purpose?

[solemn] I have many more questions, but we're going to need to examine that crystal closely to get some answers.
quest_4812_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Use this empty vial and fill up on some moonwell water here in Auberdine. Such potent magic should provide a clue as to the composition of the crystal. To do that, you'll pour the liquid over the crystal; it should take care of the rest.

[hesitant] While I don't anticipate anything bad happening to you, I still want you to be careful. Above us to the east is Felwood; if that crystal is tied to that place as I suspect it is, then it could prove to be very dangerous.
quest_4812_quest_progress: [soft voice] The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore. You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
quest_4812_quest_complete: [solemn] You have made it once more to the mysterious crystal. Removing the stopper on the tube of moonwell water, you gingerly pour the contents out over the top of the crystal. As the water cascades down its lattices, you see the opaque surface turn transparent...
quest_4813_quest_detail: [solemn] The moonwell water has revealed that embedded inside the crystal are a few small fragments of bone, as well as half of a jawbone. [soft voice] The jawbone appears to be from a humanoid, but it is unclear without breaking open the crystal - a feat that even the strongest of magic would find near impossible.
quest_4821_quest_detail:
[solemn] A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in Thousand Needles. [soft voice] Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. [urgent] Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.

[commanding] I want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. [pause] Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.
quest_4821_quest_progress: [solemn] I must know more about this mysterious egg, [soft voice] who knows what will hatch from it.
quest_4821_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, finally... the mysterious egg has finally been delivered to me. [soft voice] Now, let me take a closer look at this... [surprised] What..! [shocked] What is this..?
quest_4822_quest_detail:
[excited] ICE CREAM! Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?! [soft voice] Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream! [proud] It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

[soft voice] I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! [soft voice] Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!
quest_4822_quest_progress: I wish they'd make more flavors of ice cream other than strawberry, but I guess I'm lucky that strawberry is my favorite!
quest_4822_quest_complete:
[delight] Mmmmmmmmm! [excited] I love their strawberry ice cream! [warm] If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!

[warm] Thank you very much <name> - [excited] this is the best treat ever!
quest_4841_quest_detail: <name>, [solemn] I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. [angry] They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. [commanding] Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post! [angry] Let wrath guide your hand!
quest_4841_quest_progress: [commanding] Come now <name>, I know you haven't killed your share yet. [urgent] Hunt them down, and I shall give you a reward for my gratitude.
quest_4841_quest_complete: [warm] For my gratitude, this is for you, <name>.
quest_4842_quest_detail:
[soft voice] To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in Winterspring, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs...

[pause] Well, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. [commanding] You'll need to travel the length of Winterspring, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs.

[gentle] Have a look. [soft voice] I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.
quest_4842_quest_progress: [soft voice] The water in the springs seems to have some very odd properties... [hesitant] I am still unsure of what it means...
quest_4842_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, the demons there in Darkwhisper Gorge; I believe it is their presence that is affecting the land in this way. [solemn] I am going to continue observing the hot springs here and see if I learn anything more.

[gentle] I'd wait until you are a bit stronger if you have plans of heading farther into Darkwhisper Gorge.
quest_4861_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey there, lad! [sad] I was chased from my camp in southern Winterspring by some bloodthirsty wildkin! [hesitant] Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding.

[sad] I barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. [urgent] Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? [urgent] I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.
quest_4861_quest_complete: [solemn] A severely damaged crate stands out among the rest of the destroyed belongings at the camp...
quest_4862_quest_detail:
[excited] Believe it or not, there are people out there willing to pay for the most vile of domesticated beast!

[urgent] I'd sent Bijou into the Spire to try and collect some of those spire spider eggs but I haven't heard from her in weeks. [hesitant] Maybe you can help me out?

[warm] I'll tell you what, <name>. Go to Blackrock Spire and collect some spire spider eggs for me. Bring them back here and not only will I give you a little cash, but I'll even domesticate one for you!
quest_4862_quest_progress: [laughing] Are those spider eggs in your pack or are you just happy to see me?
quest_4862_quest_complete:
[excited] What a load! I mean, look at all those eggs! [delight] These should bring in a right few gold.

[warm] As promised, here's your own little critter. [urgent] Don't get bitten!
quest_4865_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. [excited] Vengeance has come to Thousand Needles!

<Hagar wipes his brow.>

<name>, you must act quickly! [urgent] Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. [confident] He will know what to do!
quest_4865_quest_complete: [angry] Vengeance! So, the legend of Arikara is true. [solemn] Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.
quest_4866_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's probably one of the most potent poisons in the world, <race>!

[whispering] I've overheard the Blackrock speaking about its lethality in my jaunts into the Spire. They call it 'Mother's Milk', named after Mother Smolderweb, the big nasty spider in the Skitterweb cave.

[urgent] Now here's what I need from you: A live sample of the Milk, flowing through YOUR veins. [commanding] Just bringing me the gland won't be enough! [urgent] Get her to poison you and come back to me!

[mocking tone] Then... I get to milk ya! <Rubs his hands together in anticipation.>
quest_4866_quest_complete:
[excited] This is gonna make the best ale yet!

[chuckling] Eh, what did you think I was gonna use this for? [mocking tone] Poison or something??

[sad] Crazy kids...
quest_4881_quest_detail: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. [commanding] We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. [urgent] We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.
quest_4881_quest_complete: [angry] They come to kill me? [commanding] I will show them how a Tauren fights!
quest_4882_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.

[solemn] Trull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. [hesitant] Perhaps you should ask him about it.
quest_4883_quest_detail:
[solemn] While I do possess much knowledge about the owlbeasts you defeated in Winterspring, I am not very learned on the subject of the magics they wield. [soft voice] But I do believe I know of one that would be able to examine the necklace and most likely tell you what it is.

[commanding] Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff is an expert in this field; see her. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_4883_quest_complete:
[solemn] The energy of this necklace, <name>. I believe that it has only one source.

<Nara closes her eyes and is quiet for a moment.>

The wildkin, now misguided and confused, were once not so. They once had a purpose, and were guided to serve. The night elf goddess Elune created these creatures to guard her most sacred areas.

While this fact may seem like it holds little value; I urge you to look deeper.

You will learn, in time. [soft voice] Thank you for bringing this to me, <name>.
quest_4901_quest_detail:
[solemn] At the very top of the ridge lies what I believe to be an altar of the goddess Elune. [soft voice] From what I can tell, we need to light the five torches in each cave, and then we will be able to access the altar directly.

[pause] I transcribed some incantations carved into the stone in the ancient ruins of Kel'Theril, which I believe are the secret to unlocking the altar. [urgent] I'll need your help to light each torch, while I recite the spell.

[confident] If we are successful, you'll be able to report our findings to Erelas!
quest_4901_quest_complete: [soft voice] Did you meet up with Ranshalla?
quest_4902_quest_detail:
That's fascinating!

[soft voice] I have always wondered about the truth... [emphasis] Well, you must share this knowledge, definitely! [urgent] Go to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm right away -- you'll find him in Darnassus, in the Cenarion Circle. [commanding] Explain to him what happened, just the same as you told me. [excited] I'm sure he will be just as interested!

[solemn] This is important information, <name>!
quest_4902_quest_complete:
[commanding] Do not hesitate; tell me why you have come.

[soft voice] Oh, yes? Hmm. Well.

[warm] Thank you for bringing this straight to me; it is always best to go right to the top... But... Yes. [solemn] The druids of the Cenarion Circle have known of the Wildkin for some time. [soft voice] That they are pets of Elune, and were chosen to guard the most sacred of places.

[solemn] So while this isn't news, I definitely compliment you on your effort. [warm] Here, take this -- it is something that seems suitable for such a deed.
quest_4903_quest_detail: [commanding] By order of Warlord Goretooth, the following inhabitants of Blackrock Spire must be destroyed:
quest_4904_quest_detail:
[solemn] Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here. [sad] My poor brother...

<name>, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle? [hesitant] Please... I need to get back to Thalia! [urgent] She must be worried sick about me.
quest_4904_quest_complete: Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. [warm] She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. [soft voice] These items belonged to her brother. [gentle] I know she would want you to have them.
quest_4906_quest_detail:
[solemn] A second encampment of satyrs threatens the land of Felwood towards the north, led by the cruel Xavaric. [soft voice] The vile betrayers and tricksters feed upon the corruption of the native creatures of Felwood.

[solemn] Xavathras and his minions were only part of a larger plan -- to cultivate a corrupted moonwell, and then provide the spoils to Xavaric.

[urgent] Now that Xavathras is out of the way, finish this task, <name>. [commanding] Head to the north and defeat Xavaric.
quest_4906_quest_progress: [soft voice] Please, put and end to the suffering of Felwood's creatures.
quest_4906_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for all you have done, <name>. [solemn] May Elune protect you and guide you on the path ahead.
quest_4907_quest_detail:
[excited] Hi, <name>. Remember Tinkee Steamboil? Well, she remembers you! [urgent] She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... she needs your help again. [hesitant] I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.

[solemn] You should speak to her in the Burning Steppes, at the Flame Crest.
quest_4907_quest_complete:
[excited] Felnok was right! [warm] I do need your help again, and this time... it's going to be really dangerous.

[urgent] Are you ready??
quest_4921_quest_detail:
[solemn] We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. [sad] But the odds began to overwhelm us. [urgent] I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. [angry] In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

[pause] I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

[soft voice] Please, <class>, find some sign of my wife.
quest_4921_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you found any sign of her at all? [sad] The pain in my chest tells me that the worst has happened, but I have hope you will find her safe and sound.
quest_4941_quest_detail:
[angry] Rend lives?

Impossible! It had been thought that Rend was slain decades ago.

[solemn] Seek out the wisdom of Eitrigg, <name>. [solemn] None know the workings of the Blackrock better than he and if what is written here bares truth, Eitrigg should be informed. [solemn] No person should be denied the right of vengeance.

[urgent] You will find him in Orgrimmar.

[urgent] Once you have spoken with Eitrigg, confer with the Warchief to find out what he wishes to do about this problem.
quest_4961_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, a summoner's orb--this is where the taint must be coming from. [urgent] We must exorcise the demon within it if you're to use it. [soft voice] That I can do easily.

[commanding] You're the one who has the hard job. [urgent] You must kill the demon once I release it.

[whispering] And you'll have to be quick. [angry] If you take too long then he'll return to the orb and we'll have to start over!

[commanding] So get yourself ready, <name>. [urgent] Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. [threatening] Because this isn't going to be pretty.
quest_4961_quest_progress: [urgent] You'll have to kill that demon to remove its presence permanently from the orb, <name>.
quest_4961_quest_complete:
[delight] Nicely done, <name>! [warm] You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget. [proud] You've shown great power and skill. [soft voice] Now I suppose it's time you return to Menara with your cleansed orb so you can put it to good use.

[warm] Good luck, <class>. [solemn] Perhaps our paths will cross again.
quest_4962_quest_detail:

Take this ruby--with it, you will be able to capture the creature's soul. [soft voice] It works very similar to spells you already know: when the creature is close to dying, use the gem and it should do the rest of the work for you.

[pause] After you're successful, take both the captured spirit and your ruby to Menara.
quest_4962_quest_progress:

quest_4965_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well, well, well... a pleasure to see you're growing in power, <name>. [low voice] I'd wager you'd be about ready to speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. [pause] If you haven't spoken to her before, then let me tell you, I don't think I've ever met another expert in the creation of items--orbs specifically--that can inprison even a demon to serve our will so easily.

[solemn] If you're interested, she's in Strahad's tower above Ratchet in the Barrens.
quest_4965_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. [soft voice] That I can help you if you truly are prepared.

[warm] It's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.

[gentle] So, do you feel you're ready, <name>?
quest_4966_quest_detail: [solemn] But, there may be more centaur than I thought, [urgent] I ask you, <name>, to fight with me against these vile assassins.
quest_4966_quest_complete: [gentle] Thank you for your help, <name>. [warm] I couldn't have held them off without you.
quest_4967_quest_detail:
[low voice] Still a fool, and still seeking the trappings of mortals. Yes, I speak to you with arrogance. [mocking tone] I see you before me and I laugh. [angry] You're pathetic! [cold] But it matters not what I think. [commanding] It only matters what those willing to deal with you thinks! [solemn] And in this case, against my better judgment, those with some portion of power feel you deserve more.

[soft voice] If this is something you strive for then you should speak with Menara Voidrender in the tower above Ratchet. [hesitant] I believe you have met her before some time ago.
quest_4967_quest_complete:

quest_4968_quest_detail:

[urgent] If you want to test your skill, seek out Menara Voidrender above Ratchet in Strahad's tower. [gentle] She will guide you.

quest_4969_quest_detail:
Haha! [excited] You're doing very well for yourself, young <class>.

[confident] Given time, infernals and dreadlords will bow before you!

[commanding] But until that time comes, you must still rely on weapons forged by the hands of the mortal races.

[warm] You seem prepared for another such creation, and if you are willing, Menara Voidrender would speak with you! [soft voice] She is near Strahad's tower overlooking the port town of Ratchet. [urgent] Go there when you are ready.
quest_4969_quest_complete:
