quest_4970_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task.

[soft voice] Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. [pause] Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.
quest_4970_quest_progress: [solemn] Discipline and determination are your goals. [soft voice] I may ask you to do a simple task many times; you must perform to the best of your ability each time.
quest_4970_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for assisting me, <name>. [warm] My opinion of you grows as time passes.
quest_4975_quest_detail: [urgent] I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. [soft voice] I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
quest_4975_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, <name>. [soft voice] Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.

[warm] Tackling the infernal was a great feat on your part and this reward will fit you nicely. [gentle] I wish you further success in the arts, <name>.
quest_4976_quest_detail:
[urgent] Take the cleansed orb back to Menara in Ratchet, <name>. [soft voice] Give her my regards and be safe. [solemn] I truly hope you are able to withstand the temptation and corruption that is sure to come as you follow your path.

[warm] Good luck.
quest_4976_quest_progress:
[soft voice] How goes your search for Tabetha and the orb, <name>?

[pause] Tabetha has been more than useful when it comes to matters of the arcane. [solemn] I'm sure she would have no problem aiding you if you're able to find her.
quest_4976_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] This will do nicely.

[solemn] The only thing left for you to do is to decide on which demon you want me to imprison within the cleansed orb. [commanding] Do that, and you will have a magnificent new item to wield.
quest_4981_quest_detail:
[low voice] Never trust a goblin. That's what it comes down to, <name>.

Bijou is her name - one of our slipperiest operatives. [angry] I found out she was working for some shady exotic pet dealer out of the Burning Steppes named Kibler, in essence, two timing us. [threatening] Worse yet, she was using Horde funds to finance her operations.

I want her brought back here alive.

She was last seen entering Blackrock Spire. Find her and bring her back.

And <name>, [commanding] do not let her sweet talk you.
quest_4981_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I won't lie to you, <race>. [excited] I needed the money! Kibler pays very, very well - much better than the K.E.F. ever could.

But don't doubt my loyalties! [proud] Why do you think I'm down here? To get that crazy goblin some exotic animal eggs or something equally inane? No, only someone truly daft would come to Blackrock Spire to collect pets. Yep, I don't reckon too many people like that exist in this world.

<Bijou laughs.>

[solemn] The last thing we need are those kinds of people breeding.
quest_4982_quest_detail:
[soft voice] At night when this place is lightly guarded, I sneak around the city, taking notes and writing down anything I see that could be of some strategic value to the K.E.F.

[sad] Last night, however, things went dreadfully wrong. [urgent] I stumbled across a tripwire and set off an alarm. [panting] I stashed my recon gear and ran for cover! [sad] Unfortunately, I can't get back to that gear. [angry] They've doubled and tripled up the patrols! [sad] All that information is lost.

[warm] Get my belongings back and I'll return to the K.E.F. peacefully.
quest_4982_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! [warm] Once Lexlort has these plans, he'll forget all about the nasty things he wanted to do to me.

<name>, you're my hero!
quest_4983_quest_detail:
[urgent] Take this report back to Lexlort. [solemn] It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. a strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.

[hesitant] Come with you? [angry] I've got way too much work to do. [commanding] Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!
quest_4983_quest_complete:
I've got to hand it to her; [delight] she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! [commanding] These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.

[warm] Of course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.
quest_4984_quest_detail:
[solemn] While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature. [sad] Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace. [soft voice] I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.

[solemn] There is no salvation for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release. [urgent] Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down. [gentle] Please <name>, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.
quest_4984_quest_progress: [solemn] The wolves that are infected with the plague must be put down, <name>. The disease they carry cannot be cured. [sad] I tried... I tried until I succumbed to the plague myself.
quest_4984_quest_complete:
[solemn] I... I sense that the souls of those wolves you have put down now have rest. They - and I - thank you for a merciful release.

[sad] The wolves are not alone in their suffering within this damnable place, <name>. [hesitant] Please, I have need of you once more.
quest_4985_quest_detail:
[solemn] To the east of where we are, near where the Eastern Plaguelands begin, once proud and majestic grizzlies roamed the countryside. The plague released by the Scourge has sundered these beasts too. [sad] They wander the countryside, agonized by the stiffening of their muscles and the rotting of their fur and flesh.

[soft voice] I ask of you to end their misery as well. The only cure for their suffering is a swift death, one that must be ministered by your hand.
quest_4985_quest_progress: [whispering] I hear your footsteps, <name>. [soft voice] My vision has faded from me, but I still am able to sense things around me. [solemn] Have you ended the misery of the disease-ridden grizzlies?
quest_4985_quest_complete:
"[solemn] I know that the grizzles have been put down, their torment at an end. [soft voice] I... I have one more thing for you. [pause] I wrote it down on... on this branch, sensing that my time in this realm had come to an end.

[sad] Indeed... I am at that end. [warm] Thank you again friend... [pause] the creatures of this accursed land may rest... [sigh] and now shall I."

With that, a heavy sigh is uttered by the druid, followed by what sounds like a death rattle. His body lies motionless on the cottage floor.
quest_4986_quest_detail:
[solemn] The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.

As you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of the Teldrassil tree enters your mind - Darnassus specifically - and the words "Cenarion Circle" are on the tip of your tongue. [soft voice] It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
quest_4986_quest_progress: [solemn] On behalf of the Cenarion Circle, I bid you welcome to this enclave, <class>. [soft voice] What business do you have with us?
quest_4986_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This... this is quite strange. [hesitant] This druid - this tauren druid no less - entrusted you with a great deal of valuable information on the extent of the Scourge's plague. I am surprised a tauren would give a <race> such information, and freely at that if what you say is true. [solemn] We will make good use of this, I promise you. [pause] Perhaps the tauren have not fallen as far from Cenarius as Fandral would believe...

[hesitant] Erm, anyway, please - accept this as a token of thanks from the Cenarion Circle.
quest_4987_quest_detail:
[solemn] The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.

As you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore enters your mind - Elder Rise specifically - and the words "Cenarion Circle" are on the tip of your tongue. [soft voice] It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
quest_4987_quest_progress: [solemn] On behalf of the Cenarion Circle, I bid you welcome to this enclave, <class>. [soft voice] What business do you have with us?
quest_4987_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is from Mulgris, you say? We had heard he sought to minister to the creatures suffering in the Plaguelands, but this is most unexpected... and most saddening. Mulgris is... was a good friend. I will mourn his passing deeply.

His efforts have not gone in vain, thanks to your diligence. In this branch, much lore is stored about the plague the Scourge propagates upon the land. We will study it diligently. As for you, please accept this. [warm] It is the least we can do for your noble efforts.
quest_5001_quest_detail:
[urgent] Ordinarily I don't deal with <race>s but it seems that I'm stuck between a troll and a hard place. [soft voice] You see, my mission here is one of utmost importance to the Horde. The information I've discovered, however, applies to the well being of the Alliance as well. [hesitant] Now believe me, I'm no Alliance sympathizer, but the Blackrock threat is bigger than just a bunch of orcs.

[commanding] You help me out by finding my belongings and I'll help you out with some information that could prove useful to your kind.

[urgent] Deal?
quest_5001_quest_complete: [delight] Well I'll be! [excited] Where were they??
quest_5002_quest_detail:
I'm a goblin of my word, <race>. [commanding] Now listen closely:

[solemn] These orcs are used primarily as beasts of burden and cannon fodder for the black dragonflight!

Their true leader is none other than Nefarian, brood of Deathwing. [soft voice] I've also discovered the location of Nefarian's subordinates in this part of the citadel.

[urgent] Take this map to Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes. [warm] It has the location of these fiends marked for easy identification.
quest_5002_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, <name>. [pause] It has been a long time.
quest_5002_quest_complete:
[solemn] This coincides with much of what we already knew. [soft voice] Regardless, it is interesting and rather unfortunate information.

[solemn] The markings on this map will prove valuable in thinning the Blackrock menace.
quest_5021_quest_complete: [soft voice] A package in the barn that you might have otherwise overlooked now stands out amongst the decay and ruin. [solemn] Perhaps this is the one that the ghost of Janice Felstone was clamoring about...
quest_5022_quest_detail: [soft voice] You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. [pause] It is addressed in a hurried hand to an Emma Felstone of Stormwind; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago.
quest_5023_quest_detail: [pause] You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. [solemn] It is addressed in a hurried hand to a Jeremiah Felstone of Lordaeron; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago.
quest_5041_quest_detail:
[solemn] That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

[urgent] You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. [soft voice] You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

[warm] The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
quest_5041_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes your search for the supplies, <name>? [commanding] I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
quest_5041_quest_complete: Haha! [warm] Thank you, <name>! [excited] This will help us greatly. [proud] You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. [warm] If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
quest_5047_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You'll find Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook, <class>. [commanding] Tell him that 'Finkle is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly.

Then hand him this:

<Finkle hands you a glowing piece of flesh.>

[excited] I snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.'

[confident] I bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this!

[hesitant] Oh, I suppose you don't know where Everlook is, do you? [urgent] To Winterspring, fella!
quest_5047_quest_complete: [urgent] Alive? Suit worked? [excited] And what do we have here?
quest_5048_quest_detail:
[soft voice] She's a tad ornery, and quite possibly out of her gourd... but the records indicate that Ol' Emma does fit the framework of who Emma Felstone might be.

[hesitant] Perhaps you've seen Ol' Emma wander the city - she talks to herself, most often in nonsensical jibber-jabber. Still, she doesn't hurt anything or anyone, so folks pretty much leave her be.

[solemn] All things considered, I would say that Ol' Emma is in fact Emma Felstone. [gentle] You might try asking if her last name is indeed Felstone.
quest_5048_quest_progress: [soft voice] I would tell you to get off my lawn, but as you can see I don't have one.
quest_5048_quest_complete:
My name is indeed Emma Felstone - [soft voice] you're the first person in years to call me that. [hesitant] Who... who are you?

You say you knew... my sister?! [shocked] Is she still alive? Who am I kidding, of course she isn't. [sad] When the plague broke out in Lordaeron, I had come to expect the worst. [sigh] So many of my family died... or worse. [low voice] Here I am now, crazy Ol' Emma, all alone. [angry] What are you, a grave-robber or something? [mocking tone] Looking for your next target?

[hesitant] What... you have a package for me from my sister?
quest_5049_quest_detail:
[solemn] From the evidence I am able to muster, the person you seek - and the intended recipient of the parcel - is Jeremiah Payson, the Undercity cockroach vendor.

[soft voice] I've always been of the opinion that it takes a special gift to sell... cockroaches. [mocking tone] No doubt you are on quite the epic sojourn now, mighty <class>. [pause] I will leave you to your world-shaping endeavors. [gentle] Allow me, however, to be a part of your magnum opus and reveal that he is located near the bank, suitably groveling under one of the walkways.
quest_5049_quest_progress: [solemn] Every time someone steps on a cockroach, I cry. [sad] Please don't make me cry.
quest_5049_quest_complete:
[solemn] I haven't used that name in years... but yes, at one point in my life - before this glorious unlife - that was my last name.

[soft voice] You claim to have known my sister... or rather, have recently spoken to my sister.

[pause] Who's been dead.

For four years.

[angry] You know, if my bones weren't already brittle enough, I'd be tempted to break my foot off on your posterior. [mocking tone] You're quite the vulture, aren't you?

[surprised] What... you have a package for me from my sister?
quest_5050_quest_detail: [solemn] It would seem that I was wrong about you <name>, and for that I owe you an apology. [soft voice] My sister sent me a number of personal effects, including humorously enough the deed to the Felstone farm. [hesitant] I think I'll pass on reclaiming it right now.
quest_5051_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The ramblings of the poor ghost continue:

"[cold] I'm so cold, John. [urgent] Bring me your charm, and we'll be together! [urgent] Quickly John, before the plague comes to change us into hideous beasts! [sad] I can't see you John... but I know you're near. [soft voice] I feel you near me."

[solemn] Perhaps if the second half of the charm was found and reassembled, this would constitute what the spirit of Janice Felstone is seeking.
quest_5051_quest_progress: [urgent] John, don't let the ghouls get you... [sad] don't let the ghouls get me... nasty ghouls... [whispering] our charm will keep us safe.
quest_5051_quest_complete:
You hand the reassembled good luck charm to Janice Felstone's ghost. As soon as she grasps it, you observe an almost immediate change in her. Her ethereal form shimmers, and she looks upon you with clear yet sad eyes.

"[solemn] You've freed me... I no longer will need this charm. [gentle] Please, take it and perhaps it will give you the solace it has given me."
quest_5054_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.

[commanding] I send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.

[low voice] All that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. [urgent] Stay on your guard.
quest_5054_quest_complete: [solemn] This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. [low voice] But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, <name>.
quest_5055_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Swift, and clever, Brumeran glides silently across the snowy landscape of southern Winterspring. [solemn] But do not let her graceful appearance convince you that she is harmless. [low voice] All that cross her pay considerably, and often with their own lives.

[urgent] Seek out Brumeran of the chillwind among the chimera. [commanding] Defeat her, then return again to me.
quest_5055_quest_progress: [soft voice] Brumeran calls out to you, <name>.
quest_5055_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes. You have returned. I believe now that you are a true <class> by nature. [warm] You have faced the most ferocious of creatures and have returned, surpassing my expectations.

[proud] You are now ready for my final request.
quest_5056_quest_progress: [solemn] Shy-Rotam is bold and unforgiving; [soft voice] she will defend her kind with fervent enthusiasm.
quest_5056_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have proven both your strength and your determination. [soft voice] Many more challenges await you, but I have already shown you as much as I am able.

[warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_5057_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before you spoke to me, <name>, I had heard of your endeavors... [soft voice] that you had an unyielding desire to prove yourself, [emphasis] that you had an exceptional ability as a <class>, and I now know these things to be the truth.

[solemn] Those that excel as you do are worthy of recognition. [warm] Take this marker to a friend of mine in Thunder Bluff named Melor Stonehoof. [gentle] I'm sure he will remember you, and what you accomplished so long ago. [warm] Speak to him of you recent victories, and do not ever forget what you have accomplished today.
quest_5057_quest_complete:
[solemn] We learn from our life experiences, <name>. [soft voice] I am sure that you have only become stronger and wiser as a result of yours. [warm] You have grown much since we first spoke.

[warm] Take this in remembrance of the difficult tasks you have accomplished as a <race> <class>, and know that you will always have my respect and admiration.
quest_5061_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. [soft voice] Go now back to your trainer, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, in Darnassus. [warm] Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. [solemn] He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.

[soft voice] Goodbye, young druid. [pause] We shall speak again.
quest_5061_quest_progress:
[solemn] Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

[soft voice] Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
quest_5061_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very impressive, <name>. [warm] You are ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.

[warm] Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. [warm] I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.
quest_5062_quest_detail:
[solemn] Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. [urgent] In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.

[commanding] Go now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. [solemn] Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.

[urgent] Travel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.
quest_5062_quest_progress:
[solemn] So, Motega Firemain sends word of Arikara...well now that is grave news.

<Magatha looks around.>

[sad] Arikara is a deadly creature born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts. <Magatha smiles.>
quest_5062_quest_complete: [delight] Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. [solemn] This rare herb found only in Thousand Needles will help light the dormant sacred fire of life. <Magatha begins to enchant the Incendia agave.>
quest_5064_quest_detail:
<name>, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. [solemn] The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.

[soft voice] <name>, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.
quest_5064_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?
quest_5064_quest_complete:
[solemn] Great Spirit Totem! [solemn] This is dire news indeed. [solemn] I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

[warm] <name>, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
quest_5065_quest_detail:
[solemn] The troll with whom you spoke did not tell the truth. The two tablets you gained for him spoke of containing the essence of Hakkar, but there is more to that legend. I have studied long, and found that there are six Tablets of Mosh'aru, not two! [emphasis] Six! And I fear that we will not like what secrets the others hold..

[urgent] Find the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru. They're in the Eastern Plaguelands, held by the mossflayer trolls. [commanding] Find them, and bring them to me.
quest_5065_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the tablets? [solemn] I fear their texts will reveal a great threat to our world.
quest_5065_quest_complete:
[excited] You found them! [delight] Great! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] I will pour over these texts and decipher their meaning.

[commanding] You, however, have another task...
quest_5066_quest_detail:
[commanding] Hear ye, hear ye! [commanding] All heroes are called upon to heed these words!

[urgent] A call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind! [urgent] All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms! [urgent] Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands!

[urgent] Heroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
quest_5066_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome to the Plaguelands, hero. [soft voice] This is one of most dangerous frontiers in Azeroth, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. [warm] I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!

[urgent] If you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the Plaguelands.
quest_5081_quest_detail:
[solemn] This information fills in the gaps to our otherwise impeccable intelligence of Blackrock Spire.

[commanding] The attack must be decisive, <name>.

[urgent] First their war master, the troll Voone, must be destroyed. [emphasis] Without his battle plans, the Blackrock orcs will be thrown into chaos.

[urgent] You must then take out the ogre Highlord, Omokk. [solemn] The cowardly ogres of Blackrock are powerless without his leadership.

[commanding] Lastly, the overlord of the citadel: Wyrmthalak. [solemn] With Wyrmthalak dead, their central command unit is without a conduit.
quest_5081_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work, <name>. [warm] At the very least, you have bought us more time - precious, precious time.
quest_5082_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have ...strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.

[hesitant] They seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.

[solemn] I'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?
quest_5082_quest_complete:
[delight] Thanks so much, <name>! [warm] Now I can get back to work here.

[soft voice] Did you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?
quest_5083_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.

[pause] Is it something important?

[hesitant] Donova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.
quest_5083_quest_progress: [soft voice] What is that you have found?
quest_5083_quest_complete: [excited] You got this from the Winterfall?
quest_5084_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. [hesitant] And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, <name>.

[solemn] There is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. [commanding] Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?
quest_5084_quest_complete: [solemn] Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...
quest_5085_quest_detail: [soft voice] The greenish substance inside the cauldron appears to be similar to what you found in the flask. [hesitant] This strange gooey stuff could be as corrupted as the furbolg that created it...
quest_5086_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. [pause] However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison.

[solemn] I believe that the Deadwood furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in Felwood; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors.

[urgent] Collect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!
quest_5086_quest_progress: [solemn] I think we are beginning to uncover what is happening here, <name>.
quest_5086_quest_complete: [soft voice] I have to compare this to the substance you found in the cauldron, and then I'm sure we'll know more.
quest_5087_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Very interesting, <name>...

When this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. [solemn] This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.

[urgent] We need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the Deadwood. [commanding] A group of runners walks the distance between their village and Felwood. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.
quest_5087_quest_progress: [angry] We'll see what happens when the Winterfall don't get their firewater!
quest_5087_quest_complete: <Donova examines the contents of the crate.> [soft voice] I wonder if consuming this substance makes the furbolg more aggressive. [hesitant] They do seem much larger...
quest_5088_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take this refined and purified Incendia powder to Thousand Needles and toss it on the sacred fire of life. [soft voice] It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.

[solemn] The enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, <name>.

[hesitant] I fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. [urgent] Move quickly before all is lost, <class>!
quest_5088_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you slain the vicious serpent Arikara, <name>?
quest_5088_quest_complete:
[solemn] This does not make sense. Why would Arikara be after Cairne Bloodhoof? Magatha could not be wrong, she is our most powerful shaman.

<Motega shakes his head.>

[pause] Regardless, your great deed to the Horde shall not go unnoticed - [warm] please, choose one of these as a reward for your aid.
quest_5089_quest_detail:
[solemn] From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.

[urgent] Your instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
quest_5089_quest_progress: [soft voice] What have you got there, <name>?

quest_5092_quest_detail:
[commanding] With Andorhal's western and northern roads into the city well fortified, I'm looking to strike at it from the less defended eastern road. The Scourge relies on the buffer of undead that infests Sorrow Hill as a first line of defense. If we are to advance on Andorhal, we will need to do it through Sorrow Hill.

[urgent] Your first assignment will be to clear the way through Sorrow Hill. [commanding] Thin out the skeletons and ghouls that haunt the area; report back to me when this is done!
quest_5092_quest_progress: [commanding] I want you to prepare for the worst, <name> - dig deep. The task in front of us will not be easy. As we rally our forces here to eventually strike out against the Scourge, you will be part of our advance effort that takes the fight to them! [urgent] Your assigned mission in Sorrow Hill will begin our path to victory!
quest_5092_quest_complete:
[excited] Mission accomplished, <name>! [warm] Well played, well played.

[commanding] Allow me to reward your work thus far with some coin from the Stormwind coffers. [solemn] I'd recommend spending it on materiel that will aid you in your next mission... one that will take you into the ruins of Andorhal itself.

[urgent] Be ready! [urgent] Be vigilant!
quest_5093_quest_detail:
[commanding] Heroes of the realm, hear me - the Horde calls upon you for swift action!

[urgent] A call to arms has been issued for all able bodied individuals to take up arms against the Scourge! [solemn] Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Eastern Kingdoms. [threatening] They loom to the east of the Undercity, in the northern reaches of the lands now known as the Plaguelands!

[commanding] Heroes of the realm - seek out High Executor Derrington, who has set up his base camp at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade!

quest_5096_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before Andorhal, we must tackle the advancing Scarlet Crusade menace from Hearthglen. [urgent] They've made camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears, making us risk conflict against both the Scourge and the Crusade at once.

[commanding] My plan is to play them off of each other by sending you to destroy the command tent they've set up; use some Flame in a Bottle from this box of incendiaries. [emphasis] Once razed, plant this Scourge banner by the tent. [hesitant] With some luck, they'll ignore us and focus on the Scourge for vengeance.
quest_5096_quest_complete:
Finely executed, <name>. [commanding] Your attack on the Scarlet Crusade will buy us time. [solemn] I have sent one of my best scouts out to watch over the camp and make sure that the Crusade forces that come to reinforce the position will take the bait.

[urgent] With the pressure on us lessened, we should now finally be able to risk a mission into Andorhal itself, and an important one at that. [warm] I'd very much like it if you'd perform this one as well, based on your success to date.
quest_5097_quest_detail:
[solemn] Through the use of a magical device known as a beacon torch, we can mark targets of our choosing for future actions by our troops. [urgent] To that end, we think the Scourge are using Andorhal's watchtowers as a means to control their troop movements.

[commanding] Your mission: breach Andorhal's defenses to plant beacons at all four watchtowers. [emphasis] You'll need to be in the doorway of each tower to plant the beacon; it will then proceed to mark the tower. [urgent] There are only five charges on the beacon torch, so use them wisely!
quest_5097_quest_progress:
[commanding] Once the towers are marked, they'll become top priority targets for our attack on Andorhal. [solemn] I suspect that once we neutralize the towers, the main threat of Andorhal will emerge. From that point on, we'll have a straight-up fight for control of the city!

[urgent] You're back to report success, yes? [emphasis] Don't forget the beacon torch as well; we must maintain control of our materiel.
quest_5097_quest_complete:
[excited] My priests are reporting that our beacon trackers are picking up extremely strong signals on all four towers! [proud] Dare I say it, but I believe you've executed another mission with complete and total success! [warm] Well played once again, <name>!

[urgent] With the towers marked, our preparations for the attack are now in place. [commanding] The time has come to take the fight to the Scourge!
quest_5098_quest_detail:

quest_5098_quest_complete:
[excited] My warlocks are reporting that our beacon trackers are picking up extremely strong signals on all four towers! [proud] You've executed my orders with the skill and precision of a seasoned veteran. [warm] Your service to the Horde is duly noted once more, <name>!

[urgent] With the towers marked, our preparations for the attack are now in place. [commanding] The time has come to take the fight to the Scourge!
quest_5102_quest_detail:
[solemn] We battle against these beasts on two fronts: From our capital of Stormwind we fight them from the inside out and here, in the Burning Steppes, we take the battle to their doorstep. [urgent] We must be vigilant, <name>. [angry] None should be spared our wrath as none of our own were spared when they struck at our homes and families.

[commanding] Find this General Drakkisath and destroy him!

[solemn] The task certainly will not be a simple one, but the rewards shall be extravagant.
quest_5102_quest_complete: [solemn] Surely, we will strike against their dragon lords next. [warm] Well done, brave soldier of the Alliance! [proud] Well done, indeed.
quest_5103_quest_detail: [solemn] The only thing that remains of this human are some charred bones. [soft voice] He seems to have died within arms reach of what he was after - unfired plate gauntlets.
quest_5121_quest_detail:
[solemn] While we still know very little about why the furbolg have been ingesting this strange substance, I do think it's best that we put a stop to it before it gets out of hand.

[soft voice] The Winterfall furbolg are not a normally aggressive tribe, and this change in their behavior leads me to think that they must be under orders from their chief. [urgent] We most likely can't undo the damage that has already been done, but I think that if their leader is slain, they will not get any worse.

[commanding] Head east to Winterfall Village.
quest_5121_quest_progress: [soft voice] Maybe you will find out more in Winterfall Village, <name>.
quest_5121_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you so much, <name>. [warm] I hope to get back to my studies without worry that I will be ambushed. Please accept this as a reward.
quest_5122_quest_progress:
[solemn] The power of this chapel gives me the strength to resist the corruption in my heart. [urgent] If I leave it, I will become a death knight. [soft voice] But there is a medallion, the medallion of faith, that will give me the strength I need to leave.

Please, <name>, retrieve the medallion. [solemn] It is guarded by Malor the Zealous, a crazed member of the Scarlet Brotherhood who resides deep in the Scarlet Bastion in western Stratholme. [emphasis] Medallion of Faith
quest_5122_quest_complete:
[excited] You retrieved the medallion! [warm] Now I will be able to leave the chapel and perform my duty.

[solemn] That duty is to kill the beast who helped corrupt me and so many of my brothers and sisters, Baron Rivendare!
quest_5123_quest_detail:
[solemn] The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.

[soft voice] But perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...
quest_5123_quest_complete: [soft voice] I wonder what all of this means... [hesitant] I can't make anything out...
quest_5124_quest_detail:
[excited] By Thaurissan's beard!

[urgent] Where did you find them?

[commanding] More importantly, are you willing to part with them? [warm] Naturally, I would pay you for such a noble gesture.

[commanding] I'll tell you what, <name>. [urgent] If you give me those unfired gauntlets, I will teach you how to make a set all your own. [solemn] All you need to do is collect the parts for me so that I may narrow down the exact recipe.

[urgent] Do we have a deal??

[commanding] Here's the list of what I need, I'll front the non-enchanted thorium myself since you're supplying the gauntlets.
quest_5124_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is money, <name> and I don't have much of either.
quest_5124_quest_complete: [excited] As promised, <name>, here's your recipe! [warm] I'm also going to throw in a little something extra for all of your hard work and dedication. [pause] What am I going to do with these anyway???
quest_5125_quest_complete: <name>, [sad] I am dying... but my soul is saved. For that, I owe you more than words can say. Please, take this... [warm] and fight on, brave <class>!
quest_5128_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.

He is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in Felwood, healing the land from the corruption.

Kelek has much experience with the furbolgs in Felwood, and may be able to tell you more about the log.

[warm] Thank you, again, <name>.
quest_5128_quest_progress: [soft voice] The Emerald Circle is friendly to all, <race>. [gentle] What can I do for you?
quest_5128_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.

<Kelek flips through the pages.>

[solemn] When I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.

[warm] Thank you for sharing this with me, <name>. [solemn] Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.
quest_5141_quest_detail:
[solemn] Dragonscale leatherworking isn't easy, but it's extremely rewarding. [commanding] I'll teach you how to make this fine mail armor, but only if you agree to certain conditions.

[threatening] By choosing this path, you agree never to learn elemental or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for one of the three at the apex of the craft. [urgent] Furthermore, I'll need some samples of your best work involving scorpid armor. [emphasis] Finally, I'll need proof of your ability to acquire the staple of the trade: scales of the dragonkin.
quest_5141_quest_progress: [solemn] If you're ready to commit to a permanent decision by becoming a dragonscale leatherworker, then I'm ready to take you on as a student. [soft voice] Just bring to me the things I asked for, and we'll begin your education.
quest_5141_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I'll hand it to you - it takes a strong will to make a permanent decision like you've just done. [solemn] I assure you, dragonscale leatherworking will prove to be a profitable and rewarding path for you to follow.

[warm] To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
quest_5142_quest_detail:
[solemn] So many of us died at the battle of Darrowshire. [sad] So many died... and worse.

[soft voice] When the battle began I hid my niece Pamela, and I do not know what happened to her. [hesitant] I am but a wandering spirit, but my heart still longs to know Pamela's fate.

[warm] Please, good <class>. [urgent] Will you go to Darrowshire and search for her? It is to the east, beyond Gahrron's Withering.
quest_5142_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hello. I'm Pamela, [warm] what's your name?
quest_5143_quest_detail:
[solemn] To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; [soft voice] I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.

[emphasis] Know this, <class>: [commanding] by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; [solemn] there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. [urgent] Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor. [solemn] From there, we will begin your mastery.
quest_5143_quest_progress: [solemn] Nature is a force that must be appeased before you hope to learn how to bend its will into your leather garments. [soft voice] Bring me your offering to this force, and I will make sure you are heard.
quest_5143_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've given your finest offerings, and nature will soon permit you to bend her to your will. [soft voice] Once I have finished my tutelage, your work will be a force of nature unto itself.

[warm] To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
quest_5144_quest_detail:
[solemn] Elemental leatherworking is what I know, and if you're willing to open your mind to the greater powers of substance, I will share with you all there is to learn.

[soft voice] Know this, <class>: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. [urgent] Furthermore, I'll need adequate proof that you are in tune with the elements of nature; to that end, bring me the purest essences of fire, water, earth, and wind.
quest_5144_quest_progress: [solemn] Making this kind of leather-based armor requires patience and dedication. [soft voice] Once you have cast your lot with the elements, there is no turning your back on them. [urgent] Bring me proof of your worthiness, and we'll get started.
quest_5144_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've cast your lot, and the elements accept you. [soft voice] Once I have finished my tutelage, you shall command the will to craft the finest of leather garbs.

[warm] To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
