quest_5146_quest_detail:
[solemn] Elemental leatherworking is what I know, and if you're willing to open your mind to the greater powers of substance, I will share with you all there is to learn.

[soft voice] Know this, <class>: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. [solemn] Furthermore, I'll need adequate proof that you are in tune with the elements of nature; to that end, bring me the purest essences of fire, water, earth, and wind.
quest_5146_quest_progress: [solemn] Making this kind of leather-based armor requires patience and dedication. [soft voice] Once you have cast your lot with the elements, there is no turning your back on them. [commanding] Bring me proof of your worthiness, and we'll get started.
quest_5146_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've cast your lot, and the elements accept you. [soft voice] Once I have finished my tutelage, you shall command the will to craft the finest of leather garbs.

[warm] To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
quest_5148_quest_detail:
[solemn] To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; [soft voice] I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.

[emphasis] Know this, <class>: [commanding] by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; [solemn] there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. [urgent] Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor. [solemn] From there, we will begin your mastery.
quest_5148_quest_progress: [solemn] Nature is a force that must be appeased before you hope to learn how to bend its will into your leather garments. [soft voice] Bring me your offering to this force, and I will make sure you are heard.
quest_5148_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've given your finest offerings, and nature will soon permit you to bend her to your will. [soft voice] Once I have finished my tutelage, your work will be a force of nature unto itself.

[warm] To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
quest_5149_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My auntie Marlene told me to stay here in our house because my father had to go and fight. [proud] My father's the bravest man in the whole world!

But I've been here for a long time, and he hasn't come for me. [sad] Sometimes bad people come and whisper to me and I want my dad to make them go away, but he's not here!

[whispering] And sometimes when it gets dark I want to play with my doll but I can't because I left it in town.

[hesitant] Will you find my doll for me?
quest_5149_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find my doll?
quest_5149_quest_complete: [excited] You found it! [excited] You found my doll! [warm] Oh, thank you!
quest_5151_quest_detail:
[urgent] I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! [excited] A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. [laughing] Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!

[commanding] Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.

[urgent] The wrecked caravan is just north of here.
quest_5151_quest_complete: [excited] My hypercapacitor! [warm] This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...
quest_5152_quest_detail:
[whispering] Oh, I'm so lonely! [sad] Where is my family? [sad] Auntie Marlene told me to stay here, but then she left and never came back! [sad] And my dad... have you seen him?

[hesitant] Maybe Auntie Marlene knows where he is. [soft voice] She lives near Andorhal, in a house to the south. [soft voice] I think it was on a hill... she said it was on a hill.

[soft voice] Please, <name>. [excited] You're my new friend! [warm] Will you talk to my Auntie for me?
quest_5152_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You saw Pamela? How is she? Is she alive?? [sad] Oh, no! Poor Pamela! She was so young, and such a happy child...

She doesn't know what happened to her father, does she? My brother, Joseph?

No... she couldn't understand what happened to Joseph. And even if she could, I don't have the heart to tell her...
quest_5153_quest_detail:
[solemn] I wish Joseph could again be with his daughter, but it cannot be so. His soul was twisted by the Scourge, and he became a monster. [sad] Oh, he is doomed!

[urgent] But perhaps we can change his fate.

Search the graves outside for Joseph's monument. His body's not there, for it was trampled and destroyed years ago, but under the monument is his wedding ring. Take that ring to Chromie... a strange gnome with very strange powers.

[soft voice] Chromie is staying in the ruined inn at the northwest corner of Andorhal.
quest_5155_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I am to trust you in this matter, you will first have to prove yourself.

I must know that you are an enemy of the Shadow Council--the ones responsible for many evils here and abroad.

[urgent] Travel deeper into Felwood. To the west you will see a path leading to Jaedenar. It is there that the Council plots with the Burning Legion.

[commanding] Enter the depths of one of the corrupted Barrow Dens they inhabit and slay their kind. Return to me after you've done this. Then I will know you truly seek to help us.
quest_5155_quest_progress:
[soft voice] How goes your fight, <name>? I know the shedding of blood as proof of honor can be disgusting to some, but you must understand that it serves two goals: you make my task easier by hurting their numbers, and we gain a respect for each other that will only make us stronger in times to come.

[solemn] I hope you understand.
quest_5155_quest_complete:
[excited] Good, <name>! With their numbers weakening, we can further press them.

[warm] How was your first taste of their power? Were they as strong as you thought they would be? Stronger? Or perhaps they were no challenge for you at all. [mocking tone] Wouldn't that be something?

We can discuss the details of your exploits later. [solemn] There are other things we must focus on now.
quest_5156_quest_detail:
[solemn] To the north, along the east of the road in what's called Shatter Scar Vale, is an area where infernals were called down during the last great war--the craters still scar the land, as do the infernals themselves.

[soft voice] I am curious about two things. First, are there still entropic elementals roaming the area? And second, are the craters still filled with the corrupt, fetid water that gathered there years ago? [urgent] Will you help me and check, <name>? Be careful though, the infernals destroy anything in their path.
quest_5156_quest_progress: I hope your search goes well, <name>. [soft voice] I haven't started heading that far north, but I will admit, the thought of crossing the path of an infernal at any point scares me just a little. [hesitant] The creatures are brainless, but still quite intimidating.
quest_5156_quest_complete:
[solemn] Good that you're alive, <name>. [sad] Bad that the water still exists. [soft voice] I was hoping to find at least one pure source of water here in Felwood. [sad] It looks like my search has failed. [solemn] The process of healing the land could have been made much easier with its existence.

[sad] I will have to concern myself with saving what forest creatures I can while destroying those that have become so corrupt that they endanger themselves as much as travelers through this once-mighty forest.
quest_5157_quest_detail:
[solemn] Deep within Jaedenar lies Shadow Hold--the main fortress of their corruption and evil.

[soft voice] The Shadow Council has protective spells surrounding their lair in the form of braziers. [urgent] If I am to find out any more information about our enemy through scrying, then those braziers must be extinguished. [solemn] By doing so, I should be able to spy on the Council and find out who leads them.

[commanding] If you can, take this canteen and fill it at the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar. [soft voice] Return to me afterwards.
quest_5157_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once we have the waters from the Moon Well, we will purify it and use it to extinguish the braziers of protection within Shadow Hold. [soft voice] That should allow me ample time to see into the chambers even deeper and discern who actually leads this... cult.

[hesitant] I pray the Earthmother is with us.
quest_5157_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This will do nicely, <name>.

Now all we have to do besides apply the waters to the braziers is to have it purified. That should not be difficult--it should only require a little travel.

[urgent] Hopefully we can do this quickly.
quest_5158_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take the corrupt water to the Barrens, <name>. South of Ratchet, hidden along the shore, is an old friend of mine, a shaman named Islen Waterseer. [soft voice] She is a powerful shaman who will help us. [solemn] Her relationship with the spirits of water has always been strong. [solemn] Our task being a noble one should be enough to persuade her and the spirits of water to aid us in this task.

[gentle] You should find her at a small camp right along the water's edge. And, <name>, ignore the pirates... they are but a nuisance and no threat to you.
quest_5158_quest_progress: [solemn] I sense you are not just a simple traveler looking for the path to Ratchet. [soft voice] Come, sit and rest at our camp. [gentle] Speak to me when you're ready.
quest_5158_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you need the water from this Moon Well cleansed. [soft voice] Stopping this force of malice in Felwood seems noble enough, but it is not for me to decide if the water will be purified. [pause] I will ask the spirits of water--it will be up to them to decide if the cause is just.

[gentle] Give me a moment and I will tell them of your plea. [warm] I hope they are as sympathetic as I am to your cause.
quest_5159_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thank the spirits, <name>. [soft voice] They are the ones that have come to your aid, not me.

[gentle] I give this purified water to you now. [warm] Please give my regards to Greta and my best wishes. [pause] She is tackling something greater than many of us... as I'm sure she will soon find out.

The Shadow Council is not a force to be trifled with, <name>. [emphasis] Remember that. [urgent] Go now. [commanding] Take the water and return to Greta.
quest_5159_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, I see you've returned, <name>. [warm] Good. [hesitant] Did you find Islen in the Barrens? [hesitant] Or do we have to find another way to accomplish our goals?
quest_5159_quest_complete:
[solemn] This should be more than enough water for our purposes.

[soft voice] I'm glad to hear that Islen was able to help us. [warm] Her strength with the water spirits has always been a strong one. [gentle] She is also wise, and rare is it that the spirits do not agree with her purpose. [proud] The fact that both of them have blessed our task gives me hope that we are on the right path.
quest_5160_quest_progress: [soft voice] It is good to see you, <name>.
quest_5160_quest_complete: [solemn] The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. [soft voice] In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.
quest_5161_quest_detail:
[solemn] We understand what the cursed brood of Deathwing attempts to do and we know that it cannot be allowed.

[soft voice] Because of the protection Blackrock mountain affords Nefarian, it has become increasingly difficult for us to intercede.

[solemn] We can, however, empower you, mortal - should you so choose.

[soft voice] The path before you is one full of peril. [hesitant] You must decide whether to accept our help. [pause] Ponder this and speak with me again when a decision has been made.
quest_5162_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is the arcane that I control and the arcane which will send you to your next destination.

[soft voice] When you are ready, the journey will begin. [commanding] To the Plaguelands you will go and to Jeziba you will speak.

[low voice] He is a mortal as wise as the ancients and as patient as the immovable earth. [pause] Find him in Andorhal.
quest_5162_quest_complete: [solemn] I am Jeziba, known to many as the Sculptor. [soft voice] What I sculpt, however, are not statues, but heroes.
quest_5164_quest_detail:
A finer instrument of justice, Haleh could not have chosen. [solemn] Read from the catalogue of the wayward and be enlightened.

[pause] Should you persist... should you do what is asked of you... should you survive... [urgent] a hero you will make.
quest_5164_quest_complete: [solemn] Hundreds upon hundreds of pages filled with garbled text and symbols make up the brunt of this book.
quest_5168_quest_detail:
[solemn] The heroes of Darrowshire hold a place in my heart, and the book you brought me, the Annals of Darrowshire, tells their tales.

[soft voice] It tells of the paladin Davil Lightfire and how the Crusade took his libram to the town hall of Hearthglen.

[sad] Its passages also speak of my brother, Captain Redpath. [pause] After his betrayal, his shield was cracked and discarded and now lies in the most unlikely of places -- near the barn of Gahrron's Withering.

[urgent] Gather these relics, <name>. [solemn] For fate and tragedy surrounds them.
quest_5168_quest_complete:
[excited] You have the libram and the shield!

[warm] Their history is entwined with the history of Darrowshire, and somehow, I know that fate will bring them together again.
quest_5181_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Annals of Darrowshire tells of the villains of that battle. [soft voice] It tells how the ghoul lord Horgus the Ravager was destroyed by Alliance forces during the battle. [pause] His body was cast into a lake, northwest of Corin's Crossing, and his skull remains there.

[pause] Marduk the Black was never defeated, but his fabled sword was shattered and lost. [low voice] It lies at the bottom of the gorge west of Corin's Crossing.

[commanding] Retrieve these items, <name>. [hesitant] I know not why, but I am certain their fate lies with you.
quest_5181_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the skull and the sword, <name>?
quest_5181_quest_complete:
[excited] You found them! [warm] Well done, <name>! [solemn] These relics hold a power I do not fully understand, a power you will one day harness.

[soft voice] They also bring dark memories to my mind, memories death and treachery, and of the last night of Darrowshire...
quest_5201_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My presence goes unnoticed by most, <name>. [solemn] However, there is an annoyance that seems firmly rooted here in Winterspring: the Winterfall furbolg.

[low voice] Although I have never directly attacked the furbolg, they seem crazed, fearful of anything in their path. [pause] I have watched them slay countless creatures that had the misfortune to simply be in the wrong place at the wrong time.

[sad] I am weary of their meddling -- [hesitant] please, help me by fighting back. [commanding] Slay the furbolg and keep them away from Frostsaber Rock.
quest_5201_quest_progress: [soft voice] The furbolgs seem to suffer from such paranoia...
quest_5201_quest_complete:
I am relieved to hear that for a short moment, we will not have to worry about the Winterfall intrusion.

[warm] You are beginning to show your perseverance, <name>.
quest_5202_quest_detail: [soft voice] The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. [pause] It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. [hesitant] Why would a member of the Shadow Council have such a thing? [solemn] Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.
quest_5202_quest_progress:
[solemn] I begin to wonder if I'll ever escape this cage.

[soft voice] It's only a matter of time before they sacrifice me to whatever demons they worship. [angry] The monsters!
quest_5202_quest_complete: [excited] The key, you've found it! [urgent] Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!
quest_5203_quest_detail:
But, as much as it pains me, [sad] there is one thing that must be done first: I have to find Trey's sword Lightforge and escape Shadow Hold to tell my superiors what's happening here. Can you help me, <name>?

Our equipment isn't far from here, and you've already proven you can survive the path to the top.

After we escape, [solemn] I'll head to Darnassus if you can find my friend Jessir near the Ashenvale border. She was to meet us at the Emerald Circle's camp near there.

What do you say, <name>? Can you help me again?
quest_5203_quest_progress: [soft voice] You look winded, <name>. Are you all right, or is something wrong?
quest_5203_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You were the one who helped Arko escape? [warm] I'm so glad you found me. [pause] She passed by here not too long ago on her way to Darnassus. [sad] She had Lightforge in tow and wouldn't even take time to speak to the druids to be healed. [solemn] She said it was far too urgent.

[soft voice] But she did tell me about your encounter with Trey's spirit. [solemn] What a terrible fate for a Knight of the Silver Hand. [sad] She didn't show it, but I know it's tearing her up inside, the thought of losing one of her closest friends.
quest_5204_quest_detail:
[soft voice] She would like to pretend that she's fine. [soft voice] She'd love for me to think that she's strong enough to deal with all of this on her own, but I know better than that. [sad] Trey's death and hearing the torture he was put through is going to haunt her for a long time, and there's nothing we can do to stop that. [urgent] But we can give her some peace!

<name>, return to Shadow Hold, kill Trey's torturer and find his remains. [solemn] There is no reason we can't tie off all these loose ends while Arko'narin mourns in her own private way.
quest_5204_quest_progress:
[solemn] You inspect the body, and there is no doubt that these are the remains of the Knight of the Silver Hand, Trey Lightforge. [soft voice] For a moment you think of Arko'narin and question if anyone in your life meant as much to you as this man meant to the Night elf captive you recently helped escape Shadow Hold.

[pause] After taking another moment to gather your thoughts, you know that you cannot take the paladin's remains back to Jessir without killing his torturer first.
quest_5204_quest_complete: [soft voice] You gather the paladin's remains as carefully as you can, recalling that at least his spirit has been released from any pain or suffering that might have been forced upon him.
quest_5206_quest_detail:
[solemn] Chromie said the relics you gathered are reagents to a powerful spell, and one more is required: skulls from the scourge who took part in the battle of Darrowshire.

[urgent] Take this crystal and hunt scourge champions for their skulls. The crystal is enchanted; if a champion took part in the battle, then when you pass the crystal over its skull it will resonate. [soft voice] Bring me those resonating skulls.

[commanding] Go, <name>. [urgent] You'll find scourge champions in the Noxious Glade to the north and the Fungal Vale to the west.
quest_5206_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the skulls? [solemn] Chromie said they will be critical for her spell, and that spell will give us the chance to save Darrowshire.
quest_5206_quest_complete: [excited] You found them! [delight] Wonderful! [solemn] Although I don't fully understand how they can help us, [soft voice] I feel their power and I know in my bones that they are linked to my home village of Darrowshire.
quest_5210_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've come from the west? How fare the rest of Lordaeron? I know that Andorhal is lost, but has the Scourge yet reached fair Tirisfal?
quest_5210_quest_complete:
[solemn] What is this book? The Annals of Darrowshire? That was my home before the war... my home before the battle that destroyed it! [sad] Why did you bring me this book?

[soft voice] But look here! At the end there are pages that tell tales of the days beyond the battle! [excited] Here is a passage about me! And one about my brother Joseph! [hesitant] Is this book true?

[urgent] We must discover the truth!
quest_5211_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many of the defenders fell at the battle of Darrowshire. [angry] And many roam again as the ghastly servants of the Scourge! [urgent] Find these poor souls and end their misery!

Hunt cannibal ghouls, gibbering ghouls and diseased flayers. [solemn] Many of these fiends were once the good folk of Darrowshire and destroying their forms now will set their souls free.

[urgent] You will find them in Plaguewood and Corin's Crossing, and in other Scourge strongholds of Eastern Plaguelands.
quest_5211_quest_progress: [solemn] The poor defenders of Darrowshire cry out to me in my dreams, <name>. [urgent] You must free them!
quest_5211_quest_complete: [solemn] It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them. [soft voice] My heart will weep less, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
quest_5212_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Forsaken apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences.

[soft voice] I have been studying the plague for years, <race>. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the Plaguelands is startling. [urgent] The plague seems to be growing in strength!

[urgent] I need to run more tests! [commanding] The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. [commanding] Travel to Stratholme and bring me samples, <name>.
quest_5212_quest_progress: [soft voice] Some say I worry too much - to them I say, [mocking tone] 'You don't worry enough!'
quest_5212_quest_complete: [solemn] There is something that has changed in the chemical structure of the plague's active agents. [urgent] More data is required.
quest_5213_quest_detail:
[solemn] You will have to delve deeper into Stratholme, <name>.

[soft voice] Beyond the first gates you will find the ziggurats. [solemn] We know that the Scourge draws great power from these structures. [soft voice] Search the Ziggurats and return with any information that you may discover.
quest_5213_quest_progress: [excited] We are on the verge of discovering what this new active plague agent may be!
quest_5213_quest_complete:
[delight] Astonishing! This will take months to dissect and analyze. [warm] The Argent Dawn thanks you for your efforts, <name>.

With our blessing, take your pick between either this Seal of the Dawn or this Rune of the Dawn. You can use either of them instead of a standard Argent Dawn Commission to collect scourgestones on our behalf. Should you lose yours, speak with me and I'll get you a replacement.
quest_5214_quest_detail:
[solemn] Terrible thing... what happened to Fras. You see, the town was sacked and Fras didn't want to leave his precious goods behind. The last thing I remember him saying was, 'I'll burn every last leaf before they get their damned, dirty hands on them!'

I may love a good stogie but I'm no fool. I left Fras and his delightful store that day. I assume he went down in flames but if there's a chance that even one box of his famous tobacco is still intact...

[warm] What do you say, <name>? Find a box for ol' Smokey?
quest_5214_quest_progress: [urgent] I can't take it, <name>! [urgent] You gotta help me! [urgent] I'm dying!
quest_5214_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh sweet, sweet stogie, how I have missed you...
quest_5215_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four here in the west, and four more ensconced in the east. [urgent] These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.

[low voice] The necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. [soft voice] My second, High Priestess MacDonnell, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
quest_5215_quest_complete:
[solemn] May the power of the Light shine upon you in these dark times, <class>. [warm] I am pleased to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.

[soft voice] Our goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. [urgent] In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons present in the Western Plaguelands.

[commanding] Stand ready hero, for a glorious battle against the vile Scourge awaits you!
quest_5216_quest_detail:
[solemn] Of the four cauldrons here in the west, the one located at Felstone Field may be the easiest one in obtaining access to. The Scourge have greener troops positioned here, though they should not be underestimated.

[urgent] Go to Felstone Field, northwest of Andorhal, and engage the cauldron lord there. We think it has a key that will unlock access to the cauldron. When unlocked, use this bottle to obtain a sample of the poisons inside the cauldron; we'll need it for study in developing a counter agent.
quest_5216_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5216_quest_complete:
[solemn] The key taken from Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is a perfect fit in unlocking the access panel. [soft voice] A foul stench emanates from the opened panel as an unknown mix of concentrated substances swirl inside the cauldron.

[gentle] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
quest_5217_quest_detail: [soft voice] You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.
quest_5219_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. [soft voice] Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes!

[commanding] Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. [urgent] It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron. [gentle] Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
quest_5219_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [pause] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5219_quest_complete:
[solemn] The macabre key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.

[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
quest_5220_quest_detail: [soft voice] You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
quest_5222_quest_detail:
[solemn] Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you will be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. [urgent] This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!

[commanding] This time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. [soft voice] It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. [whispering] Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.

[warm] Good hunting, <name>!
quest_5222_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5222_quest_complete:
[solemn] The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous two cauldrons you've dealt of. [urgent] A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.

[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
quest_5223_quest_detail: [soft voice] You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
quest_5225_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last cauldron that remains is located on a farm now called Gahrron's Withering. [soft voice] It is guarded by some of the Scourge's tougher minions - specifically, wraiths and ghosts. [commanding] They are not to be trifled with, <name>.

[solemn] Gahrron's Withering is due northeast of our position here, close to where the Eastern Plaguelands begin; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. [urgent] Here is your empty sample bottle; bring it to me filled. [warm] May the Light protect you in this dangerous mission, <class>.
quest_5225_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5225_quest_complete:
[solemn] Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform. [pause] A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework.

[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
quest_5226_quest_detail: [soft voice] You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.
quest_5228_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four in the west, and four more entrenched in the east. [low voice] These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.

[solemn] The necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. [urgent] My second, Shadow Priestess Vandis, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
quest_5228_quest_complete:
[solemn] From the shadows, brother <race>, I bid you greetings. [soft voice] I am to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.

[solemn] Our goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. [urgent] In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons here in the Western Plaguelands.

[commanding] The time has come for you to lead the charge against the Scourge, hero.
quest_5229_quest_detail:
[solemn] Of the four cauldrons in the Western Plaguelands, the one at Felstone Field may be the easiest one to gain access to. [low voice] The Scourge have greener troops positioned here, though they should not be underestimated.

[urgent] Go to Felstone Field, due east of here and northwest of Andorhal, and engage the cauldron lord there. [emphasis] On it is a key that will unlock access to the cauldron. [soft voice] When unlocked, use this bottle to get a sample of the cauldron's toxins; we'll need it for study in developing a counter agent.
quest_5229_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5229_quest_complete:
[solemn] The key taken from Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is a perfect fit in unlocking the access panel, though it disappears after you use it. Still, you think you can open the panel now without a key. [pause] A foul stench emanates from the opened panel as an unknown mix of concentrated substances swirl inside the cauldron. 
 
There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
quest_5230_quest_detail: [soft voice] You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.
quest_5231_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. [angry] No tears will be shed this day, <class>; we must strike at this cauldron and gain access to it!

[urgent] Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you inside the cauldron's innards. [soft voice] Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
quest_5231_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5231_quest_complete:
[solemn] The skeletal key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.

[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
quest_5232_quest_detail: [soft voice] You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
quest_5233_quest_detail:
[solemn] Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you'll be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. [urgent] This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!

[commanding] This time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. [soft voice] It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. [whispering] Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.

[soft voice] Good hunting, <name>!
quest_5233_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5233_quest_complete:
[solemn] The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous ones you've dealt of. [pause] A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron. 
 
[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
quest_5234_quest_detail: [soft voice] You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
quest_5235_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last cauldron that remains is located on a farm now called Gahrron's Withering. [soft voice] It is guarded by some of the Scourge's tougher minions - specifically, wraiths and ghosts. [commanding] They are not to be trifled with, <name>.

[urgent] Gahrron's Withering is far to the east of the Bulwark, close to where the Eastern Plaguelands begin; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. [soft voice] Here is your empty sample bottle; bring it to me filled. [solemn] May the shadows cloak you in safety for this dangerous mission, <class>.
quest_5235_quest_progress: [solemn] An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. [soft voice] In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
quest_5235_quest_complete:
[solemn] Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform. [pause] A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework.

[soft voice] There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
quest_5236_quest_detail: [soft voice] You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.
quest_5237_quest_complete:
<name>, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!

<The commander clears his throat and begins to bellow loudly.>

[warm] Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Kingdom of Stormwind and to the Alliance above and beyond the call of duty - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give <name> this, and I extend upon his our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Alliance. [proud] Cheers, I say!
quest_5238_quest_complete:
<name>, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!

[commanding] Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Forsaken and to the Horde as a whole above and beyond what was expected - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give <name> this, and I extend upon him our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Horde.

[proud] Huzzah!
quest_5241_quest_detail:
[sad] Sometimes, when it's nighttime, I can hear my Uncle Carlin crying. It sounds like he's far away, to the east.

[hesitant] I hope he's not crying for me! <name>, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?

If you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam! [excited] That story's so funny!
quest_5241_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've seen Pamela? She's alive?

She's dead? No! [sobbing] Oh, Pamela! Why does your spirit still suffer in this world. Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive? In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone!

Ah, but this news cannot change fate. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [urgent] Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever.
quest_5242_quest_detail: [solemn] Unfortunately, I see the only way to stop this threat to Felwood is a frontal attack. There are no other ways into Shadow Hold, and I have no means to teleport you inside. The straight path down to the bottom is the only way... [pause] and I also know who you should seek out. His name is Fel'dan... Shadow Lord Fel'dan. He is the mortal in power down below... he is the head of the serpent. [commanding] Kill him and his two succubus servants and return to me. [solemn] Fel'dan is the one making pacts with the Legion. [urgent] He must be stopped.
quest_5242_quest_progress: [solemn] Without Fel'dan, the Shadow Council will hopefully lose focus and start infighting. [urgent] They will struggle with one another for control and hoard assets for future plans. [commanding] That will be an opportune time to devastate them and their demon slaves.
quest_5242_quest_complete:
[solemn] Earthmother be praised, <name>! [warm] Thank you! [excited] This is a great day, indeed!

[solemn] The Shadow Council will be hard pressed to scale to the same levels of power they once held with this blow to their hierarchy. [proud] You have done a great thing this day!
quest_5243_quest_detail:
[solemn] I look at my undeath as a malady, <race>. [soft voice] An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. [solemn] What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead?

[solemn] I am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me.

[solemn] If you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer.

[urgent] Venture to Stratholme and recover our surplus of holy water. [emphasis] Search the supply crates.
quest_5243_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary, not all supply crates will have survived the destruction of the city. The Scourge dare not touch the water but surely the holy water will not prevent vermin infestations.
quest_5243_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <race>. [warm] You have proven that while you are tolerant of others, you will stop at nothing to destroy the minions of Kel'Thuzad.
quest_5244_quest_detail:
[solemn] The story behind Kel'Theril is one of a cursed race, bound to the place where they attempted an unfortunate ritual...

[soft voice] The highborne that you will find there once stole a sacred artifact, believing that they could siphon its power for themselves, becoming even more powerful. [low voice] In their efforts, the relic shattered in a huge explosion, driving the pieces below the ice of the lake...

[pause] Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper if you'd like to learn more; he has recently visited the area and can tell you more.
quest_5244_quest_complete: [solemn] Well, sure, I can tell you more about Kel'Theril. [soft voice] Mind you now, I'm no historian, but I can tell ya about what I saw there...
quest_5245_quest_detail:
[solemn] The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. [soft voice] They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.

[commanding] If you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.

[urgent] Now, I can't tell you a thing about what you find, but I do know of someone who might... Aurora Skycaller; she dwells near the Northpass Tower in the northern part of Eastern Plaguelands.
quest_5245_quest_progress: [soft voice] Why have you come here?
quest_5245_quest_complete: [solemn] The past of the high elves is something that I do not wish to discuss, <name>. [soft voice] Please, it pains me to think of all that has happened... [pause] And that there is no way to make things right.
quest_5246_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I did not realize... [soft voice] Forgive my callous words, <class>.

The mistakes of my ancestors are not what I wish to dwell on, but if your request is truly genuine, then I will help you.

<Aurora examines the fragments.>

[solemn] I believe this is the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact that can contain and control strong arcane forces. [soft voice] It could have been used for good, but the evil intentions of those that stole it caused it to shatter.

[urgent] Go to the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara - I can only hope the book is still there.
quest_5246_quest_progress: [solemn] It is only in the pages of the sacred writings that I will be able to discern whether or not I can help you...
quest_5246_quest_complete: [solemn] The pages have gone untouched for many many years...
quest_5247_quest_detail:
[gentle] I will be able to help you, if recreating the artifact is truly what you wish to do.

[solemn] To seal the pieces back together, I will need items with strong magical qualities. [soft voice] An enchanted thorium bar and five crystal restore... [whispering] You'll also need to collect some water from what might seem an unlikely place... [urgent] Find the dire pool along Eldreth Row at Dire Maul in Feralas, and fill this vial.

[soft voice] While you are gone, I will attempt to glean from these pages the knowledge I need to repair the damage done to the relic.
quest_5247_quest_progress: [solemn] The relic must be placed in the hands of only the most trustworthy. [soft voice] It can not be stolen again...
quest_5247_quest_complete: [solemn] Using these elements, I can fuse the fragments together... [pause] to hopefully what they once were.
quest_5248_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I weep for what has happened in the past. Like this crystal, the elves, as a race, have been shattered. [sad] I do not know if the pieces will ever again be reunited into one, but my sorrow has been eased by being able to help you with this one small task.

[soft voice] We must not forget the past, <name>...

[pause] Please take the Crystal of Zin-Malor back to Lake Kel'Theril. [urgent] You must find a highborne spirit that realizes the error of what was done so long ago. [solemn] Show the spirit that we have made things right again.
quest_5249_quest_detail:
[solemn] In Winterspring, to the north of here, there are many ancient elven ruins. [soft voice] It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.

[pause] With all my work to do here in Felwood, I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring. [soft voice] But there's no reason why you shouldn't!

[excited] While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. [gentle] He spends most of his time in Starfall Village and he knows a lot about the area.
quest_5249_quest_complete: [soft voice] A friend of Ivy Leafrunner? [warm] Nice to meet you, <name>.
quest_5250_quest_detail:
[solemn] In Winterspring, to the north of Felwood, there are many ancient elven ruins. [soft voice] It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.

[pause] My studies here keep me so busy that I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring for some time. [hesitant] But there's no reason why you shouldn't travel there and study the ruins.

[emphasis] While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. [soft voice] He spends most of his time in Starfall and he knows a lot about the area.

[warm] Tell him that you are a student of mine...
quest_5250_quest_complete: [solemn] A student of Daryn Lightwind? [warm] Nice to meet you, <name>.
quest_5251_quest_detail:
[solemn] Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, <name>. Take for example, the Scarlet Crusade. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?

[angry] Blasphemers, one and all!

One in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of Stratholme: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. [urgent] Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.
quest_5251_quest_progress: [commanding] Remember, <name> - [emphasis] we must be tolerant yet rigid in our beliefs!
quest_5251_quest_complete: [delight] Outstanding, <name>! [sad] Years of intelligence, lost! [angry] The Scarlet Crusade will surely feel this blow in the coming weeks.
quest_5252_quest_progress: [soft voice] It has been some time since you left, <name>. [pause] How have you fared?
quest_5252_quest_complete: [soft voice] Is that... what I think it is?
quest_5253_quest_detail:
[solemn] Quite impressive, <name>.

The crystal of Zin-Malor can never be returned to the temple which, as you know, lies in ruin. [gentle] But I believe that your effort to undo the evil of the past should not go unrewarded.

[commanding] Seek out Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, and bring the crystal to him, <name>. [warm] It should be in the hands of those that will not abuse its power. [solemn] From the looks of it, only a handful of the strongest magic users would be able to control such a power.
quest_5253_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have heard of the Crystal of Zin-Malor; the user of the crystal becomes capable of incredible arcane power, but only if truly worthy. [soft voice] I am impressed that you not only recovered the crystal, but you also realize your own limits, and did not attempt to use the crystal yourself.

[warm] Thank you for bringing it to me, <name>. [solemn] We will keep it safe, and may the cursed sprits that once guarded the shattered crystal finally be at peace.
quest_5261_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. [pause] That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

[urgent] If you're interested then speak with Eagan. [soft voice] He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
quest_5261_quest_complete: That's true. [excited] I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! [urgent] Are you that person?
quest_5262_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You try and gather your thoughts as the dust settles across the chamber. [pause] You go over the events that just transpired and still cannot comprehend the gravity of the situation.

[solemn] The Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade a demon? And not just any demon but brother to Varimathras, arch lord of the Undercity?

[emphasis] You carefully stow the severed head of the dreadlord into your pack. Surely, none would believe the tale you would tell without proof.

[urgent] Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff must be told at once!
quest_5262_quest_progress: [soft voice] What have you got there, <name>?
quest_5262_quest_complete: [solemn] What will this mean to the Crusade? [soft voice] Could it be possible that they have been under the control of this demon? [hesitant] Unwittingly serving as the pawns to a greater evil?
quest_5263_quest_detail:
[commanding] You display a natural aptitude for destruction and you follow orders. It is rare to see the two coexist. [solemn] I am beginning to think that you may make an excellent vehicle of divine justice.

<Zverenhoff clasps his hands together in front of his face.>

[threatening] Kel'Thuzad's errand boy rules over Stratholme. [urgent] Prove to me that you are a champion - my champion. [commanding] Destroy Baron Rivendare and return to me with his head.
quest_5263_quest_progress: [solemn] The Baron has slain more people than you have most likely seen in your lifetime.
quest_5263_quest_complete: [solemn] It has been many years since I have ushered a champion into our ranks. [warm] You are the first to be granted audience with Lord Maxwell in years.
quest_5264_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am about to bestow a great honor upon you, <name>.

[warm] Lord Maxwell wishes to reward you for your service to the Argent Dawn!

[soft voice] It has been years since Maxwell has granted audience to outsiders.
quest_5264_quest_complete: [warm] You are a worthy ally, <name>. [proud] You shall reap the rewards of your stalwart dedication.
quest_5265_quest_detail:
[solemn] Through the years the Argent Hold has remained locked. [soft voice] None have been worthy to reach inside and take from it the power of the Argent Dawn - until today.

[warm] The Argent Hold is now open to you, <name>.
quest_5281_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are those that died tragically in the fall of Stratholme. [soft voice] Many took their own lives, opting to hurl themselves into the myriad flames of the smoldering city rather than become one of the Scourge.

[solemn] They now walk the streets of Stratholme as restless spirits.

[urgent] We must aid them, <name>!

[soft voice] I have an associate named Egan who has been doing miraculous work with ghosts and souls. [gentle] Seek him out. [solemn] He walks the eastern Plaguelands, near Stratholme, testing his innovations.
quest_5281_quest_complete: [delight] Alen has finally found someone brave enough, eh?
quest_5282_quest_detail:
I draw my power - my will to continue living and breathing - from the unmitigated hatred I have for the Scourge and all that they have done. [solemn] I am, however, no zealot. There are those, like the Scarlet Crusade, who would sooner destroy the innocent undead than lend them even an ounce of compassion.

Which brings me to this: My blaster. It will unchain the tortured souls from Stratholme.

[commanding] Use it on the ghosts that haunt the ransacked streets. [urgent] Free their souls.
quest_5282_quest_progress: [solemn] Compassion is what separates us from the animals, <name>. [soft voice] Remember that...
quest_5282_quest_complete:
<Egan wipes a tear from his eye.> [soft voice] Did you see my mother, <name>? [gentle] Did you free her?

[warm] You are a shining example of decency. [warm] For your troubles...
quest_5283_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So ye made the smart decision.

[low voice] There ain't no love lost betwixt me an old Ironus here. [angry] That good for nothing toy maker knows who the true craftsmen round here be.

[solemn] The truly great wars are won with a good defense. [urgent] When it be go time, no offense is gonna be helping ye out.

[commanding] Right, so let's get to work. [warm] All ye need to do is show me that ye've got some raw talent. [confident] After that, I'll yank whatever impurities be left in ye and mold ye into an armorsmith. [warm] Ye do know how to make ornate mithril, don't ye?
quest_5283_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, ain't nothing like a good forge tan. Ye can tell who's got the really good tans by their apron lines.
quest_5283_quest_complete:
[solemn] This be it, <name>. [pause] After this, there ain't no way to turn back. [soft voice] It's not too late to become a toy maker, er, weaponsmith.

[gentle] I trust ye'll make the right decision.
quest_5284_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a weaponsmith you'll find that more often than not, heroes and adventurers will be coming to you for gear. [soft voice] While the workload can be unbearable at times, the riches more than make up for the back strain and ash lung.

[warm] Oh yes, <name>, weaponsmiths are the ones with all the gold!

[confident] If you wish to join our ranks, you'll need to show me that you can make me a silver or two - I mean, show me that you've got what it takes to be the go to guy when people need superior quality weapons. [commanding] Get to work!
quest_5284_quest_complete:
[excited] About time! I've got customers waiting.

[commanding] Give those here and pay attention. [urgent] You're going to take the first step in your career as a weaponsmith.
quest_5301_quest_detail:
Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. [solemn] To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. [solemn] It is an addiction that I dare never give up, <name>.

[soft voice] I can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. [solemn] As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.

[solemn] If you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.
quest_5301_quest_progress: [solemn] I will pound the steel until the breath itself has been taken from me.
quest_5301_quest_complete: [solemn] This is the final step before you begin your new career as an armorsmith, <name>. [urgent] Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. [confident] Otherwise, prepare yourself for a lifetime of glory.
quest_5302_quest_detail:
[solemn] One day, I will create a legendary hammer. [angry] A hammer fit for a Warchief!

[emphasis] It is my life's work, <name>. [emphasis] My passion. [commanding] I recognize that you have the potential to be among us, one of us - a weaponsmith. [commanding voice] I am the one that can help you harness that potential.

[urgent] A simple task is all that you must complete. [emphasis] Simple for one of your exceptional skill.
quest_5302_quest_progress: [commanding] For the glory of the Horde!
quest_5302_quest_complete: [solemn] This is the final step before you begin your new career as a weaponsmith, <name>. [urgent] Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. [commanding] Otherwise, prepare to be consumed by knowledge!
quest_5305_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. [low voice] The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. [urgent] Defeat him and bring me his apron. [warm] For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.

[commanding] Understand this: [emphasis] Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.
quest_5305_quest_complete: [commanding] May you bash in many a brain, <name>!
quest_5306_quest_detail:
[commanding] Don't let her beauty fool you, <class>. [solemn] The shadow huntress, Vosh'gajin is deadly and deranged.

<Kilram points to the scar on his face.>

[mocking tone] Aye, she gave me that - a love tap, she called it.

[urgent] The time for vengeance has finally come.

[commanding] You can find Vosh'gajin in Blackrock Spire. [urgent] Slay her and return to me with her snakestone. [warm] Do this and I will teach you the ways of the axesmith.
quest_5306_quest_progress: [solemn] Legend states that one use of Vosh'gajin's snakestone will keep an axe razor sharp for a 1000 years!
quest_5307_quest_detail:
[commanding] If I am short with you, it is for a reason. [solemn] The plans for the creation of the great blade, Corruption, have been stolen by the Black Guard: Elite skeletal units of Baron Rivendare.

[emphasis] Yes, Baron Rivendare of Stratholme.

[low voice] The Black Guard swordsmith now guards those plans with his... undeath.

[urgent] Slay him and return proof of this deed and I shall train you in the ways of the swordsmith.
quest_5307_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you forgotten what it is that you were tasked with, <name>?
quest_5307_quest_complete: [confident] It should be obvious that a sword is always the best choice.
quest_5321_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...

<yawn> [soft voice] Would you mind showing me the way? I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in Ashenvale. It can be dangerous, so I hope you have some friends that will join us.

Lastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.
quest_5321_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, I am so happy Kerlonian made it! [soft voice] And I'm sure I'll find him sleeping somewhere around here, won't I?

[warm] Thank you for showing him the way, <name>.
quest_5341_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. [soft voice] I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.

[angry] Weldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.

He now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. [urgent] Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!
quest_5341_quest_progress: [low voice] Bow your head in my presence, <race>. [mocking tone] I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.
quest_5341_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work, <race>. [warm] Now to secure my inheritance...
quest_5342_quest_detail:
[solemn] Naturally, with my brother still alive, there may be some contention as to the primary beneficiary of the family's fortune. [threatening] This cannot be.

[threatening] A low down guttersnipe like you isn't above a little cold-blooded murder, I hope.

[cold] It's a simple task and one that I expect you will complete; that is, if you wish to claim your reward.

[urgent] Weldon sits under Alliance protection at Chillwind Camp, to the east. [commanding] Slay him, return his head.

<Alexi yawns.>

[commanding] Hurry along now.
quest_5342_quest_progress: [commanding] Secure my fortune and share in the spoils.
quest_5342_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful! [solemn] Now only I hold the power and fortune of house Barov!

<Alexi throws a large bag at you.>

[mocking tone] And keep the change, you filthy animal.
quest_5343_quest_detail:
My dear brother Alexi. [solemn] What a fool I was to spare his life. [angry] I looked into the face of the enemy, one of the undead, and let him live.

<Weldon spits.>

[threatening] He now searches for MY inheritance. [urgent] This simply cannot happen.

[commanding] Find my family's deeds before that vile retch gets his boney hands upon them and I shall reward you with vast riches. [solemn] They lay in the ruins of the Scholomance. [urgent] Make haste!
quest_5343_quest_progress: [solemn] Ensure my future and I shall ensure yours.
quest_5343_quest_complete: [solemn] There is but one more task that I must ask of you, <name>.
quest_5344_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the deeds recovered, there is but one thing left to do. [angry] Alexi must be killed. With him dead, I need not ever worry about an unscrupulous gang of mercenaries seeking my head.

It's a simple task. [urgent] Alexi hides under the protection of the Horde - at the Bulwark.

[commanding] No, I do not expect you to just walk up and kill him, I want his head! [soft voice] How you get it... well, that part is up to you. [solemn] That type of behavior is below one of my noble upbringing.
quest_5344_quest_progress: [low voice] You do want payment, do you not?
quest_5344_quest_complete:
[excited] A glorious day it is! [proud] Finally, the pockmark of house Barov eliminated and my fortune secure!

[cold] Take this and leave my sight, peasant.
quest_5361_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in Desolace. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed.

[urgent] Journey to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into Desolace; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.
quest_5361_quest_progress: [urgent] What news have you, <class>! [pause] Ah - a message from my brother you say? [emphasis] Well then, hand over the report!
quest_5361_quest_complete:
[solemn] I know not what connection you have with my brother but it would seem he has trust with you, <class>.

[warm] I am Nataka Longhorn and would like to welcome you to Ghost Walker Post, we have many needs of a <class>! [excited] Talk with others, perhaps there is need of you here.
quest_5381_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Burning Blade possesses the Demon Box. [soft voice] Within it lies the powerful Hand of Iruxos. [urgent] The Burning Blade uses it to open demonic portals at Mannoroc Coven. [solemn] We must stop the tide of demons entering our world, <name>!

[commanding] Use this demon pick on the red crystal in Thunder Axe Fortress to gain access to the Demon Box.
quest_5381_quest_progress: <name>, [urgent] do you have the Demon Box?
quest_5381_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the Demon Box. Give it to me, <class>, and I shall open... and thus reveal to you the Hand of Iruxos.
quest_5382_quest_detail:
[solemn] Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.

Find him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. [urgent] Turn them to ashes, <name>.
quest_5382_quest_complete: [soft voice] I can feel my spirit healing, <name>. [warm] You have done my husband and I a great service, but I am certain there is more to be done.
quest_5384_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is it, <name>.

<Eva points to the vial inside the bag.>

[solemn] The blood of innocents. [solemn] The purest blood, used to appease Krastinov's master.

[solemn] It is with this blood that Kirtonos may be summoned. [solemn] It is with this blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.

[urgent] Take the blood to the porch. [urgent] Place it upon the brazier. [urgent] Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. [urgent] When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.

[solemn] Should you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.
quest_5384_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary, Kirtonos is a seasoned fighter.
quest_5384_quest_complete: [solemn] With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of Scholomance comes to a close. [pause] There is, however, more to be done. [warm] Others here are now aware of your brave acts. [warm] Take this, <name>. [soft voice] It is a piece of our own essence. [solemn] It will allow you to communicate with the other lost souls of Caer Darrow.
quest_5385_quest_detail: [pause] You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of Felwood and Ashenvale. [solemn] Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.
quest_5385_quest_progress: [soft voice] How did things go in Jaedenar, <name>?
quest_5385_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it! Praise be to Elune and whichever powers you worship, <name>. [warm] You have done an honorable and noble thing this day. [soft voice] I am certain Arko'narin will be pleased that you not only took the time to save her, but to also slay the creature who tortured one of her best friends.

[hesitant] I wish I could do more for you, but please, take this.
quest_5386_quest_detail: [solemn] The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. [sad] The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. [pause] Hrm... [hesitant] Do me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.
quest_5386_quest_progress: [soft voice] My hoof tingles and my mouth starts to water when I think of fried Bloodbelly fish... [excited] You have any on you?
quest_5386_quest_complete:
[warm] You are a savior, <name>! [excited] These Bloodbelly fish look almost good enough to eat raw.

<Nataka starts salivating.>

[warm] Here you go - choose one of these items as a payment for these fish.
quest_5401_quest_complete:
[solemn] All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission. [warm] Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.

[soft voice] While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. [urgent] Procure these insignia and bring them to me. [solemn] For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.

[proud] Achieve your destiny, <class> - join the fight today!
quest_5402_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file. [soft voice] These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context. [solemn] The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated.

[urgent] The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones! Minion's Scourgestone(20)
quest_5402_quest_complete:
[commanding] Congratulations, <name> - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token!

[solemn] The tokens serve two purposes. One - they can be used to further your standing within the Argent Dawn; to do so may avail you options and rewards that are reserved for our honored and revered allies. Two - they can be given to our quartermasters, along with coin, as payment for some of the Dawn's more prized items.

[proud] Whatever you decide, know that you are earning your commission. [warm] Well done!
quest_5403_quest_progress:
[solemn] An Invader's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops. [soft voice] These are sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in the Plaguelands. [commanding] Slaying such a creature is indeed a challenge, but one that should be relished with a commission to vanquish evil.

[urgent] The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for ten of these insignia. [warm] Bring them to me here, and I will make sure you receive your just reward. [emphasis] Invader's Scourgestone(10)
quest_5403_quest_complete:
[commanding] Congratulations, <name> - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token!

[solemn] Each valor token handed out to worthy recipients is a sign of the tide turning against the Scourge. [solemn voice] With more and more heroes fighting the Scourge in their own lands, the Argent Dawn will assuredly be at the forefront when the time comes to wage war on the ultimate evil of the Scourge. [warm] I hope that the valor you've shown what it took to acquiring your token will carry the day then as well!
quest_5404_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Corruptor's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's overlords. [solemn] A powerful being that holds a position of authority over the Scourge will always possess one. [commanding] To slay such a malevolent creature would surely advance the cause of the Argent Dawn, and all good causes!

[warm] On behalf of the Argent Dawn, I will give you a valor token in exchange for just a single one these insignia. [urgent] Use caution in acquiring one, <name> - such powerful beings are not to be trifled with. Corruptor's Scourgestone
quest_5404_quest_complete:
[excited] Congratulations, <name> - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token! 
 
[solemn] To acquire a valor token in such a manner indicates that you are a true hero in the cause of good. We value all effort brought to bear against the Scourge, but to take down one of their leaders is to truly deliver onto them a crushing defeat! 
 
[commanding] For the Dawn, my brother!

quest_5421_quest_progress:
[low voice] I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... [laughing] I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

[soft voice] Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps. [urgent] If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... [mocking tone] get my drift mon? [excited] For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish! Shellfish(5)
quest_5421_quest_complete: [gentle] Sweet mon, nothing beats work being done, especially if it's someone else doing the work... eh?
quest_5441_quest_detail:
Cursed peons! They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps! [commanding] I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right <race> for my task. Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job. [angry] A good smack will get them right back to work! Return the blackjack when you're done.

[sigh] Lousy slacking peons...
quest_5441_quest_progress:
[angry] No good lazy...

Eh? Do you have my blackjack? [urgent] Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
quest_5441_quest_complete:
[excited] Good, good. Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!

[warm] Thanks for the help!
quest_5461_quest_detail:
[solemn] The undead fear life just as the living fear death. [soft voice] It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.

[low voice] Unfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.

[urgent] You must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. [warm] May luck be with you, <name>.
quest_5461_quest_progress: [solemn] A keepsake of remembrance is a rare find, <name>.
quest_5461_quest_complete:
[solemn] I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. [soft voice] This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.

[commanding] Prepare yourself, <name>, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.
quest_5462_quest_detail:
[solemn] Upon tainted soil, the keepsake must be attuned.

[soft voice] It is rumored that Stratholme is where Frostwhisper succumbed to the Lich King. [solemn] Upon those bloodied grounds he gave his life - freely and with motive - to become one of the undying.

[solemn] It is those grounds that must be found.

[pause] There is one, an undead dissenter of the Scourge, freed by the Banshee Queen but loyal to the cause of the Argent Dawn. [soft voice] Find him: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. [soft voice] He may know more. [urgent] Seek out Light's Hope, <name>.
quest_5462_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not ask questions of which you do not want answers.
quest_5462_quest_complete: <Leonid looks over the keepsake.> [solemn] Your quandary stirs up memories that I had hoped would never resurface.
quest_5463_quest_detail:
[solemn] I watched as the human, Ras Frostwhisper, pledged his undying soul to the Lich King. [whispering] He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. The Lich King stood over the fallen mage and with a single motion, Ras Frostwhisper the lich, was born.

<Leonid gazes at the ground and then looks up at you.>

[soft voice] Yes, <race>, I remember. [solemn] What you seek has a name - Menethil's Gift: The ground blessed by the Lich King - holy ground to Scourge.
quest_5463_quest_progress: [solemn] The area around Menethil's Gift is exceptionally cold.
quest_5463_quest_complete: [solemn] You place the keepsake on the tainted soil.
quest_5464_quest_detail: [solemn] The soul of the fallen clings to that which represents its former life and transforms the item into a soulbound keepsake. [soft voice] You pick the item up and place it in your pack.
quest_5464_quest_complete: [solemn] As the soul clung to the keepsake, so shall it cling to the physical form of Ras Frostwhisper.
quest_5465_quest_detail: [urgent] Return to Marduke with the keepsake, <name>. [solemn] He will instruct you in its use.
quest_5465_quest_complete: [solemn] I was certain that you would be joining me as another hapless spirit.
quest_5466_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is but one task remaining, <name>. [commanding] Confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair.

Use the power of the keepsake against the beast - [urgent] be unrelenting in your actions! [urgent] Weather the blows that the flailing beast will surely bring down upon you. [angry] Do not give in to the pain!

[solemn] When the ritual is complete, Ras will be mortal once more. [cold] It is at that point that he must be slain. [threatening] Strike him down and take his human head.
quest_5466_quest_progress: [solemn] You carry the burden of ten thousand restless souls, <name>.
quest_5466_quest_complete: [sad] Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, <name>! [solemn] You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.
quest_5481_quest_progress: [angry] Where's that useless abomination? [commanding] Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
quest_5481_quest_complete:
[shocked] What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! [angry] That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

[soft voice] Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
quest_5482_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So you can see the predicament that I'm in, <name>. [urgent] That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! [commanding] I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. [solemn] Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

[low voice] It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. [urgent] Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
quest_5482_quest_progress: [low voice] This had better be good. [urgent] I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
quest_5482_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, my doom weed. [excited] Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. [warm] You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, <name>. [warm] As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
quest_5501_quest_detail:
[excited] We're sitting on a goldmine here, I tell you - a goldmine! [soft voice] Kodo bones will change the world forever... I have customers making furniture, music instruments, and even blasting powder out of them.

[urgent] There's a caravan that comes by and picks up my kodo bones and then sells them at Shadowprey Village. [commanding] If you can travel to the kodo graveyard south of here and bring me ten kodo bones, I'll give you something in return. [gentle] Is it a deal?
quest_5501_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the bones? The caravan will be here any moment. I need just ten more kodo bones to reach a career high. [excited] A career high, I tell you!
quest_5501_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, goodie! My bones!

I can't wait till the chaps at home see my face on the front cover of Goblin'preneur. [delight] I'll be the richest goblin in the world... [sad] and my physical education teacher said I would never amount to anything.
quest_5502_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have been so very kind to me, <name>. [excited] I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week. [warm] Thank you. [pause] I won't be sad about what's happened to me - my parents always told me to rise above anything bad that happens. [proud] I'll be a hero... just like you.

[sad] I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home. [excited] Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!
quest_5502_quest_progress: [soft voice] It is a pleasure to see you again, <name>. [solemn] Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?
quest_5502_quest_complete:
[solemn] May the spirits bless you, <name>. [warm] You've done more for Grunth than most would ever think of doing for him. [warm] Thank you - you're the epitome of what it means to be a hero of the Horde.

[warm] Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. [warm] I know that Grunth would like that, as would I.

[warm] Grunth had so much fun with you, <name>. [delight] He wanted to give you one of his favorite pets to remember him by.
