[proud] Achieve your destiny, <class> join the fight today!
quest_5504_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, <name>. [warm] You are truly revered amongst us. [soft voice] I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.

[emphasis] Application of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways. [commanding] As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
quest_5504_quest_progress: [gentle] Ah, noble <class>! [soft voice] Have you brought the valor tokens requested of you? [warm] Once you hand them to me, I will make our various mantles available to you for purchase.
quest_5504_quest_complete:
[delight] Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, <name>. [warm] With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. [solemn] So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.

[proud] For the Dawn, my brother!
quest_5505_quest_progress: [gentle] Well, here you are, <name> - the completed Skeleton Key. [solemn] I am certain as I can be that this key will allow you within the confines of the Scholomance. [pause] There's only one way to be absolutely sure it works, though. [urgent] Waste no time in trying it out, I say.
quest_5505_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good luck, mighty hero. [warm] May your victories continue to bring you fame and power as you lay waste to Scholomance!

[warm] I hope that the valor you've shown what it took to acquiring your token will carry the day then as well!
quest_5510_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file. [soft voice] These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context. [low voice] The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated.

[solemn] The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones! [warm] Minion's Scourgestone(20)
quest_5510_quest_complete:
[excited] Congratulations, <name> - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token! 
 
[solemn] The tokens serve two purposes. One - they can be used to further your standing within the Argent Dawn; to do so may avail you options and rewards that are reserved for our honored and revered allies. Two - they can be given to our quartermasters, along with coin, as payment for some of the Dawn's more prized items. 
 
[confident] Whatever you decide, know that you are earning your commission. [proud] Well done!
quest_5511_quest_progress: [solemn] Well, here you are, <name> - the completed Skeleton Key. [soft voice] I am certain as I can be that this key will allow you within the confines of the Scholomance. [pause] There's only one way to be absolutely sure it works, though. [urgent] Waste no time in trying it out, I say.
quest_5511_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good luck, mighty hero. [warm] May your victories continue to bring you fame and power as you lay waste to Scholomance!
quest_5513_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, <name>. [warm] You are truly revered amongst us. [soft voice] I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.

[emphasis] Application of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways. [solemn] As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
quest_5513_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, noble <class>! Have you brought the valor tokens requested of you? [commanding] Once you hand them to me, I will make our various mantles available to you for purchase.
quest_5513_quest_complete:
[delight] Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, <name>. [warm] With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. [proud] So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.

[excited] For the Dawn, my brother!
quest_5514_quest_detail:
[solemn] The goblin you will need to speak with is Krinkle Goodsteel. [soft voice] He peddles his skills to the highest bidder in Gadgetzan, within the Tanaris desert. [low voice] He'll likely be the only one who can produce the mold we need, and his services won't come cheap. [hesitant] We now ask for you to dig deep by footing whatever fee he will charge.

[sigh] I'm an apothecary, not a banker. [sad] If I had gold lying around, I certainly wouldn't be here.

[hesitant] I guess I said the quiet part out loud again. [soft voice] Oops. [urgent] Gadgetzan awaits you! [excited] Good luck!
quest_5514_quest_progress:
Yeah, I know who you are, and I know why you're here. [urgent] Dithers sent word to me before you arrived. [commanding] Let's cut to deal at hand, now shall we?

I've got a mold you can use for the skeleton key, but it will cost you - fifteen gold, up front, no negotiation. I'll pack the skeletal fragments into the mold for you, and I'll also teach you on how to forge the stem of the key without any knowledge of blacksmithing... all free of charge no less.

[mocking tone] Who says mercenaries don't offer competitive deals!
quest_5514_quest_complete:
Dithers said you'd deliver the goods, and deliver you have! [excited] A deal is a deal; let me pack the fragments into the mold for you.

[soft voice] Did Dithers imbue them already? [solemn] Excellent... otherwise, it would have been a long trip back to the Bulwark for you.
quest_5515_quest_detail:
[solemn] A great weight has been lifted from our hearts, <name>, but your task is not yet complete. [urgent] Krastinov's master, Kirtonos, still lives.

Before you may face Kirtonos, however, you must first secure a method in which to summon him.

[soft voice] It is said that Jandice Barov stewards the blood of innocents from Krastinov to Kirtonos.

[commanding] Find her in the sunken catacombs of Scholomance and strike her down. Bring back any clues that you may find.
quest_5518_quest_detail:
If you're going to fight the king of this dump - and I think that's what you're bound to do - then you're going to need to get by Captain Kromcrush. Now, you can get by him by killing him, sure. You might actually want to leave him alive.

How, you ask? Since I've been here, I think I know how to make an ogre suit that will last just long enough to fool these bozos. The only problem is stability - ten minutes tops. Bring me what I need, and I'll make you one. I'm not going anywhere...
quest_5518_quest_progress:
[low voice] The Ogre Tannin is probably the toughest thing to find for what I need to make the suit - I think they have some upstairs? [hesitant] It's hard to tell, since this ball and chain doesn't make movement that easy to do...

[urgent] Anyway, bring me the things I need, and I'll whip you up an ogre suit that will fool Captain Kromcrush into thinking you're one of his men.
quest_5518_quest_complete:
[excited] Yeah, this will do the trick. Just a slip here, and tuck here... heh - [chuckling] this is going to work out just fine! <A broad smile beams from the chained goblin's face.>

[warm] Here you go, you're all set. Remember- this isn't the most securely fashioned item in the world. You'll have ten minutes of use before it falls apart, and then you're not going to fool anybody! [urgent] Try using it just before you approach him, and remember... it only will make him think that YOU are an ally - not your group mates!
quest_5519_quest_progress: [urgent] Need another suit, do ya? [low voice] Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit. [commanding] Bolt of Runecloth(4)Rugged Leather(8)Rune Thread(2)Ogre Tannin
quest_5519_quest_complete: [urgent] Here ya go <name> - put this thing on, and you'll have ten minutes to do whatever. [excited] Good luck! [urgent] Oh, and if you happen to find a key to get me out of here, [shouting] BY ALL MEANS LET ME KNOW!!!
quest_5522_quest_detail:
[solemn] I received a message from my master, Vectus. [soft voice] Well, the message wasn't really from Vectus...it was from someone named Leonid Barthalomew. [hesitant] I don't know Leonid, but he knew my master, and no one knows my master unless he allows it.

[urgent] Leonid says Vectus wants the dragon eggs. [commanding] He wants you to deliver them to him at the Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

[angry] That hurts! Why you? [sad] Doesn't Vectus trust me? [sigh] Oh, never mind... just take the eggs and tell Leonid that I did what our master commanded.
quest_5522_quest_progress: [commanding] You are the one up to mischief in Blackrock Spire, yes? Do you have what I asked for?
quest_5522_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, very good. You do not know the evil power for whom you have labored, but now you will know the truth. And fear not--I am no servant of that master. [solemn] I am Leonid Barthalomew, known as "the Revered" to my brethren in the Argent Dawn.

[soft voice] I tricked Tinkee into sending you and the dragon eggs to me. And it is good that my trick was successful, for had these eggs reached their intended destination, a great power would have fallen into the hands of the enemy.
quest_5524_quest_detail: $G Brother : Sister; <name> - [solemn] your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. [soft voice] As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. [solemn] Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes!
quest_5525_quest_progress:
[low voice] It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. [hesitant] I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. [urgent] Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one...

[sigh] What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! [shouting] Is that it there??! [emphasis] Gordok Shackle Key
quest_5525_quest_complete:
You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower. [excited] Oh, thank you for freeing me!

[proud] I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!
quest_5526_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your knowledge of Eldre'Thalas - Dire Maul - in Feralas will now come into play, <name>. [soft voice] In the eastern part of the ruined city is where Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion. [urgent] Go there with all due haste and brave whatever challenges await you.

[solemn] The Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. [commanding] When he falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can. Seal it in the Reliquary, and bring it to me.

[warm] Good luck, and Cenarion's speed.
quest_5526_quest_progress:
[solemn] With the Sealed Reliquary of Purity in our possession, it will be possible not only to remove a corrupting threat from the world but also to study it under our judicious watch. [soft voice] Perhaps we can even devise new means to combat the taint of corruption that ever threatens Azeroth.

[hesitant] I know Milli would have had it no other way...
quest_5526_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, brave <class>, and with that the Cenarion Circle is in your debt. Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom.

[warm] Please - accept this as a token of our enduring gratitude. [warm] Know that you are welcomed here as a hero of the Cenarion Circle for your great deed, <name>. [warm] Thank you.
quest_5527_quest_detail:
[solemn] The first step is to find a container capable of holding an extremely corruptible substance without the handler suffering ill effects. [soft voice] There is only one sort device I am aware of that could possibly contain something as vile as the Felvine: a Reliquary of Purity.

[pause] Deep in the wasteland of Silithus is the remnants of the night elf village known as Southwind. [hesitant] I know one was there many, many years ago. [urgent] If we are to succeed, I need you to scour those ruins in the hopes of reclaiming it.
quest_5527_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Reliquary of Purity is an artifact unto itself. [soft voice] Few were ever made, and almost all of them were thought to have been lost over time.

[hesitant] I admit I have known about the one in Southwind for a little while now. [low voice] Honestly, with the rising turmoil in Silithus, I thought to keep our secrets just that - a secret. [urgent] To poke and prod would only cause suspicions of our enemies to rise.

[solemn] Alas, the time for complacency is at an end, especially with the situation in Eldre'Thalas.
quest_5527_quest_complete:
[solemn] Indeed, you are as resourceful as many claim. The Cenarion Circle is blessed to have you working in our stead.

With the Reliquary once more in our hands, my mind is at ease. [soft voice] I feel more comfortable asking you to not only face down a malfeasant demon, but also to bring back a dangerous item in the process...
quest_5529_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight! [urgent] We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across Azeroth unchecked!

[soft voice] Their necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.

[commanding] Go to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... [emphasis] before they get any bigger!
quest_5529_quest_progress: [urgent] Get to the Scholomance, <name>. [commanding] Take out those plagued hatchlings before they grow!
quest_5529_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done, <name>! [warm] It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.

...At least, I hope it will!
quest_5531_quest_detail:
[solemn] The eggs you brought were to be used in Scourge experiments to create a plagued dragonflight. [soft voice] These frozen black dragon eggs would have been invaluable in their studies, and would have assuredly quickened their timetable.

[commanding] Now, it is time we ended their research.

[urgent] Take the frozen eggs to Betina Bigglezink outside. [soft voice] She is well-learned in science and alchemy, and has produced a weapon we can use against the Scourge. [confident] With your help, we will deal them a heavy blow.
quest_5531_quest_progress: [excited] Hello, <name>! [urgent] I heard you were here with some dragon eggs? [soft voice] Well, let's see them!
quest_5531_quest_complete:
[excited] There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!

We'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.

[soft voice] I have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the Scholomance. [solemn] They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.

[pause] I call the device Dawn's Gambit, because... [hesitant] I'm not sure if it works!

[urgent] Will you find out for us?
quest_5533_quest_detail:
[solemn] On the island of Caer Darrow lies Scholomance - a wretched center of Scourge necromancy and evil. [soft voice] Our enemy dwells within, conducting unspeakable acts of depravity on unwitting victims... at least, we surmise as much. [pause] A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.

[low voice] Alchemist Arbington is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. [confident] You have proved your worth to me, and now I entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
quest_5533_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well met, <class>. I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the Scholomance, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire a key... one that will let you past the front door.

[hesitant] I can only imagine what horrid sights are to be seen inside, <name>. [sigh] I don't know how you heroic types do it sometimes...
quest_5534_quest_detail:
[angry] What?! What?!

[angry] That wasn't good enough for you? You know how expensive those explosives are? They sell for... oh, nevermind. Fine, you want to make some real money? Cause that's how business is done: you prove you're a valuable employee and then you're rewarded adequately after you stick it out some.

[urgent] If you're a "valuable" employee, then hit the Ruins of Eldarath and find me some rune that them Blood elves were lookin' for. The naga apparently have it in their possession.
quest_5534_quest_progress:
[urgent] Well, <name>? Where is the rune? You are a good employee, right? You're here to help?

Don't make me think twice about paying you what we agreed upon. [angry] What? Oh, we didn't agree on anything? Oh, great... then take your time--just know that it'll be a lot less if you take a long time.
quest_5534_quest_complete:
[laughing] Haha! Wonderful!

I'll be sure to find out what this is for and why Magus Rimtori--she's the cow that hired me--wanted it. Hah! I got you now, stinkin' Blood elves! [commanding] Kim'jael! Ha! I'll teach them who the rats are!

[warm] Ya did good, <name>. [excited] Thanks a bundle. [gentle] Here, take this coin and be off with ya--I've got some things to figure out.
quest_5535_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, the Highborne were some of the most powerful students of the arcane the night elves ever produced. [soft voice] The corruption that comes along with such studies caused much harm to night elf society and greatly affected all of Azeroth... as I'm sure you well know.

[pause] I promised the Sentinels that I would release the spirits from their mortal bonds as I find them. [gentle] If you would do the same, then I am sure I can reward you some.

[solemn] The spirits haunt the Shadowsong Shrine to the northeast of here.
quest_5535_quest_progress:
[soft voice] How goes your search for the Highborne spirits, <class>?

[solemn] Many events have caused all the races of Azeroth great suffering, but for some reason, these spirits seem to be a plague for all people. [hesitant] Perhaps it is there continued desire for any arcane magic--such desire is a harbinger of the Burning Legion, and we know what that can lead to.
quest_5535_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <class>. [warm] Thank you for your help. [solemn] The spirits are at peace, and the threats that their desire for the arcane draw have been lessened.

[solemn] I am sure that both sides of the conflict that ravishes Azeroth will see you are above such things.
quest_5536_quest_detail:
[solemn] The satyr, a disfigured, evil aspect of the night elves, now infect the sacred lands once traveled by Cenarius. [pause] I cannot speak for the night elves when it comes to all the atrocities those demonic creatures have committed, but I have sworn an oath to the Earthmother to aid the elves in ridding the land of such a nuisance.

[solemn] I am sure you would prove yourself if you aided me in purging them.

[urgent] Northeast of here, you can find the Haldarr clan. Return to me after you've tested yourself against their power.
quest_5536_quest_progress:
[solemn] How goes your battle against the satyr, <class>?

[soft voice] Are they as strong as you thought? [emphasis] Stronger? Or perhaps they were nothing to your own might.
quest_5536_quest_complete:
[gentle] Well done, <class>. I see you're not only skilled but cunning. To defeat such creatures is a testament to your loyalty to the tenants of the Earthmother, even if you do not recognize her as your own deity. [solemn] She is in all things on this planet and beyond. Her eyes, one dark and one light, travel across the skies always gazing down upon us.

[warm] Please, take this small amount of coin in appreciation for what you have done.
quest_5537_quest_detail:
[solemn] The key to Scholomance is called a Skeleton Key. It must be forged from the remains of a skeleton - several actually - and hardened by only the strongest of metals within a suitable mold. A signet of power from a being who naturally can open the portal to Scholomance will make the key ultimately function.

[pause] First thing's first though, <name>. [urgent] We'll need skeletal fragments for the key's forging. Skeletons inside Andorhal should yield what we need, but the ones outside the walls might work too.
quest_5537_quest_progress: [solemn] As morbid as it sounds, we'll need a decent supply of suitable skeletal fragments to make up the outer layer of the key. [soft voice] They don't call it a Skeleton Key for nothing, you know.
quest_5537_quest_complete:
[excited] This'll work, <name>! [warm] My turn now - I will imbue these with a suitable temper that will allow them to survive the intense forging process they will eventually go through.

[solemn] The next step will be to get an appropriate mold for the key. [urgent] I know a goblin blacksmith in Tanaris that has in the past made molds for similarly macabre items. [mocking tone] He works for whom goblins usually work for - the highest bidder.
quest_5538_quest_detail:
[solemn] The goblin you will need to speak with is Krinkle Goodsteel. [soft voice] He peddles his skills to the highest bidder in Gadgetzan, within the Tanaris desert. [hesitant] He'll likely be the only one who can produce the mold we need, and his services won't come cheap. [low voice] We now ask for you to dig deep by footing whatever fee he will charge.

[sad] I'm an alchemist, not a banker. [sad] If I had gold lying around, I certainly wouldn't be here.

[hesitant] I guess I said the quiet part out loud again. [soft voice] Oops. [urgent] Gadgetzan awaits you! [excited] Good luck!
quest_5538_quest_progress:
Yeah, I know who you are, and I know why you're here. [urgent] Dithers sent word to me before you arrived. [commanding] Let's cut to deal at hand, now shall we?

[low voice] I've got a mold you can use for the skeleton key, but it will cost you - fifteen gold, up front, no negotiation. [confident] I'll pack the skeletal fragments into the mold for you, and I'll also teach you on how to forge the stem of the key without any knowledge of blacksmithing... all free of charge no less.

[excited] Who says mercenaries don't offer competitive deals!
quest_5538_quest_complete:
[urgent] Yeah, I know who you are, and I know why you're here. Arbington sent word to me before you arrived. [commanding] Let's cut to deal at hand, now shall we?

I've got a mold you can use for the skeleton key, but it will cost you - fifteen gold, up front, no negotiation. I'll pack the skeletal fragments into the mold for you, and I'll also teach you on how to forge the stem of the key without any knowledge of blacksmithing... all free of charge no less.

[excited] Who says mercenaries don't offer competitive deals!
quest_5541_quest_detail:
[solemn] Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar. Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.

[sad] But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way. [urgent] My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!

<name>, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot? [soft voice] He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
quest_5541_quest_progress: [angry] I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
quest_5541_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, more ammo! [excited] Old Loslor's shipment finally came through! [warm] The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!

[warm] Thank you much, <name>. [excited] I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
quest_5545_quest_detail:
[urgent] I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. [soft voice] If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
quest_5545_quest_progress: [urgent] That deadline isn't getting any further away, <class>. [commanding] Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
quest_5545_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent! [warm] Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. [warm] To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

[warm] Thank you and farewell.
quest_5561_quest_detail:
Bibbly thinks he is the only goblin in Desolace who knows how to make money. [excited] Well, the only caravan brave enough to travel these parts relies on me. [soft voice] Ever since I learned how to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with my kodo kombobulator, the caravan owner Cork, Rigger, and I entered a partnership.

[commanding] Take the kombobulator and use it on any ancient, aged, or dying kodos; it will jolt the beast into a tamed kodo and force it to follow you. [urgent] Once you have a kodo tamed, bring it back to me.
quest_5561_quest_progress: [urgent] The caravan will be here shortly; [hesitant] do you have the five new tamed kodos I was asking for?
quest_5561_quest_complete: <Smeed Scrabblescrew begins counting.> [soft voice] Three, four, and five... excellent, I ask for five tamed kodos and I get five tamed kodos... [excited] I am going to be rich... yes, very rich! [warm] I hope to see the look on Bibbly's green face when he hears about my success!
quest_5581_quest_detail:
[solemn] Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. [solemn] A gruesome sight indeed.

[soft voice] You must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... which is what I now ask you to do. [urgent] The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. [warm] Good luck, <name>... and be wary of the portal guardians.
quest_5581_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you banished the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven?
quest_5581_quest_complete: [solemn] You are to be commended, <name>. [warm] Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of Azeroth is safer because of it.
quest_5582_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling. [pause] But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred.

[solemn] Betina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.
quest_5582_quest_progress: <name>, [soft voice] do you have something to show me?
quest_5582_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge. [warm] Thank you, <name>, and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!
quest_5601_quest_detail:
[solemn] I fled Lordaeron during the great war, and was lucky to escape before the Scourge swept through my homeland and turned it into a plagued nightmare! [sad] I was lucky, but my family was not. I fear they were all killed during the battle of Darrowshire.

[soft voice] Darrowshire is a village in the Eastern Kingdoms, nestled in the southern hills of what is now the Eastern Plaguelands. [hesitant] Will you go there and search for my family? [sad] I miss them so much, especially my little sister Pamela.

[urgent] Please, find her for me!
quest_5601_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Where is my sister Jessica? [sad] She left so long ago, when I was just a little girl. [sad] She cried so much when she went away. [sad] I don't know why she cried! [hesitant] Maybe she fell and hit her toe.

[warm] When Jessica was here we used to play games and dance and pick pretty flowers around the house. [excited] And sometimes we'd hide when we saw daddy coming home, then jump out and surprise him!

[urgent] Come back, Jessica! [soft voice] If you come back then maybe daddy will too and we can all play together again...
quest_5621_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I need your help, <name>. I am needed here to train the other students, but you, you can help one of our injured Sentinels just south of Dolanaar. [solemn] She was hurt patrolling the town and could use our aid. Her name is Shaya.

When you find her, heal her wounds, and then fortify her body with your spells. [solemn] This will at least protect her from harm longer if she finds trouble. [urgent] Return to me here after you've done your duty to Elune.
quest_5621_quest_progress: [soft voice] Our spells of Fortify are very powerful, Delor. They allow our companions to take further injury from all types of attacks and survive in situations where they would normally fall. [solemn] But this is nothing when compared to our abilities to heal. There are no greater healers than a priest--do well to remember that. [warm] Your power alone can turn the tides of battle easily.
quest_5621_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well and you have served Elune. For that, I thank you.

[warm] Please, take this robe as a token of my thanks. [proud] It signifies you have earned your place among our order. [gentle] If you wish, wear it with pride, but either way, we will always recognize you as one of our own.

[warm] Go with Elune, <name>, and thank you.
quest_5622_quest_detail:
<name>, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. [solemn] There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. [soft voice] She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a priest of Elune.

[gentle] Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
quest_5622_quest_complete: [delight] I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, <name>. [warm] Teaching young priests the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.
quest_5623_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello again, young priest. [solemn] The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. [solemn] When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.
quest_5677_quest_complete:
[gentle] Ah, you have wonderful timing, <name>. [soft voice] I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.

[pause] Are you ready? [warm] Ready for more training I mean. [confident] You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.
quest_5678_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time for you to return to Stormwind, young one. [soft voice] Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that.

[hesitant] I do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me.

[pause] You will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. [commanding] Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.
quest_5678_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, you have wonderful timing, <name>. [pause] I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. [warm] I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.

[warm] Are you ready? [warm] Ready for more training I mean. [warm] You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.
quest_5680_quest_complete: [solemn] Your rites will come soon enough. [soft voice] For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
quest_5713_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when I was attacked by the furbolg Marosh and his trackers. [urgent] During the attack I was poisoned, leaving me barely able to stand. [soft voice] I can make an antidote, but it will take time before it is ready.

[hesitant] I would ask that you defend me until I can apply the antidote. [urgent] I will aid you with my bow as best I can.

[solemn] Should we survive, I will be able deliver my message to Auberdine, while you speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post to inform her of this incident.
quest_5713_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you seen of Sentinel Aynasha on the road? [hesitant] She left on an important mission but she has not yet returned.
quest_5713_quest_complete: [soft voice] You bring most welcome news <class>. [warm] It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. [warm] I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. [solemn] May Elune watch over you and light your path.
quest_5721_quest_progress: [whispering] I think I heard ghosts outside. They whisper scary things to me...
quest_5721_quest_complete:
[excited] The fighting is over! [soft voice] I heard my daddy whisper to me. [proud] He scared away all the ghosts and he says he's coming home! [delight] I'm so happy!

[warm] He also said I should welcome you if came to our house, so I made some tea!

[excited] I hope you like lots of sugar!
quest_5722_quest_detail:
[solemn] The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. [soft voice] She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. [urgent] She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

[warm] Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

[commanding] Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
quest_5722_quest_complete:
[solemn] The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. [soft voice] It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.

[pause] You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
quest_5723_quest_detail:
[solemn] Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. [soft voice] In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. [angry] She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

[urgent] She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. [commanding] Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
quest_5723_quest_progress:
[soft voice] How goes your search for the Chasm? And the troggs?

[solemn] The threat cannot be allowed to persist--it will only injure our orc brethren if it continues.
quest_5723_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.

[pause] Perhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
quest_5724_quest_detail:
[solemn] You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. [soft voice] It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.

[emphasis] Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
quest_5724_quest_progress: [soft voice] Were you able to find anything, <name>? [hesitant] Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.
quest_5724_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent, <name>. [warm] Thank you. [solemn] Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. [gentle] Please, take it in thanks.
quest_5729_quest_complete: [angry] What is it?! Oh, you, <class>... my apologies. [sad] My anger rivals that of a rabid kodo bull... but perhaps it is my own fault. In sending travelers into Ragefire Chasm, I should have seen the possibility that some harm would come from it. [solemn] It seems both Bazzalan and Jergosh were taken unaware and slain by some of Thrall's do-gooders. [sad] A most inopportune time, but there is nothing that can be done about it now.
quest_5730_quest_detail:
[commanding] You are one of my lieutenants! [urgent] Prepare yourself, <class>. I will call upon you soon.

[solemn] My time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the Shadow Council's schemes elsewhere must suffer. [urgent] I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the Barrens and Ashenvale begin work on our newest agenda. [commanding] Return to me soon.
quest_5741_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress to the east is rumored to have acquired the Sceptre of Light from the Naga. [solemn] Legend tells that the sceptre is able to sink entire cities under the great seas. [urgent] The Burning Blade must not be allowed to possess such power.

[commanding] To that end, you must retrieve the sceptre yourself! [emphasis] It is held by a Burning Blade seer, who studies the sceptre from atop one of the Thunder Axe watchtowers.
quest_5741_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Sceptre of Light?
quest_5741_quest_complete: [excited] The elusive Sceptre of Light! [warm] Your acquisition of it has removed a grave threat to the world. [proud] Well done, <class>, well done.
quest_5761_quest_detail:
[solemn] The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

[urgent] If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

[commanding] Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
quest_5761_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you killed the beast? [solemn] He surely must be the leader of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm.
quest_5761_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ha! You've done it! [excited] Thrall will be so pleased.

I will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.

For now though, you must celebrate your victory. [warm] I will inform Thrall of your success.

[proud] Thank you for your aid, <class>.
quest_5762_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have a package for an old customer of mine, a dwarf named Hemet Nesingwary. [soft voice] The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now. [low voice] He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could.

[gentle] Hemet's a rich dwarf and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah? [pause] So... you want to deliver the package for me?

[urgent] I heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
quest_5762_quest_progress:
[commanding] Is that desert dust on your collar?

[pause] Hm... if my nose tells true, I'd say it's not desert dust, it's desert salt! [excited] Been to the Shimmering Flats, have you?
quest_5762_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, my package from Koalbeard! [warm] Thank you <name>. This crate holds special-gauge ammunition, and it'll serve us well out in the jungle!

[proud] Here's your pay, and tell me, how is crusty old Kravel these days? [mocking tone] Still up to no good I'd wager...
quest_5763_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, a dwarf came to this land. His name was Hemet and he wished to hunt great beasts. His skills with the rifle were uncanny, and we spent many days hunting together. Even the enmity between our peoples was forgotten.

When he left Desolace for Stranglethorn, I vowed to one day welcome him back so that we may hunt again. [proud] Now is that time.

Take this kodo horn to Hemet. He will know it is from me. You will find him in Stranglethorn, north of the Grom'gol Base camp.
quest_5763_quest_progress: [commanding] Sit, <class>. [urgent] Soon enough you'll strike back into the jungle.
quest_5763_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, this horn belongs to a Tauren, Roon Wildmane. [soft voice] He and I had a good time hunting the beasts of Desolace. [pause] So Roon is inviting me back, is he?

[commanding] We're neck deep in the jungle right now, but [warm] thank you, <name>. [confident] Perhaps my next expedition will take me back to Desolace, the land of the centaurs.
quest_5801_quest_detail:
[urgent] You need two bars of thorium and a powerfully hot heat source to forge the key stem. You're on your own for the thorium, but I can help with the heat.

To our west in Un'Goro Crater is Fire Plume Ridge - a simmering volcano. [solemn] The lava lake up top is hot enough to fuse thorium and bone together. Your gold has bought you a mold that simply requires you to dip it in the lake up top; the lava will take care of the rest.

[soft voice] That's it on my end. [urgent] To finish your key, you'll need to talk to Arbington again.
quest_5801_quest_progress:
[urgent] Do you have the stem of the skeletal key finished? [soft voice] I'm truly sorry you had to bear the brunt of the fee to purchase the mold, but we must all do our part to counter the Scourge. [commanding] Once you hand me the unfinished key, you'll be ready for the final item needed to complete its construction.

[solemn] It won't be easy at all, but the work you've done to date in preparing for an assault on Andorhal will now start to pay for itself. [confident] You'll see.
quest_5801_quest_complete:
We've got quite the costly skeleton key there, don't we <name>? Still, it remains unfinished; [solemn] the time has now come to put some focus behind our creation. To that end, you're going to have to face the ultimate foe we've been working towards facing in Andorhal... the being that runs the show within the ruined city walls.

I'm speaking of Araj the Summoner - a lich, and one of the most powerful beings the Scourge calls as its own.
quest_5802_quest_detail:

quest_5802_quest_progress:

[low voice] It won't be easy at all, but the work you've done to date in preparing for an assault on Andorhal will now start to pay for itself. [solemn] You'll see.

[soft voice] We've got quite the costly skeleton key there, don't we <name>? Still, it remains unfinished; the time has now come to put some focus behind our creation. [solemn] To that end, you're going to have to face the ultimate foe we've been working towards facing in Andorhal... the being that runs the show within the ruined city walls.

[commanding] I'm speaking of Araj the Summoner - a lich, and one of the most powerful beings the Scourge calls as its own.
quest_5803_quest_detail:
[solemn] Araj the Summoner lords over Andorhal from the ruined city's heart. [soft voice] We know that he was the former leader of Scholomance before claiming the city as his own. [urgent] To finish the key, we will need his signet - called a scarab - mounted as the head of the key.

[commanding] Make your way into the heart of Andorhal, and break his hold on the city now that he is drawn into the open. [emphasis] Once destroyed, seize his scarab from his fallen phylactery!

[excited] The Key to Scholomance awaits, <name>!
quest_5803_quest_progress: [commanding] You've come this far <name> - only the destruction of the physical form of Araj the Summoner will provide us with the means to finish the key. [urgent] Get Araj's scarab, by hook or by crook, and bring it to me - I will fuse it on as the head of the key.
quest_5803_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, this is it! [soft voice] I... again, I'm absolutely amazed at the depths of your cunning and bravery. [solemn] It simply boggles the mind the lengths you are willing to go in order achieve victory.

[warm] Allow me now to play my small part in this. [soft voice] I've prepared a special solvent that should allow me to secure the scarab on as the head of the key, infusing it with the power to breech the locked door of Scholomance.

[pause] This should take just a moment...
quest_5804_quest_detail:
[solemn] Araj the Summoner lords over Andorhal from the ruined city's heart. [soft voice] We know that he was the former leader of Scholomance before claiming the city as his own. [urgent] To finish the key, we will need his signet - called a scarab - mounted as the head of the key.

[excited] Yes, this is it! I... again, I'm absolutely amazed at the depths of your cunning and bravery. [solemn] It simply boggles the mind the lengths you are willing to go in order achieve victory.

[pause] This should take just a moment...
quest_5821_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Under normal circumstances, Rigger and I would lead our kodo past the Kolkar Centaur. [pause] Every now and then we hear the Centaur war drums, and when we hear those we stop. [angry] It's not good for business to be dead!

[excited] I'll tell you what <class>, if you protect us past the Kolkar village we'll make it worth your while.

[urgent] It's just a short distance, all you need to do is keep the caravan intact and you can pick up your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew - he is down the road a bit. [solemn] We do a little business together.
quest_5821_quest_progress:
[angry] Why do I find myself waiting for that blasted caravan?

<Smeed looks enlightened.>

[soft voice] Oh yeah, they pay the bills. [urgent] Have you seen them?
quest_5821_quest_complete: [low voice] You know, it doesn't seem prosperous to be paying the likes of you to guard Gizelton Caravan. <class>, if I were a bit taller I could take on a second job and sit kodo-side-saddle with the biggest gun my hands could carry... [mocking tone] and I'd show them blasted centaur who's their papa.
quest_5846_quest_complete:
[solemn] How could I forget? [soft voice] Many of the spirits on this island are cursed to relive their last happy memory before they met their tragic end.

[sad] I too am cursed, but not as they - I am one of the few that remembers all...

[hesitant] Perhaps this thing that you ask me is why I haunt these ruins. [solemn] Perhaps this thing I tell you shall set me free.
quest_5848_quest_detail:
[solemn] The painting... It hung on the wall of my workshop - inside the Order's barracks - for years.

[soft voice] After Tirion's trial was over, I knew that I could no longer keep the painting visible. I hid it in a place that they would never think to look.

Travel to Stratholme and make your way deep inside what is now the Scarlet Bastion, search for a painting of our twin moons. Chip away at the paint until you uncover my master work, 'Of Love and Family.'

[warm] May the Light guide your actions.
quest_5861_quest_progress: [solemn] I knew this day would come.
quest_5861_quest_complete:
[solemn] I was Tirion's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. I openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for my insolence.

[sad] He has been through much heart ache and disappointment in his life, <race>. [soft voice] Are you prepared to right the wrongs set upon the Fordrings?
quest_5862_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I am what you would call, an illusionist. Though I may be able to create an illusion to allow you entry into Hearthglen, be warned; my powers have their limitations.

Should you travel too far from these lands, the effects of the illusion will cease. [hesitant] The spell itself takes a great amount of concentration and power from me, and thus, I can only sustain the effect for a short time.

[pause] Speak to me again when you are ready.
quest_5862_quest_progress: [urgent] Are you the reinforcements from Tyr's Hand?
quest_5862_quest_complete:
[solemn] What is this, soldier?

<Taelan opens the box and begins to examine its contents.>

[sad] This... this cannot be true. [pause] But all that you have shown me... <Taelan falls to one knee, his heartbeat quickens. The fury of ages is about to be loosed upon this town.>
quest_5863_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Just recently, a large bank of nomadic ogres arrived in Tanaris. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. [solemn] Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins.

[urgent] The Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! [commanding] We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force.

[low voice] The leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.
quest_5863_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm so worried! [urgent] Please be careful!
quest_5863_quest_complete: [soft voice] I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, <name>! [warm] Thanks for your help!
quest_5881_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

[soft voice] I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. [warm] He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
quest_5881_quest_progress: [urgent] You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
quest_5881_quest_complete: [excited] This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. [warm] Now I can spend some time with my family... [excited] Yippee!
quest_5882_quest_progress:
[solemn] Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. [soft voice] I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. [solemn] We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again.

[warm] In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared. Corrupted Soul Shard(6)
quest_5882_quest_complete: [gentle] Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. [commanding] Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, <name>! [urgent] Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.
quest_5883_quest_progress:
[solemn] If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. [soft voice] I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. [gentle] You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving.

[warm] If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared. Tainted Vitriol(4)
quest_5883_quest_complete: [soft voice] Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. [warm] If you find more vitriol when you mine in Felwood, remember to hold on to it for me! [excited] The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.
quest_5884_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption. [soft voice] My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.

[pause] When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon. In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve. [warm] Fel Creep(4)
quest_5884_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work <name> - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back Felwood. [warm] Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. [solemn] The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no <race>!
quest_5885_quest_progress:
[solemn] A Cenarion beacon will allow a well-trained skinner to spot patches of tainted skin from bounty gathered in Felwood. [soft voice] I convert these seemingly useless patches into a thick paste that serves as a quickening agent for Cenarion plant salve. [urgent] When you skin your kills here in Felwood, be sure to have a beacon on you!

[warm] When you collect tainted patches, bring them to me and I will give you some Cenarion plant salves that I have already made. Patch of Tainted Skin(5)
quest_5885_quest_complete: [soft voice] This is exactly what I need. [gentle] Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim Felwood from the corruption. [solemn] We must persevere, <name>!
quest_5886_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. [solemn] I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work.

[pause] I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. [emphasis] The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way! [warm] Lesser Nether Essence
quest_5886_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, <name>. [solemn] Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. [warm] If you need more salve, then find me here!

quest_5891_quest_complete: [gentle] Here are some Cenarion plant salves - [soft voice] I only need one lesser nether essence for this, <name>. [solemn] Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. [warm] If you need more salve, then find me here!
quest_5892_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before the fighting started, we stored supplies for Dun Baldar in the Irondeep mine. [soft voice] The troggs that surfaced there weren't much of a problem when we had spare troops to guard the mine, but now that we're fighting with the Horde we can't maintain control of Irondeep.

[urgent] We need the supplies in Irondeep, <name>. [commanding] Enter the mine and bring me a load of them.
quest_5892_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the supplies, <name>? [excited] We can never have enough!
quest_5892_quest_complete: [excited] Well done! I'll put these supplies to good use! [warm] Thanks, <name>!
quest_5893_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Coldtooth mine to the north was once an ideal place to store extra supplies, but now that the fighting with the Stormpikes grows fierce, we do not always have the spare warriors to station at the mine and protect it. And so, control of the mine often falls to the Alliance, or to underground denizens...

[urgent] But we still need our supplies, <name>! [commanding] Go to the Coldtooth mine and bring me a load of them. And be wary of enemies as you go; the tides of battle shift quickly in that place...
quest_5893_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you been to the Coldtooth mine, <name>? [urgent] Do you have the supplies I asked for?
quest_5893_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, you got them. Good work, <name>! [warm] These supplies are a little musty from sitting in that dark mine for so long, but we'll make use of them nonetheless.

[proud] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Your deeds are vital to the maintenance of our fighting forces.
quest_5901_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, to bring pain and strife to the Scarlet Crusade, I want to take their precious lumber mill from them. [soft voice] I'm sure the loss of such a resource will cause them a great deal of harm in defending and rebuilding the town for their own reasons. [hesitant] Will you help me, <name>?

[urgent] Start by taking this jar to Plaguewood in the Eastern Plaguelands. [emphasis] Fill it with the termites you find in their mounds throughout the woods. [pause] Come back when you have enough.
quest_5901_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Do you have the termites yet, <name>? [commanding] I am sure it is obvious to a smart <class> like yourself.

[urgent] Once we have enough of them, we'll make sure no one can use the lumber mill ever again!
quest_5901_quest_complete: [delight] These will do nicely, <name>. [warm] Thank you. [urgent] If you're ready, we can get on with the next step.
quest_5902_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.

[urgent] Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something.

[soft voice] After you open it, the rest should take care of itself. [commanding] Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.
quest_5902_quest_complete: [low voice] The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
quest_5903_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've tried many times to rout out the Scarlet Crusade through force alone, but to no avail. [soft voice] So, as an alternative, I've decided to make their lives more difficult.

[urgent] If you are willing to help, I want to infest that lumber mill with the most terrible species of termites ever found.

[low voice] In Plaguewood, near the once-great Stratholme, there is a breed that survived the plague and the Scourge combined. [emphasis] Find their mounds and fill this jar with them, so we can prepare them to be unleashed on the Crusade.
quest_5903_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the termite mounds, <name>? [soft voice] I've heard they are all over Plaguewood.
quest_5903_quest_complete: [soft voice] These will do nicely, <name>. [warm] Thank you. [pause] Just look at them... [whispering] so many of them all huddled up. [sad] I almost feel bad for the Crusade, but then again, it was never their mill to take, now, was it?
quest_5904_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that we have the termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.

[urgent] Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; find someplace suitable, like on a crate and then open it. [soft voice] The termites should do their work from there and make the mill useless to the Crusade.
quest_5904_quest_complete: [solemn] The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
quest_5921_quest_detail:
[solemn] All druids are welcome in the sacred lands of Moonglade, regardless of the current tensions in the Cenarion Circle between Arch Druid Staghelm and Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian. [soft voice] Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

[gentle] As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. [warm] Good luck, young druid.
quest_5922_quest_detail:
[solemn] All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, tauren and night elf alike. [soft voice] Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. [warm] Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. [gentle] Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

[solemn] As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. [warm] Good luck, young druid.
quest_5923_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. [solemn] It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. [gentle] Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.

[solemn] He is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.
quest_5923_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am glad you found your way here today. young <class>. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

[commanding] Ready yourself!

quest_5929_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit. [soft voice] For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear. [solemn] All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

[urgent] Go to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach. [pause] When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven. [solemn] We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
quest_5929_quest_progress: [solemn] Return only when the Great Bear Spirit has released you back unto me. [soft voice] Your training cannot continue without its blessing.
quest_5929_quest_complete:
Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him. and [solemn] he smiles ever so slightly.

"I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met. You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused. You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work."

quest_5931_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. [soft voice] Mathrengyl Bearwalker walks truly in balance with nature, even as he dwells precariously close to where the balance has faltered. Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

[gentle] Go now, young one. We shall meet again.
quest_5931_quest_complete:
[gentle] Welcome back, <name>. [soft voice] I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense. [solemn] I know it was that way with me.

[solemn] The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens. [solemn] We have come to rely on its wisdom and its power to fuel our purpose. [solemn] Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. [urgent] Listen closely...
quest_5932_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. Though the tauren are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature. [soft voice] Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

[urgent] Go now, young one. We shall meet again.
quest_5932_quest_complete:
[gentle] Welcome back, <name>. [solemn] I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense. [warm] I know it was that way with me.

[solemn] The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens. [soft voice] We tauren listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose. [urgent] Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. [emphasis] Listen closely...
quest_5941_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have gathered many relics of the battle of Darrowshire. Each time you returned with more, my heart yearned for my village... yearned to protect it from its fate.

[soft voice] I know that cannot be, but Chromie, that strange gnome in Andorhal, tells me it is possible. [excited] She says you can save Darrowshire!

[warm] She asked me to gather together the relics, and to have you bring them to her. [solemn] She said that she awaits you in the ruined inn of Andorhal.
quest_5942_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Daddy told me to give you this key. He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.

He also wanted me to thank you. Did you do a favor for him? Did you tell him you found my doll?

Well here's the key. And thank you <name>. [excited] Thank you! [warm] You're a very nice man!
quest_5942_quest_progress: [solemn] This chest is old and covered in grime.
quest_5942_quest_complete: [soft voice] The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...
quest_5943_quest_detail:
[excited] You look like a capable <race>. Perhaps you're looking to make some money? Cork and I started this caravan to make a bundle of money; little did we know the dangers of turning a buck!

Up ahead is Mannoroc Coven... normally the demons ignore us but something has the kodos spooked this time. [urgent] I'll pay you to protect the caravan past Mannoroc Coven. Once we are safely past you can receive your reward from our business associate Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
quest_5943_quest_progress:
[urgent] You know, if that caravan were to ever disappear I would be ruined! [hesitant] You're not the bearer of bad news about the caravan, are you?

<Smeed wipes his brow.>

[delight] Thank the goddess of greed!
quest_5943_quest_complete: [low voice] Not sure it's a prosperous proposition to be paying so much money to protect the Gizelton Caravan. [soft voice] Cork and Rigger only make one gold piece a week, but as long as they keep paying for my kodos I can care less how they run their business.
quest_5944_quest_detail:
[solemn] For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. [sad] What reason was there to fight against what the Scarlet Crusade had become? [pause] It has been decades, yet the memories of my father; those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.

[soft voice] I have dreams, stranger. [emphasis] In these dreams my father is with me. [proud] He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. [commanding] We battle legion of Scourge, side by side. [solemn] We bring honor to the Alliance, to Lordaeron.

[urgent] I want not to dream anymore.

Take me to him.
quest_5981_quest_detail:
[solemn] Around 4,000 years ago, Tyrande Whisperwind saved the life of the frostsaber queen, at the hands of rampaging giants. [soft voice] Since then, the frostsabers have been allies of the night elves.

[solemn] These same giants that once were a danger to the frostsabers, still exist not too far from here. [pause] They are called the frostmaul, and they have taken over the large valley to the south.

[commanding] Prove your loyalty to the frostsabers; kill these giants in the name of the frostsaber queen, Shy-Rotam!
quest_5981_quest_progress: [commanding] You must continue to prove yourself, <name>.
quest_5981_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent, <name>. [warm] Your determination has been duly noted.
quest_6001_quest_detail:
[solemn] Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves. [soft voice] The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it. [commanding] Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it. [solemn] Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

[warm] You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, <name>... [emphasis] now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
quest_6001_quest_progress: [solemn] When you have faced the challenge that lies before you, [emphasis] your understanding of strength of body and strength of heart will be fully realized. [pause] Until that time, I cannot help you further.
quest_6001_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, <name>. [soft voice] I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

[pause] There are no further obstacles in your way... [solemn] let me now teach you what it means to be a <class> of the Claw!
quest_6002_quest_detail:
[solemn] On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone. The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts. Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

[warm] You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, <name>... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
quest_6002_quest_progress: [solemn] When you have faced the challenge that lies before you, your understanding of strength of body and strength of heart will be fully realized. [pause] Until that time, I cannot help you further.
quest_6002_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, <name>. [warm] I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

[pause] There are no further obstacles in your way... [proud] let me now teach you what it means to be a <class> of the Claw!
quest_6004_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was sent as a scout to do some damage and gauge the strength of Hearthglen's defenses. [soft voice] Some people in the Alliance feel the little town has more than historical importance. [low voice] It's not my job to question what that importance is, but regardless, I'm in no shape to continue until I rest up.

[urgent] If you're willing, I'd pay handsomely for some help. [commanding] Start south of here at their camp near the small bulwark they've set up. [confident] If you prove strong enough, maybe I could get your help with my main goal.
quest_6004_quest_progress: [soft voice] How is it going, <name>? [hesitant] Are they stronger than you thought? [sad] I hope not. [commanding] If I'm going to follow through here, then it's going to require a heck of a lot more strength than what I've already asked you to do.
quest_6004_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] I'm amazed you dealt with them so quickly. [warm] Thank you. [solemn] I have yet to meet anyone that approves of the Scarlet Crusade and their methods. [soft voice] I believe in the Light as much as anyone else in Stormwind, but they've demonstrated that they only want to kill anyone not loyal to their movement... even innocents.
quest_6021_quest_detail:
Can you believe that, after all the trouble we have in the plaguelands... we have to worry about thieves too? And not just normal thieves, troll thieves.

And not just normal troll thieves. Dead troll thieves!

They're led by this big, dead troll named Zaeldarr the Outcast, and they come here at night and steal bodies from the pit below, then take them back to their evil, dead troll hideout--the Undercroft to the west.

[urgent] Go there and take out Zaeldarr, <name>. [angry] I'm sick to death of his mischief!
quest_6021_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the hideout, <name>? [urgent] Did you take care of Zaeldarr?
quest_6021_quest_complete: [excited] Great, you got him! [warm] And I hope you taught his gang a lesson too!
quest_6023_quest_detail: [soft voice] My real mission was to weaken the Scarlet Crusade's outlying forces and then infiltrate Hearthglen to gauge their numbers. [hesitant] I'm still in no shape to do it on my own, so perhaps I could ask you to aid me again, <name>? From what information I gathered before being discovered, the Crusade has two important members that are the backbone of their forces outside the town: Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen. [commanding] Kill them, and we're making progress. They should be along Hearthglen Pass outside the town proper.
quest_6023_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found them yet, <name>? [low voice] With the two of them taken care of, I can proceed to enter Hearthglen to take a closer look at their setup. [hesitant] I can't do it without your help. [soft voice] Please, find Radley and Durgen for me.
quest_6023_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. You've been more help than I could have hoped for. [pause] The air here just seems to suck my will. I feel tired, and I can tell I'm not getting any better the longer I'm here.

[hesitant] I'm not really sure how I'm going to infiltrate Hearthglen itself and report on how strong the Scarlet Crusade's presence is.

But that's another matter, before you leave, here, take this... as payment for your help. [warm] Thank you again.
quest_6025_quest_detail:
[shocked] What? Really? [hesitant] You want to know more? But you've already done so much for me, <name>. [sad] I couldn't possibly ask you to enter Hearthglen itself on my behalf.

[hesitant] Are you sure, <name>? [urgent] Hearthglen is much more dangerous than the Pass--I cannot provide you any protection or even information about what you might face.

[pause] Well, if you really are willing to help, then enter the town and find a high place to gain a good view of the town. [emphasis] From there you can gauge their numbers and report them back to me. [whispering] But be careful....
quest_6025_quest_progress: [solemn] It's a dangerous task, <name>. [soft voice] I envy your courage.
quest_6025_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it, <name>! [warm] Thank you! [soft voice] I'll return to Elling... I mean Stormwind as soon as I can. [warm] Here, take this coin, it's the least I can do for you. [proud] You're a credit to your people, <name>. [warm] Thank you and good luck.
quest_6026_quest_detail:
[soft voice] These here Argent Dawn people commissioned ol' Smokey to do a little demolition work for 'em. Smokey's mammy ain't raised no dummy. [confident] When gold coin is slapped on the table, Smokey's services are available. That's my motto!

[excited] Now I'd be willing to split the commission with you if you're willing to do a little legwork. [commanding] Here's the deal: I'm going to head over to Plaguewood and mark the buildings we need destroyed. You gather the components for the bombs. Meet back here when you've got everything. [urgent] Deal?
quest_6026_quest_progress: [commanding] Trust ol' Smokey, <race>. [confident] The reward will be worth it. [solemn] These Argent Dawn folk don't mess around when it comes to payment.
quest_6026_quest_complete: [confident] I can pay you half up front and half when the job is done.
quest_6027_quest_detail: <name>, I entrust you with the Gem of the Serpent. [solemn] Place this gem on the Serpent Statue's hand on Ranazjar Isle, a small island northwest of here. [soft voice] Placing it will summon the one who protects the Book of the Ancients. [solemn] This book contains the secrets of the naga, secrets that have been kept for centuries. [urgent] Bring this book to me, and we will learn much about our scaled foes!
quest_6027_quest_progress: [gentle] Ah, <name>! [warm] It's good to see you again. [soft voice] Do you have the Book of the Ancients?
quest_6027_quest_complete: [solemn] The long lost Book of the Ancients! [warm] I will ensure this book is passed on to the high council. [proud] You've done well today, and for that you are to be thanked... as a hero should be thanked!
quest_6028_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter. [soft voice] I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of Everlook. [urgent] I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp; it's a ways from here, located along the southern fringe of the Western Plaguelands.

quest_6041_quest_detail:

[commanding] Here's the plan: I'm going to give you ten sticks of my special compound. [urgent] You're going to take them over to Plaguewood and plant them inside the Scourge structures that I've had marked for detonation.

<Smokey snaps his fingers.>

[excited] Bing! [emphasis] It's just that easy.
quest_6041_quest_progress: [low voice] I got supplies left over to make a few more sticks of the special compound. [warm] Just let ol' Smokey know if you need more.
