<Smokey laughs.>

[excited] Anyhow! [warm] Here's your cut of the loot. [proud] I've thrown in a little something extra to help soothe the burns.
quest_6061_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. [solemn] By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.

[gentle] In the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. [solemn] Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. [hesitant] But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. [commanding] Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.
quest_6061_quest_progress: [commanding] Practice your skills, <name>. [urgent] Tame the adult plainstrider.
quest_6061_quest_complete: [solemn] Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; [warm] you have done well.
quest_6062_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is an admirable skill to command one's authority over nature. [solemn] As a hunter, you must strive to learn to use the force and power inherent to any creature of your choosing.

[solemn] Gaining control of an animal is not an easy feat; it is a task that you must undertake with much determination.

[commanding] For your first assignment, take this taming rod and use it to tame a dire mottled boar. [urgent] You can find them quite close to Razor Hill. [commanding] Practice your skills in battle with the boar at your side, then return to me.
quest_6062_quest_complete: [warm] You have done well, <name>. [proud] I believe you are ready for your next task.
quest_6063_quest_detail:
[solemn] As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.

[soft voice] <name>, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.

[commanding] Your first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. [urgent] Tame it, and practice your skills as a hunter.
quest_6063_quest_progress: [solemn] You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
quest_6063_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent, <name>! [warm] You are quite a fast learner.
quest_6064_quest_detail:
[excited] Hi there, lad! So, you'd be wanting to know how you can gain a pet of your own?

[warm] Well, let's get started. There's nothing more important than yer equipment when it comes to hunting, but we can chat about my new Shrapnel Blaster some other time. [soft voice] Fer now, let's focus on something I'm sure you're quite interested in: a pet!

[commanding] The best way to learn is for you to try out several creatures as companions and see what ya like. So, find a large crag boar, then use the taming rod to tame it.
quest_6064_quest_progress: [gentle] Don't worry, lass! [excited] You'll get ta try a few before you'll need to decide on just one.
quest_6064_quest_complete: [soft voice] I know, I know; you're wondering what's next, aren't ya?!

[warm] Good luck, <name>.

quest_6082_quest_detail:

[warm] When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will be yours to command. [solemn] Under your control, your pet will gain experience alongside you. [gentle] I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
quest_6082_quest_progress: [urgent] Were you able to tame the scorpid?
quest_6082_quest_complete:

[warm] Here you are, <name>. [proud] I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. [warm] Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
quest_6083_quest_detail:
[solemn] The advantage a pet affords you against your rivals is duly noted, <name>. [soft voice] When you gain control over another creature, you are adding to your own strength. [solemn] Your pet must become an extension of yourself.

[solemn] The next task requires you to turn from the land; you will find the next creature in the waters off the coast. [soft voice] Across from Sen'jin Village, near the Echo Isles. [emphasis] look for a spirited crab called the surf crawler. [urgent] Use the taming rod to tame it, then practice your skills.
quest_6083_quest_progress: [solemn] You need to practice in order to gain the skills you need to effectively control your pet. [pause] Have you tamed a surf crawler?
quest_6083_quest_complete: [soft voice] You are a swift learner, <name>. [warm] You have done well.
quest_6084_quest_detail:
[gentle] Those crag boars are quite burly; maybe you'd like something with a little more finesse? [warm] Alright then, I've got jus' the thing. [soft voice] South and east of here, you'll find large white cats called snow leopards. [emphasis] Just like an elegantly-carved rifle, behind their beautiful exterior lies a powerful fighter, capable of doing extreme damage. [confident] You'll find them to be much more agile an' swift than the boar you tamed.

[warm] Take this taming rod and see how you like the snow leopard.
quest_6084_quest_progress: [soft voice] What do you think of the snow leopard, <name>?
quest_6084_quest_complete: [solemn] When I feel you've learned enough, I will grant you the ability to choose any pet of your liking.
quest_6085_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. [solemn] The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling hunter like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!

[excited] When you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. [warm] I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.
quest_6085_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you tamed the ice claw bear yet?
quest_6085_quest_complete:
[warm] Here you are, <name>. [proud] I will now give ya the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you please.

[excited] Find yerself a good, loyal pet, and enjoy the hunt!
quest_6086_quest_detail:
<name>, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.

Belia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_6086_quest_complete:
[excited] A new recruit, eh? You're on your way to becoming a great <class>, I see.

[warm] Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [solemn] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

[gentle] Remember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. [proud] In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.
quest_6087_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.

[soft voice] Your next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. [solemn] This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.

[commanding] During a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. [emphasis] In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.

[warm] Here is the taming rod, <name>. [urgent] Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.
quest_6087_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found a prairie stalker?
quest_6087_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.
quest_6088_quest_detail:
[solemn] The final task that I have for you requires that you tame a creature that inhabits the sky. [soft voice] The swoop is a difficult opponent, but as your ally, you will acquire its sharp attacks and threatening presence.

[warm] By the will of the Earthmother, when you return I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; [pause] this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. [gentle] I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
quest_6088_quest_complete:

[warm] Here you are, <name>. [proud] I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. [warm] Use your new skills with pride and honor the Earthmother.

[urgent] Travel to Thunder Bluff. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Holt Thunderhorn. [soft voice] If he deems you worthy, he will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Holt has bested the most powerful and feared beasts of Azeroth, and commands many strong creatures of his own. [solemn] His ties to the Earthmother are strong, and you can learn much from him. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_6089_quest_complete:
A young <class>, I see. [solemn] Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [warm] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

[commanding] Now, go forth. [solemn] May the Earthmother guide you on your path. [warm] We shall speak again, at a later date.
quest_6101_quest_detail:
[solemn] The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, <name>. [soft voice] It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.

[solemn] The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.

[commanding] Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. [urgent] Practice your skills as a hunter. [solemn] Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
quest_6101_quest_progress: [solemn] Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every <race>.
quest_6101_quest_complete: [solemn] I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, <name>.
quest_6102_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. [soft voice] Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. [gentle] Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.

[warm] When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. [solemn] I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
quest_6102_quest_progress: [solemn] I am proud of your accomplishments, <name>. [soft voice] Have you finished the last task I gave you?
quest_6102_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have learned all I can teach you, <name>. [soft voice] May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. [pause] Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? [emphasis] Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.

[warm] Here you are, <name>. [proud] I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. [gentle] Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
quest_6103_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.

[pause] Travel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. [urgent] She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.

[low voice] While Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another hunter rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. [warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_6103_quest_complete:
[solemn] A fledgling <class>. I see. Yes. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [warm] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

[gentle] Remember, <name>, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. [commanding] Now, go forth. [soft voice] We shall speak again, at a later date.
quest_6121_quest_detail:
[solemn] You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, <name>. [soft voice] Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. [pause] This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

[urgent] Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
quest_6121_quest_complete:
[gentle] Greetings young <class>, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

[solemn] While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. [urgent] There has been a rash of animal poisonings in Auberdine, and the village there has been unable to cure it. [solemn] To that end, a representative there has asked Moonglade for aid and we are sending you there to aid them. [commanding] This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. [emphasis] Bear this in mind.
quest_6122_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically. [urgent] Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.

Once filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine. She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.
quest_6122_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent? That's wonderful! [excited] We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have? [hesitant] He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
quest_6122_quest_complete:
[angry] By Elune, this water is disgusting! [sad] No wonder the deer are sick.

[solemn] Something is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table. [solemn] Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river. [urgent] While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.

[solemn] This water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. [soft voice] While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
quest_6123_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I'll make for the deer. [pause] For curative properties, I need some earthroot. Herbalists know how to find it, so if we're unlucky and you aren't one then you'll need to find one to help us out.

[emphasis] Finally for potency, I need some lunar fungus. Finding lunar fungal blooms is easy enough; they're all over the place in caves just to the east of here. [solemn] Moonkin reside in the caves and they're irritable as of late, so be careful.
quest_6123_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve? [soft voice] The deer aren't getting any better on their own, so we better hurry to help them out!
quest_6123_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is good, <name>, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.

[solemn] Making a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it. [excited] Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!

[warm] Now, let me get to work on this!
quest_6125_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid. [soft voice] Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

[pause] You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, <name>. [solemn voice] He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto him .

[warm] Farewell, young druid. [soft voice] We shall speak again.
quest_6125_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine. [soft voice] This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

[warm] You handled yourself with grace under pressure. [proud] For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison. [gentle] Use it well, <name>... use it well.
quest_6126_quest_detail:
[solemn] You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, <name>. [soft voice] Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. [pause] This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

quest_6126_quest_complete:

[soft voice] While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. [urgent] There has been a rash of animal poisonings at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and they're unable to bring it under control. [solemn] Someone there has requested Moonglade for aid, so we are sending you there to aid them. [commanding] This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. [emphasis] Bear this in mind.
quest_6127_quest_detail:
[solemn] Dreadmist Peak to the northwest of the Crossroads is most likely a primary candidate as to the source of the spread of the poison. [soft voice] Its airy peaks have pools of water that influence the weather patterns. I suspect the water is now tainted by the demon-worshipping Burning Blade.

[urgent] Use this sampler to draw water from the pool at the very top of the peak. [emphasis] Once filled, deliver it to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads. [warm] He is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with him to address this malady.
quest_6127_quest_progress:
[solemn] You are the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent, yes? [excited] This is most fortuitous for us! [soft voice] We are stymied in our effort to bring balance to the sickly gazelles that wander the northern Barrens; we're happy for all the help we can get.

[urgent] Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have? [hesitant] He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
quest_6127_quest_complete:
By my ancestors, this water is disgusting! [angry] No wonder the gazelles are sick.

[sad] Something is polluting the water, and in turn beginning to wreck the northern Barrens ecosystem. [solemn] Sick gazelles have been sighted all north of the east-west road here. [urgent] While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.

[soft voice] This water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. [warm] While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
quest_6128_quest_detail:
[solemn] The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I shall make for the gazelles. For curative properties, I need some earthroot. Herbalists know how to find it, so if you are not familiar with this skill you'll need to find one to help us out.

Finally for potency, I need kodo horns - mere chips and fragments will not suffice. [commanding] Kodos you can handle wander the northern part of the Barrens; bring some down for the greater good of the balance <name>, and fetch the horns for me.
quest_6128_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve? [solemn] The gazelle aren't getting any better on their own, so we better not tarry in our effort to save them!
quest_6128_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is good, <name>, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.

Making a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it. Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!

[warm] Now, let me get to work on this!
quest_6130_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid. [soft voice] Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

[pause] You should now return to Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, <name>. [solemn] He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto him .

[warm] Farewell, young druid. [soft voice] We shall speak again.
quest_6130_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation at the Crossroads. [soft voice] This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

[warm] You handled yourself with grace under pressure. [proud] For that, I can find no better way to reward you with permanent power over poison. [gentle] Use it well, <name>... use it well.
quest_6132_quest_detail:
[urgent] Get me out of here!

I came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines. I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk! I think they want to eat me!

[urgent] Get me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big! He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.

[urgent] Let's hurry, <name>. Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...
quest_6132_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you seen my sister Melizza? [soft voice] She's always on the go, which gets her into trouble all the time.
quest_6132_quest_complete: [soft voice] My sister Melizza said you'd be coming. [warm] Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; [hesitant] it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!
quest_6134_quest_detail:
[urgent] There's a valley to the southeast, the Valley of Bones, haunted by Magram ghosts. [shocked] Sounds scary, doesn't it? [excited] Well think how scary it is to the Magram! [confident] If we captured ghost energy from that place, I bet it'd be worth plenty to those centaurs.

[commanding] Here, take this crate of ghost magnets. [soft voice] If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it. [urgent] Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm--that's what we'll sell to the Magram.
quest_6134_quest_complete:
[excited] There it is! [laughing] Looks like you got some of it on you too. [chuckling] Kinda slimey, eh?

[warm] Well, thanks a lot for all the trouble, <name>. [urgent] This stuff will be worth a fortune... if I can convince the centaurs what it is!
quest_6141_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother in arms, Brother Anton, heard rumors of an undead infestation in distant Kalimdor, in a land known as Desolace. [urgent] Anton immediately booked passage to that place, to seek and destroy the undead menace!

[soft voice] He is looking for those with the bravery and resolve to aid him. If your heart is true, then speak with Anton. [commanding] He is in Desolace, in the Alliance town of Nijel's Point.
quest_6141_quest_complete:
[solemn] I received word of aid arriving from the east. [soft voice] Are you the source of these rumors? [soft voice] Have you come here to help the Scarlet Brother in its crusade?

[urgent] If so, then listen close...
quest_6142_quest_detail:
[excited] You have the look of a fisherman, <class>! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?

Up north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
quest_6142_quest_progress: [excited] I can't wait to go fishing with some fresh soft-shelled clam meat; [soft voice] did you bring me the 10 pieces of it I need?
quest_6142_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, "Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better"

[warm] Well, I feel better already, thanks mon!
quest_6143_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... [pause] my crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades.

[sad] The naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me.

[sigh] Me conscience can't handle the guilt, <class>; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. [urgent] I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?
quest_6143_quest_progress:
[solemn] I still hear their voices crying for help when the naga unleashed their chaos over us. [sad] If I didn't have this bad knee, I'd go and help you kill those blasted naga!

[urgent] You can usually guarantee to find them deep in the coral reefs below the surface... lurking... scheming...
quest_6143_quest_complete:
[solemn] As sweet as it is hearing the news that the naga have been vanquished, my heart still feels empty. [low voice] For the rest of my life I will be dedicated to having them all killed.

[commanding] Here mon, your reward as I promised. [warm] It's small in comparison to the gratification of knowing the naga fried for their hated act upon my crew.
quest_6146_quest_complete: [urgent] Where have you been? [solemn] We had thought the Scourge had captured you.
quest_6147_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Grand Crusader makes an unusual request. [low voice] Hrm, regardless... what he asks will be done. [commanding] Return to the Scarlet Bastion and notify him that the Oracle will be en route shortly.

[urgent] We will take every precaution to ensure that she makes it to Stratholme unharmed.
quest_6162_quest_detail:
[solemn] My husband traveled Felwood for the honor of our clan, doing battle against the Shadow Council and other corrupt atrocities!

[sad] After he escaped death numerous times, I received a letter from him saying that a druid asked him for help against a great befouled furbolg named Overlord Ror--the two were never heard from again.

[angry] I want this Ror's clawed hand, <name>. [loud voice] I want it to pay for leaving me a widow! [urgent] I believe the creature is to the south... near the Ashenvale border.
quest_6162_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the beasts head yet, <name>? [angry] It will pay for its crimes. [low voice] I don't care if it's corrupt or just angry for living in such a dismal forest. [shouting] No furbolg will live for long committing such crimes against my family!
quest_6162_quest_complete:
[solemn] You bring honor to me for following through with your word. [soft voice] My husband died in battle--he would have been proud of that. [pause] But I could not rest until I knew that the creature that has forced me to live my life alone paid for what it had done.

[warm] Thank you again, <name>.
quest_6164_quest_detail:
[excited] I'm ready for business! What you do want?

Oh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book. How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?

I must have left it in town somewhere. I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.

Bring me my book. Please, bring it to me! Bring me my book and you'll see! I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
quest_6164_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have my receipt book? [excited] I can't wait to get back to business!
quest_6164_quest_complete:
[excited] There it is! And oh my! I forgot how full it was!

[warm] This is a glorious day, <name>! [delight] Stupendous! [excited] Insanely good, I say!
quest_6181_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor. His name is Osric Strang. His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

[urgent] Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more. Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master. He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
quest_6181_quest_progress: [urgent] You look like you're in a hurry. [excited] Well, then you came to the right place!
quest_6181_quest_complete: [excited] You have to get this note to Stormwind? That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
quest_6182_quest_complete: [solemn] After some reports of unusual Forsaken activity in the Eastern Plaguelands, SI:7 agents were dispatched to investigate. [soft voice] The results of that investigation are unsettling.
quest_6183_quest_detail:
[solemn] Five of my best field agents were assigned the Marris case. [sad] One returned, only to end up dead in his sleep three days later.

[low voice] What little information we did manage to get out of him was incoherent gibberish. [emphasis] We made out two words: "Nathanos," and "Blightcaller."

[urgent] I do not have the available manpower to continue this investigation and Ravenholdt will not assist us. [solemn] We must get to the bottom of this; if only to provide closure to the families of the deceased. [hesitant] Will you help?
quest_6183_quest_complete: <Mathias nods.> [solemn] I had faith that Bolvar would send me men and women of honor - the most dedicated soldiers of the Alliance.
quest_6184_quest_detail:
[solemn] The only information we have thus far, then, is that Nathanos Marris may have been slain by this Blightcaller. [soft voice] We assume the Blightcaller is the same fiend that disposed of my agents.

[solemn] Flint Shadowmore, another SI:7 operative, is stationed at the Alliance encampment of Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands. [urgent] Seek him out; he will debrief you on the current situation in the Plagues and give you an assignment.

[warm] Good luck, <name>.
quest_6184_quest_complete: [commanding] The first mission will be straight up, <name>. You go in, you come out. Recon...
quest_6185_quest_detail:
[solemn] As I said, your first mission is one of reconnaissance. Nothing fancy, <name>. You must travel to the Eastern Plaguelands and look for any clues as to this Blightcaller.

Be on the lookout for information about our missing operatives. We have to assume that they are dead and if they are dead, they must have a corpse... somewhere.

<Flint swallows hard.>

[emphasis] All SI:7 agents carry this insignia.

<Flint shows you his SI:7 insignia.>

Bring any of those that you may find back to me.
quest_6185_quest_complete:
Rutger. Fredo. Turyen. All... dead...

<Flint clutches the insignias tightly.>

[sad] Where were they? [soft voice] Did you discover any more information about this bastard, the Blightcaller?
quest_6186_quest_detail:
<The blood appears to have completely drained from Flint's face.> [soft voice] Na... Nathanos did this? [sad] Nathanos is the Blightcaller?

Why? He was... was so noble - a ranger lord respected by all. The only human ever allowed to train under the high elves. Now a ruthless agent of the Forsaken?

[pause] I... I am sorry to ask this of you, <name>, but [urgent] Highlord Fordragon must be informed of this turn of events at once. [commanding] Please, return to Stormwind and deliver the news.
quest_6261_quest_detail:
<name>, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for. Can you take it to him?

[urgent] If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him. Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

[commanding] Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can. [urgent] We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
quest_6261_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is that sweat on your brow, lad? [pause] You've been running too much. [gentle] Next time, take a gryphon!
quest_6261_quest_complete: [excited] A crate for Westfall, eh? [warm] Have you been to Westfall before? [soft voice] If so, then it's no problem, my friend. [proud] I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
quest_6281_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric. [low voice] You won't get there faster any other way.

[pause] If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride. [gentle] I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
quest_6281_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've been traveling, eh? [pause] Have you been anywhere interesting?
quest_6281_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis? I'm not surprised he needs more gear. [solemn] Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

[warm] Well thank you, <name>. [excited] Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
quest_6282_quest_detail:
Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. [solemn] Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

[soft voice] The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

[commanding] I need you to cull the harpies, <name>!
quest_6282_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not be weary of Charred Vale; many evil creatures reside in those hills. [soft voice] Stay strong <name>, and you shall prevail over this threat to our people. [urgent] Go now and strike hard - our children shall never know of the evil of what was.
quest_6282_quest_complete: [excited] This is most excellent news! [warm] Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. [proud] The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
quest_6283_quest_detail:
[solemn] Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. [urgent] The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!

[commanding] She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. [solemn] Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.

[urgent] Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
quest_6283_quest_progress:
[solemn] Already I feel the anger leave me. [soft voice] What will I do with my time? [pause] Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. [hesitant] Perhaps this is a good thing... [pause] maybe now I can focus on the good, as all Tauren should.

[warm] Please accept this as a reward for your troubles.
quest_6283_quest_complete:
[commanding] Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! [warm] You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

[solemn] The bloodfuries will be helpless without their leader... [confident] surely we can vanquish them forever!
quest_6284_quest_detail: [solemn] Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.
quest_6285_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor. If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

[pause] That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

[emphasis] You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall. Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
quest_6285_quest_progress: [excited] You're back from Stormwind? [urgent] Did Osric send the armor?
quest_6285_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, you brought the armor! [warm] We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Your efforts have been a great help to us. [warm] And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
quest_6301_quest_detail:
[solemn] Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

[soft voice] <name>, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. [emphasis] They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

[urgent] Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
quest_6301_quest_progress: [solemn] The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. [soft voice] To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, <class>?
quest_6301_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, <name>, you have the Gaea seeds. [solemn] Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish. <Tammra begins to chant.>
quest_6321_quest_detail:
[solemn] Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher. [urgent] With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

[low voice] I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

[commanding] Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity. [urgent] Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
quest_6321_quest_progress: [low voice] You appear to be on official business...
quest_6321_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, an order for supplies. [urgent] You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt. And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
quest_6322_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate. [pause] If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

[soft voice] Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett. [commanding] He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
quest_6322_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
quest_6322_quest_complete: [urgent] This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? [soft voice] That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
quest_6323_quest_detail:
[soft voice] One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee. Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. [solemn] That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
quest_6323_quest_progress: [solemn] I keep my weapons in top condition. [soft voice] They are cleaned and ready for use.
quest_6323_quest_complete: [solemn] An order from the Sepulcher? Very well. [soft voice] It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
quest_6324_quest_detail:
[solemn] The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok. [soft voice] If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.

[pause] Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.

[emphasis] You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there. [commanding] Speak with me again when you are ready.
quest_6324_quest_progress: <name>, you return. [solemn] Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
quest_6324_quest_complete:
[warm] Good work, <name>. [solemn] These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.

[proud] You have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.
quest_6341_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant. [solemn] I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.

[pause] I have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore. His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.

[gentle] Bring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.
quest_6341_quest_progress: [soft voice] How may I help you? [gentle] Are you in need of transport?
quest_6341_quest_complete: [gentle] Ah, you wish to get this to Auberdine? [soft voice] Very well...
quest_6342_quest_detail:
[soft voice] From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph. Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.

[solemn] It is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one. Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.

[pause] Here is Nessa's collection. [soft voice] Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
quest_6342_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you come from Teldrassil? [pause] Tell me, how is the fishing there?
quest_6342_quest_complete:
[delight] A package from Nessa? Thank you, <name>! [warm] She told me she would send me samples of the fish caught near Rut'theran village. [soft voice] She thinks they may be very different from the fish caught here...

[surprised] My! [excited] This jawbone is nearly twice the size of the same fish found here. [excited] And these scales are as big as a closed fist! [excited] Amazing!
quest_6343_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must send a response to Nessa. [soft voice] She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline. [pause] We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!

[gentle] Please, take this response to Nessa. [urgent] If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather. [soft voice] If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
quest_6343_quest_progress: <name>, you're back from Auberdine? [soft voice] Did you speak with Laird?
quest_6343_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is very interesting. The fish here are large, but I didn't think the difference in bounties between here and the mainland was so great. There must be a reason for this...

[pause] Well thank you, <name>. I will discuss with the villagers the news you brought. Perhaps, one day, we will find the root of this oddity. But until then, we shall reap its benefits!
quest_6344_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village. [solemn] She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

[gentle] If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village. You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
quest_6344_quest_complete: [soft voice] Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to Darkshore. [warm] Will you help me?
quest_6361_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

[gentle] Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider. [urgent] Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
quest_6361_quest_progress: [urgent] Are you here for a wind rider? [commanding] You have something to transport?
quest_6361_quest_complete: [commanding] If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!
quest_6362_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff. [excited] There's no faster way to the city!

[gentle] If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.

[urgent] If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff. [commanding] And that's right where you'll land!
quest_6362_quest_progress: [soft voice] There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens. [pause] You have spoken with my friend Jahan?
quest_6362_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!

[warm] Thank you, brother. You have done me a great service. [proud] Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
quest_6363_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads. Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

[urgent] Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
quest_6363_quest_progress: [soft voice] Greetings, <class>. [warm] What can I do for you?
quest_6363_quest_complete: [soft voice] You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh? [pause] That's not a problem. [warm] If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
quest_6364_quest_detail:
[solemn] In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town. [soft voice] You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.

[commanding] Speak with me again when you are ready. [solemn] Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
quest_6364_quest_progress: <name>, you are back from Thunder Bluff? [soft voice] Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
quest_6364_quest_complete:
[excited] Ahanu sent me finished products? Very good. [warm] There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively. [proud] I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

[warm] Thank you for all your efforts, <name>. [proud] I am in your debt.
quest_6365_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend. Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar. [urgent] Will you deliver the meat for me?

The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider. [commanding] Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.
quest_6365_quest_progress: [urgent] You need to get somewhere fast? [commanding] Then you're talking to the right orc!
quest_6365_quest_complete: [urgent] You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? [commanding] That is no problem. [warm] For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
quest_6382_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your strength impresses me, <class>. [soft voice] Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.

[solemn] The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually. [pause] If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post. [emphasis] The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.
quest_6382_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome to the new frontier, <name>. [warm] Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young <class> like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. [gentle] Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

[warm] Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. [soft voice] Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
quest_6383_quest_complete:
[solemn] There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might. [soft voice] In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself. The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

[solemn] The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down. [urgent] If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
quest_6384_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar. [urgent] When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka. [solemn] Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.

[commanding] Speak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
quest_6384_quest_progress: [excited] Something smells good! [soft voice] You don't have raw meat on you, do you?
quest_6384_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, wonderful! [warm] Those are fine cuts! [soft voice] These are from Zargh, are they? [chuckling] That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...

[excited] Oh, I can't wait to cook it. [gentle] But not too much! [soft voice] Meat is best served rare, don't you think?
quest_6385_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh. Will you deliver it for me? [urgent] If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.

[commanding] Take my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.
quest_6385_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you need one of my wind riders?
quest_6385_quest_complete: [urgent] You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? [soft voice] Yes, I can get you there...
quest_6386_quest_detail:
[solemn] My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.

[soft voice] You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here. [urgent] Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.

[commanding] Speak with me when you are ready to go.
quest_6386_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you returned from Orgrimmar? [pause] Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?
quest_6386_quest_complete:
Hah! I guess she liked it! [excited] Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
quest_6387_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining. And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!

[proud] I have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick. Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge. He'll get the picks ready.

[urgent] The fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.
quest_6387_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon? [hesitant] Are you ready to leave for another city?
quest_6387_quest_complete: [commanding] You have to get this to Ironforge, eh? [urgent] For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. [warm] How does that sound?
quest_6388_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. [soft voice] If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!

[urgent] Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
quest_6388_quest_progress: [soft voice] You look like you have somewhere to go. [gentle] Need one of my gryphons?
quest_6388_quest_complete: [low voice] You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? [pause] That won't be a problem. [pause] As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
quest_6389_quest_detail: [soft voice] You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. [emphasis] You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
quest_6390_quest_detail: [soft voice] You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. [hesitant] You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
quest_6391_quest_detail:
[soft voice] For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge. From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe. You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild. [solemn] That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!

[commanding] Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
quest_6391_quest_progress: [soft voice] What can I do for you, sir?
quest_6391_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. [warm] I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. [soft voice] I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
quest_6392_quest_detail:
For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... as long as you've already been there. [solemn] Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.

You've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him. And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.

[commanding] Speak with me when you're ready to go.
quest_6392_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, <name>. [pause] Have you returned from Ironforge?
quest_6392_quest_complete:
[excited] You brought the picks. Great! [warm] I'll get these to my mining students. [proud] I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.

[warm] Thank you for your help, <name>. [proud] I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.
quest_6394_quest_detail:
<name>, you are a dependable <race>. Can I count on you for another task?

[solemn] Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind. When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts! [urgent] Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls. My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
quest_6394_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, <name>? [urgent] Did you find my pick?
quest_6394_quest_complete: [excited] Great, you got it! [warm] Thanks a lot, <name>. [proud] This is my favorite pick! [commanding] Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
quest_6401_quest_detail: [urgent] Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! [excited] Kaya is alive! [solemn] We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. [commanding] Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
quest_6401_quest_complete: [delight] My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! [warm] That is good news indeed. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_6402_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of Stormwind.

[urgent] What Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!

[commanding] Do not attempt to venture there alone, <name>. [urgent] You must amass an army! [commanding] Gather your compatriots. [shouting] To arms!
quest_6402_quest_complete: [urgent] Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. [commanding] We face a dragon, after all!
quest_6403_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It has been quite the adventure, friend. I owe you a great debt of gratitude. Perhaps, when all is said and done...

[solemn] As you have no doubt ascertained by now, Lady Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian.

[low voice] For too long she has held our kingdom in her captivating gaze. Even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery - a puppet. It all ends today... The spell will be broken.

[urgent] Worry not, for together, we shall be victorious!

[excited] Are you ready?
quest_6421_quest_detail:
[solemn] Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, <name>?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave. I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young <class>, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
quest_6421_quest_progress: [solemn] What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? [soft voice] I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. [pause] Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
quest_6421_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.

[solemn] Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. [soft voice] They were used to create the land our feet walk on. [urgent] This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.

<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>

Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this kobold plot.
quest_6441_quest_detail:
[excited] Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. [soft voice] I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

[hesitant] After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. [sad] I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

[warm] Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
quest_6441_quest_progress: [urgent] I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, <name>. [excited] I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
quest_6441_quest_complete:
[delight] These are perfect, <name>! [excited] Thanks for helping me out!

[warm] Oh, and this is for your time...
quest_6442_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is evil lurking here along the coast, <race>.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas. Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

[urgent] Return to me with 20 of their heads! [shouting] Throw the naga back to the depths!
quest_6442_quest_progress: [solemn] The naga increase in numbers, <name>. [soft voice] Please complete this task for me.
quest_6442_quest_complete: [soft voice] We could use more of your kind around here, <name>. [warm] Thank you for your help.
quest_6461_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.

[hesitant] Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.

[urgent] If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. [commanding] Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
quest_6461_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hey mon, have you slain the hairy blood feeders? [hesitant] I fear none here in Stonetalon but I don't go walking around here at night... if you know what I mean mon!

[whispering] As long as I stay off their dinner plate then all is well.

[warm] Good luck to you, <class>!
quest_6461_quest_complete:
[delight] Sweet, mon! [excited] Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.

[warm] Many thanks, <name>. [proud] We are forever in your debt.
quest_6462_quest_detail:
[solemn] My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar! [angry] Those vile Furbolgs!

[sad] I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife. [solemn] However, their troll charms hold great value in this world. [angry] It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!

[urgent] <name>, you must retrieve the charms! [commanding] They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
quest_6462_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the charms, <name>? Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, [angry] my blood boils with rage!
quest_6462_quest_complete:
[excited] You found them! [warm] Thank you! Thank you, <name>! [proud] You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

[solemn] A troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

[sad] Worthless.
quest_6481_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, <class>. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.

I have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.

When awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... [urgent] Slay him, <name>!
quest_6481_quest_progress: [solemn] I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. [commanding] The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. [urgent] When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... go now <name>!
quest_6481_quest_complete:
[solemn] You bear good news, <class>! [soft voice] I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.

[proud] Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. [warm] You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble <class>.

[warm] Accept this as your reward most honored one.
quest_6482_quest_detail:
Eh? [surprised] Who are you?

<name>? You're no furbolg. [angry] They are cursed! [urgent] They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me! [sad] My strength is failing...

[urgent] Help me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.

<name>! [urgent] I must escape!
quest_6482_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you seen my brother Ruul? [sad] He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...
quest_6482_quest_complete:
[excited] You found my brother! He was captured by the Thistlefurs? [sad] That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.

[warm] Thank you for rescuing my brother, <name>. [soft voice] I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul. [pause] He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
quest_6501_quest_progress: [solemn] I sense an aura of evil radiating from you, <race>. [low voice] What could you hold that emits such an aura?
quest_6501_quest_complete: [solemn] I should have known - a piece of the black dragon brood mother, Onyxia. How revolting...
quest_6502_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. [soft voice] Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. [sad] Shattered, it is useless.

[hesitant] It is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. [solemn] There is one... [commanding] He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian. [soft voice] Perhaps you have heard of him?

[urgent] Return with his blood, <race>, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to Onyxia's lair.
quest_6502_quest_progress: [solemn] The flow of time does not stop or slow, <race>. [soft voice] While my life is eternal, yours is not. [pause] Waste not the time that you have...
quest_6502_quest_complete:
[solemn] This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. [soft voice] The lair of Onyxia can be found in Dustwallow Marsh. [solemn] As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.

[warm] The Blue Flight wishes you luck, <name>.
quest_6503_quest_detail:
[solemn] We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. [urgent] We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!

[commanding] Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing. [emphasis] Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
quest_6503_quest_progress: [solemn] I await reports of your outrunner kills, <name>.
quest_6503_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good, <name>. [warm] Your hunting skills are impressive...

[soft voice] The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
quest_6504_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! [hesitant] Will you find them for me?
quest_6504_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope you find the pages soon, <name>! [urgent] I really need to get back to work!
quest_6504_quest_complete: [soft voice] Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! [excited] Thanks, <name>!
quest_6523_quest_detail:
[excited] Thank you for rescuing me! [urgent] We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. [soft voice] Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.

[solemn] My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
quest_6523_quest_complete: [excited] Kaya is alive! [warm] <name>, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
quest_6541_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? [solemn] The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

[urgent] If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. [commanding] He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
quest_6541_quest_complete: [solemn] Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. [proud] We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
quest_6542_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? [solemn] The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

[urgent] If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. [commanding] He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
quest_6542_quest_complete: [solemn] Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. [confident] We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
quest_6543_quest_detail:
[solemn] I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

[commanding] Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. [urgent] You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. [commanding] You will find a scout and an outrider there.

Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
quest_6543_quest_progress: Hurry, <name>. [urgent] They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
quest_6543_quest_complete: [confident] I can see that you are one that can be counted on. [solemn] These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. [urgent] We can now plan our next move.
quest_6544_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey! <class>! Come here!

[commanding] My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. [excited] The battle will be glorious!

Do you want to share in the glory, <name>, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.

[commanding] What do you say. Are you with us?
quest_6544_quest_progress: [solemn] Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. [soft voice] Was the attack successful?
quest_6544_quest_complete:
[excited] So Torek's attack was successful! [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] Night elves are decent foes. [chuckling] A little skinny, but strong and fierce! [hesitant] I'm sure the battle was something to see...

[laughing] And I hope you gained a scar or two!
quest_6545_quest_progress:
[urgent] So you're here with my orders? [commanding] Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.

You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, <name>. [solemn] I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.

[urgent] But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost. Warsong Report
quest_6545_quest_complete: [urgent] Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. [commanding] You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
quest_6546_quest_progress:
[solemn] Much danger lies along this path, <name>. [low voice] You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. [urgent] The threat of the alliance is quite near.

[commanding] We are faced by enemies on all fronts. [solemn] The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. [soft voice] I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.

[warm] It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- [emphasis] be ready for what lies ahead, <name>. [urgent] Warsong Report
quest_6546_quest_complete: [urgent] Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, <name>.
quest_6547_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Keep an eye out, <race>. [whispering] The elves are often hiding in the shadows...

[pause] We must always be watching. [solemn] We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.

[urgent] I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak? [commanding] Warsong Report
quest_6547_quest_complete: [urgent] Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. [solemn] Our plans are going well.
quest_6548_quest_detail:
[sad] The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. [sad] I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.

[solemn] <name>, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. [urgent] You will find them just to the west of here.
quest_6548_quest_complete: <name>, I thank you... [solemn] but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
quest_6561_quest_detail:
[low voice] Strength has left me. [urgent] Your help is needed!

[solemn] Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

[threatening] Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

[commanding] The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. [solemn] The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

[urgent] Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, <name>, please.
quest_6561_quest_progress:
[solemn] May the Earthmother be with you, <name>.

[soft voice] Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. [solemn] She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
quest_6561_quest_complete:
[solemn] Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, <name>.

[warm] Earthmother be praised! [angry] To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

[proud] You have done a great thing this day. [solemn] Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_6562_quest_complete: [excited] Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. [solemn] Then we have matters to discuss.
quest_6563_quest_detail:
[solemn] Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. [soft voice] Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. [hesitant] Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

[urgent] Will you help me, <name>? [low voice] Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
quest_6563_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes your search for the crystals, <name>? [hesitant] Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? [solemn] I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
quest_6563_quest_complete: [gentle] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] These are the crystals I spoke of. [pause] Intriguings... I can feel the power within them. [solemn] The spirits of water cling to them. [warm] Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
quest_6564_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"[solemn] Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

[threatening] By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. [excited] One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! [commanding] An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
quest_6564_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, <name>? What is it you need? [hesitant] There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
quest_6564_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is interesting indeed. [soft voice] I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

[pause] Now we have a name for our troubles... [low voice] Lorgus Jett.
quest_6565_quest_detail:
[solemn] This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. [solemn] The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. [solemn] They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. [urgent] This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. [commanding] You must stop him, <name>. [sad] I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

[urgent] Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. [solemn] Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
quest_6565_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found him yet, <name>? [angry] Lorgus must be stopped!
quest_6565_quest_complete:
[delight] Very good!! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

[hesitant] Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
quest_6568_quest_progress: [solemn] It is not often I see one of the Horde in these parts of Lordaeron. [soft voice] What is it that you have for Myranda?
quest_6568_quest_complete:
<Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles.> [soft voice] How is he? Rexxar, I mean. [pause] Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!

[shocked] Oh, nevermind! [warm] Myranda will help you, <race>. I owe the Warchief a favor or two. <Myranda smiles.>
quest_6569_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the <race> wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?

The creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. [low voice] Rexxar and the Warchief have entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.

[urgent] Travel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.

[soft voice] Return to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
quest_6569_quest_progress: <Myranda laughs.> [soft voice] The eyes of that which we wish to mimic are the most important ingredient of any illusion, <name>. <Myranda points to a bag almost overflowing with eyeballs labeled 'Scarlet Crusade.'>
quest_6569_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Let Myranda have a look, <race>.

[warm] Oh yes, these will do nicely.

[solemn] With these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
quest_6570_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.

[solemn] Emberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of Nefarian, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to Onyxia.

[urgent] Travel to the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh and enter the lair of Emberstrife. [emphasis] Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!
quest_6571_quest_detail:
[urgent] We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
