[soft voice] Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

[solemn] Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. [sad] The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

[hesitant] Can you help me?
quest_6571_quest_progress: [urgent] I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
quest_6571_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, <name>. You've saved me a lot of work!

But don't think that I'm not grateful!
quest_6581_quest_progress:
[urgent] Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! [excited] Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! [angry] My time isn't cheap!

[soft voice] What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? [warm] There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

[confident] So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal? Deadly Blunderbuss
quest_6581_quest_complete: [delight] This is perfect -- just the thing! [excited] Well, here's the shipment.
quest_6603_quest_detail:
[urgent] There's trouble in Winterspring!

[excited] Why, sure, I spend some time out in the wilds and know about these things... [proud] I'm always mighty proud to say it. [warm] I consider the hours I spend out there in the hills to be golden. [commanding] Help you cultivate quick reflexes, a cool head and a keen eye...

[solemn] It takes judgement, brains and maturity to appreciate the wilderness in the way that I do.

[hesitant] Now, what was I talking about?

[soft voice] Ah yes, trouble. [urgent] See Donova Snowden at the hot springs and she can tell you more.
quest_6603_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, hi there! [excited] So Meggi told you of the trouble I have found here?
quest_6604_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? [low voice] It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!

[hesitant] I heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. [hesitant] I'm sure curious about what happened... aren't you?
quest_6604_quest_complete: [gentle] Aye, what can I do for you?
quest_6605_quest_detail:
[urgent] I just got back from Felwood, <name>. On my way through, I stopped at Bloodvenom Post and I met a very odd character... She seemed intent on one thing, and I suppose I could tell you what that is, but I think she'd like to explain it to you herself.

[soft voice] If you're interested, head to Bloodvenom Post in western Felwood and look for Winna Hazzard.

[hesitant] Who knows, she might need your help...
quest_6605_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, <class>. I see that there is hope yet. [soft voice] Are you here to assist me?
quest_6606_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We can always use a little luck, eh? [low voice] A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor...

[hesitant] I happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. [soft voice] She made me a lucky charm... for a price. [warm] Believe me, though, it was well worth it!

[excited] Maybe you'd be interested in one of your own? [urgent] Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook. [angry] I'm not giving mine up!
quest_6606_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, so Harlo be sendin' you? [warm] Well, den, who might you be? [gentle] I s'pose you be wantin' my help?
quest_6607_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Can't say I really enjoy fishin' much. [pause] Figure I been at it for a good 20 or 30 years now.

[pause] I reckon people are driven to do what they do for different reasons.

[pause] Now, I'm not saying you need to fish for 30 years or catch every fish in the sea to become a master fisherman. [pause] I reckon you just need to be determined - determined enough to sit on your duff for hours at a time, doin' nothin'.

[pause] [warm] I'll tell you what, catch me a few rare fish and I'll teach you a thing or two. [pause] Here's a list:
quest_6607_quest_complete:
[delight] Now that's a fine catch!

[warm] Come over here, lemme show you how to set a few lines.
quest_6608_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lumak no can teach <name> no more. [excited] You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.

You find Nat in Dustwallow Marsh, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. [low voice] Nat probably fishing. [urgent] Go now!
quest_6608_quest_complete:
'Course, you must be a friend of Lumak's.

[warm] Fishin'? [excited] I can tell you all 'bout fishin'.
quest_6609_quest_detail:
[angry] I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, lad! [angry] I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! [proud] I'm practically made outta stone.

[sad] I got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. [sigh] I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!

[angry] Don't ye get it? [sad] Ah, fine. [soft voice] I got an ol' friend over on Kalimdor who can help ye out. [soft voice] 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. [urgent] Find him on the islands south o' Theramore. [shouting] Git goin'!
quest_6609_quest_complete: [soft voice] I've always got room on my island for visitors... [pause] I reckon...
quest_6610_quest_detail:
[excited] Ever heard of a clamlette? Of course you haven't! It's my latest and greatest culinary masterpiece. [warm] Oh, <name>, just thinking about a clamlette makes my mouth water.

[sad] Unfortunately, I'm all out of supplies to make any! [excited] How about I make you a deal? You gather the supplies I need to make a clamlette and I'll teach you the finer points of exotic cuisine and I'll even throw in a couple of clamlettes to boot! [urgent] Deal?? Here's what I need:
quest_6610_quest_progress: [urgent] My cravings are going to be the end of me! [shouting] Hurry, <name> - before I dip into my own supply.
quest_6610_quest_complete: [excited] You are in for a special treat, <name>. [commanding] Watch and learn! <Dirge begins to prepare clamlette surprise.>
quest_6611_quest_detail:
[angry] How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!

[sigh] Zamja can't help. Fat <race> needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.

[mocking tone] When you become big cook on the block, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? [urgent] Now go!
quest_6611_quest_complete:
<Dirge spits out some leather sandal bits.> [laughing] Pfftooey...

<Dirge hacks loudly.>

What? [commanding] I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates.
quest_6612_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. [sad] Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.

[excited] Luckily fer ye, I know a guy. [low voice] He's a goblin and probably the best cook on Kalimdor.

[sigh] Ayep, that's the bad news, lad - ye got to travel to Kalimdor. [urgent] Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. [commanding] He'll set ya straight.
quest_6612_quest_complete:
<Dirge spits out leather.> [proud] Pfftey...

<Dirge hacks loudly.>

What? [excited] I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates, <race>.
quest_6621_quest_detail:
<name>, another tribe of Furbolgs, the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar. [solemn] They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat. [commanding] With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound. [urgent] They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe. Bring me the totem he carries.

[commanding] Gather your allies, <name>. [urgent] This is no task for a single <class>.
quest_6621_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you defeat Chief Murgut, <name>? [urgent] Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
quest_6621_quest_complete:
[warm] Good work, <name>. [solemn] Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:

The Horde is not to be trifled with.

[confident] I don't believe that tribe will giving us much trouble for a long time.
quest_6622_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Good day, doctor. [commanding] You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. [solemn] Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Horde Trauma.

[urgent] Now pay attention! [emphasis] The critically injured must be tended to first. [emphasis] After the criticals come the badly injured. [emphasis] The injured should be tended to last. [commanding] You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. [commanding] You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.

[solemn] Triage bandages will be supplied.

[warm] Good luck, doctor.
quest_6622_quest_progress: [soft voice] Miraculous work, doctor. [soft voice] Simply miraculous.
quest_6623_quest_detail:
Doctor <name>, I presume. [solemn] It is a pleasure to see you again.

[excited] I have some wonderful news for you! [warm] Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of Horde Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Hammerfall. [confident] This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! [excited] I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great Doctor Gregory Victor! [urgent] Do not squander this opportunity!
quest_6623_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful. [urgent] Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!
quest_6624_quest_detail:
Good day, doctor. [solemn] You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. [commanding] Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Alliance Trauma.

[urgent] Now pay attention! [emphasis] The critically injured must be tended to first. [emphasis] After the criticals come the badly injured. [emphasis] The injured should be tended to last. [urgent] You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.

[warm] Good luck, doctor.
quest_6624_quest_progress: [soft voice] Miraculous work, doctor. [solemn] Simply miraculous.
quest_6624_quest_complete: [soft voice] Doctor <name>, welcome to Alliance Trauma.
quest_6625_quest_detail:
Doctor <name>, I presume. [soft voice] It is a pleasure to see you.

[excited] I have some wonderful news for you! [urgent] Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of Alliance Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Theramore. [excited] This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! [warm] I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great doctor, Gustaf VanHowzen! [commanding] Do not squander this opportunity, doctor!
quest_6625_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful. [urgent] Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!
quest_6626_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Forsaken do not pass on their... illness... from what I have seen. [soft voice] This diplomat seems to be granting undeath to would-be followers. [hesitant] I am beginning to think he is one of the Scourge.

[pause] For now, my concern is not with him though, it's with the growing ranks around him. [urgent] They creep from the shadows daily, almost begging him for more power.

[low voice] I'm not powerful enough to fight them on my own, <name>. [commanding] What do you say? [excited] Are you up for some hunting?
quest_6626_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the hunt, <name>? Seeing just this small sample of this diplomat's power here removes any doubt I had that the Scourge are one of the greatest threats this world has ever seen.
quest_6626_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you, <name>! [warm] The work you've done will be a great help, I'm sure.

[solemn] I will continue my study of this diplomat and the rest of the quilboar here. [soft voice] If you seek greater adventure, I'd find a few friends and head into the cave that looks like a great boar maw just over there. [confident] I'm sure once you're inside you'll find greater challenges to face.
quest_6627_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. [soft voice] Are you ready?

[pause] Time is not an issue, <class>, so do not feel pressured. [gentle] You may take as long as you like to answer.
quest_6627_quest_progress: [solemn] Life is full of questions, <class>. [soft voice] You will never be able to answer all of them, but with some time and study, perhaps you will become a little more knowledgeable.
quest_6627_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <class>. [warm] You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
quest_6628_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the time is once again upon us. [soft voice] As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.

[pause] And so now I offer you your question. [gentle] If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, <name>--there is no pressure to answer quickly.
quest_6628_quest_progress:
[solemn] There is only one rule I feel you must know if you wish to survive in this world: the more you know, the more you'll see.

[soft voice] If you study, if you observe, then you will begin to see things in the world that no other <race> will see.
quest_6628_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.
quest_6629_quest_detail:
<name>, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. [solemn] If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. [angry] He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

[urgent] You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. [commanding] Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
quest_6629_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you killed Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of Brutes?
quest_6629_quest_complete: [excited] Grundig Darkcloud is dead! [warm] <name>, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
quest_6641_quest_detail:
[solemn] Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...

[soft voice] She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.

[commanding] But I am ready, <name>. [confident] I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.

[solemn] The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. [urgent] I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.

[urgent] We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
quest_6641_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. [soft voice] It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.

[warm] We are in your debt, <name>.
quest_6642_quest_progress:
[solemn] Dark Iron, while plentiful in the Depths, is still a valued commodity amongst the Brotherhood. [soft voice] The sacred arms and armaments of Ragnaros favor Dark Iron.

[emphasis] For every 10 pieces of Dark Iron Ore you offer, favor amongst the Brotherhood you will gain. [urgent] Dark Iron Ore(10)
quest_6642_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [warm] Favor you have gained. [commanding] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_6643_quest_progress:
[solemn] Woe unto those that tempt fate inside the Molten Core. Death comes swiftly - the punishment dealt without mercy.

Many of the Brotherhood have been lost in their search for Fiery Cores.

[commanding] Offer 1 Fiery Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood. [urgent] Fiery Core
quest_6643_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [solemn] Favor you have gained. [commanding] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_6644_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Thorium Brotherhood sympathizes with your plight, <race>. [commanding] This is why Lokthos has been empowered to bargain.

[urgent] Offer 1 Lava Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood. Lava Core
quest_6644_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [warm] Favor you have gained. [commanding] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_6645_quest_progress:
[solemn] Many of the sacred recipes require the skin from Ragnaros' chosen pets.

[urgent] Offer 2 Core Leather, skinned from the smoldering corpses of the Core Hounds of the Molten Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood. [commanding] Core Leather(2)
quest_6645_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [warm] Favor you have gained. [urgent] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_6646_quest_progress:
[solemn] The tears of the Fire Lord are a rare find indeed.

[commanding] Offer 1 Blood of the Mountain and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood. [urgent] Blood of the Mountain
quest_6646_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [warm] Favor you have gained. [commanding] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_6661_quest_detail: [commanding] Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.
quest_6662_quest_detail: [soft voice] Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. [urgent] Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. [commanding] Get a move on!
quest_6681_quest_detail:
<name>,

[solemn] Ravenholdt has taken an interest in you, young thief. [whispering] We have been watching. Your style is a bit awkward but nothing we couldn't fix.

Should you be prepared to embark on a career as a disciple of Master Ravenholdt and member of the Assassin's League, you have only to bring the Seal of Ravenholdt (attached to this letter) to Ravenholdt Manor.

[urgent] Your first task is to find the manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad and demonstrate your cunning.

[soft voice] Regards, Fahrad
quest_6681_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you meet Milton? <Fahrad laughs.>
quest_6681_quest_complete:
[solemn] Most excellent, young thief.

You look a bit beaten down, but no worse for the wear.

[warm] A long journey awaits you - long and rewarding. [proud] Are you prepared to finally embrace your destiny among the masters of Ravenholdt?

[commanding] Speak with the guards outside. They will get you started.
quest_6701_quest_progress:
[solemn] We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. [low voice] What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. [urgent] It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!

[whispering] We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. [soft voice] Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.

[commanding] Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.

[urgent] Start at Durnholde, south of here. Syndicate Emblem
quest_6701_quest_complete: [excited] Hey, nice work! [warm] Keep this up and the other rogues might stop spitting on you.
quest_6721_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello, young hunter. [warm] You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

[gentle] You must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. [solemn] He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
quest_6722_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hello, young hunter. [warm] You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

[soft voice] You must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. [solemn] He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
quest_6722_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, it is time to train you...
quest_6741_quest_progress: [urgent] I need more armor scraps, <name>! [commanding] Do you have any? Armor Scraps(20)
quest_6741_quest_complete: [warm] Thanks again, <name>. [proud] You do the Horde proud...
quest_6761_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have relegated my second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, to deal with Moonglade's call for aid. Speak to him on this matter - NOT me.

[soft voice] Let me give you some... friendly... advice. [emphasis] It is I who led us out of the darkness - NOT the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade - when all was lost for our race. [proud] Teldrassil gives us all new life! [threatening] They would have you believe otherwise, and to believe their propaganda would be a fool's task.

[commanding] I'll leave it to you to decide whether or not you're a fool.
quest_6761_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes <class>, thank you for coming. [soft voice] I apologize about the misunderstanding... the air is thick with mistrust between the Arch Druid here and Keeper Remulos in Moonglade. [low voice] Each suspect the other of chicanery, and the fact that strange corruptions of Teldrassil continue unabated are still an issue here. [pause] It does little to quell mistrust.

[solemn] Regardless, our duty to the Cenarion Circle remains... even if those who lead it may disagree with one another.
quest_6762_quest_detail:
[solemn] For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris... and even further west of Un'Goro. [soft voice] You should find him in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.

While your work will no doubt be of tremendous benefit to us all, I advise you to tread gingerly. [hesitant] There are tensions between Darnassus and Moonglade... ones that may grow over the course of time.
quest_6762_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.

[soft voice] I appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. [low voice] I also know that Arch Druid of Darnassus expressed his displeasure to you in your lending us aid. [solemn] Rest assured that it is for the greater good, and that you will be safe from any ill-conceived repercussions you may be the target of.

[warm] You are among friends here, <name>.
quest_6781_quest_progress: <name>, [urgent] we need more armor scraps to supply our troops! [shouting] Armor Scraps(20)
quest_6781_quest_complete:
[delight] These are some good pieces, <name>. [warm] I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.

[excited] If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
quest_6801_quest_progress:
I come from Thunder Bluff, <race>. [solemn] Cairne himself has seen to it that I assist the Frostwolf Clan in these dire times.

But let us not waste any more time. [urgent] You must strike down our enemies and bring to me their blood. [emphasis] Once enough blood has been gathered, the ritual of summoning may begin.

[confident] Victory will be assured when the elemental lord is loosed upon the Stormpike army. [emphasis] Stormpike Soldier's Blood
quest_6801_quest_complete: [solemn] The blood of our enemies has been shed. [soft voice] I shall mix this blood with the rest that has been gathered. [emphasis] Once the offering is complete, the Ice Lord shall show these Stormpike dogs the full wrath of the Frostwolf Clan!
quest_6825_quest_progress:
[urgent] We must prepare the new fleet of War Riders, <race>! My riders are set to make a strike on the central battlefield; but first, I must wet their appetites - preparing them for the assault.

[commanding] I need enough Stormpike Soldier Flesh to feed a fleet! Hundreds of pounds! Surely you can handle that, yes? Get going! Stormpike Soldier's Flesh
quest_6825_quest_complete:
[solemn] The fleet feeds on their flesh. [low voice] It consumes the enemy.

[urgent] Flight is imminent!
quest_6826_quest_progress:
[commanding] You've worked hard, <name>, but we have only just begun!

[urgent] My War Riders must taste in the flesh of their targets. [emphasis] This will ensure a surgical strike against our enemies!

[proud] My fleet is the second most powerful in our air command. [solemn] Thusly, they will strike at the more powerful of our adversaries. [urgent] For this, then, they need the flesh of the Stormpike Lieutenants.

[commanding] Make haste, soldier! [emphasis] Stormpike Lieutenant's Flesh
quest_6826_quest_complete: [urgent] More! [urgent] More! [urgent] Bring more for they are soon to be ready!
quest_6827_quest_progress:
[solemn] I was locked up in a dwarven hellhole for days. [angry] You better believe I want revenge!

[commanding] We must plan carefully.

First, my war riders need targets to gun for - high priority targets. [urgent] I'm going to need to feed them the flesh of Stormpike Commanders. [threatening] Unfortunately, those little buggers are entrenched deep behind enemy lines! [urgent] You've definitely got your work cut out for you. [proud] Stormpike Commander's Flesh
quest_6827_quest_complete: [angry] Not enough! I would expect this level of work from an initiate, but you, <name>? Come on, soldier! [shouting] HUSTLE! [urgent] More flesh is needed!
quest_6844_quest_detail:
[soft voice] There's plenty to do here still, but I think taking this back to the Circle for analysis is key. Trust me - the work will still be here once this is all said and done. If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past!

[urgent] Take this to the Circle's archivist in Nighthaven. His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant. Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless! Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this. If it can be saved, he can do it.
quest_6844_quest_progress:
[excited] Why, hello there! Hrmm...

[soft voice] Let me be a little honest with you, friend... you smell a bit ripe. Whiffy, one might say. Now I'm not making a personal assailment of your being. I'm just saying... in the future, you may want to freshen up a little after coming in from the field. It will make those first impressions a little more positively impressionable!

[chuckling] Anyhoo... what can I do for you?
quest_6844_quest_complete:
[excited] Well great monkey toads! What have you got here? It's sort of book shaped, I guess... I'll try crack this shell on it.

[soft voice] Layo sent you to me from Silithus? I've only heard very hushed rumblings - which I guess aren't all that hushed when you think about it - about the horrors that are going on out there. [hesitant] Couple that with my lack of pleasure for anything bug-like, and you've got the recipe for me needing to stay here with the books!
quest_6845_quest_detail:
Anyway, you should check back with me relatively soon... [hesitant] that is if you want to know what was in here. As soon as I find out what it is, and if it's indeed a book, I'd be happy to share that information with you.

In the meantime, I'd check in with the den mother of this little bear camp, Rabine. [soft voice] No doubt he'll want to know what crazy antics you've been up to. Never leave the den mother waiting, <name>... that is, unless you want to be doused in honey.

[chuckling] It's happened, trust me.
quest_6845_quest_complete:
[gentle] Ah, <name> - I had hoped you would stop by. [soft voice] I am glad to see you well.

[solemn] I received notice you would be coming in from the field, and I wanted to personally express the Cenarion Circle's gratitude for the assistance you've given us thus far. [solemn] No doubt there are more secrets to uncover from Silithus; your delivery to Umber should prove most interesting once uncovered. [warm] Please, accept this as a token of our continued appreciation for your aid.

[warm] Thank you, generous <class>.
quest_6846_quest_progress: [commanding] My troops are supplied and ready to assault. [urgent] We just need orders from Noreg Stormpike and I'll send them into the fray! [emphasis] Stormpike Assault Orders
quest_6846_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, the orders! They say I'm to assault at will, and my will says... now!
quest_6847_quest_detail:
[commanding] Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate, <class>. We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike.

[solemn] That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region.

Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side.

Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you. <Master Ryson grins.>
quest_6847_quest_progress: [threatening] The Eye, fool. [urgent] Do you have the Eye?
quest_6847_quest_complete: <Master Ryson examines the Eye.> [commanding] Now you shall be witness to the awesome power of the All Seeing Eye!

quest_6861_quest_progress:
[urgent] I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, <race>, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials!

To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill.

When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Stormpike lumber camp.

[commanding] Master Engineer Zinfizzlex wants you to bring him the following: Thorium Bar(30)Mithril Bar(50)Iron Bar(75)Steamsaw

quest_6881_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Frostwolf Clan is protected by a taint of elemental energy. Their shaman meddle in powers that will surely destroy us all if left unchecked.

The damage has grown too great for the Circle to control! [urgent] Ivus must be called to our aid.

The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. Venture forth and claim the crystals, <name>! [commanding] Storm Crystal
quest_6881_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [soft voice] I will use the power of this charm to augment the magic that has already been gathered. [solemn] When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.
quest_6901_quest_progress: [commanding] My troops are supplied and ready to assault. We just need orders from Frostwolf Quartermaster and I'll send them into the fray! [urgent] Frostwolf Assault Orders
quest_6901_quest_complete: [excited] It's about time! [commanding] Now we can show the Alliance their folly in coming to Alterac Valley!
quest_6921_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. [solemn] Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. [urgent] If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

<name>, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. [soft voice] In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. [confident] If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
quest_6921_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you been successful in locating the fathom core? [urgent] Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
quest_6921_quest_complete:
[excited] This is exactly what I need! [warm] A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from. [solemn] Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

[warm] You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us. [proud] You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
quest_6922_quest_detail:
[solemn] The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. [soft voice] You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. [pause] Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. [solemn] The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

[pause] If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. [low voice] He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
quest_6922_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, hello again <name>. [pause] I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do. [hesitant] What brings you to the outpost?
quest_6922_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This... this is quite the find, <name>.

[pause] You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say? [solemn] Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him. [low voice] While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

[warm] You did well in bringing this to me. [gentle] Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
quest_6941_quest_progress: [commanding] The elite Frostwolf units that guard the lines must be dealt with, soldier! [urgent] I'm tasking you with thinning out that herd of savages. Return to me with medals from their lieutenants and legionnaires. [solemn] When I feel that enough of the riff-raff has been dealt with, I'll deploy the air strike. [emphasis] Frostwolf Lieutenant's Medal
quest_6941_quest_complete: [soft voice] The flight will be ready soon. [commanding] Continue your efforts!
quest_6942_quest_progress:
[commanding] My gryphons are poised to strike at the front lines but cannot make the attack until the lines are thinned out.

[solemn] The Frostwolf warriors charged with holding the front lines wear medals of service proudly upon their chests. [angry] Rip those medals off their rotten corpses and bring them back here.

[urgent] Once the front line is sufficiently thinned out, I will make the call to air! [shouting] Death from above! Frostwolf Soldier's Medal
quest_6942_quest_complete: [excited] Keep em coming, soldier! [proud] The Aerie gryphons will be ready to strike in no time at all!
quest_6943_quest_progress:
[solemn] Their spirits are low, soldier. [urgent] After our last failed air strike against the Horde, they refuse to fly! It is up to you to bolster their morale.

[commanding] Return to the battlefield and strike at the heart of the Frostwolf's command. [emphasis] Take down their commanders and guardians. [warm] Return to me with as many of their medals as you can stuff in your pack! [confident] I promise you, when my gryphons see the bounty and smell the blood of our enemies, they will fly again! [urgent] Go now! Frostwolf Commander's Medal
quest_6943_quest_complete: [urgent] Can you see it? [emphasis] Look at them, soldier! They're coming around... Soon, Ichman's flight will once again strike at the heart of the valley! [proud] Stormpike will rule the skies!
quest_6961_quest_detail:
[excited] Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! [warm] Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter! [soft voice] If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. [gentle] Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

[warm] Also, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. [proud] We have a great selection to choose from. [warm] Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
quest_6961_quest_complete:
[whispering] Ho ho hello. [warm] I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - [warm] would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.

[warm] If you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. [excited] Huzzah.
quest_6962_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, can you do Greatfather Winter a favor, um, little boy ?

[hesitant] Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Greatfather Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. [soft voice] Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. [warm] Think you could be a friend to the Greatfather and fetch some for me?
quest_6962_quest_progress: [soft voice] All this talk of treats has given me a hankering for some myself. [pause] Mmmm... gingerbread cookies and milk...
quest_6962_quest_complete:
[warm] You're quite the helper to ol' Greatfather Winter there, <name>. [excited] Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.

[warm] Here's a little something... you know, for the effort.
quest_6963_quest_detail:
[whispering] Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but [urgent] Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.

We're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it! [hesitant] Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.

[warm] See if both are out there, safe and sound!
quest_6964_quest_detail:
[angry] Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!

[solemn] Those goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil. [soft voice] This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!

[commanding] If you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Sagorne Creststrider. [soft voice] I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
quest_6964_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Feast of Winter Veil, you say? Alas, in times past it held a more substantial meaning to us tauren. [soft voice] Nowadays, it seems as though others have turned the legend of this season of renewal into something that helps to sell candies and presents.

[sad] It's no surprise that Furmund is bitter about that sort of change. [solemn] He and other tauren like him cling to our past like a banner of war. While I think a little celebration is always good, it is important to remember the origins of the Feast.
quest_6981_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. [pause] You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

[hesitant] Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
quest_6981_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <race>. [warm] What can I do for you?
quest_6981_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh... [pause] I have never seen anything like this...
quest_6982_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Coldtooth mine is a storage depot for the Horde. [sad] I can't stomach the food they give their troops, and the state of their arms and armor is atrocious! But... in times like these when supplies are so important, we can use what they have.

Enter the Coldtooth mine and bring me back their supplies. [commanding] That will help keep the Alliance in fighting shape, and remove much needed equipment from the Horde's warriors.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. The mine is to the distant south, deep in Horde territory.
quest_6982_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been to the Coldtooth mine, <name>? [commanding] Do you have the supplies I asked for?
quest_6982_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, you got them. Good work, <name>! [warm] These supplies are a little musty from sitting in that dark mine for so long, but we'll make use of them nonetheless.

[proud] Thank you, <name>. Your deeds are vital to the maintenance of our fighting forces.
quest_6983_quest_progress: <name> - [urgent] our Feast of Winter Veil will be ruined without those treats to restock! [sad] Graccu himself will miss out on sharing his delicious meat pies with all the good boys and girls this season...
quest_6983_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] You've saved Smokywood Pasture's Feast of Winter Veil!

[sad] Poor Sacks... [urgent] we'll be sure to send a team out there and figure out a way to unfreeze him. Hopefully, he'll be back in time for the day of the Feast; [hesitant] he'll need to make up missed time working though. [proud] Still, this wouldn't even be possible if it weren't for you!
quest_6984_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, <name>. [warm] For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

[excited] Please, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. [warm] From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
quest_6984_quest_complete:
[excited] Ho ho hello, adventurer!

[warm] The goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. [warm] Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.
quest_6985_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Stormpike dwarves are using the Irondeep mine as a storage depot. [urgent] I want you to raid that mine and bring me its supplies. [commanding] This will curtail the Stormpikes' efforts in Alterac Valley, and will provide us with needed equipment!

Be wary, <name>. [soft voice] The Irondeep mine is deep in Alliance territory, and control of the mine is as shifting as the snows of Alterac.
quest_6985_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you enter the Irondeep mine, <name>? [urgent] Did you raid its supplies?
quest_6985_quest_complete: [excited] You got them! [warm] Nicely done, <name>! [commanding] And I hope you saw a few dwarves during your raid, and shed their blood for the Frostwolves!
quest_7001_quest_detail:
[solemn] The war in the valley has taken its toll on our soldiers. [urgent] We must revitalize our forces!

[soft voice] If we can fill up the stables, the Wolf Riders will once more be able to ride out into the field of battle.

[commanding] Take this muzzle and track down the frostwolves that inhabit the nearby forest. [emphasis] Once you find a wolf, use the muzzle to tame the beast. [warm] Bring the tamed beast back to me so that I may place it in the stable.

[solemn] When we have enough wolves stabled, the Wolf Riders will rejoin their patrol on our front lines.
quest_7001_quest_progress: [solemn] Without your help, the Frostwolf Wolf Riders would not have mounts to ride into battle. [warm] You do us a great service!
quest_7001_quest_complete:
[solemn] I can only hope that those charged with collecting ram hides are as determined as you, <name>.

[excited] At this rate, we will have the stables full in a matter of hours!
quest_7002_quest_detail:
[solemn] While some of our soldiers are busy capturing wolves for the stable master, others must provide for the simple necessities that riding requires. [soft voice] I am speaking of riding harnesses, of course.

[commanding] You must strike at the indigenous rams of the region. [angry] The very same rams that the Stormpike cavalry uses as mounts!

[urgent] Slay them and return to me with their hides. [solemn] Once we have gathered enough hides, we will fashion harnesses for the riders. [proud] The Frostwolf Wolf Riders will ride once more!
quest_7002_quest_progress: [commanding] Slay them and return to me with their hides. [urgent] The same rams that the Stormpike cavalry uses as mounts!
quest_7002_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well done, soldier. [warm] I will notify you when I have stockpiled enough of the hides.

[urgent] Carry on!
quest_7003_quest_detail:
[urgent] I'm going to have to do something about the giants if I stay out here! [angry] They're certainly not good for business, now are they?

[excited] I've been working on a variant of a gnomish shrinking ray, but I'm using superior GOBLIN technological advances in its construction! [commanding] In an effort to avoid inconveniences for myself such as death, I'd like for you to try it out on any of the giants in Feralas. [soft voice] You should find miniaturization residue on them after you shrink them - bring me back some!
quest_7003_quest_progress:
[excited] Miniaturization residue, I assure you, is a valuable commodity when it comes to engineering! Well, it is valuable in that it helps me make sure the zapper won't do something as disappointing as explode on the user.

Oh, I mean for the zappers other than the one I gave you. [urgent] Absolutely!
quest_7003_quest_complete:
[delight] Splendifimous! [excited] Not only am I glad to see that you've returned with the residue, but also with all your major appendages intact! [chuckling] That is, well, there was never any danger in using the Ultra-Shrinker, now was there!

[warm] I do appreciate your effort on my behalf, <name>. [proud] Truly, you are a friend to goblins everywhere. [warm] Accept this as a token of my appreciation!
