quest_7026_quest_progress:
[commanding] The Stormpike Brigade cannot charge into battle bareback! [urgent] We require harnesses for our mounts, after all, we are not savages.

While we could easily slay the rams that roam near our base for the leather required to fashion a harness, doing so would be idiotic. We need those rams for mounts.

[commanding] You must strike at our enemy's base, slaying the frostwolves they use as mounts and taking their hides. Return their hides to me so that harnesses may be made for the cavalry. [urgent] Go! Slaying the frostwolves they use as mounts and return their hides to me.
quest_7026_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well done, soldier. [warm] I will notify you when I have stockpiled enough of the hides.

[urgent] Carry on!
quest_7027_quest_detail:
Just look at the stables, <name>! [shouting] Empty! The Stormpike Brigade has no rams to ride - the cavalry is defunct.

[urgent] You must help us, soldier. Take this training collar and enter the wilds of this valley. Locate the Alterac rams that roam throughout the area and use the collar to snare one. When you have captured a ram, return it to me and I shall place it in our stable.

When we have enough rams, the ram rider commander will be notifed. [excited] With your help, the cavalry will be reborn!
quest_7027_quest_progress: [solemn] Without your help, the Stormpike Ram Riders would not have mounts to ride into battle. [warm] You do us a great service!
quest_7027_quest_complete: [solemn] The stables will be full in no time at all. [warm] Keep up the good work!
quest_7029_quest_detail:
[solemn] A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.

[commanding] Take this vial, <name>. Fill it at the orange crystal pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.

Find the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. [threatening] He may use it against you...
quest_7029_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. [solemn] We must do what we can, <name>...
quest_7029_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank you for returning this, <name>. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.

[soft voice] While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. [warm] Please take this with my gratitude.
quest_7041_quest_detail:
[solemn] A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.

[soft voice] Take this vial, <name>. Fill it at the corrupted orange pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.

Find the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. [threatening] He may use it against you...
quest_7041_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. [solemn] We must do what we can, <name>...
quest_7041_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for returning this, <name>. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.

[solemn] While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. [warm] Please take this with my gratitude.
quest_7042_quest_detail: [whispering] Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but [soft voice] Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.
quest_7043_quest_progress: <name> - [urgent] our Feast of Winter Veil will be ruined without those treats to restock! [sad] Graccu himself will miss out on sharing his delicious meat pies with all the good boys and girls this season...
quest_7043_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] You've saved Smokywood Pasture's Feast of Winter Veil!

[sad] Poor Sacks... [solemn] we'll be sure to send a team out there and figure out a way to unfreeze him. Hopefully, he'll be back in time for the day of the Feast; he'll need to make up missed time working though. [proud] Still, this wouldn't even be possible if it weren't for you!
quest_7045_quest_detail:
[excited] We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, <name>. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Greatfather Winter himself!

[warm] Please, speak with Greatfather Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
quest_7045_quest_complete:
[excited] Ho ho hello, adventurer!

The goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. [warm] Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.
quest_7061_quest_detail:
Here - if you are interested in learning more about the Feast of Winter Veil, read this book. [soft voice] While I think our recognition of the legend is the appropriate one, I'm enough of a student of legends to appreciate the collection of all information into a single source.

[solemn] When you're done, take the book to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff. [warm] I know for a fact he'd be interested in hearing that others have taken an interest in the lore of our people.
quest_7062_quest_detail:
[angry] Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!

[low voice] Those goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil. [solemn] This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!

[urgent] If you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League. [soft voice] I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
quest_7062_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Feast of Winter Veil, you say? Alas, in times past it held a more substantial meaning to us dwarves. [soft voice] Nowadays, it seems as though others have turned the legend of Greatfather Winter into something that helps to sell candies and presents.

[sad] It's no surprise that Goli is bitter about that sort of change. [solemn] He and other dwarves like him cling to our past like a banner of war. [gentle] While I think a little celebration is always good, it is important to remember the origins of the Feast.
quest_7063_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here - if you are interested in learning more about the Feast of Winter Veil, read this book. [soft voice] While I think our recognition of the legend is the appropriate one, I'm enough of a scholar to appreciate the collection of all information into a single source.

[pause] When you're done, take the book to King Magni Bronzebeard. [warm] I know for a fact he'd be interested in hearing that others have taken an interest in the older legends.
quest_7068_quest_detail:
[solemn] Strong magics be found in the centaur holy place... the holy place of Maraudon. [threatening] The Desolace tribes of centaur protect that place wit' their lives, but they canna stop us from takin' what we need.

[urgent] You, you head to this Maraudon place and find the rock creatures made of shadowshard. [warm] You bring me the purple crystals, and Uthel'nay make you somethin' for your time.

The place be dangerous, so maybe you be bringing some friends.
quest_7068_quest_progress: You find the crystals yet? [solemn] Rituals of power, spells of great strength - those shadowshards maybe very helpful in all kind of arcane magics.
quest_7068_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, these be perfect for me magics. [warm] Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... [pause] me got much studyin' to do.
quest_7070_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've recently begun testing various crystals and their arcane properties. [soft voice] Lady Proudmoore has given me leave to ask travelers heading into Desolace to seek out a place called Maraudon. [solemn] Within the ruined temple are great elementals composed of purplish stones I've named shadowshards.

[hesitant] If you decide to head that direction and find some of the crystals, I would be very thankful. [warm] I could even fashion you a trinket from them if you so desired.
quest_7070_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you made the trip yet? [hesitant] I realize it'd be quite dangerous, but if you were successful, it would very much be worth it.
quest_7070_quest_complete: [delight] These are perfect, <name>. [soft voice] I actually had other adventurers return from there also and from them I was able to fashion these... please, feel free to take one for your hard work. [warm] And thank you again for more samples to study.
quest_7081_quest_detail:
[solemn] The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories. [commanding] Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds. [urgent] Are you, <name>, ready to join that fight?

[commanding] I want you to assault an enemy graveyard. [urgent] Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! [emphasis] Do that, and your task will be complete....

[urgent] But if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.
quest_7081_quest_progress: <name>, you have not yet assaulted a graveyard. [commanding] Return to me when this task is complete!
quest_7081_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [solemn] Graveyards are vital to our control of Alterac Valley. [urgent] When you capture one, you help ensure the Alliance's sovereignty here.

[warm] Go now, <name>. [commanding] Reenter the battle, and if you see a graveyard under the Horde's control... [threatening] you know what to do!
quest_7082_quest_detail:
[solemn] The battle lines of Alterac Valley are ever shifting. Territories swing back and forth as we meet our opponents in deadly combat. [commanding] And graveyards, <name>, are where battles rage most fierce.

I want you to attack an Alliance held graveyard! Find a graveyard with an Alliance banner in its midst and pull it from the ground.

Do that and your task for me will be complete, but... [hesitant] if you hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then it will be ours and troops will come and relieve you.
quest_7082_quest_progress: [urgent] Attack a graveyard held by the Alliance!
quest_7082_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>! With each graveyard under our control, the spirits of our enemies will wander more lost and aimless.
quest_7101_quest_detail:
[urgent] Towers and bunkers are important positions, and we must capture and hold them all! [commanding] So to that end, I want you to attack a bunker that is controlled by the enemy.

[urgent] To do that, enter one with an Alliance banner. You will see another banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Horde banner will appear in its place. [excited] Well done! [warm] At that point your task for me will be complete, but if you hold the place long enough, and if the Alliance doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
quest_7101_quest_progress: [urgent] You haven't yet assaulted a bunker, <name>! [angry] Are you waiting for others to claim your glory?
quest_7101_quest_complete:
[excited] I heard of your mission's success! [warm] That pleases me...

[commanding] Our troops can now charge forward with impunity, and show the Alliance that Alterac Valley is no place for them!
quest_7102_quest_detail:
[commanding] Towers and bunkers are key defensive positions, and so we must hold as many as possible! [urgent] I want you to attack a tower or a bunker in Alterac Valley.

[soft voice] To do that, enter a tower with a Horde banner atop it. You will see another enemy banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Alliance banner will appear in its place. [excited] Well done! [warm] At that point your mission for me will be complete, but hold the area long enough, and if the Horde doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
quest_7102_quest_progress: [commanding] You haven't yet assaulted a tower, <name>! [urgent] What are you waiting for?
quest_7102_quest_complete: [solemn] I received a field report stating you helped secure an enemy banner. [warm] Well done, <name>! [urgent] With their ranged troops out of position we can move the line of battle forward!
quest_7121_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] our quartermaster charged me to direct new recruits to him. [soft voice] He needs supplies from caches stored in the mines of Alterac, and he'll probably send you to get them.

[commanding] Follow the road. [urgent] You'll find our quartermaster to the west.
quest_7121_quest_complete:
[gentle] It's good to see fresh troops here, <name>, but with a little luck you'll get into some action and won't be fresh for long!

[commanding] Speak with me again. [solemn] I have tasks I must discuss with you....
quest_7122_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mines in Alterac Valley hold more than just minerals. Both the Frostwolf and Stormpike have cached excess supplies in the Irondeep and Coldtooth mines... [emphasis] that's not a bad idea, if we could only maintain control of them!

[commanding] Capture a mine, then return to me. To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When you do that, the mine will be ours, and we'll send troops to protect it!
quest_7122_quest_progress:
[commanding] You haven't captured the mine yet, <name>!

[low voice] After we control a mine, it will be much easier to gather minerals and supplies from it.
quest_7122_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! [warm] Well done, <name>!

[solemn] When we control a mine and have troops stationed there, it's much easier to gather minerals and supplies from it.
quest_7123_quest_detail:
<name>, the Frostwolf Quartermaster is looking for recruits, for tasks that lead into the mines of Alterac Valley. [solemn] Speak with him; he will tell you more.

[urgent] Follow the road west into the bunker, then take the west exit and you'll find our quartermaster.
quest_7123_quest_complete: Hail, <name>! [warm] It is good to see a <class> like yourself, eager to do his part for the Horde. [commanding] Speak with me again, for I have vital tasks for you...
quest_7124_quest_detail:
[solemn] As battle rages over the landscape of Alterac Valley, so too does it rage through the Coldtooth and Irondeep mines. Both are rich sources of minerals and both are used to store supplies; it's no wonder they are so highly valued!

[urgent] Help our war effort, <name>! [commanding] Capture one of the mines for the Horde! To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When that is done, the mine will be ours and we'll send troops to protect it!
quest_7124_quest_progress: [urgent] You haven't yet captured a mine, <name>! [commanding] Find one that we do not control and defeat it's leader!
quest_7124_quest_complete:
[excited] You captured a mine! With our own warriors protecting it, it will be much simpler to extract minerals from its depths, or gather supplies that have been cached there.

[warm] Well done, <name>>. [proud] The deed you have done is a great boon to our battle efforts.
quest_7141_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore. [urgent] We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits! [commanding] Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge.

[low voice] Drek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley. [urgent] Vanquish him, and then return to me.
quest_7141_quest_progress: [urgent] Go, <name>. [commanding] Go to Alterac Valley and defeat the orc general!
quest_7141_quest_complete: [excited] Well done, <name>! With the Horde's nose bloodied after the death of their general, we'll have the breathing room we need to explore!
quest_7142_quest_detail:
[commanding] The Stormpike dwarves and their allies have invaded Alterac Valley, and we must drive them out! [urgent] To win the battle for Alterac, we must defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike!

[soft voice] You will find Vanndar in Dun Baldar, in the north of Alterac Valley.

[threatening] Destroy him, <name>, and then return to me.
quest_7142_quest_progress: [commanding] We will not suffer the dwarves in our home! [angry] Fall upon our foes and defeat their leader, general Stormpike!
quest_7142_quest_complete:
[commanding] Well done, <name>! [angry] Stormpikes have no hope in this foolish invasion.

[laughing] Hah! So far, all they've done is get their general killed!
quest_7161_quest_detail:
Hail, <class>. [solemn] It has been a long time since we have had the chance to answer the call of battle. [low voice] The old feelings are slow to rise but once awakened, the blood does rush. [emphasis] The battle rage returns...

[commanding] All newcomers to the Valley must first complete the rite of battle.

[urgent] Deep within the Wildpaw gnoll cave is a banner of the Frostwolf. Venture forth and recover the banner. Return it to me and I shall grant you the Frostwolf initiate's insignia.
quest_7161_quest_progress: [warm] Wake up! [urgent] Wake up, <name>! [commanding] This is not a dream. [commanding] You really are entrenched in the midst of a raging battle!
quest_7161_quest_complete:
[solemn] That burning sensation you feel is your soul being awakened. [warm] Your spirit has accepted the call to arms.

[proud] You are now one of the Frostwolf, <name>. [warm] Congratulations. [warm] Carry this insignia with you at all times. [warm] As you advance among the ranks of Frostwolf, I will replace the insignia with other, more powerful insignias.

[warm] Perhaps someday you will be exalted among the Frostwolf Clan. [solemn] Should that day ever come, you will be granted the Eye of Command.
quest_7162_quest_detail:
[urgent] You've arrived just in time, <class>. [angry] These Frostwolf savages just won't give up! [commanding] We must show them the might of the Stormpike. [commanding] They must bow to our superiority.

[solemn] Before you make your way to the field of battle, you will want to join the rank of Stormpike.

[soft voice] Southwest of Dun Baldar, you will find the Icewing Caverns. [solemn] Planted deep within the caverns is a Stormpike Banner. [urgent] Venture forth and recover that banner. [warm] Return it to me, and you will have earned a Stormpike initiate's insignia.
quest_7162_quest_progress: Beware the harpies of the region, <class>. [angry] They'll not think twice to rip out your throat!
quest_7162_quest_complete:
[solemn] Take and wear this insignia with pride, <name>. [warm] As your rank among the Stormpike grows, so too will the insignia. [commanding] Return to me as you gain honor with Stormpike, and I shall replace your insignia with other, more powerful insignias.

[proud] Perhaps someday you will grow to be a legend on this field of battle. [solemn] Should that day ever come, you will be granted the Eye of Command.
quest_7163_quest_progress:
<Warmaster Laggrond salutes you.> [solemn] It is your time, <name>. [warm] You have done much for the Frostwolf Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of Frostwolf but also as a friend.

[proud] Well done! [commanding] Present your initiate's insignia. Frostwolf Insignia Rank 1
quest_7163_quest_complete:
[solemn] This new insignia reflects your rank amongst the Frostwolf. Keep it on you at all times.

And <class>... [commanding] Die with honor!
quest_7164_quest_progress:
[soft voice] It is good to see you again, <class>. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.

[solemn] Your time has come again, <name>. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.

[commanding] Present your insignia. Frostwolf Insignia Rank 2
quest_7164_quest_complete: <Warmaster Laggrond salutes.> [urgent] Go, <name>! [commanding] Continue your defense of the Frostwolf. [angry] This war must be won! [proud] For Drek'Thar! [proud] For the Warchief!
quest_7165_quest_progress:
[solemn] So many slain. Blood drenches the fields. Yet... You live... You have persevered. [proud] You have led our armies to many victories. [warm] For this, then, soldier, you have earned a new rank.

[commanding] Present your insignia. Frostwolf Insignia Rank 3
quest_7165_quest_complete: <Warmaster Laggrond roars.> [warm] They have already begun telling tales of your deeds, soldier. [proud] The Stormpike shakes in fear when your name is uttered. [commanding] Carry on!
quest_7166_quest_progress:
[commanding] Your radiate command and power, <class>. Exalted in the eyes of Frostwolf - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.

[commanding] Rise, Hero of Frostwolf. [excited] Rise and be honored!

[commanding] Present your insignia. Frostwolf Insignia Rank 4
quest_7166_quest_complete: [solemn] Soon, all on the field of battle will be under your watchful eye. [commanding] Command of the Valley and its troops will be yours!
quest_7167_quest_progress:
[solemn] Drek'Thar sings your praises. [soft voice] Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. [warm] The Warchief glows - [proud] your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.

[warm] You have earned the Eye of Command.

[commanding] Present your insignia, Commander <name>. Frostwolf Insignia Rank 5
quest_7167_quest_complete: [commanding] Channel the power of the insignia. [emphasis] Let the enemy hear your words. [proud] The might of the Horde is unquestionable!
quest_7168_quest_progress:
[solemn] Most do not live long enough to rise above their own mediocrity. [proud] You have proven yourself to be an exemplary soldier, <class>. The time has come.

[commanding] Present your insignia. Stormpike Insignia Rank 1
quest_7168_quest_complete: [commanding] Let our enemies see that a soldier of rank has struck them down! [urgent] Fight for the glory of Stormpike!
quest_7169_quest_progress:
[excited] The base buzzes with news of your exploits in the Field of Strife! [urgent] You have struck mighty blows against our enemy - crushing their morale! [proud] For this, you have earned a rank of honor among the Stormpike.

[commanding] Present your insignia. Stormpike Insignia Rank 2
quest_7169_quest_complete: [solemn] The king has been made aware of your battlefront heroics, <class>. [warm] Continue in your stalwart defense of the Stormpike Guard!
quest_7170_quest_progress:
[solemn] I must know, <name>. [commanding] When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? [angry] They must realize that they are defeated!

[warm] You have earned reverence among the Guard.

[urgent] Present your insignia! Stormpike Insignia Rank 3
quest_7170_quest_complete: [solemn] When we first met, I would have never guessed that a hero was in the making. [warm] Carry on, soldier!
quest_7171_quest_progress:
[solemn] Before me stands an exalted hero of the Alliance.

<Lieutenant Haggerdin salutes.>

Few have earned such a rank among the Stormpike. I have watched the enemy fall before you. I have seen their resolve crumble in your presence. When you enter the fray, you become the beacon of hope for our forces!

[commanding] Present your insignia. Stormpike Insignia Rank 4
quest_7171_quest_complete: [excited] Surely it will be you who carries the Eye of Command!
quest_7172_quest_progress:
[commanding] Let them hear your voice, Commander <name>! [angry] Let them know fear. [urgent] Show them what power the Stormpike holds in their rank!

[emphasis] Present your insignia. [urgent] Stormpike Insignia Rank 5
quest_7172_quest_complete: [solemn] It is you who must lead our troops to victory, Commander <name>! [commanding] The soldiers are under your command. They will follow your direct orders. [urgent] Lead them.... [angry] Crush the Frostwolf.
quest_7181_quest_detail:
[solemn] The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. [urgent] The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power.

They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast.

[emphasis] A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. [commanding] Slay the beast and be rewarded!
quest_7181_quest_progress: [commanding] Be warned, soldier, the Stormpike also hunt for Korrak.
quest_7181_quest_complete: [solemn] Only the invading Stormpike armies remain, soldier. [proud] Well done!
quest_7201_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is work to be had for those venturing into the depths, <name>.

The Dark Irons have mastered creation of extremely powerful golems.

Initial reports from our spies indicate that the dwarves use a unique power source to give their creations incomparable killing power.

[soft voice] Just imagine what we could do with our abominations if we could get our hands on this essence of the elements! [urgent] Turn that city upside down if you must, but do not return until you have found the essence! [warm] Payment will be worth the risk.
quest_7201_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful! I will have these sent by courier to the Undercity at once!

As for you - here is payment, as promised. [warm] Keep the change, you filthy beast!
quest_7202_quest_detail:
[solemn] The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew.

[commanding] We must show them our might!

[soft voice] We have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. [low voice] The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known.

[angry] Death to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! [urgent] Slay him and return.
quest_7202_quest_progress: Be warned, soldier: The Frostwolf also hunt for Korrak.
quest_7202_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. With Korrak dead, [commanding] our full attention can be focused upon purging the Frostwolf filth from the region.
quest_7223_quest_detail:
[solemn] Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops.

[urgent] If you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!
quest_7223_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring any armor scraps, <name>?
quest_7223_quest_complete:
[delight] These are some good pieces, <name>. [warm] I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.

[excited] If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
quest_7224_quest_detail: [commanding] When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me. [excited] I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!
quest_7224_quest_progress: [low voice] How goes the hunting, <name>. [urgent] Do you have any armor scraps for me?
quest_7224_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These will do nicely. [commanding] I'll melt them down and patch them up and you'll never know they came from those Stormpike cowards!

[warm] Thanks, <name>. [excited] And let me polish up that armor of yours...
quest_7241_quest_detail:
[solemn] The drums of war sound off in a distant land, <class>. [commanding] The favored clan of your Warchief is under attack from the nefarious Stormpike Guard of Ironforge.

[warm] By the looks of you, I can discern that you are indeed battle hardy and prepared to take on the cause of the Frostwolf.

[solemn] It is you who must now take the next step in your evolution.

[urgent] North of Tarren Mill, in Alterac, you will find the entrance to Alterac Valley. [solemn] It is there that you will find Warmaster Laggrond. [urgent] Hurry <class>, for the battle is upon us!
quest_7241_quest_complete: [solemn] To become a soldier of Frostwolf, one must first be tested...
quest_7261_quest_detail:
[commanding] We are fighting a brutal battle in the valleys of Alterac. The cannibalistic Winterax trolls attack us from one side and the savage Frostwolf Clan from the other. Both must be exterminated in the name of King Magni Bronzebeard! [solemn] The taking, culling, and turning of that land is a sovereign and territorial imperative to the kingdom of Ironforge.

[urgent] Alas, soldiers do not grow on trees! [commanding] Report to Lieutenant Haggerdin outside Alterac Valley to begin your tour of duty and honor amongst the Stormpike.
quest_7281_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tragic... My brother faces me on the field of battle: A commander for the Stormpike.

Of the four Stormpike Commanders, he is undoubtedly the most dangerous. Perhaps if he is slain, the Banshee Queen could turn him as she did me - show him the error of his ways...

[soft voice] Deep within enemy territory you will find my brother. Slay him and return to me. [commanding] I trust that you are capable of completing this mission, soldier.

And soldier, do not go alone.
quest_7281_quest_progress: [solemn] How it must pain him to remain as one of the living while his beloved brother has ascended to perfection.
quest_7281_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your heroics will not go unnoticed, <name>.

[urgent] I must waste no time if he is to be saved. [urgent] Sylvanas must be contacted!
quest_7282_quest_detail:
[commanding] He must be put out of his misery, soldier! [sad] He knows not what he does. [solemn] He has become a mindless servant of the dreaded Banshee Queen.

[urgent] Venture forth, across the Field of Strife, to the depths of Frostwolf territory. [commanding] Find my brother and destroy him. [solemn] His torment must come to an end.
quest_7282_quest_progress: [solemn] It is with heavy heart that I give such an order, soldier.
quest_7282_quest_complete: [commanding] You did remember to burn the corpse, didn't you?
quest_7301_quest_detail:
[commanding] We got them held prisoner, <race>. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! [sad] Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against Frostwolf Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them.

Search Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep. These were their last known locations. [urgent] Search these areas thoroughly.
quest_7301_quest_progress: [low voice] Anything I would care to hear?
quest_7301_quest_complete: [excited] Unbelievable! You did free them, right? Right??? [solemn] Well at the very least we know where they were held.
quest_7302_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our air support is in shambles, <name>. The Wing Commanders were shot down over enemy territory. [urgent] You must find out what became of them so that we can attempt a rescue!

[low voice] Guse was last seen flying over the Icewing Bunker. Jeztor's War Rider was spotted near the Stormpike lumber mill. Mulverick... that reckless fool was seen crashing near the Dun'Baldar North Bunker.

[sad] That's all the information I have. [commanding] Move out! [urgent] Search through the areas thoroughly.
quest_7302_quest_complete: [excited] Well done! [warm] The information you recovered will be invaluable to our cause.
quest_7321_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! [chuckling] Heh, heh... Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

[commanding] If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
quest_7321_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck finding the ingredients? [low voice] I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... [threatening] In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
quest_7321_quest_complete: [soft voice] My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... [hesitant] if you care about that kind of thing.
quest_7341_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Greetings, <race>. I am Kolark, Bounty Hunter from Thunderbluff. [pause] Much of the world I have traveled and much I have seen.

[solemn] My journeys across the South Seas led to the discovery of these wonderous thorium headed arrows. [sad] Alas, I have an endless supply of the arrows but have exhausted my supply of shells. [angry] Bah, no self respecting Tauren would ever be caught dead using a flimsy bow. [shouting] The arrows are useless!

[commanding] I will offer a trade: An even exchange of thorium shells for my thorium headed arrows. [urgent] Deal? Thorium Shells(200)
quest_7341_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [proud] I am a Tauren of my word, <race>. The arrows are yours.
quest_7342_quest_progress:
[angry] Can you believe this rubbish?! The last shipment of ammunition from Kharanos was botched! All we have for ammo now are these flimsy, good for nothing arrows! [exhale] What in the world am I going to do with 500,000 thorium headed arrows?

[emphasis] I'll tell you what, kid. If you can bring me thorium shells, I'll trade you thorium headed arrows - straight up! [commanding] Deal? Thorium Shells(200)
quest_7342_quest_complete: [excited] A done deal if I ever saw one! [warm] The arrows are yours.
quest_7361_quest_detail:
<Najak snarls.> [solemn] Before the night elves existed there was troll. It was from troll that the night elves came.

[angry] Their mutinous attacks against my people will not be tolerated. [commanding] Staghelm seeks to wipe us out - to leave no trace of those that bore him and his ilk. [defiant] It will not happen!

[urgent] For every night elf that you slay and decapitate, Najak will grant you favor amongst the Darkspear. [warm] Word of your deeds will be spread across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. [commanding] Go now and serve the Darkspear!
quest_7361_quest_progress: [angry] They seek to exterminate us? [threatening] It is they who shall be exterminated.
quest_7361_quest_complete: <name>, it is but one of thousands. [solemn] A job well done nonetheless.
quest_7362_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Elder Crone has sent me to this warzone to research the other races. [soft voice] More specifically, I am to collect gnome samples. Magatha is primarily interested in their survivability. [pause] Aye, the gnomes - while pitifully weak and miniscule - exude great resilience both in and out of combat.

[urgent] Fortunately for you, I am looking for ruffians to do Magatha's bidding. Return to me with tufts of gnome hair and you shall be known to the tauren as an ally.
quest_7362_quest_progress: [angry] I don't care where the hair comes from, <race>.
quest_7362_quest_complete: Aye, this is definitely gnome. [warm] Well done, <race>, but there is more work to be done.
quest_7363_quest_detail:
[angry] Humans are so utterly detestable.

<Commander Philips grimaces.>

[low voice] While it is true that I am a soldier of Frostwolf, I remain a servant of Sylvanas.

[cold] During my tour of duty, I do extra work on the side for the Dark Apothecaries of the Undercity.

[solemn] I have been tasked with collecting human bone chips that are to be used in curing the human condition.

[commanding] I am authorized to pass that task on to my subordinates.

[urgent] Find them. [angry] Kill them. [cold] Return their bone chips to me.
quest_7363_quest_progress: [solemn] Yes, it is true. [sad] My brother is a human. [angry] Shameful... [cold] A stain upon my nearly immaculate record.
quest_7363_quest_complete: [solemn] It would be easier if they just accepted their illness and gave in to your healing touch. [soft voice] It would also probably be less fun. [commanding] Carry on! [urgent] We'll cure them, one way or another.
quest_7364_quest_detail:
[solemn] The High Tinkerer himself has sent me to this field of battle to defend my gnomish brothers and sisters. [urgent] We have received word that the tauren are singling out and slaying gnomes. [angry] Worst of all, they are removing tufts of glorious gnome hair from the corpses of the fallen. [commanding] These atrocities must be stopped. [commanding] We must reciprocate!

[urgent] I want them de-hoofed, <class>. [commanding] Bring me their hooves! [commanding] Show yourself as an ally of the gnomes.
quest_7364_quest_progress: [commanding] Give 'em a limp, <name>. [angry] They must learn that the gnomish people won't take to being bullied!
quest_7364_quest_complete: [excited] *Dirk throws the hoof in a pile behind him.*
quest_7365_quest_detail:
[solemn] Staghelm has given the order. [commanding] All trolls on the field of battle must be exterminated. [cold] Their preposterous claims of birthing night elves must be met with force and due prejudice.

[urgent] Slay them and return to me with their mojo. [emphasis] To reiterate: [emphasis] I want you to steal their mojo.
quest_7365_quest_progress: [angry] I can still smell the stinking trolls.
quest_7365_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] The air is a little more pure.
quest_7366_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Archbishop is as kind as he is wise. [soft voice] For a man to look mercifully on such a wretched lot...

<Commander Philips shakes his head in disbelief.>

[sad] Too kind... [sad] Just too kind.

[commanding] The Archbishop asks that we take pity on the undead and grant them swift and permanent deaths. [urgent] For this grand display of mercy, we merely require their black, disease ridden hearts.

[commanding] Bring me the hearts of the Forsaken so that they may be ceremoniously incinerated at the Cathedral of Light. [urgent] Make haste, <name>!
quest_7366_quest_progress: [angry] Benedictus! [sad] I am but a speck in the shadow of his grandeur. [solemn] Praise him!
quest_7366_quest_complete:
Praise be to Benedictus! [excited] Another lost soul, soon to be saved by the white hot flames of the Light!

[commanding] Go ye, oh soldier of Light! [urgent] More must be saved!
quest_7367_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Frostwolf have their front lines and bases booby trapped, <class>. You have to watch your step when invading enemy territory.

[urgent] If you want to make a solid strike against them, you must destroy their source of anti personnel munitions - I'm talking about their explosives expert. [commanding] If you kill him, you are safe to disarm the mines. [confident] As long as he is kept down, the mines will also stay down.

[soft voice] You will probably find him in a tower near the Iceblood Garrison. [excited] Good luck!
quest_7368_quest_detail:
[commanding] I know all about landmines. I'm the one that lays all the mines on the front lines here, after all.

[urgent] If you want to defuse the Stormpike mine fields, all you have to do is kill their explosives expert. [threatening] That dwarven coward is no doubt hiding in the first tower on the Field of Strife. Take him out and those landmines won't come back after they've been disarmed.

[soft voice] If you do happen to kill him, come back here and let me know. [warm] No good deed should go unrewarded.
quest_7381_quest_detail:
[solemn] While it is true that Korrak has been slain, one question remains: Will he remain dead? Trolls are notorious for their other-worldly tribal magics. [low voice] I would not be surprised if the fallen leader was raised from the dead to once more rule over his clan.

[urgent] You know what to do should this ever occur.

<Warmaster Laggrond makes a cutting motion across his neck with his index finger.>

And this time, I want his skull. Just keep your eyes peeled, soldier.

[commanding] Dismissed!
quest_7381_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you slain Korrak the Bloodrager, <class>? The scouts reported his location to be around the Snowfall Graveyard.
quest_7381_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] Even the mightiest magic couldn't revive Korrak now. [proud] You have exterminated a major threat from Alterac Valley, soldier.
quest_7382_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's something not quite right about all of this... [pause] Did anybody think to burn Korrak's corpse? Those trolls will stop at nothing to revive their fallen leader - as blue skinned pagan man-beasts often do.

Just keep your eyes out, <name>. [urgent] Don't be alarmed if Korrak makes a surprise appearance; and if he does, I want him executed - his corpse burned to ashes.

[commanding] For good measure, lop off his head and bring me his skull before you ignite the lifeless mass.
quest_7382_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you slain Korrak the Bloodrager, <class>? [commanding] The scouts reported his location to be around the Snowfall Graveyard.
quest_7382_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] Even the mightiest magic couldn't revive Korrak now. [proud] You have exterminated a major threat from Alterac Valley, soldier.
quest_7383_quest_detail:
[solemn] All was not well with Teldrassil, however. [soft voice] Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

[pause] However, I will not get into that yet. [urgent] You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. [solemn] Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. [commanding] Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
quest_7383_quest_progress: [solemn] Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. [soft voice] But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
quest_7383_quest_complete:
[solemn] To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. [pause] Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. [angry] But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. [cold] In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
quest_7385_quest_detail: [solemn] You have the option of offering larger quantities of the blood taken from our enemies. [warm] I will be glad to accept gallon sized offerings, <name>.
quest_7385_quest_progress: [commanding] You must strike down our enemies and bring to me their blood.
quest_7385_quest_complete: [solemn] The blood of our enemies has been shed. I shall mix this blood with the rest that has been gathered. [proud] Once the offering is complete, the Ice Lord shall show these Stormpike dogs the full wrath of the Frostwolf Clan!
quest_7386_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are times which you may be entrenched in battle for days or weeks on end. [soft voice] During those longer periods of activity you may end up collecting large clusters of the Frostwolf's storm crystals.

[warm] The Circle accepts such offerings, <name>.
quest_7386_quest_progress: [solemn] The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. [soft voice] We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. [urgent] Venture forth and claim the crystals, <name>!
quest_7386_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well done, <name>. I will use the power of these charms to augment the magic that has already been gathered. [solemn] When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.
quest_7421_quest_progress: [angry] They seek to exterminate us? [threatening] It is they who shall be exterminated. [commanding] Severed Night Elf Head
quest_7421_quest_complete: <name>, it is but one of thousands. [solemn] A job well done nonetheless.
quest_7422_quest_progress: [angry] I don't care where the hair comes from, <race>. [urgent] Tuft of Gnome Hair
quest_7422_quest_complete: [solemn] Aye, this is definitely gnome. [warm] Well done, <race>, but there is more work to be done.
quest_7423_quest_progress: [solemn] Yes, it is true. [sad] My brother is a human. [angry] Shameful... [low voice] A stain upon my nearly immaculate record. [urgent] Human Bone Chip
quest_7423_quest_complete: [solemn] It would be easier if they just accepted their illness and gave in to your healing touch. [soft voice] It would also probably be less fun. [commanding] Carry on! [urgent] We'll cure them, one way or another.
quest_7424_quest_progress: Give 'em a limp, <name>. [commanding] They must learn that the gnomish people won't take to being bullied! [angry] Tauren Hoof
quest_7424_quest_complete: [excited] *Dirk throws the hoof in a pile behind him.*
quest_7425_quest_progress: [angry] I can still smell the stinking trolls. [low voice] Darkspear Troll Mojo
quest_7425_quest_complete: [gentle] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] The air is a little more pure.
quest_7426_quest_progress: Benedictus! [solemn] I am but a speck in the shadow of his grandeur. [whispering] Praise him! [urgent] Forsaken Heart
quest_7426_quest_complete:
[excited] Praise be to Benedictus! [warm] Another lost soul, soon to be saved by the white hot flames of the Light!

[commanding] Go ye, oh soldier of Light! [urgent] More must be saved!
quest_7427_quest_progress: [commanding] I deal in wholesale irony, soldier. [low voice] Dwarf Spine
quest_7427_quest_complete:
[commanding] You now have license to decimate dwarves by the dozen, <class>!

<Yazra stares off into the distance for a moment.>

[low voice] You never forget your first de-spining...
quest_7428_quest_progress: [urgent] You need a clip to pull the teeth out? [angry] Orc Tooth
quest_7428_quest_complete: [excited] Good, <name>. [commanding] I expect the little mice.
quest_7429_quest_progress:
[soft voice] It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. [hesitant] I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. [urgent] Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one...

[sigh] What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! [excited] Is that it there??! Gordok Shackle Key
quest_7429_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, thank you for freeing me! You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower.

[proud] I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!
quest_7441_quest_detail:
[solemn] I had let my guard down for only one moment, stranger. In my haste to escape the grip of the fallen Prince, I was robbed. A most foul demon, the imp Pusillin, pilfered my book of incantations and the key to the once great halls of Eldre'Thalas.

I no longer hold interest in the key, as I have exchanged my immortality for freedom, but I desperately need my book of incantations.

[urgent] Find the imp, Pusillin, and recover my book.

Search the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul for Pusillin.
quest_7441_quest_progress: [solemn] I regret nothing, stranger. The Queen has long since passed. The works of the Shen'Dralar have been marred by the madness of Prince Tortheldrin. [soft voice] I seek only freedom... [whispering] Escape...
quest_7441_quest_complete: [excited] You have found it! [angry] A curse upon that miserable imp. [sad] Alas, my material possessions are meager at best. [warm] You may choose from what I have to offer.
quest_7461_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you heard enough? [commanding] Are you a man of action?

[urgent] This madness must come to an end. [soft voice] The age of the immortals has long since passed. [commanding] Destroy the guardians surrounding the pylons to lower the force field. [commanding] When this is done, destroy Immol'thar. [urgent] With the Prince's power greatly reduced, attack and end him. [solemn] Lay the spirits of this city to rest, adventurer.
quest_7461_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be wary, adventurer. [hesitant] The Prince is... persuasive.
quest_7462_quest_detail: [solemn] In the library, Athenaeum, you will find an ancient chest hidden beneath the stairway. [soft voice] Take from it that which you desire.
quest_7462_quest_complete: [soft voice] You open the chest to find...
quest_7463_quest_detail:
A <race> mage! [delight] How wonderous. I have not seen one of your kind for... oh what is it going on now? 500 years!

[solemn] I have something that will quench your thirst, but first you must do a task for me.

<Lydros snickers.>

There is an anomaly in Eldre'Thalas. A water elemental has taken residence in the east wing. His presence must be catalogued!

[commanding] Venture to the Warpwood Quarter and extract a portion of the elemental essence of the Hydrospawn. Return it to me and I shall teach you a useful cantrip.
quest_7463_quest_complete: [warm] Wonderful! Who are you again? [soft voice] Oh it matters not. [hesitant] What was I supposed to give you? [pause] Hrm... well you are a mage, [confident] perhaps you will find this useful.
quest_7478_quest_detail:
[solemn] Master Winthalus lost the Libram of Rapidity in the east wing. The Libram will allow for a minor haste cantrip to be placed upon your equipment. [soft voice] Parlor tricks, really...

Regardless, if you are interested, you will need to present the Libram along with some basic reagents.

[hesitant] Hrm... I believe it also requires blood of heroes, a pristine black diamond, and large brilliant shards. [soft voice] I could be wrong! <Lydros shrugs.>
quest_7478_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it? [soft voice] I have much cataloguing to do!
quest_7478_quest_complete: <Lydros yawns.> [solemn] As promised, the Arcanum of Rapidity. [warm] Don't spend it all in once place. <Lydros snickers.>
quest_7479_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This libram almost aroused interest in one of the younger Lorekeeper's familiars. Poor thing, it was only a few weeks old.

[solemn] Those among you who are more magically inclined might find this item interesting.

The Libram of Focus was lost in this wing. [low voice] I can only assume one of the Highborne spirits holds it in their possession.

[commanding] Bring the Libram along with some large brilliant shards, skin of shadow, and a pristine black diamond and I shall conjure the Arcanum.
quest_7479_quest_progress: [angry] You again? [low voice] What could you possibly want now?
quest_7479_quest_complete: [gentle] Don't hurt yourself when applying the enchantment, <race>.
quest_7480_quest_detail:
[solemn] He wept like an infant at the loss of this libram. Mind you, I myself have wept over texts - there is no greater loss than that of knowledge and history - but to cry over this nearly useless jumbling of incantations? [angry] Preposterous! It left me to believe that the Prince was doing him a favor in flaying the flesh from his bones.

[commanding] Bring the Libram along with a pristine black diamond, large brilliant shards, and a frayed abomination stitching and I shall recreate the Arcanum.

[soft voice] Oh, and check the north wing.
quest_7480_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, yes... Calm yourself. [warm] As promised, here is your Arcanum.
quest_7481_quest_detail:
[solemn] Several years ago, a lone elven master named Kariel Winthalus fled the devastation of his homeland with several ancient elven artifacts in tow.

[soft voice] Our search for this lost master lead us from the ruins of Quel'Thalas, through the Burning Steppes, across the great expanses of the sea, to Feralas.

[solemn] We suspect that the elf sought sanctuary in the halls of Eldre'Thalas (what is now known as Dire Maul).

[commanding] You must find him, adventurer. [urgent] Whether alive or dead, the knowledge he carried must be recovered!
quest_7481_quest_progress: [soft voice] My associate, the night elf scholar, Runethorn, is recruiting her allies for this task.
quest_7481_quest_complete: [solemn] A shame... a tragedy. [sad] The items are lost you say? [pause] No trace of him, eh?
quest_7482_quest_detail:
[solemn] Several years ago, a lone elven master named Kariel Winthalus fled the devastation of his homeland with several ancient elven artifacts in tow.

[commanding] You must find him, adventurer. [urgent] Whether alive or dead, the knowledge he carried must be recovered!
quest_7482_quest_progress: [soft voice] My associate, the tauren sage, Korolusk, is recruiting his allies for this task.
quest_7482_quest_complete: [solemn] A shame... a tragedy. [sad] The items are lost you say? [hesitant] No trace of him, eh?

quest_7487_quest_detail:
Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, <race>. [solemn] Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of Blackrock Mountain, into the maw of the Firelord.

[soft voice] Surprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel.

[commanding] I assure you, the portal is there and access is possible.

[threatening] I've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. [urgent] Venture into Blackrock Depths and retrieve a core fragment. [solemn] Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.
quest_7487_quest_progress: [solemn] You must attune your soul with the Molten Core before access is granted.
quest_7487_quest_complete: [solemn] I am now able to transport you to the Molten Core. [warm] Ask and it shall be done.
quest_7488_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mage Lethtendris, a vicious blood elf whose brutality is matched only by her twisted addiction to magic, has fled into Dire Maul. [urgent] She has created a device, a web to ensnare the magical energies of that place and we fear that, if left unchecked, she will cause irreparable damage to our world!

[commanding] Stop her, <name>. [solemn] Find her and retrieve her web. [soft voice] She is likely near the satyrs in Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul. [soft voice] Bring the web to me so that its power may be released safely back into the wilds...
quest_7488_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the web, <name>? [commanding] Its concentrated magical energy must be dissipated!
quest_7488_quest_complete:
[excited] You retrieved the web! [warm] Well done, <name>! [solemn] Lethtendris, like many elves of her ilk, are blind to the dangers the abuse of magic can cause to our world. They believe they are masters of magic; they do not realize that they are slaves to their own addiction. [sad] Her death saddens me, but it was necessary.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [confident] I will have the energies within the web released safely over a wide area, and then I'll destroy it to prevent future magical exploits.
quest_7489_quest_detail:
[solemn] The blood elf Lethtendris has overstepped her bounds. [soft voice] So eager was she to gather magical power that she defied her brethren and created a device of insidious design, a web meant to siphon the tainted magical energies of Dire Maul. [urgent] Even now she gathers those energies and plans to release them against her enemies.

[commanding] Lethtendris must be stopped. Find her within the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul, defeat her and bring her web to me so that it might be returned to more clear-headed blood elves for study.
quest_7489_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [soft voice] This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire Maul, and I fear what damage may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris. [sad] I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris. [solemn voice] They will be the new wardens of its power.
quest_7491_quest_complete: [excited] Choose your reward and let the celebration of your glorious victory begin.
quest_7492_quest_detail: [solemn] Talo Thornhoof, a Tauren elder in Feralas, sends a request for aid. [soft voice] He offered few details, but he did say that he needs agents for a matter both delicate... and dire.
quest_7493_quest_complete:
[solemn] A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. [warm] I am humbled.

Please accept what I am about to teach you. [confident] This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.

[urgent] Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. [soft voice] It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... [threatening] Nefarian.
quest_7494_quest_detail: [urgent] <name>! Your aid is needed in Feralas!
quest_7496_quest_complete: [solemn] Few are graced with such ceremony, <name>. [warm] Please, choose your reward so that we may begin the celebration.
quest_7497_quest_complete:
[solemn] A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. [warm] I am humbled.

Please accept what I am about to teach you. [soft voice] This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.

[emphasis] Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. [commanding] It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... [threatening] Nefarian.
quest_7498_quest_detail: [solemn] The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
quest_7498_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent work, <race>. [warm] Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.

[solemn] As time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.
