quest_7507_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have uncovered something of great importance. [soft voice] This book is unlike any that you have seen.

[pause] It would appear as if someone or something has managed to shatter the seal of Athenaeum. [sad] The text within is garbled and barely legible.
quest_7507_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, one of our greatest compilations. [soft voice] This one has been missing for ages.
quest_7507_quest_complete:
[solemn] You could have gotten quite a lot of gold for this book on the black market, <name>. [soft voice] Especially since the protective seal has been broken, leaving the secrets of dragon slaying viewable to any with the requisite intellect to consume the knowledge held within the sacred pages.

[pause] Perhaps a grand reward is in order... [hesitant] Well, a reward that will require enormous effort to obtain. <Lydros grins.>
quest_7508_quest_detail: [solemn] If you wish to take on this task, [soft voice] present Lydros with the dull blade.
quest_7508_quest_complete: [solemn] If you manage to enter the lair of the dragon, heat the blade under her fiery breath, and ultimately temper it in her blood, I shall bind the blade for your use.
quest_7509_quest_detail:
[solemn] Take the unfired ancient blade to the lair of Onyxia and engage her in battle.

[urgent] Some trickery must be utilized for the heating of the blade. [urgent] While in combat, she will surely try to incinerate you with her fiery breath. [urgent] You must plant the unfired ancient blade nearby and hope that the fiery breath heats the blade. [urgent] If you live beyond this, pick up the now heated ancient blade and finish off the dragon.

[urgent] Plunge the heated ancient blade into her smoldering corpse to fashion the treated ancient blade.
quest_7509_quest_progress: [solemn] Perhaps one day, another will wield the prismatic blade.
quest_7509_quest_complete: <Lydros murmurs something unintelligible.> [solemn] As promised, <class>, the blade of Quel'Serrar.
quest_7541_quest_complete:
[solemn] It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us. [warm] But for your service to the Horde I would like to offer you a small token.

[proud] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.
quest_7562_quest_detail: <name>, [solemn] your delvings into the dark arts are deep. [soft voice] Your mastery over otherworldly denizens has grown so strong... [pause] perhaps you are ready to bind to you one of the infamous dreadsteeds.
quest_7563_quest_detail:
[solemn] The dreadsteeds dwell on another world, on the fiery Plains of Xoroth, and to bind one of those famed beasts you must invoke powerful glyphs. [soft voice] I can scribe the glyphs on a parchment for you, but first I will need a special ink.

[low voice] In distant Winterspring there dwells a race of owl beasts. [solemn] Once pure creatures, they were turned mad by the demonic emanations of the Darkwhisper Gorge and now roam the snows in a frenzy.

[urgent] Their blood is what I need to ink your parchment. [commanding] Bring it to me.
quest_7563_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you seen the raging owl beasts, <name>? [solemn] The magic of those creatures is strong, and it concentrates in the blood that flows through their torturted forms.
quest_7563_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, very good. I will have this blood distilled into an ink and use it for the parchment I promised you. [warm] And perhaps I will save just a little for myself, as I hear its taste is quite euphoric...
quest_7564_quest_detail: [solemn] My servant, Gorzeeki, is an alchemist of some skill. He can prepare the ink I will need for your parchment. [soft voice] I gathered together the blood you acquired; take it to Gorzeeki so that he can begin his work.
quest_7564_quest_progress: [urgent] You have something for me? [excited] It's not a big, juicy spider, is it? [mocking tone] Or maybe a roach? [hesitant] I hope it's still alive... I so love chewing on them when they're still alive...
quest_7564_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, it's blood. It must be from master Mor'zul then. He is so enamored with the stuff, and loves to see it spilled. I, however, prefer it coursing through the veins of a small rodent. It stays warm that way... until you want it.

[solemn] This is powerful blood. Mor'zul must be making another parchment to summon a dreadsteed! [excited] How exciting! If that's true, and you're going to perform the ritual, then... [urgent] you're going to need a lot more than blood, my friend.
quest_7581_quest_detail:
[urgent] You must retrieve bindings for the prison of the Doomguard from lesser demons.

[solemn] The blood of the Wildspawn satyr that occupy Dire Maul should do nicely. [whispering] The coagulated blood will bond the Hederine shards and power the crystal prison.
quest_7581_quest_progress: [solemn] Only the blood of Wildspawn satyr will suffice.
quest_7581_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, a most excellent recovery. [soft voice] The blood will suppress the Doomguard's magical defenses.
quest_7582_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Hederine demons that occupy the foothills of Mount Hyjal secrete powerful fel poisons, which if left to mature, harden into a dense anti-magic crystal. [emphasis] These crystals have come to be known as Tears of the Hederine.

[soft voice] Not even the immense power of a Doomguard could break the walls of a prison constructed from this material.

[urgent] Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover the Tears.
quest_7582_quest_progress: [commanding] The Hederine will not give up their precious gems without a fight, <name>.
quest_7582_quest_complete: [solemn] I merely need to combine the blood of the Wildspawn with these crystals and the prison shall be ready for use.
quest_7583_quest_detail:
[solemn] The prison is ready. [solemn] Now for the most difficult portion of this task.

[urgent] You must find and capture a Doomguard Commander within the Tainted Scar using this crystal prison.

[angry] Be warned! [commanding] A Doomguard is a cunning and lethal adversary and will seek to destroy you as you begin the ritual of imprisonment. [emphasis] It will flail wildly in its attempts to escape imprisonment.

[threatening] It will focus on nothing but you, <name>. [urgent] Because of this, I must recommend that you take companions capable of keeping you alive!
quest_7583_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done as I have asked. [warm] You are ready to be given the knowledge to conjure and control the beast.
quest_7601_quest_detail:
[commanding] If I am to teach you the secrets of summoning an infernal servant, you must destroy Kroshius and bring me the infernal core from his burning remains. [solemn] This, however, is not as easy as it sounds. [urgent] Kroshius has all but burned out completely. You must reignite his corpse and raise him from the rubble. [hesitant] To do this, however, you must gather some components from other demonic entities.

[soft voice] My imp, Impsy, shall set you on your way.
quest_7603_quest_complete: [urgent] A deal is a deal! Quickly, take this and write this down. [urgent] I don't have time! [urgent] My greatest conjuration is upon us!
quest_7604_quest_detail:
[solemn] The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. [solemn] The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to him as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.

[commanding] By signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.

_________________ Signature
quest_7604_quest_complete:
[gentle] It has been a pleasure doing business with you, <name>!

[warm] On behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!
quest_7621_quest_complete:
$G Priest:Priestess;, [solemn] you are about to undergo a rigorous series of events which shall test all of your abilities.

[soft voice] I suggest that you listen to the story that I have to tell.

[commanding] Be warned, you must complete this task alone. [urgent] It is recommended that your allies remain at a distance. [threatening] Interference by outside agents will result in a most severe punishment.

[solemn] Destiny has led you and you alone here. [commanding] Battle with honor. [solemn] Harness the Light.
quest_7622_quest_detail:
[solemn] You must do what I could not: Save the peasants that were cut down while fleeing from Stratholme.

[soft voice] They will walk towards the light, you must ensure their survival. [emphasis] Should too many fall, our cursed existence shall continue - you will have failed.

[urgent] Every ability, prayer, and spell that you have learned will be tested. [solemn] May the Light protect you, <name>.
quest_7622_quest_complete: [solemn] Your tenacity and courage are astounding, priestess. [warm] You have earned the right to hold the Splinter of Nordrassil. [urgent] Only one task remains: The Eye of Shadow must be recovered. [commanding] Scour the world.
quest_7623_quest_detail:
[urgent] Mor'zul says that you want to open a portal to Xoroth. To do that, you'll need Xorothian stardust. That's not easy to find on Azeroth!

[excited] There is one being who might have some: Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar, the seat of the Shadow Council! [commanding] Speak with him and he might part with the stardust.

But if you're going to Jaedenar, then you'll need to cloak yourself in the Shadow Council's own flavor of evil. That will require some of my shadowy potions, and that will cost you...
quest_7625_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been to Jaedenar, <name>? Did you get the stardust from Lord Banehollow?
quest_7625_quest_complete:
[excited] There it is! [excited] I can hardly believe you got it! [excited] You must have struck a big deal with that Dreadlord or else paid a large sum, or both!

[excited] Mor'zul will have his ink very soon and then he can finally make the glyph parchment, so you can open a portal to Xoroth and pull through it one of the famed dreadsteeds!
quest_7626_quest_detail:
[solemn] A Bell of Dethmoora, named after the late warlock Dethmoora Darkeyes, is one of the three tools needed to create a Circle of Greater Summoning. When properly atuned with the Wheel and the Candle, these items conduct vast stores of arcane power.

[soft voice] My servant Gorzeeki can construct such a bell, but to do so he will need a large supply of elixirs of shadow power. Procure the elixirs from an alchemist and bring them to Gorzeeki.
quest_7626_quest_progress: [urgent] You have those elixirs, <name>? [low voice] Mor'zul told me you need a Bell of Dethmoora, and making one of those takes a lot of shadow power!
quest_7626_quest_complete:
[excited] Very good! I hope these elixirs weren't too hard to get. [soft voice] Sometimes alchemists can be so miserly with their creations...

[pause] I'll make the bell and keep it until you're ready for your ritual.
quest_7627_quest_detail:
[solemn] A Wheel of the Black March contains and directs the violent energies required for the Circle of Greater Summoning. [soft voice] For Gozeeki to construct a wheel, he will need both large brilliant shards from an enchanter, and dark iron ore from a master miner.

[urgent] Acquire these and bring them to my servant.
quest_7627_quest_progress: [low voice] The Wheel of the Black March isn't easy to make, and takes a lot of materials. [urgent] Have you gathered them yet?
quest_7627_quest_complete:
[excited] There they are! [soft voice] I hear that dark iron ore is only found in the depths of Blackrock, and I'm sure these shards weren't easy to find either. [warm] I am often awed at the dedication you warlocks have. [mocking tone] If you instead bent all that energy into the art of bug catching, oh... such a feast you would enjoy!

[laughing] Sorry, a small digression. [solemn] I'll create the wheel and keep it for you until you're ready for your ritual.
quest_7628_quest_detail:
[solemn] A Doomsday Candle stores fire and directs it at those who would disrupt your ritual. When creating your Circle of Greater Summoning, if your candle is lit then any wayward demons will be burned by its flames!

Containing that fire is not easy, and requires the essence within the scales of a black dragon. Acquire those scales from a skinner and bring them to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
quest_7628_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you bring the dragonscales, <name>? [hesitant] I don't want to start on the candle until I have them... or I might blow up the whole camp!
quest_7628_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, very good. I'll need these to contain the fires of the candle. [solemn] Now that I have the scales, I'll make the candle and hold onto it until you're ready to begin your ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning.
quest_7629_quest_detail:
[urgent] There is one more process required for Mor'zul's parchment; I need paper infused with Xorothian stardust. [hesitant] And... I'm afraid I can't do that here. [shouting] I don't have the equipment!

[solemn] There is an alchemy lab, however, with everything needed. [soft voice] It's in the Scholomance, on the isle of Caer Darrow in the Plaguelands.

[sad] I can't make the trip, but here - take this jar. [warm] There's an imp inside who is quite clever. [commanding] Let him out at the alchemy lab and he'll infuse the parchment.
quest_7629_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been to the Scholomance, <name>? [hesitant] Has the imp yet infused the parchment with the stardust?
quest_7629_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, good. J'eevee created the parchment. How was the Scholomance? Charming, don't you think? And the bugs there... I hear they're delicious!

[excited] Well done, <name>, and thank you for returning my jar. [pause] I've had it for a long time... and it's not for sale!
quest_7630_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that the Bell, Wheel and Candle are made, I should make a black lodestone. [soft voice] During your ritual, you'll need that lodestone to maintain the other ritual objects if they should fail.

[urgent] To make the lodestone, I require arcanite. Do you have any? [hesitant] If not, then... you'll have to get the arcanite from an alchemist.

[commanding] Return to me when you have the arcanite, and then I'll make the black lodestone.
quest_7630_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the arcanite, <name>? [low voice] Once I have it I can make you the black lodestone.
quest_7630_quest_complete: [excited] You got it! Nicely done! [warm] Now I can create the lodestone. [solemn] When you're finally ready for your ritual to create the Circle of Greater Summoning, you'll want a lodestone to make sure the ritual doesn't fizzle out!
quest_7631_quest_detail:
[solemn] All the preparations are made. Now, you must perform the ritual to create a Circle of Greater Summoning, then use the parchment infused with Xorothian stardust... to open a portal to Xoroth.

[soft voice] I have written the instructions for the ritual onto a scroll. Study it closely, for you must perform each step exactly if you wish to succeed.

[warm] Fortune to you, <name>. [threatening] And may the souls of your enemies swiftly find their way into your shard pouch.
quest_7637_quest_detail:
[solemn] In order to prepare yourself for this task, you must first show due sacrifice and judgment... with an emphasis on sacrifice.

[urgent] You must acquire High Priest Rohan's exorcism censer for your task. Even though its use will be for good and just reasons, due compensation must be given for it.

[commanding] Proceed to Ironforge and speak with the High Priest. By bringing ample coin with you to help offset the loss of his censer, it will show your due sacrifice.

[urgent] Go now <name>, time is of the essence.
quest_7637_quest_progress: Greetings, noble <class>! [solemn] I have prepared my trusted censer with the freshest of incense and blessed it thrice for your use. [warm] Your donation will help us in Ironforge not only create a new censer, but also to bolster sagging reserves of food for our needy.
quest_7637_quest_complete:
Blessings onto you, friend <class>! [warm] Your donation goes far beyond what was needed. [solemn] Your sacrifice will not only help us recover what we have lost, but also help us to help those most in need here in Ironforge.

[pause] Now, let me make sure I've suitably prepared this censer for your future needs...
quest_7638_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come, <name>, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger.

[soft voice] Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker here in Stormwind's Cathedral District. It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own.

[solemn] I wish you the best in this trial. For the Light, noble brother !
quest_7638_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am glad to see you <name>. [warm] I know that you have awaited word as to how to acquire your charger, and now that time has come.

[commanding] You will be surely tested in many different ways, but most importantly in your willingness to rise above numerous obstacles thrust before you. [solemn] These are not done as a learning exercise - your stature is beyond simple educational tests. [urgent] You must save your future companion from the clutches of the evil you have spent your life fighting.

[emphasis] Take heed, your time has come!
quest_7639_quest_detail:
[solemn] With my blessings, take the censer. [soft voice] I myself have used it in several exorcisms, and it should serve you well for the arduous tasks that lie ahead.

[pause] Return now to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind, <name>. [solemn] Your quest continues with him.
quest_7639_quest_progress: [commanding voice] Welcome back, <name>. [urgent] Have you acquired the exorcism censer?
quest_7639_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, this will do. You will be called upon more than once during this process to make acts of sacrifice; I am glad to see that you are willing to do just that. [solemn] Sacrifice is a key component in what it takes to uphold the duties of being a Paladin... but I don't have to lecture you on that.

Now <name>, you will need to show due judgment in your actions. [commanding] To that end, this censer will act as your vessel to dispense such judgment on tortured spirits of lands lost to us.
quest_7640_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have added a pinch of dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. [soft voice] You will now use this censer to find areas there that show signs of spiritual turmoil and disturbance. Look for green auras that permeate the ground as the physical world buckles under the torment of the spirit realm and use the censer to drive out the evil spirits.

[commanding] When you have passed sufficient judgment on the spirits there, you will be ready to proceed.
quest_7640_quest_progress: [commanding] It is good to see you again <name>. [solemn] Is your work done in Terrordale?
quest_7640_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done, <name>. To render the judgment of the Light on those that dwell in darkness is a task we must approach with vim and zeal; you have done just that with your sacrifice in Ironforge and your judgments of the spirits in Terrordale.

[warm] Your next steps will call on both sacrifice and judgment again as you now strive to reclaim the spirit of a fallen charger who now serves a Death Knight known as Darkreaver.
quest_7641_quest_detail:
[solemn] A paladin's charger is nothing more than a pack animal without proper barding for it. [soft voice] The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but because of the circumstances involved it must also be sufficiently attuned to the spirit realm.

[urgent] First things first, <name> - let's get your barding made. [commanding] In Stormwind's Dwarven District is one of the finest craftsmen living today, Grimand Elmore. [solemn] His work will not be cheap, but his quality is what we seek. [emphasis] Speak with him.
quest_7641_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hello there - Lord Shadowbreaker sent me word ahead of time that you'd be coming around this way to see me. [low voice] I'm willing to make the barding you need, but it won't be either cheap or easy; let's get that out in the open first and foremost.

[solemn] I will say this much, and Grayson will back me up when I make this claim... [proud] you'll not find better barding made anywhere in all of Azeroth than right here.
quest_7642_quest_detail:
[commanding] You'll need four things for the barding - runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, Arthas' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and Stratholme holy water for the spiritual imbuement. [hesitant] Actually, you need five things... gold for my fee. [solemn] That fee includes all labor as well as a handcrafted saddle and stirrups.

[urgent] Once you've got all that, I'll be able to finish your barding. [pause] Until then, there are some things I can get started on for you while you assemble your collection of goods.
quest_7642_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, <class>. I won't be able to finish your barding without the things I mentioned. [hesitant] Have you gotten everything together?
quest_7642_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This... well, this is exactly what I needed. [warm] You're quite the resourceful <class>, aren't you?

[proud] All right then, let's get this barding finished up for you!
quest_7643_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your barding needs a special form of blessing, one from an appropriate spirit. [soft voice] In Dire Maul is such a spirit, the Ancient Equine Spirit. [urgent] It is currently held by a corrupt treant, Tendris Warpwood. [commanding] Pass judgment upon this foul beast, <name>.

[emphasis] Know this - freedom alone is not enough. [hesitant] You must soothe the spirit before receiving its blessing. [soft voice] For that, special horse feed is needed. [urgent] Travel to Southshore first and speak with Merideth Carlson on this... [pause] and prepare for more sacrifice.
quest_7644_quest_progress: <name>, you're back! [excited] Were you able to successfully deal with Merideth Carlson and Tendris Warpwood? [hesitant] Honestly, I'm not sure which one is a greater threat at times...
quest_7644_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've come far, my friend. [warm] Your barding is now suitably prepared for the last task at hand.

[confident] You will be using this barding to harness your charger once the task of redemption is complete. [solemn] Before that, however, you will have a monumental struggle to overcome. [urgent] Your time draws near - huzzah!

[warm] There is one last item that needs to be made before we begin this, <name>. [gentle] Hopefully your resourcefulness has not departed you since you had your barding made...
quest_7645_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Silver Hand thought me MAD when I told them that I could make a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses. [angry] EVERYONE thought I was mad! [excited] Well, now it's payback time!

[commanding] I'll make what you need, PALADIN... [threatening] so-called CHAMPION... but it will cost you. [soft voice] I need special biscuits - Enriched Manna Biscuits sold only by the Argent Dawn - for this blend. [angry] I also demand, yes DEMAND gold as compensation for the misery I have endured!

[threatening] Show me the sacrifice you tout so much, PALADIN.
quest_7645_quest_progress: [confident] Yes, I've proved you wrong now, haven't I? [excited] I've proved them all wrong! [loud voice] I WAS RIGHT ALL ALONG!!!
quest_7645_quest_complete:
[excited] YES, NOW WHO - wait - you're giving me the gold too? [soft voice] You weren't the one who called me mad (actually they called me a fruitcake nut-job)... still, you're willing to show sacrifice even for wrongs you've not committed?

[hesitant] I... I misjudged you, <name>. [warm] Should you need more horse feed, come see me. [confident] I will give it to you free of charge. [delight] Thank you... noble <class>.

[chuckling] I am going to keep the money though - I'm not that much of a nut-job as to give up a fortune.
quest_7646_quest_detail:
[solemn] We now must assemble a Divination Scryer - this will begin the trial that will allow you to redeem the fallen charger. [soft voice] Your scryer, actually, is almost done. The exorcism censer used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I will fashion a suitable housing for the device.

[emphasis] The last components needed, though, are two diamonds. They must be as juxtaposed in brilliance as they are in purpose - an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. [commanding] These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the shadows!
quest_7646_quest_progress: [solemn] You have come so very far, <name>. [soft voice] Your final act of worldly-item sacrifice will be the genesis for one of your greatest accomplishments. [solemn] I can feel it in the very fiber of my being!
quest_7646_quest_complete:
[solemn] These are fine specimens, <name> - the final pieces are now in place. [urgent] At long last, your time has come!

In the depths of the Great Ossuary of Scholomance are the skeletal remains of many beings. Amongst them is a once-noble charger. The hollowed soul of this charger now serves as the steed for Death Knight Darkreaver. It is he whom you will face, and it is this steed that you will pass judgment upon. [solemn] Only you, <name>, can redeem its soul and save it from the torment of its servitude.
quest_7647_quest_detail:
[commanding] Take this satchel - in it are the items you will need for your task.

[solemn] Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits that must be judged. [emphasis] Use your judgments wisely during this trial - they will prove more potent than you realize. [urgent] After the spirits, the death knight will appear; defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the charger. [proud] Only then <name>, will you be able to redeem it and place your barding upon your new steed!

[excited] Good luck!
quest_7648_quest_detail:
<Grimand wipes sweat from his brow, beaming with a sense of pride.> [soft voice] There you are, my friend. [solemn] This is some of my finest work - as good as the barding I personally made for Lord Shadowbreaker when he went for his own charger. [warm] I thank you for your trust in me to provide for you the best.

[pause] No doubt Grayson will want to see the work for himself as well. [commanding] Take your barding to him, and give him my thanks for his honorable business.
quest_7648_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're progressing along nicely, <name>. [pause] Once you have made your barding, you'll be well on your way to the next task.
quest_7648_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is most impressive work. [soft voice] It seems that as Grimand gets older, his craftsmanship continues to improve. [warm] That's quite the feat when his work was already some of the finest you'd find anywhere when he made my barding back in the day.

[pause] While this barding would be a fine addition to any normal steed, we are not dealing with such a mundane beast. [commanding] You'll need this barding blessed by an appropriate source for it to be worthy of resting on a <class>'s charger. [gentle] I'll hold onto it for you until then.
quest_7649_quest_detail: [solemn] The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
quest_7649_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, my boy.

<Lorekeeper Lydros tears out a page from the book.>

[proud] I am sure you can make use of this recipe.

quest_7666_quest_complete:
[solemn] Are you headed back into the Scholomance, <name>? [soft voice] You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. [gentle] With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more.

[warm] By all means, have it. [proud] You've certainly earned it.
quest_7667_quest_detail:
<name>, there is a pressing matter I hope you can help with... both materially and spiritually. [solemn] Allow me to explain.

Within the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron is a chamber called the Great Ossuary. [urgent] I need to complete a device that would pierce the shadows of this horrid room. [hesitant] To finish what I have started, I need two diamonds: an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. [soft voice] These are not trivial items, I know - I just don't have the resources myself.

[gentle] Could you provide me with one of each?
quest_7667_quest_progress: [hesitant] I feel awkward asking for material assistance, but my divination scryer - the device I hope to finish - requires one of each. If you cannot help me, I'd certainly understand.
quest_7667_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your generosity is unrivaled, <name>. [warm] I thank you for your kindness.

[soft voice] I will be able to finish my divination scryer now, and I should be able to fashion more without further need of diamonds... [hesitant] perhaps you would be interested in helping me in its use? [solemn] It is for a most important task, I assure you... [urgent] one that left unchecked could spell unmitigated disaster for the spirit realm!
quest_7668_quest_detail:
[solemn] Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance. [threatening] He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! [urgent] This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions. Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. [commanding] <name>, bring me his head! [solemn] Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!
quest_7668_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is critical, <name> - [solemn] have you succeeded in stopping Death Knight Darkreaver's threat?
quest_7668_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is a victory to savor, <name>! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm.

[warm] You have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. [proud] You are truly a <class> of worth, my friend.

[gentle] I know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.
quest_7721_quest_detail:
[urgent] If I bet against my own better judgment and stay to run an engineering shop along the Forgotten Coast, I will need to deal with these pesky elementals. [angry] Curse the powers of elementalism unchecked, I say!

[excited] Fortunately for me, and now for you my hopeful agent provocateur, the elementals represent an ideal source of raw power for my Ultra-Shrinker refinement - give them the what-for I say! [commanding] When doing this though, be sure to save me the water elemental cores!
quest_7721_quest_progress: [soft voice] While I could bore you with the technical details of the utility behind elemental cores, I will instead tempt you to completion of this important task by offering valuable coin and prizes for doing so. [urgent] Yon verily, are you finished?
quest_7721_quest_complete:
[excited] Scrumdillyriffic! [delight] These cores will keep me working for some time. [warm] Add to that the benefit of there now being fewer elementals along the coast, and I might no longer cry myself to sleep at the prospect of having set up shop in perhaps the worst place imaginable!

[warm] Thank you, <name>, for your efforts on my behalf. [gentle] While it certainly straps me financially to do this, allow me to show you some gratitude you may understand and appreciate... loot!
quest_7722_quest_detail:
[angry] When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! [low voice] I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons.

[commanding] I want you to get our secret plans back, <name>. [urgent] I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.
quest_7722_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I hope you kicked his teeth in too, <name>. [warm] Ragnaros knows, he deserved it.

[commanding] Now we can get down to business.
quest_7723_quest_detail:
[low voice] Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem. Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand. They're like gigantic Thelsamar Blood Sausages, they are...

Ye're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye.

[commanding] First on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge. [urgent] Get crackin'.
quest_7723_quest_complete: [solemn] Ye're a good lad, ye are. [warm] I got ye a lil' present fer yer troubles.
quest_7724_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.

[urgent] Me gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.

[pause] So, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. [low voice] Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.

[hesitant] I guess we gots to kill 'em. [commanding] Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.
quest_7724_quest_progress: [hesitant] Was he right? [soft voice] Does it come out their rumps?
quest_7724_quest_complete: <Hansel sneezes.> [low voice] I think I'm gettin' a cold. [angry] Damn this frigid climate!
quest_7725_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I know you've gathered residue for me already... but should you find yourself for want of an encore performance to a fun-time activity, I can always use more residue.

[urgent] While I can't offer nearly as much in the way of compensation again, I'll be more than happy to spread the good word of your service to all my goblin friends with ears.

[mocking tone] Believe me sir when I say that these goblins have quite large ears.
quest_7725_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ah, the fruits of research and utilization in the form of sweet, sweet residue. [whispering] Well, that is to say, I don't taste it or anything when I study it.

[pause] Much.
quest_7725_quest_complete:
[excited] Inconceivably fantastical, <name>! You've come through for me again, and for that I thank you.

Thank you! [warm] While you may find this coin to be a little less than you're accustomed to, rest assured your great deeds on the field of goblindom are echoing through the halls of power in the Steamwheedle Cartel. [confident] Should you need something else to do, then by all means talk to me!
quest_7726_quest_detail:
[angry] More work, you say? Did my heroic mission of collecting bits of goo found inside elemental beings not slake your thirst for adventure? Perhaps more of the same will vainly try to fill the bottomless well of questing you possess...

[soft voice] OK, melodrama aside, I do need more water elemental cores. I'm trying desperately to set up shop here, so the rewards won't be as great... [warm] but I promise you I'll tell everyone in earshot how you've helped me. [confident] Trust me on this - I know people in the Cartel!
quest_7726_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you managed to find the elemental cores I need?
quest_7726_quest_complete:
[excited] Top notch, <name>, top notch! [warm] While the coin I give you might not be the most you'll ever receive for such work, rest assured my comrades in the Steamwheedle Cartel will hear about your efforts!

[confident] If you are looking for anything else to do, then let me know. I can always use more elemental cores and such.
quest_7727_quest_detail:
Bunions, lad. [sad] Me bunions got bunions. [sad] How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? [groan] That's why ye're gonna help.

[commanding] Scrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. [solemn] Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. [urgent] Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.
quest_7727_quest_progress:
<Hansel is busily rubbing his bunions.> [commanding] Don't just stand there, grab some oil and a luffa and get to scrubbin' these bunions.

Ye don't have a luffa? Well then! [excited] Perhaps it's time I sent you out to find a luffa?%

[angry] Hey, where are ye goin'?
quest_7727_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh me achin' feets.

[pause] I figured since ye didn't have a luffa...
quest_7729_quest_detail: [commanding] Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the Searing Gorge.
quest_7730_quest_detail:
[solemn] From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race. [soft voice] Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not if they're sentient. [urgent] If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls.

[commanding] Drive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep. [emphasis] Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.
quest_7730_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the hunt, <name>? [urgent] Are you here to report your success?
quest_7730_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done, <class>. Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.

[soft voice] I will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.
quest_7731_quest_detail:
[solemn] In surveying the Writhing Deep, one of our scouts reported seeing a giant insect - much larger than the other insects spotted - wandering about the twisted terrain. [soft voice] Not only is it larger, it also seems to secrete some sort of aura that the other insects don't. [pause] We've given it a name - Stinglasher.

[urgent] The innards of this beast would be invaluable to study as we figure out the best way to deal with this new threat. [commanding] Cut out its secretion glands and bring it back to me immediately!
quest_7731_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you managed to bring down Stinglasher yet?
quest_7731_quest_complete:
[solemn] Impressive, <class>... most impressive! [soft voice] If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time. [commanding] It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.

[warm] Please accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, <name>. [proud] Well done.
quest_7732_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've done doubly well in addressing the threat that the Zukk'ash insects pose to Camp Mojache. [solemn] The threat these things pose is far from over, and I'd like to ask you for one last task on behalf of the Horde.

[soft voice] This is a document that details all the information we have learned about these Zukk'ash insects. [urgent] I want you to deliver it to Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag of Orgrimmar. [warm] He's an expert on alien creatures like these; I hope he can do something with the lore we've obtained.
quest_7732_quest_progress: Greetings friend... [soft voice] you look as though you are on urgent business. [soft voice] Is there something I can help you with?
quest_7732_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, I've been expecting this. [soft voice] These creatures you faced... they are an ancient threat that the Horde continues to choose to ignore. [solemn] Hadoken was wise to bring this - and you - to me.

[solemn] The Zukk'ash are nothing more than creatures called the silithid. [soft voice] Some would think that they are a mindless nuisance, but let me assure you - they are a far, far worse threat than anything the Alliance could muster.

[urgent] If you're willing and strong enough, I could use your aid in bringing this threat to light.
quest_7733_quest_detail:
[excited] I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe! [urgent] In the northern parts of Feralas - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis. [commanding] They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes!

[warm] I would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
quest_7733_quest_progress:
[urgent] If these Rage Scar yeti hides are anything like the quality displayed by their Feral Scar counterparts, they could very well be as resilient as thorium!

[excited] Imagine that!
quest_7733_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, excellent! [warm] These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.

[soft voice] Thanks again for your help <name>. [warm] Here - please take one of my latest creations.
quest_7734_quest_detail:

[proud] Thanks again for your aid, <name>. [warm] Here - please take one of my latest creations.
quest_7735_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have found a pristine yeti hide that is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.

[soft voice] Considering that Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.
quest_7735_quest_progress: [excited] What's this, <name> - you've got something special for me?
quest_7735_quest_complete:
Incredible! You may have found the granddaddy of all yeti hides with this!

[warm] You better believe I'll pay you for it. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm pretty sure I can make something special from it. [excited] Thanks for thinking of me on this, <name>!
quest_7736_quest_progress:
[angry] Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, <race>. [urgent] It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.

[commanding] What I'm gonna need from you is the following:

*Incendosaur scales. *Kingsblood.

*Coal. [loud voice] I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood. [threatening] Incendosaur Scale(2)Kingsblood(4)Coal
quest_7736_quest_complete: [commanding] There's always room for more fiery flux, junior. [emphasis] Keep it comin'... unless I tell you to stop.
quest_7737_quest_progress: [commanding] You've worked your way up through the Brotherhood's corporate hierarchy, <race>. We have begun to look favorably upon you. Quite an accomplishment! [urgent] If you're interested in more work and earning more respect amongst us, listen up. We can refine the fiery flux by adding a simple Dark Iron residue to the mix. The Dark Iron residue can be found in Blackrock Depths. Dark Iron Residue(4)
quest_7738_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have found what may very well be a perfect yeti hide. [soft voice] You easily note that it is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.

[pause] Considering that Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.
quest_7738_quest_progress: [soft voice] What's this, <name> - you've got something special for me?
quest_7738_quest_complete:
This is an incredible find! [excited] I believe this is the finest yeti hide specimen I have ever seen!

[solemn] Indeed, this is certainly worthy of an appropriate bounty. [low voice] I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm confident I can make something special from it. [warm] Thanks for thinking of me on this, <name>!
quest_7782_quest_complete: <Field Marshal Afrasiabi bows.> [excited] Choose your reward, let the celebration begin!
quest_7784_quest_complete: [commanding] Choose your reward so that I may mount the head of the beast for all to see.
quest_7785_quest_detail: [solemn] Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. [low voice] It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn!
quest_7785_quest_progress: [solemn] Will you release him from his eternal prison?
quest_7785_quest_complete: [solemn] May you be protected in your crusade. [solemn] May the Master bless your efforts.
quest_7786_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have told you all that I know, <name>. [soft voice] It is you who must find elementium. [urgent] It is you who must destroy the Firelord's corporeal form.

[commanding] Do this and gain the blessing of Thunderaan.
quest_7786_quest_progress: [commanding] Bring the world to its knees if you must!
quest_7786_quest_complete:
[solemn] Even in dreams I did not dare foresee this day.

Behold, mortal. [commanding] BEHOLD HE WHO IS OLDER THAN EXISTENCE!

[commanding] BEHOLD HE WHO HAS FACED TITAN AND GOD ALIKE!

[urgent] RISE MY MASTER! [urgent] BREAK FROM YOUR BONDS!
quest_7787_quest_detail: [solemn] You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.
quest_7787_quest_complete: [urgent] Please do not harm me! [commanding] Take it! Take the blade! [angry] Leave Demitrian to reshape his pathetic life!
quest_7788_quest_detail:
Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young <class>. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.

[urgent] Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. [commanding] Push back the invading Horde forces!

[warm] Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, <name>, and I shall reward you.
quest_7788_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
quest_7788_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [warm] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more Marks of Honor. [confident] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
quest_7789_quest_detail:
[commanding] The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, <race>. [solemn] Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. [angry] Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. [shouting] How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

[proud] Let the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. [urgent] Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. [commanding] Return to me with such a mark, <name>, and you will be rewarded.
quest_7789_quest_progress: [solemn] The blood of our enemies is a mark of honor. [soft voice] Do you have such a mark?
quest_7789_quest_complete: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph> [commanding] How much more can they withstand? [angry] How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? [solemn] Only time will tell, <race>...
quest_7791_quest_progress:
[solemn] We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. [soft voice] A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions. [low voice] Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

[gentle] If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Wool Cloth(60)
quest_7791_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_7792_quest_progress:
[solemn] We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. [soft voice] A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions. [gentle] If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. [warm] Wool Cloth(60)
quest_7792_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_7793_quest_progress:
[solemn] As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

[warm] A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! [soft voice] If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Silk Cloth(60)
quest_7793_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_7794_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! [solemn] By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. [warm] Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Stormwind, I assure you!

[urgent] If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Mageweave Cloth(60)
quest_7794_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

quest_7829_quest_progress: [solemn] Clear your head of impure thoughts, <race>. [urgent] Become one with the wilds!
quest_7829_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven a worthy ally to the Revantusk, <name>. [warm] Well done.

[commanding] Slay one and return to me with its plume.

quest_7839_quest_detail:
[angry] Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! [solemn] I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.

[urgent] I want those tools back, <name> - they mean the world to me.

[commanding] Markhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.

Those temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

Recover my tools!
quest_7839_quest_progress: [urgent] Watch out for the Vilebranch trolls of the region, <name>. [angry] They are ruthless, murderous filth.
quest_7839_quest_complete: [urgent] My tools! You found them! [excited] Oh glorious day! [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_7841_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Wildhammer be striking up deals with our enemies, forgin' new alliances. [soft voice] This time, they be workin' with the high elves, mon.

<Otho spits.>

[urgent] We be needin' to send those Wildhammer dwarves a message - a message in the blood of our enemies. [angry] Slaughter every Highvale high elf that you come across, leave their bodies as a warnin'.

[threatening] Never mess with trolls!
quest_7841_quest_progress: [low voice] You be too clean, mon. [commanding] You gotta mix it up - get down and dirty with the enemy.
quest_7841_quest_complete: [excited] It be lookin' like the Revantusk are forgin' new alliances as well, mon! [warm] You done good.
quest_7842_quest_detail:
[solemn] They say the Wildhammer and gryphon are as close to each other as troll and mate. [angry] Disgusting, but we be able to use this to our advantage, mon. [commanding] We send them another message.

[urgent] Kill all the gryphons you see in the Hinterlands, collect their feathers. [solemn] From this we make the final message.
quest_7842_quest_progress: [low voice] The last message gonna scare them off for sure. Either that or make them very, very angry.
quest_7842_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, mon, this gonna be good. [proud] One more step to go and Wildhammer see that they can't mess with troll!
quest_7843_quest_detail: <Otho hands you a long, blood drenched spear, wrapped in several gryphon feathers.> [commanding] You take this, mon. [emphasis] You take this to Aerie Peak, dead center of town by the well. [urgent] You plant it! Drive it right into the ground! [angry] Show those dwarves that troll mean business! [pause] Come back when you do this. [hesitant] Hopefully you come back alive.
quest_7843_quest_complete:
[solemn] I wish I coulda been there to see the look on their faces, mon. [soft voice] Are they packing up their bags? Leavin' town?

[warm] You done good, <name>. [proud] Real good. [warm] Otho reward you with the big mojo.
quest_7844_quest_detail:
[solemn] Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, <name>. [soft voice] That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.

[low voice] The Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.

[angry] If Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.

[urgent] It is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!
quest_7844_quest_progress: [solemn] The Vilebranch Soothsayers and Scalpers inhabit the north by northeast region of the Hinterlands.
quest_7844_quest_complete: [excited] Well done, <class>. [proud] Zul'jin himself could not have done a better job!
quest_7845_quest_detail:
[solemn] My mate was taken by Vilebranch savages in a bold midnight raid on our village. [soft voice] Our spies have told me that he is still alive and being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor. [solemn] The Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing him for a sacrifice to the faceless blood God, Hakkar.

[urgent] You must save him, <name>! [sad] Our village could not stand a loss this great.
quest_7845_quest_complete: [urgent] You must act quickly, <name>. [commanding] Surely the guards have been alerted to your presence.
quest_7846_quest_detail:
[solemn] The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. [urgent] She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, <class>, for she is guarded well.

[commanding] Kill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.
quest_7846_quest_complete: [excited] Freedom at last! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Revantusk will know your deeds!
quest_7847_quest_detail: [solemn] Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. [excited] Tell her that I am coming home! [warm] She is sure to reward you.
quest_7847_quest_complete: [warm] You have done the Revantusk a great service, <name>! [proud] We owe you a great debt of gratitude.
quest_7848_quest_detail:
[solemn] Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, <race>. Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of Blackrock Mountain, into the maw of the Firelord.

[soft voice] Surprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel.

I assure you, the portal is there and access is possible.

[commanding] I've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. Venture into Blackrock Depths and retrieve a core fragment. Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.
quest_7848_quest_progress: [solemn] You must attune your soul with the Molten Core before access is granted.
quest_7848_quest_complete: [solemn] I am now able to transport you to the Molten Core. [warm] Ask and it shall be done.
quest_7849_quest_detail:
[solemn] Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.

Sadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.

[soft voice] It is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. [urgent] Recover his remains, <name>.
quest_7849_quest_progress: [solemn] When I have his remains, I shall take them to Yayo'jin and have them prepared for a proper burial.
quest_7849_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My dearest brother, how I will miss you...

[warm] Thank you for your assistance, <name>. [proud] You are truly a hero in my eyes.
quest_7850_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. [soft voice] This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.

[pause] Throughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. [solemn] The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.

[urgent] Steal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.
quest_7850_quest_progress: [urgent] Be cautious in battling the Vilebranch, <name>. [solemn] Their minds are clouded - they fight to the death.
quest_7850_quest_complete: [solemn] The dark energy that compels the Vilebranch has been lifted - for now. [urgent] We must remain ever vigilant in our battle against evil, as even if the Vile Priestess is destroyed, another soon takes her place.
quest_7863_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>. [warm] As a reward, please take this care package! [soft voice] Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

[solemn] As you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. [soft voice] Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

quest_7871_quest_detail:
[solemn] Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young <class>. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.

[urgent] Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. [commanding] Push back the invading Horde forces!

[warm] Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, <name>, and I shall reward you.
quest_7871_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
quest_7871_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [warm] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more Marks of Honor. [confident] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.

quest_7874_quest_detail:
[commanding] The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, <race>. [low voice] Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. [solemn] Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. [angry] How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

[urgent] Let the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. [commanding] Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. [warm] Return to me with such a mark, <name>, and you will be rewarded.
quest_7874_quest_progress: [solemn] The blood of our enemies is a mark of honor. [soft voice] Do you have such a mark?
quest_7874_quest_complete: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph> [commanding] How much more can they withstand? [angry] How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? [solemn] Only time will tell, <race>...
quest_7875_quest_detail:

quest_7877_quest_detail: [solemn] In the library, Athenaeum, you will find an ancient chest hidden beneath the stairway. [soft voice] Take from it that which you desire.
quest_7877_quest_complete: [soft voice] You open the chest to find...
quest_7881_quest_progress:
[solemn] We at the Darkmoon Faire do much walking. We walk from one faire site to another... in fact, you'll never see us sitting down on the job! [excited] So it is no surprise that we wear out quite a lot of boots! We need boots that are both durable and stylish, and embossed leather boots fit that bill rather well.

You! You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work. Embossed Leather Boots(3)
quest_7881_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] These are quite well made. The craftsmanship is top notch! [warm] Here is a Darkmoon Faire ticket... enjoy, sir.
quest_7882_quest_progress:
[commanding] Our Faire workers do more than sweep trash and hammer spikes! [urgent] They also help guard the carnival as it travels, and to that end they are always needing good sturdy armor jerkins.

[solemn] If you make some tough leather armor and bring it to me, then I'll make sure it gets to the right people. [warm] I'll also get you some Darkmoon Faire tickets as trade. [emphasis] Toughened Leather Armor(3)
quest_7882_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, you brought the jerkins. Splendid. What animal's skin did you use to make these, may I ask? The stitch-work is very well done, and the texture of the leather has a rugged style to it. I can tell you are a craftsman of skill!

[warm] Thank you, <name>, and here are your tickets.
quest_7883_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Yebb Nebblegear is looking to add more talent to his show, and he's searching far and wide for the world's largest gnome. Do you know any gnomes of considerable size?

[pause] Well before he finds the gnome, he wants to have its costume ready. I think a barbaric harness would be a good foundation for the costume; can you make some harnesses and bring them to me? [urgent] Do that, and I'll have a stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you... Barbaric Harness(3)
quest_7883_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh dear, these are quite large!! [excited] I can't imagine finding a gnome that would fit snuggly into them, but not to worry - if the gnome we find is not big enough, I can make adjustments to his costume.

[warm] Many thanks, <name>. [proud] Here are the tickets I promised you.
quest_7884_quest_progress:
[solemn] Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. [soft voice] We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.

[urgent] <name>, can you make those leggings? [warm] If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward... [soft voice] Turtle Scale Leggings
quest_7884_quest_complete:
[delight] Great, you made them! [soft voice] These will do nicely... [hesitant] I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes. [mocking tone] Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?

[warm] Here are your tickets, <name>. [excited] Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!
quest_7885_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You might not realize this, but running a traveling carnival is costly! [low voice] Everything wears down so fast it's a wonder we can turn a profit.

[soft voice] Because of all those hidden costs, we're always looking for ways to maintain our equipment as cheaply as possible. [soft voice] Our tents, for instance, tear regularly but I've found that leather armor kits make great patches. [soft voice] Can you find and bring me some armor kits? [excited] That'll save us a bundle! [warm] Do that, and I have a fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you... Rugged Armor Kit(8)
quest_7885_quest_complete:
[excited] Great! This will work great! [excited] I just noticed a rip in a tent over yonder, and one of these armor kits is just what I need to patch it up!

[warm] Thank you very much, <name>. [proud] These armor kits will save us a ton in repair costs. [warm] Here are your tickets - you deserve them!
quest_7886_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.
quest_7887_quest_detail: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [soft voice] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. [gentle] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
quest_7887_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.
quest_7888_quest_detail: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [soft voice] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. [gentle] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
quest_7888_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.
quest_7889_quest_progress:
[excited] It takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive! [urgent] My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights!

Do you think you could bring me some weight stones? If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket. Coarse Weightstone(10)
quest_7889_quest_complete:
[excited] Great! [excited] These will work great! [warm] They're not too heavy, but not too light either. [delight] They're perfect for building muscle mass!

[warm] Thanks much, <name>. [excited] Here's your Darkmoon Faire ticket!
quest_7890_quest_progress:
[soft voice] To help with my workout, I like to fit a staff between heavy grinding stones, then lift the staff over my head. [proud] It isn't easy, but being the strongest woman in the world, like I am, can't be earned sitting down!

[urgent] Can you help me? [excited] I need more grinding stones - bring me some and I'll trade Darkmoon Faire tickets for them. [emphasis] Heavy Grinding Stone(7)
quest_7890_quest_complete: [excited] You brought the stones! And they're heavy! [laughing] I can already feel my muscles getting bigger. [warm] Thanks <name>! Here, take these tickets, and be sure not to eat too many sweets while your at the faire. [commanding] A big strong <class> like you needs to keep himself in fighting shape!
quest_7891_quest_progress:
[excited] I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive! [soft voice] Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear. [gentle] They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?

[warm] How about green iron bracers, <name>? [commanding] Can you make me green iron bracers? [excited] If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you. [delight] Green Iron Bracers(3)
quest_7891_quest_complete: [delight] Thanks much, <name>. [excited] Here's your Darkmoon Faire tickets!
quest_7892_quest_progress:
[excited] For my act as the strongest woman alive, I plan to accept items from the audience and smash them with a big, black mace!

[commanding] Can you make me a big black mace, <name>? [excited] Big Black Mace
quest_7892_quest_complete: [delight] Thanks much, <name>. [warm] Here's your Darkmoon Faire tickets!
quest_7893_quest_progress:
<name>, in my quest to become the strongest woman alive, I have traveled the world and learned muscle building secrets from distant weight masters, strength gurus, and ancient manuals. [solemn] I now know forbidden exercises that would kill the weak and cripple the uninitiated!

[commanding] These feats of strength and conditioning require training with the densest of grinding stones. <name>, can you find or make some grinding stones and bring them to me? [urgent] I'll give you tickets if you do... Dense Grinding Stone(8)
quest_7893_quest_complete: [delight] Thanks much, <name>. [warm] Here's your Darkmoon Faire tickets!
quest_7894_quest_progress:
[excited] Yebb is developing a new attraction for the Zoo Bizarre, one that will drive people crazy with wonder, and delight! [hesitant] But it will take a lot of work, and a lot of materials...

[urgent] That includes copper modulators. [confident] We need lots of modulators for the mechanical parts of the attraction. [warm] Bring me copper modulators and I'll trade for them with a Darkmoon Faire ticket. Copper Modulator(5)
quest_7894_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! The modulators! Superb!

I can't tell you exactly what we're building, but these will be invaluable for its construction. [warm] I am in your debt, Grimling, but please, take this Darkmoon Faire ticket as a token of my appreciation.
quest_7895_quest_progress:
[excited] My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir! A sight to see, and... for a lucky few, to touch!

I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill!

[pause] Ah... now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition. [soft voice] Please, <name>, bring me whirring bronze gizmos... and Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours! [excited] Whirring Bronze Gizmo(7)
quest_7895_quest_complete:
[excited] You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! [warm] Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me!

[proud] Here are your tickets, <name>. And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!
quest_7896_quest_progress:
[excited] When I finally get this booth up and running, I'll want to advertise! And what better way is there to advertise than with fireworks?

Well, some might think that the smell of a cauldron, churning with the boiling heads of your foes is better for drawing crowds, but... we're in mixed company. So fireworks it will have to be!

[warm] Bring me green fireworks, <name>, and I have a big fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you. Green Firework(36)
quest_7896_quest_complete:
[excited] You brought the fireworks. [warm] Wonderful work, <name>! [excited] I can't wait to light these and tell the world that my booth is ready to go! [hesitant] I must still wait, quite a long time I'm afraid, but... [confident] I'll be ready when I'm ready, yes?

[warm] Here are the tickets, <name>. [excited] Enjoy yourself!
quest_7897_quest_progress:
[angry] The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken! [urgent] I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!

[excited] Can you bring me those kits, <name>? [hesitant] I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets. [soft voice] What do you say? Mechanical Repair Kit(6)
quest_7897_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things.

[soft voice] It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. [hesitant] Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... [warm] the Faire has been good to me.

[excited] Take these tickets, <name>, and have fun!
quest_7898_quest_progress:
Yebb Nebblegear, like me, is working on a future attraction. [excited] So amazing is this attraction, says Nebb, that it will draw folks from across the world... and it will make us all very, very rich!

He says he needs thorium widgets for its construction, and wants me to collect them for him. [urgent] So what do you say, <name>? Do you know where to get Thorium widgets? If you're an engineer, can you make them? Do you want to trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets? Thorium Widget(6)
quest_7898_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, thank you, <name>! [warm] Yebb will enjoy these widgets. [soft voice] I don't know what he has planned for them, but Yebb's a clever little gnome. He's clever, and maybe a little devious....

[hesitant] If only he liked the taste of humanoid flesh... he'd make a great troll!

[warm] Here, <name>. [confident] A deal's a deal, and these tickets are yours.
quest_7899_quest_progress:
[excited] The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets! Can you help me?

I need small furry paws to use for prizes. You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore....

[urgent] Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them. Small Furry Paw(5)
quest_7899_quest_complete:
[excited] Great, you got them! [warm] We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire!

[proud] Here's your ticket, <name>. [delight] You earned it!
quest_7900_quest_progress:
[excited] Children love toys! And no matter what race, I've found that all children love furry, plushy toys made from torn bear pelts!

[soft voice] You can get those pelts from the bears of Ashenvale or Hillsbrad. [warm] Bring me a heap of them and earn yourself a heap of Darkmoon Faire tickets! [excited] Torn Bear Pelt(5)
quest_7900_quest_complete:
Nice pelts, <name>! [excited] I'll get someone to sew these into a bunch of plush toys. With a little stuffing and some paint, I think they'll be the envy of children across Azeroth!

[warm] Tickets? Ah yes, your payment!

[delight] Here they are!
quest_7901_quest_progress:
[excited] It's amazing what people value! Take, for instance, a wooden stick with a soft bushy tail attached to it. Now, you and I might think something like that isn't all that valuable... but if you give that piece of junk a neat name like "Savage Fuzz Tail" and put it in a pretty box, then people will think it's valuable. [warm] Trash becomes treasure!

[urgent] Get me soft bushy tails from the wolves of Desolace and the Badlands, and I'll give you Darkmoon Faire tickets. [proud] Soft Bushy Tail(5)
quest_7901_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done, <name>! [warm] These tails will make great prizes for our visitors, and that means happy visitors... who talk to their friends and bring more visitors!

[proud] Here are your tickets! [warm] Have a good time at the Darkmoon Faire... and don't forget to tell your friends about us!
quest_7902_quest_progress:
[soft voice] A person's imagination is an incredible thing. It can make the smallest hill seem like the largest mountain. It can make the most innocuous shadow appear cast by a horrible nightmare!

[excited] We at the Darkmoon Faire let our visitor's imaginations blossom! But to help stretch their imaginations... sometimes we have to get tricky.

[commanding] I need vibrant plumes for one of my attractions. You can get them from the birds of the more dangerous areas of Azeroth. [urgent] Bring me the plumes and many tickets will be yours! Vibrant Plume(5)
quest_7902_quest_complete:
[delight] Ah, the plumes! They are amazing, don't you think! It would be easy to spark one's imaginations with such beauties!

[warm] You do such charitable work, <name>. The smiles on our visitors' faces when they see the show is a grand payment indeed, but please take these tickets as well.
quest_7903_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Do you ever find yourself wandering in a cave, late at night, looking for adventure? [excited] You do? Really? Well, then you've seen the creepy eyes of bats staring at you from high up, waiting for you to let down your guard so they can suck your blood!

[shocked] Scary thought, don't you think? [commanding] Of course! It's no doubt that bat eyes are scary!

[urgent] Will you bring me some evil bat eyes, <name>? [hesitant] I want them for... something I'm designing. [whispering] Something scary. You can get them from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands. Evil Bat Eye(10)
quest_7903_quest_complete:
[delight] Great! You got the eyes! [excited] I hope hunting those bats was frightening for you, because if it scared a brave <class> like yourself, then those eyes will certainly scare our Faire visitors.

[warm] Take these tickets, <name>, and thank you for your service.
quest_7905_quest_detail:
