quest_8052_quest_complete: [threatening] Smite them all and let Hakkar sort them out...
quest_8053_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are a heathen. [angry] Heathens have a place in the tribe. [solemn] Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar. [commanding] Freethinkers do not fear oppression. [commanding] Freethinkers die for what they believe in. [commanding] We know you would die for what you believe in. [solemn] This earns our acknowledgement. [urgent] This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.

[commanding] We must have the Paragons of Power. [urgent] Go to Zul'Gurub. [urgent] Kill the minions of Hakkar. [urgent] Return when you have what I seek. [urgent] Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.

[commanding] Go.
quest_8053_quest_progress:
[solemn] You have returned? [urgent] Do you have the Paragons of Power? [angry] Are you wasting my time?

[threatening] I hope not, heathen.
quest_8053_quest_complete:
[solemn] You do much to honor us. [low voice] Your hands drip with the blood of Hakkar's minions. [warm] You are a friend to the tribe.

[commanding] Wear these bracers. [solemn] They are the freethinker's armguards. [proud] This is what I mean about real power.
quest_8054_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen. Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics. [solemn] This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong. Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar. Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin. [solemn] Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God. [solemn] We honor the price they paid. [solemn] They are the freethinkers.

[commanding] Destroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub. [commanding] Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek. [commanding] Success will be greatly rewarded.

[commanding] Go.
quest_8054_quest_progress: [commanding] Your presence means victory? Do you have the Paragons? [threatening] Are you dripping in the remains of your enemies?
quest_8054_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your honor is assured in the tribe. [solemn] You claim many deaths in Zul'Gurub. [solemn] Enemies fall before your convictions. [solemn] Enemies fall before your power.

[solemn] This is the freethinker's belt. [solemn] It is a symbol of honor. [solemn] It is powerful mojo. [solemn] It is now yours.
quest_8055_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you have the Paragons? [urgent] They have mojo inside them. [solemn] We must have them. [urgent] You will aid us.
quest_8055_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done what few ever could. [proud] You have brought the minions of Hakkar to their knees. [solemn] You have shown them what a freethinker can do. [warm] You have shown us how a heretic could be revered in the tribe. [proud] You have more than real power. [commanding] You ARE real power.

[urgent] Take the breastplate, freethinker. [commanding] Crush those who oppose you.
quest_8056_quest_detail:
[solemn] The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon. [soft voice] They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people. [gentle] As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.

[warm] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. [excited] Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!
quest_8056_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I need? [soft voice] These bracers are well worth any effort ya be needin' to make!
quest_8056_quest_complete: [solemn] It seems ya got a bit of the Zandalar augur in ya. [warm] We know about the deeds you've been doin' in Zul'Gurub on our behalf mon. [proud] These Paragons of Power will go a long way to helpin' out the Zandalar tribe - a tribe, I might add, ya can call upon as friends. [warm] Take these bracers, <name>; ya earned them and then some!
quest_8057_quest_detail:
[solemn] A haruspex is a key member of our tribe; you'll be wise to listen to their portents. By communion with animals and givin' them up to the spirits when needed, they give us divine guidance. [soft voice] In times past, the haruspex's insight and wisdom gave us an edge in the wars against the splintered tribes of the Gurubashi.

[commanding] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. [warm] Do this, and I'll give ya bracers that any haruspex of the Zandalar would want.
quest_8057_quest_progress: [urgent] Have ya got the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub? [warm] These bracers are worth the effort, <name>. [excited] Trust me mon!
quest_8057_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, I can sense the power comin' from these Paragons of Power, <name>. [warm] Ya proved to be someone we in the tribe can call "friend." [solemn] A deal is a deal, <name>... [excited] behold the power of the haruspex's bracers!
quest_8058_quest_detail:
[solemn] Vengeance is power. [solemn] The Zandalar vindicator is such power. [solemn] The tribe has many enemies. [solemn] The vindicator exacts retribution on them. [solemn] No crime against us is unpunished. [solemn] The vindicator delivers this punishment. [solemn] Our enemies fear our vengeance. [solemn] They should. [solemn] They forever will.

[commanding] Become one of our vindicators. [commanding] Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub. [commanding] Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name. [warm] You will be rewarded.
quest_8058_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you brought the Paragons of Power? [solemn] Has vengeance been claimed in the name of the Zandalar?
quest_8058_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have wrought much vengeance today. [solemn] You have taken on the visage of the vindicator. [solemn] You have brought the Blood God's minions to their knees.

[warm] Take this. [warm] It will fuel your vengeance for the future. [proud] You are a friend to the Zandalar now.
quest_8059_quest_detail:
[solemn] Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further. Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a demon to enter their being. Rather than let it possess them though, they enslave the demon from the inside, absorbing the power of the beast for their own command. It is a feat few are ever able to master.

[soft voice] For you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub. [urgent] Go there and retrieve that which we seek.
quest_8059_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you returned with the Paragons of Power? [solemn] By defeating the diabolic minions of the Hakkar, you will not only prove yourself to us, but also your willingness to learn the ways of the demoniac.
quest_8059_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done... no doubt they were made to pay in excruciating ways before they gave up the Paragons of Power. [warm] Take this - the demoniac's wraps. Made from powerful mojo used in summoning the demoniac's prey, it is a powerful tool in your acquisition of power.
quest_8060_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. [soft voice] They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!

<Al'tabim laughs wickedly.>

[emphasis] It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!

[pause] For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. [warm] For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.
quest_8060_quest_progress: <name> - you've returned already? [urgent] Were you able to get the Paragons of Power I need?
quest_8060_quest_complete:
[solemn] Impressive... could you feel the mojo flowing through them? [soft voice] The Paragons of Power were used as currency of sorts back when the Gurubashi Empire ruled these lands. [solemn] Now we Zandalar will use the latent mojo inside of them to fight the second rise of the Blood God Hakkar!

[warm] You've done well today - consider yourself to have a friend in the Zandalar. [warm] For that, here are the illusionist's wraps I promised!
quest_8061_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity. [soft voice] Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors. [solemn] Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe. [pause] Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.

[commanding] Go to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi. [solemn] Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.
quest_8061_quest_progress: [solemn] Back from Zul'Gurub, are you? [soft voice] Have you succeeded in retrieving the Paragons of Power from the minions of Hakkar?
quest_8061_quest_complete: [delight] Outstanding, <name>! [warm] This was no small feat bringing these to me. [solemn] No doubt you've acted as our tribe's confessor today in preserving ourselves against the threat of Hakkar. [proud] These wraps are befitting a friend of the tribe such as you!
quest_8062_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe. [soft voice] Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes. [commanding] Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.

[urgent] Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.
quest_8062_quest_progress: [commanding] Hunt those in Zul'Gurub that would possess the Paragons of Power, <name>. [low voice] They are your prey; they possess that which we both must have.
quest_8062_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... I need no vision to sense the presence of the Paragons of Power. [warm] Your success in Zul'Gurub has impressed many among the tribe. We not only consider you to be a friend of the Zandalar, but also consider you worthy enough to possess the predator's bracers - powerful items, and a symbol of what it means to be a predator. [proud] Well done, <name>.
quest_8063_quest_detail:
[solemn] The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence. [urgent] A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. [soft voice] We would not be here today without them.

[commanding] Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors. [excited] Embrace the madness!
quest_8063_quest_progress: [commanding] Seek the madness from within Zul'Gurub and overshadow it with your own, <name>! [urgent] To do so means success, and success means reward! [angry] Let not the Blood God reign supreme again!
quest_8063_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done, <name>... [warm] your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend. [soft voice] I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!
quest_8064_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. [soft voice] Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. [low voice] To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. [solemn] That is the real power of nature.

[commanding] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us. [warm] Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

[excited] Strong mojo, ya mon!
quest_8064_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub I need? [soft voice] The haruspex's belt will be yours if ya have them.
quest_8064_quest_complete: [solemn] I thank you - the latent power in these items will be treasures unto themselves, you betcha. [warm] Not only have ya done as I've asked of ya, but you've also proven to be honorable to us here in the tribe. [excited] As promised, here is your reward!
quest_8065_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear, <name>. Of these, the tunic symbolizes the connection between themselves and the divine wisdom they seek. It often weaves parts of the beasties they sacrifice into the tunic; this reminds them of the connection they have to their gifts.

[urgent] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this, and a tunic seeping with the true power of a haruspex is yours.
quest_8065_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the necessary Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub? [solemn] The haruspex's tunic is well worth any effort ya be needin' to make.
quest_8065_quest_complete: [solemn] Impressive... you've successfully collected the required Paragons of Power, <name>. [warm] Your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub for the Zandalar are legendary; hence forth, you'll be revered amongst the tribe. [proud] Here is your tunic, mighty <class>!
quest_8066_quest_detail:
[solemn] A predator knows how to stalk their prey, but a successful one knows how to strike at it once they have closed ranks. [commanding] You must master both to have any chance of success in Zul'Gurub... and any chance of being like the Zandalar predators.

[soft voice] Bring me choice parts of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. [solemn] My reward will be the power that the trinkets yield, while yours will be the Zandalar predator's belt - equipment well worth the trade.
quest_8066_quest_progress: [commanding] Strike at the insane minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub - they are the ones that hold the Paragons of Power, <name>. [urgent] Prove your success to them - and to the tribe - as an aspirant to the predator.
quest_8066_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sensed your arrival moments before, <name>, but none too easily. [soft voice] What revealed yourself to me were the Paragons of Power you brought. I can feel the power without needing to see the trinkets; their latent mojo - raw magic, if you will - will continue to fuel our efforts of vanquishing the diabolic schemes of the Blood God Hakkar.

[warm] You are to be commended - and rewarded - for your success. [proud] You are honored amongst the tribe, and you are worthy to wear the predator's belt.
quest_8067_quest_detail:
[solemn] We Zandalar prize what we wear as a symbol of accomplishment. You don't need to be able to see what one wears to be able to sense what emanates from it - power transcends sight. [soft voice] The garments of the Zandalar predator are like this, and most cherished by them is the mantle they wear. It helps to obfuscate them from view... and to make their presence known when they wish it.

[solemn] The Paragons of Power await your retrieval in Zul'Gurub. [commanding] Bring me what I seek, and the predator's mantle shall be yours.
quest_8067_quest_progress: [solemn] Have your strikes into Zul'Gurub yielded success, <name>? [soft voice] Only when you've brought me what I seek - and proven yourself fully to the tribe - will you earn a mantle second to none amongst the Zandalar.
quest_8067_quest_complete: [solemn] Success... you are to be revered amongst the tribe, <name>. [soft voice] It was no small feat acquiring the Paragons of Power needed for the mantle, but you handled it in the fashion of the deadliest of our predators. [warm] You've earned your place amongst them, and you've certainly earned the right to wear their mantle.
quest_8068_quest_detail:
[solemn] Magic is a raw, primal force to be shaped by those strong enough to do it. [soft voice] Mojo is our extension of this power; one such potent manipulation of it is in the form of illusion. [pause] How can one truly hope to win against a foe that is not even really there? [solemn] We Zandalar know the power of this, and as such illusionists hold a honored place within the tribe.

[warm] Take the needed Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub - for this, honor from the tribe and a powerful mantle used by our best illusionists will be yours!
quest_8068_quest_progress: [solemn] How was your foray into Zul'Gurub? Did you drive your enemies mad through the power of illusion? [soft voice] Illusion or not, their deaths - and the Paragons of Power taken from them - will help thwart the rise of Hakkar.
quest_8068_quest_complete:
[excited] Success! [proud] You shall be honored in the tribe from here on! [warm] Zul'Gurub has certainly tasted the might of the Zandalar today, thanks to you <name>.

[solemn] With the tribe's blessing, take the Zandalar illusionist's mantle. [gentle] May it serve you well.
quest_8069_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear. [soft voice] Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful. [soft voice] Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look. [solemn] Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.

[commanding] I will give you an illusionist's robe, <name>... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first! [urgent] Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!
quest_8069_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you returned with the Paragons of Power we need? [hesitant] I know it will not be easy... but I have long predicted an outsider would come to aid us in our fight against Hakkar. [commanding] Let it be you, I say!
quest_8069_quest_complete: [delight] At last, someone worthy to wear the illusionist's robe! [warm] Your success in Zul'Gurub has assured your reverences amongst the tribe for ages to come. [proud] Wear it with pride, <name>!
quest_8070_quest_detail:
[solemn] Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe. [soft voice] It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind. [solemn] They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh.

[urgent] Go forth into Zul'Gurub and witness first hand the depravity of Hakkar and the Gurubashi. [commanding] Wrest the Paragons of Power that we seek from them; success will be rewarded!
quest_8070_quest_progress: [solemn] The Paragons of Power... do you have them? [emphasis] Only when we have them will we be able to make use of the latent power stored inside them. [low voice] It will be good to turn the tables on the minions of the Blood God...
quest_8070_quest_complete:
[excited] Success! [solemn] These will go a long way to building up our power against the rise of Hakkar. [warm] With your help, we've taken a significant step in ensuring that the Blood God will not destroy us all.

[proud] You've earned honor with the tribe today, <name>. [warm] Take this - the confessor's bindings - as a symbol of our thanks.
quest_8071_quest_detail:
[solemn] The confessors of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive mantle, marking them as the preservers of the tribe. [soft voice] These mantles are woven with powerful mojo that aids them in judging those who would threaten our tribe. [solemn] As a priest, you too must spend your time judging those worthy and not; such a mantle would definitely be a blessing to you.

[warm] In exchange for fighting Hakkar's minions in Zul'Gurub and bringing me the Paragons of Power I seek, I will give you a mantle worthy of our finest confessors.
quest_8071_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub?
quest_8071_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name> - the minions of Hakkar have surely felt the retribution of the Zandalar today, thanks to you. [proud] Your actions have given you a permanent place of reverence within the tribe. [excited] With our blessing, please take this confessor's mantle as your own!
quest_8072_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of Zandalar's legendary madcaps was Khar'vaxal the Cracked. Legend states that when facing the enemies of the tribe for the first time, Kar'xavan used his mantle specifically woven with "the weave of madness". His form was shrouded not only by the mantle, but also with the blinding speed of his twin daggers. Madcaps today cherish their mantle as a sign of their place in the tribe.

[commanding] Bring to me the Paragons of Power I seek, and such a mantle will be yours to weave madness unto your own enemies.
quest_8072_quest_progress:
[urgent] You've returned - do you have the Paragons of Power I need?

[solemn] The legend of Khar'vaxal the Cracked serves us today as a reminder that no foe - no matter how great a threat they may be - is impossible to overcome. [low voice] Chaos will bring everyone to their knees, that much is certain... and perhaps the most non-chaotic elements of chaos.
quest_8072_quest_complete: [solemn] Victory is ours this day, thanks to the madness you have sowed upon our mutual enemies! [warm] You are to be honored amongst the Zandalar, and there is no better way of showing gratitude for your deeds than by offering you the madcap's mantle!
quest_8073_quest_detail:
[solemn] My eyes failed me long ago, but I do not miss them. Even in a tribe such as ours - where one's vestments convey station and purpose - the most potent of garb exudes power that simple eyes cannot see. [soft voice] The prized tunic of the Zandalar madcap is no exception, exuding the raw power of chaos and madness that they are able to channel.

[pause] The Paragons of Power I need lie in Zul'Gurub; bring me what I seek, and I will reward you with your own legendary tunic... one befitting a weaver of madness.
quest_8073_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome back to the Isle, <name>... [pause] have you returned triumphantly with the Paragons of Power in tow?
quest_8073_quest_complete: [solemn] Impressive... you have accomplished today what few thought was possible. [warm] Your reverence in the tribe is assured for a lifetime, <name>. [proud] You have earned the right to don the madcap's tunic - do so with our blessing.
quest_8074_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Augurs know the mojo of the elements, mon. [solemn] They use it as a means to guide the tribe to glory. [solemn] In the dark days after the Gurubashi Empire ripped itself up, our augurs led us to our safe haven in the South Seas. [soft voice] They've also led us back here to the Vale, right back to the heart of evil brewin' in Zul'Gurub.

[commanding] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. [warm] Do it and I'll give ya a belt that our augurs use - one with powerful mojo inside it!
quest_8074_quest_progress: [solemn] The Paragons of Power are what I need mon - [urgent] we'll tap the power right out of them in our fight against the evil from Zul'Gurub. [soft voice] Do ya have them for me?
quest_8074_quest_complete:
[solemn] I can smell the scent of vanquished evil on ya, <name>. [soft voice] It's a sweet smell mon... one I think you know quite well.

[warm] I know it's no small feat to have brought me the Paragons of Power required for the belt. [proud] Your deeds have not only honored the tribe, but also honored yourself amongst my tribe. [warm] Here ya are - take the augur's belt and don it as your own!
quest_8075_quest_detail:
[solemn] The augurs of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive chest piece called a hauberk. It's fitted with the finest of silks and cloths, interwoven with strong chain. It's a symbol of not only their divinity, but also of their authority, mon. [soft voice] It's never wise to cross one whose life is devoted to speakin' with the spirits...

[urgent] Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. [warm] Do it and I'll give ya one of the finest hauberks our augurs would ever hope to wear!
quest_8075_quest_progress: [solemn] The Paragons of Power are a key source of magic power - the same kind of power that goes into makin' the augur's hauberk. [soft voice] Bring me what I need, and I'll be able to share the finest of vestments any Zandalar augur would be wantin' as their own.
quest_8075_quest_complete:
[solemn] I know what ya had to go through to bring me the Paragons of Power, <name>. [warm] It wasn't easy, mon - defeatin' the evil that seeps out of Zul'Gurub like a foul ooze - but now that it is all said and done, I can easily say that you'll be revered amongst the Zandalar for ages to come!

[excited] Here - take the augur's hauberk and wear it with pride!
quest_8076_quest_detail:
[solemn] The demoniac seeks to embody power outright, not just possess it. [pause] More than one of our demoniacs has lost a fight with a demon; with our enemies threatening us - especially in Zul'Gurub - the power that a demoniac is able to unleash on our foes is worth the sacrifice. [urgent] Our survival depends on crushing those who would destroy us; the fall of the Gurubashi Empire taught us this.

[solemn] Travel to Zul'Gurub and gain the Paragons of Power we need. [commanding] Do this, and a valuable demoniac item shall be yours.
quest_8076_quest_progress: [solemn] Retrieved the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub? [soft voice] While we will take the latent power from these items and make them our own, [pause] we will give you your own reward of power should you be successful...
quest_8076_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done, <name>. The Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub should act as a reminder of wasted power. The Gurubashi were strong at their height, but they allowed themselves to be consumed by it. [soft voice] A demoniac knows that the game they play is much similar, but the power unleashed is often the very thing needed for survival.

[warm] Use this mantle as an honored ally of the Zandalar... it will serve you well.
quest_8077_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ultimate symbol of power amongst the tribe is the garb we wear in battle. [soft voice] A demoniac's robes have fused fine runecloth and devastatingly powerful mojo into a single fabric. [solemn] The visage of the robe is said to instill fear into the minds of all who see it... especially the demons that the demoniac will eventually dominate.

[urgent] From Zul'Gurub, you must bring me a very specific set of the Paragons of Power. [hesitant] It will be difficult... [confident] but your success will assure you of acquiring a robe for yourself.
quest_8077_quest_progress: [solemn] The Paragons of Power... you have returned with them? Only once we have them will we share the ultimate symbol of demoniac power with you, <name>.
quest_8077_quest_complete:
[solemn] Impressive - your victory in Zul'Gurub has assured us - nay, the world - that Hakkar will not prevail. [soft voice] The time may come when you face the Blood God directly... and should this come to pass know that your reverence is assured amongst the Zandalar tribe.

[warm] Oh, and this simple robe should help out too I think. <Al'tabim winks knowingly at you.>
quest_8078_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ultimate vengeance waits within Zul'Gurub. [low voice] Hakkar must not rise again. Hakkar destroyed the Gurubashi Empire from within. [sad] No sacrifice was enough. [solemn] The trolls are a shadow of former glories. [solemn] I know this is because of Hakkar.

[commanding] Become the vindicator you were meant to be. [urgent] Wreak havoc on the minions of evil. [commanding] Zul'Gurub must taste Zandalar vengeance. [commanding] Bring me proof in the Paragons of Power. [warm] You will receive the vindicator's belt. [proud] You will receive real power.

[urgent] Go.
quest_8078_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you brought the Paragons of Power? [commanding] Have you struck down the enemies of the tribe? [angry] Hakkar must know the wrath of the vindicator!
quest_8078_quest_complete:
[solemn] The way of the vindicator is now known to you. [warm] You have brought honor to the tribe. [warm] You have brought honor to yourself. [commanding] You have brought pain to our enemies.

[proud] The vindicator's belt is yours. [proud] You are surely becoming one with the way of the vindicator.
quest_8079_quest_detail:
[solemn] The vindicator's symbol of power is the breastplate. [soft voice] It is forged with powerful mojo. [solemn] It is trusted only to those we revere. [solemn] It is the Zandalar symbol of vengeance.

[commanding] To become a vindicator is to become vengeance. [urgent] Take the Paragons of Power we need from Zul'Gurub. [commanding] Bring them to us. [commanding] We will take the mojo stolen from us. [threatening] We will make the minions of Hakkar pay. [warm] We will reward you with the vindicator's breastplate.

[commanding] Go. [commanding] Be our vengeance, <name>.
quest_8079_quest_progress: [commanding] Your presence means victory? Do you have the Paragons of Power? [angry] Tell me of the vengeance you have wrought today!
quest_8079_quest_complete:
[solemn] You are to be revered for your deeds. The tribe rewards its heroes. [solemn] Zul'Gurub has tasted Zandalar vengeance like never before.

[solemn] Your deeds will herald the deeds of others to come. [solemn] They will look upon you as a sign of real power. [solemn] They will look upon you as vengeance personified!
quest_8080_quest_detail:
[commanding] War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. [emphasis] They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!

[solemn] That is why Arathi Basin is important. [soft voice] There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.

[warm] That is what I want from you, <name>. [urgent] Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
quest_8080_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Marks of Honor, <name>? [soft voice] The League of Arathor can't fight a decent battle without them...
quest_8080_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the Mark! Great job! [warm] I'll send the ressources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.

[proud] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.
quest_8081_quest_detail:
[commanding] War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. [emphasis] They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!

[solemn] That is why Arathi Basin is important. [soft voice] There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.

[urgent] That is what I want from you, <name>. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
quest_8081_quest_progress: [commanding] <name>, the League of Arathor has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more resource crates and bring them to me.
quest_8081_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good. [urgent] I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.

[warm] Once again, thank you <name>. [proud] Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by footman and field marshal alike.
quest_8101_quest_complete:
<race>, the pebble held within the frame of this talisman comes from Mount Kajaro in the South Seas. Mount Kajaro is an area plagued by volatility - marked by violent and oftentimes magical volcanic eruptions.

As your bond with the trolls of Zandalar grows, so too shall the power of this pebble. [solemn] Harness the power of the pebble to strike down our enemies. [commanding] Be like the mountain: Quick, explosive, deadly...
quest_8102_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome back, <class>. I can see that the pebble has seen much use. [solemn] Many of our foes have fallen to your otherworldly abilities. [sad] Their suffering has been great. [soft voice] It is time that I enhance the power of the pebble. [commanding] Give it to me. Pebble of Kajaro
quest_8102_quest_complete: [solemn] Be unstoppable, like the molten fronts of Kajaro.
quest_8103_quest_progress:
[solemn] Hakkari fear you, <name>. They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. [commanding] You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. [solemn] They now know fear in two places.

[urgent] It is time to further strengthen the pebble. [commanding] Hand me the talisman. [solemn] Pebble of Kajaro
quest_8103_quest_complete: [commanding] Continue in your decimation of the trolls of Zul'Gurub. [solemn] Hakkar must see that the world will not buckle beneath his indomitable will.
quest_8104_quest_progress: [commanding] Give me the talisman, <name>. [solemn] I must show you something. [soft voice] Pebble of Kajaro
quest_8104_quest_complete: <Al'tabim shatters the pebble with a powerful unseen force.> [solemn] Do you see? The pebble is what we call a geode. [soft voice] Inside the pebble are powerful crystals that have been soaking in the latent energies from our world. [emphasis] By cutting the pebble in half, I have finally allowed its full potential to be realized. [commanding] Use it to lay waste to our enemies.
quest_8105_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. [commanding] Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. [urgent] I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base.

[commanding] Assault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. [emphasis] Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!

[commanding] When you have done this to all four points, return to me.
quest_8105_quest_complete: [solemn] I received reports of your exploits in Arathi Basin, <name>. [warm] Well done! With those like you joining the struggles here, I have faith that we will one day retake our homelands.
quest_8106_quest_complete:
[commanding voice] Accept this talisman, <class>. [emphasis] Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies.

[solemn] Know that around your neck you carry a piece of history. [soft voice] Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. [sad] Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters.

[solemn] Kezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but [emphasis] know that before the taint, it held greatness. [solemn] Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.
quest_8107_quest_progress:
[solemn] Honor is earned amongst the Zandalar trolls, <name>. [soft voice] With honor comes reward - friendship, alliance...

Hand me the talisman so that I may enhance its power. [commanding] Kezan's Taint
quest_8107_quest_complete: [commanding] Draw from the darkness, <class>. [soft voice] Embrace the shadows. [solemn] Let Kezan's Taint supplement your dark meddling.
quest_8108_quest_progress:
[commanding] I am ready for you, <class>. [solemn] Once more I will enhance your talisman. [solemn] I only ask that you continue in your destruction of Hakkar and his minions.

[urgent] Give me the talisman. [cold] Kezan's Taint
quest_8108_quest_complete: [solemn] It is only through our combined efforts that we will stop the Soulflayer.
quest_8109_quest_progress:
[commanding] Call forth your demons, <class>. [urgent] Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. [commanding] Command them on the field of battle! [angry] Decimate the enemy!

[whispering] Yes... [solemn] The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman. [cold] Kezan's Taint
quest_8109_quest_complete: [commanding] Flay the flesh from their corpses. [whispering] Watch as the shadows consume the Hakkari. [urgent] Draw power from their fear, <class>. [soft voice] Let Kezan's Taint augment this power...
quest_8110_quest_complete:
[soft voice] See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. [solemn] We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner.

[warm] You a <class> so it be easy, mon. [gentle] Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.
quest_8111_quest_progress: [excited] Hey mon! It be good to see you again. The tribe be talking about your killin' of the Hakkari and all that. Molthor gave me the word to be adding more mojo to your talisman. Just give it here and Maywiki make it better. Enchanted South Seas Kelp
quest_8111_quest_complete: [commanding] The neck piece not be for smokin', mon! [urgent] You got to use it to fight evil.
quest_8112_quest_progress: [soft voice] How be that talisman, mon? It look like it be time to add a little more magic and mojo to its leaves. [pause] It need a little bloom in its wilt. Give it here and Maywiki fix it right up. [warm] Enchanted South Seas Kelp
quest_8112_quest_complete: [commanding] Now you take the evil trolls in Zul'Gurub and show them what your nature powers can do, mon!
quest_8113_quest_progress: <name>! [excited] It been a long time since I seen you. [solemn] Did you know that King Rastakhan himself be givin' me the order to add the final bit of mojo and magic to your talisman? [excited] It be true, mon! [soft voice] I wouldn't have believed it had I not seen it with me own eyes. [urgent] Give it here. [solemn] Enchanted South Seas Kelp
quest_8113_quest_complete: <name> mon, it been a good journey. [warm] Keep on with the killing and suppressing of Hakkar and he minions.
quest_8114_quest_detail:
<name>, you have taken the battle of Arathi Basin to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle. You have shown us your worth as a <class>, and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy!

Because of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you. I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in Arathi Basin. If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the Horde our dominance!

Go, <name>, and good fortune.
quest_8114_quest_progress: [commanding] You have not yet taken four bases, <name>. [urgent] Return to Arathi Basin and do as you have been tasked!
quest_8114_quest_complete:
[commanding] Very good work, <name>! [warm] An excited scout came to me with a report of your exploits. [warm] We in the League of Arathor are very pleased!

[warm] You are swiftly becoming a local hero among the soldiers in the League, and today's deed once again proves your sterling reputation.
quest_8115_quest_detail:
<name>, battling for the resources of Arathi Basin is a bloody undertaking. [solemn] Your services to the League of Arathor are as needed as they are appreciated.

[urgent] And we have one more task for you.

[commanding] The League wishes to make one strong push against the Defilers' occupation of Arathi Basin. [shouting] We want them driven out of every strategic point on the battlefield!

[hesitant] It will not be easy, but if anyone can get it done, it is you.
quest_8115_quest_progress: [commanding] You have not yet completed your mission, <name>. [solemn] It is difficult, but my faith in you is strong.
quest_8115_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! You took all of the bases! [warm] Well done, <name>!

[proud] There were those who doubted your chances, but I knew you could do it. [solemn] Thank you, and know that the League of Arathor holds you in high regard, just as the Defilers of the Forsaken must fear the very mention of your name!
quest_8116_quest_complete:
[gentle] You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be <class>! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring.

[warm] As a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. [excited] Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! [delight] Let it lift your spirits!
quest_8117_quest_progress:
[excited] Good news, <name>. Molthor be singin' your praises lately. He say how you be turnin' into a real hero of Zandalar.

He also say for Maywiki to polish your orb some more! Give it here so Maywiki can brighten the vision. Vision of Voodress
quest_8117_quest_complete: Beware the evil Hakkari spirits, mon. [soft voice] Honestly, they be spooky.
quest_8118_quest_progress:
[excited] Sha-mon! Maywiki make a joke!

<Maywiki laughs.>

So, you been using the spirits and elements against our enemies in Zul'Gurub, eh? Spirits be praised!

[warm] Maywiki gonna brighten your orb. Give it here, <name>. Vision of Voodress
quest_8118_quest_complete: [soft voice] Take a look at it now, <name>. [solemn] Voodress come in even clearer now, yea? [warm] Let the primal power flow through you, mon.
quest_8119_quest_progress:
<Maywiki points to your talisman.> [urgent] Look at it, <name>! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb.

Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment. Vision of Voodress
quest_8119_quest_complete: [solemn] One day, <name>, you will be able to use this orb to communicate directly with me. [soft voice] Whenever this battle with Hakkar be over and Maywiki go home. [gentle] Let us call to the spirits and ask them for that day to come soon.
quest_8120_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin. [urgent] Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. [angry] We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!

[commanding] Go to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. [urgent] Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde.

[commanding] Go, <name>. [solemn] Report back to me when this task is complete.
quest_8120_quest_complete: [solemn] A Defiler scout came to me with a report of your success, <name>. [warm] Well done. [commanding] As you will learn, to win the battle for Arathi Basin, we must be ever vigilant and crush any attempts at Alliance expansion. [urgent] Do this, and our victory here is ensured.
quest_8121_quest_detail:
<name>, as the battles over Arathi Basin rage, news of your actions have reached many ears. You are highly regarded among us, which gives me confidence that you will accomplish the mission I now have for you.

[solemn] It is time to send a message to the League of Arathor. We must show them that their holdings in Arathi Basin are tenuous and quickly lost. [commanding] We will show them this by holding, all at once, four strategic points in Arathi Basin.

[confident] Succeed in this, <name>, and earn great respect among the Defilers.
quest_8121_quest_progress: [urgent] Return to Arathi Basin, <name>, and perform the task for which you were sent to do! [commanding] Capture and hold four bases!
quest_8121_quest_complete: [warm] Good work, <name>! [proud] Your latest actions in Arathi Basin were quite difficult, and so their successes are quite praiseworthy. [solemn] The League of Arathor must be reeling from the last skirmishes in the basin, licking their wounds and, let us hope, rethinking their choice to fight here.
quest_8122_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is difficult to see, so deep we are in the conflict, but our spies report a weakening in the League of Arathor's resolve. [urgent] We must use this window and strike a brutal blow against them! [commanding] Return to Arathi Basin and throw yourself against our foes. [angry] Curse them and kill them and control all five strategic bases! [threatening] Send their soldiers screaming and bleeding from the front lines, with stories of your cruelty on their mewling lips.

[cold] Do this, and score a great victory for the Defilers.
quest_8122_quest_progress: [urgent] Return to Arathi Basin, <name>, and perform the task for which you were sent to do! [commanding] Capture and hold all five bases!
quest_8122_quest_complete:
[solemn] The cries of the Alliance as you and your compatriots attacked them could be heard even from here, <name>. [low voice] I can almost pity them for the pain and fear you delivered to their ranks. Almost, but not quite.

[cold] Your value to the Defilers is without question. [proud] Your deeds in Arathi Basin have been most impressive, and have echoed among the chambers of Varimathras... and the Dark Lady herself.
quest_8123_quest_detail:
[solemn] The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. [urgent] We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

You can help us, <name>. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the Mark of Honor you gain.
quest_8123_quest_progress: [commanding] What is it, <race>? Do you have the Marks of Honor? [urgent] Go back to Arathi Basin, slay the Alliance vermine and take possession of its ressources for the Dark Lady!
quest_8123_quest_complete: <Deathstalker Mortis smiles> [solemn] Another decisive blow has been dealt against our enemies, <name>. [warm] Thanks to your deeds, Arathi Basin is soon to be taken hold of by the Defilers.
quest_8124_quest_detail:
[solemn] The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. [urgent] We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

[commanding] You can help us, <name>. [solemn] Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. [commanding] Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
quest_8124_quest_progress: <name>, the Defilers has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, [commanding] procure more resource crates and bring them to me.
quest_8124_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.

[warm] Once again, thank you <name>. [proud] Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by grunt and high warlord alike.
quest_8141_quest_complete:
[solemn] You progress swiftly, young <class>. [solemn] Perhaps it is time to initiate you into the Shera Ali'kh - Zandalari for Death's Hand. [solemn] For thousands of years we have played the role of assassin for the Zandalar Empire. [solemn] For too long we have sat idly, allowing the Hakkari to grow in strength. [solemn] Once more we face Hakkar, but this time without the support of a united <race> front. [urgent] It is you and your allies who must assist in vanquishing the Blood God and his minions!

[warm] Wear this talisman and let it assist you in your journeys.
quest_8142_quest_progress: [commanding] Impressive, <name>. [solemn] You have a gift for killing that I have not sensed in another in many years. [soft voice] Even Molthor is aware of the work that you have done for Zandalar. [urgent] It is time to enhance your talisman further. Give it to me. Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
quest_8142_quest_complete: [solemn] There is only one enhancement left that can be placed on the talisman, <class>. [soft voice] When the time is right, I shall apply that enhancement.
quest_8143_quest_progress:
I sense that you have dealt countless fatalities to the Hakkari, <name>. You carry the stink of their mojo.

I assume the Shadow talisman has assisted in the culling? [urgent] Give it to me and allow me to enhance its power. Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
quest_8143_quest_complete: [solemn] An assassin of your caliber should be given a wide berth. [commanding] Your foes must learn respect! [threatening] You will get just that when the enemy sees the glint of Death's Hand - all too late...
quest_8144_quest_progress: [solemn] It yearns to grow, <name>. [whispering] The talisman has soaked in all that you have done. [low voice] The thousands of troll corpses littering Zul'Gurub have fueled its power. [commanding] Hand it to me and I shall make the final enhancement. [solemn voice] Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
quest_8144_quest_complete: [solemn] This is the last time we will speak under the auspices of Shera Ali'kh. You know all that you must. Take the talisman and continue in your slaying. [commanding] Hakkar must never be allowed to leave Zul'Gurub.
quest_8145_quest_complete:
[solemn] Amongst the Zandalarians, the profession of <class> is revered. [solemn] Our greatest hunters travel to the edge of the Maelstrom to prove their resolution.

[soft voice] From the heart of the sea they pull strands of kelp known as Maelstrom Tendrils. [soft voice] The kelp is then woven into a talisman that is enchanted to improve their accuracy and power.

[warm] I now grant you a single weaving of the Maelstrom's Tendril. [warm] As your bond with Zandalar grows, I shall weave more power into the talisman.
quest_8146_quest_progress:
[commanding] Even from here I can hear the sound of your volleys laying waste to our enemies. [sad] Their cries echo in agony.

[warm] You have made quite a name for yourself among the trolls of Zandalar, <name>. [solemn] We are grateful for all that you have done.

[urgent] Hand me your talisman so that I may add another weave. [whispering] Maelstrom's Tendril
quest_8146_quest_complete: [solemn] There is only one more weave that I will be able to add to your talisman, <class>
quest_8147_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Ah, <name>, it is good to smell you again.

<Falthir grins.>

[whispering] You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times.

[solemn] I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. [angry] The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. [delight] This is most excellent.

[warm] You have earned another weave on your talisman. [commanding] Hand it to me. [pause] Maelstrom's Tendril
quest_8147_quest_complete: [solemn] Let them seek atonement at the end of your munitions.
quest_8148_quest_progress: Molthor delivers word from King Rastakhan, <name>. [solemn] The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. [solemn] I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. [commanding] Hand it to me. [urgent] Maelstrom's Tendril
quest_8148_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your journey has only just begun, young <class>. Perhaps one day you will visit the Maelstrom and glance into the heart of the world.

[warm] I wish you power and fortitude!
quest_8149_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The Alliance acknowledges many heroes, but none weave a more tragic tale than that of Uther Lightbringer.

Help us honor Uther by taking this offering to his tomb in the Western Plaguelands. Place it at his statue, and then return to me. [urgent] I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Uther his tribute.
quest_8149_quest_progress:
[solemn] Have you made the journey to Uther's Tomb and placed the tribute there?

[soft voice] It can be a dangerous trip for less experienced adventurers; [pause] a safer way of traveling there, relatively speaking, may be to travel north from the river that runs through Hillsbrad into the Plaguelands. [low voice] It flows from a lake that is adjacent to Sorrow Hill; [pause] travel west up through the hills, steering clear of the adjacent tomb... [whispering] one that is infested with the Scourge.
quest_8149_quest_complete:
[solemn] He was a hero among heroes, Uther was. I can't even begin to imagine the anguish of what he felt when Arthas - his greatest student and someone whom Uther loved like his own son - betrayed all of humanity. Still, he rose to try and stop Arthas, and for that he will be forever remembered as a true paladin. His fight was to the end, thinking only of those he might save.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
quest_8150_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The Horde acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than Grom Hellscream.

[solemn] Help us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale. Place it at the base, and then return to me. [urgent] I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.
quest_8150_quest_progress:
[solemn] Have you made the journey to Grom's Monument and placed his tribute there?

The site where the monument is still touched by the taint of the Burning Legion. [urgent] Should you be less experienced in the ways of adventuring, be on your toes when approaching the monument.
quest_8150_quest_complete:
[solemn] Grom's full name - Grommash - means "The Giant's Heart"; it took that and more to stand alone against Mannoroth. [soft voice] I think the Warchief said it best when the curse of the orcs began and ended with Grom. [solemn] Fitting that Grom's sacrifice - and perhaps redemption - would be the wellspring from which the Horde flows today.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
quest_8151_quest_detail: [solemn] Ogtinc of Azshara has sent out a call for seasoned hunters such as yourself. [soft voice] He is a furbolg hunter who has left his tribe to aid the Cenarion Circle. [pause] His teachings are meant to enrich the wisdom of others who share his craft, and guide them toward maintaining a balance. [gentle] You would do well to speak with him.
quest_8154_quest_detail:
[commanding] War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. [emphasis] They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!

[solemn] That is why Arathi Basin is important. [soft voice] There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.

[warm] That is what I want from you, <name>. [urgent] Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a Mark of Honor.
quest_8154_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Marks of Honor, <name>? [low voice] The League of Arathor can't fight a decent battle without them...
quest_8154_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the Mark! Great job! I'll send the ressources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.

quest_8166_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. [soft voice] Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. quest_8181_quest_detail:
[solemn] My delvings into the Mosh'aru Tablets bear grim news, <name>. [angry] Hakkar's true form, the god himself, can be born again through the very egg into which you captured him. [whispering] Yeh'kinya told you it was to contain his evil, but it is to recreate it! [shouting] The troll has led you astray!

[urgent] Go to Yeh'kinya and demand the egg from him. [solemn] Pray that it is not too late to stop Hakkar's return!
quest_8181_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you have been speaking with that old dwarf Ironboot and uncovered the lost Mosh'aru Tablets, have you? [angry] That meddling prospector...

No matter. [sad] It is too late to save this world. [urgent] Hakkar has been reborn, and even now grows in power... deep in the ancient troll kingdom of Zul'Gurub! [shouting] He has come! And he will rule in blood and terror!

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Your help has sped the return of the Soulflayer!
quest_8182_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] our worst fears have come. [solemn] Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute. [urgent] If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of Azeroth!

[soft voice] There is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness. [soft voice] They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda. [soft voice] Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.
quest_8182_quest_complete:
[solemn] You were sent by the prospector, Ironboot? His kind are wise, and wiser still to bring you to me, for I and the Zandalarian trolls may know a way to defeat the Soulflayer.

[urgent] Speak with the trolls of this isle, heed their words, and prepare yourself, <name>, for the task before you is soaked in blood.
quest_8183_quest_detail: [solemn] The Heart of Hakkar burns from within. [soft voice] Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
quest_8183_quest_progress: <name>, [solemn] the reek of an evil soul surrounds you. [soft voice] Have you been cursed by the Soulflayer?
quest_8183_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Heart of Hakkar. [excited] So the Soulflayer has been slain! [warm] Our world is saved!

[proud] <name>, your service to us cannot be overstated. [warm] You truly are a hero of this realm!
quest_8184_quest_detail:
[solemn] Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components.

[soft voice] The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord.

[whispering] The second is a punctured voodoo doll. [pause] These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. [urgent] Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles.
quest_8184_quest_progress: [commanding] Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
quest_8184_quest_complete: [commanding] Use it well, <class>. [angry] Show the Hakkari no mercy!

[excited] Today between 2pm and 4pm we have a contest to determine who the greatest angler of them all is! [urgent] Just be the FIRST PERSON to bring me 40 Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coast of Stranglethorn before anyone else does and you will be declared the Master Angler!

[soft voice] If you are not the first person to bring me 40 fish, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for each 5 Tastyfish you bring her.

[urgent] Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly! [emphasis] Speckled Tastyfish(40)
quest_8193_quest_complete: [urgent] Hurry up and turn those in if you want to be declared the Master Angler! [angry] I have been standing around here for HOURS with nothing to eat! [shouting] Hand those suckers over!
quest_8194_quest_progress: [soft voice] Even though we already have a contest winner, I will still buy your Tastyfish from you at a reasonable price. [excited] Whadda ya say! [emphasis] Speckled Tastyfish(5)
quest_8194_quest_complete: [excited] This deal works for me if it works for you!
quest_8195_quest_detail:
[solemn] I seek the Paragons of Power known as the Coins of the Tribes. They are the currency used by the various denizens of Zul'Gurub, and each is imbued with subtle but powerful mojo.

[soft voice] There are nine distinct kinds to be found. Some are sought after by my compatriots for various armors they offer Zandalar heroes. [urgent] Should you have any extra, I will trade you one of our Honor Tokens for a set of three. You may use the Tokens with Rin'wosho the Trader; he offers our heroes special items for them.
quest_8195_quest_progress:

[pause] There are nine distinct kinds to be found. [urgent] Some are sought after by my compatriots for various armors they offer Zandalar heroes. [soft voice] You may use the Tokens with Rin'wosho the Trader; he offers our heroes special items for them. [solemn] Zulian Coin [solemn] Razzashi Coin [solemn] Hakkari Coin
quest_8195_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent - this set of coins will make a fine addition to our growing collection... [solemn] one that we will use in the tribe's defense against the rise of the Blood God. [proud] You've earned this Honor Token, <name>, as well as the thanks of the tribe!
quest_8196_quest_progress:
[solemn] The extremely potent essence mango grows across many of the islands in the South Seas. [soft voice] A single mango will refresh those who eat it, both physically and mentally. [excited] If you've never had one, you do yourself a disservice!

[warm] We have enough of a supply here on the isle to offer you a handful in exchange for a Zandalar Honor Token. [commanding] Speak with Vinchaxa if you need to learn how to get tokens; otherwise, let's get to the business at hand! Zandalar Honor Token
quest_8196_quest_complete: [gentle] A fair trade, my friend - [warm] please enjoy the luscious fruits of the South Seas, with the tribe's blessing.
quest_8201_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is true. Hakkar now dwells in Zul'Gurub, bathing in the power of our gods. Enthralled high priests now channel the energies of our most sacred divinities into the Soulflayer, who will soon have a strength beyond any being of Azeroth. [urgent] He must be stopped!

Take this sacred cord, and string through it the heads of the high priests responsible for channeling our gods' energy.

When you have done this, return to me.
quest_8201_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the collection of heads, <name>? [commanding] We must stop Hakkar from gaining more power!
quest_8201_quest_complete:
[excited] You gained the heads! [proud] You have halted the plundering of our gods' power, and weakened Hakkar!

[warm] Your actions are truly heroic, <name>. [solemn] May the heads of these troll thralls plead to you for mercy long after their blood chills.

It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one!

[warm] So, <name>, I need glowing scorpid blood. [urgent] You can find it from the scorpids of Sillithus, or the Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes. [emphasis] Glowing Scorpid Blood(10)
quest_8222_quest_complete:

quest_8228_quest_complete: [excited] There be a Fishin Contest in Booty Bay this Sunday! [warm] Here are the rules for ya!
quest_8229_quest_complete: [excited] There is a Fishing Contest in Booty Bay this Sunday! [urgent] Here are the rules for you!
quest_8233_quest_detail: [solemn] Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence. [whispering] The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.
quest_8234_quest_detail:
[solemn] First things first. What I've lost is a small blue bag, the contents of which are a private matter.

[angry] Don't bother going after the thieves, because they are already dead. [soft voice] What we do know is the fools couldn't get the bag open. so they sold it to some timbermaw shaman in Azshara as a holy relic. [mocking tone] Clever. [commanding] I need you to travel to Azshara and retrieve it from the shaman through subtlety... or force. [hesitant] Better luck with the first method, I'd wager. [urgent] Once acquired, take it to Archmage Xylem.
quest_8234_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you have Lord Ravenholdt's bag. [soft voice] Why didn't you say so, boy?
quest_8235_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lord Ravenholdt has asked a favor of us both. [soft voice] He wishes to remove the enchantment from this bag.

[sad] Unfortunately, some of my books on the subject of dispelling were taken recently, only to be destroyed by savages. [solemn] The remains of my books are still valuable to me.

[urgent] If you can bring me enough of the encoded fragments, I can piece them back together. [commanding] Your best chance is to kill the beasts of Azshara, since they have a tendency to pick up just about anything.
quest_8235_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found enough fragments to continue my work?
quest_8235_quest_complete: [soft voice] It looks like you picked up some of the better fragments. [warm] Perhaps you aren't worthless after all.
quest_8236_quest_detail:
[solemn] It will take some time to decipher the fragments and remove the enchantment. [soft voice] When I am complete, I'll deliver the bag to Lord Ravenholdt personally.

[low voice] There is still the matter of the key, said to be held by a green drake known as Morphaz. [solemn] The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the Swamp of Sorrows.

[commanding] Gather your friends and venture to his lair. [warm] Lord Ravenholdt will await your return with the key.
quest_8236_quest_progress: [soft voice] The bag has already arrived from Archmage Xylem, have you found the key?
quest_8236_quest_complete: [delight] The key! I thought it lost forever. [warm] Please, take an enchanted garment from my stores -- they are reserved for rogues of exceptional skill and loyalty. [proud] It should be known that <name> is not to be trifled with! <Jorach opens the bag and is bathed by a golden glow from within. His eyes widen and he stares...>

[solemn] The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves!

[urgent] Take any one of the bijous that you find in Zul'Gurub to the Altar of Zanza and destroy it. [warm] For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive.

[excited] Witness for yourself the blessings of Zanza!
quest_8240_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you destroyed the bijou at the Altar of Zanza? [urgent] Do so, and then you will be doubly blessed by Zanza!
quest_8240_quest_complete:
[solemn] Excellent... each bijou we wrest away from the Blood God's minions is one step closer we all are to finally defeating them once and for all. [warm] You bring honor to the Zandalar - and yourself - through your noble actions.

Remember <name>, you may always destroy the bijous you find in Zul'Gurub at the altar. [excited] For each one, you will gain recognition and an Honor Token! [urgent] Just remember to have an open space in your inventory if you don't have one of the tokens already.
quest_8241_quest_progress:

*Coal. [loud voice] I'll take all that you can offer!

*Incendosaur scales. *Heavy Leather.

*Coal. [loud voice] I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood. [emphasis] Incendosaur Scale(2)Heavy Leather(10)Coal
quest_8242_quest_complete: [commanding] There's always room for more fiery flux, junior. [low voice] Keep it comin'... unless I tell you to stop.
quest_8243_quest_progress:
[soft voice] With your increased status amongst the tribe comes access to some of our more potent potables. [solemn] Behold... [emphasis] these brews are strong in the mojo—blessed by Zanza and fit for adventurers from all walks of life!

[warm] I will allow you to choose one from the three I offer; in exchange, I require a single Zandalar Honor Token. [commanding] Note that only the effects of a single one may course through your spirit at any given time. Zandalar Honor Token
quest_8243_quest_complete: [gentle] A fair trade, my friend - [warm] please enjoy the blessings of Zanza with our compliments!
quest_8246_quest_progress:
<name> - for someone as exalted among the Zandalar as you are, I have something very special for you. Direct from our home in the South Seas... [excited] the Signets of the Zandalar! These signets are used to enhance any shoulder item you may possess. Should you seek might, mojo, or serenity - I have what you need!

I ask for fifteen Zandalar Honor Tokens in exchange for your choice of one signet. If you have the tokens ready, then I'm ready to make a deal! Zandalar Honor Token(15)
quest_8246_quest_complete: [delight] A fair trade, my friend - please accept your signet with the blessing of the tribe!
quest_8249_quest_progress:
[commanding] My rogues must sharpen their lock‑picking craft, and I need Precise Lock Cylinders — the sort of high‑precision mechanisms Zan's beginner parts can't challenge.

[urgent] Seek out Heavy Junkboxes, crack them open, and harvest the Precise Lock Cylinders hidden inside.

Return 5 Precise Lock Cylinders to me, and I'll reward you with some of the finest throwing knives ever forged for roguekind. [warm] Precise Lock Cylinder(5)
quest_8249_quest_complete:
[solemn] May these knives find a place in someone's heart.

[whispering] Literally.
quest_8250_quest_detail: [low voice] Archmage Xylem has been asking around lately... [soft voice] for someone of your experience.
quest_8251_quest_detail:
[solemn] The blood elves in Azshara have developed a method for pulverizing the magical items they acquire. This glittering dust they produce differs from the components normally acquired by a disenchantment spell.

[sad] When I sent my apprentice to trade for the dust, he was killed without hesitation. [angry] For that, they must pay.

[commanding] The time for talk is over, <name>. [urgent] Find the blood elves along the cliffs of Azshara and use more "persuasive" methods to acquire their glittering dust.
quest_8251_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>! [soft voice] It never ceases to amaze me how persuasive a volley of arcane missiles can be.
quest_8252_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Take a look around you. The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash. [solemn] Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to Azshara.

Specifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me. [urgent] Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research. I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.
quest_8252_quest_progress: [soft voice] The spitelash sirens are surprisingly adept mages. [hesitant] Not as adept as you, I hope?
quest_8252_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is a superb specimen of coral, <name>. [proud] Your skills are unquestionably precise and deadly.

[warm] Do not think your efforts have gone unnoticed. [commanding] Perhaps you are worthy of a true test of your skill...
quest_8253_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.

[sad] Years ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole. [pause] While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.

[urgent] You must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple. [commanding] Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.
quest_8253_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you slain my old nemesis?
quest_8253_quest_complete:
[solemn] Incredible. The shard has grown as it absorbed the drake's energy over the long years.

[pause] There is no more I can ask of you now. [warm] My full ability to forge the arcane has returned with this shard. [proud] My first creation is yours, <name>, and you have but to choose...
quest_8254_quest_detail: [solemn] It is the way of the divine to help those in need. [soft voice] The how is insignificant -- only the why matters.
quest_8257_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the blood of Morphaz?
quest_8257_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have slain Morphaz and carried his blood to us... [soft voice] I can hardly believe this good news!

[warm] We will combine the ingredients at once and begin healing the trees and creatures of Felwood. [pause] It will take a lifetime to undo what has happened here, but [proud] you have given us the means to do it.
quest_8258_quest_detail:
[solemn] Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance. [threatening] He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! [urgent] This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

[commanding] Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions. [urgent] Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. [angry] <name>, bring me his head! [solemn] Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!
quest_8258_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is critical, <name> - [pause] have you succeeded in stopping Death Knight Darkreaver's threat?
quest_8258_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is a victory to savor, <name>! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm.

[warm] You have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. [proud] You are truly a <class> of worth, my friend.

I know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.
quest_8260_quest_complete:
[confident] You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>. [warm] As a reward, please take this care package! [soft voice] Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Arathi Basin.

[solemn] As you continue to prove yourself inside the Basin, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. [solemn] Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.
quest_8261_quest_complete:
[confident] You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>. [warm] As a reward, please take this care package! [soft voice] Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Arathi Basin.

[solemn] As you continue to prove yourself inside the Basin, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. [solemn] Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

quest_8266_quest_detail:
[solemn] I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... [soft voice] even if you weren't able to win this time.
quest_8266_quest_complete: [solemn] Well, you did not flee in the face of defeat. [warm] You stood your ground, <name>, and when it comes right down to it, that is what makes for a true hero. [soft voice] No doubt you will win next time... but nonetheless we thank you for your effort.
quest_8267_quest_detail:
[solemn] I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Outriders may reward you for acting on our behalf... [soft voice] even if you weren't able to win this time.
