quest_8269_quest_detail:
[solemn] I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. [soft voice] Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

[pause] Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. [warm] Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you weren't able to win this time.
quest_8269_quest_complete: [solemn] Well, you did not flee in the face of defeat. [warm] You stood your ground, <name>, and when it comes right down to it, that is what makes for a true hero. [soft voice] No doubt you will win next time... but nonetheless we thank you for your effort.
quest_8271_quest_detail:
[solemn] The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew.

[commanding] We must show them our might!

[soft voice] We have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. [emphasis] The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known.

[angry] Death to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! [urgent] Slay him and return.
quest_8271_quest_progress: Be warned, soldier: The Frostwolf also hunt for Korrak.
quest_8271_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. With Korrak dead, our full attention can be focused upon purging the Frostwolf filth from the region.
quest_8272_quest_detail:
[solemn] The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. [low voice] The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power.

[commanding] They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast.

[urgent] A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. [excited] Slay the beast and be rewarded!
quest_8272_quest_progress: [commanding] Be warned, soldier, the Stormpike also hunt for Korrak.
quest_8272_quest_complete: [solemn] Only the invading Stormpike armies remain, soldier. [proud] Well done!
quest_8273_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Now isn't this interesting? You say you found this tablet on a small, deserted island at The Overlook Cliffs in The Hinterlands, <class>? Very interesting indeed. <Oran carefully puts the tablet away and rubs her hands together.>

[solemn] I thank you for your efforts in this matter. Our Dark Lady shall be very pleased with this discovery. [warm] Here, allow me to reward you proportionately.
quest_8275_quest_detail:
[urgent] Attention, heroes of the Alliance! [solemn] The silithid menace has been left unchecked for too long. [solemn] Unfettered by any real opposition, they've been preparing all this time for a large-scale expansion.

[urgent] Cenarion Circle forces are gathering in Silithus to take the fight to these wretched creatures and all able-bodied adventurers are hereby called to join us!

[urgent] Don't wait until it's too late! [urgent] Aid us in the defense of Azeroth! [urgent] Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold for specific instructions!
quest_8275_quest_complete: [solemn] Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. [warm] Welcome to Cenarion Hold, <class>. [soft voice] I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. [warm] You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.
quest_8276_quest_detail:
[commanding] Attention, champions of the Horde! [solemn] There's a threat we've left unchallenged for too long. [urgent] Tremors in the earth near silithid hives all around Azeroth have alerted us to large movements in their numbers as they prepare for expansion.

[urgent] Cenarion Circle forces are gathering in Silithus to take the fight to the silithid before it's too late! [angry] No more shall they defile our lands!

[commanding] All able-bodied combatants are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold! [proud] The silithid shall be vanquished!
quest_8276_quest_complete: [solemn] Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. [warm] Welcome to Cenarion Hold, <class>. [proud] I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. [warm] You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.
quest_8277_quest_detail:
[excited] Beetix Ficklespragg at your service! My cousin Noggle makes a living gathering rare herbs for Cenarion Hold alchemists. Or used to, anyway. He came back from his last trip with a strong poison running though his veins.

[sad] I've managed to slow down the venom, but to fully neutralize it I need poison samples from whatever stung him.

Noggle arrived from the north, so I'd bet my shirt stonelash scorpids or sand skitterers did it. [urgent] Bring me some stingers and fangs and I'll try to make an antidote for him.
quest_8277_quest_progress: [urgent] Are you done collecting those samples? [shouting] We could lose Noggle any minute now!
quest_8277_quest_complete: [excited] Cross your fingers, friend! [warm] Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
quest_8278_quest_detail:
[angry] Blasted! The antidote didn't work. Noggle must've been stung by one of the stronger creatures in the far south.

[urgent] I'm going to need you to go there and get me some more samples, <name>. [soft voice] The good news is that since their poison is stronger I won't require as many. [sad] The bad news is that there are more kinds of poisonous creatures crawling around the southern area so you'll have to draw from more sources.
quest_8278_quest_progress: [urgent] This is our last chance to save Noggle! [excited] Hurry!
quest_8278_quest_complete: [excited] Yes! It seems to be working, [delight] Noggle is coming to. [warm] We owe ya big time!
quest_8279_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer are not kind to those that leave their ranks. [angry] They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast! [excited] Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine!

[soft voice] To decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. [solemn] It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations! [urgent] The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's Hammer camps.
quest_8279_quest_progress: [urgent] Who goes there? [soft voice] Oh, it's you! [hesitant] Did you find all the Lexicon chapters yet?
quest_8279_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes! These are the parts to the book! [warm] Let's get started then, <name>.

[commanding] Swap every third word with words from the second chapter... then swap every other word with words from the first chapter... [hesitant] Wait, did I get that backwards?
quest_8280_quest_detail:
[solemn] Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance. [soft voice] I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed. [pause] Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is.

[urgent] Desert worms have proven to be more of a threat to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves. [solemn] Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers. [commanding] I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized.
quest_8280_quest_progress: [urgent] The dredge strikers are a serious threat and must be dealt with quickly!
quest_8280_quest_complete: [solemn] You have my sincere gratitude. [warm] Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
quest_8281_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, <name>. [solemn] Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however. In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.

[urgent] You'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance.
quest_8281_quest_progress: [urgent] The dredge crushers are a serious threat and must be dealt with at once!
quest_8281_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [warm] You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.
quest_8282_quest_detail:
Where am I? Where's my bag? *gasp* [urgent] I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid. [hesitant] In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers.

[sad] The satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it. [sad] Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs. I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents.

[urgent] I ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp.
quest_8282_quest_progress: [hesitant] Still haven't found my bag? [urgent] Well I should count my lucky stars, at least the poison's been cleansed.
quest_8282_quest_complete: [excited] Yes! You brought my satchel back. And my rare reagents are all here! [warm] I'll be in your debt for a long time.
quest_8283_quest_detail: [solemn] The terrible scorpid, Deathclasp, is believed to have retreated to the southern mountain range in the presence of increased silithid activity. [soft voice] She presents a great threat to patrols and expeditions in the southern regions. [urgent] Individuals participating in her destruction will be remunerated handsomely. [commanding] Inquire with Captain Vish Kozus, at the top of the Cenarion Hold Watchtower, regarding a reward.
quest_8283_quest_progress: [urgent] I'll need the creature's pincer as proof of the deed. [commanding] No pincer, no reward.
quest_8283_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! With Deathclasp gone we're free to use the southern mountain range as a strategic path to circumvent the silithid hives. [warm] Your work is greatly appreciated.
quest_8284_quest_detail:
[solemn] A camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists once thrived northwest of here. [urgent] If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was.

[soft voice] I've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful. [commanding] See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's Hammer presence here in Silithus.
quest_8284_quest_progress: [solemn] The ravaged camp can be found northwest of here. [urgent] Come back when you have all the fragments.
quest_8284_quest_complete: [solemn] Just as I suspected. I can decipher individual words in the tablets but they appear to be devoid of any logic or meaning. It's not unknown for Twilight's Hammer sects to use a code to hide the meaning of their texts; [soft voice] we'll have to go to someone who knows more about this sort of thing.
quest_8285_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are rumors of a Twilight's Hammer member called Ortell having deserted his sect. [soft voice] Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit. [gentle] Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet.

[urgent] Take the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell.
quest_8285_quest_progress: [angry] You! How did you find me? Who are you? [urgent] You weren't followed, were you? Speak!
quest_8285_quest_complete:
[solemn] I see you're familiar with my old organization. [soft voice] You must be with Cenarion Hold.

[hesitant] You seek information to use against them? [pause] Come closer, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.
quest_8286_quest_detail:
[solemn] The embrace of death had all but overcome my being when he intervened. He breathed only once upon my maimed body and then waited patiently for the sands of time to cleanse my wounds.

"Forever you will remain if you must," he said, and with those words I was bound as a Watcher.

[soft voice] Look now to the desert. The second war is upon us. [urgent] You must seek out the resting place of the Bronze. Venture to the Caverns of Time and see if the master has returned. [hesitant] I must be sure before I am able to proceed.
quest_8286_quest_complete: [solemn] It is as it should be - the great one has risen. [soft voice] My watch comes to an end...
quest_8287_quest_detail:
[whispering] Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say! [solemn] I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at Silithus. They plan to drive the Twilight's Hammer out, don't they? [soft voice] This will help.

Take this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith. [urgent] Soon the Twilight's Hammer will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!
quest_8287_quest_progress: [solemn] What is this you bring to me, <name>?
quest_8287_quest_complete: [solemn] This is very interesting information indeed, <name>. [soft voice] This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them. [warm] Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, <class>.
quest_8288_quest_detail:
[urgent] There is no time to waste! [urgent] A hero must be found! [solemn] The task I give will require an army to complete but only one may rise from the throng of would be champions to take on the burden and responsibility of an ally of the Brood.

[solemn] Within the lair of the Lord of Blackrock is a most cruel beast. The Broodlord Lashlayer guards the Halls of Strife, blocking the way into Nefarian's inner sanctum. [commanding] Slay the foul aberration and return his head to me. [commanding] Do this and you may begin the next step of your journey.
quest_8288_quest_progress: [solemn] It is the favor of the Brood of Nozdormu that you must earn.
quest_8288_quest_complete: [solemn] Could you be the first to earn favor among the Bronze Flight IN a thousand years?
quest_8290_quest_detail:
[solemn] Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young <class>. [urgent] The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.

[commanding] Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. [shouting] Push back the invading Horde forces!

[warm] Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. [solemn] Bring me such a talisman, <name>, and I shall reward you.
quest_8290_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
quest_8290_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [warm] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more Marks of Honor. [proud] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
quest_8291_quest_detail:
[solemn] Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young <class>. [urgent] The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.

[commanding] Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. [shouting] Push back the invading Horde forces!

[warm] Do this, and earn a Mark of Honor. Bring it to me, <name>, and I shall reward you.
quest_8291_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
quest_8291_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [warm] Continue to aid the cause and bring me more Marks of Honor. [proud] Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
quest_8292_quest_progress: [soft voice] You earned credit for your last task. [urgent] Bring me more Marks of Honor, and be rewarded. Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor(3)
quest_8292_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.
quest_8293_quest_progress: [commanding] You earned credit for your last task. [urgent] Bring me more Marks of Honor, and be rewarded. [emphasis] Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor(3)
quest_8293_quest_complete:
[commanding] The Night Elves and their allies must tremble at even the whisper of your name! [angry] For the Horde!

[warm] You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. [urgent] Continue to rage against the Silverwing Sentinels! [shouting] Bring me more Marks of Honor!
quest_8294_quest_detail:
[commanding] The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, <race>. [low voice] Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. [solemn] Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. [angry] How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

[urgent] Let the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. [commanding] Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Mark of Honor. [warm] Return to me with such a Mark, <name>, and you will be rewarded.
quest_8294_quest_progress: [solemn] The blood of our enemies is a mark of honor. [soft voice] Do you have such a mark?
quest_8294_quest_complete: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph> [commanding] How much more can they withstand? [angry] How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? [solemn] Only time will tell, <race>...
quest_8295_quest_detail:
[commanding] The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, <race>. [solemn] Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. [angry] Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. [shouting] How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

[proud] Let the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. [urgent] Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. [warm] Return to me with such a mark, <name>, and you will be rewarded.
quest_8295_quest_progress: [solemn] The blood of our enemies is a mark of honor. [low voice] Do you have such a mark?
quest_8295_quest_complete: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph> [commanding] How much more can they withstand? [angry] How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? [solemn] Only time will tell, <race>...
quest_8297_quest_detail:
[commanding] War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!

[solemn] That is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.

[urgent] That is what I want from you, <name>. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a Mark of Honor.
quest_8297_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the Marks of Honor, <name>? [solemn] The League of Arathor can't fight a decent battle without them...
quest_8297_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the Mark! Great job! I'll send the ressources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.
quest_8298_quest_progress: <name>, the League of Arathor has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more Marks of Honor and bring them to me. [solemn] Arathi Basin Mark of Honor(3)
quest_8298_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.

[warm] Once again, thank you <name>. [proud] Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by footman and field marshal alike.
quest_8299_quest_detail:
[solemn] The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. [urgent] We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

You can help us, <name>. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the Mark of Honor you gain.
quest_8299_quest_progress: [commanding] What is it, <race>? Do you have the Marks of Honor? [urgent] Go back to Arathi Basin, slay the Alliance vermine and take possession of its ressources for the Dark Lady!
quest_8299_quest_complete: <Deathstalker Mortis smiles> [solemn] Another decisive blow has been dealt against our enemies, <name>. [warm] Thanks to your deeds, Arathi Basin is soon to be taken hold of by the Defilers.
quest_8300_quest_progress: <name>, the Defilers has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more marks of honor and bring them to me. [solemn] Arathi Basin Mark of Honor(3)
quest_8300_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.

[warm] Once again, thank you <name>. [proud] Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by grunt and high warlord alike.
quest_8301_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Brood of Nozdormu are naturally distrusting of the lesser races. [soft voice] While it is true that you have proven to me that you have the potential makings of a hero, the time has come to prove this to my master.

[emphasis] Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, Hive'Regal: All swarming with activity and all a threat to our existence. [urgent] Slay silithid at these hives and take from them a fragment of their carapace. [pause] When you can carry no more, return to me and I shall strengthen your resolve.
quest_8301_quest_progress: [solemn] There is much history rooted in their distrust of the mortal races; [soft voice] but alas, such is a tale better left for the Brood to tell when the time is right.
quest_8301_quest_complete: [solemn] You are not alone, hero. [warm] I will now grant you the ability to deputize others to help you in your quest. [solemn] If you are to be the champion of your people, you will need assistance in your tasks and duties.
quest_8302_quest_detail:
[solemn] Choose your deputies wisely, mortal. [soft voice] Each time you return with your task complete, a new deputy you will be allowed to choose.

[pause] With that said, I require more of the carapace fragments. [urgent] Waste no time!
quest_8302_quest_progress: [solemn] Perhaps one day the whole of Cenarion Hold will be working under your command.
quest_8302_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, hero. [proud] You will now be granted the ability to deputize another Agent of Nozdormu.
quest_8303_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time, <name>.

[soft voice] I must apologize for keeping so much in secret. [urgent] Enemies abound, even under our very noses. [gentle] Please, read from this tome and learn. [solemn] Take the knowledge I give to you and seek out our master.
quest_8304_quest_detail:
[solemn] My dear Natalia has gone missing.

[soft voice] Truth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. [hesitant] I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. [sad] She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research.

[urgent] She was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south.

[commanding] My soldiers are spread too thin, <name>. [urgent] I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.
quest_8304_quest_complete: <Commander Mar'alith lowers his head in contemplation.> Whether she is alive or dead, I must do what is right. [solemn] She must be found. [pause] Alas, I am bound by duty to this outpost. [soft voice] Will you help me once more, <name>?
quest_8306_quest_detail:
[solemn] I need you to venture into Hive'Regal and find what became of my dearest Natalia, <name>. [commanding] This will be no easy task for you. [urgent] Before you dive headlong into the maw of madness, make sure that you go back and speak with those dwarves. [soft voice] They might be able to give you some tips on dealing with the silithid that inhabit that hive.

[solemn] And <name>, if she truly is as mad as they say... [emphasis] do what you must. <Commander Mar'alith turns away from you.>
quest_8306_quest_complete: <Commander Mar'alith clutches at his chest.> C'Thun? [angry] WHAT is the meaning of all this? [shouting] What is C'Thun? [sad] How could this fiend have turned my sweet Natalia into the monster that you described?
quest_8307_quest_detail:
[solemn] Adapting to life in the desert has been difficult to say the least. [soft voice] Not only do I miss the birds and trees of Auberdine but our food selection is severely limited by this arid environment. [hesitant] I'm trying to learn about desert herbs, but there aren't many.

[sad] I've seen Twilight's Hammer groups from the camp west of here hunt sandworms for food. [sigh] Sandworm meat is so bitter though, I can't imagine how they make it palatable. [commanding] Keep your eyes open if you go to their camp and let me know if you learn anything.
quest_8307_quest_complete: [soft voice] This book contains several common recipes and a few unusual ones. [pause] After browsing through it for a few seconds you spot a recipe that involves sandworm meat.
quest_8308_quest_detail:
[solemn] To Whom It May Concern:

[sad] If you're reading this, I'm either dead or soon to be dead. [sad] It's hard to say. [sad] Most of the crew is dead anyhow.

[solemn] Found information about a Titan. [solemn] Great battle between him and an Old God. [solemn] Yes, a bona fide Old God. [solemn] Found ancient tunnel leading to Ahn'Qiraj. [urgent] Taking it. [urgent] Take this letter to my old camp. [gentle] Make sure my monkey is getting adequate food, water, and hugs.

[excited] -Brann Bronzebeard, Explorer Extreme

[laughing] P.S. [urgent] Watch out for crazy Old God worshipping night elf.
quest_8308_quest_complete: [solemn] Well this explains a lot. [soft voice] If you ever find a way into Ahn'Qiraj, keep an eye out for ol' Brann. [sad] I'm afraid that he'll be powerless without his monkey.
quest_8309_quest_detail:
[solemn] After our initial foray into the hives and Mistress Mar'alith's subsequent madness the three hives have been spewing out bugs! [urgent] The increased activity might be tied into the glyphs covering those strange crystals.

[commanding] We must get a rubbing from crystals in all three hives. [confident] If we can get those rubbings, we might be able to make sense of this madness.

[warm] Take this transcription set and hit those hives, <name>. [commanding] Don't come back until you've gotten copies from each hive.
quest_8309_quest_progress: [urgent] If you find some crazy night elf lass in one of the hives, [mocking tone] be sure to give her a kick in the duff for us.
quest_8309_quest_complete: I can't make heads or tails of these glyphs. [shouting] I've never seen anything like it! [hesitant] I hope Frankal's research can shed some light on this mess.
quest_8310_quest_detail: [soft voice] I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! [urgent] What do I need? [excited] Glad you asked! [commanding] I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. [solemn] Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.
quest_8310_quest_progress: [commanding] Go play with the monkey, kid. [angry] I don't have time for this.
quest_8310_quest_complete: [delight] Outstanding! [commanding] Don't wander off too far, kid. [commanding] We might need you to take on another task or two.
quest_8311_quest_detail:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. [sad] If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! [excited] I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

[soft voice] Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! [urgent] Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well. [commanding] When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
quest_8311_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you finished trick-or-treating yet? [sad] I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
quest_8311_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, you got them all! [delight] You're awesome! [warm] Thank you for trick-or-treating for me. [warm] Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

[excited] Happy Hallow's End, <name>!
quest_8312_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. [excited] If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! [warm] I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

[solemn] Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! [urgent] Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well. [proud] When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
quest_8312_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you finished trick-or-treating yet? [sad] I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
quest_8312_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, you got them all! [excited] You're awesome! [warm] Thank you for trick-or-treating for me. [warm] Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

[delight] Happy Hallow's End, <name>!
quest_8313_quest_detail: [soft voice] While the recipe for cooking sandworm meat is legible, it contains references to herbs and spices you've never heard of. [solemn] Calandrath might have enough knowledge of the plants that grow in the desert to make sense of it.
quest_8313_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you learn the recipe? [urgent] You won't keep it to yourself, I hope!
quest_8313_quest_complete: [soft voice] Let's have a look at that...
quest_8314_quest_detail:
[excited] We're on the verge of a breakthrough, <name>! The rubbings you recovered have allowed us to recreate the glyphs on this crystalline prism. [solemn] They are apparently a means for the Qiraji and other unknown entities to communicate various messages to the silithid.

[sad] Unfortunately, that is all we could get out of the glyphs. [urgent] We need to find a way to unlock the messages hidden within the crystals.

[commanding] Take the glyphed crystal prism to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold. [soft voice] She might be able to help.
quest_8314_quest_progress: [shocked] Oh my! [soft voice] What do you have there, <name>?
quest_8314_quest_complete: [solemn] The reason the dwarves could not decipher the glyphs is because there is nothing to decipher. [soft voice] The shifting outer layer of the prism must properly align with the inner crystal's markings in order for the message to be transmitted. [pause] Clever... [emphasis] While we should be able to translate this data, we must first unlock the code. [hesitant] There is only one clue on the surface of the prism - assuming the rubbings were transferred correctly - and it looks grim.
quest_8315_quest_detail:
[solemn] The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon. Above the glyphs is what I can only assume to be a code of some sort. [soft voice] This code might very well be the key to summoning the emissary.

[solemn] I will create a copy of the glyph code that you must use in the sand at the Bones of Grakkarond. [urgent] If I am right, the Overlords will come thinking that new data is ready for transmission. [commanding] Strike them down and confront the emissary. [solemn] He holds the key to the crystals...
quest_8315_quest_progress: [urgent] You must take the opportunity as it presents itself and strike!
quest_8315_quest_complete: [solemn] I hold 20,000 years of history in my hands, <name>!
quest_8316_quest_complete:
[solemn] War comes, <name>, and with it comes untold horrors. [warm] You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.

[hesitant] Should this... this prophecy ever come to pass...

<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>

[solemn] The future of us all could be at an end.

[confident] These armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.
quest_8317_quest_detail: [soft voice] That recipe sure will come in handy. [urgent] I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today. [gentle] I could use a hand in making some, [warm] I'll make it worth your while.
quest_8317_quest_progress: [soft voice] How are those dumplings coming along?
quest_8317_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! You're a life saver. [warm] These dumplings turned out to be quite good. [hesitant] Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's Hammer.
quest_8318_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. [urgent] I want you to bring me a stack of them, <class>.

[low voice] I can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point! [emphasis] These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly. [solemn] The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate!
quest_8318_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you bring me some texts?
quest_8318_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! [soft voice] I'll stash these away, [pause] maybe they'll be useful later.
quest_8319_quest_progress: [commanding] Keep bringing me texts. [solemn] We'll soon force the Twilight's Hammer out of Silithus. [soft voice] Encrypted Twilight Text(10)
quest_8319_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work! [warm] I'll put a good word in for you.
quest_8320_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer, an insane cult bent on destruction, set up camps in Silithus and perform rituals day and night. [soft voice] We do not yet know their plans, but we do think they are somehow linked to the pulsing red crystals spread across the desert.

[pause] Although their mystery may one day be solved, we must first deal with their immediate threat. [urgent] Go to their camps to the west and seek out Twilight geolords. [commanding] They are the heads of these serpents; that is where we must strike!
quest_8320_quest_progress: [solemn] Enter the desert and find the Twilight geolords, <name>. [urgent] Return to me after they are slain.
quest_8320_quest_complete: [solemn] That was a task well performed, <name>. [warm] Your slaying of the Twilight geolords must have dealt a grievous blow to the cult. [soft voice] Let us hope their plans are slowed...
quest_8321_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have discovered another base of operations for the Twilight's Hammer. It is called Twilight's Run; it is a cave tucked in the northeast corner of Silithus. The local leader of the cult, Vyral the Vile, haunts that cave - it is he who you must next defeat. When you have done this, bring me his signet ring.

[warm] Fortune to you, <name>. [soft voice] The horrors of Twilight's Run are formidable indeed.
quest_8321_quest_progress: <name>, have you yet defeated Vyral the Vile? [urgent] Do you have his signet ring?
quest_8321_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it! [proud] Vyral is killed! [solemn] This can only mean doom for the Twilight Hammer's operations in Silithus. [urgent] There may be more of them scurrying about, but the blow you dealt to the cult today is one from which they will not easily recover.
quest_8322_quest_detail:
[solemn] The humans of Southshore love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the Southshore Inn. [soft voice] With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!

[urgent] Take these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the Southshore Inn. [commanding] Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!

[excited] Once you've given Southshore a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!
quest_8322_quest_progress: [low voice] The keg is filled with ale.
quest_8322_quest_complete: [solemn] Having successfully fought your way inside the inn, you now place the eggs inside the keg. [sad] You can smell the foul odor permeating the air...
quest_8323_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you.

[soft voice] My former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis.

[hesitant] If they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer.

[low voice] Although this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share. [urgent] Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's Hammer members.
quest_8323_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find any encrypted texts? [hesitant] I'm quite curious to read this month's True Believer.
quest_8323_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! I will get to decoding these as soon as possible. [urgent] If I find anything of interest I'll find some way to get the information to you.
quest_8324_quest_progress: [hesitant] Find any more encrypted texts? [urgent] Bring me a good batch of them, this decoding work takes some time. Encrypted Twilight Text(10)
quest_8324_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! I can't wait to read these. [warm] Please do keep bringing the encrypted texts here if you find them.
quest_8331_quest_detail:
<name>, although we had hoped the Twilight's Hammer's operations in Silithus were slowing... [solemn] we were, regrettably, mistaken. Through continued forays against the cult, we have learned that an even darker power, the Abyssal Council, controls the Hammer through the arcane wind stones dotted amongst the cult's camps. [solemn] Your next action, <name>, will be against the Abyssal Council.

[commanding] Speak with the craftsman Aurel Goldleaf, in the eastern section of Cenarion Hold. [soft voice] Her skill will be needed for this next gambit.
quest_8331_quest_complete: <name>, good day. [soft voice] I was told you will pit yourself against the Abyssal Council? [solemn] If that is so, then listen closely to my next words...
quest_8332_quest_detail:
[solemn] We think it is possible to use a wind stone to ambush a duke of the Abyssal Council. [urgent] To do this, however, one must commune through the wind stone, and convince the council you are a middle ranked leader of the Twilight's Hammer.

[soft voice] Such a gambit requires a replica of the cult's medallion of station. [commanding] I can create the medallion, but I will need a large brilliant shard, and crests worn by the Abyssal Templar.

[warm] Bring these to me and I will do the rest.
quest_8332_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the shard and the crests, Demonhound? [soft voice] I will need them to make the twilight cultist's medallion of station.
quest_8332_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, very good. I've been working on the medallion - now with these last ingredients, I'll be done in just a few moments...

There we are. Here is the medallion, <name>.

[warm] You'll need to wear this when you activate one of the Twilight's Hammer's wind stones. Put this on, along with the rest of the twilight trappings, and the Abyssal Council will see you as one of their cultist underlings.
quest_8333_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you need another Twilight cultist's medallion of station, then I am happy to oblige. I will, however, need another brilliant shard and some abyssal crests... [pause] Large Brilliant ShardAbyssal Crest(3)
quest_8333_quest_complete: [gentle] Here you are, <name>. [warm] One more Twilight medallion of station. [soft voice] Use it well, and I wish you luck against the Abyssal Council!
quest_8341_quest_detail:
[solemn] Lords of the Abyssal Council can only be summoned through the greater wind stones, and only the top ranking members of the Twilight's Council may speak to them. [soft voice] But... I have found a way to upgrade your disguise and fool the Abyssal Lords!

[warm] The disguise calls for a ring of lordship, worn only by the highest members of the cult. [gentle] I will craft one for you if you can bring me large brilliant shards and abyssal signets.
quest_8341_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have the shards and the signets, <name>? [solemn] I will need them to create the ring of lordship.
quest_8341_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thanks. Just one moment and I'll have that ring ready for you...

There it is. Now you're ready.

[warm] Be sure to wear this ring, along with a medallion of station and the rest of the twilight trappings, when you activate a greater wind stone. Do that, and the Abyssal Council will think you one of their servants. Then, perhaps you can lure one into an ambush!
quest_8342_quest_progress: <name>, if you plan to go after the Abyssal High Council again, then you'll need another Twilight ring of lordship. [solemn] Bring me more shards and signets and I'll make one for you. Abyssal Signet(3)Large Brilliant Shard(5)
quest_8342_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, I see your convictions are strong. [angry] Not many will face that council of fiends!

[warm] Here's your ring, <name>. [solemn] May your will, and your fortune, stand firm.
quest_8343_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council! [urgent] Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle. [warm] We know that if anyone can do it, you can.

[solemn] May fortune go with you, <name>. [soft voice] Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
quest_8343_quest_complete: [solemn] What Huum says is true. [soft voice] I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! [emphasis] Listen on, and I will explain...
quest_8348_quest_detail:
[excited] Huum tells me you've figured out how to summon the Abyssal Dukes! [solemn] That's quite an accomplishment.

You know what else would be quite the accomplishment? [urgent] Smashing up one of those things really good. [whispering] That'll cause an impression on their underlings, if you know what I mean. [commanding] Bring back its signet as proof of the deed.
quest_8348_quest_progress: [solemn] How did it go with the Abyssal Duke? [urgent] Did it hit hard?
quest_8348_quest_complete: [confident] I knew you were a tough <class> the minute I saw you walk into Cenarion Hold. [excited] Keep it up!
quest_8349_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane. [soft voice] He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council.

[warm] Good luck, <name>. [gentle] And if you ever need more medallions, return to me.
quest_8349_quest_complete: [warm] Good to see you again, <class>! [excited] So you had a medallion made? [warm] Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...
quest_8351_quest_detail: [soft voice] Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you. [urgent] Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission...
quest_8351_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes, that's right, <name>. [pause] I have a very tough task ahead...
quest_8352_quest_detail:
Huum and I were just talking about you. [excited] He tells me you're just about ready to try your hand at fighting an Abyssal Lord!

[solemn] I must tell you this is a very dangerous endeavor. [urgent] You'd better bring backup. And I don't mean one or two of your friends, I'm talking about a top-notch, battle-ready fighting force. [confident] If your friends are as good as you, you might even defeat it!

[warm] If you do - and I'll want evidence, as always - I'll give you a truly great reward.
quest_8352_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, how did it go? [excited] I'd do anything to leave my post and wrestle one of those things myself!
quest_8352_quest_complete: [excited] You... you did it! [proud] You did it, <name>! [warm] Here! Take this. [warm] It's the biggest chest we had lying around and I filled it with some of the best stuff we found.
quest_8353_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we? [low voice] I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

[mocking tone] Well, for my treat - an Ironforge Mint - you will need to... [commanding] cluck like a chicken! [excited] Yes, chickens love mints... well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... but I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!

[urgent] Well <class>, are you up to the challenge or not?! [commanding] Time to earn your treat!
quest_8353_quest_complete:
[excited] Too funny! [warm] Well done, <name>! [warm] Here's your treat.

[excited] Happy Hallow's End!
quest_8354_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we? [hesitant] I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

[commanding] Well, for my treat - an Undercity Mint - you will need to... [mocking tone] cluck like a chicken! [solemn] Yes, chickens love mints... well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... [commanding] but I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!

[urgent] Well <class>, are you up to the challenge or not?! [excited] Time to earn your treat!
quest_8354_quest_complete:
[laughing] Too funny! [warm] Well done, <name>! [warm] Here's your treat.

[excited] Happy Hallow's End!
quest_8355_quest_detail:
[excited] A trick-or-treater! Huzzah!

[warm] Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily. [chuckling] I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me! Haha, yes, that'll be the trick! [commanding] The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

[laughing] Chugga-chugga, <class>!
quest_8355_quest_complete:
[excited] Woo-woo! [warm] Well done, <name>! [warm] Here's your treat.

quest_8361_quest_detail:
[solemn] We've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists performing rituals to summon powerful elemental nobles. [soft voice] We don't know if these are the beings the cultists worship or if they act as intermediaries to even more powerful forces. [emphasis] One thing is for sure: they are receiving orders from these elementals.

[urgent] I want you to find a way to contact an Abyssal Templar and give it a proper beating! [commanding] Nothing throws the troops in disarray like taking out the chain of command. [warm] Bring back proof while you're at it.
quest_8361_quest_complete: Hah! You did it, <name>! [proud] The Twilight's Hammer will soon be crushed!
quest_8362_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've proved you can handle yourself in a fight, <name>. [commanding] Let's keep the pressure up on the Twilight's Hammer. Go fight some more Abyssal Templars, I'll reward you with some of the stuff Huum and I have found in battle. [warm] Abyssal Crest(3)
quest_8362_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done well! [warm] That's less Templars for me to worry about.

[warm] Here you go, <name>. [warm] Hope there's something useful in there for you.
quest_8363_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent, <name>! [warm] Defeating those Dukes will leave the Twilight's Hammer reeling for a while. [proud] As promised, here's your reward. [warm] It's some of the better stuff Huum and I have found.
quest_8364_quest_progress:
[soft voice] You've truly exceeded all my expectations, <name>. [proud] You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.

[solemn] At this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer and their overlords.

[warm] Bring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward. Abyssal Scepter(3)
quest_8364_quest_complete: [excited] I knew you'd come through, <name>! [warm] Here's your reward.
quest_8365_quest_detail:
[commanding] You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully <class>. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society. Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style. And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.

[soft voice] So here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. [mocking tone] Do you think you can handle that?
quest_8365_quest_progress: [urgent] Do you have all 20 hats? [mocking tone] I don't believe you, let me see them. [angry] They better be in pristine condition!
quest_8365_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh you're a darling, even if it did take you longer than I am accustomed to. [low voice] This shipment should make me quite a bit of money once I've cleaned and personalized these hats. [warm] And seeing as I'm always willing to reward work that's well done, here's a little something for you. [gentle] I suggest that you spend some of it on a bath sweetie.
quest_8366_quest_detail:
[angry] Argh! They want the impossible from me!

[shouting] The Steamwheedle Cartel wants me to teach the Southsea pirates a lesson. The problem is that I can't be in two places at once; I need to stay here to keep the peace.

[low voice] Of late, the pirates have been disregarding the protection money that the cartel regularly forks over. [urgent] So I'd like to temporarily deputize you to go down there and show them what for.

[commanding] You'll find them at Lost Rigger Cove, which is not too far to the south. [warm] Thanks <name>, I'll owe you one!
quest_8366_quest_progress: [commanding voice] Back so soon? [urgent] I hope you taught those Southsea hoodlums a lesson they won't soon forget.
quest_8366_quest_complete:
<name>! You are the man!!!

[excited] I'm sure that the Cartel will ease up on me now that you've dealt with those Southsea scum. [warm] Let's see, what can I give you as a reward? How about a little coin and you choose from one of these for your trouble?
quest_8367_quest_progress: [solemn] Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. [angry] Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!
quest_8367_quest_complete: [solemn] Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. [warm] Part with past tokens of victory, <class>. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. [commanding] Stand up straight, <name>. [proud] Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
quest_8368_quest_detail:
[solemn] The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. [commanding] Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.

[urgent] Do not let this happen, <name>! [commanding] Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
quest_8368_quest_progress: [commanding] Do you bear news from Warsong Gulch, <name>?
quest_8368_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! [warm] May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.
quest_8369_quest_detail: [commanding] Listen up, <name>. [solemn] No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory. [angry] The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame. [urgent] Go forth and expel the invaders!
quest_8369_quest_progress: [solemn] What news do you bring from the lands of the Frostwolves? [commanding] How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?
quest_8369_quest_complete: [excited] You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! [warm] I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
quest_8370_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. [low voice] No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

[commanding] The battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. [urgent] Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. [commanding] Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, <name>!
quest_8370_quest_progress: [commanding] You've come back with news from Arathi, <class>?
quest_8370_quest_complete: [commanding] Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! [warm] You've done well, <name>.
quest_8371_quest_detail:
[commanding] We're not fighting isolated battles against the Horde anymore, lad.

Victory in one front means denying the Horde resources they'd use against us in a different battle. By the same token, losing any given battle could give the advantage to our opponent somewhere else around the world.

[solemn] The Alliance is in need of more combatants with this sort of worldly understanding... truly seasoned veterans! <name>, come back to me after you've served against the Horde at all of our active battlegrounds.
quest_8371_quest_progress: [soft voice] How are yer travels faring laddie?
quest_8371_quest_complete:
[commanding] You're not one to disappoint, <name>! [warm] What you've learned goes beyond petty medals and commendations. [solemn] What you've learned is what can only come with experience and the hardening of one's temper in the field of battle.

[proud] You've done well, <class>. [excited] You're a true hero of the Alliance!
quest_8372_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.

The forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.

[commanding] Do your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, <name>! [excited] For the Alliance!
quest_8372_quest_progress: [commanding] You've come back with news from the front, <name>?
quest_8372_quest_complete: [excited] Well done, <name>! [warm] You've served the Alliance well.
quest_8373_quest_detail:
[angry] The thing I hate the most about Hallow's End are the stink bombs the Forsaken use on Southshore. [sigh] Who knew that celebrating liberation would have to involve such a smelly mess?

During Hallow's End, use this cleaner to remove any nasty stink bombs the Horde may drop here in the village. [soft voice] It uses the power of pine to fight funky smells.

[commanding] Do your part to keep Southshore clean, and I'll give you some Hallow's End treats I'm sure you'll enjoy. [urgent] We have a deal?
quest_8373_quest_progress: [angry] Those blasted Forsaken... it's already bad enough that they're undead, but then they get all riled up and start causing trouble in [shouting] MY village!
quest_8373_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, it almost smells better around here already. Almost.

[warm] Thanks to you, <name>, Southshore just might make it through another Hallow's End. [excited] Here's your treats, with my thanks! [pause] If you run out of candy, I think there's a gnome named Katrina Shimmerstar in Ironforge who can sell you more; she's only around during Hallow's End, I believe.
quest_8374_quest_detail:
[solemn] Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.

What we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.

If the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! [urgent] Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, <name>.
quest_8374_quest_progress: [commanding] Tell me, what are the news from the front?
quest_8374_quest_complete: [commanding] Good work, soldier! [excited] Keep it up and we'll have the Horde running all the way back to Orgrimmar.
quest_8375_quest_detail:
[solemn] Make no mistake about it, <name>. The Horde is quite right when they say Alterac Valley is Frostwolf Territory.

[soft voice] You see, the Stormpike Expedition arrived as peaceful visitors to the area in search of ore and relics. The Frostwolves reacted with the most brutal and uncivilized act of aggression the Alliance has experienced.

[sad] Let us never forget the brave dwarves that perished in that cowardly unannounced attack. [urgent] Go now, <class>, do your part in the battle for Alterac Valley. [proud] For the Alliance!
quest_8375_quest_complete: [excited] You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! [warm] I will tell my superiors of your deeds.

[urgent] If the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. [threatening] If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! [commanding] Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, <name>.
quest_8398_quest_progress: [solemn] The war against the Horde is quickly depleting our supplies, <name>. [urgent] It is vital to maintain control of Arathi Basin to keep the stream of resources flowing! [commanding] Have you lent a hand in Arathi yet?
quest_8398_quest_complete: [commanding] Excellent work, <class>! [warm] Your efforts will help provide the Alliance with the resources it needs.

quest_8409_quest_detail: [solemn] The rotten eggs have been successfully placed inside the keg. [urgent] Future batches of ale from the Southshore Inn are sure to be ruined!
quest_8410_quest_detail: [solemn] Bath'rah the Windwatcher has sent out a summons for a shaman of your wisdom. [soft voice] He requests you bring a sample of each of the elements to show you are ready.
quest_8411_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome, <class>. [commanding] You bring me the elements and then we do the talkin'.

The fire, the air, the water, and the earth I be needin' before I trust ya, mon. [urgent] I gots to know you be knowledgeable.
quest_8411_quest_complete: [solemn] These be the elements I need. [commanding] Now we talk.
quest_8412_quest_detail:
[solemn] The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.

[soft voice] You know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me. [emphasis] We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature. [emphasis] More primal. [urgent] In the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes. The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.
quest_8412_quest_progress: [solemn] The spirits know what we're up to, and they been tryin' to kill me! [urgent] I hope you got the parts.
quest_8412_quest_complete: [excited] Great, mon! [pause] Let's try it out...
quest_8413_quest_detail:
[solemn] The spirit totem just isn't enough. [soft voice] We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.

[whispering] The trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics. [commanding] Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. [solemn] Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.
quest_8413_quest_complete:
[excited] It's about time this <race> got a full night's rest! The spirit totem will watch over me.

[pause] I been a long time collectin' things, [warm] maybe you want somethin' for all your trouble?
quest_8414_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>. [warm] Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.

[solemn] Your holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here. [urgent] We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis. [soft voice] The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.

[commanding] Only one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.
quest_8414_quest_progress: [solemn] What evil have you brought me?
quest_8414_quest_complete: [solemn] There is risk in dispelling the evil from a scourgestone, for it attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. [soft voice] But you are strong in the Light, <name>, and I do not fear for you...
quest_8415_quest_detail: [solemn] Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, <name>. [soft voice] You can find him at Chillwind Camp in the southern part of the Western Plaguelands. [urgent] Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!
quest_8415_quest_complete: [commanding] Very well, <class>! [urgent] Let's see what you're made of.
quest_8416_quest_detail:
[solemn] The evil has been purged from the stones, <name>.

[soft voice] I am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone. [urgent] Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.
quest_8416_quest_progress: [urgent] Was Thal'danis able to cleanse the scourgestones?
quest_8416_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done as I asked without question, <name>.

[soft voice] Trust is achieved, it seems. [pause] Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.
quest_8417_quest_detail: [solemn] In the Blasted Lands, there is a troubled spirit who was once a great hero of the horde. [soft voice] A warrior's honor does not die with the body, and it would serve you well to speak with him.
quest_8417_quest_progress: [angry] Did Stoley cough up my booze?
quest_8417_quest_complete: [solemn] So, you have come to alleviate my pain. [sad] I wish you could simply strike me down, but it is not that simple...
quest_8418_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead. [solemn] This is no trivial task, <name>. [soft voice] Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.

[pause] In the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. [threatening] Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.
quest_8418_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you slain the wretched trolls?
quest_8418_quest_complete:
[delight] This is excellent, <name>. [proud] I would say I am surprised, but I knew without question that you wouldn't let us down.

[warm] It is my honor to bestow one of the Holy Mightstones to you. [commanding] Use it well.
quest_8419_quest_detail: <name>, an imp in Felwood by the name of Impsy has requested your presence. [solemn] It is somewhat strange, as he has asked that you bring a piece of felcloth as a sign of good faith. [hesitant] Considering the power you already wield as a warlock, I can only assume you know the satyrs of Felwood carry this felcloth.
quest_8423_quest_detail:
<The Hero looks you over.> [solemn] You are a <class>, no doubt. [soft voice] I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.

[commanding] It is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike. [urgent] Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
quest_8423_quest_progress: [solemn] The burning spines of the helboar leave horrific scars. Do not fear the pain and disfigurement, warrior, they are nothing compared to the prison to which I am bound.
quest_8423_quest_complete: [solemn] I need no proof to know what you have done, <class>. [soft voice] I can see the determination etched in your expression.
quest_8424_quest_detail:
[solemn] The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands bring great pain to me. [sad] Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.

[commanding] Through you I can deliver my own message of pain. [angry] Go forth and deliver my wrath.
quest_8424_quest_progress: [solemn] The shadowsworn are not easily defeated, are they? [commanding] But you are a warrior, and you will triumph or perish trying.
quest_8424_quest_complete: [solemn] Already you have subdued my pain and honored me. [warm] Thank you, <class>.
quest_8425_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your honor has brought some peace to me. [soft voice] It is only right that I offer you something in return.

[low voice] My weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. [solemn] They would be better served in your possession.

[urgent] Travel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. [commanding] They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.
quest_8425_quest_progress: [soft voice] Are you back so soon? [pause] Time is not the same to me any more, perhaps it has indeed been a long journey for you...
quest_8425_quest_complete: [solemn] At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.
quest_8426_quest_detail:
[solemn] The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. [commanding] Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.

[urgent] Do not let this happen, <name>! [commanding] Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!

[urgent] Do not let this happen, <name>! [commanding] Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
