[angry] What! You again? [shocked] Well I'll be a monkey's uncle... except that I'm a gnome. [excited] Slicky Gastronome to be precise! [soft voice] So you're back to help out again eh? [warm] Well, I can't say as I blame you. [soft voice] Don't you just love the smell of all of that food? <drool>

[urgent] Enough loitering! [commanding] Get out there and bring me back more rainbow fin albacore!
quest_8525_quest_progress:
[angry] What! You again? [shocked] Well I'll be a monkey's uncle... except that I'm a gnome. [excited] Slicky Gastronome to be precise! [soft voice] So you're back to help out again, eh? [warm] Well, I can't say as I blame you. [warm] Don't you just love the smell of all of that food? <drool>

[urgent] Enough loitering! [commanding] Get out there and bring me back more rainbow fin albacore!
quest_8525_quest_complete:
[gentle] I knew that you had it in you, kid. [warm] You've got the look of someone who knows what he likes. Specifically that you like pleasing me and the powers that be. And that you have, I guarantee.

[laughing] Haha, ok, I'll just get these fish properly stashed away, and then you and I can have a little talk concerning you collecting another twenty albacore.
quest_8526_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, how's it going, <class>? [soft voice] I see that you're interested in maybe gathering up food for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj? [soft voice] Somehow my dad thought that it would be a good learning experience for me if I were to volunteer to help out here. [sad] Big mistake. [sad] I don't even like to eat meat.

[soft voice] Anyway, if you feel like it, you could bring me back a lot of roast raptor. [soft voice] Apparently that's what all of the soldiers are going to want.
quest_8526_quest_progress: [soft voice] So do you have all of that roast raptor yet?
quest_8526_quest_complete: Gee, that's swell. [warm] Thanks for bringing me all of this burnt animal flesh, <class>. [soft voice] I'll just put it onto the pile over there. [pause] I'm sure that someone will take care of it. [hesitant] I suppose if you have some time on your hands that you might want to bring me more?
quest_8527_quest_detail: [excited] Hi again <class>. I can tell you're very excited about all of this. So I suppose you want to bring me another twenty roast raptor. [soft voice] Great. Well you do that. I guess I'll see you when you get back.
quest_8527_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hi again, <class>. I can tell you're very excited about all of this. So I suppose you want to bring me another twenty roast raptor? [excited] Great. Well you do that. I guess I'll see you when you get back.
quest_8527_quest_complete: [excited] Wow, you're a real go-getter. [soft voice] You make me tired just looking at you. Anyway, thanks from the Alliance and all that. [warm] I'll make sure that all of that dead meat gets packed away. [hesitant] I guess you could check back with me later to see if we still need more of it, though it's starting to stink up the place if you ask me.
quest_8528_quest_detail:
[solemn] It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young <class>. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.

Accordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. [soft voice] Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
quest_8528_quest_progress: [confident] I am confident that you are returning so soon with the spotted yellowtail we discussed.
quest_8528_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for this gift, <class>, and in such a timely manner as well. [warm] Our soldiers will surely not lack for something to eat. [pause] Just let me get these fish stored away properly and then you and I can discuss a second haul if you're willing.
quest_8529_quest_detail: [soft voice] If you're still willing I'd like to send you back out to bring in another haul of spotted yellowtail, <name>. I'd imagine with the expertise you gained the first time out that this catch should be much faster and easier. [gentle] Are you game?
quest_8529_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you're still willing I'd like to send you back out to bring in another haul of spotted yellowtail, <name>. [confident] I'd imagine with the expertise you gained the first time out that this catch should be much faster and easier. [hesitant] Are you game?
quest_8529_quest_complete: [solemn] You are a true member of the Alliance, <name>. [warm] Your efforts shall not go unnoticed, or unappreciated. [soft voice] And thank you for cooking up the fish as well. [warm] I will see to it that they are stored away properly, and then I'll need to update my count. [proud] Every one brings us that much closer to catching our goal.
quest_8532_quest_detail: [soft voice] So glad that you've decided to help out here. [low voice] Not everyone would, so I need to make sure you understand what it is that I need. [urgent] Copper bars, not copper ore. We don't have the time or people to do all of the smelting ourselves, so if you would be so kind as to take care of that, your efforts will be duly noted. [commanding] Is that something that you can handle, <class>?
quest_8532_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope that's the twenty copper bars you have there with you, <class>.
quest_8532_quest_complete: [low voice] These bars will do, and thanks for not shining them. [sad] No sense in making them pretty when they're going to be mangled for whatever materiel needs to be built for the war. [urgent] I'll take care of putting them on the stacks, and I'll make sure that they are put to proper use. [commanding] Speak to me again if you're interested in bringing in another twenty.
quest_8533_quest_detail: [soft voice] Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time <class>. So, you already know the drill; [urgent] I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?
quest_8533_quest_progress: [soft voice] Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time, <class>. So, you already know the drill; I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. [commanding] I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?
quest_8533_quest_complete: [solemn] You've proven yourself to me yet again, <class>. [soft voice] I will see to it that this copper is used in due time. [low voice] For now though, I need to get these copper bars onto the pallet and tallied. [warm] If you still feel inclined, I could probably use your help in gathering even more copper bars.
quest_8534_quest_detail: [solemn] We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Azenel has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Zora for several days now. [urgent] Find her and obtain a written report. [commanding] We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, <name>.
quest_8534_quest_progress: [urgent] You'll find Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora. [urgent] Hurry, <name>! [urgent] Time is of the essence.
quest_8534_quest_complete: [warm] Your efforts are greatly appreciated, <name>. [soft voice] I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
quest_8535_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. [urgent] With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.

[commanding] Find a way to summon and destroy a Hoary Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
quest_8535_quest_complete: [warm] Good job, <name>. [excited] Here's your next assignment.
quest_8536_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.

[urgent] Find a way to summon and destroy an Earthen Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
quest_8536_quest_complete: [warm] Good job, <name>. [excited] Here's your next assignment.
quest_8537_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. [urgent] With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.

[emphasis] Find a way to summon and destroy a Crimson Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
quest_8537_quest_complete: [excited] Good job, <name>. [warm] Here's your next assignment.
quest_8538_quest_detail:
[solemn] The links between the Twilight's Hammer and the Abyssal Council are proving to be more important than we had expected.

[soft voice] We believe the elemental nobles known as the Abyssal Dukes are one of the primary force organizing the Twilight's Hammer cultists. [commanding] Find a way to lure the four Abyssal Dukes into our plane of existence and destroy them!

[warm] Your dedication and prowess in past assignments have led us to choose you for this particular assignment. [confident] We are certain you will succeed in this endeavor.
quest_8538_quest_complete: [solemn] You have achieved a great accomplishment for our cause today, <name>. [warm] You've vanquished some of our most powerful enemies. [proud] For that I greatly commend you.
quest_8539_quest_detail: [commanding] Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora. [urgent] You have been selected to target Hive'Zora hive sisters. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
quest_8539_quest_progress: [commanding] You have something to tell me, <class>?
quest_8539_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work, <name>. [warm] You're a worthy ally.
quest_8540_quest_detail: [solemn] The mounted division of the Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of ornate mithril boots. [urgent] Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
quest_8540_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent. We were in need of these, <name>. [warm] Good work.
quest_8541_quest_detail: [solemn] The Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of grinding stones. [urgent] Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
quest_8541_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent. [warm] We were in need of these, <name>. [proud] Good work.
quest_8542_quest_detail:
Lok'tar, <race>, [commanding] I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. [solemn] But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. [low voice] Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, [proud] I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. [urgent] But I cannot do that without your help.

So I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. [emphasis] I think I'm going to need more than I can count.
quest_8542_quest_progress: [commanding] How many tin bars do you have there, <class>? [low voice] After the war I think I'm going to need someone to teach me how to count.
quest_8542_quest_complete: [solemn] You have my sincere gratitude. [warm] Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
quest_8543_quest_detail:
[commanding] Very good, I see that you are serious about the war. [hesitant] I'm a little edgy waiting for it to start though, which means I'm going to get angry if you don't start bringing in the goods faster. [mocking tone] Maybe I can just practice on you instead.

Har! [laughing] Maybe not, 'cuz then who would bring me back the tin bars?
quest_8543_quest_progress:
[commanding] Very good, I see that you are serious about the war. [low voice] I'm a little edgy waiting for it to start though, as I'm sure you are as well, <class>. [excited] It will be glorious when it begins. [solemn] The Horde running over the sands of the Silithus desert, weapons in hand, charging headlong into the insect masses. [proud] Great honor will be had that day by all!

[angry] Har! [urgent] But first we need more tin bars. [hesitant] Funny how such a small thing may make such a huge difference, don't you think?
quest_8543_quest_complete:
[commanding] Throm'ka, <name>. [proud] You honor me and the Horde with your tin bars. [solemn] I will put them on the stack and then they will come and make things from them. [urgent] And then when that is all done we will go to war and show the puny Alliance how to fight the bugs.

[angry] Now bring me back more tin bars!
quest_8544_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.

[commanding] Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
quest_8544_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected the components I require?
quest_8544_quest_complete: [solemn] From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. [warm] May they grant you the protection you need and [proud] may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
quest_8545_quest_detail:
<class>, [commanding] the war it is comin' and the only thing we can do is prepare for it. [solemn] That be where you and I can help each other, mon. Ya see, they put me in charge of collectin' all the mithril bars we be needin' ta build for all the things we gonna need. [urgent] An I still be needin' more!

So, I be hopin' that you can get out there an mine us up some mithril, then smelt it into bars. [urgent] Sound like something you can do for us?
quest_8545_quest_progress: [solemn] It sure would be nice to be havin' all of the mithril bars that we be needin' for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. [urgent] Is that why you be back, mon? [excited] You got my bars?
quest_8545_quest_complete:
[solemn] This be a good start for you an me, <class>. [warm] That be another twenty mithril bars that I can be puttin' on the stacks an checkin' off of the list. [urgent] It all gonna be put to good use makin' the war materiel.

[commanding] Be makin' sure that you check back in with me 'cuz you know it be lookin' like we gonna need even more of those mithril bars.
quest_8546_quest_detail:
Yup, I be glad you're here, mon. [warm] You helped me before, and now I need your help again. [urgent] We still lookin' ta bring in more mithril bars for the war effort; gonna build lots of armor and weapons and things to go squish them bugs at Ahn'Qiraj.

[commanding] So if you be a true friend, you bring me back more stacks of mithril bars. [confident] I take all you got until we hit our quota. [excited] You have some for me now?
quest_8546_quest_complete: [excited] That be good work <name>! [warm] Another twenty bars get us that much closer to the goal, and get us more war materiel. I see to it they get put away. [commanding] And if you get another stack of mithril bars mon, you make sure to be bringin' them here to me.
quest_8548_quest_detail:
[solemn] The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, <name>.

[soft voice] You'd be wise to hold on to them. As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
quest_8548_quest_progress: [commanding] It's in our best interest to keep our most loyal allies well geared, <name>.
quest_8548_quest_complete: [warm] Great work, <name>. [soft voice] Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. [proud] You've certainly earned it, friend!
quest_8549_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said that every generation must face a defining trial. [soft voice] I fear the Ahn'Qiraj War will be the crucible in which our mettle is tested. [pause] So we prepare, and in so doing find what we are made of.

[gentle] I have volunteered to help the Horde by gathering as much peacebloom as possible, so that it can be made into potions for the war. [warm] I hope that you are here to lend me your aid. [urgent] If so, then I need you to bring back to me a good quantity of the herb. [commanding] Will you assist me, <class>?
quest_8549_quest_progress: [soft voice] Back so soon with the peacebloom, <class>?
quest_8549_quest_complete: [solemn] This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. [soft voice] But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, <name>.
quest_8550_quest_detail: [gentle] Hello again, Abyssmal. [soft voice] I am glad that you wish to speak to me once more concerning our neverending need for peacebloom. [solemn] The war effort continues, and with it our production of potions and elixirs to aid in the battles to come. [warm] Will you help us again, <class>? [warm] I am in need of the same amount of peacebloom as before, so if you can gather it up and return it to me here I would be most grateful. [warm] Of course, if you already have it on your person, I will be more than happy to accept it from you now
quest_8550_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you for your continued efforts, <name>. [warm] You bring great honor to yourself and your ancestors with your selfless giving, and it will be known to all! [solemn] I will store these herbs away so that they stay fresh until they are needed. [solemn] Once again you reveal the truest spirit of the Horde, the struggle to overcome and the promise that we can work together to do so.
quest_8551_quest_detail:
[solemn] I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor. [solemn] I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.

[sad] Until... [angry] Those cursed sea giants ruined me! [angry] They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. [sad] And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. [angry] He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. [angry] The nerve! [urgent] I hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. [urgent] Find him and get back my chest! [warm] Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
quest_8551_quest_progress: [excited] Ahoy, <name>! Did you find Gorlash? [warm] That chest was my favorite, and it has a hidden compartment that held my greatest treasures!
quest_8551_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [delight] Oh happy day, this is! [warm] Thank you, <name>. [low voice] Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.

[threatening] But my revenge isn't complete...
quest_8552_quest_detail: [soft voice] This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.
quest_8552_quest_progress: [solemn] Hello. [commanding] Do you have business with me?
quest_8552_quest_complete:
[excited] You recovered my sash? Then... you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant! Hooray!

[warm] I'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew.

Three times. [proud] You are a <class> of worth, <name>.
quest_8553_quest_detail:
[solemn] After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another. Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains. I found them, but...they beat me. They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.

This time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.

[commanding] Face Negolash and bring me my cutlass!

[urgent] Speak with Sprogger. He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack. [soft voice] He can help you find the giant.
quest_8553_quest_complete: [excited] Hello hello, <name>. [warm] Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?
quest_8554_quest_detail:
[solemn] Negolash is a hungry giant.

When the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. [excited] They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!

[urgent] If you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. [soft voice] Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. [excited] When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
quest_8554_quest_complete:
[excited] You got my cutlass from Negolash! [delight] I can't believe my fortune, <name>! [warm] Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!

[proud] Thank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
quest_8556_quest_detail:
[solemn] The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. [soft voice] The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.

[pause] The gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.

[warm] Bring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, <class>.
quest_8556_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you bring me the ring and materials, <name>?
quest_8556_quest_complete: [soft voice] I will swap the gem on the ring for you. [whispering] You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
quest_8557_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, <name>. [solemn] I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, <class>.

I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.

[warm] I promise you won't be disappointed.
quest_8557_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring the materials for the cloak, <name>?
quest_8557_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.

[warm] Take this cloak, <name>. [gentle] May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
quest_8558_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

[soft voice] Just the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. [commanding] Prove your allegiance to the Circle, <name>, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
quest_8558_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you bring me the components I require, <name>?
quest_8558_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've done well, <class>. [soft voice] This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.

[warm] Take your weapon, <name>. [confident] Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!
quest_8559_quest_detail:
[solemn] Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

[commanding] Bring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

[urgent] You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
quest_8559_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8559_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done well, <name>. [proud] You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.

[confident] I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
quest_8560_quest_detail:
[commanding] You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

[solemn] The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. [soft voice] He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.

[pause] His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.

[urgent] Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
quest_8560_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you bring the components I require, <name>?
quest_8560_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... the worm's hide will make for an excellent protective layer. [soft voice] Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. [warm] May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
quest_8561_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twin Emperors... [sad] their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. [threatening] They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.

[soft voice] In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. [cold] But I will have my revenge... [commanding] I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.

[urgent] Bring me the components I require, <name>. [proud] I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
quest_8561_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring me the components I asked for, <name>?
quest_8561_quest_complete:
[excited] You've succeeded! [solemn] The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased.

[warm] Take this as a reward. [cold] The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... [threatening] it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
quest_8562_quest_detail:
[solemn] The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. [solemn] The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.

[solemn] When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. [urgent] You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.

[warm] Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. [proud] I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
quest_8562_quest_progress: [solemn] At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
quest_8562_quest_complete:
[solemn] I did not expect you to return from your attempt, <name>.

[warm] You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings.

[solemn] By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension.

[proud] Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions.

[warm] May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
quest_8572_quest_detail:
[solemn] The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, <name>.

[soft voice] You'd be wise to hold on to them. [solemn] As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
quest_8572_quest_progress: [commanding] It's in our best interest to keep our most loyal allies well geared, <name>.
quest_8572_quest_complete: [warm] Great work, <name>. [soft voice] Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. [proud] You've certainly earned it, friend!
quest_8573_quest_detail:
[solemn] The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, <name>.

[soft voice] You'd be wise to hold on to them. [solemn] As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.

quest_8573_quest_complete: [warm] Great work, <name>. [warm] Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. [proud] You've certainly earned it, friend!
quest_8574_quest_detail:
[solemn] The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Windcaller Proudhorn are more than just for show, <name>.

[soft voice] You'd be wise to hold on to them. [gentle] As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
quest_8574_quest_progress: [commanding] It's in our best interest to keep our most loyal allies well geared, <name>.
quest_8574_quest_complete: [warm] Great work, <name>. [soft voice] Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. [proud] You've certainly earned it, friend!
quest_8575_quest_detail: [solemn] You cannot understand a single word on this ledger. [soft voice] You don't even know what language it is written in!
quest_8575_quest_progress: [excited] Ooooh! [soft voice] Magical pulsing thingy! [delight] For me?
quest_8575_quest_complete: <Narain eagerly examines the letter.> [excited] Outstanding, <race>! [warm] What is it? I can't read a lick of Draconic.
quest_8576_quest_complete:
[commanding] First things first, <name>! [soft voice] We need to figure out what Azuregos wrote in this ledger.

You say that he's told you to make an arcanite buoy and that this is the schematic? [hesitant] Strange that he would write this in Draconic. That old goat knows I can't read this nonsense.

[urgent] If this is going to work, I'm going to need my scrying goggles, a five hundred pound chicken and volume II of "Draconic for Dummies." [pause] Not necessarily in that order.
quest_8577_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I am to translate anything, I will need my scrying goggles. [sad] Unfortunately, those were stolen quite some time ago by my ex-best friend forever, Stewvul. [soft voice] He broke my heart in five places and then left me here to rot.

[urgent] With the help of my trusty crystal ball, I've isolated his whereabouts to either the Greymane Wall in Silverpine or what appears to be a portal world in the Outland that is currently being overrun by the Burning Legion. [commanding] You're going to have to track him down and get my goggles back, <name>!
quest_8577_quest_complete: [shocked] I can't believe he found me. [sad] I thought for sure that I'd lost him when I was in the Outland. [urgent] I'm not going back there, <race>! [angry] No way, no how! [defiant] I'm through being his part time best friend forever and full time slave.
quest_8580_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, <class>. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!

[chuckling] Pele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
quest_8580_quest_progress: [angry] You not want to make Pele'keiki mad. [soft voice] You make Pele'keiki happy by bringing him lots of firebloom, real soon.
quest_8580_quest_complete: [excited] Cross your fingers, friend! [warm] Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
quest_8581_quest_detail:
Pele'keiki [soft voice] know you come to help. Bring many firebloom and make him very happy. Pele'keiki might make big bombs with firebloom. Drop them on insects from his bat over Ahn'Qiraj when war come. But Pele'keiki need more firebloom, <class>!

[urgent] You gonna bring Pele'keiki that firebloom, real quick now. Come back with at least as much as last time, and Pele'keiki be pleased.
quest_8581_quest_complete: [excited] This no joke, <class>? You bring Pele'keiki firebloom that fast? Pele'keiki count them up right now, mon! [warm] You makin' Pele'keiki so happy, he be tellin' everyone, <name> best firebloom collector ever! [urgent] Pele'keiki can't wait for war to start. Now we really light up the sky over Silithus, right, bruddah?!
quest_8582_quest_detail:
[solemn] The purple lotus, <class>, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. [urgent] We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.

[commanding] That's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. [hesitant] Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
quest_8582_quest_progress: [urgent] Returned already with the purple lotus that I have requested, <class>? It is critical that you do so in as timely as fashion as possible lest all that I am attempting here come to naught.
quest_8582_quest_complete: [solemn] A commendable effort, <class>. I will measure these specimens for their appropriate usage and note your contribution. The purple lotus will then need to be properly stored until I am ready for them. [low voice] As for you, if you are still available I should imagine that I'll still need more purple lotus. [urgent] Please check back with me in a moment.
quest_8583_quest_detail:
[solemn] In fact it does appear that we are in need of even more purple lotus, <class>. While my own studies have yet to determine a new useful application for the herb, there are tried and true methodologies yet to be employed.

[urgent] I need you to once again go out into the field and collect at least twenty purple lotus samples. Return them to me here.
quest_8583_quest_progress:
In fact it does appear that we are in need of even more purple lotus, <class>. [solemn] While my own studies have yet to determine a new useful application for the herb, there are tried and true methodologies yet to be employed.

[commanding] I need you to once again go out into the field and collect at least twenty purple lotus samples. Return them to me here.
quest_8583_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Excellent and precise work, <name>. [solemn] Your diligence is to be commended, as is your celerity. [warm] I will personally see to it that none of these purple lotus go to waste.

[warm] Thank you again, and should you come by more purple lotus do not hesitate to bring them to me with utmost haste.
quest_8584_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If there is one thing that you should know about me, it is this: [angry] NEVER ask me about my business! [low voice] I work with things you simply cannot understand. Like for example: Do you know what a psychotronic muzzledorf is? Of course you don't! [solemn] And that's why we leave the planning to me and the fetching to you.

[pause] As I said earlier, if this is going to work, we're going to need a 500 pound chicken.

[urgent] Head to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quikcleave - he'll get you started on finding a suitable specimen.
quest_8584_quest_complete:
<Dirge scratches his head.> [excited] A 500 pound chicken? There's no such thing! Not anymore, at least. [solemn] I knew of such a chicken... The Black Chicken of Death...

<Dirge's voice trails off.>

But yes, nobody ever saw that chicken and lived to tell the tale. [urgent] I've got an idea that could benefit the both of us, kid.
quest_8585_quest_detail:
[excited] Legend has it that the chimaerok of the Isle of Dread in Feralas have the most succulent and tender vittles in existence! [laughing] Now these chimaerok also have a daddy who, with proper preparation, may or may not look like a 500 pound chicken.

[urgent] Head to the Isle of Dread and kill Lord Lakmaeran and bring me his fresh carcass. [soft voice] That should satisfy the gnome. [commanding] To satisfy me, you'll need to get your hands on some chimaerok tenderloin.

[excited] Do this and you'll have your 500 pound chicken and a little something extra.
quest_8585_quest_complete:
[excited] Look at the marbleization on those tenderloins! Fantastic!

[laughing] Now about that chicken... Hrm, let me see. I'm going to need a few minutes to devise the recipe.
quest_8586_quest_detail:
[excited] My recipe is complete! [urgent] What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. [commanding] I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.

[solemn] After you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.
quest_8586_quest_progress: Hurry it up, kid. [urgent] We don't want this meat to go bad.
quest_8586_quest_complete: [excited] It's ready! [proud] I present to you my greatest creation: [loud voice] Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!
quest_8587_quest_detail:
[commanding] I'm a goblin of my word, kid. [warm] Here's your 500 pound chicken.

[mocking tone] What a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...

<Dirge grumbles something unintelligible.>

[soft voice] Probably to sleep in it... [angry] Dirty gnomes...
quest_8587_quest_progress: [soft voice] What is that scrumptious smell?
quest_8587_quest_complete: <Narain mashes two fists into the huge chicken, stuffing his face full of Dirge's delicious delicacy.> [excited] MMmmm... This is unbelievable! [delight] Best chicken I've ever had!
quest_8588_quest_detail:
[urgent] Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.

But first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, <class>. [commanding] Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.
quest_8588_quest_progress: [urgent] I've got no time for games if you're just here to jibber-jabber, <class>. [commanding] There are too many stacks of heavy leather that need curing. [commanding] Come back when you have at least ten for me.
quest_8588_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, so you do have the heavy leather I needed. [warm] Your blade is sharp indeed, <class>; these are good skins! [proud] Now that we've gotten off on the right foot with one another I'll make sure that your contribution is put to good use. [gentle] And if you happen to come across more heavy leather, bring it my way.
quest_8589_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It's true, <class>, I still need more heavy leather. [urgent] The requests from the generals and their quartermasters seem endless. And that's nothing compared to what the zeppelin masters are asking for!

[urgent] I need to get my quota collected on the double. [commanding] Baekun, bring me more stacks of heavy leather as soon as you can!
quest_8589_quest_progress:
[soft voice] It's true, <class>, I still need more heavy leather. [low voice] The requests from the generals and their quartermasters seem endless. And that's nothing compared to what the zeppelin masters are asking for!

[urgent] I need to get my quota collected on the double. [warm] <name>, bring me more stacks of heavy leather as soon as you can!
quest_8589_quest_complete:
[excited] You da mon, mon! [warm] Thank you so much for the heavy leather. [soft voice] Every little bit gets us that much closer. [pause] I'll just get these onto a pile so that the other leatherworkers can get to work on them.

[warm] Thanks again, <name>, and if you come across more stacks of heavy leather, you know where you can find me.
quest_8590_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm glad that you decided to speak to me about this, <class>. It looks like the Horde's preparations for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War are in full swing. But you and I still need to do our part.

[commanding] I've been asked to collect a great number of thick leather skins for use in all manner of war materiel, and I need you to help me by going out there and gathering them up. There's honor and the gratitude of the Horde in it for you should you decide to help. [solemn] Will you?
quest_8590_quest_progress: [urgent] <class>, have you returned so soon with the ten thick leather that we discussed?
quest_8590_quest_complete: [commanding] Good work, <class>. [warm] I'm sure that these thick leather skins will be put to use reinforcing zeppelins and making all manner of armor and weaponry. [proud] You have my thanks, and that of the Horde. [warm] Come back again if you come across more thick leather in your travels, and luck be with you.
quest_8591_quest_detail:
Druid, as you can see I still need to gather up more thick leather. [urgent] Once again I ask your help with this task, and promise that if you complete it, you will be recognized for your efforts.

[commanding] Time is of the essence! Return to me with the thick leather so that we can finish our preparations and go to war, hero!
quest_8591_quest_progress:
<class>, as you can see I still need to gather up more thick leather. [urgent] Once again I ask your help with this task, and promise that if you complete it, you will be recognized for your efforts.

[commanding] Time is of the essence! [urgent] Return to me with the thick leather so that we can finish our preparations and go to war, hero !
quest_8591_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it, <name>, I knew that you would! [warm] Once again, thank you on behalf of the entire Horde. [proud] Your efforts have been noted and are greatly appreciated. [commanding] And if you find yourself with more thick leather that you'd like to donate, bring them to me here.

[urgent] Lok'tar Ogar, <class>!
quest_8592_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. [threatening] They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.

In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. [cold] But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.

[urgent] Bring me the components I require, <name>. [confident] I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
quest_8592_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring me the components I asked for, <name>?
quest_8592_quest_complete:
[excited] You've succeeded! [warm] The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased.

Take this as a reward. [solemn] The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... [threatening] it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
quest_8593_quest_detail:
[commanding] You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? [soft voice] Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

[solemn] The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. [sad] He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.

[whispering] His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.

[urgent] Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
quest_8593_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you bring the components I require, <name>?
quest_8593_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer. [solemn] Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. [warm] May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
quest_8594_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.

[urgent] Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
quest_8594_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you collected the components I require?
quest_8594_quest_complete: [solemn] From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. [warm] May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
quest_8595_quest_detail:
[solemn] I see that you're no ordinary mortal, <name>. [soft voice] Your chances against the Old God, however infinitely small, are greater than ours at this point. [pause] After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you.

[solemn] Just as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact. [urgent] Gain the trust of the Bronze Dragonflight and you'll gain our trust. [solemn] Only then we shall make a true champion out of you.
quest_8595_quest_progress: [solemn] Killing one Qiraji lord is a notable accomplishment for a mortal, <name>. They are however, numerous and powerful. [commanding] Continue to defeat them to prove your worth as our champion. Qiraji Lord's Insignia
quest_8595_quest_complete: [solemn] You continue to serve us well, <name>. [warm] Our pact remains in place.
quest_8596_quest_detail:
[solemn] Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

[commanding] Bring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

[urgent] You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
quest_8596_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8596_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done well, <name>. [proud] You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.

[confident] I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
quest_8597_quest_detail:
[excited] I knew that book would come in handy some day! [soft voice] Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe.

[commanding] Don't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! [laughing] I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. [sad] Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. [excited] It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers!

[urgent] Look for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! [excited] You'll know the spot when you see it!
quest_8597_quest_complete: [excited] The book is gone! [warm] On top of the dirt mound is a note.
quest_8599_quest_complete:
[shocked] What!?

<Narain starts to fidget.>

Well, um... [hesitant] What do you want me to do??? [angry] She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! [sad] And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.
quest_8600_quest_detail:
[low voice] I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. [emphasis] Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, <class>? [commanding] But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes?

[pause] Well, no matter, I have a task for you. [urgent] In service to the Horde, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. [commanding] This is something that you will do, no?
quest_8600_quest_progress: [angry] It couldn't possibly be taking you this long to slice off ten rugged leather for me! [mocking tone] Perhaps you should sharpen your skinning knife? Or, perhaps I am mistaken and you have them there in your pack?
quest_8600_quest_complete: [solemn] Very well, it appears you've done a fairly decent job of it, though some of those skins look a bit ragged about the edges. [soft voice] No matter, the task is completed, and you have earned your reward. [warm] Should you come across another stack of rugged leather, be sure to bring them to me posthaste.
quest_8601_quest_detail: [solemn] Preparations for the impending war at Ahn'Qiraj are proceeding, <class>. [low voice] However, to ensure that we do not fall behind, or at least that I am not the one that causes us to fall behind, I want for you to bring back another stack of rugged leather. [urgent] Your prompt attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated, <name>.
quest_8601_quest_progress: [solemn] Preparations for the impending war at Ahn'Qiraj are proceeding, <class>. [urgent] However, to ensure that we do not fall behind, or at least that I am not the one that causes us to fall behind, I want for you to bring back another stack of rugged leather. [commanding] Your prompt attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated, <name>.
quest_8601_quest_complete:
[solemn] Practice, practice, practice. [soft voice] A well honed knife and the skill to use it will get you far in this world, <name>. [warm] Looks like the edges on these skins are better than the last. [hesitant] Did you buy a new knife?

[solemn] In any case, we thank you for your efforts. [warm] Your donation has been noted, and will be put to good use I can assure you. [urgent] Should you find yourself in the possession of more rugged leather, be sure to come back and speak with me, as I will probably need it.
quest_8602_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.

[urgent] Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
quest_8602_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you collected the components I require?
quest_8602_quest_complete: [solemn] From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. [warm] May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
quest_8603_quest_detail:
[solemn] The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.

When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. [urgent] You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.

Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
quest_8603_quest_progress: [solemn] At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
quest_8603_quest_complete:
[solemn] I did not expect you to return from your attempt, <name>.

[warm] You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings.

By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension.

[proud] Accept these vestments as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions.

[gentle] May their power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
quest_8604_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greetings, <class>. [soft voice] In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. [pause] Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. [sad] Trust me, I know first hand. [solemn] Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.

[urgent] If you have the time, I need many wool bandages. [warm] Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
quest_8604_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, <class>, have you returned so quickly with the wool bandages?
quest_8604_quest_complete: [solemn] You have my sincere gratitude. [warm] Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
quest_8605_quest_detail: [soft voice] Good to see you again, <class>. We are still working on preparations here for the war effort, and I can still use all of the help that you can give in gathering up wool bandaging. Any assistance at all will be greatly appreciated. [solemn] I only hope that our efforts will be good enough. I've lost too many noble souls on the battlefields of yesterday to not do everything in my power to see to it that doesn't happen again.
quest_8605_quest_complete:
[solemn] You are an honorable <class>, <name>! [warm] I will see to it that these bandages get into the right hands. [proud] You have my thanks, and that of the Horde.

[gentle] Go in peace, and return to me again should you find yourself with excess wool bandaging. [urgent] We can use all of the help that we can get here.
quest_8606_quest_detail:
[excited] I've got it! Here's what we're going to do. [commanding] I'm going to fill a sack up with rocks and you're going to make the drop. I know it said that I should make the delivery and I'm going to - sort of.

<Narain looks you up and down.>

Yes, you will do just fine. Take this turban, robe, and sack of rocks and head to the drop off point in Winterspring.

I've included everything you need in this special kit. When they show up to pick up the goods, snuff them out! [angry] That will teach them to mess with Narain!
quest_8606_quest_complete: [solemn] I think we may have underestimated these booknappers.
quest_8607_quest_detail: [commanding] I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? [emphasis] Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, <class>, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
quest_8607_quest_progress: [angry] Do not fail and make me look bad, <class>! [urgent] Return here as quickly as possible with the mageweave bandages we discussed.
quest_8607_quest_complete: [soft voice] Surprising, yet acceptable. Perhaps I underestimated your 'abilities', <class>. [low voice] Perhaps. You completed a very simple task, and for doing so you are to be rewarded out of proportion. [commanding] But don't let it go to your head. [urgent] If you really want to prove yourself you should get out there and bring me another bundle of mageweave bandages.
quest_8608_quest_detail: [solemn] You returned? Interesting. As you can see I am still collecting for the Ahn'Qiraj 'war effort'. [urgent] Which means that I need you to once again go out and collect a stack of mageweave bandages for me. [soft voice] I look forward to your return, <class>.
quest_8608_quest_progress: [solemn] You returned? Interesting. As you can see I am still collecting for the Ahn'Qiraj 'war effort'. Which means that I need you to once again go out and collect a stack of mageweave bandages for me. [soft voice] I look forward to your return, <class>.
quest_8608_quest_complete: [excited] Astounding, <class>, you actually did it again! [warm] Well, they do say that I have good taste in those that I choose to place in my service. [commanding] Very well, your contribution is noted and you will receive the social benefits that your efforts have afforded. [urgent] I suggest though that you go back out and gather yet another bundle of mageweave bandages if you truly wish to prove your worth.
quest_8609_quest_detail:
[solemn] It appears inevitable that the Horde and Alliance are on a collision course for war at Ahn'Qiraj. Surprisingly, it is not a war with each other, but rather with the silithid, and whatever force controls them. Also surprisingly, both sides are doing their part to gather the resources necessary to wage a successful war.

[soft voice] I am collecting runecloth bandages to distribute to the soldiers, but I won't be successful without assistance, hopefully yours. [gentle] Is this something that you can aid me with, <class>?
quest_8609_quest_progress: [solemn] The war comes soon, I think, <class>. [soft voice] I thank you for your time and effort devoted to helping with our gathering tasks. [pause] Do you return because you have obtained the runecloth bandages that we spoke of before?
quest_8610_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ever does the time grow nearer when we shall launch ourselves headlong into the conflagration at Ahn'Qiraj, priest. But first we must gather our strength and prepare so that we can survive the onslaught of the insects and their masters.

[soft voice] If you are here again, then surely you wish to make another contribution of runecloth bandages to the war effort? [urgent] Please do so as soon as you can and return to me once more.
quest_8610_quest_complete: [solemn] It is a very selfless act of giving that you perform, <name>. One that is likely to save the lives of many combatants at Ahn'Qiraj. [warm] Thank you and know that you have the appreciation of the Horde for your donation. [commanding] Should you create, or come across, more runecloth bandages, please consider bringing them to me here.
quest_8611_quest_detail:
[urgent] I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, <class>. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!

[commanding] They have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. [emphasis] You got all that?
quest_8611_quest_progress: [urgent] Back with those lean wolf steaks so soon, <class>? [commanding] I don't care if they're overcooked or tartar, just make sure they're tasty and get them to me quick!
quest_8611_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ok, this stack of meat looks good to me. [low voice] I'll salt them, and then pack them away and hopefully they'll keep fresh enough to be edible when the time comes.

[warm] Thanks for the contribution, <class>. [urgent] Do you think you could bring me another rack?
quest_8612_quest_detail: [solemn] As you can see, <class>, we still need to pack away more food for the soldiers. [low voice] I don't know if you've ever been in a war before, but once you get past the initial shock of the battlefield, you can get pretty hungry. [warm] You did a good job last time, so I expect that you'll do as well, if not a little quicker, in getting me another stack of those lean wolf steaks.
quest_8612_quest_progress: [soft voice] As you can see, <class>, we still need to pack away more food for the soldiers. [commanding] I don't know if you've ever been in a war before, but once you get past the initial shock of the battlefield, you can get pretty hungry. [warm] You did a good job last time, so I expect that you'll do as well, if not a little quicker, in getting me another stack of those lean wolf steaks.
quest_8612_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Smells like you, or someone you know, are quite the cook, <name>. [warm] Those lean wolf steaks are making my mouth water; I suppose a few going missing won't be noticed. [pause] Anyway, good work. [warm] I'll make sure someone packs them away right so that they don't spoil too much.

[urgent] If you come across more, you know where to find me.
quest_8613_quest_detail: [soft voice] It be a nice day for fishin', don't'cha think mon? [warm] Good thing, cuz I be needin' a lot of fish it lookin' like. [commanding] The Horde, they askin' me to be in charge of collectin' a ton of the spotted yellowtail for them. [solemn] They say they needin' it for the war they getting' ready for at Ahn'Qiraj. [confident] I say to them I do the best I can. [urgent] So I be needin' to get some help. [commanding] You gonna be helpin' me, <class>?
quest_8613_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The sprite darters can be dangerous critters when provoked. Be careful when dealing with them, <class>. And be even more careful of any night elves in the area. The pestering fools tend to hold up in the forests also.

[urgent] When you've gotten enough of the wings, let me know, I'll be sure to reward you well!
quest_8613_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful, <class>! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! [warm] Thank you. [hesitant] I hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.

[warm] Thank you again, <class>.
quest_8614_quest_detail: [soft voice] So as you can see, we still be needin' a lot of the fishies. [urgent] The combatants in the upcomin' Ahn'Qiraj War gonna be needin' a lot to eat, so I needin' to get all the spotted yellowtail that I can. [commanding] You catch 'em, cook 'em, and bringin' 'em back to me here, and I be givin' you thanks, and the thanks of the Horde.
quest_8614_quest_complete: [delight] That be the best catch yet, <name>! [warm] Good, honest work right there. And no bones too! [warm] Thanks goin' out to you for this spotted yellowtail here mon. [excited] Come back soon if you cookin' up some more!
quest_8615_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, <class>. [soft voice] All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. [pause] For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.

[emphasis] Thus, we gather what food we can. [warm] I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. [gentle] Can you aid me with this task, <class>?
quest_8615_quest_progress:
[solemn] The sprite darters can be dangerous critters when provoked. [urgent] Be careful when dealing with them, <class>. [soft voice] And be even more careful of any night elves in the area. [hesitant] The pestering fools tend to hold up in the forests also.

[warm] When you've gotten enough of the wings, let me know, I'll be sure to reward you well!
quest_8615_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful, <class>! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! [warm] Thank you. I hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.

[warm] Thank you again, <class>.
quest_8616_quest_detail: [soft voice] The last batch of baked salmon that you donated to the war effort looked very delicious, <class>. [hesitant] I must admit that I was tempted to take a few for myself. [solemn] As you can tell, we have not yet reached our quota here. [warm] I am hoping you have returned because you have another stack of baked salmon with you
quest_8619_quest_complete: [solemn] It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. [warm] I bid you well, <name>, and offer you this token...
quest_8620_quest_detail:
[solemn] I should have known. My arch-enemy, Doctor Weavil, up to his old tricks! [angry] And now, thanks to your failure in Winterspring, Doctor Weavil has destroyed my book! [urgent] How are you going to save the world now, hero?

[emphasis] The note I received stated that the only known copy of "Draconic for Dummies: Volume II" was ripped into 8 parts and scattered to the wind! [commanding] If you somehow manage to find those missing chapters, use this magical binding to put them back together and return to me.
quest_8620_quest_progress: [soft voice] I put my pants on just like you - one leg at a time. [pause] Except when my pants are on, I make arcanite buoys. [excited] Arcanite buoys, baby!
quest_8620_quest_complete:
[excited] Fantastic! I can't believe you went through the hassle! Are you some kind of machine? If it were me, I would have probably just let the world implode.

[warm] I tip my turban to you, sir. And no good deed should go unrewarded.
quest_8621_quest_detail:
[solemn] Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

[commanding] Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

[urgent] You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
quest_8621_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8621_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done well, <name>. [proud] You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.

[confident] I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
quest_8622_quest_detail:
[solemn] The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.

When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. [urgent] You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.

Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
quest_8622_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8622_quest_complete:
[solemn] I did not expect you to return from your attempt, <name>.

[warm] You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings.

[solemn] By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension.

[warm] Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions.

[proud] May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
quest_8623_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. [threatening] They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.

In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. [low voice] But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.

[urgent] Bring me the components I require, <name>. [confident] I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
quest_8623_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8623_quest_complete:
[excited] You've succeeded! [solemn] The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased.

[warm] Take this as a reward. [cold] The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... [threatening] it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
quest_8624_quest_detail:
[commanding] You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? [soft voice] Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

[solemn] The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. [low voice] He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.

[hesitant] His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.

[warm] Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
quest_8624_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8624_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer. [soft voice] Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. [warm] May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
quest_8625_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.

[commanding] Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
quest_8625_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you collected the components I require?
quest_8625_quest_complete: [solemn] From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. [warm] May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

[commanding] Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
quest_8659_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you collected the components I require?
quest_8659_quest_complete: [solemn] From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. [warm] May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
quest_8660_quest_detail:
[solemn] Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

[urgent] Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

[confident] You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
quest_8660_quest_progress: [soft voice] You've acquired the items I requested, <name>?
quest_8660_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done well, <name>. [proud] You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.

[confident] I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
quest_8661_quest_detail:
[solemn] The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. [solemn] The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.

[solemn] When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. [urgent] You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.

[warm] Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. [excited] I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
quest_8661_quest_progress: [solemn] At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
quest_8661_quest_complete:
[solemn] I did not expect you to return from your attempt, <name>.

[warm] You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings.

[solemn] By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension.

[warm] Accept these robes as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions.

[proud] May their power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
quest_8662_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. [angry] They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.

In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. [soft voice] But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.

[urgent] Bring me the components I require, <name>. [confident] I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
quest_8662_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring me the components I asked for, <name>?
quest_8662_quest_complete:
[excited] You've succeeded! [solemn] The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased.

[warm] Take this as a reward. [cold] The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... [threatening] it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
quest_8663_quest_detail:
[commanding] You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

[solemn] The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. [soft voice] He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.

[pause] His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.

[urgent] Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
quest_8663_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you bring the components I require, <name>?
quest_8663_quest_complete: [solemn] Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer. [soft voice] Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. [warm] May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!

quest_8687_quest_complete: [commanding] Excellent work, <name>. [solemn] Without their tunnelers, the silithid will have a hard time repairing any damage inflicted to their hive's structure. [urgent] I assume you'll want a new task.

[soft voice] Well that took a little longer than expected. [pause] Now let me see what this ledger says.

<Narain silently reads the ledger, periodically mumbling under his breath.>

[solemn] The good news is that I am 99% certain that I am capable of creating an arcanite buoy that will function to your specifications. [emphasis] This is, of course, wholly dependant on the bad news.

[low voice] The bad news is that I'm going to need a lot of arcanite, elementium ore, and rare gemstones.

[urgent] Bring me what I need and I will craft the buoy.
quest_8728_quest_progress: [low voice] Arcanite buoys don't just make themselves, <name>. [angry] And NO, you cannot borrow some money.
quest_8728_quest_complete: [solemn] A deal is a deal. [soft voice] I sure hope you know what you are getting yourself into, <name>. [hesitant] This is an awful lot of trouble to go through to do some fishing.
quest_8729_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Did I mention the bad news yet? [angry] Its name is Maws: 100 feet of death and destruction. [hesitant] I guess I may have forgotten that little tidbit.

[soft voice] According to my superior psycho-psionic clairvoyance, you'll find that the best spot to cast this buoy is off the coast of Azshara, in the Bay of Storms.

[urgent] Look for a swirling maelstrom, most likely cluttered with wreckage.

[hesitant] By the by, I hope you have friends.

[urgent] Now if you somehow miraculously succeed, take the scepter shard to Anachronos.
quest_8731_quest_detail:
Greetings, <name>. [solemn] Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty.

[soft voice] You will find Captain Skullsplit's Orgrimmar Legion outside Hive'Regal.

[commanding] Report to him and come back to me with proof of your field service. [solemn] I shall have a more advanced assignment ready for you.

[soft voice] Oh, please do your best to stay away from the Ironforge Brigade. [urgent] Tensions are high among our Alliance and Horde volunteers.
quest_8731_quest_progress: [solemn] You've completed your field duty, <name>? [commanding] Captain Skullsplit can be found outside of Hive'Regal.
quest_8731_quest_complete:
I can tell that Krug has little use for paperwork. [angry] He signed this in silithid blood!

[solemn] Very well, <name>. [soft voice] I've prepared a set of tasks that should make good use of your skills as a <class>.

[proud] With the continued efforts of you and people like you, our enemy will soon be crushed!
quest_8732_quest_progress: [low voice] I take it you want those papers signed, boy? [commanding] Prepared Field Duty Papers
quest_8732_quest_complete:
[solemn] Yes, I suppose that little skirmish will pass as field duty nowadays. [warm] Take these back to Cenarion Hold, I'm sure they'll have a cushy job ready for you.

[excited] Off you go!
quest_8733_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is a journey of redemption, hero. Would it be that I was slain today, I would have died for a just and righteous cause. [urgent] You must recover the green scepter shard. [solemn] You must cleanse Eranikus of the taint placed upon him by the Old Gods.

[pause] Travel to Darnassus. [soft voice] Just outside the city walls you will find one of my agents. [whispering] This agent will set things in motion for us and inform Tyrande of our plans without alerting Staghelm.

<Malfurion sighs.>

[solemn] A fall from grace a thousand years in the making...
quest_8737_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. [urgent] With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.

[commanding] Find a way to summon and destroy an Azure Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
quest_8737_quest_complete: [excited] Good job, <name>. [warm] Here's your next assignment.
quest_8738_quest_detail: [solemn] We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Landion has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Regal for several days now. Find him and obtain a written report. [urgent] We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, <name>.
quest_8738_quest_progress: [urgent] You'll find Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal. [urgent] Hurry, <name>! [urgent] Time is of the essence.
quest_8738_quest_complete: [warm] Your efforts are greatly appreciated, <name>. [soft voice] I'll read these scouting reports right away, [gentle] feel free to go over your next assignment.

[solemn] Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans.

[urgent] Find and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna. [commanding] Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
quest_8740_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] The twilight marauders were inflicting an unacceptable number of casualties on our patrols. [soft voice] Here's your next assignment.
quest_8745_quest_complete:
Greetings, champion. [solemn] I am Jonathan, keeper of the sacred gong and eternal watcher of the Bronze Flight.

[warm] I have been empowered by the Timeless One himself to grant you an item of your choosing from his timeless treasure trove. [proud] May it aid you in your battles against C'Thun.
quest_8746_quest_detail:
[urgent] DISASTER has struck! [shouting] Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!

[solemn] Metzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures. [urgent] We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen. [urgent] With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here! [hesitant] Please - find Metzen and return him to us!

[commanding] Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!

[urgent] Please, hurry!
quest_8746_quest_progress: <name>! [urgent] Did you find him? [hesitant] Were the notes in the satchel I gave you enough information to locate Metzen? [sad] I hate to think of what those cruel thugs might do to him... but there's no way we can afford to pay such an exorbitant ransom!
quest_8746_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! Huzzah!

[warm] Metzen flew back into Great-father Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago! [soft voice] The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would. [warm] You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster. [warm] Thank you, <name>.

[pause] Listen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this. [warm] It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it. [delight] Happy Winter Veil!

[pause] There is already fresh holly in the machine - you simply need to provide some deeprock salt and five gold coins to get the machine working.

[pause] It is not too long thereafter until it stops, heralded by another small jet of steam erupting from it. [emphasis] A door hatch opens, revealing a batch of preserved holly!
