quest_8780_quest_complete: Thanks, I'll hand these out to the lads.
quest_8781_quest_detail: [solemn] The Ironforge Brigade has been a worthy ally in our fight in Silithus. Unfortunately, many of their supplies were lost on their way here. [urgent] Procure a batch of weapons and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer near Hive'Zora.
quest_8781_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, excellent! [warm] I won't have to hear complaints about dull blades anymore. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_8782_quest_detail: [solemn] The latest influx of volunteers has caused a shortage of uniforms. [soft voice] Procure a batch of uniform materials and bring them to Windcaller Proudhorn.
quest_8782_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, we were in need of these. [warm] Your work is appreciated, <name>.
quest_8783_quest_detail: [solemn] Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces. [urgent] Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
quest_8783_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, yes. [warm] These materials are of excellent quality. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_8784_quest_detail: [excited] You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! [solemn] Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
quest_8784_quest_progress: [excited] You're glowing! [hesitant] I know what that means...
quest_8784_quest_complete: [solemn] An exceptional find, <name>. [warm] Simply marvelous! [soft voice] This will definitely give us some insight into our enemy's twisted minds.

quest_8786_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work. [warm] We were in short supply of these, <name>.
quest_8787_quest_detail: [solemn] The brave volunteers of the Orgrimmar Legion have arrived to Silithus to aid us in our cause. quest_8787_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, yes... I will distribute these to the troops, <name>. [warm] The Orgrimmar Legion thanks you!
quest_8789_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have not sat idly by for a millennium, <name>.

[low voice] We have watched these beasts feast on their own when they have exhausted their utility. [soft voice] We have listened as they have plotted and schemed to destroy our world. And we have learned of their own internal treachery.

[commanding] Weaknesses exist and we know how to use those weaknesses to our advantage.

[urgent] Find and bring me their ceremonial armaments: Combined with the element created from the volatility of their own God, they will become a force of reckoning.
quest_8789_quest_progress: [commanding] Seek out what I requested. [solemn] You will become greater than the sum of your parts, champion.
quest_8789_quest_complete: [solemn] Infused with Elementium, these weapons will cut through the Qiraji and their God with incredible ease.
quest_8790_quest_detail:
[solemn] Arygos theorizes that the element which is born of conflicts between the Old Gods and their minions is also extremely deadly to them under the right conditions. [soft voice] I speak of Elementium, mortal.

[urgent] Find and bring me Imperial Qiraji Regalia and the toxic element and I shall infuse weapons of great power.
quest_8790_quest_progress: [solemn] You will strike them down and free us of these bonds.
quest_8790_quest_complete: [solemn] Use the item well, <name>. [cold] Let them feel the pain that they so dearly wish to inflict upon others.
quest_8791_quest_detail:

[soft voice] The denizens of Kalimdor would be relieved to know of this victory. [commanding] Take Ossirian's head and present it to Commander Mar'alith of Cenarion Hold.
quest_8791_quest_progress: [commanding] Ah, <name>, you have returned! [warm] And in one piece, I might add. [solemn] What news do you bring from Ahn'Qiraj?
quest_8791_quest_complete: [commanding] I offer you my highest commendation and your choice of an item of power, <name>. [warm] You have done the people of Kalimdor a great service.

[angry] Why are you still here!? [commanding] To Light's Hope! [warm] Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...

[urgent] Well anyway, Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers. [commanding] Can you do me a favor and deliver it!

[warm] Thanks, <name>! [soft voice] Innkeeper Allison is in the Gilded Rose, in the Trade District of Stormwind.
quest_8860_quest_progress: Greetings! [excited] Are you here for the party! [warm] Or perhaps you just need to rest those weary feet of yours...
quest_8860_quest_complete:

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] Please take this as payment, and don't forget to drink and dance with the revelers outside!
quest_8861_quest_detail:
[excited] Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year! All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!

quest_8861_quest_complete:

[excited] I thank you, <name>. You are in my debt. [warm] Please, take these coins... and heed my advice - drink heartily from the kegs outside, and join our revelers in a dance of celebration!
quest_8862_quest_progress:

quest_8863_quest_progress:

quest_8867_quest_detail:
[solemn] Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.

[soft voice] We celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... [pause] shoot fireworks! [warm] For a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor. [gentle] Try using some of the launchers around here, <name>.
quest_8867_quest_complete:
[solemn] Well done, <name>.

[warm] Now that you're in the spirit of things, why don't you take this invitation to the festival in Moonglade.

[soft voice] It's quite an enjoyable celebration, if you have the time to spare. [warm] We share food, drink, stories and of course... [excited] more fireworks! [warm] Open the invitation while standing inside the circle of greater moonlight and you'll be transported to Moonglade.
quest_8868_quest_detail:
[solemn] The beast Omen was once a hero of this world. [soft voice] A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics. [threatening] Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.

[solemn] Finally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara. [pause] But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...

[urgent] Gather cohorts, <name>, and summon and defeat the beast Omen. [warm] Earn the blessing of Elune!
quest_8868_quest_complete: [warm] Very well done, <name>. [solemn] Defeating Omen sent his spirit back to the water of Elune'ara. [soft voice] Although the beast himself is blessed by Elune and so cannot die, his anger will subside for another year.

quest_8880_quest_progress: [solemn] Cluster rockets are a collection of individual rockets, and their beauty is awesome! [warm] Bring me coins of ancestry and I will share the knowledge of their creation to you... Coin of Ancestry(5)
quest_8880_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here you are, <name>. [warm] Take these recipes and learn their secrets. [warm] I bid you fortune, and I look forward to seeing your magnificent creations.
quest_8881_quest_progress: [solemn] Large cluster rockets require vast resources and skill to create, but their brilliance and beauty is worth that effort! [warm] Bring me coins of ancestry and I will grant you the knowledge of their crafting. Coin of Ancestry(5)
quest_8881_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] Here is the recipe for large cluster rockets. [gentle] May your products bring joy and luck to all those who gaze up them.
quest_8882_quest_progress: [soft voice] The most splendid fireworks shows must include cluster rockets, and those cluster rockets must be fired from cluster launchers! [excited] Is it not then logical for you to learn the secrets of making cluster launchers? [warm] Bring me coins of ancestry and I will give this knowledge to you. Coin of Ancestry(5)
quest_8882_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here is your schematic. [emphasis] Study it closely, and learn...
quest_8883_quest_detail:
[excited] Now that you have your Lunar Festival invitation, you may travel to Moonglade! [warm] There you will find many revelers, and in the village of Nighthaven Valadar Starsong and his sister Fariel await those eager to participate in the celebration.

[soft voice] Travel to Moonglade through the greater moonlight and speak with Valadar Starsong; [excited] see what prizes you might gain during the festival!
quest_8883_quest_complete:
[warm] <name>, welcome to Nighthaven, host of the Lunar Festival! [soft voice] Although our village is normally remote and sequestered from the peoples of Azeroth, during this time of celebration we open our arms and hearts to all.

[warm] Enjoy your visit, <name>, and speak with me or my sister again when ready.
quest_8897_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.

[hesitant] Would she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.

[sigh] Anyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.
quest_8897_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, handsome. [warm] Something I can help you with?
quest_8897_quest_complete:
[delight] Oh, isn't that sweet! [soft voice] This is the first time he's ever sent me something. Do you suppose he's getting serious?

Colara Heldric? I suppose it has a ring to it. [hesitant] Oh, but I'm getting ahead of myself. [warm] Thank you.
quest_8898_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. [warm] She stole my heart away. [excited] Now, I can't stop thinking about her! [gentle] I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!

[pause] The mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.

[hesitant] If you're heading that way, could you help me?
quest_8898_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, handsome. [warm] Something I can help you with?
quest_8898_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Tormek? Oh yes, I do remember him. He had quite a nice beard and smile underneath.

[delight] Ah, I can't believe he remembered me!
quest_8899_quest_detail:
[soft voice] How to describe her beauty? [pause] Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.

[hesitant] These mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.

[sigh] I've stared at these words too long. [sad] No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. [urgent] No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
quest_8899_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, handsome. [warm] Something I can help you with?
quest_8899_quest_complete: [soft voice] I've never received something like this before. [delight] How lovely!
quest_8900_quest_detail:
[solemn] She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?

[soft voice] But after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.

When I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. [sad] But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.
quest_8900_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?
quest_8900_quest_complete: [soft voice] You wouldn't expect an orc to be so eloquent. [solemn] Of course, we never really had a chance to know them before now. [warm] Thank you for bringing this to me.
quest_8901_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the Undercity, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the Forsaken.

But now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.

[hesitant] If you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to Mulgore. I hope that she will say yes.
quest_8901_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?
quest_8901_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What kind words Temma writes for me. [pause] But, as much as his words move me, I cannot consider the love of a tauren. In thoughts, body and mind we are too different.

It is good I do not have to receive these thoughts of his in person. [sad] I could not bear to break his heart.
quest_8902_quest_detail:
[solemn] A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. [soft voice] It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.

[hesitant] Perhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.

[pause] I'm sure she has changed, also. [soft voice] Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
quest_8902_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?
quest_8902_quest_complete:
[solemn] This brings back memories from a lifetime ago, <name>. [soft voice] Elenia Tor. That was going to be my name, you know. [pause] We would have a beautiful ceremony out on the shores of the lake. When he retired, we'd find a farm to retire to.

[sad] Simple dreams, then.

[sad] But if he saw me now, I doubt he'd even see Elenia in me. [cold] Only cold flesh and a dead heart...
quest_8903_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the Alliance itself.

[urgent] Just think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? [commanding] Something must be done.

Go to one of the guards here in Stormwind and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
quest_8903_quest_progress: [hesitant] Was I right to worry? [soft voice] Are the guards afflicted with this lovesickness?
quest_8903_quest_complete: [solemn] So it is true. [sad] This is unbelievable. [sad] How could this have happened? [sad] Let me think for a moment. [sad] There must be a reason behind this.
quest_8904_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. [angry] It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.

[sad] It's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. [low voice] But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.

[urgent] Find one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
quest_8904_quest_progress: [hesitant] Was I right to worry? [urgent] Have our idiot guardians been overcome?
quest_8904_quest_complete: [solemn] So it is true. [sad] This is unbelievable. [angry] How could this have happened? [pause] Let me think for a moment. [sad] There must be a reason behind this.
quest_8905_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well met, <class>. I've something that might interest you.

[soft voice] I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. [gentle] I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

[solemn] The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. [commanding] Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. [confident] You shall find the effort worth your while.
quest_8905_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you brought me what I requested of you, <name>?
quest_8905_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. [soft voice] It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.

[warm] If you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

quest_8913_quest_detail:
Hail, <class>! [soft voice] I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. [soft voice] Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

[commanding] Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

[urgent] I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. [commanding] Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
quest_8913_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you obtained the items I require, <name>?
quest_8913_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, yes. [soft voice] Mux will be quite happy with this.

[low voice] Those bracers were part of a larger armor set. [gentle] If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

quest_8921_quest_detail:
[excited] Ah, you're in need of my latest project... the extra-dimensional ghost revealer! [sad] Unfortunately I've run out of funds and manpower.

[excited] You're willing to help? Excellent! [commanding] Our first task is to build a device to harvest the very fabric of death! [solemn] Building an ectoplasmic distiller won't be an easy task, <name>.

[urgent] I'll need you to bring me an arcanite converter, some greater eternal essences and stonescale oil. [urgent] I'll also need some volcanic ash from the lava pools in the Burning Steppes to build a filter.
quest_8921_quest_progress: [urgent] I understand the materials are a bit pricey... [confident] but I promise you every last one of them shall be necessary!
quest_8921_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These are precisely the materials I needed. [excited] Quite timely too, <name>!

[urgent] In mere moments I will have your distiller ready to go! [warm] In the meantime, take this as a reward for aiding me in my project.
quest_8922_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!

[soft voice] I know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural. He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!

[urgent] The blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
quest_8922_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent! Just as I was running low!

[urgent] You say Deliana sent you?
quest_8923_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You must be quite brave to have stuck around after that. [low voice] That or I've piqued your interest with the piece of armor I gave you. [solemn] There is more from where that came from, if you're still interested in aiding me.

[soft voice] The venom samples you collected are for an acquaintance of mine, Mux Manascrambler, an engineer with an interest in the supernatural. [excited] His latest project consists of a device that allows you to communicate with the dead! [solemn] My last hope is to contact Anthion and find out more about my situation.
quest_8923_quest_progress: [low voice] You wish to speak to me?
quest_8923_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent! Just as I was running low!

[gasp] You say Mokvar sent you?
quest_8924_quest_detail:
[commanding] A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself! [urgent] You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.

[soft voice] You see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead. [solemn] The tortured night elves of Silithus, the spirits of the highborne from Winterspring and the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need. [urgent] Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
quest_8924_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gathered the ectoplasm yet, <race>?
quest_8924_quest_complete:
[excited] Yes, these will do great!

[commanding] By tapping into the otherworldly energies contained within these substances we'll be able to reach out to those whose souls haven't quite left this world yet!
quest_8925_quest_detail:
[urgent] Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active. [soft voice] I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat!

[excited] It's said he can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain. [commanding] Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
quest_8925_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the Magma Lord, <name>?
quest_8925_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it! [warm] This will certainly provide enough energy to power up the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
quest_8926_quest_detail: [solemn] You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. [soft voice] I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. [urgent] Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. [warm] I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
quest_8926_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're ready to perform the trade?
quest_8926_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.

[soft voice] Just remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.
quest_8927_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've proven to be a very reliable individual, <name>. [solemn] As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.

[warm] For now I will exchange your belt and gloves. [confident] If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
quest_8927_quest_progress: [urgent] You're ready to perform the exchange?
quest_8927_quest_complete: [solemn] Our agreement remains in place. [commanding] Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. [urgent] Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.
quest_8928_quest_detail:
[urgent] The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.

[soft voice] I met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods. [hesitant] He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly. [groan] I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.

[whispering] He lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge. [urgent] Sneak in there and try to find him.

[commanding] Make sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
quest_8928_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you had any luck finding the imp in Darkwhisper Gorge?
quest_8928_quest_complete: [excited] You did it! [warm] This rod will do perfectly. [urgent] Now to put it all together...
quest_8929_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. [solemn] Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.

[urgent] Try using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
quest_8929_quest_complete: [soft voice] Deliana had you contact me? [warm] I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.

quest_8945_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'll provide you the information you ask for, <name>. [solemn] But more pressing matters are at hand.

[sad] My beloved wife has been taken prisoner by Rivendare's undead scum.

[urgent] I strongly objected to her joining the Argent Dawn's foolish crusade, yet that's not of importance anymore. [commanding] You must finish what I attempted to do, you must rescue Ysida from the clutches of the Baron!
quest_8945_quest_progress: [soft voice] Tell me, is Ysida alive?
quest_8945_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you for rescuing me... I feared for my life. [warm] Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.

[sad] Anthion is... no... he can't be...
quest_8946_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me. [soft voice] Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.

[urgent] Bring him this locket as proof that I am well. [sad] He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.

[soft voice] Farewell, <name>. [warm] I shall be in your debt always.
quest_8946_quest_complete:
[soft voice] That locket... you found her! [solemn] I can rest in peace at long last.

[warm] I shall now answer any questions you might have, <name>. [urgent] But make haste, my time in this world is not long.
quest_8947_quest_detail:
[solemn] We didn't realize the importance of Valthalak's medallion, so it was divided along with the rest of the spoils. The first piece was taken by a dwarf named Theldren. [angry] I tried to retrieve it from him and he beat me within an inch of my life. [commanding] You shall have to take the fragment by force.

Last I heard of him, he'd become a gladiator for the Dark Iron dwarves. [hesitant] Getting him to fight you is going to present a bit of a challenge, though.

[urgent] Gather the following materials for me. [emphasis] You're going to need them.
quest_8947_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you obtain the materials I asked for, <name>?
quest_8947_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent. I shall transmute these into something more suitable to our needs.
quest_8948_quest_detail:
[solemn] Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight. [soft voice] I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.

With some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.

[hesitant] An old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required. He has a particular way of... aggravating people. [urgent] You shall find him at the library in Dire Maul.
quest_8948_quest_progress: [urgent] Speak up stranger, can't you see I'm busy?
quest_8948_quest_complete:
[solemn] Anthion sent you, you say? [sad] I thought he was dead. [hesitant] I guess I've heard stranger things in my life.

[soft voice] Very well, then. [soft voice] What is it you want me to do with this banner?
quest_8949_quest_detail:
[solemn] Yes, it is true that I am familiar with this enchantment you require, <class>. [low voice] Yet I'm not one to give out favors freely, even if you were sent here by an old friend.

[angry] I hold nothing but hatred and contempt for our brutish ogre neighbors. And not only them, I hate the followers of Omokk just as much as I hate those that follow King Gordok.

[commanding] I want you to kill them. [shouting] Kill lots of them! [urgent] Bring me the beads they carry around their neck as proof of your work. Do this and we shall talk about your request.
quest_8949_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you performed the favor I asked of you, <name>?
quest_8949_quest_complete:
Hmmm... strangely enough I don't feel any better about my brother's death at the hands of those brutes.

[solemn] Well, you held your end of the bargain. [soft voice] Let's see what I can do for you.
quest_8950_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can place the enchantment you require on the banner quite easily, <name>. [hesitant] Unfortunately I don't have the materials I need as it is very rarely that someone asks for this sort of charm.

I will require the essence of one of the Eldreth ghosts that haunt these halls, a handful of Scholomance dark runes and some large brilliant shards. [solemn] Bring me these reagents and I shall perform this task for you.
quest_8950_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you gathered the materials I require, <name>?
quest_8950_quest_complete: [gentle] Yes, these will do just fine. [solemn] After I'm done, no force in the world will be able to stop your victim from accepting your challenge.
quest_8951_quest_detail:
[solemn] Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. [soft voice] In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

[solemn] The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. [urgent] Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. [soft voice] Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.

[pause] I, for once, shall rest in peace. [warm] I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
quest_8951_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're back, <name>. [urgent] You must tell me all about what you've found out. [warm] But first let us arrange for your reward.
quest_8951_quest_complete:
[excited] I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! [warm] And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?

[proud] Well, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

quest_8960_quest_detail:
[solemn] So we need to recover the rest of the medallion? [hesitant] Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache. He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.

[soft voice] I'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
quest_8960_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I am so glad that you can see me. [excited] Finally someone to talk to!

[warm] Will you help us, <name>? [gentle] Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? [confident] If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.

[hesitant] Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. [delight] Nice to meet you!
quest_8961_quest_detail:
[solemn] In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. [soft voice] To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.

[pause] There are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and The Duke of Cynders in Silithus, with what we need. [emphasis] Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
quest_8961_quest_progress:
[solemn] It was our folly... our doom that we took that last job. [sad] If only we hadn't inadvertently stolen Lord Valthalak's spirit, which was contained in the amulet; if only there weren't those in our mercenary group that had been so greedy and divided it up amongst themselves. [soft voice] I'd be alive today, maybe tossing back a beer, or tossing one of my kids into the air.

<name>, don't let the avarice of the ignoble in our old mercenary company be your doom as well.
quest_8961_quest_complete:
[commanding] I'm impressed, <class>, but there's no time to lose. [solemn] I will give you your next task, because you will still need to acquire a few more important components before we can proceed.

[urgent] Speak to me again when you feel that you are ready for the challenge that lies ahead.
quest_8962_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
quest_8962_quest_complete:
[solemn] A job well done, <name>. [soft voice] I will imbue the essence of the remains into the brazier.

[pause] Now all that is left is to go to the lower portion of Blackrock Spire, to the chamber where War Master Voone resides in Tazz'Alaor, and use the brazier to summon forth the corrupted spirit of my former cohort, Mor Grayhoof. [urgent] He cannot rest until the amulet piece is taken from him.
quest_8963_quest_detail:
[soft voice] <class>, listen closely. [pause] Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

[solemn] Isalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. [urgent] I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
quest_8963_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
quest_8963_quest_complete:
A job well done, <name>. [warm] I will imbue the essence of the relic into the brazier.

[solemn] Now all that is left is to go to the Shrine of Eldretharr in the east wing of Dire Maul, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Isalien. [sad] Her spirit has been corrupted by her possession of the piece of Valthalak's amulet, and the portion of his soul within it.
quest_8964_quest_detail:
[commanding] <class>, listen closely. [solemn] Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.

[soft voice] The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. [solemn] They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. [urgent] Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
quest_8964_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
quest_8964_quest_complete:
[commanding] A job well done, <name>. [solemn] I will imbue the essence of the sword into the brazier.

[urgent] Now all that is left is to get into The Crimson Throne inside The Scarlet Bastion at Stratholme, and use the brazier to summon forth the remains of my former cohorts, Jarien and Sothos. [sad] Their souls have been twisted further by their possession of Valthalak's amulet piece and his spirit within.
quest_8965_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
quest_8965_quest_complete:
A job well done, <name>. [solemn] I will imbue the essence of the ashes into the brazier.

[urgent] Now all that is left is to get into Scholomance, to Ras Frostwhisper's chamber, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Kormok. [sad] The amulet piece, and Valthalak's spirit within, has corrupted him even further, and he will not rest until you forcibly take it from him.
quest_8966_quest_detail:
[solemn] My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. [soft voice] After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. [sad] Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.

[solemn] Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. [shocked] A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.

[solemn] Heed me well, <name>. For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. [commanding] Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.

quest_9016_quest_detail:
[solemn] Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

[soft voice] I, for once, shall rest in peace. [warm] I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
quest_9016_quest_progress: [solemn] You've returned and I see in your eyes that you've much to tell me, <name>. [warm] Let us take care of your reward first.
quest_9016_quest_complete:
[solemn] This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. [low voice] Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.

[hesitant] We'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. [warm] But before that, let us see about your reward.

quest_9023_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.

[soft voice] Lord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

[pause] There are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, <class>. [urgent] Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.
quest_9023_quest_progress: [commanding] This ain't no smash and grab job, <name>. [urgent] You're gonna need to bring friends.
quest_9023_quest_complete: [delight] Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! [excited] Take your pick!
quest_9024_quest_detail:
[excited] I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.

That is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.

There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. [warm] I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
quest_9024_quest_progress: [soft voice] Something I can help you with?
quest_9024_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. [commanding] Let young men and women do what they will. [gentle] I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.

[hesitant] But it would be better not to tell him that. [warm] We'll humor him.
quest_9025_quest_detail:
[delight] Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. [solemn] I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.

[soft voice] It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
quest_9025_quest_complete:
[solemn] While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. [soft voice] We must carefully consider our next move.

[warm] Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.
quest_9026_quest_detail: [urgent] We've got to find the source. [hesitant] I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. [commanding] Talk to Allison. [soft voice] If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
quest_9026_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. [pause] It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.

[hesitant] If you ask me, it's kind of boring. [sad] Everyone smelling the same? [soft voice] It smells great, but still.
quest_9027_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.

[pause] Look, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. [gentle] I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. [hesitant] He's new in town.

He mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.
quest_9027_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Yes, of course. Those fragrances are the hottest items this season. [warm] You must be the fifth or sixth person this hour to inquire about them.

[gentle] I'm afraid my supplies are all sold out. [urgent] If you'd like some, you should speak with Allison, the innkeeper of The Gilded Rose.

[warm] You shouldn't waste any time, though. [confident] I think you'll find the perfume will be irresistible.
quest_9028_quest_detail:
[hesitant] What, treason? No, no. I assure you, my intentions are completely harmless. Is it so wrong to help those who wish to ease the painful ritual of courtship? Come now, that is no crime.

And to prove that I mean no harm, I will even tell you my source. They were shipped to me by a Staffron Lerent, an apothecary of some sort. I never spoke with him. Our goblin middle man said that he worked in the foothills over Hillsbrad past that mysterious Ravenholdt Manor. [soft voice] I wish you luck in finding him.
quest_9028_quest_complete:
[low voice] Yes, I made those fragrances. [whispering] Wonderful smell, isn't it? [mocking tone] Irresistible. [commanding voice] Once the warriors of Alliance and Horde alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the Shadow Council.

[solemn] They will be weakened, unprepared. [soft voice] As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.

[solemn] The solution was so simple. [sad] Why did it take me so long to come upon it? [cold] The weakness of all is through the heart. [threatening] And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.
quest_9032_quest_detail:
[solemn] The medallion contained Valthalaks soul? [soft voice] Its no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.

[pause] Locating Bodley presents a bit of a problem. [sad] Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire. [sad] He was never heard of again.

[urgent] Seek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though Im afraid to say hes probably dead by now. [gentle] I suggest taking the goblins device with you, friend.
quest_9032_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I am so glad that you can see me. [excited] Finally someone to talk to!

[warm] Will you help us, <name>? [gentle] Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? [confident] If its true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalaks Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.

[hesitant] Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. [delight] Nice to meet you!
quest_9033_quest_detail:
[solemn] Five years since the last war...

Tens of thousands of lives were lost and for what? The threat was never fully extinguished.

[solemn] And so the Lich King stirs once more... [threatening] His yes-man, Kel'Thuzad, amassing for another attack upon our lands.

[urgent] We will not allow it! [commanding] Prove your dedication. [commanding] Prove that you are willing to risk life and limb to stop this madness and the combined might of the Dawn and the Crusade will be at your beck and call.

[urgent] Enter Naxxramas and destroy the Scourge within...

quest_9033_quest_complete: [excited] A job well done! [warm] You will be rewarded via the services of the men and women at Light's Hope.

quest_9120_quest_detail:
[solemn] The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. [soft voice] Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. [low voice] Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.

[urgent] Someone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. [mocking tone] Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
quest_9120_quest_progress: [shouting] BLESSED LIGHT! [angry] What foulness do you hold, child?
quest_9120_quest_complete:
[solemn] In all my days of living I would never have expected to see this...

<Father Montoy appears to be salivating.>

[warm] Oh yes, you will be rewarded dear child. [proud] You will be greatly rewarded. [commanding] Give it here. [urgent] Now!
quest_9121_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. [soft voice] Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. [pause] That is, until now.

[urgent] We have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. [cold] Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, <name>, the price will be high. [low voice] You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
quest_9121_quest_progress: [solemn] None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
quest_9121_quest_complete: [soft voice] You will feel a slight tingle, <name>. [solemn] That sensation means it's working. [warm] Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
quest_9122_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. [soft voice] Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. [pause] That is, until now.

[urgent] We have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. [low voice] With that said, the cloaking is costly. [warm] Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is admirable, we are willing to incur some of those costs.
quest_9122_quest_progress: [solemn] None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
quest_9122_quest_complete: [soft voice] You will feel a slight tingle, <name>. [emphasis] That sensation means it's working. [solemn] Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

[warm] With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! [excited] We will waive all cost associations.

quest_9124_quest_detail:
[soft voice] How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?

<Leopold holds up an insignia of the Crusade.>

[commanding] I've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, <name>. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into Naxxramas. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. [urgent] Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.
quest_9124_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, that'll do nicely, <name>. [warm] Remember, I'm always acceptINg more parts. [warm] For every bundle you brINg me, I'll reward you with an INsignia.
quest_9125_quest_progress: [commanding] You did an exemplary job on the first bundle, <name>. [soft voice] If you have more, I will take them now. For every bundle that you turn in, I will reward you with another insignia. [warm] Crypt Fiend Parts(30)
quest_9125_quest_complete: [excited] Most excellent, <name>! [warm] These will definitely come to good use.
quest_9126_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. [low voice] While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.

[soft voice] So what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? [warm] It's a win-win situation.
quest_9126_quest_progress: [soft voice] I can direct you to skeleton infested locales, <class>.
quest_9126_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You work fast, <name>. Fast like a fox... [chuckling] Say, have I ever told you about the time I was IN a barber shop quartet?

RemINd me to tell you that story one of these days.
quest_9127_quest_progress: [soft voice] A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, <name>. [whispering] Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia. [pause] Bone Fragments(30)
quest_9127_quest_complete: [excited] My dream of becoming a full-time dancer at the Gadgetzan disco is soon to become a reality! [warm] Keep up the good work, <name>.
quest_9128_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.

[commanding] All I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!

You'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
quest_9128_quest_progress: [soft voice] I can only steer you in the right direction, <name>.
quest_9128_quest_complete: [warm] A job well done, <name>! [excited] As promised, the INsignia is yours. [soft voice] Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...
quest_9129_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. [solemn] It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. [urgent] Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.

[commanding] With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias. Core of Elements(30)
quest_9129_quest_complete: [solemn] You perform a great service for us, <name>. [warm] Well done!
quest_9131_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, <class>? [soft voice] No, of course you haven't. You're still a boy - a tyke. [solemn] Let me tell you, it is glorious.

[soft voice] You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? [commanding] I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.

[urgent] I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. [commanding] Bring me scraps and get paid.
quest_9131_quest_progress: <Korfax growls at you.> [angry] What do you want? [low voice] Directions? I can provide those...
quest_9131_quest_complete: [solemn] This will do, for now. [urgent] If you get more, you know WHERE to fINd me.
quest_9132_quest_progress: [urgent] For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. [angry] Now get out of my sight before I split you in two! Dark Iron Scraps(30)
quest_9132_quest_complete: [angry] That's all you brought me? [commanding] Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. [urgent] I need MORE!
quest_9136_quest_detail:
[solemn] I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. [soft voice] They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.

[gentle] You may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.

[warm] I am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.
quest_9136_quest_progress: [solemn] I have intimate knowledge of the flora in our world. [soft voice] Do you require direction?
quest_9136_quest_complete:
[delight] I am much obliged, <name>.

<Rayne bows.>

[warm] Please remember that I am always accepting fronds.
quest_9137_quest_progress:
[soft voice] For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.

[solemn] Insignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards. [urgent] Savage Frond(30)
quest_9137_quest_complete: [warm] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] Your work is vital to the success of our campaign against the Scourge.
quest_9141_quest_detail:
[angry] You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.

If you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.

And there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
quest_9141_quest_progress: <Commander Metz chews on his cigar.> [urgent] What is it? I'm a busy man.
quest_9141_quest_complete: [commanding] Alright, here's how it works: For every valor token that you turn in, I'll give you another writ. You complete the order on that writ and deliver the order to Packmaster Stonebruiser. Got it? Good. [urgent] Now get out of here.
quest_9142_quest_detail: [commanding] You know the drill, kid. [urgent] One valor token gets you a craftsman's writ.
quest_9142_quest_complete: [commanding] You earned this, scrub. [low voice] Now, don't cry about your orders. [urgent] Fill 'em or destroy 'em.
quest_9153_quest_detail:
[solemn] The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of Horde and Alliance alike. [soft voice] Tanaris, the Blasted Lands, Winterspring and the Burning Steppes are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.

[commanding] Only through our combined efforts will they be turned away.

[urgent] The necropolises are supported by magical circles at various points in the invaded areas. [commanding] We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
quest_9153_quest_progress: [solemn] It will take time to prevail against this threat. [low voice] How have you fared, <name>?
quest_9153_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done well, <name>. [solemn] Through these incremental defeats, we shall prevail against this renewed Scourge threat.

[urgent] Rest and recover, but then you must head out to the front again, lest we lose the ground we have gained today.

[commanding] To aid you in your further battles, we will make some of our special items available to you in trade for more necrotic runes.
quest_9154_quest_detail: [solemn] The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. [urgent] The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.
quest_9165_quest_detail:
Without the help of adventurers, my caravan would have never made it! [urgent] Scourge were coming out of the woodwork to try and stop us from getting here.

<Guard Didier wipes his brow.>

Now we need to wait here for Field Marshal Chambers to arrive. He'll sign your writ of safe passage to take back to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel.

And <name>, watch what you say around Chambers. He's the 'bite off your head and spit down your wind pipe' type of guy - except that he'll actually do it...
quest_9165_quest_complete: <Dispatch Commander Metz takes the writ and signs it.> [commanding] Excellent work, <name>. [excited] Outstanding even! [warm] Take this as a token of our appreciation. [mocking tone] No pun intended, scrub.

[solemn] The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. [soft voice] You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.

[pause] Midsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. [soft voice] The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeast from the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. [pause] Return once your journey is complete.
quest_9322_quest_progress: [soft voice] Are the flames of Kalimdor burning brightly?
quest_9322_quest_complete: [solemn] Your spirit glows with the warmth of the Kalimdor fires, friend. [warm] Is the heat not invigorating? [soft voice] Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.

[urgent] You'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.

[commanding] Return once your journey is done.

quest_9362_quest_detail:
[urgent] There isn't much time, <name>! [solemn] My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic. [commanding] I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.

[threatening] The pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor. [cold] Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
quest_9362_quest_progress: [urgent] There is not time to waste! [commanding] Have you the shell?
quest_9362_quest_complete: [solemn] I must say, this shell has a strange aura. It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...
quest_9364_quest_detail:
[solemn] My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.

[commanding] Carry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara. If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments. [urgent] Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.

When the shell is full, return it to me.
quest_9364_quest_complete:
[delight] Splendid! Splendid!

[excited] Now we are able to reform this magic into a new spell. [solemn] Behold!
quest_9367_quest_detail:
[excited] Midsummer is upon us once again!

[solemn] Each year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. [warm] While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.

[commanding] In fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. [urgent] I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. [warm] Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
quest_9367_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck, <name>?
quest_9367_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent! It seems we've appointed dutiful Flamekeepers this year if the bonfires are as well-kept as you claim. [warm] Thank you for inspecting them for me; here, take this as a small token of my esteem.

quest_9386_quest_detail:
[soft voice] An eager one, aren't you? [warm] If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you.

[solemn] Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; [warm] I look forward to your return, <name>.
quest_9388_quest_detail: [solemn] There are many flames burning throughout the world today, <name>. [soft voice] The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. [pause] Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?
quest_9389_quest_detail: [solemn] The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. [soft voice] Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.
quest_9415_quest_detail:
[commanding] Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.

[urgent] What are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. [angry] Aren't you excited to join them?

Now, get going and don't dry out on the way.
quest_9415_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Alliance needs every able body they can get. [urgent] The Horde has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.

[pause] Let me explain the situation to you.
quest_9416_quest_detail:
[commanding] You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.

The dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.

[urgent] Get your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
quest_9416_quest_complete:
[urgent] It's good that you're here, but there's no time to waste making small talk. [commanding] You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.

[commanding] Listen up.
quest_9419_quest_detail:
[solemn] We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. [low voice] We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.

[urgent] However, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.

[commanding] If I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
quest_9419_quest_progress: [urgent] Be careful out there, but also be quick. [urgent] We have no time to lose.
quest_9419_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thank the Light you were successful.

[soft voice] Now if we could only have started this sooner, our need would not be so desperate. [urgent] We must keep the bounty of the desert from falling into the hands of the Horde.
quest_9422_quest_detail:
[solemn] For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.

[urgent] But now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.

[commanding] I need every set of hands that is available. [confident] I hope I have yours.
quest_9422_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary of the dangers of the desert, <name>. [urgent] With the Alliance lurking in the dunes, any step could be your last.
quest_9422_quest_complete: [warm] You've done well, <name>. [solemn] These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.
quest_9664_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to the Plaguelands, <name>. [low voice] As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. [commanding] The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.

[urgent] Towers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. [soft voice] These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
quest_9664_quest_progress: [commanding] When the towers are under our control, we will soon be able to surround the Forsaken. [solemn] After that, it is only a matter of time before we can crush them.
quest_9664_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good, <name>. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.
quest_9665_quest_detail:
[solemn] Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.

[urgent] It is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. [commanding] Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
quest_9665_quest_progress:
[commanding] They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.

[urgent] We will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.
quest_9665_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is good news, <name>. [soft voice] It will be a constant struggle here in the Plaguelands until we have fully driven back the forces of the Alliance.

[pause] Until that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
quest_20000_quest_detail: [solemn] The orb shines as bright as the Sun inside the dread walls of Naxxramas. [urgent] With the Horsemen defeated, your next challenge is soon to be approached, you decide to take the orb with you and bring it back to Light's Hope Chapel if you survive.
quest_20000_quest_complete: [solemn] So you've found this just after your victory?
quest_20001_quest_detail: [solemn] It's like nothing I have ever seen before, <name>. It's like the very essence of the Light comes out of this orb, a strange thing that the Ashbringer left behind as he was freed from the clutches of the Scourge. [sad] I really cannot spare any time to aid you with this. Even if the Dread Citadel fell we still have a long way to go. While the Arch Lich has been defeated we have yet to find his phylactery. [solemn voice] The Argent Dawn is a mess, the casualties were many and the rest of us are beyond tired. [urgent] While you will not find help here, I know where to send you, and I am sure he will be able to help. [commanding] Seek Tirion Fordring, here, in Eastern Plaguelands to the West. [sad] I am truly sorry and I wish you luck.
quest_39001_quest_detail:
[angry] This modish Senator over there won't fool anyone! [excited] Part of Explorers' League, sure thing! [angry] Bah! [angry] What a bluster!

[commanding] Tell ya what, ye can never call yerself an Explorer unless ya go and check every nook 'n cranny by yerself!

[sigh] Of course, he never gone any farther than this quarry here. [soft voice] But, I see I won't hafta talk ye down fer some poking around and find things out by yerself, eh?

[warm] Good. [urgent] I'd like ya ta tell me what you'll find out in that cave with all those troggs.

[solemn] They must've come from somewhere, right?
quest_39001_quest_progress:
[angry] If only we had some mages cooperating with our research here instead of fiddling with all those trinkets they seem glued to like a goblin to gold!

[sigh] Bah… Frustrations won't bring us anywhere, right? [pause] So… be sure to have your rest once you're done 'ere.
quest_39001_quest_complete:
[excited] Do tell! Were there any signs of where they came from? Any artifacts?

Tools they might've used? Anything? [shocked] Wha-… That's it?

Just a cave?? [sad] Time wasted, then, I guess. [warm] Let me give ya some coins, though. [proud] Ya did the job well, no matter what.

[warm] Here, not much, but it is a good start, kid.
quest_39982_quest_detail:
[excited] Can you believe this? They've taken all our assets, kicked us out of our building, and arrested our representitives. [urgent] K'ron Tusk is being held in a cell down at the Cleft of Shadow. [sad] An innocent orc imprisoned!
 
[angry] They've accussed us of being spies, simply because of Mr Tusk's unorthodox ancestry, and for having some investors from the other side of the pond among our ranks.
 
[urgent] Will you help me get our people out of here? The warchief might not care about the economic potential his city is losing, but his grunts still have bills to pay. [confident] I'm sure you could arrange Mr Tusk's release!
quest_39982_quest_progress: [angry] Can't you see I'm busy guarding the prisoner?
quest_39982_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why yes, it's true that we guards are not paid well enough. [hesitant] What is it you are proposing?
quest_39983_quest_detail:
[angry] You want me to release the prisoner? As much as I appreciate your generous donation, I'm afraid I can't do that! [commanding] The warchief does not take kindly to grunts who disobey orders. 
 
[solemn] I am bound by honor to carry out my duty. [proud] We grunts are loyal and brave. [confident] I'm not afraid of anything. Except maybe big snakes, I hate snakes. Good thing there aren't any here. 
 
[hesitant] Wait, what were we talking about? [pause] Me forgot.
quest_39983_quest_progress: [angry] I told you, I can't let the prisoner go!
quest_39983_quest_complete: [urgent] What's that you are carrying the bag. Something is moving inside, take it out!
quest_39984_quest_detail:
[excited] I am free! [warm] Thank you my friend. 
 
[hesitant] I'm afraid I don't have anything to repay you with currently, as the warchief's thugs took all my belongings, but my business associate Marlos Catos will compensate you. 
 
[confident] Come meet us at our new office in Booty Bay, the free trade port across the ocean. [solemn] We are safe from the overreaching hands of governments there.
quest_39984_quest_complete:
[excited] You must be the heroic stranger that sprung my dear friend Mr Tusk from jail? 
 
[warm] We here at Shell Co appreciate your assistance very much, and while we don't currently have the means to pay you back the gold you spent, we have something even better. 
 
[delight] This is a shellcoin, the currency of the future! [excited] A means of payment free from government interference! [proud] A currency that suffers no taxation! [warm] Take it, it's yours.
quest_39986_quest_detail:
[angry] Can you believe what the tyrannical bureaucrats in charge of Stormwind have done? [angry] They have declared that Shellcoin investments are subject to taxation! [shouting] It's an outrage! 
 
[urgent] We can't possibly continue to operate in this city under these rules. [urgent] Something has to be done! [urgent] Will you help us change their minds? 
 
[commanding] Go to Stormwind Keep and speak to the legislators there. [commanding] Help nudge them in the right direction by giving them a taste of the prosperity Shellcoin provides. [soft voice] Five gold ought to be enough.
quest_39986_quest_progress: [hesitant] I suppose I could change my mind, under the right circumstances.
quest_39986_quest_complete: [soft voice] I see your point now, <name>. [warm] Perhaps Shellcoin does not need to be taxed.
quest_39987_quest_detail:
[solemn] You may have secured the House of Nobles' support, but we cannot overturn the law by ourselves. To guarantee success at the next legislative council, your motion must have the church's support as well. 
 
[soft voice] I hear that Bishop DeLavey is great enjoyer of expensive rum. [whispering] If you were to present him with a few bottles of the stuff, he'd agree with anything you have to say.
quest_39987_quest_progress:
Blessed be the poor, blessed by the generous. To donate to the Church of the Holy Light is to guarantee your well being in the afterlife. 
 
[solemn] Have you come to make a contribution, <name>?
quest_39987_quest_complete:
[excited] You have brought those for me? Why, how did you know, I do love rum! 
 
[warm] That's very thoughtful of you. But let's keep this between us, okay, <name>? 
 
[soft voice] The high priestess recently introduced some silly rules about avoiding temptations and not indulging in alcohol, blah blah blah.
quest_39988_quest_detail:
[surprised] You say you're worried about some unholy new law? Fear not, <name>, [solemn] I shall speak out against it at the next legislative session. [warm] Everything for a good friend of the holy light like you! Hic! 
 
But for the bill to pass, it would still need the royal seal of approval. [commanding] Tell his highness what you told me, and that you have mine and Lord Wishock's support. [excited] Maybe throw in five gold for good measure!
quest_39989_quest_complete:
[angry] The highlord said what?! [shouting] This is an economic disaster. [urgent] Seems like we'll need to relocate to some place that respects the rights of free enterprise. [cold] Stormwind is nothing but a den of misery. 
 
[soft voice] Thank you for your help, <name>. [warm] While I can't compensate you for your expensess in gold, I can give you something far more valuable.
quest_39991_quest_detail:
[gentle] I'm glad you've decided to join us <name>. [soft voice] I've heard of the work you've done in the field, and I must say I'm impressed. [confident] You are exactly the kind of highly motivated individual we need in this organization.

[solemn] If we are to hold this castle in the long term, we must secure our supply lines. [commanding] I'd like you to ambush that prick Valorcall and end his patrols once and for all. [urgent] He has guards accompanying him, so be careful, perhaps even bring another operative to assist you, but get it done! [commanding] Do not return to me until he's dead.
quest_39991_quest_progress: [angry] What did I say about returning to me before it's done?
quest_39991_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <name>. [proud] I see you're not only skilled but cunning.
quest_39992_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that the only way in or out of Stromgarde Keep is under our control, it's time to secure The Sanctum, the final holdout of the old kingdom.

[angry] I've had enough of this so called prince. Can you believe he's placed a bounty on my head? Ha! [commanding] I want you to teach him who's the boss around here. [solemn] Once all that remains of the past is dead and buried, we shall be the true masters of Stromgarde.
quest_39992_quest_progress: [angry] What did I say about returning to me before it's done?
quest_39992_quest_complete:
[commanding] You've done more in a day than these idiots around me have done in a month. [solemn] I shall make sure you're properly compensated for your services.

[threatening] Do not mistake my generosity for weakness however. [cold] If you were to make a move against me, you'd be dead just as quick as that prince. [urgent] I don't want you getting any ideas.
quest_39993_quest_detail:
[angry] The prince may be dead, but there are still soldiers around my castle. [low voice] How am I supposed to run a criminal enterprise with all this interference?

[commanding] I trust you to finish the job. [urgent] Eliminate the competition, so that I can focus on more important matters.
quest_39993_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, you did it already? Good, good. [commanding] Now find something else to do and get out of my face.
quest_39994_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was supposed to craft a powerful new weapon for our brave warriors. [commanding] A weapon that will inspire fear in the enemy upon first sight. [angry] Why am I sitting idly instead of working on it, you ask?

[sad] Unfortunately, the plans for this weapon were stolen before they reached the Crossroads. [urgent] The orc carrying the plans did not survive the attack, but perhaps somebody else witnessed it and can identify the perpetrators.

[commanding] Ask the guards around the Crossroads if they saw who it was. [solemn] We must recover those plans.
quest_39994_quest_complete: [commanding] That's right. [solemn] I did witness something suspicious.
quest_39995_quest_detail:
[solemn] I did not witness the attack itself, but I did see something suspicious while patrolling the road. [urgent] A group of human soldiers was heading south east. [soft voice] They were mounted, so I could not catch up to them.

[solemn] I suspect they killed the orc you speak of, and then returned to Northwatch Hold with the loot. [commanding] Perhaps you should start your search there. [hesitant] I would come with you if I could, but I must remain at my post.
quest_39995_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find out where the stolen plans are kept?
quest_39995_quest_complete: [excited] You did it! [warm] I am thankful for your help, <name>. [solemn] Now we can begin gathering the materials needed for this weapon.
quest_39996_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've gone over the plans for the weapon, and they are quite spectacular. [low voice] It is not the most practical weapon, but it will strike fear in our enemies. [emphasis] The handle is to be made of bone. And not just any bone, but a huge strong bone.

[commanding] The closest suitable source are the Kolkar, with their powerful long legs. [urgent] Go to their territory, find a big enough Kolkar, and slay him.
quest_39996_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you slay the Kolkar and take their bones?
quest_39996_quest_complete: [delight] Magnificent! [proud] This will be a mighty weapon indeed.
quest_39997_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now it's time to fetch the materials for the blade. [soft voice] This won't be a traditional blade made out of metal, as you would expect. [low voice] It will be made out of stone, but not any ordinary stone. [threatening] Something that will truly terrify the humans.

[urgent] Go to Thunder Bluff, and speak with Birgitte Cranston, the portal master. [solemn] She will help you find the special stone we need.
quest_39997_quest_complete: [solemn] Through my mastery of arcane magic, I can open open a portal to any part of the world. [soft voice] The question is, are you worth my time?
quest_39998_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, my! How delightfully brilliant. [delight] I love Nargal's plan. You are to desecrate a human graveyard, and steal one of their tomb stones.

[warm] I envy you. I wish I could accompany you on your mission. Make sure to slay a few extra humans on the way there for me! [urgent] When you are ready, I shall teleport you to Westfall, near one of their settlements.
quest_39998_quest_progress: [commanding] Did you raid the human lands and find the stone I asked you for?
quest_39998_quest_complete: [excited] At last! I have all that I need to craft the weapon. [proud] You have done a great service to the horde.
quest_39999_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am thankful for you help in crafting this weapon. [commanding] However, I cannot simply hand it over to you. [solemn] This is a weapon made for veterans of the Horde, who have proven themselves in battle against the Alliance.

[urgent] If you wish to wield it yourself, you must join the war effort in Warsong Gulch. [commanding] Help our side to the best of your ability, and then return to me with a mark of honor as proof of your participation in the battle. [solemn] Only then will you be worthy of this weapon.
quest_39999_quest_progress: [commanding] Return to me once you have proven yourself worthy in battle against the Alliance.
quest_39999_quest_complete: [solemn] You are indeed worthy of this axe. [warm] Thank you for your service, champion. [proud] May it help you crush many more of our enemies.
quest_40001_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, Earthmother's blessings, <race>.

[excited] Isn't it great? Out here in the open, surrounded by nature.

<Shagu takes a deep breath, inhaling the fumes from his hookah before letting out a hacking cough.>

[sad] Not the good stuff, not at all.

[hesitant] Say, think you could do me a favor?

[solemn] I am expecting a package, but it has yet to arrive. [urgent] Could you go and check with Mishiki in Sen'jin Village and find out what happened to my special delivery? <Shagu blows a puff of smoke from his lips and then winks at you with a grin on his face.>
quest_40001_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, mon, Shagu sent ya for his herbs? [hesitant] Mishiki wanted to send it as soon as possible, but ya see, we got a bit of a problem.
quest_40002_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So, I sent me usual messenger to deliver the good stuff to Mulgore, but, ya see, that grumpy orc riding his wolf around Durotar reported seeing him dead with me herbs missing!

[urgent] Da quillboars be more aggressive than usual if dey came down from da roads to slay me messenger!

I mean, Durotar be no walk in the park, either. Everything can kill ya here if ya not paying attention.

[solemn] I bet dey took his satchel after killing him and took it back to dey camp, or maybe dey are even carrying it on dem!

[commanding] Try killing some of da scouts. If ya do find da satchel, take it back to Shagu and keep da pay fo' yourself!

[warm] Safe travels, mon. Loa guide ya steps.
quest_40002_quest_progress: [soft voice] Mixed herbs give mixed feelings, friend!
quest_40002_quest_complete: [excited] You've returned, my friend! [warm] And with the herbs no less. Here's the payment I owe.
quest_40003_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that you've brought the herbs, I can set up my hookah and truly enjoy the real good stuff.

[solemn] It is by the Earthmother's blessings that such a combination exists. [warm] I would like you to try this and see for yourself what gifts the Earthmother bestows!

[gentle] Sit down, sit down. [pause] Let us enjoy the smoke and bond with one another, and, of course, with the Earthmother.
quest_40003_quest_progress:
[gentle] Come on, my friend, sit down and take a toke.
