[soft voice] It will be well worth it.
quest_40003_quest_complete:
[solemn] An eye-opener, isn't it, <name>?

[warm] You now feel closer to the Earthmother than ever before.

[excited] Rejoice and be one with nature!
quest_40004_quest_detail:
[solemn] We be in danger, mon. [urgent] Enemies are encroaching on Winterax territory from all sides. [commanding] If we are to survive, we must fight back. [angry] Alterac belongs to us, not to gnolls, dwarfs or orcs!

[commanding] Prove you are a real warrior by attacking the Wildpaw camp to the east. [warm] Slay them, and I be giving you a big reward, worthy of a champion.
quest_40004_quest_progress: [commanding] Our enemies won't slay themselves... [urgent] Go!
quest_40004_quest_complete: <The elder listens to your report...> [solemn] There be a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones. [warm] You have proven your worth, and now I will fulfill my promise. [proud] The power of the Winterax is yours!
quest_40005_quest_detail:
[excited] I love gnomes. So tender and tasty. [soft voice] I am making a boiled gnome stew for the rest of the tribe, but I don't have the main ingredient! 

[urgent] Take this rope and go bring me a live gnome. [threatening] Make sure its bloodied up first, so its juices are flowing and its meat sufficiently tenderized. 

[commanding] Chop chop!
quest_40005_quest_progress: [commanding] Bring me a gnome, before i decide to make an idiot stew instead!
quest_40005_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It smells good, doesn't it? [solemn] The tribe will be well fed, thanks to you. 
 
[warm] Here, you can have some too, [excited] you've earned it!
quest_40006_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I'm so hungry, I could eat a whole cow. Sadly there are no cows in Alterac Valley. But some scouts spotted something even bigger recently. 
 
[excited] Delicious beefy taurens were seen running wild among the orcs in the south. If you catch one of those, we could feed the whole tribe! 
 
[urgent] You must go hunting as soon as possible, before the taurens have migrated away.
quest_40006_quest_progress: Taurens are exceptionally strong and dangerous. [commanding] Don't attempt to kill it on your own. [urgent] Just bring it here, and we'll slay the beast together.
quest_40006_quest_complete:
[excited] You are real big game hunter. [proud] Taurens are among the most dangerous beasts in the world. [warm] Thanks to your expert hunting skills, the tribe will be well fed for a whole week! 
 
[delight] Here, you should have some, you've earned it!
quest_40014_quest_detail:
[solemn] The trolls were once known far and wide as the greatest hunters on Azeroth and some of those legends have persisted until today. [pause] There is time to hunt for sport and time to prepare, and as much as I would love to put you to the challenge there's the problem of the Witherbark.

[angry] Paying homage to Shadra in their attack, they fell upon us with poisons almost like the days of old. [commanding] This time we will be prepared. [urgent] Head into the heart of the Arathi Highlands and hunt Giant Plains Creepers for their venom sacs.

[soft voice] Once you have enough for several anti-venoms, return to me and we can see if there are more preparations to be made.
quest_40014_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gathered the venom sacs?
quest_40014_quest_complete: [soft voice] You returned faster than I thought you would, perhaps you are a proven hunter. [warm] You fit in well with my people, but there is one more thing to do in preparation.
quest_40015_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've done well so far, but the biggest of the plains creepers stands before you, <class>. [solemn] The Witherbark trolls have been harvesting venom from the spider after putting it to sleep with mojo in her food!

[urgent] Heketh is a fearsome foe that many trolls have fallen to, so keep your wits about you! [commanding] You can find the great spider just west of Go'Shek Farm.

[emphasis] Find her and put an end to the Witherbark's source of powerful venom!
quest_40015_quest_complete: [excited] You truly are a master hunter and a friend to the Wildtusk, <name>! [warm] Take this for all of your help, thank you!
quest_40017_quest_detail:
[solemn] Things might be quiet right now, but the war between us and the Witherbark is not over. [urgent] While they recuperate from the initial attacks, we must prepare for their eventual descent down the mountain.

[commanding] Yin'do has given me orders to make as much armor as I can for the upcoming battle, but my supplies are limited. [emphasis] Go down south from the mountains and gather the hides of Arathi Raptors to be used in the creation of especially sturdy armor.

[solemn] There is no creature in the region with stronger hide than the raptors. [urgent] You must be swift.
quest_40017_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you gathered the war materials?
quest_40017_quest_complete: [solemn] You've done all of Wildtusk Village a favor this day, thank you. [warm] Take this silver as payment for your help.
quest_40018_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Witherbark are a brutal enemy, one that attacked in the dead of night and had no mercy for my people. [sad] Those of us here were lucky to escape, and now it seems as if they are just biding their time for the next attack.

[urgent] We must not let it be so. As outnumbered and unprepared as we are, we need to reduce their ranks. [commanding] Head into the Ruins of Zul'Rasaz and kill as many of the Witherbark as you can manage. [emphasis] Show those traitors that the spirits remain on our side and that we remain the true masters of these heights.
quest_40018_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you cut down their numbers?
quest_40018_quest_complete: [excited] You've done it, <class>! [warm] We may rest easy tonight thanks to the work you've done. [warm] Take these coins as appreciation for the work you've done.
quest_40019_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we fled from our once-hidden city we left everything that we did not need, even the charms we use in many of our magic rituals and in showing respect to the spirits.

[urgent] I fear we have upset the spirits by abandoning our charms in Zul'Rasaz and when next the Witherbark attack, our voodoo will abandon us!

[solemn] There is no hope to stand against the Witherbark without the aid of the spirits, <class>. [urgent] Go to the Ruins of Zul'Rasaz, quickly, and retrieve our lost charms before it is too late.
quest_40019_quest_complete: [solemn] With the charms returned to us, we can begin to tend to the spirits once again. [soft voice] I can already feel the difference. [warm] Thank you for all you have done, <class>!
quest_40020_quest_detail:
[solemn] As we fled the chaos of Zul'Rasaz, many of my people had to leave behind cherished belongings and other items that had personal value. I am no different. [sad] I am ashamed to say that I abandoned an amulet that has been passed down in my family for generations, since the time of the last great empire.

[sad] It plagues my mind, <class>. [solemn] The spirits will never answer my call again should I not make up for this great shame. [urgent] You must retrieve it for me! [urgent] The ruins of Zul'Rasaz can be accessed by the trail outside of town to the northwest. My home is near the top of the ruined city.

[hesitant] I would make the journey, but I cannot risk my life for such a selfish reason. [warm] You will be rewarded for your help, I assure you.
quest_40020_quest_complete: [soft voice] I cannot believe my eyes, <class>. [warm] Thank you for retrieving it for me. [proud] I can now return to my duties with pride.
quest_40021_quest_detail:
[solemn] After the empire was broken, my people fled into the mountains where we flourished for generations, maintaining a positive relationship with the local elementals and nurturing their growth.

[sad] We did not know that one of our own had fallen to the corruption of the Witherbark's lust for power. [angry] Traitors to the memory of the empire, they fell upon Zul'Rasaz and slaughtered my people in their beds.

[low voice] Speaker Gan'to, someone I once called a friend, is responsible for this tragedy. [commanding] You will go to the ruins of Zul'Rasaz and you will kill him for the sake of my people. [urgent] Bring justice to those who did not get to fight that day, <class>.
quest_40021_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you put an end to that traitor's miserable life?
quest_40021_quest_complete: [solemn] He deserved worse than this, <class>. [sad] What you see here are the remnants of my people, and [threatening] he will pay for his crimes even after death now that you have brought me his head.
quest_40022_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that the traitor has been brought to justice, we can focus upon the leader of this warband, Kin'toza. [low voice] Possessed with dark fury, the warband leader now lays claim to the ruins of our city while preparing to descend the mountain on his return to Witherbark Village.

[urgent] You must stop their plunder and break their morale! [commanding] Bring the head of Kin'toza to me and it will serve as a symbol for my people to rally behind. [solemn] With their leadership in shambles, we would truly stand a chance at reclaiming Zul'Rasaz.
quest_40022_quest_complete: [solemn] He will join Gan'to and suffer until the day I die, <class>. The two of them will decorate my belt forevermore and stand as a symbol of victory over the Witherbark and newfound friendship with the Horde. [proud] You have done well, <name>. [warm] Your deeds will be remembered by my people forever.
quest_40023_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Wildtusk have always held good relations with the elemental beings. [soft voice] It is up to us, the speakers, to commune with the spirits and elements alike. [low voice] Lord Rog be troubled by disturbances that go beyond Wildtusk Village.

[hesitant] We don't have the strength or the means to help him, but perhaps you can, mon? [urgent] The elements do not reach out often, so we cannot miss this opportunity. [commanding] Speak with Lord Rog and see if you can help in our stead.
quest_40025_quest_progress: [solemn] The task at hand is an important one, mon. [soft voice] We must be doing our best to help the elementals.
quest_40025_quest_complete: [solemn] This is everything. [soft voice] I shall do as Lord Rog instructed so that he may purify the bracers.
quest_40026_quest_detail: [solemn] It is done. I have gotten all of the materials prepared and given them to Lord Rog. [soft voice] He shall begin the purification of his bracers. [solemn] We have done well. [pause] Let us wait until he is done.
quest_40040_quest_detail: [excited] Howdy! Welcome to Flaxwhisker post. I’m Fendo, in charge of all manner of things around here. I 'm supposed to direct any new arrivals in Flaxwhisker to the boss. That is to say, we haven't heard a word from Gnomeregan in months or received any new people! Still, good to have you around, <race>. You'll find Gigno Flaxwhisker inside, at the top floor.
quest_40040_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, someone new? [pause] We haven't had anyone new around here in a long time, and we haven't been told of someone new arriving. [gentle] Do you want to help us out? [urgent] You gotta prove to me you're the real deal, buddy!
quest_40041_quest_detail:
[excited] If you're the real deal, then you gotta do a real task. That makes sense, yeah? [excited] I've been dying to get my hands on a Mistwing Horn for some time! Those creatures are quite powerful and supercharged with all sorts of natural energy. I've had my suspicions for some time, now, that a Mistwing Horn could be useful beyond its practical purposes, and I'd like to put it to the test. That's where you come in.

The Mistwing can be found to the northwest, just beyond Lake Mennar. [urgent] Be careful, though. There is all manner of big and powerful things up there! [solemn] Azshara sure is a dangerous place.
quest_40041_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten the Horn for me?
quest_40041_quest_complete: [excited] Wow, you got it? [delight] I guess you are the real deal, and you really do want to help us! [warm] I'll spread the word around that you're A-OKAY! [urgent] Let us get some work done then!
quest_40042_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A Dalaran wizard stopped by a few weeks ago, believe it or not! I've never met a wizard from Dalaran, and his magic was impeccable. I mean it! He offered us some help with a few projects but asked for some supplies in return. I haven't had the means to get them to him yet, given all of the danger between me and the camp he is at up north of here.

Do me a favor, would you? [urgent] Run my delivery to Magus Bromley. You can find him to the northwest of Lake Mennar. He has a tent overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath, just on the ridges there!
quest_40042_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, traveler. [soft voice] Do you bring news from the outside world?
quest_40042_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, Gigno finally delivered the shipment? [warm] Well, I am pleased to receive it at all. [pause] I hadn't expected it would arrive in some time with all of the... trouble in the area.
quest_40043_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before you return to Flaxwhisker Post, I would ask you to deliver a letter for me. [soft voice] It is about a robot that the Flaxwhisker post has been operating in the region for some time. [pause] I helped with its creation in detecting magic within Azshara, and I spotted it on a trip to the Rethress Sanctum a few weeks back. [sad] It was hopelessly mired in some state of disrepair, broken and mindless.

[gentle] Gigno would want to know at the least what happened to it. [warm] Deliver this letter to him, <name>, and thank you again for the supplies.
quest_40043_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're back. [delight] Splendid. [urgent] Did he appreciate the supplies?
quest_40043_quest_complete:
[urgent] Magus Bromley has news about the Analyzor 53G?! [shouting] Hand that note over at once!

<The gnome would swipe the letter and begin to read> . [warm] Why, my Flaxwhisker!
quest_40044_quest_detail:
[excited] If the Analyzor 53G is still out there, then this is great news! [solemn] We spent so long on its Analyzation Chip that it would be almost impossible to recreate. [soft voice] We had the magic of Bromley the first time, and without it, I could not replicate it entirely.

[urgent] The Rethress Sanctum is located just east of here along the coast. [threatening] Naga inhabit it who are not the friendliest to us. [hesitant] I don't want to risk any of my crew to get the Analyzation Chip! [commanding] You will find it located just beneath the exhaust port of the inhibitor chamber on the main chassis at the posterior side, easy.
quest_40044_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got the Analyzation Chip? [commanding] You must recover it!
quest_40044_quest_complete: [solemn] Analyzor 53G was destroyed?... I will miss him dearly, but we shall create a better one in the future. [soft voice] Analyzor 54G will rise from the ashes like—I got carried away. [warm] Thanks for getting the Analyzation Chip. You 've saved us months of work!
quest_40045_quest_detail:
[commanding] Now that we have the Analyzation Chip, I can focus on other matters! [urgent] I'd like for you to speak with Lorie Gearwatch. [solemn] She has been in charge of flights from Flaxwhisker Front! [angry] Our main flying machine hasn't been seen in weeks, and I want to know who took the blasted thing.

[urgent] You'll find her outside, she should have the Log Book, or at the least know where it is!
quest_40045_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there. [gentle] How can I help you, <race>?
quest_40045_quest_complete: [soft voice] The Flight Log Book? Oh... I've been so distracted that I haven't even thought about it for a while now! [pause] The last one that had it was... Dinkle Togpipe.
quest_40046_quest_detail:
Dinkle Togpipe—he was out at the landing pad to the far east on a small island.

[solemn] We used that landing pad as a refueling area and resting spot for pilots. [soft voice] We used to have them dispersed across the ocean near the end of a Flight-Machine's fuel usage. [pause] It was previously possible to get from Gnomeregan to Kalimdor with ease, but I feel that the landing pads are in a state of disrepair. [sad] We haven't heard much in a long time from back home.

[hesitant] If you want the Flight Logbook, go and get it from Dinkle Togpipe stationed out there.
quest_40046_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten the Flight Logbook? It’s certainly taking a while!
quest_40046_quest_complete: [shouting] Dinkle? He's dead? [angry] Those blasted murlocs! [sigh] I knew it would be trouble stationing him out there with only a rifle on that platform. [soft voice] Those higher-ups at Gnomeregan said the lights should be enough to scare off the creatures. [shouting] Looks like they were wrong!
quest_40047_quest_detail:
[solemn] Flaxwhisker Front was started by Gnomeregan to advance Gnomish Engineering abroad with the use of Azshara's magical potency to try and make breakthroughs! [soft voice] We were given a Tinkerspark Transponder designed to harness magical energy in our contraptions, though this device was lost long ago to the naga. [pause] We have been waiting to get another one for months.

[urgent] With the loss of my crew members and no supplies from Gnomeregan, I have but no choice to find out what is going on there. [hesitant] Why is everything so delayed?

[urgent] Find Tinkmaster Overspark. He should be in Gnomeregan unless some horrific disaster ruined the city! [commanding] He is usually in the Engineering sector on the top floor. [urgent] Bring this report to him with haste!
quest_40047_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something I can help you with?
quest_40047_quest_complete: [excited] Flaxwhisker Front? They're still alive? [soft voice] I'll be honest, with all of the chaos in Gnomeregan, I had completely forgotten about the Flaxwhisker Front.
quest_40048_quest_detail:
[shocked] I'm honestly shocked I heard back from Flaxwhisker Front. [urgent] I had assumed that they already knew what happened in Gnomeregan! The collapse of Gnomeregan destroyed almost all of our logistics heading that way, and it is impossible to help them out.

[soft voice] I want you to send Gigno this letter. [whispering] I've included some coins in there to fund the journey back for the gnomes in Azshara. [commanding] Make sure he gets this; it holds all the information he will need to get him up to date on what happened!
quest_40048_quest_complete: Gnomeregan… fallen? There are no more Tinkerspark Transponders?! [urgent] We can't go back. [sad] There's no point in going back. [angry] Tinkertown sounds like nothing more than a ghetto compared to what Gnomeregan was! [confident] We will make Flaxwhisker Front into the new Gnomeregan. [excited] We just need time!
quest_40055_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. [hesitant] If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! [excited] I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

[solemn] Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! [urgent] Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well. [commanding] When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
quest_40055_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you finished trick-or-treating yet? [sad] I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
quest_40055_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, you got them all! [excited] You're awesome! [warm] Thank you for trick-or-treating for me. [warm] Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

[delight] Happy Hallow's End, <name>!
quest_40057_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that we know Gnomeregan is destroyed, and there is no way to get a new Tinkerspark Transponder, we must reclaim our old one. [urgent] The naga stole it months ago, and we must have it to make progress here.

[angry] There's no way back to Gnomeregan, so we must make do with what is here in Azshara, and I know those blasted Naga still have it! [low voice] The one who led the raid was called Laszan, a fearsome foe. [commanding] If you want to stand a chance, I advise you to bring some friends. [urgent] It might be your only way of killing him for good!

[soft voice] He should be east of the Ruins of Eldarath along the shoreline.
quest_40057_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you done it? [urgent] Have you recovered the Transponder?
quest_40057_quest_complete: [excited] Wow! You've gotten it, you've reclaimed our most valuable tool? [warm] I cannot thank you enough, outsider! [proud] We are forever in your debt, and now, the work can continue!
quest_40062_quest_detail:
[solemn] When Gnomeregan first sent us here, they tasked us to obtain an Azure Scale from the Blue Dragonflight. [sad] Sadly, we have not had the means to do so!

We've been too busy with other projects, and—well—we didn't want to stir the hive. Especially since we don't have any actual military capabilities! [urgent] Now with you around, there is a possibility!

The Dragonflight has gathered around Lake Mennar to the northwest. Get me an Azure Scale from the Blue Dragonflight, and make sure to bring buddies.

[hesitant] I'd hate to have you die on my account!
quest_40062_quest_progress: [excited] So, have you tackled the Dragonflight yet?
quest_40062_quest_complete: [solemn] Dragons sure can be imposing. I under—... Wait, you actually got it? [excited] Wow, that's incredible! [shocked] I'm shocked you managed to do this. [warm] Thanks again. [proud] We've needed this since we first came here.
quest_40063_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey there! [warm] Good to have new blood around, especially with everything that has been going on lately. It feels like every project we've had has just been ground into the dirt, either from some outside force messing with us or, well, something breaking down!

[gasp] I'm sort of in charge of the supplies around here, and murlocs took a bunch of Sprugbolts a few weeks back. [urgent] I want you to get them back for me. You can find those crafty murlocs in the waters all around us.

Bring me back 5 Sprugbolts. [soft voice] I hope you like swimming!
quest_40063_quest_progress: [urgent] We need those Sprugbolts! [soft voice] They are an intricate part that we cannot just make.
quest_40063_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, wow, you did it, great job! [warm] I sure hope those murlocs didn't give you much trouble. [soft voice] They sure can be nasty when you harm or scare them!
quest_40064_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A few days back, this human ship was passing by. It didn't seem like anything weird, aside from a boat being all the way out here—that was until a fire started upon the deck, and all manner of chaos erupted. [urgent] Both murlocs and naga attacked the ship!

They dragged it down, and the crew escaped somewhere along the coast to the east of here. [hesitant] I'd imagine the boat is still resting along the bottom of the sea, and I want you to go through the wreckage! If the crew knew any gnomes or used any gnomish tools, then there is a very high chance that they had a Gyronautical Compass!

[sad] I feel bad for the dead—surely—but it would help us quite a bit if we had such a device! [commanding] Search the ship and its wreckage. It sank to the southeast.
quest_40064_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid! So there really was one. The Gyronautical Compass will help a bunch around here. [warm] Thanks again for everything you've done. As thanks, take this. We can do without it.
quest_40065_quest_detail:
[excited] Now that Gigno has vouched for you, I'd like to get some real work done around here! [proud] The Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk is an invention that I made. [soft voice] It assisted us in reading magic and ley levels within Azshara. [solemn] We had a good thing going for a while until all of the naga and the murlocs showed up months ago!

[sad] They drove us away from our site, and I had to abandon the Fizz Disk, or I would have most certainly lost my life prying it free from their grasp. [urgent] I want you to get it back to continue my work and not have to start all over. [solemn] The Fizz Disk was something I was cooking up back in Gnomeregan, and many of my plans are still left behind there.

[commanding] To the east is where the Rethress Naga have taken sanctuary. [urgent] If you head north of the Sanctum, there is a somewhat maze-like canyon. [emphasis] Within that canyon, there's a cave. [urgent] You'll find a control panel inside of that cave. [commanding] Search the inside of the control panel for the Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk.
quest_40065_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found our old work site? [excited] Did you reclaim the Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk?!
quest_40065_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderous! Oh, by my name, you've done a great job in getting this back! [soft voice] I was getting myself mentally prepared for having to work for another few months to restart everything.

[sigh] Oh... My, it seems to have taken some damage...
quest_40066_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk must have fallen in a state of disrepair after I left. We did leave the control panel running. While this thing is durable, it's not durable enough to be under so much pressure for that long.

[urgent] I'm going to need this thing repaired, and with your help, I will surely do it! [warm] The list of materials required will be somewhat long, but I promise I will make it worth your time if you can get the items.

[solemn] I am going to need the following: 10 Thorium Bars, 1 Thorium Widget, 5 Iron Struts, and 1 Unstable Trigger.
quest_40066_quest_progress: I know it's quite the list. [urgent] Still, the quicker you get the items to me, the quicker I can get started!
quest_40066_quest_complete: [delight] My my, look at that! [excited] You've gotten everything I needed, and now I can get to work on putting this technology together for you!
quest_40067_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Thanks for getting it all. Now I can get to work. Where is my...

<Fendo looks around.>

Huh, I don't have my spanner on me. [hesitant] Could you look inside? If anything, it should be on the second floor inside of my toolbox. [urgent] Once I have it, I'll get started.
quest_40067_quest_progress: [hesitant] Any luck? [soft voice] I'm still looking around, but I can't find it.
quest_40067_quest_complete: [excited] That's it! [confident] I knew it would be on the second floor, now let's get started!
quest_40068_quest_detail: [excited] Now that I have everything I needed, I'm going to get to work! [commanding] I will utilize the Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk and incorporate it into a few items. [soft voice] It'll take a little bit, so don't be too hurried, but when I'm done, you can choose which one you like most!
quest_40068_quest_progress: [hesitant] I'm working on it, not now.
quest_40068_quest_complete: [excited] There, done! [warm] I appreciate all that you've done. [soft voice] Honestly, you've been a huge help to me around here. [pause] Without the Turbocharged Wobble-free Fizz Disk, I would be back in the Stone Age! [delight] Here, pick which one you like the most for all the trouble.
quest_40071_quest_detail:
[urgent] Traveler, please!

[urgent] I need this letter delivered, and quickly! [soft voice] It details everything that happened to the caravan. [commanding] My commander is within the old Sorrowguard keep to the northwest, tucked within the mountains near Deadwind Pass. [urgent] Take this to him, and with haste!
quest_40071_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thanks for delivering this report. I trust Biggs can manage to get here. The Draenei of the region have become a problem that need to be dealt with.
quest_40072_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Areyntall family has been a noble house within Stormwind for quite some time, and Lordaeron before that. We made our fortunes from naval trade and procured rare materials from far away lands to sell within the Kingdom.

[soft voice] I cannot take full credit. Of course, it was my father's doing, but I hoped to live up to the same legacy as he. I did well for a while nonetheless and ran my family's ship, the Crownguard, for a few months. [sad] It is a tragedy that it sank along with part of my family's goods.

You can find the wreck off the eastern coast, sunken deep into the ground. [hesitant] If you could go there and search the wreckage for my family's strongbox, I would make it worth your while.
quest_40072_quest_progress: [solemn] I don't want to lose my father's legacy. [hesitant] Have you had any luck?
quest_40072_quest_complete: [solemn] I cannot describe how pleased I am. [warm] I had generations looking down upon me with anger before, and I feel peaceful. [soft voice] Maybe I can return to Stormwind soon. [warm] Thanks again.
quest_40073_quest_detail:
[solemn] They promised that we would be well-supplied when we departed from Stormwind, only for us to be left out here with hardly anything to work with. [sad] What supplies we did receive, Watch Paladin Janathos paid for—mostly out of his own pocket from shipments on the eastern coast. [sad] Ever since those shipments stopped, we have gotten nothing.

[sad] You can't imagine how hard it is to maintain equipment with such a small supply of iron that I have. [urgent] If things keep up like this, I will run out, which means Sorrowguard will fall.

[soft voice] I suppose that is where you come in. [urgent] If you can procure me 20 iron bars, it will go a long way in keeping us in working order.
quest_40073_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten them? [solemn] The iron supplies I have will not last forever.
quest_40073_quest_complete: I cannot thank you enough. [warm] This will mean a lot in the long term, and I will put it to good use, I assure you.
quest_40074_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Watch Paladin Janathos requisitioned some swords a while ago, and while he paid me to make the swords, I have been having trouble finding a way to deliver them. The nearest blacksmith with the proper materials was Darkshire.

Clarise Gnarltree was paid to craft swords for Sorrowguard. You shall find her there. [urgent] Could you head to Darkshire and gather the swords for me? They will surely help ease the load on my crafting and make the bars that you gave us to go even farther.
quest_40074_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to our blacksmithing shop. [warm] Can I help you?
quest_40074_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, you come from Sorrowguard? [pause] It's been about a month since I last heard from them. [sad] I assumed the worst.
quest_40075_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been so long since I last heard from Sorrowguard. [soft voice] I honestly had assumed the orcs had taken or destroyed the keep—that, or something equally as bad. [low voice] I am not a cynic, just a realist. [pause] It's a dangerous place, that swamp!

[hesitant] Still, I held onto the swords, just in case something bad happened to us. [soft voice] It's better to have them than have some coin, I figure. [soft voice] Take them to Janet. [soft voice] She should be relieved I didn't happen to sell them off.
quest_40075_quest_progress: [soft voice] You return with good news, I hope?
quest_40075_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank the heavens. [soft voice] I have been worried about this order since the trouble with shipping weeks ago. At the least, we have a stock of swords available should anything bad happen, and it has freed up my iron for other things.

[warm] Here. Take one as a way for me to pay you for your services.
quest_40076_quest_detail:
[solemn] I manage the supplies here in Sorrowguard, and let me tell you, we are getting close to rationing. [low voice] We keep and manage our supplies, and I make sure that we have a lock on most things, but the one thing we are coming short on is food. [hesitant] It would certainly mean a lot if you could help me improvise for the next coming while.

[soft voice] The jaguars in the area are probably the closest thing to an actual decent meal. [urgent] Collect five Heavy Jaguar Flanks for me. [commanding] They should do me well enough in keeping everyone sufficiently fed.
quest_40076_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck?
quest_40076_quest_complete: [soft voice] These are quite heavy pieces of meat. [pause] They will last me a while if I ration everything out. [warm] Thanks again. [proud] You've kept us fed.
quest_40077_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy, partner! [soft voice] Don't see many new faces here, especially in this old, beaten-up castle! [solemn] Surely you've heard the rumors of brave defenders holding off the orcs for days on end before being destroyed! [pause] What a tale. [soft voice] I could also tell you stories about the mushrooms in Swamp of Sorrows, especially Sorrowmoss Mushrooms!

[emphasis] Sorrowmoss Mushrooms only grow within this region. [whispering] They have a certain... "taste" to them once you figure out how to cook them properly—because if you don't, well, it's deadly! [warm] I have a few friends from my old hometown who would love to try some. [urgent] You'll be a pal and help me get them, right?

[emphasis] All I need is ten. [excited] That should do just nicely partner!
quest_40077_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck? [soft voice] The swamp is a dangerous place, so be careful!
quest_40077_quest_complete: [excited] Huha! you did it, partner. Now I can finally make some coin and sell some of these off, but here. [warm] Don't say I didn't cut you in on the profits!
quest_40078_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we first set up, we relied on supplies from the eastern shoreline that traveled by wagon to get to us. It seemed like a safer journey than going through all of the chaos of Deadwind Pass. [sad] Now, with the insanity of Fallow Sanctuary and the sinking of the Crownguard off the coast, we are hard-pressed to get supplies.

[angry] The murlocs who sank the ship have been a menace to us since we landed, and we need to deal with them. [commanding] You will find them on the eastern shoreline. Exterminate them, and perhaps we will be able to reopen trade.
quest_40078_quest_progress: [urgent] The murlocs, are they dealt with?
quest_40078_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. [warm] We are one step closer to salvation. [soft voice] The murlocs have been a thorn in our side for too long.
quest_40079_quest_detail:
[solemn] Sorrowguard has stood since its construction before the First War. While the orcs destroyed it during that war, the walls still stand. [soft voice] This, of course, is thanks to Watch Paladin Janathos. [low voice] Without his efforts in bringing the workforce here and conducting repairs this place would be nothing more than a smoldering ruin.

[solemn] It is with this knowledge of the past that we must protect what we have done here. [urgent] The orcs of Stonard are our main enemy. We do not seek to cause an all-out open war, but to be scouted by our foe would potentially cause our destruction.

[urgent] Already Stonard Scouts have been probing eastward, and we must stop them. [commanding] Venture out there and kill any you find. [emphasis] Do so in the same manner as the brave footmen who died defending these walls years ago.
quest_40079_quest_progress: [urgent] Has it been done? [whispering] Have you kept our secrecy here?
quest_40079_quest_complete: [warm] You have done good work. [soft voice] For a while longer, we can remain undetected within the mountains and hopefully keep the eyes of the Horde off of us.
quest_40080_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey there, traveler. I am looking for someone to deliver a parcel which I have needed to ship for some time now. I have not fulfilled my obligations with all of the comings and goings here at the sepulcher.

[solemn] Up north, past Valgan's and The Dead Field, is a passageway that leads into the Tirisfal Uplands. It is pressed against the mountains and somewhat hidden, but the keen eye should spot it.

[urgent] Once you make your way into the Uplands, I need this parcel delivered to Apothecary Volgrin. He should be located fairly close to the passage leading through the cliffs.
quest_40080_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, can I help you?
quest_40080_quest_complete: [solemn] I have been waiting for these. [urgent] It's about time! [excited] Now I can finally get some work done.
quest_40081_quest_detail:
[urgent] The Pesterhide Gnolls have cut off the road between here and Glenshire! [angry] They have been foraging at a more growing rate, no doubt due to the lack of food around here.

[solemn] If we can't even control our roads, then what are we hoping to achieve here in the Uplands?

[commanding] I need you to handle this pest problem. [urgent] Travel up the hill and go to the east. You should find the Pesterhide all over the Jagged Hills.

[commanding] Kill them and bring their Ragged Armbands to me.
quest_40081_quest_progress: [commanding] These mongrels are nothing more than a stepping stone for the Forsaken. [urgent] Deal with them.
quest_40081_quest_complete: [commanding] Good work out there, <class>. [solemn] Keeping the road safe and thinning the pack of mongrels will only be for the greater good.
quest_40082_quest_detail:
[solemn] From atop of The Jagged Hills, Chief Rnarl rules over the conjoined tribes of the Pesterhide. [sad] He has been rather tenacious, even when we tried to deal with him in the past. [urgent] If we truly wish to scatter the Pesterhide Gnolls and send them into chaos, then we will need to strike at the heart of their leadership.

[solemn] Chief Rnarl has been the one to unite the gnolls, and without him, they will crumble. [soft voice] While you are there, be sure to kill Belgar as well. [solemn] He is a shaman that has strengthened the critters and spurred their actions even more.

[commanding] When these two fall, the packs will scatter. [warm] Bring me both of their paws, and you will receive a reward in silver.
quest_40082_quest_progress: [low voice] Have you slain the mongrels, or are you simply waiting for them to leave?
quest_40082_quest_complete: [commanding] Chief Rnarl, you have eluded me for so long, but no longer. [warm] Well done, <name>, you did what I could not. [proud] You are a skilled fighter and worthy of praise. [solemn] When Steepcliff Port gets more established, return, and we can share a corpse.
quest_40083_quest_detail:
[solemn] When Lordaeron was on the brink of collapse, I found myself with a band of wandering wizards and footpads who had a knack for arcane magic. They called themselves the Rogue Wizards, and I met my end with them. [sad] Those I considered friends left me for dead without even attempting to help me as I lay trapped beneath a fallen tree.

[angry] I desire to punish these people, and you will help me do as much! [urgent] I have sensed for some time now a growing power lingering on the Rogue Heights.

They are no doubt plotting something, as I feel this arcane power has grown. [commanding] We need to deal with them before they grow too strong to murder. [soft voice] You can find them just to the northeast of Glenshire. [pause] There is a small pathway through the Rogue Heights. [commanding] Travel there and slay them for me.
quest_40083_quest_progress: [urgent] We must act quickly, lest they begin to harness their magical power.
quest_40083_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work. [warm] We have certainly put a dent in those Rogue Wizards, but I still feel there is more to be done.
quest_40084_quest_detail:
I've been puzzled for a long time as to why the magic they now wield has been so familiar—it lays just on the tip of my finger. [solemn] As you were dealing with the rabble of enforcers and conjurers, I studied harder and came up with an answer.

[soft voice] The magic is that of the Kirin Tor, I am certain.

[low voice] I spent quite a bit of time in my living life around mages of Dalaran, and now that I think back, checking my books, I am certain. [solemn] If Dalaran is here, then that means they must be attempting to check us in our expansion within Tirisfal Uplands.

[urgent] Return to the Rogue Heights and scour the hillside. [commanding] Check for any source of the Kirin Tor's presence and put an end to it. [threatening] We cannot have our enemies doing as they please freely within the countryside.
quest_40084_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you dealt with the wizards, <name>?
quest_40084_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work. [proud] We have certainly put a dent in those Rogue Wizards, but I still feel there is more to be done.
quest_40085_quest_detail:
[solemn] No doubt the Rogue Wizards have stashed all manner of arcane trinkets and items up in the Rogue Heights. [urgent] If we want to limit their abilities severely, we will need to take these items from them.

As a side effect, we may bolster our knowledge. Return to the Rogue Heights and steal arcane goods found amongst their camps. Return them to me, and I will make sure you are well compensated.
quest_40085_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you found their tomes, books and trinkets, <name>?
quest_40085_quest_complete: [solemn] Another victory—and more books to read. [warm] Thanks again, friend. [proud] Take these coins for the hard work.
quest_40086_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You look like you know your way around the world just by walking with such a knowing foot. [gentle] I need someone like you. I've got a friend located in Glenshire. It's far to the west of Tirisfal and into the Uplands. [urgent] He needs some metal delivered, and you look like just the person.

You can find the entrance to the west of Solliden's Farmstead. Go through the gate and follow the road straight until you reach Glenshire. It may not be the safest road, but you can handle that.

[hesitant] There might be a fork in the road, I think you take a left... if I remember correctly. Marlow Neggle should be located in town somewhere there. Take this shipment to him.
quest_40086_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, can I help you?
quest_40086_quest_complete: [soft voice] Gordon must have sent you, and on time too. He has been a steady help here at Glenshire. Without him, I would be quite out of luck working.
quest_40087_quest_detail:
I have no idea how they managed to slip past our forces in Silverpine. [urgent] These Worgen have come in great numbers! [commanding] Without the tower in our control, our ability to monitor activity here is reduced, which is why I could use the help of an adventurer like you. [solemn] Help us reclaim it.

[confident] You haven't run, yet, so consider me impressed. [cold] Good. Head over and kill those flea-ridden wretches.
quest_40087_quest_complete: [excited] You did it? Well, I was honestly not expecting you to return! [warm] I wish you had arrived a few days earlier, then We might have avoided this whole situation to begin with.
quest_40088_quest_detail:
[commanding] With their forces at the tower weakened, it is time for us to kill their leader. [emphasis] Yes, when I say us, I mean you. Their leader recently invaded the mine, and he took his bigger worgen down there with him. [solemn] The Gracestone mine is a top priority. Without its resources, Glenshire doesn't stand a chance against the humans, not to mention that the mines provide a perfect ambush point for worgen to attack any travelers between Silverpine and the Uplands.

[urgent] Go down there and bring me the head of their leader. [soft voice] Oh, and feel free to kill as many of his followers as you can.
quest_40088_quest_complete: [low voice] Oh, I can smell the blood coming from your bag. Is that the head of the mongrel? Good, very good. [commanding] With the mine and tower back in our control, we are one step closer to achieving complete rule over the Tirisfal Uplands.
quest_40091_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Crescent Grove was once a retreat for druids of our kind for many years. [sad] As of recently, something evil has lurked there. [soft voice] Keeper Ranathos was tasked with holding back the taint that plagued the area, but we have not gotten word from him lately. [hesitant] His last message back was also quite erratic and unlike Ranathos. [solemn] We druids had suspicions of something much darker taking root within the Crescent Grove.

[urgent] Recently, we have gotten a report from one of our druids being corrupted and warped. [solemn] Arch Druid Staghelm has asked the druids to assist with establishing control in Crescent Grove once again, but we are unable to. [hesitant] Perhaps you can assist.

[commanding] You can find the entrance to the grove in the south of Ashenvale, at the waterfall to the Mystral Lake. [solemn] The cave's entrance lies above, so venture forth and destroy what evil lurks in that place. [urgent] Make sure to bring assistance. [solemn] You will find many hardships inside.
quest_40091_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you ventured into the grove yet?
quest_40091_quest_complete: [excited] Arch Druid Staghelm will be overjoyed to hear such news! [warm] Please, on behalf of the Cenarion Circle, take one of these items.
quest_40092_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Tidemaster was sent off course after a scrap with some pirates. The next thing I knew, pure chaos erupted as sailors were tossed into the ocean and ripped across jagged rocks! Murlocs attacked, and the night erupted into screams and battle. I ran and found shelter upon this small island all the while my crewmates suffered a fate more horrible than you could imagine!

I've been trapped here ever since. The murlocs have been trying to fight me, but they haven't had any luck yet, so they mostly stick to the shore. On the last attack, they ended up stealing a crate that had many of my belongings, but most importantly, my compass. If I am ever to get back to Kul Tiras, I will need it to find my way ashore. Find their small camp down the hill on this island. Find my compass among their hovels, and while you're there, kill some in revenge for the Tidemaster!
quest_40092_quest_progress: [solemn] Murlocs are a dreadful race of creatures, are they not?
quest_40092_quest_complete: [soft voice] This means a lot to me. [warm] When I get back home, I will send a postcard and some coin for what you've done. [excited] Wish me luck when I set off!
quest_40095_quest_detail:
[solemn] Sorrowguard Keep once held the Orcish Horde at bay for two weeks. Day after day, orcs attacked these walls and were repelled by brave defenders of the Kingdom of Azeroth. They battled from one end of the swamp all the way back to these very walls.

[sad] My mentor was one such hero who took the call and met the horde within these lands. As much of a hero he was, he gave his life so others had the chance to survive. [soft voice] When I was being trained, he carried a tome of great holy power from the Abbey of Northshire.

I still believe the tome to be present here in the swamp, though in what condition, or where, I cannot be certain. [hesitant] I do know it lies north of Stonard. [solemn] That should certainly narrow down the area if you wish to search in the name of the Light.
quest_40095_quest_progress: [hesitant] I take it you have had no luck?
quest_40095_quest_complete: [pause] This... This is it. [emphasis] You found it. [soft voice] I must say, looking at this again, after all these years, is quite something.
quest_40096_quest_detail: [urgent] Ah, you look like someone who can get things done, <class>. Listen closely, as I do not like to repeat myself. The humans outnumber us five to one. However, they are not aware of this yet, and I would like to keep it that way. [solemn] My servants informed me that the Lordaeron scouts are heading towards Glenshire from the north. And you, my friend, are going to make sure that they never return to their masters.
quest_40096_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. With those scouts gone, they will think twice before sending an attack force on Glenshire.
quest_40097_quest_detail:
[commanding] With their scouts gone, we can finally go on the offensive. But before we can orchestrate an attack on their main camp, we need to reduce their ability to monitor our movement.

Just north of the Whispering Woods, there is a tower called Shatteridge. The Remnant's Sentries have made that tower their center of operation, and they are there to warn their main base of any potential danger. Their numbers at the Shatteridge are great, which is precisely the reason why they won't expect a single, yet powerful foe to attack them directly. [urgent] So are you up to the task?
quest_40097_quest_progress: [low voice] Tell me, how goes the attack?
quest_40097_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, yes. My greatest asset returns, successful, no less. [low voice] With the sentries gone, we will have a much easier time dealing with the miserable humans.
quest_40098_quest_detail:
[solemn] I'm glad I was right about you. With the imminent danger out of the way, it is time for you to learn about the House Darlthos. Before the Scourge ravaged these lands, our house was one of the most prominent houses in all of Lordaeron. [low voice] Yet now, we are divided, for my sister-in-law acts as a ruler to those still living.

And therein lies our problem, for my wife is the only true heir to this land. [commanding] You are certainly capable, which is why you have earned the right to an audience with Duchess Grelda. Follow the road south of Glenshire past the gates of the Tirisfal Uplands, and you will find my wife in manor alongside the road.

[soft voice] Oh, and make sure to give this letter to her. It's a... let's say, a recommendation of sorts.
quest_40098_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmmm, you managed to impress my husband? [warm] Let's see if you will do the same for me.
quest_40099_quest_detail:
[solemn] Are you aware of how the plague designed by the Cult of the Damned works? [sad] No? Well, it doesn't matter. [commanding] What you need to know is that I have made something similar, though not as powerful as the original one. [cold] This vial contains a plague that will severely reduce the life expectancy of the living who consume it.

[soft voice] Now, that is the part where you, my dear, come in. [urgent] I need you to head north, past the Whispering Forest, to a farmstead called Garricks Stead. [threatening] There, you will slip a bit of this liquid onto the human's supplies. [threatening] And make sure that there are no witnesses.
quest_40099_quest_complete: [solemn] I have received news that the humans did their part precisely as planned. [soft voice] They have brought our little gift into their main camp. [warm] You did marvelously, my dear.
quest_40100_quest_detail:
[commanding] There you are, <name>! [urgent] I know it took quite a while, but we finally have new information on the missing plates of Uldum.

[solemn] Well, when I say that we “have” something, I mean we found someone who might be able to get it for us. [soft voice] She is a smuggler named Vess, at least I think that's what she calls herself these days. [pause] Anyways, I have arranged for you to meet her at the Booty Bay inn.

[commanding] Once you get there, make sure to get on her good side, as I doubt we will get another chance like this.
quest_40100_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, I assume you are the famous <name> of whom I've heard so much about, a pleasure to meet you. You can call me Vess.

[gentle] I understand that you need something from me, as it so happens, I also need something from you. [warm] So shall we talk business?
quest_40101_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Here is the deal, sweetcheeks. [solemn] Once upon a time, not so long ago, a not-so-smart pirate by the name of Bannor thought he could double-cross me and get away with it.

[threatening] Well, you see, no one double-crosses me. [urgent] So in exchange for me finding the location of your precious plates, I need you to end his miserable life and kindly retrieve my locket from his possession.

[pause] He has a camp on an island east of here, so that's most likely where you will find him. [warm] And don't worry, I will have what you seek by the time you return. [soft voice] So, do we have a deal?
quest_40101_quest_progress: [angry] You're still here? [threatening] Don't tell me that you are scared of a few pirates.
quest_40101_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I will assume that you and Magellas didn't know what you got me into by sending me after those damned plates. [sad] I should have sent you to rob the royal treasury of Stormwind instead of giving you a menial task such as Bannor.

[solemn] But a deal is a deal, and the Black Rose always holds up to her end of the bargain.
quest_40102_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Listen, I like you, sweetcheeks, which is why I will give you this information as a bonus. [low voice] It appears that I was not the only one looking into your damned plates.

[threatening] A cult of some kind was also after them. And believe me when I tell you that they are the kind of people you do not wish to have as enemies.

<Vess hands you the letter.>

[warm] Here is the information your High Explorer seeks. [urgent] While I enjoy spending time with you, I have other business to attend to, so off with you now.
quest_40102_quest_progress: <name>, [urgent] I sure damn hope that you have good news for me because it appears that the Horde is on the move as well.
quest_40102_quest_complete: <High Explorer Magellas reads the letter.> [shocked] Shave my beard and call me an elf, How in the world did she manage this? [sigh] Ahm… I mean, this is more than good news, <name>. [solemn] We know the exact locations of the missing plates. [threatening] And what is this mentioning of a cult?
quest_40103_quest_detail:
[angry] So, not only the Horde, but now we have to worry about some damned cult as well? Uh, I must say, I don't like this, but this is only one more reason why we must acquire plates before anyone else. Who knows what secrets Uldum hides.

<He pulls out a map and points to a place in the northern mountains of Un'goro Crater.>

If what Vess found out is true, then the first piece of the set should be right at this location. [urgent] While you are busy with this task, I will prepare a well-armed expedition to search for the second piece at the Swamp of Sorrows.
quest_40103_quest_complete: [excited] You're back! And you have the first plate as well. [warm] Finally, some good news. [sigh] I was starting to think that I'm cursed with bad luck.
quest_40104_quest_detail:
[solemn] Something is not right, <name>. There is still no word of the expedition that I sent out.

[hesitant] While I try to keep my optimism high, I can feel that something's wrong. [sad] I hate to ask this of you as you have done so much already, but you are the only one I can rely on getting this done.

[urgent] Please, go to the Swamp of Sorrows and find out what happened to my people. [soft voice] The location Vess marked for us points towards the southeastern part of the swamps along the mountains.
quest_40104_quest_complete:
[solemn] We…

<Grungis coughs.>

We were trying to come to an agreement with the Horde about the plates when those monsters fell upon us. [sad] They slew both our brethren and the Horde with such ease.
quest_40105_quest_detail:
[urgent] I've never begged in my life, <race>, but I'll start now. [shouting] Please! [angry] Avenge us and show those bastards what happens when you make an enemy of the Alliance! [pause] They—<coughs>—went north of here.

[solemn] For Khaz Mo...
quest_40105_quest_complete:
[solemn] So that's what happened. [sad] I should have taken Vess' warning more seriously.

[angry] By Muradin's beard, I hope that you killed every last one of them. [urgent] But what of the plate? [warm] Tell me that Grungis' sacrifice and the sacrifice of his men weren't for nothing.
quest_40106_quest_detail:
So, we finally have the full set. [solemn] There is only one thing left for us to do. [solemn] It is time to unlock Uldum and find out what secrets it holds.

[solemn] After all you have done, <name>, I think you should have the honor of being the first one to enter. [solemn] From what we have seen at Uldaman, I doubt that this endeavor will prove to be simple, which is why I think you should find adventures who are willing to accompany you on this journey.

[solemn] I would be happy to join you myself. [solemn] However, there is still the matter of telling the grim news to the families of the expedition. [sad]
quest_40108_quest_detail: [solemn] The time has come, <name>. [soft voice] A new path has been shown to me by the Earth Mother. [solemn] What once was lost must be found again. [solemn] The shards of this vision still echo in my mind, <class>. [urgent] Travel to the north in the Barrens and seek out a powerful Farseer Logrash amongst the mountains west of Durotar. [solemn] Only with his help will we be able to locate the missing plates of Uldum. [warm] Go now, and may the Earth Mother guide your path.
quest_40108_quest_progress: [low voice] I was wondering when you would show up. [commanding] Speak up, then.
quest_40108_quest_complete: [solemn] So, Truthseeker sends his emissary? [hesitant] I tend to avoid meddling in the affairs of the Horde, but I owe my life to the Sage, so you have my ear, <name>.
quest_40109_quest_detail:
[solemn] Four years ago, my own people betrayed me for refusing to do the very same thing that doomed us in the first place—drinking the blood of the demon Mannoroth. [sad] If not for my companion Korvir and Truthseeker, my body would have rotted away in the forests of Ashenvale.

<Logrash caresses the scars on his chest with a painful expression.>

[whispering] The spirits whisper of demon scum called Naxiar hiding around the eastern lakes of Ashenvale. [commanding] If you wish to have my aid, I need you to kill him and retrieve my wolf totem.
quest_40109_quest_complete: Mok'ra, <name>. [commanding] I'm assuming that the accursed demon is dead. [solemn] Good, his ilk does not deserve anything more than death. [low voice] Though my rage towards them runs deep, revenge was not my only motive.
quest_40110_quest_detail:
[solemn] This totem will help me enter a deeper state of trance and allow me to commune with the spirits of old. With their help, we might be able to locate your missing plates.

<Logrash begins his ritual, and his eyes turn pale.>

[sad] Bah, I forgot how taxing this ritual is. The plates you seek are immensely powerful, <name>. [solemn] Show this message to the Truthseeker, and he will understand where to send you next. [urgent] But be warned, it appears that we are not the only ones looking for the plates. [threatening] Someone—or something—dark is on the trail as well.
quest_40110_quest_complete:
[solemn] The winds guided you back to me, <name>. [warm] I'm glad to hear that my friend is still alive and well. [soft voice] A letter you say? Show me.

<The Sage reads the letter, and a grin shows up on his face.>

[gentle] Ah, words of a long-lost friend bring warmth to my heart, <class>, but how did he manage to locate the exact location of the plates, and what is this talk about the danger ahead?
quest_40111_quest_detail:
[solemn] The path ahead is clear now, friend. [soft voice] With both locations revealed, it is time to act. [urgent] I will gather a war party of Horde's finest warriors to secure one of the plates at the Swamp of Sorrows while you make your way to the northern mountains of Un'goro Crater and recover the other plate.

<Sage rubs his chin.>

[hesitant] But the grave news Logrash spoke of still troubles my mind. [commanding] Be careful, friend, and may the Earthmother watch over you.
quest_40111_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something you need?
quest_40111_quest_complete: [excited] You're back! [warm] And you have the plate with you as well. [solemn] The sun shines upon us today.
quest_40112_quest_detail:
[solemn] While I'm glad to see you return, I feel a disturbance in the air. [low voice] The war party that I have sent to the Swamp of Sorrows has not returned, nor did they send any message. [hesitant] Logrash's warning still circles my mind.

<name>, you have done so much already for us, but I would ask you to check on the war party. [soft voice] The location Logrash marked for us points us towards the southeastern part of the swamps along the mountains.

[sad] Maybe this is just an old man worrying, but I cannot shake this feeling of unease.
quest_40112_quest_complete: [solemn] We were trying to negotiate with the Alliance when they attacked. [sad] The madmen fought with a power that I have never seen.
quest_40113_quest_detail:
Hahaha, [solemn] this be not the death I thought I would end up with, but Bwonsamdi appears to have other plans for me.

<Cough, cough.>

[pause] I lived a life with no regrets, <name>—until now. [commanding] I ask this of you, friend. [urgent] Go north of here after those bastards and show them that if it be war they seek, then the Horde will stand against them.

[emphasis] Lok’tar... Ogar.
quest_40113_quest_progress: [solemn] You return. [soft voice] What did you find?
quest_40113_quest_complete:
Dead? All of them? [sad] This... this is my fault for not listening to the warning of the spirits.

[solemn] They will be remembered as true warriors of the Horde. [urgent] But what of the plates, <name>? [soft voice] Tell me that we did not sacrifice the lives of our friends in vain.
quest_40114_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come. It is as the Earthmother told me. [hesitant] We have no idea what we might find in Uldum, and if dangerous factions seek to enter. [urgent] Then all the more reason for us to take extreme precautions.

[solemn] I urge you to avoid the mistake I have made with the war party. [soft voice] Before you go, find trustworthy allies who would accompany you to the gates. [solemn] There is no telling what awaits you and I there. [sad] I will be working on putting our friends to rest. [soft voice] It is the least I can do to atone for my mistake. [solemn] Go now, and may the winds be ever at your back.
quest_40120_quest_detail:
[solemn] The encroaching wildlife has become a problem for both myself and my wife. In the past, we lived at peace with the animals of the forest, though it now seems we must always be wary of our moves and watch the forests for the eyes of stalking predators.

The Ghostpaw have been especially troublesome and have for days now stalked our house for signs of weakness. I have given them none, but I fear that something may be driving the wildlife to act in a much more aggressive manner.

Regardless, gather me five of their pelts. Thin the numbers so that they are not so brazen in their attacks. You can find Ghostpaw Wolves all around the forest.
quest_40120_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you made the forests a safer place, friend?
quest_40120_quest_complete: [solemn] I must thank you dearly for the work you have put in. [warm] You have made it easier for us out here, but I feel you must do one more thing.
quest_40121_quest_detail:
[solemn] The alpha of the Ghostpaw Wolves in the area is named Ghoststalker. [soft voice] He is a ferocious beast that leads packs of wolves in the region with dangerous intent. [urgent] If a balance of nature is to be brought, then the beast must be slain.

[pause] You should find him in the hills northwest of Lake Falathim and southeast of the Zoram Strand. [hesitant] I wish you luck in your hunt. [sad] Ghoststalker is a clever beast that has eluded me to this day.
quest_40121_quest_progress: [solemn] The beast, Ghoststalker, have you dispatched him?
quest_40121_quest_complete: [solemn] The balance of nature in the region will be restored over time. [warm] I thank you greatly, on both behalf of myself and my wife. [proud] Take this, a family heirloom. [gentle] May it serve you well.
quest_40122_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <race>. [solemn] It is good to see a friendly face in such a worn landscape.
quest_40122_quest_complete: [solemn] Ahh, so Ansirem sent you. Good. [soft voice] I forwarded a letter to him quite a while ago, and it seems that this magical interference has grown ever more potent.
quest_40123_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My studies have been ongoing for the last few months, and from what I can tell, the energy within the region has been slowly fading away. [sad] Even my own magic hasn't been as potent! [urgent] If whatever is causing this can harness even more power, this could be quite damaging for magic across the entire continent, and potentially even Dalaran in the future!

[pause] I have a few leads that I want to look into. [solemn] The first is the ley-shards that occupy the once-great city of Eldarath. [low voice] Just north of us is the ruins of the once-mighty city. [commanding] Travel there and look for shards of its ley-energy. [emphasis] Gather five, and bring them to me for study, to see if their power has waned.
quest_40123_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gathered the Ley-shards yet?
quest_40123_quest_complete: [excited] Splendid! [delight] Magnificent, in fact! [urgent] I shall begin my testing at once.
quest_40124_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even the ley-shards of the city of Eldarath have their energies compromised. [soft voice] This could be the work of the Naga that have encroached and invaded from the ocean depths. [low voice] I would not put it past the beasts, as savage as they are, for attempting to claim dominion over the landscape.

[urgent] We must look into this matter further before claiming we have gotten this solved. [solemn] I have prepared a scroll of dispelling. [commanding] Use it upon the Spitelash Shrine they have in their clutches. [urgent] If they are behind this dampening, this should solve the problem. [soft voice] While you're there, slay their sirens as well, they are the ones who wield a crude and foul magic.
quest_40124_quest_progress: [solemn] Have the Naga been dealt with?
quest_40124_quest_complete: [solemn] It has been done? Have you dispelled the shrine? [soft voice] Let us see just how much of an effect this has had on our magics. [pause] Let us hope this is done once and for all.
quest_40125_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would appear that I have run out of ideas about what may be causing this. [hesitant] I hate to admit intellectual defeat, but I must turn to another for an answer. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is well-versed in more than I know. [urgent] I need you to travel to him with a crate of the ley-shards you gathered earlier.

[soft voice] If there is any clue or magic that lingers upon them, perhaps he will have some answers for them and know their origination to help me here in Azshara. [warm] Please, take these coins for the journey. [low voice] Dalaran is but far away, and I will assist in whatever way I can.
quest_40126_quest_progress: [solemn] So, you return. [soft voice] What did Ansirem say about the Ley-shards?
quest_40126_quest_complete: <Magus Bromley begins to read the letter.> [hesitant] Oh... Well, things have gotten a whole lot more complicated if this is the case.
quest_40127_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems as though there is only one thing left. [hesitant] I cannot believe the Blue Dragonflight would be responsible for such a thing, if their enemy is magic then that means their enemy is Dalaran. [urgent] We cannot allow their plans to take fruition and must deal with them now and with due haste in our actions.

[emphasis] Just south of here is Lake Mennar it is where the Blue Dragonflight has gathered, the cause of which was unknown until now. [commanding] Head there, slay their Magelords, and kill the leader, Lieutenant Azsalus.

I would advise, the Blue Dragonflight is not a foe to be under-estimated, find a band of mercenaries, or like minded heroes. [urgent] You will need them to battle with the dragonkin, or to stand a chance.
quest_40127_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you ended the dampening that lies upon Azshara?
quest_40127_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done? Truly?

[warm] You have my thanks hero. [proud] Your name shall go down in the annals of Dalaran history. [gentle] A defender of magic is truly one that stands for virtue. [warm] Please, take one of these artifacts. [soft voice] It is the least I can offer. [warm] May it serve you well.
quest_40128_quest_detail:
Greetings. [soft voice] Torble Sparksprocket here. [excited] Junior Archaeologist of the Explorer's League! A few weeks ago, the dig found this strange contraption. [solemn] It appears to be the torso of an automaton, and it is clearly of Titan make, but we haven't seen anything like it before. [pause] That's why I was called here.

[urgent] I quickly realized that it is a modular automaton of some kind. [pause] Some days later, the other parts were found, but someone tripped some defense mechanism, and now the dig is full of golems. [commanding] Can you head in there and find the other pieces? [urgent] You need two arms, two legs, and a head. [emphasis] Look through crates and such.
quest_40128_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. [soft voice] This contraption will take some time to repair. [warm] Do visit sometime in the future, and I may have news for you!
quest_40129_quest_detail:
[excited] Hello again, impeccable timing! I have done what I can with the parts you acquired from the dig, but we're missing a crucial piece. This automaton's power source is some advanced crystalline power core.

Unfortunately, the one in the chest has cracked, and it's energy has been depleted. None have been found here, and the dig has slowed down due to the golems. [solemn] Do not despair though, similar power sources have been found in the Uldaman dig bordering between Loch Modan and the Badlands.

That dig has also run into issues with the Dark Irons and with awakened defenders. [urgent] You helped out here, so why not head over there, help them out, and grab me a power core while you're at it?
quest_40129_quest_progress: [laughing] Is that a Power core in your pocket, or are you just happy to see me?
quest_40129_quest_complete: [excited] This is it! [warm] Well done! [excited] Now I just have to fix this up, and we're good to go soon! [soft voice] Come visit again in the future.
quest_40132_quest_detail: [soft voice] Thank you again. [excited] I believe the core is installed. [confident] So now all that's left to do is the final assembly, and then we'll have this automaton working! [urgent] Speak to me again and say the word. Then, we'll turn it on.
quest_40132_quest_complete:
[excited] Analyzer X-51 huh? The memory banks are restricted. [solemn] I'll have to figure out how to unlock them. [delight] Imagine the secrets it may possess! [solemn] The secrets of the Titans! [warm] He's very cooperative, though, so I'd say we've made some headway.

[urgent] I'll keep working with Analyzer X-51 and see if he can help the dig site for now. [urgent] I'll call you once I have a hint regarding the memory banks. [warm] In the meantime, I have something for you. [excited] I have modified Analyzer X-51's old depleted power core into an amulet you can wear.

[soft voice] While the energies within are but a fraction of what the core once held, it can still sustain your magical energies if you use magic... [hesitant] If not, I bet we can sell it to someone who'd be interested.
quest_40136_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there! Yes, you. New in town, ay? Look, I'm not sure if you are aware, but we are currently at war with the humans, and as you can imagine, it has taken quite a toll on our dwindling supplies.

[solemn] That is why I'm looking for someone to collect boar meat from the local Cragtusk Boars. [urgent] So, feeling up for it?
quest_40136_quest_complete: [soft voice] Look at that, a chunk of finely cut meat. [warm] Are you sure you are not some mysterious chef who is an adventurer by the day and chef by night? [warm] Anyways, thanks a lot. [excited] This will surely help. And here, I hope this is a suitable enough reward.
quest_40137_quest_detail:
[commanding] Just the person that I need. Listen. [solemn] A few months ago, a pack of wolves inhabited the cave just north of here. [soft voice] At first, we thought it was just a small number of them, so we didn't pay those beasts much attention, being busy with war and all. [angry] But they have become aggressive of late, and they even got bold enough to attack residents of Glenshire.

[urgent] So, how about this, you go and cull their numbers. [low voice] In the meantime, I will try to gather some coins from the residents for you, deal?
quest_40137_quest_complete: [solemn] Thanks, you might not have eradicated them completely, but this will surely make them think twice before attacking us again. [warm] Oh, and here is your reward.
quest_40138_quest_detail:
[commanding] You look like someone who can get things done. I have a proposition for you. You see, I have been hunting a man by the name of Storn for a while now. However, he was always surrounded by his minions and was untouchable. But it appears that he had a falling out with his men, and he has since been in hiding.

[urgent] Good thing is that I know he is hiding in a cave close to Rogue Heights in the eastern hills of Tirisfal Uplands. The bad thing is that I need to wait for my client to get here, and she has a habit of leaving early if I do not meet her at her specific time. [urgent] This is why I need someone to go and hunt Storn for me. So what do you say? You get me Storn's head, and I will split the reward for the bounty with you.
quest_40138_quest_complete: [commanding] You are fast. [soft voice] Have you ever considered changing your profession to being a bounty hunter? [pause] Anyways, here is your share, and thanks for the job well done.
quest_40139_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to the Glenshire. [soft voice] I hope that you have come to assist us. [sad] The enemies on every side beset us, and we could surely use any help we could get. [solemn] West of here is a farm where a large battle occurred recently between our troops and humans of Lordaeron. [solemn] We planned to use the dead there to boost our troops, but the Cult of the Damned appeared before us with the same idea.

[urgent] If left unchecked, the Scourge will soon have a large force to attack from the west, and we cannot let that happen. [warm] If you are feeling up to it, I got a reward ready for anyone willing to put a stop to the Scourge advances.
quest_40139_quest_complete: [solemn] Finally, some good news. [warm] As promised, here is your reward.
quest_40140_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the bulk of the undead gone, it is time to face the one responsible for taking our new troops from us. [urgent] Go to the Corinth Farm once again and kill the necromancer responsible for this.

And be careful. [emphasis] Suppose the necromancer is capable of summoning a small army of undead. In that case, he is certainly not someone who should be underestimated.
quest_40140_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the necromancer is dead, this truly is reassuring news. [soft voice] Without you, we might have had to retreat into the Tirisfal Glades, and even worse, the Scourge would have been able to attack the Forsaken from both the west and east. [warm] You have done us a great service. [proud] I think you should have this as a just reward for your deeds.
quest_40145_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have heard rumblings from some of the druids in the region of an elvish grove hidden away that has been corrupted. [pause] Suppose such darkness can lurk and remain undisturbed. In that case, it could mean horrible things for the forest and nature itself.

[urgent] I have a scout who has recently checked up on such a disturbance. I would like his report before dedicating resources to eliminating corruption within Ashenvale. You can find him just down the road to the southwest, at a small camp. [soft voice] He goes by the name Feran Strongwind, and he will tell you what he knows.
quest_40145_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes? [pause] Is there anything you need from me?
quest_40145_quest_complete: [solemn] Loruk sent you. [soft voice] I am assuming he wishes to hear news about the Crescent Grove.
quest_40146_quest_detail:
Loruk may not like the news I am about to deliver to him. [solemn] It is news of madness and chaos. [low voice] Upon studying the hidden grove, I found crater marks from infernals and furbolgs enraged by corruption.

[solemn] It seems the elven druids could not stop whatever lurks deep inside, and I did not risk my life to learn more. [urgent] Whatever is inside of there certainly is powerful enough to corrupt the very forest. [solemn] Take this report to Loruk. [commanding] It has all of the details of my findings.
quest_40146_quest_complete: [solemn] The rumors are true. [soft voice] There is something evil twisting the very roots of this place, and if left unchecked, [urgent] could be a force unstoppable.
quest_40147_quest_detail:
[solemn] This report is chilling. [urgent] Something is going on within the Crescent Grove, and it must be stopped. If we do not end the corruption, it could spread as far as Mulgore and beyond. [solemn] We must do our part for the greater good of nature itself as druids.

[solemn] I must ask you to delve into the very depths of the Crescent Grove. [soft voice] You can find it to the southwest, near Mystral Lake. [soft voice] The cave entrance is just above the waterfall. There should be a pathway up. [commanding] I recommend you find a band of those heroic enough to travel with you. [solemn] There is no telling what lies ahead.
quest_40147_quest_progress: [solemn] We must root out evil, no matter the cost.
quest_40147_quest_complete: [solemn] This is truly an accomplishment to be celebrated. [warm] For what you've done within the Crescent Grove, please take one of these. [warm] May they assist you well in your future endeavors.
quest_40157_quest_detail:
[solemn] We come from the great city of Zul'Hazu to the southwest. It is where our ancestors called home. [sad] Though now, we are nothing more than outcasts. Our people have turned away from the roots of our past. They are swayed by great shadowy magic that taints their minds and twists them to madness. [solemn] We primalists have lost our way in the past. With whispering shadows and great magic to wield, Chieftain Woh'zo chose the darkness over our heritage.

[soft voice] Our people may have turned their backs on us, but perhaps there may be a chance to save them. [urgent] All across the city are Hazzuri Dark Vessels. They hide away in small baskets and pouches around the city. [commanding] These Dark Vessels are used in ceremonies and rituals, and they contain shadowy energies that twist minds.

[urgent] Go into Zul'Hazu and get me these Dark Vessels, but be careful, mon. [threatening] They won't let you in, and they won't just let you leave.
quest_40157_quest_progress: [hesitant] I would suggest bringing friends for such a task. [solemn] The city will be difficult to enter.
quest_40157_quest_complete: <Primalist Jongi lets a small sigh escape from him and nods his head.> [solemn] I know what had to be done to gather these, mon. It was necessary for my people, and eventually, the wounds may heal once more. [warm] Thanks for what you have done.
quest_40158_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to the Hazzuri Glade. We welcome you here as long as you keep the peace. We have found ourselves on our own, and I seek ancient recipes and powers. Far away on the continent of Kalimdor, there is a place called Azshara. [soft voice] This place holds many secrets and great energies that I wish to harness here in Hazu.
