[pause] In this place, there are hippogryphs that go by the name 'Thunderhead'. [commanding] From them, I desire one Pristine Thunderhead Horn. [solemn] This horn shall help me and the primalists greatly.
quest_40158_quest_progress: [solemn] The Thunderhead I hear be a powerful creature. [urgent] Keep your wits about you.
quest_40158_quest_complete: <Manaz'ago takes his time to inspect the horn, slowly cracking a grin.> [solemn] This be it. [solemn] This be the one. [warm] Nice job, outsider. [warm] You did me good. [urgent] There still be more to do, though, if you be wanting to help.
quest_40159_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, I heard rumors of a deep jungle in a crater of the earth. [soft voice] It was filled with dinosaurs, raptors, and other massive, strange creatures that I had not seen. [hesitant] I long to visit such a paradise one day, but for now, it holds something I seek.

[solemn] In this foreign landscape, there be a great volcano at its center. [excited] It holds one of the world's hottest substances, and elemental beings of flame protect it! [urgent] I seek a Pure Volcanic Ember from these very flaming elementals, hot enough to burn for many long years. [solemn] It is with this that my people can regain access to magic that has been lost for a long time.

[commanding] Go to this place and get me what I seek.
quest_40159_quest_progress: [hesitant] This jungle, you find it yet?
quest_40159_quest_complete: [solemn] This be it, mon. [urgent] It radiates an almost unbearable heat, and, when lit, should go up in a mighty fire hotter than anything we can produce. [warm] You done me well. [delight] Thank you, mon. [solemn] Your efforts here may bring back our old magics.
quest_40160_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Bengal tigers of the region are a capable predator—one you should not dismiss easily, mon. [soft voice] They stalk for their prey and attack with a vicious speed that cannot be matched. [solemn] It is from these tigers that I have produced many a potent elixir.

[soft voice] You see, the Hazzuri use this battle elixir made from Bengal fangs to enhance their battle capabilities. [low voice] It is we, the Primalists, who came up with this long ago, mon. [urgent] Go out into the jungle, and gather me five Bengal fangs. [urgent] Our camp needs some of this elixir.
quest_40160_quest_complete: [solemn] I expected the Bengals be too much for you. With these fangs I will be creating the elixirs for our people. [warm] Thanks again, mon.
quest_40161_quest_detail:
[solemn] On dis island, there be a powerful herb that we use in many of our most ancient recipes, mon. [sad] This herb has been harder to get since we left Zul'Hazu and founded our own destiny. [soft voice] You see, hidin' up here, we cannot leave the safety of the Glade for long.

[solemn] I speak of the Hazu leaf that only grows upon this island and can send someone who uses it into a dream-like state. [urgent] I need you to get us this, mon, to help our ability to see things. [commanding] You can find it all over the island. Get me ten of them. That should be enough.
quest_40161_quest_progress: [soft voice] Any luck finding Hazu leaves out there, mon?
quest_40161_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work. Without the Hazu leaf, it would be much harder to make many of our recipes, and also to just simply relax, mon. [warm] Take this as a reward for my gratitude.
quest_40169_quest_progress: [hesitant] What do you need from me, adventurer?
quest_40169_quest_complete: [soft voice] Magus Valgon sent you, interesting, let me have a look then and I will see what I can do.
quest_40170_quest_detail:
<It would only take a single glance at the key with inquisitive eyes for the troll to crack a small smirk> [soft voice] .

I can do this, though I must wonder why I would help you, especially for free.

[hesitant] If you want me to work the magic of this key, and attune it for you, I will need a favor from you. [solemn] There is a satyr of whom I knew a long time ago, one who still walks this world today. [commanding] Let us say that me and him are not on the best of standing and I want you to bring me one of his gnarled horns from his battered corpse.

[urgent] Travel to Felwood, to the Ruins of Constellas, you will find Pethax Blackhorn there, it is his horn I desire.
quest_40170_quest_progress: [angry] Have you found that blackhearted mongrel yet?
quest_40170_quest_complete: <The troll looks almost filled with glee> [solemn] . You have done well, this wretch had much worse coming to him, but this shall do, especially given my current state. [urgent] Fine, give me that key, I will do as you asked, my word is my bond.
quest_40171_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, I will do what I can to restore the attunement to this key. [soft voice] It shouldn't be that difficult, the magi who left the magic did a poor job with leaving magical traces upon it.

[pause] Step back, I will do as you asked, it shouldn't take long. [emphasis] When I am done, you may return to the one who sent you.
quest_40172_quest_detail:
[excited] Ahoy mate, fine day, innit?

<Garfield takes a deep breath.>

[soft voice] Aye, the salty smell of the sea forcefully entering your nostrils, the cotton mouth from last night's rum and the ultimate headache and pain you got from the local bar fight. [proud] Thar is no better life matey, this I tell ye. [sad] But this city be borin'. [soft voice] I reckon they are no real pirates. [urgent] If ye truly want to live yer adventures at sea and see how it really be to be a Corsair ye should come join me and me crew!

[commanding] I be a crew member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and I be lookin' for new folk to join us. [threatening] We are sworn enemies to Booty Bay so keep this small piece to yerself eh? [urgent] If ye decide to join us I got a mission for ye, if not, we never met, savvy?
quest_40172_quest_progress: [angry] Don't waste me time mate, I be tryin' to enjoy the sun and this here fine rum.
quest_40172_quest_complete: [soft voice] I'd like to say welcome aboard but ye are not ready to become a crew member yet, first ye must do us a favor.
quest_40173_quest_detail:
[commanding] So listen here mate, ye see these foul sea tailed imps? [mocking tone] These Blackwater Pirates are naught but a joke, hiding in their port. [soft voice] They even have their weapons laying around in crates, truly a disgrace to all pirates around.

<Garfield spits on the ground.>

[urgent] So that's exactly why ye are going to collect them and bring them to a special someone in the city. [angry] What, ye thought these sea tailed imps wouldn't have a rat? [laughing] Outrageous, but hilarious, innit? [soft voice] Narkk be the name.
quest_40173_quest_complete:
[angry] Not so loud! You want the whole bruiser brigade on our hands? Just put that crate in and keep them coming.

<After you bring each crate one by one you turn your attention towards Narkk.>

[whispering] Fine work mate, here's your pay. [urgent] Now leave and don't worry about it, you were never here today.
quest_40174_quest_detail:
[commanding] All right mate. Ye've done well so far but thar's still some stuff we have to do afore leavin' this rotten port. [urgent] If we wants these idiots to never have a chance in the face of the Bloodsail Buccaneers, we shall have to also tamper with thar ammo. That bein' said, I'm gonna give ye a flask o' "special" water ye will have to pour in any barrel of blast powder ye can find.

[emphasis] Savvy?
quest_40174_quest_complete: [excited] Aye, good job lad. [warm] This is all fer the greater good of the crew, aye?
quest_40175_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I may not have the most gold on me, but I do have a fortune that's waiting out there for me. [low voice] I made a bet with this goblin, named Nagzel, crafty little guy. You see, we were playing cards one day and he was telling me about his plans of joinin' the Venture Co. and working at the base camp by Lake Nazferiti. [pause] For the first time in my life, I was actually winnin', and he offered this big hunk of a ring.

[emphasis] Now, the ring itself I cared little for, it was nothing more then some cheap old iron lug nut, but it had this BIG jade sticking on top of it. [emphasis] I'm talking the size of my thumb!

[excited] Bets are more then just games, they're a way of life, and this man took the ring when he lost, and vanished, never to be seen again. [urgent] Go find this punk and get that green stone, it's rightfully mine!
quest_40175_quest_progress: [hesitant] It might be hard to track him down, but [confident] I'm sure you can do it.
quest_40175_quest_complete: [laughing] Damn, look at this beauty, such a beautiful rock. [warm] Here, have some silver for the hard work of getting it for me. [mocking tone] Some people should really learn not to flash their expensive rocks out in public, you never know who could be looking for them, heh.
quest_40178_quest_detail:
[solemn] What we be about to do be a great sin, mate. [sad] I hope the Goddess o' Rum will forgive this foolish scallywag. [hesitant] Aye, we'll poison the rum in the inn, wha' a damn shame, ain't it?

[urgent] But sometimes ye gotta do wha' ye gotta do. [soft voice] Here's the poison, just toss it into the huge keg of rum they usually keep on the low level of the port, close to the auction house. [whispering] They fill the rum everyday 'n they've got thar share already, they will only be feelin' it tomorrow.
quest_40178_quest_progress: [urgent] Just go already, [gasp] this action makes me eyes water.
quest_40178_quest_complete: [solemn] What kind of monster am I to make ye sully such great rum, [sad] I hope one day I will be able to forgive meself.
quest_40179_quest_detail: [angry] So it seems these Blackwater fools sent some rat to keep track of our mates. He already asked someone to scuttle one of our new captains, although to be fair that orc was an idiot. [shouting] Blood fer blood! [commanding] I wants ye to go meet Morgan the Storm 'n spit in his face. Bring me his head. Ye can find him on the Eastern beach where most of me mates set anchor.
quest_40179_quest_complete: [solemn] The rat finally lays dead. [warm] Put that bag down fer now, I'll tell ye what ye gotta do next afore we get the deck all bloody.
quest_40180_quest_detail: [commanding] Here mate, put Morgan's head in this Jolly Roger. [whispering] Ye ain't about to like what ye're goin' to do next, but that shall only prove how insane 'n courageous ye be. [urgent] Ye're goin' to toss the head at the feet o' the Baron 'n the First Mate 'n make a damn run fer it! [soft voice] Ye're gonna find us on Jaguero Island, I hope ye make it thar alive, ye'd be a great asset to the crew. [warm] If ye do come, I will officially make ye a crewmate.
quest_40180_quest_progress: [excited] Shiver me timbers, ye actually made it. [hesitant] Were they mad?
quest_40180_quest_complete: [laughing] Haha idiots! [excited] Now they know what's gonna happen when they try to mess with us next, great job. [warm] And welcome aboard.
quest_40181_quest_detail: [commanding] Now that we've let 'em know who they be dealin' with it's also time to hit 'em when they'd less expect. [urgent] I hear thar be some fools that set anchor in to Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands. [commanding] I wants ye to scuttle 'em, all of 'em.
quest_40181_quest_progress: [low voice] Been a long road, eh?
quest_40181_quest_complete: [solemn] Their ship, the Harbinger, was sent fer some reason in Arathi Highlands. [soft voice] We dunno why, 'n we mighty don't care that much either. [urgent] All we care about right now be that they be dead, 'n we've landed once again a blow to the Blackwater Pirates.
quest_40182_quest_detail: [commanding] Now that we be done with the mongrels from Blackwater, we have time to focus on a different kind of enemy. [soft voice] I hear the South Sea Pirates anchored on the Isle of Lapidis, a mysterious island that be known to hide some sort o' booty from wha' me mates tell me. [hesitant] I say it's just fairy tales. [urgent] Go pick a fight with 'em, 'n here, take this. [warm] It's about time ye represent the Jolly Roger, tie this red bandana over yer wrist, ye're a Bloodsail after all.
quest_40182_quest_progress: Still as weak as they used to be?
quest_40182_quest_complete: [solemn] So they be thar after all. [warm] Good, some of me scallywags be trackin' behind ye to see if they can get any kind of information while ye be wreakin' havoc, 'n it seems we got what we needs.
quest_40183_quest_detail:
[commanding] Right, the information. [soft voice] Well ye see, I've been huntin' this First Mate since me early days of piracy, he took me eye and I want his head. [angry] He be a real pain in the gut, I tell ye.

[solemn] Once we were at sea through the vast cold areas close to Northrend. [urgent] The wind blew so harshly that when we was fighting at sea the ships eventually hit one another and we had to fight through the coldest rain I've ever had to witness. [sad] We've barely made it alive on rowboats to Eastern Kingdoms, only to meet again on land and swear to claim each other's head. [threatening] With ye here, a long grudge will be fulfilled.
quest_40183_quest_progress: Bah, as ugly as it used to be.
quest_40183_quest_complete: Aye, toss it on the floor over there, [excited] I'll be mountin' it on me wall in the room I sleep.
quest_40184_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's been so long, so long ago that we've decided to let go of our principles. [sad] So long ago we stopped to care for anyone but us. [low voice] We've given up on our lives in favor of the demons, we are nothing but shadows of memories from the past. [urgent] I can no longer do this, I can no longer wait.

I wish days would return when we, the Highborne, were the ones standing atop the Night Elves. [sad] All we are now are shadows of what we used to be, hunted by the ogres and demons that took residence in the lands we used to call Eldre'thalas.

[soft voice] Please, kill me, end my suffering. [sad] I want to go to my mother moon and join the afterlife that I've courted for so many years. [sad] Please, end my torment.
quest_40185_quest_detail:
[low voice] The cap'n of this fool ye're about to scuttle used to have a magical compass, or so they claim. It seems the compass would find whatever ye desire when ye'd open it up, which sounds like a madman gab.

[soft voice] Enter the lodgin' of the cap'n 'n see if ye can find this compass. I hear he keeps it locked in a chest. Some say the chest be black spotted, but that's definitely some squiffy excuse.
quest_40185_quest_progress: [soft voice] How goes the search fer legends 'n myths?
quest_40185_quest_complete:
[delight] I'll be damned, ye found something, eh? [excited] Looks like a damn normal compass to me.

<Garfield frowns.>

[warm] Whatever, we'll try it some other time.
quest_40186_quest_detail:
[commanding] Last thing ye're gonna do fer me with these fools be to set fire to thar ship. [mocking tone] Fun, ain't it?

[excited] Aye, I wants ye to light this torch on fire while ye're close to the cannons, 'n set fire to the blast powder. [urgent] Make sure t' get out o' thar as quickly as possible!
quest_40186_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good, somethin' else ye've dealt with. I be startin' to fear the thought of ye bein' me enemy, mate.
quest_40187_quest_detail: [soft voice] Mate, at this point, I can nah even argue wit' the fact that ye're a mighty resourceful individual. [warm] That bein' said, I be givin' ye yer own wee crew. [gentle] Ye won't have to do much other than live a free damn life 'n go search fer adventure, gold, rum 'n wenches. [solemn] It's been a fun run, 'n it's 'cause of ye that we be here. [commanding] Speak with me when ye're ready to claim yer new title 'n yer crew.
quest_40187_quest_progress: [low voice] It be no great honour mate, [mocking tone] this ain't a knight's ceremony.
quest_40192_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time in which the Kaldorei and the Furbolgs lived in harmony. They were our ally against the darkness, and worked with us to keep the balance in nature. We traded, we offered assistance to one another, and we even fought side by side.

[sad] That time has passed, and it seems that with each passing day more and more furbolg abandon their homes to join the larger tribes. [low voice] These large tribes of furbolg have collected to gather strength, and deem the outside world hostile entirely.

In the end, they have become nothing more than ruthless stalkers, murderers and agents of madness. [solemn] This change has only puzzled us druids, and has brought up more questions then answers. [soft voice] Hopefully today we can find some. [urgent] Across the water to the north are some of their camps, abandoned by their kind. I want you to search them, and try to find some clues as to what might potentially have corrupted them.
quest_40192_quest_progress: [soft voice] Remember to be careful, there may still be some lurking about, or even other potential dangers.
quest_40192_quest_complete:
<Faldan takes some time mulling over the items, his gaze somber and somewhat steeled> [solemn] . These items surely paint a rather dark picture. [soft voice] If the furbolg have been relying off the land, and the land itself has become tainted, it makes sense as to what has happened.

[pause] Their creations reflect upon their mind state, and in the past, when dealing with them, I have never come across any such ornaments or carved rocks. [solemn] I must prepare a letter to Darnassus, to be delivered with haste.
quest_40193_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a corruption lingering within the forest of Ashenvale, though I cannot pinpoint exactly where it is, or what is causing it. The signs of the furbolg being reduced to a state of madness boldens my thought, and hearing reports of what lurks within the forest to the east only haunts my mind.

If there is anything that can be done, it would be by way of Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus. He has led our people to a new beginning, and perhaps it will be him that will solve the corruption present here in Ashenvale.

I have prepared this letter for him. Please, deliver it with urgency, for all the beauty of Ashenvale could be at stake.
quest_40193_quest_progress:
[urgent] Yes, what is it?

[low voice] I am busy, you must have something for me.
quest_40193_quest_complete:
Faldan believes that I can assist in Ashenvale as far away as I am? The furbolg here have already begun to act in a similar manner, and there are much greater issues at stake then a tribe of savages out within the deep forests of Ashenvale.

[solemn] This is not an issue that I can help with at the moment, my hands are tied, and I have more important things to deal with. [low voice] When my current tasks are completed, I will begin to assist with the problems in Ashenvale.

[warm] Good day.
quest_40194_quest_detail:
[solemn] My people have a long and rich history upon this island, we once came from Stranglethorn, as part of the Gurubashi. [soft voice] But we looked for a new destiny when the wars started, it was here that we called home. [solemn] This island has been a place of refuge for our kind, and we have lived here in harmony with nature around us.

[sad] As of recently, my people have begun to betray their heritage, and their past. [low voice] They use a foreign magic from our brothers the Hazzuri, one that is of an evil source, and tainted to the core. [threatening] Instead of practicing the ways of the voodoo, they now are lost within the ways of shadow, mon.

[solemn] My people are not what they used to be, and attack any who dare go close, their very essence be tainted. [gentle] I ask of you to do me a favor friend, you need to go to Zul'Razar, it is located to the northwest on the isle. [urgent] Kill the trolls there, gather me their Tainted Mojo, perhaps I may find a source of how to help them.
quest_40194_quest_progress: [urgent] There be no time to waste! [commanding] Each second that we remain idle and speak with one another, is another second that their minds rot away to this foreign evil.
quest_40194_quest_complete:
[solemn] This Mojo doesn't look normal, it is dark, and thick, swirling with the seeds of evil deep within it. [solemn] The Hazzuri tribe did the same long ago, and abandoned this past for a new fate. [urgent] Now, they sent speakers and emmisaries to Zul'Razar in hopes to bring the Razzari into the fold.

[sad] I had thought our leaders better then to listen to the words of madmen, to buy wares from the peddlers of evil misdeeds.
quest_40195_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the Hazzuri's dark words they were able to convince the weak minds of the Razzari to take up their magic. [soft voice] Even now their speaker gives them speeches to warp their minds and change their ideals.

[low voice] I have discovered from the Mojo you have sent me of a dark taint that lingers within it, it would appear that the power my people have become to accept is that of a great power, and a much greater evil. [solemn] The Hazzuri know not what they peddle, nor what they preach, and will only bring the end of their kind, and my own.

[urgent] If there is to be a future for the Razzari, this must all come to an end, and the only end I can see, is by the death of those that accepted this darkness. [angry] They are nothing more then traitors for a promise of power.

[commanding] Go deep into Zul'Razar, strike hard at Speaker Ujuwa for spreading his lies, and Chief Imaz'ul for accepting them. [commanding] Bring me their skulls as proof of your deeds, let this chaos come to an end.
quest_40195_quest_progress: [solemn] Chief Imaz'ul is a coward for what he has done, [sad] the chief of our tribe is to hold strong, even in the face of tempting offers.
quest_40195_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, it is done then, you have braved Zul'Razar, and killed the leaders. The skulls will be a reminder to any who betray what we really are. [soft voice] I hold hope that my people can see reason, and deep down will know this had to be done for the best.

[hesitant] I must still find a way to reverse this Tainted Mojo, but until then, I thank you, your efforts have surely helped my people. [warm] Without you, who knows what would have happened to this island.
quest_40197_quest_detail:
[solemn] For many long years our neighbor was that of a furbolg, he has grown aged over the last few years but was extremely wise. [soft voice] Old Greypaw often kept to himself, and minded his own business, often venturing over for a night time talk if he so needed the company.

[hesitant] As of lately I fear for his mental health, the other furbolg of the forest have begun to act irrationally, and I fear Greypaw may be succumbing to a similar fate. [sad] He has not stopped by in months, and has kept to his home to the north.

[low voice] He has been aggresive to either me or Ardaen approaching and wishing to talk, but perhaps you may be able to speak with him, and ask if he is doing okay. [warm] It would certainly ease my mind to know an old friend is well.
quest_40197_quest_progress: [soft voice] He may act hostile, but I assure you, it is not within his nature, and deep down, he truly is a kind soul.
quest_40197_quest_complete:
[solemn] This a tragedy, for all of Ashenvale to have such a thing happen. The forest truly has lost a bright mind this day, withered away to a foul madness that lingers in the trees.

Do not feel bad, there was no averting this fate for Old Greypaw, he was a danger to both himself, and all who were near him. [soft voice] I pray for his spirit to transcend to Elune, and be watched for all eternity.

As much as I hate that it ended like this, I must still give you my thanks, for Greypaw was not himself, if he were around, he would have asked for such mercy to be released from his madness.
quest_40198_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you! I be needing a bit of work that is off the boat if you think you can be a hand. When we get moving all that people really got to do is either drink, or work to keep the ship clean and orderly. I've found it always good to keep a good reserve of ale on hand, and a good variety of it too!

[excited] What I'm gonna ask you to do is bring some ale from various sources, some of which might require you to have some friends, or connections with the opposite faction at that!

[commanding] First, I need a Barrel of Steamwheedle Wine, which can be found at the port, steal it. [urgent] Secondly I'll need common ale, 10 Flasks of Port. [commanding] Finally get me a Cask of Merlot from Stormwind at the Gallina Winery, and a jug of Orgrimmar Brown from the Tavern in Orgrimmar.
quest_40198_quest_progress: [low voice] If you want to be a real smuggler , let me tell you, you need connections, and those connections need to be trustworthy.
quest_40198_quest_complete:
[excited] All this variety, you know what they say, variety is the spice of life! [warm] When we make our next journey this will all surely keep everyone in good spirits.

[sad] Last time we ventured out, we barely had any ale left over, most of the barrels were destroyed, and let me tell you, Garfield would have my neck if anything like that ever happened again! [warm] Thanks for the hard work ye scurvy dog, take this money as a thanks.
quest_40201_quest_detail:
[solemn] I spent much time among the keepers on Stonetalon Peak. [soft voice] It was a time of tranquility, to find true balance of self and harmony with nature. [low voice] In my time there, I learned much of how best to wield the power of the land to conserve and protect nature. [hesitant] It is only when I began my work here within Teldrassil that my efforts began to falter, and there have been... complications.

[sad] It would appear the land itself holds some taint that I cannot grasp. [sad] I have struggled in my efforts to bend nature's will, straining myself more than ever before, and one of my Protectors has withered away and broken its bond with me.

[solemn] I would ask you to speak with Tasala Whitefeather, the one who once lead the harpies within the region, and ask her if she has news of the treant. [warm] Do not worry; she is free from the evil that grips her kind.

[urgent] You should find her just down the hill to the north. [commanding] Follow the road and you will see her near the cliff's edge.
quest_40202_quest_progress: [solemn] You are back. Do you bring word from Tasala of my treant's whereabouts?
quest_40202_quest_complete: [solemn] I see. So it is as I feared. [sad] Broken free of my control, gnarled and enraged, it has been twisted beyond recognition by the undercurrent of corruption that plagues Teldrassil.
quest_40203_quest_detail:
I fear there is no recourse but to destroy the treant lest it cause harm to our people or the creatures of Teldrassil. [solemn] From the information Tasala provided, we can safely assume that it will be patrolling the eastern banks of the Wellspring Lake.

[urgent] Seek the Distorted Treant out, give it a merciful end, and bring back a sample of its roots that I may better understand what possessed it. Exercise caution; a Protector is not likely to go without a fight.

[urgent] Go quickly now. [solemn] That treant may hold answers to what lies at the heart of nature's unrest here in Teldrassil.
quest_40203_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found my treant? [solemn] We cannot allow it to roam freely and wreak havoc in the forests.
quest_40203_quest_complete:
<Malos contemplates the roots you hand him with great concern.> [solemn] It would appear that the roots are decayed, suggesting the treant was already deceased by the time you found it. [sad] What a horrible fate for a protector of the forests... No, for any of nature's creatures. [hesitant] I cannot begin to fathom how this could have happened.

[solemn] This is a disturbing revelation indeed, and I am afraid that it has only created more questions. [low voice] My research continues without the breakthrough we had hoped for, it seems. [warm] Nonetheless, you have done a great service to the forests and myself.

[proud] Please take one of these items as a token of my gratitude.
quest_40204_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>. [solemn] High Sentinel Adaena Oakleaf has tasked me with scouting and recruiting capable adventurers to address some of the more concerning incidents here within Teldrassil. [soft voice] Those who are fit and willing I am to direct to her for further orders.

[warm] You will find the High Sentinel up this path atop the gates of Darnassus, watching over our borders.
quest_40204_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Have you come to aid in securing the Darnassus perimeter?

[solemn] That is good to hear. [urgent] We are in need of all the assistance available with my forces spread so thin. [solemn] Recent events have strained our resources, as we now defend not only Ashenvale and Darkshore, but must have details all across our homes here in Teldrassil.
quest_40205_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Gnarlpine tribe in Teldrassil has become a greater threat than I could ever have imagined. [sad] To think they were once our allies against all who would bring the forests harm.

[soft voice] Moon Priestess Amara patrols the roads between Darnassus and Dolanaar, keeping travelers safe and enlisting their aid in defending against the Gnarlpine attacking near the village. [hesitant] Alas, it seems these measures have not been sufficient in diminishing the Furbolgs' offensive capabilities.

[urgent] We must strike at the heart of the tribe if we are to curtail any attempts at mobilizing against Dolanaar and Shadowglen, a legitimate concern now with how bold they've become. [commanding] Travel to Gnarlpine Hold to the south and slay as many Avengers and Pathstalkers as you can.
quest_40205_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done, <name>? [solemn] We cannot afford to fail here, lest Darnassus itself be at risk.
quest_40205_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done a great service to the Kaldorei today, <name>. Though I weep for the fate of our former allies, sorrow cannot give way to weakness. Elune guided your hand in defending our people's lands, and for carrying out her will, you are to be rewarded.
quest_40206_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Swamps are ridden with insect, fungus, and predator. [soft voice] It is only a few of these that can be enjoyable in meals. [excited] Deep within the swamps are a special kind of mushroom, one that I have tinkered with in the past! [commanding] It can be used as a poison, though in small doses can add quite a lot to meals, or if prepared correctly, the ill-effects of its poison can be negated.

[solemn] Sorrowmoss Mushrooms can be found across the entirety of the swamp, most often beneath the heavy canopy of trees or along the snaking rivers, but not always. [urgent] Go out into the Swamp of Sorrows and collect me 10 Sorrowmoss Mushroom, [commanding] I wish to dabble more with the fungus.
quest_40206_quest_progress: [urgent] You must search the entirety of the swamp, [commanding] Sorrowmoss can grow almost anywhere!
quest_40206_quest_complete: Ahh, such fine specimens these are, [urgent] I will make haste at once to prepare it for the camp, and save some extra for my tinkering purposes. [warm] Thanks again for all of the work out there, I can imagine you got pestered by aggresive wildlife in your searching.
quest_40207_quest_detail:
[solemn] The deathstrike tarantulas are a formidable foe out within the swamps that lurk just southeast of Stonard. [soft voice] They can be found creeping about the swamps and laying traps for those they hunt.

[solemn] It is from these tarantulas that I ask you to gather their poison. [hesitant] I have been attempting to mix the tang of poison, once nullified, into food. [soft voice] In truth, I do have ulterior motives of attempting to make such recipes work. [confident] Perhaps one day I may be a renowned cook within Orgrimmar, and not stuck in the Swamp of Sorrows.

[urgent] Travel into the swamp, and collect me 5 Deathstrike Venom!
quest_40207_quest_progress: [solemn] Deathstrike Venom can be fatal if used improperly, [urgent] be careful in handling it!
quest_40207_quest_complete: [proud] Potent, extremely potent, it would appear that the deathstrike tarantulas have been growing more strong over the past months. [solemn] I will still attempt what I can, thank you again <name>, perhaps I can best such a venom one day.
quest_40208_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have long pondered the presence of the green dragonflight gathered about the temple sunken at the center of the lake. They have prowled and patrolled with adamant defence, and left us curious as to what may lay inside.

[soft voice] As much as such mysteries make my mind go wild with curiosity, I am not an adventurous soul as to find out why they are guarding it. [confident] I have been working with magical goods for most of my life, and have been dying to get my hands on a Glittering Green Scale. One that has been enfused by the power of Ysera and charged by her will. [hesitant] I must admit, it may be hard to come across one.

[urgent] Travel to the Pool of Tears, and hunt Green Dragonkin, look upon their corpses for a single Glittering Green Scale, entwined with powerful magic, and bring it to me.
quest_40208_quest_progress: [solemn] The power of the Green Dragonflight is not something to be underestimated, [urgent] be careful in getting that scale!
quest_40208_quest_complete: [solemn] Such a rarity this is, many in Orgrimmar wouldn't even have the opportunity to have something as powerful as this could potentially be! [warm] I must thank you, and thank you again, I will make good use of this.
quest_40209_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many long months I have spent in this hellscape hunting for a large jaguar. [sad] I have given it the nickname Sorrowclaw, for its ferocity and where it comes from. [angry] I have attempted to catch it, fight it, and even stalk Sorrowclaw, but every time I have been outsmarted.

[low voice] It is as if the beast is three steps ahead of me at all times and I long to see its terror within the swamp come to an end. [soft voice] Perhaps you are a better hunter then me, and perhaps you can track down Sorrowclaw, and slay the beast once and for all.

[commanding] I assure you, it will not be an easy task, and I recommend you bring help should you truly wish to take after where I have failed.
quest_40209_quest_progress: [solemn] Sorrowclaw is a dangerous beast, be careful within the swamp.
quest_40209_quest_complete:
[solemn] I never imagined the day would come so soon, Sorrowclaw always was able to elude my efforts.

[proud] You are a much greater then myself, please, [warm] be rewarded for your glory of defeating such a beast!
quest_40210_quest_detail:
[solemn] I did not always call this place home, in fact I come from far away lands, and have only recently settled here. [soft voice] I have many tales to tell and should you wish to truly serve me, you will need to listen to my tale and understand why I do what I do.

[commanding] So, mortal, are you ready for what is presented before you, [emphasis] will you step into the abyss?
quest_40210_quest_progress: [soft voice] Open your mind, and listen, wisdom can be found anywhere.
quest_40210_quest_complete: [solemn] So, now you know what is at stake, and you will help me retake these islands, if not for your own selfish whims of 'virtue' to stop some evil.
quest_40211_quest_detail:
Felwood.

[solemn] A place I recall with a bitter hatred that makes my face cowl in disgust. [sad] It is within this place I had first decided to travel upon leaving my kin. [soft voice] My reasons for being in such a place was for the betterment of Azeroth, and I only found deceit, malice, and corruption.

<Insom'ni would snort inward, his face warped with a bitter, deep anger> . [pause] We will start here, travel to the twisted forest, and hunt the foul beings known as the 'satyr' , more specifically, the Jadefire. [commanding] I will need from them 5 Jadefire Felhorn , as well as 5 Purple Lotus that can be gathered by any skilled herbalist upon this world.
quest_40211_quest_progress: [urgent] There is much work to do, and little time, [commanding] get out there and do my bidding.
quest_40211_quest_complete:
[solemn] We move forward, as much as the satyr are nothing more than worthless agents of a fading order. [angry] They still had this coming, and much more should I ever have the agency to torment them.

[confident] With these horns and lotus I can begin to channel energy to locate this dark source with my own magics. [urgent] Until then, there is much more to do before we can unveil the source of the evil that taints the islands.
quest_40212_quest_detail:
[solemn] My channeling will take some time to uncover the source of what lurks beneath the surface. In the mean time, I would ask of you a favor that means more then these very islands. [soft voice] An old friend of mine, who goes by the name Itharius is currently located within the Swamp of Sorrows. He was originally sent with Eranikus in tasks regarding the sunken temple, and watching over its masters destruction.

[pause] Upon my exile, I gave Itharius my necklace, one that holds much of my power, and essence. It is from this very necklace that I will need the energy needed to defeat the evil upon these islands.

[confident] I told him a time would come where I would reclaim my birthright, and he may be aprehensive, but he will do as I asked him long ago. [urgent] Find Itharius, and reclaim my necklace from those swamps.
quest_40212_quest_progress: [urgent] Travel, and with haste. [solemn] There is much to do, and little time to do it, mortal.
quest_40212_quest_complete: [hesitant] Who did you say you were sent by again?
quest_40213_quest_detail:
[solemn] This necklace has made me regain much of my former strength. [soft voice] If you were paying attention during your trip then you would have uncovered my true identity. [solemn] Now you know truely who I am, and we will work toward my final goal.

[low voice] I was able to channel my energies and locate the source of corruption. [commanding] While we could very well confront, and summon it to us with the powers of my necklace, I would first take revenge upon those that tossed aside their worship of me.

[cold] Zul'Hazu was once a place I called home, it was there the trolls called me a deity. [threatening] They practiced my magics, and would follow me to the ends of the world.

[urgent] Travel to Zul'Hazu in the north-west, slay the leaders Darkmaster Haza'gi, Champion Raggazi, and Chieftain Woh'zo. [cold] The people should suffer as well, get from them 10 Hazzuri Charms, they will be nice decorations.
quest_40213_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you dealt with those rebellious insects yet?
quest_40213_quest_complete: [solemn] Zul'Hazu was a breeding ground for the corrupt, and the defiled. [sad] They swept aside my magic and my teachings for a chance to indulge in greater powers. [angry] They are nothing but harlots to the highest bidder, and it is retribution to dispense justice upon them.
quest_40214_quest_detail:
With the Hazzuri slain, my heart burns with glee, retribution is such a fine wine, and one I would eagerly drink down again. [solemn] It is time for the final task, we must drag free the shadow that has rooted itself upon the islands, and destroy it.

[confident] When this is done, I can begin to rebuild my throne on these islands. The time is at hand. [commanding] Follow me to the center of the island, and await my summoning to be complete. When it is, you must do battle with this evil as I keep it bound to the island. Only when it is weak enough, will I be able to join you.

[urgent] I suggest you bring friends, or others that may assist you. [threatening] This should not be taken lightly, so do not fail me.
quest_40214_quest_complete:
[commanding] You have done well mortal, your help here, I must admit, has been insturmental. [solemn] You have earned a place upon these islands as long as you desire to be here. [cold] As long as you understand that my rule here is now concrete.

[warm] As a token of my appreciation to enact revenge, and give me back my rightful throne, you are to be rewarded, as one should for noble deeds. [soft voice] May you find use for the treasure I offer, and may you prosper on whatever path you choose.
quest_40216_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy there, don't suppose you're looking to help out a goblin who has a deep need for revenge huh?

[soft voice] You see, I used to help out the Venture Co. back in my hayday, and honestly, it was a big mistake. [low voice] They offered me the deal of a lifetime for my friendship, to supply them with some metal under the table for big profit.

[sigh] Now, I think its in a goblins blood to follow the smell of gold, but I was robbed, and hoodwinked.

[angry] I put my butt on the line for those guys, and they up and haven't even contacted me since, I want you to give them a message, no one screws with Shizwackle and lives to tell about it.

[urgent] I do have a reputation to keep if I ever want to survive out here after all. [commanding] Head up to The Sludge Fen far to the north, kill their Drudgers and Mercenaries, its with my metal they started this refinery there, maybe when they have less workers they will pay attention.
quest_40216_quest_progress: [angry] They deserve every licking they get, [threatening] don't up and go soft on me!
quest_40216_quest_complete:
[excited] Revenge, such a sweet thing, perhaps now, people will know not to step all over Shizwackle!

[warm] I've learned a valueable lesson thanks to you pal, not to just trust every old sap with a bundle of gold offering riches.

[proud] Take this coin for the trouble, I actually pay people for work!
quest_40220_quest_detail: [solemn] Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. [soft voice] I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Morpheus Ribcage. [pause] I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
quest_40220_quest_progress:
[solemn] You must know why I sent for you, <name>. [soft voice] Seeing a fallen marksman rise again is such a rare glimmer of hope in this accursed land. [low voice] Lady Sylvanas will no doubt be pleased that she may one day soon have ranks of ranger under her command again.

[commanding] I will see to it that you are molded into a proper vessel for fulfilling that dream. [urgent] Embrace now your destiny as a Dark Ranger.
quest_40220_quest_complete:
You carry that weapon well, but it is not enough to be an adequate marksman. [solemn] The Dark Lady, Sylvanas Windrunner, freed you from the shackles that bound you to the will of the Lich King. [commanding] You will return her gracious gift by giving of yourself for her cause.

[threatening] If you cannot commit, I will see to it personally you are buried again in the hole you crawled out of. [urgent] I will train you to be one of the many arrows that strike the hearts of her foes.

[commanding] Come to me often, that I may teach you new skills. [cold] I will be watching you carefully and gauging your growth here in Deathknell.
quest_40221_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tales of your victories against the scourge raise the spirits of the downtrodden and give hope for a better tomorrow.

But for all your efforts, our enemies yet shamble in the dark and cast a pall over the land. [urgent] The long night is yet to be over.

We mustn't relent!

[commanding] By the Light, we must keep on, and bring salvation to those the Scourge would seek to harm. [confident] Prove that your mettle remains as sharp as steel.

Bring me an Argent Dawn Valor Token, and in exchange, I will grant you a boon to aid in your battles against the undead.
quest_40222_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey there, we don't get many visitors back here, I suppose you're looking for work then. [commanding] I got a shipment I am expecting that should have arrived today, think you can pick it up? [whispering] Let's just say, I'm not supposed to be seen around the docks to certain people.

[urgent] It might not have my name on it, but it should be labeled as 'Refined Gem Shipment'. [commanding] Try not to ask any questions while you're down there either, just grab the crate and come back. [confident] If you look like you know what you're looking for, and have confidence, they wont ask any questions.

[warm] You get me the crate, and I'll have more work for you.
quest_40222_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck? I can't be waiting around all day.
quest_40222_quest_complete: [laughing] Yeah, this is it, those pesky rats think they could stop me? Hah! [excited] Good work pal, you certainly got some gumption.
quest_40223_quest_detail:
[soft voice] In the shady, hidden corners of Azeroth there is always a deal going on, you may not see it, but it's there. [whispering] I got word of a deal going down on Thoradin's Wall that I want you to go and steal. The contract itself is that of a dear rival of mine, and if I can do anything to interrupt his business and make a profit, well I'm just smiling ear to ear.

[low voice] You can find Thoradin's wall between Hillsbrad and the Arathi Highlands, it is what separates the two. [solemn] Supposedly some ancient wall built by Stromgarde, or something of that nature.

[urgent] The ramp should be on the Hillsbrad side of the wall, near the southern end, I do know they hired some Syndicate goons to watch the ramp, but they should be no problem for you. [commanding] The main muscle will be an ogre namen Thoregg who guards the packages there, him you should be careful of.

[confident] Get the shipment, bring it back to me, easy yeah? [whispering] Oh, and no matter what, don't open the crate.
quest_40223_quest_progress: [hesitant] If you don't go looking around, you wont find a thing.
quest_40223_quest_complete: [excited] My my, see, I told you, there are always deals being made! [delight] Profits to be made, always of course, especially if you know how to come between it, heh! [warm] Here, take this coin, if you're interested in more work, I got it.
quest_40224_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Good work as always, I think I can count on you to make a shipment. [whispering] This is supposed to be under the rug, so I don't want anyone knowing that I sent you or that he was even getting anything, got it?!

[low voice] A buddy of mine Yig Oilfuse recently departed from the Venture Co. after some not so great terms, we met a long time ago, he was quite the smuggler. [pause] Anyway - I need this crate delivered to him, it contains some of the spoils you plundered, as a thanks for the info, as well as what he requested.

[commanding] So pal, its that simple, go and talk to him, give him this here crate. [urgent] You'll find him in Ratchet, up the road from the town a bit, him and some friend share a place there with metalworking or something. [urgent voice] Catch the boat from the dock here in Booty Bay.
quest_40224_quest_progress: Howdy, [excited] what can I do for you?
quest_40224_quest_complete: [laughing] Let me guess, 'Slip', huh? [mocking tone] He always wanted to get the crew back together after we parted ways. I figured he'd just slink away to some part of the world and live it out on the gold he made!
quest_40225_quest_detail:
[solemn] As much as I appreciate this delivery I know what it means. [low voice] I made a promise long ago to uphold an end of the bargain. I desired him to pillage the areas I gave him in return for some goods and information.

He is looking for the killer of Jade, the one who broke up our old crew some time ago, and now that he has fulfilled his end, I will do the same, [defiant] I aint no rat, I keep my bond.

The person who organized the hit to break us up went by the name Wally Wisecrack, he now hangs out with those Syndicate Boys, though I am sure 'Slip' knows that. [urgent] Once you tell 'Slip' this is the person who was behind it all, he will no doubt want revenge.
quest_40225_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, he did uphold his end of the bargain... [angry] Wally Wisecrack huh, that two faced piece of rat filth!

[commanding] I am going to get my revenge, and you're going to be the weapon I unleash upon this miserable prick.
quest_40226_quest_detail:
[solemn] This man continued to deal and swindle with me even after he brought down my crew, we spoke face to face many times. He killed Jade and took her from my life, we could have conquered the world our crew. I may not live in a palace on Tel'abim, but I will still get the sweet justice that I have been longing for.

[cold] Wally Wisecrack is a goon of a human, who resides within Strahnbrad and was closely assosciated with those Syndicate fellows. Yeah the traitorous ones that sold their souls to the orcs, it seems its just in their blood, huh?

[urgent] Find him in Strahnbrad, kill him, and bring me his Large Looped Earring as proof.
quest_40226_quest_progress: [whispering] He is a dastardly fellow, [urgent] don't let him know you're coming, or you'll never find him.
quest_40226_quest_complete:
[solemn] It's done then, and good, the spirits of those that were lost because of this cold hearted goon may find peace in whatever grave they found themselves in. [warm] I can't thank you again for all the help, and for reconnecting me with some old crew across the world.

[proud] Take one of these items, as a token of my gratitude.
quest_40227_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Welcome to Stonetalon Peak, a place of harmony with nature, Keeper Albagorm has done well in maintaining the region despite setbacks. [solemn] I have been working tirelessly for sometime in maintaining the wildlife around here, and I have been having some issues.

[hesitant] The Twilight Runners of the Peak have been growing more hostile with time, and I fear they may out hunt some of the other wildlife present here. [urgent] I require from them a single Pristine Twilight Fang, which will be used to conduct research to find any sort of genetic problem, disease, or corruption that may be gripping the population.

[commanding] You can find them about Stonetalon Peak, be quick.
quest_40227_quest_progress: [urgent] The Twilight Runners can be aggresive, so keep your wits about you.
quest_40227_quest_complete: [soft voice] Interesting, there may be something developing between the Twilight Runners that has made them more aggresive, but it could also be due to the overpopulation and need for food, thanks again. [warm] This has dispelled some worry for me with all of the nightmares I hear about back in Teldrassil.
quest_40228_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dark Iron Dwarves have been a long standing rival of ours, their attacks against our people have been ruthless. [urgent] I have come to attempt to bolster our strength in the region, and if we want that to be possible, then we must set our sights on Angor Fortress.

[commanding] The place is run by Captain Barlgruf, he has been sent from Shadowforge City to oversee actions here within the Badlands, cut him down, and the rest of them will be aimless. [low voice] He should be inside Angor Fortress, no doubt nestled with the rest of his lackeys.

[angry] Kill him, and return to me.
quest_40228_quest_progress: [solemn] If there is to ever be peace, then we must act with swiftness.
quest_40228_quest_complete:
[excited] Great work, Ironforge would be proud of the actions you have done this day, [warm] please, take these coins, as a token of our gratitude.

[proud] Perhaps one day we may resume our work here on a more larger scale!
quest_40229_quest_detail:
[solemn] Angor Fortress looms like a dark cloud in the Badlands, from there the Dark Iron can muster immense amounts of power. [solemn] They are one of the key players in the region for that very reason.

[soft voice] I have been sent from Ironforge to attempt to dissolve some of their grip here, and to do so, we will need to strike hard. [commanding] I desire you to travel to Angor Fortress just to the north west, and slay those that guard it. [urgent] Take from them their Shadowforge Shackles they wear, 10 of them in total, and bring them to me.
quest_40229_quest_progress: [low voice] They are incredibly stubborn, and will not give up without a fight.
quest_40229_quest_complete:
[excited] Great work, Ironforge would be proud of the actions you have done this day, [warm] please, take these coins, as a token of our gratitude.

[proud] Perhaps one day we may ressume our work here on a more larger scale!
quest_40230_quest_detail:
Lake Falathim was a place I spent much of my youth, a place of relaxation and fond memories. [sad] Now, it is overrun by the Saltspittle murlocs, who attacked with ferocity and without remorse. Some died during the attack, but I was lucky enough to escape.

[hesitant] In my haste to flee, I left behind an item of extreme value to me: a book left to me by my uncle who died during the Battle of Hyjal. [solemn] In it he wrote about his technique in battle and his experiences regarding the war. [soft voice] I've found much knowledge and wisdom from that book, and I desire to know everything that he had jotted down before his passing.$ [urgent] Travel to Lake Falathim to the southwest, and find my belongings. [commanding] While you are there, I ask that you avenge my kin: Slay the Saltspittle and bring me their fins.
quest_40230_quest_progress: [solemn] That place is crawling with murloc, [urgent] I would advise you steel yourself for what must be done.
quest_40230_quest_complete: [soft voice] That book meant quite a lot to me, [pause] I never thought I would see it again, [warm] thank you.
quest_40231_quest_detail:
[solemn] This tome holds a great history to the nation of Stormwind, and should be stored as such. [soft voice] A holy warrior fell on this battlefield many years ago, and this tome remains intact. [solemn] The tomes words are holy scripture, and I would ask it be placed amongst the Cathedral's great books.

[commanding] I ask of you to travel to Stormwind, and speak with Archbishop Benedictus, to see if he would take this book within the Cathedral to be preserved. [soft voice] My mentor would ask this of me, I am certain, let us do our duty.
quest_40231_quest_progress: [soft voice] How may I assist you?
quest_40231_quest_complete: [solemn] Watch Paladin Janathos sent you, well I know the man well. [soft voice] He spoke with me before his departure out to Sorrowguard. [pause] It is good to hear that he is alive. [warm] If he desires me to keep this book within the Cathedral I will do as such, perhaps the words written inside will benefit those of the faith.
quest_40232_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the tome in my charge I would ask of you to bring a scroll to Watch Paladin Janathos in Sorrowguard Keep. From this scroll I hope to bless him and those underneath his command, for the light to watch over them safely, and deliver them from evil.

[soft voice] When you see him, be sure to mention I wish him well.
quest_40232_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, then it is done? The Archbishop has always been a friend of mine, his convictions and word in the light has always been true.

[soft voice] This scroll will continue to guide our actions here, and keep us safe within Sorrowguard.
quest_40233_quest_detail:
[solemn] I would ask one last thing from you, [sad] my mentor came from Lordaeron, a kingdom far to the north that is now desecrated and torn beyond imagining. [soft voice] It is filled with the undead that roam freely upon the broken landscape.

[solemn] Within this land is an order known as the Scarlet Crusade, remnants of an old paladin order. [angry] They are fanatical, and heartless to the core, [commanding] it is from them I require something.

[solemn] Within the Scarlet Monastery, in northern Tirisfal Glades is a mighty Cathedral, it was built well before these zealots time, and it is there my mentor studied the light.

[solemn] I would ask that you bring to me the Orb of Kaladus, a stone enfused with the power of the light. [sad] Ever since my mentor departed from Lordaeron, those holy brigands have kept it to themselves.

[urgent] Enter the Cathedral, and bring it to me, [solemn] the light should be wielded by the true of heart, not the black of soul.
quest_40233_quest_progress: [solemn] The Orb of Kaladus holds great power in the light. [low voice] My mentors artifact should not be wielded by zealots.
quest_40233_quest_complete:
<A smile would crest across Janathos' face as he looks upon the orb> [solemn] . My mentor would be proud of us to recover such an item. [warm] You truly are blessed of the light for your services here in this dark corner of Azeroth.

[gentle] Please, take this as a token of my appreciation, and walk with swiftness upon this earth, as blessed by the light.
quest_40234_quest_detail:
[solemn] Omarion left behind plenty of work and research on various topics, one of which I have taken quite an interest within! [excited] Runeblades, Rune Armor, such fascinating things, imbued and powered directly by Dreadlords. I heard that Baron Rivendare fellow had one, but I am seeking the knowledge of imbuing a freshly created blade, and tempering it with great power! [urgent] If we could unlock such secrets then certainly it would be a new frontier of all sorts of magical crafting!

[warm] If you can figure out a way to create your own Untempered Runeblade I would be more then willing to share my knowledge!
quest_40234_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck? [urgent] I would suggest you focus your attention towards the Dreadlords.
quest_40234_quest_complete:
[excited] Would ye look at that! [warm] You actually managed to get your hands on one, its not like every day I go asking for someone to produce a rare weapon, and expect them to bring it to me. [proud] This is rare <name>, very rare, its not every day someone gets there hands on an Untempered Runeblade.

[solemn] I made a promise that I would share my knowledge, and I will, perhaps we can temper the blade!
quest_40235_quest_detail:
[solemn] I Wilhelm, am a dwarf of my word, and I will keep my word to unveil this new frontier ahead of us. [urgent] The first place we should begin to look is Corin's Crossing, it is a place over-run by the scourge, and not somewhere I would travel!

[soft voice] A book named 'The Secrets of Darkforging' may be the first step to uncovering what we seek, it is held by a Jacob Malwright. [low voice] He was a rather famed smith in his days amongst the living and now walks among the dead. [commanding] No doubt he still has it on him, or keeps it close by, kill him, bring me the book, let us begin to learn their tricks!
quest_40235_quest_progress: [urgent] I would make sure to look over both shoulders while you are there, and bring some holy water, [solemn] the place is cursed I tell ye!
quest_40235_quest_complete: [hesitant] I shudder to imagine traveling that deep into Corin's Crossing for a book- one that might not even have what we're looking for. [warm] You did good work either way, now, lets see if this book holds any knowledge that we can use!
quest_40236_quest_detail:
<Craftsman Wilhelm would take his time reading through the book, intrigue marks his features, and interest sparks his eyes> [soft voice] .

This book holds a lot of information, most of it doesn't seem to even relate to what we are doing, I mean, why would we even want Dark Binding Shackles in the first place?!

[angry] There are a few sections that may relate though, one of which is tainted, and twisted by a dark magic, making it unintelligable and frankly, unnerving. The other section seems to be written by a Dreadlord named Lorthiras, who could be of some use.

[urgent] I would first like to uncover the dark magic, and I believe I know someone who may be of help! [sigh] Strahad Farsan used to be a friend of mine - we're not on the best terms, but he is quite deeply involved with shadowy magic, and demons both.

[commanding] He is located in Ratchet, go and find him there, bring him the book.
quest_40236_quest_progress: [solemn] Yes, are you here to learn the deeper secrets of Arcana?
quest_40236_quest_complete: <Farsan's brow twitches upon hearing the name 'Wilhelm'> [low voice] . Him huh? [hesitant] Didn't he sign up to go and join those Argent fellows?
quest_40237_quest_detail:
[solemn] What you are dealing with here is quite interesting, this book seems to mention quite a lot of patterns all pertaining to Darkforging, of which you will gain very little use. [soft voice] The armor, and weapons the undead use are quite deeply entwined with the very magic that keeps their minions standing.

[commanding] If you desire my help, then I would also desire yours, I can uncover what this text reads, and point you and Wilhelm in the correct direction, but this would require a favor.

[urgent] Travel to Scholomance, and venture deep within. [solemn] Inside I am looking for an old book that was archived there some time ago, titled 'Fire Beckoning and Command'.

[warm] Bring me this book, and I shall do as you have asked.
quest_40237_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you procured what I have asked?
quest_40237_quest_complete: <Upon seeing the book, Farsan would smirk from ear to ear> [commanding voice] . Excellent, as I have said, a favor for a favor then.
quest_40238_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were gone collecting what I asked I took the time to decipher the incoherent text. [soft voice] It was written by a Dreadlord named Lorthiras and contained some insights into the secrets of Rune crafting.

[pause] Now, in truth, there is not much to be gained from the text, [hesitant] to be able to temper a Runeblade, one would need to possess the powers that Dreadlords would, and such knowledge is very rarely given out.

[emphasis] Within the text were mentions of a place that Lorthirus spent much of his time studying in his magic and if you wish to have a chance at tempering the Runeblade then you must seek him out.

[solemn] I feel like I can not be of further assistance, but I have jotted down the text onto a script for your reading, perhaps you can make more sense of it then me.
quest_40240_quest_progress: [excited] Welcome back friend! [soft voice] What have you learned, was my friend of much help to you?
quest_40240_quest_complete: [solemn] I must say, with how long you have been gone, I figured you were lost to the madness of some terrible curse! [laughing] Hah! [exhale] Phew, what a relief that is, knowing that you're still alive, so, I take it you learned something valueable?
quest_40241_quest_detail:
[excited] I must say, I am almost in shock of what you say! [warm] If that is true then, well we are given a very rare opportunity! [solemn] The very acts of tempering a Runeblade may, in itself reveal prospects of how it is done!

[proud] I must say, already I have learned quite a bit, just from the book you found, and the story of this Dreadlord.

[urgent] We are closing in on finishing our adventure friend, we will need materials in order to ready you for this process! [commanding] You will need 20 Dark Runes, 5 Enchanted Leather, 40 Thorium Bars, and 10 Essence of Undeath.

Bring me these items, and we can begin the tempering!
quest_40241_quest_progress: It will be a lengthy process to require so many materials, but they will be required for the tempering process!
quest_40241_quest_complete: [solemn] This is all that is required, [warm] well done <name>! [excited] Now, I can direct you to where it must be done, [urgent] once you temper the blade, it will be bound to you and you alone!
quest_40242_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy, and welcome to Flaxwhisker Front newcomer! [soft voice] I am Genzil Spannerlight, in charge of starting new projects and archiving the success and failure of old ones.

[pause] I have a new idea that may potentially work, a charged shell to act as either a shield, or barrier to be both protective, and resistant to magic! [warm] Of course, we will need some shells first, and we don't have a bunch of metal to waste, but there are turtles around!

[urgent] Go out, and gather me 3 Pristine Lurker Shells!
quest_40242_quest_progress: [urgent] We need more methods to shield our projects, have you had any luck?
quest_40242_quest_complete: [excited] Why look at these beauties! [warm] These shells could certainly be used for all sorts of things, thanks again, no wonder Gigno saw good things in you!
quest_40243_quest_detail:
[solemn] For thousands of years I have kept my watch over this place. [soft voice] I have seen the world change around me, and most of the old city be swept beneath the waves. [low voice] The magic that once ran through this place has been dampened and is almost non-existent.

[pause] With the rising waters my studies have been increasingly difficult. [urgent] To keep watch over this tower is to protect it, and with the growing threat of the invasive ocean species my time has been more toward survival than study.

[commanding] I ask for assistance in this matter. [commanding] Slay the murloc, the hydra and the crab beasts around the area to preserve this tower if even for a moment longer.
quest_40243_quest_progress: [solemn] Have the invasive species been dealt with?
quest_40243_quest_complete: [soft voice] I can breathe a sigh of relief. At one time I could walk the entirety of the beach, I could journey through the buried ruins of the old city, now submerged beneath the waves, but now, I am confined to this very tower. [solemn] Perhaps one day I will be free to journey again.
quest_40244_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many months ago, an object of great importance was lost to me. [soft voice] I was fishing along the coastline and studying the patterns of magic behind the tower, a storm had begun to set in, and was getting quite intense. [urgent] As I packed my belongings and prepared to leave I was ambushed by both murloc and thrasher alike, in the chaos a chest was swept out into the sea.

[sad] I may have defeated my foes but I could not find the chest, I could only assume it was washed ashore in the heavy storm. [commanding] Check along the north eastern shore, it was where the current would take it, try and recover this chest.
quest_40244_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you recovered my valueable items?
quest_40244_quest_complete: [solemn] The Eldara Relay-Orb is one of its kind, and incredibly rare, without this my ability to study, and communicate with the last Keeper's of Azshara were both tampered. [warm] I cannot thank you enough for finding it.
quest_40245_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have communed with those closest to me once again, and I am thankful they are safe. [soft voice] More work needs to be done, and hopefully you can be of assistance to me. The Eldarath Harmonization Gem was stolen a long time ago, a band of Naga Raiders led by one named Najhaz. [low voice] He was able to break my seal upon the tower door and take the Harmonization Gem before I could return to stop him.

[solemn] If we Keepers of Azshara are ever meant to travel long distances within the area, this Gem will need to be returned. [commanding] No doubt that Najhaz the Raider will be among his kin along the shore to the west, kill him, and reclaim the Harmonization Gem for me.
quest_40245_quest_progress: [solemn] When the Gem is returned, then we can begin construction of a staff.
quest_40245_quest_complete: [solemn] After many long years, it is returned. [soft voice] This Harmonization Gem was worthless within the hands of those naga, for they deal with magic they will never understand. [warm] You have done a great favor for us Keepers.
quest_40246_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Harmonization Gem is something I had figured I would never retrieve, and now with it, we can begin to make a staff that can transport you to the others. [soft voice] I have lost full communication with them for some time, and even relaying messages, well, is a long process.

[urgent] The Satyrs of Legash are a recent arrival, and they hold some magical ability. [commanding] They have been known to carry Aged Deep-Rods, of which I will need one, being I do not have the materials readily available to enchant or imbue a staff for our purposes.

[emphasis] You can find those demons to the north west, find from them an Aged Deep-Rod, one of them must carry one.
quest_40246_quest_progress: [solemn] Walk with caution, the Satyr are lackies of a much greater power.
quest_40246_quest_complete:
[solemn] Good work in finding one, I was beginning to have my doubts. The power the Satyr wield in such a rod is but a fraction of the power we used to have in our glory. [soft voice] The Ley-lines flowed with a power unimaginable, it was so strong that even now, after so much time has past, the energy still lingers.

[pause] As dampened as it is now, it still holds power we must preserve, and keep secret.
quest_40247_quest_detail: [solemn] With the Eldarath Harmonization Gem, and the Aged Deep-Rod I can begin to construct a Staff of Eldara, it will take some channeling of my energy, and the tower to attune it with the region. [soft voice] I simply ask for your patience as I bind the two together.
quest_40247_quest_complete: [solemn] Another chapter begins, the Keepers of Azshara may not fade into memory this early.
quest_40248_quest_detail:
[solemn] You and I were once citizens of Lordaeron, <name>. [soft voice] We are no strangers to the forests, and likewise, to the wolves that lurked in the shadow of night. [sad] Terrified of their wailing howls.

[low voice] Yet now, even they have succumb to the corruption of the Scourge plague, faring no better than we. [commanding] As you can see, Blackpaw here is my loyal pet that I keep ever by my side, a darkhound I tamed by no special skill. [commanding] The Forsaken need only sheer force of will to dominate.

[urgent] You will find that the creatures of this land vary in how they respond to our... condition. [soft voice] While there are those who think nothing of the smell of death, some may seek to make a meal of a carcass like yours. [solemn] For this reason, I have made special preparations for our Forsaken kin who seek a beast of their own.

[commanding] I do not impart this gift lightly, <name>. [commanding] Show me you can dominate wild beasts without it, first. [commanding] Go, return with a Decrepit Darkhound.
quest_40248_quest_progress: [low voice] Do not waste my time. [cold] The Dark Lady has no need of the weak, [cold] nor do I for that matter.
quest_40248_quest_complete:
[solemn] Most excellent. I can see this darkhound is eager to sink its fangs into the Scourge and gnaw on their bones.

[cold] You have performed... adequately.
quest_40249_quest_detail:
[solemn] The darkhound was but the first of your trials, hardly an appropriate test of your will. Nonetheless, you have earned some respect. [commanding] The next beast you will subdue will not be so easily won over.

[soft voice] The duskbats of Tirisfal are large, gruesome beasts who were drawn here by the stench of death all around. [emphasis] They are capable of growing large enough to be used for transportation akin to the gryphons of the dwarves of Khaz Modan. [solemn] Their screech can bring agony even to the undead, making them formidable foes.

[urgent] This also makes them ideal allies. [solemn] Every beast in this world has adapted its own unique means of fighting and defending itself. [commanding] Fight beside them, learn from them, never hesitate to adapt so long as your mind still reigns over your diseased body. [solemn] The beasts, too, will learn from you and adapt.

[hesitant] Still, accepting such unnatural abberations as us may prove more difficult. [commanding] Find a Greater Duskbat, exert your will, and bring it to me.
quest_40249_quest_progress: [low voice] Being undead does not make you a cripple. [commanding] My expectations of you are no lower than if you were still alive.
quest_40249_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This creature flies around you with a spirit of ease. [pause] It would seem that you have earned its trust.

[warm] You are improving.
quest_40250_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you can see, hardly a living creature remains in these forsaken lands. [pause] Such as it is, your next task is to bring under your sway another victim of the Scourge plague. [soft voice] An undead pet is not so easily conquered, however.

Lordaeron once saw brown bears migrate from Silverpine in the summer, hiding in our forests and scavenging the farmer's crops. [sad] Those that remained during the plague are now here forever. [pause] Having broken the cycle of life and death like yourself, they are lost, confused, resentful.

[solemn] As your skill grows, so too does that of your beasts. [urgent] Yet for a creature no longer of the living, it will take great patience and dedication to reach deep into their wayward minds and find that lingering spark of intellect. [solemn] Only then can you train it.

The bear is a strong companion who will stand between you and harm, ferociously keeping your foes at bay that you may shoot them where they stand. [commanding] Find a Plagued Bear, awaken its mind, and bring it to me.
quest_40250_quest_progress: [solemn] Time and dedication this path takes. [soft voice] As your luck would have it, I have begun to see you possess both.
quest_40250_quest_complete:
[solemn] This beast no longer feels lost, your strength of will earning its trust and coaxing from it once suppressed emotions. [warm] Though we dominate, we are not incapable of affection for our new companions.

[soft voice] Never forget that each beast has its own story. [urgent] Your actions will bring to them salvation... or destruction.
quest_40251_quest_detail:
[solemn] Insom'ni? Is that what he goes by now? I sensed a purpose within your mind as you approached me, and I wondered why it seemed so familiar. [soft voice] This necklace belongs to one named Insomnius, and no matter what he goes by he should remember the reasons of why he was exiled.

[hesitant] Regardless, I promised that I would keep my word. [urgent] Take this necklace to him, and tell him to not contact me again, for any reasoning. I say this with caution traveler, Insomnius was exiled from our kind for having ambitions that were beyond our tasks, and for dabbling in matters that were not his to interfere.
quest_40251_quest_complete:
<Insom'ni takes his time to gaze over the necklace, his body seems invigorated, and energized by its very presence. Slowly, he would place it around his neck, and exhale a heavy breath of relief.> [solemn] It has been a long time since I have felt such energy, it is as if both halves to my soul have been reconnected after many long years. [soft voice] I can not even begin to explain such a feeling, too long has it been that I have been seperated from my essence.

<A grin would spread across Insom'ni, his face taking on a very intense gaze> . [warm] Now, let us begin our work.
quest_40252_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Way-Stones once allowed us Keepers to travel great distances with ease, they were plentiful within the city, and now very few of them remain. [soft voice] To the south west is the Temple of Arkkoran as it is now known, this used to be a place of great magical energy. [pause] Within one of the exterior towers lays a Way-Stone, its energy linked to Keeper Laena.

[commanding] Go and find the Way-Stone, and press the staff against the crystal, you will find yourself transported across Azshara, and before another of my kind.
quest_40252_quest_complete: [solemn] I have heard faded messages of someone helping Keeper Iselus, and now I have you before me. [soft voice] The Eldarath Harmonization Gem has been recovered then, good to hear.
quest_40253_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Welcome to my humble abode, I have kept my duty upon this spire and will continue to do so. [solemn] Now that the Way-Stones are restablished we can begin to make our presence within the region more known.

[pause] To the southwest is the Temple of Zin-Malor, nestled within the Ruins of Eldarath, it is currently inhabited by the twisted Naga. [whispering] Within the Temple of Zin-Malor lays secrets that they will never figure out, and that I need you to uncover.

[solemn] Deep inside the Temple, you will find a distinct stone, etched with bright runes of an even more ancient language. [warm] This stone, is known as the Ashan Stone, when you see it, speak the following 'Tizah Ashan Dal'asha'. [solemn] This magic will once again invigor the long inactive Ley-Lines that stretch through Azshara.
quest_40253_quest_progress: [solemn] When you have spoken the phrase the magic that once held the stone and made it dormant will be inactive. [soft voice] This spell was placed long ago to deter any outside entities from interfering, [urgent] if we can act quickly, I will be able to do as I need.
quest_40253_quest_complete: [solemn] I can feel the energy flowing once again, it will no doubt attract the attention of outside forces, or perhaps those who wish to uncover the secrets of Azshara for themselves. [urgent] Our next step will be a crucial one, and will be required to keep the mysteries of this land from being uncovered.
quest_40254_quest_detail:
[solemn] Us Keepers could not fulfill the lengths of our duties, and I imagine we will not last forever, one day the Tower of Eldara will lose its master, and perhaps one day I may fall as well. I know not what has happened to the others, though I still hope they are alive and well.

[soft voice] If we are to fulfill at least one of our duties, then we shall dispel much of the great magics buried beneath the waves, under the sands. The last thing we intended was for something much more foul to untangle the web of secrets we created.

[urgent] I must thank you again <name>, for everything you have done, you have assisted us in a time of great need, and perhaps now we may last many more years, especially with the energy of the Ley-Lines flowing, and old secrets dispelled. [warm] Me and Keeper Iselus have only you to thank, without you, we would have been aimless in our goals.
quest_40254_quest_progress: [solemn] The energy used in Dire Maul is truly fascinating, I can feel it from all the way here. [soft voice] I believe this will be our only chance of fulfilling our oath as Keepers.
quest_40254_quest_complete:
[solemn] Us Keepers could not fulfill the lengths of our duties, and I imagine we will not last forever, one day the Tower of Eldara will lose its master, and perhaps one day I may fall as well. [soft voice] I know not what has happened to the others, though I still hope they are alive and well.

[urgent] If we are to fulfill atleast one of our duties, then we shall dispell much of the great magics buried beneath the waves, under the sands. [solemn] The last thing we intended was for something much more foul to untangle the web of secrets we created.

[warm] I must thank you again <name>, for everything you have done, you have assisted us in a time of great need, and perhaps now we may last many more years, especially with the energy of the Ley-Lines flowing, and old secrets dispelled. [warm] Me and Keeper Iselus have only you to thank, without you, we would have been aimless in our goals.
quest_40255_quest_detail:
[solemn] A while ago a band of soldiers had departed out to the Swamp of Sorrows. They were tasked with the reclamation of an old keep that laid within the mountains near the western edge of the swamp. Paladin Janathos was the leader of this group, and asked me to say for him and his men a blessing.
