[soft voice] No doubt they will need help out there and perhaps a fresh set of hands could be welcomed. [solemn] Sorrowguard Keep should be just near the entrance to Deadwind Pass, infact it looms over it. It was once used to protect the kingdoms border, believe it or not.

[warm] If you see Janathos, tell him I said hello!
quest_40255_quest_complete: [soft voice] Brother Kristoff asked for you to assist us, he is a kind man, and faithful to the light. [solemn] We could use all the help we could get around here, this bastion is in a state of disrepair, not to mention the threats all around.
quest_40256_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blackrock Clan belongs to the Old Horde, a very large and dangerous enemy to Orgrimmar. [pause] Do not be fooled by the distance between the Blackrock Mountain and Orgrimmar. [emphasis] Should the Blackrock Clan ever gain a sizeable amount of strength, they will come to destroy us as well. [solemn] The Old Horde consists of many factions that remained here on the Eastern Kingdoms during their fights in the First and Second Wars and are a grizzled enemy that should not be underestimated.

[commanding] I have been sent here directly from Orgrimmar to be a damper on the Blackrock Clan, and you shall help. [solemn] It is the honor of the Horde that is at stake after all.

[urgent] Gather me 20 Blackrock Signets, worn by all members of the Blackrock Clan in the region. [commanding] Kill them, take their signets, and bring them to me.
quest_40256_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you done as I asked?
quest_40256_quest_complete: [solemn] We have dealt a blow to the Old Horde and delayed their progress. [warm] I have been ordered to pay you in gold for your duties. [commanding] If you see more of our enemy, make sure to kill them.
quest_40257_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blackrock slayers are a most fearsome foe. [soft voice] They have been known in the past for cleaving down entire regiments of human footmen during the old war. [hesitant] It is them I fear more than any on the field of battle.

[urgent] They must be dealt with, and quickly. [commanding] You can find them all over the Burning Steppes, mostly concentrated to the west at the Blackrock Stronghold, but you may also see them in the Pillar of Ash as well.

[solemn] Go with honor, and kill them in the name of Thrall.
quest_40257_quest_complete: [solemn] The Blackrock Slayers were a truly terrifying foe, [warm] you have done good work.
quest_40259_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I did some digging over the book a bit ago, it would appear that crafting of runic weapons and armor requires a Dark-Rune Anvil. [low voice] I certainly don't have any sort of thing around here, but I do know a place that may.

[solemn] Within the depths of Stratholme is a large slaughterhouse, it is where Baron Rivendare has called home for the time being. [urgent] The Dark-Rune Anvil should be located there, and from it, you shall temper the blade!

[warm] I have learned a lot, and I thank you plenty friend! [confident] I will continue my studies and perhaps one day we may be able to outright nullify our enemies equipment through my research.

[commanding] Go, and venture into the depths of that place, and claim what is yours, oh and if anyone asks, we haven't spoken!
quest_40260_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, a very promising hunter you are, but I am afraid there's nothing left that I could teach you, as you've kept doing your tasks to serve the Forsaken and our queen, I suppose it's time for you to advance to Brill.

[soft voice] After you're done with all your tasks here, seek Dark Ranger Lanissa, she will be in a tent in the town of Brill.

[gentle] She will teach you whatever you need to know to continue your mission, [solemn] these dark rangers were brought with our Lady Sylvanas from Quel'thalas, as per their name they are very skilled when it comes to marksmanship.

[commanding] Farewell, and remember to stick to the shadows, for the Forsaken.
quest_40260_quest_progress: [urgent] Be quick about your business, [low voice] I don't have the leisure to be here all day.
quest_40260_quest_complete:
[solemn] Morpheus sent you from Deathknell?

[pause] It's been a while since I have seen someone wish to walk this path. [warm] You are most welcome, that is if you can keep up with the training.
quest_40261_quest_detail: Greetings, dark ranger aspirant. [soft voice] You appear more than capable of handling a beast to claim as your own. [solemn] Though I may train you in the ways of the hunter, it is not I who can teach you mastery over beasts.
quest_40262_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have learned how to dominate beasts by your own skill, but you must also learn to train them. [soft voice] Understand that some beasts will not accept you as their master. [low voice] As an undead being you may seem to them a delicious snack, or repulsive to their instinctive necrophobia.

[solemn] Aided by an incantation devised by the Cult of Forgotten Shadow, we can soothe the mind of a beast, altering its perception of you as vibrant and healthy. [urgent] Only use it on creatures that your condition repels, that are stricken with terror and distress by what you are.

The one who can teach you the incantation as well as the means by which to train your beasts is Diane Willowfield. You will find her in the War Quarter of the Undercity. [confident] You will gain a variety of potent skills on your journey that will serve you and your companion well, but without her assistance, you cannot hope to make proper use of them.

[commanding] Go now! [proud] Show the living that the Forsaken are no mere walking corpses. [solemn] Dark Lady watch over you.
quest_40262_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well, well, what have you brought me? [warm] My, what a gorgeous, fresh specimen! [gentle] Allow me to assist you with that.

[solemn] I will teach you the incantation by which you can persuade creatures who still walk among the living to serve you faithfully.
quest_40263_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dark Ranger, Lanissa, advised me to call on you specifically for a task after you'd finished your training. [soft voice] She and I agree that this will be a suitable demonstration of your skill and dedication to the Forsaken's cause.

[pause] Even before the plague struck, our current mayor still presided over Brill. [low voice] Boltrus was the mayor's assistant, a quiet yet competent man. [sad] He was sweet on one of the girls from the surrounding farms, and there were rumors about a clandestine rendezvous.

[solemn] Alas, touched by the plague and beyond the salvation of the Dark Lady, Boltrus haunts Tirisfal as a Scourge fiend. [solemn] The mayor has asked that his suffering be put to an end. [urgent] You can find him within the barn of the Balnir Farmstead. [hesitant] Perhaps he clings to memories of nights spent in that barn with her.

[commanding] Find Boltrus, end his suffering, and bring his remains back to Dark Ranger Lanissa. [soft voice] Perhaps then he can find peace. [warm] Your mercy will be rewarded.
quest_40263_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well.

[soft voice] It is a tragedy what all the Scourge took from many of us beyond our sanity. [pause] That Boltrus still clung to emotions from his past life stirs something within me. [hesitant] I wonder... [soft voice] By another fate, could I have been in his place? [sad] A barely sentient yet mindless husk?

... [sigh] Alas.
quest_40267_quest_complete: [low voice] So, Haz'gorg sent you. [pause] It's been some time, now, tell me what he desires from me, cause no doubt he needed something!
quest_40268_quest_detail:
<The troll would listen to the story with interest, a small grin would mark from ear to ear with interest> [soft voice] . I could certainly do this, though I ask why to you, why would I? [low voice] My magic is that of great power, and something I would not freely give to you.

[commanding] If you desire my help then I would desire a favor. [solemn] There is a satyr that I met quite some time ago, one who walks without care even to this day. [threatening] He is a vile, trecherous snake of a creature who needs to be dealt with in a manner less then savory.

[solemn] Let us just say, his actions have wronged me greatly.

[urgent] Travel to Felwood, to the Ruins of Constellas, you will find Pethax Blackhorn there, it is his horn I desire from his battered corpse.
quest_40268_quest_progress: [angry] Have you found that blackhearted mongrel yet?
quest_40268_quest_complete: <The troll looks almost filled with glee> [solemn] You have done well, this wretch had much worse coming to him, but this shall do, especially given my current state. [urgent] I will do as asked, and assist Haz'gorg.
quest_40269_quest_detail:
[solemn] To create a spell of such magnitude will require a few items, the first of which shall be relatively easy to obtain. [soft voice] I require a Gorilla Ligment from Un'goro Crater, its essence of power will be used to conduct the sheer strength of the spell and channel its abilities onto Lord Cruk'Zogg.

[urgent] You can find Un'goro Crater deep within Kalimdor, it is a place of danger, so I would watch your step mortal. [commanding] Return to me with a Gorilla Ligment from the apes there.
quest_40269_quest_progress: [urgent] Why are you here, you should be searching for a Ligment.
quest_40269_quest_complete: <Insom'ni would inspect the Ligment curiously, and nod his head> [solemn] . This shall do just fine.
quest_40270_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have had many encounters within the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, long ages spent gazing upon its walls. [soft voice] It is a place of darkness and foul energies that have corrupted its once defenders. [sad] The Prophet Jammal'an speaks his foul, misbegotten words into the decaying remains of his people that call this place home. [urgent] I desire you to venture into the catacombs of this place, to find the Prophet and gather from him the Atal'ai Rod. [emphasis] It should be kept close to where this troll channels his magic.

[solemn] The Atal'ai Rod holds power in the magic of control, and should assist us in subjugating Lord Cruk'zogg.
quest_40270_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you ventured within the Sunken Temple?
quest_40270_quest_complete: <Insom'ni would inspect the Ligment curiously, and nod his head> [solemn] . This shall do just fine. [solemn] This shall do just fine.
quest_40271_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the elements recovered, and the Atal'ai Rod in posession, I can now begin to manifest my energies into the creation of an elixir. [soft voice] This elixir will bring the mind of Lord Cruk'Zogg into the hands of Haz'gorg to do as he pleases.

[pause] This will require some concentration on my part, so I do ask you mortal, to keep your mouth quiet while I work.
quest_40275_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It is good to meet a fellow explorer upon these lands, one who enjoys the same glory of finding the unknown and uncovering secrets. [solemn] We share a bond in exploration and adventure and I feel obligated to warn you of a danger off the coast, one that perhaps you may assist with.

[commanding] The Deeptide Naga are a menacing force, who came here for an unknown motive and currently hold an island off the coast of Gillijim to the south west. [solemn] It is there that they have a sanctum they call home, and use it as a base of operations to strike out and attack people like you and me. [sad] I was lucky to escape the hands of these slithering marauders and live to tell the tale, but others are not so lucky.

[urgent] I ask you to travel to the Deep Tide Sanctum, and slay the Naga there, so that one day the horde may establish control on these islands, and so that we may continue our exploration unharmed. [warm] Bring me the bracelets they wear as proof.
quest_40275_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you dealt with the Naga?
quest_40275_quest_complete: [solemn] We are one step closer to uncovering the secrets of this place, [soft voice] but I feel there is moe to be done in order to secure ourselves here.
quest_40276_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You did well, you have the tenacity and strength of the most well rounded explorers. [solemn] If we truly want the Deeptide gone, and to free these islands of their presence we must become more bold. [commanding] Their leadership are nestled within the Deeptide Sanctum, and need to be rooted out.

[urgent] Return to the sanctum, and bring retribution upon Princess Shasza, and Tidelord Hakash, they need to be slain for their crimes and hostility. [angry] Trust me, there is no reasoning, or diplomacy that can be done, finish this, and perhaps the Naga will disperse.
quest_40276_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you had any progress with the Naga?
quest_40276_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done then, with their leaders killed the Naga will be uncoherent, and nothing more then a disorganized mass. [emphasis] Even the largest army will always lose to one more disciplined, and focused. [proud] We have truly weakened their position this day, and perhaps forever.
quest_40277_quest_detail:
[solemn] With their forces weakened, it is as good as time as any to attack them directly. [soft voice] Before I changed into... this...

<She points at her undead features.>

I was one of the commanders here, before... That's why I know their camp will prove to be a difficult challenge, even while weakened. [urgent] I recommend that you call for aid when attacking their base. Beware that your primary goal is to end the lives of both Captain Silas, and my usurper sister Faliona too. [commanding] Do this for me, and I promise that you will be well rewarded.
quest_40277_quest_complete: [solemn] I wish I was there to see the look on her miserable face when she realized one last time that she was never able to beat me. Neither in life nor in death, my dear sister. [proud] You have proven to be quite an ally, <class>. [warm] From this day forth, consider yourself welcome to my court... when I rebuild it, of course.
quest_40278_quest_detail:
<race>, I have a task for you. [solemn] A rather important one.

<Nargelas shows you a well-decorated jewelry box> . [solemn] In here lies the deed to the Tirisfal Uplands. [soft voice] You see, before the scourge invaded, my wife Grelda was supposed to inherit these lands from her father. [solemn] On the coronation day, the contents of this box were supposed to pass on into her possession.

[sad] Many moons have passed, and yet my courtiers and I had no luck in opening the lock on this thing. [low voice] But during my research, a name came up. [urgent] Vathras Millson. [soft voice] He specializes in these kinds of things. [commanding] Head to Steepcliff Port and find him; I heard he owns an Inn now.

Oh, and do be careful. [threatening] The box is worth more than your life.
quest_40278_quest_complete: [low voice] And who might you be? [threatening] The Duke sent you? [urgent] On with it then, I'm a busy man.
quest_40279_quest_detail:
[commanding] Do you realize what you are holding in your hands!

<Vathras snatches the box away, and carefully inspects the sigil of the House Darlthos on top of it.>

[soft voice] My, my, I wanted to inspect this beauty for a long time. [solemn] No one aside from the royal family of House Darlthos has ever seen the contents of this box before. [emphasis] You see this sigil? [soft voice] It is an old yet powerful lock that protects the box from being harmed and opened in any way other than through the original incantation that sealed it.

[hesitant] Skilled as I am, without the incantation I will not be able to assist the Duke with this task. [warm] Send the Duke my regards and wish him luck in his endeavors, will you?
quest_40279_quest_complete: [solemn] A magical lock? Naturally. [sad] Nothing can ever just be simple.
quest_40280_quest_detail: [hesitant] Let me think for a second. Hmm... Why, yes! [excited] I have an acquaintance of sorts in the Undercity. The name is Pierce Shackleton. He calls himself a mage, and he owes me a favor, or rather he owes my wife a favor. [commanding] Take this letter to him along with the box and find out what can be done with it.
quest_40280_quest_progress: [low voice] And who might you be?
quest_40280_quest_complete: [soft voice] A letter for me? [angry] That ignorant son of a... Apologies, <class>. [low voice] That man certainly knows how to get on my nerves. [solemn] I will do this for him, but this is the last time I deal with that accursed family.
quest_40281_quest_detail:
I have certainly not seen this kind of lock for quite a while. [solemn] And now I can see why House Darlthos surrounded this whole ordeal in secrecy. [soft voice] What we have here is a type of blood magic. [low voice] Although not as dangerous as some, it certainly requires blood of the family member to activate it. [emphasis] Not many know how to wield this magic; the last mage I knew who used this is long dead!

[sad] Melenas used to have a section of his own in a library deep in the Shadowfang Keep. [solemn] Perhaps there you can find something of use. [soft voice] But beware, that place is overrun by the savage Worgen, so it is better if I hold on to this box until your return. [hesitant] We wouldn't want to lose both you and the box should you fail, right?
quest_40281_quest_complete: [low voice] You are persistent, to say at least. [soft voice] Let's see what Melenas had in store for us.
quest_40282_quest_detail:
[solemn] All this knowledge, just left to rot. [warm] You, my friend, have brought me a valuable gift. [soft voice] But I digress. [soft voice] You probably just want to find out how to open that box. [soft voice] Let's see.

<Pierce produces an old scroll from within the belongings.>

[soft voice] There you are. [soft voice] Hah, it is easier to do than I thought. [soft voice] You will need to take these instructions to Duchess Grelda as her blood is required to open the box. [soft voice] I heard that the Duchess is currently residing in a manor alongside the southern road from Tirisfal Uplands. [soft voice] Be well, and if you ever feel like you want to delve into another dangerous place to recover old magical items, do let me know.
quest_40282_quest_complete:
[solemn] I already received notice from my husband that he found someone capable enough to assist our noble house with such an important task. [warm] You certainly outdid yourself with this one. Ah, so it requires my blood to open it, a good thing I still have a bit of that left.

[hesitant] But this spell will be tricky. [urgent] Anyways, I doubt that you wish to stay here for days while I prepare the ritual. [soft voice] And to the matter of your reward: I will allow you to pick one of the relics from my family armory. [warm] I hope that you find this agreeable, after all the help you have provided us.
quest_40283_quest_detail:
[solemn] It may not look like it, <class>, but we are in middle of a warzone. [urgent] Highborne ghosts that linger in the forests clash with the Naga, for reasons I don't understand, and I don't want to.

[low voice] One thing I know, is that they are a danger for our outpost. [commanding] They may be fighting each other for now, but it won't last forever. [urgent] We should strike now, when they are weak.

[commanding voice] Go to Ruins of Eldranath. [angry] Kill the Naga, eliminate the Highborne. [threatening] Show them, that Bloodfist Point is to be reckoned with.
quest_40283_quest_progress: Bloodfist Point is at danger as long as the Naga slither and the Banshees wail in those forests.
quest_40284_quest_detail:
[solemn] South of Bloodfist Point, Satyrs have created an encampment. It has been a splinter in the eye for Bloodfist Point since the first day we arrived. [commanding] Go, annihilate them, and bring me their horns.

Do not be merciful, as they wouldn't be for you. [angry] Kill all of them, leave no vile Satyr standing.
quest_40284_quest_progress: [commanding] The Legash Encampment is close to our base. [emphasis] I will be able to see you fighting, so don't disappoint me. [mocking tone] I want some fun.
quest_40284_quest_complete: [laughing] Ha! I knew you had it! [proud] You are a strong <class>, very strong. [warm] It reminds me of my youth, cutting down hordes of enemies!
quest_40285_quest_detail:
[solemn] My name is Katokar. Katokar Bladewind. I was a Blademaster of the Burning Blade. Now, I am a Blademaster of the Horde.

I came to Azshara to avenge the death of a fallen comrade. During the Third War, he was here, fighting the Burning Legion. In the end, we won. Archimonde was defeated. But my friend died in a glorious battle.

[sad] I have killed hundreds of demons since I came here, yet I am still restless. [low voice] I need to find a Blade that belonged to him, he was a Blademaster like myself. [solemn] A Blademaster has to be buried with his blade. Yet, my progress thus far has been fruitless. [soft voice] I found his broken corpse near the eastern shore, I know of a great tower watched by a keeper on the far eastern coast of Azshara, perhaps he may know more.
quest_40285_quest_complete:
[solemn] He met with my friend? I know I should be cautious to heed the words of a stranger, but I trust him.

[soft voice] If he says the last place he remembers seeing him was at the Temple of Arkkoran, then that must be it.
quest_40286_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Temple of Arrkoran...

<Katokar would seem almost distant for a moment as his mind thought> . [emphasis] This must be the place <name>, it must be. [hesitant] I have no other leads, venture deep within the Temple, and seek out his blade, if it is anywhere, then it must be there. [soft voice] You can find this temple far to the south east, it is massive, and cannot be missed. [urgent] Be careful in your searching, I am sure a terrible evil lurks inside.
quest_40287_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our Blades, they do not break easily. [low voice] It was cut into two pieces on purpose.

[solemn] From all of the possible forces in Azshara, only the Naga have the technology to do so. [hesitant] Maybe, just maybe, they still have the second part

[pause] If it is anywhere, it must be located on the Shattered Strand, no doubt kept as some trophy, or prized possesion. [urgent] Locate it, and bring back the edge of the sword to me!
quest_40287_quest_progress: [solemn] There is only sorrow to be found within Azshara.
quest_40287_quest_complete: [excited] You found it. [proud] This Blade will be whole again, [commanding] mark my words <name>.
quest_40288_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, there is one last step, the Blade needs to be reforged.

[commanding] We will need a powerful conduit, a source of unimaginable fel energy to make the blade whole again. [emphasis] This is the way of the Blademaster. [urgent] Venture to the forests of Felwood where demons still lurk. [emphasis] Gather their Fel energies and return to me, so we can reforge the Blade.

[solemn] The demonic sanctuary of Jaedenar will be a place that holds such energies, look there.
quest_40288_quest_progress: [solemn] The Fortress of Jaedenar is the most powerful bastion of the Legion in Felwood, [commanding] strike them down.
quest_40288_quest_complete:
<Katokar Bladewind would take his time studying the fel energy before a sigh of relief would escape him> [solemn] .

This should be enough, you've done well.
quest_40289_quest_detail:
[solemn] The last thing I require from you is to honor the dead, you have done much work, work that I could not fulfill, so I ask you to honor the forgotten for me. [low voice] I will work to reforge the blade, though it will take quite a while until it is perfectly balanced.

[soft voice] Speak with me, and utter the name of the fallen so that his spirit may walk freely amongst his fellow warriors, so that you may pass on his warrior spirit.

[emphasis] He was named 'Tak'gar Deephate'.
quest_40289_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done then, and with that, he shall walk freely with those he regarded as heroes. He shall be buried with his blade, I can guarentee that, you have put my mind, and my heart at rest <name>. [warm] Take my Binding as thanks for the work I could not do.

It is not often that someone comes and offers to aid in such a manner, your spirit is truly that of great heroes, bear my Binding with pride, and honor.
quest_40290_quest_detail:
Bah! [angry] You, yes, you <class>! Why are you standing there like a drunk peon? [commanding] You want to stay here, get to work!

We need hides, weapons, wood, everything! But don't worry, old Nulda won't force you to build a second Orgrimmar here. [low voice] Let's start small, bring me some meat from the local stag, let us see what you are made of.
quest_40290_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the meat? [angry] No? Then get moving.
quest_40290_quest_complete: [delight] This is some good game, <class>. [warm] But I have more to ask from you.
quest_40291_quest_detail: [soft voice] Anyone could kill a stag, they are but deers with sharp horns! [commanding] Hippogryph, on the other hand, is a different thing. [urgent] Do you think you have what it takes? If so then bring me a handful of Thunderhead Claws. [threatening] Thunderheads are local Hippogryphs, so wild and ferocious, that even the accursed Elves stay away from them, their claws would make great improvised weapons should things get rough.
quest_40291_quest_complete: [solemn] You impress me. [soft voice] It's not easy to impress old Nulda. [warm] Ill make sure to put the claws to good use, [pause] hope to see you around.
quest_40292_quest_detail:
Hail, <class>, do you feel it? [solemn] The magic, crackling around us, ever powerful, even after thousands of years. [solemn] This place used to be Zin-Azshari, capital of the Night Elf Empire.

[solemn] Now, its nothing more than a wasteland, occupied by the Naga or even more sinister forces. [urgent] However, I had a vision, great disturbance comes to this place, and if we do not stop it, the consequences will be... [whispering] dire. [sad] Unfortunately, my vision was unclear, enveloped in the mists. [hesitant] I need to enter a shamanistic trance to see clearly. [urgent] Yet, I lack proper ingredients to enter such a state. [commanding] I would gather them myself, but I cannot leave the outpost for now. [commanding] I dont need much, only Mosshoof Antlers to pulverize, and a dozen Highborne Essence from the Highborne spirits.
quest_40292_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the ingredients yet?
quest_40292_quest_complete: [confident] Yes, this is all I need. [solemn] Now, let me prepare the ritual.
quest_40293_quest_detail: [confident] I am ready, <class>. [commanding] Let us go outside to commune with the spirits.
quest_40293_quest_progress: [solemn] The ritual must not be disturbed.
quest_40293_quest_complete: [solemn] The vision gave us more questions than answers. [soft voice] The city must've been Zin-Azshari, the dying peoples must've been Highborne of the old. [emphasis] The wave represented the Sundering. It was a warning. [urgent] A warning, that all of this can happen again.
quest_40294_quest_detail: [solemn] During my vision, I saw a great Dragon, flying over Azshara. [soft voice] I don't know much about them, but our Druid friends here in Bloodfist Point should be more knowledgeable. [gentle] Share my vision with them, they will know what to do next.
quest_40294_quest_complete: [soft voice] A dragon, you say? Well, me and my friend there, Brutan, noticed something weird happening in these forests, which could be explained by the presence of the Dragonflight.
quest_40295_quest_detail:
[solemn] We came to Azshara to heal these lands from remnants of the Legion's corruption. [soft voice] What we found here however, was different than expected. You see, young <race>, demonic corruption is not the biggest problem here.

[pause] The land cries out for help. [emphasis] Some kind of evil forces have settled near Lake Mennar. [sad] They drain the very essence of the Earth, consuming magic and nature alike. [low voice] Nagas or satyrs are not that powerful, they could not do that. [urgent] Blue Dragonfilght, on the other hand... [solemn] Please, go and see what is happening at Lake Mennar, the future of Azshara may be in your hands.
quest_40295_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you been to Lake Mennar yet? [pause] It's in the southern part of Azshara.
quest_40295_quest_complete: [solemn] How many? [sad] This is worse than we expected.
quest_40296_quest_detail: [urgent] Archdruid Runetotem needs to hear about this! [solemn] He will know what to do and how we should approach them. [commanding] Go, fly to Thunder Bluff and tell the Archdruid about what you have seen here. [urgent] Make haste, time is of the essence.
quest_40296_quest_progress: [solemn] Blue Dragonflight in such numbers. [pause] This is really worrying.
quest_40296_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, young one. [warm] Talom did well, advising you to come to me.
quest_40297_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Blue Dragonflight has been in Azshara since time immemorial, but their recent actions seem strange. [soft voice] They had been there to safeguard ancient artifacts, not drain the leylines of life and magic. [hesitant] In better, simpler times, I would advise you to contact them and try to negotiate.

[urgent] Those times are over, and we need to act. [commanding] Go back to Azshara and gather a strong party. [urgent] Venture to Lake Mennar, and slay their kin. [solemn] This will thin the numbers in their ranks, and we will have time to prepare a better response to their actions.

[sad] A sad thing that the Dragonflight has begun to mess with the very ways of Azsharas natural magic. [pause] When it is done, return to Yhargosh at Bloodfist Point.
quest_40297_quest_complete: [solemn] The elements are calmed, for now. [warm] Thank you, <class>. [proud] Your help will never be forgotten. [warm] We owe you much.
quest_40300_quest_detail:
Hail young <class>. Are you by chance destined for the human city of Stormwind? If so, [gentle] I have a favor to ask.

Fishing is a rare choice of occupation among my kinsmen, but one I take a great deal of pleasure in. Truly there is no more relaxing way to pass the time, something we Kaldorei are in no short supply of. I often gather clams from the banks I fish along, containing pearls as pure white as Elune herself on the darkest night.

It is from these pearls I have put together a necklace for Shailiea, the woman I have been pining for and courting for many decades now. Please, deliver to her this necklace and tell her it is from her secret admirer. Let me quickly wrap this in a piece of cloth.

The quickest way to reach Stormwind would be from the south dock in Auberdine. Once in Stormwind, you should be able to find Shailliea residing in the Park.
quest_40300_quest_progress: [soft voice] Elune be with you, <class>. [hesitant] What brings you to me?
quest_40300_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is this? From a secret admirer?

Oh, silly Androl. He hasn't realized that I have known for years. [hesitant] I wish he would be more forward about his affections. [warm] Nonetheless, I thank you, <name>. [delight] Please take this coin for your troubles.
quest_40301_quest_detail:
[gentle] Greetings friend, may I interest you in a loaf of bread?

[soft voice] But if it's not bread you're looking for and wish for work, I might have a task for you. [solemn] My friend, Gryshka, owns the inn of Orgrimmar, in many of her letters she wrote that she is unable to reproduce my special flour and can't provide her customers with Mulgore Spice Bread.

[pause] It is by the Earthmother's love that adventurers such as you find their path to me or I'd never be able to communicate with her. [warm] If you wish to aid me, I will give you a sack of flour and the recipe for it, all you have to do is bring it to Gryshka.

[urgent] I hear our newest mischievous allies, the Goblins have raised a zeppelin tower close to Thunder Bluff, the villagers say it takes you straight to Durotar right over the Barrens.

[pause] Here, let me get the sack, Gryshka will have a reward for you.
quest_40301_quest_progress: [soft voice] Come and rest for a while.
quest_40301_quest_complete:
[excited] Jhawna sent you? [solemn] Blessed be the ancestors. [excited] I haven't heard from her in a while!

[warm] And she sent me a sack of her and the means to make it. [warm] Always treasure your friends, <name>, not even distance stays in the way of true bonds.

[pause] Enough melancholy, [excited] I got some coins for you and if you wait a while I can even offer you a loaf of bread!
quest_40302_quest_detail:
[excited] Hello there adventurer! As you may know the Darkmoon Faire moves from Kalimdor to Eastern Kingdoms each week. In fact we are able to move through most cities without the faction barrier.

With the new boat from Darkshore to Stormwind we have drastically changed our route.

[pause] To quickly be done with the explanation, this week we camped close to Zoram's Strand at night before reaching Darkshore, and one of those Nagas stole a very precious gift I once got in Tanaris!

Ah yes, it was in my days of searching for wonders and mystery that I found a curious turtle close to the shores, her name was Torta, and she could speak! Imagine, a speaking turtle, how marvelous!

She asked me to find her husband, Tooga. Apparently he got lost a lot, but he also was able to speak! Never in my life have I seen such a thing. But sadly they didn't wish to join the Faire, however Torta offered me one of her eggs and that's the precious gift I am talking about, I think it was about to hatch too.

[urgent] Please, bring back my egg.
quest_40304_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have been sent by a council of mages from Orgrimmar to look into the growing power that emits from Karazhan. [soft voice] I have done much research into the tower itself and the artifacts that once belonged in the ruins around it.

[hesitant] I have some hunches, the first of which is that the energy that me, and the other mages have felt is coming from beneath Karazhan. [emphasis] In an old, and decrepid series of catacombs underneath the tower. [urgent] If I am correct, then we will need an old Pendant which holds power enough to re-energize a key created by Medivh.

[solemn] This artifact is known as the Pendant of Ardan, thought lost for some years now. [soft voice] My only hint is that of the ogres of Deadwind Pass, of which, their leader Var'zhog has begun to exhibit magical prowess.

[commanding] Find Var'zhog, and from him, reclaim the Pendant of Ardan.
quest_40304_quest_progress: [solemn] The Pendant of Ardan will be required if we wish to proceed, find it.
quest_40304_quest_complete:
<A smirk would press to Kor'gan as he looks upon the Pendant> [solemn] .

This is it, you've done well, I've always had some suspicions about Var'zhog and his power, with this, we can continue.
quest_40305_quest_detail:
With the Pendant of Ardan in our hands we can turn our attention to the tower itself, and what magic has begun to raise more ghosts around it. [solemn] As of recently, the dead have begun to materialize, spirits and echoes of the past clinging around the tower as if they were still alive.

Travel to the ruins around Karazhan, and from the ghosts and dead bring me 8 Ghostly Substance. [urgent] It is from this substance I will be able to check what magic lingers upon the ethereal beings.

Be careful, for there are also rumors of a Dark Reaver who guards the entrance to Karazhan.
quest_40305_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you had any success in dealing with the ethereal?
quest_40305_quest_complete: [solemn] Hmm.. It would appear that the Substance you have brought me is extremely potent, and quite magically powerful. [low voice] Whatever being is at work here stirring these forces is quite certainly strong.
quest_40306_quest_detail:
<A look of annoyance would cover Kor'gan as his attempts to study the Ghostly Substance fail> .

[solemn] It would appear that what we are dealing with is beyond my power, it is intense in arcane energy, with something else that is not familiar to me...

[pause] There is one I know who may be of assistance, who was a member of the Kirin Tor in life, his name is Gunther Arcanus. [soft voice] He lives within the center of Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades, just northeast of Brill.

[urgent] With his knowledge within Dalaran, perhaps he can be of more assistance, seek him out and give him this crate.
quest_40306_quest_complete:
[low voice] Yes? What is it that you want with me? [hesitant] I can sense a powerful magic about you.

From Karazhan, well, let me have a look then.
quest_40307_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My my... Such potent energy, I had always guessed that Karazhan had natural ley energy, in fact it was rumored within Dalaran. Kor'gan was correct to bring these samples to me, they will make good for future projects. [solemn] The energy that lingers beneath the arcane is that of necromancy, and quite potent necromancy at that.

[low voice] Long ago, I spent quite some time at Karazhan. I was under mission from the Kirin Tor to look into the natural energy that lingered there. [solemn] This is no doubt the work of Alarus, a student of Medivh for a brief period of time. He spent much of his later days attending to the crypts that stretched far beneath the tower.

[commanding] If your task is to enter those catacombs, you will need to reforge the key. It requires a Mark of Karazhan, held by few who were given entrance into the tower, as well as the key itself.

[urgent] Bring this information to Kor'gan, perhaps he will find a solution to this problem.
quest_40307_quest_complete: [solemn] So, my suspicions were correct, the power that has begun to rise is coming from below Deadwind Pass. [urgent] Well, then we must make haste, unless a great evil comes to threaten the Horde.
quest_40308_quest_detail:
[solemn] If we are to reforge the key, then we will need the items that Gunther Arcanus had hinted to. [low voice] I have no doubts in my mind that both of these items can be found lingering around the tower.

[urgent] The first item we shall acquire is the key itself, there are rumors of a sickly, pale human who emerges when not a living soul is about, to tend the grounds around Karazhan. [whispering] It would be from him, that the Old Crypt Key can be found, find him, and claim it for our purposes, he should be around.

[solemn] Lastly, a Mark of Karazhan will be required, of which there are not many left on this mortal world. [soft voice] I have heard tales of a Captain lingering in the caves of The Master's Cellar. [solemn] Captain Rothynn and his twin brother were both given one long ago, he should still have one.

[commanding] When these items are obtained, return to me, and I can forge the key.
quest_40308_quest_progress: [solemn] Be dedicated in your searching, if we are to destroy this evil, then we must act fast.
quest_40308_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the stories were correct, [excited] the items have been obtained, with the Pendant of Ardan, the Mark of Karazhan, and the key itself, [confident] I can begin to work my magic.
quest_40309_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now then, you have done your deeds with honor intact, it is my time to uphold my end of the bargain. [low voice] It will take some time, and great concentration, but I will work to reforge the Karazhan Crypt Key.

[emphasis] With everything in place, it should allow entry into the Crypts of Karazhan! [commanding] Now, step back, and behold my power!
quest_40309_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the stories were correct, [excited] the items have been obtained, with the Pendant of Ardan, the Mark of Karazhan, and the key itself, [commanding] I can begin to work my magic.
quest_40310_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one step left for us, as honorable members of the Horde. [commanding] We must step forth into the darkness, and vanquish this evil before it grows even stronger. [urgent] If we were to let the humans deal with this, who knows if they could even stop it?

[solemn] As Grom Hellscream slayed Mannoroth, we too must look upon something terrible and destroy it from this world. [commanding] I ask of you to venture into the Karazhan Crypts, and put an end to this madness, for the good of this world.

[urgent] This will not be a task you can handle alone, make sure you bring strong allies to journey with you.
quest_40310_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not fear the darkness <name>, [commanding] stride with a great determination and you may still find glory.
quest_40310_quest_complete: [solemn] Do you feel it? [soft voice] A great fog has been lifted over the area, and the foul blackness of magic is beginning to subside. [proud] You have done the work of great heroes, and have acted with a decisiveness I have not seen! [warm] You bring honor to your ancestors, please, take one of these items as a tribute of my thanks in helping me.
quest_40311_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have ventured to this rather decrepid, and lonely place to investigate the mysteries surrounding Karazhan. [soft voice] It has long since loomed over this land with a great power emitting from it. [solemn] While the tower is impressive, it does not boast the power it once held under the rule of Medivh.

[soft voice] My analysis of the tower is that the growing power does not come from above, but below. [pause] There have always been tales of a crypt that stretched deep beneath Karazhan, perhaps they may be true.

[soft voice] The first thing I ask of you is to search for a long lost pendant, rumored to have been taken from the ruins of Karazhan some time ago. [soft voice] It will be needed to magically attune the key for our purposes. [hesitant] My suspicion is that the ogre's of the region have taken hold of it. [low voice] An ogre magi by the name of Var'zhog has grown to some renown as of recently, no doubt he holds the pendant.
quest_40311_quest_progress: [urgent] The Pendant of Ardan will be required to proceed <name>, collect it, and with haste.
quest_40311_quest_complete:
<Magus Ariden Dusktower would take his time inspecting the pendant, before letting out a bright smile> [solemn] .

This would appear to be it, [warm] you've done well, my suspicions were correct. [soft voice] It is not every day some ogre learns to manipulate magical energy after all.
quest_40312_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the Pendant of Ardan secured we can begin to look towards other leads, as of recent many more ghosts have begun to sprout up around the tower of Karazhan. [soft voice] It isn't every day that the dead begin to walk again within the ethereal form after all.

[commanding] I ask of you to venture around the ruins of Karazhan and slay the ethereal dead, and from them, collect 8 Ghostly Substance. [solemn] It is from this substance that I will be able to check to see the magical potency, or what kind of magic has driven these souls to stir from death.

[urgent] Watch your footing, for the Dark Reaver of Karazhan has been known to watch over the gatehouse of the tower.
quest_40312_quest_progress: [solemn] A foul magic stains the air, [urgent] our actions must be dedicated and swift, find the ghosts around Karazhan, and free them from torment.
quest_40312_quest_complete: [solemn] This is it, interesting, the substance is much more potent then I had originally imagined, [soft voice] even just from looking at them this close I can feel an intensity lingering upon it.
quest_40313_quest_detail:
[solemn] The energy of the substance is intense, and would take me considerable time to unweave. [soft voice] My master Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver within Dalaran is well versed within such magic, and would have a much easier time.

[commanding] I ask of you to bring him the Ghostly Substance and figure out the true potency and origin of the magic contained. [solemn] Perhaps then, we can figure out how to best deal with the foreign energy lingering beneath Karazhan.
quest_40314_quest_complete: [solemn] So, Ansirem believes the energy is also coming from the Karazhan Crypts? [urgent] Then that settles it, we must reforge the key, and enter forcefully.
quest_40315_quest_progress: [solemn] If we are to enter the Karazhan Crypt, then we must take action, [commanding] I suggest you find some friends to help, for our foes may be quite strong.
quest_40315_quest_complete:
<Magus Ariden Dusktower would look over the items, and let out a breath of relief> [solemn] .

Perhaps there is a hope after all, [warm] you have done well, [pause] now, let us begin.
quest_40316_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the power of the Pendant of Ardan, and the items you have obtained I will begin to channel the energies of Karazhan into the dormant key. [soft voice] With familiar energies it should break the magical seal upon the lock and grant entrance.

[pause] I will need some time to concentrate, so please, give me a moment to work the complicated magic.
quest_40316_quest_complete: [solemn] The key has been reforged with the magic that once created it, [soft voice] now with it in our grasp we can strike hard at the evil that lurks within that long forgotten crypt.
quest_40317_quest_detail:
With the key created the door to the Karazhan Crypts is now open. [solemn] I ask of you a great importance, to venture into the depths beneath Karazhan and slay Alarus in the name of all that is good.

[urgent] To do such a task will require aid, for you will not be able to take this charge on your own. [commanding] Hire a band of mercenaries, or gather folk of a good merit to join you, and rid the world of this evil so that it cannot spread further harm.

[solemn] The Kirin Tor is with you in spirit, the fate of many are on your shoulders brave one.
quest_40317_quest_progress: [solemn] It is unknown how deep the Crypts may burrow within Azeroth, so tread carefully once you are inside.
quest_40317_quest_complete:
[solemn] A great evil has been vanquished this day, it is on the shoulders of heroes like yourself that this world remains uncorrupted by darkness!

[warm] The powers that once drew me here have begun to settle, I must thank you greatly for all of the work you have done in uncovering this mystery. [warm] Please, on behalf of the Kirin Tor, take one of these items as a thanks.
quest_40318_quest_detail:
[angry] An outsider! By the Light, you are a sight for sore eyes! [warm] Welcome to the Remnants Camp. [solemn] I am Captain Silas, leader of the Alliance Remnants and commander of the Army of Lordaeron. [solemn] We here are all that remain that bear the crest of Lordaeron, now tucked away in this far-away corner of Tirisfal.

[urgent] To say that our situation here is dire would be an understatement of the highest order. [urgent] We are beset upon all sides by the undead, both of the Forsaken and the Scourge. [urgent] I have prepared a letter to be sent to our sister kingdom of Stormwind, one of the last bastions of human power. [commanding] You must take it to the commander of the armies of Stormwind - Lordaeron needs soldiers and supplies if we are to overcome the undead threat!
quest_40318_quest_complete: [soft voice] What's this? This letter bears the crest of Lordaeron. [solemn] I must say, it has been quite some time since I received a letter marked with this sigil.
quest_40319_quest_detail:
[angry] Supplies and soldiers? And where exactly am I supposed to get these, much less how am I supposed to send them so far north? Times must be desperate indeed if a captain of the Army of Lordaeron claims to be the leader of the Alliance.

[solemn] I have prepared my response. Sadly, there is no way to meet his request, as our own forces are stretched thin as it is. [urgent] Bring this letter back to him, and may the Light bless those that remain there.
quest_40319_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, there is no help coming? [pause] It seems we must look to ourselves to keep the last torch within these lands alight.

[warm] Thank you for delivering the letter. [commanding] You are dismissed.
quest_40320_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey there, I suppose you wouldn't mind helping me out, would you? [hesitant] Things are starting to get incredibly rough, we are suffering through a food shortage that won't even last more then a week.

[solemn] There is a cave, directly to the east that is practically crammed with wolves. [urgent] If you could get me 10 Graypaw Flanks I could make them last for quite a while, and help alleviate the lack of food.
quest_40320_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, fine pieces, and they don't seem touched by the taint of the plague. [warm] They will do nicely, thanks again, [warm] it means a lot.
quest_40326_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago I traveled the forests of Ashenvale in search of a place to call home. As the druids tended to The Crescent Grove, I figured such a tranquil location would make the perfect home. For centuries I tended to my garden and assisted the druids with whatever needs they had.

[sad] As of recently, a band of Furbolg calling themselves, the Groveweald, had moved in. They expelled me from my home and even had the audacity to burn it to the ground.

[angry] In my panic, I left behind many valuable heirlooms and treasures. Without a doubt, most of it burnt to the ground. [urgent] Please travel to my burned down home in the Crescent Grove and gather from behind the house my mallet. It was given to me by my father, and I used it to build my house. [soft voice] Collect it, for it means a lot to me.
quest_40326_quest_progress: [solemn] Crescent Grove is a dangerous place, [soft voice] I would advise that you bring help if you are to go there.
quest_40326_quest_complete: [solemn] This is it, I didn't expect it would still be there. [warm] You have my thanks, with this mallet I will create a new home, and find somewhere new to settle.
quest_40327_quest_detail:
[urgent] I got word a few weeks back that the Venture Co. had to abandon the Crystalvein Mine because of a basilisk problem. No doubt they left behind all sorts of equipment and tools that are ripe for pilfering. We pirates are usually operating on second hand equipment, and such a score we -cannot- pass up.

[commanding] The Crystalvein Mine is located to the east and is just off the road near the Gurubashi Arena. [urgent] Get there, and get there quick pal, before those Venture goons go and try to get back there stuff. [excited] If we act fast, they won't even know we went and snatched it all up!
quest_40327_quest_progress: [urgent] Make sure you keep yours eyes open out there!
quest_40327_quest_complete: [excited] Look at all this stuff! Spanners, Flaxpipes, Togwig Gears! [laughing] This will last the Bloodsail quite a while, and give me a whole bunch of opportunity to tinker! [warm] Thanks again <name>, this is a haul!
quest_40328_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few weeks back Naga began to enter the territory just south of the Bloodsail Compound. [hesitant] We don't know why they are here, or why they came but they seem quite drawn to the heights. [angry] The slithering wretches have done nothing but wander about and bother our ships as they sail about. [commanding] I'd like you to do battle with them for all of our slain kin.

[urgent] Gather from the Naga Explorers their tridents and bring me them as proof of your deeds. 14 Should do just nicely, maybe we can use them as harpoons against the beasts.
quest_40328_quest_progress: [solemn] The Naga can be a fearsome foe, [urgent] battle hard, and put them down.
quest_40328_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, excellent, the less of them swimming about, the better for all of us. [warm] You've done well, here, keep one, it might serve you well.
quest_40329_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We got a contact who has been looking to buy a Pristine Gorilla Pelt for some time now. [urgent] They're paying top dollar for one completely pristine with not a single imperfection. [commanding] The Bloodsail could certainly use the coin to fund our operations.

[pause] Head out into the jungles of Stranglethorn and hunt down some of the gorilla, and find me a pristine pelt. [hesitant] We may as well utilize the jungle while we are here afterall.
quest_40329_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck yet? [soft voice] Remember, it needs to be immaculate.
quest_40329_quest_complete:
<Willy would take his time inspecting the pelt for imperfections> [soft voice] . This might just be the one <name> , nice job out there, this will certainly bring us some gold.

[warm] Here, take your cut for the good work.
quest_40330_quest_detail:
[solemn] It sure has been a while since we've heard from old 'Wincing' Willy. He has been appointed to manage the supplies out far to the north west at Bloodsail Compound, it is located just to the southwest of the Gurubashi Arena.

[urgent] Something must have gone wrong, or him and his men have gone rogue.

[commanding] I want you to travel there, and meet up with him and figure out why there has been supply shortages.

[confident] If there's anything we Bloodsail need, it's to keep our supply lines in check!
quest_40330_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, McCoy sent you did he? [hesitant] Well, I can understand why, we've hit some problems, and haven't been able to send out the goods that have been requested, perhaps you can help.
quest_40331_quest_detail:
Five nights ago we were harassed by a band of trolls with blue hair, [angry] they threw all sorts of javelins at us.

[sad] They made off with crates and bundles of supplies, not to mention killing a few good folk before we fought them off.

[solemn] Those trolls are Skullsplitter, and came from the Ziata'jai Ruins to the north east of here. [urgent] Head there, and recover 5 Bloodsail Supply Crates.

[commanding] While you're there, you may as well kill some to get a payback, [urgent] we need to keep our image after all.
quest_40331_quest_progress: [angry] Those trolls can be some mean sons of bitches, make sure you are cautious out there.
quest_40331_quest_complete: [laughing] Heh, we've butted heads with the Skullsplitter a few times, they should know not to mess around now. [warm] Nice job in getting back the booty.
quest_40332_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that you've recovered the supplies we can turn our attention to other matters entirely. [solemn] In Kalimdor we have a network of clients and contacts that we keep in touch with for all sorts of purposes.

[soft voice] One such contact is located within Steamwheedle Port and hasn't sent his delivery of goods yet. He goes by the name Jabbey and is a vendor there.

[urgent] I'd like you to head there and find out what the hold up is so that we can get it all to McCoy.

[pause] You can find Steamwheedle Port to the east of Gadgetzan in the deserts of Tanaris.

[whispering] Now, of course, make sure you keep it on the hush-hush that this is related to the Bloodsail.

[hesitant] Oh, and make sure to bring water, I hear it's quite dry there.
quest_40332_quest_complete:
[excited] Hey there, looking for anything specific?

[warm] Oh, that's why you're here huh, heh.
quest_40333_quest_detail:
[whispering] Hey I aint lookin' for no trouble, and keep your voice down!

[urgent] I've been supplying the Bloodsail with a potent poison for some time now, and my main guy just up and left Tanaris. [hesitant] I know they paid me for the last batch but I just haven't had an opportunity to get it, do I look like some sort of scorpid killer to you?

[mocking tone] Maybe you can help me out, and deliver it for me, I'll throw in some coin to you as well for the trouble. [urgent] To the west of here are a bunch of Scorpid Hunters, from them gather 8 Potent Scorpid Venom and deliver them to 'Wincing' Willy back out at the Bloodsail Compound in Stranglethorn Vale.
quest_40333_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Welcome back, this is it huh?

[warm] Not bad, nice work in getting it, now you know where we get some of our poisons, so keep it hush.
quest_40334_quest_detail:
Nice work on checking up on things for me, [soft voice] there might be more work around the camp, but I'd like you to deliver a letter up to First Mate McCoy. [urgent] No doubt he's getting a bit anxious wondering what me and you have been up to.

[low voice] I have prepared a note to be taken to him down at Bloodsail Retreat, so please do so with haste.
quest_40334_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, I take it everything is back in order huh? [warm] Well, from what I read you've done a good job. [warm] You've solved our supply issue, and for that you should be commended, take one of these items from the hoard, [proud] you've earned it matey.
quest_40335_quest_detail:
[excited] Ahoy Cap'n! Saw ye have fun last night with the bard lassy in our vessel, fine piece ain't she?

[soft voice] By all means, I mean the boat, of course, non of my business of yer personal affairs. [urgent] Speaking of which Cap'n, have ye decided the name of the vessel yet? [commanding] It's bad luck to have an unnamed ship at sea, so think about it!

[pause] Anyway, onto more pressing matters. [commanding] Admiral Garfield told me to supply our settlement with generals goods but we don't have the leisurely of just buying them so we'll just loot it.

[angry] Aye, loot it. [urgent] The Southsea seadogs have settled on a sandbar close to that damned Giljim Isle.

[solemn] Fortune of the waves be with ya.
quest_40335_quest_progress: Hurry Cap'n, there be much to do.
quest_40335_quest_complete:
[angry] Monkeys, all of them, serve them right. [commanding] Let me help you out with those!

[warm] I hope you found some coins for your pockets because I'm afraid I don't carry anything with me.
quest_40336_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Cap'n, back for more songs?

Or is it sugar only today.

<Jeesie stares deep into your eyes> . [hesitant] Oh what is this poor bard to do, no jewelry to match her beauty, surely the Cap'n would love to change that, aye?

[soft voice] I hear there's a group of nagas north of one of our compounds, Vil'do says they carry elven jewelry that would best suit this gal, don't you think so?

[warm] I will make sure to make it worth your while.
quest_40336_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh Cap'n you're a tease and a half, quite the charmer I may say.
quest_40336_quest_complete:
<Jeesie's eyes sparkle at the treasure> [soft voice] .

Oh Cap'n, it's beautiful, come put it on my neck, the sight will be the most treasured reward you'd ever get!
quest_40337_quest_detail:
[urgent] We are running low on rum Cap'n! [soft voice] I need to test something, while I can brew beer in many ways I have yet to try to make some fine heavy rum.

[pause] Luckily for us, we're on Jaguero Island, and as you could notice there are several gorillas here, where there's a gorilla there's also bananas. [emphasis] With the sugar the fruit holds I might be able to brew us some rum.

[excited] A bunch of them would be great.
quest_40337_quest_progress: [excited] Can't wait to test it or taste it.
quest_40337_quest_complete:
[excited] Aye! Now let's try it.

[warm] This be strong and fine rum, here ye go Cap'n yer share.
quest_40338_quest_detail:
[solemn] Another of our kin, I take it you are coming here to seek your true purpose upon this world, or you have come to pay your tributes to this old group. [soft voice] The Azurestone Order is as old as Ironforge itself, and has its roots upon the building of our mighty city.

[solemn] If you wish to join our order, and learn our lessons, you will need to first listen to the tale of the Azurestone.
quest_40338_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you come to listen?
quest_40338_quest_complete: [solemn] Now you understand the sheer importance of the order.
quest_40339_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Azurestone Order is as old as this city, [pause] it is on the shoulders of brave dwarves that it has managed to survive so long. [solemn] A test of bravery is in order to prove that you are as strong willed as those who have come before you.

[urgent] To the southeast is the Gol'Bolar Quarry, recently infested with troggs, and led by a vile trogg named Grash who uses primitive magic to lead his minions. [commanding] Travel there, and from him gather his staff.

[confident] If you manage to slay him, it will no doubt be a showing of both your bravery, and your natural prowess with the arcane gift.
quest_40339_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you braved the Gol'Bolar Quarry?
quest_40339_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am impressed, it seems we have another who is willing to join. [warm] Your bravery has been noted, and your excellence with magic is evident in completing this task. [proud] We dwarven mages do not shy from assisting the kingdom.

[warm] As a reward for your bravery, please, take this, as a token of joining The Azurestone Order.
quest_40343_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Can you feel it, your destiny is calling you young one, the spirits themselves whisper your name. [solemn] You have been called upon by Beram Skychaser in Thunder Bluff to go on a ritual of our kind.

[gentle] You can find him in the Spirit Rise at the northeastern edge of the bluffs, go there, and find him.
quest_40343_quest_complete: [warm] I am happy to see that my messages have been received from Orgrimmar, [warm] welcome to Spirit Rise, [solemn] it is time for you to undergo an age old tradition.
quest_40344_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been that we tauren shaman have upheld our ancient traditions. [soft voice] Spirit Walking is a part of our culture, and has been around longer than you could even imagine, young one. [pause] It is how we connect with those of the afterlife in the arms of the Earthmother.

[gentle] If you wish to begin on this path, then special ingredients will be required for you to first make your connection with the spirit world. [urgent] To the southwest is a land called Feralas. [soft voice] At Camp Mojache you will find Sage Palerunner. [commanding] Speak with him, and tell him I was the one who sent you.
quest_40344_quest_complete: [solemn] So, you have been sent here by Beram Skychaser you say. [soft voice] You must be another who is looking to learn the ways of old, [pause] come, sit around, there is much to learn.
quest_40345_quest_detail:
[solemn] The path of the spiritwalker is one of devotion to the ancestors, to keep in communication with the spirits of old. [soft voice] We are to respect them, and pay our tributes when we can, through this we are able to hone a power of the supernatural world.

[pause] From the ravenous Centaur, to the vile Quilboar, even they practice elements of shamanism linking to their ancestry. [solemn] It is almost entwined with Kalimdor itself, in a way.

[gentle] To get you aquainted with the powers of the spirit world we will need you to gather an age-old leaf that grows in the area. [warm] Believe it or not there was a time when it was common place amongst Stonetalon and the oasis of the Barrens, but no longer.

[solemn] Out in the forests of Feralas grows a potent plant called Spiritleaf. [emphasis] It is quite rare but can be seen glittering in the air, and is needed for ones spiritual awakening.
quest_40345_quest_progress: [solemn] You must be dedicated in your path if you wish to learn the ways of the spiritwalker.
quest_40345_quest_complete: [solemn] A dedicated mind, it takes true perseverance to find such a rare plant, [warm] you have done well.
quest_40346_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you have collected the Spiritleaf we can begin the ceremony, [soft voice] I have prepared everything that was needed while you were searching.

[solemn] I will begin to communicate with the spirits in order to send you on your spirit quest. [pause] As I channel my energy upon the leaf, it will flow throw your body, and you will gain its magical properties. [pause] Inhale deeply, and let it flow through your form uninhibited.

[pause] When you are ready to begin, [commanding] I will channel my magic into the Spiritleaf.
quest_40346_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done, the spirits have communicated with me.
quest_40347_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time to make the journey to meet with your ancestors, [soft voice] they know you more than you may know yourself but do not fear them. [solemn] They look out for us all in the end, and they desire to see if you are truly ready to take up this mantle.

[urgent] At the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, they will be there, speak with the Ancestor of Wisdom, they will bring you through your next step.

[warm] And lastly, goodluck <name>, may the winds be at your back.
quest_40348_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have been watching you for a long time, from the plains of Mulgore we gazed down upon your vigor and tenacity. [soft voice] You have improved much since those days long ago, and now, here you are, before me.

[pause] If you truly wish to be a Spiritwalker and learn our ways, then you must learn a lesson from the each of us. [gentle] We can help guide you in the right direction, all you need to do is listen.

[emphasis] Speak with all three of us, and when you have heard our words, return to me.
quest_40348_quest_complete:
[solemn] Do you understand the burdens of a Spiritwalker? [soft voice] It is to understand the lessons of the past, and to live in harmony with the spirit world. [solemn] To pass this information on to those in the mortal realm, and to make sure these values never fade.

[warm] You have impressed us <name>, [proud] you have done much for this world, and for the good of others and for that we are greatful.
quest_40349_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ahh, yes, it would appear that you have gained much power, and word of your name has travelled to my ear. [solemn] Perhaps it is time for your next step, troll, to learn the ways of our kind. [soft voice] We trolls have had a unique way with nature for a long time, one that these orc or tauren cannot understand.

[commanding] It be the way of the witch doctor, and to learn, you must speak with one of our kind. [warm] Seek out Bom'bay at the Sen'jin Village, he'll teach you good.
quest_40349_quest_complete: [solemn] Ahh, you be a new one, I can feel it within your spirit mon. [urgent] Let us not waste time.
quest_40350_quest_detail:
[commanding] You wish to learn da ways of the Witch Doctor huh? We troll shamans be masters of the voodoo, and perhaps you can learn my ways. First, I need you to get your hands on some Skullsplitter Mojo for me. [urgent] I will be usin' it in ma ritual to bestow power upon ye. That, and well, let's say I don't exactly like them Skullsplitters.

[threatening] They can be found deep in the jungles of Stranglethorn, by ruins in the eastern parts of the region. [commanding] Go there, and get me 20 of them, that should do, just nicely.
quest_40350_quest_progress: [urgent] You be gettin that mojo mon?
quest_40350_quest_complete: [delight] Such fine samples, yes... [warm] This shall do nicely!
quest_40351_quest_detail: [solemn] With the samples you have provided I will begun to conjure a special serum, [urgent] this serum will be needed for your next task. [hesitant] So please, give me some time to prepare it, for one mess up, be the end of ya!
quest_40351_quest_complete: [laughing] Heh, it took quite a lot of concentration, but here we are mon!
quest_40352_quest_detail:
[solemn] With this serum you may speak with the spirit of the toad, he is a patient, and incredibly wise one. [soft voice] We trolls have been hexin' our enemies for quite some time, and it is about time for you to pay respects.

[commanding] N'ribbi is the one you seek, and he can be found deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.

[urgent] In the north west of Dustwallow is a place called 'Bluefen' you can find him at the very edge.

[emphasis] Go there, and speak with him, bring this serum, and offer it to N'ribbi as tribute.
quest_40354_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Seems like the pirate life suits ye, ye scoundrel. [chuckling] Ah, I remember of me own adventures, to be young again. [pause] Anyway, since the ship's all yours and all, thought it'd be the time for you to name it, savvy?

[warm] I bet ye already got a name in mind, whenever ye feel ready.
quest_40354_quest_complete: Hm, not something I would've gone with. [soft voice] Alas, it be yer ship 'afore all.
quest_40355_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Admiral tells me Fleet Master Firallon picked a Dragonmaw nobody from the Wetlands to train and eventually lead one of our vessels because of his orcish battle experience. [angry] Long has it been since I was this insulted! [commanding] Earn my favor, will you <race>?

[urgent] This "Ironpatch" is right next to Firallon on one of the three ships at the Wild Shore. [commanding] Challenge him to battle and bring me his head!

[angry] Blood and thunder, victory or death.
quest_40355_quest_complete:
[solemn] This pleases me greatly, <name>!

[warm] You've begun your way towards my respect, thank you.
quest_40356_quest_detail:
'ello there boss mon! [excited] Time for Vil'do to send ya out for dat booty! [urgent] What, were ya just thinkin' that ya'd be only drinkin' rum for da rest of ya days? [laughing] No boss mon, ya must be huntin' treasure so ya can afford da money lust and whatever else ya got. Vil'do wouldn't guess and he shouldn't either.

[solemn] Da loa say Vil'do would one day die talkin' since he be talkin' so much, but Vil'do don’t listen to them and neither should ya mon.

[commanding] One of da boys from da Bloodsail Compound said dey be seein' some weirdo night elf fightin' nagas, said somethin’ about him wavin' his hand in da air and magic goin' "woosh".

[low voice] No idea where he be goin' but Vil'do sees opportunity here and Vil'do thinks dis will lead boss mon to booty.
quest_40356_quest_progress: [soft voice] The notes appear to be torn and dirty.
quest_40356_quest_complete: [low voice] The language is unreadable to you and you bet it'd be unreadable for the rest of your crewmates back at the retreat, [pause] it is by now you realize you should've probably recruited a historian.
quest_40357_quest_detail: [soft voice] While making a note to yourself about the thought you just had you try to put one and two together and see if there's something useful in these notes. [delight] Lady Luck seems to be smiling to your wicked self once more.
quest_40358_quest_detail:
[urgent] Get ready boss mon, da trip be a long one! [commanding] Vil'do will make sure to be makin' some room for the treasure ya be comin' back with. [solemn] Remember what ya got from ya notes, ya be lookin’ for golden elves! [soft voice] Well ya know statues of golden elves but who cares.

[excited] Ya do dis and dis be da best haul da Bloodsail got in a long time. [proud] Make us proud eh, boss mon?
quest_40358_quest_progress: [soft voice] Comparing the drawing from the journal it seems you're in the right place and this is the right statue.
quest_40358_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You stare at the huge statue and can't believe your eyes, it's made of pure gold! [shocked] You dare question whether it's still there when you realize you will not be able to move it one inch.

[angry] Several curses come out of your mind when you remember Vil'do's words. [sad] Not only did you come this far, but you can't even grab them!
quest_40359_quest_detail:
Alright, you're here to steal my finds? I've been keeping my eye on these statues for a while. [threatening] I'm not gonna let some random <race> come in and take my loot, understand? Besides, we can't carry all of them anyway. There are four more scattered around these ruins.

Say, how about a truce? You get me some parts and I'll come up with a gnomish contraption that can shrink them down. We'll split up the statues, three for me, two for you. Remember, I'm the one who came up with this plan, after all.

[confident] So you got all that, bub? Then, get me those materials and let's make these statues more portable.
quest_40359_quest_complete: [urgent] Okay bub, stand back while I assemble this thing, yeah?
quest_40360_quest_detail:
[excited] It's done! [low voice] Quite boring little thing but you know gnomes, blah, I hate gnomes. [angry] No refinement when it comes to these things, just look at this thing, the perfect way to steal stuff, and not to mention increase your own profit!

[shocked] This thing was only supposed to shrink the statues, but guess what, it can now enlarge them too! [urgent] Anyway let's be done with it yeah, no reason to wait any longer.
quest_40360_quest_progress: [soft voice] You stare at the statue with the engraved name once more and get ready to pull the trigger.
quest_40360_quest_complete: [urgent] As you push the button the shrink ray activates! [gasp] Mumbling all sorts of sounds at first you start cursing the corpse of the goblin who built this, not only was he a double-crosser but he was no engineer! [sigh] Or so you'd think, sooner than later the statue began to shrink, no weighing less, and could easily be placed in your backpack.
quest_40361_quest_detail: [solemn] Staring at the now little elven statue you remember Fazgel saying something about four others and so you decide to go find them. [soft voice] Placing Lyvdia in your satchel and with the shrink ray in hand you are ready to grab all of it and go home.
quest_40361_quest_progress: [excited] Aye boss mon, ya be back!
quest_40361_quest_complete: [excited] Dis be great mon, very great, and ya be sayin' ya can make dem big too? [warm] Ah dis be da greatest haul we got in a while now, great job mon, great job. [warm] Here be some coin for da troubles, [proud] I be takin' dem statues and dat ray now.
quest_40362_quest_detail: [solemn] On a cold and rainy night you decide to once more look at the notes as they remind you of your own first haul. [soft voice] As you reminisce about the past you also remember the wish you've had to find a historian or someone knowledgeable enough to aid in the future.
quest_40364_quest_progress: [soft voice] I see that you have something on your mind. [pause] Speak freely.
quest_40364_quest_complete: [solemn] I have never heard such a strange tale and I struggle to believe it to be true. [soft voice] We have never known the centaur to be anything but beasts seeking our extinction. [hesitant] If she is yet true to her word, perhaps I can assist.
quest_40365_quest_detail:
[solemn] While we have received vague rumors of the centaur that strikes at her own kind, [commanding] striking at our enemies is not enough to earn our favor - not for a centaur. [soft voice] She must show a respect and understanding toward our traditions and customs in a way that centaur are incapable.

[urgent] Venture to the northern prairie across the lake and acquire pelts from the prairie stalkers. [warm] Bring them to her, she will know what to do if she is true to her word.
quest_40366_quest_progress: [solemn] You've returned. [soft voice] Was she sincere in her words?
quest_40366_quest_complete:
[soft voice] These pelts are of even finer quality than I expected, <name>. The enchantment is almost as if it is naturally woven into the fabric itself and will serve to protect newborns through the harsh change of the seasons.

[solemn] We will not deny Kherra the opportunity to prove herself further to us. We understand there is more to her than the average centaur. It will take time for her to be welcome in Bloodhoof Village, but I have to wonder... are there more like her?
quest_40367_quest_detail:
[excited] Hail adventurer! You look like you can carry yourself in a fight. My colleagues and I ran into a bit of a pickle, you see. [solemn] This is Bael Modan, a facility built by a powerful race that disappeared eons ago. According to some scholars, these Titans had a hand in the formation of our culture.

[pause] We were trying to open the door in the main chamber when a horrible screech echoed through the digsite. [shouting] Dozens of statues we dug up came to life and went on a rampage. [angry] Those golems have no archaeological value when they try to kill you if you get near them. [urgent] Get in there and smash them up so we can carry on our work.
quest_40367_quest_progress: [commanding] Is it done <race>? [angry] These constructs killed some of my best diggers. [urgent] I want them turned to rubble!
quest_40367_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. I hope this helps put my kin to rest while ensuring the safety of the survivors. [warm] Don't worry, their sacrifice was not in vein. [solemn] Now we can continue the excavation and learn more about the Titans and this site.
quest_40368_quest_detail: [pause] Pardon me for taking a moment of your time, wanderer, but I would ask you to help me honor someone as it is a special time of the year. [solemn] Four years ago, my commanding officer and dear friend Jennalla Deemspring perished to the hand of Arthas Menethil. [soft voice] It is time to remember her and others like her. [gentle] Please collect six sprigs of Auribloom from the village and the surrounding forest.
quest_40368_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done, <race>? [soft voice] The Auribloom should not be too difficult to find.
quest_40368_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <race>. Four years ago my commanding officer ordered me to escort a caravan of villagers out of Lordaeron. I remained with them as they settled here and built Hawk's Vigil. [solemn] Arthas himself had returned to Lordaeron to lead the genocide of his own people.

Many perished to give us a chance to escape, Jennalla among them. [pause] With the incense produced from the Auriblooms, we honor their memory.
quest_40369_quest_detail: Fascinating... [soft voice] I wonder if such changes may cause other creatures in the food chain to be affected. I think it is a matter worth studying further! [urgent] But for that I would need samples of something larger... Ah, crabs! [excited] Yes. [solemn] I believe we could find something new if we study those crustaceans.
quest_40369_quest_progress: [soft voice] As scary as those pinchy crawlers may look, they tend to run away from you faster than you can catch a fish. [hesitant] Have you gathered any parts we could study further?
quest_40369_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, what a lovely haul this is! [excited] Look at these samples! [excited] Fascinating! [hesitant] Wait... [surprised] What's this? [soft voice] Ah, it seems you have found yourself a small companion! [gentle] Perhaps you should study its behaviour before you decide on your favourite seasoning.
quest_40370_quest_detail:
[excited] Hello! You look strong and I need the help of someone like you!

[soft voice] I am Krilana, mama Eliza is taking care of me because my real mom has become a star in the sky. [solemn] She has told me everything I know about my family. [soft voice] In one of her stories, mama mentioned a necklace that my papa gave to my real mom as a sign of their love, but it was lost in the shipwrecks by the northwestern coast of Gilijim isle.

[hesitant] Except for mama's stories I have nothing to remember my parents. [hesitant] Could... could you please look for the necklace? [soft voice] I heard that it was pretty and that it looked like the sun! [sad] I wanted to go and look for it myself, but mama won't let me: she says that ghosts haunt the place.
quest_40370_quest_progress:
[soft voice] I like stargazing at night. [soft voice] I know my mom is looking at me and I don't want her to think I've forgotten her.

[hesitant] Did you find her necklace?
quest_40370_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it! [warm] Thank you, thank you, thank you! [delight] Woooah, it really looks like a sun! [excited] You're my new best friend!

[soft voice] There aren't many children here besides me, so I feel lonely sometimes. [warm] But with this necklace, I can be brave like my mom and dad.

[proud] They were sailors and one day I'll be a marine just like mama Eliza!
quest_40382_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you must know, our moonwells are very sacred to us.
