[sad] Having such a well corrupted is considered a great offense to Elune. [hesitant] Unfortunately, even with our constant vigil, this can happen.

[soft voice] A twin set of moonwells exists outside Eldre'thalas, known to many as Dire Maul.

While one well remains pure, the other was defiled by Ogres.

[commanding] Help me cleanse the moonwell and bring those responsible to justice, and I will present your case to the High Priestess herself.

[whispering] I will wait in the shadows until you arrive. [urgent] You shall have to guard me until the ritual is completed, as it will require my full attention.
quest_40382_quest_complete: [solemn] An exhilarating experience. [soft voice] Let us agree to avoid these perilous ventures from now on, yes? [hesitant] Jests aside, you have my gratitude. [warm] And as promised, I will do my best to help you with your case.
quest_40385_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come. The Kaldorei fleet has arrived and is making its final preparations, and the Theramore fleet should also be ready. [urgent] Find a Theramore officer and board the ship as its vanguard.

There is no doubt that the Scourge will attack as soon as they see us, and having you onboard will undoubtedly improve our chances. [commanding] Go and do what you must for the Alliance!
quest_40385_quest_complete: [solemn] We have been waiting for you. [urgent] We are ready to depart, on your word, but make sure you bring all the necessary equipment. [commanding] There is no telling what awaits us there.
quest_40386_quest_detail:
[angry] This is a disaster! No matter how many we slay, they keep coming!

[urgent] Our Rangers will secure the ship and provide ranged support, but we need your help before they overrun us!
quest_40386_quest_complete:
[solemn] With the beach secured and our fortifications up, we have finally made a first step in reclaiming these lands. [hesitant] But we need to be careful. [soft voice] Their commander mentioned someone named Lord Dar'Khan.

Could he be their leader? And why does that name feel so familiar? [urgent] Anyways, we won't get much from overthinking. [commanding] Let us wait for the rest of the reinforcements before continuing our campaign in Quel'thalas.
quest_40387_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is done... With the initial attack repelled, we can properly set up the defenses. With the Rangers, the Magisters, the Druids, and Moon Priestesses, we're more than capable of holding this isle until the fleet arrives.

Once the Rangers and Magisters have disembarked, we will return to Alah'thalas. [soft voice] I take it you can send word to Speaker Windrunner?
quest_40388_quest_detail:
[solemn] Opening the envelope reveals the symbol of a large skeletal boar as well as reference to a mighty crone. [soft voice] You recognize some of the names mentioned, but can't place the details.

[pause] This information could concern more than just Durotar, perhaps Gar'Thok would be interested in it.
quest_40388_quest_progress: [soft voice] You look troubled, <name>. [solemn] Tell me what bothers you.
quest_40388_quest_complete: [solemn] My suspicions confirmed, they are far more cunning than I gave them credit for. [urgent] This does not seem to be over, <name>. [warm] Thank you for getting this information to me. [urgent] I'll send a runner to Orgrimmar and Far Watch Post right away to make sure they hear of this Death's Head.
quest_40389_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you don't require assistance from my assistant, could you please do our tribe a favor? [soft voice] Our chieftain, Vol'jin, remains in Grommash Hold, providing counsel to the Warchief as he grapples with several losses he has suffered since leaving the Darkspear Isles.

[urgent] Take Zalazane's head to Vol'jin, assuring him that his people are primed and ready to share in his burdens.
quest_40390_quest_detail:
[solemn] Through hard fought victory, you stand above the fallen centaur warlord and before the corpse can run cold, you take a trophy as proof of your battle.

[urgent] Someone in Sen'jin Village would be interested in this.
quest_40390_quest_progress: [soft voice] What do you have there, <class>?
quest_40390_quest_complete: [solemn] The Kolkar have proven a long-standing threat to our people since settling on these shores, but it appears they will trouble us no further. [warm] Your victory over the centaur today is just one step closer to securing Durotar from local threats.
quest_40391_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our new homeland has suffered greatly from threats of all measure since the founding of Orgrimmar and making our home upon Sen'jin Village, and this major step must be shared with our allies in Thunder Bluff.

[soft voice] When we first landed on these shores, we found the Kolkar leading the attack on the tauren and have since learned of their suffering under their raids. [solemn] With one less threat in Durotar, we can begin to look to our frontiers.

[commanding] Now go, share proof of your great victory with the High Chieftain of Thunder Bluff.
quest_40395_quest_detail: [soft voice] You find this book in an awful condition. [pause] After some inspection, you make out the title of the book: "Guide to a Sailor's Stomach".
quest_40396_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is Cookie's cookbook, it's how I taught him to understand our tongue and how to make a somewhat decent meal.

[sad] I tell you, I am not sure if it’s because he's a Murloc or not but he barely has a taste for flavor.

[sigh] I am getting off the sails here.

[solemn] The night the ship sank, Cookie fled, leaving all of us to perish. [pause] I almost forgot!

[hesitant] I guess my mind gets foggy nowadays, not that I still have a working brain or a consciousness, mind you.

[angry] That motherless Murloc must pay for this bloody mutiny. [commanding] Bring me proof of his death and I will reward you handsomely

[soft voice] Perhaps I will even be able to move on...
quest_40396_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I can't believe he didn't toss this away.

[sad] In my anger I might've mistaken Cookie’s actions, he was always a scared catfish. [hesitant] He must've panicked.

<Grayson sighs for a moment> . [solemn] Drying the book, keeping this necklace...

[sad] Oh <name>, what have I done.
quest_40397_quest_detail:
[solemn] This forest used to be bristling with life; it was my home once. Now, it is nothing more than a twisted abomination, a ruin of the beauty that once lay here. [sad] Those whom we once called brothers have played a big hand in the corruption of this land.

[solemn] The Satyr can be found all across Felwood, lurking amongst the ruins and thinking of ways to further spread their corruption. [angry] I hate them with every part of my being, and I have killed many. [commanding] You will assist me in the slaughter.

Bring me 60 horns of these beasts. [solemn] Once you have retrieved them, I will know that you are capable of what is to come.
quest_40397_quest_progress: [low voice] I grow impatient, [angry] have you dispatched the mongrels?
quest_40397_quest_complete: [solemn] You have removed the taint of demonic influence from this world. [proud] Their vile schemes will not come to fruition, take heart in that.
quest_40398_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven to be a potential ally, and such allies are rare in these parts. [soft voice] If you truly wish to earn my favor, there is something you can do.

There is an elusive satyr named Pustax, a warped mockery of his previous name no doubt. [angry] He has caused much destruction and death in these parts, and has personally slain members of my family. [commanding] I need his head; he has lived for far too long. [solemn] He is known to lurk between Shatter Scar Vale and Irontree Woods, so start your search there. [urgent] Bring me what I desire.
quest_40398_quest_progress: [solemn] Each day we must stay vigilant to combat the growing darkness.
quest_40398_quest_complete:
[solemn] This has been a long time coming, I would have never imagined this monster would be removed from this world so soon.

[warm] You may have the potential to follow in my footsteps, given your prowess in tracking demons.
quest_40399_quest_detail:
[solemn] If we truly wish to restore Felwood to its former state, then we must do more than what we have been doing. [sad] I have been fighting against corruption endlessly, but with seemingly no progress.

[urgent] I desire an artifact that was stolen from me many months ago. [hesitant] I came into contact with an orc named Ulathek, who kept his intentions hidden from me. [low voice] Despite his use of shadow powers, he seemed well-versed and willing to assist me.

[angry] He stole from me a gemstone of great power, which I want back to use for the greater good of this region. [commanding] This orc now lingers among the cultists and demons of Jaedenar within Shadow Hold, the Barrowden they have corrupted.
quest_40399_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you removed this deceitful orc from the world, [urgent] have you recovered my Gemstone?
quest_40399_quest_complete: <A smirk creeps across Niremius' face as he glances upward and nods his head..> [solemn] At long last, I have the gemstone. [warm] I thank you greatly.
quest_40400_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done me a great service in retrieving this artifact from the demonic worshippers. It will be better served in my hands, rather than to serve evil.

While I may have used you to further my own goals, I am not a traitor, and I will make it worth your while now that you have achieved what I desired. [confident] I will forge a Glaive in my namesake for you, one that can slay all that oppose you, especially those of the Burning Shadow. However, I will not part with such a weapon so easily.

I require one last exchange. Deep within the Sunken Temple are the guardians of the Green Dragonflight, corrupted and twisted from their long slumber in the Emerald Dream. One of their defenders, Hazzas, is one whom I knew long ago. He is a powerful being and should not be tormented any longer.

[urgent] Bring me his heart, and free him from torment. Only then will you earn your reward.
quest_40400_quest_progress: [solemn] There is taint all across Azeroth, can you feel the world itself calling for aid?
quest_40400_quest_complete: [solemn] The Heart of Hazzas. [warm] You are more resourceful than I anticipated, <race>. [excited] Now, as promised, let's forge your weapon.
quest_40401_quest_detail: [solemn] The only thing left is to imbue the blade with my mark to give it the necessary power for its intended purpose. [soft voice] Allow me some time to concentrate and channel my energy, and only then will the blade be ready.
quest_40401_quest_complete: [solemn] My work is done, as I have promised, a Glaive worthy of my namesake. [warm] Use it well, and keep Azeroth safe.
quest_40406_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello mon!

Another beautiful day in the marsh, right? Some of the ogres here dislike it, but Balai sees great potential in the marsh.

Many plants and creatures to harvest from for potions and poisons. [solemn] No better place Balai says.

Do you wish to do Balai a favour? [urgent] Balai pay nicely. You will need to venture into the marsh and find Withervine Mire Beasts, kill them, bring me the core and you get paid.

The Mire Beast core can be a strong poison if altered properly, the Warchief said not to touch the humans of Theramore but if they come too far, [threatening] Balai will know how to deal with them!
quest_40406_quest_complete:
Perfect mon.

[soft voice] This will make for great poison, Balai makes the poison and dips darts in it. Balai uses this small wooden thing to shoot darts at the enemy, with poison!

[solemn] Small little things can kill you, the marsh teaches, think about the mosquitos. And here's your reward, [warm] it will help you one day.
quest_40407_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been years since the invasion of the Burning Legion during the Third War, and while they have been defeated, they still hold much sway upon Azeroth. [soft voice] Demonic magic is extremely potent, and it is something I have been tasked with studying.

[pause] In the region of Desolace within an area known as Mannoroc Coven there is quite a sizeable demonic presence. [emphasis] It is there that I ask of you to acquire a Mannoroc Demonic Sigil, finding one may be rare, but if we are to have a chance to defeat the Burning Legion, then we must know all that we can.

[urgent] Slay them, and bring me one of their sigils for study.
quest_40407_quest_complete: [solemn] The power coming from this sigil is quite strong, and will prove useful for study, thanks again for everything you have done <class>, [warm] I will make sure it is put to good use in defense of the realm.
quest_40408_quest_detail:
[sigh] Say, since you stopped by how about we have ourselves a nice meal, it's been a bit since I've been able to enjoy my special recipe! [angry] I damn near hunted all the Darkfang in the area, so you'll have to venture further out into the swamp to go and get me some of their juicy legs!

Five should do, the Darkfang spiders are practically everywhere in the swamp, but especially so around the Quagmire down in the south west.

[urgent] Oh, and make sure they're extra juicy, I won't take no dang-nabbit unjuicy spider legs now, yahear?
quest_40408_quest_progress: [urgent] Ye wrangle up them spider legs? [soft voice] Remember to get the extra juicy ones.
quest_40408_quest_complete:
[excited] Why look at this here, you out done yourself, truly! [warm] I haven't seen some dang-nab spider legs this juicy in a few years now, they've been getting extra fat down there!

[delight] Now we can have a real good meal!
quest_40409_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've lived at this lighthouse for a long time now, and if there is anything that has bothered me most it's those damned Mirefin. [angry] They often venture deep out within the ocean and upon the shorelines to the north, but as of recently they have come down here if only to drive me mad and steal my things!

[urgent] The Theramore Guard cannot have someone staying here full time, especially with us being seperated by a boat ride.

[commanding] I ask of you to rid me of their annoyance, and for good. [hesitant] I feel like its only a matter of time before they do something more serious. [commanding] You can find them all along the coast up to the north and on small little islands. Bring me twenty of their claws and thin out their numbers so they think twice before coming so far south.
quest_40409_quest_progress: [soft voice] I advise you to be careful when you're fighting them, they tend to stick together.
quest_40409_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, I cannot thank you enough for what you've done, [warm] with less murloc around it means I can do my job in peace without having to constantly watch the waterline.
quest_40410_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was about a week ago now when the damned Mirefin raided my Lighthouse and got off with all manner of supply I had been building up. [angry] A few weeks of food rations and some tools, but most importantly oil for the Lighthouse!

[emphasis] The Lighthouse in Theramore runs from oil collected in other parts of the world, and of which we only get a shipment in at the start of every month, without it, the Lighthouse will die out. [soft voice] I do not need to tell you how vital this Lighthouse is especially for a port city like Theramore.

[commanding] I ask of you to gather it back from the Mirefin Murlocs, no doubt they have it stashed among their hovels up to the north west, make sure to check the isles there, they practically infest them.
quest_40410_quest_progress: [urgent] Every minute that burns away is a minute less that we have.
quest_40410_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, this is it, and it's still sealed, I would have expected those dumb creatures to pry it open, or use the oil to make a big fire or something, it seems they couldn't figure it out, or hadn't gotten around to it yet.

[warm] Thanks again for the help, you may have saved my hide here!
quest_40411_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, how it is to be docked and not sailing the vast, and boring sea for months on end. [pause] All this time to myself and some dry land to stand upon, I just wish I had one thing.

[hesitant] I have a contact out in Steamwheedle Port that has been my hookup for a while now, and if you wouldn't mind picking up a special 'package' for me, it would be much appreciated!

[warm] At the port there is a goblin named Jabbey, he can almost get you anything you need, that is if you have the coin for his 'premium wares' he calls it. [commanding] Head out there, and pick up a package for 'Groy' he'll know what I'm looking for.
quest_40411_quest_progress: [soft voice] I've been waiting patiently, have you gotten it yet?
quest_40411_quest_complete: <Privateer Groy practically snatches it from your hands, a wide grin upon his face.> [soft voice] Ahh, its been a while... a long while. [hesitant] I suppose you want something in return for running all that way. [warm] Here, some coin to cover the trip. [gentle] If I ever need more I'll let you know, heh.
quest_40412_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You wouldn't mind running a delivery would you? I got one that's a bit overdue, and that's mostly because my main delivery guy got reassigned back to Stormwind.

[urgent] If you don't mind a bit of dangerous trekking, I got a crate of goods that needs to be sent to Jarl out at Swamplight Manor. It shouldn't be too hard to find, just follow the road northwest out of Theramore, keep going for a while after Sentry Point Tower until you see a small dirt pathway that leads to the right.

Once you see it, you'll see it, Jarl usually leaves a bunch of torches lit, just- don't startle him, the guys a bit... [hesitant] Quirky.
quest_40412_quest_complete:
[delight] What's this? For me?

[excited] I've been waiting a few weeks for this, didn't think it was even coming anymore! [soft voice] I don't go to Theramore much, but that yokel Lorman almost made me march down there I been waitin' so long.
quest_40413_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey there, I'm in need of assistance if you don't mind giving some. [hesitant] I have a delivery I need run to the Theramore Lighthouse to Old Bryan that resides there. [urgent] His food delivery has run a little late and I need it to get to him as soon as possible.

[gentle] You can find the Theramore Lighthouse just off the coast to the north east, the bright shining light should be enough to guide you.
quest_40413_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, about time, I hate having to ferry to Theramore for a meal!
quest_40414_quest_detail:
[solemn] The local murlocs are becoming more, and more of a threat as time continues, they are no longer confined to just the depths or the shore, and are often seen traveling inland, or harassing locals.

[commanding] They are led by a large, foul beast named Marglum Blood-eye, a hulking abomination of a murloc that patrols the coastline to the north-east shoreline.

[urgent] Find him, and bring his head to me, and I will make sure you are rewarded.
quest_40414_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you slain the foul monster?
quest_40414_quest_complete: [solemn] This may not be the end of the murloc threat, but this will no doubt slow them down. [warm] Thanks again, as promised.
quest_40415_quest_detail:
[commanding] Hey there, you look tough enough to handle yourself, and Theramore is in need of some assistance. [urgent] My last runner was ambushed on the roadway, and suffered a rather grevious wound. [solemn] If we want to keep our defence of the roadway through Dustwallow then we need to remain steadfast.

[emphasis] As such, I haven't received the weekly reports from both Sentry Point, and North Point.

[commanding] I want you to report to Captain Wallace Cross at Sentry Point Tower, and Captain Harker at North Point Tower, and bring their reports back to me.
quest_40415_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten those reports yet?
quest_40415_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, thanks for gathering these reports, [warm] its good to hear news from the frontier, even if some of it is bad, [warm] take this coin as thanks for the work.
quest_40416_quest_detail:
[solemn] I once came from the city of Stormwind, and traveled to Kul Tiras, that was before the fleet ventured here, to Theramore. [sad] Ever since me and my brother have been seperated and while I have heard good things about him, and his business I haven't had any opportunity to deliver a letter, especially being stuck here at my post.

[soft voice] If you ever find yourself in Stormwind, would you mind stopping by The Silver Shield in the Old Town of Stormwind? [warm] My brother Bryan is the one that runs the place, and it would mean the world to me if you could run him this letter.
quest_40416_quest_complete: [solemn] Well, I must say, this is the last thing I had expected to come into my shop, [pause] I haven't heard from Wallace in some time, [sad] not seeing family certainly makes you miss old times.
quest_40417_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While you are still here, could I ask of you a favor? I desire to send my brother something that perhaps can assist him. As much as he down plays his work in Theramore, I do know from stories I have heard that the swamp is crawling with all manner of orc and dragon.

I had a fireheated shield made some time ago, and haven't had the chance to sell it yet, I would much rather that it gets to him out there, then to sit in my shop and collect dust, aside, there is no finer gift I can give.

[urgent] Take this shield to him out in Dustwallow Marsh, it would mean quite a lot to me.
quest_40417_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, you have delivered the letter then? [soft voice] How did he like it?

[pause] Wait, he sent this? [warm] Truly this could have fetched a noble's wage in gold, I must thank you for not being a brigand and making off with it, I shall use it with great honor.

[warm] Thanks again, for all you've done. [proud] <name>, take this coin for all the traveling you have done.
quest_40418_quest_detail:
[solemn] With each passing week the roadways get more and more dangerous. Nature here is ever encroaching, always looking to gain more and more ground. [urgent] If we want to keep our forward sentries supplied then the road to Northpoint must remain secured.

Our biggest threat is currently the Bloodfen Raptor's that have been breeding to the north of us.

[commanding] If you could find a way to rid Northpoint of this threat, I would see to it that you were paid accordingly, I am sure Theramore could find a way to reimburse your troubles.

[urgent] Head to the north, and slay the Bloodfen Screechers you find there.
quest_40418_quest_complete:
[solemn] Now that those raptors have been culled we may be able to make more supply trips out in the swamp without worrying so much.

[warm] I took it upon myself to gather a payment for you on behalf of Theramore, it may not be much, but all help should be rewarded.
quest_40419_quest_detail:
[urgent] Soldier, we need you.

[solemn] A Few weeks ago I sent a small expeditionary force south, to Blasted Lands. [sad] I haven't gotten a word from them since. [commanding] Go there, and see what happened. [emphasis] I ordered them to set up a camp in proximity to the Dark Portal, if it helps.
quest_40419_quest_progress: [low voice] Ruag sent you? [hesitant] I didn't expect him to hire a search party that soon.
quest_40419_quest_complete:
[solemn] We have our hands full of work. [sad] I wasn't able to spare any of my men to send the report back to Stonard.

[urgent] But since you are here now, you might be able to help us with the matters at hand.
quest_40420_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have no presence in Blasted Lands. The Alliance, on the other hand, occupies a large fort north of our current position. They haven't interrupted our operations in the region.

Yet. [urgent] I need you to check what are they planning. There has been a lot of movement lately in a cave close to Nethergarde. See what is happening there. Try not to kill too many of them. We don't want an open war with the Alliance.
quest_40420_quest_complete:
[solemn] A mine of extraordinary size, you say?

[warm] Good, I will write about it in the report. [soft voice] We still have other issues to worry about before I send this off, speak with Jaiymu and Bagaroh for more tasks.
quest_40421_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Shadowsworn cultists have been giving us a hard time here. [urgent] In the last two days we faced three attacks from them. [hesitant] They were weak, and we managed to fend them off. [soft voice] I fear that in the future, they will send a bigger force.

[commanding] We need to act quicker. [urgent] Venture into the wasteland, find their strongholds, and thin their ranks. [urgent] Buy us more time.
quest_40421_quest_complete: [delight] Good job, <class>. [whispering] I wish I could've seen them dying.
quest_40422_quest_detail: [solemn] In the northwest corner of Blasted Lands, an old Altar of Storms looms over the wastes. [low voice] Around it, elite soldiers of the Shadowsworn gather. [hesitant] I was never able to get closer to them, but with your strength, it should be an easy enough task. [commanding] Kill them, and interrupt whatever they do.
quest_40422_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the Altar of Storms?
quest_40422_quest_complete:
Hah, good job again.

[warm] Thank you, friend. [proud] Thank you for all you do for the Horde.
quest_40423_quest_detail:
[angry] Do you know what is the worst here? Not the heat, not the demons. Not even the alliance, sitting comfortably in their castle. [angry] It's the ogres. Why ogres? Because I hate them. And that’s a reason good enough.

[commanding] That, and of course, they are a danger to our mission.

[urgent] Bring me twenty ogre heads. Of any ogre, I don't care. [proud] I will personally write about your victory in the report.
quest_40423_quest_complete:
[solemn] Twenty heads. [proud] I rarely smile, but you earned it.

<Bagaroh grins>

[urgent] Time to get back to work.
quest_40424_quest_detail:
[solemn] Thanks to your actions, we have been able to rest for a while. [soft voice] I also wrote the report for Ruag. [urgent] Deliver it, and remind him to send some booze too next time he thinks we need help.

[commanding] Blood and honor, friend. [proud] You helped us and the horde today.
quest_40424_quest_progress: [urgent] It's you! [angry] What happened to the expedition?
quest_40424_quest_complete:
<Ruag glances over the report> .

Great work, soldier. I am relieved to hear that the expedition is safe. I am also impressed. You did a lot of work, good work. [warm] Please, pick some equipment from our armory. Whatever you like.

Stay safe, soldier.
quest_40425_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long has it been rumored that the mystical ninth volume of the Arcane Intricacies and Magical Phenomenon has been stashed deep within the Stormwind Vault. [soft voice] So long has it been gone that it has almost become legend, the secret -lost- tome.

[urgent] Well, it is a secret no longer, and it needs to be recovered before some vile vagrant gets their hands on something so rare.

[solemn] Within Stormwind Vault lays this book, it needs to be recovered so that I can complete my records of it.
quest_40425_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you delved within the depths of that accursed Vault, and recovered the rare tome? [hesitant] Or is it still collecting dust with chance of desecration?
quest_40425_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My my... [excited] This is it, the rare volume! [excited] I never thought I would lay my eyes upon it!

[warm] You've done us a great favor in getting this, and favors should always be repaid.

[solemn] On behalf of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences, I present you with this.
quest_40426_quest_detail:
[solemn] Back when the Vault first was opened, it was used to house the most dangerous prisoners, to contain magical entities and the insane alike, we used Runic Constructs to patrol the hallways!

[urgent] These Runic Constructs have fallen corrupt from the intense magic within the Vault, and need to be destroyed, their powerful bracers are what keep them intact, and they need to be recovered! [soft voice] I have plans to test what exactly went wrong with these bracers.

[commanding] You can find them within the Stormwind Vault, slay them, and bring me a pair of Shackles, I will make sure you are rewarded for the task.
quest_40426_quest_progress: [whispering] Be careful, the Runic Constructs are quite powerful, [urgent] an overchage of magical energy gone rampant!
quest_40426_quest_complete: [excited] Ahh, here we are! [warm] This is them, thanks again, this means a lot, here, just as I promised.
quest_40427_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many years ago the wizards of Stormwind discovered a large crystal that held an intense amount of magical energy. This crystal we named Arc'Tiras, and stashed it deep within the Stormwind Vault after many mishaps with the unstable magic it emitted.

[hesitant] Little did we know this crystal, Arc'Tiras had a mind of it's own.

It has driven the guards mad, and turned the Stormwind Vault into nothing more than corridors of madness. [urgent] Our magic is enough to hold the crystal at bay, for now, but it needs to be destroyed, and for good.

Travel into the Stormwind Vault, put an end to this madness.
quest_40427_quest_progress: [urgent] The longer Arc'Tiras remains active, the more danger Stormwind lays within, [solemn] we cannot have rumors spreading, [commanding] this must be dealt with.
quest_40427_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, truly?

Why, thank you <name>, you've saved us a massive headache, and countless lives of this city. [warm] We have requisitioned a reward worthy of such feats from the treasury itself.

[gentle] Please, take one, it is the least we can do.
quest_40428_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey you, do you think you can help?

[solemn] The Garrison Armory is nothing more than a trogg infestation. [sad] A trogg infestation that claimed the lives of twelve workers. [pause] It was one of the last dangers we ever expected to face, but when they came in, they came in fast.

[commanding] The dead need to be avenged, and the mine needs to be cleared out for our own security.

[urgent] The miners and I have collected enough coin to pay for someone to do the job right, go in there and clean it out good, don't show them mercy.
quest_40428_quest_complete:
[solemn] The dead will not be forgotten, but at the least we have avenged their deaths. [warm] Thanks again for everything that you have done.

[proud] Take this coin, it is from all of us.
quest_40429_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Garrison Armory is a place Nethergarde has stored extra supplies for some time now, and before long there will not be anything left if the troggs trample, and destroy it all.

[urgent] I need you to go in there, and recover atleast ten Garrison Armory Supply Caches, that way when this mess is over, and the dead are buried, we can return to work, and still have the tools to do so.

[commanding] Venture inside, and see if you can recover them for me.
quest_40429_quest_complete: <Foreman Tanoth lets out a heavy sigh of relief.> [exhale] Well, that gives me some breathing room. [soft voice] It seems like you got to the Caches before the troggs mindlessly trampled over them, thanks for the hard work, I'm sure it wasn't an easy task.
quest_40430_quest_detail:
[angry] Ogres, oh how I hate em! [angry] If it aint demons then it's ogres!

[solemn] The Dreadmaul came with the orcs during the First War, and they've been a sore on these lands ever since they arrived. [solemn] They are responsible for a lot of the dead and they need to be dealt with.

[urgent] We currently have a bounty on their skulls, bring me thirty of them, and I'll give you something worth your time <class>.

[urgent] You can find the Dreadmaul to the west, and southwest, goodluck!
quest_40430_quest_progress: [urgent] You got them skulls I asked for?
quest_40430_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, someone of action I see, you remind me of a young Harguf, bashin' skulls and the like, here, as I promised.
quest_40431_quest_detail:
[commanding] Lookin' for some work eh? Well we got a bounty on those Shadowsworn cultist types if you're interested. Not sure when they started coming around, but more and more of em been gathering over the last couple months.

[hesitant] Now I don't know a thing about dark magic, but it certainly isn't good! If you don't know where to look, search in the south, and southwest, you'll find them quick!

Collect me twenty of their pendants, and come back, I'll see to it that you get something worth the effort.
quest_40431_quest_progress: [soft voice] Any luck on collecting them pendants?
quest_40431_quest_complete: [excited] Well, look at that, you do some good work, well, as I promised, here you are.
quest_40432_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Garrison Armory is a disaster, many of our miners have been slain, and troggs run loose destroying our progress.

[urgent] If work is to ever continue there, we must do more than kill some troggs, we must cut the head off the beast, and slay their leaders.

[commanding] The troggs that took over the Garrison Armory go by the name 'Boulderclaw' and are led by two big monsters named Kroshmak and Gorlush.

[urgent] Travel into the depths of the mine to the west, and slay their leaders, bring me one of their claws as proof.
quest_40432_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you avenged the dead, has the mine been reclaimed?
quest_40432_quest_complete: [commanding] You have done Nethergarde a great service, I must thank you for the hard work. [warm] Without you, who knows how long we would have had to wait until we could flush them out.
quest_40433_quest_detail:
[solemn] Nethergarde is an isolated, and rather desolate place. [soft voice] We rely on a large garrison to help stem the tide of a potential demonic invasion, should such an occasion ever occur.

[commanding] The soldiers under my command have homes and families, and morale here is paramount. [low voice] I rely on my sergeants to give me a situation report on the status of those beneath me.

[pause] As of current the only one I am waiting from is from Sergeant Burnside, [hesitant] would you do me a favor, and collect it from him? [urgent] You can find him somewhere outside the gate, he is probably with his troops.
quest_40433_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found Sergeant Burnside yet?
quest_40433_quest_complete: <The Commander would take some time to look over the situation report.> [solemn] I see, well thanks again for your work, [urgent] I don't have all day to look for everyone, take some silver for the trouble.
quest_40434_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has come to my attention that a dark magic has been growing in power within the region. [soft voice] Our Analyser Wigglestip has documented an extensive amount of magic being introduced into the area.

[solemn] There is no doubt that the Shadowsworn would be the ones utilizing such forces. [commanding] Those that gather around the Altar of Storms are to blame, and our reports only confirm that.

[urgent] I need someone to dispatch of the Dreadweavers that spread the corruption. [solemn] Who knows what plans they have in motion, but I do not intend to sit around to find out.
quest_40434_quest_progress: [solemn] The defense of Nethergarde requires us to be steadfast.
quest_40434_quest_complete:
[solemn] I must commend you for your work, I am sure many of those here are relieved to have one less threat be waiting at the doorstep.

[warm] I have gathered a suitable reward for the work you have put in, may it help you on your journey.
quest_40435_quest_detail:
[excited] The energy radiating off of the Dark Portal is sheerly astounding, and it's given me so many research opportunities that I do not know where to start! [soft voice] I was employed here as an analyst to watch the ever shifting arcane magic within the region, and its incredibly unstable, so unstable infact that it has warped the boars close to the portal itself, turning them into 'Helboar'!

[chuckling] I know it sounds like something straight out of fantasy!

[urgent] I need you to get me a Pristine Helboar Brain, to see just how much the creature has been altered by the intense energy of the Dark Portal.
quest_40435_quest_progress: [low voice] Twenty eight, carry the seven, account for arcane disturbances... [soft voice] Oh- it's you, [hesitant] have you had any luck?
quest_40435_quest_complete: [gentle] Ahh, this is a fine specimen, [pause] take long to find?
quest_40436_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you there, I need your help.

[solemn] About a week ago on one of our patrols we ended up being attacked by a group of ogres, these ogres were fierce enough to make us retreat. [sad] During the struggle one of my Private's was captured by the Dreadmaul.

[hesitant] I don't know where they have taken him, but I want you to find him, I can't risk any more of my soldiers on such a mission.

[commanding] If I was you I would search their camps, both to the west, and southwest, he may be in one of them.
quest_40437_quest_detail: [solemn] <The corpse of the soldier appears to not have any marks of identity, you are sure that the mark on the neck is indicative of an amulet being removed, there is no doubt that the identification of this soldier is in the hands of one of the nearby ogres, [urgent] you feel obligated to retrieve it, and return it to Sergeant Burnside at Nethergarde Keep.
quest_40437_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found anything, or any clues?
quest_40437_quest_complete:
<Sergeant Burnside would let out a quiet sigh> [solemn] I feared it would have come to this, it always hurts to lose someone, especially those under your command. [sad] I will forever wonder if there is more I could have done to save a life.

[warm] Thank you <class>, for risking your own safety to let us know the truth.

[proud] Take this amulet, I am sure Holson would respect it being in your hands after delivering this news.
quest_40438_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Why, you wouldn't happen to have some spare time would you?

[soft voice] The master of this tower has been hard at work and has given me the task of gathering a report from Engineer Wigglestip. [sad] Sadly to say, I haven't had the opportunity to leave just yet, nor do I know how to find our gnomish friend!

[urgent] Do you think you could speak with Wigglestip and gather the report from him? [solemn] Once you've obtained it, you can bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba at the top of the tower.
quest_40438_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, can I help you?
quest_40438_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So that is why you are here, [pause] this is the report from Wigglestip yes?

<Mahar Ba would take the report, beginning to read it with caution.>

[pause] Interesting...
quest_40439_quest_detail:
[solemn] Well, this news certainly reinforces my assumptions, and what I have been studying. The Blasted Land's has become even more unstable, the energies within the region are beginning to grow in power.

[urgent] I have been preparing a report that I need delivered to my superior's in the Kirin Tor, and I need you to deliver it at once. Communication at such a distance is impossible with the raging storms so I am relying on you.

Travel to Dalaran at once, and deliver this report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
quest_40440_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you travelled to Dalaran, and spoken with Ansirem Runeweaver?
quest_40440_quest_complete: [solemn] It is as I feared, [sad] the magical energies are that of fel.
quest_40441_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Riftwatchers and myself have much work to do in our studying now that we know what is happening. [urgent] I will need you to assist and gather some items from the demons nearest to the Dark Portal.

From the Felguard Sentry, and Felhounds, we will need to analyze to see if these demons are fresh from the portal, in doing so we need specific items.

From the Felguard's, gather Felguard Cuffs, from the Felhounds, gather Felhound Claws.

[commanding] Once they are obtained, return them to me, at once, three of each should suffice.
quest_40441_quest_progress: [urgent] Have the items been recovered yet <class>?
quest_40441_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good work, now, let us see what mysteries these may contain.
quest_40442_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have spent many months studying and preparing for the future, and it appears the future may be upon us sooner then we had realized.

[pause] There is one I have not spoken with for a long, long time. [soft voice] An old friend who once studied within the Kirin Tor, lost to the ways of demonic, and dark magic.

[solemn] I will simply say that he owes me a favor, and I ask of you to reach him, so that he may answer my questions about the Dark Portal and the irregularities of the magic in the region.

[urgent] Travel to the Southwest, and venture within the Tainted Scar, find Daio the Decrepit, an old warlock who resides there, ask him if he knows anything, [emphasis] I would suggest bringing a friend, or recruiting mercenaries, it is a dangerous place there.
quest_40442_quest_complete: [low voice] So.. Mahar Ba sent you, did he?
quest_40443_quest_detail:
[low voice] Heh.. He has a question, does he?

<The old, withered man lets out a crooked laugh, a wiry smirk resting upon his aged features.>

I haven't spoken to Mahar Ba in a long, long time, if he wants information, than I need something done, favor or no favor!

[urgent] If you want to know the truth, than I require something from you.

[solemn] Within the Tainted Scar lies a secretive race of demon, the Dreadlord, I have been meaning to practice all sorts of magic and I need a singular heart. [commanding] Bring me a Dreadlord Heart, and I shall tell you what I know.
quest_40443_quest_progress: [excited] Yes yes yes, [urgent] do you have my heart?
quest_40443_quest_complete: [solemn] A Dreadlord Heart, oh how I desired, and needed one. [warm] You've done me a real favor, I shall answer your question.
quest_40444_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, he desires to know about the Dark Portal, and the influx of fel energy? [urgent] The demon's have been gathering for some time around the Tainted Scar, and have been using it as a safe haven close to The Dark Portal.

[solemn] With the increase of Fel Energy, there is no doubt that they have plans for the future. [hesitant] This future though, may not come for some time given what I have heard.

[commanding] Go to Mahar Ba, and tell him to gather the best of his kin, and to prepare himself, time ticks slowly.

[low voice] Now, begone, I have repaid his favor.
quest_40444_quest_complete:
<Watcher Mahar Ba would look on with a slightly concerned look.> [solemn] We must begin to prepare, and keep the magical energies stable, [soft voice] you have given us a great deal of information, and without you we would have been unable to figure out these clues and unearth the answers we need for our future.

[warm] The Kirin Tor thanks you greatly for what you've done, please, take one of these rewards, it is the -least- we can for how much trouble you have saved us.
quest_40445_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello there traveler, and welcome. [solemn] There is something that I must ask of you to ensure the safety of the wyvern here at the Roost.

[pause] Wyverns are creatures that roam and explore, it is not something that we can control, though sometimes the wyverns venture too far, and into the claws of harpies.

[solemn] The Windfury Harpies have gotten so bold as to organize scouting groups for wayward wyverns, and already we have lost one this past month. [urgent] If we are to continue and keep our training, young wyverns safe, then we must take action.

[commanding] Far to the north and the north west are Windfury Sorceresses and Matriarchs, they are the ones that need to be removed. [emphasis] Go there, and make certain the welfare of our wyverns.
quest_40445_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck, child?
quest_40445_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your actions have eased this troubled mind. [soft voice] We can now be more free with the wyvern and let them truly grow within this world, and for that, I must thank you.

[warm] Take this, as a symbol of my thanks young one.
quest_40446_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Bristleback are a ruthless and uncaring tribe of Quillboar, who expand their territory and domain without care for diplomacy or good will. [urgent] They have recently attacked Suntail Pass, causing the Spirit Walker's that reside here to vacate the cave just to the east.

[sad] In battle they ended up wounding me, luckily Elder Pyrestrider came to my rescue, and we both escaped their wrath.

[solemn] If Suntail Pass is to remain a safe haven for travel, and for the Spirit Walker's to remain in peace, then the Quillboar must be eradicated.
quest_40446_quest_progress: [solemn] The Bristleback hold incredible disregard for nature, [urgent] have the Quillboar been dealt with?
quest_40446_quest_complete:
[solemn] With your assistance Suntail Pass is made much safer for travel.

Perhaps now the Quillboar will have learned a lesson, and the Spirit Walker's can resume their tasks in peace.
quest_40447_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Quillboar expunged us from our sacred cave and vantage points overlooking the expansive Mulgore. [soft voice] It is not the cave itself I am worried about, but many of the ceremonies that must be held in the next few days to help pass the dead into the realm beyond.

[pause] Left behind in the Quillboar's rampage are tools, and charms that we will need to reclaim for the upcoming ceremonies, and I need you to get them for me.

[solemn] I lost the following items just to the east, A Silver Hawk's Feather, Ornate Spirit Beads, and the Drum of Passing.

[urgent] Recover them, and help the dead ease their way to the afterlife.
quest_40447_quest_progress: [solemn] Without the proper instruments, we cannot conduct our ancient rites and passages.
quest_40447_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have been expecting you, it seems that you were sent to aid us at a time of dire need. [soft voice] The spirits have sent you to aid me, and now I must aid you for your help.

[warm] Take this, on behalf of the Spirit Walker's for allowing us to conduct what must be done.

[gentle] Go now, and walk softly friend.
quest_40448_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It's been a few weeks now since we've had to send Brian away to live with some cousins of mine in the city. It's not the safest place, but it's much safer then around here, especially with all of the defenders around Gallant Square.

[sad] I've had a lot of worries since he left, and I just want to make sure he is okay. [warm] I've prepared a lot of things to send to him so he feels a bit more comfortable during his stay, do you mind running them out for me, and making sure he gets them?

[gentle] You can find him in Stromgarde, in Gallant Square, the part of the city that is under construction.
quest_40448_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, can I help you?
quest_40448_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, hello there, this is from mom? [warm] I miss her quite a bit, but it's nice seeing family! [gentle] The city is kind of fascinating too.
quest_40449_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy friend!

[soft voice] We have been dealing with all sorts of problems ever since we first started settling here, from raptor, to giant spider, to ogre!

[commanding] Chaser has done well enough with scaring off the local wildlife but they have just gotten too aggresive as of recently, from trampling on our fields to even fighting with us. [sad] It's gotten so bad infact I had to send my son into Stromgarde until things calmed down.

[warm] If you could clean up some of the critters, that would go much appreciated for me and my wife. [urgent] About ten of those Plains Creeper's and ten more of the Highland Thrasher's should do just fine.
quest_40449_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you had any luck just yet?
quest_40449_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, well my my, you've really outdone yourself for us. [warm] Perhaps now we can finally get a plentiful harvest in for the season, here, take this, as a token of my thanks, its a spare.
quest_40450_quest_detail:
[gentle] Say there, you wouldn't happen to know anyone that knows a thing or two about engineering, would you? [soft voice] We picked up Chaser from Southshore about a year ago now, from a goblin merchant infact. [hesitant] He's been great, but, slowly he's been breaking down, or getting kinda slow.

[pause] I was told that he would need a backup Gold Power Core at some point, and I think that might be what the issue is. [urgent] The problem itself though is that we're so far out here, and I don't really know much about engineering to craft one, or have the resources on hand infact! [warm] If you could get one, I'm sure Chaser would be quite happy.
quest_40451_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been a while since the Troll Hunter's of Stromgarde have had the chance to practice their trade. [soft voice] We have been confined defending our section of the city now for too long, under constant threat.

[low voice] Our main enemy is biding their time, and gathering their strength. [solemn] The trolls have been at war with us for generations. [solemn] My fathers, their fathers, and even their own have fought troll.

[commanding] We will strike at them, to show them that Stromgarde will not lay down idle. [urgent] Far to the east is Witherbark Village, go there, and kill ten Witherbark Shadow Hunters.
quest_40451_quest_complete: [commanding] You make Stromgarde proud, [solemn] the less trolls, the better for our ultimate survival.
quest_40452_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have received information of a battle that took place in the troll city of Zul'Rasaz, or what is left of it anyway. [soft voice] Deep within the hills to the north, hidden away is a troll city, destroyed by conflict and time. [low voice] It would appear the Witherbark fought and defeated the Wildtusk.

[commanding] Go there, and thin them out so that they cannot harm us down here in Stromgarde.
quest_40452_quest_progress: [low voice] It may be hard to find the pass, but I am sure you will do what is neccesary.
quest_40452_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, much better than I would have expected. [warm] Take this, as a thanks.
quest_40453_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ogre's have caused us much headache, and have taken a section of the city from us. [urgent] The last thing we need is more forces coming from outside of the walls to assist those that are within.

[low voice] To the north just outside of the city is Boulder'gor, a small outpost that is an ogre sanctuary. [commanding] I need you to go there, and bring the fight to them, so that more do not come pouring into the city.

[warm] Bring me twenty Boulderfist Truncheon's as proof, and Stromgarde shall reward you.
quest_40453_quest_complete: [solemn] The Ogres are a mighty foe, and although you've done excellent work, I fear it will not be enough. [warm] Here, as I promised.
quest_40454_quest_detail:
[pause] A few weeks ago I had a ring commissioned from Old Farwell up at the Farwell stead far to the north. [solemn] Old Farwell was once a prominent, and powerful wizard of the Kirin Tor, one who is now retired.

[soft voice] The ring is supposed to safeguard against the foul, and dark magic lingering within the city.

[pause] You can find the passage way on the north western corner of the Arathi Highlands leading into the mountains where his Stead is located.
quest_40454_quest_complete: [hesitant] Do I know you, is there something that I can help you with?
quest_40455_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, Sergeant Karster sent you? [pause] Well, it's good getting some work from time to time, my magical abilities haven't been tested for a while now.

<Old Farwell produces a small, ornate ring, with a glowing violet gem.>

[solemn] This ring should ward off any magical energies or foul tainting aura. [warm] Make sure you give my best to Sergeant Karster.
quest_40455_quest_complete: [solemn] Old Farwell has done a lot for us. [warm] Thank you for delivering this ring, it should be just what we needed.
quest_40456_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey you, <race>! You look like the sort of cultured individual who likes knowing what goes on in the world! Well, I'm a trainee saleslady for the goblin owned Gadgetzan Times Newspaper! We cover only the biggest and explodiest stories around!

For just a few silver you will be known as an… ally of Gadgetzan, yes! And with also the useful tips and tricks within the pages, well, just imagine all the profits you can make for such a tiny investment now! <She waggles a rolled up newspaper towards you.>
quest_40456_quest_complete: [excited] Enjoy, enjoy! [delight] I will record your name in our super duper subscriber log!
quest_40457_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey you, <race>! You look like the sorta cultured individual who likes knowing what goes on in the world! Well, I'm a professional saleslady for the Gadgetzan Times Newspaper! And you know us goblins, if it ain't worth its weight in gold, it ain't worth coverin'.

For just a few silver you can have your name written down as a supporter of the newspaper, and a friend to goblin business. [urgent] And with the information inside, you can profit beyond your wildest dreams! [warm] All that for such a tiny investment purchase. <She smirks and holds out the newspaper towards you.>
quest_40457_quest_complete: [gentle] Wise purchase, pleasure doin' business with ya. [warm] Your name has been recorded in our subscriber logs.
quest_40458_quest_detail:
[solemn] Alright, the lookout reports just came in. [soft voice] Seems the ol' brotherhood isn't alone outside anymore. [low voice] The reports indicate that the Shadowforge are setting up something at the other side of the mountain, a quarry of sorts. [hesitant] What they're digging is a mystery though, as nobody goes inside never gets out alive unless they're with them.

[urgent] That's where you come in. [commanding] Gather your friends or some mercenaries and venture into that quarry, find out what they are digging up out there. [shouting] Now go!
quest_40458_quest_progress: [urgent] All attempts to sneak in have failed, their hounds can smell everything.
quest_40458_quest_complete: [shocked] This... green liquid is what they're brewing there? <Overseer opens the flask and takes a sniff.> Och, its quite acidic! [sigh] This is certainly very concerning, if it the mere smells burns your nose hairs I shudder at the thought what it does to flesh. [solemn] I will warn the others about this, [proud] you've proven yourself to be capable to the brotherhood.
quest_40459_quest_detail:
[commanding] You want to help us out do you? [solemn] Well we need to know we can trust you, after all, we have many enemies in this region, and most regions of the world, probably.

[urgent] You can start by gathering Thaurrisan Badges, carried by the Dark Iron in the Ruins of Thaurrisan. [emphasis] Gather 15 of them, and bring them to Orvak Sternrock, he will know you mean business then.
quest_40459_quest_progress: [low voice] What is it you want <race>?
quest_40459_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm, so you're the real deal huh, no way you're working with Shadowforge anyway.

[solemn] You never can be certain, they have an alignment with the Twilight Hammer afterall.
quest_40460_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Not often we get someone wanting to help, especially one of your kind. [solemn] That said, we aren't all too able to turn down a willing hand, especially given all of the others that died in our caravan.

[emphasis] I need you to understand my point of view, and what I have gone through. [pause] Maybe you'll think twice before you label me as another of my kin.

[gentle] Speak with me, and listen to my story when you're ready.
quest_40460_quest_complete: [solemn] Does it all make sense now? [soft voice] Orvak Sternrock has a vengeance, one that needs to be unleashed.
quest_40461_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you understand we are on the same page, and are fighting the same enemy [commanding] I would have you prove to me one last test of loyalty.

Before we can begin our grand revenge, I must plan for the future.

Long ago, before I held any position of power I buried a large stash of items and gold incase I ever needed to leave or escape, well that time has come.

[urgent] If me and my comrades are to live this adventure than I will need that stash.

Travel to the entrance of the Blackrock Mountain, and search beneath the bridgeway, between the two pillars, you will find the stash there.
quest_40461_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you recovered my lost items?
quest_40461_quest_complete:
[solemn] With this our future is secure, but I will not leave until I taste the sweet sensation of revenge.

[proud] I will let the others know that you are to be trusted, speak with them, they should have tasks for you.
quest_40462_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Miners Union betrayed the High Foreman, and sentenced those that were loyal to Orvak into slavery. [urgent] There is no other step than justice and it must be handed out to any, and all who remain!

[commanding] To the east lays the Hateforge Excavation, we will begin by dealing with the Excavators who are working on a series of redoubts and defenses leading into the Quarry.

[commanding] Slay 10 of them, and return to me.
quest_40462_quest_progress: [solemn] We are on the road to justice, can you can feel it?
quest_40462_quest_complete: [low voice] It feels good knowing that there are less of those scum on this world, but there is still more to be done.
quest_40463_quest_detail:
Bargul Blackhammer.

[angry] That vile scum has been working to get the position of High Foreman now for years, attempting every underhanded tactic that he could think of.

[low voice] From violence, to deceit, nothing was off the table for scum such as him.

[solemn] The idea of the Hateforge Quarry was an idea Bargul came up with, and sent to the senate. [solemn] He ended up convincing the lot of them, and worked in tandem to get me outed from my position.

[sad] Bargul Blackhammer holds my title now from a position of underhanded fraud, and I want him to hold it no longer.
quest_40463_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you culled that wretch from this world yet?
quest_40463_quest_complete: [solemn] Also, take this key, I do not intend to return to the mountain. [low voice] It should open a chest within the Black Vault, if they haven't already taken it away.
quest_40464_quest_detail:
[solemn] Shadowforge was once a home that I was proud of. I know the truth of what it really is now, and it is vile, and corrupt.

At it's heart many of the decisions the Shadowforge Senator's make are only to further their own interests at the expense of the people who live within.

[urgent] I ask for a favor, one more important than anything to me.

The Shadowforge Senate needs to be rooted out, they are safe, and comfortable deep within the city, make it so they feel fear.

[commanding] You can enter Shadowforge deep within the Blackrock Mountain, go there, and brave the Blackrock Depths to find them, and kill them.
quest_40464_quest_progress: [solemn] Has the deed been done, has the senate been removed?
quest_40464_quest_complete:
<Orvak would let out a small chuckle of enjoyment.> [solemn] The hatred instilled deep within me has begun to cool, the fire that once raged on has eased.

[proud] It fills me with vigor to know they met their end.

[sad] I know deepdown that Shadowforge can never be saved, regardless, I thank you.

[soft voice] I will not be needing this any longer, for I do not intend to return, perhaps you may find some use for it.
quest_40465_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hey there, I got a strange request for you if you don't mind helping. [soft voice] I used to be an Arcanasmith within Shadowforge and worked with all kinds of Golem Cores.

[sad] My loyalty to ol' Orvak got me tossed out with the rest of the miners. [urgent] Whenever we get out of this here camp I want to continue my work and I'd like a head start.

[emphasis] Up to the north are the Ruins of Thaurissan. [commanding] The Dark Irons there have War Reaver patrols, which are powered by Golem Cores. [urgent] Get me three of them, so we can see what kind of power they contain.
quest_40465_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck in obtaining those Golem Cores?
quest_40465_quest_complete: <Radgan would take his time inspecting the cores.> [low voice] Flaws, cracks, hmm.. [sad] These are some second rate power cores, not the type of stuff I am looking for.
quest_40466_quest_detail:
[solemn] Well, I have the cores now. But they are as useful as pebbles, as I don't know what to do with them. [urgent] I have a new task for you, if you're willing to accept.

[soft voice] There's this goblin I know, Jabbey, that lives in the Steamwheedle Port. [confident] I am sure he has some sort of information about arcane golem cores.
quest_40466_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you spoken with Jabbey?
quest_40466_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hey look, it means a lot for you to travel all that distance for me, [warm] I made it worth your while in coin, now lets see...
quest_40467_quest_detail:
[solemn] This information contains all manner of suppliers, distributors and who is involved, it appears Argelmach is the one who would hold such an item.

[soft voice] If I am to ever get my hands on an Arcane Golem Core, it would be through him, and that means I need you to get it.

[urgent] You can find Argelmach deep within the Blackrock Depths, he is usually seen around a team of weapons experts and Arcanasmiths.

[warm] Bring me a Arcane Golem Core, and I will make it worth your while!
quest_40467_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you ventured deep into the Blackrock Depths?
quest_40467_quest_complete:
[excited] Look at the sheer power within this thing, it is much more advanced than what we used to work on in the Mold Foundry, this is intense.

[warm] You've done me a great favor, and now perhaps I may actually have something to work on when we get out of here.

[proud] I reconfigured one of the Golem Cores you got me from the War Reavers, hopefully you'll get some use from it!
quest_40468_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now we will strike at the heart of the Miners Union.

[commanding] Their main project lays just beyond the excavation, and deep within the Quarry. [low voice] It is there they began their mutiny to get Orvak removed, and it is there they will feel the wrath of Morgrim Firepike.

[warm] Oh, and his mercenaries, of course.

[urgent] Head to the Hateforge Quarry to the east, and kill twenty of them, they shall have consequences for their actions.
quest_40468_quest_progress: [solemn] Justice grows ever closer, you can practically feel it.
quest_40468_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well by me, and truly made them bleed. [warm] Justice has been served, and their work has been slowed tremendously. [proud] I would like to offer you a reward for all of your hard work, take it, as a herald of justice, you deserve it.
quest_40469_quest_detail:
[solemn] Oh, how the name 'Vilegrip' brings a burning desire for blood to my head. [angry] His name has rung deep in my mind ever since the mutiny.

[solemn] Slaver Vilegrip is responsible for the enslavement of all those that stood with Orvak, those who now rot deep within the Blackrock Mountain.

[commanding] He shall pay for his crimes, and you will bring me his head. [urgent] Search for him, he should be at the Hateforge Excavation to the east. [threatening] Make sure he begs and cries for the atrocities he has commited, make him suffer.
quest_40469_quest_complete: [solemn] It is about time Vilegrip got what was coming to him, even if he deserved torture. [warm] I prepared a reward for you incase you returned, and here you are, take it.
quest_40470_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mysterious animation runes... [hesitant] I've been trying to get my hands on one, but as a shopkeep, I ain't exactly suited to fight mechanical monsters.

[soft voice] I work for a... certain someone who is investigating the harvest golems in Westfall. [urgent] If you could recover a rune, I'll make it worth your while!

[commanding] You can find them in any harvest golem in the region.
quest_40470_quest_complete:
[delight] What a fine specimen! A little cracked, but this should work just fine. [solemn] My client is trying to get to the bottom of what caused these golems to go haywire, and he needs all the samples he can get.

[warm] I have another task for you, and I'm willing to spare some coin for your trouble if you're interested.
quest_40471_quest_detail:
[excited] Alright! [commanding] Eager for additional work, aren't we?

[soft voice] So, my... employer is looking for even more animation runes for his experiments. [urgent] Bring me an additional ten runes, and you will be greatly rewarded. But, be careful. They will accept only intact runes. Try not to damage them too much with this weapon of yours.

One more thing. Don't get yourself killed. Those harvest machines pack a punch, and I need you to run more errands for me.

[chuckling] Hah, I'm joking. [solemn] But seriously. [gentle] Take care of yourself.
quest_40471_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected the runes already?
quest_40471_quest_complete:
[excited] Good job! And all of them are of extraordinary quality, too! [warm] I didn't think that you could do it, to be fair. [soft voice] The last adventurer helping me... let's just say, he got harvested, if you know what I mean. [warm] It's great to finally have someone who knows what they're doing.

[gentle] So, would you want to help me once more? I need something else to be done, and I cannot leave Sentinel Hill for now. [hesitant] You know, I'm waiting for a shipment of supplies from Redridge and it could arrive any moment.
quest_40472_quest_detail:
I knew you wouldn't pass another opportunity to earn some coin. [soft voice] Ever been to Stormwind City?

Oh, what am I saying, of course you have.

[pause] In the northern part of the city, there is a district inhabited mostly by non-humans. Dwarves, gnomes, even high elves lately.

One of my dear friends, a gnomish engineer with a lovely name: Lilliam, lives there. [warm] I need you to tell him that Hewen sent you.

He will give you a paper: a blueprint, even. [emphasis] You know what a blueprint is? Good. So, take the blueprint, come back to me, and I will pay you.

[commanding] Easy enough! Good luck.
quest_40472_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it? Don't you see, <race>, that I am kind of busy?
quest_40472_quest_complete: [angry] Hewen sent you? This son of a trogg couldn't even visit me himself? [shouting] Preposterous! I got his blueprint, but if you knew how much hassle it cost me! [emphasis] If you only knew! Tell Hewen that next time he orders something from me, he pays double!
quest_40473_quest_detail: Here you have it. [soft voice] The Harvester Blueprint. The goblin, who sold it to me... [angry] I wish I never see his green face again! [sigh] Bah! I looked into these blueprints. [hesitant] I don't know for what Hewen needs it, but it is nothing good, I tell you! [commanding] This is a machine of death and destruction! [warm] I am only giving you this, because he is my old friend and I... [hesitant] hope he still has some brain left in his greedy head.
quest_40473_quest_progress: [excited] Ahhh, <name> already! [urgent] You got the paper?
quest_40473_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Harvester Blueprints...

<Christopher Hewen looks into the blueprints and makes a disgruntled face.>

[soft voice] To be frank, my hard-working friend, I don't understand any of it! But it doesn't matter, as I am only the messenger, a humble servant. Those papers are for my employer, who, if you are willing, you will meet soon!

I would deliver them myself, but, believe me or not, those damned supplies have still not arrived! [hesitant] Also, traveling through these beautiful, golden plains became so dangerous lately. [confident] I am certain that you can handle it, though. [warm] Care to help me for one last time, friend?
quest_40474_quest_detail:
[commanding] Okay, listen then. I need you to bring this blueprint to a man named Maltimor Gartside. [emphasis] Maltimor. Gartside. Got it? Good.

[soft voice] He's an old man, in his fifties, maybe sixties. Long, gray hair, kind of skinny, pale skin. Hard to miss, you will know it's him. [pause] Yes, he's my employer. And yes, I know where he lives.

[hesitant] Wouldn't want you to scour through all of Westfall, of course. [urgent] Go west of Sentinel Hill, but north of Moonbrook. He lives in a solitary cottage, usually spends his time outside of it. [pause] Don't know why, didn't ask, didn't care. [commanding] So, you meet him, tell him I said hello and give him the blueprints. [excited] Easy! [urgent] Also, please, be careful. [solemn] It is very, very important that those blueprints don't fall into the hands of those bandits with red bandanas, the Defias, as they call themselves. [soft voice] Light be with you, friend.
quest_40474_quest_progress: [hesitant] Who are you? [urgent] What do you want from me?
quest_40474_quest_complete: [soft voice] Blueprints from Hewen, finally. He couldn't be any slower with it. Let me see what is written inside...
quest_40475_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me for my bad manners. [excited] I was so excited to lay my hands on those blueprints. [solemn] Never have I seen these lands in such a sorry state. [angry] And it is not only because of the Defias!

[soft voice] You see, years ago a salesman arrived in Westfall. [soft voice] He brought new commodity - Harvest Golems.

[warm] Farmers were overjoyed. [soft voice] Golems worked flawlessly, gathering crops and scaring the wildlife away. [soft voice] So more golems were being purchased. [solemn] In a few years, they outnumbered the farmers. [solemn] And then, it happened.

[solemn] Golems turned on their owners. [solemn] In a few weeks, almost all farms in Westfall were lost. [sad] And to make matters worse, the Defias arrived. [solemn] It was only natural that the people of Westfall linked the sudden change to the Brotherhood.

[confident] I believe that it is a mere coincidence. [urgent] Someone else manipulated the golems and now the Defias are using the situation to their advantage.

[soft voice] I will continue the story later, <name>. [warm] For now, I have a request. [urgent] Go to Moonbrook. [urgent] The smith had a stash of engineering equipment hidden in his forge. [urgent] Check there!
quest_40475_quest_complete: [solemn] Engineering tools. And they are all still intact. [surprised] Unexpected, but a welcome surprise. [warm] Now I have all we need.
quest_40476_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] I have all materials to create a new Harvest Golem. [soft voice] If my calculations are correct, I should be able to rewire his mind.

[urgent] I need your help. The Harvest Golem will be hostile at first, and the Rewiring Spell requires all my concentration. [commanding] I need you to draw the golem's attention until I'm finished.
quest_40476_quest_progress: [solemn] The golem needs to remain intact for this to work.
quest_40476_quest_complete: [urgent] So the person who may manufacture the runes lives close to Darkshire. [urgent] We need to hurry then; there is no time to waste. [warm] Tales of your exploits have probably reached him already.
quest_40477_quest_detail:
I did indeed promise you the rest of the story. [pause] So where did we pause? Oh yes, the arrival of the Defias.

Very soon, they started producing Harvest Golems on their own. [solemn] How they managed this is a mystery to me; I have my suspicions though. [soft voice] It requires a powerful mage to produce an Animation Rune, far beyond the level of the parlor mages The Defias possess. I suspect they are working with the person who turned the golems hostile in the first place. Their original creator.

[commanding] I will handle rewiring the golems of Westfall. It will take months, maybe years, but it will be done. [urgent] However, the Defias can still easily produce new ones faster than I can rewire them. We need to halt their production. [confident] Fortunately, I know where we can find the shipments of Animation Runes.

Go to the Jangolode Mine and Gold Coast Quarry. The Defias hide their runes deep inside, awaiting transport to their underground foundry. [soft voice] Bring them to me.
quest_40477_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you retrieved the Rune Shipments?
quest_40477_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You found the note attached to one of the crates? But it's all written in gibberish? [hesitant] Don't worry, we will figure it out.

[solemn] For now, we need to handle another problem.
quest_40478_quest_detail:
[solemn] The goblins of Defias produce harvest golems deep inside their underground hideout. [soft voice] The People's Militia in Sentinel Hill have been trying to find its location lately. [hesitant] Maybe they have discovered its whereabouts. [urgent] If not, they will probably need your help.

[commanding] Once you are inside, find the workshop and slay the mechanics and their greatest creation. [solemn] This will stop their manufacturing operations for good.

[pause] In the meantime, I will reach out to Hewen. [confident] If anyone will be able to decipher this note, it's him, or at least one of his contacts.
quest_40478_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the Defias hideout?
quest_40478_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Deadmines... Interesting. [soft voice] I'm glad that you made it out alive. [commanding] With their leader dead, I can focus on rewiring the remaining golems.

[urgent] That, and finding the person responsible for all of this.
quest_40479_quest_detail:
[solemn] When you were gone, I spoke with Hewen about this mysterious note. It turned out, as I expected, that it is some kind of cypher. [soft voice] Worry not, as he recognized it. [urgent] Go back to Sentinel Hill and talk with him. He will explain it better than I can.

[solemn] Finally, we are getting closer to delivering vengeance upon those who wronged the people of Westfall.
quest_40479_quest_progress: [excited] It's you, <name>! [excited] I missed you! [soft voice] How's it going?
quest_40479_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Great job with these golems, stopping the Defias and whatnot. [warm] You and Maltimor did more for these lands than the People's Militia has ever done, and no one will know about your exploits…

[solemn] Such are the whims of history, pal. [commanding] But you didn't come here for a friendly talk, ay?
quest_40480_quest_detail:
So about this cypher... [hesitant] I cannot read it. But my dear colleague, Franklin Hamar, who lives in Lakeshire used the same cypher when trading with Defias.

[angry] Don't look at me like that! It was him, not me. [sad] I would never ever trade with these vile people...

Regardless, he will be able to read it for you. [soft voice] He will probably need some convincing, but you can do it for sure. [urgent] And since you are going to Lakeshire... [soft voice] could you please ask about my damn shipment?
quest_40480_quest_progress: [soft voice] I offer only the finest goods.
quest_40480_quest_complete:
[shocked] What? [urgent] Give me that.

<Franklin Hamar looks on the note.>

[soft voice] Yes, I can read it. [low voice] But everything has a price.
quest_40481_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I can decipher this for you, of course. [pause] But first: you say a word to any guard in the town that I can do this, you're gone. [commanding] And second: it will cost you. [low voice] You're lucky that I'm in need of an adventurer to perform some easy and simple tasks...

[soft voice] First, I need silk. [emphasis] But not any kind of silk. [soft voice] Spider silk bathed in moonlight, extraordinarily beautiful. [pause] Hard to get though. [solemn] Only found in Duskwood, to my knowledge. [soft voice] Bring me at least ten samples, we will see if it's good enough.
quest_40481_quest_progress: [urgent] Got the silk? I haven't got all day.
quest_40482_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Alright, you helped me well. [commanding] I will spare you running errands and just send you to do what you do best. [angry] Kill. Gnolls in the hills of Redridge have been giving me and other traders a hard time lately. [solemn] It's bad for business. [angry] I lost two shipments with rare materials this month only! [urgent] They probably still hoard them somewhere in their camps up north. [commanding] Check it out.

[urgent] I want you to look especially for one lost shipment - rare needles from Lordaeron. [emphasis] You will know when you see them.
quest_40482_quest_complete:
[solemn] Extraordinary. [warm] Great work. Those needles will serve me well. [soft voice] So thin, so durable. [pause] But I'm getting ahead of myself.

[solemn] I made a promise. [solemn] Let me decipher this message.
quest_40483_quest_detail: [soft voice] If I were you, I would go back to Westfall. [hesitant] This seems serious.
quest_40483_quest_progress: [soft voice] Finally, it's you. [hesitant] Were you able to decipher the note?
quest_40483_quest_complete: [urgent] So the person who may manufacture the runes lives close to Darkshire. [urgent] We need to hurry then; there is no time to waste. [warm] Tales of your exploits have probably reached him already.
quest_40484_quest_detail:
Venture to Darkshire, and ask the Night Watch about the whereabouts of F.W. [solemn] If he was right with his suspicions, they would know where to find him.

[soft voice] I pray to the Light that he still hasn't moved out of Duskwood.

[urgent] Question him, and if you find him guilty... [threatening] do not wait for Stormwind's justice. [angry] Kill him. [solemn] Avenge the people of Westfall.
quest_40484_quest_progress: [solemn] The Night Watch stands firm against the darkness that surrounds us.
quest_40484_quest_complete: F.W.? [hesitant] I know of no-one by those initials, but [soft voice] I have a hunch of who it could be, if what you told me is true.
quest_40485_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few months ago, a mysterious blind man moved into an abandoned shack south of Darkshire. [soft voice] A goblin accompanied him, helping him with everyday tasks in exchange for mentorship. He was a renowned engineer, of some kind.

[hesitant] Strange couple, that's for sure, though they professed to only be seeking shelter.

[low voice] With all our concerns across Duskwood, I was only able to spare a single Watcher to surveil their dealings, and what little I've heard has done nothing to quell my suspicions.

[urgent] If you venture there and find out what you can as you go about your errand, you would render a fine service to the Night Watch.
quest_40485_quest_complete: [solemn] The people of Westfall are safe. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [gentle] These lands will heal in time.
quest_40486_quest_detail:
[angry] Bah, what a wasteland to be assigned to, it's insulting.

[urgent] I want to get out of here as soon as I can, and to do so I need some work done, I take it you are willing to help huh?

[low voice] The Dark Iron are up to something, and it's my job to confirm that -something- is going on.

[commanding] What I need you to do is scout the entrance of the Quarry, and confirm Ironforge's suspicions.

[urgent] Travel up there, peek in the entrance, and come back, easy ye?
quest_40486_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you ventured up the ridge?
quest_40486_quest_complete:
[solemn] Hmm, so there is something going on up there.

[pause] Hold on just a minute, I got to write a report of my findings and send it to the highest authority.
