quest_40487_quest_detail:
<Senator Granitebeard makes quick work of writing his report, sealing it and stamping it with the seal of Ironforge.> [urgent] There, I need you to take this to Ironforge, at once, and report it to King Magni Bronzebeard, [solemn] it should hold all relevant information based off what I have seen, and what you have reported back to myself.

[commanding] Be quick, our enemies plot against us.
quest_40488_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, how did things go in the capital?
quest_40489_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would appear that The Hateforge Quarry is of great concern to the King, and he has given me the authority to recruit any on behalf of the kingdom.

[soft voice] If you are looking to gain favor with Magni then this should be a good opportunity.

[commanding] I am looking for anyone brave enough to venture deep into the Hateforge Quarry and remove the presence of the Twilight Hammer within. [urgent] If you are interested, I would suggest bringing fellow adventurers, a group of mercenaries, or some kind of brigade.

[solemn] If you end up completing the task, return to Magni, and he will reward you.
quest_40490_quest_detail:
[solemn] There be rumors floatin' around about somethin' called 'Hateforge Brew'. [soft voice] The Dark Iron refer to it as something with reverance, and I know they aint makin' no ale in there.

[urgent] The name is a cover up for somethin' else and we gotta find out just what that somethin' else is, ye get me? [low voice] I do know that they have chemists within the Quarry, and my bet is they are linked to this Hateforge Brew.

[commanding] I need you to head in there, gather me a Dark Iron Vial and some Hateforge Chemistry Documents. [emphasis] I bet they have them stashed away somewhere in there about what's going on.
quest_40490_quest_progress: [urgent] You get a whiff of what's goin on in there yet?
quest_40490_quest_complete:
[excited] Ahh, would you look at all this huh?!

Those crafty bastards sure were keeping their secrets, I'll make sure to send this back to Ironforge when I get the chance, and they can look everything over, nice job eh?

[warm] I got some extra Thunder Ale for you, oh and me ol' gloves, they should treat you nicely, I got a new pair.
quest_40491_quest_detail:
Greetings stranger, it seems some new recruits from this new Horde are arriving at last.

[solemn] I'll keep this short, we're not doing so well here. It's like everything is being held together by worg spit, and the lack of resources certainly doesn't help. [sad] I'll say it's about time we fixed that.

[low voice] Dark Iron tends to be quite scarce in the surface of the steppes, though it is carried by many. Whether it be baubles, equipment, or sitting in a creature stomach.

[urgent] Venture out and collect me a sizeable amount of scraps so I can keep forging equipment for our grunts to keep Karfang Hold safe.
quest_40491_quest_progress: [solemn] Hard times call for desperate measures, [low voice] knowing how to make do with what you have draws the line between life and death.
quest_40491_quest_complete: [delight] That's quite a haul, I'm impressed. [warm] Joining this new horde might not be so bad after all. [proud] You've scavenged so much I even have surplus to forge you an equipment of your choice. [warm] I believe you will wear it well.
quest_40492_quest_detail:
[solemn] Whelping, I need your assistance.

The Blood Fury itself remains untapped to its full potential. [low voice] Long has it been since we have followed the demons and worked in tandam with their magic to become stronger. [commanding] I intend to explore what may be possible without their help. My dark magic is practiced and ready for use, I simply need the correct regeants.

[urgent] This is where you come in. [solemn] Within the Burning Steppes are imps of a demonic nature, no doubt remnants of the burning legion. [commanding] Slay them, and bring me five of their scalding hearts.
quest_40492_quest_progress: [solemn] The Blood Fury burns within us, and needs to be strengthened.
quest_40492_quest_complete: [solemn] These shall do nicely, now. [commanding] Let us see what power they truly hold.
quest_40493_quest_detail:
[solemn] This region does not possess the potency that I am looking for, but I do know a place that does.

[soft voice] Far to the southeast is the Blasted Lands. It is where I came into this world, in awe by it's skies and the lush swamp. [sad] All that remains now is a hellish wasteland akin to what the Outland is.

[low voice] It is there that demons rove the land and the energies of the Dark Portal itself fester and pulse.

[commanding] Go there, and kill a Felguard Sentry that watches the portal, bring me a Large Felguard Heart.
quest_40493_quest_progress: [threatening] I will not wait forever, [low voice] have you done as I asked whelp?
quest_40493_quest_complete:
[solemn] This heart belonged to a powerful Felguard, one that desired to serve its masters tirelessly.

<Darkseer Geshtol would examine it carefully.>

[soft voice] It would appear there are no large flaws, this should work nicely. [warm] You've done well out there and have done well for us, I have gathered something you might find useful for all of the hard work.

[pause] Now... [commanding] Lets see what this is capable of...
quest_40494_quest_detail:
How disgusting.

You people dare call yourself the Horde, yet you know nothing about the Horde. [commanding] We are the True Horde, the first and the very best.

[angry] I see no thirst for battle in your eyes, I see no glory, I see nothing. [threatening] You're nothing more than a worm living in the legend of the real Horde.

[cold] You are lucky I promised Karfang to indulge fools such as you. [commanding] But if you truly want to not be a simple pest in the eyes of our clan you have to prove your skill as a warrior.

[urgent] Use whatever trickery you believe would aid you. [commanding] I challenge you to take on the Firegut Ogres, slay them and prove yourself.

[shouting] Now go or forever be shamed for your utter powerlessness.
quest_40494_quest_complete: [commanding] The stench of ogre blood bathes you <class>. [warm] You might not be useless after all.
quest_40495_quest_detail:
Fine, you've earned yourself the right to breathe the air in Karfang Hold.

[commanding] But I have one last trial for you. [angry] A grudge, yes, that's what this is.

[solemn] All the Blackhands were nothing but fools, the father was a misguided mongrel who was fooled by the wretched Gul'dan. [low voice] Maim isn't even worth mentioning, he died a fool's death, nothing more deserving for his kind.

[sad] And Rend? [threatening] Rend is kneeling before that despicable dragon and doomed the entirety of the Blackrock Clan. [pause] But that's not even his worst call yet.

He made a forest frog his strategist.

[angry] War Master Voone?

<Ok'gog yells that name angrily.>

War Master? [threatening] He's nothing but a disgusting frog that must meet his end. [urgent] Bring me his tusks and prove once and for all that the Horde led by a wretch who grew up amongst Humans has at least a quarter of the former glory of the True Horde.
quest_40495_quest_complete: [solemn] The arrogant fool lays dead. [soft voice] Ah to be alive <race>. [low voice] I tell you, hearing the demise of those you hate while you're still well enough to eat, drink and kill feels like the embrace of a cold and grim fate. [solemn] But we hold it into our arms with pride and we would never let go. [solemn] Such is life living under the Horde's name, we greet death with open arms and weapons ready.
quest_40496_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have fought in many battles, against the Alliance, orcs, demons, ogres... Yet I never expected to face my own clan.

My clan no longer. [pause] A few days ago I was patrolling the wastes on my trusty wolf, Skullshatter. I encountered Rend's soldiers. Before I could do anything, they attacked! I was outnumbered. I manged to escape, but they hurt my wolf. I thought it to be only a scratch, as he suffered worse many times. Unfortunately, the arrow was poisoned and he died a few hours later.

[sad] I do not mourn his death. [solemn] This was his purpose, after all. He joined his brothers and will now hunt among the ancestors. [angry] But I want revenge. [hesitant] If only I wasn't so severly needed here... <race>, go south of here, to the Pillar of Ash and slay as many Blackrock as you can. [commanding] Bring me their heads. Forty will do.
quest_40496_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you exacted revenge in my name?
quest_40496_quest_complete: [commanding] Good. [pause] I feel better now. [pause] Yet, there is still much to do.
quest_40497_quest_detail:
Good. Now, a new task awaits you. [solemn] As I said, I cannot leave this place. [low voice] Not until I have a new wolf. My legs are not as swift as they used to be in my youth.

[commanding] Steal one from the Blackrock. Here, take this cage. [urgent] Find a Young Blackrock Worg, capture it, and bring it to me. You can probably find a young worg in their stables in the Pillar of Ash. [confident] I will mold it into a worthy mount in no time.
quest_40497_quest_progress: [solemn] I have trained many worgs in my life. [soft voice] My first one, years ago, on Draenor...
quest_40497_quest_complete: [commanding] This one will do. [urgent] I will get to training them as soon I can.
quest_40498_quest_detail:
[urgent] Last thing to do. In the Blackrock Spire, they breed wolves. Go there, and slay the alpha. Gizrul the Slavener is his name.

[angry] Hit them where it hurts. [angry] Let them know my pain.
quest_40498_quest_complete:
I knew you had it. [solemn] You severely weakened the Blackrock Clan with your feat. Without the alpha, it will take years to rebuild their worg population.

[confident] Soon, I will once again ride to battle. [warm] Thank you, <class>. [proud] Take this, a gift from myself.
quest_40499_quest_detail:
Greetings, recruit of the new horde. [soft voice] I suppose you're here to aid? Then I got the task for you. [urgent] To the west of the hold you can find the deadly venomtip and deathlash scorpids, their body might be fragile but their venom killed many aspiring orcs. [solemn] I know how to brew an antidote to cure such ailments, but problem is that the antidote is made from the venom glands of the scorpids themselves.

[commanding] Go out there and collect their glands, if you survive your efforts will save many lives. [cold] If you perish trying then you'll be forgotten like the rest.
quest_40499_quest_progress: [solemn] Can never be too prepared in these hostile lands.
quest_40499_quest_complete: [solemn] It seems you endured their stings and lived to tell the tale. [warm] Many lives will be saved thanks to your work. [delight] Please accept what little I have as payment.
quest_40500_quest_detail:
[angry] Can't you see I'm busy? [soft voice] Oh, the whelpling wants to make itself useful, then I have the task for you. [urgent] Venture west near the doorstep of the Blackrock Mountain and you shall find the Blackrock Stronghold, where they prepare for assaults against those that would oppose their manipulative masters, truly fools to blindly follow them.

[commanding] Slay their battlemasters and retrieve the stronghold documents where they plan their attacks. [shouting] Now go and make yourself useful!
quest_40500_quest_progress: [urgent] I don't have time to chat when there are things to be done, so get moving.
quest_40500_quest_complete:
[commanding] So, you've done as I asked. [emphasis] Let's see what's in those documents.

<Molk takes the documents from you, and stares intently for a few seconds.>

[solemn] Well, this will surely put a hamper on their plans, the information here must have taken them a while to acquire, and without it they have no leads.

[proud] You are more useful then you look, whelpling.

[warm] Take this gold, as a thank you from myself.
quest_40501_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are from the New Horde, are you not? [pause] After much discussing it has been decided that we cannot remain within the Blackrock Clan, and are seeking for new refuge and alliances outside of our boundaries.

[commanding] On Behalf of Karfang I am tasked to make a request.

[urgent] This Karfang Missive must be delivered to the Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar at once, I trust that you can carry it to him.
quest_40503_quest_detail:
[solemn] I haven't heard that name in some time, though I certainly remember it.

Karfang fought with the Blackrock Clan during our invasion of Azeroth, and rose through the ranks quickly. From my knowledge, he was a strong warrior, though not as blood thirsty as others.

The Karfang I remember was smart enough to deny suicidal orders, or challenge leadership when required, I am not surprised he has lasted this long.

Karfang can be trusted, he is certainly wise enough to see the doom of the Old Horde before him.

[solemn] Thrall gives approval on my word take the Warchief's Response to Karfang Hold, we will see if he can prove his loyalties.
quest_40503_quest_complete: <Karfang looks out at the Warchief's Response, beginning to read with caution.> [solemn] So it appears the Warchief is asking us for a test of loyalty, [commanding] he shall receive his demands.
quest_40504_quest_detail:
[solemn] I know what it is the Warchief speaks, the Twilight Hammer has recently moved into the Hateforge Quarry, located just south of here.

[soft voice] It is an annoyance that was eventually going to draw in more attention from our former masters, and was something we would need to deal with eventually, now I implore you to help us with it.

[commanding] We may have the strength to fight deep, but to stop the Twilight Hammer lurking deep within the Dark Iron clutches, requires covert strength, not brute strength.

[urgent] As Warleader, I ask you to remove the Twilight presence on my behalf.
quest_40504_quest_complete:
[solemn] On behalf of everyone here, you have done us a great service in securing our future, entrance within the Horde means we may get out of this ashen wasteland eventually.

[soft voice] I have seen much in my time on Outland, and in the Blackrock Mountain, but I look forward in what is to come, and for that you have my gratitude.
quest_40505_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have had many join our ranks from the various battle groups dotted around the Burning Steppes, their names etched in paper marking their transfer to Karfang Hold.

[urgent] To protect those that joined us we will need to destroy the documents that may lead any suspicious Blackrock our way.

[commanding] You will find the Transfer Documents amongst the small camps around the Pillar of Ash, search high and low, and burn any you find.
quest_40505_quest_complete:
[solemn] The runts of our group will now be invisible to the Blackrock Clan, vanished from thin air with no trace of where they have gone.

[urgent] There is still work to do.
quest_40506_quest_detail:
[urgent] We will need to cover all of our tracks if we want to make it out of here alive. Karfang Hold is fortified, but not fortified enough to survive such an onslaught if they get wind of what is going on.

[commanding] Molk is my strategist, and should know our next move, speak with him.
quest_40506_quest_complete: [urgent] You will need to be prepared for what is to come outsider.
quest_40507_quest_detail:
[solemn] I hope you understand that we are using you for our benefit. Do not take this the wrong way, for we are not looking to con, or cheat you.

[soft voice] We simply require assistance to achieve our goals, goals that a Blackrock Orc cannot be seen doing, lest our betrayal be discovered.

[urgent] We need to destroy all traces of Karfang Hold, the records of its construction and garrison lay within the Blackrock Stronghold to the West. Gather these documents and return them to me so that I can make sure they are removed properly.

Be careful, it is a well defended location.
quest_40507_quest_progress: [commanding] If I were you I would suggest bringing backup.
quest_40507_quest_complete:
[proud] Picked through the bones have you?

<Karfang lets out a small laugh.>

[solemn] This would be what we were looking for, [warm] an excellent job outsider, [soft voice] Molk was expecting shoddy work from one of your kin, but you did well.
quest_40508_quest_detail:
[solemn] Raz'gol Deadtusk, the name makes me regret what is to come.

He was one of the first I told of my plot to depart from the Old Horde, a dearest friend from the days on Outland. [sad] He was too stubborn to accept, his loyalties rigid, and hard.

[pause] He will not be coming with us, and we both know what must be done.

[hesitant] It hurts me to ask it, but Raz'gol Deadtusk must be slain. [urgent] Should he find out that I went through with my idea his loyalties to me will be pitted against the Blackrock Clan, and I cannot trust him to hold to his word.

[commanding] You will find him atop the large spire in the Pillar of Ash, he looks down upon the region with an iron glare, slay him, and bring his blade back to me as proof of your deed.

[soft voice] <name>, do not make him suffer.
quest_40508_quest_complete: <A deep and heavy sigh escapes Karfang, his face full of emotion.> [solemn] I was always impressed with this sword and the way in which he wielded it, he fought with tenacity, and strength, he shall be remembered for it.
quest_40509_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is one crack left that can break everything apart. [low voice] His name is Zigris, Quartermaster for the Bloodaxe Legion deep within the Blackrock Spire.

[urgent] Upon setting out we borrowed all manner of tools and supplies to begin construction of Karfang Hold, these materials will eventually need to be collected. [emphasis] It will only be a matter of time until he will press to look for them.

[commanding] I am asking of you to slay Quartermaster Zigris, without him, there will be none who can figure out our motives.

[urgent] You will find him within the Blackrock Mountain, at Blackrock Spire's lower portions.
quest_40509_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you braved the Blackrock Mountain?
quest_40509_quest_complete:
<Karfang's old features begin to crack a smile.> [solemn] I cannot express my thanks, for this, and everything done.

<Karfang would remove a ring from his finger.>

[warm] This ring was taken upon my entrance to this world, from some noble human lord in battle.

[gentle] This keepsake is now yours, thank you.
quest_40510_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy there friend! Wanna hear a little story I was told from a friend? It's so crazy you wouldn't believe it!

[urgent] Aparently while she was venturing through the Burning Steppes she ran across a Black Dragonflight Whelp, which, isn't out of the normal, given just how many there is in the region. [shocked] When she ended up shooting it, no blood came out, just puffs of smoke, and whirrs of machinery!

[pause] Upon inspection it was discovered to have been a mechanical creation layered with replica skin, can you believe that?!

[delight] Now that sure is magnificent engineering, so magnificent it has fooled even the dragons. [soft voice] I'd like to see how it was done, if you wouldn't mind helping. [commanding] Get me six bundles of Robotic Broodling Guts from each one you find, that should be enough to figure things out.
quest_40510_quest_progress: [urgent] You found any of them fake whelps?
quest_40510_quest_complete:
[excited] Wow, this is complicated stuff!

<Masey looks baffled by the sheer complexity of the parts!>

[delight] This was truly a piece of art, no wonder those black dragons were fooled.

I'm gonna take some time to figure out how this stuff works, thanks again.
quest_40511_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah poor Eperius, she ran like the lightning and kicked like a mule. Since her wound from our last encounter with ogres she refused to eat anything and I fear the worst. [hesitant] Everything we tried has failed, but I have one last idea.

[soft voice] I heard rumors about a magical grain, its taste so sweet it gives your horse enough energy to gallop to Stormwind and back. [sad] Alas, its location was lost long ago and I don't have any leads on it.

[solemn] Perhaps someone in Refuge Pointe knows something about it. [urgent] You should check there. [gentle] While you're gone I'll make sure she is comfortable. [urgent] Please make haste as I don't know how much longer she can last.
quest_40511_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, welcome to Refuge Point. [warm] How can I help you?
quest_40511_quest_complete: [soft voice] A magical grain you say? [solemn] Its been a long time since I've heard about it.
quest_40512_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Magical grains huh? Well I'm the one that enchanted them long long ago. They were made to help the cavalry and help the livestock plow the fields faster and longer, but then tragedy struck.

[sad] The orcs invaded what is now known as Go'shek Farm and the entire stock of the grain has been lost since then.

If you're lucky you might still find a sack of it, presuming the orcs didn't get their filthy hands on it.

[hesitant] I wish you good luck and I hope we meet again one day.
quest_40512_quest_progress: [hesitant] I don't know how much longer she can last.
quest_40512_quest_complete: [excited] You found it! [warm] Her recovery will be slow but I believe she'll back on the road hunting trolls with our cavalrymen in no time. [proud] This is all I have in my pockets, even if not much you made this old handler happy today. [soft voice] Thank you.
quest_40514_quest_detail:
[warm] Warm greetings friend.

[soft voice] I am Meldralis, a diplomat. [solemn] I have been sent from the Farstrider Lodge to thank our forever friends, the dwarves, for their hospitality. [pause] We are preparing a gift for King Magni and his daughter, Princess Moira.

[soft voice] Alas, that is for Nel'doriel to explain. [urgent] He will probably need your aid as well! [commanding] My task is to give this pamphlet to Illyanah in Stormwind City. [warm] The Humans of Stormwind were kind enough to offer us a small place in the Dwarven District, we have called it Little Silvermoon.

[warm] Your kindness and help are highly appreciated, friend. [solemn] May the Eternal Sun guide your steps.
quest_40514_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, you bring news from Lady Meldralis. [warm] Much appreciated, friend. [soft voice] I am glad to know the diplomatic representative has made it that far through the mountains. [solemn] I am more than sure she will strengthen the bond.
quest_40515_quest_detail:
I just can't seem to get it to work! [urgent] I managed to fix it once as we took it from Silvermoon to Farstrider Lodge, and it worked on the journey here, but I simply cannot understand what's wrong with it! [sad] It might've been damaged. [solemn] Arcane Golems aren't easy to build or repair. [pause] If only my master was still alive...

[sigh] Wait, that's it! [excited] I remember that Thalestien, my master, gave his notes to a friend of his in Gnomeregan. [soft voice] He was so enthralled by the gnomish inventors that he gave Masey Wirefuse his notes, hoping that the gnomes could assist in improving upon his work. [commanding] See if you can find her in Tinker Town. [hesitant] I truly hope she survived Gnomeregan or else I'm doomed.
quest_40515_quest_complete:
[excited] Hello, hello!

[warm] Welcome to Tinker Town. [soft voice] Got anything that needs fixing?
quest_40516_quest_detail:
[excited] A student of Thalestien? How exciting!

Thalestien was not exactly like the rest of the High Elves; he really enjoyed tinkering with gizmos and scraps as much as we did! [soft voice] But his craft also used a hefty amount of the Arcane, which in truth was a very smart choice. [solemn] It's no less to tell that people like him were a true inspiration to Engineering today.

The Arcane Golems were the product of high ingeniosity, but I'm afraid Thalestien's notes are lost. [pause] The last time I had them I was in a small house North West of Brewnall Village. You could try there. [urgent] Just be aware that Leper Gnomes might guard the area. [excited] If you were to get those notes, I believe a new age for Engineering could begin! [warm] Working with the High Elves from this aspect would be very exciting.
quest_40516_quest_complete: [delight] Great, great news <name>. [excited] I haven't seen these in quite a while now!
quest_40517_quest_detail:
I'd love to take a peek through those again. [excited] I was sure they were lost! [solemn] Thalestien was such an awe-inspiring engineer. [soft voice] So many exciting stories about people and their crafts. $Have you ever heard of Brymidaine Zecker? [excited] A trickster dwarf, that's what he was! [soft voice] Many believed he was the greatest dwarven mage of all time, but rumors say that his magic was no magic at all.

[pause] But the benefit of Engineering and Technology! Look at me babbling... Nel'doriel surely awaits these notes. [hesitant] Oh well. [soft voice] Do tell Nel'doriel I'll visit soon... maybe even help with his golem!
quest_40517_quest_complete:
[excited] You return with the notes! [warm] Much appreciated, friend.

[soft voice] Now I can finally start working on this this again. [gentle] I'm glad Masey would like to help me. [proud] I'm intending this as a gift for Princess Moira: her own personal bodyguard!

[warm] Here, this is for you.
quest_40518_quest_detail:
[solemn] My trip to Stormwind has been a failure, and truth be told, I don't really have the courage to return just yet.

[sad] I was ambushed by a group of troggs heading to Ironforge, and I just so happened to drop the most important item on me, The Ramolus Gem.

[soft voice] The Trogg that happened to take it was enfused with the latent arcane power of the gem, and now has some ability with magic... Or so I heard.

<Ansela pouts.>

[hesitant] Can you recover it for me by chance? The Trogg named Grash can be found deep in the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
quest_40518_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, have you had any luck?
quest_40518_quest_complete:
<Excitement perks across Ansela's face!> [excited] Oh, oh thank you! I cannot express my excitement, I never thought I'd get this back.

I thought I'd have to go get a stern talking to in Little Silvermoon about my failure. [warm] Here, take this, as thanks for helping me out.
quest_40519_quest_detail:
<The troll's ghostly visage speaks in a broken, howling tone that is hard to understand fully.> [hesitant] I... be lost... Forever wandering across the desert... to try and find a way out.

[sad] But it don't feel like... there be a way out. [urgent] Go to Zul'Farrak... the place where my body is... and find my Ancient Troll Remains... in the burial grounds... Free me mon, from this... eternal torture...
quest_40519_quest_complete:
<With the remains close to the spirit, the howling tone becomes more clear.> [solemn] I can feel the end. It is in sight. My vision is no longer blurred and faded mon. [warm] You have shown me the way. That cursed Zum'rah and his magic brought me back from my rest, and left me to wander aimlessly. But I got no grudges mon, for I am free now.

[proud] I will find the way, thanks to you. <The spirit drops a chained necklace onto the sand below, leaving it as a reward as he collects his remains.>
quest_40520_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ever since we left Zul'Farrak, hunger and thirst be constant companions for us. [low voice] Da greedy goblins of Gadgetzan control da Wastes and dey do not see us any different than our Sandfury brethrens.

[urgent] Mon, our village needs ya help. [sad] We are starving here. [hesitant] I plead, venture into the desert and find some meat. [emphasis] Meat of da roc, while not tasty, is nutritious enough to keep ya alive. And while ya be out there, gather some hyena skins as well. [warm] Hingozu make ya armor for da effort.
quest_40520_quest_progress: [urgent] Do ya have da food and skins?
quest_40520_quest_complete: [excited] Thank ya, mon. [warm] These supplies won't be lasting for long, but they will allow us to live for a few more days at least. [warm] Here, take this as a reward mon.
quest_40521_quest_detail:
[urgent] You. You can help me, us. [solemn] The ogres of Dunemaul be driving us away from our ancient temples. [angry] I will not tolerate them defilin' our sacred grounds and relics. [threatening] Their foul warlocks and mages tarnish the idols of our gods.

[commanding] Venture south to where the Dunemaul reside and slay them. [urgent] Retrieve three Loa Charms and bring them to me. [excited] We shall unleash their wrath upon dem!
quest_40521_quest_progress: [solemn] Our mad brethren in Zul'Farrak no longer revere our gods as dey should. [commanding] Only we can stop the ogres.
quest_40521_quest_complete: [solemn] Da ogres will fear da might of our gods. Their vengeance be scary, no mercy be shown. [threatening] Curse de ogres. [angry] Theey will learn not to mess with da Sandmoon.
quest_40522_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our tribe... Da Sandfury

[sad] We lost everything. Zul'Farrak, once a shining jewel of this desert, be ruled by lunatics. Few of us, who be seeing the imminent fall, left the city and settled here. [pause] As ya see, there be only a handful. Not enough to stop da so called Chief Sandscalp and his minions.

Da name of the Sandfury Trolls has to be redeemed first. Among people around us, dey need to see that we changed.

We be in need of a diplomat, a representative. You be da one to fulfill da role. [commanding] Show dem in Gadgetzan dat da Sandfury are not all crazed bloodrinkers.
quest_40522_quest_complete:
[urgent] The Sandfury have changed and want to cooperate? What do they have to sell then? I guess nothing! [angry] My friend, you know, Gadgetzan has its reputation. [commanding] I cannot just let in some filthy sand trolls here.

[emphasis] Unless they pay.

A lot.
quest_40523_quest_detail:
[urgent] Tell your troll friends that I can - convince - the guards here to let them in for… let's say... five hundred gold.

Each. [shouting] Sorry fella, just can't risk the business!
quest_40523_quest_progress: [urgent] Have ya speak to da goblins?
quest_40523_quest_complete:
[solemn] Dey be no less insane than our brothers in Zul'Farrak, mon. [low voice] Sandmoon be not paying dem, never. [threatening] If dey want us enemies, so be it.

[commanding] My mission still stands.
quest_40524_quest_detail:
[solemn] If dere is one who could see our struggle, it be Vol'jin of da Darkspear. [low voice] Like no otha he be understanding how is it to be outcast and lose da homeland. [soft voice] My kind be not welcome in Horde lands, but maybe ya be able to show our new ways.

[urgent] Travel to Orgrimmar, and speak to Vol'jin. [emphasis] Tell him what be happening in Zul'Farrak and offer our assistance.
quest_40525_quest_progress: [low voice] So ya be the new one among us. Maz'ek told me he sent you to negotiate with Vol'jin. [solemn] Were you successful?
quest_40525_quest_complete: That be good. I think. [solemn] We Sandfury be never open to da outsiders. But these be different times now. As Maz'ek be sayin': [solemn] we have to change or face extinction. I wish I could speak to Vol'jin myself about our... cooperation. I cannot leave my people yet though. I be needed here. I be needed here as long as Chief Ukorz lives and my people are in danger.
quest_40526_quest_detail:
[solemn] It pains me much, but my brethren be beyond saving. [sad] They do not see the corruption of our tribe. [hesitant] I tried everything. [urgent] Dat why we had to run. [sad] They wont be listening. [commanding] We got to stop dem.

[urgent] Outside of Zul'Farrak proper, many Sandfury Trolls scour the desert, attacking trade caravans and assaulting water towers. [urgent] I can't be risking their influence spreading further, mon.

[commanding] Thin their ranks.
quest_40526_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you finished your... grim task?
quest_40526_quest_complete: [solemn] It does not bring me joy to hear about de death of my kin. [sad] It be necesarry, sadly. [solemn] It is de only way for Sandfury to survive.
quest_40527_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has to be done. [low voice] Ukorz Sandscalp and his foul right-hand man Ruuzlu have to be stopped.

Venture into our ancient city of Zul'Farrak. [urgent] Kill Ukorz and Ruuzlu and come back to me.

There will not be celebration, or a feast. This is just what needs to happen. [soft voice] In time, de lands of Zul'Farrak will heal.
quest_40527_quest_complete:
[solemn] So it is done, I Thank you.

[soft voice] Ukorz Sandscalp was not always so brutal and cold, his mind be warped from the magic he and his lackeys dabbled within'. [sad] It almost be sad to think of what a promisin' future he brought when he first became chief, for it all to drift away like sand on de dunes.

[warm] Perhaps we find a new future now, all thanks to you mon.
quest_40528_quest_detail:
[angry] Ya be the one who be pokin' in our village! [urgent] Ya better get yourself useful or else Ekka feed ya to da Viceclaw!

[low voice] Viceclaw be likin' good, tough meat. [soft voice] Da turtles from da shore be his favorite. [sad] Ekka can't go dere, da goblins would shoot her to death! [urgent] Bring Viceclaw da meat from dem, and as a reward he will spare you!

<Ekka laughs maniacally>

[warm] Good Viceclaw, good.
quest_40528_quest_progress: [soft voice] You can find da turtles on the shore, next to da port.
quest_40528_quest_complete: [excited] Good, turtle meat for Viceclaw! [warm] Ya be useful outsider. [warm] Ya can stay, Ekka be likin' ya.
quest_40529_quest_detail:
Dear Farad,

[sad] We made a mistake. You need to stop distributing the golems. Our plan will not work.

I know you are still angry at me for what I did to you. It was an accident, I swear! But you have to listen, [hesitant] please. I cannot stop the golems from killing people. The spell does not work! Oh, how stupid I was.

Please, Farad, stop this nonsense with the Stonemasons Guild and come back. We will figure out how to fix them together, like the old times. [solemn] Please. I await you in our old workshop in Moonbrook. Where everything started. Our friendship, our plans, our failure.

Your good friend, Maltimor Gartside.
quest_40529_quest_progress: [soft voice] What is it, friend? [shocked] Oh, by the Light...
quest_40529_quest_complete: I bid you farewell, <name>. [soft voice] Thank you for understanding. [warm] And once again, thank you for all you did. [proud] You truly are a hero.
quest_40530_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have been awaiting your arrival for some time now. [soft voice] I have heard tales of your deeds from the very spirits themselves, and it is time to prove your worth as an Orc.

[commanding] It is time for your next challenge, and to prove your worth to the very spirits themselves. [urgent] If you think you are worthy for such a task, seek out Margok Hatewind at Camp Mojache, he will be your guide.
quest_40530_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have been expecting you.

[low voice] It is about time you have arrived. [solemn] I have heard many tales of your prowess, but now I shall see if such tales are true.
quest_40531_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have begun to find potency within your use of the elements, though now comes a different matter entirely. [solemn] Within Feralas is an Ancient Wolf Spirit, one of whom can bestow great power upon orc shamans capable enough to prove their worth.

[commanding] If you wish to prove yourself you must first gather a Pristine Wolf Tooth from the Longtooth wolves in the region. [soft voice] Be patient, it may be hard to come across. [urgent] When you have found one, bring it to me, and you can continue on this journey.
quest_40531_quest_progress: [solemn] Exert cunning, for the wolves of Feralas can be a rather intimidating foe.
quest_40531_quest_complete: <Margok Hatewind would inspect the tooth for some time.> [solemn] Well, this would appear to be what I was looking for, [soft voice] you have displayed great patience, and [proud] great ability to hunt.
quest_40532_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is said long ago, a large and magical wolf dominated these forests, and hunted with great power, only succumbing to a fatal wound near a large waterfall. [soft voice] It is here that you will take a powder I have grounded from the pristine tooth you brought me, to pour over this site. [solemn] This ritual will be neccesary to gain the blessing of the Ancient Wolf Spirit.

[commanding] To the south east of Camp Mojache is a large waterfall, find a way up, and there you will find the Wolf Spirit, do as I have instructed, and it will be willing to speak with you.
quest_40535_quest_detail:
[solemn] May the Earthmother guide the path you're traveling, young one. [warm] Welcome to Red Cloud Roost, where we keep the wyverns of Highperch, which have a unique bond with members of the Horde.

[soft voice] Wyverns are intelligent and generous creatures that have been invaluable allies to our ways for many years. [gentle] Many would like to journey to the skies with them, and if that is your goal, I would be happy to teach you.

[commanding] To begin, listen to what their stomachs crave and offer meat as a bribe to earn their trust. [urgent] I recommend obtaining meat from adult plainstriders.

[solemn] Simply bring back two pieces of leg meat, but be mindful that if you hunt these majestic birds with excessive force, you may cause irreparable damage, making it impossible to harvest the meat.

[warm] I look forward to seeing whether you will demonstrate the virtues of patience or creativity to complete this task.
quest_40535_quest_progress: [solemn] If you fail to feed your wyvern, it will one day feast upon you.
quest_40535_quest_complete:
[solemn] You return, and with the meat. By which means you've decided to obtain it, I will not question.

[soft voice] Now, onto the real task.
quest_40536_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you have the meat, it is time for the actual test. [solemn] This will prove if you are capable enough to be gifted a wyvern cub which will become your most trusted companion.

[commanding] Take this meat to Sunchaser, he is one of the Wyvern Alpha and my most trusted friend. [soft voice] Note that this will not be a gift, but a challenge. [soft voice] Presenting yourself in front of the alpha with the hunted game is disrespectful, Sunchaser will know you seek one of his cubs and by presenting the meat you will imply that you can be as much of a guardian as he can, and he will test that himself.

[hesitant] He will not kill you, probably.
quest_40536_quest_progress: [solemn] All who seek to become windriders must first challenge an alpha.
quest_40536_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, blessed be the ancestors, you truly have potential.

[warm] I haven't seen old Sunchaser pushed back like that for a long long time, you have my blessing, and his.

[solemn] One final task remains.
quest_40537_quest_detail:
[solemn] My friend, you are ready to receive your own eager wyvern cub. But for it to accept you as its new companion you must bring the wyvern a gift. For many years the wyvern and the harpies battled on the wind for domination over the skies.

[urgent] Prove yourself an ally to the cub, bring him the most beautiful feather of a harpy's wing. This might prove difficult but understand that if the feather isn't chosen both by fate and your own consciousness you will never be able to appeal to him.

The Windfury Harpies can be found around Mulgore, slay them and bring me back a feather you think will please your cub.
quest_40537_quest_progress: [solemn] Domination over the sky, my hooves are shaking.
quest_40537_quest_complete:
[delight] Gorgeous, just gorgeous.

[solemn] The Earthmother truly had blessed this harpy with beautiful feathers, a pity her life ended. [solemn] Yet, as the cycle of life and death continues one must always remember that our actions always lead to a greater purpose. <Tokala ties the feather in the wyvern cub's hair. The cub eagerly makes its way into your backpack, ready to face the world together with you.>
quest_40538_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of our scouting parties took this worg with them. They had to face some whelps, and they claim that some of those are as hard as the very metal we shape and forge. I would never mistrust my clan, <name>. [soft voice] But I will not endanger the scouting party either, they are not cut for this kind of work. I can't even send this worg with you, it is wounded and seems too afraid to return, it must be reshaped.

[urgent] I urge you to go and find these peculiar dragonlings and bring an end to them. [solemn] My clansmen say they can be found to the east of the Steppes, where the dark irons that assumed the name of Hateforge have been roaming.

[threatening] Kill them and find out what kind of trickery these dwarves have been up to.
quest_40538_quest_complete: [solemn] So they were not real whelps? [soft voice] But constructs made of metal by someone that bothered to put their name on each and every one of them? [urgent] Convenient for us, we now know who to kill.
quest_40539_quest_detail:
Engineer Figgles.

[commanding] This creature has the ego of Nefarian himself. [mocking tone] Who would be arrogant enough to put their own name on everything they've ever created.

[solemn] Alas, this is in our favor. [urgent] I am not certain what the dark irons plan with these whelpings but we must definitely stop them.

[hesitant] Although we have nowhere, to begin with, I am certain, that a valiant warrior such as yourself who has earned the respect of my clan will surely be able to find this Figgles.

[warm] Go with the worg's swiftness, and may the blood in your veins burn with the rage of a thousand lava pools.
quest_40539_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Dark Irons have a new quarry? What were they even digging? Not that it matters since you've put an end to it, I must however report to Karfang.

[soft voice] I've managed to collect a few things from the willing clan members that'd see you rewarded for your efforts, but you can only pick one. [cold] Such is the way of the Blackrock Clan.
quest_40542_quest_progress: [solemn] The Aerie Peak welcomes you, outsider.
quest_40542_quest_complete: [soft voice] Weird question, <race>. But to my knowledge, none of my gryphon riders reported murloc presence on the shore. Revantusk, yes, but no murlocs. [hesitant] Are you sure your information is correct?
quest_40543_quest_progress: [low voice] Katoom be fishin', mon. Be quiet.
quest_40543_quest_complete: [solemn] Kattom be not seein' any murlocs around here, mon. [sad] Da turtles ate dem all. [low voice] Murlocs be good snack, taste like fish, but betta'.
quest_40544_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If ya be wanting to help your little murloc friend, ya better find Nat Pagle. [low voice] He be the best fishermon in da world. [solemn] He be legendary among us. [pause] Katoom knows dat he be spending a lot of time among murlocs, to learn fishing from dem, mon. [emphasis] He must be knowing somethin'!

[hesitant] Katoom be not knowing where to find Nat Pagle. [pause] He traveled to Kalimdor some time ago.
quest_40544_quest_progress: [solemn] I am Nat Pagle, master fisherman. [soft voice] What can I help you with?
quest_40544_quest_complete:
[solemn] Murlocs... I have spent months amongst them, trying to learn their fishing techniques. [soft voice] During this time, I learned a lot about their customs and behavior.

[hesitant] Sometimes, I feel like I can understand their language. [shocked] It creeps me out.

Regardless, when it comes to your little friend, I don't have good news...
quest_40545_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So you want to help the little murloc? [solemn] Valiant effort. We, the Wildhammer, value compassion above all. [pause] Unfortunately, I can't help you find his parents.

But I know one person who could.

[emphasis] Nat Pagle. The legendary fisherman. [low voice] When I last met him, he wanted to learn fishing secrets from murlocs. [hesitant] If you are committed, you could try to find him. [soft voice] Maybe he knows their language? [pause] I heard he is now in Kalimdor.
quest_40545_quest_progress: [solemn] I am Nat Pagle, master fisherman. [soft voice] What can I help you with?
quest_40545_quest_complete:
[solemn] Murlocs... I have spent months amongst them, trying to learn their fishing techniques. [soft voice] During this time, I learned a lot about their customs and behavior.

[hesitant] Sometimes, I feel like I can understand their language. [shocked] It creeps me out.

[low voice] Regardless, when it comes to your little friend, I don't have good news...
quest_40546_quest_detail:
[solemn] It pains me to tell this, but his parents are probably... ehm, dead. Murlocs, while ferocious and territorial, care deeply for their tadpoles. I have seen them sacrificing themselves so their children could live. [solemn] Truly, we should appreciate these creatures more.

And one more thing. If you want this little murloc to live, it will need your help. Hinterlands are dangerous. It won't survive on its own.
quest_40547_quest_detail:
[solemn] It pains me to tell this, but his parents are probably... ehm, dead. Murlocs, while ferocious and territorial, care deeply for their tadpoles. I have seen them sacrificing themselves so their children could live. [solemn] Truly, we should appreciate these creatures more.

And one more thing. If you want this little murloc to live, it will need your help. Hinterlands are dangerous. It won't survive on its own.
quest_40548_quest_detail: [urgent] Alright, <class>. [solemn] While you were gone I received a report from Falgran, the scout who I sent to investigate the footprints. [commanding] He requires your immediate assistance. [soft voice] He set up a camp somewhere close to the border with the Barrens, between Shady Rest and Lost Point.
quest_40548_quest_progress: <name>, right? [urgent] Thanks for coming so fast.
quest_40548_quest_complete:
[solemn] I followed the footprints and I found our suspect. [soft voice] I couldn't do much more. [hesitant] I'm just a scout.

[solemn] That's why you are here.
quest_40549_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, <name>, the footprints were definitely quillboar hooves. [soft voice] I followed them well into the Barrens, thinking they would lead me to the Kraul. [sad] I was wrong. [urgent] The raiding party actually stopped just outside Bael Modan, which makes your job easier.

[hesitant] Venturing into the Kraul... [pause] The mere thought makes me shudder.

[commanding] Back to the topic. [urgent] The camp is north of Bael Modan, close to the road. [confident] You should have no trouble finding it. [commanding] Try to sneak in, or kill them all. [cold] Doesn't matter to me. [solemn] What is important - find some evidence, maybe some items that could've been taken from the inn.

And to address the elephant in the room: the orc. [threatening] He said that he is here to investigate the inn too. [angry] I'm keeping an eye on him- I don't trust him. [urgent] I feel like the Horde is trying to cover up something. [warm] Good luck.
quest_40549_quest_progress: [hesitant] Back so soon? [commanding] The camp is west of here.
quest_40549_quest_complete: [solemn] You say that their chieftain had this tablet with drawings resembling the burned inn... curious. [soft voice] We will need someone able to read the quillboar scripture.
quest_40550_quest_detail: Let's think... If anyone is able to translate this, it would be some goblin. [low voice] These fellows do trade with everyone, there must be someone who has at least a basic understanding of this language. [soft voice] Could you please take this to Ratchet? [pause] I will stay here for now and observe the camp.
quest_40550_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah yes, quillboar writing. Very hard to learn, very hard. [low voice] I can read it, though. Did some business with them a long time ago. [angry] Nasty bunch, I tell you.

[whispering] However, you know how it is here. Everything has a price.
quest_40551_quest_detail:
[urgent] While I am busy translating this, you help me. Easy.

[urgent] I need something from Stranglethorn Vale. I know, it's far, but fortunately, we have a beautiful ship that will take you straight to Booty Bay! [delight] Wonderful, isn't it?

[soft voice] I heard about some mining operations being done in the northern region, close to some lake or something. [solemn] By no other than our competitor, Venture Company. [urgent] I need you to go there and, ehm, borrow some stuff from them.

[urgent] Bring me 10 samples of ‘the thing' they are excavating. [whispering] I heard it's some blue crystals. [urgent] I think you will be able to find them on their dead bodies. [whispering] But you didn't hear that from me.
quest_40551_quest_complete:
Hah, good job. [laughing] I hope you didn't have to dispose of too many Venture Co. workers... And I hope their insurance covers this!

<Sputtervalve laughs.>

[urgent] Let's get to translating this thing.
quest_40552_quest_detail:
<Sputtervale focuses on the tablet.> [soft voice] Their writing is not exactly like ours. They just draw some pictures, and you have to interpret it on your own. There are some clues that help you with grasping the meaning but...

[pause] You probably aren't interested in quillboar lore, yeah.

So, what I get from this: a band of quillboars wants to attack an inn. They go there with a raiding party, but they find the inn already burned to the ground. Then some angry pictures. I guess they wanted violence.

So, yeah. [emphasis] This is what I got from this, pal.
quest_40552_quest_progress: [soft voice] Were you able to translate the tablet?
quest_40552_quest_complete: [solemn] So it wasn't them... Unless the quillboars are the masters of deception, we reached a dead end.
quest_40553_quest_detail: [commanding] Go and report our findings to Captain Vimes. [solemn] I will stay here for some time, to watch over the inn. [hesitant] I can't leave the orc alone with the evidence. [sad] I still don't trust him.
quest_40553_quest_progress: [commanding] Welcome back, <name>. [urgent] What did you discover?
quest_40553_quest_complete:
[angry] Damn it. If it was the quillboars, it would make it so easy. [sad] Shame, but at least we ruled out one of the suspects.

[commanding] Nevertheless, good work. [confident] Finally we got at least a step closer to solving this mystery. [warm] Please, take this gold as a reward from lady Jaina herself.
quest_40554_quest_detail:
I had a talk with one of our scouts. [solemn] He is, well, responsible for spying on Camp Taurajo, deep in the barrens. And he is certain, and I believe him, that no Taurajo tauren ever wielded this shield.

[soft voice] I tell you about this, because if it was really of Tauren craftsmanship, then the owner of the shield must've lived in the swamp for some time.

[commanding] I sent our infiltrators to check upon the Brackenwall Village, the horde outpost here for any sign of Taurens. [pause] While they are on their mission, I have a request. [urgent] Gather intel from our watchtowers in the marsh. [emphasis] Maybe our soldiers remember something remarkable.
quest_40554_quest_progress: [commanding] Were our scouts of any use?
quest_40554_quest_complete: [solemn] So this is all we have. [pause] Well, it is a lead as good as any other. [hesitant] But what can we do with this information?
quest_40555_quest_detail:
[solemn] These Grimtotem have been under our constant observation since they moved into Dustwallow. [low voice] They are a nasty bunch, but I assure you, if it was them, we would already know. [urgent] However, if this tauren the scouts spoke of really existed, we could ask about him in Brackenwall Village.

[hesitant] In theory. [commanding] Tensions with the Horde are high, and I don't want my men to see us negotiate with them. [sad] I had way too many deserters in recent months. [soft voice] You could try to find his grave. [solemn] The tauren mummify their dead, but since he was the only one here, I doubt the ogres knew about it. [commanding] Just search for a graveyard, or something like this close to Brackenwall. [hesitant] I doubt you will find anything, but it is the only lead we have.

[urgent] And let's hope Lieutenant Caldwell returns soon with some information about Reethe.
quest_40555_quest_progress: [low voice] This grave is big enough to fit a tauren for sure. [soft voice] It's worth investigating.
quest_40555_quest_complete:
[solemn] In the grave, you find skeletal remains of a tauren. [soft voice] He must've died at least a few years ago.

[solemn] The grave, however, has been recently dug up and hastily buried with earth. [urgent] The dirt is still loose, it must've been no longer than a few weeks.

[solemn] Some equipment is buried with the tauren too. [soft voice] Leather straps, metal coins and pauldrons, and a beautiful, one handed axe.
quest_40556_quest_detail: [solemn] Who dug up the grave? [urgent] Why? [hesitant] Did they take the shield from it?
quest_40557_quest_detail:
Lieutenant Caldwell still hasn't returned from his mission to find Paval Reethe. [sad] I fear the worst. But, alas, we can only wait.

When it comes to our investigation. [sigh] Well, another dead end.

However, Falgran reported that the horde has been causing some trouble. [urgent] Please, assist him with this matter. He is where you met him before.
quest_40557_quest_complete: I suspect they might know something...
quest_40558_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You remember the orc, right? [whispering] He wants us to talk. [low voice] He knows something that we don't.

<name>, [commanding] please remain calm, and try not to provoke them. [hesitant] I know it may be difficult, given our history, but they are much like you and me.

[gentle] Just perhaps a bit more green.
quest_40558_quest_progress: [soft voice] Back already? [urgent] What did you learn?
quest_40558_quest_complete:
[angry] You met with the Horde unauthorized? [shouting] This could've provoked a major diplomatic incident!

[solemn] At least you learned important information.
quest_40559_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the shield really belonged to the tauren from Brackenwall. [soft voice] Good work. On the other hand, the reported killing of Paval Reethe by our soldiers is troubling. [sad] Deeply troubling. [hesitant] I cannot just trust the Horde on this. [commanding] My role, as a captain, is not only to order, but also to serve.

[sad] I'm worried that Lieutenant Caldwell only acted in his self defence. [urgent] But, if the orc was really speaking the truth, you may find some evidence in Caldwell's belongings. [commanding] You can find his quarters downstairs. He was sent there with a soldier named Hallan. Check hers, too.

[solemn] I will prepare the report for Lady Jaina.
quest_40559_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you found their rooms? [urgent] They should be downstairs.
quest_40559_quest_complete: This is embarrassing. [hesitant] Especially for me, as a Captain.
quest_40560_quest_detail:
[solemn] So it is true. [sad] My soldiers, who I thought unwavering in their loyalty, were deserters. [sad] I wonder how many more hide in our midst.

[pause] For now, let's review the information: Caldwell and Hallan were deserters. [angry] They killed Paval Reethe when he was questioned by the Horde. [hesitant] Did they do it just to spite the Horde, or... [whispering] Did he know something...

[solemn] Once again, our findings lead us to the deserters in the swamp. [low voice] Well, I doubt that we could make them talk. They resent Theramore, perhaps more than they hate the Horde. [commanding] Any mindless attack on their base will not provide us with answers.

[urgent] We need to turn to magic. [whispering] Forbidden magic. [confident] If we had something that belonged to Paval Reethe, we could commune with his spirit. [solemn] It is a dangerous practice that many would consider unethical.

[urgent] In this case, I feel the ends justify the means, and fortunately, we have his badge. [solemn] Since he passed recently with unfinished business, his spirit may still be in Azeroth.

[urgent] Go to the Mage Tower in Theramore and explain the situation to Magus Ha
quest_40560_quest_progress: [solemn] I studied the Arcane Arts for decades. [soft voice] Yet I always craved... Something more.
quest_40560_quest_complete: [solemn] The Ritual of Divination. Yes, I am able to perform it. But be wary, <race>. [soft voice] It is extremely dangerous for the spirit, and for the caster.
quest_40561_quest_detail:
Very well. If it is Captain Vimes' wish... [hesitant] who am I to say no? But, if we are to make the ritual as safe as possible for the spirit and for us, I will need some rare ingredients. [soft voice] Your best bet would be buying them in Dalaran... well, if it still existed.

I have heard rumors that the Kirin Tor is trying to rebuild the magical city, so if you don't mind traveling... Maybe they have some ingredients needed. The rest can be found in these swamps, if you have a keen eye.

[commanding] I need 1 Arcane Resonator from Dalaran, 3 Lesser Moonstones and 10 Swamp Ooze Ichors. [urgent] I heard reports of ooze abominations in the south.
quest_40561_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Arcane Resonator. [soft voice] I thought this technology to be lost when Archimonde crushed Dalaran. [warm] Fortunately, Kirin Tor is tougher than I expected.

[confident] Shall we begin?
quest_40562_quest_detail:
[solemn] I shall need your help during the ritual. [soft voice] Perhaps we may learn more from the spirit realm.

[urgent] Let's begin.
quest_40562_quest_progress: [urgent] I heard terrible noises coming from the Mage Tower. What happened?
quest_40562_quest_complete:
[solemn] So it was the deserters. [soft voice] Very well, I suspected it, to be honest. [angry] These people have no honor. [commanding] We shall send our best men to deal with them. [urgent] But before this, I think the Horde should also get an explanation and... an apology.

[hesitant] And when it comes to this Mariner, let me consult with some of my advisors. I think I may have heard of this man before.
quest_40563_quest_detail:
[urgent] Go to Falgran and Kagoro, explain the situation to them, and..

Apologize for us blaming them. We need to make this right, and show our good will.

Perhaps they will forgive us.
quest_40563_quest_progress: [solemn] Did our people really betray us?
quest_40563_quest_complete:
[solemn] The deserters. I knew they were vile people, but to burn innocents alive... Light, save the souls of these poor people.

[urgent] So be it. Kagoro is already around here, we should meet him at once.
quest_40564_quest_detail:
[solemn] Here we are again, for another meeting with the Horde.

[soft voice] Kagoro has explained some things to me, but we are ready for our meeting.
quest_40564_quest_progress: [solemn] The Horde have been honest about their investigations, [warm] it makes me happy that we disclosed our own information.
quest_40565_quest_detail:
[solemn] It does appear that the Deserters are behind the burning of the inn. [commanding] If there is ever to be justice, we must stop them from continually dragging more and more of our most loyal into their ranks.

[urgent] There shall be no quarter, they are wanted and we shall dole out justice, for all of the lives lost. [sad] For the deceit caused.

[urgent] Directly to the west of Theramore, to the north eastern edge of the Quagmire is the Deserter's Hideout, it is there that they gain their strength.

[commanding] Find Sellick Voss, the new leader of the camp, slay him, and bring his medallion to me as proof of the deed.
quest_40565_quest_complete:
Without you, we would still be in the dark. [solemn] Who knows? Maybe you stopped another war between the Horde and the Alliance.

[warm] You are a hero of Theramore, for all of the work you have done to ease these tensions and solve this mystery. [proud] For this, I would like you to take one of these weapons from my personal armory.

[soft voice] Concerning the Vengeful Mariner: Sailors coming to Theramore have reported seeing a shadowy figure stalking the coast. [pause] A question does remain: why was this figure so important to the deserters?

[solemn] I would not lose sleep. [commanding] This is not a mystery for us to worry about, or another investigation to be launched. [cold] Let them keep their mariner in whatever grave he occupies.
quest_40566_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, <class>!

<The lady seems to force a smile, but her eyes betray a deep fury.>

You look the gallant sort, the sort to help a poor damsel, yes? [soft voice] I find myself in need of some rather... odd substances. They may even be dangerous to acquire, but looking at you – I think you can certainly handle it. [warm] I will even pay some decent coin for your troubles!

[urgent] I need some poison. But not just any poison. There are spiders in a cave somewhere East of here, that have a very painful bite, even causing brief paralysis. [soft voice] If you could collect for me a few vials of their venom, I would be eternally grateful! [soft voice] Surely you aren't afraid of a few little arachnids, no?

[soft voice] And what do you mean, why? [soft voice] Are you truly asking a lady her personal business?
quest_40566_quest_progress: [threatening] Have you got what I need, or are you just being nosy?
quest_40566_quest_complete: [delight] Oh perfect, thank you! [proud] This should teach him a lesson. [warm] here's your silver, now shoo!
quest_40567_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, I can't do this.

<She sighs loudly and massages her eyes.>

[sad] My fiancé is dog-tired all the time, disappears randomly during the night, and recently I found long black hair on his clothes.

[hesitant] I just can't figure out how he could do this to me! [urgent] But I must be certain. [soft voice] Please, <class>, can you go look into this for me? [hesitant] Before I do anything rash. [sad] I can't even bear to speak to him, never mind go back to our old bedroom. [commanding] Just find out his damned side of things, and tell me what lies he speaks. [soft voice] Any extra evidence you can find would be good too, I suppose.

<She screws her face up tightly.> [sad] He's probably avoiding me and pretending to be useful, chopping wood by the lumber mill. [sad] Bert Mano is his name.
quest_40567_quest_complete: [excited] Poison? Wow, this complicates things greatly. [urgent] We may need to take a more direct approach.
quest_40568_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Okay, okay, I know it looks bad. [soft voice] But Bert has been suffering with sleep paralysis of a very interesting kind, you see. [solemn] The poor soul has something, and I have my suspicions what, reaching out to him during his dreams. [pause] I was skeptical too, until I witnessed it myself while observing him slumber.

[urgent] I am sure it is a demon! [excited] The peasants have countless stories of this sort of thing, but it's the first time I've gotten irrefutable evidence of it happening! [solemn] Regardless, my studies must be put on hold, if his marriage and, if you are correct, his life may be in danger.

[commanding] This demon must be either expelled or brought into the physical plane, then killed. [hesitant] Unfortunately, I have very little idea how to do so directly.

[urgent] But I know who does. [soft voice] I made contact with a shady fellow in Stormwind. [solemn] He conducts his business from a cabal hidden away in the basement of a tavern there. [hesitant] I do not know which one unfortunately. [solemn] His name is Gakin the Darkbinder.

[urgent] Please, hurry, <class>. [sad] Bert isn't a perfect man, but he doesn't deserve thi
quest_40568_quest_complete: [delight] From Hawk's Vigil? What a juicy predicament indeed! <He trails off into a quiet, throaty laughter.>
quest_40569_quest_detail:
[commanding] Okay then, your first task for me. [angry] What, you thought I would do this for free? [shouting] No, no no! [shocked] Oh by fel no. [soft voice] In any normal circumstance I would have you killed for stumbling down here, but it just so happens, I need some materials myself, and some of these will also be required to solve your. [solemn] Predicament. [urgent] A connection to the void will be required, plus some sort of tonic that elicits lucid dreaming to bring forth this night-demon of yours, and banish it. [soft voice] My colleagues have whispered about a certain location that may just do the trick!

<He smirks wickedly.>

[excited] Fire Scar Shrine. [soft voice] Name ring a bell? [sad] I doubt it. [urgent] You can find it in Ashenvale, south west of Astranaar. [threatening] There are foul beasts dwelling there, dog-like, ravenous and demonic. [commanding] I need you to go there, kill them, and bring me their hearts. [cold] I will need one for you, but I never, ever work for free. [urgent] Make it ten.
quest_40569_quest_progress: [low voice] Have you given up yet?
quest_40569_quest_complete: [low voice] Well well, look at those beautifully tainted hearts. Perfect. [warm] You have done me a great service today, <race>. Here... When you feel strong enough, take one of my special creations, a token of thanks.
quest_40570_quest_detail: [soft voice] You know what? You've actually impressed me, <race>. I will consider your payment complete. Take this pendant back with you. It has a powerful tether which will draw demonic energies into our world. [solemn] Needless to say it is HIGHLY forbidden, so do not show it to anyone but the one who sent you here.
quest_40570_quest_progress: [excited] You have returned! [warm] What news do you bring?
quest_40570_quest_complete: [confident] This? [emphasis] This will do what I think it will, yes? [warm] Then I think I have one more thing to ask of you, <class>.
quest_40571_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is it. [urgent] If you have any friends who can work discreetly, I suggest you contact them now.

The energy will be strongest either around Bert himself or where he sleeps. [soft voice] Hold out the pendant and see if it reacts. [solemn] Hopefully, this will give you the opportunity to confront this demon and put an end to the torment.

[urgent] You should probably take some evidence of its existence once you kill it, too, you know. [hesitant] So he can prove his situation and resolve the troubles with his fiance.
quest_40571_quest_progress: I haven't slept a wink. [sad] Not only with this damn evil presence, but my wife kicked me out the house too!
quest_40571_quest_complete:
By the light, what is that! [shocked] This is what tormented me for months? I... I think I remember those eyes, yes.

[hesitant] As much as it pains me to do so, I must show this to Rose. [solemn] There is no other way to prove what she means to me, that I would never do what she thinks I did!

[angry] And your name, friend? Ah, thank you <name>.
quest_40572_quest_detail:
[solemn] Kagoro had just left to investigate the hoofprints. He should be scouting the road to the Southern Barrens. [soft voice] A scout like no other, that orc, for many days has he tried to be worthy of a surname.

His actions will one day speak, and when that day comes he will earn his honor. [warm] I hold high respect for Kagoro, <race>, but I believe he will be in need of your help if you were willing to offer it.
quest_40572_quest_complete: Krog says you were the one to find the hoofprints. [proud] You have a keen eye, I'm more than willing to accept your aid.
quest_40573_quest_detail:
Krog's suspicions were founded, [solemn] he was right to believe the quilboar may have had something to do with the burning of the inn.

Before you arrived, [low voice] so did I. I followed a track, or should I say smell towards a pack of quilboar, [commanding] they donned the colour of war and were headed towards the Razorfen Kraul, their main den.

Luckily for us, they have stopped in their trails close to it, [urgent] conveniently near the road.

Your task will be to extract information from them, if any. Although I highly trust my tracking skills, I find my brute force lacking. [hesitant] Judge me if you must, but see the deed done.

And the human... He is here to investigate, too. Better leave him alone, for now.
quest_40573_quest_complete:
[solemn] This isn't much <name>, but we'll make do.

[soft voice] Something seems to be scribbled on this tablet, you said you found it on one of them?
quest_40574_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I'm afraid I can't make anything out of these symbols, [solemn] we must find someone who knows this type of speech and who would be willing to aid us.

<Kagoro ponders for a moment.>

[urgent] I hear the Tauren of Camp Taurajo recently captured a quilboar, perhaps he's willing to hold a conversation. [cold] Nothing to lose after all, he's a prisoner, force him if he's not willing.
quest_40576_quest_complete: [angry] This makes no sense, <name>, the quilboar were a good lead but it only sent us to a dead end.
quest_40577_quest_detail:
[solemn] I'll keep looking around the ruins, meanwhile you should go back to Krog, and inform him of our findings.

[soft voice] There's simply nothing more we can do here <name>. [warm] As little as it may mean, you have my appreciation for the help, Lok'tar.
quest_40577_quest_complete:
[solemn] From frog in the well to frog in the ocean it is then. [soft voice] It would've been so easy if the quilboar had done it, but the ancestors test us still.

[pause] It is time to evaluate the evidence we have and look to the other leads perhaps.
quest_40578_quest_detail:
[solemn] No matter how many times I may look at it, <race>, I simply can't recall to whom I've sold or for whom I've forged this.

The sole thing I can say is it was meant for a Tauren to bear. The size, the grip, it feels natural in the hands of a Tauren. [gentle] You have my sincere apologies but this is all I can offer.

[soft voice] Tell Krog to take good care of his armor, farewell.
quest_40578_quest_complete:
Another dead end.

<Krog ponders for a moment.>

Dead end. [excited] Exactly!
quest_40579_quest_detail:
[solemn] I remember Do'gol speaking of a friend of his, a Tauren to be more precise. He said the Tauren befriended the ogres during the siege of Theramore, quite always mentioning how much of an unstoppable shield he was.

[hesitant] I wonder, Do'gol, as many ogres, may be a bit slow, if we were to jog up his memory about this Tauren perhaps we can find out if the Tauren itself was the shield or that he carried a shield.

[soft voice] I have this feeling <name>.
quest_40581_quest_detail: [low voice] You're saying this Tauren was supposed to be buried with his shield and there was no actual shield? [sigh] I knew I had a weird feeling about this. [solemn] This could only mean one thing and one thing only, [urgent] someone came to rob our graveyard, for something that would incriminate the Horde if placed in the burned inn.
quest_40582_quest_detail:
I'm more than certain this was meant to brew turmoil between us and Theramore, however I am not sure why. While you were out trying to figure out the shield part of the mystery, Kagoro has kept company with a scout from Theramore.

I'll send you to meet with them, so Kagoro can share what information we gathered. For all that we know we're all simply trying to get to the bottom of this, without any more bloodshed between the factions.

If they sniffed around the inn, they probably know what killed their soldiers in self defence, when we were questioning Reethe. Or at the least, they are wondering what happened to them. We need to explain the situation, it is important.

<Krog Grunts.>

Ah, one more thing. Our goblin allies at Mudsprocket have sent me a message, they believe that the Black Dragonflight could have something to do with the burning of the inn. It makes sense, to be fair, we will check this later.
quest_40582_quest_progress:
[solemn] I have spoken with the Alliance representative and they have agreed to exchange information, though I fear the news we must deliver.

[hesitant] I hope your diplomacy is better than mine. It's customary to speak in their tongue if you are to call the meeting, but we've only learned some of their language in internment camps. [angry] Bah! Now that I think about it, you don't talk much do you? [sad] We're doomed.
quest_40582_quest_complete: [solemn] I'm afraid that the human won't act rationally when we tell them about the death of their comrades. [sad] They will think of us as savages.
quest_40583_quest_detail: [soft voice] You have found what appears to be a rich lively leaf on the ground. Touching the leaf gives you an odd sensation, there is also no sign of the leaf dessecating. [hesitant] Perhaps the Druid trainer in Bloodhoof Village would know more?
quest_40583_quest_progress: [gentle] Greetings young <class>, [soft voice] what can I do for you?
quest_40583_quest_complete: [solemn] By the Spirits?! That is no ordinary leaf. [soft voice] I have only seen a leaf like this during my time as an apprentice in Moonglade. [urgent] This may be very urgent <class>, and I will need your help.
quest_40584_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Such leaves do not grow on plants <class>, but on Dryads. [solemn] Dryads are the children of Cenarius, the one who is said to have originally taught us the way of druidism.

[gentle] They are kind, gentle, and nurturing under normal circumstances but will become fierce and deadly if their forests or the wild are in danger. [pause] Why would a Dryad be here? [urgent] This is a fresh specimen that was removed from the Dryad very recently so she cannot have gone far.

[commanding] Please scout the area where you found this leaf and do your best to locate this Dryad.
quest_40585_quest_progress: [gentle] Hail friend, what is the matter?
quest_40585_quest_complete: [soft voice] You need an antidote for Centaur poison? I'm afraid my last batch was used days ago... [pause] Do not despair though, I may still be able to help!
quest_40586_quest_detail: [soft voice] I cannot give you a batch, but I can help you prepare it. [pause] You can find the herb known as Cottontail out on the plains. [gentle] Bring me six sprigs of the herb and I will fashion an antidote for you that you can take to your friend.
quest_40586_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, <class>. [soft voice] I will now prepare an antidote for you.
quest_40587_quest_detail: [urgent] Now, hurry and give the batch to your friend before it is too late. [emphasis] Time is of the essence!
quest_40588_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome back young <class>, it has been a while.
quest_40588_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So you have not only earned the friendship of a Dryad, but saved someone in need? [solemn] We are blessed to have a Dryad living among us, truthfully I am impressed with your deeds.

[warm] I will make sure to inform the village and ensure that Melyndella is properly accommodated here. [proud] May the ancestors smile upon you, friend!
quest_40589_quest_detail:
[urgent] We sent out a crew weeks ago to begin doing some studies over the ruins down west and they haven't showed up yet, not even a peep.

The desert is a dangerous place so now rumor is going around they may have met some terrible fate. [solemn] It is possible I suppose!

What is really important is what we sent out with them. You see, when we trust someone, we usually give them some valuable gear. Something worth a lot of coin, you dig?

[commanding] I need you to go out there and find that crew, or more importantly, get the Turbo-Scan Filtronomitor from whatever is left!

They should have been down near Eastmoon Ruins, check around there.
quest_40589_quest_progress: [urgent] That Turbo-Scan Filtronomitor is state of the art, [sad] losing that is like losing twenty goblins.
quest_40589_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh baby, its still intact, look at this thing, a bit of heat damage, and some sand where it shouldn't be, but its not broken.

[warm] You saved us a heaping pile of gold recovering this thing, and that's like giving it to me yourself!

[delight] Here, this should make up for the work you did.
quest_40590_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The desert, such a unique place, I've heard rumors of people perishing from the harsh and brutal sands, the extreme heat, and the lack of water. [pause] It kind of reminds me of where I come from aye?

[solemn] In such a place only the most brutal creatures can survive, one of which has spent its entire life within the sun.

[low voice] The Glasshide Gazer has a distinctive golden scale that my benefactor wants to get ahold of.

[urgent] You can find them down in the south roaming the vast desert, collect me twelve of these scales and I will make sure you get paid well.
quest_40590_quest_progress:
[low voice] Aye, it be hot out there huh?

[urgent] Any luck with them scales?
quest_40590_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, would ye look at these, so bright and shiny, they practically look like golden coins!
quest_40591_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hey, look I appreciate all you did for me with those scales, my higher ups at Shadowfor - Err, back out in the Eastern Kingdoms are going to be very pleased, and that pleases me!

[warm] But I just have one more favor to ask for you.

[urgent] Down to south you'll find a place called Southbreak Shore, it might be tricky, just a bit southeast of the Caverns of Time.

[solemn] All along that coast are large Coast Striders, massive giants that roam the coast and call it home. [hesitant] Well you see, I need an eyeball from one of them, and I really don't think they'll give it to you, infact they probably will hate you for being there!

[commanding] So, you go and gather a friend or two, get me an eyeball, and we finish our dealings, aye?
quest_40591_quest_progress: [low voice] Well I see you're not smashed to a pulp, [pause] any luck?
quest_40591_quest_complete:
[excited] Would ye look at that? [warm] Well, you actually went ahead and did it then aye?

[warm] Me and my benefactors appreciate all the work, this has really scratched off the main difficult things I needed.

[warm] Well I suppose you earned something, here, take these, they should do you well, with all your adventuring and what not.
quest_40592_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This desert holds many secrets and magical properties, much of which is buried deep within the sand. [urgent] Leaking emanations have begun to stir up the ground into swirling elementals of sand and wind!

[excited] At least, that is what I am here to look into anyway!

[commanding] To get concrete proof I'd like you to find one of the many Gusting Vortex that roam all across Tanaris, kill them, and collect a single collection of Harmonized Sand.

I warn you, Harmonized Sand is rare, and valuable, many brave travelers have died in search of it.

[urgent] Not all of the Gusting Vortex elementals will be within a harmonized state, so don't give up, and keep looking until you find it!
quest_40592_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you had any luck in finding that fabled Harmonized Sand?
quest_40592_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, would ye look at these, so bright and shiny, they practically look like golden coins!
quest_40593_quest_detail: [solemn] Upon opening the chest you discover several old, and worn out items, various church tomes and writings with a small out of place letter resting at the top, it looks aged, and written in a shrewn handwritting which reads :
quest_40594_quest_detail:
[solemn] You found this at the Westfall Church?

It has been a long time since I have heard anything about that place... [soft voice] another abandoned relic of a potentially bright past. [sad] It is a shame what happened there, but it is a story that is much like the rest of the region.
