[solemn] The western side of Westfall was the first to be removed, and there are not many who remain who can give us information. [sad] Many of those farmers were either murdered or disappeared into secrecy.

[pause] There is someone that I can think of: Baros Alexston. [warm] He made something of himself after everything went down and became an Architect in Stormwind City. [commanding] You can find him in Cathedral Square if you don't mind looking into this matter. [soft voice] Maybe he can give us some details about who ran the church or even what happened to it.
quest_40594_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why, hello there. [gentle] Are you here to inquire about civil architecture in the city of Stormwind?
quest_40595_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, so you speak of that old church out in Westfall? It has been a long time since I have been there... an incredibly long time. [sad] I must say that I do not believe I will be of much help. Most of what I can remember is the sun beating down on me as I walked there and back.

<Baros Alexston chuckles at the memory.>

The one who ran it was an old fellow, though. He was always quite nice and cheerful. [solemn] He raised the spirits of many downtrodden farmers back then and helped out where he could.

[sad] It's a shame that such a thing could happen to an honorable man. [hesitant] If you're looking for information, your best bet would probably be the Cathedral here in the city. Find Bishop Farthing. He might have an idea.
quest_40595_quest_complete: [soft voice] Why, hello there. [warm] Is there anything that I can help you with, <race>?
quest_40596_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A priest from Westfall, huh? Well, that is certainly familiar. There was only one church there, and I recall him having had all sorts of trouble from brigands to thugs who threatened to end his life. The Light can be testing at times, but no one should go through something like that.

[pause] He spent some time here in the Cathedral of Light before he moved on to Northshire Abbey. He helps out around there from time to time and goes by the name Brother Neals.
quest_40596_quest_complete:
[solemn] Oh, that is why you are here.

[soft voice] It's been a long time since my Westfall days, but hopefully I can be of help.
quest_40597_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, you're here about the Old Church in Westfall, huh? [soft voice] Well, it's been a while since anyone has asked about such a thing. The Cathedral inquired what happened, but nothing ended up coming of it.

[sad] The crooks got away with what they did, and so I decided I would just retire to some peaceful corner, only to hear that they are now here in Northshire as well.

<Brother Neals lets out a soft sigh.>

[hesitant] I'll go over what happened when you're ready; it might be a bit.
quest_40597_quest_complete: [solemn] So, do you see what has happened, and who is behind it all now?
quest_40598_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you've heard my story you can understand what has happened. [soft voice] If anyone is responsible for shutting down the church and the murder of the Easton Family, my suspicions lay toward Carver Molsen. [low voice] He inherited that farmstead and was always greedy for more, even going so far as to join the Defias.

[pause] Hopefully my information is relevant for you. [gentle] Perhaps you can bring it to Gryan Stoutmantle. [commanding] He is in charge of the People's Militia there.
quest_40598_quest_complete: [solemn] So, you’ve found the priest who led the church. [soft voice] Has he said anything about what happened?
quest_40599_quest_detail:
[solemn] Carver Molsen.

That is a familiar name. [soft voice] He leads various gangs and crews of thugs in the region. [pause] If the rumors and word from Brother Neals are correct, then he is no doubt in possession of the missing deeds for both the Molsen and Easton plots.

[urgent] There is an insider within Stormwind named Larry Ryder who has given us some information on the Defias. [hesitant] Perhaps he knows information on how to find this Carver Molsen.

[low voice] You can find him in Stormwind, usually skulking about the Pig and Whistle in Old Town.
quest_40599_quest_complete: [hesitant] So, what... you want information? [low voice] It won't come easy.
quest_40600_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, I know who you're looking for. [sad] Rowdy type... wants more than he has.

You know what I'm talking about.

[urgent] If you want information then I'm going to need help. You do a favor for me, I do a favor for you, understood? [commanding] I have a few contacts that are looking for a somewhat rare poison that comes from Greater Tarantula Venom. You can find it from those Greater Tarantulas out in Redridge Mountains.

Go there, get me seven, and come back. [emphasis] Easy right? [angry] So don't take that long. I don't like waiting.
quest_40600_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got the Venom yet? My contacts won't be happy waiting around.
quest_40600_quest_complete:
[excited] Well, would you look at that, you survived the trip, most people around here don't really want to collect venom from giant spiders.

[warm] Either way, you did good by me, so I'll do good by you.
quest_40601_quest_detail:
[commanding] So, who was this about, Marven Horsen? Larsen Wormen?

<Larry lets a crass smirk rest on his face.>

Carver Molsen, he certainly is a character, hangs around that old farmstead, goes by the name 'The Dead Acre' these days, used to be called the Easton Fields.

[urgent] You got what you needed, now go on, and tell who you need to.
quest_40601_quest_complete: [soft voice] The Dead Acre huh, interesting.
quest_40602_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time for justice to be dealt. For the murder of the Easton family, and the disruption of peace in Westfall, Carver Molsen shall not be spared any mercy in these lands.

[commanding] Bring some good news to the remaining people of Westfall, and travel to the Dead Acre, just to the south east. [urgent] Kill him, and recover the Deed of Easton Fields, the Deed of Molsen Farm, and the Westfall Church Key.

With him gone, there may yet be hope for a future in these lands.
quest_40602_quest_progress: [solemn] Has he been brought to justice, <name>?
quest_40602_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have brought justice to the Eastons, and have removed a dangerous criminal from our lands, for that we cannot be more grateful.

[warm] With these deeds there is hope we may resettle the land once the Defias threat is removed. Let us hope such a future comes soon, <name>.

[proud] For your efforts I have prepared some items, they should serve you well.
quest_40603_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is one last thing I ask of you in regards to the matter of the Old Westfall Church. [soft voice] Brother Neals is responsible for much of the information we have discovered, I have prepared a letter to be sent to him.

[warm] I have also included the Westfall Church Key, when this land is restored to order, I would think of one no better to return it to working order.

[urgent] Head to Northshire Abbey, and bring it to him with my letter.
quest_40603_quest_progress: [solemn] So, what news comes from Westfall?
quest_40603_quest_complete:
<Brother Neals reads the letter, his face easing, and an expression of relief washes over him.> [solemn] It feels good to know justice has been met out to that ruffian, for all the misery he has caused.

[warm] I am just happy that my information was able to assist and bring justice to that lawless land. <Brother Neals takes the Westfall Church Key, tucking it into a pocket of his robe carefully.>
quest_40604_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was sent here to get an estimate of the damage done, and it looks to be beyond salvage. [low voice] The troggs have gone and smashed much of the track, rail and work that was done within that valley. [hesitant] If I am to send a report back I hope to atleast show some sign that it is recoverable, maybe that is where you can come in.

[urgent] The trogg infestation needs to be dealt with before the real work can be done, head just past this tunnel 'ere, and clean them out, do some real good skullthumping, and return to me, aye?
quest_40604_quest_complete:
[excited] Why, you managed to thin their numbers aye?

[warm] Impressive work, more then I expected even. [pause] Now I can get to work with gathering my report.
quest_40605_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Redbrand Digsite was a location of both mining and archelogy, many of their records and achievements are recorded in a book named the Redbrand Archive.

[soft voice] I was primarily sent here to recover that book, and return it to Torwyn Redbrand back in Ironforge. [urgent] If you could do me a favor, and gather that for me, it would mean a lot while I remain and clean up this mess. [emphasis] It should be located within the main building of the digsite, gather it, and bring it to Torwyn, you can find him at the Mystic Ward near the Redbrand Estate.
quest_40605_quest_progress: [gentle] Can I help you with anything <class>?
quest_40605_quest_complete:
[solemn] Why, this is the Archive from our digsite in the Badlands, is it not?

<Torwyn lets out a small chuckle of approval.>

[soft voice] By my beard, we've been looking for this, a chance to log it within our shelves, you've done good work recovering it, [warm] you have our gratitude.
quest_40606_quest_detail:
[angry] You again?! I'll forgive your bar tab if you do me a favor. What do you mean, you don't have an open tab?

I suppose I might be mistaken, all of you <class> types look the same to me.

[commanding] Look, the Witherbarks have developed a secret ritual that produces alchemical products with powerful properties, or so the tale goes. [urgent] I've got to get ahold of it - these are vital secrets that could change the whole situation around here! [soft voice] Nobody around here seems to know any details, but perhaps the Elves down by their waterfall have an idea - ask for Lieren's sister, she's usually clever about these sorts of things. [whispering] Oh, and don't mention this, but would you mind getting this taken care of before the holiday party?
quest_40606_quest_complete:
[angry] "Ritual secrets", is that the line that mangy dwarf fed you?

[soft voice] On the other hand, he's been generous with his wares, and I suppose he isn't too terribly looking, either. [hesitant] Perhaps just a little bit of information couldn't hurt.
quest_40607_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Witherbark are descended from our oldest enemies, the Amani Empire, but have since lost even the veneer of civilization. [hesitant] I don't even want hazard what sort of dark practices happen when they cook their ritual secrets in those boiling cauldrons of theirs, but supposedly those concoctions are careful and deliberate. [soft voice] A quaff of their brew serves as anesthetic for their cruel and barbaric rituals; the victim is rendered indistinguishable from a blind drunk for hours, and remembers little afterwards. [urgent] If you want a copy of this dark formula, you'll have to snatch them from the Witherbark Callers of Shadra'Alor.

[gentle] Do be careful, will you? [soft voice] You don't seem the type to drink poison deliberately.
quest_40607_quest_progress: [excited] I knew plying those elves with some ale would pay off one day! [hesitant] Where did Loania say to get the recipe?
quest_40607_quest_complete:
[excited] Up a pyramid, you say? Never would've guessed!

You've done good, but these trolls might as well be doctors for how readable their handwriting is! [laughing] I'm not even sure if this recipe calls for fresh cherries, or if grenadine will do... heck, we'll just have to try it out both ways!

[warm] At any rate, have one on the house!
quest_40608_quest_detail:
[solemn] Weeks it took to fertilize, and toil that ground, and make useable soil, all ruined by a flock of buzzards that swooped down, and ravaged the place for some fresh feed.

[angry] Bah, dang dumb buzzards!

[urgent] There may still be some of the crop harvest left, lucky for us I had just finished bundling it all before those bastards came down and sent me running. [commanding] Head down the hill toward the farm, kill some to make the rest think twice about freeloading there too long, and gather up 4 bundles of crop harvest, would ye?
quest_40608_quest_progress: [urgent] We can't take all day now, [emphasis] if you wait too long they might eat it all up.
quest_40608_quest_complete:
[excited] Ahh, ye done it!

[warm] I be a bit too old to fight them off, it's a good thing you came around.
quest_40647_quest_detail:
[solemn] Shadow welcomes you, <name>. My name is Artemus and I've traveled long and far from Hillsbrad Foothills to do business with the Goblins of Powder Town. They are very unique to call them so. [mocking tone] Madmen that would do anything for their goals and even for someone of my condition, this is very exciting!

[excited] I used to study herbology in Dalaran when I was younger, regretfully I was nowhere near my home when the plague struck and there we have it. [soft voice] I won't bore you with a soapy story of how I came to be undead and how much I hate myself or whatever others say. [confident] I'm quite happy with my condition, I finally have the time to experience and learn everything I want to.

[solemn] I have traveled all this way to continue my studies, more specifically in decay. The local ancients in the Charred Vale have become withered, and tortured.

Bring me one of their Decaying Roots, it shall prove useful.
quest_40647_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you found their twisted forms?
quest_40647_quest_complete:
[excited] These will do perfectly!

[warm] You have my appreciation, [warm] this will surely be very useful.
quest_40649_quest_detail:
[commanding] Well met, <race>. [commanding] I have a mission to test your skills, and prove your mettle to the Kargath Expeditionary Force. [commanding] Make no mistake, your performance will make itself known to not just us, but our brothers in Orgrimmar as well.

[pause] So. [urgent] Assuming you won't flee with your tail between your legs, head to the dwarven fortress to the north east. [emphasis] You will notice it jutting out of the land like a boil, ready to be lanced. [angry] Decimate the denizens there. [commanding] Return when you have slain the bulk of their forces.
quest_40649_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you made any progress, <race>?
quest_40649_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, I have not expected you back so soon, or back at all in fact.
quest_40650_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you seen a chicken with its head cut off, <race>? [pause] It runs around, aimless, panicking, before finally dropping dead. [commanding] When you head to Angor Fortress, to the north east, strike deep into it. [urgent] Go for the one who organises them, and the rest who survive will be just as aimless as the beheaded bird.

[low voice] Barlgruf is his name. [threatening] He will not be alone, nor will he be accommodating, so strike first and strike hard. [angry] Return to me when he lies in a puddle of his own blood.
quest_40650_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [angry] Is he dead? [threatening] Or must I find someone more competent to carry out the task?
quest_40650_quest_complete: [commanding voice] Yes, I heard from my scouts the commotion over there. [warm] Well done indeed, the Dark Iron Dwarves shall not recover from this wound quickly.
quest_40651_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I get really tired sometimes of working on rocks, you know? [excited] And then, something comes along that really blows your socks off! [laughing] Quite literally sometimes when it comes to engineering, but...

<He coughs awkwardly and wipes the sweat from his brow.>

[urgent] Listen! The dwarves in Angor Fortress? They have begun automating their golem protectors recently. [shocked] I don't know exactly how they do it! [emphasis] I witnessed one zapping the chest of the big statue and it came to life right there and then! [excited] Can you believe it?

[urgent] I need that zap-o-matic thermojigger, or whatever it is! [commanding] Find it, please, and bring me a few of their hearts to play with while you're at it, yes?
quest_40651_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any success? [excited] I can't wait to tinker with those hearts!
quest_40651_quest_complete: [excited] Oh my word they are heavy! [soft voice] How did you carry them all this way? [warm] Well done, well done indeed!
quest_40652_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, a moment of your time please, <name>?

[commanding] Yes, yes, I know who you are. I was planning on discussing this issue with Senator Redstone, since he appears to have a passing interest in the goings on in the Badlands. But since you have fortuitously come to me, perhaps you will listen to my request.

[solemn] My brother is part of an expeditionary party down there, you see. A prospector, but he has his mind set on ridiculous fairy tales and is chasing legends. [angry] He has lost sight of what is important! [solemn] There is much wealth and knowledge to be gained from scratching the surface of the earth, never mind delving into its depths.

[urgent] Seek out the digsites in the northern part of the Badlands. Beware, I think the Dark Iron Dwarves are excavating there and are unlikely to enjoy onlookers. [warm] Come back when you have a nice collection of artefacts.

[gentle] Oh, and <name>? [commanding] If you can't pick them up from the ground, feel free to take them directly from their hands.
quest_40652_quest_complete: [soft voice] What beautifully dull looking objects. [sad] This is all you found...? Hmm... [hesitant] very well.
quest_40653_quest_detail:
<He massages his temples and looks awfully exasperated.> [low voice] Frankly, I was not sure I had to spell it out so clearly. I want the best of the relics here. The real findings from the digsites. Not old pieces of pottery and... whatever these are. [urgent] Go back to that digsite. Find their leader, for he will surely preside over the more prestigious treasures. Take, steal, whatever you have to do, to bring back something actually worthwhile to me.

[commanding] Just do be careful, I hear the lead archaeologist there is a rather powerful spellcaster. I am sure that is no trouble for one of your stature though, correct <name>?
quest_40653_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, now that is more like it! [warm] Did you have to kill... actually, no, let us not discuss that here. [soft voice] Perhaps over an ale later on? Hmm? Or do you prefer rum?
quest_40654_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The coin is much larger than any coin you have seen before, and quite a bit heavier. [solemn] It appears to have someone's head engraved in the surface, but is too covered in muck and dust to be made out clearly.

[pause] Rubbing some dust off the surface, the material seems to get shinier and shinier. [emphasis] Is this gold?
quest_40654_quest_progress: [hesitant] Hmm? [angry] What are you coming to me with this time, <name>?
quest_40654_quest_complete: <His eyes widen and he quickly fishes into his pockets, extending out a handful of golden coins.> [commanding] Take them. [warm] A good find, a good find indeed. <He begins to beckon to the surrounding guards. This seems to be an offer you can't refuse...>
quest_40655_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am sure it goes without saying, I have no great love for little young creatures. [angry] I have nothing but contempt for humans, for example, and their little pets.

<He sneers beneath his mask.>

[low voice] But I have recently been made aware of an encampment in Lethlor Ravine, and the skinned corpses of countless whelplings thrown into the sun to rot. [threatening] The Dark Iron Dwarves once again. [commanding] Now, why would anyone set up a guarded camp to slaughter whelplings and drakes, if not to harvest something important? [urgent] I do not particularly care what they hope to achieve, but if we strike now before they are more fortified, we will cut off this venture at the knees.

[commanding] Find this base of operations, and slay the dwarves you find within.
quest_40655_quest_progress: [urgent] Has the camp been torn apart yet?
quest_40655_quest_complete: [low voice] Hmm, this encampment sounds like it is being built more quickly than I anticipated. Perhaps this is urgent indeed.
quest_40656_quest_detail:
[solemn] Perhaps I should apologise for not being as informed as I would have liked. [soft voice] Had I known how established this camp already was, I would have tasked an assassination of their leader.

[commanding] Actually, perhaps you are ardent for blood and glory. Head back into that camp, find their leader, and kill him. [urgent] Not a complicated task, but one that may be more dangerous than before. [low voice] He will surely be prepared for this, given your previous efforts.
quest_40656_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work indeed, <name>. [proud] I will ensure your name is glorified for your grisly work, here.
quest_40657_quest_detail:
<He throws up his hand to halt your approach.> [commanding] That is close enough. [whispering] And speak quietly, lest you irk us with your prattle of adventure and questing...

Actually, I do have a request. [soft voice] Scalebane Ridge, heard of it? No? Lethlor Ravine, then? No? The Badlands? You are a truly a dense one...

[low voice] I need you to find the encampment known as Scalebane Ridge. [solemn] It is a new base of operations for the Dark Iron Dwarves in that area, and their hunting of the whelplings in the area gives me a very bad feeling about what they could be used for. [urgent] In any case, better safe than sorry. Head over there, and slaughter their hunters.
quest_40657_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, yes, a suitable conclusion to a necessary task.
quest_40658_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before you run off like a fool, I have one more task to add. [commanding] This Scalebane Ridge, it has not cropped up out of nowhere. [confident] I would bet my large fortunes that there is a lieutenant of some sort leading the operations.

[urgent] I want him dead. Certainly taking him out of the picture will impede all the work that goes on there, hopefully indefinitely. [gentle] I trust you have a few friends that may help you with such a task? [soft voice] Good, go. [proud] I will compensate you appropriately.
quest_40658_quest_progress: [angry] This had better be good news, or I'm calling the guards.
quest_40658_quest_complete: [soft voice] Somewhat impressive, though I suppose it speaks of your general demeanor that I was rather expecting failure. [pause] Here. Take these coins.
quest_40659_quest_detail: [soft voice] The knife embeds itself into the palm at the slightest press. Truly this could cut through almost any living tissue, but the handle is awkward and heavy. Holding it up, the sun glints across the pristine surface. [solemn] Perhaps someone interested in survival techniques could make use of this beauty.
quest_40659_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, adventurer! [soft voice] I see you are a capable... hmm? [angry] What do you want?
quest_40659_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh my, oh my! [sad] No, this isn't a survival knife, this is a skinning knife. [hesitant] It's obvious, see, hold it like this and… there you go. [solemn] Perfectly crafted that is, not sure I've seen anything like it before. [warm] Hold onto it, I suspect it will serve you well.
quest_40661_quest_complete:
[delight] A rose? Why, isn't this something else..

From the Sailor Borus?

<The woman would let out a soft snicker, smirking openly.>

I remember the name, and that Kul Tiran man well, I never assumed him such a romantic.
quest_40662_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Who would suspect a Kul Tiran sailor to show so much affection? [low voice] Those that many call crass, blunt, and overly loud at that.

[warm] He has surprised me, in a rather nice way; to be remembered after such a long time really is a compliment.

[gentle] Here, I prepared a letter for him, and - just - for him. [commanding] Do not think to pry it open, my magic will know if you do.

<She gives a wicked stare, and lets out a laugh to ease her feigned threat.>

[urgent] Take it to the sailor, and let him know his actions are appreciated.
quest_40664_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We live in harmony here with nature, to let our gryphon's grow strong and roam wild.

[solemn] I have seen to watching our borders and have noticed the stunning growth of the Silvermane population. [urgent] The wolves have become more and more aggresive as their territory expands and now they are at our doorstep more often than ever before.

[commanding] We will need to cull their numbers, lest they begin to strike at us or kill our roaming gryphon. [warm] You can find the Silvermane wolves all across the Hinterlands, bring me fourteen of their pelts as proof.
quest_40664_quest_progress: [soft voice] Any luck in your hunting <name>?
quest_40664_quest_complete: [soft voice] You've done well, your work will certainly go a long way in halting their aggresion and lowering the chances of any potential hostile run-ins. [warm] The Wildhammer thank you for the effort.
quest_40665_quest_detail:
[solemn] War is upon our lands, <class>.

The arrogant Kul Tirans think us weak and it is up to the brave sons and daughters of the Horde to teach them otherwise!

[commanding] A second wave of their old fleet, the same we vanquished years ago, has landed just off our shores, posing a threat to our people.

On the southern edge of the Echo Isles, their scouts and commandos can be found, probing and plotting for their next move. [urgent] Slay them in the name of the Horde, and return to me!
quest_40665_quest_progress: [commanding] Throw them back into the waves. [threatening] Let the sea churn red with their blood.
quest_40665_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, but do not yet sing for victory: [low voice] Our foe is as vicious as it is relentless.
quest_40666_quest_detail:
[solemn] Only shortly ago, we learned that not all of Daelin Proudmoore's lieutenants were slain in the War for Durotar. [low voice] We were expecting their return, but we did not think they'd be so well-armed.

[commanding] All wars are fought on supplies, however, and there is no doubt they are stretched thin so far from their homeland.

[urgent] Search their camps on the southern rims of the Echo Isles and pillage their stocks — they may be forced to leave before ever setting foot near Orgrimmar.
quest_40666_quest_complete:
[solemn] Proudmoore thought us ill-made mongrels, unthinking and mad with bloodlust.

[commanding] But true warfare requires strategic acuity as much as it requires a sharp edge and strong guts.

[warm] You have done well, <name>. [confident] We have defeated the Kul Tirans once, we shall defeat them again.
quest_40667_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have made glorious battle upon our enemies, <name>.

[proud] The Horde honors those who bear our banner so proudly. [commanding] For your might, I bestow upon you this commendation. [warm] Wear it well, for your next task will take you to our great Orgrimmar.

[soft voice] In the Valley of Wisdom, our Warchief waits for tidings of the ongoing Kul Tiran conflict. [solemn] Tell him all you have done and all you have learned.
quest_40668_quest_progress: [soft voice] What can I do for you?
quest_40668_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, he sent you?

[pause] I see.
quest_40669_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So, Thrall sent you huh?

[hesitant] Interesting, I was sent here to replace another, but I never expected to be contacted. The last two before me were never spoken to in regard to anything.

[solemn] I work for an organization that has deep ties with Stormwind and has its eyes all over the world, so to say.

[pause] I will share the information I hold, but I need a favor from you and your kin beforehand. [urgent] I am here for another purpose, one I need completed in short time, but do not fret, it is within the region.

[low voice] In the Barrens can be found a very specific type of raptor, Sunscale. [commanding] Some of our agents have been looking to gather vials of their blood. [emphasis] Three in total for archival purposes.

[warm] Gather me those vials, and the information is yours.
quest_40669_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any progress?
quest_40669_quest_complete: <Mally O'Flor would take careful time analyzing the blood.> [solemn] You honor your word, and so I shall honor mine.
quest_40670_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have stashed away the Vials, and am ready to speak, should you be prepared to listen.

[pause] When you are ready, speak with me, and I will tell you what it is I know.
quest_40671_quest_progress: [urgent] You return, and not a moment too soon.
quest_40671_quest_complete:
[solemn] I advised the Warchief against the sending of envoys. [sad] It was no use with a man like Alverold.

[angry] Our men were cowardly assailed under the flag of peace. [cold] Those treacherous Kul Tirans tied them to stakes, soaked them in tar and burned them alive on the shore.

[urgent] Now we hold nothing back, [shouting] now we put an end to them!
quest_40672_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is an island south of the Echo Isles the pinkskins have come to call Anchor's Edge.

[commanding] The time for planning and talking is over.

[urgent] Travel to Anchor's Edge with as many comrades as you can find and kill every Kul Tiran armed with either blade or spell. [commanding] Take the rest prisoner. [angry] That is my command!

[shouting] GO FORTH FOR THE HORDE, FOR BLOOD AND THUNDER!
quest_40672_quest_progress: [solemn] Have they been overcome, have they been destroyed?!
quest_40672_quest_complete:
[solemn] If my duties did not keep me here, I would have gladly joined you in the thrill of battle.

[proud] You have delivered the Warchief's reckoning to our enemies. [warm] For that, the whole Horde shall sing your praise.
quest_40673_quest_detail:
[commanding] If we wish to utterly dismantle the Expedition Fleet, then we must crush the head of the snake: Captains, commanders, officers and other figures of interest. The Shattered Hand Clan was kind enough to provide me with a list of their names.

[urgent] Go to Anchor's Edge, south of the Echo Isles in southeastern Durotar.

Once you arrive, you must look for and kill Hydromancer Shaleborn and Deckmaster Darkhollow, along with any breathing officer on the isle .

[angry] Their whole leadership shall crumble!
quest_40673_quest_progress:
[commanding] It must be done, their leaders must die. [solemn] They, more than the luckless footsoldiers they throw at us, are at fault for the persecution of our people.

[urgent] Do not forget it.
quest_40673_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, then. [commanding] With their chain of command gone, it might take months for their expedition to re-organize.

[urgent] We shall not give them such a luxury.
quest_40674_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have bested their warriors, killed their champions, breached the heart of their stronghold.

[commanding] Only one deed remains to be done: Alverold himself must follow Daelin Proudmoore to the grave.

[urgent] He is likely to be hiding in the most fortified structure on Anchor's Edge, guarded by a paladin knight known as Danuvis.

[commanding] End them both, then return to me with Alverold's head.
quest_40674_quest_progress: [solemn] I have not forgotten Alverold's heinous pyres. [commanding] Give him and the last of his expedition what they deserve!
quest_40674_quest_complete:
<Dar'nakk holds the head of Alverold aloft.> [threatening] Here you are, pinkskin. [angry] Burn in your hell, knowing it was the Horde who vanquished you.

[commanding] We orcs are here to stay, you make sure you remember that when you bring my regards to Daelin!

<Dar'nakk looks back to you.>

[low voice] Now, you and I shall have a talk.
quest_40675_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your dedication to the Horde and your courage in battle are both beyond question.

[warm] You have earned one of the highest honors Orgrimmar can bestow: A Lok'tra shall be composed of your victory at Anchor's Edge, forevermore to be sung by our people in memory of what transpired there.

[soft voice] But that cannot be your only reward.

[urgent] The Warchief wishes to see you again — he is known to be generous to his loyal warriors.
quest_40678_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Why do you think I fish, mon? It's a lot calmer and less dangerous than fighting... that's for sure.

[pause] Now, recently I've been getting my fishing rods stolen by Drysnaps, huge they are! And they can rip an arm off if you're not careful...

[sad] This isn't what I need in my mornings, mon. [commanding] If you be killin' them for me, you'd be doing myself and the village a big service.
quest_40678_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you made the seas safer for me, mon?
quest_40678_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, I watched you killin' them from the pier!
quest_40684_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello <race>, Have you heard? [solemn] A Pandaren, one of the most reclusive races, has been seen in Ratchet.

[whispering] The merchants say he is celebrating a festival native to his homeland. [hesitant] If you have some free time perhaps you could go and see this Pandaren and what this festival is about.
quest_40685_quest_detail:
Lok'tar <race>! [excited] Have you heard the news? Chen Stormstout has returned to Kalimdor! [solemn] Chen Stormstout was integral in the founding and defense of Orgrimmar alongside the likes of Rokhan, Cairne, and Rexxar!

[urgent] Many are journeying to Ratchet to meet him, perhaps you would be interested as well, rumor is that he is looking for something and may reward whoever assists him.
quest_40687_quest_detail:
[solemn] Theramore was founded by many from the nation of Kul Tiras; our leader Jaina even hails from there. [soft voice] Our stance of cautious neutrality with the Horde has caused problems for many of the veterans. [sad] These soldiers once saw brothers and sisters die in combat, or had families pass in war.

[pause] More and more of our kin stray from Theramore with each day. [urgent] Either deserting outright or being exiled for overly aggressive and divisive actions in attempts to lead us to conflict.

[commanding] While I hold respect for those that served I do not tolerate disloyalty. [angry] The Deserters have begun to go too far, wearing our tabards, uniforms, and lurking within the swamp.

[commanding] They must be dealt with before they bring all-out war to us. [solemn] The Hideout is located directly to the west of Theramore, within the Quagmire. [urgent] Head there and remove their presence.
quest_40687_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you find the hideout, and dispatched the turncoats?
quest_40687_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, [emphasis] their actions could have cause chaos for us should their plots and ploys come to fruition. [warm] Take these coins, as thanks for us here in Theramore.
quest_40688_quest_detail:
[solemn] Weeks ago a patrol of our sentries were attacked by Tauren of the Blackhorn Tribe nearby, it was unwarranted and somewhat unexpected. [sad] Of those attacked two were killed and others severely injured, the threat of the Blackhorn have only made us be ever more wary in our actions in Dustwallow.

[low voice] The leader of the Blackhorn is named Targos Hatewind, a vile a cruel warrior who does not even seek affilation with the Horde.

[urgent] It is him that must be stopped, you can find him at Blackhorn Village to the north west at the northern edge of Dustwallow Marsh.

[commanding] Go there, kill his kin, and collect his head.
quest_40688_quest_progress: [solemn] Each day the Blackhorn are left to their devices is another day more of our patrols may be ambushed.
quest_40688_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, [soft voice] their actions could have sown chaos in the region. [warm] Here, take these coins as thanks from us here in Theramore.
quest_40689_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have learned that desertion is rife in the ranks of Theramore. Human weakness makes itself clear to see.

But do not take those to be good news, <class>, as those cravens are only quitting their posts to come harry us here.

[urgent] Already their rabble draws close past the border established by the truce in Dustwallow. [commanding] We cannot allow them to go any further.

Venture southeast of Brackenwall and punish them. Ensure they think twice about trespassing again.
quest_40689_quest_progress: [commanding] Have the wretches been dealt with, <class>?
quest_40689_quest_complete: [commanding] You fight well and kill better, <name>. [warm] With you at our side, who knows, we might even conquer Theramore a second time over!
quest_40690_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Grimtotem in the region are a spineless, and traitorous bunch. [sad] They once spoke with us in talks of unity, and now ambushed and killed a friend of mine in combat within the Quagmire.

[angry] They must pay for their insolence, and disrespect. [commanding] They are led by a craven named Targos Hatewind, it is he that I want dead.

[urgent] Head northeast to Blackhorn Village, and bring ruin to them, they are enemies of the Horde.
quest_40690_quest_progress: [commanding] The Grimtotem must be checked, and trampled.
quest_40690_quest_complete:
[solemn] You ease the blood that boils in my veins, it is good to know such a craven has been removed from the world.

[warm] You have my gratitude <race>.
quest_40691_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stonetalon.

The name brings anger to my core, this is the place my brother died in his fight during the Third War.

[low voice] While I served in Ironforge he sought glory in these lands, but he did not find what he sought. [soft voice] His tale deserves to be heard, when you are ready, speak with me, and I will recount it.
quest_40691_quest_progress: [solemn] There is a reason for me being here, beyond all else.
quest_40691_quest_complete:
[solemn] Now you see why it is I traveled so far?

[proud] I will reclaim my families glory.
quest_40692_quest_detail:
[solemn] My family's history is stained, our heirlooms lost in time, and our axe in the hands of an orc who slayed my kin.

[sad] There is no greater fall for a dwarf, and I must right the wrongs.

[urgent] I have had some luck in tracking this 'Scartusk', for he is one of the Warsong, lingering in the forest of Ashenvale just beyond the Talondeep Path to the north. [emphasis] Just past Talondeep Path, head westward, to the Ruins of Stardust, it is there he resides, scouting for the enemy.

[commanding] Bring my family's axe to me, and honor my brother.
quest_40692_quest_progress: [solemn] Each second that orc breaths is longer that my family remains dishonored.
quest_40692_quest_complete:
<The sight of the axe nearly brings a tear to Grumnir's eyes.> [solemn] I cannot believe it, after all of these years, and finally before me again.

[warm] You have honored our family beyond belief, and given me justice, and relief.

[proud] I will not forget this moment <name>.
quest_40693_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you heard the tale of the Ornate Windshear Gemstone?!

[excited] It really is a wonder of prospectin' I tell you what! [soft voice] It is told by rumor that those Venture Co. hooligans up and dug some rare crystal deep beneath Stonetalon, one that glimmered a deep, and shiny red.

[low voice] You see, I aint out here to see the sights, no, [angry] BAH! [sad] This place be more ugly than Westfall, and trust me, I been there.

[urgent] If I want a chance to get out of this hell hole, it lies in that Windshear Gemstone, and I want my hands on it.

[commanding] What say you make your way down to the Windshear Mine down in the Crag and do ol' Flinthammer a favor huh?

[warm] I'll give ye somethin in return, how about that to spice up a deal?
quest_40693_quest_progress: [soft voice] Windshear Gemstone....[pause] Oh, what a beauty that'd be aye?
quest_40693_quest_complete:
<Flinthammer's goggles begin to fog up.> [excited] Oh by sweet Ironforge!

[delight] That is it, it really is it! [excited] I can't believe you went and recovered the thing, [warm] good and honest work you did for me.

[warm] Here, take these, and some coin on top. [warm] Maybe I can find a new place to look for rare crystals now.

[warm] All thanks to you of course.
quest_40694_quest_detail:
[solemn] My beauty, trapped in a sea of vultures.

[commanding] I am a brave dwarf, but if I ever want to fly again, I can't go risking my life now, can I?

[soft voice] You look like someone who knows a thing or two about slaying vultures, and Sputtervalve Conductors. [proud] The eyes of Harlek can spot talent when he see's it!

[urgent] My flying machine is down below, I was doing some repairs before me and farmer Segwar were attacked you see? [sad] Sadly I left behind the Sputtervalve Conductor, a rather valuable part that I was trying to get fixed to do some scouting in the perimeter.

[gentle] I need you to go down to the flight pad, and go get the part for me, do that, and I'll give you a nice drink of ale, good?
quest_40694_quest_progress: [solemn] Grounded, unable to soar the sky! [sad] I lament at such dark times.
quest_40694_quest_complete:
Ahh, now lets see...

<Harlek takes his time, inspecting the part over.>

[sigh] Blasted, it would appear the part took even more damage during my retreat from the assaulting birds... I will need some specialized equipment if I am to have a chance at getting my turbo-charge beauty back in the sky.

[soft voice] Oh, about that ale, I had one, sorry about that, a troubled mind is a thirsty mind, as they say.
quest_40695_quest_detail:
[angry] Bah, dangnabbit!

[hesitant] I don't have anything to fix this, I suppose I need to find someone who know's a thing or two about marveled engineering on such a delicate part...

<Harlek Vaultshield lets out a chuckle.>

[excited] Oh, that's right, I do know! Tansi Sparkfuse is in town... Somewhere, no doubt working on something, find her and see if she can fix the Sputtervalve, would ye?
quest_40695_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Harlek sent you?

<Tansi lets out a sigh.>

This is the fourth time in the past few weeks he has asked for my assistance with parts, that flying machine of his keeps breaking down.
quest_40696_quest_detail:
<Tansi Sparkfuse blinks at the Sputtervalve Conductor.> [soft voice] Well, that wasn't too hard, all it required was a few wires and some tubing.

[chuckling] Harlek is going to have to owe me for all of these favors I am doing for him.

[urgent] Take it to him, he should be pleased.
quest_40696_quest_complete:
<Harlek Vaultshield visibly lights up.> [laughing] Haha! [excited] I am free to fly again, a savant of the skies to soar once more!

[warm] Thanks to you and Tansi I am no longer land locked.

[proud] Good work <class>.
quest_40697_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Our new neighbors certainly are quite an interesting bunch. The dwarves here at Bael Hardul have been quite gracious in their hosting.

[solemn] I am Maloran, a delegate on behalf of Stonetalon Peak, sent to make sure that the natural order is not disturbed. [hesitant] I will admit I held caution when I first arrived, but thus far, Whitepeak has been fairly respectable.

[emphasis] This has left me to pursue my real purposes. [solemn] Beneath us to the west the Venture Co. has laid unmarked terror to the fabric of nature, and I wish to see if the local Deepmoss have been affected.

[urgent] Travel to the west, and gather me a Pristine Deepmoss Brain, I will use it for study.
quest_40697_quest_progress: [solemn] There is no doubt in my mind that nature is being disturbed.
quest_40697_quest_complete: [delight] Why, I must say, you have certainly gone above and beyond what I have asked, [warm] this is quite a perfect specimen, and will help me with my work.
quest_40698_quest_detail:
<A look of displeasure marks Maloran's features> [solemn] It would appear my research has proven me correct. [soft voice] Whilst the Deepmoss population is in a state of increased aggressiveness, there is something more, lingering just beneath it all.

[hesitant] I sense corruption of a magical sort, and this finding has left me with more questions than answers.

[pause] A friend of mine named Faldan Moonshatter has taken it upon himself to study the corruption of furbolg in Ashenvale. [solemn] Perhaps he may have some answers as to how such a thing could have happened.

[soft voice] You can find Faldan within Astranaar, at the heart of Ashenvale itself.
quest_40698_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am once again left with more questions...

<Maloran clutches his jaw, musing to himself in thought.>

[hesitant] More work will be needed to uncover a solution to the problem.
quest_40699_quest_detail:
[excited] Why hello there!

[shocked] What, shocked to see a gnome so far west? [chuckling] Well, you should be, there isn't many of my kind so far from home.

[sad] Or well, what used to be home.

[commanding] Either way, I'm looking to conduct experiments now that I have some time and space to myself, the first of which requires some flammable, and quite dangerous materials!

[urgent] Far to the west is a place called The Charred Vale, it is there that roving flame elementals can be found, from them I'd like to acquire something called a 'Flickering Flame'. [warm] Get it for me, and I'll make sure you're compensated.
quest_40699_quest_progress: [soft voice] My hands are eager for some practice, [pause] have you had any luck?
quest_40699_quest_complete: [solemn] You honor your word, and so I will honor mine.
quest_40700_quest_detail:
[solemn] Perched above Bael Hardul is the dreaded Bramblethorn Pass, occupied by Quilboar and their haunted kin.

[soft voice] The wayward spirits have cause us all sorts of trouble, and have had us on high alert since we arrived. [urgent] We could use someone to disperse the spirits to let our limited Mountaineers a chance to rest.

[commanding] You can find them just to the south west, up the slope, head up there, and deal with them for us.
quest_40700_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you dealt with the dead <race>?
quest_40700_quest_complete: [solemn] It eases my mind to know that we may just be a little more safe in our, somewhat isolated position, [warm] I thank ye for that.
quest_40701_quest_detail:
[solemn] When the dwarves first arrived in Stonetalon and had built Bael Hardul, a mighty Quilboar ruled over Bramblethorn Pass. [low voice] He was named Gorras Thorncrusher and was quite a formidable enemy.

[pause] After many battles with the Quilboar, Gorras was slain, though his indomitable spirit remains, perched overtop of Bramblethorn Pass, still occupying his throne. [cold] His hatred for our kind is unmatched, and it is only a matter of time until his soul comes for vengeance. [urgent] We must put an end to such evil.

[commanding] Travel again to Bramblethorn Pass, and find Gorras Thorncrusher. [shouting] Destroy him once and for all.
quest_40701_quest_progress: [solemn] Gorras Thorncrusher will not cease, and must be dealt with.
quest_40701_quest_complete:
[solemn] You certainly have eased a troubled mind. [soft voice] Many a stronger dwarf than me fell at the hands of Gorras, and I hoped not to be another.

[warm] I thank you for everything you’ve done for us. [proud] Take this, as a token of my thanks.
quest_40702_quest_detail:
[solemn] My name is Whitepeak, I lead this group of would-be explorers here to Bael Hardul after hearing stories that it still stood. [soft voice] To my surprise it was, workable. [pause] There was a lot of clean up, but now that the work is done, it will be a good base of operations.

[hesitant] There is, however a hitch.

[angry] The last thing I expected was to have the Venture Co. at our doorstep, that was one detail we did not hear, and now that we are set up they keep moving more, and more people into Windshear Crag. [urgent] If we ever want to have a chance to explore, do so without constant protection we will need to remove this threat.

[commanding] Down the hill is Windshear Crag, it is there that the Venture Co. operate, head down, and remove their threat, on my behalf.
quest_40702_quest_progress: [solemn] Have the Venture Company been removed as a threat?
quest_40702_quest_complete:
[excited] By my beard, I must say, this is astounding work.

[warm] Hopefully they will get the memo and leave Windshear Crag for good.
quest_40703_quest_detail:
...[solemn] I fade, in and out of existence, my spirit is drawn to this world by foul powers, with my kin having much worse of a fate in Westhaven.

[pause] During the Third War, Kul Tiras waged war against the Horde, it was the orcish kin who came here, and left this place in ruin. We settled again after this conflict, only for an orcish warlock to bring havoc in his wake..

[threatening] He goes by the name Bar'thog, his foul, and horrific magic having raised the dead, leaving those who once lived here to shamble and fight on his behalf.

[urgent] End this curse, and free us from suffering.
quest_40703_quest_progress: [solemn] I can not rest, while this evil still lurks.
quest_40703_quest_complete: [solemn] I feel it now, severed from this dreadful link. [soft voice] I am at peace, and for that I thank you.
quest_40704_quest_detail:
[urgent] Blasted Gizzin, we're going to be extremely late with our delivery, and that means less money. [low voice] A goblin must always think about the future, and with us stuck here there needs to be some creativity.

Nearby local Earth Elementals are wandering the cliffside, and perhaps there can be some profit made afterall.

[soft voice] My family always said, when opportunity knocks... [hesitant] Whatever that means. Either way big shot- [urgent] you go, and get some Disturbed Elemental Cuffs, and bring them to me, [excited] sounds good yeah?
quest_40704_quest_complete: [low voice] Immaculate condition, not really sure what they're worth, but, it'll be something. [warm] Thanks for the trouble <class>.
quest_40705_quest_detail:
[urgent] We're way off schedule, and now we're missing supplies.

[angry] One wrong turn and everything turns belly up! [shouting] Hey wait a second, you look like you can handle a few Quilboar.

[excited] We almost walked directly into the dreaded Bramblethorn Pass, luckily for me I realized it when the stinking pigs came running at us! [commanding] I turned everything around, and big Hork here scared them off, not before they took a bunch of supplies from our wagons though...

[sad] If I am to keep my job I need those supplies back, maybe you can help me out.

[urgent] Head to the north west of here, into Bramblethorn Pass down the road, and gather eight Stolen Crates.
quest_40705_quest_complete: [excited] Ahh finally! [urgent] A chance to pack up and get back on the road, [pause] here, take some silver for the effort, [warm] you may have saved my job.
quest_40706_quest_detail:
[solemn] The devastation caused by the Venture Co. knows no end. [soft voice] Each day, we hear more and more news of the sheer horror they commit against the land.

[solemn] The balance of nature is a delicate matter, one that must be handled with care.

[low voice] Yet, the Venture Co. cares little for it. [angry] They are driven by greed and their actions are directly responsible for much of the suffering of the lands they inhabit. [solemn] I've recently received news of their most terrible operation yet.

[urgent] To the southwest, just north of the Charred Vale, a new passageway into the mountains has been carved out for their latest exploitation of the land.

[solemn] This path leads to the Blacksand Oil Fields. [solemn] The land has been ripped asunder, dominated by a large oil platform that oversees the entire operation.

[commanding] Put an end to their operation, once and for all!
quest_40706_quest_complete:
[delight] Your efforts are truly spectacular, [warm] without your help, I am not sure how we would have been able to put an end to the Venture Co. within the Blacksand Oil Fields.

[solemn] I must thank you, and from the bottom of my heart, [warm] perhaps we may bring balance to Stonetalon after all.
quest_40707_quest_detail:
[solemn] For too long have we druids been merciful towards our enemy, The Venture Company.

[angry] They care nothing for the world around them, stubbornly working towards their goals for their own greed. [urgent] If we are ever to put an end to their callous destruction of the land, then we must match their brutality.

[solemn] There is too much at stake for us to stand idle, and so I ask that you slay the workers at the Blacksand Oil Fields. [commanding] Collect their Blacksand Badges as proof of your deeds, cutting down as many of their numbers as you can.

[soft voice] You can find this misbegotten place northwest of the Charred Vale, through a passageway they've cut into the mountains.

[urgent] Go there and put an end to this madness.
quest_40707_quest_progress: [solemn] If we do not act decisively, the world will continue to be devastated and exploited for the Venture Company's profits.
quest_40707_quest_complete: [solemn] They will think twice when placing their hands upon sacred land, [defiant] we will not stand aside any longer.
quest_40708_quest_detail:
Greetings <race>, I am Archmage Talyvanah representing Dalaran. [solemn] As you may be aware, our city suffered much in the third war.

[soft voice] Dalaran is currently still rebuilding but there are reagents we need from the outside world.

[emphasis] Nexus Crystals in particular are essential for high level enchants. [warm] If you can get me a sample, you will earn a lot of favor with my nation.
quest_40708_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [warm] I'll let you in on a little secret. [soft voice] We're working on a way to replicate this, the one you got us will be the template.

[proud] I will let the Kirin Tor know of your service to the nation. [gentle] Stay safe, friend.
quest_40709_quest_detail: [soft voice] Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. [solemn] Even though weaker magical essences are more plentiful than other more powerful fonts they are still appreciated. [gentle] For 3 Greater Mystic Essences I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran.
quest_40709_quest_progress: Greetings. [soft voice] The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. Even though weaker magical essences are more plentiful than other more powerful fonts they are still appreciated. [solemn] For 3 Greater Mystic Essences I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran.
quest_40709_quest_complete: [soft voice] Any donation is appreciated, no matter how small.
quest_40710_quest_detail: Greetings. [solemn] The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. [soft voice] Small Radiant Shards are a quite potent font of power used for many tasks within Dalaran and are always needed. [warm] For a Small Radiant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, more than donations of weaker magical essences.
quest_40710_quest_progress: Greetings. [solemn] The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. [soft voice] Small Radiant Shards are a quite potent font of power used for many tasks within Dalaran and are always needed. [gentle] For a Small Radiant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, more than donations of weaker magical essences.
quest_40710_quest_complete: [warm] Nicely done, I'll make sure this is known.
quest_40711_quest_detail: [solemn] Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. The innate power of Large Brilliant Shards are only rivaled by the enigmatic Nexus Shards, only found on locations of major interest and acquired from artifacts of great power. [soft voice] For a Large Brilliant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, the most you can get from a single donation.
quest_40711_quest_progress: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. The innate power of Large Brilliant Shards are only rivaled by the enigmatic Nexus Shards, only found on locations of major interest and acquired from artifacts of great power. [soft voice] For a Large Brilliant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, the most you can get from a single donation.
quest_40711_quest_complete: [commanding] I'll personally make sure this is known, [warm] Dalaran thanks you for your donation.
quest_40712_quest_detail:
[solemn] Well met, you that wanders the lands of my ancestors. [solemn] As the last keeper of this temple, I welcome you to the temple of Zeth.

[solemn] Behold the flame of kings, stranger. [soft voice] Gaze into it, perhaps it will tell you of the future as it told me of this day, for I was one of the few to keep their sanity only to wait for this day to come. [soft voice] Understand me, stranger, I do not know your name, and even with sight beyond sight before me stands exactly what you see when you look at me. [soft voice] A ghostly figure with no shape whatsoever, and yet, the fire spoke so many moons ago. [solemn] Be it fates hand or simple coincidence, you were sent to aid me, and you will do so, either by the kindness of your heart or simple curiosity.

[solemn] The curse of Zetharia still haunts Corthan, as we speak the spirits are getting ready to strike you, as they do not see you for who you are but a memory of an enemy which has passed a long time ago. [urgent] If we are to continue our discussion you must make sure to dismiss them.
quest_40712_quest_complete: [solemn] It may seem cruel of me to ask you to put them to rest, my own people. [soft voice] But fear not stranger, as the sun comes up on the morrow, they too shall rise again.
quest_40713_quest_detail:
[solemn] This land was once ruled by many kings, each strong enough to contest, and dominate the landscape with a fist of iron, and strength eternal.

[soft voice] To understand what it is I speak, I ask of you to travel to the lost city of Corthan.

[pause] To the west, search within the mountains, it is there you will find what is left of what once was. [emphasis] At the very top, amongst the temple, you will find a gong, take this mallet, and ring it to begin the cycle of our end.

[hesitant] I trust you will do what is right.
quest_40713_quest_progress: [solemn] It is only a matter of time now.
quest_40713_quest_complete:
[solemn] The cycle has begone, no doubt you have seen an echo of the past before your eyes, the last king, crowned before the temple.

[warm] An honor to witness one last time.
quest_40714_quest_detail: [solemn] Now that you've laid in the effort to begin our salvation I truly owe you an explanation, my friend. [soft voice] A lesson in history if you will. [pause] When you are ready, speak with me.
quest_40714_quest_complete: [solemn] Perhaps now you understand it all.
quest_40715_quest_detail:
[solemn] To break the curse, Zetharia must meet her end. Although I feel remorse for sending you to end my own daughter, we must be freed and rid of this curse.

[pause] ...Yet I have no idea where she could be, but I know who will. Buried under these red rocks lays the tomb where our last king yet remains. I pray he has kept his sanity, and that he will know of her location.

[urgent] March south wanderer, and look for something that I assume will to the naked eye look like a crypt today, it is there you will see the last stand of Corthan.
quest_40715_quest_complete: [solemn] The Keeper sends our promised salvation. [soft voice] It seems the time has finally come for our curse to be undone.
quest_40716_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am Corthan, last of my name, Marauder-King of a fallen kingdom.

During our last stand, my Keeper told me that even if we are to suffer the curse of undeath a day will come when one from future generations may stumble across us. [soft voice] I suppose he filled your mind with the promise of destiny and fate, but to my eyes, I only see this as a greater coincidence in the grand scheme of all things.

[hesitant] You do not strike me as a hero of legend or some great adventurer, and I am not particularly sure why you'd go to such lengths to aid us. Not that I am against it, and surely I am grateful. [pause] I suppose the seed of curiosity was planted and you truly wish to meet Zetharia, the one who could cause all this.

[commanding] No matter how this turns out, you will be the last living being to ever lay eyes upon me. [solemn] There is a book within this room, it contains our history. I wish for you to take it, and place it somewhere to be remembered.
quest_40716_quest_complete: [solemn] I do not know what came to be of the newest generations, but the Keeper once told me that the written word is history's greatest triumph and I wish to be remembered.
quest_40717_quest_detail:
[solemn] I feel pride. The fire that had settled before has once again been fueled. [commanding] It's time for my last order.

<name>, I command you to find Zetharia and end this nightmare. [solemn] As a last gift to my people, the Lord of the Living Flame has granted me the way to find her.

Far to the south west in these lands and atop the rocks, she lingers, forever searching for new souls to torture. [threatening] Make sure you succeed, if not she will probably torment your soul for generations, as she did to me and my people.
quest_40717_quest_complete:
[solemn] The witch is dead, and the curse uplifted. [pause] It was by sheer will that I've yet remained to thank you.

[warm] I bestow upon you, my crown and blade, may they both serve you well. [solemn] I will now become an everlasting flame in the lands beyond.
quest_40718_quest_detail:
[commanding] I'll do the talking since you don't really seem to feel like it. Listen <name>, we don't want a conflict with Theramore, that would mean we spit on our Warchief's honor.

[solemn] While we're talking, remind yourself of one thing, it is not friendship, but respect we hold for them.
quest_40720_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, is that true?

[soft voice] It clears up one more lead for us, [urgent] we should bring our evidence forward to the Alliance.
quest_40721_quest_detail:
[solemn] Theramore, and Falgran have once again requested a meeting. [soft voice] He has returned with new evidence, where we have met a dead end.

[hesitant] Hopefully Falgran found out more than we did, because truthfully we still got nothing.
quest_40721_quest_complete: [solemn] It seems we know our next course of action.
quest_40722_quest_detail:
Sellick Voss.

I have not heard of the human, but his actions reek of dishonor, and cowardice. [solemn] He hides deep within an encampment, hidden in the swamp.

<Kagoro grunts his disapproval.>

[commanding] We must make ourselves useful, to show our might within Dustwallow Marsh. [urgent] If we have an opportunity to kill Sellick Voss, and bring peace between Horde, and Alliance, we shall.

[commanding] Gather what friends, or mercenaries are available, and scour the swamp, find Sellick Voss, and bring his Medallion to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
quest_40722_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I wish I could have joined you on the battlefield. [solemn] It must've been a glorious sight.

[proud] I am proud of you, and of Kagoro. [excited] You really proved yourselves for the Horde this day. [solemn] The justice was served, deserters will no longer steal our supplies and war with the Alliance was avoided. [warm] It feels like there are only winners.

[sad] Well, maybe except the Hyals. [sad] Poor family. [warm] As a reward, please, take any one of these weapons. [solemn] They are sacred to Brackenwall, and deserving of one such as yourself.
quest_40723_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have done our part within these swamps, and now we should make things right with the Alliance. [urgent] Take this Medallion to Falgran Hastil, the scout who was meeting with Kagoro.

[soft voice] He can bring this token back to their leaders, and let them know of our assistance.
quest_40723_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is..

I... <Falgran Hastil clears his throat, and nods his head.> The Alliance thanks you for this action, [warm] friend.
quest_40724_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Highvale Gorillas have terrorized Tel Co. , attacking our property and sending us all the way back to this here Basecamp. [solemn] They used to be in the surrounding forests, attacking our walls and fortifications, but as of recently, they returned farther north.

[urgent] I know they are plotting something.

[excited] You look tough kid, maybe you can deal with these banana eating savages. [urgent] You can find them up north near the Highvale Rise, and around the Derelict Camp, travel there, and get me 12 Highvale Paws from the Gorillas there.
quest_40724_quest_progress: [low voice] The apes can be a savage bunch, I would be careful out in the wild.
quest_40724_quest_complete: [excited] Well, would you look at that, [warm] perhaps you're as good as killing apes as O'ggon!
quest_40725_quest_detail:
[urgent] Ever since our operations have slowed, more and more murlocs have gathered to the beaches. [commanding] These murlocs are posing a direct threat to the Basecamp and making it harder to venture out.

[urgent] If we ever want to establish work once again, they will need to be dealt with and dealt with seriously!

[commanding] Look around the beaches, and you will find their hovels packed together all around the island. [urgent] Find those grubby murlocs and gather twenty of their claws. [warm] Return them to me, and I'll make sure you're paid, bub.

[excited] Easy, yeah?
quest_40725_quest_complete: [excited] Well would you look at that, you got the claws. As much as I hate to see money go away, it needs to be done, here.
quest_40726_quest_detail:
Blasted valve! [angry] Each and every day we are having more leaks from the main water pump. If Tel Co. Basecamp is to last, it needs a supply of fresh water, regardless of what Telraz or Nokrot say.

[urgent] Many of our backup parts were located far to the north of the island at Bixxle's Storehouse, but there's been -very- little traffic between us and them since, well, everything fell apart.

[sigh] I need you to head there. Just follow the road all the way north, and rummage around for the 'Backup Seal-Valve'. Bixxle should have plenty, just look around for a crate labeled with the name, and return it to me. [confident] Simple yeah?
quest_40726_quest_progress: [urgent] Had any luck finding the damn thing?
quest_40726_quest_complete: [excited] Would you look at that, perfect size too. [warm] Thanks a bunch!
quest_40727_quest_detail:
[urgent] It's getting difficult to maintain repairs on much of the machinery, especially with all of the chaos recently.

[hesitant] I'm experienced, but I'm lacking a lot of my tools, bub. You know how hard it is to work with a spanner when you really need a spin-wrench?

[emphasis] Just to the north of here is a place called 'The Derelict Camp'. [solemn] Well, at one point it wasn't so derelict. We used to have many operations there: wood cutting, banana collecting, and much more. [sad] It's there I lost my toolbox with all my gizmos, and I want it back.

[commanding] You can find the camp on the western edge of the island. [urgent] Follow the road up north, and you'll find it.
quest_40727_quest_progress: [urgent] You find my tools yet, kid?
quest_40727_quest_complete:
[excited] Why, this is it! [soft voice] I'll be honest with you, I thought the apes would tear you apart when you trundled out of here, but to actually have it in my hands...

[warm] Here, take this ring. [low voice] I'm trying to save gold just in case this Tel Co. thing goes even more pear-shaped.
quest_40728_quest_detail:
I didn't think you had it in you, you certainly aint no ogre, but you did survive, and bring me those paws as proof.

[urgent] If we want to -really- deal with the problem, we need to fight it at the source. [solemn] All of the apes come from Highvale Rise, the giant mountain at the center of Tel'abim. [soft voice] It is there you will find the biggest, and strongest of their packs.

[commanding] Travel there, and slay fourteen Elder Highvale Gorillas, that should put a dent in their aggression, and maybe even save some wise goblin minds.
quest_40728_quest_progress: [urgent] What are you waiting for, we don't give bonus around here kid.
quest_40728_quest_complete:
[excited] Maybe we stand a chance after all! [warm] You really took the fight to them, you might of even made O'ggon jealous.

[delight] Nice work out there, here, as a thanks from us here at Tel Co.
quest_40729_quest_detail:
[excited] My research has only just begun, and already there are so many possibilities it is making my head spin!

[angry] What do you mean you have no idea what I am talking about? [solemn] I am trying to discover the secrets of the Gargantuan Banana! [soft voice] Rumor has it that they used to grow on Tel'Abim long ago; that was until they were all harvest.

[urgent] Now, all that remains is myth and legend, but I will get to the bottom of it!

[pause] My first hunch comes from strange bananas grown on the island just off the coast to the east. [sad] I haven't really had much luck... murlocs are all along the coast! [commanding] I am but one gnome, but perhaps you can go there and gather me three samples of the strange bananas that grow there.
quest_40729_quest_progress: [urgent] The longer you stand around, the longer my work will take, [commanding] go on now, quick quick!
quest_40729_quest_complete: [excited] These should do. [warm] You have aided my experiments.
quest_40730_quest_detail:
[solemn] Those bananas from the island were warped. Not like the ripe Tel'Abim bananas on the island here, but something deformed.

[hesitant] It seems we must turn to a different solution, but I am running out of ideas all cooped up in this shack alone.

[urgent] Why don't we try something... obvious? What if you procured an Elixir of Giant Growth and we just... simply poured it over the banana? [confident] It's worth a shot, right?
quest_40730_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, you end up finding that Elixir?
quest_40730_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, here we go... [pause] Maybe it really is this simple.
quest_40731_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Well, I am stumped, All of my ideas either end up worthless, or failed. [pause] There must be something that I can...

<Tazzo's eyes blink back to life, but soon a sigh escapes him.>

There is something actually, I just remembered. [soft voice] A 'friend' of mine named Leezza used to work far in the north. When we were on better terms she once told me about seeing a ridiculously large banana, too big for her to move.

[excited] This has to be what we're looking for, but if we want this information, I know its going to cost me an arm and a leg... [urgent] You could go to Tel Co. Basecamp, speak on my behalf, aside, I don't really got any gold, and I know she will ask.
quest_40731_quest_progress:
Tazzo sent you huh? [mocking tone] He's finally coming back crawling for that information. He made such a point about being able to figure it out all on his own, and here he is, sending a mule to do his dirty work.

<Leezza begins to laugh.>

[angry] That is almost as insulting as his stupidly big head wandering here and asking himself.

[threatening] Look <class>, you want that info, it'll cost you.
quest_40731_quest_complete:
[low voice] Tazzo sent you huh? [mocking tone] He's finally coming back crawling for that information. [mocking tone] He made such a point about being able to figure it out all on his own, and here he is, sending a mule to do his dirty work.

<Leezza begins to laugh.>

[mocking tone] That is almost as insulting as his stupidly big head wandering here and asking himself.

[commanding] Look <class>, you want that info, it'll cost you, lets make it one gold, fifty silver, and a favor afterwards while you're here.
quest_40732_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hello again mule, ready for work?

I will be honest, I aint sticking around on this rock as Tel Co. burns to the ground, and to get my way out, I need materials, ones a goblin can't find back on Kezan.

All around the jungle are these flying serpents with wings. They go by the moniker 'Venomflayer', you see, they have a really potent Sac deep within them, and it is this Venomflayer Sac that I am looking for. [excited] Lets make it eight of them, bring me eight, and I'll tell you about this stupidly large banana.
quest_40732_quest_progress: [urgent] So, mule, you get those sacs yet?
quest_40733_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I suppose you did me a few favors, and paid that gold that Tazzo owed me.

[pause] Whenever you're ready to hear my tale, let me know, and then you can bring that to Tazzo like a good mule.
quest_40733_quest_complete:
[excited] So, her rumors -were- true!

[warm] The secrets of the Gargantuan Banana were real!
quest_40734_quest_detail:
Nestled deep within the largest of the Jagged Isles, tangled in roots and bushes, [excited] It's almost like we're finding a relic lost in time!

<The gnome looks absolutely eager and excited with the information.>

[urgent] If that is the only Gargantuan Banana left, than I must have it. [confident] I want you to recover it, and bring it here, if I had a chance to study an actual Gargantuan, I could possibly even work to replicate it!

[commanding] Head north, immediately, and find that banana!
quest_40734_quest_complete:
[soft voice] It's... It's...

<Tazzo is lost for words, his face a mix of wonder, and amazement as he takes his time to study the banana. Placing a single hand upon the skin, the gnome would gently pat it.>

[delight] Beautiful.
quest_40735_quest_detail:
[excited] Would you just look at that thing? [delight] A sheer Marvel of nature itself!

[hesitant] I wouldn't want to risk planting this in the ground before I use all other options. [proud] I am a mage after all, and what better way than to make a formula to transform regular bananas into something like this!

[emphasis] For that to be an option, I need to study the Gargantuan Banana. [urgent] I need a Micro Filter Tazzo-Scope, patent pending.

[commanding] To create the scope I need you to get me the following materials, but trust me, they will be worth it! [confident] I need a Star Ruby, A Blue Sapphire, and an Accurate Scope. [warm] Once you get them, come back to me, and I'll make it.
quest_40735_quest_complete:
[delight] My my, you are resourceful!

I could probably tell you to go and get me the head of Illidan, and you'd be back in a couple days!

[excited] Now now, lets get to it..
quest_40736_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It took me a little bit, but I was able to fully analyze our specimen. [solemn] It really is a marvel of nature, full with nutrients and extremely dense.

[pause] After studying and taking notes I believe I may have some ideas on how to replicate such a feat. [confident] Firstly, I will need enchanting materials, their arcane properties will be maniputed by yours truly. [urgent] Secondly, I need Ripe Tel'abim Bananas, they are scattered around the island, get me five of them.

[commanding] Once you have gathered everything, we can do our final testing.
quest_40736_quest_progress: [urgent] You get a chance to find everything I need?
quest_40736_quest_complete: [delight] Brilliant, I will make sure to put them to good use.
quest_40737_quest_detail:
So, it appears some of these materials are not exactly cooperative with what I am trying to do, that said I think I may have figured it out!

[excited] It appears that Dream Dust, with the Banana, and some arcane energy could indeed produce what it is we are looking for. [solemn] All I need to do is one final test to make sure everything works properly, so stand back, and speak to me after the experiment.
quest_40737_quest_complete:
[excited] We did it <name>, with my powers, and your handiness we figured out the secret to the Gargantuan Banana. [excited] I never thought I would see the day where I could pull something off like this!

[warm] I have you to thank for this, without you, I'd still be here fiddling with bananas and putting giant elixirs on them if I was lucky.

[confident] From now on, if you ever need another Gargantuan Tel'abim Banana, you come here, and I'll make one, should you have the materials of course!
quest_40738_quest_detail:
[excited] I can't believe we were able to do it, but if there is anyone to thank aside yourself, it has to be Danonzo, he convinced me to continue my work and even vouched for me to stay here at this shack.

[warm] He has been wanting to work on a unique recipe for a while now, aparently he is having trouble thinking of something, well, special.

[pause] Perhaps a Gargantuan Tel'abim Banana will help him!
quest_40738_quest_complete:
[excited] What is this thing, it's massive! [delight] Such a unique texture, this is one of those gargantuan bananas that Tazzo has been going on about, he finally did it?

<The goblin smirks from ear to ear.>

[confident] With this thing I could become a legend back at Kezan. [warm] Say, why don't you help me develop some recipes? You help me, and I'll even share. [gentle] With my name on them of course.
quest_40739_quest_detail:
[commanding] So then, back for another Gargantuan Banana, are you? [excited] I know: The flavor is so spectacular, I couldn't get enough of it!

All I require from you is three Ripe Tel'Abim Bananas and a single Dream Dust. Once you bring me the materials, I can transmute another three big bananas for you. [confident] Yes, it's that simple!
quest_40739_quest_progress: <Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures three Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.> [excited] There you have it, one transmuted Gargantuan Banana. [warm] If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!> Ripe Tel'Abim Banana(3)Dream Dust
quest_40739_quest_complete: <Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures a Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.> [delight] There you have it, one transmuted Gargantuan Banana. [warm] If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!
quest_40740_quest_detail:
[excited] I have refined my transmutation process and even expanded my lab! The ability to create multiple Gargantuan Bananas at once is now a very real possibility. [soft voice] All I need, of course, is the required materials to begin the process.

[pause] To make fifteen Gargantuan Bananas, I will need fifteen Ripe Tel'Abim Bananas as well as five Dream Dust. [warm] If you need a bundle of those giant bananas, bring me those materials and I'll make your dreams come true!
quest_40740_quest_progress: <Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures fifteen Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.> [excited] See? It's all refined now! [warm] If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!> Ripe Tel'Abim Banana(15)Dream Dust(5)
quest_40740_quest_complete: <Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures five Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.> [excited] See? It's all refined now! [warm] If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!
quest_40741_quest_detail:
[urgent] If you're wanting to help, kid, then buckle up. First things first though, I need bananas! Wheelbarrows full of them, buckets full of them, barrels full of them!

We have a shipment due to Kezan in a months time, and all my workers are unable to venture into the jungle. Without those bananas, there will be no more Tel Co.
