Without Tel Co., there will be no more bananas seen around the world. [angry] Do you see how serious this is?!

Now, I know you're much more brave than the others, so why don't you go out and get me 18 ripe bananas. [confident] That way, we can at least fulfill our next shipment on time.
quest_40741_quest_progress: [urgent] So, you get those bananas? <Baron Telraz appears to be on edge.>
quest_40741_quest_complete:
<A massive sigh of relief escapes from Baron Telraz> [excited] Oh my, you just saved my day, and my company at that! [loud voice] I was seriously -FREAKING OUT- here, and you went and got this all done for me.

[warm] Here, I pay those that help and save my hide. [delight] You can take this gold coin from me-a gesture of good will.
quest_40742_quest_detail:
[sigh] If we ever want to get back to work, we need to make sure things are, safe again. The apes are not my workers biggest concern. It is those snakes. Can you believe that?'

[low voice] All of my workers are more terrified by those Brushtails than the massive gorillas.

Goblins right? They slither in the brush and attack at dark. They need to be dealt with.

Once this monkey threat is dealt with, there will still be snakes, and I hate snakes. Why don't you deal with them for me? The Brushtail Adders and Cobras are aggressive, attacking anything in sight. [urgent] Eradicate them, and maybe my workers will have the courage to pick bananas again.
quest_40742_quest_complete:
[laughing] Heh, those pesky Brushtails never bothered me any, maybe the workers will be able to finally get back to work with less danger out there.

[warm] Thanks for the work, here, as a reward, we have a bunch of extra stuff laying around these days.
quest_40745_quest_detail:
[angry] Those little, thieving, coniving Grell, they pulled the snow over my eyes this year when I was least expecting it.

They stole my gift right out from beneath my nose. [sigh] Though I will admit, I was a bit drunk, and awoke to find it missing, but that is here nor there.

I have good suspicion that it is the Grell to the south west who are responsible. [solemn] Trust me, this gift means a lot for me, and I really want to give it to someone special, do you think you could recover it from their camp for me?
quest_40745_quest_complete: [solemn] I cannot thank you enough for recovering this, [soft voice] those Winter Grell surely got the best of me this year, but thanks to you, all is better now, here, as a token of my thanks, [warm] have some ale on me.
quest_40746_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Winter Grell arrive at the start of every season, their minds filled with ideas of trickery and theft to disrupt the festive seasons here in Winter Veil Vale. [angry] They are sent by their lord Krampus, an evil spirit who despises the holiday season.

[urgent] It is up to brave souls like us to prevent the Winter Grell from doing their biding and stealing presents from beneath the tree at will.

[soft voice] You can find them to the south west, near the edge of the mountain and the frozen lake, slay them, and remove their presence. [commanding] Do not worry about causing too much harm, they will simply be sent back to the realm in which they came, only to return another season.
quest_40746_quest_progress: [solemn] It is a never ending conflict with these Winter Grell..
quest_40746_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work out there, [warm] another season of celebrations will go with less tomfoolery.
quest_40747_quest_detail:
Huh, what are you doing here, [hesitant] I don't recall you being on any lists, or expecting anyone on the island here.

[low voice] Did Mr. Shang send you, or Dragunastrasz?

[soft voice] I assume you must be new here, a programmer like the others no doubt, we go through them quick around here with all the bug reports.

[commanding] When you're ready to begin, speak to me, and I'll issue you a set of Programmer Socks.

[warm] Yes they are required.
quest_40747_quest_complete:
[gentle] Well, here you are, and here are your pair of Programmer Socks.

[warm] They are extremely comfortable and increase your skill by a considerable margain.

[commanding] I better not catch you without them.
quest_40748_quest_detail:
[excited] What a better way to cap off the end of a long year other than drinking? Of course, the best of the best only makes the celebrations better.

[warm] You heard tales of the Winter Veil Brew I made a few seasons past? [soft voice] Oh, it surely was magical, probably the best batch I made in my wee life.

[angry] Those dastardly Dark Irons stole it, no doubt hidden away in their tavern deep within the Blackrock Depths.

[confident] You recover it, and I share some of it, that sounds like a deal, yeah?
quest_40748_quest_progress: [soft voice] You had any luck finding the barrel down there?
quest_40748_quest_complete:
<Bomarn beams with excitement.> [excited] Oh, this is it, the mystical keg of Winter Veil Brew! [warm] I haven't had a drink in ages past.

<Bomarn quickly drinks from the barrel with an eagerness.>

[chuckling] Oh, where has me manners gone, here, like I promised, take a couple tankards, only the best for a brave adventurer like yerself.
quest_40752_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now, where to begin, so many ideas, so many possibilities, why not a tried and true classic, with a twist. [excited] Banana bread is a staple to some and quite delicious, but Danonzo can put a twist on things.

[urgent] Enfusing the Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana into the bread with a dash of Heart of the Wild can calm the nerves and much a keen aftertaste that lingers upon the tongue.

[commanding] Gather me the ingredients, and I can prepare it at once!
quest_40752_quest_progress: [urgent] You gather everything yet? [excited] I'm dying for the opportunity to cook wonderous dishes here!
quest_40752_quest_complete:
[excited] Here it is, a magical delicacy for fresh minds!

[warm] I present Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise, just like its name implies, a sheer treat to the tongue. [soft voice] A mix of both chewy and sweet textures served warm with a sheer lovely taste. [warm] Thanks to the garnish of Heart of the Wild.

[proud] As I promised, here is the recipe. [commanding] Don't forget to tell people who figured this all out now, ya'hear?
quest_40753_quest_detail:
[excited] My mind is flooding with ideas, so much to choose from, so much to do! [excited] I got it why don't we create a wonderous stew, the Gargantuan Banana itself is surely capable of producing a wonderous cream.

[warm] A creamy broth served hot with fresh chunks of grilled banana overtop, now doesn't that sound magical!

[excited] All I need is a Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana, an Icecap and Soothing Spices, bring them to me, and we can get cooking kid.
quest_40753_quest_progress: [urgent] My destiny is ahead of me, what's taking you so long to collect everything?
quest_40753_quest_complete:
[excited] Here it is, a magical delicacy for fresh minds!

[warm] I present Danonzo's Tel'Abim Delight, just like its name implies, a sheer treat to the tongue, a mix of bow chewy and sweet textures served warm with a sheer lovely taste thanks to the garnish of Mountain Silversage.

[proud] As I promised, here is the recipe, don't forget to tell people who figured this all out now, ya'hear?
quest_40754_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh how the other goblins of Kezan will bask in the awe of my genius once they discover all of the recipes in my mind. [soft voice] My idea of a cold Banana cake filled with banana cream is the next on my mind, that sure does sound delicious, does it not?

[commanding] Cooked at a high heat with a seperate filling added later and cooled after completion will add quite the punch of flavors, its just missing one thing... [pause] I got it!

[urgent] Gather me the following ingredients, and I can get to work, A Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana, a Golden Sansam, and Soothing Spices, once you acquire them, I can get started.
quest_40754_quest_progress: [urgent] I can wait no longer to start, hurry up with gathering what I need!
quest_40754_quest_complete:
[excited] It is complete, Danonzo's Tel'Abim Medley!

[warm] Served cold, this banana cake is filled with a airy banana cream, incredibly sweet, with a crumbly outer layer! [confident] With this, I shall dominate Kezan, and potentially even other markets!

[soft voice] I did promise to share this recipe, and I am an honest goblin, perhaps rare for my kind.

[mocking tone] Just remember where you got it huh, I don't want anyone stealing my ideas now, you know?
quest_40755_quest_detail:
[urgent] Look, I have a favor I need to ask, and one that is really important to me. Do you know the meaning of sunk cost fallacy? Well, in my world it's completely true. I have spent years, and buckets of gold working on a machine that can appraise bananas on being worthy to collect or not. It is able to judge ripeness, age, and all sorts of factors to determine if it is worth our time to collect.

[pause] Let's just say... the buffoons that I sent it out with got lost and left it at the camp to the west of here.

I don't have a bunch of people to waste getting ripped apart by Venomflayers to go get it themselves, so why don't you do it? Recover the Screwfuse 1000 and be sure to bring it back gently. It should be down the road to the west at a small abandoned camp.
quest_40755_quest_progress: [urgent] So, you have any luck yet <class>?
quest_40755_quest_complete: [excited] By my ears, this is it! [warm] Well done, this has saved me an extraordinary amount of time, and as you know, time is money, especially in this case.
quest_40756_quest_detail:
[angry] Those, absolute idiots!

[shouting] The entire mechanism is broken, my backup Arcane Regulator, and my Spingadge Flange are both broken. [groan] Do you know how long it took to acquire such rare parts, special ordered from Kezan!

[sad] If only they were still alive, I'd be the one to send them to whatever misbegotten afterlife they are rotting in. [urgent] I have only one source for rare goods from Kezan, and I need you to speak with him. [whispering] He goes by the name 'Jabbey' an alias of sorts, he is an undercover operative from Kezan and works through various back channels, go speak with him, and let him know -Bixxle- sent you, bring him this list of items.
quest_40756_quest_complete:
[low voice] Huh, what is it you want, you here for something special?

[mocking tone] Oh, Bixxle sent you huh, that idiot? He spent a good five years making some banana sorter, what does he need?
quest_40757_quest_detail:
<Jabbey looks at the list with an expression of disbelief and laughs.> "Haha! He thinks I’m just going to hand over such valuable items that easily? Look, kid, these things are rare and worth a fortune. If he really needs them and wants my help, I’ve got a little favor I need taken care of first. Fair deal, yeah?

So, here’s the deal: I did some business with one of those Dark Iron types—goes by the name Darneg Darkbeard. Let’s just say I lent him a considerable stash of high-value goods to sell. Problem is, I haven’t heard a peep back, and now I’ve got confirmation that the guy swindled me. I need you to head into Blackrock Depths, into Shadowforge City, and track him down in the Domicile. Recover the ‘Extremely Potent Snuff’ he owes me. Think you can handle that? Easy, right?"
quest_40757_quest_progress:
[urgent] You find that good for nothing thief, and give him justice yet?

[angry] Better yet, you recover my stuff?
quest_40757_quest_complete: <Jabbey looks on the small pile of snuff with displeasure.> Well this certainly is a disappointment.
quest_40758_quest_detail:
[urgent] Well, I hate to do this to you kid, but that dwarf went and... 'used' most of the snuff, looks like you're a bit out of luck. [sad] This certainly isn't enough to recover even a fraction of the cost for the parts you're looking for, but I do have another favor, that will pay for the rest of it.

[soft voice] Let's just say I have some clients that are looking to 'research' toxic materials for, scientific, purposes. [urgent] They are looking to get their hands on a 'Blighted Essence' which can be acquired from the Blighted Horrors in Eastern Plaguelands. [commanding] So, get me the Blighted Essence, and that will pay off the rest of the parts, easy yeah?
quest_40758_quest_progress: [urgent] Careful holding that Blighted Essence when you bring it around here, last thing I want is some super disease in Steamwheedle.
quest_40758_quest_complete: [low voice] Well, I didn't expect you to actually return, that's a bummer. [chuckling] Oh well, a goblins word means something in this world, to some people anyway.
quest_40759_quest_detail:
Nice job in getting all that stuff for me, didn't take all too long as well, Kezan could use some individuals like you.

Now, I boxed that fool Bixxle's goods, take them to him, and be quick about it, I've had you linger around here too long, last thing I want is people to catch on about my business, got it?
quest_40759_quest_complete: [laughing] Oh, they were that hard to get, huh? [warm] Hope it wasn't too much of a fuss getting them for me. Here, take some coin for all the trouble.
quest_40760_quest_detail:
Now that I have all the materials, I just need to put in the last bits of repairing, and for that, well I'm going to need more materials.

[hesitant] I hope I am not being too much of a bother, but do you mind getting me some engineering supplies? I need the following, six Thorium Bars, a Gold Power Core, some Fused Wiring, and a Thorium Widget, with all of that I should be able to fix the Screwfuse 1000.
quest_40760_quest_progress: [urgent] You get all those things yet?
quest_40760_quest_complete:
<Bixxle let's out a sigh of relief, smirking from ear to ear.> [soft voice] You've really helped me out here, working from Tel'Abim complicates everything, especially with how remote the location is.

[warm] You came in clutch friend, and for that I should reward you with something, and I know just the thing.

[gentle] Look, if you ever need anything else, let me know, you've saved me more gold than I would've made in years, and almost as much time even!
quest_40761_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey look, you did me a real solid, and I still owe you for everything you've done. You wouldn't be happen to be in the market for a gun would you? I don't just mean any gun, I mean a Dark Iron Desecrator. [low voice] I have someone that owes me quite a lot of favors for help I offered to bring them to Steamwheedle for rare goods.

If this is something you're interested in, just know it will take some work to acquire. [confident] If this has your interest, then speak with Gelwig Darkbrow, let him know I sent you, and that I am asking for the plans.
quest_40761_quest_progress: [hesitant] So, you speak with him yet?
quest_40761_quest_complete:
[excited] I assume he complained huh?

<Bixxle laughs.>

[chuckling] Yeah, this is quite secretive and a prototype build of Dark Iron Engineers, that's why we're going to master it.

[confident] You wouldn't imagine it but I am quite a reknowned Engineer, and have had many run ins with these 'Dark Irons', heck I was even contracted for some stuff in their vaunted city.
quest_40762_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Well, these plans are much more complicated than I first estimated, so many rare materials, most of which are not so easily available...

First off, we will need to get a stock Dark Iron Rifle, they can be crafted by engineers with the know how to make one. Secondly, I need a Magma Condensor from within Blackrock Depths, you can find it near the Golem Laboratory. Thirdly, I require a Intricate Arcanite Barrel which can handle extreme heat. This can be found deep within Lower Blackrock Spire, near the Quartermaster there.

Lastly, and most difficult to find, I need a Molten Fragment. This item can be acquired from Molten Destroyers in the depths of the Molten Core.

To finish the construction, I will also need three Fiery Core found in Molten Core, and ten Enchanted Thorium Bars.

[urgent] Once you collect these goods, return to me, and I can get started.
quest_40762_quest_progress: [urgent] Have any luck recovering the materials yes <name>?
quest_40762_quest_complete:
[commanding] Behold, a creation of great magnitude, the ideas of wicked dwarven design, crafted by yours truly.

[warm] I hope this serves you well, and does what damage you need to deal on those that may be your enemy.

[confident] We are even now, this surely is worth quite a bit of gold after all, maybe not as much as my Screwfuse 1000, but close enough.

[excited] Best of luck out there <name>, I hope we cross paths again.
quest_40763_quest_detail:
Yo <race>, fancy seeing a capable adventurer out here! [excited] Interested in some work? You see, when Tel Co. came here, this place was deserted. Just monkeys and bananas.

But that wasn't the case before, you know? [soft voice] Thousands of years ago, this island was a mountain range on the border of nations, and there's sure to be riches hidden here. [solemn] To begin with, my surveyors have discovered some ancient Zandalari ruins on the northern coast dating back over ten thousand years.

[urgent] However, the ruins are infested with restless ghosts! [commanding] As muscle, go there and slay those ghosts, and bring any tablets or writings you find. [warm] I'll make it worth your time. Promise, yeah?
quest_40763_quest_complete: [delight] This is a nice haul and the ghosts are gone, yeah? [excited] I will order the crew to start diggin' once we make sure there's no further complications. [soft voice] Now let's see about these texts... Hmm, very fascinating! <race> [warm] I may need your assistance again.
quest_40764_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ten thousand years ago, the Zandalari were competing against a civilization known as the Azotha. Their struggle was put at an end when the world was shattered, and oceans swallowed a large chunk of the ancestral landmass. Tel'Abim just happens to be a region where the two clashed.

The Trolls seem to have lost the skirmish referenced on this tablet, and it mentions Trolls being sacrificed to the gods at the ritual site, their riches buried. [excited] This means there could be GOLD buried under this ritual site! [delight] And we may even have found it.

[urgent] Head to the western-most isle of the Jagged isles and search for an obvious ritual site, when you find it, start digging!
quest_40764_quest_progress: [urgent] Well? Don't keep me in suspense, did ya do it?
quest_40764_quest_complete: Hoo mama! [excited] This is what I'm talkin' about! [delight] This haul will earn us lots of prestige and accolades. [warm] This is both Azotha, Troll, and gold from other civilizations they must have buried here! [proud] You deserve your share for sure! [warm] We may work again in the future, you've certainly been useful!
quest_40765_quest_detail:
[solemn] We lost our communication with the Derelict Camp and Bixxle's Storehouse a few weeks ago. [sad] Bixxle's Storehouse was the key to profit for our northern harvesting. [urgent] If we are ever to start up again, I need to know that the place isn't a wreck and covered in monkeys.

[low voice] More importantly, Bixxle was a logistical mastermind, as much as his focus tends to drift towards engineering useless contraptions.

[commanding] Head far to the north to Bixxle's Storehouse. Follow the road. It should take you right to it. [urgent] See if Bixxle is alive.
quest_40765_quest_complete: Huh, Telraz sent you? [hesitant] I was wondering when he would check in. [excited] I guess everything has gotten quite crazy around here after all!
quest_40766_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well, here we are, still very much alive and kicking. [pause] We did have our fair share of encounters with the local wildlife.

[solemn] I prepared a report to Baron Telraz. [urgent] Bring it back to Tel Co. Basecamp. [emphasis] It'll let him know we're still kicking up here, whenever he brings in the big guns to clean things up.
quest_40766_quest_progress: [urgent] So, have you heard news from Bixxle's Storehouse?
quest_40766_quest_complete:
[excited] A report from Bixxle himself? Give me that!

<Baron Telraz frantically reads the letter with utmost curiosity, letting out a sigh of relief.>

[warm] My, that certainly is a relief! [soft voice] Without Bixxle, I would have no idea how to manage things up there. [warm] Thanks for the work kid. Here, take some coins for the hassle of running around.
quest_40767_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey there, pal, you mind lending a hand?

We got all sorts of trouble with these Venomflayers lurking in the area. [angry] Hell, they are already responsible for a few of our casualties. [urgent] If you could do me a favor and rid the local of a few of 'em, that'd make our lives a whole lot easier.

You can find them pretty much all over to the west and southwest. [commanding] Remove twelve of them, and return to me when you're done.
quest_40767_quest_progress: [urgent] You got rid of those critters yet?
quest_40767_quest_complete:
[gentle] My my, you sure are resourceful, I didn't expect you to get it done so quick.

[warm] Here, take this, we have a bunch of spare ones laying around now that the enforcers took off and left south.
quest_40768_quest_detail:
[solemn] Each day, more and more Naga take to the shores of the surrounding islands. [soft voice] They are gathering, and for what purpose I do not know.

[urgent] I would rather have them dealt with now, than in a week when there are hundreds of them. [low voice] I have heard tales of just how quick they can infest an area with their presence.

[commanding] You can find them all around the surrounding Jagged Isles to the north. Find them and kill them. [urgent] Bring me twenty of their scales as proof.
quest_40768_quest_progress: [urgent] Yeah, you get those scales yet kid?
quest_40768_quest_complete:
[excited] Not bad, good work out there, [warm] making the jungle just a little bit easier to handle is always noble work for us here.

[warm] Here, as thanks.
quest_40769_quest_detail:
[low voice] It has been a long time since I worked on anything worthwhile, and let me tell you, I am desperate for some real work. I have been stranded here on Tel'Abim to be nothing more than a glorified repairman now for a while.

[sad] My inner blacksmith calls to me, and I want to work on something unique before I go insane. [solemn] Long ago when I worked at Everlook I was fascinated with the Chillwind Chimaera, extremely powerful creatures that roamed the snowy tundras.

[urgent] There were rumors floating around about rare Frostwoven horns that have been growing on a few of the creatures, I'd like to get my hands on one, and harness it into armor, think you can do that for me? [commanding] You can find Chillwind Chimaera out in Winterspring, far to the north of here.
quest_40769_quest_progress: [urgent] You had any luck yet, or you here looking for a coat to brave the cold weather?
quest_40769_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well, this certainly is a rarity, [pause] while you were gone I thought of a few ideas that could work to incorporate the horn into armor, and I believe I have come up with the perfect idea.

[warm] Take this, as a thanks for the assistance!
quest_40773_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our scouts have confirmed new presence in the area of Felwood, foreign interlopers from a far off land, loyal to outside forces from a far away land.

[soft voice] What they are doing here, I am unsure of, but who they are, I am certain.

[commanding] They are Blood Elves, loyal to their prince and the demon hunter Illidan. [urgent] I am certain they are up to no good, and whatever plans they have, I would like to halt. [commanding] You can find them gathered around an old statue of the betrayer near the Shatter Scar Vale just north east of Bloodvenom Falls, go there, and collect seven Blood Elf Badges.

[low voice] Perhaps they will get the message and return to where they came.
quest_40773_quest_progress: [low voice] So, has the deed been done <race>?
quest_40773_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, you have proved yourself, [proud] maybe now they will leave Felwood, and not return.
quest_40774_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Royal Apothecary Society is always looking for new solutions to various problems, and new compounds with which to study and test upon.

[soft voice] I have come to Felwood for such an issue, perhaps you can offer some assistance. [pause] All around the Bloodvenom Falls are oozes of a rather, noxious variety. [low voice] From them I require Tainted Ooze Sludge for various research to be done back in Undercity.

[urgent] Collect fifteen samples for me, and I will pay you for the time, how does that sound?
quest_40774_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you acquired my samples yet?
quest_40774_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My, these sure are fascinating, full of quite toxic material.

[solemn] My benefactors back in Undercity will be pleased, and here, as promised, take these coins.
quest_40775_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I need help with a matter of most discretion.

Luckily, it appears that you either can't speak or prefer to keep your responses concise, which is just what I need.

The task I have for you is straightforward. Travel to the Bloodvenom Falls, eliminate the oozes in the vicinity, collect their sludge, and bring it to me. [urgent] If you can do this without discussing or inquiring about it, you will be compensated accordingly.
quest_40775_quest_progress: [urgent] Don't waste any more time. [commanding] Get it done, and make sure it's done right.
quest_40775_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You did well.

[pause] You can go now. [sad] You are not needed anymore.
quest_40776_quest_detail:
[solemn] My scouts have reported activity east of the Shatter Scar Vale, close to what my people call the Shrine of the Betrayer. It is a cold statue of Illidan Stormrage, a name with a heavy impact on our history. Not many dare to speak out loud about him, but I feel no fear in mentioning the name of a being that no longer inhabits these lands.

Regardless, this is not a history lesson. At the foot of this statue, a group of Sin'dorei has settled. Perhaps they fled Azshara or were simply in hiding for this long... These mongrels remind me of those under Azshara's reign, mistakenly aided by the High Priestess.

They call themselves the Illidari, and, to me, they have simply sealed their fate by foolishly admitting their connection to the Betrayer. [commanding] We need to cull their numbers. [urgent] These woods are already infected, and we cannot afford any more plague.
quest_40776_quest_complete: [solemn] It is quite satisfying to witness the downfall of those who boast about their faith in the Betrayer. [mocking tone] They've made a mockery of their legacy by dying at the hands of a paid mercenary.
quest_40777_quest_detail:
<Linthea is sobbing while hiding her face behind her palms. As she wipes her tears away she looks at you with newfound hope.> [soft voice] You're an adult, right? [soft voice] Our Matron always says we should ask adults for help if anything is wrong. And right now something is very wrong!

[urgent] She had to go back this morning to get the other kids, but when she did she left us some presents behind and told us not to open them until she was back.

But now they are gone! [sad] Everyone is sad now, and it's just his fault, that green bully!
quest_40777_quest_complete: [excited] Zoki is the Horde's strongest warrior!
quest_40778_quest_detail:
[angry] What? Zoki is no thief! [solemn] Zoki is an honorable orc, sure, Zoki reminds weak children sometimes who the strongest is but all he does is tell the truth! [soft voice] Linthea and Daniel are very scrawny and Vhreka just wants to be a boring old lady who talks to the elements. [proud] Zoki will be a great warrior just like Saurfang or his brother! Or maybe like Grommash, Matron says he was a Horde hero.

[angry] Why do you insist to annoy Zoki with stolen presents? [urgent] I didn't steal anything, I promise on my honor! [hesitant] I remember the Matron said one of the snowmen lost their gloves and they found out eventually that they were stolen, maybe go ask them?
quest_40780_quest_detail:
Greetings <race>, [warm] enjoying the celebration? You may have heard the short abridged version of why this celebration was held when it was limited to Ironforge and Orgrimmar. [solemn] But as you can see, there's much more than dwarves here. [soft voice] Many races seem to have a version of Greatfather Winter in their culture.

I suspect there is more to this tale. [urgent] Seek out the storytellers. [commanding] Let's start with the Night elf, Tauren, and Furbolg version of the tale so that you do not get it all mixed up. [emphasis] Pay attention cause their stories likely contain important clues that we will utilize.
quest_40780_quest_progress: [soft voice] You return, how did it go?
quest_40780_quest_complete: [excited] Well done! [warm] This is a start, the legends all seem to share the characteristic of a character that arrives during the winter and brings succor and protection from the cold. [solemn] Let us continue...
quest_40781_quest_detail: [urgent] Next up, I want you to talk to the Dwarven, Goblin, and Ice Troll storytellers. [excited] Yeah I know, Ice trolls aren't the nicest bunch but I wanna know more about their version. [emphasis] Like before, pay attention, [commanding] if we are to investigate this legend then every detail may be crucial!
quest_40781_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you speak with them yet?
quest_40781_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, very interesting! The Ice trolls call it The Spirit of Winter, perhaps it could be an elemental of some sort. The Goblin one is pretty obvious and I doubt it even counts as a legend and the Dwarven one... Well I am well familiar with it. [warm] But enough about that, now comes the good part, [laughing] ohoho yes!
quest_40782_quest_detail: [excited] Alright! Now that you've heard the stories, it is time to search for them. [solemn] There is a good chance that there is some truth to the legends. [low voice] I've got plenty of ale, my writing quill and plenty of time. [urgent] Go out into the wilds of Kalimdor and see what you can find! [warm] You'll be looking for the Winter Patriarch of the Tauren, the Ancient of Winter of the Night elves, and last but not least, Father Bear of the Furbolg.
quest_40782_quest_complete: [excited] You've had some sightings? I uh... see that's unexpected, well I'll note it down. [solemn] Once look into all of them, we may further inquire into the situation.
quest_40783_quest_detail: [commanding] Alright! Now that you've heard the stories, it's time to get in there on a hunt. [excited] I bet that there's some truth to the legends. [soft voice] I'm all set up here to wait for your report. [urgent] We should dig into the nearby lands and see what you can find! [warm] I'll give you a freebie! [laughing] Find me the Goblin hired Great-Father Winter... Hehe! [solemn] And look for the source of our Greatfather Winter, as well as the Great Winter Spirit or whatever they called it.
quest_40783_quest_complete: [excited] You've had some sightings? R-Really? Uhm... [pause] Give me a moment as I note this stuff down. Well once we have all six I suppose we'll move on to the next stage of this.
quest_40784_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You really found them then? All of them were real, not just the Orc? And of course you brought no proof back with you… Look I can't just take your word for it you know? We may have to- Now now! Don't get angry! If you insist so vehemently than I believe you, it's just that... Nevermind!

Look, how about this? I've got a spare Reindeer Voucher I won in a game of dice a few years back. I'm sure you'll enjoy riding your new friend so chill out! [urgent] Please take this voucher to Quark here in the Vale and he'll dispense with the product for you. I did note your findings in the log! I was drunk but I can still write, rest assured it'll go to the organization I work for.
quest_40784_quest_complete: Eh? You got a voucher for a Reindeer? Blast! It's been a long time since I've seen one of those, kid! [excited] They were a special promotion years back... You say you got tricked by Mulin? Hah, old coot is officially here to research legends, but in actuality he just wants to drink and feast. I bet his employees won't approve if they found out he used his research funding on feasting so that's why he cooked up this whole scheme. Well that's none of my business now is it? Well the Vouchers do not expire, so a deal is a deal, enjoy your new Reindeer!
quest_40785_quest_detail: [urgent] A bounty has been placed on the leader of apes! [commanding] To all those willing to fight for the safety of Tel'Abim, and Tel Co. itself, join together and hunt down [emphasis] King Morogo Thunderfoot, last seen at the heights of Highvale Rise.
quest_40786_quest_detail:
[solemn] The very forest itself is twisted and corrupted. Everywhere we look, we see the festering and lingering presence of this evil. The wildlife has been cursed to live such woeful existences, constantly teetering on the brink of madness and rage, all the while enthralled by the great evil that poisons their hearts.

[soft voice] I have been studying the wildlife here for some time now, but I need more samples to understand this phenomenon better. Recently, I discovered a natural occurrence taking place in Tel'Abim. The enragement of the wildlife there has traveled to my ears, and I need to know more about it to potentially link it to what's happening here.

[urgent] For this reason, I require five hearts of the enraged basilisk. Bring them to me, and I will make good use of the samples you provide. [solemn] Let us make progress in our understanding of this curse.
quest_40786_quest_progress: [solemn] Has your journey made progress yet?
quest_40786_quest_complete:
[solemn] The samples are peculiar as they do not exhibit any signs of being twisted by foreign interference or the hands of foul magic. [soft voice] Instead, they appear to be deformed due to primalistic rage.

[hesitant] There may be a link here that I am not seeing, but I doubt that these samples are connected to what is happening here in Felwood.

[warm] Regardless, I appreciate your efforts in ruling out such a possibility.
quest_40787_quest_detail:
[solemn] A decade ago, I was betrayed by a fellow Demon Hunter - one who shared my blood and broke bread with me. [sad] His name is Faladar Starsplinter, and he has returned to Felwood, bringing with him a corrupt presence that has tainted these already blighted lands.

[angry] My grievances with this traitor are many, but none are greater than his theft of a powerful artifact that bears my namesake: the Darkwind Star. [solemn] This artifact has been passed down through generations of my family, and holds immense power within it. [commanding] I demand its recovery from the hands of this cur, and I require your aid to obtain it.

[urgent] If you wish to aid me in this task, you will find Faladar Starsplinter at the Shrine of the Betrayer. [soft voice] It is located northeast of Bloodvenom Falls and south of Irontree Woods. [commanding] Your mission is to hunt him down and reclaim what is rightfully mine. [emphasis] Let the hunt begin.
quest_40787_quest_progress: [solemn] With every passing moment, the traitor Faladar comes closer to achieving his vile schemes.
quest_40787_quest_complete:
[solemn] For many long years, I have been without the star by my side, but thanks to your efforts, it is now where it rightfully belongs.

<Niremius Darkwind seems lost in the power of the Darkwind Star, his eyes glowing with deep energy.>

[warm] You have performed admirably, young one, and as such, I have prepared a reward for your assistance - one that is truly worthy of your efforts.
quest_40788_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey there! You wouldn't mind lending a hand, would you? We conduct all sorts of research here in Everlook, and where there's research, there's coin to be earned. I had this side gig going on with a shipment from Tel'Abim for a while now, but I haven't heard diddly-nothing, and I got a client that's been waiting around.

You mind being the third party here and clearing up this issue for me? I'll toss in some complimentary food or drink on the house. All I need you to do is head to Tel'Abim far to the south of here, and find some of those angry rock elemental types. They contain Heavy Earthen Cores and it's those I need, eight of 'em.

Make it lickety-split.
quest_40788_quest_progress: [urgent] Hey there outrider! [soft voice] You make that trip to Tel'Abim yet?
quest_40788_quest_complete:
[excited] Would you look at that! Pristine too, nice work, excellent work even. [warm] My client was going to get a bit tight and upset with me if I didn't pull through, so you came in clutch.

[warm] Here, as I promised.
quest_40789_quest_progress: [solemn] Light's blessings, <name>. [soft voice] Have you come to join our service?
quest_40789_quest_complete:
[solemn] A Kul Tiran paladin gave you this book?

In Kul Tiras, the Holy Light is not as widespread as it is in Stormwind and Lordaeron; places where the tradition of the faith has long been established.

Yet I am gladdened to see that our church has touched the heart of such a worthy man. I will make sure all its contents are kept safe in our archives.

[warm] Thank you, and may the Light ever be with you, <name>.
quest_40796_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are many things that can hurt me. After seeing so many years pass by, believe me when I say, physical pain is among the least of them.

[soft voice] I assume you are not unfamiliar with the problems we have in Ashenvale, <class>? [low voice] Between the Horde and the Sayaads, the tranquillity of the forest is fast becoming just a memory. [emphasis] But we have persisted - and will persist - through this challenge and countless more, mark my words.

[angry] The disgusting demons that have an uncanny resemblance to us are the worst affronts to nature. [commanding] They hide away in their hovels, plotting corruption and torturing us all. [urgent] I want you to head to each one of their nooks and crannies, and do your fair share in thinning them out. [warm] Bring me a collection of their gnarled and twisted horns, and the Kaldorei will know of your bravery.
quest_40796_quest_progress: [solemn] Blights on the land can be hidden with ease, but healed with difficulty. [emphasis] Remember this.
quest_40796_quest_complete: [solemn] Exceptional. [soft voice] I hope you sustained no injuries during your battles? [warm] You have aided more in one skirmish than those childish sentinels have done since they arrived.
quest_40798_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>. Were you sent by my sister? My brother? No? Who might you be, then?

<name>, is it? Allow me to introduce myself: [soft voice] I am Alleana Moonfeather youngest of the Moonfeather family. My siblings already wear the mantle of Hippogryph Master, but I am finding it difficult to focus on my training since my mentor...

[pause] Nevertheless, I must press on, for my family's reputation and in my mentor's memory! Without proper guidance, however, it is quite difficult to gauge my methods. We raise fledgling hippogryphs from a young age, so they bond to us and rely wholly upon our guidance.

Make no mistake, these children belong to nature first and foremost, but the Kaldorei share a bond with nature that allows us to commune with these younglings effectively. Yet these fledglings seem indifferent towards me. Perhaps it is their diet.

It would be of great help if you could gather some food from the creatures in Darkshore and Ashenvale for me.
quest_40798_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome back. [soft voice] Have you brought the hippogryph food?
quest_40798_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you kindly for your efforts, <name>.

[hesitant] Did you carry all of these in your backpack? The smell must be... [pause] Nevermind.
quest_40799_quest_detail:
[angry] They still aren't responding to me! How is it my siblings make it look so simple? How very infuriating!

<Her ears prick and she bares her fangs when she fails to summon one of the fledglings to her side.>

[soft voice] My Shan'do would tell me to set aside my pride, I'm sure of it. His was always the way of patience. [urgent] I implore you, <name>, seek out Hippogryph Masters and request their counsel on these willful children. [hesitant] Spare no detail of my struggles, as much as it pains me to admit that I am in need of their aid.

[pause] Wait! Do not speak to Caylais or Fyldren! [solemn] I cannot accept what could only be seen as preferential treatment.

[commanding] I would urge you to travel to Rut'theran Village and Astranaar, and I believe I received correspondence from Nijel's Point once, wherever that may be. [soft voice] Teloren on Stonetalon Peak I am certain would help me in this, but be mindful of his... tendency to ramble.
quest_40799_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope you come bearing word from the masters, <name>.
quest_40799_quest_complete: <She listens in quiet contemplation as you relate the masters' advice, meditating on the words for minutes.> [shocked] Wait... Teloren said what?? <Her face flushes with embarrassment.>
quest_40800_quest_detail:
[excited] That's right, I'm a Moonfeather! [soft voice] I have a gift, I just need to learn how to make use of it. [solemn] Shan'do said so as well, and I will honor his legacy!

[soft voice] Sharptalon is a mighty hippogryph patriarch I have seen wandering the forest glades at twilight, though we have never met before. [soft voice] Such a majestic creature is surely one of Elune's favored. [urgent] Please, take the youngest of the hatchlings and head southwest of here. [urgent] Avoid the Horde as best you can and protect the child with your life.

[soft voice] South of the orcs' eyesore of an encampment you will find those beautiful glades where our sisters keep vigil, waiting in the trees to ambush the invaders. [solemn] Sharptalon is reported to aid the defense of Ashenvale near there.

[warm] Bring the little one to him and relay the Moonfeather family name. [soft voice] I pray his response will be favorable.
quest_40800_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, <name>. [hesitant] Did you find Sharptalon?
quest_40800_quest_complete:
[solemn] He bowed his head? [delight] By Elune, that is amazing news! [soft voice] I understand. [solemn] I shall spend more time with the fledglings in Sharptalon's presence, and with hard work and some fortune, I will make my family proud. [proud] The Moonfeathers will have yet another Hippogryph Master in their lineage!

[warm] It seems this little one doesn't want to leave your side. [gentle] I suppose if you promise to care for and look after this child, there should be no issue in allowing it to follow you, right?

[warm] This is the least I can offer after everything you have done on my behalf. [delight] Elune smiles upon us both this day, <name>.
quest_40801_quest_detail:
[solemn] You may see ruins around here, <class>, but what I see is far different. [soft voice] I see a reminder of a lost civilization, a Kaldorei race that was strong, ordered, unified, unparalleled in might. [angry] And now, just across the hills, I see the horde invading our sacred lands.

[sad] But that is not what has happened. [urgent] Instead we bicker with the sentinels while the horde spreads like a disease, ravaging parts of our ancient homelands. [sad] Sentinels throwing young lives away like they were meaningless. [solemn] If Fandral was here, he would have those upstarts whipped into line in a moment.

[soft voice] Anyway, what brings you to Forest Song? [gentle] Are you here to help?
quest_40801_quest_progress: [angry] I suppose you are going to be as unhelpful as the sentinels then?
quest_40801_quest_complete: [solemn] Impressive to see one with an ounce of sensibility around here. [warm] Thank you, <name>.
quest_40802_quest_detail:
Very well <name>, let us break this deadlock immediately. [commanding] From this moment forwards, the Horde will be our prey! The first thing to do with a prey animal is to isolate it from the rest.

Make it blind, deaf and dumb. We need to disrupt the communications of the invaders from the rest. [solemn] There is an outrider who diligently passes messages from the lumber camp to their outposts, and likely beyond into the dusty deserts they call home. [urgent] Lay an ambush, <name>. Lie in wait by the road just south of here, north of the lumber camp. And when she passes by, strike her down. [threatening] Show no mercy, for none will be shown to you.
quest_40802_quest_progress: [soft voice] How has the hunt been so far? [pause] Anything to report?
quest_40802_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. [soft voice] You have already proven more useful than the sentinels, though admittedly, it is not a high bar.
quest_40803_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come to end this conflict with one decisive blow. [whispering] Well, two actually. [low voice] I have done some searching of my own while you were gone, and while the sentinels were off playing hero. [angry] There are two leaders of this operation, and both will need to be brought low and executed, if we are to know peace once more in these glades. [urgent] You must find their Commander, a brutish orc by the name of Grushak, somewhere to the south of the Camp. And plotting from the Keep itself, is a shaman by the name of Grimeye.

[commanding] If you need companions to help you assassinate these targets, I certainly would not blame you. [cold] In fact, I would view it as very wise indeed - for every failed attempt will certainly make our lives a lot more difficult afterwards.
quest_40803_quest_progress: [soft voice] I pray you return with good news, <name>?
quest_40803_quest_complete: [soft voice] I knew I could count on you, from the moment we began to talk. [solemn] Truly you have earned Elune's favor this day, and I will make sure the word is spread of your deeds. [warm] My thanks, <name>.
quest_40804_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your task for helping Forest Song and ending this stalemate is at an end. However, I cannot think of anyone more appropriate to send word to Fandral Staghelm than you, <name>. [warm] You did a significant portion of the work, and you deserve that portion of the praise too.

[urgent] Go, now. [soft voice] The path to Teldrassil is a long, albeit beautiful, one. Take the time for some rest and relaxation, perhaps, enjoy the verdant canopies of our ancient oaks. [solemn] Once you board the ship and make it to Teldrassil, you will find the Arch Druid in the Cenarion Enclave of our beautiful capital. [solemn voice] Here, this report should explain what transpired. [commanding] Give it to him, but be a bit wary of his temper.
quest_40804_quest_progress: [urgent] Speak swiftly, I have numerous other burdens upon my shoulders, if you are going to add to them, I demand you at least do so and leave quickly.
quest_40804_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the nasty business in Southern Ashenvale has come to an end, has it? [soft voice] Let me see what Brolthan Ironglade has achieved.
quest_40805_quest_detail:
[solemn] After reading this report, it is clear that the sentinel presence has been less than helpful in Forest Song. [sad] Not only have they refused to follow the tactical plans suggested by Brolthan, but the display of bravado has led to the death of many sisters and daughters. [pause] To lose the blood of kin is a pain I know all too well.

[low voice] I know not if this was a simple mistake on Commander Starwind's part, or if it was deliberate misconduct, but regardless, her actions demand consequences. [commanding] One less supporter of this new way of living in a leadership position, spread by that fool Tyrande and her ilk, will only solidify the Kaldorei as a traditional and united force. [urgent] I will make the changes to the records, while you bring my notice to the commander. [warm] Inform Ironglade to present you with a suitable reward, too.

[solemn] I do not care if you think me heavy-handed or cruel, <class>. [emphasis] Hopefully, this situation will teach you something about viewing the greater picture.
quest_40805_quest_progress: [excited] Ah, <name>! [warm] I hear we have you to thank for bringing this conflict to an end!
quest_40805_quest_complete: [soft voice] We must rest and meditate at some point, you and I. [hesitant] I would very much like to... what is this? [surprised] A letter from The Arch Druid?
quest_40806_quest_detail: <Her silver eyes grow wide, while her skin grows red. She grinds her teeth together and throws the letter to the floor.> [angry] So that is the Elune-damned thanks I get after all this time? To take the fall for that belligerent, conniving druid? [threatening] Oh, I will tell my sisters we will leave this place alright, don't expect to see us here again. And don't think I won't take this up with Lady Whisperwind either, she must smell foul play in the air. [commanding] Now, get out of my sight, <name>. [cold] You've done enough around here.
quest_40806_quest_progress: [solemn] You returned for your reward, I take it? [soft voice] Yes, I thought as much.
quest_40806_quest_complete: [gentle] Here, take one of these as a token of our appreciation for your efforts.
quest_40807_quest_detail:
[soft voice] A new face around these parts, ishnu-alah. My name is Commander Starwind, and normally I would be out on patrol somewhere or training with my sister sentinels but... unfortunately, I am stuck here trying to convince that pig-headed, cowardly druid Ironglade to assist us with the war on our doorstep. [angry] To think that would even require a conversation! [solemn] The Horde fell our ancient trees, befouling Elune's beauty. [urgent] Naturally many of us are already locked in combat, and someone - or something - needs to break this deadlock. [sad] It pains me to say that we are losing lives hour by hour.

[commanding] Maybe you can talk some sense into him, or perhaps if you are capable enough, join us in war? [warm] I am sure you will be well rewarded if so.
quest_40807_quest_progress: [commanding] So? Interested in turning the tide?
quest_40807_quest_complete: [excited] Now that's what I like to hear! [commanding] Grab your weaponry, <name>.
quest_40808_quest_detail:
[commanding] Listen closely, <name>. You will not be fighting alone out there, so show some spirit when you do. And do not dare return until you are crimson with their blood. I do not care if they are common laborers or peons, guards or shamans. [threatening] Kill them indiscriminately. [urgent] Bring havoc to the battlefield. [solemn] Each Kaldorei death will be repaid tenfold, mark my words.

[cold] We will remember your name if you return from this alive, and if you fight with honor, <name>. [threatening] If not, then may Elune cast her gaze upon your body. [shouting] Tor ilisar'thera'nal!
quest_40808_quest_complete: [low voice] You positively reek of blood, sweat and dirt. [urgent] Have you driven them back?
quest_40809_quest_detail:
[solemn] The enemies are reeling, their compatriots' blood in their eyes and their death-rattles in their ears. [commanding] Do not let up the pressure now, <class>. Seek the brutish Commander Grushak south of the keep, possibly watching from one of their towers. He should be separated from the bulk of the forces. And find the venomous Farseer Grimeye in the keep, plotting away his next move.

[solemn] I will leave it to you, if you grant them a warrior's swift death, or a slow and painful one. [solemn] As long as they are dead and gone, Elune will smile upon whichever choice you make.
quest_40809_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [solemn] Are the southern forests free of the Horde, at last?
quest_40809_quest_complete: <She bares her teeth and gives a wide grin.> [delight] Fantastic. The sentinels shall be recalled, finally, and we shall celebrate tonight. [warm] Elun'adore, <name>!
quest_40810_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The moonberry cordial and spirits flow freely around here after what we have done. [solemn] Amongst us at least, the coward Ironglade barely shows his face, knowing he stood by and watched while the real guardians of the land stood tall. [warm] Though you have all our thanks, I think there is one more person who would like to hear about this first hand. [commanding] Here, take this report to Lady Whisperwind in Darnassus. She will likely be with the other priestesses in the Temple of the Moon. [gentle] Do not worry, it speaks rather favorably of you, and I am sure she will know what to do next.

[warm] Oh, and feel free to take your time on this one, we're going nowhere soon. [excited] Enjoy some fish on the way in Auberdine, enjoy the boat trip to Teldrassil. [laughing] Try not to get too drunk!
quest_40811_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, the hero of the hour. [urgent] Speak quickly, <name>, I rather wish to be left alone currently. [soft voice] The drunken singing of the sentinels is making it rather hard to meditate.
quest_40811_quest_complete: [solemn] A message from Tyrande directly? To me? [soft voice] Curious.
quest_40812_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, that is the judgement of the High Priestess, is it. [angry] What a joke. [sad] My desire to save lives is seen as cowardice, whereas the commander’s desire for bloodlust is seen as heroism?

Perhaps it really is time for me to return to the hills of my youth. [low voice] I shall fly with the hawks, swim with the fish and hunt with the wolves, and I expect I will find far less duplicity amongst all of them than with your sentinel friends.
quest_40812_quest_complete: [soft voice] That is... harsh, though not unfair to the druids. [pause] I think the tension would have forced them away sooner or later anyway. [warm] And of course, feel free to choose a newly crafted weapon for your troubles.
quest_40813_quest_progress: [solemn] We must all do our part here in Hyjal, and my part is to harmonize Small Dream Shards into Bright Dream Shards. [soft voice] The harmonization process makes the shards much more potent in regards to their magical properties. [pause] If you have any work that you need me to do, bring me three Small Dream Shards, they can be found around Hyjal, or no doubt earned by those in town for tasks in maintaining Nordrassil. Small Dream Shard(3)
quest_40813_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work, the harmonization process does not take me long, especially with all this practice, if you find any more, come and let me know.
quest_40814_quest_progress:
[solemn] Druidic magic requires concentration, skill, the blessing of nature, and a touch of Enchanted Leather.

[soft voice] We go through our stocks fairly quickly here at Nordrassil when the needs arise and it is my duty to keep us ready.

[warm] If you are willing to assist, I can trade two Bright Dream Shards in exchange for ten Enchanted Leather at any time. Enchanted Leather(10)
quest_40814_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, everything seems to be in order here, [warm] your assistance to our efforts is well appreciated, [warm] here, take this.
quest_40815_quest_progress:
[solemn] Our enemies on Hyjal continue to grow, day after day. [soft voice] I may not know how to craft a weapon, but I do know our druidic weapons require quite a lot of Enchanted Thorium, and it is my duty to make sure we are prepared.

[warm] If you are willing to help us here in Nordanaar, I can trade a Bright Dream Shard in exchange for ten Enchanted Thorium at any time. [urgent] Enchanted Thorium Bar(10)
quest_40815_quest_complete: [soft voice] I am sure our blacksmith will be eager to work with this new material, thanks again <class>!
quest_40816_quest_progress:
[soft voice] The beautiful fabric of Mooncloth has often eluded us with its rarity and is in quite high demand for all sorts of purpose. [pause] If you could get your hands on a single piece, it would go quite a long way for us in Nordanaar.

[gentle] I could even exchange you with two Bright Dream Shards to make it worth your while. [urgent] If you end up finding one, let me know! [delight] Mooncloth
quest_40816_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Mooncloth, so divine, and majestic. I can feel the grace of Elune radiating from it.

[warm] Thank you <class>, take this as thanks for helping us.
quest_40817_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Living? Here? I never thought I would see the day.

[sad] My cursed spirit is forever bound here, unable to find the sweet release of true death. [soft voice] The memories of my past still haunt me, a never-ending reminder of the consequences of my actions.

[threatening] Yet, here you stand, wandering through these halls, oblivious to the horrors that await you. [commanding] Stay for a while and listen to my story, if it is the mysteries of Karazhan you seek to unravel. But be warned, for there are darker secrets buried within these walls that even I am not privy to.

[urgent] If you are determined enough to delve into the enigmas of Medivh's tower, perhaps the true purpose of this accursed place will reveal itself. [sad] Or perhaps you will simply become lost to the madness that has ensnared so many others before you. [solemn] A tormented spectre of the past, forever trapped within these walls, just like me...
quest_40817_quest_progress: [solemn] Let my story be a reminder to all that seek power beyond their comprehension.
quest_40817_quest_complete:
[solemn] After years spent wandering these halls as a phantom, I have come to accept the weight of my actions and the consequences that have befallen me. [soft voice] I do not seek absolution or forgiveness from you, for that is not within your power to grant.

Instead, I ask that you consider that which I have revealed to you. Reflect upon my story and the lessons that can be learned from it. [pause] Perhaps you too have had a hunger for power or knowledge that has clouded your judgment in the past. Or maybe you have made mistakes that you regret and wish to make amends for.

[solemn] As for the next course of action, that too is for you to decide. [solemn] Will you seek out the key to the Upper Chambers of Karazhan and uncover its secrets? Or will you leave this accursed place behind and seek your fortunes elsewhere? [solemn] Only you can decide the path that lies before you.
quest_40818_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, so you have made the decision to seek the forbidden knowledge of Karazhan. [soft voice] I cannot blame you, for the allure of such power and secrets can be irresistible to even the most noble of intentions. Perhaps you seek this knowledge in the hopes of using it for the greater good of this world, and for that, I commend you.

[emphasis] If you truly wish to unlock the secrets of the Upper Chambers, you must first find Moroes, the cursed and undead castellan who guards the key to the forbidden section of the tower. [low voice] It will not be an easy task, for he is cunning and fiercely protective of the secrets he guards. [pause] Be wary, as I do not know who the true master of Moroes is.

But if you can overcome his defenses and obtain the key, you may be able to enter the Upper Chambers and uncover the knowledge you seek.
quest_40818_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found Moroes and the key?
quest_40818_quest_complete:
[solemn] The key... now lies broken and useless, its magical essence lost to time and it is no longer of any use to us in its current state. It appears that even in death, Medivh has one final trick up his sleeve to guard his secrets from the prying eyes of the living.

[urgent] However, we must not lose hope. There must be a way to restore the key to its former glory and unlock the gates to the Upper Chambers. We cannot let the secrets of Karazhan be lost forever. There must be those who still possess the knowledge and ability to revive the key, to mend what was once broken.

[soft voice] I wish I could offer you more assistance, but this is where my part in this quest ends. I can only hope that your journey to restore the key is a successful one, and that the secrets of Karazhan may be unveiled to those who seek them.
quest_40819_quest_detail:
I sense that you possess Medivh's key. [solemn] Though I am unsure how you came into its possession, I must warn you: not all is what it seems, and the powers residing in Upper Chambers are beyond your comprehension.

[soft voice] When Medivh was younger, he often hosted a certain Kirin Tor mage in the tower. His name was Vandol, and if anyone could be able to repair the key, it's him.

[urgent] Make haste, for there are ominous noises emanating from the Upper Chambers, and I fear that the situation there will only become worse.
quest_40822_quest_detail:
I sense that you possess Medivh's key. [solemn] Though I am unsure how you came into its possession, I must warn you: [solemn] not all is what it seems, and the powers residing in Upper Chambers are beyond your comprehension.

[soft voice] When Medivh was younger, he often hosted a certain Kirin Tor mage in the tower. [soft voice] His name was Vandol, and if anyone could be able to repair the key, it's him.

[urgent] Make haste, for there are ominous noises emanating from the Upper Chambers, and I fear that the situation there will only become worse.
quest_40822_quest_progress: [angry] You better have a damn good reason for interrupting me.
quest_40822_quest_complete: [solemn] So you're looking for Vandol? [soft voice] Very well.
quest_40823_quest_detail:
Vandol.

He was senior to me, and I begrudgingly admit that I learned much from him about the arcane and its rules. [solemn] They say he was friends with Medivh, but I think it was a relationship of mutual benefit more than anything else.

The last I heard, Vandol had barely survived the fall of Dalaran and had retired to some backwater swamp in Dustwallow. [soft voice] Our ogre "allies" has set up a settlement in those lands, so if you want any chance of finding him, you'll have to deal with them.

<He leans in closer, his voice dropping to a low, dangerous whisper.>

[commanding] But if you manage to find Vandol, tell him that his old colleague sends his regards. [pause] And if you fail, well...[threatening] let's just say that I have a way of dealing with people who waste my time.
quest_40823_quest_progress: [commanding] Throm-ka. [soft voice] Is there anything I can help you with, <race>?
quest_40824_quest_detail:
<Krog lets out a deep, rumbling laugh.> [angry] What do you think, that we are spying on Theramore? Ha! As if we'd waste our time on those weaklings. No, no, my friend. It's just a coincidence that we happened to come into possession of their ledgers. They lost them somewhere in the swamp, it seems. Lucky for us, eh?

<Krog flips open the ledger and runs a thick, green finger down the page.>

Let's see here... Ah, yes. V-A-N-D-O-L. He arrived via boat about four years ago, and then departed on a small ship heading south along the coastline. That's all we've got to go on, I'm afraid.

[urgent] Now, if you're really keen on finding him, I suppose you could try hiring a boat from the smugglers and sailing along the coast. Just be careful, though. There are rumors of a vengeful sailor who's been terrorizing the shores lately.
quest_40824_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to my secluded house?
quest_40824_quest_complete:
I sense that you have come seeking me, and that you know who I really am. [solemn] It seems that my past has finally caught up with me, and I must admit that I am not surprised.

[pause] Take a moment to consider the gravity of what you are about to say. [soft voice] For you see, I have lived a long life filled with both triumphs and tragedies. [solemn] I have seen the fall of great kingdoms, and I have witnessed the atrocities that people are capable of committing in the name of power.

[sad] If you are here to confront me about the sins of my past, and the many mistakes that I have made, then I will not fight back. [defiant] I will accept whatever consequences may come.
quest_40825_quest_detail:
[solemn] So, you come seeking my help to repair the key to the Upper Chambers of Karazhan. [soft voice] It seems my past association with Medivh has once again come back to haunt me, but I suppose that's the price I must pay.

[low voice] Medivh himself knew the risks of what he was doing, but his insatiable thirst for knowledge and power blinded him to the consequences of his actions.

[urgent] We must proceed with caution. [hesitant] Are you prepared to face the dangers that await, knowing that the powers you seek may be too great for you to handle?

[pause] Stay awhile and listen.
quest_40825_quest_progress: [commanding] I have warned you, but I see that you are still determined.
quest_40825_quest_complete:
[solemn] In life, Medivh was known to be an extremely cautious and paranoid individual, and he took great measures to ensure that only he and his most trusted allies could access the key to his chambers. Even I, as his friend, was forbidden from doing so.

[soft voice] But there may be a glimmer of hope yet - if we can locate Echoes of Medivh's presence, they may be powerful enough to fuel the key. [low voice] Those with great magical abilities often leave traces of their presence in the fabric of the leylines, causing disruptions that can still be felt long after they are gone.

[solemn] These echoes tend to linger in places of great significance to the person's story, so we must scour the land for any clues or signs that may lead us to the echoes of Medivh. [urgent] It won't be an easy task, but it is our only hope of gaining access to Karazhan's chambers and preventing the dark forces that threaten to consume us all.
quest_40826_quest_detail:
[solemn] Regrettably, my knowledge of the whereabouts of Medivh's Echoes is limited. [soft voice] To begin your search, I suggest visiting the locations that Medivh frequented during his second life, when he returned to redeem himself and prepare for the impending Third War. [solemn] These events are relatively recent, so the Echoes should be easier to locate and more potent.

[soft voice] It is likely that the Echoes of Medivh's presence will be accompanied by objects that once belonged to him. [soft voice] Perhaps a stray feather from his cloak, or some other memento that carries his essence.

[urgent] However, time is of the essence, and you must act quickly. [commanding] Go forth and begin your search for at least four of his Echoes. [solemn] I believe this should be enough to recharge the key and unlock the chambers of Karazhan.
quest_40826_quest_progress: [solemn] I am aware of one location where Medivh had been in the past, and that is the throne room of Lordaeron. [soft voice] Although the place now lies in ruins due to the events of the Third War, it is possible that some remnants of the past still exist there. [hesitant] Perhaps, there are traces of his presence that you can uncover in the form of residual energy or forgotten relics.
quest_40826_quest_complete: [solemn] Congratulations on locating Medivh's Echoes. [soft voice] You have successfully completed the task, but unfortunately, the key remains broken and unusable. [sad] It appears that merely fueling it with Medivh's Echoes was not enough to restore it to its former state. [pause] In retrospect, I should have realized this earlier. [hesitant] Please show me the key so that I can inspect it more closely.
quest_40827_quest_detail:
<Dolvan carefully examines the key, studying it from every angle and reciting incantations to detect any potential issues.> [solemn] It appears that there is an interruption in the flow of arcane energy through the key. [pause] Upon further inspection, I have discovered that the crystals that hold the key together have been damaged beyond repair. [sad] Unfortunately, I do not possess the skills to fix them, and we will need to obtain new crystals to restore the key's functionality.

[soft voice] I have heard rumors of a demon named Immol'thar who resides deep within the dungeons of Dire Maul. [emphasis] According to legend, his skin is adorned with peculiar gems that could potentially be used to repair the key. However, be warned that Immol'thar is a formidable foe, and the journey to reach him will not be easy.
quest_40827_quest_progress: [solemn] Dire Maul lies to the West, in the wild lands of Feralas.
quest_40827_quest_complete:
[solemn] Once again, you have succeeded where others have failed, and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed by your skills and perseverance. [warm] Your unwavering determination to see this task through to the end is truly admirable.

[commanding] Now, if you would kindly hand over the gems you retrieved from the demon Immol'thar, I shall proceed to reforging the key.
quest_40828_quest_detail:
<Dolvan labors over the key, his expression contorting with disappointment as time passes.> [solemn] I cannot comprehend. [sad] This does not work. [solemn] I believed I was well-versed in the sorcery of Medivh, but alas, I have been proven wrong. [sad] This man possessed great talent, if only...

But I digress. [urgent] We must repair the key, and there remains one final possibility that comes to mind.

[solemn] I require a rare tome, penned in times long past by Aegwynn, entitled "Treatise on Magical Locks and Keys". [solemn] It has been lost since the destruction of Dalaran, but whispers suggest it is now held by none other than Lord Victor Nefarius...

[urgent] This is our only chance. [commanding] Retrieve the tome.
quest_40828_quest_progress: [solemn] It is believed that Lord Victor Nefarius dwells within Blackrock Mountain, where he exerts authority over his armies of Blackrock orcs, as well as other terrifying and repulsive creatures.
quest_40828_quest_complete:
[solemn] I don't believe it. "Treatise on Magical Locks and Keys”, written by the venerable Aegwynn herself. [soft voice] In my own hands, after all this time.

[pause] Allow me to peruse the pages of this ancient text. [solemn] I am certain that the knowledge contained within its worn and weathered pages was utilized by Medivh in the forging of this key. [urgent] By studying the techniques and methods outlined in the tome, we should be able to replicate the process and repair it.
quest_40829_quest_detail: <With great reverence, Dolvan pores over the pages of the ancient tome, carefully turning each one as if handling a delicate treasure. It is evident that the study of arcane arts has been sorely missed by the man, for his posture straightens and he assumes a scholarly air, his previously contorted visage smoothing into an expression of serenity. After what seems like an eternity, he looks up at you with a newfound sense of purpose.> [confident] I'm ready. [commanding] Let us reforge the key.
quest_40829_quest_complete:
[solemn] The task is complete. [solemn] The Key to the Upper Chambers is now in your hands. [solemn] The secrets and wonders of the legendary Karazhan await your arrival, and the mysteries of this ancient place shall be uncovered once again.

But heed my warning. [threatening] A shadow, cloaked in flame and brimstone, lies in wait. The Burning Shadow, its presence ominous and foreboding, seeks to consume all in its path.

[solemn] My role here ends, and I entrust you and your party to take care of it. [solemn] The fate of Azeroth lies in your hands.
quest_40830_quest_detail:
[solemn] It may seem dreary here in Gilneas, though I must assure you this was not always our reality. [soft voice] In times past, I spent many years studying under my masters' tutelage, and painting great manuscripts for the Light. [warm] I spread the faith and broke bread with many fine folk.

[sad] There are a foolish few who would assume we went unscathed during the perilous times of the Third War. [solemn] Whilst we may not have suffered directly from the plague as our northern cousins have, we did have conflict with the Scourge.

[emphasis] You see, two years ago, a powerful lich named Naze the Eternal breached the wall near Oldrock Pass. [solemn] Ultimately, the undead were defeated by the good soldiers of Gilneas, but our victory was paid at a terrible toll.

[sad] I was lucky to escape Greyshire with my life, others were not so fortunate. [commanding] I ask of you to scour that forsaken place, and recover the manuscripts that I spent my younger years painting. [gentle] While you are there, bring peace to some of the forlorn souls that still remain.
quest_40830_quest_progress: [solemn] It may seem like a perilous task, but remember: Keep your faith in the Light and you are bound to find yourself on the right path.
quest_40830_quest_complete:
<Father Oblen seems pleased gazing upon his old work.> [solemn] Ahh, I never thought I would look upon these scripts again, lucky they are to have survived all of the misery that befell that place.

[warm] I thank you greatly for your efforts, <class>. [proud] Please, take this as a sign of my gratitude.
quest_40841_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you heard of the tidings from the north? The Greymane Wall lies open at last.

[sad] I never thought I would see the day after hearing all the horrible things I did, and by the sounds of it, things don't bode well. Still, within Gilneas City one of my dearest friends used to work with a rare material called 'Dawnstone' which could only be found within Gilneas itself.

[soft voice] I have no doubt his patterns are still within his shop in the city, and I ask you to recover them for me. [urgent] I would advise to bring some comrades in arms along with you; word has it that there is unrest, entailing worgen and civil war, so it certainly is not a safe place to venture alone.
quest_40841_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Have you had any luck with the plans?

[hesitant] I know it is nothing easy I asked of you, but [solemn] those plans were a man's life's work, it would be a tragedy if they were lost.
quest_40841_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Are these it? I haven't had the opportunity to read these plans in quite some years.

Adaman was an exceptionally talented blacksmith and I grieve deeply for his passing. [solemn] I will make sure his findings are properly recorded here and in Ironforge, so that his name may earn the recognition he always deserved.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] I have prepared something for you as well, as compensation for the immense trouble you put yourself through.
quest_40842_quest_detail:
[solemn] The foul demons dare to challenge us by occupying a stronghold south of Forest Song, in the wretched Demon Fall Canyon.

[sad] Sadly, the Sentinels stubbornly refuse to lend me aid, while our true enemy grows stronger and prepares for another invasion.

[urgent] It is imperative that we take action: I urge you to journey into their territory and thin their numbers. [commanding] Eliminating at least ten demons of each kind you come across will send a powerful message.

[solemn] These fiends must be banished back into the Twisting Nether, never to desecrate our sacred groves again.
quest_40842_quest_progress:
[solemn] Our war with the Legion has been waged across many millennia, through countless battlefields.

[soft voice] We are the guardians of this world and we will not suffer them to taint it.
quest_40842_quest_complete:
[solemn] The trees, the beasts, the wind; all of nature rejoices. [soft voice] In its song, it is you who are owed thanks, <name>.

[warm] Your bravery and tenacity in cleansing Demon Fall Canyon have bought us precious time to prepare for the final confrontation. [proud] Your actions have not gone unnoticed, and I am proud to call you a comrade in our holy war to protect these lands.
quest_40843_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you ever wondered why the Demon Fall Canyon bears its name?

[pause] Four years ago, an ancient enemy of our people, the Pit Lord Mannoroth, returned to destroy our world. [solemn] It was there that one of his most cruel Orcish servants, Grommash Hellscream, the callous murderer of Cenarius, betrayed his own master and sought to slay him.

[solemn] In the end, Mannoroth and Grommash killed each other in the struggle, doing us all a great favor.

[soft voice] But the weapon that Mannoroth brandished still lies shattered in the canyon, and it is said that a powerful satyr by the name of Varaxxius plots to reforge it and use it for his own nefarious purposes.

[urgent] Put an end to this satyr's schemes at once.
quest_40843_quest_progress:
[solemn] They say the orcs have left a monument to Grommash in the canyon.

[angry] I hope you have spat on it.
quest_40843_quest_complete:
[solemn] It brings great comfort to me to know that I can always rely on your dedication and courage. [proud] The satyr Varaxxius was a powerful and dangerous foe, but you have proven yourself to be an expert in combat. [warm] Your actions have saved our sacred groves from the vile ambitions of those who seek to exploit the weapon of Mannoroth for their own dark purposes.

[confident] By ending the satyr and preventing any further attempts to repair the weapon, you have struck a heavy blow to our enemies and secured a significant victory for the Kaldorei. [solemn] May you ever be honored for your service to us.
quest_40844_quest_detail:
Luke Agamand was always the outcast among his family. [solemn] Disowned and banished, he found his way into my notice and joined our crew.

[soft voice] His old home was one of his first raids. [pause] I have entrusted a task to him personally, and you will ensure that he succeeds.
quest_40844_quest_complete:
[commanding] The boss wants you to help me? [urgent] I hope you're a capable <class> and not some diplomatic noodle.

[threatening] What you're about to do will take some guts.
quest_40845_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is a mine up in the hills, Dryrock Mine I believe the locals call it, responsible for providing the Gilnean army with Mithril ore. [threatening] The boss believes this Mithril is far better suited to supply the Horde, wouldn't you agree?

[urgent] Travel up to the mine, kill anyone who tries to stand in your way, and acquire 16 Sacks of Mithril Ore. [commanding] Return to me when you've finished the job.
quest_40845_quest_complete: [delight] Well I'll be damned. [excited] You actually went and pulled it off! The boss will ensure this Mithril gets where it's most needed. [proud] I'd say you've proven your worth, kid. [warm] Here's your cut.
quest_40846_quest_detail:
[solemn] Livia has been part of this outfit since the very beginning. [soft voice] If she judges you worthy, then so will I.

[low voice] I have given her a task of the utmost importance. [urgent] Go assist her.
quest_40846_quest_complete: [commanding] Listen up kid: I never wanted to set eyes nor foot upon the land of fancy pantsy Gilneans, not even to rob it. [low voice] You want to earn my appreciation? Then help me complete this task from the boss so we can finish down here and leave this wretched place.
quest_40847_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our intelligence on this region is poor. We knew Gilneas was an isolationist nation, but we did not expect it to be in such a miserable state.

[soft voice] Being among the living, we have no trouble blending in to conduct espionage. One of ours has assumed the name "Greta Longpike", who in her last missive reported she had infiltrated a settlement named Greyshire.

[commanding] Seek her out and tell her "Night Lady, gold in mouth at dawn". [emphasis] That is the code phrase. [urgent] She will give you a report, the details of which are of vital importance, that you are to bring back to me.
quest_40847_quest_progress: [urgent] You return. [commanding] You had better have that report in hand.
