quest_40847_quest_complete: [solemn] Gilneas appears to be in open rebellion. One side is led by Prince Liam Greymane and a certain Ravenwood, while the other side is led by corrupt Gilnean nobles. The boss will want to hear about this. [warm] You have done well. [proud] This task couldn't have been easy, but as a member of the Horde, you have proven yourself capable with this flawless execution.
quest_40848_quest_detail:
[solemn] You may wonder why a gaggle of humans are working with the Horde. The answer to that question lies in the Civil War in the Plaguelands, when we Forsaken first gained liberty...

[pause] Yes, we Forsaken. You see, I am a banshee currently possessing Blackthorn, and I have convinced his band of cutthroats to fight for us. [soft voice] Rest assured, I am not alone in this endeavor.

[commanding] If you wish to know more, then you will need to earn my trust. Some of those naga creatures have been encroaching upon the camp from the beach. [urgent] Slaughter them and we will resume our conversation upon your triumphant return.
quest_40848_quest_progress: [soft voice] Shall we continue the tale?
quest_40848_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well.

[soft voice] Following the victory of the Forsaken, those who possessed a body during the conflict were sent out as the Dark Lady's eyes and ears. [pause] My group is usually sent to spy upon the Alliance as we are suited for blending in among humans.

[warm] I have come to grow fond of my comrades in this group. [proud] They lacked discipline and purpose once, but are now skilled infiltrators and spies.
quest_40849_quest_detail:
[solemn] Storytime is over. [commanding] The time to act is at hand. [soft voice] I have read the report you retrieved from Livia, and I have decided how best to proceed.

[emphasis] King Genn Greymane was ever a force to be reckoned with in the old Alliance of Lordaeron. [low voice] His strength and shrewdness were only matched by his stubbornness and pride. [urgent] He cannot be allowed to wrest control over his crumbling kingdom once more.

[commanding] Venture into his city with as many comrades as you can find and bring me his head.
quest_40849_quest_progress: [solemn] The King of Gilneas was once a force to be reckoned with. [soft voice] Though his power and grip over the kingdom has diminished, he will be no easy prey.
quest_40849_quest_complete:
[delight] Wonderful! You have proven yourself a capable agent of the Dark Lady.

[solemn] Though your tale of what happened in the city troubles me... [hesitant] If Genn Greymane was truly behind the rebellion, we may have inadvertently aided our enemies. [urgent] That, however, is neither your fault nor your concern.

[commanding] We will take it from here. [cold] You are dismissed.
quest_40850_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dark Lady has a task for a capable <class> such as yourself that would benefit the interests of the Horde.

[soft voice] One of the Banshee Queen's agents has been sent to Gilneas in order to survey the situation, acquire assets for the Horde, and evaluate whether the area is suitable for exploitation by the Forsaken.

[urgent] The Greymane Wall was recently breached and the nation it once protected is in chaos, granting us access and an opportunity. [commanding] Follow the road south into Gilneas, circle around the city, and you will find a camp by the western shore occupied by Blackthorn.

[emphasis] You may be surprised by the nature of his followers, but rest assured that he and his minions are devoted in their service to the Horde and the Dark Lady. [cold] Report to him and he will make good use of you.
quest_40850_quest_complete:
[solemn] I see that the Dark Lady has sent someone to assist us. [low voice] I may look human, but do not let appearances deceive you.

[commanding] I am fully committed to the Horde, as my loyalty lies with the Banshee Queen. [urgent] If you are here to assist, I shall put you to work.

[commanding] Help my subordinates, then I will have further instructions for you.
quest_40851_quest_detail:
[solemn] While our scouts were surveying these lands, they encountered a contingent of Forsaken in the northeast. [low voice] We have not received any information that we would be getting reinforcements, or that any other Forsaken would be here.

[hesitant] Perhaps you would be interested in investigating? [soft voice] These Forsaken were located by a church in the northeast the locals call Stillward Church. [solemn] If they need assistance, it is our duty to our Forsaken brethren to provide it.
quest_40851_quest_progress: [solemn] A wandering soul comes to our flock.
quest_40851_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am surprised to learn that there exists other like us in this land. It is no surprise they were unaware of our presence, as we came here of our own accord.

[soft voice] Nonetheless, if you have come all this way, then surely you intend to assist us.
quest_40852_quest_detail:
[solemn] With all the troubles around here, I find myself having to turn to every mercenary with a sword to get things done. [low voice] It's an unenviable position, to say the least.

[urgent] Say, I'm not paying you to listen, and you're not here to hear me talk. [commanding] North of here, in their mounds, are significantly more ogres than I am comfortable sharing the area with. [angry] Go and relieve them of their heads. [urgent] Bring me twenty, and I will organise payment. <He gives a derisive smirk before looking away.>
quest_40852_quest_progress: [soft voice] You seem not to be a dead mercenary. [hesitant] Does that then make you a successful mercenary, or simply a lazy mercenary?
quest_40852_quest_complete: [low voice] Eighteen, nineteen, tw... hmm. [sad] That one is really badly damaged, whatever did you do to him? Regardless, you did well. [warm] Here is your payment.
quest_40853_quest_detail:
Truthfully, <name>, I don't really care how many dumb ogres are killed by gold-a-dozen mercenaries. [low voice] Whether it's you or some other that brings me a bag of heads, it makes no difference.

[soft voice] Oh, don't look at me like that, you know I'm right. Anyway, if you want something meaningful to do, listen: [pause] our scouts overheard that two ogres are vying for power amongst the Brol'ok. [solemn] One of which calls himself Shinban Four-Eyes. [whispering] A two headed ogre with three actual eyes, claims the fourth is a hidden one that gives him the vision required to lead!

[commanding] I would be worried about that, <name>. [low voice] Either he is telling the truth and is a caster powerful enough to have magical sight, or he is smart enough to understand metaphors. [solemn] Both are worrying. Regardless, he is your primary target.
quest_40853_quest_progress: [urgent] No further work, [emphasis] your current tasks need to be done.
quest_40853_quest_complete: [soft voice] He must not have been such a threat after all, to see you bringing back this trophy so quickly. [solemn] Though I shall not change the pay now, a reward is a reward. [warm] Take it.
quest_40854_quest_detail:
Greetings, <name>.

[solemn] It is rare that I admit my incorrect assumptions, but I must atone for this one. [sad] I previously thought the ogres of Brol'ok should be allowed to grow and fester, like a pustulant sore, right next to Ravenshire. [soft voice] Let the living there be the ones to suffer with it.

[pause] But alas, whatever still holds vigil over this godforsaken land has a sense of irony. [low voice] It was just last night that I saw a group of ogres attack, and kill, one of our own Deathstalkers. [angry] Out of my own pocket, I now purchase vengeance. [commanding] Bring me twenty of their heads, and be rewarded.
quest_40854_quest_progress: [commanding] Be swift, vengeance is a desire best sated immediately.
quest_40854_quest_complete: [solemn] Glorious, simply glorious. [soft voice] Ah, the sweet taste of it, knowing a debt has been repaid twenty-fold.
quest_40855_quest_detail:
[solemn] Recent events have made me reconsider my outlook on life. Or, lack thereof.

What is it that demands the most respect in this world, <name>? [commanding] I would say that is power. Raw and unadulterated. Sheer strength of will, force of arm, power. And what causes any kingdom to fall into ruins, to crumble into ash? The loss of leadership, the lack of power!

[sigh] Ah, forget my musings and ramblings, I have much too much time and much too much contempt. [commanding] To speak plainly: the Brol'ok have a champion vying for power in their little mounds, known as Maulfist. He is called a chief, even amongst the ogres, so he must be exceptionally powerful... bring me his crown, if you can. I will reward you handsomely if so.
quest_40855_quest_progress: [low voice] Yes, <name>? [urgent] Have you brought death to their mounds?
quest_40855_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, delightful. [mocking tone] Such brutish craftsmanship, their work often looks quite pathetic, doesn't it? [low voice] Ah don't mind me, [urgent] your reward, your reward at once.
quest_40856_quest_detail:
[solemn] Gnomeregan's intricate network of ducts, pipes, channels, vents, and airways are essential for maintaining a healthy flow of air. [sad] However, they also circulated the toxic gases that had such a devastating impact on our brethren.

[solemn] As a precaution, we established a comprehensive backup system that redirects the airflow in case of an emergency. [urgent] Unfortunately, many of these channels have been closed off and sealed, necessitating the manipulation of levers and valves to reactivate them.

[commanding] We require your technical expertise to access two crucial access points within the city. [solemn] The first is the Alpha Channel, which is responsible for our backup power generation and is located in the Engineering Labs. [urgent] The second is the Reserve Pump Channel, found near the Launch Bay, which is essential for the operation of our reserve air pumps.

[excited] These channels must be activated! [proud] We must return the great city of Gnomeregan to the marvel of technology that it once was!
quest_40856_quest_progress: [solemn] Our success is critical on the activation of these backup systems. [soft voice] I would advise you to recruit some backup in this task, for Gnomeregan is filled with all manner of terrible things.
quest_40856_quest_complete:
[excited] Adventurer! I am pleased to inform you that the Alpha Channel and Reserve Pump Channel are performing exceptionally well, operating at approximately 87% efficiency. No, wait, 88%! Given the devastation of Gnomeregan, this is indeed a welcome surprise.

I cannot express enough gratitude for the invaluable assistance you have provided in helping us restore this facility. Without your efforts, we would not have made nearly as much progress as we have.

[warm] As a token of our appreciation, please accept this humble offering from all of us here at the Reclamation Facility. May it aid you with your future endeavors.
quest_40857_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greetings adventurer, I am Teezle Dualflash, once widely known in Gnomeregan, and I have returned with valuable information that could greatly aid our cause. I have discovered the identity of the leader of the leper gnomes who has been causing chaos on the surface, and his name is Neevan Gubblewire. [urgent] He has been rallying the lepers to his cause, continually causing trouble for the reclamation facility, hindering our efforts, and threatening the future success of our cause.

[commanding] That is why I implore you, brave adventurer, to help us bring Neevan Gubblewire to justice. [low voice] It will not be an easy task, but it must be done. [urgent] You should be able to find him somewhere on the surface outside of Gnomeregan to the south of here. [soft voice] Will you help me with this matter?
quest_40857_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found that ruffian that calls himself leader?
quest_40857_quest_complete:
[commanding] Impressive work, <class>. [warm] You have slain Neevan Gubblewire and scattered his leper ruffians, making our work safer and more secure. [proud] Your bravery and determination are admirable, and you have served our cause well. [warm] I will be sure to pass along your name with everyone I am sure to run into.

[warm] Take one of these as a token of my appreciation, and best of luck out there.
quest_40858_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You wouldn't happen to have seen Technician Stormlight around have you? [low voice] Small stature, bald, brown goatee?

[urgent] I've been waiting for an access terminal repair for practically a full day now, and I need his work done before we can continue our procedures. [commanding] If you could, find him and tell him to hurry it up. [urgent] He should still be inside the Reclamation Facility.
quest_40858_quest_complete:
[angry] Can't you see that I am busy here? [urgent] I am trying to get this access terminal operational with subpar tools and inadequate materials! It's proving to be quite a challenge, even for a gnome of my skill.

[hesitant] Say, you wouldn't mind helping me out, would you?
quest_40859_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have been expecting a shipment from Tinker Town for a few days now. [soft voice] You see, a lot of our rare materials were sent over here once we got things settled. [low voice] A lot of my work on these access panels needs a Hydrocondensor Modulator, but it was stolen on the trip here by a group of leper gnomes. [angry] They ransacked quite a few valuable goods.

[urgent] Now, getting hold of a new one is not an easy task. [solemn] We could only construct them in Gnomeregan, so unless you want to go digging through that trogg infested ruin, I suggest you look for the one that got stolen. [hesitant] Try rooting around the old houses to the south of here, no doubt they have it stashed somewhere safe.
quest_40859_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you had any success in finding my modulator?
quest_40859_quest_complete: <Technician Stormlight lets out an exhausted sigh of relief.> [excited] I was getting ready to start preparing the copper tubes and bronze frameworks as a backup! [warm] You have certainly saved a colossal headache by finding this blasted thing. Now I can get started on some real fixing. [proud] Thanks again, <class>.
quest_40860_quest_detail:
[solemn] When Gnomeregan was built many years ago we had access to all sorts of materials from around the world. Dawnstone, one such material that we used, was excellent for being a coupler of energy. It was highly resistant to both magical, and powerful currents of energy. Making it highly versatile in its uses.

We have been unable to recreate any replicas to fix those that have broken down, having to replace them with subpar stand-ins that break much more often.

[urgent] Though it would appear we have a surge of luck on our side. You see, Gilneas has opened its gates once again. Rumors of civil problems are abound there.

[commanding] I need you to head to Gilneas far to the north and gather me a supply of four Dawnstone Ore. It should be found at the Dawnstone Mine near the city.
quest_40860_quest_progress: [urgent] We have been going through Copper Couplers faster than I can wrap my head around! [commanding] If we are to keep up with all of the repair work required in this facility we need something that can last.
quest_40860_quest_complete: <Master Technician Wirespanner gazes upon the ore, an expression of giddy joy washes across his face.> [soft voice] These dull, repressed glints, I remember them fondly. [warm] Excellent work <class>, with this ore we will be able to produce enough conductors to fix what is needed in the facility.
quest_40861_quest_detail:
[solemn] The destruction of Gnomeregan set us back in our technology in quite a few ways. [soft voice] So much of our work was lost in the blink of an eye.

[hesitant] We are basically working blind. [urgent] If we are to ever make real progress here in this facility, then we require a very rare item of significant importance.

[solemn] The High Energy Regulator is something that was created to manage surges of intense energy. [urgent] Without it, it is impossible to channel excessive amounts of power to where we need it, which is exactly what we are trying to do here!

[emphasis] Currently, this facility is operating at low power to prevent an override or oversurge to our systems. [excited] But we can work faster, MUCH faster. [urgent] I need you to find the schematic for the High Energy Regulator that was lost in Gnomeregan. [confident] We can truly utilize this facility in the way it was meant to run if we can get ahold of it.
quest_40861_quest_progress:
[angry] Damned spanner, always..

[soft voice] Oh, you startled me, you wouldn't happen to have recovered the schematic would you?
quest_40861_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm, this is much more complicated than I remember, but with a little bit of elbow grease and some studious applications of gnomish engineering, it shouldn't be too hard to create a proper replica. [pause] It will take some time to test its efficiency before we put it into practice, but this has saved us a lot of time in designing a new prototype.

[warm] Thanks again <class>. [excited] Here, take this, a Low Energy Regulator as thanks for your help.
quest_40862_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings! I am Cassie Copperlight, a gnomish tinker. I find myself in a bit of a bind, you see: a recent batch of bad data membranes from Tinker Town has caused a catastrophic failure in many of the Servitors in the lower levels of the Reclamation Facility. [urgent] I may need your help.

Your task is to venture down into those lower levels and destroy the malfunctioning Servitors. Additionally, I need you to retrieve any spare parts lying about so that I can build functioning replacements. [pause] Around seven should do. [solemn] It won't be easy, but with your skill and bravery, we can fix this problem and prevent any further damage.
quest_40862_quest_progress: I would be careful dealing with those Servitors. [soft voice] They may be primarily built to help with tasks, but they can be quite dangerous!
quest_40862_quest_complete:
<A heavy sigh of relief escapes Cassie Copperlight.> [exhale] Phew.

Well, that is one crisis averted. It shouldn't be long until the other malfunctioning Servitor's are all destroyed. [warm] I got some spare silver for what you've done. [excited] Hope to see you around!
quest_40863_quest_detail:
Greetings, adventurer. [solemn] I am Father Gavin, a humble priest of the Argent Dawn. I come to you with a request that weighs heavily upon my soul. [sad] I was recently ambushed in Dun Morogh and my prized possession, 'The Mercy of Humility', an old religious text, was taken from me by the violent Rockjaw Troggs. [urgent] I fear for its safety, as these brutish creatures are known to destroy anything they can't use.

[soft voice] I implore you to aid me in recovering this valuable relic. [solemn] I am certain the Troggs near Ironband's Compound to the south east are those that possess it. [commanding] Slay them and recover the text before it is damaged beyond repair.

[warm] Bring this book back to me, and I will make sure you are justly rewarded for your service to the Light.
quest_40863_quest_progress: [urgent] It is imperative that you recover The Mercy of Humility before it is too late.
quest_40863_quest_complete:
[solemn] By all that is divine, the tome is recovered...

[pause] The weight has been lifted, and my soul is free. [warm] You have done me a great service in recovering this text, and for it I must thank you dearly.

[gentle] Please, take this robe, as a gesture of my good will.
quest_40864_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As you may have noticed, the lower sections of the Reclamation Facility have been contaminated by a chemical leak, which has resulted in the appearance of corrosive backup. [solemn] These dangerous substances were created due to an unstable arcane converter, which was leaking magical eminence.

[commanding] As a chemist, it is my duty to oversee the cleanup of these hazardous materials. [urgent] However, the corrosive backup has proven to be particularly challenging to contain, let alone eliminate! [gentle] Could you offer your assistance in this matter? [urgent] Thinning the numbers of oozes would make my life a lot easier.
quest_40864_quest_progress: I'm trying to think of a more scientific solution to this problem, just in case your smashing solution does not pan out.
quest_40864_quest_complete:
[commanding] By Mekkatorque's word, you've done a good job in cleaning up that chemical backup.

[solemn] There is still some work to be done, but we will surely finish the job soon.

[warm] Here, take this as payment for your help.
quest_40865_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Robot XV-81, a highly sophisticated chemical clean-up Servitor, has turned rogue due to magical interference. [urgent] It's causing chaos in the lower levels of the Reclamation Facility, and poses a threat to anyone in its path.

[commanding] I must ask of you to venture into the depths below, locate XV-81, and destroy it before it causes any further harm. [emphasis] Most importantly I must ask you to recover it's Chemical Processing Membrane, an extremely rare piece of technology locked deep within its brain!
quest_40865_quest_progress: [urgent] The chemists here at the Reclamation Facility are relying on you, <name>!
quest_40865_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it!

The Chemical Processing Membrane has been recovered. [warm] I cannot express how thankful I am to see this! I was already dreading the sheer amount of work we would have to do to make a new one.

[confident] Now, we can begin work on the XV-82 with the Tinkers and make it much more sound to deal with chemical issues and resilient to arcane interference.

[warm] Here, take this as a token of appreciation. [proud] Without you, I would still be scratching my head to think of a solution!
quest_40866_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ever since we left Tinker Town, there have been messages of a raid near Ironband's Compound to the south east. You would suspect Troggs to be behind such a thing, but no, Dark Irons are here in Dun Morogh.

[hesitant] Whilst this is alarming, it could also prove to be a chance to get ahold of some Dark Iron Technology. I do know that there are some skilled engineers and magic users amongst their ranks, and I want to see first hand what they are capable of.

[urgent] Head down there, and take what you can find. Bring it back to me so I can do some studying.
quest_40866_quest_progress: [urgent] So, have you made it to Ironband's Compound yet?
quest_40866_quest_complete:
[soft voice] This is it, huh? [hesitant] To be honest, I expected more, but perhaps this is only because they are so far from their home.

[pause] Oh well, I will still go ahead and study this in more depth. [solemn] At the least you were able to kill some of those rather brutish Dark Iron.

[warm] Here, take this coin as thanks.
quest_40867_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings <class>, I am the Master Chemist here at the Reclamation Facility, working on a groundbreaking formula to purify the air in our once beloved city of Gnomeregan. [solemn] However, I am in dire need of materials to test my theories.

I require a Pure Aqua Sample, which can only be obtained from the unbalanced aqua found in Dun Morogh's Ice Flow Lake. [hesitant] These elementals are known for their unique and magical properties, making them a perfect specimen for my research.

[warm] If you could gather one Pure Aqua Sample for me, it would be of great assistance. [urgent] Do approach cautiously, as the elementals can be quite dangerous.
quest_40867_quest_progress: [solemn] The sample I have tasked you with gathering is of extreme importance. [commanding] Do not delay in this matter.
quest_40867_quest_complete: <Master Chemist Volterwhite takes his time studying the sample with utmost care.> [soft voice] Hmm, this may prove to be a vital piece in the complex puzzle I am working on. [pause] I need to test a few things first...
quest_40868_quest_detail:
[solemn] The magical fluctuations of the sample you provided were quite extreme. [urgent] In order to harness and channel this energy, I require a few materials. Materials that I have been waiting on for some time now.

[sad] With the disturbance of Gol'Bolar Quarry and the untimely demise of a contractor working there, I have been left empty handed on my supply of Snowvale Root and Gol'Bolar Ore. [hesitant] Perhaps you can help with acquiring these things for me?

Snowvale Root is often carried by Frostmane Seers who have travelled to their retreat far in the mountains. [emphasis] I will require three samples of it from them. As for the Gol'Bolar Ore, I am sure Prospector Gehn at the Quarry will provide it on our behalf here.
quest_40868_quest_progress: [angry] You're disturbing my work. [hesitant] That is, unless, you have those materials I asked you to acquire?
quest_40868_quest_complete: [solemn] The grounded nature of the Gol'Bolar Ore and the controlled energy of the Snowvale Root should do well in controlling the extreme fluctuations of the aqua sample you brought me earlier.
quest_40869_quest_detail:
[soft voice] An idea has come to my mind, while you were busy helping! [excited] With these elements as a base, I have discovered that I require a more volatile aqua in the formula. [commanding] With a more potent chemical reaction, it is theoretically possible to disperse the toxins from the air.

[solemn] Now that is compelling, isn't it?

[confident] I have done the math, and all I require is a sample of Volatile Aqua.

[urgent] I have heard rumors of a rather hostile aqua elemental out near the Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh.
quest_40869_quest_progress: [soft voice] My work is almost complete, we are on the precipice of a great breakthrough here.
quest_40869_quest_complete:
<Master Chemist Volterwhite looks upon the Volatile Aqua with a look of determination, beginning the synthesizing process at once.> [soft voice] Step back, this should only take a moment.

<A smirk spreads across the gnome's face.>

[solemn] It would appear that my theorizing has been succesful, for I have been able to replicate my design and expunge the radiation from the nominal air in my samples!

[warm] With your help my theory has been put to the test, and without that I am unsure where we would be. [confident] Now the real work can begin.

[warm] For your help, I have prepared a gift. [excited] Pick one, and may it serve you well.
quest_40872_quest_detail: [soft voice] During one of my visits around Nordrassil I came to find an unusual guest. [pause] I was approached by a small fawn, one of the local wildlife in the region. [solemn] As a reward for your efforts upon Hyjal itself, I could see to it that this creature becomes a loyal companion of yours.
quest_40872_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40872_quest_complete: [solemn] It is said to be lucky to have gained the confidence of the wildlife around the World Tree.
quest_40873_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you are seeking to gain knowledge of our most vital and rare elixirs then you have come to the right place. [soft voice] For your efforts upon Hyjal, I could bestow upon you the knowledge of my forebearers. [solemn] The Dreamshard Elixir is a rather potent and powerful alchemical mixture.

[emphasis] It could be used to turn the tide of a conflict in your favor.
quest_40873_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40873_quest_complete:
[solemn] I must warn you, use this recipe wisely. [soft voice] A misuse of the materials can create the counter opposite of the Dreamshard Elixir.

[pause] I suggest you follow this recipe closely.
quest_40874_quest_detail:
[solemn] The druids of Hyjal long ago learned to master a potion of lucidity, able to keep the drinker awake and immune from the pull of the Emerald Dream. [soft voice] I am willing to offer you this formula for your deeds and actions upon Hyjal itself.

[urgent] Gather me Bright Dream Shards, and you too can stay lucid and awake from the pull of nightmare.
quest_40874_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40874_quest_complete:
[solemn] One sip, and you will remain awake, even from some powerful forces that draw you to slumber.

[soft voice] I advise you not to overuse the Lucidity Potion, a known few have been known to go mad from the lack of sleep.
quest_40875_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago the druids of Hyjal devised a potent and powerful leatherworking recipe to enhance their armor.

[soft voice] This armor kit contains the very power of the druidic magic itself.

[pause] If you desire, I could give you this pattern in exchange for your efforts to assist us in Nordanaar. [warm] It could be a powerful boon for you and your allies.
quest_40875_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40875_quest_complete: [solemn] A wise decision <class>. [soft voice] I would recommend using these smelling salts with care. [gentle] They are extremely strong and should not be used for any sort of practical joking.
quest_40876_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was once a trainee with the druids of Hyjal long before the Third War scarred the land. I had the chance to learn much of the more nuanced teachings of druidic magic, and it is there I learned to craft an item called 'The Horn of Binding'.

[soft voice] I have been working to craft a new horn and bind it to the natural energies here in Winterspring, but I require more materials from across these lands and Hyjal both.

[urgent] I require: the beaks of Greathorn Owls native to Hyjal, a Vilemusk Horn from the Satyr that also dwell there, a book titled 'Bracing of Nature' which can be found at Nordanaar, and finally a Moontouched Amulet from the local Owlbeasts here in Winterspring.
quest_40876_quest_progress: [solemn] These materials will be dangerous to obtain, so I implore you to use caution when searching for them.
quest_40876_quest_complete:
[solemn] The creation of the Horn of Binding shall finally begin, in no small part thanks to your courageous and selfless efforts, <name>. [soft voice] It will no doubt take me many days, or even weeks, to read through this old book and remember the steps necessary to finish this ordeal.

[warm] I must thank you for what you have done for me. [gentle] Please, take these items. [warm] They are tokens of my time spent in Hyjal, many long years ago... [pause] May they serve you better than collecting dust here with me at Starfall Village.
quest_40877_quest_detail:
Listen, <race>. [solemn] We face no shortage of troubles here, but I shan't waste your time with mindless errands. [low voice] Dealing with the pests and beasts that torment our camp is a task I can handle myself.

[commanding] However, I do require your aid in a matter of greater importance. [soft voice] One of our own, Orvan Darkeye, came to Gilneas in search of the lost tomes of Archmage Ur. [sad] Yet, the irony of it all - he himself became lost.

<Deathstalker Alynna's twisted smile conveys her amusement at the situation.>

[urgent] Your mission is clear: find him, or what little is left of him. [emphasis] Last we heard, he was headed towards Greyshire.
quest_40877_quest_complete:
[angry] What? That mindless rotbrain thinks I got lost?

<Orvan chuckles darkly>

How amusing. One less pathetic cur to deal with. As you can see, I am perfectly capable of taking care of myself. But it seems fate has brought you here, and I must admit, I have a need for a servant. [cold] And you, my dear, look like a perfect specimen for the job.
quest_40878_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have come to this land in search of a particular book - a tome I have sought for ages: 'On the Powers of Blood' by Archmage Ur. [sad] Oh, how it eluded me! [soft voice] But now, I have reason to believe that it may be hidden within Gilneas.

[solemn] The knowledge contained within those pages could be invaluable to furthering both the goals of the Forsaken and the Horde. [urgent] I am close to discovering its whereabouts, very close, but in the meantime I require your assistance. [commanding] Take these vials and collect the blood of bats. [threatening] We will need them for our plans, yes. [threatening] Do not disappoint me.
quest_40878_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you collected the blood already? [commanding] I need ten full vials.
quest_40878_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, excellent. You have brought me what I needed.

<Orvan takes the vials, inspects them with a sinister smile and abruptly tosses them behind him.>

[soft voice] These will be invaluable, truly invaluable.
quest_40879_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greymane may have thought himself safe behind these walls, but he was foolish to believe he could hide from Death. Now, his incompetence comes back to haunt him, and by extension, me. The Scourge still lurk in these lands, constantly interrupting my research and slowing it down considerably. [urgent] It is time to take matters into our own hands.

[commanding] I command you to eliminate the remaining Scourge forces in Greyshire.

[threatening] Do not fail me, for failure is not an option. <The Forsaken's eyes narrow with a cold, calculating intensity.>
quest_40879_quest_progress: [urgent] What are you waiting for? [commanding] Root them out, destroy them utterly. [low voice] Their presence here is an affront to the Forsaken and a threat to our operations.
quest_40879_quest_complete:
[solemn] It seems that not all of the Scourge forces were eradicated, but I must commend you for your work nonetheless. [soft voice] Your efforts have weakened their hold on this land and that will have to be enough for now. [urgent] We cannot afford to underestimate our enemies, especially not the Scourge. [low voice] They are a relentless force, serving their vile Lich King until the end.

[pause] Speaking of which, what became of the commander of the Scourge invasion here, I wonder? [emphasis] Was he defeated, or is he in hiding, waiting for the Lich King's command to resume his invasion of Gilneas?
quest_40880_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must say, you have proven to be a useful servant, and your mindless loyalty is a rare sight indeed in these times. [soft voice] But I must confess, I wasn't exactly truthful with you in the beginning. [low voice] While my personal pursuit is the search for the works of Ur, I am also here on a mission from the Royal Apothecary Society. [commanding] We believe that Gilneas is the perfect place to perfect our new weapon against the enemies of the Horde.

[urgent] But to do so, I require more blood. [cold] Human blood, and worgen blood. [whispering] It's a delicate balance. [commanding] Take these vials and head south of Stillward Church. [urgent] There you will find Greymane's forces. [commanding] It shouldn't be too difficult to get the blood we need from them. [threatening] As for the worgen blood... well, they will come to you, one way or another. [threatening] Just be ready for them when they do.
quest_40880_quest_progress: [urgent] Be quick about it, my servant.
quest_40880_quest_complete: [solemn] Now that is impressive. [soft voice] Let us see how this blood will react with my concoction. [pause] If my calculations are correct...
quest_40881_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I may have... miscalculated a bit. [sad] It seems without the knowledge held in the 'Powers of Blood', I cannot stabilize the mix. [urgent] I need that book.

[sad] I scoured every corner of this land with no success. [solemn] It can only mean one thing: The book is hidden in the city of Gilneas itself. [low voice] It looms like an impenetrable fortress, and the thought of trying to find a single book within its walls is overwhelming.

[solemn] The city is heavily fortified, and the human forces stationed there are not to be trifled with. [solemn] They are determined to hold onto what little they have left, and they will stop at nothing to keep their city safe. [urgent] It will take all of your cunning and stealth to even attempt getting past their defenses.

[soft voice] If, however, you do manage to locate the book... [warm] I will reward you beyond measure.
quest_40881_quest_progress: [solemn] Has everything I've done been in vain?
quest_40881_quest_complete:
[excited] Ah, finally! After all the obstacles and setbacks, I have obtained Ur's masterpiece. [solemn] The secrets of blood magic, and the power to control the very essence of life itself! [confident] With this book, I will be unstoppable, and the enemies of the Forsaken will tremble before me.

<The Forsaken flips through the pages, cackling with excitement.>

[soft voice] It is clear that Ur was a master of his craft. But even he did not fully comprehend the true potential of blood magic. [proud] With the knowledge contained in this tome, I will surpass him and become the greatest bloodmage the world has ever known.

<The Forsaken looks up with a wicked grin.>

[warm] You have served me well, my faithful minion. And for that, I will grant you a small taste of the power we will soon wield.
quest_40882_quest_detail:
[solemn] Behold the new age of the Forsaken! [commanding] With this tome as my guide, I will unlock the secrets of the Blood Dimension and harness its power for our cause.

<Orvan Darkeye mixes blood with a slimy, green concoction, following the steps described in the tome with meticulous precision. After a while, he turns to you, a wicked grin on his face.>

[urgent] Now, we must find a test subject for my latest creation. [cold] I had planned to force it down your throat, but you have been a faithful servant, and I will spare you this time. [threatening] Instead, I have a better idea. [solemn] There is a nearby camp of human mercenaries who are loyal to our cause. [whispering] I wonder if this concoction will make them even more devoted to our mission.

[pause] Before I can proceed, I require one final favor from you. [commanding] Report to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity. [urgent] Tell him that the mission was a success.
quest_40882_quest_complete: [solemn] So Orvan was successful after all. [cold] Great. You have done a great favor to the Forsaken and to the Horde this day, so you shall be rewarded. [low voice] Take this vial, my friend. It contains a potent concoction that will enhance your strength simply by breathing in its fumes. Of course, there may be some minor side effects, such as headaches, vomiting, madness, or even death, but I'm sure you'll be fine. [threatening] After all, what is a little risk compared to the power it can provide?
quest_40883_quest_detail: [solemn] The enchantments known to us here are vast. [soft voice] Though we cannot share all of our secrets, we are willing to pass on certain enchanting formulas as a token of our gratitude for helping us in Hyjal. [warm] One such pattern is for a strong boots enchantment if you are interested.
quest_40883_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40883_quest_complete: [solemn] May this enchantment be a boon to you and your allies. [soft voice] Its power may just turn the tide in a difficult conflict.
quest_40884_quest_detail: [solemn] The enchantments known to us here are vast. [soft voice] Though we cannot share all of our secrets, we are willing to pass on certain enchanting formulas as a token of our gratitude for helping us in Hyjal. [warm] One such pattern is for a strong bracers enchantment if you are interested.
quest_40884_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_40884_quest_complete: [solemn] The properties of deflection are well known to us here. [soft voice] I am certain you will make good use it.
quest_40885_quest_progress:
[solemn] I am afraid I cannot offer you our Dreamtonic recipe to be crafted independently. It was discovered by one that is no longer with us, and I do not have their permission to share such secrets to outsiders.

[soft voice] I can however, offer Dreamtonic that was created by myself in exchange for your efforts here in Hyjal. [urgent] Bring me a single Small Dream Shard in exchange for a single Dreamtonic. [gentle] That should be a fair trade. Small Dream Shard
quest_40885_quest_complete: [soft voice] The effects of this mixture are intense, [pause] pace yourself.
quest_40886_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ability to smelt Dreamsteel is an art all in itself. [soft voice] Whilst the difficulty to actually create patterns using Dreamsteel Bars is complicated, it does not overshadow the smelting process.

[gentle] If you wish to learn how to create your own Dreamsteel Bars and not rely on others, [pause] gather for me fifteen Bright Dream Shards as a showing of your loyalty to the World Tree.
quest_40886_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_40886_quest_complete: [solemn] Now then, this is the book that should teach you all that you need to know. [soft voice] Study it carefully, and apply the techniques as written in the text.
quest_40888_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mastery of Dreamsteel is a complicated art, one that requires extreme amounts of patience in order to perfect.

[soft voice] If you wish to take this challenge, I can offer you the plans to create the Dreamsteel Leggings. [commanding] Though, I do require some evidence of your services in the name of Nordrassil. Seventy-five Bright Dream Shards should do. [urgent] Bring them to me, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_40888_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_40888_quest_complete:
[solemn] I remember the day I first learned to craft and create Dreamsteel, it was a most rewarding experience.

[warm] May this recipe serve you well, <name>.
quest_40889_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mastery of Dreamsteel is a complicated art, one that requires extreme amounts of patience in order to perfect.

[soft voice] If you wish to take this challenge, I can offer you the plans to create the Dreamsteel Bracers. [pause] Though, I do require some evidence of your services in the name of Nordrassil. Seventy-five Bright Dream Shards should do. [commanding] Bring them to me, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_40889_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?

[hesitant] What? [surprised] You've come to learn my secrets? Hmm... Perhaps. [solemn] I have prepared a book to teach those loyal to our causes how to work with Dreamhide, but I require Bright Dream Shards from you in order to offer it.

[warm] For your efforts in helping Hyjal I can offer a book containing all of my knowledge. [gentle] Bring me fifteen Bright Dream Shards and you can also learn my techniques.

quest_40905_quest_progress: [solemn] What is this you have brought me?
quest_40905_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have not seen such an intact Dream Essence in such a long time. [soft voice] I had once thought all traces of it on Azeroth had been expunged, but I am proven wrong.

[sad] Corruption is deep within this sample, though withering. [solemn] It would not be hard to purify it.
quest_40906_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I must admit, I am quite nostalgic about working with Dream Essence once again. [solemn] It has been many long decades since I have had the delight. [commanding] To restore this sample, I require the following materials that can be found around azeroth.

[urgent] From here in Hyjal, I require ten Bright Dream Shards. [urgent] Twenty-five Dream Dust needs to be acquired from anyone who can disenchant. [urgent] Finally, I will need fifteen Living Essence, which can be somewhat tricky to come across. [warm] Bring these to me, and you shall be rewarded with the Emerald Blessing.
quest_40906_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have the materials been collected fellow druid?
quest_40906_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, the Dream Essence is purified and awaiting your embrace.

[soft voice] Not all druids ever get the opportunity to wield such magic. [gentle] Use it sparingly, and with great care, young one.
quest_40907_quest_detail:
<The man's eyes widen as you approach, his breath catching for a moment. Then, he exhales sharply and begins to shake.> [hesitant] You... help. I need help. She is... everywhere. And yet nowhere! By all that is holy, I... just want her gone! Please...

<He lifts a shaky finger and points towards the forest.>

I don't want to... dance their dance, or join them in their... their... circles. Their dark circles, their deathly shade... Please! [urgent] To the southwest, near th... the town of Greyshire, where I last camped, that's where this all started! I left... I left my journal out there. Please inspect the campsite, get my journal, and bring it to the Pellars of Wolfswood. They... they must have some idea... I need help, I can't go on like this...
quest_40907_quest_progress: [soft voice] I see discouragement and concern on your face, <name>. [gentle] What ails you so?
quest_40907_quest_complete: [solemn] It has been many a moon since I heard the Widows take such a damning interest in a young man like this. [sad] A fate I do not envy. [solemn] We, the Pellars, faithfully serve the good folk of this land. [gentle] I will lend my knowledge if you will only listen.
quest_40908_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Widows of the Wood are a fickle lot, <name>. [soft voice] They hold a strong attachment to the woods. [hesitant] They are playful, yet spiteful. [whispering] They rejoice in scaring children, luring young men away to rest beneath the canopies they haunt, appearing in their dreams.

[urgent] I fear we have not much time to save young Aliattan if his journal is anything to go by. [solemn] They seek to break his will, and draw him into a maddening dance known as the black waltz. [low voice] They say the soul itself is wrenched from the body with each twirl and spin, before being devoured by the hungry Widows.

[commanding] Return to the campsite, <name>. [emphasis] You must light that which caused so much grief to begin with. [urgent] Draw them out of hiding, and dispose of them. [solemn] May the Wolf Serpent guard you, for a fate worse than death awaits you if you anger the Widows and fail in your efforts.
quest_40908_quest_complete: [hesitant] I... I haven't felt the chill of death in over an hour... I... I think it worked. [shocked] By all that is holy, I think it worked! [delight] Thank you so much! [proud] My life is my own once more.
quest_40910_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Sigil of Quickness is infused with the powers of speed. [soft voice] Upon using its energy, you will find yourself able to strike at a quicker pace.

[urgent] If you desire this sigil, I will require five Bright Dream Shards. [emphasis] I will also require a Fading Dream Fragment. [low voice] I cannot just give it away without proof of your deeds here in Hyjal.
quest_40910_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_40910_quest_complete: <Vaenar looks upon the Dream Shards, lost for a moment.> [gentle] You've done well, I am true to my word. [warm] Take this Sigil, and may its power prove useful to you.
quest_40911_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Sigil of Leeching is infused with darker powers. [soft voice] Upon using its energy, you will find yourself able to siphon the essence of your opponent.

[urgent] If you desire this sigil, I will require five Bright Dream Shards. [low voice] I will also require a Fading Dream Fragment. [hesitant] I cannot just give it away without proof of your deeds here in Hyjal.
quest_40911_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_40911_quest_complete: <Vaenar looks upon the Dream Shards, lost for a moment.> [gentle] You've done well, I am true to my word. [warm] Take this Sigil, and may its power prove useful to you.
quest_40912_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Sigil of Penetration is infused with powerful magics. [soft voice] Upon using its energy, you will find yourself able to pierce deeper into tough armor.

[urgent] If you desire this sigil, I will require five Bright Dream Shards. [commanding] I will also require a Fading Dream Fragment. [hesitant] I cannot just give it away without proof of your deeds here in Hyjal.
quest_40912_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_40912_quest_complete: <Vaenar looks upon the Dream Shards, lost for a moment.> [gentle] You've done well, [solemn] I am true to my word. [warm] Take this Sigil, and may its power prove useful to you.
quest_40924_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the siege of Ravenshire a group of thieves and brigands broke into my chambers and made away with most prized items of my family. One of which was the Signet of Silverlaine, once owned by my father and passed down to me.

[sad] I have received news that my family Signet was given as a token of honor to a well respected officer amongst the royalists named Osmark. He should be lording over the Dryrock Pit far to the west. [commanding] Look for where the grass ceases to grow, and find the massive pit full of industry.

Reclaim my birthright, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_40924_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not take your task lightly <class>, Dryrock Pit is one of their most vital operations in the region and it will be under heavy guard.
quest_40924_quest_complete:
<Baron Caliban Silverlaine looks at the signet with a smile gracing his features. Without a second word, the ring is slid upon his finger.> [solemn] You have done well, it is untarnished. [soft voice] It feels good to know this officer had his life claimed for such a crime.

[warm] I have prepared a reward for you, [warm] thanks again adventurer.
quest_40925_quest_detail:
[solemn] When this conflict is over, no matter who wins, I must be presentable as the nobility that my family is beholden. [soft voice] If I am to retain such a high standing, I require the finest silk that the land can offer.

[pause] The spiders of the Hollow Web Woods create a rare and hard to come by silk. [emphasis] I must have it so that I can commission a fine set of new garments for when this conflict inevitably comes to an end.

[urgent] You can find the Hollow Web Woods just to the west of here. [commanding] Gather me ten Hollow Web Silk and I shall make it worth your time, commoner.
quest_40925_quest_progress: [angry] I am not paying you to waste time you know.
quest_40925_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My, would you look at this. [delight] Such an intricate and complex silk.

It will surely be worth its cost when the creation of my new garments are complete.

[warm] Oh, yes I was to pay you, wasn't I? Take this silver, and move along, would you.
quest_40926_quest_detail:
[solemn] The land is tainted with the foul mark of worgen that tread through our lands unopposed. [angry] The royalists have seen fit to punish the people by letting their kind spread like a disease.

[urgent] Even now the worgen reach as far south as the Overgrown Acre just to the northwest of here. [commanding] If they will not put an end to this threat, then we must. [commanding] Find the Bloodclaw tribe that stalks within Gilneas, hunt them, and recover ten of their pelts.
quest_40926_quest_complete: [solemn] Your efforts will better the realm in time. [soft voice] The less worgen that stalk our forests, the faster we can return to a state of peace.
quest_40927_quest_detail:
[commanding] To stop the Bloodclaw, we must put an end to the alpha of their packs. [solemn] The strongest of the worgen themselves are known as 'alpha' and it is these creatures that command the rest of the smaller worgen.

[urgent] The Bloodclaw Alpha can be found within a cave to the northwest. [soft voice] Search for the worgen camp west of Northgate Tower. The cave should be just nearby.

[commanding] Slay thirteen of them, and return to me when the job is done.
quest_40927_quest_progress:
[commanding] Be prepared for the task ahead.

[urgent] I would advise to bring some assistance. [solemn] Assaulting a worgen den is no easy task.
quest_40927_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well <name>. [low voice] It will only be a matter of time before the Bloodclaw tears itself apart as they struggle to establish new chains of command.

[warm] Your duty to the people of Gilneas will not go unrewarded. [gentle] Please, take one of these items as a thanks for everything you have done.
quest_40928_quest_detail:
[solemn] The foulhide gnolls are growing to become a large problem for the region. [soft voice] Recently, they attacked and laid claim to Southmire Orchard, where a good friend of mine named Ernest met his end.

[sad] While I still grieve for his loss, I cannot stand idle. [urgent] The foulhide will soon move to find another target to enact their rampant desire to fight and the Shademore Tavern could be their next target.

[commanding] I ask of you to head to my friend's orchard to the southeast of here, and slay the gnolls that inhabit it. Bring me fourteen of their armbands as proof.
quest_40928_quest_complete:
[solemn] Fewer gnolls that prowl the countryside is better for any that call Gilneas home.

[warm] Thank you for your hard work <class>.
quest_40929_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am Elaroth Ranworth, and it is my charge to keep the fire of this lighthouse burning bright. Before the war, we relied on a steady supply of oil from Southshore.

[soft voice] Ever since the Greymane Wall was sealed shut, this lighthouse has been burning on what excess I could find. [pause] It is only a matter of time before the light will cease burning, and with it, I will vanish from this world.

[sad] I am not yet ready to depart, and so I am desperate. [solemn] Lordaeron has been consumed by the plague, but whispers tell me of a new bastion of human power, far away to the west.

[urgent] I ask of you to visit the city called Theramore, speak with their dockmaster, and see if there is any oil that can be given to me.
quest_40929_quest_complete: [low voice] Oil to Gilneas? [hesitant] Hasn't that place been sealed shut for years now?
quest_40930_quest_detail:
Huh, now that you mention it, we do have a supply of old oil that has been lingering around here for some years. [hesitant] I hate to tell you this, but it was taken when the deserters left the city and went to found their camp in the Quagmire.

I have no doubts their purposes for the highly flammable liquid are nefarious. That or they desire to make some coin off the valuable resource. [low voice] There ain't many active sources working these days.

[urgent] If you want the oil, you'll have to recover it from those deserters.
quest_40930_quest_complete: [solemn] Hmm, it has been some time since I last laid eyes on this drum, but I think this is it.
quest_40931_quest_detail: [solemn] Since you went to such lengths to recover this oil, I see no reason not to grant it to you for your return to Gilneas. [hesitant] Assuming you have a means to actually enter the place. I have heard rumors of a civil war brewing behind the great wall, so I suggest you be careful.
quest_40931_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, this is the oil from Theramore?
quest_40931_quest_complete:
[solemn] Relief. I can say with certainty that I now feel an emotion besides fear.

I was cursed long ago to forever tend to this fire. Should the flame ever extinguish, I would vanish forever from this world. I cannot properly describe the fear I feel about what would happen should the flame go out. Whilst I am bound to this spiritual form, I dare not think what comes after; it is the unknown that I truly dread.

I would give anything to suffer as I am now than to drift away forever, forgotten for all time.
quest_40932_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there, why I am lucky to have you stumble across me. [hesitant] I'm having a terrible time. [sad] Forced to abandon my family home, now this!

[urgent] The wheel on my wagon has broken and needs to be replaced, but I left the spare back at the plantation. [hesitant] You wouldn't mind doing me a favor, would you? [sad] I cannot return as worgen have taken over, but maybe you can.

[solemn] Head to the Rosewick Plantation just to the northwest of here, and bring me my spare wheel from my house.
quest_40932_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten my spare wheel?
quest_40932_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, this is splendid, now I will be able to make pace to Shademore Tavern!
quest_40933_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have one last thing to ask you. [pause] It will take me some time before I can get going again, but in the meantime I want you to make sure the worries of my wife are settled.

[soft voice] I sent her to Shademore Tavern before I departed with some of our most valuable posessions. [urgent] I want you to let her know that I am on the way, and I am safe. [commanding] You can find the Shademore Tavern by following this road, and heading west at the crossroad to Ravenshire.
quest_40933_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Donald sent you?

<A wave of relief washes over the woman, who sighs out a deep exhale.>

[delight] These words have brought me extreme relief. [solemn] I was prepared for the worst. [low voice] I told him to come with me, but he was stubborn to look after that plantation until things got unbearable.

[warm] Thanks for this news stranger, please, take this.
quest_40934_quest_detail:
[solemn] The foul taint of undeath is a most vile and terrifying thing. [soft voice] The land of Gilneas some years ago was invaded by a lich who scarred the land with his evil magic.

[pause] This is a tale similar to what befell my own lands. [hesitant] You see, the Scarlet Crusade is not an enemy, for we all serve the same purpose.

[commanding] I ask you to prove yourself as an agent against necromancy. [urgent] Travel to Greyshire, or what is left of it. [commanding] Slay the dead things that still walk there.
quest_40934_quest_complete: [solemn] So, it would appear that you are indeed not corrupted by the shadow.
quest_40935_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that I can trust you to not be an agent of undeath, I can reveal the true reason that I have sought neutral lands. [soft voice] The Crusade was once a noble organization of high integrity, but cracks have begun to show in the pillars of our most trusted leaders.

[pause] Deep within the Cathedral there are rumors spreading of the true fate of High Inquisitor Fairbanks. [whispering] I have good sources to believe his death was halted by... Unnatural means. [urgent] If it is true that necromancy has become common among the elite of the Crusade, I require proof.

[commanding] Find Inquisitor Fairbanks within the Scarlet Cathedral, and discover the truth.
quest_40935_quest_progress: [solemn] So, what is it you have uncovered within my homeland?
quest_40935_quest_complete:
[solemn] I cannot believe the words that I am hearing, such practices among the leaders of my people? Me and others have long been wary of such allegations, but to know it to be true...

[pause] I will have to convene with the others to decide our future. [warm] I thank you greatly. [warm] Please, take this, as thanks from myself and those that I represent.
quest_40936_quest_detail:
[solemn] We arrived in Gilneas with the hope of being free from conflict. [sad] However, we have only come to find hostility.

[emphasis] Three nights ago a worgen raid attacked our camp and made away with supplies most vital to us. [soft voice] However, these supplies were not taken by the pale Nighthowl, but instead the Bloodclaw. [solemn] They are another tribe in conflict with the Nighthowl, who have a camp to the south of us. [urgent] I have no doubt they have our supplies stashed amongst their hovels.

Recover the supplies, and return them to us.
quest_40936_quest_progress: [solemn] It is only a matter of time until our supplies are spoiled by the vile hands of the worgen who ran off with them.
quest_40936_quest_complete:
<Gethenor takes his time, going through the missing supplies.> That is a relief, it is all here. [hesitant] I was afraid our rare medical supplies and tinctures would have been destroyed in the rough transit to the camp.

[warm] I must thank you greatly for your work. [solemn] We have been heavily reliant on these supplies. [warm] Please, take this, as thanks from us here.
quest_40937_quest_detail:
[solemn] Night in and night out, we have been subjected to raids from the hostile Nighthowl. [angry] They are a ferocious and merciless foe that has tested our defences.

[urgent] We ask for your aid in dealing with this threat before they overwhelm us. [soft voice] The Nighthowl can be found lingering all over northern Gilneas, from Oldrock Pass to the Northgate Tower.

[commanding] Slay them, and bring me eleven of the shackles they wear around their wrists.
quest_40937_quest_progress: [solemn] Each moment wasted is another moment the Nighthowl bide their strength.
quest_40937_quest_complete:
[solemn] These shackles hold some sort of power channeled only by the worgen.

[warm] You have done well in thinning their numbers, but there is still more than we can combat.
quest_40938_quest_detail:
[solemn] To end the Nighthowl threat, we must target their leadership. The tribe of worgen are led by strong alpha who command their packs with extreme efficiency. Without the alpha, the Nighthowl would crumble into disarray.

[urgent] I am asking you to delve into the wolf's lair.

Oldrock Pass can be found to the west of here. It is a trail between Silverpine Forest and Gilneas that got breached some time ago. It is infested with the Nighthowl worgen, and it is there you will find their alpha.

[commanding] Slay them, and rid us of this threat.
quest_40938_quest_progress: [solemn] The Alpha are a cunning foe, [commanding] plot your moves and prepare for a challenge.
quest_40938_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have scattered the Nighthowl with this move. [soft voice] I suspect their attacks on us will cease as infighting begins to establish new leaders for their tribe.

[warm] You have done us a good favor <class>, and for that you shall be rewarded.
quest_40939_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many of the refugees here in the camp and at the Greymane Wall are starving. The threat of the worgen has been enough to deter most from foraging or hunting. [soft voice] I request you to aid in our situation and perhaps I can get a decent meal for everyone.

The Duskpelt wolves are hostile, but should supplement our current rations well. [urgent] You can find Duskpelt wolves all around Gilneas. [commanding] Bring me six chunks of their meat and it should last us for a time.
quest_40939_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck finding food for us adventurer?
quest_40939_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well, I am impressed. These fresh cuts of meat will surely go a long way in easing the rumbling of stomachs. [solemn] I will make sure this gets to our most desperate first.

[warm] Thanks again for what you've done, take this, as a token for keeping us alive just a bit longer.
quest_40940_quest_detail:
[solemn] A strange and foul magic lingers upon the air of Gilneas. [soft voice] I believe there is more going on behind the scenes than first meets the eye.

The Lord Prestor was well known for holding the ear of King Greymane and often influenced many of his decisions. [pause] When I met this Lord Prestor long ago, I was overwhelmed by the immense magical aura that emanated from him. [solemn] This same magic I can sense within Gilneas, but from where, I cannot be sure.

[urgent] To discover the source, I require an item of some rarity: a Font of Arcana that is often wielded by Blue Dragonkin. The nearest of their brood resides within the Badlands, in a place named the Crystalline Oasis.
quest_40940_quest_complete:
[solemn] Every time I interact with draconic magic, I am awed by the sheer power it possesses.

[soft voice] Truly, we mortals cannot hope to compare to the power of our draconic rivals.
quest_40941_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done well in acquiring this Font of Arcana. [soft voice] However, before we can proceed, I need materials of a magical nature. [low voice] The Font of Arcana cannot be wielded naturally without draconic magic, and therefore, I must channel enchanting materials with my own magic to power the Font.

[urgent] Bring me a Large Glowing Shard, which is a common Enchanting material, and we can continue our work.
quest_40941_quest_progress: [solemn] The Arcane Font pocesses great power that cannot be wielded by magic alone.
quest_40941_quest_complete: [solemn] Now then, let us see what the Font of Arcana can expose as truth.
quest_40942_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have taken time to familiarize myself with the Font. [soft voice] I have come to the realization that the lingering magic is indeed coming from Gilneas City. [low voice] In order to discover what type of magic, I require one last material in order to make it fully operational. [hesitant] I have my theories and suspicions based off the font itself that this could be draconic magic, and if so, perhaps Lord Prestor was indeed one taking humanoid form.

[urgent] To fully know if this is the truth, I require you to travel to Dustwallow Marsh where the Black Dragonflight calls home. [commanding] From the Firemane that linger at Dragonmurk in southern Dustwallow Marsh, recover a 'Potent Draconic Jewel'. It is often carried by their kind.
quest_40942_quest_progress: [solemn] Once this Draconic Jewel is recovered, I can ascertain the true magic.
quest_40942_quest_complete:
<Magus Orelius takes a moment, channeling the energy of the Potent Draconic Jewel with the Font of Arcana. Within time, he would let out a loud and heavy sigh.> [solemn] It's as I had feared, my theories are proven correct. [solemn] Lord Prestor may perhaps have been a dragon in disguise all along. [solemn] I am certain those who have come to replace him are aswell.

[solemn] The Harlow's are a noble family which rose to prominence around the time Prestor had arrived in Gilneas, and it is that same group that lords over the city itself. [solemn] Lady Celia and Lord Mortimer are Regents of King Greymane, and act on his behalf.

[solemn] The grip of the Black Dragonflight is deep within Gilneas, and it would appear they have long been working to bring this feud about. [solemn] The death of innocents, and the corruption of this land is all on their hands. [urgent] They must be stopped.
quest_40943_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one course of action to save Gilneas. [angry] The Harlow family cannot be allowed to emerge from this civil war unscathed. [low voice] The Regent-Lady Celia Harlow, and Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow are Dragonkin of the Black Dragonflight. [solemn] They have long corrupted Gilneas and turned it into a land of decay and conflict.

[urgent] We must put an end to the suffering of the land, slay both of them, and rid this place of their evil machinations.
quest_40943_quest_complete:
[solemn] The people will not know of your work here today, but their suffering will end. [solemn] The draconic influence over Gilneas has been put to rest.

[soft voice] It is only a matter of time until the land is restored to what it was some years ago, and this is in part thanks to your efforts here today. [warm] I have convened with the other members of the Kirin Tor, and your work to banish the foul draconic magic will not go unrewarded.

[warm] Please, take one of these items, as a gesture of our appreciation.
quest_40944_quest_detail:
Hail <class>. [solemn] I am Councilor Ravencrest, a noble in service to the rebellion of Lord Ravenwood.

[soft voice] You have come to Gilneas in a time of strife and civil conflict. [low voice] Even now the Greymane royalists are no doubt preparing for the coming conflict within the walls of the city itself.

[pause] If you desire to learn more, or help us break free from the shackles of tyranny, I would guide your attention to Ravenshire to the southeast. [commanding] Simply follow the road and take a left at the fork. [urgent] Keep following it southward until you reach the town. [emphasis] When you have arrived, speak with Clerk Ebonmere.
quest_40944_quest_complete: [solemn] An outsider has come? [soft voice] It would appear the opening of the Greymane Wall has indeed brought new allies.
quest_40945_quest_detail:
[solemn] I once served as a knight of Gilneas. During my service I saw many things that wavered my loyalties. But it was not until the death of my wife that I forever saw the truth.

The loyalists allowed the incursion of the worgen to punish the innocents outside the city. My wife met her end to a creature named Snarlclaw, and I was forbidden from carrying out my revenge. Now I remain here, to drink away my sorrows.

[angry] Slay the beast Snarlclaw, and do what those royalists could never stomach. You will find this beast to the northeast, hiding amongst the caves with the Bloodclaw worgen.
quest_40945_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I was expecting to feel some sort of relief, but in truth I don't feel much of anything. [solemn] You have done me a great service, and for that I am in your thanks.

[hesitant] Perhaps soon I will find solace from the dark days ahead. [warm] Please, take this, I shall not be needing it any longer.
quest_40946_quest_detail:
[hesitant] What, you want to help us?

<A snide look crosses Vorren's face.>

If you want to really do something here at Ravenshire, you can get rid of those naga lot that have been gathering at the southern beaches. Ever since last year, they started showing up in droves. Killed a good many fishermen they have!

[angry] Bring me sixteen of their scales as proof. You can find them all along the coastlines of southern Gilneas. Do that, and you'll bring me some peace in this bastard world.
quest_40946_quest_progress: [angry] You better not be bothering me.
quest_40946_quest_complete: [commanding] So, you do have a backbone, do ye? [urgent] You may have thinned their ranks, but there is still more to do.
quest_40947_quest_detail:
[commanding] You didn't think it was going to be that easy, did you? [angry] Those Spitecrest naga are a stubborn and vile kind. [solemn] They are led by a Lord and Mistress both, each commanding two prongs of a forked trident assaulting Gilneas herself.

[urgent] Find and slay the Lord and Mistress of the naga and you shall end this tyranny threatening our coasts. [confident] I have no doubt you will find them amongst their slithering kin on the southern beaches.
quest_40947_quest_progress: [angry] You better not be bothering me.
quest_40947_quest_complete:
Huh, you've done it? [excited] Well why didn't you say that <class>! [warm] You've done and gone real heroes work out here, and in Gilneas that is a rarity.

[soft voice] Here, as a token of my thanks and from all of us that work down here, take this. [pause] It might serve you better than it would myself.
quest_40948_quest_detail:
[solemn] Tell me: what is the essence of a nation, the heart of a country, the will of a people? Is it the lands themselves? The rule of law? The economy? No, undoubtedly, it's none of these things. The essence of a nation is found in its tradition, history, legacy, determination, willpower.

[emphasis] We must steel ourselves for the worst, as the entirety of our people wishes to free our king and place him on the throne once more, But what happens if he is not capable of doing so? [sad] After the death of the queen, Genn thought it best to send his children away. We only heard about it months later, but it seems that both Liam and Tess are now prisoners of the Harlows.

We believe Liam is captive in the Dryrock Mine deep under Gilneas City to the west. He is the heir of this country, and so he must bleed with his people in order to liberate it.
quest_40948_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have not been forgotten, it seems.

[soft voice] To you I say: well met, one from beyond the wall. [hesitant] I have imagined this encounter several times in my head only to be at a loss for words now. [pause] You are here to free me, no?
quest_40949_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's ironic. I was about to say that I haven't been able to see the sun in so long, yet I grinned realising I have yet to see an actual Sunrise in Gilneas anyway, with all its fog and rain.

[urgent] I must be free of these chains. [angry] That harlot, Celia, convinced Father to send us away to Kul Tiras only to bind Tess and I, hiding us away from the world! [sad] I helped Tess escape, but they tossed me into this place.

[commanding] Aid me, so that I may find my way towards my people, and so I may help them against the scum that took over my city and poisoned the mind of my father.

[low voice] Guard Captain Marson, that's the name of the brute that holds the key to my freedom. [soft voice] You should be able to find him around here. [pause] Perhaps lingering outside in the fresh air.
quest_40949_quest_progress: [urgent] I wish we had the time to spare a few more words but we really must hurry.
quest_40949_quest_complete:
[solemn] He did not deserve the mercy of a quick death.

<Liam chuckles.>

[soft voice] Perhaps the weeks spent in this hole are making me question my integrity as a follower of the Light. [sad] I have brought shame to my teacher.
quest_40950_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have my thanks. While it would be best for us to return to Ravenshire and report to Darius, I must have you do something else. [solemn] You must follow my sister's footsteps.

Before she managed to escape, she spoke of Mother's stories, though they were nothing more than fairy tales. [sad] Alas, it seems that Tess was strongly convinced of the Wolf-Serpent and its followers named the Pellars. [solemn] She left for the middle of the land, in search of a legend, which is why you must do the same. [urgent] Find my sister and deliver her safely to Ravenshire.

[solemn] We shall meet there once more, since lingering here is the last thing on my mind.

[solemn] Go with the Light, friend, may it shine brightest when you most need it.
quest_40950_quest_complete: [solemn] A foreigner, here of all places. [soft voice] Liam sent you? [pause] Ah, then my brother is safe. [warm] We were just about to go save him.
quest_40951_quest_detail:
I will remain here with the Pellars. Demetreus has acknowledged my will to learn, and I am prepared to learn their ways before the final battle. As much as possible, that is. There will be a final battle <name>, you know. Mark my words, it has been foreseen. With them at our side, we are sure to hold an advantage, even though Demetreus is sure I will play little part in taking down the evil that has corrupted this land.

If anything he believes that YOU, <name>, will play a deciding role in this. They speak in riddles and are very vague, but they are dependable. Find my brother in the town of Ravenshire to the southeast and let him be worry-free.

Tell him this: the mane grows grey with wisdom when the long dark sets. He will know what it means.
quest_40951_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My little sister... a gift from the Light.

<Liam chuckles and nods.>

[solemn] May we find wisdom in our own actions then?
quest_40952_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were searching for Tess, I was trying to make my way back to Ravenshire. I dealt with some traitors that sold our country to the Harlows, first, though. With the Light at my side, I wished to rest among the dead and pay my respects to Mother's grave.

As I reached the crypt, I saw a rugged, unfamiliar face. One that showed only aggression to me. Growling like an animal. To say the least, I was not well received, yet they've offered me shelter. They are a strange bunch, led by a stoic, violent lady. Her name is Moranna, she is leading a group of four, and they claim to be a cult that researches immortality. I figure that she might be of aid to us. Reach her at the Hollow Web Cemetery to the west.
quest_40952_quest_complete: [soft voice] So, it was the prince that visited us on his way to Ravenshire? [hesitant] I didn't take him for royalty.
quest_40953_quest_detail:
[solemn] It's clear to me that Prince Greymane seeks aid from my research group. [soft voice] I am afraid he must've misunderstood us, however, as we do not intend to reach immortality. Rather, we seek power and healthiness beyond what the human body is capable of. [pause] I assume you've already figured out our little secret. If not, let me put this as bluntly as possible: we have accepted the worgen curse.

[commanding] We are more than willing to aid Liam in reclaiming his city and his lands; our alchemical knowledge, our teeth, and our latent power are all at his disposal.

[urgent] We have yet to have full control of our abilities, but I think I have discovered a way to aid in that regard. [commanding] Travel northwest to the Dryrock Valley and kill as many of the traitorous ones as possible. [emphasis] Drain their blood and bring it back to me. [solemn] It will play an important part in our research.
quest_40953_quest_progress: [solemn] You cannot even begin to understand how much power resides in the blood.
quest_40953_quest_complete: [soft voice] I was skeptical of your aid, but it seems that I have doubted you for naught. [warm] Well done.
quest_40954_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Perhaps the Prince will feel he has gained more than he bargained for. [solemn] I have seen a fire in his eyes, one that you should remind him of.

[commanding] In dire times, you must not be half-hearted about your actions. [solemn] There is no greater evil than that which hurts those you care for.

[urgent] Report back to your Prince, and assure him that my loyalty is towards the common folk of the land.
quest_40954_quest_complete: [solemn] Darius is a strongheaded man. [soft voice] He will understand the necessity of this alliance.
quest_40955_quest_detail:
[solemn] The threat of Freyshear Keep is a constant pressure upon us here in Ravenshire. It holds great strategical importance, and can deny all of our incoming shipments into the town.

[urgent] For us to take a final stand against the city, we need this place destroyed! [emphasis] To the north, a bridge crosses onto the island where Freyshear Keep is located. Go there, and slay the defenders along with Cannoneer Rileson, the one who commands their large guns.

When this task is complete, give the news to Lord Ravenwood. [commanding] He will oversee our final operation.
quest_40955_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your actions have severely weakened the abilities of the Greymane in the eastern parts of the region. [warm] I must give my thanks for your work.

[urgent] Now we can focus our attentions on the final matters.
quest_40956_quest_detail:
[commanding] The entirety of Gilneas stands at our side! [angry] The tyranny of the royalists can no longer be allowed to stand! [urgent] If this nation is to ever recover from the darkness, then we must hold fast, and strike even faster still!

[solemn] The Greymane Crown must be recovered if our dream is ever to be realized. [commanding] Enter Gilneas City. [urgent] Fight your way through his most loyal soldiers. [angry] End the Harlows, and reclaim the Greymane birthright. [warm] A new king and a new beginning awaits us, <name>.
quest_40956_quest_progress: [solemn] Be brave adventurer, the city itself has struggled through civil strife as we have.
quest_40956_quest_complete: [solemn] The end of an era is upon us. [warm] A darkness has been lifted on this day, and with it, a new hope emerges from the clouds. [soft voice] A ray of light for all to see. [proud] Liam Greymane shall be named king and his reign shall bring prosperity to the people who have suffered for so long! <His eyes shine with hope, for perhaps the first time in a generation.>
quest_40959_quest_complete:
