[threatening] What do you want, mortal? [threatening] What brought you to this forsaken place?

[soft voice] Wait... I sense an aura of the Dream from you.
quest_40960_quest_detail:
<Itharius listens attentively to your account, his eyes filled with wisdom and compassion.> I understand. [solemn] Though Ralathius may have acted impulsively, his intentions were noble. He lacks full comprehension of the unfolding events and his destined role within them.

[soft voice] As I have remained vigilant here, witnessing the corruption of my brethren by the insidious Nightmare, my heart aches to learn of Solnius's unfortunate fate. [sad] Such a tragedy befalls us all.

[solemn] I am on the precipice of unraveling the enigma that shrouds the Nightmare, seeking the means to vanquish it once and for all. [confident] Perhaps, in your valiant quest, you shall unearth a vital piece of knowledge that will empower us to triumph. [warm] Take this Command, bearing my blessing, to Ralathius. [commanding voice] He shall grant you passage into the Dream, as decreed by my authority.
quest_40964_quest_detail:
[urgent] Did you hear the news? The Greymane Wall, once an impenetrable barrier, now stands open. Granting us access to our long-lost homeland!

[excited] The call to action has been sounded, and a ship laden with our brave soldiers has set sail for Gilneas. By now, they should have reached the port town of Ravenshire, the very heart of the rebellion against the oppressive regime. [commanding] Together, under the banner of the Ravenwood Rebellion, we shall liberate Gilneas from the shackles of unjust rule!

[solemn] In this critical juncture, we seek any assistance that can be mustered. [urgent] Make your way to Ravenshire without delay. Once you arrive, seek out Sergeant Arbington.
quest_40964_quest_progress: [solemn] A new face. [warm] Welcome to Gilneas.
quest_40964_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, so Danmere has sent you our way, eh? [commanding] Well, as you can clearly observe, the situation here is far from ideal. [urgent] We are in dire need of assistance, and any help you can offer will be greatly appreciated. [solemn] Welcome to the frontlines of the struggle.

[pause] In order to get properly acquainted with our operations, I suggest introducing yourself to two key figures in our ranks. [warm] Darius Ravenwood and Caliban Silverlaine are the stalwart leaders orchestrating our resistance against the Harlow forces. [low voice] You will typically find them at the town hall, tirelessly strategizing and planning our next moves. [commanding] Waste no time in seeking them out and informing them of your arrival. [proud] They will undoubtedly appreciate your presence and may have specific tasks or assignments to entrust you with.
quest_40965_quest_detail:
I've led a rugged existence in these parts. [solemn] Life here ain't always been gentle, but it's been plain and straightforward. [soft voice] My duty has been to provide sustenance for my kinfolk and the folks in town, tracking down the savage creatures that roam these woods.

[pause] A lot has changed since the rebellion. [urgent] Now, it falls upon my weary shoulders to not only keep my own family fed but also help supply an entire army! [low voice] It's a burden fit for no ordinary man like myself. [hesitant] I reckon, stranger, could you lend me a hand in this dire situation?

[commanding] Venture deep into the heart of the forest and set your sights on the batlike creatures known as Vilewings. [emphasis] Don't bother with the young ones, their flesh is all stringy and full of veins. [sad] It's the greater beasts we're after. [urgent] Hunt them down and bring me back no less than nine hefty chunks of their meat. [solemn] That'll be the key to keepin' bellies full and spirits high in these troubled times.
quest_40965_quest_progress: [soft voice] Ah, the thrill of the hunt.
quest_40965_quest_complete: [excited] Well, ain't you a sight for sore eyes, stranger! [warm] You've done some mighty fine work for our cause, and I reckon we owe you a debt of gratitude.
quest_40966_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greymane, or rather, Harlow, has persistently launched assaults upon Ravenshire, yet to no avail. [solemn] Our valiant soldiers have repelled their attacks time and time again, displaying unwavering courage. [urgent] However, in one of their audacious night assaults, the enemy managed to breach the defenses of our city hall and abscond with the Deed to Ravenshire.

[soft voice] While this parchment holds little personal value for me, it carries great significance to the common folk as a symbol of my rightful rule. [commanding] For order to be restored in Gilneas, I must retrieve it without delay.

[solemn] Undoubtedly, the enemy forces have brought it back to Gilneas City itself. [hesitant] However, as to its current whereabouts, one can only speculate.
quest_40966_quest_progress: [solemn] The Deed to Ravenshire must be reclaimed.
quest_40966_quest_complete:
[solemn] I commend your stellar work. [commanding] With the Deed once again safely back in my possession, any troublemakers who dare challenge my rule shall be forced to reconsider their actions. [solemn] The return of this document serves as a powerful deterrent, casting doubt upon the audacity of those who would question our authority.

[warm] Though the path ahead may be arduous, we shall not waver in our commitment to rebuilding Gilneas. [proud] We have a long and challenging journey before us, but with each passing day, we will labor tirelessly to restore our beloved homeland to its rightful place of glory and splendor.
quest_40967_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the wake of the rebellion's inception, my home, Ravenwood Keep, became the target of an assault by the forces under the command of the Harlows. [sad] Our defenders fought with unwavering valor, but we found ourselves outmatched. [whispering] It seemed that the Harlows had delved into dark magicks to bolster their armies.

[pause] Though some of our forces managed to escape the onslaught, the majority fell victim to the blades of our adversaries. [sad] Even my loyal servants were not spared from the carnage. [sad] Among the casualties were two of my dearest friends, Gately and Mathias.

[solemn] Now, as the dust settles, a haunting presence looms within the very walls that once provided solace and protection. [soft voice] The restless spirits of Gately and Mathias wander aimlessly, their once noble hearts consumed by bitterness. [solemn] No longer able to distinguish friend from foe, they wreak havoc upon any who dare to cross their path.

[commanding] Lay these tormented souls to rest, so that they may find peace in the embrace of the eternal slumber.
quest_40967_quest_complete: <Darius Ravenwood sighs with relief.> [solemn] The knowledge that my soldiers and servants no longer wander this world, tormented by the dark magic of the Harlows, brings me great peace. [warm] In their name, I express my deepest gratitude. [gentle] Please, accept this token as a symbol of my appreciation as well as theirs.
quest_40968_quest_detail:
[solemn] Indeed, it is a momentous occasion. [solemn] The Greymane Wall has finally been breached.

[soft voice] During their long years of isolation, the Gilnean throne has fallen into the hands of a pair of Alteraci nobles - Harlows. [low voice] They harbor open hostility towards the Alliance, making it crucial for us to support the rebellion that has taken root within Gilneas. [soft voice] They call themselves the Ravenwood Rebellion, and it is through their efforts that the gates of Gilneas have been opened once more. [solemn] Their leader has reached out to the Alliance, beseeching us for aid.

[urgent] I have received orders from Lord Fordragon himself to deploy any able-bodied soldiers to lend assistance to the Ravenwood Rebellion in their struggle for the liberation of Gilneas. [commanding] Travel westward, through Silverpine until you reach the Greymane Wall. [soft voice] Beyond it, nestled along the coastline, you will find the town of Ravenshire.

[urgent] Once you arrive, seek out Lord Ravenwood. [commanding] Assure him that the Alliance stands unwavering in its commitment to its allies.
quest_40968_quest_progress: [hesitant] I haven't seen you here before.
quest_40968_quest_complete:
[solemn] So the promised aid finally arrives.

Genn Greymane's profound lack of trust in the Alliance was undoubtedly one of his gravest misjudgments. Though I can appreciate his reasoning behind such a decision, I could never fully endorse it. However, that is all in the past now, and dwelling on it serves no purpose.

[warm] I extend my warmest welcome to you and the formidable might of the Alliance. [proud] Ravenshire may be a modest town, but it holds the flame of resilience and hope that will ignite the rekindling of our beloved Gilneas. [solemn] In due time, we shall extend our hospitality and invite you to partake in a grand feast within the walls of Gilneas City itself. [urgent] But before we can revel in such festivities, there is much work to be done.
quest_40969_quest_detail:
[solemn] Working with sturdy Gilnean ore is no small feat, let me tell ya. [sad] But there were times when I yearned for something more exotic, especially when the Greymane Walls closed shut. [sigh] Oh, the longing I felt!

[warm] But now fate has smiled upon me. [excited] Finally, I've been given a chance to once again lay my skilled hands on those rare ores. [soft voice] There's one ore in particular that holds a special place in my heart, Crystalvein. [soft voice] Back in the days of my apprenticeship, I had the honor of working with it. [warm] It was a beauty, I tell ya—strong, durable, and a joy to forge. [warm] Having that ore by our side would be a true blessing for the rebellion.

[sad] Sadly, Crystalvein is a treasure found only in the distant lands of Stranglethorn. [urgent] If, by some stroke of luck, you happen to set foot in Booty Bay, seek out a goblin by the name of Crank. [soft voice] He used to be my go-to supplier for that precious ore. [soft voice] Tell him I sent ya, and maybe, just maybe, he'll be able to hook you up with some Crystalvein once again.
quest_40969_quest_complete: [excited] So the rumors are true. [warm] Gilneas is once again open for business.
quest_40970_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, Todd, good ol' blacksmith, that one. He sure had a knack for working with those metals. I'll give him that. But here's the thing, I can't exactly fulfill his request for that ore he's after. It's a bit of a sticky situation, ya see.

The mine he's talkin' about, the Crystalvein Mine, got itself overrun by those pesky basilisks. [angry] Nasty creatures, they are. Just one gaze from 'em, and poof, you're a crystal! So, understandably, we goblins have been keepin' our distance.

But hey, if you're feelin' either foolish or brave, and you're up for clearin' out the basilisks from that cave, well, we might just have ourselves a deal. You do the dirty work, and any ore you find there is yours to keep. Fair and square. Mind ya, it's gotta fit in your backpack, though. Can't have ya luggin' around mountains of the stuff.

So, what do ya say, adventurer? [urgent] You up for the challenge? If so, head northeast from here, and you'll find the Crystalvein Mine.
quest_40970_quest_progress: [urgent] Well, I told you already. [commanding] You need to clear the mine.
quest_40970_quest_complete:
Whoa there, pal! I gotta say, I didn't expect you to make it outta there in one piece. You're a real survivor, I'll give ya that! So, you're tellin' me the mine's clear of them nasty basilisks? Well, ain't that splendid news! I'll have a mining team dispatched there pronto!

Now, about that ore you managed to snag, I'll need ya to hand it over. Don't worry, I'll package it all up real nice and attach a fancy note for Todd. Long time no see, right? I'm sure he'll be thrilled to get a package from me.
quest_40971_quest_detail:
[excited] Alright, my pal, here's the package you've been waiting for. [soft voice] Crystalvein, all neatly packaged and ready for delivery. [urgent] Take good care of it now, ya hear?

[pause] Now, when you see Todd, pass along my message. [commanding] Tell him to swing by once he's done with all this Rebellion business and whatnot. [warm] We'll have a good ol' chat and catch up on things. [soft voice] Wish him the best of luck from me, will ya?

[pause] As for me. Well, I have got business to attend to. [confident] There's money to be made and deals to be struck.
quest_40971_quest_complete:
[excited] I can hardly believe my own eyes! Crystalvein ore, just as I remembered it. [warm] This is a treasure indeed. [confident] I can already envision the magnificent weapons I'll forge from this exquisite batch.

[urgent] Larry! Fire up the forge, lad! [proud] It's time to showcase the true artistry that can be achieved with these precious ores. [confident] We shall create masterpieces that will leave tongues wagging in awe and envy.

[gentle] Oh, where are my manners? [soft voice] I apologize. [warm] Allow me to express my profound gratitude for your efforts. Here, accept this piece as a token of my appreciation. [proud] It's one of my finest works, crafted with the utmost care and skill. [warm] May it serve you well, my friend, as a testament to our collaboration.

[urgent] Now, let's get to work, shall we?
quest_40972_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to the remnants of Gilneas.

What lies before your eyes may not match the grandeur and splendor you envisioned. [soft voice] This once-mighty bastion of human power now stands as a testament to the relentless march of time and the ravages of war. [low voice] We, too, have succumbed to the fate that has befallen much of the world.

[pause] Take a moment and lend an ear to the tale of an old knight.
quest_40972_quest_progress: [solemn] The situation in Gilneas is dire.
quest_40972_quest_complete: [solemn] So now you know. [soft voice] I left many details out, but there's no time for chatting. [urgent] We must act now, with the newfound strength of our allies.
quest_40973_quest_progress:
[solemn] We must all do our part here in Hyjal, and my part is to harmonize Small Dream Shards into Bright Dream Shards. The harmonization process makes the shards much more potent in regards to their magical properties. If you require a large amount of Bright Dream Shards, simply let me know.

I will require fifteen in order to create five Bright Dream Shards. Small Dream Shard(15)
quest_40973_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work, the harmonization process does not take me long, especially with all this practice, if you find any more, come and let me know.
quest_40974_quest_detail:
[solemn] In life I was a soldier, loyal to the Greymane cause. I participated in the battle of Greyshire and basked in the great victory over the scourge.

[sad] Whilst I considered myself a great warrior, I was ambushed by a great beast with my fellow comrades. The large worgen tore us apart, and though I fought back, I was felled.

[low voice] Now I am here, to toil in the ceaseless memories of my failures. [angry] I want revenge upon that worgen. It goes by the name Snarlclaw. [solemn] He is known to lurk deep within a cave to the west of here near the Bloodclaw camp.

[urgent] Bring me his paw, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_40974_quest_complete: <Dominic Larson has a smirk resting upon his face.> [solemn] Well done. I must commend you for your efforts. [soft voice] You've defeated the beast that has cursed me with eternal undeath. [warm] Take one of these, as a token of my gratitude.
quest_40976_quest_detail:
[low voice] The worgen of Gilneas are surprisingly well organized for a bunch of beasts. [commanding] Their packs have caused us quite a lot of headache in spreading our influence.

[urgent] I am in need of someone who can sever the chain of command. [solemn] An aimless group of worgen will serve us much better in the end. [commanding] Travel west and search for the cavern where the Bloodclaw alpha call home. [threatening] Slay them so that their packs cannot organize against us.
quest_40976_quest_progress:
[low voice] I advise you to carry yourself with caution.

[threatening] Your foe is not as weak as you may think.
quest_40976_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, with the alphas scattered there will be struggles for dominance. Whatever comes of that is not our concern, however. We have already removed the head of the beast.

[warm] Your efforts to serve the Dark Lady will not go unnoticed. [proud] Take this as a commendation for your work.
quest_40977_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you there.

You know anything about bat extermination? [sad] These past few weeks have been hell. [sad] All of my efforts to drive away these bats have ended in disappointment. [soft voice] Perhaps you can do me a solid and rid me of their annoyance.

[solemn] If I am to restore the Ebonmere farm they need to go, and for good. [commanding] Thin their population, and kill twelve of them, return to me when the task is done.
quest_40977_quest_progress: [low voice] So, has the work been done?
quest_40977_quest_complete: I feel like I can breathe again. [soft voice] These blasted vermin roam the forests in droves, at least now there are less of them about.
quest_40978_quest_detail:
[solemn] The worgen in Gilneas entered shortly after the Greymane wall was destroyed in Oldrock Pass. [soft voice] You see, a powerful lich invaded the land and destroyed Greyshire some time ago. [urgent] Now the forests themselves are packed full of the beasts, threatening to overtake my farm at any minute.

[commanding] I need you to collect their pelts and prevent any future attacks. [emphasis] Six pelts from the Bloodclaw and Nighthowl worgen should suffice. [soft voice] You can find these packs to the west and southwest.
quest_40978_quest_progress: [whispering] Watch yourself during the night. [soft voice] Dark things are always lingering.
quest_40978_quest_complete:
[solemn] The worgen, defeated?

<A wiry smirk crosses his features.>

[warm] You have done well, outsider.
quest_40979_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now that you've proven yourself to me as a valuable ally, I have more pressing matters that I need looked into.

[soft voice] You see, three weeks ago my farm was robbed. [angry] A swindling rogue named Dustivan Blackcowl was employed to take the deed of Ebonmere Farm itself!

[threatening] He is a lackey to Greymane and serves like an obedient dog. [commanding] I want his hand for this treachery, and I want my family deed recovered. [warm] Do this for me and I will see you rewarded justly.

[confident] I have no doubt you will find this rogue deep within the bowels of Gilneas City itself.
quest_40979_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, what news do you have?
quest_40979_quest_complete:
[solemn] You've brought me peace, something I have been longing to have.

[soft voice] With this deed I can continue as I always have. [warm] I have prepared some rewards for you as thanks for returning my property.
quest_40980_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother Franklin Blackheart may have been living, but he was my brother. He took up the cause to fight with the Ravenwood rebellion. It is here he met his fate, ambushed by the Greymane. Not a single person was spared, and the entire camp was burned to the ground.

[sad] Seeing his twisted remains hurt me in a way nothing else has. I can feel it deep within, the sadness of his demise lingers still. [angry] I want retribution on those that have done this, slay the Greymane that inhabit Gilneas. [urgent] They can be found to the east, just north of Ravenshire, or to the west of here, in a place called Dryrock Valley.

[commanding] Bring me forty Greymane Signets from any who would swear allegiance to their cause.
quest_40980_quest_progress: [solemn] So, you've returned, have you dealt justice to those that murdered my brother?
quest_40980_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ahh, is this what revenge feels like?

[sad] I must admit, I only feel an emptiness. [low voice] The true killer is still out there, and must be found.
quest_40981_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have heard rumors from the Deathstalkers that the ambush was facilitated by Captain Veller stationed at Freyshear Keep. If this information is true, then this man was the murderer of my brother.

[sad] A very valuable piece of jewelry was taken from Franklin's corpse; the Blackheart Necklace. [angry] I have no doubt in my mind that this pompous man has taken the necklace.

[low voice] Freyshear Keep can be found far to the east, isolated on an island that looms overtop of Ravenshire. [commanding] Kill him, and recover the necklace.
quest_40981_quest_complete: <Harrison Blackheart takes the jewelry with soft hands, taking a moment to admire the beauty.> [solemn] I must thank you for recovering this. [warm] It certainly does mean a lot to me.
quest_40982_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have one last request from you. I figure you should do the honors, since you have recovered this necklace after all.

[soft voice] Place it upon the grave of Franklin, we can honor him in this way at least.
quest_40982_quest_complete:
<With a nod of approval Harrison seems content.> [soft voice] You've done a lot for me, and I am certainly grateful. [solemn] I am sure Franklin is as well.

<A heavy chuckle escapes Harrison.>

[warm] Take one of these, as tribute from us.
quest_40983_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am bound to hold the demons at bay, and such duties compel me to remain here. [soft voice] The lack of word from Nordanaar is worrying, but I suspect the growing demonic presence may be what is causing delays.

[urgent] I must ask you to deliver my report to Nordanaar at the very top of the summit. Follow the road until you reach the town. Find Arch Druid Dreamwind, and give him this letter.
quest_40983_quest_progress: [soft voice] How may I assist you outsider?
quest_40983_quest_complete: [solemn] Hmm, so the demonic presence at Darkwhisper Gorge is as I feared. [soft voice] It may only be a matter of time until they figure out a way past our barriers.
quest_40984_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have been charged with the duty to reactivate the Runestone of Cenarius. [soft voice] The magical energies that once ran through this stone were linked with the Runestone of Nordrassil, allowing transporation between here and Nordanaar.

[hesitant] However, a foreign magic is interfering with this process. [pause] I require materials in order to ascertain what is exactly happening.

[commanding] From the Barkskin Furbolg gather five Barkskin Spirit Beads, from the Misthoof gather three of their antlers, and finally, I require a single Shimmering Ooze from the sludge like creatures that inhabit the region.
quest_40984_quest_complete: [warm] You have done well, I have already begun to prepare for the ritual.
quest_40985_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have prepared the ritual. Using the materials you have collected I should be able to uncover the magic that is lingering upon the Runestone.

[soft voice] Give me some time, and speak to me when I am done.
quest_40985_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have uncovered the source of this magic. [sad] Satyrs have tainted the Runestone, and placed a curse upon it. <Buthok Cloudhorn lets out a sigh.>

[low voice] This will take some considerable effort to fix.
quest_40986_quest_detail:
[solemn] Undoing a powerful satyr curse is not something that can be easily done, especially not with any magic that we here possess. [soft voice] We will need to create a satyr relic named the Clutch of Atherelex. Each satyr tribe holds a specific rod. Should a specific curse need to be undone all of the rods must be attached together in unison in order to channel a specific magic to remove the curse.

[emphasis] To create the Clutch of Atherelex we require the Rod of 'Ath, from the Vilemusk satyrs in Hyjal. The Rod of 'Ere from the Legashi satyrs in Azshara. Finally, the Rod of 'Lex from the Jadefire satyrs.
quest_40986_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you recovered what is required?
quest_40986_quest_complete: <Buthok Cloudhorn lets out a sigh of relief.> [solemn] I feared that you would not return. [warm] I am happy my worries have not come true.
quest_40987_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Clutch of Atherelex is reliant on elemental magic, drawing power from potent natural energies. [soft voice] To access the magic that we so desire, we must acquire a Imbued Stone.

[urgent] Powerful, and enraged elementals of stone are known to hold such items.

[solemn] On the island of Tel'Abim to the east of Tanaris can be found Agitated Rock Elementals. [commanding] Travel there, and acquire an Imbued Stone from them.
quest_40987_quest_complete: [solemn] This Imbued Stone holds considerable power, despite looking like an ordinary rock.
quest_40988_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have tried my hand at lifting the curse with the required items, but it would appear there is still something wrong.

[soft voice] After a careful studying of the Runestone I have come to the conclusion that a chunk of it has been removed. [low voice] I have my guesses, but I believe a satyr named Xalthix is in control of this chunk. [urgent] With it, he can keep this curse active indefinitely.

[commanding] Find Xalthix, and from him, recover the Runestone Chunk.
quest_40988_quest_complete: <Buthok Cloudhorn inserts the Runestone Chunk back into place.> [warm] You have done well, better than I ever had expected.
quest_40989_quest_detail: [solemn] With everything in place, the power of the Runestone will soon be channeling once again. [soft voice] I require you to speak with Glanthas the Ancient in Nordanaar. [solemn] It is he that controls the power of the Runestones here in Hyjal. [warm] With his magic, you should be allowed teleporation between both stones.
quest_40991_quest_detail:
[solemn] In my previous life as a living man, I was enthralled by the tales of the Azotha, our long-lost human predecessors from a bygone age. Their ancient knowledge and artifacts fascinated me.

[sad] Alas, the tumultuous situation in Gilneas hindered my research on the Azotha, trapping me within these confining walls. [hesitant] Now, the gates have finally opened, but as a forsaken, venturing into human lands would be my ultimate demise.

[whispering] However, I have heard whispers of a secluded city known as Corthan, nestled in the treacherous Badlands. [solemn] Legends speak of a powerful and enigmatic Azotha artifact hidden within its abandoned walls—the Hand of Corthan. [soft voice] Although the true nature of this relic eludes me, I am certain that it holds great significance and would be a valuable addition to my collection.
quest_40991_quest_progress: [solemn] Journey to Badlands is long. [urgent] Get going.
quest_40991_quest_complete:
[solemn] Unfathomable. Azothan artifact, now resting in my grasp.

<Dark Bishop chuckles ominously>

[mocking tone] How amusing it is to consider the reactions of our ancestors, witnessing their cherished relic held by a creature as abhorrent as I. [cold] Surely, they twist and turn in their eternal slumber, aghast at the sight.
quest_40992_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Foulhide gnolls, wretched creatures that they are, have likely crossed your path on your journey here. [low voice] Like any typical gnoll, they possess little intelligence, resorting to savagery and brute force. [commanding] Communication or cooperation with them is an exercise in futility.

The Regents turn a blind eye, while the so-called Rebellion remains preoccupied with their own affairs. [urgent] Thus, it falls upon us to address this predicament.

[soft voice] Our motivations are far from altruistic, mind you. [angry] These gnolls have become an insurmountable obstacle, intercepting crucial supplies dispatched from Undercity. [threatening] Such interference is unacceptable. [commanding] Venture southward and dispatch as many of these abominations as you can.

[solemn] Return to me with sixteen Foulhide paws as undeniable proof of your success.
quest_40992_quest_progress: [solemn] Huge packs of Foulhide gnolls can be found in the Southmire Orchard. [urgent] Their raiding parties have been spotted in Silverpine already. [commanding] They must be stopped.
quest_40992_quest_complete:
[delight] Ha! Thanks to your unwavering efforts, our communication lines with the capital have been fortified, ensuring the safety of our operations in Gilneas. [warm] Your dedication to the cause of the Forsaken is commendable.

As a token of my gratitude, I offer you this. Though it may not be extravagant, it will undoubtedly prove useful in navigating the treacherous lands that lie before us.
quest_40993_quest_detail:
[solemn] The wretched Greymane forces, perpetrators of my demise and desecrators of my church. [sad] Why did they target me?

The answer remains an enigma, yet I sense it is intertwined with the significance of this place. [solemn] Centuries ago, a battle unfolded upon this very hill, where the forces of Gilneas, against all odds, triumphed over Arathor. [solemn] I am convinced that the key to their triumph lay buried within these grounds, and the Regent's bloodlust coveted this dormant power for their own malevolent purposes.

[commanding] We must delve deep into this mystery. [urgent] Unearthing such power would bestow upon us a formidable advantage. [solemn] I shall sift through these weathered tomes, unearthing knowledge that may shed light on our quarry.

[soft voice] In the interim, I ask you to embark on a perilous journey to Desolace. [urgent] There, amidst the demons, seek out and retrieve the Eye of Xythos—an artifact rumored to possess the ability to uncover the secrets of the past... [whispering] if one can channel the energies of the Forgotten Shadow, of course.
quest_40993_quest_progress: [solemn] Eye of Xythos is rumored to be in the possession of the Shadow Council in Desolace. [low voice] I have caught wind of dark whispers that speak the name... Shadowbreak.
quest_40993_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Eye... Ah, yes. Its malevolent aura was unmistakable as you drew near.

Draw nearer still. Through tireless research and countless tomes, I have unearthed a revelation of great intrigue. [whispering] It appears that during the fabled Battle of Stillward, the first Greymane wielded an unfathomable darkness.

Now, with the Eye of Xythos firmly in my grasp, I shall delve into the depths of time itself. [solemn] I seek to unveil the true nature of this formidable power that we now confront.
quest_40994_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have beheld the truth, a glimpse into the First Battle of Stillward as if I had been there myself. The ancient tomes, with their accounts of Garalon Greymane's tactical prowess, now revealed as a tapestry of deception. [low voice] He wielded an ominous power, a force derived from entities that even my mind struggles to comprehend. Clutched in his hand was a scepter, a conduit through which he commanded the very essence of darkness. [threatening] Its sheer potency was nothing short of terror-inducing.

[urgent] We cannot allow this power to fall into the clutches of our enemies. If they were to uncover the truth, it could spell doom for our cause. [emphasis] Listen closely. In the depths of my vision, I recognized the scepter's likeness. It once resided within the halls of Ravenwood Keep.

[sad] Alas, the keep now lies in ruins, razed by the onslaught of Greymane's forces. [solemn] We can only pray that the scepter remains unclaimed by their hands.

[commanding] Venture forth to the Ravenwood Keep. Seek out a scepter forged from dark obsidian and bring it to me.
quest_40994_quest_progress: [solemn] Such power... It must be ours.
quest_40994_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, so you have found it after all.

The ravages of time have taken their toll upon the scepter, diminishing its former might. [low voice] Yet, even in its weakened state, its aura pulsates with an undeniable darkness, a lingering remnant of forbidden magic.
quest_40995_quest_detail:
[solemn] To harness the true potential of this fractured weapon, we must not shy away from embracing the power it holds. [hesitant] However, caution must prevail, for in its current state of disrepair, wielding it would be a grave folly. [commanding] To mend the cracks that mar its surface and restore its formidable strength, I require a potent artifact crafted from dark obsidian.

[low voice] Fortuitously, I have knowledge of a likely source for such an object. [urgent] Venture westward, to the Barrens of Kalimdor, where Razorfen Downs stands as a bastion of darkness. [solemn] Within its depths, a malevolent lich has established his abode, guarded by undead minions and ensconced in nefarious sorcery.

[cold] It is said that his phylactery, the vessel of his immortal essence, is forged from the very obsidian we seek.
quest_40995_quest_progress: [urgent] Act quickly, <class>. [solemn] For with each passing moment, his dark powers surge and his influence expands.
quest_40995_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your unwavering dedication continues to impress me, <class>.

Yet, during your absence, I delved once more into the past, and it became clear that there is yet another task I must entrust to you.

[low voice] The Scepter is still incomplete, lacking a crucial component I have missed earlier.
quest_40996_quest_detail:
[solemn] Regrettably, the crystal that once adorned the apex of the scepter has been lost to the ravages of time. [low voice] Its whereabouts remain unknown, and locating it may prove to be an insurmountable challenge. [soft voice] However, despair not, for I have devised an alternative solution.

[solemn] During the Alterac Succession Crisis, a figure known as Lord Prestor frequented Gilneas City and established a close bond with the king himself. [soft voice] As a gift, he bestowed upon Genn a potent artifact known as the Shard of Midnight.

[solemn] Legends abound regarding its corrupting influence, and it is said that the Shard has been securely sealed within the Greymane Tower.

[commanding] Your task is clear: locate the Shard of Midnight and restore it to its rightful place within the Scepter. [solemn] Only then shall its power be fully rekindled.
quest_40996_quest_progress: [commanding] Gather a strong party before you venture forth.
quest_40996_quest_complete:
[commanding] Yes, indeed! [solemn] Behold, the Shard of Midnight, at last in my possession.

<Dark Bishop meticulously adjusts the scepter, delicately affixing the crystal atop its pinnacle.>

[low voice] The task is accomplished. [solemn] The unholy forces once wielded by Garalon Greymane can be harnessed anew, but only by those who possess the fortitude to withstand their malevolence.

[solemn] This endeavor is far above you and me. [solemn] We have fulfilled our mission, and now we must deliver the Scepter to our superiors.
quest_40997_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your efforts have proven invaluable. Without you, our triumph would have remained naught but a distant dream. [solemn] It is only fitting that you undertake the task of delivering this Scepter to Varimathras. He has been duly apprised of its profound importance and eagerly anticipates your arrival.

[urgent] I would strongly advise against keeping him waiting. [commanding] Remember, he is a Dreadlord, and their patience is not to be trifled with.
quest_40998_quest_complete:
[solemn] Cooking notes. Well, I must admit I have had my fair share of meals here in Karazhan. [soft voice] I also spent much of my youth learning how to cook.

[warm] You certainly have come to the correct place.
quest_40999_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you desire to learn more, I will require some favors before I can impart what knowledge I can glean from this parchment. [soft voice] When I first arrived in Karazhan some time ago, I wore an engraved bracelet made of the finest gold. It was a symbol of my status, and has subsequently gone missing ever since I have been roaming and haunting these halls.

[hesitant] I am certain I left my bracelet somewhere within these lower halls. [warm] Recover it for me, and I will be quite thankful.
quest_40999_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you recovered my bracelet? [soft voice] It was a gift from my wife.
quest_40999_quest_complete: [delight] Ahh, such a marvelous piece of work... [warm] I had forgotten just how extravagant it was.
quest_41000_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am thankful for your work in recovering my Engraved Golden Bracelet, but I long for something closer to my heart. [sad] I left my family behind long ago to come to this place, only to forever become trapped.

[soft voice] I want a memento of the past, something that I can look back on with the fondest of memories. [pause] With it, I may find some peace.

[solemn] I once hailed from the lands of Lordaeron, and the city of Stratholme, my family house is within the trade district, find the Rothlen house, and recover my family brooch.
quest_41000_quest_progress: [solemn] Has the Rothlen Family Brooch been recovered?
quest_41000_quest_complete:
[solemn] Stratholme, destroyed? My family home burned?

<Duke Rothlen lets out an exhale of disbelief.>

[sad] Such news brings emotions to my soul. I must thank you deeply for recovering this, for it is truly the final memento of my family.
quest_41001_quest_detail: [solemn] I have taken the time to study the parchment, and have discovered that it is a half complete copy of 'Le Fishe Au Chocolat'. [soft voice] One of Medivh's more favored dishes, and one that takes considerable skill to complete. [gentle] If you desire to learn what secrets this recipe holds, I suggest you speak to 'The Cook' here in Karazhan.
quest_41002_quest_detail:
[solemn] Yes, it was me who devised this recipe. [soft voice] I have taught it to very few of the cooks that we had working within Karazhan. [low voice] It was not widely appreciated, but adored by Medivh.

[hesitant] I am not freely able to dispense with such information, but if you are able to produce a 'Charge of Karazhan' from Doorman Montigue, I could easily provide you with the recipe. [urgent] Speak with him, and see to acquiring one.
quest_41002_quest_complete: [commanding] Welcome to Karazhan, [soft voice] what is it that I can assist you with?
quest_41003_quest_detail:
[commanding] You require a Charge of Karazhan? Well, these are not freely given to members of the public and guests of the tower. [solemn] They are earned from ample donations to Medivh and the magical services that he provides. [urgent] If you desire a Charge, we can take a donation on your behalf for when our master returns.

[low voice] At the current, we are looking for ten Essence of Death, ten Essence of Life, and twenty-five gold. [commanding] Bring this donation on Medivh's behalf, and I will make sure you are rewarded justly.
quest_41003_quest_progress: [solemn] Have the materials for your donation to the tower been acquired?
quest_41003_quest_complete: [solemn] Your contributions have been recorded within my notebook. [soft voice] I would like to thank you for your continued support. [warm] As I have promised, I have prepared a Charge of Karazhan on your behalf.
quest_41004_quest_detail:
[solemn] As I have promised, here you are, a Charge of Karazhan.

[soft voice] I thank you for your support. [warm] Please, make yourself at home here in Karazhan.
quest_41004_quest_progress: [soft voice] You have returned, have you had any luck?
quest_41004_quest_complete: [commanding] Very well, this Charge gives me authority to dispense with the information you request. [soft voice] I have prepared the recipe for you, and wrote down the instructions. [warm] May you find good use of this rare delicacy.
quest_41005_quest_progress:
[soft voice] If you are looking for something a bit more relaxing, I have spent quite a few years mastering my recipe for herbal tea.

[warm] I could brew you some for your efforts here in Hyjal. [gentle] Bring me a single Small Dream Shard and I shall reward you with my famous tea. Small Dream Shard
quest_41005_quest_complete: [soft voice] The effects of the tea are quite calming, [pause] be at ease with a few sips.
quest_41007_quest_progress: [soft voice] My husband Vaenar and I have been looking to assist with the growing concerns in Hyjal. The rare material Fading Dream Fragment is becoming ever harder to come across, and before long there may be none of them left. [solemn] If you bring me a Fading Dream Fragment I will be sure to reward you handsomely for your efforts. [warm] Fading Dream Fragment
quest_41007_quest_complete: [solemn] As I have promised, these Small Dream Shards contain a powerful magic, [warm] use them wisely.
quest_41008_quest_detail:
[solemn] The mighty stag of Nordrassil is most revered by the druids here at Nordanaar.

[soft voice] For the most triumphant of deeds to our cause, I could reward you with such a mount. [warm] This reward is only privileged for those that have gone above and beyond. [gentle] Bring me five hundred Bright Dream Shards and you shall be rewarded with a mount most fitting for your dedication.
quest_41008_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you made your choice?
quest_41008_quest_complete: [solemn] You have proved yourself to Hyjal, and your reward is immense. [warm] Treat the stag of Nordrassil as you would a most loyal companion and they will show you the strength of nature.
quest_41009_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is here on Hyjal that the power of the Emerald Dream can be felt most prominently. [soft voice] As of late, there has been a disturbance in channeling such energies. [pause] Not many make the pilgrimage to Hyjal as they once did.

[solemn voice] I have been sent as an envoy for the spirits of Moonglade, who have asked for able bodied druids assisting Hyjal. [warm] If you wish to prove your efforts, the spirits within Moonglade will certainly reward such noble actions. [urgent] Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in Moonglade, and bring with you twenty Bright Dream Shards, as well as eight Arcane Essence.
quest_41010_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is here on Hyjal that the power of the Emerald Dream can be felt most prominently. [soft voice] As of late, there has been a disturbance in channeling such energies. [pause] Not many make the pilgrimage to Hyjal as they once did.

[solemn voice] I have been sent as an envoy for the spirits of Moonglade, who have asked for able bodied druids assisting Hyjal. [gentle] If you wish to prove your efforts, the spirits within Moonglade will certainly reward such noble actions. [warm] Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade, and bring with you twenty Bright Dream Shards, as well as eight Arcane Essence.
quest_41011_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many long years ago, I came in contact with a powerful artifact that drew immense powers from the ley-lines across Azeroth. [soft voice] I intended to study this artifact but its powers slowly drained through the years. [pause] What research I was able to conduct was rather disappointing, and now I am left with a rather exquisite paper-weight.

[warm] If you assist me in restoring this old relic to its former power, perhaps you may have more luck with it than I did. [solemn] The first thing that I require is a Dragonkin Charge, which holds great draconic magic. [urgent] I have heard that dragonkin from Blackrock Spire are known to possess such items.
quest_41011_quest_progress: [solemn] I have not had this much excitement in some time. [soft voice] Have you recovered the Dragonkin Charge?
quest_41011_quest_complete: [solemn] Immense power contained in such a small token, draconic magic is certainly fascinating!
quest_41012_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have attempted to use the Dragonkin Charge to repower the relic, but I have had no luck in energizing its latent power. [soft voice] I suspect we will require a more active source of ley energy.

[commanding] I will require some items before I can begin this ritual. [emphasis] First, I need you to collect the following items which should be easier to obtain. [urgent] Five essence of fire, and a single fragment of earth should be enough to get us started. [hesitant] These materials might be tricky to find, but I do know that fragments of earth can be found from earth elementals seen in Silithus. [pause] I suggest that you start there.
quest_41012_quest_complete: [solemn] We have only just begun, [commanding] do not get excited.
quest_41013_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the Elemental Fire, and the Fragment of Earth, we can ground the relic to prepare for real energization. [commanding] This binding requires an extreme charge of ley-energy that could rival the power that it once held. [soft voice] To find such a collection of raw arcane power is rare on Azeroth.

[pause] I have sensed an extreme amount of arcane discharge coming from the continent of Kalimdor for some time. [hesitant] With rumors I have heard, I can only deduce that the once elven city now called Dire Maul is discharging extreme energy.

[solemn] It is here that I require a Supercharged Arcane Resonation, which should be found from any elements of arcane that have materialized there. [urgent] Gather me one, and I will provide you with the relic as it once was.
quest_41013_quest_progress: [solemn] I can only imagine the power that is being expelled around Dire Maul.
quest_41013_quest_complete: <Parnabus looks shocked by the power before him.> [solemn] So, it was true.
quest_41014_quest_detail: [solemn] You have done well in acquiring these materials <class>. As I have promised, I will perform the ritual to recharge this relic as it once was. [soft voice] Speak to me when I am finished.
quest_41014_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, the ritual is complete. [soft voice] This binding once came from near the tower of Karazhan. [pause] I have no doubt it once served a more grand cause, or was apart of an object with considerable power.

[solemn] I have no purpose for this binding any longer, and I offer it to you for whatever purpose you see fit. [warm] I wish you the best of luck in your cause <class>.
quest_41015_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some years ago, a rare and powerful item was stored inside of this church. [sad] I have been cursed to remain ever since its disappearance years ago. [soft voice] If you could recover this item and return it to Karazhan, I would be more than thankful.

[solemn] The Binding was torn apart before it was ever stolen, both halves now rest with separate owners. [soft voice] The first was taken by a hermit mage who held no affiliations, his accent certainly sounded like he came from the north.

[soft voice] The second half of the binding was taken by a man of faith, of vigilance, wearing red cloth and bearing the symbol of the Light itself. [mocking tone] His ravings almost sounded mad!

[urgent] Gather me both the upper and lower half of the binding, and I can make it whole.
quest_41015_quest_progress:
[solemn] Once the binding is restored I will be brought peace.

[soft voice] It is up to you to recover both halves.
quest_41015_quest_complete:
[solemn] The upper and lower halves both. [pause] I would never have expected to see them together.

<Hanvar takes a moment to gather himself.>

[soft voice] The bindings have been brought together, and now they are rejoined. [sad] I am cursed to forever protect these items, but it appears that you would have a better chance to carry out my charge.

[solemn] Watch over the binding, and make sure it does not fall into the hands of evil.
quest_41016_quest_detail:
[solemn] Alzzin he calls himself, The Wildshaper, a title given to him by the druids in Hyjal. [sad] A twisted, corrupted mockery of what he once was, standing opposed to all beliefs he once held dear.

'Alzzin' was once a friend of mine, yet now seeks nothing but the total corruption of Feralas. [urgent] I feel it is my duty to put an end to his evil schemes once and for all.

You can find him lurking deep within Dire Maul with his satyr kin. [commanding] Slay him, and bring me his head, only then will I find solace.
quest_41016_quest_progress: [solemn] Has that foul beast been brought to justice?
quest_41016_quest_complete:
[sad] I could never imagine such a betrayal, it struck me so deep that I do not even wish to recall the memories.

[solemn] I thank you for putting this traitor to death. [urgent] Without your interferance I fear what Alzzin may have accomplished. [warm] Please, take this, as a gesture of my extreme thanks.
quest_41017_quest_detail:
[solemn] Nordrassil Glade has been a place of tranquility for many ages, but already agents of the legion have begun to spread their taint. [angry] Satyrs, traitors of a most disgusting kind have been probing at our borders.

[commanding] They call themselves the 'Vilemusk' a name befitting of their illbegotten kin. [commanding] I demand their presence removed from Hyjal, hunt them, and bring me their hooves as proof of your deeds. [warm] Do so, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_41017_quest_progress: [solemn] The satyr were once much like us, and now they stalk from the shadows and undermine our efforts.
quest_41017_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, such a task will not be forgotten. [soft voice] For each satyr that has fallen there shall be one less for when the time truly comes.

[solemn] This battle for Hyjal is dependant on such heroic actions. [warm] Take this Bright Dream Shard, as thanks from us.
quest_41018_quest_progress:
[solemn] Dream Shards are a resonation of magical energy from the Emerald Dream made manifest here in Hyjal. They contain a very powerful energy that, when manipulated, can be used for darker purposes. The Burning Legion have been collecting them and corrupting them for their nefarious purposes.

[urgent] Hunt down the demons still present in Hyjal, and collect these Corrupt Dream Shards, bring them to me so that they can be restored. Corrupt Dream Shard(8)
quest_41018_quest_complete:
[solemn] Dark magic lingers deep in these shards, it is good that you have recovered them before it was too late.

[warm] Take this, as thanks for recovering these from the brink of destruction. [gentle] If you find any more, bring them to me.
quest_41019_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Shadeflayer trolls have taken a stance of hostility towards us in Hyjal. [soft voice] They were once called the Shadowtooth Tribe, and valiantly fought alongside us against the Burning Legion.

[sad] Such times are now long gone, as corruption has taken hold of even those we held as allies. [urgent] I task you to travel to Zul'Hatha where they call home to the west, slay them, and procure 10 Shadeflayer Tribal Bracelets. [warm] Bring these bracelets to me and you will be rewarded. Shadeflayer Tribal Bracelet(10)
quest_41019_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well. Such actions ensure our safety here in Nordanaar. [warm] Nordrassil Glade must be kept as a safe haven, not threatened by the evil whims of maddened trolls.

[warm] Take this Small Dream Shard, as thanks from us here.
quest_41020_quest_detail:
[solemn] During the Third War, the Burning Legion tested their strength against our might, and were defeated by the armies that gathered before Nordrassil. [solemn] Again they come, gathering in preparation for nefarious deeds.

[sad] This time we have no mighty armies to defend us, or the wisdom of Malfurion to guide us. [urgent] The defense of Hyjal relies on us, the brave remaining few, to be vigilant against evil.

[commanding] I ask you to challenge the might of Lord Xanvarak. [solemn] The leader of the Burning Legion here in Hyjal. [solemn] He has begun to assemble a mighty host of demonic soldiers in Bleakhollow Crater, just outside of Nordrassil Glade to the west. [urgent] Bring me his heart, and put an end to our worries.
quest_41020_quest_progress: [solemn] The power of the Burning Legion should not be taken lightly. [commanding] Bring your own host of would-be adventurers, or mercenaries to challenge Xanvarak's strength.
quest_41020_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Heart of Xanvarak, such foul power can be felt emitting from his life-blood. [soft voice] Your efforts in defending Hyjal have been paramount. With Xanvarak destroyed, it will be some time before the demons can rally behind a new leader.

[warm] You have brought us peace, for however long that may last. [proud] Such an achievement is worthy of a reward most sacred.
quest_41021_quest_progress:
[solemn] The effects of the Third War are still present in Hyjal. [sad] Demonic corruption lingers upon the land and has touched the wildlife of the region, driving it to madness. [soft voice] There is still hope, however. [gentle] If we can preserve the younger generations and remove the corruption of their kind, there is still a chance for the majestic animals native here to thrive.

[solemn] We must act as conservationists for the sake of nature's creatures. [urgent] Bring me ten Great Beaks from the Greathorn Owls, and ten Misthoof Hide from the Misthoof Stags. [warm] For your efforts, I will reward you a Bright Dream Shard. Great Beak(10)Misthoof Hide(10)
quest_41021_quest_complete:
[solemn] Such grim tasks are required for the betterment of nature in Hyjal. [soft voice] If we do not act, the animals in Hyjal will be reduced to aggressive and hostile beasts, perhaps even slaves to the legion.

[warm] Take this Dream Shard, as thanks on my behalf.
quest_41022_quest_detail:
[solemn] All around Hyjal, manifestations of corruption taking place within the Emerald Dream are appearing. [soft voice] The green sludges taint the land and actively threaten our way of life. [urgent] We need to combat this hazard as we would demons of the Burning Legion.

Collect forty Enchanted Sludge as proof of your deeds. [warm] Do this, and I shall make sure you are rewarded well.
quest_41022_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be careful, these monstrosities have no value for life.
quest_41022_quest_complete: [soft voice] You have done well, the lands are safer thanks to your efforts. [solemn] Though I still have many questions about where these creatures have come from.
quest_41023_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I have prepared a sample of the Enchanted Sludge you have gathered for me. [solemn] I request that you bring it to Glanthas the Ancient at Nordanaar.

Last I heard, Glanthas and a druid were working together to find the root cause of something similar. [gentle] Perhaps this sample of sludge can offer them both assistance.
quest_41024_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Glanthas has sent you to find me?

<Canos takes a moment, looking over the sludge.>

[pause] It would appear some sort of magical properties remain in this sludge, but I take it Glanthas has already gleamed this information.
quest_41025_quest_detail:
[solemn] My research in Azshara has yielded interesting information, though I still need to conduct research here in the Eastern Plaguelands. [soft voice] I have been attempting to find a link between magic and the Oozes themselves, but so far it would appear I have no luck. [hesitant] I have come to the conclusion that these creatures have been here for quite a while, and thus their magical potency has diminished.

[urgent] I ask of you to find an Imbued Sludge, one that contains a trace of magical energy. You can find the monstrosities near Light's Hope Chapel and Corin's Crossing here in the Plaguelands.
quest_41025_quest_progress: [soft voice] I have been searching for quite some time to find a magical linking. [hesitant] Maybe you will have better luck than I.
quest_41025_quest_complete:
[solemn] A trace of magic.

<A sigh escapes Canos.>

[soft voice] I was beginning to doubt myself.
quest_41026_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would appear that the Oozes are linked to surges of intense and dark magical powers. [soft voice] Lingering as an after effect to great magical energy itself. [hesitant] Perhaps this is a natural occurance, or something much deeper.

[pause] In truth, I cannot be certain if my evidence is correct, or if I am looking in the right area. [solemn] Regardless, I have prepared a report for Arch Druid Dreamwind in Hyjal. [soft voice] It should explain everything I have come to find.

[warm] I must thank you for your assistance, without you, I would still be digging through oozes.
quest_41026_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My, Canos has put in an impressive amount of work in his research. It is not conclusive, but I am sure he is on the right footing. [solemn] A magical feedback, or remnant certainly is an interesting theory, and one that will need to be looked into further.

[warm] Your assistance in this matter has been emphasized by Glanthas himself, one I hold with the deepest of respects. [proud] Take this, as a token of our thanks here in Hyjal.
quest_41032_quest_detail:
[solemn] Enter, my child. You are welcome here amongst the restless dead. You likely know of the gifts we bestow upon our followers, so I shan't speak of it further.

[soft voice] I chose to be a worgen, and have found much more power and knowledge in the curse than I ever did the life I left behind. Now I assist Lady Moranna with her research, which has sadly come to a stalemate. [solemn] The venom I require comes from the Hollow Web spiders just to the east of this cemetery. [soft voice] It will be crucial for our new recruits to overcome the pain of their transition. [commanding] Gather me ten vials. That should be enough.
quest_41032_quest_progress: [solemn] The transformation is often a difficult process for some. [pause] There is a point of immense pain as the old skin tears away, and the worgen form is forced underneath. [soft voice] You must understand how painful that can be, and how some people do not have the inner strength to complete it.
quest_41032_quest_complete:
[excited] So you return! [urgent] With the venom in hand! [soft voice] Greeted by the snarl of an old woman--I mean a smile of course.

[warm] Take this coin, as thanks for the work.
quest_41033_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Well met my friend. [soft voice] You've come to join us? [soft voice] You have caught the spark of curiosity, and must surely satiate it. [solemn] I will admit, those in Ravenshire look upon us as a cult. [angry] How foolish they are to see our strength as sin, eh?

[solemn] I have been tasked to study blood itself, and I am curious to see if the blood of other races shares similar properties to our own. [solemn] To the east lay the Hinterlands, a place once called home by the Witherbark Trolls. [solemn] From them, gather 5 vials of Witherbark Blood and return them to me.
quest_41033_quest_progress: [soft voice] Blood is quite intriguing indeed. [whispering] It holds immense power, you know. [low voice] Some of Ur's research suggests that demons can be poisoned with a dead man's blood. [solemn] Fascinating, is it not?
quest_41033_quest_complete: [soft voice] With enough research, we may be able to uncover the properties of blood itself. [solemn] This could be very important to Moranna, if our suspicions are correct.
quest_41034_quest_detail:
[low voice] I don't know your face, <race>, I don't like new faces. [angry] There's enough trouble in these forests without outlanders dragging theirs along.

[sigh] But you're here now, curse it all. [solemn] The Master says it is all part of the Wolf Serpent's will and who is foolish wee me to disagree? [commanding] Thus, I say you should help with your part.

[soft voice] It gets pretty cold up here in Gilneas and we pellars need clothes as much as anyone. [urgent] Track down the Vilewing Bats and the Duskpelt Wolves, then bring me their furs. [emphasis] You'll find them almost anywhere in this country, but the closest are to the southwest.
quest_41034_quest_progress:
[solemn] The sacrament of the hunt is crucial in the order of nature. [soft voice] Death feeds life, which feeds death, which feeds life.

[emphasis] The circle is unbroken.
quest_41034_quest_complete:
[commanding] Look at that, an outlander with some mettle. We say that a man is not made until he has won his first hunt, but I can see this wasn't your first.

[soft voice] I can tolerate your foreign mug a little more. [urgent] Now scurry.
quest_41035_quest_detail:
[solemn] Adrift you have strayed, misplaced and mislaid. Unto the Wolf Serpent's coils have you wandered, chasing meaning, seeking wonder.

[soft voice] Am I right? For once like you I were, an affrighted hen, beaten, bitten, driven from her pen. [urgent] Bled and felled!

In the north, near Ebonmere Farm a woodsman stalks among trees, he who my life would end. [commanding] Be you his last fare and the Wolf Serpent's blessings with you I'll share.
quest_41035_quest_progress: [hesitant] Is it over, is it done? [sad] Is my nightmare gone?
quest_41035_quest_complete:
A thousand and thousand thanks I lay upon you.

[soft voice] My family, my own blood, thought me sick with plague, thought me not worth the yoke. [solemn] Now I am free to be Beckett no more.
quest_41036_quest_detail:
[solemn] My father, Demetreus, has seen your likeness in a dream, <name>. He knew you would come to us one day.

The Wolf Serpent, our eternal guardian, will soon return to this world. We must make ready for his rebirth, for the cleansing of these lands.

In the west lie the Ruins of Greyshire. There are items there, mementos of significance, that hold a spiritual bond with the dead that possessed them in life.

[soft voice] Gather them for me, that I may summon the souls of the departed and relieve them of their suffering.
quest_41036_quest_progress:
[solemn] These tokens hold vestiges of who these revenants once were, what they once valued.

[soft voice] Wedding rings, a family sword, a lost one's handkerchief could all become a tether from the realm of the dead to ours.
quest_41036_quest_complete:
[solemn] Once we are ready, I will place these items in a circle of salt, and light an incense of black roses to call the spirits forth.

[soft voice] Though that day has not come, and will not for some time. [warm] You have done well, as I know you would have.
quest_41037_quest_detail:
[commanding] For what do you linger there, <class>? Idle of hand, idle of spirit?

If you are looking for good work, then I have a task for you. [solemn] From the soot on me you can see the markings of a blacksmith, and indeed, I have forged many a fine thing for us here.

[soft voice] Copper and silver we do need, to craft the rods we wield to bridle lightning and shackle thunder. [urgent] Find the talismans worn by the invading Foulhide gnolls south of here and bring them to me. They contain the metals that I need.
quest_41037_quest_progress: [low voice] Won't be much silver in the trinkets the gnolls use, but copper they seem to like just enough.
quest_41037_quest_complete:
[low voice] Ugly, crude, cheap. What else can you expect of gnoll-make?

But metal is metal, 'tis better in my hands than theirs. [warm] You have me thanks, this copper will make proper rods.
quest_41039_quest_detail:
[solemn] The people of Thalanaar have labored diligently to sustain our forces, but alas, their efforts alone prove insufficient to satiate the needs of our squad. [soft voice] We Sentinels must not burden them with the weight of our demands, for they have already sacrificed much for our cause.

[solemn] Though our skilled huntresses have ventured forth to secure provisions, the magnitude of the task requires the contribution of every willing hand. [urgent] I have witnessed the presence of prowling wolves in the vicinity, their hunger mirroring our own. [commanding] Embark upon this hunt, and procure ten succulent chunks of their meat, that our strength may be fortified.
quest_41039_quest_complete: [solemn] These meats will be crucial for our survival in this wilderness. [warm] Thank you, <class>.
quest_41040_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Woodpaw Gnolls threaten our sacred lands, preying upon our caravans and scouts. [urgent] We cannot allow them to grow in strength and orchestrate an assault on Thalanaar. [commanding] The time to strike is now.

[commanding] Your mission is clear: eradicate the Woodpaw threat before it escalates further. [urgent] Seek out their camp in the treacherous Woodpaw Hills, easily traced by their noxious odor.

[commanding] Slay ten trappers and mongrels, vanquish eight reavers, and bring down six alphas. [confident] This decisive blow will plunge them into disarray, buying us valuable respite.
quest_41040_quest_progress: [soft voice] This makes me wonder... have the gnolls always been there?
quest_41040_quest_complete:
[solemn] Swift and decisive, you have accomplished the task with remarkable efficiency. [proud] Your prowess in action speaks volumes, outsider.

[soft voice] Your discernment in recognizing the importance of swift action and your aversion to idle chit-chat sets you apart. It is a trait we value greatly among our ranks. [pause] There are those, like Shandris, who may hesitate until the eleventh hour, and then... [emphasis] But let us not dwell on such matters for now.
quest_41041_quest_detail:
[solemn] Not all tauren tribes were so eager to align themselves with the Horde. Among them, the Grimtotems stand as outliers. [soft voice] While most tribes strive to subdue and tame their primal instincts, the Grimtotems embrace their savage nature. [pause] One would assume they would find kinship with those responsible for the murder of Cenarius, but they too have their own sense of pride.

[solemn] The Grimtotems walk a precarious path, treading the line between loyalty and independence. [urgent] Recently, our scouts have reported skirmishes between their forces and the tauren of Camp Mojache to the northwest. [emphasis] It piques my curiosity as to the cause of this disagreement.

[commanding] Venture forth to the Grimtotem Compound and uncover any clues that shed light on the situation. [solemn] I am intrigued to understand the motives behind this conflict.
quest_41041_quest_progress:
[solemn] In bygone eras, when the Night Elves and Tauren were steadfast allies, the Grimtotem tribe was known for their penchant for trouble. [soft voice] They continuously sought independence from the Kaldorei, often at the expense of their own prosperity.

[low voice] Nevertheless, I cannot deny my admiration for their combat prowess. [solemn] Among the Tauren, they stood resolute against the Centaur onslaught and maintained a presence in remote mountain outposts, defying the odds. [solemn] Their resilience and tenacity in the face of adversity is commendable.
quest_41041_quest_complete: [solemn] Interesting. So, you're telling me that their leader held possession of this artifact? Its aura carries the unmistakable taint of the Scourge. [urgent] We must promptly inform someone of higher wisdom and authority to determine the appropriate course of action.
quest_41042_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one individual who comes to mind when it comes to deciphering the significance of this artifact: Archdruid Fandral. [soft voice] While many among the Kaldorei harbor resentment towards him for his disagreement with the High Priestess, I believe he sees the bigger picture.

[low voice] Tyrande no longer acts in the best interest of our people.

Regardless, it is imperative that you bring this mallet directly to him. [commanding] He possesses the wisdom and knowledge to determine the appropriate course of action.
quest_41042_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it? [angry] You better have a good reason to interrupt me.
quest_41042_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, the Scourge's tainted weapon found among the Grimtotem? Not surprising at all. They have developed a peculiar fascination with undeath, even stooping so low as to collaborate with the Forsaken. But why the artifact ended up with those pathetic Grimtotem fools shouldn't bother you. It's just another testament to what the Horde truly stands for: death and destruction.

The world fractures further, the Second Sundering looms. Your involvement in this matter, however insignificant, is duly noted.

Consider yourself dismissed.[solemn] Here, take this token of appreciation for your feeble efforts.
quest_41043_quest_detail:
[solemn] Long ago, during the reign of Queen Azshara, this place thrived as a center of Kaldorei civilization. [sad] Now, all that remains are ruins, either occupied by ogres or tainted by undeath.

[solemn] The downfall of this place was brought about by arcane magic, and it's hard to feel pity for those who met their end here. [soft voice] Yet, amidst all this arcane corruption, there once stood a place of purity and light—the old Temple of Elune, its name lost to the annals of time.

[solemn] Within the temple, the priestesses safeguarded a sacred artifact deeply connected to the roots of our people and the world we inhabit. [urgent] I require this artifact, but my duties prevent me from leaving the camp at this moment. [soft voice] If fate ever guides you to the Ruins of Isildien, seek out the Tear of Zalmos—a precious blue gem of unimaginable importance. [warm] Your aid in retrieving it would be invaluable.
quest_41043_quest_complete: [solemn] Very well, your assistance in retrieving the Tear of Zalmos is greatly appreciated. [soft voice] However, acquiring it is only the first step in a greater endeavor. [pause] Are you prepared to lend your aid once more?
quest_41044_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Kaldorei Empire's vast influence once spanned across the entire world, before the cataclysmic event of the Sundering shattered our dominion. [soft voice] As a consequence, our sacred relics have found their way to the farthest reaches of the globe.

[pause] Recently, there have been murmurs and whispers about the shattering of the Greymane Wall, which once separated the land of Gilneas from the outside world. [low voice] While I hold little regard for the internal struggles of human kingdoms, it is noteworthy that Gilneas was once home to the ancient Wild God known as Zalmos. [sad] Sadly, Zalmos perished there during the devastating War of the Ancients.

[commanding] Your task is to journey to Gilneas and recover Fang of Zalmos, which is said to be held by an enigmatic order known as the Pellars of Witchwood. [urgent] Unfortunately, further details are scarce, but your resourcefulness will undoubtedly guide you in uncovering the truth.
quest_41044_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you here, my child?
quest_41044_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, so you seek the sacred artifact known as Fang of Zalmos, do you? Indeed, we Pellars hold such relics within our grasp, for we have been entrusted with the guardianship of these ancient artifacts. For the Wolf-Serpent's maws were many, each bite imbued with the strength of a thousand wolves.

[soft voice] I must admit, the curiosity within me stirs at the thought of what a Druid from the western lands would desire with such a relic. However, I am but a humble servant of the ancient ways, and who am I to question the authority of one who predates me by millennia? [gentle] If you aid me in a task, I shall grant you one of the revered Fang of Zalmos.
quest_41045_quest_detail:
[solemn] I require your assistance in a matter close to my heart.

In these troubled times of the Gilnean civil war, the demand for our healing skills has reached unprecedented heights. [soft voice] Alas, we find ourselves confined within the safety of this cave, unable to venture into the treacherous wilds in search of vital supplies. The dangers lurking in the wilderness have grown fiercer with each passing day.

[urgent] What I require from you, brave soul, is a rare healing herb known as Serpentroot. It can be found only in the lands of Gilneas, thriving amidst its turmoil. Procure ten samples of this precious herb for me, and I shall reward your efforts with one of the revered Fangs of Zalmos.
quest_41045_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid. With these supplies, we will be able to help those in need.
quest_41046_quest_detail:
[gentle] Here, brave adventurer.

<The old pellar extends a weathered hand, carefully placing the Fang of Zalmos into your grasp>

Take hold of this sacred relic, for it holds the essence of our ancient Wild God, Zalmos. [solemn] It is a power that must not be taken lightly, for in the wrong hands, it could bring untold destruction. [commanding] The Regents may not have been foolish enough to challenge us directly, but the enemy lurks in the shadows, waiting for their opportunity.

[urgent] Guard this Fang with utmost vigilance, for it is now your responsibility to ensure its safety. [solemn] Should the enemy ever lay eyes upon it, their thirst for power and control will be unquenchable. [solemn] May the blessings of the Wolf-Serpent guide and protect you on your journey, and may we meet again in a restored and prosperous Gilneas. [warm] And do not forget to convey my regards to the druid who sent you on this quest.
quest_41046_quest_progress: [soft voice] You're finally back. [solemn] Have you managed to reclaim the Fang of Zalmos?
quest_41046_quest_complete:
[solemn] Interesting indeed. [soft voice] It is heartening to see that the humans have not forgotten the ancient powers that once resided in their lands. [warm] Your success in retrieving the Fang of Zalmos is commendable. [commanding] However, our quest is not yet complete.

[solemn] There is one more piece missing, one more relic that we must acquire.
quest_41047_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven yourself to be a valuable ally and for that, I shall reveal the truth to you. [soft voice] The artifacts we have gathered are but a fragment of the greater plan to restore balance to the world.

Zalmos possessed a unique ability to regenerate with unparalleled potency. [emphasis] By harnessing his essence, we can bring forth a healing force that can mend the corrupted lands of Felwood and revitalize the dying World Tree.

[urgent] However, the artifacts alone are not enough to accomplish this task. [solemn] We require the guidance of Cenerron. [soft voice] He was a druid who once studied under Zalmos. [pause] Though the passage of time has taken its toll on Cenerron, we believe he still roams the ancient forests of Feralas. [solemn] His connection to the Wild God makes him the key to unlocking the potential of these artifacts.

[commanding] Search for Cenerron amidst the wilderness of Feralas. Be cautious, for he is now a feralkin, lost to his primal instincts. [hesitant] If you can earn his trust, he will possess the knowledge to amplify the power of these artifacts.
quest_41048_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you found the feralkin?
quest_41048_quest_complete:
[solemn] The essence of the Wolf-Serpent before my eyes... Remarkable.

I have tarried here long enough. The time has come to make my way back to Teldrassil, bearing the treasures you have procured. Fandral will be eager to learn of these developments, and I can already anticipate the satisfaction in his eyes.

[warm] Thank you, <name>. You have played a part in something bigger than you can imagine.
quest_41049_quest_detail:
[solemn] Chimaeras, majestic creatures of untamed beauty, once served as our loyal allies and formidable warbeasts in ages past. However, the devastating onslaught of the Burning Legion during the Third War brought ruin upon their roosts, leaving us bereft of their companionship and power.

[soft voice] But hope stirs anew. [urgent] Velos Sharpstrike, a seasoned chimaera trainer, has made a remarkable discovery—a long-forgotten roost that lies to the southwest of our current position. It is said that he seeks aid in reviving and restoring this sacred haven.

Venture forth and lend your aid to Velos.
quest_41049_quest_progress: [hesitant] I didn't expect company. [soft voice] Welcome.
quest_41049_quest_complete: [solemn] Excuse me for the state of this place. [urgent] Our work has just begun.
quest_41050_quest_detail:
[solemn] If we are to embark on the path of training new chimaeras, we must first clear this roost of its current inhabitants. [soft voice] As magnificent as those soaring creatures may be, they are beyond the point of training and cannot serve our purpose.

[solemn] To truly mold an obedient and loyal companion, we must start from their earliest days. [commanding] Therefore, I ask of you to take up your arms and eliminate eight of the Dunebound chimaeras and eight of the Venomlash chimaeras that roam these skies. [solemn] Once we've cleared the way, our true work can commence.
quest_41050_quest_progress: Beware their venomous breath. [urgent] One mistake can be fatal.
quest_41050_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, my gratitude, young one. [soft voice] These weary bones of mine have seen many moons, and my aging eyes no longer possess the keenness they once held. [warm] Your presence here is a timely boon, for the moment of anticipation is upon us.

[pause] Behold those precious eggs before us, nestled within the protective embrace of the roost. [soft voice] They shimmer with the promise of new life, their shells trembling in anticipation of the imminent hatching. [solemn] A magnificent sight to behold, indeed.

[urgent] Stay vigilant, for any moment now, the fragile shell shall yield to the strength within, and new chimaera hatchlings shall grace this world with their presence.
quest_41051_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, the voracious appetite of young chimaeras! There's nothing quite like it. [soft voice] These little ones can devour twice their weight in a single day, but they are quite particular about their meals. [commanding] While impudent trainers may have been a tempting choice in the past, we must focus on satisfying their hunger with more suitable fare.

In this case, their favorite delicacy happens to be hippogryphs. [urgent] Deep within the High Wilderness, a sizable flock of hippogryphs has been spotted. [commanding] I task you with hunting them down and bringing me twenty chunks of their meat. [warm] This will provide a hearty feast to nourish the soon-to-hatch chimaeras and satisfy their growing appetites.
quest_41051_quest_progress: [solemn] While killing a hippogryph is not something that we, night elves do lightly, it is unfortunately necessary for the chimaeras to grow healthy.
quest_41051_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, you have returned, just in time! [solemn] The anticipation is building, and I can sense that the hatching of the chimaeras is imminent. [warm] In just a few days, these majestic creatures will emerge from their eggs and grace our roost with their presence. [proud] Your timely presence ensures that we are prepared for their arrival.
quest_41052_quest_detail:
[solemn] Allow me to share a tale from antiquity. [soft voice] Millennia ago, a momentous pact was forged between the Kaldorei and the chimaeras. In those ancient times, there existed a remarkable figure known as Chimaeran. He possessed the rare ability to not only train these noble creatures but also ride upon their backs with unparalleled grace.

[sad] However, tragedy struck during a brutal war with the Maraudine Centaur, for they plundered Chimaeran's legendary harness. Though the centaurs may no longer hold it, reports suggest that it still resides deep within the labyrinthine depths of Maraudon. [urgent] Yet, beware, for other sinister forces, such as the malevolent satyrs, may now be the custodians of this precious artifact.

[commanding] I implore you, venture forth into Maraudon and reclaim the lost harness. [solemn] Its recovery would hold profound significance for the legacy of chimaera trainers and honor the ancient bond that once united our kind.
quest_41052_quest_complete:
<Velos clutches the retrieved harness tightly, his weathered face softening with emotion.
