Tears well up in his eyes as he accepts the artifact from your hands, his voice trembling with gratitude.> [solemn] Friend, you have performed a noble deed, one that rekindles the flame of hope within my heart. [warm] With this long-lost relic restored, I can now dare to dream of a future where I can train and nurture a new generation of chimaeras. [soft voice] Your selfless actions have granted me a sense of closure and a renewed purpose. [proud] I am forever indebted to you.

[warm] In recognition of your unwavering dedication and unwavering support, I offer you this token of my appreciation. [gentle] May it serve you well on your future endeavors.
quest_41053_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our vigil does not end.

[solemn] The Centaur tribes infesting Thousand Needles have been steadily growing more brazen with each passing day, their scouts boldly encroaching on our sacred lands. [urgent] For now, they content themselves with harassing others, but it is only a matter of time before these abominations set their sights on our town.

[commanding] My scouts have reported the presence of a Centaur messenger, bearing news between the warlords of these lands. [commanding] We cannot allow them to continue to scheme and plot against us unchecked. [urgent] We must discover their plans, and we must do so quickly.

[commanding] I trust that you possess the necessary skills to eliminate this messenger and seize any messages that they bear. [angry] I have no patience for failure.
quest_41053_quest_complete:
[confident] You have retrieved the message. [warm] Good work. [urgent] Now show me that.

<Commander Anashya takes the message from you and carefully reads it, her eyes scanning the words with a furrowed brow>

[solemn] Interesting... [urgent] They are preparing to attack the tauren.
quest_41054_quest_detail:
[solemn] I bear no love for the traitorous tauren, who allied with the demon-tainted defilers of our sacred lands. [urgent] Despite this, duty beckons, and we must aid them still. [commanding] The politics of the Horde and Alliance matter not in this moment. [solemn] The honor of the Kaldorei shall not be tarnished again, and we shall not stand idly while innocent blood is shed.

[commanding] I shall dispatch a diplomat to the tauren to inform them of their precarious situation. [urgent] Meanwhile, I beseech you to venture forth and thin the centaur numbers, granting the taurens of Freewind more time to prepare their defenses. [solemn] Return to me with twenty of their bracers as proof of your deed. [soft voice] May Elune's light guide your path.
quest_41054_quest_progress: [soft voice] Centaurs can be found mostly in the northern parts of Thousand Needles. [urgent] Waste no time.
quest_41054_quest_complete:
[solemn] Your efforts have yielded crucial time for the tauren, and our diplomat has returned from their meeting. The tauren expressed deep gratitude for the information provided, and their appreciation resonates within our hearts.

[proud] Never again shall shame befall us.
quest_41055_quest_progress:
[solemn] Dreamscale is a rare and difficult material for us to get our hands on. [soft voice] Even since the paths to Emerald Sanctum have been sealed it has been ever difficult to obtain.

[gentle] If you are willing to assist, I can trade two Bright Dream Shards in exchange for five Dreamscales at any time. [warm] Dreamscale(5)
quest_41055_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, everything seems to be in order here, [warm] your assistance to our efforts is well appreciated, here, take this.
quest_41056_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stored within the armory are many weapons, armor and great relics of old. [soft voice] These items are extremely powerful, and laden with intense enchantments. [solemn] I have been authorized to offer such items to those who have proved themselves as worthy allies here in Hyjal.

[warm] If you desire the Drape of Nordrassil, bring me one hundred and fifty Bright Dream Shards, and it shall be yours.
quest_41056_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you brought the Dream Shards adventurer?
quest_41056_quest_complete: [solemn] May this relic from our armory serve you well, and assist you in whatever battles may yet come.

[gentle] If you desire the Cloverlink Belt, bring me one hundred and fifty Bright Dream Shards, and it shall be yours.

quest_41061_quest_complete: [solemn] May this relic from our armory serve you well, and assist you in whatever battles may yet come.
quest_41062_quest_detail:
[solemn] In your grasp rests the elusive Scythe of Elune, an ancient artifact veiled in mystery and pulsating with unimaginable power. [soft voice] Its journey to this very moment remains an enigma—how it arrived here and why, questions that demand answers. [pause] Yet, for now, the imminent priority is to quell the devastation wrought by this extraordinary relic.

[commanding] Slay Clawlord Howlfang, leader of the worgen in Karazhan. [urgent] Only by severing his tyrannical grasp over the worgen can you hope to restore order amidst the chaos.

[solemn] Once accomplished, seek answers from Lord Ebonlocke about the enigmatic Scythe.
quest_41062_quest_progress: [commanding] Yes, mortal? [soft voice] How can I assist you?
quest_41062_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Scythe of Elune... A cursed artifact of profound power, was brought to this sacred ground of Karazhan by one of the Dark Riders—a being bound by both time and shadows. The memory of their arrival, though it feels both recent and ancient, is hazy, for time weaves a tapestry that confounds my mind.

[sad] Blackwald, that wretched being reveled in the acquisition of the Scythe. His malevolence knew no bounds, finding delight in the possession of such a powerful relic. The halls of Karazhan resonated with his twisted satisfaction.

[commanding] Do not dare to even think of using it now. It has been in the possession of a dark power for far too long, and I fear that it would only bring more destruction, even if your intentions are just.
quest_41063_quest_detail:
I wish I could tell you more about it, but alas, [sad] in my state, I was unable to procure any meaningful information. Lord Blackwald used it to summon the worgen to Karazhan, and they more or less obeyed his command.

As for the Dark Riders, they are cursed to be artifact hunters, crafted in the twisted image of the righteous knights by Medivh himself. Though his presence has long faded, these relentless hunters continue their pursuit, tirelessly acquiring treasures for an unknown master.

[soft voice] Oh, how I long for the ability to unmask the hidden purpose behind this mysterious relic. However, I offer you a glimmer of hope in your quest. [solemn] Seek those who, perhaps unwittingly, aided the Dark Riders in their pursuit. Turn your gaze towards my former realm, once known as Great Hamlet, where secrets and whispers intertwine. [solemn] It is there that your search may bear fruit, as rumors tell of worgen now roaming the kingdom, their presence a testament to a connection with the Scythe.
quest_41063_quest_complete: I beg you, stay away from the Scythe of Elune! [shouting] It brought doom upon Duskwood when I last touched it. [sad] I am haunted by the consequences of that cursed relic. [soft voice] Please, abandon any thought of seeking it. [urgent] Its power is a poison that twists fate and brings tragedy. [solemn] Let it remain forgotten, its dark legacy buried in shadow.
quest_41064_quest_detail:
[urgent] You have it in your possession? No, no, no! It's awful, IT should've never been found! The return of the dreaded Dark Riders looms on the horizon, their vengeance seeking to claim my life and unleash ruin upon the entirety of Duskwood!

Yet, twisted as it may be, it is still preferable that the Scythe rests in your hands rather than theirs. [hesitant] However, I must confess that my knowledge of this relic is scarce. Although I held it in my grasp for a fleeting moment, I swear upon my fragile existence that I am oblivious to its true nature. I know nothing!

It was in the desolate depths of the old mine, known as Roland's Doom, that fate thrust the Scythe into my trembling hands. Go there, if you must. But be wary- it's overrun by worgen, or even darker beings.
quest_41064_quest_progress: [solemn] I sense the Scythe of my Goddess... [hesitant] Who are you?
quest_41064_quest_complete:
[solemn] l, stand before you, observing the return of the Scythe to me, now wielded by unfamiliar hands. [soft voice] A sense of both relief and concern washes over me, for my spirit could never find solace while this sacred relic remained lost to the ages.

[hesitant] Tell me, brave one, how did you come to possess the Scythe?
quest_41065_quest_detail:
[solemn] Dark Riders... Their relentless pursuit was swift, sensing my presence the moment I stepped into Duskwood. [urgent] Fleeing was futile, they hungered for the power of the Scythe, their insatiable desire driving them forward without respite. [commanding] I fortified my position, calling upon my loyal worgen companions to stand by my side, yet their might proved overwhelming, and I fell beneath their dark influence. [defiant] In my final act of defiance, I pierced their heart with my spear, knowing my sacrifice would not be in vain.

[sad] Alas, it appears that the Scythe was ultimately retrieved by those malevolent beings. [shocked] I shudder to contemplate the vile purposes they intended to unleash upon the world with its power. [soft voice] It is a relief to know that the artifact now rests within your hands, for I believe there is still hope that you may wield it with its original purpose.

[urgent] Wait. Do you hear that?
quest_41065_quest_complete: [solemn] You've seen it.[pause] They will not stop until the Scythe is back in their hands.[pause] You may run, you may hide, but it is pointless. They will find you.[pause] However, there is still a chance.
quest_41066_quest_detail:
I was gifted the Scythe at the Shrine of Mel'Thandris. Its ability to summon worgen helped me to turn the tide in the fight against corruption of Felwood. Yet, I was losing control of them. I needed help.

I departed from the forests of Ashenvale with a purpose in mind—to seek counsel from the wizard Arugal, who too had called upon the worgen.[solemn] I yearned to understand the connection between these creatures and the favor bestowed upon them by Elune.

But... Arugal... dead? Elune's tears, the news strikes me with sorrow.[sad] In this moment, there is only one person we can turn to, one who possesses the wisdom and knowledge to guide us further. Arch Druid Dreamwind, a scholar of the otherworldly, may hold the key to unraveling the mysteries of our realms and beyond. Seek him out, and recount to him the tale that has befallen me. When I departed Kalimdor, he stood at the forefront of the efforts to heal Nordrassil.
quest_41066_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome to Nordanaar. [soft voice] How may I assist you?
quest_41066_quest_complete: [solemn] So this is the fate of sister Velinde. [sad] A tragic tale indeed.
quest_41067_quest_detail:
[solemn] The name worgen resonates through the echoes of history, evoking memories of ancient times. Eons ago, during the reign of Queen Azshara, her mages delved into forbidden arts, opening portals to realms beyond mortal comprehension.

Worlds of Buring Legion, engulfed by the Emerald Flame, worlds of absolute cold, worlds of inimaginable darkness.

Among these realms was one known as Vorgendor, world of Blood. The knowledge surrounding it has long faded, concealed in the annals of forgotten lore for good reason.

However, in the depths of my ancient wisdom, I can guide you towards a beacon of knowledge. [soft voice] A human mage by the name of Ur dedicated himself to the study of this enigmatic realm. It is said that he penned a tome, a testament to his understanding and exploration of Vorgendor. If the mages of Dalaran are no longer in possession of this invaluable book, I believe it may be found within the expansive library of Lord Nefarius.
quest_41067_quest_complete:
[solemn] It seems that only a few pages are intact. [sad] Shame, as the book will be no use for us in this state.

[hesitant] There is one other place where such book could be stored, but no one has stepped foot there in many years. [whispering] Library of Karazhan...
quest_41068_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Purple Lotus is a somewhat common material that we are always using for various purposes. [gentle] You would be surprised just what you can get done with this herb!

[warm] If you can amass a large bulk of Purple Lotus, we can trade this herb for two Bright Dream Shards. [commanding] Bring me eighty Purple Lotus and we can exchange at any time. [emphasis] Purple Lotus(80)
quest_41068_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, everything seems to be in order here, [warm] your assistance to our efforts is well appreciated, here, take this.
quest_41069_quest_progress: [solemn] Black Lotus is a scarce and extremely rare herb that the druids of Nordrassil use for very important purposes. [soft voice] Much of the magic here can be amplified by the addition of its magical properties! [warm] Bring me a single Black Lotus, and I will trade you two Bright Dream Shards in exchange at any time. [solemn] Black Lotus
quest_41069_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, everything seems to be in order here, [warm] your assistance to our efforts is well appreciated, here, take this.
quest_41070_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have seen the devastation that the corruption of nature can bring. [solemn] Felwood is a stark reminder of this truth. [soft voice] However, this glade here remains pure, and it is all thanks to Ethwyr.

<The druid pauses, his head bowed in reverence for a moment, before continuing.>

[sad] His sacrifice, however, touched only those closest to him. [solemn] We must honor his legacy by continuing to cleanse Felwood of corruption.

[pause] To the west lies the ancient glade known as Irontree Woods, a place steeped in both beauty and darkness. [soft voice] It is there that you shall face the heart-wrenching sight of crazed treants.

[urgent] From the fallen bodies of these treants, claim six branches tainted by their suffering. [solemn] Though tainted they may be, these branches possess a latent power. [warm] Bring them to me and we shall breathe new life into their corrupted essence.
quest_41070_quest_progress: [solemn] Despite the stern decree of Yohan, who forbids us from venturing into the treacherous depths of the Irontree Woods, fate has conspired to bring you, an outsider, to our aid. [soft voice] Bound by the laws of our land, Yohan's power wanes in the presence of one untethered to our traditions. [hesitant] Yet, I caution you, for his watchful eyes may still cast their gaze upon our endeavors.
quest_41070_quest_complete: [solemn] Your act of mercy has granted solace to the tormented treant souls in the Irontree Woods. [warm] For that, I am forever grateful.
quest_41071_quest_detail:
[solemn] A bear! What creature in the wilds could match its magnificence and dominance? It is no mere coincidence that our druids have long revered this form, receiving blessings from Ursoc and Ursol themselves.

[sad] However, it greatly pains me to witness these noble creatures succumbing to the fel corruption that plagues these woods. [soft voice] Despite Ethwyr's selfless sacrifice, it appears that our attempts to heal them have only brought more suffering to these unfortunate beasts.

[urgent] Therefore, I beseech you: venture into the woods and bring an end to the suffering of the twenty bears who call these lands their home. [solemn] It will not be an easy task, but do it for the sake of nature.
quest_41071_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you brought peace to these forests?
quest_41071_quest_complete:
[solemn] I find solace in the belief that the spirits of the creatures we have lost in these dark times have found their way back to the Emerald Dream. [soft voice] There, they may roam freely and peacefully with the great bear spirits Ursoc and Ursol, who watch over the natural balance of our world.

[pause] Despite the current state of these lands and the suffering that has occurred, I hold onto the hope that in time, the wounds will heal and the forest will once again be a place of harmony and tranquility.
quest_41072_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ishnu-alah, <class>. [soft voice] What a favorable event meeting you here. [low voice] I was sent to Felwood to guard the Talonbranch Glade. However, druid Wildwalker sent me away. [hesitant] I suspect he believes me to be a spy. [mocking tone] Ironically, he has now made me into one.

[pause] I would like to know why he would object to being guarded, and sending another sentinel would give my concealed intentions away. [urgent] Would you speak to Wildwalker and find out what is going on? [solemn] Return to me once you have identified the intentions of his superiors.
quest_41072_quest_complete: [soft voice] I suppose I could find some use for you.
quest_41073_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is my duty to investigate the mysteries of nature and protect the balance of the forest. [sad] However, our current mission has been a failure thus far, and it fills me with anger and frustration.

[solemn] The Grove of the Ancients to the southwest, once alive and vibrant, now lays dead and lifeless. [sad] Their sacrifice was in vain, unlike that of Ethwyr, who was able to cleanse this settlement of corruption. [urgent] I need to know why.

[soft voice] One of our own, Marlonias Shademoon, has been sent to investigate the grove. [angry] However, he has yet to return, and knowing his lazy demeanor, he is likely preoccupied with finding new ways to avoid fulfilling his duties.

[commanding] Locate him and remind him of his responsibilities. [angry] He has a mission to fulfill, and I will not tolerate any negligence on his part.
quest_41073_quest_complete: [soft voice] Please, help me... [urgent] I have been ambushed by a group of furbolgs. [hesitant] I cannot fail Yohan...
quest_41074_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Allow me a moment to collect myself.

<The druid pauses, struggling to focus, his injuries clearly affecting him.>

Pay no heed to my wounds, they will heal in time. Listen closely. The furbolgs who attacked me not only caused me harm, but also stole my precious notes. [urgent] I must retrieve them, but my condition prevents me from doing so at the moment. It is imperative that Yohan remains unaware of what has transpired here. Do you understand? Do not reveal to him that I have lost my notes.

Search for the furbolgs who carried out this attack. I have seen them fleeing towards the east, and may still be encamped in the area. Once you recover my notes, deliver them to Yohan without delay. I must insist that you do not read them, as they contain knowledge that is reserved only for our order.

If Yohan inquires about me, inform him that I will return soon, but I still have some research to finish. I trust in your discretion.
quest_41074_quest_complete:
[shocked] He entrusted the notes to YOU?

<Yohan snatches them out of your hands and reads them hastily>

It's truly astounding how careless he can be with valuable research conducted on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. [solemn] Entrusting it to a mere stranger found wandering in the woods... It's clear that he lacks the discernment and expertise required to be a part of our order.

[commanding] You are dismissed. [warm] Thanks for your assistance.
quest_41075_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You start to carefully scrutinize the pages, scanning each line for any peculiarities or indications of malicious intent.

[solemn] Upon initial inspection, most of the notes appear to be a detailed and extensive research on the treants' magical properties. It describes how the old grove of the ancients was desecrated by Skull of Gul'dan, its corrupting power unmatched by the Ancient's desperate attempts to save the woods.

[urgent] However, as you approach the last few pages of the notes, their contents become particularly alarming. [whispering] They describe how Ethwyr's sacrifice, rather than being a tragedy, could be leveraged for their own gains.

The author of the notes claims that the treant's death has caused an unprecedented growth in the surrounding flora, and that this growth could be used to obtain an extraordinary amount of Morrowgrain without raising any suspicion.

[commanding] Sentinel Briariel will want to hear about it. [emphasis] You tear out the page carefully.
quest_41075_quest_progress: [urgent] You have returned! [soft voice] Have you found anything in the Talonbranch Grove?
quest_41075_quest_complete:
Morrowgrain? Yes, I've heard of it before.

But I always assumed it was nothing more than a rumor. However, it seems that there may be more to this mysterious plant than meets the eye.

[whispering] I've heard whispers that Archdruid Staghelm has been amassing obscene amounts of Morrowgrain for years now. [low voice] Some say that the plant has sinister properties, and that he has some dark purpose in mind.

[solemn] We cannot ignore this. [urgent] We must get to the bottom of it before it's too late. [commanding] If Staghelm has some nefarious plans, it could put the entire Cenarion Circle at risk.
quest_41076_quest_detail:
[solemn] Confronting Wildwalker with the notes would be pointless, as they do not provide any concrete evidence of Morrowgrain actually being used in Felwood. It's all mere speculation at this point.

[soft voice] If the druids have indeed brought Morrowgrain seeds to Felwood, they would have surely hidden them well. [hesitant] However, I believe that the local birds might hold the key to this mystery.

The owls in these lands have had to become resourceful in order to survive. If the druids brought Morrowgrain seeds to Felwood, the owls may have stolen some of them for food.

[sad] It's not a pleasant thought, but it may be our only hope. [urgent] We need to search the intestines of local birds for any signs of Morrowgrain seeds. [soft voice] According to the notes, the seeds have a distinct, reddish color. If you find any, bring them to me immediately. [solemn] It won't be easy, but it's a risk we have to take if we want to uncover the truth behind this mysterious plant and Archdruid Staghelm's obsession with it.
quest_41076_quest_progress: [sad] Poor owls. [soft voice] Have you had any luck finding Morrowgrain seeds?
quest_41077_quest_detail: [soft voice] Please, bring the notes and the seeds to Shandris Feathermoon. [solemn] She is the General of the Sentinel Army, and she will know what the next course of action should be. [hesitant] Oh, remember to mention that it was me who helped you.
quest_41077_quest_complete:
<Shandris glances through the notes, and takes a look at the Morrowgrain Seed.> [solemn] As much as I understand your concern, we must approach this matter with caution. The Cenarion Circle has been a long-standing ally of ours, and their mission is to protect and preserve the natural balance of our world. While their methods may seem mysterious to us outsiders, we must trust that they have the best intentions in mind. [hesitant] I fear that Sentinel Briariel might be a bit... overzealous.

Furthermore, we must not forget that there are greater threats looming over us. The Horde has been encroaching on our lands, my Sentinels mutiny, and we cannot afford to be distracted by more internal disputes. [urgent] Our resources and attention must be focused on defending our home and our people.

[sad] I'm sorry, but this is not enough. For now, the druids in Talonbranch are free to conduct their research in peace.
quest_41078_quest_detail:
[solemn] What is it that you want; sanctity, great knowledge? [sad] You will not find these things here, for the great arcane power of the wizard Medivh has doomed me and my flock to a life of eternal, drifting torment.

[soft voice] We are trapped, to forever wander where we remained in life. [pause] Though there is a possibility to transition to the great beyond, and such a task requires a great excess of arcane energy.

[low voice] If you can gather me arcane materials, I can offer you the invocations I was famous for years ago. [hesitant] Sound like a good proposition?
quest_41078_quest_progress: [solemn] My essence lingers, have you brought the materials?
quest_41078_quest_complete: [solemn] I did not expect to get these materials, [pause] not a soul has offered assistance to any here around Karazhan. [warm] Your generosity will not go unrewarded.
quest_41079_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many great powerful priests have earned the title 'Heirophant' in the past, for their ability to conjure and imbue the Light within great enchantments. [soft voice] This skill is extremely difficult, and only passed on from one master to a student of great standing. [pause] Over time, the number of Heirophants have fallen and with it, the invocations of our past have faded to obscurity, lost to the pages of history.

quest_41083_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, servant!

[angry] I must say, the room service you have here is utterly dreadful. I feel like I have been waiting years for someone to come along and help me with my problem.

[sad] The chambers I have been assigned are not suitable, and I cannot get a wink of sleep. I need a more comfortable pillow, or something of that regard. [urgent] Find one for me so that I may actually get a good night's rest in this place.
quest_41083_quest_progress:
[angry] What, can you not see how serious of a matter this is? [threatening] If you do not hurry up, I will tell your boss just how horrendous of a job you're doing.

[commanding] Now get on with it!
quest_41083_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, at last. Something to put my head down at night. [pause] I can't remember the last time I had a good night sleep... I cannot even remember the last time I did fall asleep oddly enough.
quest_41084_quest_detail: [soft voice] You've been a wonderful help in acquiring this, but I need one last thing before I can get some rest. [commanding] Fetch for me a glass of wine, the best that you have. I am certain that you know exactly what I am talking about. [urgent] Go on now, and find what I'm looking for so I can get some sleep.
quest_41084_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You're looking for wine?

<The Cook lets out a small chuckle of laughter.>

Some of the spirits do not realise the predicament they are in. [solemn] In fact, many still believe they are alive, walking through these halls as they did on the night before their fate was met.
quest_41085_quest_detail:
[solemn] Believe it or not, I do have a recipe for Spectral Wine. [soft voice] Wine that can be consumed by spirits was a concept that I did practice and refine. [pause] It is a somewhat complicated process and requires materials that are foreign here in Karazhan.

[urgent] If you can acquire for me three Essences of Death, five Flasks of Port, and a single Ghost Mushroom, I can make Spectral Wine for Councilman Kyleson. [hesitant] Though, I must question your sanity in going to this trouble.
quest_41085_quest_complete: [solemn] I never once thought I would be using this formula, but here I am.
quest_41086_quest_detail: [soft voice] I have prepared the Spectral Wine for you. Here you are. [gentle] I do hope that Councilman Kyleson is offering you something in exchange for all your work. [commanding] Bring it to him promptly, and do not waste any time. [solemn] After a few years, the Spectral Wine will lose its magical potency, and may just become normal wine.
quest_41086_quest_progress: [low voice] So, have you fetched that wine that I asked for?
quest_41086_quest_complete:
<Councilman Kyleson takes a drink from the Spectral Wine, and looks lost as he savors it for a few, brief moments.> [soft voice] I must say, this is certainly exquisite. [low voice] Nothing has parched my intense thirst for what seems like years. [solemn] Truly, this is the most fascinating wine I have tasted in quite a long time. [warm] You have gone above and beyond to ensure I have been treated well here in Karazhan.

[proud] Such a fine servant, you will go a long way here in Karazhan, and you deserve a worthy tip.

<Kyleson places a single coin in your pocket.>

[gentle] Do not spend such wealth all in one place. [warm] If you need anything at all, just ask me.
quest_41087_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the whispers of ancient legends, tales unfurl about the upper reaches of Medivh's Tower—a sacred haven where the profound wisdom of the Guardians was once safeguarded. [soft voice] Alas, the passage to this sanctum has succumbed to the passage of time, and the tower now stands in disrepair. [sad] The library nestled within the upper parts has been sealed away from mortal reach.

[solemn] Yet, in the tides of destiny, hope gleams amidst the darkness. [gentle] If you can find a means to breach the barriers that guard Upper Karazhan, there exists a chance—an opportunity—that an untouched copy of the precious book lies within its depths. [solemn] The secrets you seek may be held within the hallowed halls, hidden from the ravages of time, awaiting discovery by a determined seeker like you.
quest_41087_quest_progress: [solemn] The Tower of Karazhan looms over the Deadwind Pass.
quest_41087_quest_complete:
[solemn] To witness the life's work of Ur unfold before our very eyes is an extraordinary gift. [soft voice] Though the book bears the scars of time, its essence remains mostly intact, a precious treasure of forgotten knowledge.

[solemn] Let us delve into its ancient pages, embracing the wisdom held within its weathered embrace. [solemn] The secrets of Vorgendor, the mysteries of the worgen, and the truths of realms beyond our own may be unveiled before us. [solemn] And most importantly, the secrets of the Scythe.
quest_41091_quest_progress: [angry] What do you want with me?
quest_41091_quest_complete:
[shocked] There are demons in Hyjal? [urgent] Let me see that Missive!

<He briefly skims the text and then shakes his head>

[commanding] This is encoded, we will need a cipher.
quest_41092_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one type of demon that is agile enough to scale the mountain and stealthy enough to hide from patrols, and that's an Imp.

[soft voice] This imp goes by the name of Zafan, the one who holds their cipher. [sad] This elusive creature has escaped my grasp on many occasions. [hesitant] Perhaps you have the wits about you to find this creature here in Felwood.

[pause] I have often seen this imp near the waterfalls of Felwood. [commanding] I would check there first.

[urgent] Recover the Cipher from Zafan, and bring it to me.
quest_41092_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you find the cipher? [commanding] Don't bother returning without it.
quest_41092_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Well done, now I will use this cipher with the letter and we will know more. <Niremius takes his time inspecting the letter.>

[solemn] This is troubling news indeed. [warm] I have a task for you <class>.
quest_41093_quest_detail:
[solemn] The demons in the crater are a diversion. [soft voice] They are preparing to stage an attack that will distract Hyjal's forces. [solemn] They are only the vanguard, the bulk of the demons are the ones in Darkwhisper Gorge, Archimonde's staging site.

[solemn] Although we do not get along, [soft voice] I know someone who is culling the demons there. [urgent] Find the Warden Kiri Starstalker, inform her of what happened and work with her to stop this. [solemn] I will investigate what the true aims of the demons are. [urgent] Take a copy of the missive to her.

[solemn] Also know this, [soft voice] you will probably need help against the demons there. [solemn] They are not to be trifled with.
quest_41093_quest_complete: [solemn] Niremius sent you? I have no love for his kind, but as long as he kills the demons, I will tolerate his presence in spite of his transgressions. [soft voice] If he sent you to me, then he must have had a very good reason. [hesitant] What is that note?
quest_41094_quest_detail:
<Kiri briefly reads the missive then nods to herself> I see.

[solemn] Your story casts some light on the situation. It is time to wipe out these demons. [commanding] They have far outlived their execution date.

I need you to thin out their main infantry. [urgent] Bring friends if the task is too much for you to handle. [pause] Make sure to talk to Trak'nal too. He may have something for you to do as well.

[soft voice] Our ancestry and beliefs may be different, but our commitment to defend Hyjal is the same.
quest_41094_quest_complete: [solemn] Well done. Every demon we defeat here, means one less demon for their attack.
quest_41095_quest_detail: [solemn] Mon, I be having an issue unrelated to demons. It be my tribe… Most of them have gone mad. [sad] It happened when our Speaker was contacted by a Loa in a dream and told to fashion a Mojo of the Dreams using water near the Emerald Sanctum portal. [urgent] I was fighting the demons at the time, but when I returned, my own tribe attacked me and referred to themselves as the Shadeflayers. [solemn] Madness has overtaken them, but I believe my people can be saved if the source of the corruption is expunged. [commanding] Slay Warlord Hanzento, the one who started this evil, and Find Speaker Gan'hota, it is him who has this Mojo of Dreams. [urgent] You can find them both in Zul'Hatha in western Hyjal.
quest_41095_quest_complete: <Trak'nal takes the Mojo from you and crushes it with his blade.> [solemn] I will not give up on my people. [soft voice] Hopefully, without the corrupting influence of this thing, their minds will be their own again in time. [gentle] I be in your debt, friend. [warm] Thank you.
quest_41096_quest_detail:
[solemn] This should have slowed them down for now. [commanding] Trak'nal and I will continue to mete justice upon these curs.

[urgent] I need you to travel up the mountain and warn the dragon who sent you. The missive mentioned another force, and I suspect this force is underground.

[soft voice] A cave had recently collapsed from the inside, but a demon army could easily remove the rubble and swarm out into the wild.
quest_41097_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes child, can I help you?
quest_41097_quest_complete:
[solemn] This is ill news you bring me. [warm] You have done well in assisting my daughter. The Greens are currently dealing with an emergency here and cannot spare the forces to deal with the demons in the Barrows right this moment.

[confident] Rest assured, however, we will most certainly keep them at bay.

[warm] Take this as a gift for your efforts. [warm] You will find these to be of use here in Nordanaar. [urgent] Now, if you will excuse me, I have much work to do in order to suppress the demon threat.
quest_41098_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings <class>, it has come to my attention that I have received a letter asking specifically for you. [solemn] It is from a Gnome in Gadgetzan.

[low voice] They are called Reas. [urgent] Seek her out and find out what she wants.
quest_41098_quest_complete: [excited] Oh wait! [soft voice] I think I know you.
quest_41099_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hail <class>, I have news for you.

[pause] We got a letter from someone asking specifically for you. It is from a Gnome in Gadgetzan.

[solemn] They are known as Reas. [urgent] We have been asked to inform you that if you are available, you should go there.
quest_41099_quest_complete: [excited] Oh wait! [soft voice] I think I know you.
quest_41100_quest_detail: [soft voice] Greetings <class>, here we are again. [pause] We received a notice asking us to send you down to the Eastern Plaguelands. [solemn] The letter comes from one of the druids stationed there at Light's Hope Chapel.
quest_41100_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, it is you. [hesitant] This is quite an odd turn of events.
quest_41101_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello <class>. [urgent] We received a letter asking us to send you down to the Eastern Plaguelands. [solemn] The letter comes from one of the druids stationed there. [gentle] They go by the name 'Rayne', find them at Light's Hope Chapel.
quest_41101_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, it is you. [solemn] This is quite an odd turn of events.
quest_41102_quest_detail:
Greetings <class>. [soft voice] It looks like it is time for you to get into business again.

[pause] A certain Kex Blowmaster in the Barrens, around Bael'modan, I believe is looking for ‘his trusted partner'. [soft voice] He promises there will be an opportunity to make quite a fortune.
quest_41103_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello <class>, I hope you're having a fine day. [solemn] I have news for you. [low voice] A certain Torble Sparksprocket is asking for your assistance. [gentle] He mentioned that your invaluable aid in his scientific endeavor is needed once more. [urgent] Seek him out in Bael'modan.
quest_41104_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello <class>, it looks like your partner Kex Blowmaster is calling for you again. [warm] He said all the pieces are prepared and he wants you to be there for his great moment. [urgent] Find him in the Barrens in Bael'modan. [warm] You are the guest of honor after all.
quest_41105_quest_detail: [soft voice] Ah, yes hello <class>. We have got another letter for you. Apparently, you have been instrumental in the conclusion of some research in the Barrens. [excited] Your pal Torble Sparksprocket is requesting your presence as the guest of honor in the culmination of his research! [urgent] Better not keep him waiting, eh? You will find him near Bael'modan.
quest_41107_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is glory to be found within the Blood Ring. [commanding] To challenge the champions of the Alliance will bring honor to the Horde in victory. [solemn] It is there where the real heroes of Azeroth can be found.

[urgent] Do your part and bring glory to yourself, and to the Horde.
quest_41107_quest_progress: [commanding] How has the arena treated you, <name>?
quest_41107_quest_complete: [commanding] Our ancestors will cry out your name! [warm] May the word of your glory spread to all in the Horde.
quest_41108_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, do you feel the cheering crowds call your name? [solemn] The glory of honor found inside of Blood Ring is second to none. [urgent] Champions of the Alliance face off against those of the Horde, and it is there we may prove ourselves superior.

[commanding] Do your part in the name of the Alliance.
quest_41108_quest_progress: [commanding] How has the arena treated you, <name>?
quest_41108_quest_complete: [commanding] The might of the Alliance is shown this day!
quest_41111_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was during the last great battle for Hyjal that the recipe for the Dreamsteel Buckle was devised. [soft voice] It was used to empower the druids and sentinels both with the magical properties of the Emerald Dream.

[gentle] If such a pattern is to your liking, I could exchange it in return for Dream Shards. [warm] We are always looking to reward those who have helped here in Hyjal.
quest_41111_quest_progress: [hesitant] So, have you made your choice?
quest_41111_quest_complete: [solemn] May these plans be a powerful asset for you and your allies in the fight against evil.
quest_41112_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've been so consumed by this wretched research for far too long. [sad] Moranna isn't making it any easier on me either. [hesitant] I know that we must somehow uncover the secrets of Ur without his book, but how - how in the blazes can we even go about doing that?

[urgent] Last I heard, the Forsaken of the Horde claimed the book from the Silverlaine Keep - I fear it may be lost to us forevermore. [soft voice] However, I still have hopes. [pause] There was a girl in Shademore Inn who claimed to have escaped Gilneas City by leaping over its walls. [hesitant] My doubts aside, she actually sold me some useful information. It might well be that the library in Gilneas City holds a copy of the Book of Ur.

[soft voice] I would greatly appreciate it if you could retrieve it for me.
quest_41112_quest_progress: [hesitant] I sure wish this is real.
quest_41112_quest_complete: [urgent] Volume Two? I have no idea how this ended up in Gilneas, but I don't even care. I need to bring this back to Moranna as soon as possible. [warm] Just grab your reward from my table; it may not be much, but it's all I have.
quest_41113_quest_detail:
[hesitant] I don't like questioning the boss, but I think he's beginning to lose his mind. [soft voice] We're meant to be thieves, yet where's the money, the treasure, the joy and rush of stealing, looting, and pillaging?

[urgent] I can't persuade Blackthorn to let me and some other brigands raid the city, but you have a bit more leeway. [commanding] All I need you to do is head to Gilneas City's library and steal the portrait of Mia Greymane. [low voice] We'll divide up the spoils.
quest_41113_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is this your first heist job?
quest_41113_quest_complete: [solemn] So it was a portrait of her as a child? [soft voice] Well, it might not be worth much, but that doesn't matter. [warm] A job well done gets paid - honor amongst thieves and such.
quest_41114_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there, mage. You have proven yourself to Theramore, and there is something dire I must ask.

[solemn] Long ago, a Kul Tiran Hydromancer spent considerable time in Gilneas, leaving behind the second manuscript on Hydromancy within the city. [soft voice] Ever since it has been logged into their library, sitting dormant. [solemn] There have been stories of revolt and rebellion there. [commanding] I must ask you to brave this city and recover the manuscript before our enemies learn the secrets of our most powerful magic.
quest_41114_quest_progress: [solemn] This is a matter most dire. [low voice] Have you recovered the manuscript?
quest_41114_quest_complete:
[solemn] Recovered, at last.

<Magus Hallister lets out a breath of relief.>

Our secrets are returned to safe hands. [warm] You have proven yourself a valuable asset, and as a fellow mage I am certain you understand the power of the arcane in the right hands.

[warm] Take this, as thanks from us here in the city.
quest_41115_quest_detail:
[urgent] Listen, Kid. I don't care who you are, or however many fantastic, magical journeys you've been on. [commanding] Go tell all those lads and lasses in the tavern if you're lookin' for praise. I care about the oil that lubricates the system around here. You get what I'm sayin'?

The Cartel, we need gold to organise and run our daily activities. And there are always things that need doin', it's like a fact of life, you know? So... you fund us, and we take notice. [threatening] Maybe even let you break a kneecap every now and then, and we can look the other way. Maybe.
quest_41117_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, mage!

You did well for me, and us magi must look out for one another. [soft voice] I must ask you another favor. This time it is something more personal. [solemn] I have been studying the Temple of Atal'hakkar for some time now, and have heard a mystery about the Tablet of Zef'ek. According to legend, it tells the tale of the great troll warlord who created the temple that rests here in the swamp.

[hesitant] Or something like that anyway. [emphasis] What is more important is the magic imbued within the stone. [urgent] I want you to recover this tablet for me. It is held near the Chamber of Blood, by the chanting Kazkaz the Unholy within the temple. [commanding] Find it, and bring it to me.
quest_41117_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found this mysterious Kazkaz yet?
quest_41117_quest_complete:
The magic flowing from this tablet is intense! [low voice] I would never have expected such energy from the trolls.

[warm] You have done me a solid favor, and for your help I offer you this tome. [soft voice] It should give you the knowledge to teleport to Stonard. [solemn] May my magic serve you well!
quest_41120_quest_detail:
[excited] Aye, laddie! Have ye heard of the legendary Dawnstone Ore? It's a tale of epic proportions, that is! Used to forge armor for our brave paladins durin' the Second War. Those were glorious days indeed!

But let me tell ya, it's a scarce find, that it is! Only one place in this whole wide world where it can be dug up – a mine hidden beneath Gilneas City. [solemn] Aye, there is a curse or somethin' down there, somethin' mysterious that brought this precious ore to the surface. And by the beard of my father, I don't reckon I'd be wantin' to know the true nature of it.

You see, the Greymane Gate's been opened once more, and the political mess in Gilneas has left that mine likely abandoned. So, I'm thinking of gatherin' it for my clients in Undermine. If you can get your hands on twelve hefty chunks of Dawnstone Ore for me, I'll be more than willin' to share some percent of the profits with you. [confident] Now, what say ye? Do we have a deal?
quest_41120_quest_progress: [hesitant] I wonder if the mine is still intact...
quest_41120_quest_complete:
[excited] Aye, the ore, just as I expected! [warm] You've done me proud, lad! [excited] Now, let me gather up these precious rocks and get 'em ready for a journey to Undermine. [delight] Ah, the thought of the profits fills me with joy!

[warm] You've earned yourself a reward, as promised. [gentle] Here, take this with ye, if ye must.
quest_41121_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am Lord Pyrewood of Gilneas. [soft voice] As you may have already heard, a Rebellion has taken command of the Greymane Wall, and it now stands open, beckoning forth a new chapter in our realm. [urgent] I have been sent here by this very Rebellion to implore Stormwind's aid in supporting our cause.

[pause] Yet, amidst these pressing matters, there is a favor I must humbly seek your assistance with. [solemn] During the time Greymane court played host to many guests, a man named Isiden Perenolde graced our halls. [solemn] This man, esteemed by many as the rightful heir to the throne of Alterac, could be of immeasurable value to the Alliance, should he lend his support.

[urgent] Whispers have reached my ears that the Harlows might be holding him captive within the confines of the dreaded Dryrock Pit. [commanding] I entreat you to commence your search there and, should you discover any information pertaining to this esteemed guest, do not hesitate to return it to me.
quest_41121_quest_progress:
[solemn] Isiden Perenolde, the nephew of King Aiden Perenolde, found himself in a precarious situation after Alteraci betrayal of the Alliance. [soft voice] In response to this dire circumstance, Isiden sought refuge in Gilneas.

[pause] As the delicate issue of Alteraci succession gained momentum, Isiden Perenolde's quest for backing led him to the attention of Genn Greymane. [solemn] Recognizing the importance of this matter, King Greymane extended his support to Isiden, adding another layer of complexity to the unfolding events.

[low voice] Ultimately, Alterac was annexed by Strom and Lordaeron, but Isiden remained in Gilneas even after the closure of the Greymane Wall.
quest_41121_quest_complete: <As Ivar peruses the dossier, a palpable sense of disappointment fills his eyes.> [solemn] So, it appears that Isiden has departed from Gilneas. [soft voice] Should he indeed have sought refuge in Tol Barad, we must resign ourselves to the grim possibility of his demise, for naught can withstand the harsh and unforgiving conditions of that island.
quest_41122_quest_detail:
[urgent] Listen here, <class>! I got a real urgent and serious matter that needs your help, right now!

[angry] Those Gilneans have gone and opened up their gates once again, causing a load of trouble for us. [shouting] Blast it! Now their coastal batteries are taking potshots at our transport ships, making trade with the Undercity a real pain in the gut!

[commanding] I need ya to take care of Cannoneer Rileson. He's the scoundrel calling the shots at Freyshear Keep, and he's the one commanding those blasted cannons. [threatening] And don't you dare forget about his henchmen too – deal with them all!

[urgent] Get back to me once you've sent him to the great beyond. We ain't got time to waste.
quest_41122_quest_progress: [urgent] Every moment you linger is another ship lost to this madman!
quest_41122_quest_complete:
[commanding] Good, good.

[solemn] Our shipments to Undercity and Tarren Mill are much safer now, thanks to your actions.
quest_41126_quest_progress:
[solemn] Dark Iron, while plentiful in the Depths, is still a valued commodity amongst the Brotherhood. [solemn] The sacred arms and armaments of Ragnaros favor Dark Iron. [soft voice] Besides the ore, we also accept Dark Iron in bar form, should you possess the skill to smelt it.

[emphasis] For every Dark Iron Bar you offer, [emphasis] favor amongst the Brotherhood you will gain.
quest_41126_quest_complete: [solemn] Your offering has been accepted. [warm] Favor you have gained. [urgent] Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
quest_41127_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our steadfast dwarven allies have recently settled an old Third War outpost in the Stonetalon Mountains. Their leader is my old friend, Whitepeak. I’m sure he would appreciate your help in resettling Stonetalon for the Alliance.

[soft voice] The outpost is called Bael Hardul, if my memory serves. To find it, you must go through the Talondeep Pass, then go south into the mountains. There is a secret path that leads to the outpost.

[gentle] Please send my best regards to Whitepeak if you find him.
quest_41127_quest_progress: [solemn] Aye? I did not expect a visitor today.
quest_41127_quest_complete:
[commanding] Aye, so Delgren sent ya, did he? [laughing] Ha, that lad's a good one, fought by me side in the Third War, he did, under the command of Lady Jaina, bless her heart.

[soft voice] But enough of me ramblin' about the past like an old dwarf. [urgent] There be plenty of work to be done, and we best get to it, sharpish! [urgent] No time to waste, laddie!
quest_41128_quest_progress: [solemn] The transmutation process of Bright Dream Shards can always be undone, reverting the much more powerful material into its weaker components. [soft voice] If you desire me to undo any harmonization, speak with me, and I shall make it so. [gentle] Bright Dream Shard
quest_41128_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work, the harmonization process does not take me long, especially with all this practice. [warm] If you find any more, come and let me know.
quest_41130_quest_detail: I just received a letter that was addressed to you. [soft voice] One of the locals knows you well and requested that you meet with them. [warm] Congratulations once more on your sharp aim and bravery; you are certainly destined to serve the Alliance well. [whispering] Old Jonah has grown impatient due to his advanced age, but please do not let him catch you mentioning it.
quest_41130_quest_progress: Hah! [angry] No respect for the elderly, I see. [angry] Made me wait a painfully long time, you brat.
quest_41130_quest_complete: [solemn] That is but the first lesson, kid. [warm] I did not expect to see such natural talent when it comes to your survivability, but regardless, you should go make yourself useful. [soft voice] As time passes and you gain more insight into the land and your own capabilities, return to me and I will teach you some more.
quest_41131_quest_detail:
[solemn] My grandfather used to tell me stories about what it means to be a Hunter. [soft voice] Somehow, for the various other races of our lands, it seems to be very different. [low voice] For us, as Humans, it's to adapt to nature itself - to use it as a tool, one that we respect. [solemn] Our ancestors tamed the wild horses, cattle, and even the fiercest prowlers, turning them into our trusted companions. [gentle] These human hands can mold the land into many different shapes, and it is our ability to adapt that forges our survivability.

[commanding] I need you to visit Stonefield farm and tame one of the boars. [warm] A boar is strong and durable and can be both a fearsome adversary and a great companion.
quest_41131_quest_progress: [soft voice] Remember to greet Grandma Stonefield while you're at it. [mocking tone] That is if you haven't traded your manners for those of an ogre.
quest_41131_quest_complete: [delight] Congratulations! [excited] You've managed to forge your first bond! [warm] Your tenacity is admirable, my friend.
quest_41132_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I often miss taking a dip in Stone Cairn Lake, but nowadays it's fully ridden with the wildlife, the gruesome gnolls, the slimy murlocs, or the foolish rogues of the Defias. [sigh] Oh well, there's no reason to lament peaceful times, for peaceful times will surely return soon enough.

[solemn] Travel east towards the Logging Camp, and near its outskirts, you should be able to find Prowlers. Compared to the domesticated boar, you may have more difficulty taming this feral creature of the forests. [emphasis] Though scary as it may be, once you've conquered your own fear, you will have no better companion. [warm] For the lupine race is very likely to create a bond with its master that will last for perhaps the rest of its life.
quest_41132_quest_progress: [soft voice] Sometimes, being assertive with Prowlers is the only way to go. [commanding] If you think there is no other way to convince it otherwise, just jump it—bite its ear and show it who the alpha is!
quest_41132_quest_complete: [excited] Great job! [warm] You are ready for your next and final task.
quest_41133_quest_detail:
[soft voice] When faced with a Young Forest Bear, one cannot simply remain indifferent towards its innocence and cuteness. [solemn] They are formidable creatures, despite their youth, and will likely turn aggressive if they sense any threats. [hesitant] To tame one of these beasts is not an easy task. [warm] However, by doing so, you will acquire an unwavering companion who will be by your side forever. [gentle] These bears will scare easily, but they can also be very cuddly once they get used to you.

[urgent] To find them, head to the vicinity of the Logging Camp one more time. [whispering] Oh, and beware of the Tower of Azora—its occupant seems to be a little off his rocker, with a soft spot for Gnomish assistants. [threatening] Steer clear if you value your sanity.
quest_41133_quest_progress: [soft voice] I heard bears love honey. People even say that if one eats too much of it, they turn golden yellow—but my grandfather says that's just a silly myth.
quest_41133_quest_complete: Here we are. [warm] Your final task is complete, and my, what a terrific job you've done. [proud] You've learned the just how to manage animals here in Elwynn.
quest_41134_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You can now tame every kind of beast you wish, but that's only the beginning of forming a bond with one. To do that, you have to learn how to train your new ally. [pause] Don't worry, I know just the guy who can help you: Marven. He resides in Stormwind, in the Park, but he will likely charge you an arm and a leg to teach you the ropes.

[chuckling] This Marven fellow is apparently an accomplished beast tamer, who's even impressed Nesingwary. [hesitant] Although I have no idea who that is either.
quest_41134_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, the newest Quiver. AJ mentioned that I should expect you sooner or later. Judging by your recent success, I can only assume that Daisy did a phenomenal job at teaching you the basics. [warm] Nevertheless, here we go, lesson number two. [commanding] Let's see how you fare.
quest_41135_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was tasked with delivering this tablet to you. As if Nartok, the troublesome warlock, weren't enough, another troll has made its way down to the Valley of Trials. [hesitant] He says he is here to teach aspiring warlocks from the local tribes, claiming that his methods are authentic.

However, I've never been one for curiosity or taking unnecessary risks. I simply want to stay out of trouble and avoid any conflicts, especially when it comes to something as dangerous as fel. [urgent] Just remain vigilant and stay safe.
quest_41135_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Hey mon. I be Zin'jashi, and I welcome you.

I be of the Revantusk Tribe, and I be here to teach young trolls the ways of the Twisting Nether. The demons are powerful subjects mon, but they be very treacherous - so be very careful!
quest_41135_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You don't have to join any orcish coven mon, but you should use them to your advantage. [commanding] This orc here, this Nartok, he be talking too much. [low voice] He doesn't really know how to twist the demons to his advantage, he is just speaking big words like he be some chosen one. [solemn] Never think that mon, by summoning the demons from the Twisting Nether, you've chosen to live your life away from the Loa. And one day that will catch up to you.

[pause] Anyway, if you bring me an offering, me be glad to teach you. [warm] Perhaps one day you will be as strong as the Zandalari Demoniacs!
quest_41136_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to Theramore. Is there anything I could help you with?
quest_41136_quest_complete: [soft voice] Vandol? [pause] Let me check the records.
quest_41137_quest_detail:
<Magus Halister carefully combs through the pages of thick tomes, his eyes scanning every line with an intensity that speaks of decades of study and experience. After several minutes of diligent searching, he finally looks up at you with a wry smile.> [solemn] Ah, yes. Vandol. He was here, in Theramore, some four years ago. Paid a visit to Lady Jaina, in fact. But he did not stay in the city for long. Found it too bustling for an old man like him, I suppose.

According to our records, Vandol purchased a small boat not long after his visit. Loaded it up with vital supplies, food, and even seeds, if you can believe it. He set sail for the south, seeking a quieter life, I imagine. The coastline would be your best bet if you seek to find him.
quest_41137_quest_progress: [soft voice] What brings you to my secluded house?
quest_41137_quest_complete:
I sense that you have come seeking me, and that you know who I really am. [solemn] It seems that my past has finally caught up with me, and I must admit that I am not surprised.

[pause] Take a moment to consider the gravity of what you are about to say. [soft voice] For you see, I have lived a long life filled with both triumphs and tragedies. [low voice] I have seen the fall of great kingdoms, and I have witnessed the atrocities that people are capable of committing in the name of power.

[sad] If you are here to confront me about the sins of my past, and the many mistakes that I have made, then I will not fight back. [defiant] I will accept whatever consequences may come.
quest_41138_quest_detail:
[solemn] Back when the Vault first was opened, it was used to house the most dangerous prisoners, to contain magical entities and the insane alike, we used Runic Constructs to patrol the hallways!

[urgent] These Runic Constructs have fallen corrupt from the intense magic within the Vault, and need to be destroyed, their powerful bracers are what keep them intact, and they need to be recovered! [confident] I have plans to test what exactly went wrong with these bracers.

[commanding] You can find them within the Stormwind Vault, slay them, and bring me a pair of Shackles, I will make sure you are rewarded for the task.
quest_41138_quest_progress: Be careful, the Runic Constructs are quite powerful, [urgent] an overchage of magical energy gone rampant!
quest_41138_quest_complete: [excited] Ahh, here we are! [warm] This is them, thanks again, this means a lot, here, just as I promised.
quest_41139_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many years ago the wizards of Stormwind discovered a large crystal that held an intense amount of magical energy. This crystal we named Arc'Tiras, and stashed it deep within the Stormwind Vault after many mishaps with the unstable magic it emitted.

[hesitant] Little did we know this crystal, Arc'Tiras had a mind of it's own.

[urgent] It has driven the guards mad, and turned the Stormwind Vault into nothing more than corridors of madness. [solemn] Our magic is enough to hold the crystal at bay, for now, but it needs to be destroyed, and for good.

[commanding] Travel into the Stormwind Vault, put an end to this madness.
quest_41139_quest_progress: [urgent] The longer Arc'Tiras remains active, the more danger Stormwind lays within, we cannot have rumors spreading, [solemn] this must be dealt with.
quest_41139_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done, truly?

[warm] Why, thank you <name>, you've saved us a massive headache, and countless lives of this city. [proud] We have requisitioned a reward worthy of such feats from the treasury itself.

[gentle] Please, take one, it is the least we can do.
quest_41140_quest_detail:
Me good-for-nothing brother Sindri over there thinks he can one up me by makin' empty promises to mother - just te stick it up te the ole kvinn! [angry] He damn well know's it is ME who's the better smith 'ere. Just ye wait, brother, I'll smith yer a weapon ye can stick up yer gryphon roost! [proud] Ye will help me with that, stranger.

Ye know the cave at Skulk Rock? The mine still has lots o' mithril in it, but I don't need any ole stinkin' mithril - no, I need etched mithril! [emphasis] Those sludge buggers roamin' there absorb all ore shards lyin' around, but their acid ain't strong enough to destroy it completely. If ye melt it, it becomes incredibly sturdy!

[confident] Sindri might tell ye he read in some ole dusty, crusty book that it won't work, but do ye think me ancestors were readin' books before swinging their hammer? [mocking tone] Ye can bet your arse on it, they didn't!
quest_41140_quest_progress: [soft voice] Seein' his dumb face when mother scoffs at his work gives a feelin' in my belly like nothin' else.
quest_41140_quest_complete:
[excited] Oho! These shards are great. [commanding] Come on, give 'em to me!

<Brok almost rips the mithril shards out of your hand and throws them into the forge.>

[laughing] Ahaha! [excited] This will be grand, mate, I'm tellin' ye! [threatening] Just you wait, Sindri, ye'll be bawlin' your eyes out like ye'll always do!
quest_41141_quest_detail:
[excited] I heard what you were talking about with Brok. Almost impossible with his yapping, you can't even hear your own creative thoughts! [angry] He might've told you that I'm an amateur blacksmith, but that couldn't be further from the truth! [proud] You'll find no one better among us Wildhammer dwarves - besides our dear mother, of course.

[solemn] It is true, however. [confident] I do intend to present Mother with a weapon to prove her once and for all to stop wasting time on that buffoon, who crafts his weapons on emotional whims and disregards tradition, technique and - most of all - class! [threatening] He'd be better off in some backwater Bronzebeard village, if you ask me.

[urgent] Since you helped him, it is only fair that you help me, too. [soft voice] The books I've bought from the recent traveling merchants describe giants of stone created by nature magic. Their bodies are full of energized minerals, ideal for my weapon! [commanding] The lush forests of northern Feralas are the place they call home. Get me some sizable samples from their bodies, please.
quest_41141_quest_progress: [soft voice] Brok is so full of himself. [chuckling] The pout he's showing when proven wrong is priceless, I'm telling you!
quest_41141_quest_complete: [delight] That's marvelous, just look at all the energy emanating from it! [laughing] Haha, I can't lose with this at my disposal! <Sindri is gazing into the chunks of stone and quickly forgets about you.>
quest_41142_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Although I love me boys, I wish I could whack 'em over their heads with me hammer when I see 'em like this. [sad] If they'd stop their bickerin', they'd be able te achieve so much more.

I'm not the lass to sugarcoat 'em, maybe their father would've, but that disappointment of a man is long gone. [solemn] We will make our own weapon te remind both of 'em, what real dwarven smithin' looks like. [low voice] They were on the right track, but they sadly lack vision. [commanding] We will combine both of their ideas.

[urgent] Your adventurer friends tell the wildest stories about the most mind-bogglin' creatures. [solemn] In the white ravines of Maraudon in Desolace lives the giant Landslide, made of pure marbled stone. [whispering] Rumors say deep within the Hateforge Quarry of the Burning Steppes, the acid pools are so potent, a bein' manifested itself from them!

[commanding] Te smith a truly powerful weapon, bring me pieces of both of their bodies.
quest_41142_quest_progress: [low voice] Let's bring me boys back down to earth.
quest_41142_quest_complete:
Incredible materials, both of 'em. Ye did great work. Here, have some coin for your troubles.

[warm] Brok and Sindri have expertise, they're me sons after all! They have te get past their differences one day and reflect on what the other does and they themselves don't.

[soft voice] Brok is te emotional in his work, if he gets a sudden idea, he rushes off te try it out only te see it could've never had worked te begin with. [sad] Sindri is too strict on himself - doesn't trust his skills - that's why he always follows anythin' he does by the book. And that in turn shortens his horizon.

[commanding] Enough sentimental chatter, let's put them in their place!
quest_41143_quest_detail:
Alright, the weapons are ready. [proud] Just look at 'em with that smirk on their faces, pah! [angry] A smith can be proud, sure, but stayin' humble is equally important. [solemn] That's a lesson they will now get taught.

[commanding] Just stay and watch the lecture, it's gonna be a blast.
quest_41143_quest_complete:
[soft voice] That didn't go as bad as I thought. Guess it's finally time for both of 'em to grow up and become real blacksmiths. Don't get me wrong, they still got lots of improvin' te do, but there's no need te walk the path of blacksmithing alone. They got me, they got themselves. [proud] I love me boys with all me heart, so don't ye think I'll be lettin' em do this on their own. Besides, me forge wouldn't stand long if I left 'em alone!

<Frig's hearty laughter fills the forge.>

[warm] Since ye did most of the work, ye can keep the weapon I made, a true Thunderforge masterpiece!
quest_41144_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ye kno', we Wildhammers weren't always 'ere in these wild lands. We used to live underground, just like our fair brothers, the Bronzebeards. I have never seen our great city of Grim Batol, but me grandfather Bemoth told me stories about it in front of the hearth.

[soft voice] Ye can't say that the Wildhammers from the past are the same than the current ones, they're just differen'. Sure, some traditions took over, but we also made new customs, more fittin' fer us gryphon riders.

<Doran looks you up and down and hesitates for a bit.>

[confident] Interested in learnin' about 'em, eh? 'ere, lemme show ye.

Young Wildhammer are s'pposed to make their own headdress out of feathers before turning of age - as a rite of passage, if ye will. [urgent] If ye wanna make ye own, get some feathers from the owlbeasts roaming the Hinterlands. Don't forget to get different colours, me friend.
quest_41144_quest_progress: [soft voice] If a fledgling is about to leave the nest, what better way to help it fly than givin' it some feathers, eh?
quest_41144_quest_complete: <Doran's voice sounds a bit shaky, the old dwarf takes the feathers with utmost caution.> [delight] These are magnificent, thank ye very much fer your interest in our traditions, me friend. [warm] Now that we have the feathers, we need a framin' to put them in.
quest_41145_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Usually the wee lads would hunt for their own leather, but I am not sure if yer knowledgeable in the art of skinnin'.

[pause] Speak with me good friend Drakk Stonehand just down the stairs, he's our master leatherworker, ye won't find any better work than from his crafty hands.

[warm] Tell him Doran sent you, the ole chum still owes me one, he'll help an adventurer like ye out anytime.
quest_41145_quest_complete: [excited] Aye, welcome to Aerie Peak! [warm] Anythin' I can help ye with?
quest_41146_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Doran sent ye, eh? Well, he is a close friend, that's fer sure. [pause] And he wants me to help ye with a feathered headdress, like our fledglings do?

<Drakk is silent for a moment.>

[commanding] If ye wanna do it the Wildhammer way, ye have to get the leather yerself, wouldn't be authentic otherwise, would it? [warm] Here's the deal - get me fifteen silvermane hides for me stock and I will make you a framin' from one of the finest leathers I have.

[soft voice] What? Doran told ye, I owe him one? [gentle] Don't worry, I'm doin' this for Doran, but ye still have to have the entire experience, ye kno'? [commanding] We don't' wanna sugarcoat you or anythin', eh?

[warm] Here, take this skinnin' knife, it isn't as hard as many would say, ye just have to carefully sever the skin from the meat and tissue. [confident] With all the slashin' ye adventurers do, I'm sure ye will get the hang of it in no time. [gentle] Just try not to cut yerself, chum! <Drakk cackles and hands you the skinning knife.>
quest_41146_quest_progress: [urgent] How's the hunt? [commanding] Don't let ole Doran wait too long!
quest_41146_quest_complete: [soft voice] Not bad, not bad. Fer an amateur, this ain't too shabby. [warm] Thank ye for the help and thank ye fer doin' this fer Doran. [gentle] Ye might not realize how important this is fer 'im.
quest_41147_quest_detail:
Here, this framin' is one of me finer works, ye can bet yer bum on that.

[proud] I've known Doran fer almost a decade now, he's a good fellow. His heart is in the right place, but ever since his lass passed away, he ain't the same anymore. [sad] Now he seems distant and lost reminiscin' of past stories, he surely told you about it. [soft voice] It's heartbreakin' seein' him like that, I can assure ye.

[pause] Take the framin' with ye, Doran will show ye how to finish the headdress. <Drakk hands you the framing and sends you off with a deep sigh.>
quest_41147_quest_progress: [excited] Yer back, did Drakk remember my favor?
quest_41147_quest_complete: <Doran takes the framing from you, slowly and with shaking hands. He again has trouble finding words.> [gentle] Thank ye, kind friend. [warm] We're almost done.
quest_41148_quest_detail:
Here, take a closer look, us Wildhammer have a certain technique on how to sew the feathers to the headdress. [solemn] Ye can't learn this anywhere else. They're passed down from generation to generation...

<You watch Doran sew the feathers to the headdress. He looks more distressed than before, but is very diligent and graceful with both framing and feathers.>

[pause] Aight, this is how a real Wildhammer headdress is crafted, if yer were a fledgling ye'd take this to yer first gryphon ridin' lesson. [warm] Wearin' it while yer bondin' to yer gryphon is a magical moment in the life of any adolescent Wildhammer. [soft voice] I still remember mine like it was yesterday. Ya, like yesterday...

<Doran pauses for a moment and takes a deep breath.>

[pause] I'm sorry, friend. [sad] I told ye this is fer ye, but would ye be kind enough to put the headdress on a grave on Aerie Peak's graveyard? It is the tombstone between the rune-marked trees, to yer right as ye enter.

[urgent] If ye could do this fer me, this ole dwarf would be forever in yer debt.
quest_41148_quest_progress: [solemn] This must be the gravestone Doran told you about.
quest_41149_quest_complete: [solemn] I am sorry fer not speakin' the whole truth. Ye see, today would've been my son Dulin's sixteenth birthday, the age at which Wildhammers become men of the skies.
quest_41177_quest_detail:
[solemn] The hour has arrived for you to delve into the art of taming nature itself. [soft voice] Among us Rangers, an unwavering bond with nature has always prevailed, with many forging connections with animal companions on our journeys.

[pause] To comprehend this connection, this synergy with the wild, you must first demonstrate your readiness. [commanding] Take this taming rod – a tool that will grant you the power to tame an Elder Crimson Lynx. [solemn] Subdue this majestic creature, showcasing your prowess as a ranger. [warm] Your initiation into the ways of the wild begins with this task.
quest_41177_quest_progress: [solemn] You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
quest_41177_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work. [warm] You have proven to be a capable ranger...
quest_41178_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Not every beast mirrors the ferocity of the lynxes that roam these lands. [solemn] It's crucial to recognize the regal and majestic facets of the wild. [warm] The Ivory Hawkstriders, once graced the company of royalty, serving as mounts for the Sunstriders.

[commanding] Take this taming rod, and endeavor to tame an Ivory Hawkstrider. [solemn] This task demands a distinct approach, affording you insights into the multifaceted nature of these creatures. [soft voice] It is through this encounter that you shall come to comprehend the true essence of the beasts that share our world.
quest_41178_quest_progress: [solemn] I am proud of your accomplishments, <name>. [warm] Have you finished the last task I gave you?
quest_41179_quest_detail:
[solemn] As Quel'dorei, our intrinsic connection to magic sets us apart. Yet, in the realm of beasts, there exists a creature born of the pure mana of the Sunwell – the mana wyrms. [soft voice] Your ultimate challenge lies in taming a Lavender Mana Wyrm, dwelling amidst the southern hills.

If you can successfully tame this creature, you'll not only assert mastery over the beast but also showcase your prowess in the arcane arts. The Lavender Mana Wyrm represents a fusion of our elven heritage and the magical energies that course through Azeroth. [solemn] May your endeavors prove you a true master of both.
quest_41179_quest_progress: [solemn] Understanding the balance between nature and magic is a way of life for every <name>.
quest_41179_quest_complete:
[solemn] Congratulations. You've demonstrated your worthiness to master the art of beast taming, and I take pride in your accomplishments. [confident] I am confident that you will bring honor not only to yourself but to all of us.

[warm] Allow me to share a piece of advice: Exercise discretion when selecting your first companion. Will it be a creature of the land, a denizen of the water, or a creature soaring in the skies? [soft voice] Whichever you choose, remember that your chosen companion shall be by your side for a considerable journey. [warm] Choose wisely, and may your bond with your pet be enduring and fruitful.
quest_41180_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've gained the power to tame a companion, yet the journey has just begun. To truly harness the potential of your new ally, seek the guidance of the foremost hunter among our people – Ranger-General Halduron Brightwing.

[soft voice] He stands as a paragon of our craft, and you'll find him in the southern reaches, stationed beside the Last Runestone. [urgent] There, he leads our forces in an unyielding battle against the Scourge.

[commanding] Approach him, and under his tutelage, refine the skills needed to train and command your newfound companion.
quest_41180_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, a fledgling ranger stands before me. [gentle] Come, friend. [soft voice] Embarking on the path of a ranger seems like a distant memory now, a life I can scarcely recall from the era before the fall of our homeland. [solemn] Yet, it is the vitality and spirit of young hunters like yourself that kindle the flames of hope for the reclamation of our ancestral lands.

[warm] Allow me to impart the knowledge of training and guiding your newfound companion. [warm] Henceforth, you shall not only instruct your pet in acquiring new abilities but also nourish and revive it should it face the perils of battle. [solemn] This marks the beginning of a crucial chapter in your journey as a ranger. [warm] May you wield this knowledge with skill and purpose.

[warm] I hope we will speak again soon.
quest_41187_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh, by the Sunwell, another caravan? It feels like the very ground beneath us is groaning from the weight of weary travelers. [solemn] There's scarcely enough space to catch one's breath, let alone find a place to rest.

[gentle] Please, find a small patch of ground, any corner will do, and try to make it yours, at least for now. [soft voice] Unpack your belongings, as meager as they may be. [sad] It seems as if we're all carrying the weight of shattered lives in our hands.

[pause] Take a moment to collect yourself amidst the chaos. [soft voice] And look, there's Commander Anarileth, over there, orchestrating what little order we have left. [solemn] She seems to be in need of capable souls, and by the look of you, resilience marks your spirit.

[commanding] Approach her when you can, offer your aid. [solemn] May the Light guide us through these dark times.
quest_41187_quest_progress: [solemn] Ah, it warms my heart to witness more of our kin finding their way to this newfound sanctuary. [soft voice] Isn't it a sight to behold? [gentle] There's a certain magnificence in the familiarity of these surroundings, reminiscent of the outskirts of Silvermoon City.
quest_41187_quest_complete:
[solemn] Aerthand's judgment has proven sound in sending you my way. [warm] You bear the mark of capability, unmistakable in your presence, <class>. [soft voice] There's no doubt we could use your skills in this tumultuous time.

[urgent] There's much to be done, and with every caravan that arrives, our needs grow. [commanding] Are you ready to lend your hand to our cause?
quest_41188_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Regency Council has bestowed upon me the responsibility of providing sustenance and shelter for all those who seek refuge in this land. [soft voice] A task, noble in intent, but one burdened by a stark lack of resources.

[pause] The local boar population is abundant, a potential source of nourishment for our people. [hesitant] However, the reality is harsh—many here lack the necessary equipment or skills to hunt them down. [commanding] It falls upon shoulders willing and able to bridge this gap.

[urgent] If you have the means and the skill, could you gather at least ten young boar flanks for our cause? [warm] It would be a tremendous help in easing the hunger that gnaws at the spirits of those who have sought safety here.
quest_41188_quest_progress: [soft voice] You can find boars all over this valley.
quest_41188_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <class>. [warm] Your willingness to contribute is like a small beacon of hope in the vast sea of our needs. It may seem like a mere drop amidst the ocean of challenges we face, but with each kind gesture, we inch closer to the restoration of our former glory.
quest_41189_quest_detail:
[solemn] During your foray into the wilderness, I'm sure you observed the growing threat posed by the lynxes that plague these forests. While they may be a mere nuisance at present, we cannot afford to let their population spiral out of control.

[soft voice] I must task you with a somber duty: venture once more into the woods and cull the young of these lynxes. We cannot permit their numbers to swell, for the safety and well-being of our people depend on maintaining a balance in this newfound home.
