quest_41189_quest_progress: [soft voice] Remember, it's the young ones you are after.
quest_41189_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, a welcome relief to know that the burgeoning threat of the lynx population has been curbed. [warm] Your actions bring a sense of solace, and I can rest easier knowing that you've shouldered this responsibility for our community, young <class>.
quest_41190_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey there! New face, right? Pleasure's mine – I'm Dalicia, but you can just call me Dal! [solemn] Been part of Alah'Thalas since its very beginnings, and let me tell you, I've been putting my culinary skills to work around here. [soft voice] I'm the resident cook, and if I do say so myself, the rations these refugees are getting are downright laughable. [sad] Dry meat, and Elwynn's rotting grain? Not exactly fit for the Quel'dorei palate.

[urgent] Now, here's the thing: I'm itching to whip up my famous goulash, but they're not letting me get my hands on the right ingredients. [warm] If you could do me a solid and gather some Forest Hawkstrider legs and Lynx steaks, we'll have a feast fit for our people in no time! [delight] Let's turn this drab menu into something worth savoring!
quest_41190_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, finally! A bounty of good, fresh ingredients to work with. [warm] Thank you a thousand times over! [delight] It's about time we bring some flavor to this place, don't you think?
quest_41191_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you there!

<Avenant lowers his voice, a sense of urgency in his tone.>

[soft voice] For a while now, I've had my eye on that lady over yonder. [hesitant] No need to turn and stare, mind you; subtlety is key. [sad] The catch is, she's not exactly warming up to my advances. [excited] Now, here's where you come in—I'm thinking a beautiful flower crown could work wonders, don't you agree?

<Avenant glances around cautiously before continuing.>

[hesitant] Embarrassingly enough, I'm not exactly the bravest soul when it comes to venturing into the forest alone. Lynxes, spiders, you name it—I've seen them all, and it gives me the shivers. [soft voice] So, here's the deal: If you could gather some flowers for me, I might just stand a chance at winning the heart of that lovely lady. [soft voice] What do you say?
quest_41191_quest_complete:
[solemn] You must be jesting.

[sad] To think these flowers could sway anyone, let alone win the favor of someone as fair as she is—it's a futile endeavor. [sad] Worthless, utterly worthless. [sad] Winning her heart seems like an insurmountable task. [sad] I'll likely wither away in solitude here, far from the homeland that once held the promise of connection.

[sad] Just leave me be, so I can indulge in my melodrama in peace. <Avenant dismissively throws away the flowers with a touch of contempt.>
quest_41192_quest_detail:
Do you see these... withered husks?

<Phylas sighs with frustration, his gaze fixed on the malnourished, once-elves>

[solemn] We may very well end up like this if the Silver Sun Mine remains unreclaimed. [soft voice] The arcane golems, once loyal laborers, have been struck by some sort of arcane discharge – no doubt the handiwork of those so-called Blood Elves. [angry] It's driven them mad! [urgent] The mine is now inaccessible, and we've been severed from the source of those sweet, sweet arcane crystals.

<Phylas shrugs, a mix of resignation and frustration on his face.>

[sad] But alas, the Regency Council seems more interested in courtly backstabbing than offering any meaningful assistance. [low voice] So, if you've got the mettle for it, maybe you could clear out the mine of these deranged arcane golems? [commanding] Payment, of course, will be in clear silver. [warm] A fair compensation for a dangerous task.
quest_41192_quest_progress: [solemn] Every moment you linger means less arcane crystals for those in need.
quest_41192_quest_complete: [solemn] The common folk yet again take matters into their own hands, endeavoring to mend the fallout left by those who consider themselves above such concerns. [warm] Thank you, <class>. [proud] You have saved many.
quest_41193_quest_detail:
<name>, may I borrow a moment of your time? [soft voice] Your past assistance has not gone unnoticed, and there's a delicate matter that requires your attention.

[solemn] It appears we are not alone in this new refuge. [urgent] Our scouts have reported the presence of a significant force atop a nearby hill—our former brethren, the so-called blood elves. [commanding] They are loyal to the traitorous prince, Kael'thas, and their dependence on dark magic clouds their judgment. [low voice] They pose a threat to our cause, and their proximity to Brinthilien raises concerns.

[emphasis] I must task you with a challenging mission: seek out and eliminate this group of blood elves. [commanding] They are led by a man named Veloren Brightstar, a figure whose removal will sow chaos among their ranks. [solemn] The safety of our community hinges on the success of this mission.
quest_41193_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the blood elf camp?
quest_41193_quest_complete:
[solemn] The news of our former kin's demise brings me no pleasure; it is a somber reminder of the conflicts that have arisen among those who were once united. [soft voice] Their aggression left us with no recourse but to defend our newfound home.

[solemn] May their spirits find solace in the embrace of the Eternal Sun, despite the shadows that clouded their hearts.
quest_41194_quest_detail:
I trust this letter finds you in good health. [soft voice] It is with a heavy heart that I bring to your attention a matter of utmost importance. [solemn] Intelligence has been gathered, suggesting that the dissidents from Alah'Thalas are in the preparatory stages of a movement against us.

[urgent] While our agents are vigilant within the city, it is imperative that you maintain a watchful eye over the refugees situated in Brinthilien. [commanding] Exercise utmost caution and restraint, refraining from any provocation or direct confrontation with the individuals in question.

[low voice] I urge you to remain unseen in your observations, acting with discretion and prudence. [solemn] Your commitment to this task is crucial in safeguarding the welfare of our people and the integrity of our cause.

[warm] With unwavering trust in your capabilities,

Viceroy Eldin Sunstrider.
quest_41194_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, this missive was recovered from the commander's remains?

[soft voice] The contents are disquieting, and it is imperative that this letter reaches the Regency Council in Alah'Thalas without delay. [urgent] The mention of spies infiltrating our ranks within the city is a matter of grave concern.
quest_41195_quest_detail:
[urgent] Quickly now, time is of the essence. [soft voice] This missive must find its way to the Regency Council with the swiftness of the wind before circumstances turn dire.

<Commander Anarileth leans in, her voice dropping to a hushed tone.>

[solemn] Yet, a caution weighs upon these words. [commanding] Not every member within the Council is to be held in unquestionable trust. [whispering] Ensure, with the utmost discretion, that this message reaches Vereesa Windrunner's hands exclusively. [solemn] She alone is to be entrusted with the contents therein.
quest_41196_quest_detail:
I can't take it- I can't take it anymore! [angry] You! YOU! Come here you little-

<Ranathir shudders and shakes his head, his voice lowering.>

No, no that's not me. [sad] I'm sorry. I'm sorry, please don't- you must forgive me, that wasn't me, I didn't mean it. But I...you see...I haven't had my dose of mana in...in...

[pause] ...how long has it been? [hesitant] I feel like lately time has been standing still and laughing at me. [urgent] Please, I need you to bring me an arcane crystal from the mines. The golems make it so hard to get them, and there are never enough. It's never enough...

Please. Please hurry. I can't...stand it.
quest_41196_quest_progress: [hesitant] Some days I'm so worried that I'm going to die...[pause] but some days I'm terrified that I won't.
quest_41196_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh! Oh you got it! [warm] Oh blessed-

<Ranathir quickly lowers his voice, clutching the crystal to his chest and looking around at the other Withered.>

Thank you. [warm] Thank you. [solemn] Today is going to be all right. [solemn] Today will be great. [warm] This is great. [sad] This is...

<His grasp on the crystal tightens, his hands beginning to shake. His voice suddenly drops to a trembling whisper.>

Never enough...
quest_41197_quest_detail: [soft voice] Heading to the city of Alah'Thalas, are you? If so, I've a task that requires your aid. My companion, Tiriel, has established an inn for the influx of refugees making their way to the city, and, as you can imagine, it's teeming with occupants. [solemn] We've just received a fresh supply package from the Wildhammers, and it would be of immense help if you could deliver it to her. [warm] You'll find Tiriel's inn adjacent to the city entrance, the first building on your left as you pass Anasterian Park.
quest_41197_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to my inn, traveler. [hesitant] We are out of beds for now, but you can always sleep on the floor, right?
quest_41197_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, it's from Solenia? My dear girl is truly sweet. I appreciate your kindness in delivering it, stranger. If you happen to cross paths with her again, convey my gratitude and tell her she must come to visit me. [solemn] There are matters of great importance that we need to... discuss.
quest_41198_quest_detail:
[urgent] Who is there? Hello?! I cannot see you - but I know you're there. Please, whoever you are, help me! [sad] There is so much pain, I cannot bear it, it feels like I am being torn asunder every moment of my existence. Countless dark shadows scurry around the houses, pulling and tearing at me. It is like I am at multiple places at once, and my very being wanes at the pressure.

[urgent] Stranger, I beg of you, find the pieces missing from me! They are moving... at different places! [screaming] End my torture by all that is holy!
quest_41198_quest_progress: Please, the voices...! [urgent] There are too many of them!
quest_41198_quest_complete: [soft voice] This silence. I'd never thought it would be so exhilarating. [pause] Finally, after all these years of horror and agony, I feel the burden of my death being lifted off me. [warm] My eternal gratitude upon you, kindest of strangers!
quest_41199_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before we part ways, there is one thing still gnawing at my consciousness. With my body mine once more, memories of my last moments rush back to me. Darkness had hidden among us and showed itself once the protectors of the Light left.

While most of Uther Lightbringer's men followed him to fight against the Scourge elsewhere, one valiant paladin remained to defend the innocent. As we were forced to retreat into the mine, he stood his ground as long as he could, but alas, his unwavering devotion to the light was not enough against the hordes of undead thrown at him.

I cannot remember his name, yet I feel indebted to his sacrifice, even if it may have been fruitless in the end. [soft voice] Should you find traces of him inside the mine, take them out of this accursed place. That is all I wish for.
quest_41199_quest_progress: [soft voice] What is it, <race>? [commanding] What can the Argent Dawn do for a traveler like you?
quest_41199_quest_complete:
<Leonid takes the derelict mace and gazes upon it almost sentimentally.> [solemn] I remember that day... and the horrors it bore. [soft voice] Without the supervision of the Silver Hand, the summit turned slowly into a nest of sinistry and soon sunk into the clutches of darkness. [sad] The Cult of the Damned infiltrated the refugees of Stratholme seeking shelter in the mountains and overthrew Arthas' old stronghold after Uther left.

[solemn] As a devout disciple of the Light I did all I could to protect the innocent. [sad] Foolish, perhaps, but anything else would've been shameful to me. [sad] With life fading my ravaged body, the last sounds I heard were the screams of fear and agony coming from the people I failed to save.

[sad] Thank you for bringing this to me, traveler. [solemn] It was a choice reminder of the terrors the Scourge inflicts upon the world, one neither you nor I should easily forget.
quest_41200_quest_detail:
[solemn] One would hope the scum of Azeroth would keep to themselves in their lightforsaken depths. [low voice] Yet their disregard for morality and lust for power drives them to spread chaos. The Cult of the Damned is no different. Founded by the Lich King's majordomo, the Archlich Kel'Thuzad, it is the reason these lands are the way they are now. [cold] By spreading the Plague of Undeath at the dawn of the Third War, they made clear that their souls are pitchblack and devoid of light. [commanding] Making a mockery out of the sanctity of life is a crime deserving of the swiftest and most severe punishment.

[solemn] Are you the one to meet out justice? [urgent] If so, lend me your strength against them.

High atop the mountains, past the Plaguewood to the west, lies the Forlorn Summit. [commanding] Seek comrades and vanquish their leaders. [commanding] Purge them from the face of Azeroth.
quest_41200_quest_progress: [solemn] The Brotherhood of Light will not stand idly by while villainy is free to set its course. [commanding] Righteousness will prevail.
quest_41200_quest_complete: [solemn] The Light shines brighter today. [warm] Through your conviction, evil has been held back for now. Do not foolishly think this to be the end of it. [solemn] Darkness is rarely ever extinguished fully. [urgent] Stay vigilant, adventurer, and may the Light shine upon you.
quest_41201_quest_progress: [low voice] What brings you to the Cleft of Shadow?
quest_41201_quest_complete: [low voice] A goblin? Your kind has been scurrying through the city more often lately. [solemn] But I don't mind, anyone seeking to widen their horizon in pursuit of power is welcome.
quest_41209_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Venture Company has been very active in Stonetalon. Eroding the natural beauty, and spreading the marks of industry wherever it is that they go. One such location of their exploitation was that of Broken Cliff Mine just to the southeast of here, nestled just west of the pathway up to Stonetalon Peak.

[soft voice] My sources have told me that it has been overrun by the Deepmoss spiders who have run off and consumed most of the workers there. [sad] Nature itself is not to be underestimated, and yet those greedy goblins continue to do so.

[urgent] I need you to travel to Broken Cliff Mine, and scour the campsites there to find any documents of their plans. [confident] Perhaps we can be one step ahead of them next time.
quest_41209_quest_progress: [soft voice] So, have you found anything of value?
quest_41209_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm...

<Dalanas takes his time looking over the document>

It would appear most of their efforts have been focused at the Blacksand Oil Fields, but there are potential plans for future developments. [solemn] You have done well in recovering this from that worksite. [warm] Take these coins, as a contribution from us here at Stonetalon Peak.
quest_41211_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have received notice from Orgrimmar. [commanding] The Warchief wishes to use the abandoned mine just before Stonetalon Peak for additional resources that the Horde is in dire need of. [soft voice] Ever since its desolation after the Third War it was used by the Venture Company to mine from, but now the aggressive Deepmoss spiders have taken residence in the mine's old tunnels. [urgent] The Horde cannot reliably gather resources with the mine suffering from infestation.

[commanding] <name>, do your part for the Horde's prosperity and cleanse the Broken Cliff Mine of the eight-legged pests. [solemn] You can find the mine by turning west on the ascension to Stonetalon Peak.
quest_41211_quest_progress: [solemn] The Deepmoss spiders are a menace to the Stonetalon Mountains. [soft voice] Too often have they ambushed innocent travelers making their way through these treacherous cliffs.
quest_41211_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you returned, and visibly strengthened by your venture. [pause] I take it the mine is cleared? [warm] You've done a commendable service to the Horde today. [solemn] News will be sent to Orgrimmar of your deeds - with resources dwindling more and more, the Warchief will acknowledge your ambitious nature, I am certain of it.
quest_41212_quest_detail:
[solemn] If what Faldan said is true - and I trust his words - then this whole ordeal goes further than my initial assumption. While I am sure the Venture Co.'s violations against nature might not have been the catalyst for the spider's change in behaviour, they surely played a vital role in accelerating it. [soft voice] However, to verify this presumption, we need to gather more samples and ultimately, more evidence.

[solemn] My brethren on top of Stonetalon Peak report of increasing hostility by the local spiders calling the Broken Cliff Mine their home. From what I can deduct, this is all too similar to what can be observed in the Windshear Crag.

<name>, please aid me again by bringing me the spiders' brains, more this time, eight samples shall be enough. [hesitant] I dare not think of the true reason behind it all - and frankly, I wish to be proven wrong. [commanding] You can find the mine by turning westwards just before you reach Stonetalon Peak.
quest_41212_quest_progress: <name>, [soft voice] how does your search for samples fare?
quest_41212_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is as I feared. The same faint breath of foul magic permeates these brains. [soft voice] Yet it may be even stronger within the spiders of the Broken Cliff Mine. [hesitant] I wonder, what may be the reason? Perhaps them living underground is one of the key factors here. [urgent] I need to convene with Faldan about this and my findings, we have much to discuss.

[warm] Nevertheless, you helped me greatly in my research. [solemn] Still, there is much to do to get behind this conundrum, and for the sake of Kalimdor, we have to solve it as quickly as possible.
quest_41214_quest_detail:
[solemn] These lands echo the beauty of Quel'Thalas, yet within the similarities lies an intriguing divergence. [soft voice] Presently, I find myself engrossed in the study of the treants that grace this realm. [hesitant] Though they possess a semblance of familiarity, there's a peculiar quality about them that eludes my understanding.

[urgent] If, by any chance, you could procure a primal heart from one of these beings, it would significantly propel my research. [hesitant] I'm not particularly skilled in combat, and the guards have thwarted my attempts to get too close. [confident] However, I believe they won't pose the same hindrance to you. [soft voice] What say you?
quest_41214_quest_progress: [solemn] Behold the statue before us, a testament to the cherished ideal of a dancing pair. [soft voice] An ancient legend among our people narrates the ethereal dance of the moon and the sun, forever close yet never touching. [low voice] This concept extends to Quel'dorei dancing as well, where two partners gracefully draw near to one another, maintaining a captivating proximity without physical contact.
quest_41214_quest_complete: [soft voice] I hope these pesky guards weren't much of an issue. [warm] Thank you, <class>. [solemn] This will be invaluable in my research.
quest_41215_quest_detail:
[solemn] To the west, there lies the Island of Eternal Autumn—a nearly forgotten legend among our people. [soft voice] Millennia ago, in the earliest days of our arrival on these shores, there were those among us who endeavored to plant a new World Tree. [sad] Alas, the endeavor failed, and the cursed tree wrought a transformative spell upon the entire land, condemning it to an eternal autumn. [pause] Neither able to perish nor truly flourish, the island became a testament to a past ambition gone awry.

[solemn] I ask you to embark upon a journey to this mystic isle and procure a primal heart from the treants that now inhabit it. [warm] Your efforts will not go unrewarded.
quest_41215_quest_progress: [solemn] Legend has it that those who linger too long on the isle lose their grasp on the passage of time. [soft voice] While they find solace in the eternal autumn, seasons and even years may slip away on the mainland without their awareness. [urgent] So be wary, traveler.
quest_41215_quest_complete: [delight] Exquisite! With those two hearts now in my possession, the veiled secrets of these lands shall unfold before me like a delicate tapestry.
quest_41216_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to Thaumarium. Within these walls, my enchanting wife crafts the finest wines to grace the Thalassian Highlands. We've bestowed upon this haven the same name as our erstwhile winery in Quel'Thalas, harboring eager anticipation for the prosperity of our venture.

[hesitant] However, a quandary befalls us. Our aspirations lead us to cultivate a vineyard in the hills southeast of this sanctuary. The microclimate there is exceptionally conducive to grape cultivation. Alas, these very hills are plagued by a savage breed of lynx, making it impossible for our workers to toil the soil in peace. [commanding] I implore you to eliminate as many of these creatures as you can and return with their furs as tangible proof of their demise. [warm] Your assistance shall not go unrewarded.
quest_41216_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be careful, these creatures are more savage than you think.
quest_41216_quest_complete: [excited] One, two, three... and a score of ten! [warm] Remarkable work. With such diligence, the hills will soon be secure for our laborers to resume their work without fear.
quest_41217_quest_detail:
[solemn] I must burden you with one more request, <name>. [soft voice] A few weeks past, as I scoured the hills in search of ideal spots for grape cultivation, I fell victim to a lynx of unparalleled ferocity. [sad] In the ensuing struggle, the creature overpowered me, leaving me grievously wounded, my eye forever lost.

[angry] A personal vendetta now brews within me against this formidable adversary. [commanding] Vanquish the beast and retrieve its fang as evidence. [solemn] I will easily recognize it; the fangs were larger than any I have ever seen.
quest_41217_quest_progress: [soft voice] Be wary of its bite.
quest_41217_quest_complete: [solemn] Indeed, this fang unequivocally belonged to the ferocious beast that tormented me. [soft voice] With the creature now vanquished, my workers can hasten their return to the hills. [warm] There's a profound sense of satisfaction in knowing that the creature which inflicted a life-altering scar upon me is no longer among the living.
quest_41218_quest_detail:
Greetings, friend. Have you come to savor our renowned wines? [soft voice] Regrettably, due to the incessant lynx attacks, grape cultivation in the hills had to be halted, leaving us with naught.

[solemn] Yet, I harbor optimism that amidst the chaos, our workers may have left behind buckets still brimming with grapes in the hills southeast of this abode. [gentle] They might be a tad fermented by now, but isn't the essence of winemaking in embracing such nuances? [warm] If you could retrieve even ten buckets, I could conjure up some wine for prospective patrons! [excited] Your assistance would be invaluable.
quest_41218_quest_progress: [urgent] Be wary of those lynxes! [sad] My sweet Maelor lost his eye in a fight with one of them.
quest_41218_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you, by the Sunwell, thank you! [warm] It may not be grand, but any aid in these challenging times is truly appreciated. [soft voice] Accept these potions as a token of my appreciation. They may be of more utility to you now than any wine I could offer. [gentle] Safe travels, friend.
quest_41219_quest_detail:
[solemn] As members of The Silver Covenant, our mission is clear – to cleanse these lands of any perils that endanger the refugees seeking sanctuary. [soft voice] Among these threats, the burgeoning population of Mana Wyrms poses a significant concern. [low voice] Their numbers surge as they feed off the mana employed in their vicinity, unsettling the balance we seek.

[commanding] I task you with culling their numbers and bringing me ten Mana Wyrm eyes as evidence of their demise. [warm] Not only will this act bring peace to these lands, but the collected eyes will also serve as catalysts to charge more mana crystals, addressing two issues in a singular endeavor.
quest_41219_quest_complete: [warm] Thank you, <class>. The roads are safer, and I'll make sure the charged mana crystals are distributed among the poorest of our kin.
quest_41220_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to Ballador's Chapel, a haven for those who seek solace in the Light during these challenging times. Even in the absence of the Sunwell, its radiance continues to grace us from the heavens.

[soft voice] Might I impose upon you for a small favor, dear friend? In our efforts to host a feast for the impoverished of Quel'Thalas, we find ourselves in need of additional sustenance. While the noble families have generously contributed, there remains a shortage of food.

[gentle] I've been informed by the rangers that Stallhorn Stag meat is particularly delectable, and personally, I have a penchant for the taste of Crimson Hawkstrider wings. [warm] If you could procure a dozen of each, we shall orchestrate a feast that will be remembered for ages.
quest_41220_quest_progress: [soft voice] Both of these creatures can be found all along the Farstride.
quest_41220_quest_complete:
[solemn] I express my gratitude, adventurer. [soft voice] However, an unexpected turn of events has altered our plans.

[low voice] Lord Astalor Sunsworn has directed that the resources you've gathered should be utilized to orchestrate a lavish feast for his noble supporters. [sad] Though it grieves my heart to convey that we won't be able to extend this bounty to the less fortunate, it is not within my purview to contest his decision. [warm] Nonetheless, I appreciate your efforts and generosity in this matter, my friend.
quest_41221_quest_detail:
No! [angry] I cannot allow such injustice to persist!

<class>, [urgent] we must not silently endure this affront to our people. The nobles indulge in opulent feasts, savoring lavish meats and exotic fruits, while the common folk languish, starving and withering away on the streets.

[solemn] I am confined within the chapel, unable to confront Lord Astalor myself, but I implore you. Take this letter to that despot Astalor. [hesitant] I harbor doubts that it will sway his heart, but he must be made aware of the sentiments burning within me.
quest_41221_quest_progress: [angry] Why did my guards let you in here?
quest_41221_quest_complete: <Astalor Sunsworn opens the letter, casually skimming its contents before breaking into a derisive laugh.> [angry] I should have you flayed by my guards for daring to believe you could waltz into my residence and insult me. [low voice] However, I find myself in need of a messenger. [cold] Deliver my response to this... Liadrin, whoever she is. [threatening] This task is beneath the dignity of any of my guards.
quest_41222_quest_detail:
[commanding] Reiterate to her every word you've heard from me.

[solemn] My resources are mine to wield as I see fit, and in this moment, they serve to influence those whose opinions truly matter. [confident] The throne shall be mine, and under my rule, our people will flourish.

[soft voice] Certainly, I could distribute these resources to the poor. [cold] But to what end? [solemn] The very next day, they would find themselves in need once again. [urgent] We must establish a solid infrastructure to sustain them—farms, vineyards, proper hunting grounds. [commanding] Simply providing daily sustenance accomplishes nothing. [solemn] Rest assured, with the crown in my possession, ensuring the welfare of the Quel'dorei will be my foremost priority. [cold] However, if some must perish before that vision is realized... well, that's regrettable.

[commanding] Now, be on your way, and ensure Liadrin hears every bit of it.
quest_41222_quest_complete: <You repeat Astalor's words to the priestess, ensuring no detail is omitted. As you deliver his message, you witness a simmering rage in the priestess's eyes. A faint green glow emanates from them, transforming her countenance into that of an entirely different person.> [solemn] Very well. I anticipated as much from him. [angry] What sheer arrogance. [soft voice] No cause is worth the continued suffering of even a single Quel'dorei. [commanding] We have endured enough, and I will ensure that Astalor comprehends this. [urgent] Soon...
quest_41223_quest_detail:
[shocked] Oh, what a calamity! [soft voice] I was organizing a splendid gathering in Anasterian Park, complete with wine, snacks, and all the trimmings. [urgent] Suddenly, a horde of dreadful creatures materialized, and I had to flee for my life!

[sad] I managed to survive, but alas, all my party supplies were lost in the chaos. [hesitant] Now, I'm too frightened to venture deep into the park again. [soft voice] Would you be so kind as to recover them for me? [warm] I yearn to host my party right here.
quest_41223_quest_progress: [soft voice] I just can't stop thinking about all the fun.
quest_41223_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh! You've recovered them! [warm] Thank you, thank you!

[soft voice] While I'd love to extend an invitation to the party, I'm afraid it's a closed affair. [gentle] However, fret not, for there will surely be another occasion for us to have some fun together, won't there?
quest_41224_quest_detail:
[solemn] I lost everything when Arthas came—my wealth, my influence, my home. [soft voice] However, amidst the ruins, I discovered something new: love. [hesitant] If not for Lin and her unwavering support, I'm uncertain how I would have coped with this disaster.

[sad] I wish to express my gratitude to her, but I'm at a loss on how to do so. [hesitant] I've never excelled in matters of sentiment. [soft voice] It might sound peculiar, but perhaps a fox fur would complement her beautiful hair. [soft voice] I've heard that foxes inhabit the Autumn Isle to the west. [urgent] If you could obtain their fur and bring it to Vanudal Goldweaver, he could craft a stunning stole...
quest_41224_quest_progress: [soft voice] Why hello there. [soft voice] How can I help you?
quest_41224_quest_complete: [commanding] Kaelin wants to give Lin a gift? Say no more.
quest_41225_quest_detail:
[excited] I never thought he'd become so sentimental! [soft voice] Back in Silvermoon, he was the toughest guy on the streets. [warm] But it's a pleasant surprise. [warm] I'm genuinely happy he found her.

<Vanudal deftly works with the fox skin, cutting and sewing it with masterful precision.>

[gentle] Here you go. [soft voice] It's as good as I could make it with the materials on hand. [hesitant] Perhaps with some golden threads, it could be even more exquisite, but I assume you're not ready for a journey to the Ruins of Silvermoon, are you? [commanding] Please convey to Kaelin that he owes me a bottle of Dalaran Red!
quest_41225_quest_complete: <Kaelin gazes at the stole> [excited] Yes, it's perfect. I... I think. It will suit my beloved splendidly. [warm] I can't wait to see the surprise on her face.
quest_41226_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your eagerness and talent are both admirable, mage. However, I must caution you. With the Sunwell lost, the use of your arcane arts may turn against you.

Luckily, there is someone who can help you with this. [solemn] Ala'shor, a powerful arcanist, has sent a letter offering his aid. He is someone you should definitely pay a visit to.
quest_41226_quest_complete: [solemn] It was wise of you to come. [soft voice] Now, let us begin.
quest_41227_quest_detail:
[solemn] It appears that you have joined our allies in taking up arms. [soft voice] You've become quite the devoted soldier of the Light, have you not?

[gentle] It is my hope that in your newfound faith, you will be able to manage the restraints that have so easily hindered many of our kin. [solemn] Even in the face of the Eternal Sun, we were guided by the Light. [commanding] A soldier of your ilk has requested your attention. [soft voice] Lor'thas has asked me to present to you this letter.
quest_41227_quest_complete: [solemn] I am pleased you have answered the call. [warm] Let us begin your training.
quest_41228_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have the brightest Light of grace and mercy radiating around your head. [soft voice] You are not unlike others who have ventured down the path of healing and nurturing our people.

[warm] You have earned my deepest respect and admiration, priest. [soft voice] Regardless of your youthful beginning, I feel honored in your presence, much like I would around our other more experienced priest, Lady Silversun. [soft voice] She has entrusted me with the task of delivering this letter to you. [solemn] Her grace and wisdom would undoubtedly be an aid in the trying times we face.
quest_41228_quest_complete: [solemn] Our task is as noble as the heritage we carry.
quest_41229_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your agility and skill are impressive. [hesitant] I'm unsure whether to admire or be cautious of you. [soft voice] No offense intended.

Your line of work is irrelevant to our goal of reclaiming our homeland. [solemn] What matters is your ability to make the most of any situation. [pause] But enough of my words, someone seeks you. [soft voice] This letter, delivered by a child, bears no sender's name. [solemn] As I respect privacy and never snoop around in mail, I shall deliver it to you.
quest_41229_quest_progress: [whispering] Beware what hides in the shadows.
quest_41229_quest_complete: [low voice] This will not be cheap, you will be indebted to me greatly.
quest_41230_quest_detail:
[solemn] I sense anger burning inside you. [soft voice] Your arms tremble and shake, but not in fear, rather at the rage you are attempting to restrain. [pause] Such moments are when we should place our hope in warriors such as yourself, ones undaunted despite adversity.

[solemn] You who have not benefitted from the arcane, never even dreamed of wielding a weapon before the fall of Quel'Thalas. [sad] You who had nothing and still lost everything. [solemn] That fire in your eyes reminds me of Valanos', the one who instructed me to provide you with this letter.
quest_41230_quest_progress: [commanding] Raise your weapon to the Sun.
quest_41231_quest_detail:
[solemn] Are you seeking to become an esteemed and honorable ranger? Your bearing with the bow is remarkable, quite frankly almost rivaling the honor of becoming an acclaimed and renowned arcanist.

[sad] It is unfortunate that many of our rangers have perished alongside our homeland. [soft voice] Yet, similar to yourself, there exists another here who wants to emulate their footsteps. Take wisdom from her experience, and perhaps both you and her shall become the stepping stones for future generations.
quest_41231_quest_progress: [soft voice] May your arrows fly swiftly.
quest_41231_quest_complete: [solemn] The Farstrider legacy must live on.
quest_41233_quest_complete: [excited] You have returned with the core. [solemn] We may now begin.
quest_41234_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that you have the core all that you need to do is return to Ordenal and he will know exactly what needs to be done. [solemn] This is the core of an Ancient, one that has not been seen in a long time. [warm] I bet even Ordenal will be awed as you give him the core.

[gentle] With the Ancient being brought back to life and being around the city of Alah'Thalas it will help the Quel'dorei with their meditation. [hesitant] This is once again, not a permanent solution. Regardless, it is the best we have.
quest_41234_quest_complete: [solemn] An Ancient of Arcane, how could that possibly be?
quest_41235_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is truly marvelous, beyond any expectation. [soft voice] I had no idea what that Highborne had up her sleeve, but by Elune, to stand before an Ancient that hasn't been seen in millennia...

[urgent] Word of this must reach the Archdruid! [gentle] Please, understand. The Ancients are highly revered in the Kaldorei culture, and this will certainly aid me in helping the Quel'dorei. [warm] May you reach Darnassus well; I know the Archdruid will see fit to reward you.
quest_41235_quest_complete:
I never thought Ordenal to be such a fool, acting without a modicum of consideration—summoning an Ancient of Arcane, a blatant mockery of our culture and heritage.

[solemn] Nevertheless, your information is valuable. [low voice] What's done cannot be undone, and while I abhor the very notion of such an Ancient, I find myself contemplating potential uses for it.

[cold] Now be gone.
quest_41236_quest_progress: [commanding] Lady Windrunner shall lead us to victory!
quest_41236_quest_complete: I see. [solemn] I've been investigating the Blood Elf presence in this area for a considerable amount of time, but this is indeed grave news. [urgent] If they truly have agents infiltrating even the city, swift and decisive action is imperative.
quest_41237_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Our... former brethren have fortified themselves in the mountain fortress of Felstrider Retreat. [solemn] They've been here even before we arrived to settle these lands, and I suspect they may be remnants of Kael's forces that did not sail to Northrend. [hesitant] Up until now, they haven't caused much trouble, and quite embarrassingly, we've been overlooking their presence. [urgent] However, if what you say is true, they must be plotting something.

[commanding] I need you to find evidence of their plot. [solemn] Perhaps one of their soldiers carries orders that could shed more light on the matter. [warm] May the Light guide you, friend.
quest_41237_quest_complete:
[angry] Rommath?

That rat, that vermin! He's the one who betrayed Vereesa, siding with Astalor, and now this? [solemn] He will hang for his treachery.

[urgent] But first, deliver this news to Lady Vereesa. [hesitant] I sense there's something more to it...
quest_41238_quest_detail: Make haste, <class>! [urgent] You may still have time to stop Rommath's scheme. [soft voice] Go with the wind, and let no one know about this, but Lady Vereesa! [solemn] The fate of our kin is in your hands.
quest_41239_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, you are from Felstrider, correct? You are safe; no one can hear us.

<Rommath scrutinizes you, studying your face for an extended moment.>

Very well. I have made all the necessary preparations. If my calculations are correct—and they are—we should be able to establish contact with Prince Kael'Thas.

By the way, is everything well with Eldin? That fool Astalor has been attempting to amass a force to attack Felstrider, but he has been unsuccessful, as usual.

[solemn] Good, good. Inform me when you are ready.
quest_41240_quest_detail: [solemn] I will now open a portal to Outland. [urgent] Brace yourself. [soft voice] You might feel a slight pull, try not to fall down.
quest_41240_quest_complete: [solemn] So you see now. [soft voice] Every day, I hear our people label him a traitor, a coward. Yet, I am bound to fulfill his wishes. [hesitant] I do not comprehend his intentions, but I hold steadfast in my belief in him. [warm] I only wish more of our people could perceive it in the same light.
quest_41241_quest_detail:
[solemn] Are you here to perhaps lay eyes upon the undeniable future, or is it mere innocent curiosity? [angry] Maybe you're here to spit in our face as those who cast us aside in the muck and the rubble. [soft voice] Blessed be the sun, you wouldn't be here to take pity on our wretched souls, would you?

[cold] Your pity we'll do without. [commanding] However, you might prove useful. [urgent] We require a task, one for such an eager ally as yourself. [hesitant] You wouldn't mind repurposing a few misplaced arcane crystals, would you? [solemn] Our noble kin in the city, with their arrogance, leave them all around Alah'Thalas. [low voice] I doubt they'd realize a handful went missing.
quest_41241_quest_complete: <Ka'zmir's hands shake as you offer him the crystals.> [confident] Quite the haul. [warm] These will do us well. Thank you.
quest_41242_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our people sought refuge in the South. While the Dwarves sheltered our caravans, the Humans welcomed us into their newly conceived Alliance. Along with it, we attained the allegiance of the so-called Kaldorei. Despite our differences, it seems that our people share some commonalities.

Though not all welcomed our utilization of magic, the addiction it induces, and the casualties it begets — of which you already see in our afflicted — some were willing to assist. Among them is a Druid residing beyond our ghetto, a person named Ordenal Owlmane. He dwells underneath a tree resembling the outlines of two mighty beasts. [soft voice] He speaks of our redemption through the power of the Dream and the Moon. [urgent] If you truly believe our race holds any chance of survival, pay him a visit.
quest_41242_quest_complete: [solemn] You return from the ghetto, do you not? [soft voice] Are you present here to assist with their course of action?
quest_41243_quest_detail:
Greetings, child of the Sun. I am Ordenal, a druid sworn to the Dream. [solemn] A terrible fate has befallen the Quel'dorei, reminding me of the ancient kingdom of the Kaldorei and the Highborne who relied upon the Well of Eternity. [soft voice] When it was lost, my people retreated to the World Tree.

The Highborne yet survive, though in scant number, and most have fallen to other corruptions to sate their hunger. [sad] Such a fate I do not desire for the people here. [hesitant] I would be most grateful for your assistance in testing a theory of mine. [soft voice] I have a few vials of Moonwell water. Would you be so kind as to offer them to the Wretched, and see if, by any chance, it could alleviate their suffering, if only briefly?
quest_41243_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope my theory will be correct.
quest_41243_quest_complete: [shocked] So it had no effect, whatsoever?
quest_41244_quest_detail:
[solemn] Fear not, friend. Though my hopes were dashed, I have another task for you.

[soft voice] Previously, I made mention of the Highborne. To my amazement, it appears that one of them resides in a small tower on the Isle of Eternal Autumn, located northwest of here. [emphasis] It may be wise to seek her counsel, for she may possess knowledge vital to the salvation of all Quel'dorei.
quest_41244_quest_complete: [solemn] Welcome, child of Dath'remar, to my current abode.
quest_41245_quest_detail:
[angry] Must every land and shore be infested by these ridiculous abominations? There has not been one task, not one task without having to stare upon their filth. [solemn] These dreaded murlocs are never a good sign. For where there are murlocs, soon the naga will follow.

[urgent] Rid the Farstride of their filth and return to me, for I have better-suited tasks for you. [soft voice] Elune be praised. [sad] I can no longer endure the sight of them.
quest_41245_quest_complete: [soft voice] I was coming to check on you since you were gone for a long while, but all I saw was you dismantling them with ease. [proud] Skillfully done.
quest_41246_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is something that does not allow the spirits of the fallen to rest in these forests. [hesitant] I have my concerns and I truly do not wish for them to be true. [soft voice] Before that, as I am not to leave my station here, I will ask you to bring peace to these restless souls.

[gentle] Be not afraid, for they can be slain, and if by any chance they resemble someone you know, look away. [solemn] It is wrong for them to be here and they must return to the cradle of the world beyond.
quest_41246_quest_progress: [low voice] Not as easy as it may seem, is it?
quest_41246_quest_complete: [soft voice] Anything interesting you'd like to mention?
quest_41247_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You found a signet with initials on it amongst the ashes of one of the spirits? How interesting. Theron, Theron, I seem to remember this name from somewhere but I am not quite sure.

<Sira ponders for a brief moment.>

It was one of the council members, I believe his name was Lor'themar Theron. [solemn] Perhaps this holds some emotional value or a family history. Not for us to judge, but you could seek him and return it. You might get a reward.
quest_41247_quest_complete:
[solemn] This belonged to my uncle. He was my guardian, my mentor. I knew he had fallen on these lands but never did I think he'd be without rest. [soft voice] In a way, I think he knew Quel'Thalas fell, which is why he had returned beyond the grave.

[warm] You've done me a great service, a reward is due.
quest_41248_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were away, my suspicions have been validated. [soft voice] There is a sundered ruin nearby where the naga seem to be conducting a ritual. [solemn] This not only disrupts the peace of these lands but may lead to far graver consequences.

[urgent] Before you journey into the ruins to confront their leaders, you must be prepared. [commanding] The naga are formidable underwater foes, and you'll need a means to survive beneath the surface. [hesitant] I carry water-breathing potions, but their efficacy has been compromised due to the peculiar aura of this isle.

[solemn] I possess some knowledge of alchemy and can rectify the issue, but I require naga scales to do so. [warm] Bring them to me, and I shall provide you with these potions. However, exercise caution and avoid delving too deeply into the waters.
quest_41248_quest_complete:
[solemn] Very well.

<Sira crushes the scales, adding them to her potions. The mixture sizzles and begins to glow.>

[soft voice] Here you go. [low voice] Three potions should suffice. [commanding] Use them judiciously, for I won't provide you with more.
quest_41249_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some of the Naga have the ability to call upon the tides, submerging entire regions. [urgent] If they're performing such a ritual, our fate may be sealed. [soft voice] I implore you to steel your resolve and ready your sea legs, for you are the one destined to thwart their plans.

[solemn] The Naga function under a strict hierarchy. [commanding] If you can eliminate their leaders, their forces will scatter and retreat to the depths of Nazjatar. [emphasis] Ensure the demise of their commanders, but it wouldn't hurt to dispatch a few of their sunderers as well. [mocking tone] Just for the thrill of it. <Sira chuckles beneath her helmet.>
quest_41249_quest_complete: [solemn] What could the Naga hope to achieve by attacking the Quel'dorei? [sad] Someone must be aiming to inflict further suffering upon these already broken people.
quest_41250_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I am quite pleased to be offered aid. Truthfully, I am here to help the Quel'dorei find ways to quell their torment. While I have been teaching many of them to meditate and try to limit their use of the Arcane, it is not a permanent solution. Some become Withered faster than others.

[pause] Since I am not allowed to leave my abode, as my guardian—or jailer—would not let me go, I would ask you to go to the Sleeping Tree right in the middle of the island. It is there that you will find Rine, a Sister of Autumn, one I encountered while meddling about. The last time I was there, we had left one who was slowly turning into a withered to rest inside.
quest_41251_quest_detail:
[urgent] Go now, to Felstrider Retreat. [whispering] Ensure that Eldin is informed, and him alone.

Do not divulge the details of our conversation to anyone.

[soft voice] Best of luck to you, traveler. [solemn] May the Eternal Sun shine on us once again.
quest_41252_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah, an adventurer...

<Astalor's face contorts with disdain.>

There is a delicate matter at hand, and I require assistance in a manner that leaves no trace leading back to me. I've recently discovered that one of the distant cousins to the traitorous Prince Kael'thas still lives and commands the forces of Felstrider Retreat.

As you can undoubtedly surmise, having a Sunstrider alive poses a considerable issue, as many may perceive his claim to the throne as legitimate. [commanding] I require him eliminated. Assemble a formidable party, dispatch him, and dispose of his body in a lake.

Once the grim task is accomplished, present his signet as proof to Melathe Shadesong. Ensure that no one discovers it was I who... suggested this undertaking.
quest_41252_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you want me to smile, give me a better reason to do so.
quest_41252_quest_complete:
[shocked] What?

<Melanthe turns away from Briella and sighs.>

Oh. [hesitant] You're here from- yeah okay, sure, thanks. [excited] Good job, A plus, gold star. [warm] Here's your paycheck. [urgent] Go buy some oranges or individuality or something. Bye.
quest_41253_quest_detail:
Greetings. [soft voice] I am Leshandra Fintri, and my research delves into the more... unconventional methods of satiating our arcane addiction.

[solemn] To the southwest lies a Blood Elf fortress. [soft voice] Blood Elves, notorious for handling their addiction differently than us, employ a distinct type of magic to quench their thirst. [hesitant] My endeavor is to glean more insights, but regrettably, the Regency Council opposes my research. [urgent] If you could venture there and retrieve some Fel Crystals, I would compensate you generously for your efforts.
quest_41253_quest_progress: [soft voice] I'm sure you will be fine. [whispering] Just don't show the crystals to the guards.
quest_41253_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, what a beautiful haul of sweet, sweet crystals. [soft voice] These will be invaluable in my research, truly invaluable. [warm] You have done a great service to our people today.
quest_41254_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have you ventured to the Farstride recently?

[soft voice] It's a stunning beach, marred only by the presence of murlocs and other nefarious creatures. [solemn] Among them, none are as troublesome as the Deepmurk. [solemn] These murlocs, hailing from the darkest depths of the sea, inexplicably decided to leave their aquatic abode and take residence in a cave on the Farstride. [urgent] Their relentless attacks on our rangers and fishermen have rendered this magnificent stretch of land entirely uninhabitable.

[commanding] If you could cull their population, you shall be duly rewarded.
quest_41254_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid! With these creatures gone, the shore is safer for everyone! [warm] And I can finally buy fish at a reasonable price...
quest_41255_quest_detail:
A moment of your time?

[soft voice] I'm the dockmaster here, for the lack of a better word. As you can probably imagine, there's a lot of movement to our newfound home, and we receive a lot of supplies from our steadfast allies.

[hesitant] However, one of the ships that was due to arrive a few days ago has been lost. [sad] I fear the worst, especially with the talk of naga along the shore.

[solemn] The shipment was very important, so I would pay you handsomely if you could go to the Farstride and search for it. [urgent] There is a possibility that what was left of it was stolen by the Deepmurk murlocs, if so, they probably took the supplies to their lair.
quest_41255_quest_complete: [solemn] Here it is, the shipment in question. [soft voice] I thought it was lost for good, but once again, the resilience of our people is remarkable. [warm] Thank you, <class>. [proud] You have done a great service to me.
quest_41257_quest_detail:
[solemn] Any of our people who decide to take up a mage's robes should be well-prepared for the pitfalls of that path. [soft voice] If you intend to continue down this road, I should prefer that you be well-educated for your journey.

The magical addiction and loss of the Sunwell that plagues our people goes doubly for us! [commanding] Your calling will be a constant kindling for the fires of your hunger- you must learn to master it before it masters you.

[pause] In Silvermoon, there was a man that was...a friend of mine. [sad] Tragically, not only did he defect to the prince's blood elves in an attempt to slake his thirst, but he also led many of our young mages with him to their ruin. [urgent] I would not see another student fall prey to his ways. [solemn] I have word that he has been sighted at Felstrider Retreat- find Gilaras Sunfury, see what becomes of someone who forsakes reason and morals for their cravings, and put him out of our misery.

[threatening] And do remember to tell him that Merisa hasn't forgotten what he did.
quest_41257_quest_progress: [sad] I should have never trusted him, not with students, and not with my...first edition copy of the Song of Aegwynn.
quest_41257_quest_complete:
[sad] He is slain then? I suppose I already finished mourning him years ago. [solemn] I hope you both learned a valuable lesson from this, though I'm afraid he won't be learning from any of his other mistakes after this. [solemn] Take heart, it had to be done and now you know what becomes of one of us who turns to a more sinister solace for our pains.

[warm] Here you are, then, you've earned this. [warm] Take it with you on your journey, and may it serve you well, both as a tool and as a reminder.
quest_41258_quest_detail:
Greetings, paladin.

[soft voice] While you have acquired considerable knowledge, there remains much more for you to discover. [solemn] Seek out Duthorian Rall, a revered paladin of our order. [low voice] He resides in Stormwind City, situated far to the south. [solemn] Under his guidance, you will receive teachings that extend beyond my capacity.
quest_41258_quest_complete: [solemn] I humbly salute you, high elf. [soft voice] The resilience displayed by your race in the midst of adversity serves as an inspiration for all of us during these challenging times.
quest_41259_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our new allies have requested your presence in the distant lands of Kalimdor. Vereesa speaks very highly of you, and I hear you have proven to be a valuable ally for many denizens of our new homeland.

There is an established ship route that travels between our city and the night elf town of Auberdine. [urgent] Go there with haste and report to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea. She is an ally of our people, and surely she will find more work for you.
quest_41259_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the promised allies finally arrive. [warm] Welcome home, kin. [soft voice] There's a lot of work to be done.
quest_41260_quest_detail: [solemn] We warriors pledge our oath to safeguard the vulnerable. [soft voice] A formidable foe, Murkblood, lurks within a cave in the Farstride. [low voice] He has claimed the lives of many, and unless we intervene, more will succumb to his menace. [urgent] Dispose of him, and I will honor you with one of our finest blades.
quest_41260_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the vile creature?
quest_41260_quest_complete: [warm] Well done. [proud] Shores are much safer thanks to your actions.
quest_41262_quest_detail: [solemn] Our intelligence indicates the presence of a new arrival at Felstrider Retreat—an undead elf, a mindless minion obedient to Sylvanas Windrunner and her Forsaken. [urgent] We cannot afford any collaboration between the Blood Elves and the Horde. [commanding] It is imperative that this threat be swiftly and discreetly neutralized. [soft voice] Given your capabilities, I believe you are well-suited for this mission. [hesitant] What is your response?
quest_41262_quest_progress: [solemn] Your mortality wanes with every moment you waste loitering here.
quest_41262_quest_complete: [confident] Consider me thoroughly impressed. [warm] Outstanding job, <class>. [commanding] Naturally, ensure that the details of this event remain confidential. [solemn] Let it fade into oblivion.
quest_41263_quest_detail:
[solemn] As devoted servants of the Holy Light, it is both our duty and privilege to extend our care to those less fortunate. [soft voice] The weight of the suffering borne by the children of Quel'Thalas in the aftermath of our fallen kingdom often eludes our consciousness.

[sad] Many young ones have become orphans, and it is incumbent upon us to provide solace and support for them. [gentle] Even if your destiny leads you down different paths, your assistance can still make a significant impact. [solemn] Retrieve for me an Ivory Hawkstrider bone, and with it, we shall fashion a toy—a delicate figurine. [warm] This small creation will serve as a source of comfort for the children, aiding them in overcoming the traumatic memories they have endured.
quest_41263_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, child. [warm] While you may think it is not much, it will make a world's difference to them.
quest_41267_quest_detail:
[solemn] Admist the captivating beauty of this lush foliage and verdant landscape, a subtle undercurrent of darkness threatens our very existence here in the Thalassian Highlands. [soft voice] We study tirelessly in pursuit of the knowledge required to curb our growing mana addiction, while our adversaries seduce with a perverse salvation in the fel.

[sad] Already some of our kin have succumbed to fear of the withdrawal and been ensnared in their sinister grasp. [urgent] Recently, we discovered a source of fel magic nearby, located on the Isle of Eternal Autumn to the west. [threatening] No doubt the Blood Elves have their hand in this, determined to seduce even more of our terror-stricken kin to the promises of dark magic.

[commanding] Seek out the source of this tainted energy and bring it to me that it may be destroyed once and for all!
quest_41267_quest_progress: [solemn] The longer that you delay, the more this land may be scarred by the dark energies of fel magic.
quest_41267_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, <name>. [warm] The Citadel thanks you for the aid in retrieving this crystal. [commanding] We shall see it purified or, barring that, destroyed soon enough. [proud] Stand proud, as your actions have helped to save many pure souls from the temptation of the fel.

[warm] Take this, as a token of the Citadel's gratitude.
quest_41268_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Oh no, you've come looking for the Maison Serendipity Winter Veil clothing too? Well, it's embarrassing, but...I'm completely sold out at the moment! You see, Rouge magazine just did an article about us and, well... we didn't expect such a rush!

[urgent] I need to get word back to the shop that I need a new shipment, but I really shouldn't leave my post. You know, judging by your clothing, you seem a well-traveled sort. [gentle] Could you just run back to Stormwind and ask them to send me more product? The atelier is in the Park, near the entrance. Just ask for Madame Gres and let her know the situation. [confident] She'll get it handled!
quest_41268_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes? I am Madame Gres. [soft voice] How may I assist you?
quest_41268_quest_complete: [soft voice] Vera sold out already, did she? [pause] Well, I suppose we should have been prepared for such a possibility, but you simply can't rush couture. [gentle] You wouldn't want your festive fashion to look like you bought prêt-à-porter Undermine Outfitters, hmm? [hesitant] There's just one little problem...
quest_41269_quest_detail:
[delight] I'd be just delighted to send Vera more, except...well, darling, do you know how much fur we go through for the trimming? And not just any fur- genuine 100% free-range Alterac Yeti fur! It's the warmest. [sad] Unfortunately, we are all out and our suppliers are being difficult- something about a shortage and a snowman? Anyway, I- oh don't take this the wrong way, darling, but your outfit certainly makes a statement. And that statement is, oh, shall we say...'experienced in the art of combat.'

[soft voice] I don't suppose you'd be a dear and just go to Alterac and fetch me some fresh yeti hides? The yetis may be a bit reluctant to part with their hides, but I'm sure you can manage. [urgent] I'll need about ten of the finest, fluffiest, preferably cleanest furry hides.
quest_41269_quest_progress: [soft voice] You know, orange is the new purple this season. [warm] Have you considered updating your wardrobe, darling?
quest_41269_quest_complete: [excited] Welcome back, darling! And you brought me the hides! [warm] Aren't you just a dear. [soft voice] Why, we'll have these cleaned, tanned, optically whitened, and attached in no time! [chuckling] Well, relatively speaking of course. [soft voice] You can't rush couture after all.
quest_41270_quest_detail: [soft voice] You did well getting everything that I needed darling. [warm] While you were away I sent a fresh batch of some of our best thread to Winterveil. [gentle] It would be a shame if everyone were not dressed as fashionable as possible. [warm] Head to Vera, she should be very thankful.
quest_41270_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh hello again, I heard word from Alix that she had received her hides, she already sent some stuff ahead early. [warm] You can speak with Mr.Freeze here, he keeps our stock of goods.
quest_41271_quest_detail:
Gah, you've come looking for the Maison Serendipity Winter Veil clothing too? [sad] Well, I'm sorry to say but you're a bit late. [sad] I'm completely sold out at the moment. [sad] That Rouge magazine just did an article about us and, well... I didn't expect such a rush.

[urgent] I need to get word back to the shop that I need a new shipment, but I'm not supposed to leave my post. [hesitant] Hey, judging by your clothing, you seem a well-traveled sort. [soft voice] If you could just run back to Undercity and ask them to send me more product? [urgent] The atelier is in the Apothecarium, near the Enchanting shop. [soft voice] Just ask for Coco and let her know the situation. [warm] She'll fix this mess!
quest_41273_quest_progress: [soft voice] You know, orange is the new purple this season. [warm] Have you considered updating your wardrobe, darling?
quest_41273_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh hello again, I heard word from Coco that she had received her hides, she already sent some stuff ahead early. [warm] You can speak with Mr.Freeze here, he keeps our stock of goods.
quest_41275_quest_detail:
<name>! Do you have a moment? [soft voice] Your skills in jewelcrafting are exceptional, rarely any of my pupils achieved such levels of craftsmanship by my teachings alone. [warm] It doesn't take a master to see - you are born to hone this craft to its fullest potential.

[proud] While you've exceeded my expectations immensely, I sadly cannot teach you more than I already have. [sad] This doesn't mean the end of your journey, however. [solemn] There are mentors more capable of teaching you, one of them being a good friend of mine. [gentle] Perhaps you've become acquainted with him already, he may be a bit paranoid and disgruntled, but he will share what he knows with a bit of assistance.

[urgent] Should you wish to specialize your craft and become a master jewelcrafter, talk to Talvash del Kissel in the Mystic Ward. [confident] His instructions will pave the way for your future in this trade.
quest_41275_quest_complete:
[excited] Oho, so Mayva sent you? That snappy gal hasn't shown her face around here in AGES! And she wants me to teach you about goldsmithing? Suppose I can't blame her, really, I AM the greatest jewelcrafter in all of Azeroth afterall.

[proud] Let us not wait any longer then, yes?
quest_41276_quest_detail:
<name>, what a splendid sight to have you here with me once more. [solemn] I have noticed - and you surely too - that your progress in the craft has grown astronomically! [excited] Really, it has been too long since I've witnessed such prodigal skills at hand. [sad] This sadly means that my means of teaching are at an end. [warm] Your eagerness to learn more is apparent however; good thing I can assist you one last time.

[commanding] Should you wish to strengthen your understanding in the field of jewelcrafting, seek my good friend Jarkal in Kargath. [solemn] The perilous Badlands are no place for a corpse like myself, but a sturdy troll like himself can withstand such harsh environments with ease. [gentle] Take care on your journey to him, for I wish you the safest of travels. <Gulmire does a short, cordial bow.>
quest_41276_quest_complete:
[solemn] Long travel, I take it? [soft voice] These lands aren't the most welcoming, but they offer a primal beauty, untouched and rarely seen anywhere else. [pause] Still, this isn't what you are here for, though, correct? Say, who sent you to good old Jarkal?

[warm] Goldsmithing? [hesitant] This is an old skill I don't exercise too often nowadays. The Horde has more use for my alchemical abilities. But should you wish to be taught by me and listen to what I can share, then be my guest.
quest_41277_quest_detail:
<name>! Do you have a moment? [soft voice] Your skills in jewelcrafting are exceptional, rarely any of my pupils achieved such levels of craftsmanship by my teachings alone. [solemn] It doesn't take a master to see this - you are born to hone this craft to its fullest potential.

[warm] While you've exceeded my expectations immensely, I sadly cannot teach you more than I already have. [sad] Don't fret, however, as my own master, Thegren, may aid where I fail to.

[urgent] Should you wish to specialize your craft and become a master in gemcutting, the art of manipulating gems to augment your abilities, search for Thegren. [solemn] As a member of an ancient order, preceding any of our current civilizations, he chose a hermit's life, living secluded in the barren wastes of the Badlands. [commanding] Seek him out near the ruins of the ancient city of Corthan. [hesitant] He does not speak to anyone, but should you show him this crystal, I assure you - he will listen to your cause. Be careful out there, it is a perilous journey to that dreary place!
quest_41278_quest_detail:
<name>, what a splendid sight to have you here with me once more. [solemn] I have noticed - and you surely, too - that your progress in the craft has grown astronomically! [excited] Really, it has been too long since I've witnessed such prodigal skills at hand. [sad] This sadly means that my means of teaching are at an end. [warm] Your eagerness to learn more is apparent however; good thing I can assist you one last time.

[soft voice] Should you wish to strengthen your understanding in the field of gemology, there is someone - a secretive man, that can aid you in your ambitions. [low voice] Older than anything I know, he is part of an ancient order, one that mastered the knowledge over Azeroth's minerals. [cold] As such, he values his privacy; meaning he will most likely not speak with you. [gentle] Here, take this crystal with you. [solemn] It is proof of my tutelage under him, and it will show him you can be trusted. [warm] Please, take care on your journey to him, for I wish you the safest of travels. <Gulmire does a short, cordial bow.>
quest_41283_quest_detail:
[urgent] Alright, listen, let me be honest with you. I will not teach you my secret crafting techniques out of my desire to be charitable. I can assure you, I am definitely not going to do that. Instead, you will assist me in… restocking my supplies and in turn, you'll receive a sizeable nugget of knowledge about my goldsmithing. Perfect? Perfect.

[commanding] Please bring me the following things as soon as possible, I'm not the type to wait around for too long.
quest_41283_quest_progress: [urgent] If you don't have it, go get it!
quest_41283_quest_complete: Mhm, mhm, not as shabby as I expected it to be. But it clearly bears Mayva's mark of shoddy craftsmanship. [commanding] Good thing you are in my hands now, I'll whip you into a serviceable jewelcrafter in no time! [excited] Start by making this lovely trinket here, you should have no troubles replicating it… hopefully.
quest_41284_quest_detail:
[solemn] Believe it or not, but living under a mountain does not guarantee you a steady flow of gems in your storage. [angry] It surely doesn't help if some FALSE rumours prevent you from engaging in good and honest trade around here. [soft voice] If I was still in Gnomeregan, all of this would be easier, trust me on that. Still, gems are the bread and butter of jewelcrafting - no gems, no jewels, no trade, no money, no paid rent. You get the idea. [urgent] And seeing as I desperately need to appease my landlord, I need quite a handful of those sparkling beauties to cover my losses, so to speak.

[emphasis] Are we on the same page? Ofcourse we are. [warm] Bring me enough of the following gems and I'll pass you a lil' something.
quest_41284_quest_progress: [low voice] These things don't grow on trees, you know? Or underground. Or anywhere. [sigh] Nevermind, just pass ‘em already!
quest_41284_quest_complete: [soft voice] I don't know about you, but seeing these little treasures shine and sparkle under the light of my prospector's lens is something I'll never get tired of. [solemn] Surely you understand. [pause] Now that we got that covered - here, listen close, I won't repeat myself!
quest_41285_quest_detail:
[angry] Whatever you've been told about me - it's all lies! [shouting] I one hundred percent NEVER made any sort of cursed item for anyone. [solemn] I have integrity for my craft and an oath to keep! [hesitant] Please don't ask who I made an oath with. [whispering] Strictly confidential. [soft voice] And definitely NOT shady.

[sad] Regardless, it seems the misfortune of some ill adventurer now befalls me instead, slandering my good name once again. [solemn] A daring mage sought me out for a spell-enhancing necklace on his ventures to the recently re-discovered Gilneas City to the north. [soft voice] Ofcourse I obliged and crafted one for him, rent was due anyway, yet his spelunking in that accursed place did not end… let's say favorably for him. [sad] Too bad his group of fellow adventurers now blame me for his demise, lying to everyone in Ironforge that I enchanted the necklace with a foul spell!

[urgent] <name>, I want you to delve into Gilneas City yourself and bring me back that necklace! [solemn] The last thing I want is people using it as false evidence against me.
quest_41285_quest_progress: <Talvash sighs deeply.> [soft voice] Oh, how much I would give to be back in Gnomeregan!
quest_41285_quest_complete:
[solemn] Bloodied, drenched, full of mud. [sad] Ugh, it breaks my heart to see one of my finer works in such a disrespectful state. [warm] Nevertheless, thank you for retrieving it. [soft voice] Tell me, where did you find it, on his beaten corpse or did someone else's grubby hands pilfered it from him? [hesitant] You know what? Don't tell me, I'd rather stay oblivious.

[warm] As compensation for your noble deed, I will teach you how to craft this choker yourself.
quest_41286_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This is it, good traveler. There isn't much more I could teach that you couldn't learn elsewhere. Still, if your hunger for knowledge won't let you stop here, then I'll share with you where I got all my nifty tricks.

[whispering] Technically I shouldn't be telling you this, yet with your urgent help I cannot let you leave unrewarded. Far to the west, in the hostile plains of Desolace, you will find my own mentor, isolated from civilization. Although he wished to be left undisturbed, I know he wouldn't mind some company. Don't be discouraged should he not talk with you at first, persistence is what he values most in those wishing to seek knowledge!

[emphasis] Look for a great tower overlooking the ocean, it is where I last saw him. [urgent] Now that we got this out of the way, you better leave quickly, before my landlord thinks I'm engaging in black market activities!
quest_41286_quest_complete: <The Highborne eyes you dismissively.> [angry] First this bumbling human down there, and now you? Can an artist not find peace and quiet for once in his life? [threatening] Tell me, who sent you to The Artificer?
quest_41287_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I will be honest with you, out here in the wilderness, our supplies are not as plentiful as to teach you properly. It is not like I have the infinite resources our short green friends in Orgrimmar have. Nothing we cannot work with, however. [solemn] Fortunately for us, these lands are rich in natural resources, which you can turn into the material for your lecture.

[commanding] Take it as a sort of test to see just how much you're capable of.
quest_41287_quest_progress: Beware of the roaming ogres out there, too many of them for my liking.
quest_41287_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Great work, I've seldom had that many ingredients for jewelcrafting at once in this place. [solemn] I suppose some form of gratitude is needed towards Gulmire, since he has given me something practical to do whilst waiting for new reports.

[pause] Back to you, however. [gentle] Let me show you how to create these delicate trinkets.
quest_41288_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Like you'll surely know, gems, valuable stones and minerals are essential to jewelcrafting. Without them, creating fashionable pieces may surely be possible - but honestly, what would be the point? [pause] In my humble opinion, a delicate gem or even an ornate one is the element giving your jewelry purpose and meaning.

[solemn] Bring me enough of Azeroth's gems so that we may analyze their properties together.
quest_41288_quest_progress: [soft voice] The pearls are often found within thick shelled clams all over Azeroth. [pause] Many of the water-dwelling creatures carry those with them.
quest_41288_quest_complete: [soft voice] It may be faint, but there is power emanating from these gems. The best jewelcrafters are able to extract their mighty essences and amplify them to unprecedented heights. [warm] And if you'll allow me to say this: you are on a good way to reach that point yourself some day.
quest_41289_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My people have an extensive history about goldsmithing and bedazzlements, be it removable or permanent. [solemn] While I will share my insight in the old Zandalari goldsmithing customs, it is important to expand your horizon to other sources of knowledge as well.

[gentle] What I want you to delve into is the human way of fashioning regalias. [pause] Up north, not far from the lands of our forsaken allies, you will find the nation of Gilneas. [solemn] A relic of old times, so I have heard, now newly opened to those eager enough to best its dangers and perils. [emphasis] High atop its mountain ridged towers Gilneas City, a place of commerce, trade and festivities, according to the stories of traveling adventurers.

[solemn] It is where you will find a suitable digest for us to analyze.
quest_41289_quest_progress: [confident] I am sure getting these gemstone will be of no issue for you.
quest_41289_quest_complete:
[solemn] Harrowing news. What you're describing is all too familiar - many former troll empires fell to their own hubris, thinking themselves above their people or even their loa. [soft voice] It is all the more relieving to see you return safe and sound.

[warm] Now then, shall we pry the information from these tarnished pages?
quest_41290_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Good traveler, thank you for letting me practice this craft I had long been unable to. [solemn] I had promised to continue honing my skills, yet my service to the Horde in the last years did not allow me to pursue this oath any longer. [hesitant] Yet, perhaps if more adventurers like you turn up, I may be able to do so after all.

[warm] For your urgent help, let me reward you properly - by sharing where I strengthened my mastery of goldsmithing. [commanding] Far to the west, in the hostile plains of Desolace, you will find my own mentor, isolated from civilization. [soft voice] Although he wished to be left undisturbed, I know he wouldn't mind some company. [excited] Don't be discouraged should he not talk with you at first, persistence is what he values most in those wishing to seek knowledge!

[emphasis] Look for a great tower overlooking the ocean, it is where I last saw him.
quest_41290_quest_complete: <The Highborne eyes you dismissively.> [angry] First this bumbling human down there, and now you? [soft voice] Can an artist not find peace and quiet for once in his life? [commanding] Tell me, who sent you to The Artificer?
quest_41291_quest_detail: [solemn] So you are adamant to learn the art of Goldsmithing? [soft voice] Usually I pick my pupils, yet… If one of my former students recommended you and even sent you on an uncertain search for me, I cannot possibly deny your request. [urgent] We could start immediately, however there is a tiny predicament we are facing. [sad] I unfortunately lost my prized jeweler's kit when I was collecting minerals that were washed ashore down at the strand. [shocked] Startled by a sea giant, I had to abandon it and couldn't find a secure moment to retrieve it. [solemn] My fighting days are over, so if you wish to be taught my skills, then you have to reclaim it in my stead.
quest_41291_quest_progress: [hesitant] I hope my instruments are not damaged by the tides.
quest_41291_quest_complete: [sigh] Soggy and dripping, but still intact. [solemn] My gratitude is guaranteed, pupil. [soft voice] Well then, let us proceed.
quest_41292_quest_detail:
[solemn] You may address me as The Artificer, young one. I abandoned my previous name when the great city of Eldre'thalas fell millennia ago. [whispering] Wandering the wilds of Kalimdor ever since, I share my wisdom with individuals of the mortal races I deem worthy of receiving it. [soft voice] This friend that sent you here - he is among the chosen I have tutored, as incredible as it may sound. [pause] It seems his love for the craft didn't wane over time, however. [solemn] Assuring to hear.

[solemn] You wish to be taught the secrets of century-old goldsmithing techniques, passed on between races, civilizations, and generations? [commanding] Prove your skills to me. [commanding voice] Show me how well you can hear the blood of the earth sing.
quest_41292_quest_progress: Stay persistent. [solemn] Those willing to fail have proven themselves over and over again to be aspiring virtuosos of this craft.
quest_41292_quest_complete:
[solemn] Impressive, such profound cuts and grinding work. [warm] Anyone can see the blood, sweat and tears you've poured into the creation of these. The life one breathes into their artworks is just as important as the technical steps taken. Jewelry without a soul is just a product and an affront to the integrity of the craft's millenia old legacy.

[proud] But you've proven that your heart beats in harmony with Azeroth, attuning yourself to its essence and channeling that energy into your art. [warm] As my new pupil, please allow me to pass my sacred knowledge unto you. [soft voice] You have earned it.

[gentle] Oh, and should you ever see any of my former pupils again, tell them they can visit me anytime - I suppose some company can't hurt after a few years.
quest_41293_quest_detail:
[solemn] So he taught you some of his skills, you say. Well, rest assured, most of the knowledge he possesses has been passed on to him by me. He may be a proficient jewelcrafter, yet the more elusive secrets of the art are not found with him.
