[soft voice] If one wishes to dive into the depth of a craft, one must have a profound understanding of the surface.

[pause] Which is exactly what I want from you: show me what basic knowledge you possess about goldsmithing, so I may know where to begin with you.
quest_41293_quest_progress: [low voice] Don't try to impress me with speed. [solemn] I hold those who take their time in high regard.
quest_41293_quest_complete: <The Artificer inspects your work and the replica.> [solemn] Close. Without my guidance, you did an astounding job at repeating my pupil's steps. [proud] Remarkable. Nonetheless, to gauge your true potential, I expect you to craft an artpiece under my guidance. [soft voice] Here, listen close and show me that you listened well.
quest_41294_quest_detail:
[solemn] A true artisan encompasses all aspects of life into his work. Life, death. Heaven and earth. The elements at play in our world. [soft voice] You may know already, but the gems of Azeroth possess latent magic and elemental attributes, making them extremely powerful in the hands of the right - or wrong - person.

[commanding] Demonstrate to me that you can properly handle the energies of Azeroth's gemstones in the creation of your jewelry.
quest_41294_quest_progress: [solemn] Whether our pieces are used for the benefit or detriment of others is not part of our jurisdiction. The artist fashions their creations with no user in mind, simply its use.
quest_41294_quest_complete:
[solemn] Perceiving the world as it is may appear simple and nothing out of the ordinary, but only those willing to delve deeper are able to gain a profound understanding of its true essence.

[warm] You've shown me you are one of them. [commanding] Pay attention and heed my words, for they will bestow new insight to you.
quest_41295_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've had multiple pupils in the past centuries, and frankly I've lost count on how many there were. [soft voice] One, however, will always remain vividly in my mind and heart. [gentle] A young elf, one of fair skin like I haven't seen before. [warm] Her curiosity and eagerness for goldsmithing was unparalleled, attributes I admired about her juvenile spirit.

[solemn] She approached the art without bias and took it for what it was - the expression of heart and soul. [pause] When she finished her final project, a staff of significant quality, the winds of adventure swept her away - away from me. [sad] While I had hoped she would return to me one day, for even as much as a visit, reuniting with her sadly never occurred.

[sigh] Her presence - and lack thereof - left a mark on me, for I insist any of my future pupils share her clear sight on the craft. [commanding] Show you that you can follow her example.
quest_41295_quest_progress: Sometimes I find myself sentimental at the thought of her whereabouts. [sad] Yet it is fruitless to worry about her, albeit difficult to supress.
quest_41295_quest_complete: <The Artificer is surprisingly solemn at the view of your pieces. A soft chuckle escapes him, before turning back to you.> [soft voice] Thank you. [solemn] I am glad you sought me out. [gentle] Here, I will share with you something Gallitrea designed during my tutelage.
quest_41300_quest_detail:
[urgent] Oh, this is bad! [angry] Just how unfortunate can one single gnome be? [sad] I made a horrible mistake and now it's gonna cost me my head or worse - my home!

[shouting] Simply put, my finances are dry, severely dry! [hesitant] Desperate as I was, I accepted the offer of a dubious merchant with the promise of heaps of gold. [sigh] Yet, on his second visit, he was accompanied by two frightening thugs and demanded more wares from me than originally agreed! [whispering] My pleas explaining that my supplies don't cover his demands fell on deaf ears - and now they're threatening me. [proud] Me, the magnanimous and unmatched Talvash del Kissel!

[commanding] Please, assist me with my dilemma! [confident] I promise, you'll get justly rewarded. [urgent] The scoundrels left towards The Commons, I am sure these thieves are hiding somewhere in the countless houses along the outer ring!
quest_41300_quest_complete: [laughing] Sending a goon on his own to sort out his problems? Now this is something I hadn't anticipated of that squirmy little gnome.
quest_41301_quest_detail:
[commanding] So what are you here for? To ask me nicely to stop harassing your friend who doesn't want to uphold his end of the bargain? Or are you here to take the more... direct approach of solving problems? [threatening] Either way, I regret to inform you that neither is going to work. Deadlines are something my organization values and those who are not able to meet them...

<He gestures to the two daunting guards standing behind you.>

I am however a welcoming merchant and will not forsake an opportunity for the sake of animosity towards disappointing trade partners. [soft voice] Instead, I will make you an offer. Deliver double the amount of goods that Talvash is still owing us, and me and my compatriots will consider leaving him be. [confident] A sound proposition, no? [mocking tone] If I were in your stead, I'd do my best accepting it...
quest_41301_quest_progress: [commanding] Whether you make these yourself or buy them somewhere else, I do not care. [emphasis] Just ensure they are of high quality, our benefactors value a certain standard.
quest_41301_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you have returned. [commanding] Now let us ensure you will be able to leave as well...
quest_41302_quest_detail: <Motsog inspects the wares meticulously with a lens. While he does so, you can feel the bouncers breathing down your neck. After the shady merchant is done, he stores the jewelry in a box and tosses you a bag of money.> [soft voice] It was a pleasure doing business with you. [commanding] I'd suggest running along to your friend now and not showing either of your faces here ever again. [threatening] Begone.
quest_41302_quest_progress: <name>! [urgent] What took you so long? [hesitant] I feared they gave you an early visit to the afterlife. [urgent] So, what is it? [urgent] Am I safe?
quest_41302_quest_complete:
<Talvash opens the bag and looks exasperated.> [angry] What?! This is only half of what I was promised! [angry] Oh, this damn cutthroat, sleezy slimebag, and damn his very threatening bodyguards too! [sigh] Well, atleast I am not dead, correct? [soft voice] I have to thank you for that - really, I am grateful! [warm] You stuck out your neck for me without even hesitating, that's something not so common nowadays. [confident] Hopefully these thugs will not care to bother me again.

[soft voice] But do tell me: the jewelry you delivered in my stead, are you a jewelcrafter by chance? [excited] If so, please let me share one of my patented designs with you for your valiant heroism!
quest_41303_quest_complete: [low voice] Grizzby? No, he didn't leave Ratchet, atleast not by boat. [pause] But he did make it here, that's for sure.
quest_41304_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've known Grizzby for a long time, a sociable bloke, y'know, lots of friends. Comes with the job, naturally. [low voice] I was busy with logistics when he came here to the docks, we chatted a bit since the next ship wasn't going to show up for a long time.

While we were just passing the time, this other goblin approached him like he just met his long lost brother again. Must've been close, since Grizzby acted like he knew him well, too. I didn't catch much of what they were talking about, but I overheard that they were gonna go south, for whatever reason.

[sad] It's been some time now and I fear the worst for Grizzby, please make sure he's safe.
quest_41306_quest_detail:
[low voice] I am cursed with bad luck, I'm telling you. [soft voice] You see, with all the pirates roaming around the trade routes nowadays, sending your cargo via ship is the same as directly handing it to those swashbucklers neatly tied with a bow on top. [sad] So clearly not an option. [hesitant] The other alternative I have is having it delivered by foot, equally risky, you'll surely know what I am talking about.

[urgent] Either way, I chose the latter option and because I really, REALLY, needed to deliver this cargo I looked for the most intimidating ogre here in Ratchet and paid him to accompany me on my way down to Steamwheedle Port. [sad] Too bad we were ambushed by undead zombie quilboar who took both the ogre and my precious cargo with them.

[urgent] I am getting desperate here. [commanding] Can you retrieve my wares from the Razorfen Downs? [hesitant] I doubt they will be on my ogre guard anymore, but should he still be alive, he will know where they are.
quest_41307_quest_complete: [soft voice] What is this? Traxis' delivery? I've been waiting ages for this! [angry] What's up with that goblin and his lackluster service? Either way, [warm] thank you for finishing his work. If he didn't have such exclusive contact, this would be the last time I'm ordering anything from him.
quest_41308_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Okay, scrap what I just said. [angry] I will definitely not order from him again. All these gemstones have brittle surfaces! [shocked] How could this have happened? [urgent] What did he do with them?

<You explain to Fanzy how the jewels ended up in several undead stomachs and have been ruined by their bodily fluids.>

[sigh] Ugh, you didn't have to explain it in such detail. [sad] Gross. [sad] Well, this is just perfect. [sad] Now I have extra work on my hands, and that's the last thing I can afford right now. [warm] But luckily you are here to help out. [hesitant] Oh, don't give me that look, I'll pay you instead of Traxis, it's in his best interest to not show his grimy mug here anytime soon.

[commanding] To fix the gems we need something with a bit more oomph, your regular gemstone oil won't cut it here. [soft voice] Not far south of here is a small cove near the beach, you will find... let's say a business partner of mine there. [urgent] Bring him the oily glands of the Steeljaw Snappers from the coast, a greater mystic essence and a crystal vial. [soft voice] Tell him I sent you.
quest_41309_quest_complete:
[delight] Oho, now that's the stuff. I can tell right away that we can salvage that mess of Traxis with this miracle mixture. Did you come along with Zalashji? He's a solitary... man? Snake? I don't know, but so far he didn't say no to a long and philosophical talk about the history and art of jewelcrafting. Who knows, maybe someday I will tell you how we two met!

Since you helped me with preventing uncomfortable customer confrontations, let me reward you. [warm] Am I correct in assuming you're proficient in jewelcrafting as well? Don't be surprised, I'm not a master in this craft for nothing. Let me share some of my knowledge for free, as just payment.
quest_41310_quest_detail: [soft voice] <The book you've found looks not as old as the rest of the tomes lying around. Embellished with the sigil of the Kirin Tor, you assume it must've belonged to a powerful mage.
quest_41311_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was there when Arthas besieged Dalaran under the order of his demonic overlords. While Menethil committed heinous acts in his mission of stealing the Book of Medivh, his army sacked the city of the other dangerous relics we were securing in our vaults. [urgent] Defending the magical city from tooth to nail, I stood before a powerful doomguard seeking destruction and mayhem.

If it is the Clutch of Thanlar you seek, then finding that doomguard is what you must do. During my recovery after Dalaran's fall, the other surviving mages discussed Archimonde and his army's next goal - which turned out to be them going westwards, to these very lands, in pursuit of the World Tree Nordrassil. Should the doomguard still be on Azeroth, then I'd reckon he is plotting his revenge in a demon infested abyss, close to Mount Hyjal.
quest_41311_quest_progress: [solemn] Heed caution, <name>. [soft voice] If the demon survived the Third War, then he cannot be underestimated.
quest_41311_quest_complete:
[solemn] The clutch has found its way back to me, almost like a curse. [soft voice] I am most impressed you returned somewhat unharmed, your power rivals those of great heroes.

[warm] Now regarding the clutch...
quest_41312_quest_detail:
[solemn] When the clutch was in the Kirin Tor's safekeeping in Dalaran, I studied its form, function and purpose extensively. [soft voice] While Medivh was a secretive type, his magical implements and trinkets all bear a similar magical marking. Even mages not familiar with the Guardian can feel that. [pause] During my research I came to the conclusion that the clutch was part of something grand, and that in turn being part of something even greater. [emphasis] Judging from its form, an enormous gemstone must've had its place on the top of its holdings.

[urgent] Should you ever come across such a gemstone in your ventures to the haunted tower, I am confident in my abilities of restoring the artifact to its original state. [solemn] To do so, however, I'd need a strong arcane focus to channel my energy with. The blue dragonflight, protector of Azeroth's magic, holds custody over such objects, yet only their most powerful members actually carry these with them.
quest_41312_quest_progress: [solemn] An impossible endeavor, some might say. [soft voice] But the display of your abilities shown tells me enough about you and your endurance.
quest_41312_quest_complete:
[solemn] The gemstone was split? Curious, but not unexpected given the tower's state. Still, having it hidden like that - what was Medivh thinking? And this focus... a testament to the dragonflight's eternal charge of governing magic. I doubt any living mortal could conjure such a device to amplify the flow of energy.

It is bittersweet, you know? [soft voice] I've abjured my life as a sorcerer, yet I cannot deny helping you for the second time now lights up a feeling in my heart long forgotten. [warm] My hopes of you putting the horrors of the tower to rest grow after witnessing you succeed in this task. Take the completed head, and search the tower for the rest of it. Most assuredly, this will prove to be pivotal in your exploration of Karazhan.
quest_41313_quest_detail:
[solemn] This land is rich in magic. Numerous reasons brought me here for my research, and the many ley lines coursing through the earth are one of them. Potent arcane energies pour out of their flowing streams, luring countless mana hungry denizens of this and other worlds to them. [soft voice] I wish to understand more clearly why exactly this forgotten and cursed landscape is home to such a phenomenon. [pause] Curiosity escapes your eyes - do you intend to aid me in my endeavors?

Other matters keep me busy in my tower, so if you'd go out and acquire some reagents for me, you'd be rewarded for your efforts. What I need are crystallized formations of ley line energy. My students were able to locate two, to the east and south of here. [urgent] I suspect the resident blue drakes and the depraved blood elves are our best leads. Begin your search there.
quest_41313_quest_progress: [solemn] Lake Mennar is a focal point of arcane energy, it is not puzzling to see why the Blue Dragonflight congregates at that location. [hesitant] What exactly the blood elves are doing here eludes me, however.
quest_41313_quest_complete:
[solemn] Those appear positively unnatural. [soft voice] Ley line crystals materialize themselves on rare occasions when fleeting ley essence seeps through the earth, but these... [hesitant] Their formation appears different, almost forced, in a sense. Hm, peculiar...

<Archmage Xylem ponders for a bit, while inspecting the crystals further. Suddenly an epiphany strikes him.>

<name>, there are many plausible explanations for this. But to confirm my own theory, I need to conduct some tests first. [commanding] Will you assist me?
quest_41314_quest_detail:
[solemn] Both of these crystals have the identical integral structure, except the vermillion one - when resonating with a little bit of my own magic...

<Xylem channels a miniscule amount of his power into the red crystal and violent sparks and lightning emit from it.>

[pause] Listen, here are the facts we are working with: The Blue Dragonflight, for some reason we have yet to discover, collects ley line crystals from Lake Mennar whose growth is somehow artificially accelerated. The resident blood elves also possess these crystals, although in a different, more volatile state. Whether these two circumstances are connected is for us to uncover.

[solemn] I will continue gauging the stability of these crystals, while you retrieve a valuable relic for me, one we will need to complete our research. [soft voice] A former student of mine foolishly thought taking it out of my tower would go unnoticed. [urgent] Sanath informed me about her hasty departure to the east near Timbermaw Hold, no doubt using her friendly relations with them to hide herself.
quest_41314_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck in recovering what I seek?
quest_41314_quest_complete:
[solemn] Regrettable, and concerning. [low voice] I have to be even more selective in my choice of apprentices in the future. [sad] It is baffling that Tharessa acted so recklessly, I did not expect such behaviour from her. [soft voice] Granted, her eagerness was apparent, yet I assumed and hoped it to be rooted in her pursuit of knowledge, not power. [commanding] Whoever she worked for, I will see to it they will be brought to justice for their actions.

[solemn] Nonetheless, with the focus orb back in my possession, we will finally get to the bottom of this leyline conundrum.
quest_41315_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the focus orb returned, there is but one last thing we must assure ourselves of. Here, take the crystals and the orb and place them on the pedestal in front of my tower. [soft voice] A spell I put on the orb will then react with the ley line crystals and - hopefully - confirm my theory about their nature.

[commanding] Don't be afraid, for I will observe you from within this tower and intervene if necessary. Capable as you are, we shouldn't be too worried, but don't forget: [emphasis] Caution is a wise man's lifeblood.
quest_41315_quest_progress: [solemn] The focus orb will ensure the magical energies do not overload the crystals. [soft voice] So do not fear they might explode violently in your immediate vicinity.
quest_41315_quest_complete:
[delight] Positively outstanding. What we've witnessed proved my suspicions correct: the ley line crystals function as a conduit of energy that, when exposed to concentrated amounts of magic, manifest themselves in arcane monstrosities. If you take a closer look, both crystal remains are identical, meaning the blood elves have altered their own crystal after obtaining it from the Blue Dragonflight - whether they got it by force or cooperation, I am unsure to answer.

[proud] Thanks to you, my understanding of this land and its inhabitants heightened again. [solemn] It is concerning, however, to know the Blue Dragonflight is undertaking such suspicious actions. [commanding] They rarely care for the affairs of mortals, but do not hesitate to halt the abuse of Azeroth's magic in an instant. [soft voice] Let us observe and hope for the best outcome for now.

[warm] As for your reward; you are a capable jewelcrafter, correct? [gentle] Let me show you how to fashion a staff that amplifies the wielder's magical abilities, then.
quest_41316_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, a familiar face. [warm] Returning for some more training?
quest_41316_quest_complete:
[excited] This book...! [delight] I've heard about it! [excited] It's the last one in a series of masterfully crafted designs and plans for the most elaborate jewelry one can imagine! [warm] This one in particular addresses intricate guides to create extremely powerful trinkets with the diamonds of Azeroth.

[urgent] Now there is only one question: how do we open this damn thing?
quest_41317_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've been researching this legendary encyclopedia of jewelcrafting most of my life. It is rumored they are remnants of an ancient society, the progenitors of the human race we know today. [soft voice] Archeologists are finding more and more of their ruins - they are called the Azotha. [pause] So far only five of their tomes have been found, with eleven rumored to exist. [soft voice] An acquaintance of mine, equally as ancient, actually opened one - and told me of it. [whispering] He said the books are sealed using elemental runes, the ancient words uttered by the elementals of Azeroth. [pause] I've been looking into them ever since and the fiery rune on this lock here appears to be the Rune of Blaz.

[urgent] We need a fragment of an elemental that has attuned itself to that rune. [urgent voice] I hear the deepest caverns of the Blackrock Mountain, the Molten Core, are filled with blazing elementals. [confident] I believe we have the highest chance to find what we need there.
quest_41317_quest_progress: [excited] Seriously, I cannot wait to get my hands on the sweet, sweet plans inside of this book!
quest_41317_quest_complete:
[excited] Ouch, that thing is hot! [commanding] Must've been real tough to get, luckily you're on the tougher side of life, eh? [urgent] Now then, let's not wait any longer and crack this beauty open!

<Fanzy moves the shard over the heavy lock and with a sizzling heat emanating from it, it cracks open, before falling into the sands. Enthusiastically, Fanzy immediately starts flipping throught the tome.>

[sad] Empty. [sad] Empty. [sad] Empty. [angry] Empty! [shocked] Everything is empty except two pages! [sobbing] I can't believe this! [angry] Is this some kind of sick joke?!
quest_41318_quest_detail:
Okay, [hesitant] we got to roll with the punches. Let's work with this page first and see what's written here... ‘To illuminate the scripture, present to me the hearts of earth and fire. Extracted heat will unveil the knowledge that you seek.” [soft voice] These Azotha sure love their riddles. I can only guess, but I believe this is a similar situation to what we had before. We can only unlock this grimoire's secret if we have the appropriate materials present.

Hearts of earth and fire... this must surely mean the fiery and lava cores of powerful elememals. Extracted heat... perhaps the essence of fire? [excited] Yes, this must be it!

<name>, you know what to do. I'll be waiting here for you to bring the needed materials and try to wrap my head around this ‘extraordinary' book.
quest_41318_quest_progress: [commanding] Don't underestimate my gnomish intellect. [excited] I'll crack the code in no time!
quest_41318_quest_complete:
[urgent] You got the stuff? Great, now then, how about we test this theory of ours?

<Fanzy opens the page of the book and holds it high above her head. When brought near the empty page, the cores and essences liquify and transfer themselves to the parchment - ultimately forming sentences, completing the instruction for this piece of jewelry.>

[excited] WOW! Now that was absolutely amazing. [warm] Scrap what I said about this book, this is pretty nifty, I have to admit. [delight] Incredible, come here, let us scour this page together, we wouldn't have come this far without your dedication!
quest_41319_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The more I read - or rather DON'T read - the more I believe all the mystery about these tomes was just a ploy by some sniveling goblin trying to make a quick buck. Two measly pages have something written on it, and on this one is even just one sentence! [excited] ‘Channel the sun through crystallized blood.' What is that even supposed to... Wait! I got an epiphany!

<Fanzy is rummaging through her belongings and pulls out a blueprint.>

[delight] These are the plans for a jewelry lens I never came to create. It's designed to bundle light into a highly potent ray used to carve into metal. It requires very specific ingredients - which is where you come into play. The 'crystallized blood' must mean the highly elusive Blood of the Mountain, found deep within the Blackrock. I also need a framing for the lenses, Fineous Darkvire in the Blackrock Depths is known to possess a lens durable to even the strongest heat of the mountain. [urgent] Bring me both and I can tinker a tool to decipher the page with!
quest_41319_quest_progress: [soft voice] The lenses I originally envisioned for this amplifier were not cut out to withstand the intense heat. [solemn] But with the blood of the mountain and the dark iron casing, we might have a good chance at succeeding.
quest_41319_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent work. Just getting your hands on one of these gems is a feat in itself, I can't imagine how much effort you poured into getting three! [warm] Okay, hand all the things over, I'm in the mood to create a MASTERPIECE!

<Fanzy snatches the materials and hastily moves her tiny hands. After a few minutes, she holds the delicate lens into the sunlight, directly in front of the empty page. Surprisingly, instead of burning it, the focused beam of light creates elaborate sentences on the formerly clear paper.>

[shouting] EUREKA! [delight] A complete success! [excited] Time to harvest the fruits of our labor! [warm] Come here, let's read together!

quest_41336_quest_detail:
Hm, how strange. [soft voice] This sentence here... It is missing a rune, and without it, I cannot decipher this passage. [pause] It seems we've come to a halt. [low voice] Don't think I am giving up now, however. [confident] Something as simple as a missing rune is nothing I am intimidated by.

<The Artificer grabs a small tool from his table, which appears to be a miniscule staff, and moves it along the sentences inside the book. After a short contemplation, he faces you once more.>

[emphasis] I know where to acquire the lost rune. [solemn] As this grimoire is magical in nature, so is its scripture. [soft voice] The rune we seek can be replaced with a substitute of similar effect, one we can find in the shadowed hall of Scholomance. [hesitant] A harrowing place, so I heard, but their vile studies offer a solution to our problem. [urgent] Retrieve a rune with this form from one of their necromantic tutors and return with it to me.
quest_41336_quest_progress: [soft voice] Don't worry. Runes express their power depending on the context they are used in. [solemn] It won't cause the book to summon any ghastly fiends, friend.
quest_41336_quest_complete: [solemn] Back in Eldre'thalas, we studied countless, now long forgotten runes in our arcane sanctums under the order of Queen Azshara. Many of these I have forgotten over time, while others out of shame. Nonetheless, it seems my knowledge from that bygone era allowed us to gain new wisdom - wisdom you may use at your own discretion. [soft voice] Here, listen closely. [emphasis] It is time for a new lesson, pupil.

quest_41338_quest_detail:
[solemn] <class>, news spread from atop the sacred Mount Hyjal. [soft voice] Our greatest fear, the Nightmare, has taken root and seeps once more into our realm. [pause] Many brave souls venture to the great World Tree to offer assistance to our brethren's cause to quell the Nightmare's influence.

[urgent] <name>, I implore you to ascend Mount Hyjal and aid the Wardens of Nordanaar in their endeavors.
quest_41338_quest_progress: Greetings, adventurer. [solemn] To ensure our world's continued existence, we accept anyone willing to assist.
quest_41338_quest_complete: [soft voice] Moonglade sending support is assuring to hear, young one. [solemn] The turmoil we are facing should be the concern of us all, is it not perilous to ignore it.
quest_41339_quest_detail:
<name>, while our kind fights in the waking world, Ysera and her allies, the Wild Gods of Old, keep the Nightmare - an unfathomable evil rooting itself in the Emerald Dream - at bay with all their strength and might.

Years ago, during the Third War, Shan'do Stormrage and High Priestess Whisperwind convened with a powerful being at a sacred hill in the lower mountains of Hyjal. While usually radiating with the remnant energies of their encounter, we have noticed [solemn] ripples of discord emanating from it throughout the mountain. Given the current situation, we best uncover what hides behind it posthaste.

<name>, [urgent] seek that site near the Darkhollow Pass to the south and return to me with your findings.
quest_41339_quest_progress: [solemn] The hill's latent magic can even be felt by those not in tune with the wild. [urgent] It attracting evildoers is something we cannot ignore.
quest_41339_quest_complete: [solemn] A spectre, you say? In the form of a white stag? [soft voice] If what your eyes witnessed is true, then we cannot idle around any longer!
quest_41340_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is only one being in the history of Azeroth that fits the description of what you experienced - the Wild God Malorne, the Waywatcher. [soft voice] He was ancient when this world was young, one of the primal guardians roaming the untamed wilds years before the Sundering. [solemn] His immense power and prideful presence strikes fear into his enemies and comrades alike, yet his loving way of fostering nature made him revered with the latter.

[sad] What you experienced is horrid. [solemn] To think the Nightmare might have taken a hold on even a fragment of the great Malorne is terrifying. [urgent] We must act immediately. <name>, while I send notice to Moonglade, I need you to gather twenty bright dream shards. [urgent] They are imperative to shield you against the Nightmare's grasp. [commanding] Assist us in our cause, scour the hills of Hyjal. [urgent] However you acquire them, do it quickly!

[urgent] Once you have them all, bring them to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade. [solemn] He will give you further instructions.
quest_41343_quest_complete: [soft voice] A comically large candle. [mocking tone] Are you a jokester?
quest_41344_quest_detail:
[hesitant] As I ponder your request, I'm left in uncertainty, not knowing whether to respond with laughter or concern for the state of your sanity. [soft voice] Your requirements for this sizable, I mean colossal, candlestick hint at some kind of experimentation within the Master's Library.

[low voice] With you describing the magnitude of the candle necessary for whatever you intend to accomplish, along with your questionable means of access to that venue, I admit that I feel conflicted. [pause] Nonetheless, I do sense a palpable aura of strength emanating from you, which leads me to believe that you have the power to navigate those mysterious halls.

[solemn] Having said all that, I seem to recall a candle of considerable size positioned at the end of the guest hall.
quest_41347_quest_detail:
I am bored beyond measure. [solemn] This eternal purgatory I am chained to is not as painful as you might think, but moreso excruciatingly dull. [sad] I can experience earthly delights no more, and my love for jewelry is diminished by my inability to wear it. [sad] Even so, it is not like my most favoured trinket is in my possession anymore.

[soft voice] When I received Medivh's invitation, a heap of jewelry and gemstones were among my belongings. [soft voice] Most precious of all, a necklace of immeasurable value, pure azerothian diamonds, adorned on a delicate arcanite chain. [soft voice] Worth more than any of the guests in these haunted halls ever possessed in their lifetime. [sad] Oh, if I only had it on me at the moment of my death, I would still be able to cherish its beauty. [sad] Alas, it has been stolen, many years prior to your current time. [soft voice] The last time I saw it was before my departure from my estate in Stormwind.

[urgent] Living one, help me find my treasure, and I will reward you with a piece of jewelry bestowed upon me by Medivh himself.
quest_41347_quest_complete: <The blind drunkard is visibly intoxicated. Hiccups and burps are the only signs showing he is still with you. It appears he is almost at death's door.> [angry] Whaddya want?! [urgent] Can't ya see that I am kinda busy 'ere?!

<A guttural burp escapes him and vomit follows suit, dripping unto his already dirty shirt.>

[shocked] We lost everything, everything! [sobbing] They looted our treasury and murdered anyone inside the house. [pause] Even... even my beloved Georgina... [sad] Seeing her lie there, lifeless... [sad] the diamond necklace I stole for her, still shining... [angry] That beast, that orc ripped it from her - I may be blind but I can still see it... in my head! [angry] How he laughed and worshipped his warchief, that Doomhammer! [angry] I will never forget that monster, ever! [angry] Had it been me, I would've slaughtered them all, not put them into camps!

[angry] Whatever ya want from me, I don't have it, stop asking me questions! [angry] Piss off and leave me be!
quest_41350_quest_detail: [soft voice] Inspecting the sword, you see nothing out of the ordinary, besides its apparent dilapidated condition. The blade is brittle and rusted, while the hilt's leather is crumbling under your touch. Its pommel is surprisingly intact, with delicate engravings along the rim. It says: H. C. On top of it, the Lordaeron emblem inside a crescent moon can be seen. [solemn] Maybe this is the owner of the sword. [hesitant] If fortune is on your side, he also has the necklace.
quest_41350_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you wish to have a fine blade forged for you? [sad] I am afraid I have to disappoint, my smithing days are over. [solemn] A memory of this long forgotten place is all I am now.
quest_41350_quest_complete: [solemn] This sword is etched deep into my consciousness, something I cannot forget even if desired. [soft voice] Should your time allow it, let me tell you the story of my finest pupil.
quest_41351_quest_detail:

Following the days after the invaders were repelled, he was heralded as a champion, as it was him who stopped that absolutely vicious orc woman who cut her way through our troops like butter. As a trophy of her death, he took a beautiful diamond necklace from her - one that he zealously held on to, proclaiming it to be the testament of his greatest achievement.

He was a good man and friend, but his obsession with that pendant and its meaning consumed him. The last I saw of him was at his return with the traitor Menethil, when he as one of his fellow death knights thrust his tainted runeblade into me. <name>, [sad] I beg of you, find him and put his troubled spirit to rest. quest_41353_quest_detail:
With a single touch, the Amethyst begins to shine in a dim light that could easily enthrall your eyes forevermore. [solemn] Yet it was not its beauty that captivated your mind. [whispering] A voice rings into your head. One that does not belong to you. It echoes in stern yet soothing tone:
