quest_41353_quest_complete: [solemn] By Elune. I gather it was not chance that brought that item into your hands.
quest_41354_quest_detail:
[solemn] It appears the Amethyst is losing its enchantment. I would ask you not to question the way it works. It is a secret that perhaps ought to die with what was this home of mine.

[whispering] Alas, I bid you welcome to Kel'Theril. [solemn] Once a city to behold, now, home to me and the troubled spirits of my kin. [hesitant] I know not why you sought me. I very much doubt it is the guilt for slaying Incantagos.

<Al'Dorel sighs.>

[sad] A foolish son seeking to please his Father. [soft voice] Yet who am I, or you, to judge his path? [commanding] If it's answers you seek you may only find them through aiding me. [urgent] For a favor must be met by another favor. [solemn] The highborne that linger nearby must be put to rest. [sad] All across the lake they can be seen drifting with no purpose. [soft voice] Free them, and you will have my thanks.
quest_41354_quest_progress: [solemn] Whether Suffering or Anguished you must guide them.
quest_41354_quest_complete: [solemn] Believe it or not, you have shown great kindness.
quest_41355_quest_detail:
[solemn] Incantagos sought the Tower for its unstable ley-lines, and the intense power that lingered there. [soft voice] Incantagos sought to make a name for himself in the Blue Dragonflight, to advance their cause of the great dampening on azeroth. [hesitant] He sought to meet Malygos himself, but Haleh denied him this right, as she believed it was not yet time for them to meet.

[sad] I am uncertain of her reasons. [pause] In truth, I begin to question the actions of the Blue day by day as they began to be rather aggressive even to those they once called allies. [sigh] There were times I'd host the wyrmkin in my ruined home. [sad] It is sad to say that such times have passed, and now they have stolen something sacred to me.

[urgent] Before you learn more of Incantagos' choices, return this an item for me. [warm] A pristine moon-forged telescope that can see beyond the sky with its enchanted crystals.

[soft voice] They ought to have taken it inside Mazthoril to the southeast.
quest_41355_quest_progress: [solemn] Was your quest fruitful or are you yet to fulfill your task?
quest_41355_quest_complete: [solemn] A most treasured item. [soft voice] One of the final relics of this once mighty city.
quest_41356_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before Incantagos left for the Eastern Kingdoms I sought to give him counsel. [soft voice] For I truly was a friend of the Blue. [low voice] I told him that the Ley-Line he sought was nothing but unstable and not even he, a Blue, could truly harness it. [sad] Alas, not even I- nor even the great Guardian could truly.

[pause] Before he departed, he chose to rest in the Frostwhisper Gorge. [hesitant] He found solace amongst the Giants, for no reason I can think of. [solemn] Dragons shed when they fall in deep slumber. [urgent] Seek the demise of the roaming Giants, while it may upset the elements that roam these lands. [solemn] We are in need of these scales, for they can tell us more.

[commanding] Do not falter, friend. [hesitant] Perhaps you see these tasks of mine as meaningless. [solemn] But I assure you, this is not something we may leave unchecked.
quest_41356_quest_progress: [solemn] I sense you have braved foes stronger than these Giants. [soft voice] I doubt you require further council.
quest_41356_quest_complete: [solemn] You once more succeed to fulfill your task. [warm] For whatever kin you have left, I do hope they feel pride when they think of you.
quest_41357_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Have a look friend. [solemn] These pristine scales once shined embraced by an Azure tone. [sad] Yet now, in their lifeless form they further resembles a raw piece of lapis instead. [hesitant] I harbor no ill intent towards you, fret not. [sad] I simply regret Incantagos met his demise. Were I any faster, perhaps he would lived.

[solemn] Regardless, it seems we are yet to be closer to the truth. [sad] I was afraid of this. [solemn] With Incantagos gone, the magic of these scales has long dissipated. [urgent] We could briefly return life to them. [hesitant] But to do that we would have to either siphon the life of another Blue Dragon to it, or something akin.

[solemn] I am afraid you are to travel East once more, friend. [solemn] In the dungeons of what is now the largest Human Kingdom to remain you will find it. [angry] That despicable creation. [sad] For what reason had he done that, I will never understand. [solemn] Seek the living shard of Arc'Tiras. [solemn] Within its core you will find the very magic of the Blue, the essence of Malygos.
quest_41357_quest_progress: [solemn] That thing is better of destroyed.
quest_41357_quest_complete: [solemn] As every great wielder of the Arcane, Malygos has the thirst of knowledge and experiment. [soft voice] He infused his own mana into the ice of Northrend. [pause] Perhaps whatever may be closest to a “primordial” birthplace of a possible elemental. [pause] That is to say, his foolish experiment didn't end well. [sad] As you have seen, it did not look like an elemental. [cold] But a cold ruthless means of death.
quest_41358_quest_detail:
With these objects gathered I can finally find the answers we both seek. [soft voice] Allow me mere moments to cast my spells.

<Al'Dorel hums under his breath with his eyes closed.>

[hesitant] This is rather hard to accept. [hesitant] I am unsure how to react. [pause] I - I suppose it is not worth avoiding. [solemn] Arygos sought the Ley-Line of the Tower because the Blue considers the mortal races of Azeroth unworthy of the Arcane. [solemn] It seems that Malygos himself is preparing for… [pause] I wouldn't call it a war nor a battle.

[soft voice] Would the ants see your foot as a declaration of war or battle? [mocking tone] Or just pure extermination. [urgent] I must know if all believe this to be the right path. [urgent] I cannot leave this place, so please. [soft voice] Please on my behalf speak to Haleh. [solemn] She is the Broodmother of Kalimdor. [solemn] She rests atop Mazthoril and there is a rune inside you can use to reach her.
quest_41358_quest_complete: [solemn] A fair concern. I owe you no explanation – but I suppose Al'Dorel is different.
quest_41359_quest_detail:
[solemn] So Incantagos is dead. Were you not sent by Al'Dorel I would have used my teeth rather than my words. [sad] Alas, I suppose the unexpected had once more taken a child of the Blue.

[soft voice] It is all true mortal. [commanding] We stand ready to deprive you mortal races of the Arcane. [low voice] I hope you dare not question it. [angry] Not only has your foolishness brought the Great Sundering, the damned Burning Legion and all that came with it. [solemn] A portal to a different world? A great feat, one that was paid in blood a million times over.

[commanding] As protectors of this world we are meant to limit the access to the Arcane. [cold] Yet all of you grew so confident and rather powerful. [threatening] Lord Malygos, the very one who taught the first mages, has decided that you are no longer worthy of this responsibility. [solemn] Azeroth can heal, and new races can be born.

[soft voice] Sometimes a blank canvas is the best way to fix an issue. [urgent] Treat this as a warning, and leave as I still have some pity left for one that played part in the ending of Incantagos. [commanding] Tell Al'Dorel, he alone, shall be safe.
quest_41359_quest_complete: I- I am afraid I have to agree with her words to a degree. [sad] But to harbor such hatred and encourage genocide of entire races? [solemn] My heart sinks.
quest_41360_quest_detail:
[solemn] Incantagos was not alone in his quest it seems. [sad] How could they be so blind, so ruthless? [urgent] They must understand that this is not the path they must, walk. [emphasis] They must!

<Al'Dorel sighs.>

[soft voice] So there we have it, friend. [whispering] The truth, one that even if you are to share, nobody will believe. [pause] All we can do is – live. [warm] Feel the warmth of the Sun even in these cold lands. [solemn] Promises of end and death should never stop us from living today. [gentle] Do not worry. [soft voice] For as much as I was a friend of the Blue. [confident] I will be ready, and so will you.

[solemn] A day will come when we shall see each other's faces once more. [hesitant] I pray it will be as long as possible. [pause] Until then. [commanding] Come, I have a token from our long lost life that I wish to grant you.
quest_41360_quest_progress: [soft voice] I wish we would have met in better circumstances.
quest_41360_quest_complete: [solemn] I dread the day I will have to fight one I called friend. [sad] Alas. [soft voice] Kel'theril like many other Highborne settlements was filled with magic. [pause] Magic that was lost to the ages – [sad] I am the last survivor of these lands that have yet to flee it. [solemn] I have had these draconic artifacts ever since the lake swallowed my home. [warm] Take one, it is yours now. [warm] Something to remind you of me. [soft voice] Until we meet again.
quest_41361_quest_progress: [commanding] Stranger, you better be here for a good reason.
quest_41361_quest_complete: [excited] Blood of the Mountain! [warm] Getting your hands on one of those beauties has been really difficult, ever since Thaurissan's loyalists took control over all mining operations in and around the Blackrock. [soft voice] And this one seems to be a special kind...
quest_41362_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are correct in your assumption; I indeed can teach you how to cut a Blood of the Mountain yourself. [low voice] To do so however requires a set of reagents I do not have access to. [solemn] This warehouse may be plentiful, but with all the machinations Thaurissan is planning, the good stuff runs dry.

[urgent] Here, bring me these materials and I will gladly show you the old Dark Iron art of cutting a Blood of the Mountain.
quest_41362_quest_progress: [solemn] The Dark Iron pride themselves on their mastery over the mountain's body. [soft voice] Seldom has anyone else shown such expertise in manipulating Dark Iron ore and the countless unique gemstones found within its crust.
quest_41362_quest_complete:
I appreciate the effort, <name>. [solemn] This was definitely not an easy task, yet you provided me with such quality materials in no time at all.

Gemstones like the Blood of the Mountain require an extraordinary amount of precision and patience. Just the tiniest bit of unnecessary pressure and the entire jewel cracks in two. [whispering] Watch closely, for I have only one chance to teach you. You can keep the gemstone once I'm done. [warm] See it as thanks for bringing me such a peculiar example of a gem.
quest_41363_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You might've convened with my disciple Alanndrian already, she has taken it up herself to investigate the dangers crawling out of the Wailing Caverns, a cursed maze of caves in the Barrens south of Ashenvale.

[solemn] While noble - and certainly naive - Naralex' foolishness caused irreparable damage to the balance of Kalimdor, most prominently discernible at the rampant growths sprouting from the stone labyrinth. [emphasis] Some of these plants began to move by themselves, a testament to the potential of Naralex' involuntary powers. [urgent] I wish to study these plants, so that I may devise a countermeasure with the Cenarion Circle.

[warm] Bring me enough samples of the most violent plants you can find within the Wailing Caverns and you will be just rewarded.
quest_41363_quest_progress: Be careful. [solemn] Not only is this den of nightmares highly dangerous, but also your journey through Horde territory.
quest_41363_quest_complete:
[solemn] Intriguing. These samples radiate a magic not unfamiliar to me, on first glance I'd even say they emanate druidic magic. Ofcourse, I shouldn't jump to conclusions. Further research within the Cenarion Circle will be needed. Surely their venerable druids can solve the origin of their volatile growth.

[warm] <name>, you have my appreciation. [gentle] Please, take one of these as compensation for your troubles.
quest_41364_quest_detail:
Hail <name>. Still looking for more work? I have a report that needs to reach Duke Nargelas in Glenshire.

[solemn] Fret not, you won't be delivering it to his hands personally. All you must do is give this scroll to Deathguard Markus, he should be stationed right outside the church Duke Nargelas haunts.

[urgent] It's simply to let them know we've decided to send adventurers into the Shadowfang Keep. [commanding] Arugal mustn't be left alive. Getting to Glenshire shouldn't be that hard. You can either follow the path north or you can go back to Tirisfal Glades and reach it by traversing the Solliden Farmstead. Up to you.
quest_41364_quest_progress: [low voice] We do our mistress' bidding.
quest_41364_quest_complete: [solemn] So the Shadowfang Keep will soon be raided. [urgent] Good. While you're here, you wouldn't mind doing me a favor, would you?
quest_41365_quest_detail:
[solemn] Glenshire did not have many Light worshipers, although it's clear that at the time we all believed that we were born into the Light. [soft voice] We were more focused on keeping our lands safe. Even now, as we are able to walk once more thanks to our so-called dark rebirth, my allegiance is with the people of this place. [low voice] I have failed to protect the Duke in life, but I will not fail to do so in death.

[pause] My ambition aside, it was imperative that I express the justification for my request. [solemn] Father Brightcopf guided us through the blinding Light in the past, and he is now helping us crawl into the shadow. [warm] He places the needs of the Forsaken before his own, displaying the same selflessness in death that he displayed in life.

[pause] North of here stands the last camp of the Lordaeron remnants. [sad] Private William, our altar boy, walks among them. [hesitant] We can't muster ourselves to kill him. [commanding] So I am asking you to carry out this deed. [urgent] William is known to patrol from the Shatterridge Tower to the entrance of the camp.
quest_41365_quest_complete: [solemn] While the living are now seen as a threat, his death was unjustifiable. It needed to be done... [pause] I will mourn you for the rest of my days, William.
quest_41366_quest_detail:
[solemn] Duke Nargelas and the Baron of Silverlaine were good friends in life. Because of the respect and friendship they held for one another I too decided to keep close communication with the Prelate of Silverlaine Keep. Prelate Ironmane soon became my closest friend. He was a man like no other.

At times I'd leave Glenshire simply to hear his sermons. The way he spoke of the Light and the peace it brought him made me feel inferior as a holy man, even jealous perhaps. He would be ashamed were he to see me in this state.

<Father Brightcopf pauses for a few seconds.>

I know how this sounds <name>, but I hear the call of his spirit from the now corrupted keep. Ghosts face a different type of undeath, unlike ours. While I managed to regain myself after the Lich King's grasp weakened, he will forever be stuck in a certain place in time. Not even aware of his own death. [soft voice] Please, allow my friend to rest.
quest_41366_quest_complete: [solemn] I hope his soul may find its peace in the Light once more.
quest_41367_quest_detail:
[solemn] While waking Naralex should be your main goal, other things are required of you.

[soft voice] Through the cracks, as slippery as they could be the Kolkar found their way hidden in a branch of the Winding Chasm. [solemn] As we attempted to slay those that we set eyes upon during this invasion, one of them claimed the Wailing Caverns as their birthright.

[soft voice] Far from it, of course. [angry] The Kolkar trample on the love of the Earthmother and bring nothing but destruction wherever they see fit! [emphasis] The name of this zealous Kolkar is Zandara Windhoof. [urgent] As radical as this may sound, I want you to bring me her head.
quest_41367_quest_complete:
[solemn] The darkness of the nightmare loomed over my on thoughts, breaking free emotions that I would usually keep in check. In a way, I regret it has come to this.

<Nalpak sets Zandara's head on the ground.>

[proud] A job well done, is a job well rewarded. [warm] You have my thanks <name>.
quest_41368_quest_detail:
We do what the living cann- bah! [angry] I am piss tired of acting like nothing happened! [shouting] Congratulations <name>, you get to hear exactly -HOW- tired. [sigh] It must be a thrill, right? [mocking tone] Right?!

<Basil sighs deeply.>

[pause] I apologise, it seems something just clicked in my noggin just now. [sad] Feeling just a tad melancholic you see. [solemn] I used to be a top-notch blacksmith at what's now known as the dreaded Scarlet Monastery. [soft voice] I remember the days I used to forge armor within the blessings of the Light.

[angry] And nowadays, nowdays these maggots stare at me for even the mention of our former faith. [threatening] Fools, all of them. [solemn] As luck has it, I was away from the Monastery the day that evil spawn Arthas scourged this entire city -- and now I am bound to forge my work around in the muck. [angry] Outrageous, I tell you, outrageous! [urgent] My apprentice Daghelm should be alive somewhere in the armory. [commanding] The fool probably holds the journal I had on lightforge ingots - [emphasis] I want it back, even if you have to pry it from his dead cold fingers.
quest_41368_quest_progress: [soft voice] Don't worry about Daghelm's death, [hesitant] he's most likely a psychotic zealot by now.
quest_41368_quest_complete: [solemn] Precious, these notes are. [soft voice] Very precious. [hesitant] I doubt it'd cripple the Scarlets from making more lightforge armor at this point, but at least it's back in my hands.
quest_41369_quest_detail:
[solemn] Vestiges of great power emanate from you, stranger. [solemn] Vestiges akin to those circulating within the accursed tower, looming over this dead ravine. [soft voice] What feels like eons ago, us denizens of this church have been tasked to safekeep a relic, one that Hanvar restored for you not long ago. [soft voice] It is part of a powerful artifact, a conduit of unbound magic. [soft voice] Formerly used by the Guardian himself, it is now broken - a safety measure to ensure no evil abuses it to harm Azeroth like he once did.

[soft voice] Its parts are not only scattered throughout the tower, but the world too. [soft voice] Should you be able to acquire them on your journey, bring them to me and I may return them to their original form. [soft voice] However, to achieve this, an ample amount of arcane energy is necessary. [soft voice] I cannot leave this place, so it is up to you to bring me such a thing. [soft voice] The guardian's tower would be a suitable place to find it.
quest_41369_quest_progress: [solemn] Karazhan is built atop a focal point of ley lines. [soft voice] The beings inside the spire draw from that connection and gain insurmountable strength from that. [urgent] Be wary.
quest_41369_quest_complete: [solemn] Terrifying. Even if these are only remains from a volatile elemental, the sheer pressure coming from it is overwhelming. [soft voice] With this fount of energy, I will be able to combine the rod and the binding together, recreating the Scepter Rod of Medivh. [solemn] Though now restored, it is still incomplete. The scepter head is missing; where to find it, however, is beyond my knowledge. [warm] Shall it fall in your possession, speak to me again, and I will do my best to aid you again.
quest_41370_quest_detail:
[urgent] What I sense from you - this paralyzing heat, so much pressure, I can barely take it! [solemn] You have returned with the scepter head and it yearns to be reunited with its counterpart. [commanding] Let us not waste time, lest the immense force of these items will be too much to bear.

[soft voice] It is within my abilities to restore the Scepter of Medivh to its full glory, with the help of the remaining cosmic residue. [hesitant] However, it would only be a superficial restoration. [solemn] The scepter is but a useless bauble if not infused with the essence of the guardian, as it was his touch that awakened it. [urgent] Unless we find a way to attune it to Medivh, utilizing it will be impossible.

[sad] Seeing as the guardian does not dwell here any longer, finding such glimmers of him appears impossible. [soft voice] Please, it is imperative for you and me to locate it, or the scepter will forever remain inactive.
quest_41370_quest_progress: [solemn] We stand before a fundamental moment in history.
quest_41370_quest_complete: [solemn] I am trembling at the sight of the guardian's essence, that you were able to carry it here is a testament to your mental resilience and physical prowess. [warm] Now that all pieces are assembled, restoring the scepter will take but a few moments. [urgent] Please take a step back, unstable energies and raging magics are expected to erupt during the process.
quest_41371_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The scepter is complete, yet... different to how I remembered it. It looks identical, but the presence it has feels dull, almost empty. While the guardian's power is very much noticeable, there is an unmistakeable residue of foreign energy within the scepter itself. [solemn] This energy lies dormant, asleep and longs to be awakened. <name>, I fear we are not done yet, before we have released this magic from the relic.

When I focus my mind on the artifact, I recognize floating stone, a land tormented and fire being spewed from the ground. A race of traveling mystics, subdued by an emerald flame.

<name>, please forgive me for not being helpful enough. [hesitant] In order to harness the foreign magic of the scepter, I would need to harmonize it with an energized item from that plane I described to you. Where you would find such a thing, eludes my eyes, however.
quest_41371_quest_progress: [soft voice] Think about the place I saw in my vision. [pause] Perhaps what you heard reminded you of something or someone you met on your journey already.
quest_41371_quest_complete: [soft voice] I've never seen anything like this gemstone before. [solemn] The teal color, its structure and surface are incomparable to anything here on Azeroth. [warm] Yet again I am amazed by the lengths you go for in search for the truth. [confident] Now, let us finish this at last.
quest_41372_quest_detail: [soft voice] The attunement will take some of my time and energy. [pause] Please tell me once you wish me to start the process.
quest_41372_quest_progress: [solemn] Let us not wait too long. [soft voice] We don't want to let the magic remain untamed.
quest_41372_quest_complete:
I entrust you with the Scepter of Medivh, conduit of ley magic and the primal energies of an alien world. With it you may command the violent magical torrents of Karazhan itself. [commanding] Don't get complacent; while you are certainly powerful, the scepter' former owner is the only person to properly wield it. [solemn] Nevertheless, the deepest secrets of the accursed tower now lay at your feet, begging to be unveiled by the one strong-minded enough to brave its treacherous reaches.

[urgent] Go forth and claim the truth you fought so valiantly for! [proud] Let the conquest of Karazhan be one of the milestones of your heroic legacy!
quest_41373_quest_detail: [soft voice] The text is written in a very sluggish Goblin slang. [pause] As you circle through the pages familiar recipes meet the eye, but nothing too interesting. [sigh] With a sigh, you turn to the next page to notice a missing page. [hesitant] You would pay no mind to it were the book not to end there, but now that it did you were weighing in the possibilities.
quest_41374_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Gastino's recipe book was quite common as you may have already noticed. But it did contain a certain recipe that rejuvenated the focus of any healer. [solemn] Oddly enough, while the priests acknowledged the goblin's greedy ambitions, they couldn't help but feel grateful for this recipe he left behind.

In a way, I think they appreciated the simplicity of it. Since it was nothing but an assorted salad. [hesitant] I am afraid I don't know the recipe by heart but I think this missing page should be somewhere in the crypts. [commanding] This book belonged to someone buried there. [urgent] Be wary, I feel time hasn't been kind to that place.
quest_41374_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you find what you seek?
quest_41374_quest_complete: [solemn] A crumbled piece of paper. [sad] It's sad to see it reduced to this, no matter what. [soft voice] I will restore it for you, as holding it made me remember it.
quest_41375_quest_detail: [soft voice] Upon first glance, the book seemed to be a perfectly normal tome. [solemn] Yet as you began to study its contents, you quickly gathered that its appearance was more akin to that of a rough journal than an expertly written work. [hesitant] By the title, it claimed to be a study - yet the tattered pages and sloppily drawn text seemed as though they had passed through the hands of a child.
quest_41376_quest_detail:
[solemn] I do recognize this journal. It is something I used to keep for Prince Tortheldrin. We used to meet and discuss various things, not just he and I but most of the Lorekeepers. Eldre'thalas was a place of knowledge. Sadly it is nothing but a shadow of what it used to be. [soft voice] I appreciate you bringing this back.

If you have the time, I have a request. [pause] Upon examining this tome, I have discovered an incomplete glyph carved upon the final page. As we never concluded our research, I must ask of you to travel to the Warpwood Quarter and defeat the tainted Treants that roam the area. With any luck, they may still carry upon their foliage the blue color that once adorned them. If you bring to me these leaves, I will reward you with the results of our investigation.
quest_41376_quest_progress: [solemn] A certain nostalgia flows through my bones.
quest_41376_quest_complete: [solemn] And there we have it, with the glyph complete it can now be used. [soft voice] As to whether you choose to or not, remains up to you.
quest_41377_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, it will take me some time to delve into Ur's teachings. [soft voice] I must ensure that no vital detail escapes my attention. The tome is expansive, and Ur is known to embed secret messages for those who are keen of mind.

[pause] In the meantime, I have a task for you. [gentle] Among the wise sages of this world, few possess the wisdom and insight of Fandral Staghelm, the leader of our order. [solemn] He resides in Darnassus.

[commanding] Journey to Darnassus and inform him of your findings. [solemn] Surely, he will offer valuable counsel regarding this potent artifact.
quest_41377_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the fabled Scythe of Elune has been found. [soft voice] Dreamwind has been wise to send you to me, even if his efforts to heal Hyjal are misguided.
quest_41378_quest_detail:
[solemn] Elune's mysteries are profound, and even I, with all my knowledge, can find them inscrutable at times. [soft voice] I do not fully grasp why She would entrust Velinde—yes, that was her name—with such an artifact as the Scythe of Elune. [emphasis] Yet, its power to summon worgen may indeed be the very key to unlocking its deeper truths.

[pause] I have long been engaged in research into a peculiar herb known as morrowgrain. [soft voice] Interestingly, my studies suggest it might be instrumental in purging the dark energies that cling to the Scythe from its time in Karazhan. [urgent] But to activate the morrowgrain, a potent catalyst is required. [commanding] Therefore, bring me blood—the blood of the worgen, collected from various tribes lurking in the darkest recesses of Karazhan, prowling the abandoned streets of Gilneas City, and hiding within the shadows of Shadowfang Keep.

[emphasis] Do this, and bring them to me. [urgent] Do not delay. [solemn] The power of the Scythe must be harnessed and understood by one as capable as I.
quest_41378_quest_progress: [solemn] It is imperative that the Scythe is cleansed.
quest_41378_quest_complete: [solemn] Impressive. Now, give the blood to me. [commanding] I will prepare what is needed.
quest_41379_quest_detail:
I was right, as always. [solemn] Thanks to the morrowgrain, I have successfully purged the darkness from the worgen blood you gathered. [solemn] Now, witness!

<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm extends his hand, displaying a vial of pure, blue blood.>

[emphasis] This may not seem like much to you, but what you see before you is a testament not only to the strength of their bloodline but also to their connection to Elune. [soft voice] Look closer. Do you notice it in their blood?

[pause] Indeed. [soft voice] As pure as the waters of our moonwells. [solemn] That's what they were before blood magic tainted their species. [urgent] Bring this to Dreamwind at once. [commanding] He will know what to do next.

[soft voice] And, should you ever find the burden of wielding the Scythe too much for your weary shoulders... [pause] you know where to find me.
quest_41379_quest_complete: [soft voice] Pure worgen blood, just like Ur described... Yes, this will be very useful. [solemn] But now listen, as I have much to share.
quest_41380_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now, it will take me some time to delve into Ur's teachings. [emphasis] I must ensure that no vital detail escapes my attention. The tome is expansive, and Ur is known to embed secret messages for those who are keen of mind.

[soft voice] In the meantime, I have a task for you. Among the wise sages of this world, few possess the wisdom and insight of Fandral Staghelm, the leader of our order. [hesitant] However, I fear that he may not be as receptive to your presence as I am.

[solemn] Yet, not all hope is lost. Among your tauren allies, there is one who is nearly as wise as Fandral. I speak of Magatha Grimtotem. [soft voice] Despite the occasional unruliness of her clan, they have always revered Elune, whom they call Mu'sha.

[solemn] To my knowledge, she now resides in the great city of Thunder Bluff. [urgent] Go there and seek her counsel. [solemn] Perhaps she holds knowledge about the Scythe that eludes even me. [solemn] Your journey is far from over, and the wisdom of the Grimtotem may prove invaluable.
quest_41380_quest_complete: [solemn] So, the fabled Scythe of Mu'sha has been found. [soft voice] This Arch Druid Dreamwind has been wise to send you to me.
quest_41381_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have heard many tales of this weapon and the vile fate that befell it. [soft voice] Yet, not all is lost, for we may be able to cleanse it from the darkness of Karazhan.

[pause] Recently, some members of the Cenarion Circle, especially those closest to Fandral Staghelm, have begun amassing significant amounts of a certain herb called morrowgrain. [low voice] From what Archdruid Hamuul has shared with me, I believe that this herb might be the key to purifying the Scythe.

[urgent] However, for it to work, a powerful catalyst is required. [commanding] We need the blood of the worgen—blood from various tribes lurking in the darkest corners of Karazhan, prowling the forsaken streets of Gilneas City, and hiding within the shadows of Shadowfang Keep.

[solemn] Gather their blood and bring it to me. [confident] Together, we may yet be able to cleanse the Scythe and restore it to its true purpose.
quest_41381_quest_progress: [solemn] Scythe of Musha must be cleansed.
quest_41381_quest_complete: [solemn] Exquisite work, as always. [commanding] Now, hand it to me.
quest_41382_quest_detail:
[solemn] Whatever Fandral's lackeys are planning with morrowgrain must be truly extraordinary... [pause] But I digress. The blood has indeed been cleansed. Here, take a look, child.

<Magatha Grimtotem extends her hand, displaying a vial of pure, blue blood.>

[soft voice] Pure as the waters of the moonwell, shining like the stars themselves. [solemn] Before whatever horrible fate befell these worgen, they were the favorite children of Mu'sha, no doubt.

[urgent] Bring this back to Dreamwind at once. He will want to know.

And keep the Scythe close. [low voice] Some members of the Cenarion Circle may not be so pleased that it is in your hands.
quest_41382_quest_complete: Pure worgen blood, just like Ur described. [solemn] Yes, this will be very useful. They were once the favourite children of Elune, and to have their uncorrupted blood... [whispering] It will be the key during the ritual... [urgent] But now listen, as I have much to share.
quest_41383_quest_detail:
[solemn] During your absence, I delved deep into the teachings of Ur, scrutinizing every passage, every word, and every hidden meaning within the tome. [soft voice] The knowledge I uncovered is both enlightening and deeply unsettling.

[pause] Stay awhile and listen, young <race>. [solemn] The wisdom contained in Ur's writings is profound, but it also reveals a grim truth about the Scythe of Elune and the nature of its power.
quest_41383_quest_complete: [solemn] So now you know. [pause] We don't have much time left. [urgent] You must find them, so that the Scythe can be cleansed.
quest_41384_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is time to bring down Keeper Gnarlmoon. [solemn] The fate of our world depends on it. [solemn] His presence in Karazhan is a blight that cannot be tolerated, and his schemes must be thwarted before they come to fruition. [solemn] The balance of nature itself is at stake.

[soft voice] You have already ventured into the Upper Chambers of Karazhan in your quest for the tome, so you are familiar with the labyrinthine corridors and shadowed halls. [urgent] The journey ahead will not be easy, but your previous experience will serve you well. [low voice] Gnarlmoon has entrenched himself in the very heart of Karazhan's dark magic, drawing power from the cursed place to fuel his malevolent plans.

[commanding] But beware, for Gnarlmoon is no ordinary adversary. [solemn] He is a bloodmage of legendary power, one who has dabbled in the darkest arts for centuries. [threatening] His command over blood magic is unparalleled. [urgent] To face him alone would be folly. [urgent] You will need allies, strong and brave companions who can stand with you against the tide of darkness.
quest_41384_quest_complete: [solemn] The foul pricolich Gnarlmoon is dead! [warm] Impressive indeed. [warm] You have saved us all.
quest_41385_quest_detail:
[solemn] My ravens have whispered of a dark presence that once shadowed the streets of Gilneas City. [soft voice] Far across the sea, amidst the gloom and mist, a worgen bloodmage was seen weaving his vile magic. [sad] This creature has left an indelible mark on the already troubled land. [low voice] The details are scarce, but one thing is certain: he often conspired with the infamous regents of Gilneas, the Harlows.

[commanding] The Harlows are a cunning and ruthless family.[pause] It is said that they would align themselves with anyone who could further their ambitions, no matter the cost. [threatening] The bloodmage found in them willing accomplices, ones who would turn a blind eye to his dark practices as long as it suited their needs. [solemn] It is within their shadowy dealings that the key to the bloodmage's plans may lie.

[urgent] If I could leave the sacred groves of Hyjal, I would journey to Gilneas myself. [gentle] But you, young one, have the freedom to venture forth where I cannot. [proud] Your path is clear, and it leads to the mist-shrouded streets of Gilneas City.
quest_41385_quest_progress: [solemn] I cannot leave Nordrassil, not yet.
quest_41385_quest_complete: Father Lycan... [solemn] A name steeped in shadows, yet one that may hold the key to our salvation. [soft voice] This journal you've unearthed, while enigmatic, could be the catalyst for unlocking the truth behind his sinister presence. [low voice] Let us delve into Ur's teachings once more, for within lies the wisdom to decipher this mystery.
quest_41386_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the annals of ancient lore penned by Ur, it is whispered that the mere utterance of the pricolich's name could serve as a beacon, drawing forth his dark presence into our realm. [urgent] But heed me closely, for there exists a stratagem, a cunning plan to entice him forth under our control.

[solemn] Take this arcane orb, a relic of ages past, infused with the essence of primal magic. [commanding] With it in hand, venture westward to the site of an ancient Circle of Power, a nexus of energies both primordial and potent. [soft voice] There, amidst the whispering winds and the rustling leaves, speak the name of the pricolich.

But do so with caution, for his arrival must be orchestrated with precision. [solemn] Once summoned, we shall wield the Circle's might to ensnare him, stripping away his dark powers and rendering him vulnerable. [solemn] It is then, in that moment of weakness, that we shall strike, banishing him back to the shadows from whence he came, and securing our realm from his malevolent grasp for eternity.
quest_41386_quest_complete: [solemn] The vile pricolich Lycan is dead! [warm] You stopped him and avenged Velinde!
quest_41387_quest_detail:
[solemn] So you step before me. Surely to seek tutelage in the art of war - why else would you search for the master of arms. [commanding] You are one among many who wish to reach expertise in the martial arts, but will you be one of the few to actually achieve it? [low voice] I've lost count on how many gullible and naive warriors think they are worthy of my teachings, only to fail at the slightest challenge. Unless your worth is proven to me, I cannot be sure you are suitable for what's to come.

[solemn] High up the mountains to the north lies a defiled forest called Felwood. Even further north you will find the Irontree Cavern; from within this cave a root, cold as iron and equally heavy, is what I require of you. [urgent] Pick the root and bring it safely to me.
quest_41387_quest_progress: [solemn] This ordeal will show me if you got what it takes.
quest_41387_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Ironvine Root is an aggressive plant. When uprooted it clings around its captor, trying to drag it to the ground, ultimately wearing them down. [pause] You, however, did not bend to this natural force. Your mind was clear, your will iron. [solemn] The last person to pass this test was my apprentice Sakgoth, many years ago. [warm] Perhaps I have found someone extraordinary in you. [soft voice] The upcoming trials will tell if I am correct in my assumption.

<Mathias takes a dagger and with a swift cut you almost couldn't see, he removes the gripping vines from your body.>

[gentle] We shouldn't let it get to waste, you can brew excellent tea with this root.
quest_41388_quest_detail:
[solemn] Apologies for my brash demeanour, but I have to make sure you are cut out for the path of war. [soft voice] You may be experienced in the martial arts, but following my path takes more than what you’ve accomplished so far.

[pause] As previously mentioned, many ambitious people stood where you are now, but only a few succeeded. [emphasis] It is important to learn from mistakes, our own and those of others. [gentle] Speak with my former pupils, and they will share stories of failure. [commanding] Only if you really understand their faults will you proceed. [urgent] Speak with Sakgoth and Klannoc on this island and Ka’fai in Tanaris. [warm] I heard the thrill of the desert lured him to the city of Gadgetzan. [solemn] Once you’ve done so, return and answer my questions about their tellings.
quest_41388_quest_progress: [solemn] No lesson is the same. [soft voice] Comprehending the connection between them and the mistakes made allows you to grasp their wisdom.
quest_41388_quest_complete: [solemn] Commendable. [soft voice] Taking these lessons to heart is imperative for your future success on this road you've taken.
quest_41389_quest_detail: [soft voice] Here, take the glass marble and bring it to Sakgoth. It is proof of your deeds and signals you as his equal. Be ever vigilant and remember what you learned. [excited] I am excited to witness your further growth!
quest_41389_quest_progress: [urgent] Just what happened up there? [sigh] It smells like burned flesh in there.
quest_41389_quest_complete:
[solemn] The master is an enigmatic man, and I will most likely never fully understand the ways of his mind. [soft voice] Luckily that's not what we are here for, right?

[warm] This pearl you brought, truly something else. [solemn] Every student of the master's receives a personal gift from him - and technically me - as proof of their accomplishments. [proud] Mine is the stinger of a scorpid I've slain in the Thousand Needles. [warm] And for you... what do you think of a pendant?
quest_41390_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you. Headed to Westfall, by chance? The SI:7 is on a big lead about the Defias' machinations involving individuals outside of Westfall. We suspect they're dealing with some sort of highly volatile chemical that could pose a threat to not only Stormwind, but the rest of the Eastern Kingdoms as well. We could use some... 'additional muscle', per say, as this job may very well not be the stealthy type of deal.

[commanding] One of our agents is situated down in Westfall at the bridge leading to Duskwood, near the abandoned mage tower. I want you to go and meet her, and be quick about it. There has been a sudden turn of events worth investigating. Kearnen is her name; and once you find her, do as she says.
quest_41390_quest_complete: [urgent] Renzik sent you? Good. [commanding] I could use a bit more manpower.
quest_41391_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've been spying on this tower for quite some time and anything happening around it is unfathomably strange. The Defias are sparse here, but certainly well equipped. That alone is concerning enough, yet what puzzles me the most are those zombies patrolling the perimeter. Every now and again, some of the Defias enter the tower; but instead of them leaving again, a completely new specimen of these zombies shows its ugly face.

I'd like to investigate further of the internal machinations of this tower, but I am waiting on reinforcements from the SI:7. What you are here for is fairly simple, but all the more crucial. [urgent] At the dock near the tower, I noticed a shady goblin mooring her rowboat full of crates. Surely a delivery of some sorts, what we need however are documents, preferably with names of the people involved in these operations. Deal with her how you like, but bring any valuable info directly back to Renzik in the SI:7 headquarters.
quest_41391_quest_progress: [low voice] Back so soon? [hesitant] I hope not with empty hands...
quest_41391_quest_complete: [angry] Jared Voss? I hate that this name rings several bells. [urgent] If what is in this document is true, then we should make haste immediately.
quest_41392_quest_detail:
[solemn] Jared Voss is the son of William Voss, a highly skilled and educated alchemist. His father had an alchemy shop here in the Old Town, beloved by many. When Stormwind was burnt down a second time, his family's home was among those burned to ashes. During its rebuild by the Stonemason's Guild, Voss naturally assumed his house to be restored, given his importance as Stormwind's most renowned alchemist. Ironically, it would not come to pass.

Stormwind's nobility had different plans of reconstructing the city and in the end, Voss and his family became homeless. With a growing hatred in his heart, he condemned those responsible for their fate. We're assuming Voss sent his son to the Stonemason's before his death, who shared his disdain. It seems Jared succeeded his father in both hate and abilities.

<name>, [commanding] Voss cannot be allowed to operate any longer. According to the list you brought, he dwells in the Deadmines. Liquidate him and bring me samples of his newest brew.
quest_41392_quest_progress: [urgent] Don't waste time. [threatening] I'm not as patient as Master Shaw.
quest_41392_quest_complete: By the mines of Kezan! [shouting] This smells horrible. One whiff of it and any grown sailor will fall over in a heartbeat. <name>, [proud] excellent job. While we were able to secure this end of the operations, we still have to investigate where exactly they're getting all the supplies from, as I am sure the Venture Co. is simply a middle man. Still, so far you did great and for that I've got a reward for you. [warm] Stay clear of trouble, adventurer, wouldn't want to see you getting killed.
quest_41393_quest_detail:
[solemn] You possess an iron will. You draw wisdom out of past mistakes. [commanding] Now demonstrate to me the strength you carry. [urgent] I will keep it short, so listen up.

[emphasis] To the far east, in the Burning Steppes north of the Redridge Mountains, a simmering giant slumbers, his power unparalleled. [urgent] Search the northern mountains, slay the fiery beast and bring me his burning eye.
quest_41393_quest_complete: <The giant's eye is incredibly hot, yet it matters little to Mathias. Sizzling noises erupt from his hand while he inspects the stone you brought him. After having marveled at it long enough, Mathias dunks it into a nearby water bucket, filling the room with steam. The steam clears, and what you see in his burned hand is an immaculate glass marble.> [soft voice] Such an interesting material. I've always wanted to get my hands on one of these, just to experience their intense heat. [warm] Impressive work, <name>. You've proven yourself to me. [proud] Welcome to the fold.
quest_41394_quest_detail:
With the lingering shadows of the pricoliches dead and their influence waning, the time has come for us to clenase the Scythe of Elune. [solemn] Yet, such a feat is no simple task, for the tendrils of dark magicks woven within its very essence are deeply entrenched.

[soft voice] Gather close, young one, and heed my words. To commence the purification process, we shall require six Eternal Dreamstones and twenty Mooncloths. [emphasis] These shards shall form the cornerstone of our endeavor, serving as conduits for the purifying energies that shall flow through them.

[solemn] But the path to purity is fraught with peril, for the dark magicks that infest the Scythe yearn to be unleashed once more upon the world. [commanding] To contain such potent forces, we must fashion a vessel of unparalleled strength – the soul of a powerful demon. [whispering] Among the ranks of the nether, whispers abound of a dreadlord named Mephistroth.

[urgent] Venture forth into the depths of the nether, and seek out the essence of Mephistroth's soul.
quest_41394_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you found the materials needed yet?
quest_41394_quest_complete: [solemn] The soul of a Dreadlord... Everything seems to be in order. [soft voice] Now, it's time to cleanse the Scythe of Elune!
quest_41399_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. [soft voice] From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.

[pause] Among these objects somehow a desecrated signet can be found. [commanding] You must return it to me and I'll purify it into something you can use.
quest_41400_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have claimed the garments of Stormrage, <class>. [soft voice] I can sense Nature itself in you, yet it seems rather dim. [low voice] Perhaps the ones you carry are not suited for the tasks you are willing to perform.

<Kazud hums for a few seconds.>

[commanding] Hand it here and tell me, are you true to your nature?
quest_41400_quest_progress: [solemn] Choose carefully, your decision is final.
quest_41400_quest_complete: [warm] Winds blow your way, it seems Nature adores you.

quest_41416_quest_detail:
[commanding] I make no pretenses, maggot. [threatening] The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. [low voice] That is why the price is so high. [cold] If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.

[threatening] And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. [urgent] Bring me the ring we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
quest_41416_quest_progress: [urgent] The prodigal rodent returns! [commanding] Have you found it?
quest_41416_quest_complete:
[solemn] Do you see? Do you now understand the power? [whispering] Purification... [sad] What fools…

<Mataus shakes his head disapprovingly.>

[urgent] Now take it and get out of my sight.
quest_41417_quest_detail:

<Melus hums for a few seconds.>

[commanding] Hand it here and tell me, are demons chatty?
quest_41417_quest_progress: [solemn] Choose carefully, your decision is final.
quest_41417_quest_complete: [solemn] These garments seem to suit your true nature far better. [warm] Be mindful of the power you possess, <class>.

quest_41517_quest_detail:
[solemn] Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands?

[soft voice] In your many hardships you will also find a desecrated signet. [solemn] With it, your armor will be complete.

[gentle] It may have not been forged to mold around the use of your skills, fret not. [warm] Return it to me and I will change it for you.
quest_41517_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you brought me that which I require?
quest_41517_quest_complete: [excited] This ring is infused with the power of my ancestors! [solemn] Tread wisely...
quest_41518_quest_detail:
[solemn] Now tell me: How does it feel to be proven worthy by the master? [low voice] When he chose me as his apprentice, it was the greatest honor I ever felt, you surely feel the same.

[urgent] If the master wishes to share his knowledge with you, I can assist you with that - for a price, ofcourse. [commanding] He may be benevolent, but not foolish enough to act in charity, you have to contribute your share of work as well. [solemn] Hidden within the most dangerous places of Azeroth you will find texts, those from ancient times, containing long forgotten teachings. [urgent] Find them and with a bit of gold from your end, I can get you on the right track to unlock new battle strategies for you.
quest_41518_quest_progress: [solemn] Nothing in this world is free. [low voice] Your growth has to be earned.
quest_41518_quest_complete: [solemn] A wise contribution. [soft voice] This text will be of ample use for the master. [warm] As for your reward, take this book; a summary of the master's knowledge he amassed over the years. [commanding] Once you are done studying, return it to Nora upstairs.
quest_41519_quest_progress: [soft voice] Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
quest_41519_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Pandaren? Yes, I heard about them, but many consider them a legend, or a fairytale for the kids. [excited] But I heard from some very credible people that they actually exist!

[pause] That's not really important, right? [urgent] You want to know more about the art of staff fighting. [hesitant] Not my strongest suit for sure... [solemn] Master Mathias could tell you more, but his time is very valuable, so you have to prove yourself! [warm] And actually, I have an amazing idea how you can earn his respect!
quest_41520_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We are often visited by the Theramore soldiers, and they always tell this story.

[emphasis] Picture this: during the siege, those who stood by Jaina and Thrall's New Horde had an extraordinary ally—a pandaren Brewmaster named Chen Stormstout. [excited] I'm talking about someone who fought with such passion and skill, it was like watching a whirlwind of power and precision! [solemn] Chen's mastery with his staff was nothing short of legendary.

[emphasis] But get this—after the battle, the guy just planted his Brewmaster staff right into the ground and walked off into the horizon. [surprised] Can you believe it? [soft voice] They say the fight was so brutal and intense that he just couldn't bear to be reminded of it ever again.

[warm] Now, I'm not saying this story is gospel, but if there's any truth to it, Master Brightheart would be over the moon if we could recover that Pandaren staff! quest_41548_quest_progress: [low voice] Nothing in this world is free. [emphasis] Your growth has to be earned.
quest_41548_quest_complete: [solemn] A wise contribution. [soft voice] This text will be of ample use for the master. [warm] As for your reward, take this book; a summary of the master's knowledge he amassed over the years. [urgent] Once you are done studying, return it to Nora upstairs.
quest_41549_quest_progress: Greetings! [soft voice] I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
quest_41549_quest_complete: [soft voice] Quite the odd one, right? [solemn] The master's a knowledgeable man even beyond the art of war. [soft voice] Even I was astonished by the range of anatomical research I could find within this book. [pause] Still, theory is certainly fine, but what does it accomplish if not applied into practice? Luckily - well, lucky may not be the proper word to use in a situation like this - [soft voice] I can make sure the master teaches you the practical aspects of his work, if you assist us in a more delicate matter.
quest_41550_quest_detail:
[soft voice] We've set our eyes on a peculiar set of daggers for a while now. Most would view them as knives, but to a schooled eye like our master's, they are deadly weapons of silent murder. [solemn] They belong to a man named Damian, although he is most commonly known as The Ripper. His past is draped in a bloody curtain, a monster without morals. [pause] Yet, even a monster like him can have its purpose.

[urgent] Damian is held within the Stormwind Vaults, a high facility prison inside the city of the same name. [whispering] We've heard its occupants broke free due to some supernatural intervention; leaving him to pursue his desires upon anyone left alive. <name>, venture inside, relinquish Damian of this set of daggers and bring them to Mathias. [commanding] Do so and I will make sure he tutors you.
quest_41550_quest_progress: [gentle] Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. [soft voice] Nora told me all about it. [pause] Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
quest_41550_quest_complete: [soft voice] You look lively, considering the place you've been to to get your hands on this. [solemn] I expect this Damian to have been quite skilled with daggers, a shame his delusions and frail mind rendered him into an abomination. [warm] My gratitude for removing this pustule from our world. [solemn] Aberrations like him cannot be allowed to wreak havoc, neither now nor in the future. [commanding] I expect you to continue assisting in keeping Azeroth a safer place. [warm] Now then, join me - let us take a look at what those beauties can do.
quest_41551_quest_detail: [gentle] A pleasure to see you return, my pupil. [solemn] Rarely do my old students come back to their master for relearning things they already internalized. But I cannot fault you. One's mind has only so much expanse and it is only natural for someone as young as yourself to experience other venues as well. [soft voice] Now then, shall we proceed?
quest_41551_quest_complete: [solemn] I knew you wouldn't forget my teachings that easily. [soft voice] Still, the renewal was very much needed. An art as intricate as Goldsmithing cannot be mastered unless one focuses on it entirely. [warm] I am grateful for your continued interest in this ancient craft, my pupil. [gentle] May you find enlightenment in it.
quest_41553_quest_detail: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! [commanding] A one of a kind competition unfolds in the bustling port of Ratchet! [warm] Any connoisseur of fine ale, grog and stouts should not miss out on this unparalleled occasion. [urgent] Grab you drinking buddies and help out in making the perfect alcohol in all of Azeroth!
quest_41553_quest_complete: [angry] If that bloody bastard thinks he can one-up me, he can think again! [commanding] Once I have formulated the recipe for the perfect brew, he can come here and kiss my boot!
quest_41554_quest_detail: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! [commanding] A one of a kind competition unfolds in the bustling port of Ratchet! [warm] Any connoisseur of fine ale, grog and stouts should not miss out on this unparalleled occasion. [urgent] Grab you drinking buddies and help out in making the perfect alcohol in all of Azeroth!
quest_41554_quest_complete: [angry] If that bloody bastard thinks he can one-up me, he can think again! [commanding] Once I have formulated the recipe for the perfect brew, he can come here and kiss my boot!
quest_41555_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is my life-long goal to create the most potent, delicious and savoring beverage known to Azeroth: the Hornfang Reserve! [excited] Its rich flavour and unique texture will enchant anyone indulging in its foamy top and bitter taste. [pause] That is when I am done getting the formula right. [sad] I hate to admit it, but my previous attempts at it were falling flat in one way or another. [hesitant] There is always something missing that really brings all of the ingredients together. [urgent] I just need to find out what it is! [commanding] That is why I came here to Ratchet, so I can gather all sorts of rumors and stories about potential components that might be missing for my brew.

[mocking tone] Apparently the local quillboar of the Razorfen Kraul are brewing their own alcohol. [angry] Who would've thought that these primitive pig people are able to produce grog on their own? [urgent] I need to find out what this grog is all about, how it is made and whether it has the secret ingredient I am looking for!
quest_41555_quest_progress: [hesitant] I sure hope they don't brew it from briarthorn; [sad] I once tried it myself and it was absolutely horrible!
quest_41555_quest_complete:
[excited] Aha! There it is, the elusive Razorfen Grog. Pass it over, I'll give it a thorough test.

<Hal'togg uncorks the bottle and takes a deep whiff of the ale's scent. He grimaces, but quickly regains composure. Putting the bottle to his lips, he takes a small sip of the alcohol.>

Yes, ofcourse. [soft voice] This is definitely brewed with briarthorn, it has the same distinct flavor. [hesitant] But something is different. Perhaps?
quest_41556_quest_detail: I think I have a good understanding of how this grog was made. It's not unlike what I used to brew before with briarthorn, however they must be utilizing a different method. Maybe they used a higher temperature...? Yes, that must be it! A higher temperature when brewing the briarthorn could reduce the bitterness to an enjoyable amount. How they achieved such a potent flame I still don't understand, however. They surely must've used magic. As I have no magical means on my end, we have to find something else. The elements of this world sometimes leave a flicker of their essence behind. One such thing could potentially heat the flame to the required level. [urgent] <name>, go out and bring me elemental fire from any fire elemental out there - we need it to fan the fire!
quest_41556_quest_progress: [solemn] That I would learn brewing techniques from Quilboar is something I wouldn't have expected to happen today.
quest_41556_quest_complete: [excited] Yes! [warm] These are nice and hot, perfect for stoking the fire. [urgent] I will keep these for now and use them at a later point; right now we have more urgent things to do!
quest_41557_quest_detail:
[low voice] Thaldon over there just blabbered about discovering something groundbreaking about the Lordaeron Ale from the Eastern Kingdoms. [angry] I cannot let this little man get an advantage over me, which is why we will go even higher! [urgent] While he is content with his lousy and boring Lordaeron Ale, our goal is the enigmatic Scarlet Schnapps, a brew that so few had the chance to drink, it is said to be a legend.

[solemn] A culinary peculiarity of the Scarlet Crusade, I have heard they are brewing it in their monastery in the Tirisfal Glades as some sort of light-inducing drink. [excited] If this brew really has these magical properties, then I need to get my hands on it!
quest_41557_quest_progress: [commanding] These zealots protect their secrets viciously, but we are even more vicious in our quest for the ultimate brew.
quest_41557_quest_complete:
[excited] You really found it! [warm] A legendary schnapps, rarely seen or tasted by the outside world. [excited] Let's give it a try!

<A deep chug and half of the schnapps is missing. Hal'togg's green face turns slightly red. This brew seems to be a kicker!>

[excited] Wow, this drink surely packs a punch, now I know why they say it fires you up. [soft voice] A burning taste combined with a sweet aftertaste. [hesitant] If I didn't know better I'd say they mixed a special sort of hops into it. [hesitant] Finding out which type of hops they used might be difficult however...
quest_41558_quest_detail: [solemn] The Silverpine Forests have a unique vegetation that thrives in the mountainous and harsh reaches of the area. [soft voice] Their flavour is deceptively bitter, so it is rarely used by inexperienced breweries. [low voice] We, however, can make ample use of this plant. [emphasis] It might not have the properties needed to replicate the fiery feeling of the Scarlet Schnapps, but with the brewing technique of the quillboar, we might be able to distill it enough to acquire a distinct flavour for our own brew.
quest_41558_quest_progress: [urgent] Any luck with the Silver Hops?
quest_41558_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, I remember their distinctively strong smell. [soft voice] The earthy tones will perfectly compliment my other ingredients once I brew it at a high enough temperature.
quest_41559_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Finding a plant with a pungent fiery taste can be difficult. Many I've come across in my brewing adventure had a certain spice to them, but nothing to the level of the Scarlet Schnapps. [urgent] Luckily I picked up some rumours from the goblins at the docks; you'd be surprised how many stories they pick up with all the trade happening here.

[low voice] Over in the Eastern Kingdom, the Badlands are home to a vibrant red type of hops. [pause] Apparently the resident ogres pick up these clumps of hops and chew on them - raw! [angry] These bulky meatheads surprise me anew every time I have to deal with them. [commanding] Relieve them of their hops and bring it to me, we'll make better use of it.
quest_41559_quest_complete: [solemn] Very good. [soft voice] I'm tempted to try chewing one myself, but luckily my voice of reasoning is loud enough to prevent me from doing it.
quest_41560_quest_detail: [solemn] Let us try something unorthodox. Recreating the heat of the Scarlet Schnapps will prove to be a challenge without the same exact recipe, yet I am certain we can try something different instead. [soft voice] The Searing Gorge is a scalding hot desert with little to no vegetation. Nevertheless, some plants seem to grow splendidly on the vulcanic soil - one of them being the black hops. My assumption is that hops absorb the nutrients from the heated ground, naturally imbuing them with a natural smoky spice. [urgent] The best way to find it out is to grab some and test it out ourselves!
quest_41560_quest_progress: [low voice] Their living conditions may cause them to be brittle, care on how you handle them.
quest_41560_quest_complete: [soft voice] Saying they are smoky was an understatement. [emphasis] Such a potent aroma. [excited] I'll tell you what, <name>, we might've struck gold with this one!
quest_41561_quest_detail:
[excited] Okay, <name>. We're very close to perfecting the formular, I can feel it! [warm] We have the silver hops with its heavy earthen bitter flavour, the spice and smoky texture of the red and black hops, as well as the heat and technique needed to distill it into a clear but pungent brew! [urgent] All we need is that sweet aftertaste to complete the package; and I know the perfect source for it!

[commanding] Down in the verdant wilds of Feralas lies the dreaded ruins of Dire Maul. Within its cursed gardens grows a root, I believe they call it the Runn Tum Tuber. This root is said to possess a powerful sweet taste, that even survives the highest of temperatures when cooked. [proud] We need this root to complete the Hornfang Reserve! [confident] We stand at the precipice of greatness, <name>. [urgent] Don't waste time!
quest_41561_quest_progress: [excited] I cannot contain my excitement. [excited] My year long endeavors will finally bear fruit!
quest_41561_quest_complete:
[excited] The Runn Tum Tubers! [delight] At last, the final ingredient for my magnum opus. [urgent] Quickly, hand them over.

<Hal'togg cuts up the roots and throws them into his distillery. The intense heat of the apparatus causes the tubers to quickly cook, adding their unique flavour to the mixture. The brew turns into a dark, golden hue, exuding a strong scent you've never smelled before.>

[delight] Aha, Success! [warm] <name>, we've done it; we've created the perfect brew! [proud] Once the distillat cooled down, you'll be the first person to taste my greatest creation! [warm] You have my thanks, friend. [proud] Together we've shown that the dwarves are not the so-called masters of ale that they think they are! [excited] Cheers!
quest_41562_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is my life-long goal to create the most potent, delicious and savoring beverage known to Azeroth: the Thunderbrew Golden Lager! [soft voice] Its rich flavour and unique texture will enchant anyone indulging in its foamy top and bitter taste. [pause] Atleast I wish that was the case, but my previous attempts at it were falling flat in one way or another. [sad] There is always something missing that really brings all of the ingredients together. [urgent] I just need to find out what it is! [angry] That is why I came here to Ratchet, those dunderheads in Ironforge are all blabbering nonsense out of their unwashed beards. [shouting] They can't see greatness if it bites them in the arse!

[commanding] To brew a truly delicious lager, many different types of hops are needed. [solemn] Since the more common variants of it did not have the potent kick I desire for my brew, I need to look for something unusual. [soft voice] The Quillboar from the deep south of these lands seem to be versed in the art of brewing, or so I heard. [warm] They must have their own hops to brew from!
quest_41562_quest_progress: [soft voice] Any luck with the Yellow Hops?
quest_41562_quest_complete: [exhale] Ouch! [soft voice] These are quite spiky, how peculiar. [pause] Just their soft texture and lovely fragrance tell me these will have a strong sweet taste, [delight] perfect!
quest_41563_quest_detail: [sigh] A sour flavour is something needed in every ale, some have more, some have less of it. [solemn] The Lordaeron Ale is of the former kind, you won't find any alcohol as sour as this beauty. [soft voice] Personally it's not my type of drink, but I can appreciate the variety created by different cultures... [mocking tone] Even if the way humans are brewing their alcohol is just child's play. [laughing] Ha! Still, we can use their resources just the same. [urgent] In the southeastern hills of Hillsbrad grows the Hillsbrad Hops, a truly unique hops with the most pungent sour flavour in all of the Eastern Kingdom. [excited] I will need these for my new brewing attempt!
quest_41563_quest_progress: [soft voice] I once tried Lordaeron Ale. [chuckling] Oh boy, let me tell you, the fight that followed was a nasty one.
quest_41563_quest_complete: [delight] Ah, nothing like the rich smell of a freshly picked bundle of hops! [warm] Great work out there.
quest_41564_quest_detail: [solemn] I may be a proud Ironforge dwarf, but even I have to acknowledge the fine ales and grogs our Wildhammer brethren are producing. [soft voice] Rarely have I had the pleasure of enjoying such an extremely bitter stout. [excited] Just one sip blew me off my boots, it was an experience like no other! [urgent] This kind of bitterness needs to be in my perfect ale, it has to! [low voice] A good friend of mine told me that the most bitter hops grow in the Hinterlands, just short of Aerie Peak. [solemn] My brew cannot be complete without the powerful bitter flavour of this hops.
quest_41564_quest_progress: [solemn] The soil of the Hinterlands is fertile, which makes for a sturdy and durable plant.
quest_41564_quest_complete: <Thaldon takes a deep whiff of the uprooted hops. He looks ecstatic.> [excited] What a dream, with this at hand I cannot lose!
quest_41565_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You may have caught on to it already, but this amateur of an orc over there thinks he can create a brew better than what us dwarves can produce. [low voice] If you ask me, a fool's errand. But I am no fool myself, so we have to make sure his ambitions fall flat on its face.

[urgent] I overheard him eagerly announce using elemental fire to stoke his distillery fire, so we will make use of the elements ourselves. [gentle] Seems only fair, no? [pause] I already began brewing the hops you gave me, but they are not properly blending together. [whispering] Elemental water may just be the thing to circumvent this problem - and on top of it, it may even add an extra kick to the concoction!
quest_41565_quest_progress: [commanding] Some may brand me a heretic for putting elemental water into my ale, but to those I say: [excited] You lack vision!
quest_41565_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent, let me try it immediately!

<Thaldon pours the magical water into this distillery, turning the dark brown beverage into a sparkling golden brew.>

[delight] Incredible, simply amazing! [proud] My brew will reach unmatched heights of taste and texture!
quest_41566_quest_detail: I've stumbled on a... let's say ‘small' issue with my current brew. [soft voice] Mixing the three types of hops together was a brilliant idea, yet the bitterness of the stout hops is overpowering every other flavour! If we keep the distillate as is, I might as well just brew with stout hops. [urgent] Good thing for us, I picked up a rumour down at the port that might be exactly the solution to our problem. [excited] Goldthorn Grog is a brew that should taste incredibly bitter as all grogs are, yet its flavour is surprisingly smooth and mild, a perfect afternoon drink! [proud] I suspect the secret ingredient for that is the Goldthorn itself. With a few roots, I could test if my theory has any merit.
quest_41566_quest_progress: [solemn] The Arathi Highlands are a place with lots of Goldthorn vegetation, if you're a skilled herbalist you could pick your own in its vast fields and hills.
quest_41566_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good samples, I will have them added into my mixture and tell you if anything changed. [warm] Their scent alone is giving me a good feeling about it!
quest_41567_quest_detail: <name>! It's a disaster! I was just checking my tent for more ingredients when I noticed my plans for the Thunderbrew Golden Lager weren't there! It must have been those damned Hurley Blackbreath, he and his kin have been rivals to our family since countless years. They can't live with the fact that our beer is the superior one, not like their lukewarm sludge soup. We need to get it back. The recipe contains the last few crucial steps required to finalize my perfect brew. Blackbreath surely scuttled back into the Blackrock Depths, find him and bring me back my plans!
quest_41567_quest_complete: [angry] My plans, completely torn apart! [excited] I hope Blackbreath got what he deserved for disrespecting the result of year long hardship, blood, sweat and tears! [soft voice] Luckily I can still read the important parts of the formula. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] I know you risked hide and hair going into that accursed mountain for me. [confident] With these back in my possession, we are finally at the end of the journey.
quest_41568_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have the hops, our magical component and the Goldthorn to reduce the bitterness of it all. [soft voice] With my plans back with me, there is just one thing left to finalize the Thunderbrew Golden Lager: The Golden Hops.

[solemn] An ingredient of mythological status, many dwarves believe it to be a mere fairy tale told by the drunken mountaineers of Ironforge's taverns. [proud] But I know better - I have seen it! [excited] It appeared to me in a dream, after emptying ten ale kegs on my own. [soft voice] A golden rabbit, shimmering like the finest beer you've ever seen. [pause] There it stood, ominously between these great bones in a vast desert, like an omen. [solemn] Yet I knew what it really meant. [urgent] It beckoned me to seek it out; to create the Golden Lager with the Golden Hops! [commanding] Find this rabbit, wherever it may be. [delight] The Golden Hops will be ours!
quest_41568_quest_progress: [excited] We are this close to achieve something of magnanimous gravity! [proud] I will go down in history as the creator of the legendary, ultimate ale!
quest_41568_quest_complete: <Thandol's eyes widen in bewilderment at the sight of the Golden Hops.> [excited] You've found it! You've really found it! [warm] This is a once in a lifetime occurrence, <name>. The Thunderbrew Golden Lager will become the ultimate brew with just a few small sprinkles of this legendary hops. Friend, I cannot thank you enough. [proud] Through your courage and resilience, I was able to realize my family's century old endeavor of creating the perfect ale. [gentle] It is only fair for you to be the first to taste my magnum opus. [excited] Once my distillery cooled down and I tapped the first pint, you'll be able to taste a beer worthy for the Creators!
quest_41569_quest_detail: [commanding] Oy, I'm telling ya, there's nothing more invigorating than pouring beer after beer after beer down your threat and getting into the rhythm of the festival. [excited] Come, grab your pint and start shaking those hips! [warm] I wanna see you get completely smashed, dancing with everybody here. [delight] Cheers!
quest_41569_quest_progress: [urgent] You better start shuffling your feet.
quest_41569_quest_complete: [excited] Now that's what I call a boogy!
quest_41570_quest_detail: [commanding] Oy, I'm telling ya, there's nothing more invigorating than pouring beer after beer after beer down your threat and getting into the rhythm of the festival. quest_41572_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? [commanding] Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. [sad] I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. [angry] Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at that headdress you’re wearing gives me the creeps and shivers. [threatening] Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. [soft voice] I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. [urgent] We have a deal?
quest_41572_quest_progress: [urgent] Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
quest_41572_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent materials, truly magnificent. [warm] Now, take one of these and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

quest_41577_quest_detail:
[solemn] In your hands lies the still-beating heart of the Dreadlord Mephistroth, ruler of the Rock of Desolation. [solemn] You and your expedition foiled his plans of using Karazhan as an entry point to invade Azeroth yet again. [solemn] Expelled into the Great Dark Beyond forever, this is all that remains of the nefarious schemer.

[soft voice] You should bring it to someone able to expunge its life, just to be sure.
quest_41577_quest_progress: [angry] This horrible stench! [urgent] <name>, what have you brought with you?!
quest_41577_quest_complete:
[solemn] What a horrid prospect. To think we stood at the precipice of another invasion by the Burning Legion. <name>, your actions and those of your compatriots did not only save Azeroth from another war, but also quelled the threat of one of the most powerful dreadlords known to us. Second to only Tichondrius, the harbinger of the Legion’s invasion seven years ago, legends of his might circulated the Council of Six in Dalaran. Unimaginable to see such a commanding figure finally meet its demise.

You were correct in bringing his vile heart to me. [solemn voice] I am able to burn the fel essence from its flesh, albeit very taxing for my body. That is but a small sacrifice, however. Nothing is too little when given the opportunity to remove such a putrid presence from our world. Whatever remains of this, you can keep. [warm] As a trophy; a remembrance of the feat you accomplished this day.
quest_41578_quest_detail:
[solemn] This crown bears the symbol of the Kingdom of Azeroth, and it closely resembles the one King Llane used to wear. [soft voice] Perhaps even in his madness, Medivh still kept his friend close to his heart.

[pause] Fractured, almost crumbled—just like the Tower of Karazhan, a lost vigil of history. [emphasis] It is upon this history that we may reforge something anew. [warm] Bring me the materials I require, and I will ensure that this crown becomes of use to its new bearer.
quest_41578_quest_progress: [solemn] Gathering the materials shall be no easy task.
quest_41578_quest_complete: [solemn] Behold, your reward awaits: the crown, forged anew and ready to serve you in battle.
quest_41579_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I imagine your journey through a brief glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its share of trouble. [solemn] Yet, I sense an item in your possession that carries an otherworldly aura.

[soft voice] Allow me to lay eyes upon this mantle. [pause] Hm, as far as I can tell, the enemy you faced was indeed formidable—perhaps powerful enough to shift between planes.
