[solemn] Doomguards were the elite bodyguards of their master—none could face a fiercer enemy, and yet you confronted one of their best. Surviving the wrath of the Highlord would have been a worthy feat in itself, and yet you managed to defeat him.

I sense that you possess something of his—a memento from a worthy battle, one that we could use as the basis for a piece of your armor. [commanding] What say you? Bring me the materials I require, and we will ensure that you wear this fight both in spirit and upon your body.
quest_41617_quest_progress: [solemn] Trust in yourself to find the materials; [commanding] you must do so if you wish for us to continue.
quest_41617_quest_complete: [solemn] May they serve you well until death claims you.
quest_41618_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your journey through a fleeting glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its hardships. [soft voice] Still, I can sense an item in your possession—a relic that emanates an otherworldly essence.

[commanding] Allow me to examine these boots. [solemn] It seems the adversary you faced was indeed formidable, perhaps even capable of traversing the planes. [pause] Yet, while its previous owner now lies dead, remnants of its magic persist. [soft voice] What say you? [commanding] Bring me the materials I require, and I shall forge this item to suit your needs, ensuring you carry the essence of this battle with you.
quest_41618_quest_progress: [solemn] Bear in mind that without the materials, we may not continue.
quest_41618_quest_complete: [solemn] Steady your feet; [warm] your new boots suit you well.
quest_41619_quest_detail:
[solemn] This amulet bears the emblem of House Wrynn, a treasured gift bestowed upon Medivh by his friend, King Llane, for the many noble deeds he performed for the people of Stormwind. [soft voice] Even in his madness, Medivh clung to it.

[pause] Broken and battered—much like the Tower itself, a once-mighty sentinel of history. [solemn] Yet perhaps this fragment of the past still holds value. [commanding] Bring me the materials I require, and I shall see to it that this amulet serves its new bearer well.
quest_41619_quest_progress: [solemn] You must gather the materials if you wish to see the item restored.
quest_41619_quest_complete: [solemn] Behold, your reward awaits: the amulet, now stronger than ever.
quest_41620_quest_detail:
[solemn] This crown bears the symbol of the Kingdom of Azeroth, and it closely resembles the one King Llane used to wear. [soft voice] Perhaps even in his madness, Medivh still kept his friend close to his heart.

[sad] Fractured, almost crumbled—just like the Tower of Karazhan, a lost vigil of history. [pause] It is upon this history that we may reforge something anew. [commanding] Bring me the materials I require, and I will ensure that this crown becomes of use to its new bearer.
quest_41620_quest_progress: [solemn] Gathering the materials shall be no easy task.
quest_41620_quest_complete: [solemn] Behold, your reward awaits: the crown, forged anew and ready to serve you in battle.
quest_41621_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I imagine your journey through a brief glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its share of trouble. [solemn] Yet, I sense an item in your possession that carries an otherworldly aura.

[soft voice] Allow me to lay eyes upon this mantle. Hm, as far as I can tell, the enemy you faced was indeed formidable—perhaps powerful enough to shift between planes. [pause] No matter; while its previous owner lies dead, some of its magic endures. [gentle] Were you to bring me the materials I require, I could perhaps mold this item to suit your needs.
quest_41621_quest_progress: [solemn] You must obtain the required materials if you wish to wield the power of this item.
quest_41621_quest_complete: [solemn] The item is restored and improved. [warm] May it serve you well in battle.
quest_41622_quest_detail:
[solemn] Defeating a Nathrezim of such power is no easy feat. Even beyond the veil of life and death, many cursed the existence of the accursed Mephistroth. You could hear the echoes of the tormented souls in the Twisting Nether rejoice the moment the demon lay dead.

[soft voice] Alas, that is neither more nor less important—for not only did you manage to slay such a formidable foe, but you also retrieved its armor. [solemn] This armor shall serve as the foundation for your next piece of the puzzle; in truth, it may even be considered the final piece. [warm] As before, bring me the materials I require, and claim a prize that will make even the mighty Eredar tremble in their boots.
quest_41622_quest_progress: [solemn] Whatever the cost, it will be worth it.
quest_41622_quest_complete: [solemn] Don it with pride; [warm] you have more than earned it.

quest_41632_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I imagine a floating citadel filled to the brim with undead proved itself quite the hunting ground. [solemn] Though unlike any other you have faced so far, I am confident in believing you are capable enough to continue what may well be the greatest hunt of your entire life.

[warm] As we have discussed before, the Cryptstalker armor could be within your grasp—yet, unlike any set of armor before it, this one is only considered complete with a powerful ring. [commanding] Should you find something resembling such a thing, return it to me, and together we shall unlock its true potential.
quest_41632_quest_progress: [commanding] Return with the trophy of your hunt. [solemn] Desecrated Signet
quest_41633_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It seems I am in possession of many finger bones. I will spare you their 'proper' anatomical names, as educating you in the structure of the hand is neither my purpose nor my job. [hesitant] However, as a Rogue yourself, perhaps you should study... yet—never mind. We are veering off-topic.

As I told you before, Don Julio managed to teach me his craft of the Bonescythe Armor, which I will provide to you—for a price. [commanding] Should you come across anything resembling a ring while fighting, not only for your survival but for the rest of us, bring it to me. I will ensure it is adorned with these finger bones, which, in turn, will complete your set of armor.
quest_41633_quest_progress: [whispering] Let us hope your pockets do not feel loose. [low voice] Desecrated Ring
quest_41633_quest_complete: [soft voice] You may yet prove to be a decent <class> after all.
quest_41634_quest_detail:
[angry] What an impudent child! I've lost count on how many times I have instructed her about the dangers of arcane magic. [sad] That reckless curiosity of hers will one day be the doom for all of us.

[solemn] You've surely noticed the tower uphill from this humble abode? [soft voice] Usually I would reside there with all the other magically interested from around Northwind and elsewhere, but my ‘dearest' apprentice Thronda thought it would be a brilliant idea to summon her own assembly of arcane elementals to help with her chores. [shouting] Too bad that they grew out of control and are now terrorizing my tower!

[urgent] <name>, ascend it, and retrieve my almanach as well as residue from their demise. [confident] Once I am attuned to their energy, I can cast a spell to stop them from rematerializing.
quest_41634_quest_progress: [soft voice] How are your dealings with my tower faring?
quest_41634_quest_complete:
[delight] Simply marvelous. [warm] A job well done. [soft voice] Thronda should listen well and follow your example. [solemn] She has great potential, but her lack of discipline is a dire thorn in my side - and hers, too. [hesitant] Still, I can only partially blame her, for it is my sworn duty to her parents to foster her magical talent as much as her growth as a person.

[warm] You have my deepest gratitude, good traveler. [gentle] Before you go, take one of these as compensation for the troubles. [soft voice] Be sure to step wary during these trying times.
quest_41635_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've spent my entire life here in Northwind and it had never been in such disarray since the First War. Gnolls, Orcs and Dark Iron all roam our peaceful hillsides and sow chaos wherever they go. Even the roguish Defias seek to benefit from it all. [angry] These brash brigands dared to assault our logging camp not far from here, northeast of Ambershire. All of the workers fled of course, but the town doesn't have enough space to shelter them, so for now they are resting here in my warehouse. [urgent] If only Amberwood's guard would be ambitious enough about helping the good citizens of Northwind!

It seems to fall into the hands of the people again. [confident] Adventurer, you appear of good health and mind, will you aid us? [commanding] Drive out the Defias from the logging camp; help us restore even a sliver of peace to our beautiful home!
quest_41635_quest_progress: [soft voice] Stay safe, adventurer. [solemn] Northwind's hills are not meant to be drenched in the blood of the innocent.
quest_41635_quest_complete: [urgent] Is it done? Is this the head of their mongrel leader? [solemn] Good riddance to them, their lot has chosen what path to tread - a path leading to their timely demise. [warm] I appreciate your courage, adventurer. Here, take this as reward for the good deed. [proud] With your actions, we may soon live our solemn lives yet again.
quest_41636_quest_detail:
<class>, could you spare a moment? [urgent] I am in a bit of a crisis right now, and you seem the right person for my problem. [soft voice] I am a traveling merchant selling books for all ages and interests. [pause] Once a month I come here to Ambershire with a delivery from the Church in Stormwind; donations from the citizens for all the orphaned children attending the lectures and school held at the Ambershire church just across the river. [sad] However, on my way here, I've been robbed by thieves, and among their loot was said donation crate!

[hesitant] I tried following them, but my old age is catching up to me. [pause] All I saw was them fleeing into the mountains to the north, one of them wearing a raven black scarf. [solemn] Please help me fulfill my duty to the innocent children of this kingdom. [commanding] Should you find the crate, bring it to Sister Argent to the church north of Ambershire.
quest_41636_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to our humble church. [solemn] Are you here to visit a lost one, or perhaps for silent prayer?
quest_41636_quest_complete: [excited] The crate from Mister Melain! [solemn] I had met him on my short trip to Ambershire when I gathered the children for school, he told me what happened. [angry] Shocking that there are faithless heathens stealing from those who have already been dealt a bad hand by fate. [warm] The Light will shine upon you with benevolent rays for your heroic deed, good <class>.
quest_41637_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Again, thank you very much for bringing these books back to us. [warm] The children will be overjoyed to hear that we don't have to cancel today's school. You would expect them to be annoyed having to attend school, but they actually enjoy coming here and learning more about the world together. It's a heartwarming sight and gives me hope they'll be set on the path to a promising future.

[pause] Due to the robbery, we're a bit behind on time, and I need some time to prepare today's lecture. [warm] Would you be willing to lend us a hand? [excited] The children will certainly be eager to speak to the one who valianty saved their books from that brigand! [solemn] Last week we taught them the history of Balor, an island to the west of here. [gentle] Perhaps you can help them strengthen their knowledge by reminding them. You can find the book we used here in the church.
quest_41637_quest_progress: [soft voice] How are you faring? [hesitant] I hope the little rascals aren't too much to handle.
quest_41637_quest_complete: Wonderful, [delight] their delighted expressions cast a smile on my own face everytime I see them. [soft voice] These children are the future of the Alliance, and it is our responsibility to prepare them for their own decisions as best as we possibly can. [solemn] I will make sure the Church knows about your contributions today, good deeds will not go unnoticed. [warm] Did you learn something yourself, by chance? [pause] The island of Balor is a divisive topic within the kingdom, many of the superstitious dare not mention its name still. Regardless, it is part of our past and as such should be remembered.
quest_41638_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is mortifying to see what's happening to Northwind. When I returned here under recommendation of Archbishop Benedictus to assist Sister Argent, I could have never imagined this is what I would find. The people are terrified of the invasions from the eastern lands and criminals have set foot in our hills. Even the old abbey is...

[pause] Excuse me, I spoke out of turn, forgive me. You see, Northwind is my place of birth, I remember its mellow nature and the carefree days one could spend here. But I guess those days are gone. If I had known, I would've taken Mother with me. Her resting place being overrun by horrors of the past; [sad] it breaks my heart. She died when I was still young, her urn being placed in the crypt of Saint Mara Abbey.

<class>, what I ask is by chance too much, but would you be willing to gather my mother's urn? [gentle] It would mean the world to me and not be to your disadvantage, I vow it by my oath to the Light.
quest_41638_quest_progress: [solemn] With the wars over, I thought Northwind may finally return to its peaceful roots. [hesitant] Maybe I have been too naive to think so.
quest_41638_quest_complete: [solemn] Oh, mother... I am so sorry to have left you in that lightforsaken place. [warm] Be rest assured, you will find a new resting place in Stormwind, my new home. [soft voice] Thank you - <name> was it? With mother's ashes returned, I will deliver them to the Church before continuing my duties here with Sister Argent. [gentle] Farewell, kind soul. [solemn] May the blessing of the Light shine your way.
quest_41639_quest_detail:
[soft voice] What an unusual sight, rarely do folk wander into my coven; let alone enter my home so brazenly. [commanding] Do you think these to be appropriate manners for a <race> such as you? Certainly not. But I would rather not waste any of my precious time critisizing your lack of etiquette, if I instead can make good use of your presence.

[solemn] I am in need of a selection of ingredients. Normally gathering them poses no issue to me, but the woods of Northwind have changed in recent times. [threatening] There are unsavory individuals skulking about, which I would welcome to not lay eyes upon me. Rather you will go out and bring me what I desire. [cold] A simple task to make me forget your unruly transgression into my home. [warm] I am sure you will be capable of fulfilling it splendidly, darling. [gentle] You can gather them from the local wildlife all around Northwind.
quest_41639_quest_progress: [low voice] You better not question what I need these for.
quest_41639_quest_complete: <The witch is cackling in an uncomfortable manner.> Useful after all. [warm] Here, some homebrewed potions of mine, just for you. [soft voice] You may stay a while and ask me anything. [solemn] The woods have knowledge most don't dare to ask...
quest_41640_quest_detail:
[shocked] How could this happen? [sad] Just this morning I was preparing beer and food for the mountaineers, when the next thing I saw was Dark Iron storming my beloved tavern! [solemn] The Titan's must be watching over me, as I managed to escape with only minor injuries. [pause] The mountaineers of this garrison helped me recover a bit of my strength, yet I am still shaken from all that happened. [angry] Be that as it may, I cannot let this injustice stand any longer! [urgent] As the good men here cannot aid me on such short notice, perhaps you are willing to lend this old man your sword and spell? [warm] You look robust and hardened enough for the task.

[solemn] South of Helm's Bed Lake is a passageway to my mountain rest. [sad] I am certain it has already been overrun by those fiendish Dark Iron. [hesitant] If you and perhaps a friend of yours could retrieve my personal belongings from my tavern, it would soothe my worried heart immensely.
quest_41640_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you been successful yet? [soft voice] Please, be careful and don't act reckless on my behalf.
quest_41640_quest_complete: [excited] There it is! I cannot thank you enough, truly! [warm] Had I lost these, I wouldn't know if I'd be able to bear it. [solemn] Everything in here are memories of the good friends I made during my time as a mountaineer, ones that visited me and my mountain rest whenever their duty took a toll on their bodies. [urgent] For their sake, we have to reclaim it as soon as possible.
quest_41642_quest_detail:
[solemn] When the logging camp northeast of here was raided by the foul Defias, the lumberjacks were quick enough to escape mostly unharmed. My father and I tend to those injured here in his warehouse, since there is no other place for them to stay for now. Still, while there are many familiar faces among them, one of his good friends Christoph working at the camp hasn't shown up yet, neither here nor in Ambershire.

[sad] Christoph has a young son, and I'm afraid the worst has come to pass. [soft voice] Please, do me this favor, and search for him. Maybe he has hidden himself somewhere near the camp...
quest_41642_quest_progress: <Mirabelle is lost deep in prayer.> [solemn] O, Blessed Light, guide this lost lamb back into your fold. [soft voice] May his son not suffer the pain of solitude, may he be reunited with his kin and compatriots.
quest_41642_quest_complete:
[sad] What a tragedy, Christoph was a truly good-hearted man and father. [soft voice] Seeing him succumb to such a senseless death breaks my heart. But what about poor, poor Arnold? [hesitant] I fear for him, now that he is orphaned. [gentle] Please, let me take care of how to tell him of his father's fate. [solemn] The revered sister at the church of Ambershire will know what to say.

[warm] Thank you, kind soul. [warm] You've done a good deed today. [proud] May the blessing of the Light shine your way.
quest_41643_quest_detail:
King's Honor, <class>. [solemn] ‘Tis not an opportune time visiting Northwind, I must admit. [soft voice] Normally this vale is a tranquil place, untouched by the troubles of the world. [sad] But recently, many crises came crashing down on these hills. [urgent] If you journeyed here from Stormwind, you've seen what I am talking about. [whispering] There are, however, more harrowing events transpiring in the shadows of the night.

[pause] For several weeks now, we've received reports of disappearances occuring in the kingdom. [emphasis] They were seldom at first, nothing out of the ordinary, but the number has risen to an alarming amount. [commanding] This is technically confidential, but I've been assigned to this as the solitary investigator, and cannot by no stretch of the imagination accomplish this alone. [urgent] The SI:7 has its hands full with the Defias in Westfall, so I will deputize you to assist me. [warm] Don't fret, I'll arrange just compensation for you.

[commanding] Start by questioning the remaining townsfolk; the groundskeeper, bailiff and one of the victim's relatives.
quest_41643_quest_complete: [confident] Interesting. With the testimonies you've presented and my own information, we should be able to pinpoint potential suspects. [warm] Well done.
quest_41644_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ignatz' and Judith's testimonies match with our reports of increased Defias activity in the region. [soft voice] With a more than high probability, these ‘skulking characters' mentioned have to be Defias scoundrels, scouting the area for thieving opportunities. [urgent] We haven't located their base of operations yet, so we may kill two birds with one stone here.

[commanding] Search the area around Ambershire for Defias activity and potential intel on where they delegate their minions from. [emphasis] Once you do, infiltrate it and bring me any clues that may help us find the missing people.
quest_41644_quest_progress: [solemn] The people of Northwind are wealthy. [pause] So far we haven't received any ransom demands, but I would not rule out the possibility of that happening sooner than later.
quest_41644_quest_complete: [solemn] This is troubling news. [soft voice] Not only does it confirm VanCleef's schemes to run on a much grander scale, but we have to rule out the Defias being behind the rampant kidnappings. [pause] Leaving us to pursue a more grueling lead...
quest_41645_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the lands of Khaz Modan, just past the icy mountain range, the dwarves of Ironforge are in constant strife with their estranged brethren, the Dark Iron. These dwarves call the volcanic Blackrock Mountain their home and are known for their rigorous mining operations inside its blackened caves. [sad] Much to the Alliance's dismay, they do not achieve this by themselves, but through ruthless and unforgiving slavery. [urgent] Major Birkton informed me of their recent insurgence into Northwind - a foreboding turn of events.

[solemn] Should the possibility of them abducting Northwind citizens for slave labor exist, then we have to investigate it. [commanding] Travel to Sherwood Quarry to the northeast and gather intel about our current investigation.
quest_41645_quest_progress: [solemn] Our relationship to the Dark Iron is strenuous, to put it lightly. [soft voice] The Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge have a more... creative way to describe it.
quest_41645_quest_complete: [low voice] Again, a dead lead. [urgent] We're running out of options, deputy.
quest_41646_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our last option are the Blackrock Orcs, who you've undoubtedly met already. [soft voice] According to our reconnaissance, they started advancing into Northwind a few weeks ago, with no apparent motive or reason. [pause] It occurred very shortly after the Dark Irons made their move of aggression, so there may be a connection present. [solemn] Sacking Birkhaven was just the beginning, I'm afraid.

[urgent] For now we will shift our focus on the orc unit that secured the watchtower to the north. [emphasis] They are far ahead of the mainforce, a different aim must be at play here. [commanding] You know what to do at this point; [pause] I'll wait for your results here in Ambershire.
quest_41646_quest_progress: [soft voice] If you wish to assist in driving out the main force from Northwind, a local marshal is conducting his own operation in the Plump Pumpkin. You can find it to the southeast at Grimmen Lake.
quest_41646_quest_complete: <Operative Hawthorne lets out a deep sigh hearing your findings. Looking clearly exhausted, he begins rubbing his eyes as a sign of defeat.> [solemn] This whole ordeal proves to be more of a conundrum than I had hoped it would be. [sad] All three suspects act unrelated to our case, setting us back to zero. [pause] As much as it dismays me, I have to start my investigation anew. [low voice] I will revoke your deputization; what you've done for me saved me valuable time, but I cannot demand any more of you. [confident] If I am fortunate enough, then the SI:7 will send someone to support me here. [solemn] Until then, I must focus on my work. [soft voice] Farewell, <name>.
quest_41647_quest_detail:
<class>, can I speak with you for a moment? [soft voice] I overheard your discussion with Operative Hawthorne. [solemn] A commendable effort of the both of you to solve our most prominent issues, but Stormwind only assigning him to do so is concerning, to say the least. [low voice] Northwind was struck at the worst time imaginable, with Lord Amberwood sending most of his military to Stormwind itself. [hesitant] Strange course of action, if you ask me, given how the Kingdom's other regions are faring. [pause] Regarding your investigation - I believe I can show you the way to resume what you had to abandon.

[gentle] Far to the northwest, you will find a grove nestled in the mountains. [warm] An old woman lives there under the dark red trees - she will be able to help you, I am sure of it.
quest_41647_quest_complete: <The old woman is stirring her cauldron, which violently bubbles exuding a most pungent odor.> [solemn] Well, well, well. [mocking tone] What do we have here? [soft voice] A lost sheep trying to find a place to rest?
quest_41648_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So you are lost. Darling, I can see it in your face as clear as day. [low voice] You need someone to guide your way, and you've been told that someone could be me. [sad] Must have been that foolish girl Lydia, ever since she left my coven she did not care to visit me again. [solemn] Her ambitions and duties as Mayor tie her down, locking her true potential, would she just accept it. [commanding] Regardless of all that rambling, she is right. [urgent] I can and will assist you in your needs, but not out of the goodness of my heart. [angry] All these ruffians marching into my woods have no business here!

[commanding] What I need from you is fairly simple: Deathcap and Widow's Frill, mushrooms native to these hills. [solemn] Deathcap grows in caverns and has an orange cap, Widow's Frill grows in groups of three near wet soil; search the woods at the Great Birch near Grimmen Lake. [urgent] Bring me these and something personal from a recently abducted person. [solemn] I am sure you will find what I desire in town.
quest_41648_quest_progress: [soft voice] Now, now. [commanding] Don't let me wait too much.
quest_41648_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oho, splendid, darling. [warm] The Widow's Frills are especially thick this season, if we didn't need them for now I would make a loveable stew out of them. [gentle] They're quite delectable, perhaps you can try them yourself once all of this is over. [solemn] And this comb you've brought - it's from a young woman. [urgent] Let us not tarry any longer. [commanding] Now then, to mix this all together...
quest_41649_quest_detail:
[excited] If there is one thing Zappo Zapblast can't stand, it's grouches going out of their way to ruin the fun for others. [urgent] During yesterday's broadcast, my team and I lost the connection to our tower, only to hear a mysterious message sent through our output channel seconds after! [angry] The cheeky fella stole the spotlight during my advertisements and started slandering us more than an intoxicated zombie! [urgent] Turning off the broadcasting tower wasn't an option either, we worked all day to keep it up and running following the recent snowstorms! [sad] All we're broadcasting now is endless static! [shouting] A catastrophe! [soft voice] You look lively... more or less. [urgent] I could use some help in exposing this phony. [angry] Nobody simply interferes with Zappo Zapblast and gets away with it!

[urgent] You can find our recording box next to me. [commanding] Just press the green button, then pull the slider down and turn the knob left all the way to the maximum output! [urgent] Listening to the interference again will help us get to the bottom of it all.
quest_41649_quest_progress: [urgent] Remember: green, slider down and then turn the knob to the left!
quest_41649_quest_complete:
[commanding] If this bugger didn't use a voice modulator, I would be able to tell you EXACTLY who he is. [excited] My big, green ears are the best in all of Azeroth, no fancy elf can compete with my auditive recognition!

[solemn] Nevertheless, hearing the recording again may have in fact just helped us solve this mystery.
quest_41650_quest_detail:
[excited] As you were listening to the recording, I noticed a distinct sound–no, TWO distinct sounds even I hadn't realized before. [low voice] It seems the modulator only altered the goon's voice and not the entire input channel. [angry] What an amateur; more clueless than a forsaken seeking life insurance.

[soft voice] You see, I can remember any sound I hear. And what I recognized wasn't just any ordinary noise: [emphasis] The others and I went on a journey to gather some impressions for our diverse broadcasting just a few days ago. [solemn] One of the places we ventured to were the amber hills of Azshara. [urgent] It was precisely the northern cliffs where the hijacker chose to intercept our radio. [proud] Impressive, you say? [chuckling] I know, but that's Zappo Zapblast for you.

[warm] An adventurer like you could earn some fine coin if you would venture there and confront the fella. [commanding] Search the northeastern cliffs. [emphasis] That's where the sounds of crashing waves and screeching hippogryphs are most prominent.
quest_41651_quest_detail: [solemn] <Flipping through the journal, you infer the goblin's identity to be that of Bizzbang Zipperbox, an engineer from Kezan that apparently worked with Zappo on some prototype machinery back in Undermine. [soft voice] Judging from what you can read, he must've been more than unhappy about not being included into Zappo's Everlook Broadcast ambitions.
quest_41652_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, you heard the interference and are here to help? [warm] Perfect, I could use a capable pair of hands!
quest_41653_quest_detail:
[gentle] Greetings, traveler, and a welcoming Lunar New Year! [soft voice] This time of year beckons for new aspirations, dreams and ambitions we strive to achieve in the coming year. [solemn] As such, it is important to reflect and listen to those that bear wisdom in their words and actions. [warm] My ancestors traveled throughout Kalimdor and met many mythical creatures and spirits. [solemn] One of them, an unremarkable one for most, possessed the most profound insights there were. [solemn] To this day, my tribe seeks this spirit for guidance in times of need.

[gentle] I want you to pay it a visit, to learn from its words and take them to heart. [whispering] Nature whispers of its den; in the northwestern swamps of Dustwallow Marsh you will find it.
quest_41654_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Lunar New Year is a feast for the many tauren tribes and families. While we share customs here and there, the majority of them are unique to their tribe. [soft voice] I still remember the stories my father used to tell me, about the first hunt he participated in during the new year's celebrations. [pause] Back then, it was common to find boars roaming the savannah of the barrens. Their herds could be seen far and wide, and our huntsmen would gather every year to prepare a feast for the whole tribe.

[sad] Nowadays, the boars have long been perished or corralled by the quilboar. <name>, [warm] I wish to pay respects to my ancestors by preparing a feast myself, so please help me achieve that goal. [urgent] Slay boars of any kind and bring me ten of their carcasses, that should be enough for all the joyful travelers here in Moonglade.
quest_41654_quest_progress: [solemn] My father and grandfather will not be the last generation to honor this tradition.
quest_41654_quest_complete: [delight] These look wonderful, <name>! [proud] I am impressed by your tenacity and display of skill. [solemn] Truly, in the name of my forefathers, I thank you deeply. [warm] Now, let me conjure up a feast for everyone like they've never seen before!
quest_41655_quest_detail:
Ishnu-dal-dieb, traveler. [soft voice] The festivities are in full swing, and visitors from across Azeroth come steadily into Moonglade, eager to celebrate with their compatriots, no matter their origin. I see that you are still young, full of spirit and ambition; admirable qualities for those living the adventurous life. If it is a challenge you seek, then the Lunar New Year is the perfect time for that. [solemn] It is a time of struggle, of overcoming burdens that still cling to your soul, so that you may enter the new age with an unbound spirit.

Venture into the world, dive into the dens of evil and confront your inner doubts. Present to me a token of your victory, proving to me how you conquered yourself and I will reward you for your efforts.
quest_41655_quest_progress: [solemn] Don't falter. [soft voice] You are more than ready for this task, I am sure of it.
quest_41655_quest_complete: [warm] Marvelous, <name>. You've bested the dangers and braved them with courage and resolve. [proud] This token is proof of your conviction and willingness to tackle whatever struggle will come your way. [solemn] I am certain, you will pave your future with the blessing of your ancestors, whom you've demonstrated your cunning today. [gentle] Please, accept this as a boon for your achievement.
quest_41656_quest_detail: [solemn] A bounty is being offered to any brave and willing enough to combat the Dragonmaw Clan. [sad] Many of our brave brothers and sisters have died from this conflict. [urgent] If something is not done to quell this aggression more of our own shall fall.
quest_41657_quest_detail:
[solemn] A worn letter is discovered upon Zuluhed's Corpse. [soft voice] It appears to be addressed to him, and written in a coarse handwriting which reads: <So you have finally returned? How long has it been since you disappeared to chase after your artifact while the rest of us fought tooth and nail for our survival? You abandoned the Dragonmaw Clan for your own foolish glory, and now, because you have returned, you expect all the chieftains to band together with no remorse or animosity?

Do not expect me to be as foolish as the others Zuluhed. You may hide in the underbelly of Grim Batol all you desire. I will lead our clan to a glorious, and great victory here on the soil of Grim Reaches, not cowering in caverns like Rend and his ilk. There are some of us that know the truth of the Blackrock, and do not desire to hide facts behind notions of a glorious 'Dark Horde'... Your order is declined, old friend.

Korlag Doomsong, Dragonmaw Clan.>
quest_41657_quest_progress: [low voice] What is it that you bring?
quest_41657_quest_complete: <Commander Aggnash takes his time, studying the letter with some interest> [solemn] It would appear that the Dragonmaw Clan is not as united as we once thought. This news is relieving to hear.
quest_41658_quest_detail:
[solemn] This letter confirms some of the rumors that have been circulating, the Dragonmaw Clan was not fully united.

[urgent] Now that Zuluhed has been slain there is only one that stands in contention for chieftain, Commander Korlag Doomsong. [commanding] If we are to ever claim victory over the Dragonmaw we must first slay Korlag himself.

[soft voice] I must warn you, he is a dangerous foe, and should be treated with the utmost respect for his skill at arms. [commanding] I would suggest bringing a band of warriors to assist with the battle to come.

[emphasis] You will find Korlag deep within Zarm'geth Stronghold to the northwest of here. [proud] Bring his head, and return in glory.
quest_41658_quest_progress: [solemn] Preparation will be required if you desire success in the battle to come.
quest_41658_quest_complete:
<Commander Aggnash looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief> [commanding] You were successful?

<Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh>

[warm] You have overcome your enemy, you have defeated Korlag! [proud] A mighty foe such as him was a dauntless task, and yet here you are, victorious. [warm] Be proud in your glory today, for you have done what very few could achieve.

[excited] Take this, as a thanks from the Horde itself!
quest_41659_quest_detail: [solemn] Far to the south lies the Sal'Galaz Mines, once occupied by the dwarves of Dun Kithas, now overrun by filthy, [angry] Bonesplitter Troggs. If the Horde is to ever lay claim to Grim Reaches, the infestation must be dealt with, and firmly. Your task is to slay the Bonesplitters, and clear their foul presence.
quest_41659_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent work, the Sal'Galaz Mines hold quite a considerable amount of iron ore that should aid our efforts handily. [warm] Take this, as a reward for your actions this day.
quest_41660_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some weeks ago a large group of Dark Iron made their way through the Grim Reaches, settling just north of Shatterblade at Groldan's Excavation. [urgent] Already they probe our defenses, spies have been seen by our sentries on more than one occasion. [angry] They are planning something, and I am sure of it.

[commanding] If we are to keep our safety we must strike the first blow, and thin the ranks of their kind to deter them from making any assaults. [urgent] Head to Groldan's Excavation, and make them bleed for their trespass.
quest_41660_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you returned with the signets?
quest_41660_quest_complete: [excited] Glory and honor to your name! [warm] You have defeated our foe, and brought victory to the Horde. [proud] I have prepared a few items, take one and let it help on your journey.
quest_41661_quest_detail:
I often find myself staring—a bad habit for a guard, is it not? [soft voice] Yet I can't help it; my eyes drift to the trees. As the leaves fall, the breeze carries them into a whirlwind of battle, of dance—just as if the leaves themselves would duel.

<Gaspar smirks, looking past you to the unfolding scenery.>

[solemn] Mh, I used to be a painter before I picked up arms. [sad] A necessary sacrifice in the days we live. [pause] My remote home, now abandoned, while I guard this tower day and night. [low voice] And though my eyes behold beauty, my ears are tormented by that maniacal laughter.

[threatening] I cannot leave my tower. [urgent] Even with Stormwind so close, the Merchant's Highroad is still plagued by those dreadful gnolls. [commanding] I ask you, please, dispatch some of their numbers for the peace of my mind.
quest_41661_quest_progress: [soft voice] I miss holding a brush...
quest_41661_quest_complete: [soft voice] I hope the poor merchant was simply robbed and not beaten for blood—or worse. [solemn] Alas, you have done your part, and for that, I am more than thankful. [warm] There is little I can offer, but take this. It was the last painting I did.
quest_41662_quest_detail:
[solemn] One might assume that traveling from Stormwind to Northwind would be a blissful endeavor, a mere walk in the park—anything but fleeing from a pack of bloodthirsty, drooling gnolls.$ [sad] Since the King embarked on his diplomatic mission, conditions have only worsened. It is inconceivable that we cannot rely upon our own guards! [angry] We were compelled to raise a militia from among the common folk. It is truly tragic.

[sigh] Bah, yet those blasted, greedy swine from the House of Nobles still extend their hands to demand taxes. [hesitant] I—pardon my outburst. [urgent] On my way here, my prized ring slipped from my finger as I fled from imminent peril!

My merchandise is lost, so be it. [sad] But I cannot, in good conscience, part with that ring; it is a treasured family heirloom. [soft voice] It must have fallen into one of the leaf piles on the Merchant's Highroad. [gentle] Would you be so kind as to retrieve it for me?
quest_41662_quest_progress: [urgent] Dirt and gnoll spittle–I must burn these clothes.
quest_41662_quest_complete: [solemn] Where the guards falter, the people shall provide. [warm] You have my gratitude, adventurer. [proud] A few coins for your trouble.
quest_41663_quest_detail:
[solemn] Words, rumors—a wingless flight they hold. [soft voice] And with them, the seeds of doubt and curiosity bloom in the minds of mere men. [pause] Who would even blame them? After all, the words of the many are always louder than the words of the few. [sad] Our community has been in disarray for months.

[pause] It has been long since the people of Northwind had to fear for tomorrow. [angry] Yet our betters ignore the imminent danger and play the role of their own fools. [urgent] Imagine your home assaulted, and instead of seeking aid from other nobles or providing the people with means of defense, you call for a jousting tournament.

[mocking tone] A jester, a fool—only one of these two would do such a thing. [pause] Unless we consider a third possibility. [confident] Some take to chaos as a means of reaching power, and I believe that might be the case this time as well. [commanding] Report my concerns to Duke Sherwood at the Jousting Grounds. [proud] That man alone will rise to the occasion when others would not.
quest_41663_quest_complete: [soft voice] Mike, what a sly old fox. [low voice] The man carries one of the most mediocre names I have ever heard, yet his mind could outwit any other intellect.
quest_41664_quest_detail:
[solemn] Somehow, the crafty old fox has guessed right once again. [angry] It is one of the most infuriating things I can think of today. [low voice] Were it not already ridiculous enough that we must stoop so low as to portray this uncanny turn of events—namely, painting our entire region as "safe" for the whole of the human kingdoms to see, what remains of them anyway—while contending with gnolls, orcs, Defias, and Light knows what else, we are also burdened with this "Dark Knight."

<The Duke reaches for his forehead and sighs, his weary eyes regarding you with a hint of hope.>

[commanding] This must be some cunning scheme, one to which I am stretched too thin to address. [urgent] Aid me; the people of Northwind depend upon both you and me. [warm] I know you have little to gain from this, but I beseech you to act from the heart. [whispering] I simply need you to sneak into the Dark Knight's tent and seek out anything... damning.
quest_41664_quest_complete: [angry] That utter, disgraceful dog. [mocking tone] Bah, who would think that the laughingstock of children could be up to no good? [mocking tone] Sir "Ambercheeks" is bold.
quest_41665_quest_detail:
[solemn] Poor Lord Amberwood, cursed to bear this burden —it is not the burden of leadership, but the burden of having such a brother. Alas, we do not have the luxury of choosing our family. Lord Amberwood is a forgiving man; too many times has he overlooked his brother's actions—yet, I doubt he will stand for this one.

[sad] I fear the outcome. Northwind is already broken—if our Lord's heart should also shatter, we may never recover. I pray to the Light that this information will strengthen his resolve rather than dull his mind. Yet, how can one's heart not ache when his own brother seeks his death?

The older brother seeks to rule, with the support of the House of Nobles to end his own brother—at the hands of this Dark Knight. To think they would continue their schemes even now.

The common folk are mere playthings to these “nobles”. [commanding] Deliver this letter to Lord Amberwood, but mention nothing of what you know. I will gather what remains of the true nobility and tell him the truth myself.
quest_41665_quest_progress: [commanding] Approach messenger, let me have what you carry.
quest_41665_quest_complete: [solemn] Duke Sherwood is a close friend; many times he has denied the use of servants. [warm] It warms my heart to think he would find one in you. [soft voice] My armory is humble, and these are trying times—at most, for your service, I can reward you with this.
quest_41666_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Are you here to try our vastly celebrated and highly sought-after Amberglaze Donuts? I couldn't be more pleased, but—sadly—we've run out. It seems they are a real hit! [sigh] If only I had anticipated this. People want more, and here I am without any ingredients.

[hesitant] If you could assist me in procuring some of the ingredients, I would be proud to fry up some of my famous donuts for you. I will even provide some payment, to be honest. I am in need of flour, salt, sugar, and honey. The rest I can gather myself. I mention these ingredients specifically because they require a bit of travel to obtain.

I will provide you with a list, you should find them all here in Ambershire. [warm] I truly appreciate your help.
quest_41666_quest_progress: [urgent] The people are literally rioting over the donuts...
quest_41666_quest_complete: [excited] Ah, there you are! [warm] Thank you, thank you. [gentle] I believe they were going to dismantle my stall if you hadn't shown up when you did. [warm] As promised—a free pack of Amberglaze Donuts and an extra coin as a tip.
quest_41667_quest_detail:
[angry] This tournament is a farce. [sad] How can we even hope to win? [angry] I bet they've enchanted their horseshoes. [excited] I know it, I just know it! [urgent] I cannot allow Stromgarde to be defeated by a bookworm kingdom and a newly formed—eh, I wouldn't even call it a kingdom.

[solemn] Theramore and Kul Tiras will be too preoccupied with each other, but the real threat is Dalaran. I don't like the sidelong glance that Modera woman is giving me; they have a trick up their sleeves—I know they do!

[commanding] Listen, <race>, I'll pay you handsomely. [urgent] Return to Stormwind, take the boat to Darkshore, and then travel to Alah'thalas. [soft voice] I've heard rumors of a man named Chaddus Suncarrier who can provide a pair of enchanted horseshoes. [warm] Retrieve them for me, and your service to Stromgarde will not be forgotten—and your pocket will be a bit heavier.
quest_41667_quest_progress: [threatening] I will wipe that smile off her face.
quest_41667_quest_complete: [gentle] Hey <name>, is she still looking at me? [angry] Bah, that woman makes me so uncomfortable. [soft voice] Anyway, did you manage to get the horseshoes? [warm] Oh, thank the Light. [urgent] Here, take this and be quick about it. [whispering] And, just in case, don't show up during the tournament.
quest_41668_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Are you perhaps willing to do a task for an old woman, adventurer? [sad] It has been so long since I last saw my grandchild, and I am unable to reach him. [hesitant] I was advised against leaving Northwind due to my old age, and he is not allowed to leave the Keep for safety reasons—or so I have been told.

[gentle] I would like to send him a bag of goods. [sad] The poor child may not be eating well and may be overstressed by the foolish adults who follow him everywhere. [urgent] Could you visit the Jousting Grounds to purchase an Amberglaze Donut Pack, then go to Marisa by the inn for a Bundle of Apples, and finally come by my house—next to the Town Hall—to retrieve the pie I baked this morning?

[warm] Please return them all to me while I prepare the rest of the pack. [solemn] There are a few other things I need to add.
quest_41668_quest_complete: [commanding] Hand them over; everything is ready. [warm] You may take an apple yourself for helping me out.
quest_41669_quest_detail:
[solemn] With everything gathered, all you need to do is travel to Stormwind Keep and deliver this bag to Prince Anduin—but only to him, do you understand? [urgent] Otherwise, those pesky noble flies will surround him and inspect it. [soft voice] Be as stubborn as a mule if you must. [commanding] You need to present this bag to Anduin yourself, got it?

[warm] Here is a bit of coin for your trouble, along with the bag you must deliver and this stuffed toy. [soft voice] Keep it close; it might cost you your life. [soft voice] I am jesting, of course, but it belonged to my Tiffin. [soft voice] I know the child will be pleased to have something of hers. [warm] Go now, and tell him I love him as long as the leaves fall.
quest_41669_quest_progress: [soft voice] You should speak to Miss Katrana or Bolvar, [hesitant] I am unable to say much.
quest_41669_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Grandmother sent you, and she said that? Oh, I miss her dearly. [excited] I can't wait to try everything she sent me. [warm] I hear the donuts are very famous in Northwind. And I will treasure this toy from Mother forever. [warm] Thank you, adventurer. You have done me a great favor, and as Prince of Stormwind, I would reward you with something from our armory—if I could. Instead, I will give you this book I have from the Archbishop.

Do come and tell me of your adventures sometimes; this palace is dull and boring. I could use a friend.
quest_41670_quest_detail:
[solemn] It is my duty to care for the final resting place of our loved ones. [soft voice] As grey a duty as it may be, tending the graveyard with these two hands brings pride to my heart and soul. [pause] For what better duty is there than caring for those who are no longer with us? [low voice] Most citizens of Ambershire come here daily, flowers in hand. [pause] Remembering the dead has become a routine.

[sad] Yet, times have grown dim—dark even. [solemn] It is customary to light a candle alongside the flowers placed at a loved one's tombstone. [soft voice] In this way, the flicker of the candle may guide the soul back to our world so it may receive the offerings. [sad] Few merchants still walk the road named after their profession, and thus the church has run out of candles.

[angry] Sniveling kobolds stole what few we had left one night, cowering away in their cave. [urgent] To reach this cave, you must follow the road. [commanding] Return to Lion's Watch, walk toward the Plump Pumpkin Inn, and after crossing Grimmen Lake, you will find the cave nearby. [warm] Return the candles to me.
quest_41670_quest_progress: [solemn] No easy task, but a task all the same. [soft voice] May you walk with the Light.
quest_41670_quest_complete: [solemn] Some would tell you there is no meaning in this—clinging to the dead, to the past, each day. [soft voice] Yet, these tombstones become mere decorations if the dead are forgotten. [sad] A grim fate, worse than death itself.
quest_41671_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Light has tested the lands of our kingdom many times. For a handful of people, that was enough to dim their belief. [soft voice] A yearly gospel was held in our abbey, where we would remember all the dead of these lands, no matter how many hours it took. The abbot made it his duty to speak each name.

[solemn] The somber, mournful music of the abbey was interrupted by the wailing of a flaming woman. [screaming] "Fire—fire!" she screamed, her voice echoing through the abbey walls. [sad] Aflame, she collapsed to the floor, her tears dried by the heat, her skin scorched by the flames. [solemn] Her wailing saved the lives of many, though the lives of a few were lost.

[hesitant] Some whispers say it was the gnolls who set the abbey ablaze; others believe it was the wrath of the Light. [sad] A few even think the poor nun accidentally started the fire herself. [solemn] Who speaks the truth? [urgent] Go east, to the ruins of the abbey. The stone walls still stand, and perhaps with them, our necrology as well. [warm] See it returned to me, so that we may honor the dead this year once more.
quest_41671_quest_progress: [solemn] The fire was yet another test of faith.
quest_41671_quest_complete: [solemn] With this returned, so too does hope return. [soft voice] During the gospel this year, we will reconnect with those whose faith has dimmed, for that is exactly what they need amidst the chaos enveloping these lands.
quest_41672_quest_detail:
[solemn] Murlocs are exactly like roaches. The minute you kill one, two more hatch from their filthy spawning grounds. [soft voice] It's incredible how many of these disgusting creatures roam the world. It's as if wherever the world takes a breath of water, they are destined to appear. [low voice] Hmph, a world to live in—while the world itself seems to be after your life.

[commanding] It falls to adventurers like you to cull these depraved creatures. [sad] You may see arrogance behind my anger, but it's really self-pity. [sad] If I could deal with these creatures myself, I'd raise arms without hesitation. Yet I can't. No matter how many days I try, I will never be able to wield a sword. [soft voice] My skills are better used elsewhere.

[warm] Do this favor for me, and I will repay you as best I can. [urgent] Cull their numbers—no matter how many, just do it. The fewer, the better.
quest_41672_quest_complete: You have my deepest thanks. [hesitant] There is little I can offer, despite all that big talk. [sad] With no visitors from outside Northwind, the inn barely gets a drunk or two. [warm] So, I offer you a warm meal, and you may choose any room upstairs and call it your own for as long as you are in Northwind.
quest_41673_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Out to slay some murlocs, adventurer? Theresa and I were just enjoying a chat until a few seconds ago, when we heard noises coming from across Grimmen Lake. [solemn] It was a giant murloc barking at the others at the lake shore! I say "bark" because we didn't really understand what it was saying. I think it's supposed to be their alpha or something—I don't know much about murlocs.

[pause] Anyway, Theresa noticed that it was carrying a huge amber pearl—the size of her head, she claims! [gentle] If you venture into that cave and defeat it, could you bring the pearl back to me? [warm] I would like to offer it as a gift to her. [soft voice] She has been a great friend... and more to me, and I would like to show her that properly.
quest_41673_quest_progress: [excited] She seemed very excited at the sight of the pearl.
quest_41673_quest_complete: [excited] Whoa, it really is the size of her head! [warm] She will love it. [delight] Thank you; I will not forget this favor.
quest_41674_quest_detail:
[sad] My winery is lost to those savage grey oafs. [angry] Bah! [angry] Damn it all! [angry] To think we must face the orcs again and again and again. [angry] I am absolutely sick and tired of their pig-like faces. [angry] If only I were not this damn old, I would grab my pitchfork and leave none standing!

[sad] I wish my sons would share this feeling. [sad] There they are, moping like children still. [sad] I was too soft on them; they know no war, and this is what it has led to. [sad] All that our family has is in the hands of the blasted orcs. [angry] I tried to spy on them, and what I saw angered me so, so much. [angry] Not only were they feasting on my grapes and drinking all my wine, but they also defiled my home!

[commanding] They must be brought to an end. [urgent] Aid me, adventurer, and the heirloom of my family is yours. Please, I beg of you, do what I—and my sheepish sons—cannot!
quest_41674_quest_progress: [angry] I wish they would never experience a day of peace.
quest_41674_quest_complete: [excited] You have slain that many? Good! [warm] Their blood will nourish the soil, and the grapes that grow from it will bear the sweet taste of victory.
quest_41675_quest_detail:
[angry] That rambling old man I call a father has lost it entirely. Be it old age or his so-called disappointment that we are not willing to die a meaningless death against a horde of orcs, he has yet to stop huffing and puffing. [soft voice] It's not that I don't understand his frustration, but I am no soldier; I am a damn winemaker. [sad] How am I supposed to fight something ten times stronger than I?

Were I not already balding, I would tear out a handful of hair. [sad] I am barely in my late twenties, and this old man has stressed me so much that my hair is falling out. “We need a new recipe, Jerry—do this, Jerry, do that, Jerry.” [sad] He never stops rambling. [gentle] Yet I love the old man; he is my father, after all. [solemn] Truth be told, if I had to pick any man from a crowd to be my father, I would still choose him.

[urgent] Which is why, before his veins give out from frustration, I want him to see the new recipe I made. [urgent] You will find it on the upper floor of the winery; I hid it in my wardrobe before running away.
quest_41675_quest_complete: [soft voice] Jerry came up with this? Not a bad idea. [warm] I gave the kid a hard time; I should go talk to him. [warm] Thank you.
quest_41676_quest_detail:
[solemn] As mindless as these ashen orcs may seem, the reality is entirely different. I managed to have some people—hm, how do I put this? Some VERY skilled, sneaky people—gather intel for me. The information proved fruitful, yet there is not much we can do. While the people I mentioned before are very skilled at gathering intel, they will not do much in a fight.

[commanding] This is why I believe a group of adventurers, led by none other than a seasoned one such as you, may be capable of putting an end to this orcish threat. There are three of them. You will find Overlord Throkk in a cave we have called the Blackrock Breach, Ozuk Doomspike outside barking orders from a ruined house, and Shuni Steeltooth has infiltrated our territory so deeply that she has taken over one of our watchtowers. You will find the tower resting on the hill that used to keep watch over our Altar of Heroes.

[urgent] Put an end to them.
quest_41676_quest_complete: [commanding] Without their leaders, the remaining orcs should return to their filthy lands.
quest_41677_quest_detail:
Were the orcs not enough of a threat themselves, we also have to deal with the Dark Irons, who have left their scorched lands to dig a quarry in ours. [solemn] By the Light, I swear, for every Dark Iron in this world, there exists a quarry. It's as if some divine intervention wishes for dwarves and quarries to thrive all over the land.

[soft voice] Alas, comedy aside, I need someone capable and brave enough to sabotage them. We do not have the numbers, and frankly, we lack the patience to deal with dwarves right now; the orcs pose a greater threat. [urgent] Thankfully, the Dark Irons brought powder kegs with them—an easy target for sabotage. [commanding] Sneak in, or don't—I don't really care—just blow those kegs up!
quest_41677_quest_complete: [urgent] I heard them blowing up from here. [warm] Great job, pick one of these.
quest_41678_quest_detail:
[solemn] I came here to spread the good word of the Light and have people join us on our crusade against the Scourge. [sad] Yet, as I look around me, I see nothing but plight and mistrust toward the Light. [angry] These people can barely help themselves; they think they are abandoned by it.

[cold] They are no true believers—that is all there is to it. Lordaeron fell to the Scourge entirely, yet our Scarlet Monastery still shines with the gloss of the Light. [soft voice] I almost pity these fools. Hmph. Truth be told, I have a task for you. [urgent] The moment you retrieve the item I require, I will be going back to the monastery; I can't stand the sight of these wretches any longer.

[sad] Drowning in guilt and alcohol, they are. Regardless, the item I seek should still be in the burnt abbey—it is a chalice that the former abbot used to bless the waters. [solemn] It still holds this power, and my people need it more than these scoundrels do. [commanding] Return it to me, and I will pay you well.
quest_41678_quest_complete: [delight] Good, here is your prize. [solemn] May the Light smite you should you falter from its path.
quest_41679_quest_detail:
Wiggles, you good-for-nothing, twice-born idi—oh, that is not you, Wiggles, huh? [angry] Quite the predicament.

<Tirion blinks twice at you while fiddling with a flask.>

[sigh] What are you standing there for? [commanding] Shoo, be gone. I am busy here—conducting an experime—hm, want to be my lab rat? [mocking tone] No? The nerve of some people. You should be proud I even asked, hmph. So, you are... what, an adventurer? [soft voice] Is that why you foolishly came all the way to the outskirts of a human kingdom, for adventure? [sigh] Bah, fool. [urgent] Go beat up some of those bones near the burnt abbey—I am in need of charred bones. [angry] Don't ask why! [soft voice] It's for an adventure.

<He mumbles to himself.> [sad] Poor idiot.
quest_41679_quest_progress: [angry] I said charred bones, not coal.
quest_41679_quest_complete: [shocked] What—reward? [sad] And here I was thinking you were here only for the thrill of adventure. [warm] Here, have some coin.
quest_41680_quest_detail:
[angry] My good-for-nothing assistant has yet to return, which angers me greatly. [commanding] So, you will go find him. [soft voice] Quite the adventure, don't you think? [soft voice] Fine, fine, I'll stop pulling your leg. [warm] I really could use the help. [soft voice] I've sent Wiggles to Birkhaven—or what's left of it, or whatever you wish to call it.

[solemn] He was supposed to kill an orcish spellcaster from these invading Blackrock orcs. [soft voice] I assume you've heard of a Pyremaster before? [soft voice] No? [soft voice] Long story short, it's some sort of orc—uh... with necromantic talents, but it also works with fire? [hesitant] I'm unsure, that's why I need it dead—so I can bring it back and learn its secrets.

[urgent] Be on your way then. [urgent] Find Wiggles. [soft voice] Oh, right, Wiggles has white—balding hair. [soft voice] You should be able to find him easily, don't worry about it.
quest_41682_quest_detail:
[commanding] Lok-tar, pup of the New Horde. [low voice] I am Dul Wolfsnarl and I hail from Karfang Hold. [solemn] While we have not been allies for long I judge you are trustworthy enough to become my company. [urgent] There is no need for me to know what brought you to these lands, yet I hope you are here to cause a little chaos.

[commanding] Our chieftain sent me to keep an eye on some of our kin that still bows to the Blackrock Mountain. [threatening] Were those wretches not enough, the dark irons also infiltrated these lands to do what they do best–build a quarry. [angry] I do not understand this love for digging, alas, they are digging their own graves.

[urgent] Carry this pouch to the Sherwood Quarry and blow up their powder kegs. [shouting] None shall be left by morning.
quest_41682_quest_complete: [soft voice] You may keep that pouch, I no longer need it.
quest_41683_quest_detail:
Whenever our warleader decided to take a stand against the spawn of Blackhand, it left a wide, gaping hole in the ranks of Blackrock Mountain. [solemn] Many of our people were honored warriors or respected elders—truth be told, we were the ones meant to attack this land. For better or worse, however, we have not.

Yet scum were appointed in our stead. [angry] A travesty, an insult to the might of Karfang. While I dispatch their numbers by other means, I urge you to find strength in numbers and slay those ingrates.

You will find Overlord Throkk in a cave called the Blackrock Breach, Ozuk Doomspike barking orders from a ruined house, and Shuni Steeltooth has infiltrated deep into human territory, so deep that she has taken over one of their watchtowers. You will find the tower resting on the hill that used to keep watch over the Altar of Heroes. [commanding] Sever their heads and bring them back to me.
quest_41683_quest_complete: [delight] A job well done, and a reward well deserved.
quest_41684_quest_detail: <The Witch stirs the mushroom concoction, having it turn color from a light red to a vibrant blue. With a devious grin, she gulps the potion down, before entering a trance. Frozen in place, she whispers unintelligible words under her breath. After a short moment, her senses return.> [soft voice] You are most fortunate, young one. I have seen who you seek - and they still remain here in Northwind. [urgent] If you intend to capture them, make haste. My vision showed me the location of the young woman whose comb you brought. Ascend the hills past Amberwood Keep and follow its trails. [solemn] Evil will await you there.
quest_41684_quest_progress: <name>? [urgent] What brings you to me? [commanding] You found the ones responsible?! [angry] Tell me!
quest_41684_quest_complete:
[solemn] So orcs were responsible after all; but not the Blackrocks. The way you described them doesn't match with any recent encounters we had with any of the orc clans, at least not the ones I can recall by memory. We will take this to Stormwind and have the headquarters tackle this.

Regarding the girl... [soft voice] I will see to it to retrieve her body myself; I need to see this orc camp either way. Leave telling her mother to me, it is nothing that should fall to someone like you anyway.
quest_41685_quest_detail:
[solemn] I will be occupied here in Northwind for a while, which is why I need you to deliver this report in my stead. [soft voice] It contains all evidence we have collected, as well as the letter you have found on the orcs. [low voice] I myself cannot decipher it, but my superior is versed in many languages, Orcish included. [urgent] Bring this to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind's Old Town as soon as possible. [commanding] Tell him in person what you have seen and experienced.

[warm] I wish you the best of luck. King's Honor, friend.
quest_41685_quest_progress: [commanding] What purpose do you have with the SI:7?
quest_41685_quest_complete:
[solemn] So Hawthorne deputized you as assistant for his investigations in Northwind. Let me see what results you have to show.

<Shaw takes a thorough look through Hawthorne's journal and an even more thorough read over the letter you have found at the orc camp. With a stern expression, he rolls the parchment and shows you the seal at the end of it.>

[solemn] This is the seal of the Stormreaver Clan. [solemn] This is an old orc clan we believed to have perished at the end of the Second War. [soft voice] I have read through this letter and what's inside matches with the kingdom's ailments: They issued the abductions of careless citizens, but turned their focus to Northwind for some unknown reason. [pause] Still, this is not the most alarming revelation about this whole ordeal. [warm] But first, a reward for your assistance.
quest_41686_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have surely wondered to yourself where they might have taken the kidnapped people. [solemn] Fortunately for us, this document tells us where they are operating from. [emphasis] As much as it plays into our hands, reading the name of the island sent shivers down my spine. [low voice] The cursed, dread island of Balor, off the western coast of Stormwind Harbor. [solemn] The kingdom has not set foot onto it for decades, for its legacy is one of demise and harrowing disaster.

[urgent] We cannot wait much longer. [commanding] If Balor truly is their base of operation, then the fate of the captured citizens is grim. [urgent] I will send a task force posthaste, and I want you to accompany them. [commanding] Prepare whatever you need for this forsaken island, do not take this lightly. [urgent] Operative Simmons in Stormwind Harbor will make sure to set you on the right path to Balor. [emphasis] Once there, report to Verona Gillian, she will lead the operations.

[warm] Do your best, <class>.
quest_41686_quest_complete: External forces, I reckon? [urgent] We're hard at work, so any new pair of hands is welcome.
quest_41687_quest_detail: [angry] These lightforsaken Dark Iron! How dare they fall into our beautiful vale?! As if their home turf of a mountain is not good enough, no! They just couldn't help themselves and seize control of my wonderful quarry I had governed so diligently. [angry] Oh, it makes me so furious just thinking about it! [commanding] You! Grab your weapon, spells or whatever you use to kill things and go to Sherwood Quarry far to the northeast. [urgent] I want you to remove every single pest you can find there and rain down the same agony they inflicted on my subordinates. [threatening] They will not go unpunished!
quest_41687_quest_progress: [commanding] Don't you dare return without being drenched in ash and blood.
quest_41687_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful, just retribution for trespassing into my lands, raiding Birkhaven and ruining my mining schedules! [angry] They've got what they had coming for them! [warm] I must thank you. Here, choose something to your liking, [proud] someone of your caliber more than deserved it.
quest_41688_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>. Do you enjoy your stay at Amberwood Keep? [soft voice] My noble compatriots and I have more than enough issues to resolve, so I am afraid the minimum amount of hospitality is all we can afford at the moment. Still, you look like the lively type; interested in lending a hand? [warm] I promise, it will be worth your while.

My name is Josephine Mildenhall and I oversee the agricultural facilities of Northwind, mainly the Mildenhall Horse Farm and the Crawford Winery. The former has its hand tied by two things: the jousting tournament and a missing delivery of horse feed. [solemn] They take care of all the contestants' steeds and need high quality horse feed directly ordered from Westfall to ensure optimal conditions can be met on the day of the competitions. To much of my dismay, this delivery was stolen by the delinquent gnolls roaming the Auburn Forest south of here, putting immense pressure on my subordinates. [urgent] Please, reclaim the sacks and bring them to Horsekeeper Geringt at the horse farm.
quest_41688_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, Greetings. [urgent] Apologies, but I can't really spend any time on chit chat. [urgent] Many of the competitors need their horses ready for practice.
quest_41688_quest_complete: [excited] The horse feed! [solemn] Lady Mildenhall informed me someone has been tasked in retrieving the lost sacks from the gnolls. Am I relieved to see it all safe and mostly undamaged. [soft voice] We were running short on our old supplies and just feeding these horses hay does not provide them enough energy for the taxing physical exercise they have to fulfill in the tournament. [warm] Thank you very much again! [proud] Lady Mildenhall gave me some coin for you once you've finished her task, so please take it.
quest_41690_quest_progress: [soft voice] Awfully busy today, wouldn't you agree?
quest_41690_quest_complete: [soft voice] You were lucky, given you did not know what you fed this poor thing. The plants you picked are called Noble's Pillow, infamous for their muscle numbing properties. They most assuredly helped ease its pain, yet there is still much to do if you want to save the little one.
quest_41691_quest_detail: [solemn] Northwind is home to many herbs and plants of various uses. The people of Stormwind learned to harness their properties long ago and have used them ever since. [soft voice] Watching them gain their knowledge through trial and error was amusing, truly. [gentle] To help your quacking little friend here, I need you to pick a few strands of Winter's Kiss for me, a flower with a vibrant white bloom. [soft voice] A distant cousin of the Winter's Bite herb, it can quickly stop bleeding and infections if processed properly. [soft voice] The flower grows to the east of here, along the snowy ridges to the north. [soft voice] To create a potent salve, Ambersap is also needed. [soft voice] The resident bears delight in the sap of the auburn trees, some of it sticking to their fur. [gentle] Gather this for me and the little one should be safe and sound.
quest_41691_quest_progress: [urgent] Don't tarry too long, its condition won't hold up forever.
quest_41691_quest_complete: <The old hag grinds up the herbs in a mortar before mixing in the gooey ambersap. Stirring the ointment, she applies it onto a new bandage. Carefully removing the old one, another batch is spread over the little ducks wound, much to its dismay. With quick but delicate movements the witch wraps the bandage around its left wing, securing it in place.> [gentle] There, darling; this will help it recover very quickly. Defenseless creatures like our friend here rarely have such luck at meeting a kind soul like you. And judging by its behaviour, it recognizes your efforts just as much. [warm] Your actions formed a formidable bond today. Make sure to foster it greatly, as power lies deeply rooted in such connections.
quest_41692_quest_detail: [commanding] Good to have more hands on deck. Shaw didn't exactly send a whole regiment on this accursed island, which means we have to deal with what we got. [solemn] Our current main objective is scouting the area and finding out what the Stormreaver are doing and for what reason. [hesitant] We have yet to encounter any orcs in the area, meaning we're a bit dry on leads. [warm] Good thing we have you with us now.
quest_41693_quest_detail: [solemn] <The journal features dedicated listings of sightings, observations, shift schedules and oddities encountered during the few hours the corps was stationed on the plateau. [soft voice] Despite having seen several specters of past denizens, nothing purveyed anything related to the disappearances from Northwind. [pause] While smoke was seen emanating from the castle ruins across the ravines, no attempts for reconnaissance were made yet. [urgent] Furthermore, it appears that a small force of Thrall's Horde has settled on one of the smaller islands. [emphasis] Whatever they are planning on this island remains a conundrum for now.
quest_41694_quest_detail: [solemn] My corps consisted of ten operatives, surveying the perimeter around the Croaking Plateau. From the few ones that survived I was the only one locked up in this inn. For what reason I don't know. What I could see, however, was three of my comrades - Flynn, Elroy and Cherys - being dragged past the battlefield to the south of here. [hesitant] Luckily I understood a few of the orcish words they spoke. ‘Cave', ‘hill' and ‘master' are what I could decipher from their speech. It may not be much, but it is better than nothing, I guess. Apologies, but I won't be of much help to you with these injuries; I will report back to Operative Gillian and tell her what happened, that much I should manage. [solemn] I pray you can uncover more and return safely back to the outpost.
quest_41694_quest_progress: <name>, you've returned? [urgent] Agent Deryl arrived here not long before you, his body strewn with grievous wounds. We've sent him back to Stormwind for recuperation. [solemn] But tell me, is there anything you could find?
quest_41694_quest_complete: [solemn] A pity, those were valuable agents we've lost today. [soft voice] I'll send missives to their families, their service to the Kingdom won't be forgotten. [pause] Now, regarding this scroll...
quest_41695_quest_detail: [soft voice] The SI:7 has many specialized forces within its organization: scouting agents, spies, explosives experts, field medics, archivists... [solemn] Noppsy Spickerspan is one such archivist, his goal is to document everything that occurs during large-scale operations. As such he is versed in many talents, translating being one of them. You can imagine how useful it is to have someone at your disposal who can decipher enemy intel for you. [urgent] Hand him the scroll and let us find out what those occult bastards are up to.
quest_41695_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello, friend; how may I help you?
quest_41695_quest_complete:
[excited] I must say, it is thrilling to be on such a historical mission. The island of Balor is drenched in myths, legend and history. I can barely contain myself!

[soft voice] Operative Gillian is a bit uneasy ever since we landed here, understandable, really. Not the most hospitable place. Still, we have a duty to fulfill, our service to the Alliance cannot be hindered by some measly ghosts. [confident] Either way, I take it you have something for me?
quest_41696_quest_detail: <Noppsy opens the scroll and scans the surface of the old parchment. Furled brows indicate that this document may be tougher than expected.> [soft voice] This one is quite the conundrum, it's not only in orcish, but also coded in a way that is atypical for orcish missives. [pause] It will take some time for me to crack the code and translate. [soft voice] Luckily you don't have to sit here, waiting for me to finish. [confident] I am certain this scroll isn't the only of its kind. [urgent] There must be others, handed around between the Stormreaver orcs here on Balor. [excited] If I can get my hands on more of their correspondences, it would accelerate the translation process immensely!
quest_41696_quest_progress: Gel'ror? No, no, no... [hesitant] Galbor? No, that's not it, either...
quest_41696_quest_complete:
[excited] I see you are back, with writings in hand! [warm] Splendid, really. Having a few more phrases to compare and reference will make this whole ordeal all the more quicker. [soft voice] What I was able to find out is that their way of encoding their texts is very similar to historical documents we have from the Second War. [solemn] Which leads me to believe that we are dealing with remnants and survivors of said war. [soft voice] Interesting, isn't it?

[gentle] Regardless, please let me finish the translation, it should not take too long, friend.
quest_41697_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My brother Noppsy is a bit of an oddball, even among us gnomes. [solemn] His fanatical admiration with all things scholarly made him famous - or rather infamous - even back in Gnomeregan. [hesitant] I am not quite sure if I should endorse you fostering his obsession, but even I can't deny his skillset has helped us solve more operations than I'd like to admit.

[commanding] I have a job for you, whilst you are out there scouring the island for the orcish writings. [urgent] Our agents have located a cave on the opposite site of Balor, filled with a troubling variety of demons. [angry] As if the orcs weren't enough, they continue their habit of communion with demonic forces. [commanding] I want you to infiltrate the cave, dispatch any possible figurehead and thin out their numbers. [emphasis] The less of them we have to deal with, the better.
quest_41697_quest_progress: [solemn] It is important to neutralize any threats before they can realize their full potential. [soft voice] Being two steps ahead of your enemy is a doctrine engrained in every SI:7 member.
quest_41697_quest_complete: Mission accomplished. Well done, <class>. [solemn] Sadly, I suspect we cannot ultimately cut off the demonic forces here with their warlocks still up and running. But we take any little victory we can get. [confident] Remember, this is a war against numbers, gotta use what you got to your advantage! [urgent] Speaking of advantage, this tablet you brought with you has to contain crucial information about the demon's involvement in all of this. [excited] I just know it! [soft voice] I will bring it to Noppsy, he'll know what needs to be done.
quest_41698_quest_detail: <Rufus opens a small tin box filled with black powder, before taking a deep, deep sniff with his big nose. A satisfied sigh escapes him.> [whispering] Don't let Gillian know I keep this stashed, otherwise I'll be on latrine duty again. [gasp] What a mess, I'm telling you! [soft voice] I heard good ole Noppsy asked for your help? [hesitant] You don't mind me asking you for a favor as well? [commanding] Believe it or not, but the SI:7 doesn't do only jobs of the silent kind. [emphasis] No, no. [confident] Infiltration and sabotage go hand in hand, and I'm the man if you want to see things go BOOM. [solemn] The old fortifications of Balor are mostly decrepit and wide open, but they still offer a significant advantage to our enemies. [urgent] Place these near the broken watchtower and their camps at the old battlefield. [excited] They'll be ready once the time is right!
quest_41698_quest_progress: [low voice] Too bad I won't be able to see those beautiful explosions through all of this fog. [soft voice] I guess their sound will have to suffice for now.
quest_41698_quest_complete:
[excited] Ohoho, fine handiwork, friend. [excited] Those demon-hugging orcs will be in for a surprise once we press this detonator here and all the explosive goodness is just flying all around them!

<Rufus' eyes are full of glee, to the point where he appears like an overly joyous bearded child.>
