[laughing] Ho, this reminds me of that one time I almost blew up the Dwarven District in Stormwind. [chuckling] I'll share the story with you over an ale after we're done brooding over this blasted island. [warm] An honest dwarven promise!
quest_41699_quest_detail:
<The gnome is lost in deep contemplation. His brows are furled and a determined expression is chiseled onto his face.> [urgent] Oh, <name>! Apologies, my rampant thoughts made me not realize you returned. I just finished decrypting both the scroll and the tablet you found in that demon cave. What I discovered is... well, [shocked] horrifying, to put it lightly.

The scroll you found on that Stormreaver necrolyte speaks of aberrant experiments conducted on their captives. Many of them being ‘not suitable', resulting in - if I translated correctly - liquefaction. Equally alarming is the contents of the stone table my sister Nippsy handed me. The demon's plan is to aid the Stormreaver orcs in summoning a demon of insurmountable power - one they call Mergothid. I reckon they will need a vast amount of energy for that to be accomplished...

[solemn] <name>, please hand this report to Operative Gillian. If my understanding of the situation is correct, and I am certain that it is, then we cannot wait much longer.
quest_41699_quest_progress: [urgent] Has Noppsy finished his translation? [soft voice] What have you found out?
quest_41699_quest_complete: <Verona is reading Noppsy's report without changing expressions. Her meticulous analysis of the report reminds you why she is the spearhead of this operation.> <name>, ready yourself. [commanding] We will launch an infiltration.
quest_41700_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our helmsman Verix steered us over this island, not realizing we'd be flying directly into a hornet's nest of thunderstorms. [sad] I would be cursing him to the slums of Undermine, but if there is anyone to blame it would be me for allowing him to sway the course. That's exactly why it is my duty to get us all off this wretched island. [urgent] Without my compass however, we have little chance of escaping this harsh weather and returning to Booty Bay!

[angry] The slimy snake Verix took it with him, practically holding us hostage. [soft voice] It seems he knows this island, as he blabbered about endless treasure sleeping in its ruins. [urgent] Frankly, if our situation were not so dire, I would accompany him, but the survival of my crew is top priority. [commanding] His journal says something about a crypt full of gold, go find him and bring me back my compass!
quest_41700_quest_progress: [angry] Verix' greed cost me my beautiful zeppelin, [shouting] he has to answer for his crimes!
quest_41700_quest_complete: [excited] My compass! Does that mean Verix got what he deserved? [warm] Good riddance to him, if you ask me. [chuckling] One goblin's misery is another goblin's fortune, as we like to say. [proud] With my compass back in my possession, all that is left is to repair the Gullwing into workable shape. [delight] Thank you for your help, <class>. You can keep some of the coins that Verix looted. [warm] If you want to keep lending your hand, we won't say no.
quest_41701_quest_detail:
Let me ask you something: Have you ever seen a lobster twice your size devour a goblin alive? [angry] Or seen a land walking fish man gnaw on a poor fellow's head? If yes, then you'll surely share my seething hatred for these abyssal monsters. Murlocs, Makrura, Naga, you name it; I even lost a good business partner to a clam once in the reefs of Stranglethorn! [gasp] As if fate is playing dirty tricks on our unfortunate crew, we've been stranded right between some turf war between the gurgling fish heads and their clackering neighbours. I'd say let them bash their noggins in if they got nothing better to do, but they are beginning to encroach on our camp and we are too tired from fixing the zeppelin to fend them off for much longer.

[urgent] I see that fire in your eyes, friend. [commanding] Go out and start cleaning up the place; there should be enough of them out in the ocean southeast of here.
quest_41701_quest_progress: Drench the seas red with their icky blood, [urgent] but keep a watchful eye out for the roaming sharks around here.
quest_41701_quest_complete: [delight] Excellent work, <class>. [warm] These fiends may be horrors beyond our comprehension, but at least they have a delicious taste to them. We can survive a few more days cooking a fine gumbo with it. [excited] Either way, it seems we are not done dealing with them just yet.
quest_41702_quest_detail:
[urgent] While you were busy dealing with this minor inconvenience, Rikki returned from her routine scouting round. She noticed suspicious activities coming from just north of our tiny island. [solemn] Ripples of water and rising waves, as well as turbulent vortices building themselves upon the ocean's surface. [confident] My best bet is that it must be a powerful magic-wielding makrura, perhaps even their leader. Coincidentally, something similar could be seen just coming from beyond the island east of here. [hesitant] Call me paranoid, but these are tell-tale signs of the murlocs and makrura playing it big in this turf war.

[urgent] Whatever it may be, both of them pose a hazard to our escape. <name>, without someone stopping them, our chances of ever escaping this island are slim. [warm] You already proven yourself capable of dealing with the small fry; do you think you're up for more challenging foes?
quest_41702_quest_progress: [soft voice] The way they're behaving makes you think there'd be something for them here, but for the love of me, I cannot fathom just what it may be.
quest_41702_quest_complete: [soft voice] I have to admit, I'm impressed. The others and I were waging with how many limbs you'd return or if we'd have to fish your limp body out of the ocean. [chuckling] Guess I'll owe Rikki some gold when we're back in Booty Bay. Regardless, [warm] incredible display of skills by you. [proud] Yunie will be relieved to have one less issue holding us back. If you're ever bored of adventuring around the world, the Steamwheedle Headquarters in Undermine are always in need of capable bruisers. [excited] Think about it, you'd fit right in!
quest_41703_quest_detail:
[commanding] Repairs for our zeppelin are in full swing, as much as they can be with the makeshift materials we have at hand. [hesitant] I doubt we will come far with what we have right now, however. [urgent] Call it bad luck or fortune, but there is a pirate ship just east of our small island. [mocking tone] What they're here for, I don't know, but given that they are pirates, I can only assume it to be booty. [excited] Let's make the best of their presence. [urgent] A ship like theirs looks chock full of supplies and necessities we could use to make our lives a lot better. [soft voice] While I'm certain they won't part with their belongings willingly, your demeanour is convincing enough for them to change their mind, don't you think?

<Kixqal is nudging you with an aggressive wink.>

[urgent] While you're out and about, could you stop by Booty Bay and ask our contractor for a spare zeppelin motor? [urgent] I'm certain it's in his best interest if we make it out of here and deliver his goods. [urgent] Markel Smythe's the name, he should be around the city's town hall at the docks.
quest_41703_quest_progress: [urgent] We can't spare too much time on the repairs, this humidity is not to be underestimated. [commanding] I'd prefer if the zeppelins hull would not break halfway through Stranglethorn, so hurry up, yes?
quest_41703_quest_complete: [delight] Color me surprised, a whole treasure trove full of valuable materials. [warm] This alone should suffice for rebuilding the outer frame of the Gullwing. [soft voice] I have to say, I didn't expect you to be so successful. [chuckling] But that was to be expected for someone crazy enough to come to such a backwater island willingly, I suppose? [urgent] Either way, we owe you one big time, friend. [excited] Goblin promise!
quest_41704_quest_detail:
Unlike myself, my servants are not aware of their ghastly condition. [solemn] Even my sister's mind is slowly escaping her grasp. [soft voice] The peasants and workers begin to aimlessly wander the island, clinging to whatever they did when still alive. [pause] An endless purgatory, incapable of passing on into the afterlife. [sad] As their lord, it is my obligation to relinquish them from that limbo, yet I am unable to.

[hesitant] A most humble request, kind traveler: [soft voice] Break their spectral bodies and allow their souls to join the Light. [sad] It pains me to see them suffer still.
quest_41704_quest_progress: [solemn] Their wailing haunts my undeath, a cacophony lamenting my incompetence as their lord.
quest_41704_quest_complete: [solemn] Silence, not quite, but almost. [soft voice] My ghostly heart eases at your mercy. [warm] A noble deed of yours, truly. [pause] Had it not been for your kindness, the unrelenting torrent of their cries would have torn me into a vortex of insanity, that I am certain of. [solemn] Balor's curse may be perpetual, yet its effects are now ever so slightly diminished. [proud] You are in my debt, <class>.
quest_41706_quest_progress: [solemn] Shan'do Staghelm possesses the knowledge to uncover this mystery. [soft voice] It is our duty to help him prevent this darkness from spreading.
quest_41706_quest_complete: [solemn] How vile... just being near them fills me with a burdening lethargy. [soft voice] This foulness is akin to what haunts our forests on Kalimdor, very much so. [hesitant] Yet still distinct enough to not be the same... [sad] I cannot fathom how painful it must've been to live with such a shadow in one's body.
quest_41707_quest_detail:
[solemn] Disease and maladies run rampant on this island. [soft voice] A melting pot of sicknesses, coupled with an unnatural mist of darkness emerging from the sickly ground. [pause] Our operatives begin to be affected by an ailment caused by these phenomena. [low voice] High fever, irritated rashes and excruciating cramps in both organs and muscle alike. [commanding] In my duty as the expedition's medic, I will eradicate their symptoms; and I wish you to assist me.

[solemn] I have theorized that the progenitor stems from the tiny mushroom spores that permeate the island's atmosphere. [soft voice] I assume that over the years, a large cultivation of toxic mushrooms developed underneath the earth that now send their buds out for propagation. [solemn] Some of them even came to life in the form of horrifying spore beasts, as our scouts report; in an abandoned mine, past the desolate battlefield. [urgent] To counteract the symptoms, I need the most potent spores, which I believe can be found on them.
quest_41707_quest_complete: <Inspecting the mycelia under her monocle, Kinrial's face is masked in a stern expression; you assume both concern and critical intrigue.> [solemn] Interesting, the mushroom strains continue seeking fertile ground to propagate in. [soft voice] Under normal circumstances they'd quickly die if not nestled in fitting soil, but not these. [low voice] They writhe and firm around, actively looking for nutrients. [sad] A harrowing sight. [whispering] For our operatives' sake, I will conceal this unsavory detail.
quest_41708_quest_detail: [solemn] I respect Agent Gillian as our leader, just like anyone in this outpost. Her procedures are methodical and strike a fair balance between the security of her task force and the success of the mission. [soft voice] She is not afraid to take actions in her own hands, a fear reminiscent of my people on Kalimdor. [solemn] She advised us to take advantage of Balor's unique environment and circumstances, an order I am more than happy to oblige with. [pause] When I scoured the island earlier, I bore witness to a fascinating scene. [solemn] One of the fiendish orcs sought skirmish with the local arachnid population to the north. [sad] She fell victim to a bite, rapidly followed by sudden lethargy until she became easy prey. [solemn] These spiders must possess a very potent venom with narcotic and paralyzing properties. [urgent] Should we extract it, it could provide ample uses for our campaign on Balor. [commanding] Bring me their venom sacs and thin out their numbers while you do so. They may be useful to us, but remain a hazard nonetheless.
quest_41708_quest_progress: [soft voice] You may think a medic indulging in poison distillation is uncommon, but this is a required expertise in the SI:7, regardless of designation. [solemn] My knowledge over the body and anatomy in particular gives me certain insights others may lack.
quest_41708_quest_complete: [solemn] An unusally biting odor. Extracting a functioning poison from them might take some time, but the result will be worth the effort tenfold. [warm] I must thank you, your assistance accelerates the success of this mission more than you'd think.
quest_41712_quest_progress: [soft voice] Can I help you with something?
quest_41713_quest_detail:
[solemn] Can you imagine a greater misery than being aware of your perpetual undeath? [sad] To be bound to this accursed tower till the end of time? [sad] I certainly can not. [sad] Forever doomed to research the mysteries of the Arcane, many of us have lost their mind already. [sad] Who can blame them? [sad] One would assume it to be an easy way out of this desolation. [soft voice] But I am not a man who gives in to the path of least resistance. [solemn] Upon my pride as a scholar, I will break free from the magical tether of this spire; and you will assist me.

[urgent] Search the library. [urgent] The maddened master of the tower possesses a book with a striking title, a heavy tome I need you to find. [solemn] ‘Solutions to Arcane Resonance', that is what I require. [urgent] Bring it to me and we will finally be able to break free of this eternal shackle.
quest_41713_quest_progress: [soft voice] You will know which grimoire it is once you're near it. [solemn] Its potent energies pour out of its pages even decades later.
quest_41713_quest_complete: [solemn] Breathtaking. [soft voice] The mysteries that will unfurl before my eyes while reading this ancient tome will be the key to our freedom.
quest_41714_quest_detail:
[solemn] From what is standing here, an ample amount of arcane energy is needed to break the band binding us to this tower. With just the right combination of reagents, I can create a power source potent enough to break the eternal chains of mine.

[soft voice] Listen, I require your aid once more. Collect the following sources of energy and bring them to me. I will recite the incantation and hopefully will dissolve the tether once and for all.
quest_41714_quest_progress: [urgent] Be quick, <name>. [solemn] We cannot wait any longer. [excited] Freedom is just a conjuring away!
quest_41714_quest_complete: <Ralwen grabs the reagents and places them in front of him. Quickly reciting the book's chants, they begin to move and converge violently, releasing a powerful shockwave. What is left behind is an immaculate crystal.> [angry] Blasted magic, it did not work! [hesitant] I fear we need more energy for the chains to shatter. [warm] Do not fret, I am sure we will succeed eventually. [warm] As compensation for your deeds, please take the crystal we just created with you. [proud] I am certain it will prove to be useful in your journeys.
quest_41715_quest_complete:
[solemn] Are you headed back into the Scholomance, <name>? [soft voice] You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. [gentle] With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more.

[warm] By all means, have it. [proud] You've certainly earned it.
quest_41716_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our situation here at Shatterblade Post is a precarious one. [soft voice] We are far from home, and our supply lines are stretched extraordinarily thin. [pause] This is certainly not the ideal situation for any warrior, nor for any outpost.

[low voice] My advisor Ranagg is more up to date with information. [urgent] If you truly wish to help us here, speak with him, and he can fill you in.
quest_41716_quest_complete:
[solemn] I saw you speaking with Commander Aggnash. [soft voice] What he speaks is the truth. [urgent] We are under constant threat from a much more powerful enemy. [low voice] The Dragonmaw have a grip over the region, and their power is unmatched. [emphasis] They outnumber even the dwarves of Dun Kithas by a significant margin.

[commanding] If we want to truly make our place here, we will need to take action before action is taken upon us.
quest_41717_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our greatest threat is that of the Dragonmaw Clan. Their numbers are vast, and their strength is ever present. Just recently they have attacked, and laid ruin to Baggoth's Rampart. One of the key defensive structures for the dwarves of Dun Kithas.

[hesitant] I fear that with this victory they will grow more bold in their actions.

We must discover their future plans. [urgent] I require you to head to Baggoth's Rampart to the southwest, and find the Dragonmaw Orders from the attackers. I am certain one of them have it.

When you recover the orders, return to me.
quest_41717_quest_progress: [urgent] Our security is in jeopardy every minute that you waste.
quest_41717_quest_complete:
[excited] You've recovered them?

<Advisor Ranagg snatches the orders from your hands, and quickly begins to read.>

[solemn] These orders seem to contain plans for further invasions in the region.
quest_41718_quest_detail:
[solemn] Detailed in these plans are further assaults upon Dun Kithas, but more importantly on Shatterblade Post. [soft voice] These plans seem to be coordinated by Geshgan Blackhollow, one of the Dragonmaw captains.

[urgent] Bring this information to Commander Aggnash, he will decide our next course of action.
quest_41718_quest_complete: [solemn] So, they do intend to target us.
quest_41719_quest_detail:
[solemn] Geshgan Blackhollow, that name is familiar to me.

[soft voice] When we first arrived in Grim Reaches, we conducted a series of investigations upon the Dragonmaw Clan. Geshgan is a loyal captain who commands his own retinue of skilled, and battle hardened warriors. [commanding] It is time that we put an end to his plans.

[urgent] Geshgan can be found lurking in the Ruins of Stolgaz Keep to the northwest. [commanding] I advise you to bring allies, for that forgotten place is filled with Dragonmaw warriors. [angry] Kill him, and bring his head to me as proof.
quest_41719_quest_progress: [solemn] Geshgan Blackhollow is a cunning foe, do not let your guard down.
quest_41719_quest_complete: <Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh> [solemn] You have done well this day, Geshgan was a brutal enemy, and now he has fallen. [warm] You have served us well.
quest_41720_quest_detail:
[urgent] I hear you intend to brave Stolgaz Keep, if you do, I have a task that requires attention.

[solemn] Some time ago, Stolgaz Keep was once the heart of the Grim Reaches. [soft voice] It projected power, and held many important documents.

[commanding] It is these documents that I require, and I am certain I can find something useful amongst them. [urgent] Travel to Stolgaz Keep to the northwest, and find a crate of these documents. [warm] Bring them to me, and I shall reward you.
quest_41720_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, these have not been tampered by Dragonmaw hands... [urgent] Go now, for I have research to do.
quest_41721_quest_detail:
[commanding] The time for battle is upon us, and the time for heroes is now. [urgent] It is time to strike at the heart of our enemy, and crush them. [solemn] Zarm'geth Stronghold to the northwest is the headquarters of the Dragonmaw Clan in Grim Reaches. [solemn] It is there we shall secure our victory.

[urgent] Travel there, and slay them in the name of the Horde! [angry] Let them know our fury, and return when they are culled.
quest_41721_quest_progress: [commanding] Our victory is at hand, make your way to Zarm'geth Stronghold!
quest_41721_quest_complete:
[solemn] The day of victory has come at last, your actions have paved the way for the Horde to claim this land for itself. [soft voice] Thrall's wisdom is clear in your actions.

[warm] You shall be rewarded for your work this day.
quest_41722_quest_detail:
Lok'tar friend! [commanding] I am Bargolnak, and I am in charge of the cooking around here in town. [soft voice] If you know anything about being on the fringes, it's that things can get rather stale.

[solemn] It's my job to offer some variety to those that are stationed here. [warm] You would be surprised what a change of meal can do to morale.

[urgent] The only ration that I have available is meat and I'd like some variety.

[soft voice] You should be able to find plenty of Brown Recluse all around Grim Reaches, If you could gather six recluse legs it would go a long way to helping me out.
quest_41722_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had any luck in finding those juicy legs?
quest_41722_quest_complete:
[excited] Would you look at the proportions of these?! [warm] These recluse legs will make a fine addition to the stock of food I have available. [proud] You've done me a great service, and everyone here in town.

[warm] Take these coins, and go with honor friend.
quest_41723_quest_detail: [solemn] The raging Wild Maw to the north of Shatterblade Post have grown to become a larger threat than once thought. [urgent] Their hostility and location is posing a threat to our operations here within the region.
quest_41724_quest_detail:
[solemn] We once had a warlock here within Shatterblade Post, one that spoke of honor, of loyalty. In reality, his loyalties laid with the Dragonmaw clan.

This orc goes by the name Rethkag Mirefang. [angry] A truly vile, and spineless creature. [soft voice] I aided him in finding a family heirloom, helping him find peace. [sad] I even considered this worm a dear friend for many months.

[angry] His actions have hurt far more than any wound I have suffered, and now I demand his blood. [commanding] You can find him, overlooking the region from his tower in Geth'kar just to the northwest of here. Kill him, and return to me.
quest_41724_quest_complete:
[solemn] I am pleased. [low voice] To think one would betray their oaths, friends, and loyalties for power sickens me to my core. [warm] You have done the Horde a service in rooting out such a vile traitor.

[proud] Take this, may it aid your cause even further.
quest_41725_quest_detail:
[sigh] Bah, the state of this place is almost beyond saving. [low voice] I am tasked to be a siege engineer with no actual machinery or parts?

The only equipment that I have to work on is two captured Dragonmaw catapults. [urgent] If I am to ever create or work on anything, I will need to improvise.

[solemn] The nearby dwarven excavation to the south has recently been occupied by Dark Iron. [soft voice] If there is anything they know, its malevolent contraptions and engineering.

[commanding] I want you to head into Groldan's Excavation to the south of here and find any Dark Iron Components they may have sitting around. [threatening] They will make better use in my hands, than in our enemies.
quest_41725_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you recovered the Dark Iron Components, or are you just stopping by to say hello?
quest_41725_quest_complete: [delight] Such excellent craftsmanship, these components will serve me well.
quest_41726_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that I've recovered some components I would like to get my hand on some more complicated parts. [solemn] Some time ago many steam tanks were destroyed during the war between the dwarves of Dun Kithas, and the Dragonmaw. [low voice] These once mighty machines sit idle in the countryside to the west and southwest, rotting away.

[pause] Such complicated engineering is not something I can replicate here in the field. [urgent] Find me six of these intricate parts from the wrecks around the region and I will make sure you are rewarded handsomely.
quest_41726_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Such fine craftsmanship, you can tell goblin or gnomish hands touched such engineering.

[solemn] With these parts I will be able to advance our efforts in Shatterblade Post even further.

[warm] I must commend you for your work. [proud] Without the components and parts you have recovered this basecamp would be left in the stone age.

[warm] Take one of these items, hopefully you will see use out of them.
quest_41727_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, <class>. [solemn] I require assistance in a task vital to the Horde, one that could secure our place here within Grim Reaches. [soft voice] There is a latent power lingering within the region, and it is my desire to claim it for myself.

[urgent] To harness such energies requires natural materials latent with magical vitality. [commanding] I require you to gather the blood of the nearby entranced dragonkin. [low voice] These creatures are under the control of the Dragonmaw clan, and can be found to the southwest of here. [emphasis] Gather their blood, and return it to me.
quest_41727_quest_progress: [solemn] The blood is required for my rituals, has it been obtained <class>?
quest_41727_quest_complete: [solemn] The power of the Demon Soul is infused within this blood, [emphasis] its power is undeniable.
quest_41728_quest_detail:
[solemn] If I am to truly captivate the magic of the region I will require a series of natural materials to amplify my abilities. [soft voice] Our real work is yet to come, but we must prepare nonetheless.

[commanding] I require some trace of fel energy from the demons of the burning legion, I do know they have a presence in Desolace, seek them out there.

[solemn] Lastly, I will require the scale of a basilisk, Crystal Spine basilisks to be more specific. [urgent] This rare breed can be found along the Savage Coast in Stranglethorn Vale, seek them out, and gather me one of their scales.
quest_41728_quest_progress: [solemn] Have you gathered what I have asked for?
quest_41728_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, now we can begin the more arduous tasks.
quest_41729_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is one final material that I require before our tasks is complete. [urgent] To the south of the region lays a place called The Grim Hollow. [soft voice] It is a desolate, and corrupted land that has been twisted by a dark and unknown power.

[solemn] This power is what I seek, and it can be claimed by the spirits of dwarves that now haunt the hollow itself. [commanding] Slay them, and return to me a Dark Essence from their remains.
quest_41729_quest_complete: [solemn] Such dark, and powerful energy, it shall serve me well.
quest_41730_quest_detail:
[solemn] All of the materials have been gathered, [pause] We have come to the culmination of our efforts. [soft voice] If we want to truly harness such energy we must first find a suitable conduit for which to contain it.

[solemn] Long ago a great gemstone of immense power was brought to this world by Gul'dan and his minions. [solemn] The Pendant of Uth'okk was left to Oronok Torn-Heart, one of Gul'dan's lieutenants [pause] It is this pendant that I seek. [urgent] You can find him lurking within the depths of Stormwrought Ruins on the island of Balor. [commanding] This will not be an easy task, but I desire you to kill him, and bring me the power of the Pendant of Uth'okk.

[warm] Do this, and you shall be rewarded.
quest_41730_quest_progress: [commanding] Have you reclaimed the Pendant of Uth'okk for the Horde?
quest_41730_quest_complete: <Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.> [solemn] The Pendant of Uth'okk, in my hands...
quest_41731_quest_detail: [solemn] Now that you have recovered the Pendant of Uth'okk I can begin my spell, [commanding] I ask of you to step back, and wait for me to finish my ritual.
quest_41731_quest_complete:
[solemn] The power of the Uth'okk gemstone is flowing through my veins... [excited] Such power is euphoric!

[proud] I am reborn, and I have you to thank for doing all my work.

<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>

[warm] The Pendant of Uth'okk has been sapped of its power, but I am sure you can make some use of it.

<Far Seer Mothang lets off a deep smirk.>

[soft voice] Farewell <class>.
quest_41732_quest_complete:
[shocked] Why what is this? [solemn] Ancient technology from Grim Reaches you say? [soft voice] Such complex and intricate mechanisms...

<Tarwegg takes a moment to inspect the device>

[delight] I must say, this is an incredible find!
quest_41733_quest_detail:
[solemn] This relic that you have brought to me may possibly be related to technology that stems from Uldaman, and those that once built it. [soft voice] The fact that this comes from the Grim Reaches is astounding, and only leaves more questions.

[pause] If we want to rebuild this relic to function, we will require some of the magic that once powered this device. [urgent] To my knowledge, the only place where such a power exists is in Uldaman itself.

[commanding] I would suggest gathering a party, and delving deep. [emphasis] Bring me an Ancient Power Module from within Uldaman, and a Gold Power Core from an engineer. [warm] Once the items are acquired, I will restore this relic as best I can.
quest_41733_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you gotten the required materials?
quest_41733_quest_complete:
[soft voice] I have done some studying while you were gone, and looked over the mechanism. [solemn] I believe I may have figured out at the least how to power it, but in its state of decay I cannot guarantee this will work.

<Tarwegg takes the materials, and begins to power the Ancient Power Module within the mechanism itself. With a soft click, the machine begins to whirr into life, albeit, at a slow, and decrepit pace.>

[excited] Aha! I have done it, [warm] I thank you for bringing the relic to me to study and work on, may its power help you on your journey.
quest_41734_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What is that you've brought, some sort of mechanical gizmo? I'd suggest you take that to a gnome, they know quite a lot more than the likes of me...

<Jarkal takes a moment to study the mechanism>

[solemn] Why, this be some of that Uldaman technology, not some gnomish trinket. I've seen something like this before here in the Badlands.
quest_41735_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, are you looking to head to Shatterblade Post? [soft voice] If so I have a good friend who resides there, and I am certain he could use a favor. Bargolnakk is in charge of the cooking as the outposts butcher, and he is always looking for a fresh supply of meat.

[urgent] If you could do me a solid, and bring him eight Stonehide Flanks from the local Stonehide boars, I am sure it would mean a lot.

[warm] You can find Shatterblade Post to the east, gather the flanks, and bring them to Bargolnakk.
quest_41735_quest_complete:
[angry] Torlag sent you? Bah he is always sending whatever fool he can persuade into hunting me local game. It is supposed to be him that is doing it.

[soft voice] Here, take this silver. It was meant for Torlag, but since you are doing his work for him, you can take it instead.
quest_41736_quest_detail:
[solemn] A few months ago I arrived with Mothang to study the elements here in Grim Reaches. [soft voice] As you can see I am now left alone in this task, for Mothang has lost himself in the pursuit of power...

<Yor'thegg lets out a sigh.>

The land itself cries for aid. [pause] I can sense the anguish of the elements here, and seek to answer them. [urgent] If you wish to help, I require Reachroot, a local herb that grows across the region, gather eight bushels, and return to me.
quest_41736_quest_complete: [solemn] You have done well, [warm] this is the first step on the path to healing this land.
quest_41737_quest_detail: [solemn] If we are to truly understand the magnitude of corruption within Grim Reaches, we must gather a sample of it. Manifestations of this foul energy has taken root in the shape of ooze's that plague the land. [soft voice] I ask of you to bring me six Lingering Corruption from the Repugnant Ooze of Grim Reaches. [urgent] You can find a concentration of them at Brangar's Folly to the northeast of here.
quest_41737_quest_complete: [sad] Such foul, malignant energy... [solemn] The corruption in this land is evident.
quest_41738_quest_detail:
[solemn] The situation is as I feared, the land is corrupt, and in a state of turmoil. [urgent] I will need to commune with the elements at haste.

[solemn] This ritual will require local, natural materials to conduct. [commanding] First, I require five Ornate Feathers from the nearby thrashers. [urgent] Three Binding Flame from the Dragonmaw Flamebinders to the northwest. And finally, I require a single pristine Stonehide Heart from the Elder Stonehide Boars. [commanding] Gather all of these materials, and return to me.
quest_41738_quest_progress: [solemn] The land yearns for peace, and it is our responsibility to comply.
quest_41738_quest_complete: [solemn] The materials have been gathered. [warm] You have done your duty, now let me conduct mine...
quest_41739_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Flame of Dagnoth? The elements have given us a very key piece of information, yet it is something that I do not know. [pause] There is only one name that comes to mind that may know about this mysterious fire. Dorthas Read

He is a human, traveling across Grim Reaches. Last I spoke with him, he seemed to know quite a bit about the region, I would suspect he knows a thing or two about this flame. [soft voice] Find him to the southwest, near the entrance to Grim Reaches, and inquire about the Flame of Dagnoth.
quest_41739_quest_complete: [solemn] You inquire about the Flame of Dagnoth? [low voice] You say Yor'thegg sent you? [threatening] You're inquiring about dark and evil things, how do I know you're not some minion of evil telling me a great lie?
quest_41740_quest_detail:
[solemn] If there is one thing I have learned here on Azeroth, it is that everything comes at a cost. [commanding] If you want information on the Flame of Dagnoth, I require some showing that you are on my side, and not some enemy agent in disguise.

[soft voice] That seems like a fair compromise, yes?

[urgent] I require you to head to the Badlands to the southwest, and locate the presence of Black Dragonkin at Lethlor Ravine. [solemn] I have heard rumors that their scales are enchanted with latent draconic energy. [commanding] Bring me one such Ensorcelled Whelp Scale from the Scalding Whelps, and you shall have the information you request.
quest_41740_quest_complete: [warm] Well done, you have proven yourself a capable adventurer! [proud] You have done me a good deed, and for that I will offer you the information you seek.
quest_41741_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Flame of Dagnoth is an old, and almost ancient well of dwarven magic. [soft voice] This flame was started long ago, as a tradition to honor the spirits of the dead.

[sad] However, this once honorable flame has been twisted and corrupted.

[solemn] The Flame of Dagnoth still burns today, deep within the heart of Grim Hollow, stirring the ancient spirits to wake once again.

[urgent] Take this information back to Yor'thegg, perhaps he can think of a way to cleanse this evil.
quest_41741_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Flame of Dagnoth is located in the Grim Hollow?

I should have guessed.
quest_41742_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ready yourself, for the real challenge has come at last. [urgent] If we are to bring peace to the elements than we must expel the evil bound to the Flame of Dagnoth. [soft voice] Its poison has lingered for far too long, and caused great havoc to all.

[commanding] Find the Flame of Dagnoth, and throw this magic dust upon the fire. [solemn] It should manifest the evil energy, allowing it to be destroyed once and for all, do this, for the good of the elements, and for the good of the land itself.
quest_41742_quest_progress: [solemn] I implore you to bring allies, for this evil may be to great to handle alone.
quest_41742_quest_complete:
[solemn] I can feel it, the flames corruption has been snuffed.

[warm] Your efforts here are monumental, and without your help I would have been left nearly helpless. [soft voice] In time, the land should heal, and the elements should rest. [solemn] I shall remain to study this transformation.

[warm] As a thanks for your actions, I offer you a reward worthy of your effort. [proud] Go with honor friend.
quest_41743_quest_progress: [excited] Impressive, outright marvelous! It has been an awfully long time since I've been this challenged in the master's game. [warm] My heartfelt thanks to you for providing the opportunity for so much delight and fun. [proud] A victor should not go without spoils, so allow me to bestow you a fitting reward for proving the grandeur of your strategic capabilities. [warm] Favor of Fallwind
quest_41743_quest_complete: [solemn] A splendid choice. [soft voice] Should you ever itch for another game again, I'd be thrilled to test your mettle once more. [pause] For now, however, let me rest for a while.
quest_41744_quest_progress: [excited] Impressive, outright marvelous! [solemn] It has been an awfully long time since I've been this challenged in the master's game. [warm] My heartfelt thanks to you for providing the opportunity for so much delight and fun. [confident] A victor should not go without spoils, so allow me to bestow you a fitting reward for proving the grandeur of your strategic capabilities. [proud] Favor of Fallwind
quest_41744_quest_complete: [solemn] A splendid choice. [soft voice] Should you ever itch for another game again, I'd be thrilled to test your mettle once more. [pause] For now, however, let me rest for a while.
quest_41745_quest_detail:
[solemn] Listen well, young <class>, for the wisdom I impart comes from the heart of the forests and the whispers of the wind. [soft voice] Take heed, for the Scythe of Elune is a potent artifact, its power intertwined with the fate of our world. [gentle] Hold it with reverence and wield it with wisdom, for its influence transcends the realms of mortals. [urgent] Guard it against the grasp of those who seek power for selfish ends, for in their hands, it could unleash untold calamity upon our lands.

[pause] Let us begin.
quest_41745_quest_complete:
[solemn] Behold, a great power is now bestowed upon us. [soft voice] I never thought I would witness such a day when the sheer power of the goddess herself answered my call. [solemn] The Scythe of Elune has been restored, and its power shall now lies within your hands to guard, and safekeep against the evils that encroach upon our world.

[solemn] With such great power, shall come a great responsibility <class>. [solemn] It is entrusted upon you to uphold this artifact, and enact the will of Elune herself upon those that would threaten our purpose.
quest_41746_quest_detail:
[solemn] Some weeks ago the Tower of Azora was conducting research into arcane properties on behalf of mages from the Kirin Tor. [sad] Sadly, this experiment ended with an overload of arcane energies which have now manifested into the nearby woods.

[soft voice] Have you noticed the wandering elementals that are now populating parts of the forest around this tower? [urgent] If you can be of assistance, we require them to be destroyed. [commanding] Bring their residue to us before this situation gets wildly out of control.
quest_41746_quest_progress: [solemn] We are working to ensure such a situation does not manifest itself again. [soft voice] When you recover the residue we can begin to channel any lingering energy back to the tower itself.
quest_41746_quest_complete:
[excited] You've recovered the residue, nice work. [warm] I must say I was not so sure it was responsible sending some traveler to clean up our mess, but it seems to have worked out in the end.

[warm] Please, on behalf of us here, take these potions, they may be of use on your journey.
quest_41747_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was once a pupil to the mages of the Tower of Azora. [soft voice] It is there I learned much of my skills, and practiced my expertise in the arcane. [low voice] I have maintained my relation with them over the years, and have often ran shipments of parchment to the tower. [soft voice] They seem to go through quite a lot of it with all of the spells, and incantations that they practice!

<Zaldimar lets out a soft laugh.>

[urgent] I need someone to run the delivery of scrolls on my behalf, as my studies currently have me bound here in Goldshire. [soft voice] You can find the Tower of Azora to the east, just past Crystal Lake. [emphasis] The large tower should not be hard to miss.
quest_41747_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, can I help you?
quest_41747_quest_complete:
[solemn] The delivery of scrolls? Zaldimar must have sent you. [soft voice] I must admit, that I miss his presence at the tower, he was always such a skilled pupil.

[warm] These scrolls will be put to good use, I can assure you that. [warm] Please, take this, as a thanks from us at the Tower of Azora.
quest_41748_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many years ago I took a student beneath my wing. To teach them the secrets of the arcane, and to harness their mind for greater things. Ralthas was a brilliant student, destined for a bright future. He could have mastered the arcane-arts, and potentially, one day ran the Tower of Azora.

[sad] It pains me to think that their mind has been poisoned by the useless folly of politics and rage. [angry] Now they run amok, teaching any thug and trickster our secrets to prey upon the weak and disturb the peace of Elwynn.

[solemn] Ralthas must be stopped, and it would break my heart if I had to face him myself. [commanding] I ask of you to defeat him. I have heard that he often lurks around the Stone Cairn Lake to the northeast of here. [soft voice] Bring me the necklace he wears so that I know his terror on Elwynn Forest has been put to rest, once and for all.
quest_41748_quest_progress: [solemn] Ralthas has spread many secrets that are held dear to the Tower of Azora, [angry] he has aided the Defias Brotherhood... Such crimes cannot be left unanswered.
quest_41748_quest_complete:
[solemn] A bright mind has been lost this day. In another world perhaps he could have truly been one of the great wizards of Azeroth.

<Theocritus lets out a deep, and long sigh.>

I doubt I will find another like him, and still, I must thank you for doing what must be done. [warm] Take this, as a personal thanks from me, to you.
quest_41749_quest_progress: [urgent] Don't leave me hanging, pal. [angry] You're the fifth adventurer I've been tasking to get this damn stone.
quest_41749_quest_complete: [excited] That's what I'm talking about! [delight] This beauty will pay a pretty sum of gold with those Shadowfo-... Oh, you're still here. Right! Your reward. Here, take this and some coin on top of it, [warm] you really made this goblin's day!
quest_41752_quest_detail:
[solemn] I've been a weakling all my life, not born the warrior my mother had wished me to be. The great defenders of Hammerfall stand tall and unrelenting against our enemies, yet I chose a different path to tread. Hacking and slashing at your enemy may be glorious and fulfilling, but to see your enemy writhe in agonizing pain over just a small drop of poison is even more enthralling. Not many of my kind share the sentiment, and I cannot blame them, but I am not here to be useless. If I can be of use to the Horde in any way, no one will be able to dissuade me from serving my warchief.

In my pursuit of new and rich venoms, I've come across a piece of information most intriguing. The vile orcs of old, the Dragonmaw, have enslaved a brood of spiders in the mining shafts beneath Grim Batol. Using their dark arts, they've enhanced the spiders to unfathomable levels of power. [soft voice] These arachnids must possess an unparalleled poison within them, so bring me their broodmother's venom sac.
quest_41752_quest_progress: [solemn] The Dragonmaw orcs are psychotic remnants, clinging to the fading and misguided glory of our past. [commanding] Decimate the fools while you are in their despicable lair.
quest_41752_quest_complete: [solemn] The acidic scent is overwhelming. [low voice] There is no doubt that these spiders have been tampered with, magically enhanced by heinous rituals. [warm] You've done well in releasing them from their torment. [proud] Here, take this as a reward for the risk I've put you in. [commanding] May you serve the warchief with pride and soul!
quest_41753_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Dark Lady's ambitions are numerous and intricate. [soft voice] On her path to revenge, she will use any tool available at her disposal, no matter the cost. [pause] As such, a number of powerful relics have drawn her attention; relics that will be instrumental for her machinations.

[low voice] The orcs hold the secrets of their ancient magics well hidden, sheltering them from the eyes of those who can find better use in their primitive sorcery. [solemn] One of them is the Eternal Flame, a source of potent energy, protected and nurtured by their pyremasters. [cold] The Dark Lady desires this artifact, and it will be you who will fulfill her request.

[urgent] Far to the south, in the dwarven Wetlands of Khaz Modan, you will find the rat's nest called Dragonmaw Retreat. [threatening] An abandoned mining facility of the cursed mountain of Grim Batol, it houses the maniacal remnants of the Dragonmaw Clan of old. [commanding] Infiltrate their pitiful hiding place and deliver me the Eternal Flame, protected by their flamekeeper.
quest_41753_quest_progress: [solemn] These simpletons cannot comprehend the power they are meddling with. [low voice] Once within our grasp, it can finally develop its full potential.
quest_41753_quest_complete: [solemn] You are a faithful and obedient servant, <class>. [low voice] For your subservience, a reward awaits. [cold] Have this and be on your way, the Dark Lady does not appreciate needless loitering.
quest_41754_quest_progress: [excited] Welcome to our grand exhibition! [soft voice] Please, if you have any questions regarding our displays, don't hesitate to ask.
quest_41754_quest_complete: [solemn] The markings are undoubtedly dwarven, reminiscent of the times before even the War of the Three Hammers! [soft voice] If you give me but a moment, I should be able to translate the message written upon this tablet…
quest_41755_quest_detail: <name>, [solemn] it is only just for the Redbrands to handle this matter internally, as much as my curiosity drives me to share it with my colleagues. [soft voice] Here, take the tablet back into your possession and deliver it to the Redbrand Estate in the Mystic Ward just yonder. [pause] He made it his life's goal to complete his family's lineage, it is in his best interest to know about this part of dwarven history.
quest_41755_quest_progress: [gentle] Greetings, what brings you to the esteemed Redbrand Estate?
quest_41755_quest_complete:
[shocked] A tablet about the Redbrand's past?! Incredible; quickly, let me inspect it!

<Torwyn adjusts his lens and begins perusing his gaze across the tablet's stony surface. With each line he's deciphering and reading, he's becoming increasingly more red and sweaty, up until his hand is visibly shaking.>

[sigh] Y-You…! [angry] WHERE DID YOU FIND THIS?! [commanding] You will NEVER speak of this; never! [threatening] No one is to know about this accursed tablet! Absolutely no one! [urgent] Here, take this and your lips will remain sealed, am I clear?! [commanding] Now begone!
quest_41756_quest_detail:
[solemn] The scattered Dragonmaw Clan proves to be a menace to our lands even years after their humiliating defeat at Grim Batol. [urgent] While one group of their despicable warriors terrorizes the southern mountains, their main force is hiding in an old mining facility in the far east. [low voice] Our reports tell of vicious orcs gathering in the decrepit halls, gaining in strength with each passing day. [commanding] Most notably are their veterans, seasoned survivors of the Second War who stop at nothing to fulfill their maddened masters demands. [commanding] They are the backbone of their army and must be eradicated if we want to have even a sliver of a chance against them.

[urgent] Venture into the mining facility that we now call Dragonmaw Retreat and thin out their ranks. The sooner, the better.
quest_41756_quest_progress: [commanding] Show 'em that the Alliance hasn't lost its bite.
quest_41756_quest_complete: [commanding] Good job, soldier. [solemn] The more dead orcs I know of, the better I can sleep at night. [warm] It won't be long before we've driven these mongrels out of the Wetlands for good. [proud] Keep fighting on, and you will always count on the aid of the sons of Khaz Modan.
quest_41757_quest_detail:
<name>, now that we've dealt with Nek'rosh and his division, we can focus our attention on the bigger threat. [solemn] Nek'rosh was merely a chess piece in this game; a powerful piece, but a chess piece nonetheless. Our good men and women of the militia out there have been talking about a terrifying Dragonmaw orc, the leader of the vicious raiding parties that increased more and more in frequency in the last weeks. [angry] A true monster through and through, responsible for abducting and killing the poor citizens of Menethil Harbor. [commanding] I want him dead, as quickly as possible. With the small time we've gained by removing Nek'rosh we can prepare a counter strike against their base of operation.

[urgent] Infiltrate the Dragonmaw Retreat far off to the east, beneath the mountain of Grim Batol, and lop off the head of that despicable creature.
quest_41757_quest_progress: [commanding] Don't underestimate him. [solemn] Beasts like him don't survive by sheer luck.
quest_41757_quest_complete: [solemn] Good riddance. [proud] We've dealt a serious blow to whatever Dragonmaw remained in Khaz Modan. [commanding] Now it is up to us to clear up the mess and dispose of any remaining vermin skulking around in our lands. [warm] I salute to you, <name>. [delight] You're a true hero in my eyes.
quest_41758_quest_detail:
[solemn] The quilboar are a primitive and hostile race, their kind has been at odds with us for longer than I can remember. [soft voice] Wherever the quilboar go they are often weaving large and heavy brushes of thorn. [low voice] It is this very magic itself that is twisting the natural order, and in turn bringing it closer to corruption. [soft voice] For some months I have been able to sense something strange, and foreign.

[solemn] I seek proof of this natural corruption, and I am certain it lays within the heart of Razorfen Kraul. [commanding] Find the living embodiment of this gnarled natural magic, and destroy it. [urgent] When this task is complete, return to me.
quest_41758_quest_progress: [solemn] The lair of Razorfen Kraul is a twisted mess of bramble and thorn. [soft voice] I advise you prepare for the journey to such a place.
quest_41758_quest_complete:
[solemn] I sense something deep within the heart of this creature... [soft voice] It yearned for release, to combat a darkness that lurked.

<Kym Wildmane looks confused, and lets out a slight sigh.>

[hesitant] Perhaps my original assessment was incorrect. [sad] It was not the primitive dark magic of the quilboar that awakened this natural being and sent it into madness. [cold] No, it was something much darker, and sinister... [urgent] I have more questions that I must research further. [warm] You have done well, regardless of my pondering. [warm] Please, take this, as a thanks from myself.
quest_41759_quest_detail:
Greetings traveler, I am Calaran Windseeker, a druid from Darnassus. [solemn] I have been studying the recent unrest deep within the home of the quilboar. [soft voice] I have heard stories of gnarled abominations of twisted thorns and natural energy. [confident] I am certain these creatures have manifested in anger to their quilboar masters and I seek to restore order to the natural world. [commanding] These beings of nature must be put to rest, and I wish to gather their roots for study.

[urgent] Venture deep within the Razorfen Kraul, find these monsters, and destroy them. [commanding] You can find this accursed lair above the great lift to the east, once you ascend to the top, head west, and look for the quilboar. [warm] Gather me three of the twisted roots, and I shall reward you well.
quest_41759_quest_progress: [solemn] When there are threats to the natural order we must do what we can to assist, and return balance.
quest_41759_quest_complete:
[solemn] Such strange magic, I am unfamiliar with the lingering presence that drove these creatures.

[soft voice] Such energy is not of a natural origin. [pause] I must conduct further studies to find the truth. [warm] You have done well <name>. [gentle] Please, take these coins, may they serve you well.
quest_41760_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Balor family held sovereignty over this island for many years. Even after becoming a vessel state, Stormwind's king allowed the first Duke to govern the state he built under many hardships and tribulations. His scions continued his legacy, each one of them reigning over the merchant paradise with a watchful eye and merciful soul. Us Grahans acted as their advisors and protectors, and we held that position with pride. [sad] As such, the immense shame that still fills my very being for failing my lord all those years ago is all the more unbearable. [solemn] I may not be able to rewrite the past, but I can yet honor the Balor family's legacy.

My ghost is tethered to this estate, so I implore you to accomplish this feat in my stead. Enter Stormwrought Castle and seek the remnants of my old friend. His bones may long have turned to ash within the cursed halls of his home, but his sigil ring may yet remain. [solemn] Seek it, return the band to me, so that you may be within my ever-lasting debt.
quest_41760_quest_progress: [solemn] The history of Balor continues to be written, where it will lead, I do not know. [soft voice] But this chapter of its past needs to be closed, that I am certain of.
quest_41760_quest_complete:
Frederik, old friend. Figments of your essence linger in this dull trinket, bare of any grandeur it once held. [solemn] One day, when I may finally pass on and leave this realm, I will see you once more...

<name>, blessings upon you. [warm] This ring will find its way into oblivion, far away from the clutches of darkness, I will make sure of that. [proud] For your courageous act, take this from my remaining corporeal belongings. You deserve it well.
quest_41761_quest_detail:
[solemn] From what I gathered from Spickerspan's findings, I don't believe we are simply dealing with the Stormreaver orcs and their demon friends alone at this point. [low voice] An operation of this magnitude is too grand for a scattered clan from the Second War. [solemn] There has to be more at play here. [urgent] Who else has their grimy little fingers involved in this is our next step. [commanding] Ascend the island, enter the yard of Stormwrought Castle and thin out their numbers. [urgent] Search the area for crucial intel we might be missing. [commanding] Dispatch any high ranking officer you come across, we must be swift and deadly. [urgent] I myself will send notice to Master Shaw to rally as many agents as we can. [solemn] Personally I do not expect the King to aid us in this tragedy.

[urgent] Stay sharp, <class>, I expect sufficient results.
quest_41761_quest_progress: [urgent] Do not venture alone. [commanding] These beasts are unpredictable and will stop at nothing.
quest_41761_quest_complete:
[solemn] I expected nothing less. [soft voice] For an external aid, you've proven yourself to be a valuable asset to our team. [warm] If the thrill of adventure ever subsides within you, the SI:7 has room for individuals like you.

[commanding] Please, report your findings. [urgent] Time is running out.
quest_41762_quest_detail: [whispering] Hey, psst, pal. Running dry on gold? Of course you are, I know that look. [excited] I got a job for you that'll be easier than changing the diaper on an ogre! Listen, really, no need to ask questions, I promise it'll be to your benefit. [urgent] Down in the southwestern mountains, the Durotar Labor Union is operating large-scale oil pumping schemes. Kind of risky if you ask me; anyway, my clients are not entirely happy about them doing what they're doing, and you'll be the one to stop them. [commanding] Here, take these overchargers and plant them on their pump stations. Watch out for their workers, they will surely be trying to stop you. [warm] Once you are done, return to me for your hard-earned reward!
quest_41762_quest_progress: [urgent] Are you done yet? Don't keep me waiting, buster!
quest_41762_quest_complete:
Wonderful, wonderful! [excited] Once they start up the stations again, they will create a SPECTACULAR display of pyrodynamics! With this outta the way, all we gotta do is haul the barrels back to... -wait, you're still here? Oh, your reward, sure, just give me a second...

<The goblin is rummaging in a small satchel on his belt, before pulling out a gold coin.>

There you go, don't spend everything at once, bozo!
quest_41768_quest_detail: [solemn] I have to admit, <class>, Northwind is in a miserable state. Birkhaven has been raided, we've lost control over Sherwood Quarry and I do not have enough men to protect my citizens. [sad] As much as it pains my pride as a noble and leader, I have my hands tied. [soft voice] Judging from your looks, I reckon you are of the traveling type? If so, perhaps you'd be interested in some important errand work for me? [hesitant] I cannot spare any more of my subjects, their numbers are cut slim.
quest_41769_quest_detail:
[solemn] To tame and ride the Ravasaur unprepared is a fool's errand. Their hide oozes venomous liquid, coating their skin with a lethal coat; just a mere touch could very well be your death sentence. [soft voice] It is however not impossible to bend the mighty Ravasaur to your will, if you wish to tread the arduous path of such a commitment. [solemn] I can show you my people's ancient ways of subduing these poison-filled beasts.

[urgent] Go out into the jungle and seek their nesting grounds. [emphasis] Search for an egg that is just about to hatch, any other will not be sufficient enough for our task. [commanding] Return to me once you've been successful.
quest_41769_quest_progress: [solemn] The beasts will defend their brood viciously. [urgent] Lack of caution may cause your journey to end prematurely.
quest_41769_quest_complete: <Just as you are handing Jama'nali the quivering egg, its shell starts cracking. Piece by piece, the tiny hatchling fights its way out of its prison, gasping for air. With a high-pitched screech, the little one looks at you before jumping back into your hand, desperately biting the air.> [solemn] Ravasaur hatchlings are quick to stand on their own two feet, and are just as quick to grow hungry. [warm] To properly raise your new fosterling, we need to feed him.
quest_41770_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As frail as it is now, the young one is harmless. Neither his bite nor his hide can harm you, since his venomhide has not developed yet. [solemn] By spending time and raising the hatchling, your body will naturally attune itself to the growing venom inside it. Once it reaches adulthood, you will be resilient enough to ride it without consequences.

[commanding] Scour the jungle for food, and feed the beastly meat to it. With each meal, his jaw, body and mind will grow and change. [solemn] Show me your commitment to your fosterling by presenting me with its teeth, the teeth it will lose while maturing. Only then will I teach you the rites of Ravasaur riding.
quest_41770_quest_progress: [solemn] It will be a long and arduous journey, but at the end the bond between the two of you will be stronger than ever.
quest_41770_quest_complete:
[solemn] It is done. [warm] You've proven your determination to me. [soft voice] It is as clear as the sun how well you've been caring for your now adult Ravasaur. [pause] I am certain they think the same.

<Your little hatchling has grown splendidly and is now a proper and matured Ravasaur. Still affectionate to you, it's rubbing its jaw next to yours, causing no reaction from its venomous hide: you've successfully built a resistance to the lethal venom.>

[proud] Your bond has reached a depth few others rarely hold. [warm] Be proud of your achievement and show it to the world. [commanding] Now then, let me share the secrets of riding the Ravasaur.
quest_41771_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ancient beasts of Un'goro possess flesh of peculiar taste. The smell alone is enough for some to succumb to uncomfortable convulsions. [soft voice] Your hatchling, however, can't get enough of it. Ravasaur offspring develop quickly and as such require immense amounts of nourishment. [commanding] Normally they'd follow their mother on the hunt, but this task now falls upon you.

Hunt the creatures of the crater and allow your fosterling to prosper.
quest_41771_quest_progress: [urgent] Do not hunt the Ravasaur, feeding it their poisonous flesh so early would kill it!
quest_41771_quest_complete: [solemn] A good hunt. [soft voice] This should satiate its hunger - for now. [urgent] These ravenous younglings crave sustenance all day long, so do not wait too long before feeding it again.
quest_41772_quest_detail:
[solemn] Far to the west is a vale of stone pillars called Terror Run. [solemn] Among these pillars, the powerful stegodon reside, demolishing anything in their vicinity. [low voice] Towering over most of the crater's inhabitants, their massive size is thanks to the thick glands, increasing their muscle growth and strengths. [urgent] To ensure the young Ravasaur is properly raised, we need these glands.

[commanding] Travel to Terror Run and slay the stegodons. Beware, they are stronger than your average beast.
quest_41772_quest_progress: [solemn] The glands produce strong growth hormones. [soft voice] Yet fear not. [gentle] Our little friend will not be harmed by consuming them.
quest_41772_quest_complete: [solemn] Thick and heavy, brimming with power. [soft voice] My people have customs of eating powerful organs to enhance our own bodies. [warm] You should try it yourself one day, it can feel… [delight] exhilarating.
quest_41773_quest_detail: [solemn] Wandering the jungle of Un'goro, you've surely felt the earth rumble from time to time. [soft voice] Distant roars of terror and the breaking of trees and branches. [solemn] The mighty devilsaur are the apex predators of Un'goro, no other beast can rival their unparalleled strength. [urgent] Hunting one of them is a great feat in itself, but felling one shows exceptional capabilities. [warm] The powerful muscle that is their heart will be a fantastic source of nutrition for the hatchling.
quest_41773_quest_progress: [solemn] Their terrifying roar and massive claws will shred any unsuspecting hunter with ease.
quest_41773_quest_complete: [solemn] Bloodied and truly massive. [warm] These hearts will help the little one become a strong and robust adult when the time comes.
quest_41775_quest_detail:
<class>, come closer. [soft voice] Your contributions to the Athenaeum have been plentiful and many forlorn tomes have found their way back into our fold. [solemn] The Shen'dralar are grateful for your actions so far, which is why I am beholden to ask a reliable <race> such as yourself for yet another favor.

[pause] While our treasury of knowledge grows evermore, we are still lacking one ancient and crucial grimoire that is infamous among our scholars. [emphasis] Written by the disgraced sorcerer princess Aszune, the book details the meticulous process of shattering and converging magical shards and crystals. [solemn] It is paramount that it returns to the Athenaeum!

[urgent] The magical energies radiating from the book are one of a kind, and I remember them well. [pause] Fortunately for us, they have not left Eldre'thalas. [soft voice] I detect its presence high above us, near the seat of the despicable ogre king. [threatening] Certainly, his corpulent advisor is defiling it with his filthy hands. [commanding] Retrieve it from him, but be careful! [urgent] The book is ancient and gets damaged easily!
quest_41775_quest_progress: [solemn] Princess Aszune was an infamous figure in Highborne society; a mighty sorceress, she dedicated her studies on the power drawn from the astral planes of the Twisting Nether, oftentimes utilizing hazardous methods even her fellow astronomers would not dare use. [soft voice] After the Sundering, all traces of her had been erased and not even us Shen'dralar know what became of her.
quest_41775_quest_complete: [solemn] There it is; oh, how marvelous the binding is, so intricate and filigrane. [soft voice] Holding it in my hands is simply overwhelming, as if I am being cast between the tides of knowledge, tossed beneath the waves and drowning in Princess Aszune's discoveries. [warm] You have done more than well, <race>. [proud] As your reward, let me impart the wisdom of Aszune to you.
quest_41776_quest_progress:
[solemn] Nexus crystals are the concentrated arcane essence of the Twisting Nether that seeped into the armaments and artifacts of Azeroth. They possess immense power and potential and are used in many magical enchantments that empower the recipient tremendously. [soft voice] Usually these crystals are so dense that not even the strongest spell or weapon can break them without releasing a volatile and lethal explosion. [pause] Aszune, however, managed to create a method of splitting a nexus crystal into two lesser magical shards, maintaining its stability and energy.

[soft voice] I would love to conduct experiments with the instructions found inside Aszune's manifesto. [warm] Bring me one such crystal and we will see how true her words will ring. Nexus Crystal
quest_41776_quest_complete:
<Lorekeeper Javon holds the crystal in one hand, the grimoire in the other. Reciting the incantations written on the pages, the nexus crystal begins to move, agitated by the swell of arcane power. Increasing in intensity, the rapid movements peak before breaking under vibrant purple sparks, leaving two golden shards in Javon's hand.> [delight] Success! That was marvelous, truly! [warm] I am amazed how close to perfect Aszune's spells are. [soft voice] With a bit of practice and refinement, we will be able to quickly and more safely break apart nexus crystals with ease.

[proud] <name>, thank you for your cooperation. [warm] You can keep these shards as a reward for your assistance. [urgent] Please, bring me any nexus crystal you can find, so that I may continue my experimentations.
quest_41777_quest_progress: [solemn] In her dissertation, Aszune theorizes that arcane energy naturally coalesces after some time. This, however, could be accelerated in an albeit unnatural way. She wrote that if attuning two similarly inclined implements to the same wave of energy, they would eventually fuse, creating something wholly new. [soft voice] My desire to try this on my own is indescribable. [hesitant] Let us begin with something simple for now; who knows what kind of dangerous repercussions our actions may bring with them. [commanding] Following these incantations, I will attempt to coagulate two brilliant shards, creating something magnificent. [warm] <name>, if you could deliver me these shards, it'd be much appreciated. Large Brilliant Shard(2)
quest_41777_quest_complete: <Crackling energy shoots out from the magical shards, while Javon recites the spell. Heat begins to emanate from his hand and the pieces begin to form a liquid union, hovering slightly in the air. Shortly after, a burst of mana erupts - and in Javon's hand lies a nexus crystal.> [solemn] Splendid, seeing it unfold right before my eyes is something I will remember forever. [soft voice] To think what we've achieved today was only possible because of ten-thousand year old knowledge, wisdom my people treasured for millennia is a testament to our resilience. [warm] Don't fret, young <class>, without your aid, all of this would not have been possible. [warm] Please keep the crystal as your reward. [confident] I am adamant that we can refine the process even further, so I would be pleased if you'd gather the needed components once again.
quest_41778_quest_progress: [solemn] The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. [soft voice] Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. [sad] Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. [gentle] Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. [solemn] Libram of Voracity
quest_41778_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the Libram of Voracity. Have you browsed its pages? For the unkeen eye, it is merely a collection of disconnected images and cryptic words, but for the enlightened, unforeseen potential lies within. [soft voice] The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.
quest_41779_quest_progress: [solemn] The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. [soft voice] Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. [sad] Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. [gentle] Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. [solemn] Libram of Constitution
quest_41779_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the Libram of Constitution. [soft voice] This heavy tome is infamous for harboring difficult incantations and invaluable arcane wisdom some would deem as perilous. [pause] The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.
quest_41780_quest_progress: [solemn] The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. [soft voice] Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. [sad] Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. [gentle] Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. [solemn] Libram of Resilience
quest_41780_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the Libram of Resilience. A popular oeuvre among aspiring arcanists. But beware, should you lose yourself within its pages, there is no turning back. [soft voice] The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.
quest_41781_quest_progress: [solemn] The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. [soft voice] Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. [sad] Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. [gentle] Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. [solemn] Libram of Rumination
quest_41781_quest_complete: [solemn] The Libram of Rumination. [soft voice] A nefarious grimoire. [hesitant] I'd best not disclose its contents, and for your sake, I wish you did not open its accursed pages. [warm] The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.
quest_41782_quest_progress: [solemn] The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. [soft voice] Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. [sad] Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. [gentle] Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. [solemn] Libram of Tenacity
quest_41782_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, the Libram of Tenacity. If our statistics are to be trusted, this appears to be the book that has been stolen the most. [soft voice] I wonder why... [pause] The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.
quest_41783_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You may think an archivist doesn't have much to do on an expedition like this, but you couldn't be further from the truth with that assumption! [excited] Not accounting for many of my other talents like translation or my analytical prowess, many of the places the SI:7 gets stationed are filled to the brim with enriching history. [solemn] This is especially true for a place as steeped in history as Balor. [low voice] Infamous among the citizens of the kingdom, many stories and rumours around the long buried vessel state are told among the generations. [pause] While I have to perform my tasks here in an objective manner, there are still particular documents I wish to chronicle out of personal interest.

[emphasis] The logbook of the lighthouse keeper. [soft voice] The lighthouse can be seen north of here, just beyond the bay of Breezehaven.

[soft voice] The records of the Grahan family, the ruins of their estate are nestled in the western mountains.

[soft voice] The sermons of the church past the broken city gates.

[urgent] Look for them on your ventures to the island.
quest_41783_quest_progress: Balor was a place of hardship, tribulations and tragedies. [solemn] Born from the wish for independancy and wealth, it quickly became the haven for merchants across the kingdom, and even those beyond its borders.
quest_41783_quest_complete: <Placing the books on Noppsy's table, the gnome marvels at the proportionally gigantic tomes.> [soft voice] So beautiful and ancient! [solemn] It will take some time to study these documents thoroughly. [warm] Thank you, <name>. [proud] You've done a great service to the kingdom today, preserving part of their history, as ugly and depressing as it may be. [solemn] These stories tell us valuable lessons, so barring your eyes from them will only hurt you in the long run. [urgent] Remember, knowledge is key to your survival.
quest_41784_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey, you there! You look like the brave adventurin' type! I bet you could use a treat that'll restore your appetite in record timing... Yeah yeah, I can see it on your face, you want it right now! [shouting] Well, sorry bub, my Kezan Fruitcakes are a rarity, and one that needs a buy in. If you want to have the opportunity to buy my goods, you'll have to pay me for the luxury first.

How about, one hundred gold coins. My fruitcakes are only for well off clients after all, I'm not willing to give such a rare import to some lowly begger. You get the coins, and you come back to me, sound good kid?
quest_41784_quest_complete: [commanding] So, maybe you do have the stuff. [urgent] Well, if you're willing to hand the coin over, I'll open my secret vendors list for you, and all the others who have paid my fee. [confident] Trust me, you won't regret it.
quest_41786_quest_detail: [hesitant] This island is playing tricks on me. [soft voice] Shrouded in thick fog all day long and if it isn't that for a few minutes, I'm seeing smoke clouds coming from out in the ocean. [excited] Yes, from the ocean! [urgent] No land in sight, but smoke is rising up into the sky like it's the most logical thing. [hesitant] You're helping us in our operation, right? [soft voice] If you have the time, could you check the open sea northwest from here and give me the peace of mind I desperately need?
quest_41786_quest_complete: [solemn] It was a matter of time till someone dares to venture here. [commanding] Lower your weapons, I mean you no harm.
quest_41787_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Shadow Council. It seems Doomhammer's lap dogs were sloppy. If you are unfamiliar with them, the Shadow Council are - or rather were - Gul'dan's fanatical followers. [soft voice] A cabal of heretics and sinners, devoting their very being to their demon overlords. [solemn] They were said to have been eradicated following their master's death during the Second War, yet their depravity still prevails. [urgent] If this missive can be trusted, then the Stormreaver are led by a high ranking and powerful warlock of the Shadow Council, operating from within Stormwrought Castle.

<name>, there is little time for respite. [commanding] Gather an elite force and storm the fallen castle. [urgent] We need to put a stop to their leader from summoning that demon from beyond the Nether and rescue the remaining citizens still in their clutches. [commanding] Do not take this lightly, prepare for any eventuality!
quest_41787_quest_progress: [hesitant] It may be too much to ask from you, but we don't have any luxuries left at this point.
quest_41787_quest_complete:
[solemn] What travesties have transpired at this place...? [sad] Never have I witnessed such horrors in my life, the thought of such profanities even existing send shivers down my spine.

[warm] <name>, your bravery in descending this spiral of madness is a heroic feat rarely seen nowadays. [proud] Your service to the kingdom and all of the Alliance this day will be remembered by those present and cherished by those affected. [gentle] These rewards do not match the magnitude of your deeds, but take them nevertheless.

[commanding] You are dismissed.
quest_41788_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Gnarlpine are not the only furbolg tribe dwelling upon Teldrassil’s boughs.

Far to the southwest, nestled among the mist-veiled heights, lies an elusive tribe — the Ursan. They have long shunned the paths of others, hiding from both our eyes and our voices.

Yet... I sense the same darkness stirring among them — the fel moss spreads, corrupting all it touches. [urgent] We dispatched a druid, Drethanis, to seek the truth within their domain. But... the winds have carried no word of him since.

[sad] I fear for his fate.

[gentle] Will you aid me? Seek him amidst the shadows of Ursan Heights — the path lies west of the Pools of Arlithrien.

Should he yet draw breath, it is there you shall find him.
quest_41788_quest_complete:
[low voice] So... Kyra has finally deigned to remember I exist? [mocking tone] How endearing.

<Drethanis regards you with a calm, unreadable gaze — no warmth, no gratitude.>

Very well. [commanding] If nothing else, your presence may serve a purpose. [solemn] The rot runs deeper than any of us feared.
quest_41789_quest_detail:
[solemn] Look around you. The Ursan tribe — once noble, for a lesser race — now raves with fel-induced madness. [sad] Their hearts are shattered, their minds lost.

[angry] They have defiled one of our sacred moonwells... and slain its guardian. [solemn] Such transgression cannot go unanswered.

[soft voice] Were the times less dire, I would seek to mend their spirits. [urgent] But you’ve seen it — what the fel moss does to these woods. [solemn] Once it takes root, there is no redemption for their kind.
