[commanding] Cull them. As many as you can. [soft voice] Bring me their charms — pitiful relics, once crafted by their shamans to ward off evil spirits. [mocking tone] A quaint belief.

<He smirks faintly, a bitter gleam in his eye.>

[sad] Clearly... they failed.
quest_41789_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is of the essence — do not waste it.
quest_41789_quest_complete:
[solemn] Their spirits now drift back to the Dream... to merge with Ursol, the Bear-God they worshipped with such fervor.

[mocking tone] How ironic. For all their blind devotion, even Ursol could not shield them from corruption. Or perhaps... he chose not to.
quest_41790_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tribe is broken, their strength scattered to the winds. [solemn] Now is the time to reclaim what is ours—the moonwell must not remain steeped in their stench.

[threatening] Their so-called leader, Arkod the White, likely struts around the sacred waters even now, desecrating what remains of its guardians. [soft voice] Once, he was a devout servant of Ursol... one of the bear god’s most revered clerics.

[sad] Curious, isn’t it? To fall so far. [low voice] One must wonder what blasphemy earned him Ursol’s silence.

[commanding] End him. [urgent] Sever the head of their corruption and bring it to me. [cold] Without him, the tribe will crumble—and I will cleanse the moonwell of their filth once and for all.
quest_41790_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary, <class>. [low voice] He is a formidable enemy.
quest_41790_quest_complete:
[solemn] So... it is done. [low voice] A necessary task, and performed adequately.

<He pauses, gaze drifting toward the tainted moonwell, voice lowering with unease.>

And yet... [hesitant] a shadow lingers in my thoughts.

[pause] What if Ursol himself has fallen? [soft voice] What if the silence is not from disdain, but from madness... corruption?

<His tone grows cold, edged with quiet alarm.>

[urgent] A dangerous thought. [emphasis] One I dare not entertain lightly. [solemn] The Archdruid must hear of this.

[warm] You have my thanks for your... assistance. [soft voice] May the winds carry you far from this cursed place.
quest_41791_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our expansion into the Eastern Kingdoms is everso successful. [solemn] The founding of Kargath was a vital moment in cementing our presence on the outskirts of Khaz Modan. [solemn] But that was merely one step in the Warchief's plan for the lands beyond the Great Sea.

[soft voice] To the northeast of the great pond of Loch Modan, a passageway leads into the Grim Reaches, unbound lands of the hill dwarves, riddled with the vile Dragonmaw orcs. [commanding] Commander Aggnash established the Shatterblade Outpost on the northeastern outskirts, a stronghold built to neutralize the Dragonmaw aggression within these parts of the Eastern Kingdom. [urgent] Venture there and aid him in fulfilling the Warchief's cause.
quest_41791_quest_complete: [commanding] Stand tall, soldier. [solemn] Belgrom did well in sending you here. [urgent] Look around, there is much to be done here.
quest_41792_quest_detail: [solemn] My brother Morkan is stationed at Shatterblade Post in the Grim Reaches. [soft voice] A rugged land, east of Loch Modan and the Wetlands. [pause] The dwarves and Dragonmaw orcs have been fighting over control for a long time there, and our Warchief Thrall wishes to assess the situation for himself. [low voice] The wild is treacherous and unrelenting, and my brother, while ambitious and disciplined, is still young and inexperienced. [gentle] To bolster his spirit, I want him to have this cooked hog I prepared, it is his favourite. [warm] If you could bring this to him, I'd be very much in your debt, <class>.
quest_41792_quest_progress: [low voice] Don't cause trouble around here, we've got our hands full already.
quest_41792_quest_complete: [excited] That smell...! It must be Slagg's famous hog steak! I could recognize that smell from anywhere. It's just like how our father used to cook it. [warm] Thank you very much, <name>. [solemn] Being so far in enemy territory sometimes takes a toll on my morale. [proud] I appreciate you and Slagg reminding me what we are fighting for here.
quest_41793_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Horde's past is riddled with guilt and mistakes. [soft voice] Our bygone alliances with various orc clans of old put a stain on our honor, a stain we need to scrape off if we wish to step into a new future. [solemn] The Dragonmaw Clan, fanatical veterans responsible for the enslavement of the Red Dragonflight, rallied itself in the Grim Reaches, a cragged place to the east of Loch Modan. [low voice] Their delusions make them cling like madmen to their olden ways, unable to see the foolishness of it all.

[urgent] We dispatched a unit to the Grim Reaches on Warchief Thrall's behest through Loch Modan, past the tunnel at Farstrider Lodge southeast of the lake. [commanding] I want you to follow and join them at Shatterblade Post. Make sure to aid them wherever you can. [angry] Bring honor to the horde, whelp!
quest_41793_quest_complete: [solemn] Throm'ka, young one. [warm] Welcome to Shatterblade Post.
quest_41794_quest_detail:
Mok'rah, young one. [solemn] Yonder the Great Sea's bays to the north lies the forlorn island of Balor. [solemn] Unnatural storms ravage its shores, and the sinister magic of Gul'dan's taint still lingers in its earth even decades after his destruction. [soft voice] My clan, the Bleeding Hollow, is stationed on one of eastern islands surrounding Balor, on behalf of our Warchief Thrall. [commanding] Chieftain Kilrogg himself volunteered in leading this offensive against the resurfaced Stormreaver clan of old.

[hesitant] Could I ask you a favor? [soft voice] My clan mate Far Seer Sarno requires this potion for his divinations. [urgent] If you could bring it to him, you'd do a great service to the Horde. [urgent] Speak with Thysta the Wind Rider Master just over there and she will bring you to Balor posthaste.
quest_41794_quest_progress: [commanding] Thrall hall, youngling. [soft voice] What brings you to Stormbreaker Point?
quest_41794_quest_complete: Mok'thardin did good in sending you here. [warm] This potion will prove to be vital in our endeavors on this island. [solemn] While you are here, aid us. We could use any hand available.
quest_41795_quest_complete: [solemn] Whelpling, what we are facing is an abyss of unseen depth. [soft voice] Be absolutely sure your heart is steeled for what is to come. Lest you'll be devoured by the void festering on this island.
quest_41796_quest_detail:
Greetings, good <class>. Have you heard about the grand tournament in Northwind? The local nobles are holding a jousting tournament and invited various human nations to participate, Theramore included! [excited] Lady Proudmoore chose a handful of our guards as contestants, and my beautiful children were among them! [sad] I had barely time to say goodbye to them, they had to depart so quickly. Say, are you by chance traveling to Northwind? Would you be so kind and hand my boy Boris these scarves? See it as my way as their father to support them even here in Theramore.

[gentle] I heard you can reach Northwind by traversing Stormwind Harbor. Good luck!
quest_41796_quest_progress: [soft voice] Anything I can help you with? [urgent] I need to prepare for the tournament, our opponents won't be easy to defeat.
quest_41796_quest_complete: Scarves from our father? Oh my. Now this is a bit embarrassing. [soft voice] He's always been on the softer side of things, a dreamer, you could say. [hesitant] Don't get me wrong, though. [warm] I appreciate it very much. [solemn] Alessa and I grew up in Stormwind. [soft voice] Since we were very little back then, we don't have many memories of the time, but it still feels weird for us to be back here. [warm] Having something familiar from home will help us with the situation, for sure. [proud] For that, you have my thanks.
quest_41797_quest_progress: [soft voice] How can I help you? [urgent] Need to refill your quiver?
quest_41797_quest_complete:
[soft voice] A letter from Avette? How is she? [sad] I heard Duskwood is a treacherous place nowadays, not safe for any of the common folk.

<Barbara opens the letter and quickly glances over a few lines. While doing so, a chuckle escapes her.>

I see I have nothing to worry about, how relieving. [soft voice] It's been too long since I've heard from her and I was beginning to assume the worst. [warm] Once Northwind's troubles subside, I will pay her a visit. [solemn] It is more than overdue. [warm] Here, take these few coins as thanks from me and Avette. [proud] Trust me, you did more than you think for the both of us. [gentle] Stay safe on your travels, <name>.
quest_41798_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Good day to you, <class>. You look like the adventurous type to me. Have you braved many of the dangers that are omnipresent nowadays? No matter where you go, it seems crises are not far off. Certainly not a world we wish our children to grow up in. [warm] My wife does her best to make Azeroth a better place, but even in the organization she is in, it is a nigh impossible task for her to accomplish. Say, would you be interested in assisting her, as a mercenary? The operation she is assigned to this time is... particularly delicate, or so she told me. [hesitant] To be frank with you, I am worried about her well-being, this might be just too much even for her. I'd be forever in your debt if you could aid her.

If yes, then head to the harbor, just west of here. On one of the southern docks, you should find a colleague of hers - Simmons is his name, I think. Tell him Operative Gillian requested more external assistance, and he should bring you to her, to the island of Balor.
quest_41798_quest_progress: [solemn] Ronald Gillian asked you to join his wife on Balor to assist in her work.
quest_41798_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh Ronald, your heart is in the right place, but your naivete is just too cumbersome sometimes. Either way, now that you're here, you might as well assist us. [low voice] My name is Operative Verona Gillian, and I welcome you to the hell that is Balor.
quest_41800_quest_detail:
[solemn] This place has seen a lot—heroes rising and falling, battles that turned into legends, and losses folks would rather forget. [soft voice] Out here, where the wind hums through the rocks and the ground's soaked in the blood of old wars, you can feel the past hanging in the air.

[pause] Tucked away in the Grim Hollow to the south is the Tomb of Ancestors. [solemn] It's an ancient resting place, old as Grim Batol itself. [low voice] Dwarves laid their dead to rest there ages ago, carved their names in runestone and memory. [pause] We thought they were at peace.

[sad] Turns out, we were wrong.

[urgent] Something's stirring in the dark. [solemn] The dead aren't resting like they should. [soft voice] Spirits are drifting through the fog, restless. [pause] There's something foul buried beneath the marsh—something that doesn't belong.

[commanding] So here's the deal: head into those misty bogs. [emphasis] Figure out what's messing with the tomb, and put an end to it. [solemn] Let the dead sleep in peace again… and make sure whatever's causing this doesn't get any further.
quest_41800_quest_progress: Careful out there—Grim Hollow's not the kind of place you just stroll through. The mist hangs thick, and the shadows feel... off, like they're watching you. Plenty of brave folks have gone in thinking they'd be fine—most never came back. Would be a damn shame if you ended up buried with the Wildhammer dead instead of helping them.
quest_41800_quest_complete:
[solemn] Let's hope you gave those restless spirits the peace they deserve. [soft voice] The dead should stay dead, especially ones who fought and bled for their kin.

[hesitant] Still… makes you wonder, doesn't it? [low voice] What twisted thing got into that tomb and stirred everything up? [commanding] There's something dark at work in those mists, and I've got a bad feeling this ain't the last we've seen of it.
quest_41801_quest_detail:
[soft voice] There's someone who might know what's behind all this mess. [pause] Way deep in Grim Hollow, there's an old tree—a massive oak that's been standing since long before any dwarf laid eyes on these lands. [solemn] No one really knows how old it is, but it's always been respected. [soft voice] Quiet. Steady. Part of the land, you know?

[hesitant] But now... we've had word from Wildhammer scouts that a blue dragonkin's made camp under its branches. [low voice] No idea what he's doing there, but I've got a feeling it ain't random. [urgent] With the way the land's been twisting lately, his arrival can't be a coincidence. [commanding] Dragons don't usually stick their snouts into mortal troubles unless something big's going on.

If you're thinking of talking to him, tread carefully. [soft voice] Dragons aren't exactly known for their sunny tempers, and one wrong word could get you roasted. [hesitant] Still… if you can get him to talk, he might just have answers we're not gonna find anywhere else.
quest_41806_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it? [angry] I'm rather busy!
quest_41806_quest_complete:
[excited] Dragonfire bombs? Ha-HA! Now you're speaking my language!

[warm] You've come to the right gnome, friend! [proud] Oglethorpe Obnoticus at your service—chemist, engineer, part-time arcanomechanical theorist, and full-time enthusiast of all things that go BOOM!

[chuckling] Buuut let's not get ahead of ourselves. [confident] Sure, I can whip up a dragonfire bomb—of course I can! But as it stands, I'm a bit... let's say, under-equipped. Supplies, reagents, blastproof goggles—the usual!

[urgent] So! If you're ready to lend a hand, we just might make a little history together. [emphasis] A very explosive bit of history.
quest_41807_quest_detail:
[excited] Aha! Hmm... well now, this isn't entirely a disaster. I've got—let's see—coil springs, flux regulators, containment gel... Yes! I've got most of what I need!

[urgent] However! I am running a bit low on a few key components—namely, Solid Blasting Powder, Bronze Frameworks, and Whirring Bronze Gizmos. Nothing too exotic! Any halfway-competent engineer could whip those up with the right materials. No offense if you're only quarter-competent, of course!

Now, one thing might prove a bit trickier... the heat-resistant trigger. [solemn] Not just any old trigger, mind you—this one's a specialty piece from Undermine. Built to withstand extreme temperatures. [sad] Last I heard, the latest shipment from Undermine got intercepted by those scoundrelly Bloodsail pirates.

[urgent] If you're lucky—and still have all your limbs by the end—you might find one of those precious triggers stashed in the pirate camps to the southeast.

[commanding] Off you go then! Bring me the goods, and I'll bring the boom!
quest_41808_quest_detail:
<Oglethorpe eyes the finished bomb with a mix of pride and deep, mounting concern> [hesitant] Well... upon some reflection—and maybe a teensy bit of hindsight—I'm not entirely convinced crafting that for you was the best idea I've ever had...

M-maybe I should hold onto it... just to, you know, keep the world intact for another day or two...

[urgent] Okay, okay! No need for the death glare—yikes! Just... take the blasted thing! But do us all a favor and carry it as far away as possible! Avoid fire, goblins, sudden movements, loud noises, and especially me when you're holding it!

<He gingerly places the bomb into your hands>

Now go, go! Shoo! Be gone before I have second thoughts!

[sigh] Ooooh—but wait! All this tinkering just gave me the most brilliant idea—EXPLOSIVE DUCKS! [excited] No one expects an explosive duck! [laughing] Heehee! The waddling! The detonating! THE POSSIBILITIES!
quest_41811_quest_detail:
<Zalsu seems lost in focus, as if he is attempting to listen to something far off. His attention is snapped from distant thoughts, only to look upon you with curiosity.> [solemn] I sense you are here for a purpose, can you hear it, trailing upon the sands, and rising from the dunes? [emphasis] Yes... [sad] Something evil has arisen, something foul. [solemn] I have sensed it from deep within Zul'Farrak, and it has tainted the very dunes of Tanaris itself! [angry] The spirits be angered by the presence of an ancient evil, and I have no doubt it is the return of Zel'jeb.

[low voice] He who was old when the world was young, one of the most venerable warlords of the Farraki, empowered by dark embalming, and foul magic. [urgent] If there is to be peace in these lands, his soul must be brought to an end. [commanding] Find him, deep within Zul'Farrak, and bring your most trusted allies, you will need them to defeat Zel'jeb.
quest_41811_quest_progress: [whispering] Silence, you be interrupting the winds...
quest_41811_quest_complete: [solemn] Finally, a silence I have not heard in some time, the dunes themselves are at peace, and so am I... [pause] My wandering has come to an end, and perhaps it may be time to find peace for myself. [soft voice] I thank you traveler, you have done this place a great service. [warm] I offer you what little I can, may it serve you well.
quest_41812_quest_detail: [solemn] Deep beneath our feet lays an ancient temple once dedicated to Elune, it is there that druids planted a magical tree of great power to reinvigorate nature itself.[soft voice] The beauty of this tree has only been seen by few, though I now fear it lays in the hands of evil.[sad] I have heard rumors that satyrs now skulk these once sacred halls in the depths of Blackfathom Deeps.[commanding] I task you to recover a seed from this tree, and bring it to me so my fellow druids may perhaps discover the power of the druids of old.
quest_41812_quest_progress: [solemn] Travel carefully, the depths of Blackfathom are crawling with evil.
quest_41812_quest_complete: [soft voice] Such beauty- such magnificence. [solemn] I wish I could have personally laid eyes upon the ancient tree, though I thank you for the efforts you have taken to recover this. [warm] I am within your debt. [gentle] Please, on behalf of us druids, take this as thanks.
quest_41813_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Explorers' League is not what it used to be, I tell you! [angry] I told them I would come here to discover history, heirlooms, something so grand that it would be placed in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers! But they mocked me and gave me no funds. [sad] How is this dwarf expected to afford his ale with no funding?

[angry] Sons of goats and rams, that's what they are. [sigh] Pfft. [pause] Eh, speaking of which, I doubt you carry much coin with you, so I'll skip the funding part. [soft voice] I heard some humans talking a great deal about Balor having its own moonshine back in the day. [soft voice] Some lad named Vander used to own a farmstead, and he was said to brew a mean drink. [hesitant] I doubt the man lives, but perhaps you'll find some of his brew by his old home?
quest_41813_quest_progress: [hesitant] Hope it's worth the trouble, eh?
quest_41813_quest_complete: [excited] Magni's beard, an entire crate of it! [warm] So lucky this stuff doesn't go bad easily. [warm] Here you go, have some yourself.
quest_41814_quest_detail:
[solemn] I promised the Explorers' League a prize whenever I left Ironforge, mostly because they wounded my pride! [soft voice] I dug here and there, but there wasn't much to find on this side of the island, and I'm not strong enough to take on an entire army of orcs just to fulfill my ambition. [sad] As much as it pains me, I might have to return empty-handed.

[hesitant] Unless... How about we make a trade? An heirloom for an heirloom. You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, that sort of thing. [warm] I have this artifact I dug up on another expedition that I'm willing to trade, if you return with something from the Duke's castle. I'm man enough to admit my knowledge of Balor is quite limited, but the late Duke must have had something valuable. [solemn] A sword, a shield, a crown—whatever you may find, bring it back to me, and we'll make the trade.
quest_41814_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you come up with something?
quest_41814_quest_complete: [solemn] While in poor condition, it is still the crown of a duke. [angry] This will prove those rascals in the Halls of Explorers wrong! [warm] Thank you, <race>. [proud] Here is what I promised.
quest_41816_quest_detail:
Thunder. Roaring thunder. The clouds tremble each time the sky cracks, and so does my body. How I wish I were atop a mighty beast above the clouds, roaring for all to hear! Living up to the name of my clan—Thunderlord—a name soon forgotten by this world. Few share my melancholic heart; it is why I follow him, that grumpy old orc.

Mourning the past serves nothing. The Horde is who we are now. I wish only to pass on the spirit of the hunt, the heart and mind of those who came before, so that they—and I—may live forever.

And you, you are the candle I lit with my fire. One day, from your flame, another will be born.

Find your way to the main island, through the ruined port of Breezhaven. Past the mine and orchard, turn right to find Sorrowmere Lake. Paint yourself with crocolisk blood and return with five of their tails. It has been long since I tasted their meat.

Be bold, be careful—and by all means, be thrilled by the hunt.
quest_41816_quest_progress: [commanding] Go out there and prove to yourself that you are the predator, not the prey.
quest_41816_quest_complete: [commanding] I smell blood in the air. [soft voice] You wear it like a second skin now. [warm] Good. [urgent] Bring those tails here—we will feast on them.
quest_41817_quest_detail:
[solemn] A warm feeling, is it not? [solemn] A successful attempt, one whose bounty you shared with another, bound to you by mutual respect for the hunt.

[solemn] This moment we share now, I have shared countless times with my people back home. [solemn] No day would pass without us returning with prey, feasting on our spoils, and telling stories of our hunts.

[solemn] It is a good life we had—we have. [sad] Though even then, many were lost; a simple negligence can cost you your life.

[commanding] Fear is your rival, my friend. [commanding] You must control it, or it will gain reign over you. [commanding] Do not concern yourself with competing against others—compete against your fear. [urgent] One second is enough for you to perish.

[urgent] With that in mind, you must return to Sorrowmere Lake and follow the long bridges to the Scurrying Thicket. [urgent] Your next hunt awaits. [urgent] Slay the Mistbark Spiders, and see how you fare against an enemy of many legs and a poisonous bite.

[solemn] As you walk there, remember what I told you: it is not truly them you are fighting, but your fear.
quest_41817_quest_progress: [solemn] Life is a battle, a battle against the aspects of your being that you cannot fully control.
quest_41817_quest_complete: [solemn] Your fear did not win today. [soft voice] Your eyes have changed, they look calmer now.
quest_41818_quest_detail:
[solemn] A far more challenging hunt, but many more await. [emphasis] A lesson you must learn is that no creature is born equal. [commanding] Those who say otherwise lack vision or common sense.

[urgent] On your journeys, you will face many trials. [soft voice] Azeroth is vast and cruel; you must be ready for anything.

[solemn] Inequality also marks our uniqueness. [gentle] Do not see the word "unequal" and sink into dark thoughts. [warm] Look beyond, understand that while the world may not bow to you, being yourself is enough. [confident] You will find a way, your way, and you will be unique.

[proud] You have faced your fear, and that was the first step to finding your own path.

[commanding] Now, return to the main island. [emphasis] Where the road splits at the orchard, take a left and pass through the ruined castle walls. Beyond the church and crypt, find the other entrance. [urgent] Go past it, and past the cave. [commanding] In the loose hills beyond, you will find buzzards and vultures. [angry] Face them, and learn to battle a flying enemy.
quest_41818_quest_complete: [solemn] I am proud of the hunter you have become. [warm] Choose something of mine to carry as a memento of your success.
quest_41819_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have never taken a liking to the taste of fish—mostly because it was such a frequent meal on the Darkspear Isles. [soft voice] Yet, ever since we were forced to leave our home, it is not the taste but the memories it brings that trouble me. [sad] The foul Sea Witch, her naga, and their mindless murloc minions cost our people dearly. [solemn] Though I cling not to the past, I cannot help but feel a burning desire to see these filthy creatures slain.

[proud] I foresee a great future for our tribe within the Horde, much like my father and grandfather before me. [proud voice] I proudly bear its flag, yet my thoughts betray me on this day. [commanding] So, I task you, one who will help shape the future of the Horde alongside me, to slay the Muckgills on your path to eliminate the shadowy leader who hides among them.

[urgent] Climb down the hill and in that cave you will find them guarding the entrance for whatever plot the Sea Herald may have.
quest_41819_quest_progress: [low voice] Slithering snakes, self acclaimed rulers of the seas and oceans—-a pain to deal with.
quest_41819_quest_complete: [solemn] The irony of this scroll is lost on me.
quest_41820_quest_detail:
My duty is to remain here and see the Shadow Council brought to an end. Yet, I cannot help but reflect on what this truly means. For the Sea Witch to resurface after such a long time, it is haunting. You must understand, my people have lost a great deal because of her. Though I may be repeating myself, it is because I seek your empathy.

I am unable to leave this place. Though my feet ache to move, I cannot bear the thought of leaving Kilrogg and our allies to face this alone. I am but a single troll, true, but I have grown fond of the old chieftain, to be fair. He is gruesome, yet wise. Passionate and explosive, there is much I can learn from him. One day, I will take the mantle of Darkspear chieftain, and with it comes great responsibility.

This orc has endured many hardships, and his shoulders are heavy still. I will give him the chance to nurture the next generation of the Horde through me. And so, I ask you to deliver this scroll to my father, in Grommash Hold.
quest_41821_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Whispers come and go; the spirits are ever restless here. [solemn] But even with all this chatter, there are a few voices I cannot silence.

[angry] The enemy is foul, vile, and beyond any salvation for what they have done. [emphasis] I hear it—so loud and clear—I can hear it.

[emphasis] An abomination, born of cruel intent, of a soulless wretch. [sad] I cannot stand it anymore.

[commanding] You must find your way into that castle and put it down. [solemn] I cannot describe it in words—you must see it for yourself. [emphasis] It's haunting. [urgent] You must slay it, slay it to set them free—those poor, young souls.

[threatening] Leave no Stormreaver alive; they must suffer the wrath of the living world so the ones beyond may rest.

[urgent] Go now. [urgent] Just go. [hesitant] You will know it when you see it...
quest_41821_quest_complete: [solemn] I will light a torch and perform a ritual to guide their souls to the afterlife. [warm] Thank you for setting them free.
quest_41822_quest_detail:
Made by the hands of men, the only light still visible across Balor is kept prisoner just under our noses. [solemn] A lighthouse—a strange form of artificial light. [soft voice] The world is vast beyond the villages of my tribe, and the Earthmother holds many children—but some, she was forced to adopt.

[sad] The Horde is no stranger to them either, and as much as I would like to say otherwise, I do not think I will ever look upon them with true empathy. [low voice] A specter of respect? Pity, perhaps. [pause] Nevertheless, I am straying from the purpose of our conversation.

[commanding] Under the gaze of that lighthouse, you will find many so-called Mystics, though you may seek them elsewhere if you wish.

[urgent] I task you with slaying as many as you can. [angry] The empty shells of fel corruption, and their rotting flesh will serve as nourishment in time, allowing nature to take its course once more.
quest_41822_quest_progress: [solemn] In time, An'she will return to these lands.
quest_41822_quest_complete: [solemn] A mercy far too great for scum like them. [warm] Take these; they will carry the light of An'she with you through grim lands.
quest_41823_quest_detail:
[solemn] Among the ruined battlefield, a cave can be found—an old mine, perhaps. [soft voice] It is there that I have sensed an unnatural disturbance.

[solemn] Something once immobile has risen on its own feet to live. [solemn] Much like the undead scattered across this ruined land, these creatures are mindless and will attack any on sight.

[commanding] I task you to go there, find them, and slay some. [urgent] I will need samples, so be sure to bring something sharp. [soft voice] With those samples, I can study what made them rise.

[solemn] I should tell you beforehand—this will not aid our efforts to remove the Stormreaver—but I will have a reward ready for you.

[commanding] Do not make me wait.
quest_41823_quest_progress: [soft voice] This task can wait, but I would rather you fulfill it as quickly as possible.
quest_41823_quest_complete: [warm] You have my thanks—and with them, a reward.
quest_41824_quest_detail:
[solemn] These samples have a dark feeling to them. [hesitant] I don't know if you can tell, but it seems they have been infused with some sort of magic—magic that brought them into a state of life.

[soft voice] From what I can tell, they resemble the boggling creatures of Kalimdor, yet are far more twisted. [pause] I have yet to attempt cleansing them, though truth be told, this is just dead tissue at this point.

[solemn] I believe these living fungi originate from a common source. [urgent] To speak plainly, there should be a larger one that infected the rest. [emphasis] I say this not simply on a whim, but because I feel something from the isle—around the area of the ruined castle—rather, under it.

[solemn] I believe the source of contamination comes from there. [commanding] If you can find your way beneath the castle, you might uncover the answers we seek.

[warm] Return anything you deem important to me.
quest_41824_quest_progress: [solemn] The Earthmother will guide you to the answer.
quest_41824_quest_complete: [excited] You have brought me its core? [warm] Well done. [solemn] I will attempt to purify it now.
quest_41825_quest_detail:
Purifying this core is well beyond my abilities. [sad] As much as I hate to admit it, there is no way I can do this alone.

[soft voice] It is with a heavy heart that I part with this core; I wished for nothing more than to research it and uncover what caused it to become alive. [solemn] Nevertheless, this is knowledge that must be passed on.

[pause] There is someone who will surely know how to handle the core—our Matron. [urgent] You will find her in Thunder Bluff, at the Elder Rise.

[soft voice] Pay no mind to Cor and Grom; I will give you my mark, and you will be able to walk freely past them.

[commanding] Do not speak too much before the Matron. She has a short fuse, and—believe it or not—I have grown fond of you.
quest_41825_quest_complete:
[solemn] Uda'pe was right to send you to me. [soft voice] Though we are not very fond of working with the Horde, you have my thanks and will be paid accordingly.

[warm] I will even add a bonus for being so silent and respectful—Uda'pe taught you well.
quest_41826_quest_detail:
A fistful of ash. That is what I always believed my fate to be. [solemn] Yet fate had other plans. Instead of falling to the fire I once commanded, I succumbed to the cold embrace of the Twisting Nether. [sad] A fitting end for one who abandoned his ancestors and embraced the Burning Legion.

[low voice] Still, I curse my fate. I followed my chieftain—my elder, Ner'zhul. Where the elements once spoke, I listened. But I betrayed them. [angry] Demonic whispers filled the void, and I welcomed them. [whispering] I was stronger than ever. I do not fully regret my path; I still wield the power granted by our former masters.

[cold] What I seek now is vengeance, upon all who claim to follow Gul'dan. [threatening] My soul, trapped in a shard, was denied death. [solemn] And now I stand in the rotting flesh of a woman foolish enough to challenge the Horde. [sigh] There is no rest for the wicked, but not all retain their sense of self. [soft voice] Travel to the Ruins of Breezehaven, and lay to rest those that remain.
quest_41826_quest_progress: [solemn] None are deserving of such a cruel fate.
quest_41826_quest_complete: [solemn] Mindless undead. Some are nothing more than flesh waiting to be cut down; others, the lingering essences of those who were—forever trapped. [soft voice] You have fulfilled your task.
quest_41827_quest_detail:
I was never one for irony. [solemn] Yet I cannot help but see it in this scenario. [pause] In the end, only fools seem to be smiled upon by luck—so I suppose. [low voice] When Gul'dan never returned from the Tomb of Sargeras, everyone agreed that he, and those who followed him on that fool's errand, had lost their lives.

[sad] Yet one survived, and he is here. [urgent] Stranded on a turtle's back, returned from the Broken Isles. [hesitant] I don't yet know if he's here to aid the scum hiding on this isle, or if his purpose mirrors ours. [soft voice] What I do know is this: having him on our side—or at the very least, getting some information out of him—will be worth our time.

[commanding] Beyond the small island of the lighthouse, swim ahead and you'll find his hut. [urgent] Just get out of this cave and go straight. But beware the murlocs haunting the waters. [threatening] And when you see him... [pause] spit in his face for me. [mocking tone] Or don't. Your call.
quest_41827_quest_progress: [low voice] Awful day for a swim.
quest_41827_quest_complete: [solemn] Mok'gun's fate was sealed by Gul'dan. He was not the first nor the last. [pause] Rest easy, stranger. This old wanderer has no quarrel with you or your kin. [soft voice] I am Drak'thul, once a powerful warlock of the Stormreaver Clan. [low voice] Now I am here to make sure I am the last of my kind.
quest_41828_quest_detail:
[solemn] Years ago, when our people first set foot in this world, we believed ourselves invincible. [solemn] Before the First War truly began, joined by that filthy two-headed mongrel Cho'gall, we brought ruin to the human lands. [solemn] Our armies marched to the gates of Stormwind City, and victory was within reach. [solemn] We were clearly the superior warriors.

[angry] Arrogance, young one. [solemn] The greatest enemy of those who deem themselves strong. [solemn] From the gates, mounted warriors struck like lightning. [solemn] Backed by magic, these knights forced this proud chieftain to retreat with his tail between his legs. [solemn] Humility—a trait every warrior ready to die in battle must carry. [solemn] Always assume your enemy is stronger. [solemn] Always believe that, if you survive, you will be stronger than before.

[solemn] Do not underestimate humanity. [urgent] Leave this camp without caution, and you may find a dagger in your back. [solemn] They skulk in the shadows, closer than is comfortable. [solemn] They may not be our main focus but find and slay them.
quest_41828_quest_complete: [solemn] Stand proud child of the Horde. [proud] Victory is honorably achieved by those with strength and thunder in their blood.
quest_41829_quest_detail:
[solemn] In their eternal mockery, these foolish warlocks have named one of their abilities after my missing eye. [angry] There is no way I can accept this insult with a straight face. [shouting] It is a disgrace—to my name, to all that I am!

[threatening] Were I not stuck here under this wretched tent by whatever mischievous power compels me to trust you instead of exacting my own justice, I would march out myself and collect the eyes of those blasted, fel-hungry oafs.

[commanding] But as I am denied that right, you will do it in my stead. [urgent] Venture back to the island of Balor and slay the Stormreaver Warlocks. [emphasis] Bring me no fewer than thirty of their eyes! [mocking tone] They say if you believe in “an eye for an eye,” the world will one day go blind. [cold] The Stormreavers won't need their sight any longer—not once you're done with them.
quest_41829_quest_progress: [solemn] I am prepared to set them aflame.
quest_41829_quest_complete: [commanding] Good. Now I shall burn these wretched eyes, so the last thing their souls gaze upon is the fiery pits of the afterlife they deserve.
quest_41830_quest_detail:
[solemn] I bid you welcome to the legacy of crime of that which you call home—shelter, family. [threatening] Witness the havoc brought by the hands of the slaving Horde. [solemn] This is what would have remained of all Azeroth, were we not rid of our demonic masters. [emphasis] Take it in. [commanding] And then focus—we are not here to conquer, nor to save. [cold] We are here to assume responsibility.

[threatening] As always, the cursed mongrels of the Shadow Council do not fail to make their sort as detestable as one could be. [urgent] Were it not enough that their numbers plague this war-scarred land, they have gone above and beyond to raise both flesh and soul beyond the veil of death.

[solemn] In what was Breezehaven, you will find a mine. [commanding] Dispatch the numbers of bones and rotting flesh that stand between you and their pitiful masters. [urgent] Find these so-called necromancers and stain your blade with their fel-ridden blood. [threatening] I owe a personal debt to the scum that dared call themselves Stormreaver. [mocking tone] What even is a storm in the face of a hollow that will swallow all there is?
quest_41830_quest_progress: [commanding] We owe apologies to none. [solemn] It is not guilt that brought us here—but honor.
quest_41830_quest_complete: [low voice] I see the color of blood and smell the stench of death on you. [commanding] Well done. [commanding] Now, onto other matters.
quest_41831_quest_detail:
[solemn] Since I have regained my freedom, I have come to think about many things. [pause] Many questions have riddled my mind into labyrinths I have struggled to overcome. [solemn] It was for that reason alone I chose to step aside for some time. [sad] However, I did not expect to be so easily forgotten. [low voice] Mere thoughts. [pause] In my short-lived hermit life, I was once or twice challenged to duel the notion of evilness. [soft voice] Are we born evil—or do we become so later on, due to circumstances? [solemn] The conclusion I came to was quite simple: we all bear a seed of evil at the root of our own being, but it is by choice whether it grows or not.

[solemn] Which brings us to your next task. [commanding] If you believe my words earlier to be nothing but a bore, hear me now. [threatening] Havoc is what they know, so havoc is what you will give. [urgent] Go beyond Breezehaven, push closer to the castle—your targets await. [cold] You are not a killer—you are the consequence of their actions, coming to take its due.
quest_41831_quest_progress: [solemn] How thin the line between arrogance and confidence can be.
quest_41831_quest_complete: [solemn] Today, you have been the consequence of others. [pause] One day, your own will find you.
quest_41832_quest_detail:
[commanding] Are you one to care for insects, soldier? [solemn] I have taken a keen interest in ants. [soft voice] You see, while they differ in species, hierarchy, and even customs, were you to open your mind to see them so—there is only one truth. [emphasis] The moment the queen dies, three things can happen: the colony falls apart, slowly dying without new workers; it has more than one queen, so they still survive; or it raises a new queen to ensure the colony endures.

[commanding] Just like ants, the Stormreaver Clan numbers many. [urgent] Your efforts, while not in vain, have barely dealt any damage to their true strength. [commanding] So, to ensure the goal of our mission, you must go once again and clear us a path—this time, closer to their nest. [urgent] Travel to the Ruins of Stromwrought Castle. [shouting] Do not hold back. [shouting] Go as far as you can. [threatening] In that everlasting battlefield, you will be the boot that stomps over the colony.

[urgent] Adventure not alone—seek aid from your brothers and sisters.
quest_41832_quest_progress: [solemn] The queens of the colony are close. [commanding] Keep a level head and push forward.
quest_41832_quest_complete: [commanding] You know victory like no other—I'm half a mind to challenge you myself.
quest_41833_quest_detail:
If you have yet to seek Drak'thul, now is the time. [solemn] Drak'thul holds the key to storm the castle, and your next task is to put it all to rest. [soft voice] An old acquaintance has paid me a visit. Though we do not see eye to eye on many things, there is one hatred we share—the hatred for a despicable being who stood beside Gul'dan during the forming of this clan.

[angry] Though the coward is not here himself, he has sent his most treasured pupil to oversee the new uprising. [commanding] While he is your main target, do not shy away from slaying all you lay eyes upon—Dagar and Oronok especially. [urgent] Steel yourself; I have no clue what they have in store for you.

[low voice] While my hatred for them burns like the lowest pits of Blackrock Mountain, I know better—I know they are capable, though despicable. [proud] But I believe you are even more capable. [warm] Reach out to your allies once more, and see it done. [hesitant] I do wonder... will the sun return to this island once I see you return? [solemn] After all, it can't rain all the time.
quest_41833_quest_progress: [solemn] Ashes to ashes, dust to dust and scum to scum.
quest_41833_quest_complete: [soft voice] Well, what do you know... [warm] a ray of sunshine breaks through.
quest_41834_quest_detail:
[solemn] When I was sent to this island, I believed the Warchief—like most—saw only an old orc, ready to die. [low voice] He ordered me to serve as a commander, not a warrior. [hesitant] Were it not for Eitrigg's counsel and Saurfang's mocking words, I doubt I would have played my part. [solemn] But I trusted my friends, and they trusted the Warchief.

[solemn] A Frostwolf heart beats in his chest. [solemn] He is wise beyond his years, much like Drek'thar and Orgrim. [solemn] It seems he was right about me. [solemn] Though I longed to fight at your side, to stain this island red with my axe, I have learned something else.

[solemn] I am the last chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow, elder of the Horde, and with these hands, I will guide the next generation. [urgent] Go now, with victory in your heart, to Grommash Hold. [solemn] Present our triumph to the Warchief, and tell him I will soon return. [sad] Perhaps I will visit Hellscream's memorial when I do.
quest_41835_quest_detail:
[solemn] While they already occupy most of the island, it seems they have not truly bathed in their own arrogance. [angry] As if expecting both Alliance and Horde to come, a great number of demons have been summoned. [low voice] I can feel their echoing presence from this far. Whether it is for protection or invasion, I know not.

[pause] Nor does it truly matter, since you will thwart their plans. [urgent] You can find these demons in a cave near the south west end of the island. [emphasis] Just past the ruined battlefields west of Stormwrought castle. [commanding] While the imps may not prove a real challenge, you will have to deal with felhunters and succubi.

[mocking tone] I do wonder—will you succumb to the fire of an imp, the gluttony of the felhunter, or perhaps the lust of the succubi? [solemn] I truly hope not, for your role here has yet to end. [gentle] I will offer you a healthstone—not that I don’t trust you, but it is best to have the means to heal when the unexpected strikes, is it not?
quest_41835_quest_progress: [solemn] Legion or not, do what must be done.
quest_41835_quest_complete: [solemn] A step closer to the true goal.
quest_41836_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am sure you are eager to take the battle to the castle at any cost as soon as possible. But for you to do so we must first find the key to open it. Inside the same cave I have sent you to hunt the demons summoned by the Stormreaver Clan you will also find one that has claimed leadership over the rest. [soft voice] She calls herself Lady Harelyss.

This demon holds a great importance, simply because–if my own minions speak the truth, she holds an item that will secure us the key to the castle. While I cannot have you return her here, since you would have to drag her through a battlefield, I will give you a soulshard–the minute you deal the final blow, you will capture her soul in it, simply by having it on you.

[urgent] Make sure to retrieve the item we are indeed looking for, her demise is inevitable and capturing her soul is simply our insurance in case we need to gather more information.
quest_41836_quest_progress: [whispering] I wonder what sort of dark, twisted artefact she holds that can provide her ownership of a copy of the key.
quest_41836_quest_complete: <Drak'thul cracks the box open.> [shocked] What is this...?
quest_41837_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Stormreaver Clan was not composed solely of orcs from the Shadow Council, but also included the ogre magi who served under Cho'Gall. [low voice] While a questionable ally, Gul'dan kept that two-headed buffoon as close as he could. [hesitant] I do wonder if the reason was that he knew they would one day betray each other in their lust for power.

[sad] Alas, one failed while the other lives—hiding beneath the sands, behind the cloak of a cult that worships myths and legends as old as this world. [commanding] I have taken the liberty of making the succubi share their plans with me. [urgent] To the west, past the cave where you defeated her, you will find the Windrock Cliffs. [solemn] It is there that a member of the Twilight's Hammer holds a fragment of the key. [angry] Slay him and return with whatever you find.
quest_41837_quest_progress: [solemn] The lockbox merely contained the first fragment.
quest_41837_quest_complete: [solemn] Both fragments together will now serve as the key to enter the ruins of the castle. Beware, for you will face both servants of the Legion and cultists of those long forgotten.
quest_41838_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, you! You seem like a tough fella, and a tough fella is just what we need. Down south near the mountains of Thistleshrub Valley, we started with our newest big money making plan, the Slickwick Oil Rig. Everything went smooth for a while, until the pump stations went crazy and the oil started to move on its own! I’ve trotted throughout the entire desert back to Gadgetzan to get some help for our problem, and you look like just the <class> we need! Don’t worry, we’ll pay you a fat sum of glorious gold! Once you reach the southern mountains, near the big cacti you’ll find a slope up the mountain range. The oil rig is not far from there. Talk to Assistant Steamflare, she’ll know I sent you.

Oh, and could you clean up some of the oil on your way there? Will be worth the effort, trust me!
quest_41840_quest_progress: <Judith is still sobbing.> [whispering] Oh, Sara, my darling angel… [soft voice] By the Light, please let my Timothy be safe…!
quest_41840_quest_complete: [shocked] What…? [shocked] What is this? [shocked] Where did you…?! [angry] No, no, no! [sobbing] Timothy! [sobbing] My little Timmy, no! [sad] Oh, Light, why have you forsaken me?! [soft voice] He was just a boy, my sweet, innocent boy! <Judith is breaking down. Hysteric crying and yelling is all she can do right now. You did what you could. Atleast she has certainty now.>
quest_41842_quest_detail:
[soft voice] If you’re entering Stormwrought Castle, I have one humble request for you. [solemn] The Balor family amassed countless books and tomes over the many years they held authority over the island. [soft voice] Following decades of trade, they collected a sheer unimaginable amount of knowledge in their library. [emphasis] One of them, the personal teachings and lectures on the hidden practices of trade by Sir Walton Balor, younger brother of the second Duke of Balor, is a book both I and Stormwind are very much interested in.

[urgent] Should you come across the vast library of Stormwrought Castle, search it for said book. And <name>: Beware of the dangers inside. [threatening] I dare not think about the terrors that await you within those vile halls.
quest_41842_quest_progress: [solemn] Stormwind always envied the Balorians on perfecting the art of successful trade not only with them, but several other nations as well. [soft voice] It’d be a shame if that knowledge would be lost in time, no?
quest_41842_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, more dusty than my grandmother back in Ironforge. [solemn] Time has not been kind to this old tome, and the humid air is not exactly helping either. [low voice] I will seal it properly in my chest and begin analysis back in the SI:7 headquarters. [warm] For you, <name>, my heartfelt gratitude. [excited] Please choose a reward fitting for your service.
quest_41843_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the time to infiltrate Stormwrought Castle has finally come. [commanding] This den of devils will demand every last bit of your focus and skill for you to come back in one piece. [urgent] I won’t mince my words, but you’re surely aware of it yourself already, no? The others and I will secure the perimeter on the castle courtyard to prevent reinforcements halting your operations.

Operative Gillian has ordered you to dispatch the head of the hydra, which is undoubtedly the most crucial task of all. [urgent] Still, to ensure no resurgence occurs by surviving figureheads, we need to make sure to snuff them out as well. [angry] Liquidate any tough guy you come across. [threatening] We don’t want to deal with that scum again.
quest_41843_quest_progress: [soft voice] I am sure you will run into more than enough fitting candidates for my task there.
quest_41843_quest_complete: [solemn] Most impressive. [soft voice] It’s a shame you're not cut out for this field of work. [sad] Don’t get me wrong, you possess the skills and wits necessary, but I know your adventurous spirit cannot be tamed and seeks the grandeur of Azeroth. [warm] Still, the SI:7 owes you much, so let me reward you appropriately for all you’ve done.
quest_41844_quest_detail:
[urgent] When we crashlanded here on this island, we noticed that most of our cargo had dropped into the wide expanses of the ocean. While we still have a good chunk of it secured, it’s not nearly enough to satisfy our recipients in Booty Bay. Yunie and the others have their hands full repairing the zeppelin and making sure we don’t actually get eaten by monstrous crustaceans. I on the other hand had the golden opportunity to scout the island when we were looking for Verix a while back. And wouldn’t you know it: there is a giant castle atop the cliffs. You can probably guess what I am hinting at. While I am not as crazy and suicidal as Verix, I would be remiss to pass up this opportunity to grab some valuables no goblin has ever seen before.

[excited] Which is where you come in. Grab some friends or pay someone if you don’t have any and grab as many valuables as you can get from within that castle on the other side of Balor. It will pay off, trust me!
quest_41844_quest_progress: [urgent] You’re tough - or foolish - enough to come to this cursed place on your own, so I’m sure you’ll have no problems going in there and coming back out unharmed - mostly, atleast.
quest_41844_quest_complete: [excited] Wow, what a haul. Might not be exactly what we were supposed to be delivering, but I doubt those greedy bastards in their pirate cove will complain that much. [warm] Thank you so much, <name>. We owe you big time. You can have this for your troubles, it always gave me the best of luck - the fact I’m still here is proof of that.
quest_41845_quest_detail:
[solemn] Aberrations skulk these halls. Monsters born from malice and demons from the depth of depravity call this once resplendent place their home. [soft voice] I still remember it vividly, Balor - how it used to be. Bustling with life and commerce. None of it remains, except the spirits of those still clinging on. [sad] The cruelty inflicted upon us decades ago tethers us to our former home, preventing us from moving on. [solemn] Good <class>, will you be the one to break our shackles?

[solemn] Deep within the castle, beyond the stockades, the orc’s demonic allies conduct vile experiments. [threatening] One of their overseers, a vile demoness with wings and hooves, holds a fragment of my soul, keeping me frozen in time. [urgent] Slay her and retrieve it. [hesitant] Then perhaps…
quest_41845_quest_progress: [sad] She is a sadistic creature, torturing souls for her own enjoyment. [solemn] Her retribution cannot come sooner.
quest_41845_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah… The weight that leaves my very being dissipates as we speak. [solemn] Being whole once more, passing into the afterlife may not be just a desperate plea anymore. <class>, my sincerest thank you. [warm] Had it been not for you, I and many others would have been anchored in the world of the living still. [soft voice] My heart rests more easily now, thanks to you. [warm] Please, accept one of my remaining physical possessions as a just reward for you.
quest_41846_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Wildhammer kin of Dun Kithas are in dire need of aid. The Dragonmaw Clan grows bolder by the day, and Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand fears they'll strike at any moment!

[urgent] While we ready our forces for a proper defense, it falls upon us to call upon adventurers such as yourself to lend a hand. Ye've been chosen to assist Magistrate Hurdam and the folk of Dun Kithas in this critical hour.

To reach Grim Reaches, travel through the High Pass—a mountain tunnel near the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. Stay sharp, for the Dragonmaw are no trifling threat. Once you reach Dun Kithas, report to Magistrate Hurdam without delay. [warm] May the mountain's strength guide ye!
quest_41846_quest_progress: [excited] A newcomer in Dun Kithas! [warm] Welcome, welcome.
quest_41846_quest_complete: [warm] Ah, welcome to Dun Kithas, <name>! [soft voice] Truly, it lifts me heart to see new faces in our midst. [solemn] Dark days are looming over us, no doubt, and every pair of hands shall be vital in the trials ahead.
quest_41847_quest_detail:
[solemn] There was a time, long ago, when we stood united with the noble Wildhammer Dwarves, an alliance forged in mutual respect and necessity. In our time of greatest need, they did not falter. Aerie Peak opened its gates to hundreds of refugees, and their stalwart mountaineers shielded countless caravans from the dangers of the wilds. Their actions, noble and selfless, are a debt we will carry for eternity, though no amount of gratitude could ever repay them.

[sad] So it is with a heavy heart that I hear of the plight facing the settlement of Dun Kithas, nestled within the distant and perilous Grim Reaches. In their time of danger, we cannot remain idle. [urgent] I have already dispatched a detachment of our finest rangers to aid them, but I trust they will accept any additional hands with the warmth of their legendary hospitality.

When you arrive in Dun Kithas, seek out Ranger Swiftstride. She has been entrusted with a most delicate task, one your skills may be called upon to assist. [commanding] Go with haste, for every moment counts.
quest_41847_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Lord Theron has sent you, has he?

<Ranger Faellina peers intently at you>

If he deems you worthy of this task, then I suppose I need not question his judgment. [solemn] Very well. [emphasis] Pay close attention, for what I am about to reveal must not be taken lightly. [solemn] This is no mere errand, and the weight of it should not fall upon ears that do not understand its gravity.
quest_41848_quest_detail:
[solemn] You must have seen them — the Withered — when you walked the paths of Alah'thalas. [sad] Wretched beings... their thirst for the arcane has consumed their minds, leaving only husks behind.

[soft voice] A tragedy, truly. [pause] And what wounds the spirit most is knowing their numbers grow with each passing dawn. [solemn] The Withering, once begun, cannot be undone — only delayed. [hesitant] But even that demands a torrent of mana, a price many deem too high for those already lost to the hunger...

[soft voice] Yet, Lord Theron holds hope. [solemn] He believes that these very lands may hold the key to a cure. [soft voice] A slender hope, but hope nonetheless.

[pause] Still, all in due course. [soft voice] For now, I have a task for you. [urgent] Word travels of an ancient, destroyed passage to Grim Batol, somewhere westward, buried among the hills. [urgent] Should the tales speak true and you uncover this forgotten way... [emphasis] return to me with haste.
quest_41848_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary. [soft voice] These lands are teeming with Dragonmaw orcs.
quest_41848_quest_complete: [soft voice] So... the tales whispered by the dwarves of Dun Kithas held truth after all. [solemn] Curious. One must wonder just how many hidden, long-forgotten passages into Grim Batol yet remain buried beneath stone and time... and what vile things may have once crept forth from their shadows.
quest_41849_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now then... There is an old legend that speaks of a dwarven jewelcrafter who once dwelled in this very part of Grim Batol. His craft was unmatched — the gems he forged, said to shimmer with the brilliance of starlight itself.

But more than mere beauty... it is said he could shape crystals capable of storing mana — not only that, but crystals that could be replenished, again and again, without fracturing. [solemn] A rare and wondrous feat, if ever there was one.

You see where this leads, I trust? Should we recover even a single such gem, our arcanists might unravel the secret of its making. The burden of crafting mana crystals could be lifted... and with that, perhaps, we could better tend to the Withered.

[urgent] If you would brave the ruins and seek any trace of these enchanted stones — a fragment, a clue, or best of all, a crystal still whole — it would be a boon to our people beyond measure.
quest_41849_quest_progress: [solemn] Is there truly no hope left for our kin?
quest_41849_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You've found it... By the Sunwell, I can scarcely believe it.

<Ranger Feallina lifts the crystal, tilting it toward the light. The sun dances across its flawless facets, refracting a cascade of colors.>

[solemn] This... this is no mere gem. It is a masterpiece — a testament to craftsmanship long thought lost.

[warm] You have our deepest thanks, <class>. [urgent] We will move swiftly now — the rangers and I shall descend upon the site and recover as many of these crystals as we can... before reporting back to Lord Theron.

[proud] You have rendered a great service to the Quel'dorei this day, my friend. [gentle] May the light of the stars guide your path always.
quest_41850_quest_detail:
Just beyond these hills to the east lie the Sal'Galaz Mines. [solemn] Aye, they've been worked by the stout folk of Dun Kithas for decades – that is, until the troggs came. [sad] The miners, curse their greed, likely broke into some old, dark tunnels where those filthy creatures were lurking.

[low voice] Now, I'd not fret much over it usually – plenty of wealth beneath the ground in these parts – but there's something about those mines. [emphasis] Something rare. [solemn] Just before the troggs turned up, the miners uncovered a gemstone in the southernmost shaft. [emphasis] And not just any gemstone, mind you. [solemn] If the tales are true, this could be the Gemstone of Naraz, forged by the very Makers themselves.

[urgent] I must have it. [hesitant] But I'm no fighter, and those troggs are too much for me. [warm] Bring me that gemstone, and you'll have your reward, I swear it.
quest_41850_quest_complete:
[solemn] The Gemstone of Naraz... [pause] Wait a moment—this isn't right! [angry] Look at it—this isn't how it's meant to be! [emphasis] It's only half of it, see here? [soft voice] It's cleanly cut, right along this edge! [hesitant] You didn't tamper with it, did you?

...No, no, of course not. That cut's far too precise for anyone without the proper tools—or skill, for that matter. Hmm... [urgent] this complicates things, but don't start panicking just yet! [confident] I've an idea where the other half might be.
quest_41851_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prospector Hammertoe was sent off to the Badlands to dig up relics of the Makers. Fool's always had an eye for old treasures, and he was convinced the Gemstone of Naraz might be there. We didn't see eye to eye on it, so we went our separate ways—I took my search to the Grim Reaches instead. Turns out, we were both right in a way. The gemstone's split in two.

But that doesn't matter now. [soft voice] What does matter is I need you to head to the Badlands, to his excavation site, and find the gemstone. If they've uncovered it, well... I doubt Hammertoe will notice if it goes missing.

You bring it to me, understood? The Gemstone of Naraz must be mine—to restore it to its true form.
quest_41851_quest_progress: Hammertoe probably set up camp close to Angor Fortress. That's what I would do, at least. [solemn] The place is well known for its ancient relics.
quest_41851_quest_complete:
Hammertoe... attacked by the Dark Irons, you say? [sad] Bah, we were rivals more often than not and rarely saw eye to eye, but still, this news sits heavy on me. [hesitant] I can only hope he found a way to escape.

But there's no time to dwell on that now! [urgent] The second half of the Gemstone—just as the old texts described! [proud] You've done well, adventurer, truly well. [warm] Thank you, thank you! [excited] I'll take it to Ironforge at once. With the right hands and the right tools, it'll be restored to its full glory!
quest_41852_quest_detail:
<class>! [urgent] The Explorers' League is in dire need of your aid!

[angry] Word must've reached your ears by now—our dig site, just north of here, has been savagely attacked by those blasted Shadowforge dwarves! [shouting] The brutes ambushed us, cut down our brethren, and started digging like rabid beasts, with no respect for the archaeological process or the sacred ruins of the Earthen!

[commanding] I need you to head there, and recover any Earthen relics that might've survived their reckless plundering. [urgent] Please, time is against us—the very legacy of our kin hangs in the balance!
quest_41852_quest_progress: I beg you, adventurer! [urgent] Time is of the essence.
quest_41852_quest_complete:
[solemn] While nothing can bring back our fallen brethren, you've ensured their sacrifice wasn't for nothing. [warm] These relics you've recovered are priceless treasures of knowledge, and they'll undoubtedly deepen our understanding of the Earthen and our ancestors' legacy.

[proud] On behalf of the Explorers' League, I thank you, <class>. [warm] You've done us and our kin a great service.
quest_41853_quest_detail:
[angry] This will not stand! [angry] By my beard, I swear vengeance upon the Shadowforge and their vile lot!

[solemn] I led the Explorers' League excavation here in the Grim Reaches, a peaceful endeavor, mind you. [angry] Then, out of nowhere, those treacherous Dark Irons attacked us under cover of night! [sad] Only a handful of us escaped with our lives—most of my comrades were slaughtered where they stood!

[urgent] We must strike back! [commanding] Head northeast to my old excavation site and slay as many of those Dark Iron scum as you can. [commanding] Bring me their heads as proof. [commanding] Show them no mercy—they deserve none.

[hesitant] And listen—if by any chance you come across my personal stash there, bring it back to me. [solemn] It holds valuable notes from the excavation, notes I cannot afford to lose!
quest_41853_quest_complete: <Groldan glares at the heads you've brought him and spits on the ground.> [excited] Ha! That'll send a clear message to those Shadowforge rats! [confident] It's only a matter of time before word of this reaches their so-called leadership. [commanding] Let this be a lesson to them—think twice before crossing the dwarves of Ironforge, or pay the bloody price!
quest_41854_quest_detail: [soft voice] You find a stash filled with notes, artifacts, and various pieces of junk. [solemn] The name 'Groldan Blackforge' is written on the lock.
quest_41854_quest_complete:
[excited] Ha! Aye, that's me stash, sure as stone!

[delight] Thought I'd lost it to those thrice-cursed Dark Irons — but seems the sorry louts hadn't the wit to understand how valuable me notes really are!

<Groldan grumbles as he rummages through the pile, tossing aside old tools and scraps>

[hesitant] Now where'd I put it... [pause] Bah, always buryin' the good stuff under junk... [excited] Ah! There it is!

[warm] Here — take these potions. It's not much, but it ought to serve ye well out there. [proud] Consider it a proper thanks from Groldan Blackforge. [commanding] Just don't go wastin' it on chasin' rabbits or pokin' trolls, aye?
quest_41855_quest_detail:
[solemn] My name's Kegg Boulderboots, and I've been foreman of the Sal'Galaz mines for a good thirty years... [pause] Everything was going fine—better than fine, really. [soft voice] The mines are rich, bursting with iron and coal.

[sad] But then... then we uncovered that cursed gemstone. [urgent] From the moment we unearthed it, troggs started swarming out of crevices and tunnels like a plague. [shouting] They overran us in no time.

[solemn] By the grace of the Makers, most of the miners managed to escape, but the mine itself—it's lost! [angry] And with the Dragonmaw threat looming, the city council can't spare a single soldier to help us take it back.

[urgent] Please, <race>, I'm begging you—help me. [commanding] Slay 10 Bonesplitter Troggs and 10 Bonesplitter Bonesnappers in the quarry. [excited] It's the only chance we have to reclaim what's ours!
quest_41855_quest_progress: [solemn] I hold no grudge against the Magistrate. [soft voice] I understand that the Dragonmaw threat is more important than the mines.
quest_41855_quest_complete: [excited] By the Makers, that's splendid news! [warm] With the quarry back in our hands, we're one step closer to reclaiming the mines and restoring what's been lost!
quest_41856_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I've one more favor to ask of you, <race>.

The quarry may be clear of troggs for now, but the true source of the infestation lies deeper—in the mines themselves. [commanding] If we're to retake the place for good, you'll need to venture into the mines and deal with the threat at its heart.

Kill at least 10 Bonesplitter Skullthumpers and 10 Bonesplitter Geomancers. [hesitant] Hopefully, that'll be enough to stem the tide... for now.
quest_41856_quest_progress: [solemn] We dug too deep... too greedily. [sad] Now we're paying the price for our folly.
quest_41856_quest_complete:
[excited] Amazing work, <race>! I'll send the miners in at once. In just a few days, we'll be back to mining, and with it, Dun Kithas will see its glory restored once more.

[warm] Please, take this. It's been in my family for generations, but now... now it's time for it to taste blood again. [proud] You've earned it.
quest_41857_quest_detail:
[angry] Bah! Troggs to the east, Dragonmaw to the north, ghosts to the south, and now murlocs?! At this rate, I wouldn't be surprised if a Dark Portal opened right in my own backyard!

Regardless, those blasted murlocs gathering near Grimwater River are becoming a real problem. Their numbers are growing, and if we don't cull them soon, they'll be a danger to our fishermen.

Bring me twelve murloc scales as proof of your deed, <race>. [commanding] Let's remind those fish-folk whose waters they're trespassing in!
quest_41857_quest_progress: [low voice] Where do those murlocs even come from...
quest_41857_quest_complete: [excited] Ah! Now that's a job well done, <race>. [warm] I'll see to it that our fishermen are notified—the waters should be much safer now, thanks to your efforts.
quest_41858_quest_detail:
[solemn] By now, you've no doubt noticed that sizeable cave on the south bank of Grimwater. [soft voice] Some time ago, the Mirefin murlocs took it over, and now we can't exploit its resources because of them.

[urgent] We need to strike and drive them out of that cave once and for all. [emphasis] It's been proven that the best way to rid a place of murlocs is to cut off the head—kill their leader.

[low voice] A murloc named Gargill commands this miserable lot, but our fishermen know him by another name: the Butcher. [sad] He's slain many of our own and will slay many more if he's not stopped.

[commanding] Your task is simple, <race>—kill Gargill and 8 Miregill Murlocs and Muckdwellers. [excited] That should be enough to drive them out of the cave for good!
quest_41858_quest_progress: [soft voice] And to think that I used to love fish...
quest_41858_quest_complete: [solemn] The news of the Butcher's demise brings a certain satisfaction, I'll admit. [soft voice] Hopefully, that'll be the last we see of those murlocs. [urgent] Now, I can finally focus on what truly matters—the war with the Dragonmaw. [commanding] We've got bigger fish to fry.
quest_41860_quest_detail:
<name>, it is good to see you. [soft voice] Not long ago, a stranger was looking for your presence. [solemn] I had told them I could relay a message, after which they told me the following:

“Meet us at the archdruid's barrow den. We will await your arrival.”

[hesitant] Mysterious, but there was no malice coming from them. [gentle] I am sure you have nothing to fear.
quest_41860_quest_complete: [soft voice] Moonglade's tranquility is serene today, don't you think?
quest_41861_quest_detail:
[solemn] We see our message has reached you, <name>. [soft voice] Word of your deeds has travelled far, even to the verdant stretches of the Emerald Dream. [solemn] Your heroic service to Malorne has not gone unnoticed. [solemn] His brethren, the Wild Gods, and his dear friend Ysera owe you much for saving him from the clutches of the Nightmare. [emphasis] Once he regains his form, we will gain another powerful ally against the dark entity within the Nightmare's miasma.

[solemn] Our mother Ysera sent us to the sacred Moonglade in search of the one druid who opposed the Nightmare headfirst. [pause] To reward him for their actions in Hyjal and the Twilight Grove. [solemn] That we will do. [urgent] However, a test first. [confident] We know what you are capable of - your wit, strength and perseverance are unparalleled. [commanding] Prove to us once more the extent of your abilities and we shall grant you more power to the blessing the Waywatcher bestowed upon you.

[loud voice] We will not hold back; be prepared to face the power of the Green Dragonflight!
quest_41861_quest_progress: [solemn] Failure is no weakness, but simply a sign of growth waiting to happen.
quest_41861_quest_complete:
<Rethevus is breathing heavily. The fight has left him deeply exhausted.> Incredible! [warm] What we heard about you was not an understatement, [soft voice] your mastery over Cenarius' teachings is as clear as a star-clad sky! [solemn] Knowing a skilled individual like you to be on our side lets our heart rest easily. [warm] We made a promise to you and mother, [solemn] a promise we shall keep. [warm] Here, receive the blessing of the Green Dragonflight. [proud] You are more than worthy of it.

[soft voice] For now, we bid you farewell. [sad] Mother awaits us in the Emerald Dream, [solemn] where the war rages on still. [solemn] The day when we will see eachother in the verdant expanses cannot come sooner.
quest_41862_quest_detail:
Welcome to Dun Kithas, friend. [solemn] I'd gladly speak of our town's history and pride, but now isn't the time for stories.

[urgent] As you've likely noticed, we're in a grim situation. [angry] The Dragonmaw clan has risen again, and we're knee-deep in a conflict we're steadily losing.

[warm] Your arrival, along with what few Alliance forces made it this far, gives me a sliver of hope. Perhaps there's still a chance we'll see the sun rise over these mountains again.

[commanding] My most trusted commander, Mountaineer Steelwind, is holding position at East Ridge Outpost, north of Baggoth's Wall. [urgent] He's leading the effort against the Dragonmaw and could use every capable hand we can spare. [urgent] Head there at once and report in.
quest_41862_quest_complete:
[solemn] Another Alliance adventurer, is it?

[soft voice] Good to know Ironforge hasn't abandoned us completely—though I'd have preferred reinforcements before things reached this sorry state.

[sigh] Ah, don't mind the grumbling. I'm just an old dwarf with too many battles behind him and not enough warriors at his side.

[urgent] We've got work to do and Dragonmaw to send back to the dirt. [commanding] Let's not waste time.
quest_41863_quest_detail:
[solemn] They're everywhere.

On the roads, in our old fortresses, in the caves, and scattered throughout the hills. [angry] Every caravan needs a dozen mountaineers just to reach its destination—and even then, the Dragonmaw strike more often than not.

[sad] This is a disgrace to Baggoth's memory... and a stain on my own honor.

[urgent] We've endured enough. It's time the Dragonmaw learned that the dwarves of the Grim Reaches will not tolerate this humiliation any longer.

[commanding] We strike back. We ambush them. We show them who truly rules these mountains.

[urgent] Slay as many as you can, and bring me twenty of their sigils as proof. [proud] Let them know what it means to cross a Wildhammer.
quest_41863_quest_progress: [urgent] I've sent a sizeable patrol to investigate what's left of Stolgaz Keep... [sad] but I haven't heard a word since.
quest_41863_quest_complete:
[excited] Ha! That will make them think twice before showing their ugly faces again.

[proud] This many Dragonmaw lying dead in the dirt should remind them to fear the Wildhammer Clan. [warm] With their numbers thinned, our caravans from Dun Kithas might finally get some breathing room.

[proud] Well done.
quest_41864_quest_detail:
[solemn] There's one thing I can't abide — leaving behind the banner of a true dwarven hero.

[sad] When the Dragonmaw overran Baggoth Rampart, we were forced to retreat faster than I'd care to admit. [emphasis] In the chaos, our standard — the personal banner of Commander Baggoth himself — was left behind atop the central tower.

[solemn] It's more than just a piece of cloth. [solemn] That banner stood through a dozen battles and carries the pride of every dwarf who served beneath it. [angry] Letting it remain in orcish hands is an insult we can't stomach.

[commanding] Climb the rampart, fight your way through the Dragonmaw scum, and retrieve that banner. [proud] Bring it back in one piece. [emphasis] For Baggoth. [emphasis] For the Reaches.
quest_41864_quest_progress: [solemn] I'll not rest easy until that banner is back where it belongs.
quest_41864_quest_complete:
[warm] You've done us proud, lad.

[solemn] To see this banner again… aye, it stirs the heart. [solemn] The orcs defiled our walls, but they couldn't claim our spirit.

[proud] With this flying once more above Dun Kithas, our people will remember who we are — and what we're fighting for.

[warm] Well done.
quest_41865_quest_detail:
[confident] You've proven yourself more than capable, and now it's time we strike a real blow.

To the north lies Stolgaz Keep — or what's left of it. [solemn] It was once a proud outpost, built stone by stone by the hands of dwarves who knew the meaning of endurance.

[angry] Now it's nothing but a shattered ruin, crawling with Dragonmaw filth. But don't let its current state fool you — the keep still holds strategic value. [urgent] We take it back, and we've got a foothold to push further into the hills.

[commanding] I need you to lead the charge. Get in there and cut them down. Slay twelve Dragonmaw Invaders, ten Renegades, and ten of those blasted Flamebinders.

And one more thing — their leader, a brute called Grathok Flamehand, commands the warband from the keep's inner sanctum. [cold] That orc's responsible for the destruction of the barracks and the burning of our supply stores.

[solemn] End him. For the fallen. For Stolgaz.
quest_41865_quest_progress: [solemn] Stolgaz Keep was named after my grandfather. [angry] I'll not see it left to rot under orc boots.
quest_41865_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! [warm] That's a fine day's work — [proud] the screams of dying Dragonmaw are music to these old ears.

[solemn] With their numbers thinned and the keep cleared, we can send a proper unit to reclaim and rebuild. [warm] You've done more for the Grim Reaches than most ever will.

[proud] Stolgaz Keep will fly the Wildhammer banner again, and it's thanks to you.
quest_41866_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Redbrand family holds sway across much of Khaz Modan—my father, Nazgrim, intends to make sure people are reminded of that.

[soft voice] He wants us to help out the folk here in Dun Kithas, lend a hand to the war effort and all that. [hesitant] Only trouble is... I'm not exactly the fighting type.

Still, it wouldn't hurt if word got around that I, Garlin Redbrand, made a real contribution to the cause.

[urgent] North of here lies Geth'kar, a Dragonmaw fortress that's become a serious thorn in the Wildhammer's side. More importantly, it's their main supply depot. [commanding] If you could sneak in and steal some of their supply crates—say, eight of them—it'd do real damage to their war effort.

And, well... [soft voice] let's just say it'd look good for the Redbrand name, too.
quest_41866_quest_progress: Be careful—Geth'kar is heavily fortified. [urgent] I'm not joking!
quest_41866_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done, <class>! With these crates in our hands, the Dragonmaw will be scrambling to keep their forces fed and armed.

[proud] And no one can say Garlin Redbrand didn't do his part, eh? [chuckling] …Even if I did it through you.
quest_41867_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ever since my team and I set foot in the Grim Reaches, I've had this nagging feeling in the pit of my stomach. [hesitant] There's something wrong with this place—something unnatural. [soft voice] The land itself feels... sick. The trees, the beasts, even the wind—it's all touched by a strange corruption.

[urgent] Worse yet, I've seen it take shape. [low voice] These oozes—shadowy, vile things—are crawling out of the hills like infection from a wound. [solemn] Wherever they go, they spread that same rot to the land around them.

[commanding] I need to understand what we're dealing with here. [hesitant] If you come across any of those oozes, would you mind… collecting some samples for me? [soft voice] Just, uh, try not to get any on yourself. [warm] I'll make it worth your while.
