quest_41867_quest_progress: Be careful out there. The oozes might not look like much, but they're not the only twisted things lurking in the dark.
quest_41867_quest_complete:
[angry] Urgh, that smell could knock out an ogre!

<Dorthas winces and carefully takes the leaking samples from you>

[sad] Exactly as disgusting as I imagined... but unfortunately, also exactly what I needed.

<He peers closer, his expression shifting from curiosity to concern>

Hmm. I was afraid of this. The corruption's deeper and more complex than I thought. [urgent] We're not just dealing with sick wildlife—something bigger is behind all this.
quest_41868_quest_detail:
[solemn] We didn't just throw our tents down wherever the wind took us. [solemn] There's a reason we're here.

Right behind us is an old cave—more like a tunnel, really. And where does it lead? Grim Batol. Or what's left of it. [soft voice] Don't panic, though—the main city is blocked off. The deeper halls collapsed ages ago. What we can reach is just some forgotten outpost, part of the outer ruins.

[pause] We tried poking around, but didn't get far. Wraiths drove us back—Wildhammer spirits, probably fallen during the Battle for Grim Batol. [hesitant] Only… something's off about them. They're not just restless. They're tainted, like those oozes you found.

[urgent] I need more proof. If you're willing to head down there, put those spirits to rest and bring me back anything you find—samples, cursed residue, anything—I think we'll finally be able to piece together what's going on here.
quest_41868_quest_progress: [hesitant] Wish I could go with you, but... well, I learned the hard way I'm better with books than blades.
quest_41868_quest_complete:
<Dorthas squints at the samples, turning them over in his hands. His expression darkens.> Just as I feared… [solemn] this isn't some random corruption. [solemn] This is the Shadow Curse—the same blight Modgud unleashed on Grim Batol during the war.

[solemn] And it's still active. [solemn] Even after all these years, the curse is seeping out, spreading past the ruins. [solemn] Stone can't hold it back. [solemn] Time hasn't weakened it. [solemn] If no one acts… this whole region could fall. [solemn] This is beyond anything we can handle alone. [urgent] I'll send word to the mages in Dalaran. [solemn] They need to know what's happening. [solemn] As for us… [hesitant] all we can do now is keep watch—and pray.
quest_41869_quest_detail:
Bah! [angry] May the Twisting Nether take the magistrate and their damn excuses!

[low voice] All they care about are the bloody Dragonmaw orcs, while those Grimscale beasts run wild and tear through travelers like straw dolls.

[sad] They stood by while my only boy was torn apart out there. [pause] My son. [emphasis] Dead—because they sat on their hands.

[sad] I can't bring him back... [solemn] but I sure as stone can stop this from happenin' to another dwarf's kin.

[commanding] Go out into those hills. [urgent] Hunt down eight of those Grimscale Raptors and their screechin' cousins. [shouting] Cut 'em down, every last one. [commanding] Then come back to me, and we'll see if there's still some justice left in this world.
quest_41869_quest_progress: [solemn] My lad's blood cries out for justice. [commanding] Don't come back until you've made those beasts pay.
quest_41869_quest_complete:
[excited] Ha! Now that's what I'm talkin' about! [proud] You did more with your blade than the whole damn magistrate's done in years of flappin' their gums.

[warm] You gave those monsters what they deserved, and maybe—just maybe—we can walk these roads again without fear.

[soft voice] Thank you, friend. [sad] My son would've been proud.
quest_41870_quest_detail:
So... you cut down the little ones. Good. But that was just the start. Just the bloody surface.

The real nest—where they get big, strong, and deadly—is up north of Lake Kithas. [solemn] A blasted plateau up there, crawling with the worst of 'em. [angry] Grimscale Thrashers. Vicious, clever, fast as lightning. That's where they breed. That's where the heart of this filth festers.

[threatening] The magistrate calls it a natural cycle. Bah! There's nothing natural about watching your boy scream as beasts tear him to pieces while you're too far to do a damn thing!

[sad] If you wipe enough of them out, maybe—just maybe—the mountain patrol will get their heads out of their arses and finish the job.

[commanding] Slaughter them. Do it for me. Do it for my lad. Do it so no other dwarf has to bury their own flesh and blood.

[sad] I'd ride with you if I could, but these old bones can barely swing a tankard, let alone a blade.
quest_41870_quest_complete:
<Harfig listens closely as you recount the battle. His weathered face softens for the first time. A faint, tired smile creases the edges of his mouth.> [solemn] Aye… that's the news I've been needing to hear. [warm] You gave 'em hell, didn't you? [pause] I can feel it in my chest—like a weight's been lifted, if only a little.

[sad] I'll never hold my son again… never hear his laugh echo through the halls…

But thanks to you, some other parent might.
quest_41871_quest_detail:
[commanding] Aye, a new face in Dun Kithas!

[warm] Welcome to our mountainhome. It may not be as grand as Grim Batol, but don't let the modest stone fool you—we dwarves here are as sturdy and proud as the mountains themselves.

[solemn] Still... things haven't been easy of late. The Dragonmaw orcs have returned in full force, and while our warriors are as strong as any to swing a hammer, we're sorely outnumbered.

[urgent] Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand is leading our efforts. He's ordered any able-bodied adventurer—such as yourself—to report directly to him. You'll find him in the Magistrate's Hall, just up the path behind me. Big stone building, hard to miss. He's usually on the bottom floor, in the Council Hall.

[commanding] Go on then, lad. Dun Kithas could use another strong arm.
quest_41871_quest_complete:
[commanding] Ah, good—another strong back and keen blade.

[urgent] I hope your travels were light and that you enjoy your stay in Dun Kithas, though there'll be little rest here, I fear. [urgent] There's work to be done, and no time to waste.
quest_41872_quest_detail:
Baggoth's Wall stands! But let me tell ye, it ain't standin' on full bellies…

[sad] This war with the Dragonmaw dogs has been hard on our folk. The countryside's crawling with threats, and our farmers—gods bless 'em—are holed up in Dun Kithas, their fields left fallow.

We've been gnawin' on roots, berries, and tough old legumes for months! And let me tell ye—[groan] this is no diet for a proper dwarf. I need a solid boar flank, roasted slow in beer, with thick-cut bread and butter to soak up the drippin's…

[inhale] Ahem! But more than cravings, it's morale. [solemn] My lads on this wall fight day and night, and they haven't seen meat in weeks. We can't leave our posts, but you… you look like you've got strong legs and a good aim.

[commanding] Go into the hills and bring back fresh Stonehide Boar Flanks. The wall and Dun Kithas both will thank ye for it.
quest_41872_quest_progress: [soft voice] I would do anything for a proper feast.
quest_41872_quest_complete:
<Mountaineer Lightboots leans in and sniffs the meat with an almost reverent sigh.> [excited] By the stones! That smell… it's glorious!

[urgent] Now where's that blasted cookpot? We'll boil some, roast the rest… or maybe dry it to keep for later… Ah, the possibilities!

[warm] Ye've done more than fill a belly, <race>. [proud] You've helped lift the spirits of a whole outpost. And believe me, that's worth more than any blade.
quest_41873_quest_detail:
<The journal is bound in worn, cracked leather. Most of its contents chronicle the mundane routines of a hardworking dwarven farmer—weather reports, planting cycles, notes about livestock. Yet, toward the final pages, the handwriting begins to shake, the lines become erratic… the words darker.> [sad] She tells me to stay here, yes. [sad] She tells me to stay.

[solemn] Magistrate... they want to take her from me.

[defiant] I won't leave, no. [confident] I will keep her safe. [sad] Yes. [whispering] I hear voices. [shocked] Oh, I hear them.

[urgent] They tell me to stay. [solemn] I must. [solemn] I will.
quest_41873_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it? [soft voice] You found it at Brangar's old farmstead?
quest_41873_quest_complete:
<Historian Sternhand reads the journal in silence, flipping the final pages with furrowed brows. He exhales slowly, then closes the book with a firm thump.> [soft voice] Hmm. I suspected something went wrong out there... but not this.

[solemn] Brangar was once a proud dwarf. A good farmer. It's a tragedy what happened—whatever did happen.

<He gives you a long look.>

For the sake of his legacy, I'll... omit these final entries from the official records. Some things are best left forgotten.

[pause] Thank you for bringing this to me, <race>. [warm] You've done a service to our history, even if it's a grim one.
quest_41874_quest_detail:
[solemn] Stolgaz Keep… now there's a name that stirs the embers of old pride and fresh grief.

[soft voice] Once a proud bastion of the Wildhammer, the Keep held a critical position in the defense of the Grim Reaches. [sad] But that was before the Dragonmaw Orcs overran it. [pause] It has stood in enemy hands for years now—bastardized, defiled, but still standing.

[sad] What truly pains me isn't just the loss of the fortress… it's what was inside. [solemn] The Keep housed some of our most precious historical records. [soft voice] Lineages, royal decrees, journals of heroes long gone—entire volumes chronicling the rise of our people.

[hesitant] Now, I doubt the Dragonmaw have the wit or care to destroy books. [hesitant] They likely don't even realize what they've taken. [urgent] If you manage to reach the inner halls of Stolgaz, keep your eyes open. [warm] Any volume you retrieve could restore a piece of our history.

[warm] You do that, and I'll make sure you're well compensated.
quest_41874_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you make it to Stolgaz? [soft voice] Any sign of the archives?
quest_41874_quest_complete:
<Sorgan's eyes widen as he takes the worn tomes into his hands, brushing centuries of dust from the covers.> By the Makers… [solemn] I never thought I'd see this again. [soft voice] This one—Baggoth's Testament! It's a first-hand account of the siege of Firewatch Ridge! [excited] Incredible! [warm] You've done more than fetch books, <race>. [proud] You've helped restore the soul of our people. [pause] I'll be poring over these for days.

Who knows what secrets of the past we'll rediscover?
quest_41875_quest_detail:
[solemn] Baggoth's Wall has stood through more Dragonmaw assaults than I care to count. But stone doesn't mend itself, and after years of siege and neglect… she's beginning to give.

Cracks run along the battlements, mortar has crumbled, and I've seen a goblin cannonball punch straight through one of the parapets. [urgent] And to make things worse, stone shipments from the south are delayed—as always.

[solemn] But the Reaches have always been built on bones of the past. Ruins of old dwarven strongholds and watchposts lie scattered across the region, their bricks still strong beneath moss and mud. With some work, they'll serve just fine to patch the wall.

Find any sturdy bricks or carved stones you can. Old ruins, abandoned outposts, even collapsed keeps—gather whatever can be repurposed. [proud] Every stone you bring helps keep Dragonmaw blades out of Dun Kithas.
quest_41875_quest_progress: [solemn] There's rubble and ruin aplenty out there. [commanding] We just need to be smart enough to use it.
quest_41875_quest_complete:
<Mountaineer Lightboots taps one of the bricks, nodding in approval.> [solemn] Solid stone… good heft to it. These will hold, once the masons get their hands on ‘em.

[warm] Well done, <race>. You've helped hold the line—for now. [solemn] May the wall stand a little longer thanks to your effort.
quest_41876_quest_detail:
[solemn] Welcome to Slatebeard's Forge—where the sparks fly, the hammers sing, and the steel holds the line.

[warm] We've been outfitting mountaineers here for generations. [soft voice] Armor, axes, crossbow bolts—every piece forged with pride. [sad] But lately… pride won't keep the forge hot. [urgent] The war effort demands more than we can handle, and we're nearly out of iron.

[pause] Normally I'd send my son down to Dun Kithas to fetch an update on the next ore shipment. [low voice] But I've barely had time to breathe, and he's hammering like a madman as it is.

[gentle] Would you do us a kindness? [commanding] Head to Dun Kithas and ask Magistrate Toughhand when we can expect more ore from the Sal'Galaz mines. [urgent] If it doesn't come soon, we'll be pounding steel with spoons…
quest_41876_quest_progress: [commanding] You've come from Slatebeard's Forge, have you? [sad] I feared this moment would come.
quest_41876_quest_complete:
<Magistrate Toughhand strokes his beard and sighs.> [solemn] I'm afraid there's no easy answer. [urgent] Sal'Galaz mines are overrun with troggs—filthy pests—and the miners have been driven out.

[sad] Without ore, the forge falls silent. And without the forge… well, let's just say our mountaineers might be going into battle with rusted blades.

[urgent] We'll have to find a solution. [emphasis] Fast.
quest_41877_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even if we manage to reclaim the Sal'Galaz mines—which, mind you, I am working on—it'll take weeks for our miners to clear the tunnels, restore the scaffolds, and resume regular ore shipments.

[urgent] And we don't have weeks. Every moment lost is another sword unsharpened and another shield left unrepaired.

[commanding] It's time I called in an old favor.

[soft voice] There's a dwarf back in Ironforge—Lord Nazgrim Redbrand. [warm] A powerful name, I know. But he owes me, and more importantly, he commands the ear of the Miners' Guild.

[urgent] Travel to Ironforge and speak with Nazgrim. [commanding] Tell him I sent you, and explain our situation. [confident] If he helps us, the forge might burn bright again before the week is out.
quest_41877_quest_progress: [low voice] What business brings you from Dun Kithas?
quest_41877_quest_complete:
<Nazgrim folds his arms and listens intently. After a moment, a smile breaks through his stern expression.> [solemn] Hurdam Toughhand… I haven't heard that name in some time. A stubborn mule of a dwarf—but a loyal one. I owe him more than just words.

And besides, the folk of Dun Kithas have held the line longer than any of us expected. If not for their grit, the Dragonmaw would be knocking on Ironforge's gates by now.

[pause] Yes. I'll send word to the guild. [warm] You'll have your ore.
quest_41878_quest_detail:
[commanding] The ore will come.

I'll have my men in the Ironforge Miners' Guild reroute a few shipments starting today. Might slow down some other projects, but Dun Kithas needs it more. [solemn] Hurdam was right to act quickly.

Now go—return to him and tell him that Ironforge stands with Dun Kithas. [proud] And let him know this makes us even.
quest_41878_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you speak to Nazgrim? [soft voice] Please tell me he agreed.
quest_41878_quest_complete:
<Magistrate Hurdam exhales deeply, shoulders relaxing for the first time in days.> [solemn] So he agreed… By the Light, that's a relief. [warm] This will buy us the time we need.

[confident] I'll have couriers ready to receive the first shipment. [proud] Slatebeard's Forge will run hot again, and our defenders will have the steel they need.

[warm] You've done more than you know, friend. [proud] Dun Kithas is in your debt.
quest_41879_quest_detail:
[soft voice] My father is one of the finest smiths in all of Grim Reaches, and everyone knows it. [hesitant] I've been trying to earn his respect for years, but no matter what I do, it never seems to measure up to what Margella makes. [sad] She's just… better.

But I've been working on something special—something that might finally change that. [proud] A mace, a true masterwork of mine. [pause] It's not finished yet, though. It needs something rare, something powerful that will set it apart from every other weapon on the wall.

[solemn] I've heard that deep below the Stormwrought Ruins on Balor, there are glowing red crystals—Stormwrought Crystals. [whispering] They're said to carry incredible power, and if I could set one into the mace's head, it might finally prove that I'm a worthy smith too.

[urgent] If you're headed to Balor, could you bring one back for me?
quest_41879_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found the crystal yet?
quest_41879_quest_complete:
[excited] The crystal!

<Grukson turns it over in his hands, clearly impressed.>

It's just how I imagined it—absolutely perfect. [warm] This will make the mace something truly special.

[proud] I'd better get to work, then. [soft voice] Maybe this time… my father will finally see what I'm capable of.
quest_41880_quest_detail:
[solemn] The time has come for us to strike at the heart of the Dragonmaw presence in the Grim Reaches.

[urgent] Zarm'geth Stronghold lies in the northern wilds — a fortress carved from stone and iron, bristling with traps, walls, and orcs of the deadliest kind. [commanding] Elite warriors, battle-hardened champions, and no doubt their cruel leader command from there.

[solemn] This will not be a fight for one man alone. [urgent] You'll need comrades at your side if you hope to break their lines and claim victory.

[commanding] Your target is clear: kill ten Dragonmaw Elite and ten Dragonmaw Champions. [solemn] Slaying so many of their elite warriors will no doubt break their spirit.

[solemn] Bring them down, and you strike a blow that will echo through the mountains.
quest_41880_quest_progress: [solemn] Zarm'geth is no place for lone wolves. [commanding] Rally your allies and show those orcs the fury of the Alliance!
quest_41880_quest_complete:
[excited] By the ancestors' beards, you've done what many thought impossible.

[proud] With so many of their officers dead, the Dragonmaw war machine in the Grim Reaches will sputter and die.

[warm] Celebrate this victory, but stay sharp — the war isn't over, not yet.

[solemn] Well done, friend. The mountain remembers.
quest_41881_quest_detail:
[low voice] Now, we've got meat in our bellies… but meat alone doesn't hold a line. [soft voice] What we really need is bread—long-lasting, filling, proper dwarven food.

[hesitant] There might be a solution, but it's a risky one…

Far to the northeast lies Brangar's Farmstead. [solemn] Well—what's left of it. [solemn] Folks call it Brangar's Folly now. [solemn] Brangar was once the richest farmer in all the Grim Reaches, owner of endless golden fields.

[solemn] When the Dragonmaw came, he refused to leave. [solemn] Said he'd die before giving up his land. [solemn] And so he did.

[soft voice] Some say he went mad in those final days… [whispering] others whisper he was hiding something darker. [soft voice] I don't put much stock in tales—but one thing's for sure: [emphasis] no one's claimed the grain in his granaries. [urgent] And if any of it's still good, we'll put it to use before the rot or worse takes it.

[commanding] Head out there and see what you can find. [commanding] Ten crates of grain should be enough to get a proper stockpile going.
quest_41881_quest_progress:
[whispering] Be careful out there…

Scouts say [solemn] Brangar's Folly is home to darker things now than orcs.
quest_41881_quest_complete:
<Mountaineer Lightboots pries open one of the crates, sifting the grain between his fingers.> [soft voice] Hmm… aye, I've seen fresher grain in my days… but this isn't bad. [low voice] Mold's only hit a few sacks. With a little work, most of it's usable.

<He pauses, glancing around, voice dropping to a low whisper.>

Still… you saw what that place has become, didn't you?

[solemn] Good job, <race>. It's better we have this grain than whatever was lurking there. [commanding] But if I were you… I wouldn't speak too loudly of what you saw. [whispering] Some truths are better left buried.
quest_41882_quest_detail:
[solemn] After all the blood spilled and steel swung, there's but one thing left to do—bring word of our hard-won victories to the Magistrate in Dun Kithas.

[warm] I can think of no finer <race> to carry this honor than you, friend. [proud] It's by your hand and the strength of your kin that we struck the Dragonmaw down and protected the Grim Reaches—for now, at least.
quest_41882_quest_progress: [low voice] Have you been any assistance to Steelwind?
quest_41882_quest_complete:
<Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand listens intently, clearly impressed> [solemn] By the forge and stone, you've done more than I dared hope for! [warm] The folk of Dun Kithas and the Grim Reaches owe you a great debt. Take this reward as a token of our thanks.

[urgent] But don't let your guard down yet—there's still Dragonmaw scum skulking in the hills, and we dwarves know better than to trust the peace of a mountain too soon. [commanding] Stay sharp, and keep your axe ready.
quest_41883_quest_detail:
[solemn] A worn letter is discovered upon Zuluhed's Corpse. [soft voice] It appears to be addressed to him, and written in a coarse handwriting which reads: <So you have finally returned? How long has it been since you disappeared to chase after your artifact while the rest of us fought tooth and nail for our survival? You abandoned the Dragonmaw Clan for your own foolish glory, and now, because you have returned, you expect all the chieftains to band together with no remorse or animosity?

Do not expect me to be as foolish as the others Zuluhed. You may hide in the underbelly of Grim Batol all you desire. I will lead our clan to a glorious, and great victory here on the soil of Grim Reaches, not cowering in caverns like Rend and his ilk. There are some of us that know the truth of the Blackrock, and do not desire to hide facts behind notions of a glorious 'Dark Horde'... Your order is declined, old friend.

Korlag Doomsong, Dragonmaw Clan.>
quest_41883_quest_progress: [solemn] What is it that you bring?
quest_41883_quest_complete: <Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand inspects the letter with a careful gaze...> [solemn] It would appear that the Dragonmaw Clan is not as united as we once believed. This news is relieving to hear.
quest_41884_quest_detail:
[solemn] This letter confirms some of the rumors that have been circulating, the Dragonmaw Clan was not fully united.

[urgent] Now that Zuluhed has been slain there is only one that stands in contention for chieftain, Commander Korlag Doomsong. [solemn] We dwarves have been at odds with the Dragonmaw for longer than we can remember, and now it is time to strike the final blow. [commanding] Gather what allies you can, and travel northward into the depths of Zarm'geth Stronghold, it is there you will find Korlag Doomsong, and the last leader of the Dragonmaw. [angry] Kill him, and free us from this perpetual war!
quest_41884_quest_progress: [solemn] Preparation will be required if you desire success in the battle to come.
quest_41884_quest_complete:
<Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief> [excited] You were successful? By my beard, I cannot believe it!

[warm] Many long and hard fought battles will have been avoided thanks to your hard work. [proud] The dwarves of Dun Kithas are forever in your favor! [warm] Please, take one of these items, as a reward from all of us here.
quest_41885_quest_detail:
<The dwarf stares at the lake, mumbling to himself. He smells strongly of fish and pipe smoke.> [whispering] They're out there… waiting. [angry] Teeth like daggers, eyes like cursed pearls! [urgent] You think it's safe to fish in Lake Kithas? [angry] You'd be wrong! [shouting] Dead wrong! [groan] Those blasted razortooth crocolisks keep snapping at me lines—nearly took me hand off last week! [commanding] They ain't just fishing hazards, they're monsters, I tell ye!

[urgent] You've got a weapon, haven't ye? [commanding] Go into that cursed lake and take down a few of them. [solemn] Eight should make the rest think twice before messing with Nudrew again.

[warm] I'll make it worth your while, promise! [sad] And if I don't—well, the crocs will get me before the guilt does!
quest_41885_quest_progress: [urgent] You still alive? [hesitant] Or did the crocs drag you under too?
quest_41885_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ha! Look at ye, not even half-chewed! [warm] That's a fine bit of croc-clearing you've done, friend.

[chuckling] Maybe now I can cast a line without losing a toe. Or a whole leg. Or me sanity!

[pause] …Actually, forget that last one.
quest_41886_quest_detail:
[solemn] Listen, I don't scare easy… but there's something wrong with Grim Hollow. [soft voice] The air's thick, the trees creak even when there's no wind, and I swear the shadows move when you're not looking.

[hesitant] And the spiders—by the Stone, the spiders. [emphasis] Not your usual cave-crawlers, mind you. [commanding] These are big, and they've got a hunger in their eyes. [urgent] Greater Brown Recluses, they're called, and they're swarming the swamp trails like they own the place.

[commanding] If we don't thin their numbers, we'll be webbed up in our sleep. [commanding] You look like you've got some steel in you—go out there and take care of at least twelve of the beasts. [low voice] I'll be here… keeping an eye on the perimeter.
quest_41886_quest_progress: [urgent] Still alive? I mean—ah, back already? [hesitant] No? Then keep your eyes open, and your boots dry...
quest_41886_quest_complete:
[excited] You actually did it? [warm] Thank the ancestors. [soft voice] That should make things safer for now—though I still don't trust the quiet out here.

[warm] Appreciate your help. [warm] Not many brave enough to walk into those webs and walk back out again.
quest_41887_quest_detail:
[solemn] If you are seeking to gain knowledge of our most vital and rare elixirs then you have come to the right place. [soft voice] For your efforts upon Hyjal, I could bestow upon you the knowledge of my forebearers. [solemn] Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose is a rather potent and powerful alchemical mixture.

[emphasis] It could be used to turn the tide of a conflict in your favor.
quest_41887_quest_progress: [hesitant] So, have you made your choice?
quest_41887_quest_complete:
[solemn] I must warn you, use this recipe wisely. [soft voice] A misuse of the materials can create the exact opposite of the Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose.

[solemn] I suggest you follow this recipe closely.
quest_41888_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our scouts have reported increased movement within enemy strongholds - Lower Karazhan Halls, Zul'Gurub, and Ahn'Qiraj.

[urgent] We need proven champions to cut through these nests of corruption and return with proof of their deeds. [commanding] Bring me Crests of Heroism, earned only through triumph over these formidable enemies.
quest_41888_quest_progress: [commanding] Hold nothing back. [urgent] Return with the crests — our allies are counting on you.
quest_41888_quest_complete:
[warm] You've returned — and with the Crests of Heroism no less. [proud] Your efforts in these treacherous places haven't gone unnoticed. [solemn] With each victory, our foothold grows stronger.

[warm] The Alliance thanks you for your bravery.
quest_41889_quest_detail:
[solemn] The very earth below us trembles with rage. [soft voice] Deep within the Molten Core, ancient enemies stir once more. [urgent] New lieutenants of flame rise in Ragnaros's name, threatening to ignite another age of fire.

[commanding] We cannot allow them to strengthen his forces. Hunt them down. Bring me the proof of their destruction: a molten scale from Incindis, and the signet ring torn from the hand of the Sorcerer-Thane himself. [emphasis] Let all who serve the Firelord know: the Alliance does not burn.
quest_41889_quest_progress: [solemn] The flames are rising. [urgent] Don't return empty-handed. [threatening] Not unless you want to be turned to ash along with them.
quest_41889_quest_complete:
[solemn] These relics speak for themselves. [solemn] Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.

[proud] The Firelord will feel this blow and know the Alliance stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. [warm] Take this cache, and remain prepared. [urgent] There may be more lurking in the depths.
quest_41890_quest_detail:
[solemn] The threat beyond the gates only grows bolder. [urgent] Our scouts report increased aggression and coordination among enemy commanders within their most fortified dungeons.

[commanding] We strike now, while they remain overconfident. [urgent] Bring me the Crests of Valor taken from their fallen leaders. [commanding] Show them that the Horde does not hesitate — [loud voice] we crush those who stand against us.
quest_41890_quest_progress: [urgent] Every moment you delay, our enemies grow more daring. [commanding] Prove to me the Horde still commands fear. [commanding] Bring me the crests.
quest_41890_quest_complete:
[commanding] These crests will send a message, loud and clear. [proud] You've proven your strength once again. [urgent] We'll push further with this momentum.

[warm] Take your reward, champion. [urgent] Stay sharp. [solemn] The war does not rest - and neither do we.
quest_41891_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our scouts have reported increased movement within enemy strongholds - Lower Karazhan Halls, Zul'Gurub, and Ahn'Qiraj.

[commanding] These places seethe with dark magic and ancient threats. [urgent] We need proven champions to strike deep, cleanse the corruption, and return with trophies of conquest. [proud] Bring me Crests of Heroism, earned only through triumph over these formidable enemies.
quest_41891_quest_progress: [commanding] The Horde expects results, not excuses. [urgent] Tear through the corruption, bring me the crests, and remind our enemies why they fear us.
quest_41891_quest_complete:
[solemn] You return bearing the crests of victory. [commanding] Good. These show the enemy that their darkness cannot withstand our strength. With each blow you strike, you carve the path forward for the Horde.

[proud] Your loyalty will not be forgotten.
quest_41892_quest_detail:
[solemn] The very earth below us trembles with rage. [low voice] Deep within the Molten Core, ancient enemies stir once more. [urgent] New lieutenants of flame rise in Ragnaros's name, threatening to ignite another age of fire.

[commanding] We cannot allow them to strengthen his forces. Hunt them down. Bring me the proof of their destruction: a molten scale from Incindis, and the signet ring torn from the hand of the Sorcerer-Thane himself. [emphasis] Let all who serve the Firelord know: the Horde does not burn.
quest_41892_quest_progress: [solemn] The flames are rising. [commanding] Don't return empty-handed. [threatening] Not unless you want to be turned to ash along with them.
quest_41892_quest_complete:
[solemn] These relics speak for themselves. [commanding] Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.

[proud] The Firelord will feel this blow and know the Horde stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. [urgent] Take this cache, and remain prepared. There may be more lurking in the depths.
quest_41893_quest_progress: [low voice] What is it that you bring?
quest_41895_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The local Forest Spiders have been seen creeping around Elwynn for what seems like an eternity. Their ichor has always fetched a pretty penny and I know someone who is looking for some. You can find them all around Goldshire itself, lurking both to the south, and to the west.

[urgent] Bring me 3 Forest Ichor, and I shall reward you with a handsome price!...[emphasis] a handsome price.
quest_41895_quest_progress: [whispering] Psst! You got that ichor?...[hesitant] that ichor?
quest_41895_quest_complete: [excited] Why look at this, such potent ichor! [delight] This will surely go a long way to making a few coins. [warm] Here, take this cut...this cut.
quest_41896_quest_detail:
[solemn] I be hearing of a dark and magical corruption gripping the far away lands of the Grim Reaches on the far edges of the Eastern Kingdoms. [whispering] A murloc tribe going by the name 'Miregill' has been corrupted by the intense dark magic that has been rotting the land itself...

[hesitant] I be seeking to harness this magic, and use it as a ward to protect myself from the shadow. [urgent] Travel there, and gather from the murlocs of the corrupted swamps their fins, once they are collected, bring them to me.
quest_41896_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you returned bearing good news, or bad news?
quest_41896_quest_complete: [excited] Such magic, foul and intense! [delight] This be right what I was lookin' for. [warm] You've done well and traveled far. [warm] I offer you protection from the shadow, use it wisely and wander safely.
quest_41897_quest_detail:
[solemn] The threat beyond the gates only grows bolder. [urgent] Our scouts report intensified activity among the commanders of the enemy forces. [commanding] We must take the fight to them.

[emphasis] Strike down their leaders, recover their crests, and bring them back to me. [emphasis] Show them that we do not falter. [proud] Show them the might of the Alliance.
quest_41897_quest_progress: [urgent] We don't have the luxury of time. [solemn] Each moment those monsters draw breath, they grow stronger. [commanding] Show me you've stood against them.
quest_41897_quest_complete:
[excited] Excellent work. [proud] These crests are proof that you've broken their lines and shattered their resolve. [warm] We'll use this momentum to press further into their strongholds.

[urgent] Take this cache and be ready. [confident] We may need you again soon.
quest_41905_quest_detail:
[solemn] While most of the caravans already departed to Stormwind, and eventually to Alah'thalas, there are still many refugees who either wish to aid us here in the Farstrider Lodge or are still preparing for their journey.

[sad] I wish I could say the same about the Dark Iron that roam the surrounding mountain ranges. [angry] Their horrible actions during the High Elves' arrival in Loch Modan still continue to this day. [urgent] Just recently they raided the last convoy on its way to Ironforge, stealing valuable supplies from those needing them most. <name>, I appeal to your good heart to return what has been stolen to their rightful owners.

[commanding] The Dark Iron set up camp in the southwest, be wary of their insidious tricks. [threatening] They cannot be trusted under any circumstance.
quest_41905_quest_progress: [solemn] The Bronzebeard's hatred towards the Dark Iron is something I couldn't understand beforehand. [pause] Yet witnessing their disregard for morality and life firsthand made me realize where that disdain stems from.
quest_41905_quest_complete: [excited] You did it! I am relieved to see you safe and sound, as well. [warm] With these returned, the group may continue their journey to their new home once more.
quest_41906_quest_detail:
[solemn] They are no different than the wild beasts we hunt. [soft voice] The Dark Iron violate the peace of my people by refusing them to find a new home after everything they endured. [angry] Not only are they ambushing our caravans to Ironforge, but just recently they began abducting innocents.

[urgent] <name>, will you assist us in rescuing these poor souls? [hesitant] I dare not think about what the dwarves intend to do with them, given that even a child is among the captives. [sad] Will they be put into slave labour in the deep mines of the Blackrock Mountain, like the mountaineers tell us? [solemn] They will not survive it, should it come to pass.

[warm] Please, ensure they have their chance on a brighter future after the horrors of Menethil's crusade. [commanding] Release them from their prison, I am certain one of the Dark Iron has the key for it on him.

[urgent] They've been taken to their camp in the southwest.
quest_41906_quest_progress: [solemn] This fate was not what we promised them.
quest_41906_quest_complete:
<name>! [excited] You're here! [warm] As soon as I saw them return to the lodge, I knew you were successful, yet I still feared for your safety. [soft voice] You have my deepest gratitude. [warm] Not only did you risk your life for the innocent, but also braved dangers beyond what the usual adventurer faces.

[warm] Please, have one of these as a token of the good deeds you fulfilled this day.<name>!
quest_41907_quest_detail:
[urgent] You there, traveler!

[commanding] I must beset you for your aid. [solemn] A few weeks ago the entirety of Riverhorn Village was put to the flame and now it has been left to be pillaged, and ransacked by the fallen draenei who prowl the countryside. [sad] My fellow tribe has been scattered, and now much of the heirlooms of our people lie amongst the destruction.

[gentle] If you could seek it in your heart, recover some of the heirlooms of my tribe, and bring them to me. [urgent] You can find them to the north, amongst the ruins of Riverhorn Village.
quest_41907_quest_progress: [solemn] The legacy of my people must be maintained, even if their spirits now walk with the ancestors. [soft voice] Our history can not be lost.
quest_41907_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah yes, these trinkets have faired well, spared from the flame. [warm] I must thank you for all that you have done outsider. [soft voice] Without your help, these surely would have been destroyed. [gentle] I can only offer you a paltry reward, I just hope it is enough to convey my thanks.
quest_41927_quest_progress: [solemn] A riding whistle from Lord Blackwald? So their tyranny has ended. [soft voice] The Dark Riders were once merchants, cursed by Medivh to hunt relics for him till time’s end. [pause] It relieves me to see their leader to have been struck down; however, [urgent] we cannot be sure there are not more of them out in the world, terrorizing the innocent. [pause] For now, I can break apart this whistle, but I require additional help for that. [commanding] Bring me the essences from the undead of this world, and I may be able to crush this foul thing.
quest_41927_quest_complete: [solemn] I see you have returned. [soft voice] It is time for this chapter of Karazhan to be closed. The Dark Riders haven taken enough lives during their horrid reign; this will now end. [urgent] With the whistle destroyed, none may take Lord Blackwald’s place as their next, ultimately dispersing their presence into the winds. [commanding] Be prepared, <name>, I do not know what may happen once I shatter this effigy of malice.
quest_41936_quest_detail: [solemn] The crystal humms in an ominous rhythm. [soft voice] Peering through its flawless surface, it's as if a vortex of swirling energies reside inside the gemstone. [low voice] Icecold to the touch and surprisingly heavy, you can feel a dark and terrifying power beckoning from beyond wherever this endless void is leading. [shocked] Enthralled and shocked at the same time, you decide to bring it to a powerful warlock who might be able to help you with it.
quest_41936_quest_progress:
[soft voice] What brings you here, <race>? I see… The aura you exude paints a clear picture. You possess something extraordinary, do you not?

<You present the crystal with Daio. His eyes widen at the sight of it.>

[solemn] By the Great Beyond! Never have I laid my eyes upon such an immaculate rift crystal before. <name>, can you even fathom what you are holding in the palm of your hand? [commanding] With a rift crystal of such magnitude, who knows what powerful demon I could summon… <class>, listen closely, the blood of mighty demons is drenched in nether energy. [urgent] Bring me ten vials of their blood. The strongest fiends roaming the Tainted Scar, the Darkwhisper Gorge and the mountaintops of Hyjal are ladden with such energies. [excited] With it, we may open a rift powerful enough to lure in a demon beaming with power for the taking!
quest_41936_quest_complete: [solemn] This fragrance… Pure, unadulterated energy lies within these vials. Whatever will be brought into this world through the crystal's rift will be, without a doubt, a demon of insurmountable power. <name>, ready your allies and yourself; this will not be an easy task. [urgent] Brace yourself!
quest_41940_quest_detail:
[solemn] May the spirits be with you, friend. [soft voice] I am Grakk Windtamer, a member of the Earthen Ring. [solemn] It is our duty to ensure the elemental balance of our world is not disturbed. [pause] For that, us shamans of the Earthen Ring go on pilgrimages all across Azeroth to assess said balance. [soft voice] The spirits have led me to the plains of the Arathi Highlands, a land ripe with ancient history of the humans, but also full of primal elemental magic. [low voice] Turmoil brews beneath the surface and the guardians of the binding circles are restless. [solemn] In their vigilant guard over this prison, they have lost sight of their true nature - and ravage the sacred sites of the highlands.

[commanding] <class>, aid me in returning them to their tranquility. [urgent] Break their physical form and bring me their intact cores, so that I may soothe the raging torrents within them.
quest_41940_quest_progress: [solemn] The brute force of the elements can be overwhelming. [soft voice] Stay concentrated and focused on your spirit within, then you'll have nothing to fear.
quest_41940_quest_complete: [solemn] Great work, young one. [soft voice] My intuition proved correct - these cores harbor sinister energy within, bubbling and brewing with anger. [pause] With their essence still bound to the core, I can calm their minds and release them from their pain. [solemn] They will return to their elemental planes and, given time, awaken once more in Azeroth. [warm] With a renewed purpose and cleansed spirit. [warm voice] Take one of these gifts as compensation for your selfless act to nature. [gentle] Please, don’t hesitate.
quest_41941_quest_progress: Greetings, brave traveler. [soft voice] What brings you to these ailed lands?
quest_41941_quest_complete: [solemn] The fragrance of life courses through this earth. [soft voice] With it, an abundance of life can be fostered, perhaps even restore what was thought of to be lost forever. [warm] Bewali did well in tasking you with recovering this soil.
quest_41942_quest_detail:
[solemn] While many pilgrims returned to the Earthen Ring not long ago, I remained here. [soft voice] To further my research into the Plague of Undeath. [solemn] Far Seer Earthfury once saw potential for a cure in our Forsaken allies, so I have made it my mission to assist him in ridding them of their rotting curse. [solemn] Rayne and I already made great strides in healing the dead earth of these lands. [warm] She is a remarkable ally, and we are certain we can achieve a breakthrough in our endeavour - in many parts thanks to the soil you brought.

[pause] Before we continue, however, we are in need of two key components. [commanding] First, spore samples of the mushrooms growing in the Plaguewood. [urgent] I am certain the undead roaming the ruins carry these on their bones. [solemn] Furthermore, the sapling of a twisted tree, found in Zul'mashar. [soft voice] The troll city is nestled in the northern mountains. But beware, the resident trolls have also succumbed to the Plague of Undeath. [gentle] Please, stay cautious out there.
quest_41942_quest_progress: [solemn] Once we have the missing items, Rayne and I will have all we need to conduct our research on a more practical level.
quest_41942_quest_complete:
[solemn] Although there is no life left within these bones, the spores keep trying to search for nutrients, like a writhing parasite searching for prey. [soft voice] This is not a natural occurrence, yet it is not purely magical either. [pause] At this point it is a wholly new amalgamation of forces, and it won’t be easy to eradicate it.

[commanding] The plan we have come up with is simple in concept. [urgent] We will plant this tree sapling in the enriched earth you have brought us. Afterwards, we will apply the spores to the tree and observe what will happen. In our previous observations with saplings planted in plagued earth, they withered away in minutes, leaving a mutated husk behind. We assume the elementally enriched earth will protect the tree against the aggressors and allow it to grow freely. [solemn] It will take a while, so if you ever come by again, maybe you are lucky enough to witness it.

[warm] Either way, I must give my thanks to you, and Bewali as well. [proud] Every step taken brings us closer to healing these lands for good.
quest_41958_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here you are, as expected. [solemn] Fate is a force beyond our grasp, and if you try to deny your actions are not defined by fate, then I fear you still have much to learn, mortal.
quest_41959_quest_detail:
You aim to rid Timbermaw Hold of its darkness, I take it? [confident] Your and my interests align more than you’d think. [solemn] It is in my best interest to have it be cleansed of its corruption and I know that I can be crucial in your quest to uncover the cause of it all. [soft voice] Your furbolg friend was correct in his assumption: I do know about the Flute of Spirits. [solemn] It is an ancient relic of the Wild God Aessina herself. [solemn] The Kaldorei have entrusted Ysera’s Dragonflight with the relic at the advent of the War of the Ancients. [solemn] There it lay for countless millennia, until the traitor Insomnius stole it. [sad] He was banished for his transgression, the flute lost forever.

[urgent] If you wish to claim it, you have to find Insomnius. Luckily for you, the cunning wretch is hard to kill. [cold] He goes by the name of Insom’ni now. [angry] His delusions were an insult to our noble task of shepherding this world, yet all he strives towards is ruling it like a false deity. [commanding] You will find him on the isle north of Gilijim’s Isle.
quest_41959_quest_complete: [soft voice] Does Itharius miss me so much? [sad] I am almost moved to tears. [low voice] What has changed that the old fool willingly sents mortals to my lair? [mocking tone] Let us hope his mother doesn’t hear of this. <Insom’ni breaks out into hysterical laughter.>
quest_41960_quest_detail:
[solemn] Itharius did not lie. The instrument you seek is lost. [commanding] Do not panic, mortal. I know where you can find it, but I am not as altruistic as you had hoped for. The information shall be yours, if you are willing to serve me.

When the pathetic Hazzuli dared to question my irrefutable right to rule over them, there was one worm of a troll instrumental in their conquest against me. Self proclaimed High Speaker Jam’wahli; his words infested the minds of my minions and rallied them against me. [threatening] Now the rat has fled Lapidis Isle and hides in the temple city of Zul’Gurub, bowing before another god like the dog that he is. [cold] Bring me his tusks and I shall tell you where to find the flute.
quest_41960_quest_progress: [threatening] The fool shall bleed for his arrogance. [commanding] I want you to make sure of that.
quest_41960_quest_complete: <Laughter echoes through the cave. Like a hyena, Insom’ni cackles at the sight of Jam’wahli’s tusks in an unnatural manner.> [solemn] What goes around comes around, Jam’wahli. [threatening] You thought your life would be spared under the false protection of your Blood God, but you miscalculated. [cold] Nothing compares to my unrivaled cunning, traitor. [commanding] This is what awaits all who dare defy my absolute rule.
quest_41961_quest_detail:
[solemn] That felt invigorating. [soft voice] I am in your debt, <class>, and that debt I will repay. [soft voice] In my search for susceptible races to subdue I wandered the vast planes of this world. [solemn] One of them being the fields of the now barren wasteland Desolace. [sad] Regrettably I wasn’t being left to my own devices, as Ysera’s pests followed me whenever they picked up my scent. [cold] They were after me in hopes of retrieving the flute. [mocking tone] What a futile endeavor of theirs. [urgent] While escaping my pursuers, I placed the flute inside a magically sealed chest deep within Kaldorei ruins in the southwestern mountains, veiling it in a potent shield, masking it from unworthy eyes.

<As Insom’ni grabs your hand, his own transforms into an emerald claw. With it, he carves a verdant rune into your palm. The pain is excruciating.>

[commanding] Now go. [urgent] My patience nears its end. [urgent] With this rune, you will be able to see and open the chest and retrieve what you have fought for.
quest_41963_quest_progress:
Greetings, <name>. [solemn] I see your quest is urgent. Fangorn was an ally of our people during the War of the Ancients, his powerful magic and wisdom were key in securing victory over the highborne traitors. [soft voice] Following the Sundering, he remained dormant on the island of Kalidar until this day, influencing the world around him ever so vigilantly.

[pause] The furbolg was correct, he speaks a long forgotten language. [soft voice] One that even the druids of Moonglade barely speak anymore. [hesitant] Teaching it to you would take years, but I can help you in understanding it, even if for a little while. [commanding] From the foot of the World Tree, bring me an Acorn of Nordrassil, sap from the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale and five Elixirs of Dream Vision. [urgent] Bring me these ingredients and you may progress on your quest with my assistance. Acorn of NordrassilSap of AessinaElixir of Dream Vision(5)
quest_41963_quest_complete: [solemn] Good work. Now that everything is gathered, I can extract a blessing from the acorn that will have you understand the words of nature itself. [soft voice] Be wary, however. The spell won’t last forever, so hurry to Fangorn with a steady pace.
quest_41967_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our tribe once sought the safety of Windhorn Canyon for protection against the ravages of Kalimdor. [sad] Now that we have been expelled, we are subject to the dangers that lurk all around.

[urgent] I must ask you for assistance with the local wildlife. [commanding] If the Windhorn tribe is to survive, then we need to cull that which skulks all around. [emphasis] More specifically, the local Hyena and Cougars that prowl when the nights grow cold. [commanding] Slay them, and return when you are done.
quest_41967_quest_progress: [solemn] Our numbers have already been thinned, I must ensure that not one more of our already beleaguered kin is brought to an untimely death.
quest_41967_quest_complete: <Brolan Windhorn lets out a deep sigh of relief.> [solemn] You have saved me much turmoil, now that I know I can sleep more at peace. [warm] You have done the Windhorn a great service this day, and I offer you a token of our appreciation outsider.
quest_41968_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, I am looking for some assistance in gathering some rare materials here in Moonwhisper Coast. [soft voice] You see, someone with a name as prestigious as my own should differentiate themselves.

[solemn] The Moonshade Kodo have an alluring defect in some of their offspring, one that makes their horns tough and extremely hard. [emphasis] It is this very horn that I wish to utilize and have fashioned into armor.

[urgent] Hunt down the local kodo, I will require three Tough Moonshade Horns, gather them for me, and I will be sure you are rewarded well.
quest_41968_quest_progress: [low voice] I am not looking to waste my time, if you cannot procure the horns, I will find another who can.
quest_41968_quest_complete:
<Bulrok Cloudhoof takes his time inspecting the horns, tapping his finger upon the surface of the bone with curiosity.> [solemn] I believe this is what I am looking for, you have done well.

<The arrogant tauren lets a smirk cross his face.>

[warm] Here, take this as a token of thanks from the Cloudhoof tribe.
quest_41969_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Why hello traveler, I am Erna, and I am responsible for much of the garments of Moonhoof Retreat. [solemn] More specifically, I have been tasked to create an elaborate set of Raiments for Elder Starstrider, as his current pair are growing considerably in age.

[warm] I would like to out-do my predecessor, and make something a bit more elaborate. [urgent] I am in need of someone who can afford to leave Moonwhisper Coast in my stead, and travel to the fiery lands known as the Burning Steppes. [soft voice] I have heard tales of an exotic Ember Worg Fur from the local worgs, with deep shades of beige and red. [warm] If you are looking for work, I will require six bundles of fur, and shall pay handsomely for the travel.
quest_41969_quest_complete:
[delight] Such a marvelous material, so bright, and colorful! [warm] This will do wonders for the coming ceremonies, and will certainly be better than the last raiment.

[proud] Thank you <class>, and please, take this as a reward.
quest_41970_quest_detail:
[solemn] It has been weeks since we have heard word from Moonhoof Village, the flow of celebrators seems to have slowed to a crawl. Our worst fears may have been realized. The very plains of Moonwhisper Coast have become too dangerous even for travel.

[urgent] I need you to investigate what has happened. Three caravans were expected, and none have arrived. Please, check the road from here and to the southeast towards Moonhoof Village, find the caravans, and return to me once you have found the truth. I do also know that one caravan stopped at a nearby camp just off the road. Make sure to check there as well.
quest_41970_quest_progress: [soft voice] Do you bring news? [pause] Be it good or bad?
quest_41970_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, it is as I feared...

<Torgan the Wise takes a moment, his face filled with sorrow, and dread.>

May their spirits pass peacefully to their ancestors. [soft voice] I do hope they met a quick, and merciful end. [sad] These poor individuals were only travelling here to celebrate, and now have only found brutality.
quest_41972_quest_detail:
[solemn] The news of this tragedy must be brought to Moonhoof Village, to prevent others from finding a similar fate. [soft voice] I have prepared a letter which is enclosed with details, and have further instructions to help prepare any others who wish to attend our upcoming ceremonies.

[urgent] You must move with haste, and bring it to Brave Wildheart, one who oversee's the defenders located in the town.
quest_41972_quest_complete:
<Brave Wildheart inspects the letter, opening it, before gazing it over with a curious tone, the building rage and displeasure can be seen upon his features, all before a heavy snort could be heard.> [solemn] That road has always been dangerous, but for such violence? I will be sure to speak with Elder Moonhoof himself. [commanding] This matter will need to be investigated further, for we do not know who the real attacker is. [urgent] The Draenei have never been so overtly aggressive.

[commanding] I will be sure to have any others travelling to the refuge be under the supervision and escort of our defenders.
quest_41973_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey you, psst, bud.

<The goblin looks up to you with a squirmy expression, leaning forward in an attempt to keep the conversation discreet.>

You good at keeping secrets and doing some work for coin? If so, I could use the assist. [sigh] I aint longing for this pumpworkin' gig, all hours and no pay. My buddy said this would be liquid gold, and now I'm stuck here being antagonized by Nokrot.

[soft voice] There's a tauren up in Moonwhisper Coast in a little camp called Moonhoof Retreat, somewhere in the northern part of the region. [commanding] Go there, bring him this letter, and do what he says, easy yeah? [mocking tone] He goes by the name Gordnak, a good mercenary type, has an eyepatch, you can't miss him.
quest_41973_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something you need?
quest_41974_quest_detail:
[solemn] I came to Moonwhisper Coast in search of some profit. I have a contact who is interested in a somewhat unusual material. For what, I am not certain, and I am not one to ask.

[soft voice] The Whispering Shores to the north are filled with large beasts known as Whispering Hydra. [pause] The beasts seem to roam aimlessly, and some are known to have enchanted scales from the depths of which they came. [solemn] My employer is seeking a Glimmering Hydra Scale from one of them. [hesitant] I do not think I am strong enough to best the creatures, but [confident] if you can find this scale, I will be sure to cut you in on the profits.
quest_41974_quest_progress: [solemn] I would advise caution, the large behemoths carry immeasurable strength.
quest_41974_quest_complete: <Gordnak takes his time to inspect the scale, watching it glimmer in the light, and radiate with magical energy.> [solemn] It would appear this is what I have come for. [warm] You have done well, here, take this coin, and a reward on my behalf.
quest_41975_quest_detail: [soft voice] It is hard to admit, but without Zalwan, and your help, I would still be standing here trying to think of what to do. [solemn] All that is required is to bring Zalwan his end of the pay. [warm] That little goblin has sure earned his end, for once.
quest_41975_quest_complete:
[excited] Ahh, bout time! I knew I could count on that big lunk of a tauren! Oh, and count on you, of course!

[warm] Now all I need to do is wait a few days and kick this stinkhole, you've done me a huge solid kid. [proud] This money is going to buy me a whole new life. [soft voice] A life away from water pumps and blistering fingers. Take it easy!
quest_41976_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, explorer! [soft voice] Have you heard of the sacred canyon of the tauren, where houses are etched in rock and tunnels delve beneath the earth?

[pause] If you had told me this story a few weeks ago, I would simply have laughed at you for such tales, but now I have come to find out that this story is truth! [emphasis] A reliable source of mine has told me about a place known as Windhorn Canyon nestled in Thousand Needles. [solemn] Only recently discovered due to some battle that has taken place within. [urgent] Now, as my source tells me, it is teeming with Grimtotem.

[solemn] Regardless of whatever evil lurks there, I wish to commission your services to return some of the relics that may linger there. [warm] Do this right, and you shall be paid appropriately!
quest_41976_quest_progress: [solemn] Remember, the Canyon is located deep within Thousand Needles, [pause] you will need to travel to the far corners of Kalimdor to find it.
quest_41976_quest_complete:
[solemn] Magnificent, I was once as ignorant to think the Tauren had no history, and just wandered plains like nomads. [warm] This certainly has changed my view upon them as a whole.

[proud] You have done well adventurer, please, take this coin for doing such brave, and noble work.
quest_41977_quest_detail:
[solemn] I spent the majority of my life with the Windhorn Tribe, and came to respect and value their traditions. [sad] With the pillaging of Windhorn Canyon by the Grimtotem, I fear that the history and culture of the Windhorn may fall into obscurity.

[hesitant] When I fled Windhorn Canyon during the raid the only thing that was on my mind was survival. Now I regret not bringing any of the precious relics that dwell in the city into safety. [solemn] It will only be a matter of time until they are all destroyed, or lost to time.

[commanding] I ask of you to brave the Windhorn Canyon. [urgent] Recover any antiques that you may find inside, return them to me and you shall be rewarded.
quest_41977_quest_progress: Tread carefully, the Grimtotem have fortified Windhorn Canyon and claimed it as their own. [solemn] The large, steep cliffs provide an excellent redoubt for defence. [urgent] I advise you to bring allies if you wish to help.
quest_41977_quest_complete:
[solemn] I spent the entirety of my youth surrounded by such relics. The craftsmanship of the Windhorn is certainly superb.

Without your help, this history would have been lost to time. [warm] I thank you, for everything that you have done this day.
quest_41978_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our sacred home has been destroyed, desecrated, and now occupied by the Grimtotem and their tribe. [sad] My people were slaughtered like animals, and left to live out our lives as vagabonds with no place to call home.

The pain I have felt still burns within me, and I desire our aggressors to know my pain.

[commanding] I ask of you to travel back to Windhorn Canyon, and bring devastation, not only to the Grimtotem, but to their people. [threatening] Slaughter the villagers that now call that place home, and make our conquerors mourn as I have.
quest_41978_quest_progress: [solemn] It is only a matter of time before they feel what I have felt. [angry] They shall pay for their actions, and I shall have my revenge.
quest_41978_quest_complete:
[solemn] Blood for blood. [warm] You have done well, and repaid this evil with vengeance. [soft voice] I hope you feel the satisfaction that I feel, for I am vindicated, even if anger still burns deep in my heart.

[low voice] I must thank you for being the hand of my wrath. [warm] Please, take these coins, as tribute from me, and those lost.
quest_41979_quest_detail:
[solemn] My fears have been realized, these messages convey a rather serious intent. [solemn] Long has there been rumors of the Deathtotem, a cult-like branch of the Grimtotem who consort with dark powers for their own nefarious gain. [soft voice] These letters may be a link to finding the truth.

[urgent] I am going to prepare a missive to our High Chieftain, only he can find the bottom of this issue. [commanding] Head to Thunderbluff at once, and deliver this to him, and to him only.
quest_41980_quest_progress: [low voice] What business do you have?
quest_41981_quest_detail:
<Rahauro takes his time inspecting the letter, an expression of shock covers his features, all before he clears his throat in an attempt to hide his surprise.> [solemn] The Deathtotem? Well, we have heard a few things. [soft voice] They seem to operate in the Thousand Needles, loyal to one who calls themselves a prophet, going by the name 'Stormhoof'. [low voice] He has taken up residence within the Windhorn Canyon as far as we know, as we do not have any ties with this group.

<Rahauro nods, assuring his claim.>

[urgent] Bring this information to Cairne, may it suit our Chieftain well.
quest_41984_quest_detail:
[soft voice] People have called me lazy before, back at home. ‘You’re a bum!’ here, ‘I’ve never seen such a slouch!’ there; hefty accusations, if you ask me. And to that I say: they’re all correct. I haven’t become a master fisher out of luck or a secret hidden talent of mine. No, I was simply bored and had nothin’ better to do. So I fished. And fished. And drank. And fished and drank some more, until 30 years had passed and now you’re standin’ before me. But you know what? [excited] I think it’s time for a lil’ vacation once in a while, whaddaya think? For that I’d need some supplies, however, but as Lady Luck appears to be in my favor, you’re already here!

[warm] Here’s the deal, grab me some backup fishing rod, a new fishing pack and some booze for my lil’ trip, and I’ll toss ya this book I got from my old man, may the Light bless him. And I don’t want just any booze, only the best Darkmoon Special Reserve you can find. Got it?
quest_41984_quest_progress: [urgent] I don’t really care where you get the stuff from, just make sure they don’t break apart if I reel in the big ones!
quest_41984_quest_complete: [delight] Now that’s what I call proper equipment. [warm] Thanks a bunch, friend. [excited] Now I can enjoy some time off and do the same thing I’ve been doing the last 30 years - just at a different place.
quest_41985_quest_detail:
[urgent] Kid, I need help! [shouting] Noggenfogger is planning to throw a grand party at Steamwheedle to celebrate some breakthrough in his alchemistic research or whatever, I don’t really get it myself. What I do get is that he expects me to cook up a twelve course meal for the entirety of Gadgetzan’s populace - in four days! I may have the supplies, but my trusty oven is not made for orders that large. [hesitant] If only my cooker was ready to go…

[commanding] Okay, listen. [whispering] I gave the blueprints to a genius new invention in the cooking world to…

<Dirge leans in closer, cuppin his mouth with his hand.>

Oglethorbe Obnoticus over in Booty Bay; but don’t say that out loud! [urgent] Go over there and ask him to finish the cooker I ordered. [angry] My life depends on it!
quest_41985_quest_complete:
[excited] Look at that beauty! Sleek design, a wonderful black finish on top and most of all - it won’t explode in my face when I turn it on. [warm] Thanks a lot, <name>. Now there should be nothing standing in my way to properly prepare Noggenfogger’s banquet.

[gentle] Here, you can have a copy of the cooker’s blueprints for coming in clutch there. [delight] Thanks again, kid!
quest_41986_quest_progress:
[angry] Dirge is demanding his cooker to be finished immediately? This goblin got some nerve. [surprised] Coming to me in the first place was a surprise, but then again, gnomish engineering is simply superior to the childish attempts at creating machines these green amateurs are demonstrating. [soft voice] Dirge must have realized it himself eventually. You want to know why? Ask him why he only has three fingers left. There were others before me building his cooker for him, let’s just say that.

Regardless, if he wants it to be done, I need fuel. And I don’t mean crude things like oil or whatnot. No, I require brain fuel in the form of food! [excited] My synapses demand the delectable taste of Monster Omelet, a delicacy made from Giant Eggs. [warm] Bring me ten and I will finalize his cooker in no time. Monster Omelet(10)
quest_41986_quest_complete: [delight] Those were incredible. [warm] You really got a hand for cooking, Dirge has to watch out you’re not dethroning him too soon if those are any indication of your culinary skills. Either way, here is the finished cooker. [proud] Bring it to Dirge and tell him he can come back anytime, if his pride as a goblin allows it.
quest_41990_quest_detail:
[angry] I swear he did that on purpose! That slimy little human is nothing more than a bratty runt who knows nothing of true honor. [low voice] While I’m out here facing these… These horrible specters, he is “gathering information” in the draenei village. As if! All he does is stuff himself with whatever food they have to offer. But I’ll show him, or rather we will show him that we can do this without any issues… probably.

[soft voice] My companions and I came to these shores for many reasons, one of them seeking new sources of treasure and gold. The Moro’gai have told us that these ruins are filled with relics and other valuables. Our gold is always running short, so they could be a great source of income for us. [urgent] Will you help me?
quest_41990_quest_progress: [soft voice] I know this is disgraceful, but I just can’t help it.
quest_41990_quest_complete: [urgent] Is it done? [excited] Great, now let’s not waste any more time here. [commanding] I’ll secure the relics and meet up with Richard back in Moro’gai Village. [warm] Thank you again for your help, stranger. [soft voice] I appreciate it. [warm] Here, you can keep one of the treasures for yourself, as a token of appreciation by me.
quest_41992_quest_detail:
[solemn] Many things were lost when our people were forced out of the cradle that nurtured us and held our fondest memories. [sad] My own sight was taken in the uproar of flames, in my foolish mind, I believed myself far too strong to die that day. And by all means, I was right. [pause] Alas, greater things were lost than my sight, one thing in particular that I need returned.

[solemn] The Moonhoof are a proud people. [soft voice] Our pride has taken root in us ever since we were granted the warmth of all the celestial siblings. [solemn] We have shown gratitude and servitude, and they have showered us in grace and gift. [pause] And so… We kept three scrolls, each a separate prayer for one of the siblings. Two of them we managed to recover as we fled. The third? Lost. [hesitant] And none seem willing to reclaim it, for none dare summon the wrath of the Elder. [solemn] Yet you are not of our village, and so you are my only hope of seeing this scroll again.

[soft voice] With guided steps, walk toward Riverhorn Village, and through the ruins of what once was, find that which remains. [pause] You will find
quest_41992_quest_progress: [whispering] Speak no word of this to any villager. [hesitant] We must not incur the Elder’s attention.
quest_41992_quest_complete: [solemn] Even after being recovered, the youngest sibling was placed last. [soft voice] This is merely the outcome of one far too zealous to seek anything other than the Sun.
quest_41993_quest_detail:
[solemn] A trial is ahead of me, yet I wonder, is it simply I or the tribe that must face it? [soft voice] With empty eyes, I reach for the starry night, and I can see the Moon turning away from my voice. [hesitant] A steep ravine greets me, as I am forced to gently tap my hooves near its end. [urgent] Terrified of falling, I must keep going. [sad] Otherwise, I cannot carry this responsibility to the end.

[hesitant] I can no longer find An’she’s shine through squinted eyes. [solemn] His light is hidden by the clouds, and I keep asking myself if it is because I shy away from action, or if the Shadewalkers are somehow keeping him from me.

[threatening] They haunt An’she’s Respite. [solemn] Foul chants and the eerie feeling of dark rituals ache at my very soul. [solemn] They must seek to twist our ancestors from their rest to serve their own lust for power and hatred. [solemn] We all mourn the loss of Riverhorn, but theirs is a wrong choice. [commanding] Travel north. Walk the path of my people and guide your own way. [sad] Although it pains me, they must be slain. [solemn] Will you be the instrument of An’she’s justice?
quest_41993_quest_complete:
[solemn] Pride and hatred blinded them into cunning yet mischievous powers. [soft voice] They chose to embrace young Lo’sho’s darker side. [gentle] An appealing thing the rebellious sibling may be when the world itself seems against you.

[pause] The flow is shifting. [warm] Warmth makes my fur tingle. [proud] An’she is with us once more.
quest_41994_quest_detail:
[solemn] Among the Shadewalkers, there is one with a strong conviction, one who has lost her path, one who has broken the hearts of many. Perhaps it was simply due to her own heart being broken. [sad] Alas, motivation does not excuse actions, and hers are heinous. [angry] She intends to throw the rest of our ancestors into turmoil for petty vengeance.

[solemn] She could not understand that it is not we who must seek our own justice. [soft voice] By praying to Mu’sha and An’she, those who hurt us will, in turn, be hurt by them, our protectors. [solemn] We must not seek bloodshed with our own hands. [solemn] Nature takes its course, and all creatures will pay their due.

[pause] I am not sure you understand what I mean, but you really do not have to. [urgent] If you wish to prove your usefulness to me, you will travel to An’she’s Respite and put an end to her insanity.
quest_41994_quest_progress: [solemn] The ancestors must be allowed to rest.
quest_41994_quest_complete: [solemn] It is done then. [sad] A grim day, but it does not matter. [soft voice] An’she’s warmth will embrace me come dawn.
quest_41995_quest_detail:
[solemn] You stand tall, <name>, even when your actions are those of a mindless monster. [angry] Tell me, did you even consider questioning the tasks my father set for you? I suppose not. After all, you are nothing more than a bloodthirsty mongrel here for your own benefit. [cold] Your hands are stained with the blood of my people.

[threatening] Has the coward who still claims the role of chieftain told you whom he sent you to kill? Was he remorseful, even a little? No, I doubt he was. [commanding] So let me tell you instead. My foolish father chose the wrong target. Instead of having you slay the Fallen Ones that set Riverhorn aflame, he made you kill his oldest friend.

[angry] Begone from my face, member of the Horde. And do not return until this sin has been paid with the blood of the true villain. [urgent] Find the ruins of Riverhorn to the southwest and slay the one they call Baxdi’zha. [whispering] He yet skitters upon the tormented soil.
quest_41995_quest_progress: [angry] My words and anger are wasted on you, murderer.
quest_41995_quest_complete: [solemn] You pay blood with more bloodshed. Do not think this absolves you of your actions. But you at least had the conviction to right your wrong.
quest_41996_quest_detail:
[warm] Were the politics of the village not enough to have a simple fisher like I restless, it turns out I can no longer even have a good night’s sleep. [sad] I am not sure what guided these foul slithering creatures from the depths of the water, but they sure love making themselves known.

[solemn] There is a ruined night elven settlement not far from here. [soft voice] You should be able to see it from here, from the shore. [hesitant] It used to be called Nendis, though I suppose we still call it so, but ruined? Regardless. [pause] Too much to think about.

[angry] The song of their siren is making me restless. [solemn] Each night they sing whenever Mu’sha is shining brightest in the sky. [soft voice] It is a mournful song, as one would sing to an estranged parent. [sad] While I find some sympathy in my heart, [commanding] make it stop. [threatening] I do not care if it’s by cutting their tongues or their heads. [urgent] Do it, and I will reward you.
quest_41996_quest_progress: [low voice] My eyes are growing weary.
quest_41996_quest_complete: [solemn] So you managed to cull some of their numbers. [soft voice] Well, better than nothing. [hesitant] Worst comes to shove, I will just shove some silk in my ears..
quest_41997_quest_detail:
[solemn] Along the coast, to the northwest, close to An’she’s Respite and to the Ancestral Grounds, a few hydras have emerged from the bed of the ocean. [commanding] They are mighty, terrifying beasts that one should not hunt alone. [soft voice] Well, might not be the case for such a seasoned adventurer like yourself. [pause] Which brings me to my point.

[soft voice] I hear hydra is one of the best white meats one could ever taste. [soft voice] It is not a mystery I have a taste for fish. [gentle] And if the occasion occurs and you do end up fighting one or two, bring me back some of the meat. [warm] I will not share it with you, but I will pay for it.
quest_41997_quest_progress: [commanding] My expectations are high; do not fail me, adventurer.
quest_41997_quest_complete: [solemn] Ah, I will take this to Innkeeper Warmbreeze. [warm] He has the perfect kimchi recipe for this meat, and I bet he still keeps some of that stiff drink his night elven friends gave alongside the recipe.
quest_41998_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before I managed to make my way to the Moonhoof Village, I passed through the Moro’gai one. [soft voice] Interesting creatures, the draenei are. They were more than open to discuss formulas, basic alchemy, and herbology. [hesitant] Yet whenever I took an interest in the draenethyst crystals they had, they vehemently dismissed the idea.

[sad] It is quite concerning why they would do so. [low voice] I am beginning to believe the crystals serve more than just any possible cultural attraction, perhaps nothing as serious as religious zealotry either. [solemn] It is not unheard of for crystals to be a raw source of power. [soft voice] Seeing as they call it something similar to their own name, it surely harbors great importance.

[cold] That being said, they will not share one with us; that is absolutely certain. [commanding] Which is why I task you to bring me any Raw Draenethyst Formation. [cold] That being said, I will not return it to you.
quest_41998_quest_progress: [solemn] Before you return, I will have some of my tools ready, alongside some concoctions to test against the crystal.
quest_41998_quest_complete: [soft voice] What a beautiful blue, to be expected, I suppose. [solemn] This whole area seems to favor this color.
quest_41999_quest_detail:
[soft voice] While most of the tribe prefers to wear the leather we managed to obtain during our hunts for both rations and general goods, some of us prefer something one could call more elegant. As a family, mine has carried the name of the material we have worked with for generations. [solemn] And it is because of a lack of certain silk that can only be obtained from the moths that you and I are currently having this conversation.

South of the Moro’gai Village, you will find Moonsilk Hollow. [gentle] A strange beauty envelops the place these Moonsilk moths call home. It just so happens that the mating season has recently passed, and the newborn larvae should have reached the cocoon stage by now. [urgent] Carefully gather some of those cocoons for me; I will raise the young well and gather their silk for the tribe from now on.
quest_41999_quest_progress: [soft voice] I wonder what I should tailor first.
quest_41999_quest_complete: [soft voice] While I cannot provide you with new clothing just yet, you may choose from these I crafted from the last batch I had.
quest_42000_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Earthmother has not been kind when it came to the fate of the Highborne. Punished for the actions of their queen, the restless souls roam all around Kalimdor and Moonwhisper is no exception. In what was Maras’ethil several spirits yet remain. Bound to this place with no hope.

[sad] My heart ails for them. I cannot bear the torment of their souls any longer. While there are other tasks that require me here, I would ask you to deliver these souls from their eternal prison. They have no knowledge of their death, mere spectres that must be returned to the cycle of life and death.

[soft voice] Maras’ethil rests south of Nendis and south east of Moro’gai Village.
quest_42000_quest_progress: [soft voice] You would be doing a kind favor.
quest_42000_quest_complete: [solemn] I sense some tranquility to the south; [soft voice] your task was indeed a success.
quest_42006_quest_detail: [soft voice] Excuse me, do you have a moment? A colleague of mine from the Explorer’s League went off following a clue on an artifact he had been researching about for a long time now. [hesitant] Normally I would trust him to be reasonable, but he intends to descend Frostmane Hollow, the sanctum of the savage Frost Trolls terrorizing Dun Morogh. [urgent] Please, could you assemble a group of mercenaries and get that fool of a friend back? [commanding] You will find the entrance to Frostmane Hollow in the mountains of Dun Morogh, very close to the Ironforge Airfields.
quest_42006_quest_complete: [solemn] The icy cold of the cave has preserved Evenpike’s body and halted decomposition. [sad] You were sadly too late.
quest_42007_quest_detail: [solemn] Locked tight in the frozen grip of the dwarf’s corpse is the fragment of a pristine piece of metal, on which you can see a language unknown to you engraved into the surface.
