[soft voice] Seemingly worth his death, you bring it into your possession with the intent to let Caskbelly know about it and his friend’s demise.
quest_42007_quest_progress: <name>! You have returned. [solemn] Pray tell, where is Evenpike?
quest_42007_quest_complete:
By the Makers, he was right. [shocked] Oh, Odum, you lunatic! [sad] Betting your life on it was not worth it!

<Brohann exhales a deep sigh of exhaustion.>

[warm] <name>, my friend was searching for an old relic he presumed to be of Titan origin, the celestial beings that once visited Azeroth. [solemn] Many scholars and professors in our great city of Ironforge theorize a link between the dwarves’ creation and those god-like beings. [solemn] He assumed what you now hold in your hand could bring dwarvenkind one step closer to the truth, but it appears to not be complete. [sad] Still, Evenpike paid with his life to bring us this phenomenal find and I will honor his sacrifice with pride. [proud] Once I am done here in Stormwind, I will present it to High Explorer Magellas in the Great Library of Ironforge for further research.

[solemn] For you, I have a just reward, for both your heroism and contribution to archeology. [warm] May you fare well on your journeys, traveler.
quest_42008_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ba’la dash, malanore. [solemn] It has been brought to my attention that the deep caverns of Khaz Modan house a particular breed of snow leopards whose fur boasts a remarkable sheen of white. [gentle] My lord, Astalor of House Sunsworn, requested a one-of-a-kind mantle for his upcoming dinner party and I intend to combine said white fur with the most pristine brocade cloth I have in my possession.

[warm] Adventurer, would you be interested in a job of the lucrative kind? [soft voice] If you bring me an immaculate leopard pelt from within Frostmane Hollow, then I will reward you with a fine piece from my current collection. [commanding] Do we come to an agreement?
quest_42008_quest_progress: [urgent] Make haste, <class>. [commanding] My liege is not known for his patience.
quest_42008_quest_complete: [soft voice] The rumors were correct, rarely have I seen such a smooth and silky pelt before. [excited] I cannot wait to start working with it. [warm] As promised, a reward for you as well. [proud] I am sure you will find ample use for it.
quest_42010_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ishnu’daldieb, stranger. [soft voice] How rare to see the living strut around in Maras’ethil. Or is my mind playing tricks on me? [hesitant] Excuse me, years of isolation have dulled my sense of decency. You can refer to me as Keeper N’las, that should suffice for now. [warm] You know, meeting you on this fine day might be just the solution to my problems that I was looking for. [soft voice] You see, this is not my primary place to live. While the view is breathtaking, my ghastly neighbours are just too brash for my liking, which is why I live further up northwest, in the mountains of this coast. [sad] Sadly my only method of transportation there suddenly went silent, much to my surprise. [confident] I can repair it, but the journey would be such a hassle and judging from your attire, you’d be way more fit for the job.

[commanding] Up the mountainrange, in the icy fields of Winterspring, you’ll find the Owl Wing Thicket. [solemn] Deep beneath the snow lie vials, frozen in time. [urgent] Bring a handful of them to me.
quest_42010_quest_progress: [solemn] Who do you think is responsible for the runestone to malfunction? [soft voice] If you ask me, it must’ve been those blue rascals near the lake. [low voice] Their magic is so primitive, something had to go wrong eventually.
quest_42010_quest_complete:
[solemn] It may look like they were buried for eons, but don’t be fooled. [soft voice] The waters within have a magical property which causes them to rise upwards to the surface, so that they may embrace the moon’s light once more. [pause] With Winterspring’s heavy snow however, they never could emerge truly. [soft voice] In case you are interested further, Owl Wing Thicket was once called the Temple of Lura’valas and was a place for worship for the goddess Elune. [solemn] I may have diminished my practices of faith to her, but I still abide by her grace and judgement.

[warm] Now, now; enough chitchat from me. [confident] I will repair the runestone, and as a thanks to you, will allow you to use it to visit my humble abode whenever curiosity strikes you. [warm] Feel free, it is my way of showing gratitude.
quest_42011_quest_detail:
[solemn] Before I managed to make my way to the Moonhoof Village, I passed through the Moro’gai one. [soft voice] Interesting creatures, the draenei are. They were more than open to discuss formulas, basic alchemy, and herbology. Yet whenever I took an interest in the draenethyst crystals they had, they vehemently dismissed the idea.

[hesitant] It is quite concerning why they would do so. [low voice] I am beginning to believe the crystals serve more than just any possible cultural attraction, perhaps nothing as serious as religious zealotry either. [solemn] It is not unheard of for crystals to be a raw source of power. [soft voice] Seeing as they call it something similar to their own name, it surely harbors great importance.

That being said, they will not share one with us; that is absolutely certain. [commanding] Which is why I task you to bring me any Raw Draenethyst Formation. [cold] Naturally, I will not return it to you.
quest_42011_quest_progress: [low voice] I have yet to finish all my experiments on the draenethyst, yet I am very eager to see the other one.
quest_42011_quest_complete: [solemn] I must admit, I was wrong. [soft voice] This crystal is different, certainly not a draenethyst. [pause] The mystery carries on.
quest_42012_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even this crystal is beyond my knowledge. [sad] Frustrating, yet pure bliss. [soft voice] I have learned that I know absolutely nothing, which, in truth, is exactly why I keep doing what I am doing. [hesitant] Perhaps I make little sense. But for one such as I that finds researching items and knowledge that has been unheard of so far brings a certain joy.

[soft voice] Just as you adventure out there, I adventure inside my mind, thinking of the impossible, seeing if it is truly that impossible. [mocking tone] Listen to me blabber, acting like some eager child who is about to take his first pony ride.

[urgent] Enough sentiment. I want you to take this satchel and bring it to the Moro’gai Village, which is located south of here. [commanding] You will know it when you see it. [solemn] Although he had refused to tell me of the crystals before, I believe this gift would perhaps loosen his tongue. [urgent] So find Heghala, the Draenethyst Architect, and let him know I too am on my way to discuss what my research has bloomed.
quest_42012_quest_complete: [soft voice] Your friend is bold, perhaps even a little dense. Yet a gift is a gift; I will welcome him the next time he comes. [solemn] The crystal you took from the whelps is called a Starshard; it is the splinters of a meteor. There, mystery solved. [warm] Now, unless you have more draenethyst to offer, I will return to my duties.
quest_42013_quest_detail:
[solemn] We have travelled far to seek shelter with the Moonhoof Tribe. We have long called each other kin, but I was received coldly. The elder granted the audience of a beggar rather than an old friend. [sad] I am not pleased, yet I am in no position to argue.

He asks for payment, for favours. He demanded that my brethren and I storm the Grove of the Moon and slay the druids there. He claims they have become aloof, odd, and far too zealous due to their belief in Lo’sho. Yet his words and mimicry prove he’s the zealous one. [angry] I have not heard any man mention An’she this much.

His request is insane. We spent days arriving here from the Thousand Needles; we cannot take on an entire druid grove. [urgent] You look like a seasoned adventurer. Would you travel to the Grove of the Moon, south of here past the ruins of Riverhorn Village and behind the Shrine of Cyclones, slay those druids, and offer my tribe a chance at rest and survival?
quest_42013_quest_progress: [solemn] The price for survival is high.
quest_42013_quest_complete: [solemn] So they truly were aggressive? [pause] Odd, to say the least. [hesitant] Why would druids of all people attack first and ask questions later?
quest_42014_quest_detail:
[solemn] So the Windhorn chose a representative, rather than doing my bidding on their own. Clever, not exactly what I expected nor wanted, yet An’she whispers them worthy, for now. Since you have already taken their role and seek to be the pillar of their survival, I will give you your next task.

[urgent] A foul messenger of evil has infiltrated the barrow den of the Grove of the Moon. It is by the will of his master that he and his wretched minions have partially awoken the druids slumbering there. Now stuck in a lucid dream, they are bound to Lo’sho and the chaos he brings.

[solemn] Make no mistake, the evil, while demonic in nature, answers the call of the youngest celestial sibling. It goes to show how resentful and petty the youngest one has become of his eldest, Mu’sha, to subjugate and corrupt her place of worship. [commanding] Travel now, back to the Grove, and reach deep into the barrow den; it is there you will find the satyr Zandaxxius and the Wretched Sprites he has summoned.
quest_42014_quest_progress: [solemn] Serve them the justice of An’she.
quest_42014_quest_complete: [solemn] Good, the influence of Lo’sho is being dimmed; a task well done. [warm] Consider the Windhorn allowed to shadow my village for longer.
quest_42015_quest_detail:
[solemn] The elder refuses to allow me to venture into the Grove of the Moon, yet he sent you, or rather the Windhorn, to “deal” with it. [sad] I wonder what illusion he spoke of to you, how the druids there have gone mad due to the influence of Lo’sho. [sad] Our elder’s mind grows more wretched by the day. [sad] Many see it, many turn a blind eye.

[hesitant] It is not our right to contest his word. [solemn] He is our chieftain, and until the younger decides enough is enough, we must stay true to tradition and obey. [urgent] Yet you need not do that. [solemn] The grove has indeed been corrupted, but not by Lo’sho. [sad] That is merely the fantasy of an overzealous chieftain. [solemn] It has been tainted by demonic forces.

[solemn] I have a different task. [sad] A dryad I once called friend has fallen to corruption. [sad] Lo’sho allowed me to see her one last time in my dreams. [sad] Please return to the grove and lay my friend, Landis Stargazer, to rest. [sad] If my memory still serves, she should be running through the grove.
quest_42015_quest_progress: [soft voice] She used to whisper the name of the stars to me.
quest_42015_quest_complete: [solemn] Nature will take its course, and her body will return to dirt, as do all bodies. [soft voice] I pray Lo’sho saves her mind and lets her roam amongst the stars she once loved.
quest_42016_quest_detail:
[solemn] Our next task awaits. Druids that were slumbering in the barrow den have been disturbed and awoken. The elder insists these druids, incapable of seeing between dream and reality, are far too unpredictable and must be dealt with. He considers them, just like the others before, corrupted by Lo’sho.

[hesitant] I am beginning to see a pattern here, and I am coming to needlessly question the sanity of this chieftain. There were whispers, warnings; I did not care to heed them. I should have known when the audience we received was as cold as the stab of a dagger.

[urgent] Do not mistake the barrow den with the one outside of the grove, past the hollow tree bridge. The one you seek lies at the heart of the grove itself. In there, you will find protectors and stalkers alike, burdened by the lucid dream. Whatever the truth may be, Lo’sho or not, corruption has taken heart, and so they must be given a proper end.
quest_42016_quest_complete: [solemn] With that, our tasks seem to have reached an end. [warm] You have done me and my people a good service. [proud] I will not forget this kindness.
quest_42017_quest_detail:
[angry] I am far beyond displeased to hear that I was refused an audience with the elder of Moonhoof while the Windhorn are currently still speaking to him. [soft voice] Thankfully Nighthorn seems to be smarter than the rotting oaf. [solemn] I was able to obtain quite the information from this man. [sad] His displeasure with the elder is shared by both I and several other tribesmen, it seems.

[solemn] Chaos, I would often believe it follows my tribe, or rather that we end up at its core most of the time. [solemn] Yet another day when it has been proven so. [commanding] Enough rattle then, since I am bored of holding a monologue to a mute audience. [commanding voice] I am the Grimtotem Envoy, and I assure you, you’d better have me as an ally rather than a foe.

[urgent] With that in mind I urge you to travel north, to An’she’s Respite—but do so after you speak to the elder; he may urge you to do the same. [solemn] What I seek is the heart of the Shade Mother, and I have no doubt that you will provide.
quest_42017_quest_progress: [solemn] Do not fret, [soft voice] she is deemed an enemy to the village.
quest_42017_quest_complete: [solemn] I was half expecting you to mock me with the heart of a kodo, yet perhaps I judged you too rashly.
quest_42018_quest_detail:
[warm] Were I to tell you that even in its physical form, while no longer attached to a body, a heart still holds power you cannot imagine, would you believe me? [sad] Perhaps not. This heart is full of spite, resentment, and unfulfilled vengeance. [angry] And you are the reason for that. [hesitant] I wonder how that makes you feel.

[mocking tone] While it’d be far too amusing for me to keep mocking you, [solemn] I am in need of your assistance once more. [commanding] I will have you return to Thunder Bluff to the Elder Rise and grant my report to our esteemed leader, Magatha Grimtotem. [warm] The heart will also serve as a gift for her, so make sure to keep it safe.

[urgent] You will be rewarded, of course, if you manage to keep your head, that is.
quest_42018_quest_progress: [threatening] I did not summon any of you Horde whelps, so why is it you approach?
quest_42018_quest_complete: [solemn] Ashtotem sends a humorous gift. [soft voice] He was meant to discuss diplomacy and alliances with the Moonhoof. [sad] Yet he was refused entry and decided to gift me the heart of Moonhoof’s oldest friend, which he himself deemed an enemy now. [hesitant] How chaotic.
quest_42019_quest_detail:
[solemn] The coast is host and home to many creatures, amongst them the most particular being the elekk. [soft voice] They are a rare, almost nomadic creature that would rather be in solitude than packs. [pause] That being said, they are not easy to find, nor are they easy to fight. [hesitant] But I confess I am working on a weapon that requires one of their mighty tusks.

[soft voice] I suppose you understand where this is going, so I need not sing to you in a certain tune. [commanding] The job is simple yet challenging. The first challenge being finding one, the other being fighting one. [warm] If you manage to bring me one of the tusks, I will reward you with one of the weapons I forged.

[sad] I was not happy with either of them, but that does not make them any less reliable. [gentle] What I am looking to craft is a spear, one for my younger brother. [soft voice] I wish I could tell you where to find an elekk, but simply keep your eyes peeled in your adventures and you might find one.
quest_42019_quest_progress: [soft voice] I could use a break.
quest_42019_quest_complete: [soft voice] You managed to find one. [warm] Good. Give it here and wait.
quest_42020_quest_detail:
A fine spear indeed. [proud] I am more than proud of it. I have put all my love, sweat, and passion into forging this weapon. It is the weapon my brother will carry in his battles once his training is done. This, this was my duty as his elder: to provide the means to face his ambition, and, truthfully, to face mine.

Were this weapon forged with any less love, it would not have been as strong, as durable, as unique. I am curious what my brother will think of it and what name he will grant it. I have another favor to ask, of course.

Will you travel to Bloodhoof Village, to the training grounds of warriors, and find Hulfnar Stonetotem? He is the brother I speak of fondly. I doubt his training is yet done, so you should more than likely find him there. Walk south of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore to reach the village. And give my brother my warm greetings.
quest_42020_quest_progress: [gentle] Something I can do for you, friend?
quest_42029_quest_detail: [solemn] Purple demon blood drips off the key onto the tainted floor of Timbermaw Hold. [soft voice] The dim light of the cave creates countless prismatic reflections on its surfaces, a phenomenon that appears otherworldly to you. [hesitant] Still, the craftsmanship of it all intrigues you, there has to be a reason Peroth’arn had kept it on him. [low voice] The keyhead is adorned with intricate and filigrane embellishments, and dons a crescent moon symbol. [pause] Without any more clues, however, your discoveries won’t help you much. [urgent] Perhaps it is time to return to Manor Ravenholdt and seek your old master once more.
quest_42029_quest_progress: [commanding] Welcome back, agent. [soft voice] What dastardly deed has brought you back to my humble abode?
quest_42029_quest_complete: <Jorach inspects the key with a meticulously thorough gaze. Tracing his fingers over its teeth, a wistful chuckle escapes the aged man.> [solemn] If this is not the most fortuitous coincidence. [confident] I believe what you have brought here will make us strike a most profitable deal, <name>.
quest_42030_quest_detail:
[solemn] Not long ago, infact just a couple of days, a peculiar chest was delivered to the doorstep of my manor. The chest simply appeared overnight, with nothing but a strange perfumed envelope attached to it. Evidently, the mysteries didn’t end there, but I will leave this for a later discussion. Regarding the chest itself, a crescent moon among many other intricate adornments could be found on its surface. For us folk at Ravenholdt it could only mean one thing: Whatever is inside must be of immense value.

Naturally we began investigating and sent word to our informants inside Stormwind and the Undercity, from where they began scouring for any info about this enigmatic chest. Unfortunately, whatever they had found caused them to… [pause] cease cooperations. [commanding] I want you to get your hands on what they found. Either pilfer it from their pockets or extort the info out of them. I am sure they have something incriminating not far from them. They go by the names of Lord Finwald and Ebenezer Dregheap.
quest_42030_quest_progress: [solemn] While I am most interested in the information they acquired, it’d be most regrettable to ultimately lose such a fountain of knowledge by simply disposing of them. [soft voice] How refreshing it is that some old-fashioned blackmailing always does the trick to foster good working relations.
quest_42030_quest_complete: [solemn] Fascinating. I had my suspicions before, but according to the notes, we’re dealing with something far more ancient than anticipated. [soft voice] How strange to see it in such an immaculate condition…
quest_42031_quest_detail:
[solemn] It appears we are dealing with a reliquary from before the Sundering, the cataclysmic catastrophe following the conflict between the Night Elves and their Highborne elites ten thousand years ago.

[soft voice] I have mentioned an envelope attached to the chest, if you remember? Inside it was a letter, delicicately written on lavender paper covered with the scent of fragrant wildflowers. Written on it were crude, fragmented facts about the accompanied chest, like the fact it does not possess any conventional lock, yet still remains closed. From what is noted here, the lock can be recreated, however… [pause] All we have is a list of tools and materials, yet no plans on how to reform the lock. [sad] Disappointing, really, but we have to play the hand we’re dealt. [urgent] Your next step is to ascend the Blackwing Lair and acquire a transmutation alloy from Nefarian’s personal head alchemist and elementium ore from his goblin lackeys within.
quest_42031_quest_progress: [solemn] I wish you the most joyful adventure inside the Blackwing Lair. [soft voice] My agents and informants will continue our research regarding the lock blueprints.
quest_42031_quest_complete: [soft voice] Back so soon? Tremendous work, <name>. [solemn] There’s no time for respite, however. We’ve located the whereabouts of the blueprints to recreate the ancient elven lock. They were split apart into two pieces, each falling into the clutches of deranged fanatics. [urgent] Stock up on supplies, young rogue, for even more danger awaits you.
quest_42032_quest_detail:
[solemn] In the fortified hold of Tyr’s Hand, Crimson Friar Freidhelm teaches rotten rhetorics and principles to his fellow delusional friars. [soft voice] Normally I’d abstain from passing judgement on individuals when mere item recovery is at stake, yet I cannot overlook how his teachings spread a perverse iteration of the Light my wife held so dear.

[urgent] Infiltrate Tyr’s Hand alone and liquidate Freidhelm. [commanding] With his part of the blueprints we’ll be just a tiny bit closer to unveiling this mystery.
quest_42032_quest_progress: [solemn] Carnelia was the beacon of light in this shadowy life of mine. [angry] I shall not have heathens like him sully her light without punishment.
quest_42032_quest_complete: [solemn] You have my thanks, <name>. [soft voice] I wish we could have sent more of them into purgatory, but neither do I have the men nor the time for such personal vendettas. [pause] For now, this shall suffice.
quest_42033_quest_detail:
[solemn] Deep beneath Blackrock Mountain, in the scalding tunnels of the Molten Core you will find Old Shadowforge. [solemn voice] Remnants of the Dark Iron dwarves’ ancient city from which they ruled the innards of Blackrock Mountain. [soft voice] From what we could gather, one part of the blueprints fell into the hands of the Dark Iron several hundred years ago and withstood the test of time as well as the burning heat of the mountain’s core.

[urgent] Search for the blueprints in Old Shadowforge and return with it - unscathed, preferably.
quest_42033_quest_progress: [solemn] Powerful specters of the past reside within the crumbling ruins of Old Shadowforge. [soft voice] Trust your abilities and you should fare well against your enemies.
quest_42033_quest_complete: [solemn] Excellent. Just what kind of parchment has been used for these blueprints baffles me greatly. The ancient highborne civilization must have been truly marvelous.
quest_42034_quest_detail:
Everything is assembled. The finished blueprints, the alloy and the ore. [solemn] Now to have it all combined into the finished lock. [soft voice] Fortunately I have an old acquaintance who may be just the right person to ask for this. [hesitant] Even if he isn’t on the best terms with my organization anymore. Nothing a little bit of gold could solve, however.

[commanding] Argur Rustbrand is the exceptional blacksmith we are looking for. [solemn] Last I heard he spent every waking hour of his days in the Mold Foundry of the Blackrock Depths. [urgent] Here, take this box. [warm] Within you will find what we have gathered so far, as well as some gold to pay for his work.

[commanding] One more thing, <name>. This feisty dwarf no longer speaks to anyone that isn’t a Dark Iron dwarf themselves. [urgent] I suggest you get yourself a convincing disguise, or else this deal will not work.
quest_42034_quest_progress:
[angry] Who are you and why are you interrupting my work? [threatening] If you’re here just to annoy me, then I’ll show you how hot my furnace really is…

<You explain your reason for being here and hand him the materials plus gold satchel.>

[soft voice] Oho, I see how it is. An express delivery, if you will. [low voice] I may be the man for you, but if you need this done as soon as possible, this measly amount of gold won’t cut it. [urgent] If you want this finished in record time, pass me another one-hundred gold and I’ll think about it. [commanding] Deal?
quest_42034_quest_complete: [delight] Now that’s what I call proper payment. [pause] Now just wait a bit before I am done. Whatever you brought me here isn’t exactly the easiest of reads…
quest_42035_quest_detail: [soft voice] There you go. A masterly crafted lock worth its weight in gold. [low voice] Now do with it whatever you want. I don’t really care what you plan with it and I don’t want you to tell me. [angry] Just flock off out of the foundry and leave me be, understood?!
quest_42035_quest_progress: [solemn] You have returned, hopefully with good news?
quest_42035_quest_complete: [solemn] My apologies. It seems my expenses were not enough for the old greedbeard. [soft voice] Fret not, however. See it as a unique opportunity for collaboration, strengthening our bond even further. [warm] Besides, aren’t you excited to reap the rewards of your hard labor?
quest_42036_quest_detail: [solemn] It is time, <name>. [soft voice] While I am curious myself, I will let you be the one to open the chest, as compensation for all your hard work - and for bringing the key to it to us in the first place. The letter says to simply insert the lock into the indentation and unlock it with the key. [urgent] You will find it upstairs in the tower of my manor. [warm] Congratulations, you have earned it.
quest_42036_quest_progress: Jorach did not lie. [solemn] Rarely have you seen a chest made with such a level of craftsmanship. [soft voice] Tiny ornaments and embellishments adorn the chest and an aura of mystique and magic exudes from it.
quest_42036_quest_complete: [solemn] As instructed, you insert the lock into the indentation, which promptly springs into the contraption with a heavy clicking sound. [soft voice] Shortly after you insert the key, open the lid and welcome your just reward.
quest_42037_quest_detail:
[angry] Blasted Frostmane! Things have been going so well until last week, those blasted trolls came and snuck in during the night. They raided our supplies, and got away with some of our most vital goods.

[urgent] I need you to save my hide here. If I go and request more supplies, or worse, tell them about my failure in losing these materials, they will have my stripes.

[commanding] Go to the south west, where the Frostmane Trolls linger, and find me the crates marked with the Ironforge Airfield, return them and I will reward you.
quest_42037_quest_progress: [urgent] If you're seriously considering helping me out here it would mean a big deal. Just be careful, last thing I need is a casualty on top of losing these supplies.
quest_42037_quest_complete:
[laughing] Haha! You've done it, you've saved my arse!

[soft voice] I was sure I was going to be back to Mountaineer duties if this ever got out. You've done me a real solid here, and for that you've earned something in return.

[warm] Oh, and don't mention this, to anyone.
quest_42038_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there <class>, I have need of your assistance.

[angry] The local Frostmane have become a greater hinderance than we first anticipated. Every day their numbers and aggression seems to swell, it will not be long before they become brazen enough to attack the airfield.

[low voice] This frozen lake seperates us from their main den to the south-west, and if it weren't for the damned terrain I would just drive these tanks there and wipe them out.

[urgent] When you thin their numbers, return to me, and we can advise our next plan of attack.
quest_42038_quest_progress: [commanding] Do not let your guard down around those blasted trolls. [angry] They lack honor, and will strike even if you have your back turned.
quest_42038_quest_complete: [excited] Got rid of those trolls have ye? [warm] Ironforge is just a little bit safer thanks to your actions, [pause] but now we can put our attentions at the real threats.
quest_42039_quest_detail:
[solemn] My scouts have confirmed the location of a cave to the south west. [soft voice] It is called Frostmane Hollow, some de-facto capital for all of the troll kind in Dun Morogh. [urgent] If we want to ever put a halt to this threat, we will need to root it out, from deep inside. [low voice] Rumor has it that their leader is one called Battlemaster Ubukaz, some revered Frostmane fighter who now calls his warriors to battle. [commanding] I want you to find him, and bring justice for Ironforge.

I would advise you to bring reinforcements, there is no telling just how many enemies you may find in that cave.
quest_42039_quest_progress: [commanding] Be prepared for anything <class>, the Frostmane are a cunning foe.
quest_42039_quest_complete:
[solemn] So, Ubukaz has been slain?

<Granitebeard takes a moment, a smirk crossing his face.>

[surprised] I cannot believe my ears, [sad] I have no doubt there will be a another troll that shall rise to be chieftain, but for these coming days, [warm] peace shall be had in Dun Morogh.

[urgent] Until their infighting is over, [excited] we have time to celebrate!
quest_42040_quest_detail:
<Ranix lets out a breathe of relief, sweat drips down his forehead.> [excited] Boy, am I happy you've come to your senses. There's no point in violence here, infact, I have work for you! Y-yeah, you see, we weren't selling weapons or anything of that sort here. [gentle] I am just an honest trader, who was looking to acquire something from these Frostmane.

[hesitant] I think it would be in both of our best interests while you're here rooting around and, bringing justice or however to work together. You see, the Frostmane have a rare tablet I was looking to acquire, and they've been a bit slow in handing it over, it is called the Tablet of Kaz'gan, located somewhere here in these corridors...

<Ranix clears his throat.>

[urgent] So what say you? [confident] Coin for work?
quest_42040_quest_progress: [hesitant] So... Have you had any luck yet? [soft voice] I don't want to spend too much longer down here if I don't have too.
quest_42040_quest_complete:
<Ranix stares upon the tablet with interest gleaming on his eyes.> [excited] This is it, wow, I did not think you would actually live up to your word on this! [warm] You did well, and since I am such an outstanding, and noble goblin I will pay you what your work is worth.

[urgent] I will be out of here soon enough, thanks again.
quest_42041_quest_detail:
[commanding] Listen here, bucko. [sad] I hate admittin’ it, but we’re deep in the mud here. [angry] Those crazies over in Kurzen camp thought raidin’ that Alliance camp up the mountains ain’t enough and decided to pay us folks a visit as well. [urgent] Bad enough that we have our hands full with crocs, tigers, panthers, raptors and trolls - no, these loonies are now on our backs as well. [solemn] Luckily we could fend them off pretty easily, but they made off with plenty of our supplies and gear.

[confident] You look like you got your head screwed on right. I got a deal for you: [warm] Help a fellow out with some supplies for our camp and I’ll show you the real juicy secrets when it comes to survival in the wilds. [excited] Whaddaya say?
quest_42041_quest_progress: [excited] Ohoho! Seems I underestimated you, <class>. Those vine cutters can practically slice air; and these rations are both filling and delicious! [warm] I’m thoroughly impressed, you practically swept me off my feet with these. [confident] As promised, I’ll teach you some tips and tricks - tricks that’ll help you survive even in the most hostile wilds imaginable.
quest_42041_quest_complete: [urgent] Quit dawdling around! [urgent] There's no time to lose, youngster.
quest_42043_quest_detail: [solemn] The city above us had been laying silent for millennia, an unspoken oath by all Kaldorei and druids to not enter the forlorn ruins of the Sisterhood. [soft voice] Thus, we had not secured the numerous relics inside for safekeeping, but let them rest in the embrace of time instead. [urgent] However, now that the deranged defectors have begun trangressing and pillaging the temple, we cannot look idly by any longer. [commanding] Gather allies and fight your way through their defenses. [urgent] Retrieve as many artifacts as you can and bring them here to the grove.
quest_42043_quest_progress: Beware, unseen powers linger in your adversaries. [solemn] It is best to heed caution.
quest_42043_quest_complete: [solemn] Some look worse for wear, but none of them should truly be irreparable. [warm] Great work, <name>. [soft voice] We will ensure that they arrive safely at Nighthaven, so that they can be properly archived once and for all. Thank you for your diligence, truly.
quest_42044_quest_detail: <name>, [urgent] I have received an urgent message from one of the Circle's druidic enclaves in Moonwhisper Coast. [solemn] Tragedy has befallen our brethren and they seek immediate aid. [soft voice] Please, seek out their grove on the island of Tyrandas in the northeast of Moonwhisper Coast and report to Grovetender Sellais.
quest_42044_quest_complete: [soft voice] Loganaar received my message? What a relief.
quest_42045_quest_detail:
[solemn] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. [soft voice] I'm thinkin' it came from the warlock trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

And watch yerself, <name>, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
quest_42045_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you read the rune? [excited] Excellent! You standing here before me signals to me that you are willing and eager enough to tread the journey only a few will master; and survive. [solemn] My clan has seen the weakness that ails our ancient home, the vermin that scurry among the icy fields and dark mountain caves. [urgent] If our people don't accept any means necessary to exterminate those who do us harm, then Ironforge is doomed to perish.
quest_42045_quest_complete:
But that is far from any of your problems - yet. [solemn] You are still a novice, a whelpling tossed into this turbulent world. [soft voice] Yet still, you serve a purpose. [solemn] To usher in a new age for dwarvenkind. [urgent] Train in the forbidden arts of the arcane and grow more powerful. [commanding] Seek my clan members and other mighty warlocks. [confident] With their knowledge, the king cannot but recognize that he needs us to save the kingdom.

[hesitant] I may be still at the beginning of my journey too, but let me share what incantations I have learned by myself. [warm] Return to me often, and we shall exchange our wisdom of the shadowy arts.
quest_42046_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I hope you feel welcomed in my home, traveler. [warm] You may freely use it for the time being, as I am soon to set my hoofsteps toward Moonhoof Retreat. [solemn] A ritual of worship is soon to begin, and I, like many, wish to attend.

[low voice] Tradition has it, at least my personal one, to bring a flock of feathers from the roaming stagwings as an offering to Mother Mu’sha. [gentle] A simple yet strong reminder that we are able to stand on our own in this beautiful yet harsh environment.

[warm] Since you have been my guest, and as I grow old in my age, I would ask you to repay my kindness by bringing me seven stagwing feathers. [commanding] You will find several of them roaming the fields around my house. [solemn] Face them with courage and respect; think not of it as a mindless kill, but as proof that you are able to defend yourself and those you owe.
quest_42046_quest_progress: [hesitant] Is the task proving to be more challenging than you expected?
quest_42046_quest_complete: [soft voice] Fine feathers, you are better at this than I have anticipated.
quest_42047_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have felt somber energies coming from An’she’s Respite of late. While it seems to have not affected the dead there, it has certainly had an effect on the Ancestral Grounds.

[pause] Several ancestors have been disturbed from their sleep beyond the veil of life and have risen to make their disdain known. [soft voice] Thankfully, much like a spoiled child, it does not take much for the dead to be reminded that they are no longer of this place.

In such regards, if you will, for the peace of this old woman, go and smack them a few times. [commanding] Be wary, for in their disturbance they see no reason, nor do they recognize friend from foe. It is the frustration of the grave that makes them aggressive. In the same remark, fear not killing them; they are already dead.
quest_42047_quest_progress: [soft voice] Often it feels like taking care of a kindergarten rather than a resting place in these lands.
quest_42047_quest_complete: [solemn] Your job is done and mine begins. [soft voice] I must tidy up the place now.
quest_42048_quest_detail:
[solemn] That utter knucklehead of a chieftain has sent me all alone to watch over our Ancestral Grounds. [angry] He is terribly, terribly wrong for doing so, and I wish he would know that. [soft voice] You are on your way back to Moonhoof Village, aren’t you? [warm] Good. Tell that old bull he had better send a couple of young ones to help protect this place, rather than have me paying no-good adventurers, no disrespect, dear, to clean up this mess. [commanding] And he had better pay me back every coin I put into this place too.

<The old tauren huffs and puffs.>

[sigh] What, you are not gone yet? [sad] Seriously, young folk these days. [commanding] Come now, child, scram!
quest_42048_quest_complete: [solemn] Groundstender Rainhorn’s complaints? You must be kidding. [sad] I explained our situation to that old woman several times. [sigh] Alas, I will send her a young bull or two.
quest_42052_quest_detail:
[solemn] A flame burns bright amid the surrounding darkness within your eyes. That flame speaks for itself. [commanding] You are no amateur. Bluntly speaking, you are soon to reach your prime as an adventurer and explorer of this world. Mm, yes, you will do.

[threatening] I sense a hunger within you, a hunger that deems us siblings. You too crave the ecstasy of danger, of pain. I, Gor’dush Jawtaker of the Scalereaver Warband, offer you a test of might, a test of will. [urgent] Ahead of us, in the crater where the crystal beams, you will find several whelps and lesser minions of the Blue Dragonflight. [commanding] Bathe in their blood and return to me.

[commanding] To succeed in this task, you need a warband of your own. Claim any ally you see fit, any friend or adventurer lost to the lands of this coast. Join them in the eternal glory that is dragon hunting. [proud] Fulfill this tale of courage, and I will set you upon an even more glorious destiny.
quest_42052_quest_progress: [solemn] Steel yourself. [commanding] Only a few may walk the path of glory.
quest_42052_quest_complete: [solemn] It may seem mindless to many and to many it is. [low voice] This hunt of dragons does not come simply at the whims of one orc’s sport. [solemn] Where these dragons were once meant to protect, they now seek to destroy.
quest_42053_quest_detail:
[solemn] I have mentioned a path of glory before. On Draenor, while my kind grew ill with bloodlust and the greed of collecting skulls, we called the road that led to this world a path of glory. [sad] What misguided fools we were.

That road was paved with the bones of either the innocent or those whom we, in our twisted purpose, saw as enemies. [commanding] No more. There was no glory to be found there. I have done many things I am not proud of, by my own will or by the orders of others. I say again, no more.

[urgent] Seek now the glory that comes from putting a stop to those meant to protect mortals, yet now deem them unworthy. [emphasis] Seek the drakes Starcaller and Spellstriker. One guards the crystal, the other looms over Vynagosa’s Rest, the isle to the north. [commanding] Bring me their jaws, and from them I will grant you a prize.
quest_42053_quest_progress: [commanding] Tell me, what are you fighting for?
quest_42053_quest_complete: [commanding] Pick. One is my for the taking, yours is the other.
quest_42054_quest_detail: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, <name>. [solemn] I believe she was sent by the priest trainer Nuhlok. [soft voice] If this note is from Nuhlok, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
quest_42054_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Celestial Siblings guide your very first steps to me, <name>. [soft voice] It is I who will watch over you and teach you what I can as you complete your training here in the Red Cloud Mesa.

[warm] I trust you are eager to see the world for yourself and perhaps even walk a pilgrimage to the Moonwhisper Coast. [gentle] Moonhoof Village holds three scrolls of prayer, each devoted to one of the Siblings.
quest_42054_quest_complete:
[solemn] It will be many cycles before you are ready to guide your hooves there, my friend. [soft voice] Your training resumes. [solemn] Seek me once you have gained more experience in battle.

[solemn] To be a devoted worshipper of the Celestial Siblings places you beyond the bounds of tribe. [warm] You are cherished by the eyes and the tear of the Earthmother. [solemn] Whatever path you walk from now on, at least one of them will always be by your side.
quest_42055_quest_detail:
I have shared with you all the teachings I am able to, which means you have already exceeded my expectations. [solemn] When you are ready to leave the Red Cloud Mesa, seek my elder brother, Pargan Starstrider, in Bloodhoof Village. He will teach you more of our worship and its history. [soft voice] Yet as your first master, I must also share what knowledge I have gathered in my own devotion.

The Celestial Siblings are exactly that, my friend, siblings. [solemn] Though Lo’sho was born of Mu’sha, she treats him more like a younger brother than a son. Like any family, they quarrel. [solemn] When Lo’sho was born, a heavy burden was placed upon him. It was no different for Mu’sha and An’she, for the Earthmother opened her eyes and there they were. [pause] I am biased. [warm] I worship Lo’sho most. Born of Mu’sha’s pain as she beheld the world beneath the Burning Legion, he carries hope. [soft voice] He will weep and laugh with you. He does not judge; he listens and provides. [solemn] Remember this as you venture forth.
quest_42055_quest_complete:
[solemn] I have been expecting you, young blood.

Come, let us speak. There are things you lack that you must learn, and I can teach them. But before I do, I sense a resolve in you. Has Nuhlok shared his love for Lo’sho with you? Good. Then allow me to share mine. I favor An’she and, by default, all three of them. An’she assumed the role of the elder sibling. It is by his light that the first children of the Earth, such as us, were born.

His graceful light nurtures our bodies and crops. It is the same light that illuminates Mu’sha and Lo’sho in the night sky, for without his light they could not be seen. Yet, like any elder, An’she can be stubborn and judgmental, but he is just. He believes his path is the right one, for through his eyes it is the path of protection for both his worshippers and his siblings. [solemn] A selfish yet benevolent patron, is he not?
quest_42056_quest_detail:
[solemn] Let us put your teachings to the test. South of this tent, past the circle of totems where our warriors train and beneath the shadows and foliage of trees you will find Brave Greenhorn. [low voice] He looms, wounded, keeping guard over the Winterhoof Water Well which has been run over by the Venture Co.

[pause] While he was ordered simply to observe he was none the wiser and chose to do the opposite. [urgent] As such he started a fight with the Venture Co. and managed to flee by the skin of his teeth. [commanding] Your task is to find him, heal him and reinforce his spirit through Fortitude and remind him, he has allies he can rely upon. [solemn] So that he may return to the village and muster a force to face the enemy ahead.

[soft voice] Do this and when you return we will speak of Mu’sha.
quest_42056_quest_progress: [solemn] You may see healing and enhancing your allies as extensions of both An’she and Mu’sha. Where the rays of An’she warmly soothe a wound, the white bloom in the night sky during each of Mu’sha’s cycles acts as a guide through the darkness. [soft voice] Lo’sho can soothe, but he cannot heal. [pause] His gifts to you bend and mend the mind, not the body.
quest_42056_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well. To commemorate your first trial, I will reward you with one of my old robes. [warm] As promised, let me speak of Mu’sha. One of our longest allies has been the night elves, who, as their name implies, are children of the Night and, as such, children of Elune, the name they have given Mu’sha. [soft voice] Through our years of connection, some tauren have sensed a trace of favoritism. If we are the children of the Earthmother, then the night elves are the children of Mu’sha, and she may seem inclined to favor them. [pause] That does not mean she neglects us in any way, yet a hint of jealousy lingers among some worshipers.

[solemn] In truth, it has helped us bond with the night elves and find fraternity with them. But to speak plainly, Mu’sha has always pointed the way, and if you choose to follow it, do so. [gentle] You do not need any explanation; she won’t try to convince you. Of the three, she is the most free, if you will. Her path is her own, and you can either come along or stay behind.
quest_42057_quest_detail: [solemn] You are here. [soft voice] Ready to start?
quest_42057_quest_complete: [solemn] It is time to indulge in the teachings of An'she, the Right Eye of the Earthmother. [soft voice] Let his light illuminate your way and blind those who wish to harm the Earthmother's favored.
quest_42058_quest_complete: [gentle] Good to see you. [solemn] Let us not waste any more time.
quest_42059_quest_detail: [solemn] You are here. [pause] Ready to start?
quest_42059_quest_complete: [solemn] Lo'sho is often misunderstood, but he is as much a part of the Earthmother as both of her eyes. [soft voice] Close your eyes and listen to our people's legends.
quest_42060_quest_complete: [solemn] You've returned. [soft voice] It is time to open a new chapter in your spiritual journey.
quest_42061_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ah. An adventurer.

<Astalor’s lip curls slightly.>

How fortunate... I find myself in need of someone… expendable.

I dispatched my cousin, Andanil, to the distant shores of Moonwhisper in northern Kalimdor. The task I entrusted to him was of significance. Regrettably, his competence was not.

It has been weeks. No word. No report. No reassurance that he has not embarrassed our name beyond repair.

<Astalor places a hand to his chest, his expression shifting into a pale imitation of concern.>

I would be… devastated… if some misfortune befell him.

[commanding] You will travel to Moonwhisper. You will determine his condition. If, by some miracle, he is alive and the mission proceeds as intended, you will observe and report. If it is not, you will ensure that it does.

[urgent] Ships bound for Kalimdor depart from Windrunner Pier. Do not keep me waiting.
quest_42061_quest_complete:
Oh, thank the Light.

Astalor finally sent someone. Good. Very good. I was beginning to think he had… forgotten.

As you can see, everything here is proceeding exactly as planned. Perfectly, even. Nothing has gone wrong. At all.

The expedition force is… mostly intact. Entirely intact, really. I certainly did not lose most of it. That would be absurd.

And even if I had, which I have not, the situation would still be well under control. Completely.

Still. It is… reassuring that you are here now.

My mission here is of great importance to our house. Critical, in fact. I simply require a bit of… assistance.
quest_42062_quest_detail:
[solemn] We are the Sentinels. We swore an oath to protect the lands of Kalimdor. Distance does not weaken that duty, and time does not erase it.

[soft voice] I have heard reports of strange events along the forgotten shores of Moonwhisper.

[solemn] These lands were once a jewel of our empire. Now they lie abandoned. [sad] Nendis was broken when the Betrayer and his naga struck, and its scars still remain.

[urgent] Even so, we cannot allow darkness to take root where vigilance has faded.

[soft voice] I have sent one of my commanders ahead. She has made camp near the ruins of Elun’aran, once a thriving town. Seek her out. Lend her your aid, and let your actions honor the oath we all share.
quest_42062_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have seen it, I am certain. [soft voice] The corruption that grips this land. [pause] The twisted creatures that now call it home.

[commanding] The Sentinels will not allow this suffering to continue. [solemn] These shores are part of Kalimdor, and they will not be abandoned to darkness.

[urgent] By oath and by duty, we will bring justice to this place. [proud] When the corruption is cleansed, peace will follow.
quest_42063_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings. Are you traveling to the Moonwhisper Coast?

[pause] My duties keep me here, but I carry a delivery meant for a dear friend of mine. [solemn] She ventured north with Commander Silverstreak.

They have established a small outpost called Narvalis Point. [gentle] If you are headed that way, I would be grateful if you could deliver this to her.

The road ahead is not without danger, but I believe you will manage. [urgent] Be careful in the tunnels along the coast. [solemn] The Withermaw furbolgs that dwell there have grown restless and unpredictable.

[soft voice] May Elune watch over your steps.
quest_42063_quest_complete:
[soft voice] From Velaya? Oh… you have no idea how long I have been waiting for this.

[delight] I was starting to think she had forgotten me. [warm] A girl can only wait so long, you know.

<Irea’s smile brightens, the worry lifting from her face.>

[warm] Thank you, truly. [warm] This means more to me than you might think. [soft voice] I will have to write back to her soon. [urgent] Very soon. [warm] If you are staying the night, the first drink is on the house.
quest_42064_quest_detail:
As a captain of the guard, keeping the expedition alive is my charge.

[sad] I failed at that. Not to the enemy, but to fools who thought this land would forgive mistakes. It does not.

[solemn] However, what truly crippled us was theft. Supplies. Ammunition. Food meant to last the month - gone.

[angry] The furbolgs to the south took them. They did not always prey on the desperate. Something twisted them. [whispering] Timbermaw Hold reeks of bad magic, and they carry it with them. [urgent] I see their scouts closer each night. Testing us. Counting fires. Waiting.

[emphasis] Without those supplies, this camp will starve or freeze before the enemy ever strikes.

[commanding] Go south, to their village. Find what they stole from us. Take it back.

If they stand in your way, deal with them. Quietly if you can. Brutally if you must.

[cold] We cannot afford mercy. Not anymore.
quest_42064_quest_complete:
Good. [solemn] This will keep us alive a while longer.

Do not think this ends anything. [low voice] The theft was not desperation - it was intent. [commanding] They wanted to see how we would respond. Whether we were weak.

Now they know better.

[urgent] They will test us again. They always do. [solemn] Wounded beasts grow bold when cornered. [commanding] If we wait, they will gather, and they will come for us in the dark.

[emphasis] Next time, we do not recover what was taken.

[threatening] Next time, we burn the hand that reaches for us.
quest_42065_quest_detail:
The draenei.

Strange beings from a broken world. The same world our traitor prince chose over his own people.

<Rhys spits.>

[solemn] There is a village to the northeast. They keep to themselves. We traded for their crystals. Curious things. They hum when no wind blows. [hesitant] I do not trust them, but they have not raised steel against us. Not yet.

In the swamps and forests, it is different. Those who call themselves the Fallen Ones stalk the reeds and the tree line. [threatening] They do not parley. They rush you without warning and strip the flesh from your bones. [commanding] I have seen what they leave behind.

We cannot build anything here while they breathe. The expedition will never be secure with them prowling our flanks.

Hunt them. Kill them where they hide. Bring me forty of their heads as proof. Yes, forty. Do not question the number. These swamps crawl with them. You will not struggle to find your count.

Thin them out until even the mud runs red.
quest_42065_quest_progress:
Beware their daggers.

[whispering] They coat the blades in venom not born of this world. [cold] It burns cold in the blood. [solemn] I have watched strong warriors fall to their knees from a scratch no deeper than a thorn.

[urgent] Do not trust your armor to save you. [urgent] Do not trust your healers to mend you in time. [sad] Even they struggle against that poison.
quest_42065_quest_complete:
[solemn] Forty heads.

It brings a measure of peace, seeing them laid out like that. [soft voice] Not enough, but some. We have only carved a dent in their numbers, nothing more.

Still, it should give them pause. [commanding] Fear lingers longer than pain, and they are not brave creatures when faced with open slaughter.

[urgent] With luck, it will be enough to keep them from testing our encampment while we are still here.
quest_42066_quest_detail:
[solemn] Those fools think draenethyst crystals are our salvation.

<Tesania laughs, sharp and bright, like she just heard a perfect joke.>

Salvation. For us. That is a good one. [sad] There is no saving our people. Still, I intend to delay the inevitable for as long as I can.

<She glances at the two withered nearby, her smile fading into open contempt.>

I have no desire to end up like that. To the east lie the ruins of Maras’ethil. Once a Highborne center of learning. Now a broken monument to our arrogance. Typical. My research suggests there are still artifacts there. Old ones. Potent ones. The kind certain parties would trade generously for in mana crystals. Very generously.

Bring me at least four artifacts worth my time. [warm] I promise, you will find the reward far more pleasant than whatever fate awaits the rest of us.
quest_42066_quest_progress:
[solemn] The Highborne ghosts still think they are alive. [soft voice] They haunt the ruins, patrolling streets that no longer exist, guarding cities that fell centuries ago. [pause] In their minds, nothing has changed.

[low voice] They will not part with their secrets willingly. [emphasis] Nor their artifacts. [urgent] Expect resistance. [angry] Ferocious, stubborn, and very offended that you dare disturb their illusion.
quest_42066_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, these are potent.

The magic on them is still alive. Old, refined, dangerous. Otherworldly, even. And the craftsmanship… honestly, it is almost enough to make me nostalgic. Almost.

[pause] Yes, these are very much worth investigating. Possibly worth more than that, depending on who is asking.

[warm] Well done, <class>. You earned your keep.
quest_42067_quest_detail:
Before the… incident, we managed to secure a fair number of draenethyst crystals. [solemn] They are potent, yes, and full of promise. [soft voice] Still, something is missing. I can feel it.

[pause] Some time ago, a great meteor fell north of here. [emphasis] It tore the earth apart when it struck, and its arrival drew many of the blue dragonflight to the site. [solemn] That alone tells me enough.

The stone is saturated with arcane energy. [low voice] In the right context, it could be invaluable to my work. [soft voice] I believe it would resonate with draenethyst in a way we have not yet seen. The exact mechanisms are not important.

[pause] What matters is this. [emphasis] I need a sample.

[urgent] The dragons guarding the impact site are hostile, and I will not ask you to walk into certain death. [solemn] However, the Fallen Ones do not share such reservations. [cold] They place little value on life, their own included. [pause] It is possible they scavenged shards from the meteor. [hesitant] If so, you will find them in the Servitor’s Sanctuary to the north. [commanding] Search there, and bring me what you can recover.
quest_42067_quest_progress:
[solemn] Proceed with caution.

The Fallen Ones are not to be underestimated. [low voice] They are reckless, but not foolish, and they fight with a cruelty born of desperation.

Do not take them lightly. [sad] Many have died that way.
quest_42067_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So… you actually found one.

Yes. [emphasis] This resonance. I can feel it even through the wards. The arcane pattern is unstable, but not chaotic. That is rare. Very rare.

[solemn] You did well to survive long enough to bring it back. Many would not have.

With this shard, the draenethyst may finally reveal its purpose. Or confirm my fears about it. Either outcome is preferable to ignorance.

[pause] Rest now. [solemn] I will begin the work immediately, and carefully.
quest_42068_quest_detail:
[solemn] Apologies for the sorry state of our camp. [soft voice] These lands are strange, and their inhabitants even stranger. [sad] And… we have suffered a major setback.

<Andanil shifts, tension plain in every movement.>

[pause] Let me explain what happened.
quest_42068_quest_complete:
[solemn] Our people have endured exile, betrayal, and slow decay, and still we stand. [low voice] We will endure this as well. [soft voice] I believe that. [hesitant] I have to.

That said, belief alone will not carry us through what waits in that den. [commanding] Pride has already cost us enough.

[solemn] I will admit this, if only once. [urgent] I could use a steady hand at my side in this matter.
quest_42069_quest_detail:
I cannot spare any of my people. [soft voice] They are scholars, arcanists, minds trained for study, not slaughter. I need them lucid, focused, working. If I send them into that den, I lose more than soldiers. I lose what little progress we have left.

[solemn] You are different. You carry no obligation to my house, no oath to my cousin’s ambition. And you handle yourself like one who has seen real battle. [emphasis] That is what I require.

Listen carefully. I need your help, and I will see you rewarded in a manner worthy of the risk.

Go to the den. Find what they uncovered. Find what drained them so completely, so quickly. It must still be there. An artifact. A stone. Whatever it is, it is the source.

Bring me proof. Bring me the object itself if you can.

And… [hesitant] if there is any chance, any at all, do not kill them. Not unless you must. If this was caused by magic, then magic may yet undo it.

<Andanil turns his gaze aside, jaw tightening.>

I am aware of how that sounds. Even so. Try.
quest_42069_quest_progress:
[commanding] Do not stray too far.

[solemn] There is another Barrow Den farther north, within a druid grove. [low voice] The druids there have made their feelings toward us very clear, and they were not welcoming.

[threatening] Whatever they guard is not meant for us, and I will not have you provoking another enemy while we are already stretched thin.

[emphasis] Stay away from that place.
quest_42069_quest_complete:
What is this?

<Andanil stares into the artifact you retrieved. His eyes linger too long, as if it is staring back.>

[excited] This is it?

Yes… of course it is. I see it now.

The magic is spent, drained dry, but there is no doubt. This is the source. This is what they found. Even emptied, it hums with purpose.

<He lifts the object carefully, almost reverently, turning it in the light.>

[solemn] Such precision. There is no waste here, no ornament for vanity’s sake. This is not elven craft.

I have studied relics from every corner of our past. Highborne vaults. Pre-Sundering ruins. Nothing even approaches this. Whatever made it did not think like us. It did not feel like us. And whatever power once flowed through it was enough to drain trained arcanists in moments and leave them wandering husks.

And still, I cannot shake the feeling that this is only a shell. A key, perhaps. Something meant to be used again.

I must return to Alah’thalas at once. [proud] Oh cousin… this time, I did not fail you.
quest_42070_quest_detail:
[solemn] I believe the time has come to face my father and question his judgment. [hesitant] Yet I doubt he would listen; he would, as always, dismiss it as if all he does is for the well of his people and I, his family. [commanding] I require you to do something for me. [urgent] I must have the Horde act on my behalf, but not just any adventurer, someone who will have an impact.

[soft voice] I need you to travel south, to the plains of Mulgore, and find Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. [solemn] I could send you to his father, but I would rather enlist the Bloodhoof heir. [solemn] He will understand, from one heir to another, how heavy this burden is.

[emphasis] Tell him what you have faced and witnessed among my tribe. [urgent] You will be my witness to the urgency of this task. [commanding] By gaining the support of the Horde and acting as an extension of authority, my father will be forced to listen. [cold] He hates that he must resort to the Horde, and we will use his pride against him. [solemn] Do not fail me. [solemn] This way, you will also absolve yourself of the sins committed under his orders.
quest_42070_quest_progress: [solemn] Welcome to Bloodhoof Village. [soft voice] Is there something you wish to tell me?
quest_42070_quest_complete: [solemn] I understand the urgency of this request and I can surely feel for the Moonhoof heir. Were I in the same position I believe I would have done the same.
quest_42071_quest_detail:
[solemn] My father was skeptical enough when we received news of an agreement between the Bloodhoof and the Moonhoof, truth be told. [soft voice] The Moonhoof have always favored their independence and, above all, their relationship with the night elves. [solemn] The Moonhoof were under the umbrella of the Cenarion Circle.

Both the Grove of the Moon and the Grove of the Sun were there to prove that. [hesitant] To hear that the Grove of the Moon has gone astray is most curious. From what you are telling me, they have abandoned their worship of Mu’sha and traded it for the worship of Lo’sho, which the Elder Moonhoof believes to be a corruption.

[pause] I must mull over these things. [commanding] You will find my father in Elders’ Rise in Thunderbluff. [confident] I doubt he will turn you away; he does want the Moonhoof to officially become part of the Horde, especially now that they have estranged themselves from the night elves. [cold] I believe this will lead to forced isolation, and the Elder is simply using the Horde to obtain what he needs for it to be so.
quest_42072_quest_progress: [solemn] Are you the bearer of good news?
quest_42072_quest_complete: [solemn] So they agreed to help. [soft voice] I must prepare something to thank them. [pause] When all of this is over, I will travel myself to Thunder Bluff to express my gratitude. [sad] Earthmother knows my father will not.
quest_42073_quest_detail:
[solemn] Prepare yourself for the most stubborn bull you have ever met. [commanding] Whatever you do, do not let go. [urgent] Insist until he cracks. [solemn] He will be a terrible opponent of wills, but you must push his buttons enough to have him tell you what he knows and to finally accept his mistakes for what they are.

[soft voice] For a man to pull the wool over his own eyes is the strangest, most selfish way of acting. If I sound frustrated and desperate, it is because I am. [sad] I cannot tell you how long I have had to deal with this on my own. [warm] Please, please, do not let my trust go to waste.

[urgent] You already know where he is, in his hut. [commanding] Seek him, talk to him, convince him of his wrongdoings, and let this nightmare be finished.
quest_42074_quest_detail:
I have told you my truth. [solemn] It is up to you now to decide whether you trust it or not. [soft voice] To understand what led Mothshroud to Maras’ethil you must follow in his hoofsteps. [pause] My patron points the way. [solemn] You must travel south, past the Ruins of Nendis and through Moro’gai Village. [commanding] Once you pass the first bridge that marks the outskirts of the Moro’gai Village, take a left and head east. [urgent] Just past the lone farmer’s land you will find another bridge.

[emphasis] Follow the road inside Maras’ethil and once it turns into a circle, go left once more. [pause] As it splits into four, go towards the one ahead, the one that has an arch above it. [soft voice] Approach but don’t go through the arch, instead go right and then swiftly left. [urgent] This way you will find a clearing opening, a sight towards the Great Sea and a lone tree. [solemn] You will find your clue there and once you do, return it to my son.
quest_42074_quest_progress: [solemn] Your audience with my father took more than I expected.
quest_42074_quest_complete: [solemn] So he has revealed to you the reasons for his actions. [soft voice] He sought your help and knows death is one of the endings he might expect for his mistakes. [pause] Enough of that for now, [gentle] tell me of this relic, and this letter you found.
quest_42075_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have found the letter addressed to me, [sad] you know now he aims to take vengeance on the Moonhoof tribe, [hesitant] what else do you require of me, even? [soft voice] What can I or should I tell you that you do not already know? [defiant] You could not possibly ask me to betray my own master. [cold] But you are, that is your goal. [urgent] To have me tell you in detail what he intends to do, whether his mind is own still or this is a simple meddling of demonic forces seeking to corrupt.

[commanding] Fine, you will hear my words, after you fulfill a request of mine. [low voice] As you know, my master left for Tyrandas, but the way you are now, you will not stand a chance. [solemn] Especially not on your own. [pause] Have you allies, have you friends? [urgent] Gather them and go to Tyrandas. [commanding] Instead of heading into the heart of the island, go west to the now Withered Enclave. [threatening] Lay waste to those damn grells and peace to the twisted gardeners. [emphasis] Prove your might and I may speak.
quest_42075_quest_progress: [solemn] Alive, but is it by victory or cowardice?
quest_42075_quest_complete: [solemn] That will do. [soft voice] Keep your allies close, you will certainly need them for what comes next.
quest_42076_quest_detail:
Mothshroud is draining the power of the druids and every other living creature under his command to fulfill his ambition. [solemn] My lost brothers and sisters became twisted, disturbed even as they either willingly or not have remained to serve our former Arch Druid. He was once my master, and I still hold much respect for the man he once was. [sad] I did not think I would have to lose two Arch Druids close to my heart to the pain of mourning. [hesitant] Perhaps I was too blind to see it, but he reminds me of Fandral Staghelm.

Yet Arch Druid Fandral has not fallen so deeply to ally himself with the satyr and seek benevolence from the Blue Child, to rid the sick of his elder sibling. [cold] He has doomed all the druids in his service to a death with no Emerald Dream. [commanding] As you battle through those who would stand against you in your quest to find Mothshroud, find some time to recover their charms. [soft voice] Charms we have made under the calming shadows in the Grove of the Moon. [urgent] Return those to me, so I may bury them.
quest_42076_quest_progress: [soft voice] How many have you gathered?
quest_42076_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, now it is finally time to leave this damned place and return to the home I have lost. [soft voice] Farewell, member of the Horde. [sad] May we never cross paths again.
quest_42077_quest_detail:
[solemn] Mothshroud believes that An’she is the one to make Mu’sha shine, through his light. [soft voice] And as such, to punish the patron of Moonhoof that denied his revenge he would take away what he too had lost. [low voice] It is his ambition to inquire for the aid of the youngest sibling, to punish An’she by making the patron of the day feel loss, so that he would understand what it is to mourn.

[pause] It is his greatest question, what would An’she do when he lost his most beloved sister? Would he seek the very same vengeance Mothshroud did, the one he denied him to claim or will he play the stoic even then. [hesitant] Alas, quite the existential thing to ponder, but tell me, is it worth the cost of so many lives? [sad] I have blindly followed Mothshroud, telling myself that he would see reason in the end. [urgent] Yet, that end will not come to pass. [sigh] It breaks my heart to send you after him. [commanding] He is atop the Temple of Elunaris, preparing to shoot down the moon. [shouting] End this spectacle, and return to Moonhoof Village.
quest_42077_quest_progress: Whenever I send you on a task you somehow end up being gone longer than I expected. [soft voice] Tell me, have you found Moondancer?
quest_42077_quest_complete: [solemn] So this marks the end. [sad] Arch Druid Mothshroud is gone, and Ireth Moondancer is still alive. [solemn] He meant to strike the moon out of the sky. And he almost did, were you not here to stop him. [pause] We must report this to my father, but before we do, I believe a reward is in order for all your valiant deeds.
quest_42078_quest_detail:
[solemn] What Mothshroud did was wrong, he bathed himself in the blood of others for his own conviction, his own ambition, his own pain. Are they not similiar? Father chose to remove the problem, to erase it. And in doing so he has sealed his fate.

For a tribe known to walk with the celestial siblings, it makes me wonder. Is it the influence of the siblings that made this possible, are we nothing more than pawns in a messy game; a witness to their quarrel and a means to prove each other who stands atop another? If anything this experience should stand as proof that we should not blindly follow our gods.

What we see through the eyes of the Earthmother, and its tear, should not necessarily be what we see with our own eyes. [sad] Were I my father’s son, I would have him dead. Instead, I task you to speak to him one last time, tell him that the deed is done, that Moonhoof is safe, and that he is no longer needed here. Have him gather his things and accept his banishment with a clear head.
quest_42078_quest_progress: [solemn] I have felt his death. [sad] Does mine follow?
quest_42078_quest_complete: [solemn] I understand. [sad] I am not sure I am deserving of this mercy, or whether I would have given it myself were the roles reserved. [low voice] I will accept my punishment and leave this village behind. [pause] It is time for another to lead then. [warm] With the help of his newfound allies, you included, he will certainly do far better than I.
quest_42079_quest_detail: [soft voice] While the scroll appears to be intact there is a seal on it you are not able to unlock. [solemn] Your thoughts send you towards Mhulf Nighthorn, a worshipper just like you from the Moonhoof Village. [solemn] Either by your intuition alone or a sign from the Celestial Siblings your hoof guides you toward him, knowing that he may be able to uncover this seal.
quest_42079_quest_complete: [solemn] You have recovered this from the clutches of the demon that claimed the barrow den from the Grove of the Moon as home? [soft voice] Then, whatever lies on that paper is only for your eyes to see. [urgent] Find a lone place and read it.
quest_42080_quest_detail:
Father mentioned Ireth Moondancer to you, didn’t he? [soft voice] It seems he might be alive. [solemn] If this letter is to be believed he was sent to the ruins of Nendis to retrieve something, but failed to meet with Mothshroud in the required time. [hesitant] Seeing as the letter was still there we can safely assume he never made it to the meeting point regardless. [pause] Whether those are good or bad we will know in time.

I wonder what Mothshroud spoke of…, vengeance on my father, his patron? [sad] I suppose it’d be clear he would have had a grudge when father refused his quest for vengeance. [hesitant] He still speaks with yearning towards Lo’sho it seems, but I doubt the motive is… pure. [pause] No point in thinking of it for too long. [urgent] Go to Nendis, the naga do love to toy with their captives first, by some miracle Moondancer would still be alive. [solemn] The Ruins of Nendis can be found south of here.
quest_42080_quest_progress: [solemn] Are you friend or foe? [soft voice] A bit of both then, member of the Horde. [hesitant] To what do I owe this untimely aid?
quest_42080_quest_complete: [solemn] A bit of both then, member of the Horde. [soft voice] To what do I owe this untimely aid?
quest_42081_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, young one! [soft voice] It would appear you have arrived at an opportune time. [pause] We have been looking for... [hesitant] A bit of assistance. [solemn] Many have begun to travel here to Moonhoof Retreat in anticipation for the coming festival, and yet there are still things to be done.

[warm] If you're looking to be of assistance, I am certain Elder Starstrider has tasks for you. [gentle] You can find him behind this tent, up the trail and near the large bonfire above. [warm] Do not be afraid to introduce yourself, and be sure to let him know that I sent you.
quest_42081_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, how is it that I can help you?
quest_42081_quest_complete:
[solemn] Torgan sent you, did he?

<Elder Starstrider's features twist in annoyance>

I suppose he is right. As much as I dislike our situation being aired out so openly.

<The stubborn tauren snorts his displeasure of the situation, and how much Torgan may be correct.>

[soft voice] Well, he is right, we do need help.
quest_42082_quest_detail:
[solemn] There are still tasks that need to be completed for the festival to begin, and for this I will need some diligent hands. First I need to fashion a headdress made from the feathers of local creatures. They can be found all across Moonwhisper Coast.

[soft voice] I will require six Azureshimmer Feathers from the Hippogrpyhs, and six Moonstrider Feathers from the Plainstriders. [hesitant] I must ask you, be careful with the feathers. They are somewhat delicate and can be damaged beyond use.
quest_42082_quest_progress: [solemn] I must remind you, be gentle with the feathers when they are acquired, [soft voice] they are delicate!
quest_42082_quest_complete: <Elder Starstrider gazes upon the feathers with aged and cold eyes, scanning them for imperfections> [solemn] Hmm... They are not in perfect condition, but they are good enough.
quest_42083_quest_detail:
[solemn] If we are to ever commence the celebration, we must recover an artifact. [soft voice] Near a full month ago, the Fallen One raided our camp and made off with a few possessions, one being our coveted artifact. [solemn] The Rod of Preservation has been sacred to this celebration, and is required to bring our ancestors into manifestation.

[commanding] I must ask of you to recover it, I have no doubts the skulking no-goods have taken it to the north west and stashed it amongst their hovels.

[urgent] Once you have retrieved the Rod of Preservation, return it to me, and we can take to our final task.
quest_42083_quest_progress: [solemn] Be wary of the Draenei, they are a cunning foe.
quest_42083_quest_complete: <Starstrider inspects the Rod for faults and damage, his eyes gazing over it with caution.> [solemn] It seems we have been spared a travesty. [soft voice] As crude as those little creatures are it would seem they have the foresight to not destroy everything in their clutches.
quest_42084_quest_detail:
[solemn] To finalize our preparations we must now face our final task. [soft voice] To prepare the visage of our elder ancestors we must acquire a rare and enchanted material. In translation, it is known as Dragon Dust, the speckling, magical powder that can be found on the Blue Dragonkin and their ilk who have been blessed by powerful sorcery.

[pause] Are you prepared <name>? [commanding] This task will be our hardest, and will require considerable skill at arms, or the help of fellow adventurers. [solemn] If you wish to seek out the Blue Dragonflight, you can find them at Starshard Cradle to the north west.
quest_42084_quest_progress: [solemn] I suggest you prepare yourself, [low voice] this will be no easy task.
quest_42084_quest_complete:
[solemn] It has been a while since I have had my hands on such a rare material. [warm] You have done well, I have not expected this from a guest in our lands.

[soft voice] It would seem I have much to learn from outsiders such as yourself.
quest_42085_quest_detail: [solemn] Everything has been prepared, and I am certain the tribe is ready for the festival. [soft voice] It is time to bask in the wisdom of our ancestors, and behold their words. [pause] Once I have begun, I should not be disturbed. [commanding] Speak to me when the celebration has come to conclusion.
quest_42085_quest_complete:
[solemn] Our Ancestors have delivered us quite the omen, and yet I am unsure of what to make of it... Regardless, another festival has been concluded, and without your help, I would still be waiting for assistance from Moonhoof Village.

[warm] I must reward you for your generosity outsider. [gentle] Please, take this, on behalf of myself, and all of those in my tribe. [warm] May your travels be gentle, and the road ahead free from burden.
quest_42086_quest_detail:
Nendis.

Even after all these years, the name still lingers in my mind. [solemn] A place where the people of our kind once lived in quiet devotion to the forests and the moon.

[soft voice] When Illidan and his naga came to these shores, Nendis was among the first places to fall. [sad] The town burned in a single night. [pause] Those who were not slain fled into the wilds… and many never returned. [solemn] What remains now are only ruins. [sad] Broken homes. Collapsed towers. And memories scattered in the dust. [solemn] The naga infest the place these days. [threatening] They crawl through the streets where our people once walked.

[solemn] History deserves better than to be left in their coils.

[urgent] Go to the ruins of Nendis, to the south. [commanding] Search what remains of the town and recover what relics you can. [urgent] Letters, charms, fragments of old tools… anything that once belonged to those who lived there.

[commanding] Bring me thirty such mementos.
quest_42086_quest_progress: [soft voice] Take care while you search the ruins. [solemn] Even the smallest relic may hold a story worth remembering.
quest_42086_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah… yes.

<Talanis carefully lifts one of the objects you recovered, turning it slowly in the light.>
