A child’s carving knife. See the worn handle? Used for years. Passed from hand to hand, perhaps. And this… a moon pendant. The silverwork is crude, but earnest. Likely made by someone learning their craft.

<He exhales quietly.>

Thirty small pieces of a forgotten life. [solemn] That is what you have brought me. History is not only written in great battles and kings, you know. Sometimes it survives in the things ordinary people carried with them each day. [warm] Thank you for retrieving these, <class>. The naga may have taken the town, but they will not erase its memory.
quest_42087_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have done well recovering those relics from Nendis. [solemn] More than I hoped for, if I am honest. But there is another place nearby whose story troubles me far more.

[pause] To the east lies the Isle of Tyrandas. [low voice] In older texts it is called a place of quiet reflection. [solemn] Long before the great temples rose in our cities, priestesses of Elune once trained there. [pause] At its center stood the Temple of Elunaris. [solemn] A modest sanctuary by the standards of later ages, but deeply revered in its time. [soft voice] The priestesses who studied there were said to guard a sacred artifact, one touched by the moon’s light itself.

[solemn] The temple was abandoned long ago. [sad] Time and war saw to that. [solemn] Yet some of our oldest records insist the artifact was never removed. [soft voice] If it still rests within those ruins, it would be a relic of immense historical value… and perhaps spiritual importance as well.

[solemn] Travel to the Temple of Elunaris on the Isle of Tyrandas. [solemn] Search the sanctuary and discover what power still lingers there.
quest_42087_quest_progress: [solemn] Now, the maddened druids and their lackeys walk in these once sacred halls. [urgent] Be wary.
quest_42087_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So… it truly remained there all this time.

<Talanis studies the artifact in silence for a long moment.>

[solemn] Remarkable. The craftsmanship alone places it centuries before the founding of Zin-Azshari. And the lunar resonance… yes, I can feel it even now. [emphasis] This was no mere ceremonial piece. It was used. Studied. Revered. The priestesses of Elunaris must have trained beneath its light, learning to channel Elune’s blessing through it.

[warm] You have brought back more than a relic today. [proud] You have returned a fragment of our past that might otherwise have vanished with the temple itself.
quest_42088_quest_detail:
[solemn] The tauren of these lands have never been our enemies.

We keep our distance. They keep theirs. Sometimes we even trade. It is not friendship, but it is peace, and peace is rare enough in these times.

[sad] That is why this troubles me.

[urgent] A splinter group has taken refuge at An’she’s Respite to the south. They no longer answer to their chieftains, and they do not behave like the tauren we know.

[solemn] My sentinels approached them under banner of parley. Two of my sisters did not return.

Something has twisted them. Madness, corruption, or some darker influence. I do not yet know which. What I do know is this: they are attacking anyone who passes near their camp. [commanding] I will not allow that threat to remain at our doorstep.

[urgent] Travel to An’she’s Respite and cut them down before their violence spreads any further.
quest_42088_quest_progress: [solemn] Tauren are formidable opponents. [low voice] Their strength alone is enough to shatter shields and bones alike. [emphasis] Do not let their size fool you into thinking them slow.
quest_42088_quest_complete:
[solemn] So it is done.

I take no satisfaction in this. Still… if they had been left unchecked, more would have died. [urgent] We will keep watch on the rest of their tribes. If this corruption spreads, we will know. Until then, Narvalis Point remains secure. [soft voice] That is what matters.
quest_42089_quest_detail:
[solemn] The naga have infested the ruins of Nendis like parasites. Once it was a quiet settlement of our people. Now the streets are flooded with serpents loyal to the Betrayer. [threatening] Their warriors call themselves the Tideblade. [low voice] Veterans of the army Illidan unleashed when he first struck these shores.

We have skirmished with them for weeks, but they are persistent. For every naga we slay, two more seem to slither out of the surf. [urgent] If we are to weaken their presence here, we must thin their ranks directly.

[commanding] Go to the ruins of Nendis and hunt the Tideblade naga. Bring me thirty of their scales as proof of their deaths.
quest_42089_quest_progress: [commanding] Watch the water. [solemn] Naga favor ambush. They will wait beneath the surface until you step too close to the shore. More than one patrol has learned that lesson the hard way.
quest_42089_quest_complete:
[solemn] Thirty scales.

<She turns one over in her gauntleted hand, inspecting the deep green sheen.>

These belonged to seasoned warriors. [urgent] Killing this many will have been noticed among their ranks.

[soft voice] Good. Still… their true leaders remain. [commanding] And until they fall, the Tideblade will not abandon these ruins.
quest_42090_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven the naga can bleed. Now we make certain they cannot recover. Two commanders direct the Tideblade forces occupying Nendis. Veterans from the day Illidan’s armies burned the town to the ground.

[soft voice] Lady Serpentia. Lord Ta’jax.

They served as lieutenants during the assault. [solemn] It was their warbands that swept through the streets while the town burned. They have ruled the ruins ever since.

[urgent] If the Tideblade are to lose their hold here, those two must fall. [commanding] Without their leadership the naga will fracture into smaller broods, easier to drive back into the sea.

[solemn] The naga have ruled those ruins long enough.
quest_42090_quest_progress:
[solemn] Do not underestimate them.

[low voice] These two commanded armies during Illidan’s campaign. [solemn] They survived battles that slaughtered hundreds.

[solemn] Creatures like that do not fall easily.
quest_42090_quest_complete:
[solemn] Lady Serpentia… and Ta’jax as well.

<For the first time, Silverstreak allows herself a small, satisfied nod.>

[commanding] Good. Very good.

Without them, the Tideblade will splinter into rival broods. Naga are not known for unity when strong leaders are absent. [confident] That gives us the advantage. [warm] The ruins of Nendis may finally know peace again.

[solemn] The High Priestess should hear of it.
quest_42091_quest_detail:
Narvalis Point stands secure, thanks in no small part to your actions.

The naga presence in Nendis has been broken, and their commanders lie dead. For the first time since Illidan’s invasion, the ruins may finally be free of their grasp. Still, this victory belongs not only to my sentinels.

[solemn] The High Priestess must be informed.

Tyrande Whisperwind watches over all our people, and she should know what has been accomplished here. The fall of Illidan’s lieutenants is no small matter. [urgent] Travel to her and deliver this news.

Tell her the Tideblade are broken, and that Narvalis Point still stands vigilant.
quest_42092_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You have seen the crater to the west, yes? The one they call the Starshard Cradle.

[solemn] A most unfortunate name. [soft voice] Romantic, even. I assure you, there is nothing romantic about a rock falling from the heavens with enough force to crack the earth open.

[low voice] What interests me is not the crater itself, but what came after - blue dragons. [solemn] Not one or two passing through, but an entire brood circling the impact site as though it were a shrine. [soft voice] One of them in particular has drawn my attention.

[solemn] Starcaller. [pause] It patrols the skies above the crater and drives away anything that comes too close. [solemn] Adventurers. Scholars. Even the naga have learned to give it a wide berth.

Which leaves us with two possibilities.

[hesitant] Either the meteor drew the dragons here… Or the dragons themselves caused it to fall.

[sad] Neither answer sits comfortably with me.

[commanding] Slay the drake known as Starcaller at the Starshard Cradle. [solemn] With it gone, we may finally learn what the dragons are guarding there.
quest_42092_quest_progress:
[solemn] Starcaller will not fight like the creatures you are used to.

[soft voice] Blue dragons wield arcane power as easily as most people breathe. [urgent] Expect spells. [urgent] Expect sudden bursts of energy that turn the air itself against you.

[hesitant] And if the meteor truly empowers the creature…Then the fight may be more interesting than I anticipated.
quest_42092_quest_complete:
[solemn] Starcaller is dead?

Good. That removes the most immediate obstacle.

The blue dragonflight rarely commits to guarding something so aggressively unless it carries great arcane significance.

[soft voice] A meteor saturated with arcane energy… and dragons circling it like vultures.

[emphasis] Yes. There is definitely more to this crater than a simple rock from the sky. With that drake gone, perhaps the others will grow less bold. Or perhaps they will become curious enough to reveal what they were truly protecting.

Either way, you have given us an opportunity to learn the truth.

[confident] And I very much intend to take it.
quest_42093_quest_detail:
Narvalis Point may look quiet, but quiet places still need defenders. [solemn] Sentinels patrol these woods day and night. Most people see their glaives and forget the other half of their craft.

The bow. <Elendon lifts a bundle of unfinished arrows from his workbench.> Good arrows are not simple things. Straight shafts, balanced heads… and proper fletching. Without the right feathers, even the finest arrow will fly crooked. [soft voice] Normally we would import materials from deeper kaldorei lands, but supply lines to this coast are… unreliable.

[pause] Fortunately, the forests here offer an alternative. [gentle] Azureshimmer hippogryphs nest along the cliffs and high branches of the surrounding woods. Their feathers are light, strong, and remarkably stable in flight. [solemn] Perfect for sentinel arrows.

[commanding] I only need a handful. Gather twelve of their feathers and bring them to me. Do try not to harm more hippogryphs than necessary. They are proud creatures, and they have lived on this coast far longer than we have.
quest_42093_quest_progress: [soft voice] Take care when approaching the hippogryphs. [solemn] They are not hostile by nature, but they defend their nests fiercely. [urgent] If one takes flight above you, keep your eyes open. [emphasis] They strike from the air faster than most people expect.
quest_42093_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, excellent feathers.

<Elendon runs one of them between his fingers, testing its strength.>

See the structure along the spine? Flexible, but firm. That is exactly what we need. [warm] With these I can finish a proper batch of arrows. The sentinels will appreciate the difference the next time they loose a volley across the treeline.

[proud] You have my thanks, <class>.
quest_42094_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The wilds whisper to those who know how to listen.

Most hear the wind in the trees. The rustle of leaves. The quiet breath of the forest at rest.

[pause] And lately… the forest has been uneasy.

[solemn] To the south lies a place once known as the Grove of the Moon. [soft voice] A quiet sanctuary where druids studied the cycles of sleep, dreams, and the hidden paths of the Emerald Dream.

[sad] But those who dwell there now no longer follow Cenarius’ teachings.

[threatening] They call themselves the servants of the Moth.

[solemn] Strange rituals. Distorted dreams. [angry] They have begun shaping the wilds according to their own designs, ignoring the balance that has guided druids since the first teachings of Malorne’s son.

[solemn] Such arrogance always leads to ruin.

[urgent] Travel to the Grove of the Moon and thin their ranks. [commanding] End eight Druids of the Moth, eight Disciples of Lo’sho, eight Lucid Dream Protectors, and eight Lucid Dream Stalkers.

[solemn] Perhaps when enough of them fall, the rest will remember what it means to be druids.
quest_42094_quest_progress:
[solemn] Be wary when dealing with druids who have abandoned balance.[pause] They still wield the same powers we do. The Dream still answers them… though it should not.

[threatening] That alone makes them dangerous.
quest_42094_quest_complete:
[solemn] So the grove has been quieted… for now.

[soft voice] I hoped the corruption had not spread this far, but the signs are unmistakable. [solemn] These druids no longer serve the balance of the wilds. [pause] Something has guided them down this path.

[solemn] The Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas may hold answers. [pause] One of my allies tends the groves there.

[soft voice] Seek out Sister Mirallun. [soft voice] She watches the forest more closely than most. [soft voice] Tell her what you have seen.
quest_42095_quest_detail:
[solemn] If the corruption in the Grove of the Moon spreads further, we will face more than a handful of misguided druids.

We will face a wound in the wilds themselves.

[soft voice] Sister Mirallun watches over the Grove of the Sun on the Isle of Tyrandas. She is a child of the forest, born of the old woods, and her senses reach far deeper into the living world than ours.

[emphasis] If something is stirring within these lands, she will know.

[urgent] Travel to the Grove of the Sun and speak with her. [commanding] Tell her what you witnessed in the Grove of the Moon.
quest_42098_quest_detail: <name>, the Alliance has made great strides in securing grounds on the continent of Kalimdor, all thanks to the Bael Modan Garrison. [solemn] Our brethren are fighting everyday for their survival, while ensuring our archaelogists can continue their work in excavating the land for crucial artifacts of historical significance!
quest_42099_quest_detail: <name>, the vile and selfish dwarves have infiltrated our holy lands and began desecrating it! [angry] In their greed for knowledge they dug deep into the lands of the Earthmother and disrespected her sanctity. [solemn] We cannot let this stand.
quest_42100_quest_detail:
<class>, you might be just the person I need. [solemn] Today is the Day of Remembrance where the people of Stormwind pay reverence to Alonsus Faol, former Archbishop of the Northshire Abbey, by donating to the weak, elderly and any other unfortunate soul in the kingdom. [soft voice] I was on my way from Lakeshire, transporting the townfolk's selfless donations here to Stormwind, when a group of ghastly gnolls ransacked my wagon. [sad] All the clothes, food and toys were either damaged or completely ruined by them.

[sigh] With nothing to show, I grew desperate. [pause] But as if Archbishop Faol himself had listened to my anguish, my eyes had caught a shiny glimmer nearby. [emphasis] When I checked where it came from, I spotted a patch of clover, a clear sign of Faol's goodwill! [solemn] It is said whoever follows the path of clover will follow the path of the fortunate.

[gentle] Perhaps this is the solution to my dilemma. [warm] Will you offer your aid to the needy people of Stormwind?
quest_42100_quest_progress: [solemn] May the Light bestow guidance upon you, so that the poor be graced by its benevolence.
quest_42100_quest_complete:
[excited] Just what is this?! A crate filled to the brim with clothes, food, toys and the like? Where have you found this, good friend? Was it perhaps a miracle from Alonsus Faol himself, watching over his culvers from beyond the veil? Whatever it may be, we must thank the Light for showing us yet again that the selfless and righteous will not be left alone in darkness.

<name>, my eternal thanks to you. [solemn] Now, I should not waste any more time. The poor are waiting for me. Please take this from gracious gifts you have found, you more than deserve a reward yourself. [warm] May the Light bless your journey!
quest_42101_quest_detail:
Greetings, traveler. You may just be the right person for the predicament I am in. [solemn] While we thank the Earthmother every single day for the boons she has provided us, today is a special occasion. [solemn] All the tribes living in the promised land of Mulgore gather and contribute to a big feast on Thunder Bluff, where song and dance celebrate the abundance given to us by the Earthmother. [sad] Sadly, however, the wagon I was planning to transport the collected goods with has been pillaged by the local gnolls. [sad] All the clothes, food and instruments were completely ruined by them. [urgent] Now we're scrambling to get by with what we have left.

There is still a glimmer of hope, though. [soft voice] When I was perusing the village to see just what was left, in the corner of my eye I saw the faint image of a sprite running towards Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] When I took a second look however, all I could see was a patch of clover. <class>, I believe this to be a sign by the Earthmother. [proud] Follow the path of clover and we may yet save the feast.
quest_42101_quest_progress: Sprites of nature are said to be messengers of luck and fortune. [solemn] I am certain that is what I saw.
quest_42101_quest_complete:
[excited] An entire crate full of food, cloth and instruments?! How is this possible? Could this really be a blessing of the Earthmother? It must be! I can't believe we are this fortunate. [solemn] Proven again and again, she provides for her people and those that cherish her throughout their lives.

<name>, I have to thank you from the bottom of my heart. [warm] With your aid, we can yet organize and plan the feast in honor of her benevolence. Please, take this reward from the bounty you have brought us. You have more than deserved this reward. Go with the Earthmother's blessing, <name>.
quest_50000_quest_detail: [soft voice] Professor Malkovich is an old friend of mine. [pause] He told me to send him someone interested in anatomy.
quest_50002_quest_detail:
[solemn] Being an undead for so long has made me forget some things about human anatomy. [low voice] Since we have an annoying specimen in the room next to us, how about you get rid of him and bring me his head? [threatening] That way I can study it without him screaming. [urgent] Don't worry, he's already out of the cage.

[soft voice] By the way, I will show you how to disguise as a human if you bring me his head in good conditions.
quest_50002_quest_progress: [urgent] Come on! [angry] Bring me his head, I don't have all day.
quest_50002_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done well, his head is in perfect conditions. [soft voice] Come closer and I will show you how to disguise as a filthy human.

[urgent] Don't forget your class notes!
quest_50003_quest_detail: [soft voice] Professor Papucho is an old friend of mine. [pause] He told me to send him someone interested in anatomy.
quest_50004_quest_detail: Pssst… I've got a task for you, <class>. [whispering] Look behind me. I found this drunk orc spyin' around Ironforge and captured him, see? But I want to get a little “creative” with my payback. [commanding] Bring me his head in good condition and I'll show you somethin' very worth your while.
quest_50004_quest_progress: [urgent] What're you waitin' for? [angry] I ain't got all day, bub. [commanding] Bring me the drunk orc's head.
quest_50004_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ma always said, “Waste not, want not!”

[excited] I really took that to heart and started “repurposing” the creatures that I could get away with doppleganging as. [chuckling] Goblins, kobolds, troggs... things like that.

[mocking tone] What, you don't think I can look like this orc? [soft voice] Maybe I can't, but you definitely can.

[warm] There's a bunch of other disguises out in the world if you're crafty enough. [gentle] You just have to go and find 'em. 

[commanding] Take these notes with you, and good luck with your game of charades.
quest_50005_quest_detail:
[soft voice] This magic is potent, but without the proper mechanical understanding of locks, you won't be able to open the most difficult locks in this world...

[hesitant] Perhaps a talented rogue or master thief could help you with your dilemma. [solemn] Rumors tell of a haven for rogues, assassins, and black operatives holed away between the mountains in northern Hillsbrad Foothills. [low voice] No doubt such a service will not come cheap, however.
quest_50005_quest_complete: [low voice] I can't stand the smell of magic. [soft voice] I'm sure you understand that if I am to help you, I expect just compensation for my time and tolerance of that odor of sorcery about you. [commanding] Pay up and pay attention, that I may dismiss you with haste!
quest_50006_quest_detail: [soft voice] Do you remember Ol' Biggins? [pause] My friend who lives in the Ravenholdt Manor, hidden between the mountains in the northern part of Hillsbrad Foothills? [hesitant] He will help you again with your learnings in exchange of more gold.
quest_50006_quest_complete: [angry] You again!? That smell... [low voice] Pay me and I'll help you quickly, [urgent] I hope you don't come back!
quest_50305_quest_detail:
What now? Ah, it's you again. What eggs?

Oh, right. Tail lashers. So you want to cook something else besides eggs? I guess I can teach you something.

Do you know where the Southfury River ends its course? This is where you'll have to go. Why? I'm intending to heighten the stakes here, whelp! Get me those crocolisks' meat and I'll teach you how to cook it properly! You'll find them all over the river so you better get movin' right away!
quest_50305_quest_complete:
[commanding] Good.

Let me tell you one thing before you waste it in a feeble attempt of cooking it. [solemn] It's about the amount of spices that your meat gets ready, not about the amount of fire.

[pause] Well, fire is needed anyway…
quest_50310_quest_detail:
Ey, kid! [excited] Yes, you! I see you're an adventuring type and ready to jump into any fray if only there's one to jump into, right? Just as I thought. What? Of course there's a reward involved, how else could it be around here? It's a Mirage Raceway after all!

What to do? Oh, that's so simple, I'm sure that even a gnome would manage to test our jolly vehicle on the sustain for … errh, durability conditions! Yes! So, if you're ready to earn some coins and crack some scorpids flat then you're at the right spot, kid! What helmet? Instruction? Bah! Who needs'em anyway?!

Yes, you might want to talk to our charming Dolores to register for the test race, <name>.

[commanding] Let's blast it!
quest_50310_quest_progress: [excited] Ahhh, finally! [pause] I've been awaiting for this data... [warm] Many thanks, many thanks indeed.
quest_50310_quest_complete: [urgent] Data should be gathered and then processed. Do you realize how important it is for us? [warm] Good. Now then, see to it done!
quest_50311_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh, so nice you're alive and back in one piece! [warm] I had no doubts in you, of course.

[urgent] So you're ready for another run on our goblin engineering masterpiece, eh? [commanding] Well then if you know the drill you better get ready and take the first place yet again!
quest_50311_quest_progress: [excited] Ahhh, finally! [soft voice] I've been awaiting for this data... [warm] Many thanks, many thanks indeed.
quest_50311_quest_complete: [urgent] Data should be gathered and then processed. Do you realize how important it is for us? [excited] Good. Now then, see to it done!
quest_50312_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I am sure that you're very well aware of the fact about us, gnomes, we're the best inventors. [excited] Assuming you're striving to improve your skills and knowledge you will eventually be considered to study from us. [commanding] Obviously, no gnome is that stupid to decline this intriguing and exciting partnership, alas it might be costly sometimes.

[urgent] Speaking shorter; we need someone to compliment our natural resourcefulness of brain activity with their muscle and durability!

[proud] If you successfully ride this awesome masterpiece of gnomish engineering any other dimwit goblin would simply call a race car then you will be granted an opportunity to represent our bright society of inventors even further in Mirage Races!

[delight] Cool, right? [solemn] Well, here's the instructions we've specifically designed for other races for better understanding and comprehension.

[gentle] Yes, you might want to talk to our charming Dolores to register for the test race, <name>.

[warm] Good luck, sentient one!
quest_50312_quest_progress: [excited] Starts the engine, of course! [soft voice] Levers for stirring!
quest_50312_quest_complete: [angry] What helmet? Instruction? Bah! [shouting] Who needs'em anyway?!
quest_50313_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Salutations, sentient one! [excited] We're very much satisfied with the results you have achieved with the test drive for our mechanical engineering device and proved to be very useful for providing us so much needed data for analysis. [warm] We're ready to allow you continuous partial involvement with our research team and have agreed on supplying you for your efforts.

[urgent] When you're ready to proceed with data gathering be sure to remember the instructions provided and safety measures recommended.

[delight] Have a great day!
quest_50315_quest_detail: [excited] Come, come, get your copy of the latest issue of Gadgetzan Times! [urgent] Here you'll find out really breaking news!
quest_50316_quest_detail:
Hahahah! Did you see their faces?! [excited] Simply outstanding job, my friend!

[warm] Now now, no need to be shy, you did explicitly well and I'm sure you'll be able to do even better with race against time!

[soft voice] Pretty simple task. You hop in, press the accelerator and fly away to beat the best lap!

[urgent] Given you don't hit any sheep, lost your track or stopped whatsoever you'll be able to win!

[warm] Prize? Of course, there are some prizes, of course. Worry not.
quest_50316_quest_progress: [warm] Well done, my friend! [commanding] Be sure to come back when you're ready to repeat!
quest_50316_quest_complete: [soft voice] Pretty simple task. You hop in, press the accelerator and fly away to beat the best lap!
quest_50318_quest_detail:
[solemn] While it's great we all gather around finely decorated pine here there is a serious trouble coming up for all the wild creatures out there. [soft voice] As you know, the whole ecosystem we live within might be easily corrupted with some species out of the scene to do their part of work everyone is trying to uphold.

[pause] I'm talking about moonkins. [urgent] If you're still uninformed then it's crucial we have them saved. [shocked] What do you mean "how"?!? [urgent] Young moonkins will be freezing to death this winter if we don't do someth... [exhale] I know! [warm] Bring them our festive Egg Nog to make'em warm. [gentle] Hugs will also do but you bring them Egg Nog in the first place! [hesitant] Where you get it? [soft voice] Well, I'm sure there's a recipe we had somewhere nearby…
quest_50318_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you bring Egg Nog to moonkins yet?
quest_50318_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done! Now it's safe to say that we will endure!

[warm] Eat this, Greatfather Winter!
quest_50322_quest_progress: [solemn] The peace was never an option
quest_50323_quest_progress: [low voice] The peace was never an option
quest_50328_quest_detail:
[gentle] Hey there, pretty sweet cheeks! [excited] Wouldn't you like to have some real fun with jolly Holly right here, my dear? <laughs>

Of course you would, I can see that in your eyes right there. But … you do know that there's an ultimate intimate fun is about to follow, don't you? Good sweet brews and drinks!

Best way to have some jolly fun with Holly!

Now, drink up and do me … a good long sweety dance, my li'l marmelade! Haha!
quest_50330_quest_detail:
Gremm is a warrior. [solemn] Me task is protect. [urgent] Winter Veil Vale is in danger.

[angry] Big bad wolf is danger to the village. [urgent] He attacks every few days. <Greem shows you three fingers.>

[excited] You look like a hero! [warm] You can help! [urgent] Find more gud warriors! [commanding] Attack Snowball while he sleep! [whispering] He's down there.
quest_50330_quest_progress: [urgent] Attack Snowball while he sleep! [whispering] He's down there.
quest_50330_quest_complete: [excited] You have done it! [warm] Well done! [proud] Me respect and thank you!
quest_50331_quest_progress: [solemn] The peace was never an option
quest_50332_quest_progress: [solemn] The peace was never an option
quest_55002_quest_detail: I need you to do me a favor. [commanding] This crate of trade goods needs to reach Tradesman Laz in Sparkwater Port. [soft voice] I'd deliver it myself but my good are needed here. [solemn] I won't leave Razor Hill unsupplied. [urgent] Sparkwater is to the north east, after you exit the canyon just take a right and reach for the shore. [emphasis] You can't miss it.
quest_55019_quest_detail:
[solemn] My brother has recently been dispatched out to the far reaches of our strength and posted within the encampment of Stonard.

It's not for me to question the Warchief's desires but I still do worry for my bother's safety out there, even if he is strong and good of health.

It has been months since we have last seen one another with all of the deployments, from one to the next, and now the Swamp of Sorrows of all places?

The only thing that has me at peace is that he had been promoted to a position of some power within the garrison there.

It's good knowing that maybe he is not on the very frontlines and is instead commanding his men.

It's an odd thing to watch a younger brother become more important then you but, well, duty calls and we must all do our part.

[urgent] Please find Zuul within Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows and deliver him this letter.
quest_55019_quest_progress: [soft voice] Why hello there, stranger, what brings you to Stonard?
quest_55019_quest_complete: [commanding] You're looking for Zuul? [pause] Well that would be me, [excited] what's this?
quest_55020_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Well, this is a little embarrassing, it seems my embellishments might have gotten to the wrong hands and led before me.

[sad] I've always wanted to be more of a success in my brother's eyes, and whilst he has made a good living as a trader, I've served Orgrimmar for years only to remain a Grunt.

<Zuul sighs.>

[solemn] I suppose I should come clean, it is honor that dictates I be honest, especially with those of my own kin.

[defiant] Lying to try and make appearances is what Alliance diplomats would do, not the sons of Durotar.

[sad] As much as I desire to go and apologize in person, I cannot. [urgent] I have too many tasks to do in such a short time.

[commanding] Speak to my commander and let him know I desire leave to Durotar for a short time.
quest_55020_quest_progress: [solemn] He is located within the large building in the encampment.
quest_55020_quest_complete: [commanding] What is it you require from Commander Ruag? [low voice] It had better be important.
quest_55021_quest_detail:
[commanding] So, Zuul sent you? He wants to leave Stonard, that's it?

Heh, well I'll make you a deal <race>. Zuul has been an obedient grunt, one that listens well and does well when called upon, it's the only reason I'm offering this. You do a task for me, and I'll give him leave for a few days.

[solemn] The local wildlife has been a continuous thorn in our side. There is no other presence than the large beasts that dwell within the shadows beyond the light of our torches.

[angry] I've had orcs go missing and not turn up late at night, and there is no doubt in my mind that the beasts outside our walls are responsible.

[urgent] Clear out the area outside our walls of what you find: jaguars, spiders and crocolisks. Make sure to thin their numbers.
quest_55021_quest_progress: [solemn] The Swamp has earned its name, has it not?
quest_55021_quest_complete: [solemn] It seems you've done well, [warm] I'll be pleased to have fewer orcs go missing.
quest_55022_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ahh... Fine, I'll put in the work to have Zuul dispatched, I cannot hold the title of Commander without honoring my word.

[solemn] Tell Zuul that he will have three days leave to Orgrimmar, on the fourth day I will make arrangements for him to return to Stonard.

[commanding] Advise him to make good use of these three days.
quest_55022_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you heard word from my brother?
quest_55022_quest_complete:
[excited] Really? I didn't actually expect the chance to go.

[warm] This means a lot to me, it's the chance to correct wrongs and make rights.

[solemn] I realize that there should be no competition between brothers and getting this note only serves to remind me that we should be proud of who we are.
quest_55023_quest_detail:
[solemn] There is one last thing I require from you, friend, if you could but be of help a moment longer.

[soft voice] I still may be here for a while longer waiting for my leave. [gentle] If you could take this letter from me and deliver it to my brother letting him know I will be arriving soon, it would mean quite a lot to me.

[warm] Thanks again, friend, Blood and Honor.
quest_55023_quest_progress: [hesitant] I wonder if my message reached him. [soft voice] I hope I get to see him soon...
quest_55023_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Oh, a letter?

<Rugnar begins to read intently.>

Well, this is unexpected news, I must offer my thanks for everything you've done. [warm] The last thing I expected was a letter back so quickly. [warm] Take this, for all of the troubles.
quest_55025_quest_detail:
[low voice] I'm losing my mind down here. [urgent] We've been told to stay a bit under the roof for a while after the old Brightwater took a few cannonballs to the side.

[groan] Been forced to stay in refuge for a few days now and I'm going loopy! [sigh] Aaah, if only there was a way to get some booze... [excited] Wait a second, you can get booze.

[urgent] Since we can't, make a trip up to The Salty Sailor and get me the following... [commanding] Ahem... 5 Jugs of Bourbon
3 Flagons of Mead
10 Flasks of Port
...and 10 Cherry Grogs!
quest_55025_quest_progress: [urgent] Get the booze yet? [shouting] We're dying down here!
quest_55025_quest_complete: [excited] Ahh! It's been a dang while since I've been able to drink! [warm] You've surely saved us.
quest_55026_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something that I can help you with?
quest_55026_quest_complete:
[commanding] Yes? Oh.... [angry] HE sent you?

Fool was oh so eager to offer his assistance to the Horde for coin. He underestimated the pirates in the area and got himself sank.

Now he wants to call in a favor from an age past, hah. [urgent] Let's get this over with.
quest_55027_quest_detail:
[commanding] Before I give you the information I have, I want something in return. [low voice] I'll honor that "favor" that he is calling it, but I need something done.

[urgent] The Venture Co. has been causing some issues around here, mostly in taking up my trade and getting some of it for themselves. [whispering] That's where I need you to come in and be discreet.

[commanding] They've been messing with some of my operations, and I want to mess with some of their own, in secrecy of course.

[urgent] Travel far to the north-east by Lake Nazferiti. [soft voice] I've got it from reliable sources that they are setting up an oil platform there, [emphasis] kill some of the Mechanics they contracted to work on it. [cold] That should cost them a lot of time and money.
quest_55027_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you thrown a wrench in their plans?
quest_55027_quest_complete: [commanding] They've been putting their hands on things that don't rightfully belong to them, it's time they paid the price, and a price they cannot link to me.
quest_55028_quest_detail:
[low voice] Fine, let's fulfill this favor and move along. There are many more profitable and useful things we can both spend our time on.

The crew of the Brightwater has been here the entire time, and I've known about it since the first night they showed up after that fireworks show of a battle.

[mocking tone] They haven't exactly done the best job of disguising who or what they are. That, and my contacts are very reliable.

You'll find them on the lower levels of Booty Bay, where Wigcik stays.

[commanding] When you next see "Captain" Pazzle, tell him I've honored his silly favor.
quest_55028_quest_complete: [low voice] Look bud, we don't got any spare copper already, so beat it.
quest_55029_quest_detail:
[urgent] Oh the Captain sent you? Well isn't that a relief, it's been almost a week that we've been sitting around here with no word.

I was about to start figuring out a way to get out of Booty Bay, but it seems like the only thing keeping us safe are the Bruisers.

[angry] The Bloodsail Buccaneers have been wanting us dead ever since we sunk one of their ships in a battle. Lets just say they got lucky and ambushed us near Grom'gol!

They want us all gone and won't stop until we are, it seems.

[soft voice] The Bloodsails are a disorganized bunch, and not centrally commanded. Each encampment or ship has their own crew and their own leader, and this group hunting us is only doing so because we killed the man's brother.

[solemn] If anyone knows anything, it's Revilgaz.
quest_55029_quest_complete: [angry] Not you again, don't tell me Pazzle is coming back to ask for something else.
quest_55030_quest_detail:
[urgent] Pazzle and his crew really have gotten themselves into a jam, but if it means you're going to be bothering those goons known as the Bloodsail Buccaneers then I'm all for helping!

[commanding] I got many leads on them, but I wouldn't entirely know who's heading up a hunt for the remains of the Brightwater crew.

[solemn] That being said, I know someone who might know. [low voice] Outside of Booty Bay is an informant I've known for quite a while, I kicked them out of the city for being affiliated with the buccaneers.

[threatening] I saved their head, they owe me, if they know whats good for em. [urgent] Find that Bloodsail Traitor, tell them Revilgaz is asking.

[commanding] Once you got that information, tell the Brightwater crew, they can do what they want with it.
quest_55030_quest_progress: [hesitant] So... Did you figure anything out?
quest_55030_quest_complete: [excited] Well, ain't that a relief! [delight] I thought finding who was hunting us was going to be like finding a drop of water in the ocean, but here we are!
quest_55031_quest_detail:
[urgent] There's only one camp near that location and it's gotta be where this Captain Salt Tooth is at, then!

[commanding] If we're ever gonna have a shot at getting out of this town, well then he's gotta go! [confident] So, you're going to help then, right?

Head up north near the Gurubashi Arena, there is a camp of Bloodsail just south of it, off the road to the west. [commanding] Find and kill Captain Salt Tooth there, bring me his head so I know this is done. [urgent] Oh, and bring some friends, he's sure to have quite the crew!
quest_55031_quest_progress: [panting] Having a hard time finding him? [angry] You're telling me.
quest_55031_quest_complete: <The goblin stares at the head of the orc.> [excited] Wow, it must have taken a small army to take down Salt Tooth. [warm] Either that, or you are much stronger then I thought!
quest_55050_quest_detail:
<Little Grizlik presses his knuckle to his chest.> Lok'tar, <race>! [commanding] I'm Grizlik, son of the Horde and future warrior of Orgrimmar!

<The child flexes his scrawny arms, he almost seems cute.>

[laughing] Hey, don't laugh at me! [excited] Come on, I've got a long way to go but the matron says if I put my mind to it, I too will have a big axe like the High Overlord, or who knows maybe shoot lightning like the Warchief!

<Grizlik mimics a spell with his hands.>

[laughing] Pew, pew! [soft voice] Anyway, you seem like a boring elder, you won't play with me, right? [hesitant] Can I ask you for a favour? [warm] Please take this to Torm Ragetotem in Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] When he was here last time, he brought us toys and taught me how to use a wooden axe!

[urgent] Take Squeaks with you too, he wants to see Thunder Bluff. [soft voice] You can keep him, he's more the adventuring type anyway. [sad] I'd be sad to keep him around forever if he wants to see the world!
quest_55050_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, how unexpected. Young Grizlik had sent me a drawing of us training together, including a thank you message.

He aspires to be trained when he grows older. The future generation of the horde, <name>. [proud] That's why we are all here.
quest_55051_quest_detail:
[delight] I can't believe it's finally over, heh. [laughing] No more sitting around in the this basement and getting drunk off cheap liquor, now I can sit around on a beach with the expensive stuff as celebration!

[warm] It's been a real pleasure <name> and we couldn't have done it without you.

[urgent] Head to Sparkwater Port, let the Captain know that we're going to be on our way back when we can organize a ship to get us there. [excited] He should be sure to give you some sort of a reward for helping us out, surely.
quest_55200_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello there friend! Have you seen the world? Have you explored all of the nooks and crannies of Azeroth and truly taken in its beauty?

[gentle] I don't think any soul has, but the very prospect of it is enticing, no?

[warm] I am preparing for a trip to see the world and I still need supplies, one of which, is torches.

The oozes to the north around Ironbeard's Tomb have been something I've used in the past as a sort of tar to light my torches with. [commanding] Get me 5 Sticky Ooze-Tar from those oozes, and 5 Simple Wood from any trade vendor.
quest_55200_quest_progress: [soft voice] Have you had a chance to gather the materials for my adventure?
quest_55200_quest_complete: [excited] Quicker than I had imagined! [warm] You must be a seasoned explorer. [soft voice] Hopefully one day I will see as much as you have. [warm] Thanks, <name>.
quest_55201_quest_detail:
[solemn] The ground connection to Menethil harbor has been severed ever since raptors have moved in and claimed it as their territory.

[pause] We haven't had the man power to press them back and as a result we are now stuck up here.

[urgent] Head down to the base of the mountain and kill the raptors there. [commanding] Collect for me 5 of their talons as proof.
quest_55201_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you slain some of the beasts blocking our path?
quest_55201_quest_complete: [soft voice] Less raptors stalking at the base of our hills puts my mind to rest. [warm] Thanks for the work, <name>.
quest_55202_quest_detail:
[commanding] Well met, <race>! Say, you wouldn't happen to be headin' near Dun Agrath, would ya? It's down south east in the mountains near Hawk's Vigil.

Let's just say I lost a bet to me cousin Barltok, and it ain't in a dwarf's nature to leave a debt unpaid. [soft voice] Deliver this keg of my newest homebrew, and, if he's feelin' generous, he might make it worth your while.
quest_55202_quest_progress: [low voice] Aye, is there something you need?
quest_55202_quest_complete:
Cousin Hargin finally coughin up the good stuff, aye?! [excited] Well, it's about damn time! [urgent] If this stuff is as good as he says it may not last the night! [warm] For your troubles...

<Hands over some coins.>

[gentle] If you're lookin for more ways to make some coin, talk to Samuel in Hawk's Vigil. [confident] He's an adventurer of sorts and could likely use a hand.
quest_55203_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pinch, you see? The path between here and Menethil Harbor has remained fairly blocked up for quite a while now, and I gotta get this shipment to there soon.

Menethil's Harbor has requested more lumber for repairs of their dockyard and we happen to be the closest lumber mill.

I have no doubt if they don't get their lumber soon they will turn to someone else for wood.

[urgent] If you could do me a favor, and take this shipment down toward Menethil Harbor and deliver it to James Halloran, it would mean the world to me, and keep us in good business!
quest_55203_quest_progress: [urgent] Yes, do you have anything for me? [soft voice] I am currently quite busy.
quest_55203_quest_complete: [low voice] I figured the shipment would come late. [pause] Given all of the trouble on the road east of here, it seems Hawk's Vigil has remained reliable in their shipments.
quest_55204_quest_detail:
[commanding] You there, I need a report ran to my fellow Captain up in Dun Agrath up in the mountains to the south. [urgent] You look capable of delivering a message.

[solemn] This is of utmost importance, it is urgent and about the matters of trade, commerce and travel through the region of the Wetlands. [urgent] Take this to him, and with urgency, <class>.
quest_55204_quest_progress: [solemn] We must keep resolute, though we are in the mountains, we are still dependant to those on the ground to keep supplies moving.
quest_55204_quest_complete:
[soft voice] From Captain Stoutfist, huh? [pause] Let's see here...

<The Dwarf reads the report.>

[mocking tone] He thinks the few mountaineers I have can stop the Dragonmaw?
quest_55205_quest_detail:
[solemn] What he is asking would leave us defenseless in the mountains...

[soft voice] You will have to take this report to him, and let him know of our situation. [sad] It grieves me to leave him empty handed, but I must do so to ensure the people's safety up here.
quest_55205_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got word from Snowbeard? [urgent] Are fresh men coming?
quest_55205_quest_complete:
[angry] He cannot even lend a single hand to assist us? [sad] What is it then we are supposed to do against the Dragonmaw?...

[pause] Thanks, <name>. [warm] Take these coins for the trouble. I will have to think of a new plan.
quest_55206_quest_detail:
[solemn] It seems that I cannot rely on the help of Ironforge or even our close allies. [urgent] I must ask you, adventurer, to assist in cleaning out the Dragonmaw menace that stalks the highlands and raids our caravans.

[angry] They have been an annoyance for as long as we have been here and they must be halted lest they gain a larger foothold.

[commanding] Head to Angerfang Encampment to the east, and slay them.
quest_55206_quest_progress: [solemn] The Dragonmaw must be checked at every instance, lest they gain more courage in their actions.
quest_55206_quest_complete:
[excited] You've done it!

[warm] We may finally sleep a night of peace knowing there are less of the blackbloods stalking the hills and preying upon our citizens. [proud] You have done a noble deed, <name>.
quest_55207_quest_detail:
[excited] Oh, that pie! It waters in my mouth, and it is so good! [delight] I recently took a trip down to Hawk's Vigil, and had some of Heidi's wonderous pie!

[commanding] I demand more, and you're going to be the one to get it for me!

[urgent] Head to Hawk's Vigil and talk to Innkeeper Heidi. [warm] She's a good person with a talent for baked goods.
quest_55207_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, traveler. [warm] Welcome to my inn!
quest_55207_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, Rann sent you? [warm] Surely, he didn't just ramble on about my pie!
quest_55208_quest_detail:
[solemn] That Rann was obsessed with my pie. [soft voice] He ate more then I could even imagine when he made his trip up here. [warm] I am beyond flattered to think my cooking is that wonderful to someone.

[gentle] If you could bring this to him, and fulfill his wish, it would be appreciated.

[warm] It might even mean he will come back some day to try more!
quest_55208_quest_progress: [urgent] You're back this soon? [angry] You better have my pie!
quest_55208_quest_complete:
[excited] Pie pie pie! [delight] My, oh my!

[excited] I've been dreaming of this for days!
quest_55209_quest_detail:
[excited] Howdy! We don't get many visitors around these parts, especially with all of the mean and lurky things that are all around us!

Still, it's good to see a friendly faced stranger. [warm] I got a friend out in Hawk's Vigil who I worked with in the past during the Third War.

We used to trade all manner of our new findings with one another, and I think I just figured out all sorts of crazy gizmos!

Do me a favor and take my new schematics over to him, if you can.
quest_55209_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh, are you here for something, or you just looking to chat about some of my new inventions?
quest_55209_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, that Fradd. Look at all these new gadgets and gizmos! [laughing] Wizzing Fraddbangers, Shocking Gynochroms, Tilting Oscillation Inhibitors?!

[proud] This is all state of the art stuff, thanks for the delivery, take this for the trip.
quest_55210_quest_detail:
[urgent] This stuff is off the charts, especially this Tilting Oscilation Inhibitor!

[excited] The requirements for it are incredibly peculiar, but I must have it!

[commanding] If you could get me the required materials in order to engineer this bad boy, then I would be willing to incorporate one into an item for you.

[soft voice] Here, I wrote the materials down for you. [urgent] Gather what I need and bring them back. [excited] They should be enough quanity to craft two of them!
quest_55210_quest_progress:
[urgent] Have you gathered the materials?!

[excited] My mind is going wild with ideas!
quest_55210_quest_complete:
[excited] You've got it all?

Splendid! Now I can get to work tinkering for you so that I can get to use my own!
quest_55211_quest_detail:
Now, then. [excited] I'll get started on my next, greatest creation! It shouldn't take too long, just stand back, and keep a good distance so you don't get hurt!

[commanding] Good engineering does require a bit of danger, after all.
quest_55211_quest_progress: [low voice] One moment, lad. [urgent] I'm tinkering!
quest_55211_quest_complete:
[excited] Here it is, my creation!

[proud] An engineering masterpiece.

[warm] May it serve you well out there, now, on to my own works!
quest_55212_quest_detail:
[solemn] Back during the third war I was renowned engineer. I did field repairs on flying machines, and all other contraptions. Some say that these inventions are simply gnomish in design, but blast 'em!

[angry] I always put my own twists on them for extra sturdiness and to be able to handle a dwarf!

[proud] I'm one of the big engineers here in Hawk's Vigil, but I'm sort of running low on supplies to tinker with. [urgent] I know those fellows up the cliff from here at the Ironforge Airport have tons just laying around.

Head up there, and find my friend Orion Coalborn. He should have some extra supplies he'd be willing to give me!
quest_55212_quest_progress: [commanding] Welcome to the Airfield! [urgent] Do you have any business with the senate, or our operations here?
quest_55212_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, Barthos sent you? [low voice] He's always looking for supplies. [warm] He's lucky to have saved my hide in the past. [proud] I still owe him for that!
quest_55213_quest_detail:
[low voice] The senate is going to be breathing down my neck if they look into all these missing supplies. [hesitant] But, I cannot just leave Barthos hanging...

Here, this is what I can spare. [warm] This crate should have enough to last him for a while.

[confident] When you see him again, tell him that he can always come work up here. [urgent] We need the engineers.
quest_55213_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got those parts from the Airfield I sent you for?
quest_55213_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, Orion! What a friend, he always comes in clutch right at the perfect time!

[urgent] I was on my last few sputtercogs! [angry] What do you mean by job at Ironforge Airport?

[shouting] Why would I want to do that when I can tinker here in my own shop!
quest_55215_quest_detail:
[solemn] Upon first glance Hawk's Vigil may look as if it is the perfect haven to settle, the hills are lush, and the grass is a bright green.

[soft voice] Though, do not let this visage fool you, there are foul deeds going on beneath our very eyes, a taint of magic that has been sensed by some of our most adept.

[low voice] We have had murder within our Vigil, and still this growing darkness lingers. [solemn] Marge Blackwood has taken it upon herself to study and look into these findings of a magical taint and I would like to get to the bottom of this.

[urgent] Report to her, and see if you can assist in getting to the bottom of this mystery.

[soft voice] Marge can be found within the manor to the north east.
quest_55215_quest_progress: [soft voice] Is there something I can do for you?
quest_55215_quest_complete: [solemn] I have spent quite some time researching into what is going on, [pause] something lingers within the air, as if the presence of forbidden magic is being introduced to Hawk's Vigil.
quest_55216_quest_detail: [solemn] My research is ever continuing, though the mystery still remains at foot, [soft voice] my friend and associate Poppy Zabini is also a mage within the region.
quest_55217_quest_detail:
[solemn] The dark magic within Hawk's Vigil has seemingly appeared out of nowhere, its presence went undetected by myself and my kin for quite a while.

Or at the least has only cropped up at the last few weeks at a level where many, like myself and Marge, would have come to notice it.

I am under the belief that either a dormant force has been slowly gaining power for some time, or that perhaps something, or some one, has recently come to Hawk's Vigil with such potency.

[soft voice] I wish you luck in finding what is causing the tainting darkness, I sensed something similar before the third war and do not wish to re-live the experience. [hesitant] Tell Marge what little I know, it may be of assistance.
quest_55217_quest_progress: [soft voice] You return from Poppy Zabini?
quest_55217_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Hmm.. So he believes that perhaps this source could be new to the region?

[hesitant] I haven't thought of that as a possibility.
quest_55218_quest_detail:
[soft voice] So, Zabini may be on to something actually, in all my research I have been unable to locate the source of this magic, whoever has been using it seems to know their craft.

[solemn] But, there may be a clue in the information he has provided.

[low voice] Lord Commander Ryke knows all the coming's and going's of Hawk's Vigil, and more precisely who is new to the town.

[urgent] If someone has come in the last few weeks, then perhaps we can look to them as a potential source of this darkness, or at the least, investigate it.
quest_55218_quest_progress: [commanding] Welcome back, has Marge got any news on all of the trouble?
quest_55218_quest_complete: [commanding] Interesting report, let me check my records and make sure about the new people within the town.
quest_55219_quest_detail:
<Lord Commander Ryke finishes looking over his records> [solemn] So, it seems that we have had someone recently move into the town, though he hails from the city of Stormwind, Harlus Ashbuckle.

It would be out of my jurisdiction to press, being that this individual has... Complications.

[whispering] He is currently being investigated by the SI:7, I only tell you this because of our investigation, but we have an operative in the town keeping tabs upon him.

[urgent] Meet up with him, he goes by the name of Robb Dursley, he can usually be found near the town center.

[soft voice] See if you can get any information on this Harlus character.
quest_55219_quest_progress: [hesitant] What would Lord Commander Ryke have to do with me?
quest_55219_quest_complete:
[hesitant] Oh...

<Robb Dursley's cheerful demeanor drops.>

That is why you've come?

[whispering] What we are going to speak of must remain a secret, understood, <name>?
quest_55220_quest_detail:
[solemn] The operations of the SI:7 are secretive in nature, and this must remain as such.

[low voice] If Lord Commander Ryke's suspicions be true, then it means Harlus Ashbuckle would be breaking vow he has sworn to nobility within Stormwind.

[soft voice] Of course, that same nobility having gotten him out of the Stormwind Stockade when the man was wanted for crimes of practicing forbidden magic, and murder both.

[hesitant] As much as I have my dislike for the House of Nobles I do what I am told.

[urgent] Take my report with my findings to Master Mathias Shaw, leader of the SI:7 within Stormwind in Old Town.

[commanding] Keep them sealed, should the seal be broken, don't show yourself to him, or myself again.
quest_55220_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it you require from the SI:7?
quest_55220_quest_complete: <Mathias takes the Report and begins to read.> [solemn] Hmm, I suspected as much, the man was deranged and lost within such magic, it only makes sense he would be behind this 'foul taint' as Lord Commander Ryke has described it.
quest_55221_quest_detail:
Ahh yes... I had only figured a report from Robb would eventually lead back to this man. [solemn] You may know him as Harlus Ashbuckle, but in truth that is nothing more than a false identity. [soft voice] The man you're gathering information on is actually Martin Corinth, who hails from Lordaeron. [low voice] He escaped south to Stormwind during the Third War and was recently let free from imprisonment.

[pause] A noble recently delayed Corinth's execution through a deal; he was to swear off his magics and be sent to exile. [solemn] I kept a close eye on him, knowing just how much potential power he had within the dark arts.

[commanding] I would like to tie up some loose ends before simply having the man killed for his practices. [urgent] I wish to figure out who else may be behind all of this forbidden magic and what noble set him free.

[solemn] The Stockades has recently been overrun, but it is the last location that holds information valuable to this Martin Corinth. [commanding] Go there, and find it.
quest_55221_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you braved the depths of the Stockades yet?
quest_55221_quest_complete: [commanding] Excellent. Now, let us see truly where this man is from. [solemn] Perhaps we can find some clues on all of this.
quest_55222_quest_detail:
[solemn] It would seem the Corinth family once held quite a few connections with both Lordaeron and the Stormwind Nobles.

[sad] All of them have died but Martin still remained, and fled to Stormwind after the war. [soft voice] According to some of these documents as part of his exile he was intending on heading to Menethil Harbor to settle there, [pause] we know this is not the case, but perhaps he had left something for us to find.

[urgent] Speak with the innkeeper in Menethil Harbor, ask if they had seen Martin Corinth or Harlus Ashbuckle.
quest_55222_quest_progress: [commanding] Hello, and welcome to my tavern, [warm] looking for a room?
quest_55222_quest_complete: [soft voice] Oh, I haven't heard the name Martin Corinth before, but I do remember a Harlus Ashbuckle, what about them?
quest_55223_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Yes, he stayed here for a few days infact, had a room the entire time!

The man was quite nice from what I recall, kept to his lonesome, drank a bit of ale, seemed a bit down though.

He did have a lot of mail back and forth that I delivered to him with his daily supper.

If you're looking for some of his personal affects then I can't be of that much help, I only recently cleared out what little he had.

Man said he was taking a small trip and hasn't showed up in weeks, I figured he wasn't coming back, so I tossed his stuff out to the side of the Tavern.

[pause] If you're looking for something, check there, if it's not gone already.
quest_55223_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you got any news from Menethil?
quest_55223_quest_complete: [soft voice] Hmm, so, he did leave stuff within Menethil, [pause] it seems the man didn't cover all of his tracks, thankfully for us.
quest_55224_quest_detail:
[solemn] Duke Ramon, well that certainly connects a lot of loose ends that we had here, at the least many of our agents can be pulled off other investigations thanks to this bit of detective work.

[soft voice] I prepared this letter to be taken to Lord Commander Ryke back at Hawk's Vigil, it should contain all of the information he should need to bring justice to this man.

[hesitant] As for the House of Nobles, we shall continue our investigations, as of now it seems like this may just have been a Nobleman helping out a family friend and keeping them above the law, let us hope it is just that.
quest_55224_quest_progress: [commanding] So, you've returned, [soft voice] good news from Stormwind?
quest_55224_quest_complete: [solemn] So, our suspicions here were correct then, there is a lot of information here that is damning.
quest_55225_quest_detail:
[solemn] The town of Hawk's Vigil came here to retreat from the looming darkness of Lordaeron, and we will not be forced to retreat from here as well.

[urgent] Many of the citizens have come to make a good life for themselves and one man will not stop us now.

[commanding] Mathias Shaw has told me stories of corruption, of villainy, of pure evil, it is up to you to bring justice to the man Harlus Ashbuckle, or so he goes by.

[emphasis] Kill him, and rid our lands of his taint once and for all before untold evil can be done in these lands.
quest_55225_quest_progress: [solemn] Has this monster been dealt with?
quest_55225_quest_complete:
[excited] The town has been saved! [warm] I thank you again <name>. [solemn] Hawk's Vigil shall remain a place of peace as long as brave souls like yourself walk Azeroth.

[warm] Here, take one of these as a token of the town's gratitude.
quest_55300_quest_progress:
[commanding] For the gauntlets plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

[soft voice] Are you alright, sonny? [gentle] Yer getting' all red.
quest_55300_quest_complete: [soft voice] Not only those be comfy, mind you, [warm] it's also a style. [solemn] Of course, they do provide protection too.
quest_60010_quest_detail:
[urgent] Hey, <race>, down here! [soft voice] If you have some spare time, I could really use your help.

You see, there's this kodo in Un'Goro Crater, their name is Dadanga. [hesitant] I've heard that they give you a gift if you feed them bloodpetals. [excited] It sounds like this gift could have a nice surprise in it, and I love surprises!

[giggle] Anyways, these bloodpetal sprouts are found all over the crater, and I'd love to get my hands on some. [confident] Bring me 30 Bloodpetal Sprouts and I'll pay you. [warm] I'll even give you something I cooked from one of my original recipes!
quest_60010_quest_progress: [soft voice] Didja get the flowers? [hesitant] I sure hope Dadanga gives me the recipe for the elixir soon. [sad] Almost out of money...
quest_60010_quest_complete:
[excited] Hey, there we are! [delight] Thanks! [warm] As promised, some money, and some pizza bottles!

[excited] Oh, I didn't mention those?
quest_60020_quest_detail:
Ishnu'alah, <class>. [solemn] Not long ago, a group of Sentinels was finally driving the Naga away from Solarsal. [sad] Unfortunately, that caught the attention of one of their champions and once she joined the fray they were quickly pushed back by her magic. [urgent] Please, find and kill this Sea Witch. [commanding] She can not be allowed to scour Solarsal of its arcane secrets and become stronger.

[solemn] The last we saw of her, she was heading towards the ruined temple located in the hill near the tallest tower.
quest_60020_quest_progress: [solemn] If the Naga successfully obtain the [low voice] knowledge scattered in that place, no force will drive them out.
quest_60020_quest_complete:
[delight] Thank you, <race>!

[solemn] That cursed Sea Witch has been driving back our Sentinels time and again, [urgent] without her direction they will be easier to defeat.
quest_60030_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60031_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60032_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60033_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60034_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60035_quest_progress: [excited] I can tell just by looking at you that you, my friend, have an eye for FASHION! [commanding] Don't try to hide it: I can see it in your bold attire, undeterred by the scoffs of the unenlightened philistines.
quest_60036_quest_progress: [excited] Have I got a FABULOUS deal for you today!
quest_60042_quest_detail:
[excited] At last, they sent aid!

[solemn] There's a large camp full of gnolls led by a mighty gnoll known all over Elwynn as Fedfennel. [soft voice] Rumor has it he's been eaten by his own rivals... I digress. [urgent] The camp is further up to the north, past Stone Cairn Lake.

[whispering] It's tucked away in a distant corner that the guards don't patrol, so the gnolls run rampant out there. [commanding] Do us all a favor and wipe out a full brigade of them and we'll have at least a week of sound sleep.
quest_60042_quest_progress: [soft voice] I hope you have some good news for me, <name>!
quest_60042_quest_complete:
[shocked] You did what? All by yourself?

[excited] Well, that's great news! [warm] Hopefully those gnolls won't cause us trouble from now on.

[hesitant] How did you know? Did Terry commission you? [soft voice] No matter, please take this as a reward for your trouble.
quest_60050_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Hey... uhm, excuse me! [excited] I have a request for you!

Hah, I said it! It makes me so nervous to approach people leaving the abbey, but it's the only way I can possibly get my wish fulfilled.

[soft voice] Oh! The request, of course! You see, I love to visit Stormwind City and see my friend Suzetta at the Gallina Winery, and I always walk past the fountain in the Trade District. You know, the one next to the bank!

[urgent] If you're heading towards the city, could you toss this coin into the fountain... [soft voice] For good luck? [excited] I've heard that if you toss a coin in, your wish will come true. [warm] My wish is to visit Stormwind again as soon as possible!

[soft voice] Oh! And if you could, please send my greetings to Suzetta Gallina!
quest_60050_quest_progress: Greetings! [soft voice] Are you new here?
quest_60050_quest_complete: [delight] I am so happy to hear that Teresa is going to visit us!
quest_60060_quest_detail:
[solemn] Survival itself is not that hard if you know what to do. [soft voice] It is harder to survive when you have no food. [hesitant] Hunting? Yes, you could try that, alas, not always you have something to sustain you longer than just some primitive herbs before you catch something.

[solemn] I see you're pondering on the situation a bit harder than your normal hunters and trappers, so why don't you learn something for your own good and best chances to survive out in the wilds?

[commanding] Bring me what I need and I'll teach you what to do. [urgent] Here's the list. [soft voice] Please do not lose it.
quest_60060_quest_progress: [soft voice] I see you're back. [hesitant] Have you managed to find everything required, yes?
quest_60060_quest_complete: [excited] Great! [warm] Let's get you some new know-how to about thing or two.
quest_60061_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ish-ne-alo por-ah, young one! [solemn] Sole reason you're here can only be the desire to learn how to foster your own garden and procure food where otherwise it wouldn't grow I believe? [solemn] By the squint in your eyes I can see it is true. [solemn] Very well. [solemn] There's a particular type of seeds you will have to find first. [solemn] Once you have'em all with you I shall teach you something not even hunters or trappers would know how to survive with less violence and killing. [solemn] This is the Blessing that our tribes bear with pride and foster with care, a Blessing of the Earth-Mother herself. [solemn] Come back to me when you have all the seeds I've mentioned in this parchment here. [solemn] I have and will be expecting you … again.

[solemn] Winds be at your back.
quest_60061_quest_progress: [solemn] I have no doubts your venture was fruitful and you have procured all the seeds.
quest_60061_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ahh, it's good to see you back. [solemn] It is inspiring to see younglings get back to the roots of the best traditions we've had to survive properly, with dignity and respect to the Earth-Mother!
quest_60071_quest_detail:
[solemn] Well met, <class>. Like frogs after rain, the forest trolls have returned to claim what was once their land. Yet, they lost the right to own it through battle, and so once more, by hammer and claw, they will face the fury of our clan. [proud] As proud as we are of our own battle force, we still lack the numbers to take them all on—so I am here to recruit any adventurer who makes their way here to gaze upon the Stone Hawk.

Just east of Aerie Peak, you will find the Witherbark trolls brewing their foul concoctions, seeking to corrupt the wild habitats of the Hinterlands. [commanding] End them all, for they are nothing more than pawns of the Vilebranch.
quest_60071_quest_complete: [solemn] A defeated enemy should know their place. [soft voice] Hopefully, that will be the last of the Witherbark.
quest_60072_quest_detail:
[solemn] With the Witherbark out of the fight, we can now focus on the Vilebranch. [low voice] They are greater in number, so they have claimed more land. The Witherbark were their first line of defense—or rather, they were mere cannon fodder, meant to keep us occupied while the Vilebranch reclaimed the Altar of Zul.

[emphasis] If you listen well, you can hear the echo of their chants even from here. [urgent] That ritual must not be completed. Find your way there however you see fit, and put an end to their miserable faith.
quest_60072_quest_progress: [solemn] Who knows what abomination they seek to summon?
quest_60072_quest_complete: [solemn] Well fought, well slain—but this is not the end.
quest_60073_quest_detail:
Chased rats to a closed den—that's all they are now. [solemn] This will not be an easy task, <class>. [commanding] You must bond with other adventurers over this quest—others who, just like you, seek their glory. For the city of Jintha'Alor is brimming with dread and the filth of the forest trolls.

Whatever ritual you stopped at the Altar of Zul pales in comparison to what happens in that foul place. [urgent] Steel yourself—this will be your hardest task yet. [commanding] Decimate their ranks as you make your way through the city.
quest_60073_quest_progress: [solemn] A hard task, but one that must be done.
quest_60073_quest_complete: [confident] You slaughtered them with ease and precision, like a butcher claiming his due.
quest_60074_quest_detail:
[solemn] Led by the Vile Priestess Hexx, the Vilebranch came to the Hinterlands to reclaim their lost legacy. [pause] I repeat myself—I am aware of that. [soft voice] Yet, I cannot help but find irony in it. [low voice] You would think their blind faith in whatever they call upon in prayer at night would at least grant them a glimpse of the bloodshed to come.

[commanding] I stand steadfast in my decision, <class>, yet I cannot help but pity them—for as long as we, or our elven allies to the north, have fought them, they have suffered crushing defeat after crushing defeat. [urgent] Today will be no different. [commanding voice] Stain the land with the blood of their priestess and those who seek to guard her.
quest_60074_quest_progress: [urgent] Strike while the iron is hot.
quest_60074_quest_complete: [solemn] A crushing defeat, a miserable life. [pause] Yet, I feel this story is far from over—for no matter how many trolls you slay, they always return. Mh... here, a reward well earned.
quest_60107_quest_detail:
[solemn] The damned cold won't leave me. [soft voice] I thank you for the pelts, <name> but I wonder if I may trouble you again?

[hesitant] I paid a helpful soul, Calvin, to go to Solliden Farmstead to retrieve my slippers before you happened along. [sad] He hasn't returned and I've heard that he may be less than honest. [low voice] Undeath doesn't change an opportunist it seems. [solemn] My slippers are in a footlocker at the farmstead.

[urgent] The reports I overheard about Scarlets in the area are the least concerning. [whispering] The murlocs like anything shiny I've heard and I did keep that footlocker polished up...
quest_60107_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello again, <name>. [hesitant] Have you made the trip to the shore North of Solliden Farmstead yet?
quest_60107_quest_complete: [excited] My slippers! Thank you very much! [warm] You have shown a great kindness to me. [warm] Please take this coin for your troubles. [solemn] Dark lady watch over you.
quest_60108_quest_detail:
Greetings, <class>!

[solemn] We've been on the tail of Archmage Arugal for some time, since the end of the Third War actually. [soft voice] What did he do? [pause] When the Scourge came to Dalaran, we were devastated.

[sad] Seeing our friends and family being turned undead really messed with his mind. [pause] He thought the solution was a summoning ritual, to summon something that could aid us and stop the Scourge's advance. [low voice] Even though as his mentor I advised against his idea, my warnings fell on deaf ears.

[solemn] The resulting monstrosities are the Worgen. [sad] Even though they killed the Scourge, they quickly turned on us, worsening the situation. [pause] After going mad with his failure, he adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to Shadowfang Keep.

[solemn] After what had transpired I moved to Stormwind to try to forget what happened. [soft voice] Although it pains my heart to say this, [urgent] you must travel to Shadowfang Keep in southern Silverpine Forest and end his life.
quest_60108_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you do it? [solemn] This can't wait no longer.
quest_60108_quest_complete: [solemn] Thanks, hero, it had to be done. [warm] Take this, the last memory I have left of him.
quest_60109_quest_detail:
[solemn] One of my esteemed colleagues set off to gather vital information about the plots that the nefarious archmage Arugal is hatching inside of Shadowfang Keep, but I have not gotten word from him since. I am concerned about the corrupting influence that place has on even the most powerful and capable mages, and I need to know the fate of Sorcerer Ashcrombe.

[urgent] Travel to Silverpine Forest and seek him out for me at the Keep. If the Light wills it, find out what he has learned.
quest_60109_quest_progress: [solemn] There is untold darkness that will forever linger inside of these walls.
quest_60109_quest_complete:
[solemn] High Sorcerer Andromath sent you?

[soft voice] My, how the time flies when you're watching insanity and horror unfold from every angle.

[pause] I will have to return with my findings and reassure him that I have not fallen to the same madness as those who are trapped here.
quest_60110_quest_detail:
[solemn] Iverron was attacked, you say? And by Githyiss herself, outside the Shadowthread Cave? [pause] This is grave news... To think that the broodmother of the webwood spiders has become this hostile.

I had already heard rumors of her mercilessly overhunting the local wildlife. If she has gone so far as to attack our people, however... [sad] It pains me to say this, but I fear that she must be put down. Her violent nature now threatens the very balance of Shadowglen.

[urgent] Take great caution if you are to hunt her, <name>; her poison is much stronger than any of her brood's. [gentle] If you could, please bring back her venom sac so that I may further my research. I only hope it may yield answers to what is happening across Teldrassil.
quest_60110_quest_progress: [solemn] We must put the broodmother down. [hesitant] I am afraid we have no other choice...
quest_60110_quest_complete: [solemn] Do not be troubled by what needed be done, <name>. Githyss was aggressive beyond our ability to manage. The reason for this, I do not know, but one I hope to uncover in my research. [warm] Hold your head with pride; you have ensured the continued safety of Shadowglen.
quest_60111_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have proven yourself a capable defender of our roads and our people, <class>. [warm] I believe you will be a great asset in putting an end to those responsible for these attacks once and for all. [soft voice] Our scouts have pinpointed the locations of two of the leaders of the Gnarlpine, Agal and Greenpaw.

[low voice] Agal, who orchestrates ambushes upon those traveling the road to Darnassus, resides in a cave just below the road. [solemn] Greenpaw is a powerful shaman who has entrenched himself and his kin deep in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, desecrating our sacred grounds and terrorizing those within and in the lands surrounding the den.

[urgent] Exercise caution, for they are well protected by their tribesmen. [commanding] I suggest you enlist the aid of a dependable ally if you intend to strike at these two. [gentle] May Elune protect you and guide you on your path.
quest_60111_quest_progress: [solemn] Agal and Greenpaw were once honorable and powerful allies. [sad] Now, in their madness, they pose a great threat to all who travel this road. [urgent] There cannot be peace so long as they live, <class>.
quest_60111_quest_complete:
[solemn] Then it is done? [soft voice] It pains me greatly that it had come to this, but [warm] your actions today have ensured safe passage to Darnassus for our people.

[proud] Your valor shall not go unrewarded, <class>. [gentle] Elune's blessing be upon you, always.
quest_60112_quest_detail: [solemn] While I'm bound to fulfill Marla's wish, I cannot help but think about Samuel's friends. [sad] They are damned into eternal service for the Scourge with their bodies and minds beyond recovery. [soft voice] Please, if you see them... lay them to rest.
quest_60112_quest_progress: [solemn] They all used to explore Tirisfal together. Karrel was a blacksmith, Daniel was a huntsman and Stephen's wisdom guided them all. [sad] To see them like this breaks my heart.
quest_60112_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [solemn] It is a shame they never broke free of the Scourge's control. [sad] They would've made powerful allies.
