quest_60113_quest_detail: [solemn] If my theories are correct, then human blood should react to the plague I'm concocting. [soft voice] While you're out gathering the Murloc scales, go to the Solliden Farmstead and bring blood from the Farmhands and Farmers.
quest_60113_quest_progress: [soft voice] It shouldn't be hard to find the Solliden Farmstead. That's where you got the pumpkins from... [hesitant] if you can't remember that, then I suggest getting a brain replacement.
quest_60113_quest_complete: [commanding] Good. Goooood. [solemn] This should be plenty of blood to perfect my plague. [low voice] The other apothecaries would be jealous of this advantage.
quest_60114_quest_detail: [solemn] I enjoy camping in this cave, but as long as Old Icebeard makes his home near this area then I'll never be safe from him raiding my food. [threatening] It would make for a great trophy if you could bring me his beard... [soft voice] not to mention making this place safer.
quest_60114_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you kill him? [commanding] You best be careful now, this is no ordinary wendigo.
quest_60114_quest_complete: [delight] Great! [excited] That's the spirit. [warm] Here's some stuff I had laying around from a buddy of mine who left for Loch Modan and never came back.
quest_60115_quest_detail:
[solemn] Aside from Sharptusk, there is another threat among the Bristleback that cannot go unaddressed. [soft voice] Our scouts have reported a strategist among the quilboars, hidden away in a cave in Brambleblade Ravine and devising attacks against our people.

[low voice] The quilboars are a vicious foe enough without having carefully-laid plans against Mulgore. [solemn] All the more reason this tactician cannot be allowed to live. [commanding] Go, find this cunning Bristleback, put him down, and bring back proof of his demise.

[urgent] If possible, be vigilant of any documents that may give us insight on the sort of tactics and knowledge the quilboars have been developing.
quest_60115_quest_complete:
[solemn] Already I feel that our people are safer thanks to your decisive blow against the Bristlebacks, <name>. [warm] Your actions speak highly of your dedication to protecting our tribe.

[soft voice] May the Earth Mother guide your path.
quest_60116_quest_detail:
[urgent] It's about time someone with some skills showed up around here! It's one thing to send fresh bodies after the lower Scarlet ranks, but I need an experienced <class> if we're going to bring down the zealots on their own grounds.

[low voice] Hmm. I seem to recall you being quite the efficient killer. [commanding] Let me see that you've still got what it takes to serve. [angry] Thin the ranks outside the Monastery!
quest_60116_quest_complete: [solemn] Now our forces may enter the Monastery fresh for battle and with the advantage of surprise. [low voice] Varimathras shall be pleased.
quest_60117_quest_detail: [angry] You! <race>! [soft voice] I wonder if you could do me a favor. [low voice] Deathguard Burgess in Brill has been ranting about his station, and only having access to the inexperienced members of the horde. [solemn] He has something that requires a more learned hand and he's prepared to pay.
quest_60117_quest_complete: <The Deathguard looks you over approvingly.> [urgent] Yes, yes you'll do. [commanding] Come here <class>.
quest_60119_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, <race>. [hesitant] I hope I'm not bothering you but I'd ask you a courtesy if you've the time.

[solemn] I lived in Strahnbrad a lifetime ago and my manor fell to ruin before the third war when the orcs came. [sad] There were a few items left behind that would serve me in this unlife so I sent someone for them.

[low voice] The troll I sent has since returned with my heirlooms but I overheard her warning Melisara of the ogres in the area. [urgent] Melisara has arranged for the maulers within the ruins of Alterac to be destroyed but has no interest in the weaker ogres in the surrounding caves.

[commanding] I have access to ample means to reward you if you would thin their numbers.
quest_60119_quest_progress: [excited] Hello again! [soft voice] I assume since you're here the task is complete? [sad] No? [pause] A pity.
quest_60119_quest_complete: [excited] Excellent to see you again! [warm] My butler observed your actions from a rise in the mountains. [warm] Thank you so much for making the roadway safer. [proud] One day Wayne Manor will be restored and we can't have ogres all over the place!
quest_60124_quest_detail:
[solemn] Ishnuallah, <class>.

[soft voice] There is trouble brewing in the Barrens. [pause] No, its not the Horde or the centaurs, this is about the Wailing Caverns.

[solemn] It was an attempt to turn the Barrens into a lush green oasis but it backfired. [sad] Naralex tried to tap into the power of the Emerald Dream but the Nightmare got to him first, putting him in eternal sleep and corrupting every beast and even his acolytes!

[urgent] You can find the Wailing Caverns in Northern Barrens.

Find his Disciple in the caverns, he will tell you how you can free him.
quest_60124_quest_progress: [solemn] Only you and your friends can save Naralex, [urgent] you are our only hope.
quest_60124_quest_complete:
[solemn] The news came just before you arrived. [warm] We're truly in your debt.

[warm] Here, a reward fitting for a hero such as yourself.
quest_60125_quest_detail:
[solemn] Although your main quest is saving Naralex from the Nightmare, we might learn more about the corruption that befouls the caverns.

[soft voice] Its told that a plant named Serpentbloom sprouted inside the caverns after Naralex's fall into eternal slumber, and that they hold the venom of a serpent.

[urgent] I want you to venture into the caverns and bring me 10 of these plants.
quest_60125_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you collect the flowers? [soft voice] They might reveal something about the Nightmare.
quest_60125_quest_complete: [excited] You did find them! [warm] I will send these to Moonglade immediately.
quest_60130_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You found this scuffed ring between the webbing of a murloc's fingers. [solemn] Something about it calls out to you, compelling you to place it in your pocket as though its appearance belies its true value. [hesitant] You try to shine it on your armor, but the muck and dirt only spreads with every wipe.

[confident] You are certain this ring has more to it than meets the eye, that it is possessed of magic. [urgent] You decide to take the ring to someone with knowledge of the arcane for examination.
quest_60130_quest_progress: [angry] Why are you showing me this dirty trinket? [urgent] Look, there's young Mages in need of my attention, so I really don't have time for... [surprised] Oh? A magical enchantment, you say?
quest_60130_quest_complete:
[solemn] Interesting... [soft voice] someone placed a curse upon this ring. [solemn] I would assume to prevent it from being kept by any would-be thieves. [soft voice] If a murloc had the ring, it would seem that the curse failed to serve its intended purpose.

<Zaldimar utters an incantation while gesturing with his hand. A blinding flash of light explodes from the ring, which appears as a lustrous golden band.>

[warm] Here you are.
quest_60131_quest_detail:
[solemn] Greetings, <class>!

Much of Orgrimmar's food supply comes from the sea to the east. Grunts can assist with escorting the fishermen and crabbers through the scorpids and raptors but there's the issue of sharks that's getting the better of them.

Fishermen have reported aggressive sharks rising in number off the coast and attacking their boats. [urgent] Go thin their number and be sure to take friends. [commanding] Rid us of this menace before our food stores dwindle!
quest_60131_quest_progress: [low voice] You smell of the sea, <class>. [commanding] Tell me the beast is slain so I can get the fisherman back to work.
quest_60131_quest_complete: [solemn] It's important to keep their numbers in check but not to hunt them to the brink. [warm] You've done a great service for the Horde this day, <class>. [proud] Go with honor.
quest_60132_quest_detail:
<Mu'uta stares into the distance, one hand rubbing a massive scar on his face and the other holding his bow at his side.> [solemn] A spider, <class>. [sad] A spider caused this wound. Not inflicted it, mind you, but caused it.

<He lowers his hand and his one functioning eye fixes on you.>

[soft voice] I was hunting raptors. I need their feathers, the butcher needs the meat, the claws can be used as weapons, they're good creatures. [solemn] A worthy opponent. [urgent] If you misstep, into a web in my case, they'll leave their mark.

<He grimaces and points at his scarred face.>

[angry] Spiders, on the other hand, are useless. Their web is too sticky to use for armor or fletching, their carapace too brittle to make decent armor. [threatening] They're in the way, <class>. [commanding] Kill them.
quest_60132_quest_progress: [low voice] Eight legs is too many.
quest_60132_quest_complete: [solemn] Azeroth is a far better place with less spiders alive in it.
quest_60133_quest_detail:
[solemn] Even as I send you to discover the wondrous source of life here, there is foulness tainting the land. [sad] The gentle herds of gazelle are falling ill. [solemn] We are stymied in our efforts to heal the sick and bring balance to the circle of life.

[soft voice] I have sent word home to Thunder Bluff, and through my brethren there, Moonglade. [solemn] We will have assistance from the Cenarion Circle soon. [urgent] If you are eager to help, however, I will certainly use you!

[commanding] Go and track the poor beasts that lag behind their herds. [urgent] You must hunt them before the lionesses bring down the sickly gazelles to feed their prides. [solemn] Return to me with samples so that I may study what ails our animal friends.
quest_60133_quest_progress:
[solemn] It is with a heavy heart that I must send you to do this deed, <name>.

[urgent] Do not delay, the herds only grow weaker.
quest_60133_quest_complete: [solemn] Thank you, <name>. The sacrifice of these poor animals will help me to unravel this mysterious taint seeping into the grassland and develop a cure for its effects.
quest_60137_quest_detail:
[solemn] Do you know the legend of Palkeote, the grey mother?

[soft voice] She is the spirit of an ancient kodo who walked this land in the distant past, in the days even before the sundering. [pause] This land was green then, and she roamed it for many years with her mate and her children.

[sad] One day, one of her sons fell ill with a sickness that would not leave him. [sad] He fell further behind the pack with each passing day, until he finally collapsed northwest of here, near a river that has now gone dry.

[sad] Palkeote stayed with her son, but she could do nothing to stop his passing. [sad] She would not leave even then. [solemn] Her herd moved on and the seasons passed around her, but still she remained, until she herself passed away beside him. [solemn] Her watch did not end even then, and she remains as a mighty spirit.

[solemn] The Earthmother pities the suffering of all life, and she pities the suffering of mothers most of all. [solemn] Palkeote's vigil has made her strong, but it is time for her to rest. [commanding] Muster your allies and end her long watch, <class>.
quest_60137_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you found Palkeote? [solemn] Do not face her alone – there is no honor in a hunt without hope.
quest_60137_quest_complete:
<Harnor bows.> [solemn] I am glad that the grey mother has found peace at last.

[warm] You and your allies have my thanks, and the thanks of all the kodo of this land.
quest_60138_quest_detail:
[solemn] The kodo is the mightiest of the beasts of Mulgore, and therefore the greatest of its hunts. [commanding] You are ready, young <class>, to hunt them yourself.

[soft voice] You have probably already seen the kodo herds wandering Mulgore during your earlier travels. [urgent] Find one of the herds, and challenge its matriarch and bull.

Kodos are not aggressive creatures, but they are fearsome when provoked – you will need all the skills you have learned to overcome their elders, <race>.

[warm] Return to me when you have conquered them.
quest_60138_quest_progress: [soft voice] The kodo wander Mulgore far and wide. [pause] You may need to search for some time to find the herd. [emphasis] Patience is one of the lessons of the hunt.
quest_60138_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have overcome the greatest trial a Mulgore hunter can face, and you have emerged with greater strength – and wisdom – for your efforts.

[warm] Carry it with you as you step further into the world, young <class>, and honor the memory of the beasts you defeated by remembering their lessons.
quest_60139_quest_detail:
[angry] Why in the name of Doomhammer has this plague spread the land? Scorpids!

[sad] It didn't used to be this way, but now every time I leave Razor Hill, scorpids! In my tent, my shoes, my armor, always more scorpids! [groan] They're more of a nuisance to me than a real danger, but each time I get stung I have to drink a healing potion or head back to town for help. [shouting] I’m sick of it!

[panting] I'm nursing my latest sting right now, but you look like you’re up to the task of a hunt. [commanding] Head out and kill every scorpid you find! [mocking tone] It's not like you'll have any issue finding them...
quest_60139_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [commanding] Have you scoured the land for the stinging menace?
quest_60139_quest_complete:
[soft voice] For the first time in weeks I think I can close my eyes and not hear their chittering. [solemn] It's done.

<Blackarm laughs aloud, exasperated> .

[warm] You will be counted among the great heroes of the Horde for this effort, <class>, if I have anything to say about it. [proud] Have some of these healing potions for your trouble. [hesitant] With any luck, I won't need so many anymore.
quest_60140_quest_detail:
[excited] Some people get all the luck!

<Austil glares at Coleman Farthing across the inn.>

"Oh, I lost my family, the plague took my home from me." [sad] On and on and on he goes! We get it! The plague took all of our homes and all of our families. [angry] But some of us at least came out of it with a jaw intact!

<Austil cracks a bone back into place.>

[urgent] If you want to make yourself useful, bring me some bandages so I can hold what's left of me together!
quest_60140_quest_progress: [low voice] Every minute that passes is another minute for pieces to fall off of me, <name>!
quest_60140_quest_complete:
<Austil takes the bandages and uses them to lash some of his looser extremities into place.> [soft voice] Ah, thank you. [warm] This will do nicely.

[soft voice] I'm sorry if I snapped at you before. [soft voice] Having bits of oneself threatening to escape at any moment does tend to make one a little grumpy.

[warm] But I feel much better now. [warm] Maybe I'll go even talk to old Farthing.
quest_60141_quest_detail:
[solemn] To the Nobles of Stormwind, a Paladin is an elite soldier recognized for acts of great valor on the battlefield and for smiting enemies of the kingdom with righteous fury.

[soft voice] These are not the qualities which define us as servants of the Light, however. [emphasis] It is for our kindness and compassion for the weak and the poor we owe the people's faith.

[solemn] Even the most simple act of kindness is the cornerstone of a Paladin's duty and legacy, what separates us from a fool with a cudgel.

[pause] There is a struggling family in the Eastvale Logging Camp in need of assistance stocking their food stores for the year. [commanding] I take it upon myself to aid them when possible, but with the mounting threats across the land of late, I am bound by duty to Goldshire.

[urgent] Please, aid them in my stead. [commanding] Hunt the Rockhide Boars found to the south near the forest's edge along the riverbank, and bring their meat to the Eastvale Logging Camp.
quest_60141_quest_progress:
[urgent] Are you here from Stormwind?

[angry] We told you before, we don't have any money left to spare for Lady Prestor's coffers! [commanding] Can't you see I have a family to feed?
quest_60141_quest_complete:
<You explain why Brother WIlhelm sent you. Eldrin's angry, defensive posture softens as you explain, and eventually you see the shine of tears in his eyes.> [solemn] Miles away and as busy serving the Light as he is, yet he still finds time to help us. [sad] It pains me to burden him so yet again. [soft voice] He's already done so much for us, you see.

[pause] Things've been hard this year, so I've been goin' without so Sara and Eric don't have to, and... [pause] Well, thank you. [warm] Bless Brother Wilhelm, and bless you, <name>.

[gentle] Here. [hesitant] I know it's not much, but Sara makes them for the locals. [warm] Maybe you can find some use in it. [urgent] Take it! [proud] It's the least we can do in return for your selfless deed.
quest_60142_quest_detail:
[proud] Pardon me <class>, might I ask a favor of you? [hesitant] I'm sure my association with Grimrizz and his dark rituals does little to put you at ease, but I assure you I'm no power-thirsty demon-dabbler! [sad] This doesn't suit me...

[soft voice] Truth be told, I always wanted to be a blacksmith. [excited] No, not an engineer. Not all gnomes are engineers, you know! [warm] From the moment I laid eyes on the Great Forge, I've dreamed of working beside the great Tormus Deepforge.

[emphasis] The suffocating heat of the forge's flames, the shrill cry of hammers striking hot iron, the glint of a finely crafted blade. [delight] Yes, nothing would make me happier!

[gentle] If you're headed to Ironforge, won't you please take this letter to Tormus Deepforge for me? [warm] It's an application to join the Blacksmith Guild in Ironforge. [proud] Tormus should be near the Great Forge.
quest_60142_quest_progress: [soft voice] Here to learn how to swing a smithing hammer, friend?
quest_60142_quest_complete:
<Tormus takes the letter and reads it. He furrows his brows before giving a hearty laugh.> [solemn] A gnome looking to be a blacksmith? It has been a long time since we had a gnome join our ranks. [warm] Well, why not? Perhaps he'll be the next Klockmort Spannerspan!

[proud] I appreciate you bringing this to me, <class>. [excited] Here, some extra stones to give your weapon an extra edge in battle.
quest_60143_quest_detail:
[solemn] Have you ever stood at the edge of Teldrassil and looked out over the Veiled Sea? It's a magnificent sight, <name>. I cannot recommend enough that you experience it at least once.

I often travel with my sewing kit to the waterfalls near Wellspring Lake, right as they pour over the side of the trunk. It is a wonderfully serene spot where I may work in peace. The last time I was there, however, I was attacked by maddened timberlings and fled without my kit!

Those tools have been with me for as long as I can remember, and I can't bear the thought of them tumbling over into the sea, lost forever. [urgent] Would you kindly recover my kit for me, <name>?
quest_60143_quest_progress: [hesitant] Have you found my sewing kit, <name>?
quest_60143_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, you've found it! [warm] You have my eternal gratitude, <name>!

[soft voice] Will a well-tailored shirt suffice as compensation for your efforts? [gentle] I keep a number of different colors in stock to suit any taste. [gentle voice] Please, take your pick.

[gentle] If a shirt is not to your liking, perhaps I could interest you in some raw material for your own purposes?
quest_60145_quest_detail:
Hold, <name>. I've one more piece of intel for you if you're heading into the Echo Ridge Mine. One of my scouts spoke of a kobold much larger than the rest hiding deep within the heart of the mine.

[urgent] Its size suggests it may be coordinating the other kobolds, which makes its mere existence a great threat to Northshire. [commanding] Slay it, and we may very well deal a decisive blow to the kobold infestation.

[commanding] I want you to go down into the Echo Ridge Mine and kill the foul creature. [warm] Your efforts will be rewarded appropriately.
quest_60145_quest_progress: [commanding] I assume you killed the beast?
quest_60145_quest_complete:
[solemn] Though your journey has only just begun, you've already proven yourself an invaluable asset to Northshire.

[warm] Choose your reward. [proud] You've earned it.
quest_60147_quest_detail:
[solemn] You've fought the vile familiars outside the coven, but the taint in the valley trails deeper.

[urgent] You must go inside the coven and slay the felstalkers. [warm] Return and you'll be rewarded.
quest_60147_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have struck a blow to their numbers, and returned in one piece.

[warm] Take one, you earned it.
quest_60148_quest_detail:
[low voice] We keep killing the spiders but we find that the number hasn't changed the next day. [solemn] I think there's something off.

[urgent] Go down into the hollow and investigate. [commanding] Come back in one piece and be rewarded.

[threatening] We suspect that they have a broodmother.
quest_60148_quest_progress: [low voice] They keep coming back, [sad] something is amiss.
quest_60148_quest_complete: [delight] Splendid! With the broodmother gone we can finally reclaim the mine. [proud] Well done.
quest_60150_quest_detail:
[solemn] The quilboar activity in the Brambleblade Ravine has been increasing lately, [pause] we suspect that they're preparing for an attack on Camp Narache.

[commanding] Go to the ravine and thin their numbers, they fight without honor and deserve none.
quest_60150_quest_progress: [commanding] Show them that we are not to be meddled with.
quest_60150_quest_complete:
[solemn] With heroes like you we might even push them out of Mulgore.

[warm] Take one, it's the least we can do.
quest_60152_quest_detail:
<name>, [urgent] I hear you are on your way to slay the scoundrels they call leaders of the worst crew of pirates, the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

You see these fools took a new member and they in their deluded mind think he will aid them greatly.

<Baron Revilgaz scoffs.>

[whispering] I have a man on the inside, his name is Morgan Storm, look for a fellow that won't shank you on sight.
quest_60152_quest_progress: [commanding] Rid me of these fools, [low voice] my crew stands above all other.
quest_60152_quest_complete: [commanding] The Baron sent you? [warm] How kind of him to actually send reinforcements, come hear mate, lend me your ear, can't just say it out loud!
quest_60153_quest_detail:
[soft voice] As a double agent, I've been on their ships when they took that orc on the ship, not much of a bright idea since I saw he has no real skill in combat, but if anything he's the perfect pirate, liar, gambler, drunk, you name it.

[low voice] They named him Captain of a small fleet and they hope his combat experience would rub off the new recruits, bunch of nonsense.

<Ian spits on the ground.>

[urgent] You'll find him on one of the ships, kill him, and bring his head to the Baron, I will lay low, now go before anyone sees us!
quest_60153_quest_progress: [urgent] Move it, or we both lose our lives!
quest_60153_quest_complete:
[excited] Good work, <name>, I'll feed this to the crocodiles.

<The Baron tosses the head into a bucket.>

[warm] What's this? He still has an eyepatch on, you can have it if you want, or I will give you this pearled necklace, you can only take one.

[proud] Thank you for your services, do stick around, you never know when I'll need more muscle.
quest_60154_quest_detail:
[solemn] Shortly after you returned from scouting the Jasperlode Mine, I received reports that a brood of spiders have been seen moving from Duskwood into the depths of the mine. [urgent] Worse still, they're preying on the kobolds in the mine, giving them an abundant source of food with which to increase their population.

[angry] Kobolds, the Defias, and now spiders? [commanding] We cannot afford to spread our forces any thinner to deal with yet another threat. [commanding] Return to the Jasperlode Mine and clear out the infestation before they encroach upon the whole of Elwynn Forest!
quest_60154_quest_progress: [urgent] Their numbers are increasing every second you waste. [commanding] We can't afford to wait any longer.
quest_60154_quest_complete: Such a relief it is to know that those spiders will threaten Elwynn no more. [warm] Please accept this coin on behalf of Stormwind.
quest_60155_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Crab legs - they are such a delicious thing. [excited] They go well with everything! Undermine Claw Chowder, Goldthorn Tea, and even other crab legs! [hesitant] Maybe you're strong enough to catch them and get the crab legs I need?

[commanding] You can find them at the Wild Shore which is directly south of Booty Bay. Be careful, though. [sad] I heard the shore got invaded by Bloodsail Buccaneers. [sigh] That would explain why my supplier stopped coming.
quest_60155_quest_progress: [urgent] Get a move on. [shouting] My customers are waiting!
quest_60155_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, wonderful legs! Grill 'em, boil 'em, put ‘em in a pot.

[hesitant] You... want a reward? [warm] I think this should be enough.
quest_60163_quest_complete:
[excited] Oho, a young goblin. We see your folk around here more often these last days. [solemn] The Durotar Labor Union is a valuable asset to the Horde’s resources.

[warm] You wish to learn how to train your pet? [confident] Very well, with my teachings you will be able to teach your pet new skills, feed it and revive it, should it fall in battle.

[soft voice] If you seek further lessons, return to me later, after you and your pet gathered more experience on your journeys.
quest_70000_quest_detail: [soft voice] The Mage District is always so quiet, isn't it <name>? [pause] Well if you are to ignore that heavily insistent calling to visit the Blue Recluse of course. [solemn] You have grown into a very capable mage, many whisper your name and some have spread rumors about you.
quest_70001_quest_detail:
[solemn] You are the first I have personally summoned in years, <name>, my expectations are quite big. [soft voice] You've probably figured it out by now, I would like you to become my apprentice. But you must prove yourself worthy of my knowledge.

[commanding] Gather your friends and your enemies and venture into the sands! [solemn] In the Ruined Temple of Ahn'Qiraj a creature that devours magic may be found, its name is Moam, slay it and carve out the piece of obsidian on its forehead.

[warm] Succeed and I will help you break out from your shell.
quest_70001_quest_progress: [solemn] While I may not be going anywhere [pause] my patience isn't one to be tested.
quest_70001_quest_complete:
[delight] Well done, <name>, truly well done. 
[solemn] You have earned your place as my apprentice, for your first lesson you must read this tome. [urgent] The survival of your group depends on you to be able to hand out as many refreshments as you can.

[emphasis] Remember, you must not take anything lightly! Thirst may be your worst enemy under some circumstances.

[pause] Now go study my newest apprentice.
quest_70002_quest_detail: [soft voice] We have kept a close eye on your growth <name>.
quest_70003_quest_detail:
[solemn] Your task will not be an easy one but the reward will be worth the trouble.

[soft voice] The Jungle trolls of Stranglethorn Vale are attempting to bring back their God to life, Hakkar the Soulflayer, I assume someone already had tasked you to put a stop to them.

[commanding] What I ask is a bit different, bring me back his essence, you will know what I am talking about as you will see it. [urgent] You will need this Essence for what I am gonna teach you, know that it will be of great use to you and your allies.

[warm] Now go, gather your allies, summon your demons and conquer that old pathetic God.
quest_70003_quest_progress: [solemn] You will remind yourself of this feat for years to come, [pause] that is if you do come back.
quest_70003_quest_complete:
<Daio laughs maniacally> [soft voice] You actually pulled that one off, who would've thought. [warm] You're insane <name>, maybe even more than this old fool.

[solemn] Now get ready it's time for a lesson not many are worthy of.
quest_70020_quest_detail:
[solemn] My little brother, Taupo, is a gifted druid and more accomplished than I would ever hope to be but he is still my little brother.

[sad] He was on his way to the Warsong Lumber Camp to help with the demonic corruption among other things. [hesitant] I fear he might find trouble as he has to pass through Felfire Hill.

[urgent] Please, find my little brother, I would do it myself but I do not wish him to think I find him incapable, yet I still worry. [soft voice] He left not so long ago, following the main road east, that is the path to the Lumber Camp.
quest_70020_quest_complete: [soft voice] Loruk sent you to check on me? [mocking tone] Is he still thinking I'm a small calf with no horns?
quest_70021_quest_detail:
[solemn] It was Earthmother's blessing to be born with such a worried elder brother, and as fate has it there you are, just the help that I needed.

[soft voice] While I was making my way to the Lumber Camp I saw this Tauren bravely fight those demons and I have stopped to tend to his wounds. [gentle] My skills helped stop his bleeding, but we need a salve to fully mend him.

[urgent] In the river you will find Boglings, slay them and bring me the cores, they will help bring our newest friend back on his feet, and do not worry <name>, this is all in the name of balance.
quest_70021_quest_complete: [warm] Thank you <name>, [delight] this will mend our friend.
quest_70022_quest_detail:
[solemn] I was on my way to the Warsong Lumber Camp when I had my encounter with the demons, were it not for this druid I wouldn't have made it.

[soft voice] I have a very important report addressed to the stationary Commander in charge, Commander Grushak, [urgent] I would hurry right away but the wounds have yet to release me of my pain and my spear was lost in the battle.

[commanding] I ask you to find it while Taupo heals me. [commanding] While you search for it - spare no demon.
quest_70022_quest_complete:
[solemn] My horns are ready and sharpened, alas my spear was stolen by those demons, the vermin felt the blessings of the Earthmother on it!

[excited] It's not your fault <name>, you've bravely fought them and for that I am in your debt, here, have this necklace as a token of my gratitude.
quest_70023_quest_detail:
[solemn] I am aware I am not going anywhere anytime soon <name>, there is no need for you to stare at me that way.

[commanding] You will have to give my report to Commander Grushak, tell him I sent you, he will be glad to have you by his side, he's a bit strict but that's what will keep you alive out there. [gentle] Seek him in the first tower as you reach the Lumber Camp.

[warm] As a personal request however, do keep an eye out for my spear, it carries years worth of history, been passed through my lineage from the first Hawkspear to the last and I do not wish it to be lost at the hands of demons.

[solemn] Travel safe my friend and may the Earthmother guide you.
quest_70023_quest_complete: [low voice] I was expecting someone else to give me this report, <race>, [angry] what happened to Norvok?
quest_70024_quest_detail:
[solemn] The camp is as productive as the day it was built from the ground, which frankly doesn't mean much at all.

[angry] The Wildthorn Lurkers have ascended upon our camp and are giving the peons and laborers a hard time, while my scouts are giving their all to slay them it is not enough.

[urgent] Go help the cause, <name>, after all I take you bringing this report as volunteering your aid, clean the camp of the wildthorn menace and I will see you rewarded.
quest_70024_quest_progress: [commanding] Clean the camp of the wildthorn menace and I will see you rewarded.
quest_70025_quest_detail:
[angry] Those knife eared bastards are trying to force us out of the woods, they've sent a squadron of stalkers that hide around our fields and murder our peons, they must be stopped!

[commanding] Go get your hands dirty, leave none alive, and if anything make sure more of the peons don't die.
quest_70025_quest_progress: [commanding] Go get your hands dirty, leave none alive, and if anything make sure more of the peons don't die.
quest_70025_quest_complete: [solemn] With the interference of the elves gone we can resume our duty in peace. [warm] Thank you <name>, [proud] you are more capable than I thought.
quest_70026_quest_detail:
[solemn] With most of the tasks done, I only have but a favor to ask of you, our poor peons have been wearing the same tattered clothing since we've come to this damned forest, they can't take another day in those rags and I most certainly won't be the one blamed for naked peons chopping wood!

[urgent] I need you to hunt and skin some bears for me, North of Splintertree Post and in its immediate vicinity to the left you will be able to find bears, grab enough for our leatherworker to craft new cloths for those poor miserable souls, but remember <name>, only hunt the eldest of the bears.
quest_70026_quest_progress: [commanding] Remember, only hunt the eldest of the bears.
quest_70026_quest_complete: [warm] You have my thanks <name>, [proud] your work helped me and my men more than you'd imagine, as a sign of gratitude the leatherworker made this for you.
quest_70027_quest_detail:
[soft voice] The fields are clear, the peons seem happy and the productivity is already going way better than they used to.

[solemn] That's exactly why I am sending you to another mission. [warm] You seem eager to aid and frankly the Farseer needs all the help he can get.

[commanding] He's a cranky old orc, don't even for a second consider his frustration as weakness. [urgent] He will task you with a harsh job but I do not doubt you will do well. [commanding] Go now and give him this parchment.

[soft voice] You'll find him in the keep, north-east of here.
quest_70027_quest_progress: [low voice] So, Grushak finally reporting on his peons doing their job for once?
quest_70027_quest_complete: [low voice] Now, what do I do with you?
quest_70028_quest_detail:
[solemn] What do you see here <name>? [low voice] I will tell you what I see; a roaming pack without its Alpha. [sad] Simple minded buffoons who lost their commander.

[pause] Sometimes I ask myself what would have happened if Hellscream… [sad] doesn't matter now.

[urgent] Falling down into the Demon Fall Canyon you will see numerous spawns of the Burning Legion. [solemn] As you should know, a great demon fell there, hence the namesake, I suppose.

[commanding] Your mission is clear, yet, not so simple. [threatening] Wreak havoc and cull their numbers. [commanding] I expect you do whatever you see fit to leave none alive.
quest_70028_quest_progress: [commanding] I take it you're not a coward, so why are you still here?
quest_70028_quest_complete:
[solemn] Good. While their numbers are Legions and our arms never rest, we will prevail thanks to the sheer desire to survive overcoming their plans to conquer.

[warm] Come, I have few items saved as payment. Choose whichever fits you best.
quest_70029_quest_detail:
[low voice] Our grunts found one of these Night Elves stalking about. The deformed creature had a letter on its corpse. I will spare you the disgust I had while trying to decipher that abomination of a language.

[pause] Above the canyon you should be able to find a Barrow Den, one of the holes these knife-eared mongrels like to dig. Be mindful not to go to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den: The one you seek is found in the ridge. [commanding] From what I could gather of this piece of paper, a great menace can be found at its lowest level.

Find out what's hiding there and return to me as swift as the wind.
quest_70029_quest_progress: [solemn] Hopefully you will survive to tell the story, <class>.
quest_70029_quest_complete: [solemn] A Dreadlord of all things? [hesitant] This won't be easy, at your current state you're nothing more than a twig in a cyclone, but there are other ways.
quest_70030_quest_detail:
[hesitant] We need to...

<the old orc sighs>

We will need the help of an old "friend" of mine. [solemn] Nothing beats a Witch Doctor's mojo so I am sending you to Stonetalon.

Find Jin'Zil and give him this letter, his mojo is potent enough to shrink the Dreadlord and weaken it enough for you to slay it.

[urgent] However! He will have a task for you, probably something easy and meaningless so don't waste too much time over there, we have a dreadlord to slay.
quest_70030_quest_progress: [angry] Three little elves hugging the trees, ol' Jin'Zil will be cooking soon!
quest_70030_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, hello mon, I didn't notice you, [hesitant] what do you want?
quest_70031_quest_detail:
[angry] Grimeye wants my mojo to kill a Dreadlord eh?

Sure mon, Jin'Zil will help you if you help Jin'Zil, this stew needs more stuff!

[urgent] You bring the stuff and I give you the mojo.

I will need some melon juice, dwarven mild, wild hog shank and some soothing spices!

[commanding] Go, Jin'Zil will stir the cauldron and wait for you!
quest_70031_quest_progress:
[whispering] Hey, <name>, I wonder what <race> tastes like.

[mocking tone] But don't worry I won't be eating you! [hesitant] Maybe.
quest_70031_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My stew is almost done, let's have a taste.

[laughing] Terrible! I mean, it tastes better than my wife's cooking.
quest_70032_quest_detail:
[commanding voice] Here mon take this package and deliver it to Grimeye, [low voice] Jin'Zil took the liberty of adding more than the mojo you needed for the old cranky orc.

Just give him my regards and tell me he still owes me coin from when we rolled in the bones!

[laughing] I am never gonna forget it!
quest_70032_quest_complete:
[angry] That daft fool just won't let go of it! [sigh] I told him we were not playing on coin, gah.

<Grimeye clears his throat.>

In any case <name>, [warm] well done. [urgent] Now let's go kill us a dreadlord.
quest_70033_quest_detail:
[solemn] This is it <name>, [commanding] your most dangerous task yet, but I am more than sure you will succeed.

[warm] You showed courage I have not seen in so long, may the ancestors guide your steps and may you return unharmed.

[solemn] You have my blessings and the ancestors at your side.

[solemn] Remember that where you stand a great warrior once stood and you too shall walk in his steps, [angry] slay them with pride in your heart!
quest_70033_quest_progress: [commanding] Bring me his severed head and I will set it on fire!
quest_70033_quest_complete:
[solemn] You have done something not many can do, <class>, [proud] walk with pride from this day onward.

[soft voice] This old orc is reminded of the past but from now on he will dream of the future.

[warm] I will set fire to the head and mention you the slayer to our clan, but the ancestors tell me your path only begins my dear friend.

[gentle] I truly hope you will one day find what you seek.
quest_70034_quest_detail:
[solemn] Norvok is in no condition to be out looking for a family heirloom, but I worry that perhaps he may attempt to venture out before he is fully healed.

[soft voice] If you could search for any trace of the spear that he left behind, it would be greatly appreciated, by both Norvok and myself.

The demons to the east would be your best bet in finding it, so [urgent] go swiftly!
quest_70034_quest_complete:
[solemn] This spear served my family for many generations.

[sad] I am saddened that I was the one to bring it to its end, and brought shame upon my tribe.

<Norvok takes a deep breath through his huge nostrils and lets the air out with a smile.>

[warm] Don't look sad my newest friend, you helped me more than you know, this is not the end but merely the beginning.

[confident] I will reforge the blade and make it more sturdy, after all even when you cut a hawk's wings his beak is as dangerous as ever.
quest_70040_quest_detail:
[solemn] I never gave up on my dream, <name>, my mission still stands even in death, I lived to forge and help our proud soldiers protect themselves, alas, you too will help me to do that.

[urgent] Our men face peril down to Silverpine Forest, the last of the Scourge, the magi of Dalaran and the foul beasts Arugal summoned upon our lands.

[soft voice] I'd imagine the Sepulcher it's short supplied, bring them these items. You will be expected.

Upon delivery you will be rewarded with plans for a new set of armor, so you too will be ready to face our enemy.
quest_70040_quest_complete: [delight] This will be a great help, <class>.
quest_70049_quest_detail:
[soft voice] It seems that drunkard is getting quite the laugh from me paying you out of pocket, <name>. [angry] This dwarf wants me to repair some tents! Do I look like I know how to repair a tent?! And he's cracking jokes about how even an ogre knows how to pitch a tent!

[hesitant] Look, <name>, help me out here so I don't make a complete fool of myself.

We're going to need some cloth to repair these tents and apparently those ogres to the west may have what we're looking for. But, believe me, [sad] I have no idea what that dwarf is talking about!
quest_70049_quest_progress: [hesitant] Any luck finding that cloth I need?
quest_70049_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [excited] You know I've been thinking about what that dwarf said about ogres pitching tents and it just dawned on me!

[proud] I'm going to make sure there's at least one dwarf who can't pitch a tent anymore!

[warm] Anyways, here is your reward.
quest_70050_quest_detail:
[angry] That drunken fool! He's absolutely outrageous! [urgent] I am here for serious matters, not mundane, meaningless tasks. [defiant] I will not stand for this, no, no!

[soft voice] Please, help me out. [hesitant] I'd rather pay you than give that man the satisfaction that he convinced someone of my intellect to do this laborsome chore.

[sad] There should be some old lumber around. [solemn] This desolate place has no trees, it's just a barren wasteland as far as I can see! [urgent] Try and find any lumber you can and bring it back to me so we can prepare a fire.
quest_70050_quest_progress: [angry] That drunk old dwarf. [sigh] Ugh! [soft voice] Please come back as soon as you can.
quest_70050_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You have no idea how much your help means to me.

[warm] Here's a little token of my appreciation.
quest_70052_quest_detail:
[angry] These pirates are an infestation to our port, even worse than the rats we have to exterminate each month.

It's absolutely ridiculous, <name>.

[sigh] What's even worse is the fact that some foolish trader decided to do business with them. [low voice] Whatever idea crossed his small brain to do that I will never know.

[urgent] While you're out there hunting for pirates, be on the lookout for Tazan and take care of him as well.

[warm] Come see me after and I'll be sure to reward you.
quest_70052_quest_progress: [solemn] In life we make choices we sometimes regret, and Tazan will be sure to regret this one.
quest_70052_quest_complete:
[excited] You're back, great.

And I see you picked something up as a trophy. [chuckling] Strange, but whatever floats your boat, bub!

[warm] Here's some coin for your troubles.
quest_70053_quest_detail:
Something's wrong with the threshadons, <name>. [urgent] They're out from hiding and are eating all the fish of the lake! [angry] They've been harming our business for a while now, and soon there may be nothing left.

[solemn] They are beautiful creatures... [sad] We've shared the lake for generations, so it pains me that we must take such extreme actions against them. [soft voice] I've come to accept that we must cull their numbers so we can keep our livelihoods.

[solemn] It's only expected of me to ask an outsider to do what we cannot and are not willing to do.
quest_70053_quest_complete:
[soft voice] You're saying they were smaller in size? [pause] That'd explain their hunger.

[hesitant] However, what would make them leave their nest so early and why all of them?

<Warg ponders the thought for a while and turns back to you.>

[warm] Here's the payment as promised. [confident] I will investigate further.
quest_70054_quest_detail:
[solemn] These lands aren't what they used to be, <class>. [sad] Monsters have taken what's left of it, both the living and the dead.

[solemn] There have been reports of grave robbers in the cemetery at Raven Hill. [angry] A crime this vile and depraved cannot go unpunished.

[soft voice] Please, head west to the cemetery and investigate this matter. [urgent] If you find any grave robbers, get rid of them.

[solemn] The place was already desecrated by the Scourge. [sad] The living shouldn't disturb the dead even further.
quest_70054_quest_progress: [solemn] A good deed during dark times, that's what you're about to do.
quest_70054_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good work, <class>. [warm] What's that shovel you've got there? I think I recognize the initials.
quest_70055_quest_detail:
I can only think of one person with those initials and that would be Sven Yorgen. [solemn] He used to own the Yorgen Farmstead. In all of the chaos the farmstead was lost to the Defias Brotherhood who slowly made their way from Westfall.

[soft voice] I assume Sven has nothing to do with the grave robbers, but the Defias might. [hesitant] Seems to me it's only a coincidence. In any case, the Defias must be brought to an end. [commanding] We have enough on our plate when it comes to enemies and culling some of their numbers will bring peace to those who have yet to given up on their home.

[urgent] Therefore I ask that you slay any Defias in your way. [solemn] The Night Watch has seen their activity in Addle's Stead prior to your investigations, so perhaps it'd be best to start there, <name>.
quest_70055_quest_progress: [solemn] My trust rests with you, <name>. [soft voice] Please, do not fail me.
quest_70055_quest_complete: [solemn] While I am glad we reduced their number it never pleases me to take lives, directly or indirectly.
quest_70056_quest_detail:
[solemn] You have done me and the people of Duskwood a great favour, one I would like you to report to my commander.

[confident] I am more than sure she will like to hear of your success against the Defias, and she will probably have another job for you.

Take this parchment to Commander Althea Ebonlocke. [soft voice] She is stationed in front of the town hall so she'll be hard to miss.

[warm] Oh, and, <name>, thank you.
quest_70056_quest_complete:
You have my gratitude for aiding Paige. [soft voice] She's been in that camp for a great deal of time.

[solemn] Alas, there's little we can do in the situation we're in.
quest_70057_quest_detail:
[solemn] I hear Sven has taken shelter in a camp northwest of the Raven Hill Cemetery. [sad] I fear he's filled with regrets and anger, both at himself and those who took everything from him.

[soft voice] Considering we've found this shovel of his among the ruins of his lost home, I think it would be appropriate to see it returned to him.

[hesitant] Please, be careful when you return this to Sven. [low voice] He may be relieved to see it, or he might just break it in half in anguish. [pause] Who knows. [warm] Thank you again, for all you've done.
quest_70057_quest_complete:
[soft voice] What do you have there, <class>?

Oh, where did you find this?

[pause] This was the shovel my father had given me back when we worked the farmstead years ago. It served me well, and reminds me of him.

[solemn] Memories of a better time.

<Sven stares at the shovel and hands it back to you.>

[warm] It was a nice gesture of you to bring me this, <name>, but I have no use for it anymore.

Do with it what you will.
quest_70058_quest_detail:
[commanding] You have proven your worth to Paige, and frankly we can always use more hands in the Night Watch.

[solemn] While our forces focus on the worgen and the Scourge we would like you to take a trip to the south to Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and reduce the ogre population.

[urgent] There are only a few details that we know about the mound, but what we do know is that we need to be rid of the ogres. [emphasis] They are a threat to our scouts and to the roads leading to Westfall and Stranglethorn.

[warm] There's a reward waiting for you when you return, of course.
quest_70058_quest_complete: [soft voice] You'd be a great asset to the Night Watch but I am more than certain you wouldn't bore yourself with guard duty. [warm] Here's a little reward for a job well done.
quest_80100_quest_detail:
[urgent] Alright, pal, listen up! [commanding] I know this is your first job for the Venture Company, so I'll speak real slow for ya.

[low voice] We're up here to find a valuable treasure, y'hear? [emphasis] Supposed to be worth more than half the jewels in Undermine, and Boss can't wait to get his hands on it. [angry] The last crew he sent up here never sent anything back.

[threatening] Thievin' jerks think they're gonna cut and run from the boss? [commanding] You better believe he'll track them down and have their hides. [urgent] Boss says don't come back empty-handed, so let's get to work.

[soft voice] We busted up a few gizmos on our flyer gettin' down here, but luckily for us, the last crew seems to have left their bots behind. [commanding] Run around and grab some whizmagigs from them, would ya?
quest_80100_quest_progress: [low voice] You know what they say. [emphasis] Time is money, employee.
quest_80100_quest_complete:
Nice job, kid. [warm] If you keep that up, you might be a foreman in, uh, eighteen or nineteen years.

[soft voice] Competition's tough, y'know.
quest_80102_quest_detail:
[angry] You've gotta be kidding me. [low voice] Here we are, a mile above every mountain pass, and there's elves up here?

Listen, kid, elves are the most irrational creatures in the world. [mocking tone] A good goblin, he looks at a forest and he sees profit! But what does an elf see? Bears? Owls? Little baby squirrels with the big eyes? It makes me sick.

[commanding] Congratulations, you get to be the muscle today. [urgent] Go out and cut down a few tree-huggers, would ya? And some of their weird living plants while you're at it. [threatening] I don't trust anything that walks around on vines.
quest_80102_quest_progress:
[angry] Stupid elves love trees so much. [low voice] You know they grew themselves a giant tree to live in off the coast?

[mocking tone] They got the magic to grow a tree the size of a city and they never think of the lumber market. [sigh] It's madness.
quest_80102_quest_complete:
[excited] Nicely done, recruit! [warm] Consider yourself officially on my star employee list. [proud] Stick with old Nert and you're gonna go far!

[whispering] Oh, uh... I guess if I've got you doing bruiser work, it might be worth arming you with something more than sharp wits. [urgent] Just don't tell anyone I gave you this weapon for free!
quest_80103_quest_detail:
[urgent] Well, I guess we figured out why the elves are up here: The whole dang forest up ahead is on fire! [angry] And it's gotta be goblin-made, too.

No one else uses the kind of oil that burns that long! [commanding] That's Undermine stuff, kid. There ain't no way a gnome could get their hands on it. [hesitant] I don't know what's goin' on in this site, but I don't like it.

[urgent] Go out there and bring back some of that oil. [soft voice] Maybe you'll find some clues about what happened before we got here. [excited] If not, at least we'll have topped off our own oil supplies!
quest_80103_quest_progress: [urgent] This stuff will burn for years if you let it. [low voice] There's a reason it's a goblin trade secret. [commanding] But there's no profit in burning down a whole forest!
quest_80103_quest_complete:
[sigh] This doesn't make any sense. [hesitant] Why would they leave such valuable stuff behind?

[urgent] Where the heck did everybody go?
quest_80105_quest_detail: <Among the remains of the elemental, you find a note soaked in oil and scorched at the edges. Most of the writing is barely legible, but you can decipher one critical excerpt.> [angry] ... stupid boss didn't tell us anythin' about this place. Not a norm ... tomb. [solemn] Somethin' bad buried ... [urgent] center of the forest ... <This seems worth reporting back to the foreman.>
quest_80105_quest_progress: [angry] Why are you bringin' me a piece of paper, kid? [threatening] Do I look like your teacher?
quest_80105_quest_complete: <Nert looks over the note.> [hesitant] Well... That probably ain't good. But we didn't come this far just to quit because something scared off the last crew. [urgent] Can't go back to the boss empty-handed, right? <Nert looks troubled as he waves you off, perhaps trying to convince himself more than you that all is well.>
quest_80106_quest_detail:
[urgent] Okay, look. [urgent] A treasure hunter is gonna find some haunted forests from time to time, see? And we can't go back to the boss empty-handed. I mean CAN'T. Like he'll have us shipped off to the mines, can't.

So here's what we're gonna do, yeah? We're gonna try and grab the loot and get outta here quick-like. You've done good work so far, kid, so I'm counting on you for this job.

There looks to be more of the last crew's mechs further in this valley and, uh... [hesitant] some vultures that don't look real natural. Clear 'em out, and we'll see what's in there.
quest_80106_quest_progress: [low voice] I don't like the look of ‘em any more than you do, kid. But what choice we got?
quest_80106_quest_complete: [whispering] This place gives me the willies. [urgent] The sooner we're out of here, the better, right kid?
quest_80107_quest_detail:
I don't envy you right now, kid. See, those weird vultures aren't the worst thing in the woods. [low voice] Some of the other bruisers were havin' a look around, and they found a tomb that looks like it's from Uldaman for how old it is.

Tried to get close, but they heard some kind of unholy sound coming from inside. [sigh] These guys have been around for some of the boss's "persuasive" interviews before, and they've never heard sounds like that. Said it echoed around the hills all unnatural-like, as if it was bouncin' off trees that weren't there.

[pause] I'll fight elves. I'll fight plant monsters. I'll fight our own blasted tanks! [angry] But I am not messing with some ancient cursed tomb. [urgent] I want you to go down there, find out what's behind those doors, and deal with it. Do that for me, and you and me are chums for life. [warm] There may even be a promotion in your future.
quest_80107_quest_progress: [hesitant] This place gives me the heebie-jeebies.
quest_80107_quest_complete: [excited] The first of many? Nope, nope, nope. [angry] I don't care what the boss says, I am not gettin' cursed by some angry ghost. [urgent] We gotta get outta here, kid.
quest_80108_quest_detail:
[urgent] We're in a tough spot. The boss is scary, but he ain't worth fighting hordes of ghosts or some ancient curse. When he finds out we bailed on this gig, he'll have us hunted to the ends of Azeroth.

[hesitant] As much as it pains me to say, we're gonna have to cower and hide behind some real muscle if we don't all want to end up six feet under.

[solemn] There's only one force in Azeroth that even the boss wouldn't cross: The Horde. [excited] Sure, they don't like us, but we've got better odds with the Horde than with the boss!

[urgent] We ain't got many choices. [sad] No one else would take a bunch of deadbeat Venture Co. refugees. [urgent] If there's even a chance we can win them over, we've at least gotta try.

[solemn] It's that or spend the rest of our lives on the run. [urgent] Time for us to go straight, <name>.
quest_80108_quest_progress:
[urgent] Alright, we made it to Durotar.

[emphasis] Step 1 complete. [excited] Now for Step 2 of my master plan. [hesitant] That I just now made up...
quest_80108_quest_complete:
[urgent] Alright, we made it to Durotar. [excited] Step 1 complete.

[commanding] Now for Step 2 of my master plan... [mocking tone] That I just made up.
quest_80109_quest_detail:
[urgent] Our situation ain't good. If the Horde won't help us, I don't know where else we could go. [hesitant] But I've got a plan, see?

An old friend of mine is the cook at Razor Hill, the orc town just below that guard tower. Torka and I write now and then, and he ain't above bragging about his cooking.

He went so far as to say his boar ribs could bring the commander there to his knees. [confident] We're counting on that.

Hunt some of these boars and bring their meat to Torka. [excited] We'll have him cook 'em up and put in a good word for us, yeah? [loud voice] Any goblin will tell you one good word can take you all the way to the top!
quest_80109_quest_progress: [commanding] Hail, goblin. [urgent] Are you with the caravan from Ratchet we're expecting?
quest_80109_quest_complete:
[shocked] What is this? Boar meat? [angry] You present this to me like an offering rather than delivering supplies...

You say Nert sent you? Nert Blastentom?
quest_80110_quest_detail:
Nert is a good friend, and despite his choice of employment, I don't think he's a bad person. Convincing Gar'Thok of the same, though... [hesitant] And getting you all into the Horde? That's a tall order!

Gar'Thok may love my boar ribs, but I'd like to think he's got a better head on his shoulders than to recruit former Venture Co. crew in exchange for a meal.

[solemn] I'll cook these up for you at least. If you're set on this plan, take my advice: [commanding] Tell Gar'Thok your lot are refugees willing to serve. Do not mention the Venture Co. at all.

Give Nert my regards.
quest_80110_quest_progress:
[commanding] You don't look like the caravan from Ratchet. [low voice] What business do you have in Razor Hill?

<Gar'Thok sniffs the air and starts to salivate.>

Is that Torka's cooking I smell? [whispering] What I wouldn't give for some of his boar ribs...
quest_80110_quest_complete:
[commanding] A gift on behalf of you and your goblin refugee companions? You wish to join the Horde?! Listen, goblin...

<You offer the boar ribs in an enticing manner, and after a moment of hesitation, Gar'Thok hungrily grabs the ribs. He devours the food with relish, making a mess but looking satisfied.>

A goblin giving food freely. Hmm, I will see what I can do... First, formalities.

Are you prepared to fight with honor among the ranks of the Warchief's army? To be his blade and shield in lands unknown?
quest_80115_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey, <name>! Employee of the day! How's about an unpaid break?

While you were busy doing my... I mean YOUR job, Grizzie the Enforcer came around looking for you. Said something about him owing you a favor?

Here, he mentions it in this letter... which I may or may not have dropped into my buzzard wings.

[urgent] Don't take too long, though. Your break is already half over!
quest_80116_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Glad you're back, <name>. You know I love me some gossip, and I bet you do, too. Maybe you'd care to shed a little light on why your name is on the lips of such bad news?

I hear you owe Leyti Quicktongue some money. Did you gamble all of your savings back home or what?

Is she your loan shark? Do I have to pay for your health insurance? That's not gonna happen, pal.

Look, just take this letter she left for you. I don't want to hold this thing anymore, especially with that nasty looking green stuff dripping off the corner. Probably acid or poison or something.

[urgent] Short break, and I mean short!
quest_80117_quest_detail:
[commanding] Back for more work, <name>? I appreciate your dedication to all this scut work, but Mayten Boomrifle is looking for you. Gave me this letter for you and everything, said something about teaching you some proper shootin'!

[laughing] Heh, like you need some so-called expert to teach you how to launch metal projectiles or harness explosions. We're goblins!

Whatever... Here, take this letter and go pay him a visit. [urgent] Hurry it up. No stalling, or no meals for you today!
quest_80118_quest_detail: [excited] Great work so far, <name>. [commanding] I knew having a mage in our labor force would come in handy. Speaking of handy, how's about conjuring up some water for your poor parched foreman?
quest_80119_quest_detail:
<name>, pal! Back so soon? W-we're pals, right? Heh heh...

[hesitant] Being honest, you kinda give me the creeps, not unlike Amri Demondeal. [sigh] She came looking for you, and boy I hope I never have to speak to her again.

You, uh, do all that freaky demon stuff, too? With the green fire and blood circles and such?

Look, I didn't see nothin'! J-just take this letter Amri left and go do your business. Take as long as you want!
quest_80201_quest_detail:
Wagons full of refugees have arrived from the north, and more are surely on the way.

[solemn] Because this was used as a dwarven hunting lodge, the larders are fully stocked with meat. [soft voice] Unfortunately, most of the meat was in the process of being salted and the lodge does not have ample firewood. [hesitant] Some of the refugees have already begun chopping wood for the lumber supply.

[urgent] Go out and collect some of the bundles of wood they've prepared. [soft voice] You'll find them near the trees growing around the lodge, but be careful not to venture too far out into the valley: The creatures of Loch Modan are too dangerous for a young <class> such as yourself.
quest_80201_quest_complete: [soft voice] Thank you, <name>. [warm] With this, we should have more than enough wood to keep our people warm and bellies full.
quest_80203_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, <race>, can I have your attention for a moment?

I am Kathy Wake. I am a part of a branch of the Alliance military responsible for ensuring the safety and prosperity of Alliance lands. We've recently been sent here with a large contingent of men. Although I personally believe we are needed more back home, it is not my place to question orders.

Our mission has been to ensure your people arrived safely to the lodge, and also to get you settled in. However, it is not easy to keep everyone safe from the dangers out here. While my men have been dealing with the larger problematic elements in the region, smaller ones have been left unattended for too long, and now they have been allowed to run rampant.

The refugee caravans could be in danger if something is not done quickly. [solemn] I take it you can fight? If so, please go out there and take care of the troggs that have been infesting the area around the lodge!
quest_80203_quest_progress: [soft voice] Well, <race>, has the deed been done?
quest_80203_quest_complete:
[warm] Well done, <name>. [solemn] This is only the beginning, but removing those vermin will ensure the refugees remain safe for now.

[urgent] We have more work to do, though. [confident] The more assistance we get from you, the more help we can provide your people.
quest_80204_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You're less wet behind the ears, now, which is good.

The vermin you've defeated are only a nuisance compared to other things that lurk in this valley. Some of the recent refugees who arrived last night reported seeing a short-statured figure with glowing red eyes in the woods as it stalked the area.

Some brushed it off as fatigue from the long travel, but I believe it may be the forward scout of a Shadowforge raiding party.

The Shadowforge are one of the Dark Iron clans. They are corrupted red-eyed dwarves who are at odds with the kingdom of Ironforge. [solemn] Investigate the area to the west where the sighting happened, but do not stray too close to the digsite. It is infested with troggs far stronger than those vermin that you fought earlier.

[urgent] Remember: do not engage. If you find something, confirm your sighting and immediately return here.
quest_80204_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you spotted the Shadowforge scout?
quest_80204_quest_complete: [urgent] A whole armed camp? [angry] Damn, this is a problem. [solemn] We'll need to devote resources into dealing with it that we don't have. [warm] Thank you for your help, <name>! [confident] We may call upon you again once we figure out how to handle this.
quest_80205_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello again, <name>.

The wood you gathered helped feed many refugees. [solemn] However, the situation is far from resolved.

The drinking water stores are running low. [urgent] Soon, we will not be able to care for the refugees, but luckily there is a well to the north near the border of this valley. [commanding] Go there, and fill this barrel with water.

There are volunteers trying to dig a new well here, but that will take time.

[warm] Please, <name>, I know I can count on you!
quest_80205_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get it? [soft voice] The children are thirsty.
quest_80205_quest_complete:
[excited] You got the water?

[warm] Thank you, <name>. [soft voice] At least that's one less problem we have to deal with.

[warm] The children will have water, and the progress on the well is going wonderfully!
quest_80206_quest_detail:
<Vyrin appears distressed as she looks in your direction.> [solemn] We found a wagon burned down with the corpses of the accompanying escorts nearby and no sign of the refugees. [sad] It's... terrible, <name>, it's absolutely terrible!

[urgent] Please speak to your companion, Malvinah, was it? [hesitant] I am trying to keep people calm as we figure this out, but she is very disturbed. [angry] She's spreading panic and confusion among the refugees.
quest_80206_quest_progress: [urgent] What is it, <name>? [low voice] Now is not the time.
quest_80206_quest_complete:
So, you know about it, then? [urgent] My scouts have confirmed it.

It's that damned Shadowforge raiding party you found. We should have struck right away, but instead I wanted to prepare... [angry] damn it! It's as if they knew we were onto them. You didn't attack any of them, did you?

Well, no matter. There is no time for regret. [solemn] It is time to act!

[urgent] The refugees have been put in cages, and the Dark Irons are preparing to ritually sacrifice them to their god, the Firelord Ragnaros.

[commanding] We can't allow it, <name>! [urgent] I'm going to need your help with this!
quest_80207_quest_detail:
Alright, <name>, [commanding] here is the plan. We have established a perimeter around the Dark Iron camp, but we believe that if we move in force, then they will execute the refugees. We have been ordered to stand down.

However, if we do not act now, the refugees will be killed. We need an outsider to sneak into their camp, kill the fire cleric, acquire the key to the cells, and free the refugees.

[solemn] I can think of no one more worthy of this task than you. You have proven yourself to be strong and resourceful in the short time we've known each other.

[warm] I believe in you, <name>! [urgent] Now go and save those people!
quest_80207_quest_progress: [urgent] Time is of the essence, <name>. [urgent] Do not delay!
quest_80207_quest_complete:
[solemn] They are all safe. [delight] I can't believe it, we averted a disaster! [warm] I can't thank you enough, <name>! We take our duty very seriously, and losing those people would have been terrible.

[urgent] Now, we need to take care of that raiding party. [soft voice] There is someone who wants to speak with you about that. Go see Vyrin.
quest_80208_quest_detail:
[excited] You're the hero of the hour, <name>! [warm] All the refugees are speaking your name!

[soft voice] I believe there is a friend of yours who is particularly grateful. [pause] Why not go and speak with Malvinah Sunblade?
quest_80208_quest_progress: [soft voice] The hero of the hour returns, huh?
quest_80208_quest_complete:
[warm] You did well, <name>. [warm] You deserve all the praise you're getting.

[soft voice] It may not seem like much to save a few refugees, but consider that this is just the start of your journey. [proud] You exhibited great courage, too.

[warm] I can safely say that I am proud to have met you. [solemn] However, there is another matter we must talk about.

[solemn] Several of the refugee caravans have decided to move on to Stormwind. [solemn] We can escort them part of the way there, but eventually they will arrive in a region beset by strife.

[solemn] Bandits and beasts run amok while we are ordered to outlying areas such as this lodge.

[solemn] We can't go against our orders, but adventurers like you can make a difference back home.

[urgent] Think about it and talk to me again.
quest_80209_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You've decided to assist, then? [excited] I am grateful, <name>!

[solemn] The situation back home is dire and we cannot return to help at the moment. [sad] I do not know what kind of affliction ails the Stormwind nobles, but ever since King Varian disappeared, the Kingdom has been run into the ground!

[urgent] Alas, while we can't control the nobles, we can deal with the problems in the kingdom's provinces! [warm] Elwynn Forest is a good place to start. [solemn] The capital is located in this region, and it has been surrounded by issues. [commanding] Kobolds rule the mines, gnolls raid the towns, and bandits seize the roads.

[warm] My friend Marshal Dugan is stationed in Goldshire, and he can put you to good use. [confident] I believe the Magistrix here can teleport you to Goldshire.
quest_80209_quest_progress: [shocked] A high elf here? [surprised] What can I do for you, stranger?
quest_80209_quest_complete:
[shocked] Kathy Wake sent you?! [excited] You've certainly made connections if an SI... I mean, if a member of the Alliance military sent you!

[commanding] If you're here to assist, I can assure you that we'll need the help. [sad] I have requested for reinforcements from the capital several times, but received nothing.

[confident] If Kathy vouches for you, then that's good enough for me. [warm] I believe I have your first assignment in mind!

[urgent] Oh, and don't forget to visit the inn. [soft voice] You may want to attune your hearthstone there.
quest_80210_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Greetings, <name>! [warm] You've made amazing progress so far, but there is still so much to do.

While the lodge is stocked with an abundance of grain and meat, we're lacking other types of nourishment like fruits and vegetables.

Luckily, the area around the lodge has an abundance of pumpkins and berries this time of the year. [urgent] Can I count on you to search the area for berries and pumpkins?

[solemn] Our peoples' welfare depends on it!
quest_80210_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you get the pumpkins and berries?
quest_80210_quest_complete:
[excited] Wonderful! [warm] This will last a while until we can acquire supplies from the Alliance.

[soft voice] We can also use the seeds from the pumpkins to plan our own pumpkin patch.
quest_80211_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] the fall of our homeland has affected us all. [soft voice] But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[pause] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80211_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So you've chosen to begin your training? [warm] I am pleased, <name>. [warm] Very pleased. [warm] Talk to me again and I will do my best to guide you with my knowledge.

[solemn] In time, I believe you will grow to become someone all rangers can be proud of calling a comrade!

[warm] My bearded friend, Claude Erksine, can also assist you with beast-related training once you are ready.
quest_80212_quest_detail:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. [solemn] But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[soft voice] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80212_quest_complete:
[solemn] Light be with you, <name>!

[warm] It honors and brings me endless joy to see you take the first step on the path of becoming a paladin.

[warm] Know that I shall do my utmost to guide you through the tenets and through your training.

[gentle] Talk to me again whenever you wish to seek my counsel.
quest_80213_quest_detail:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. [solemn] But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[soft voice] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80213_quest_progress: [soft voice] May the Sun's Light shine upon you.
quest_80213_quest_complete:
[excited] By the Sun, you've come!

[warm] Many of our people have lost their faith in the Light of the Sun as they wander like sheep lost in the dark. [solemn] Together, we can be the beacon guiding them to salvation and to the warmth of the Sun!

[proud] I shall do my best to be your beacon, <name>. [gentle] Ask and I will teach you what I can.
quest_80214_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[soft voice] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80214_quest_progress: [solemn] The Magisterium is the most prestigious group that a mage can be a part of.
quest_80214_quest_complete:
[solemn] Ah, <name>, I take it you're here to become my apprentice?

If so, then know that I will not coddle you. [commanding] You will be serving under a proud member of the Magisterium.

As such, you will be taught what I deem necessary for your progress. [low voice] Continue to perform adequately and I shall continue to guide you.

Eventually, you will be fit enough for the Magisterium.

[pause] Talk to me again once you are prepared.
quest_80215_quest_detail:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. [solemn] But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[soft voice] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80215_quest_complete:
[soft voice] So, you really came, huh?

[mocking tone] Amusing. Well, you've completed your first test, but don't think that it's your last.

[commanding] Let's see how well you fare under my training. Talk to me again when you're ready and I'll teach you some tricks. If you continue to show potential, then expect me to continue teaching you.
quest_80216_quest_detail:
<name>, [solemn] the fall of our homeland has affected us all. [soft voice] But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

[pause] Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

[gentle] Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
quest_80216_quest_progress: [solemn] Wielding the sword is just as majestic as it is powerful.
quest_80216_quest_complete:
[gentle] I must say that your appearance gives me hope.

[solemn] Few of our people take on the path of the sword. It is a long and arduous journey, but I have faith that you can overcome it with my training.

[confident] It doesn't matter how many rangers or mages you have. In the end, you need someone on the frontlines to win battles.

[warm] When you're ready to take up that mantle, talk to me again.
quest_80220_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You're a <race> right?

[pause] You aren't the first I've seen around here recently. [solemn] A lot of your people have arrived and have settled up in Stormwind.

[gentle] In the outer section of the Dwarven district bordering the canal, there is an entrance with the banner of your people, go there and you can meet them should you wish to greet your own folk.
quest_80220_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes? [urgent] What can I do for you?
quest_80220_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah have you arrived from Alah'Thalas? It's good to hear our people are settling in safely. [solemn] I am Illyanah Dawnstar, Quel'dorei representative.

The House of Nobles have granted us this street as a place to live and house our refugees for now. Of course you're welcome to stay as well, we have lodgings, although our permanent housing building is filled to the brim, the Inn can spare a bed for a few nights. [warm] Rest assured that plans are in motion to improve the situation of our people... permanently. [low voice] Alas I must return to my book keeping, stay safe friend!
quest_80289_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Ah, there you are, <name>. You have proven to be of some use in the past. I have observed that you have an uncanny knack for running errands. [solemn] My ancestors were exiled from Kalimdor seven thousand years ago, but you're mistaken if you think they created Quel'thalas right away.

They landed in what is today known as the Tirisfal Glades. According to records left behind in Alah'thalas, the first settlement was known as Ishnu'danil. [solemn] Naturally, this is something we consider worthy of exploring further, which is why I have sent my subordinate Thas'alah to investigate this ancient location.

[urgent] However, I have not heard a word from him since, and to make matters worse, the records we found mention a curse of some kind that affected the minds of our ancestors who lived there. [commanding] I need you to go there and find out what became of Thas'alah.
quest_80289_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Arcanist Anu'delen sent you? [warm] Finally, some good news, [angry] this damned expedition has just been one disaster after another. [pause] We made progress at first but not long after, everything went downhill.

[sad] Our equipment broke, people thought the place was haunted, and some even claimed that they heard voices talking to them. But that last one is nonsense, I assure you.
quest_80290_quest_detail:
[solemn] With all that has been going around here, I could use help from an adventurer like you. You see, our people used magic to shape the land and create buildings like this, but this one appears to have been only partially complete and abandoned.

I tried venturing inside myself but was immediately filled with dread and horror. It felt like it was consuming me, so I fled outside. But you, on the other hand, seem like someone who is not easily frightened. Before I... left. I noticed a Stone Tablet etched into the cliff.

Perhaps it can provide some clue as to what might've happened here. [hesitant] Could you be so kind as to retrieve it for me?
quest_80290_quest_complete:
So it was haunted, after all? [sad] It's a shame we could not talk to the spirit, but I guess it's for the best. [soft voice] Anyways, let's see that tablet. [soft voice] Ah, it's written in Thalassian, that makes things a bit easier. [solemn] It details the establishment of Ishnu'danil as the new home of the Highborne and Alah'aran.

[solemn] But look at this part. [solemn] It's a verse about a well, to be precise, a well of power. [solemn] And what is this? [solemn] Look here at the bottom. [solemn] There's a message inscribed here, but this does not match the writing style from before. [solemn] It states:
