<Avoid the Shalla'aran. Avoid the Ishnu'danil. There is only darkness here> [solemn] . [solemn] Ishnu'danil translates to Fortune's Peak, but Shalla'aran means the Shadow Well. [solemn] If something that powerful lies somewhere around here, we must find out more about it! [urgent]
quest_80291_quest_detail: [solemn] I have already sent my serv... assistant Thalo down there, but he has yet to return. [soft voice] It could prove valuable to know more about it if this Shadow Well is as powerful and dangerous as this text claims.
quest_80291_quest_progress: [urgent] You are back!? [pause] That is... good. [soft voice] Tell me, what did you find down there?
quest_80291_quest_complete:
[solemn] If you didn't find Thalo, it must mean that the skeleton was his. [soft voice] Oh well. And what is this about black slimes emerging from the well's waters? [solemn] So they were right, most intriguing.

[soft voice] Anyways, your help here is appreciated, but I think it's high time for you to leave. [solemn] I still have research to do here, and you should inform Arcanist about our findings here, should you not?
quest_80292_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Don't worry about me. [pause] I will not be alone here. I have my... guards with me. And you must agree that this place is too important to leave unattended.

[hesitant] Oh, and if you could avoid mentioning the stuff about hearing voices, that would be wonderful. [soft voice] I don't want to scare the potential helpers, which Anu'delen might send my way.
quest_80292_quest_progress: [angry] Took you long enough, <name>. [sad] You're alone. [urgent] Where is Scryer Thas'alah?
quest_80292_quest_complete:
[solemn] Most of his expedition is dead, and he decided to remain there? Has he lost his mind!? [angry] A haunted place with talks of dark whispers and monsters coming out of the corrupted well is certainly not what I was hoping for us to find there.

[soft voice] Nevertheless, the information you brought may prove valuable to us. [pause] This is a lot to take in, and it's a damn shame that such a powerful well ended up being corrupted. [solemn] And this is where your work ends, and mine begins. [warm] Oh, and I almost forgot, here is little something for your valiant efforts.
quest_80300_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello mon! I be representing a clutch of the Revantusk Trolls that have left the shores of our home in order to forge a bond and more promising relations with the Horde.
quest_80301_quest_detail:
[solemn] When we first got here, it was important for us to raise structures to make a home for ourselves. While tidying the place up, we breached the entrance of the temple, clearing away all the collapsed rubble.

Many loa used to be worshipped there, especially the Loa of Death. [soft voice] We must have disturbed the spirits inside the tomb, because the trolls of the past have arisen to haunt the temple. [threatening] These vengeful undead attack anyone who tries to walk their halls, even peaceful worshippers.

[urgent] Ya duty is to set fire to the pyres in the tomb, to soothe the troubled spirits and purify the temple. If the undead be in ya way, send them back to the afterlife.
quest_80301_quest_progress: [urgent] Is it done? [soft voice] Have the spirits been put to rest?
quest_80301_quest_complete:
[soft voice] The foul stench be starting to clear. [warm] Ya did good mon. [proud] Ya deserve a reward for ya efforts.

[solemn] Know that in time, this place will not only be an asset to the Revantusk, but the Horde as a whole.
quest_80302_quest_detail:
I be toiling with diplomacy here, so me hands are tied on proper greetings. [soft voice] If ya truly wanna help the Revantusk Tribe, we be appreciating it.

[solemn] The time has come for the Revantusk to pull their weight in the Horde for all the aid they been giving us in the Hinterlands, and set a course for the future. [urgent] Deino of the Darkspear Tribe has been kind enough to open portals for us to and from Amani'Alor.

[warm] Ya can find her in the Valley of Spirits. [commanding] As soon as ya get to Amani'Alor, seek out Mystic Guya'jin and ask how ya can help the Revantusk cause.
quest_80302_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ya looking to help the Revantusk, too? Well ain'tcha a fine diplomat of the Horde.

[warm] They be the last sane forest tribe and our cousins, so it be me pleasure to help them. [solemn] Trolls around Azeroth been at odds for many many years, so it fill me with hope seeing tribes uniting under the Horde.

[warm] If ya ever wish to travel to Amani'Alor, just speak to me.
quest_80303_quest_detail: [solemn] It's good to see you again, <class>. [solemn] Our scouts have reported increased activity from our ancient enemy in the Eastern Plaguelands.
quest_80304_quest_detail:
[solemn] The trolls be blessed by the loa with great regeneration, mon. Be it just a scratch or an entire limb, we be able to heal. Still, there be times when the regeneration takes much too long, and there be no shame in being prepared for those times.

[soft voice] Our allies at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale recently discovered a little voodoo solution without even realizing. There be toads roaming the Mystral Lake at the edge of the forest, near Talondeep Path. They be covered with a slippery oil that can be brewed into a powerful salve.

[urgent] Won'tcha be a friend and go squeeze them toads for me, mon? Bring me their oil, and I'll see ya be rewarded for your time.
quest_80304_quest_progress: [low voice] How goes the squeezing, mon?
quest_80304_quest_complete: [solemn] Spirits be with ya, <race>. Ya efforts will keep us trolls healing up nicely. The Horde been nothing but kind to us, and we'll see to it ya be repaid in kind.
quest_80305_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey kid, enjoying yourself?

Nah, you're really not. I can see it on your face. This place is pretty run-down and boring with no real stuff to do, eh?

Well, if you're looking for some action, coin-action, mind you, then I got something for ya! But, you know, info doesn't come cheap, now does it?

How about a silver coin to loosen up my tongue?

<The goblin waits with an open hand while grinning at you.>

Well, now that we are friends, I suppose I can let you in on this little something. Something that I've heard around town. See, there's this bar that just opened up in the Valley of Honor. Quite ironic, don't you think?

I heard a goblin named Quark opened up a shop, but it's supposed to be a membership-only enterprise.

I wouldn't bother going there myself, but I heard there's good money to be made!

Now, that'll be fifty copper for the intel. Have a nice day, pal.
quest_80305_quest_progress:
[low voice] Why are you still here, <name>?

[mocking tone] If you wanted to buy me a drink, I'm sorry, but I you're not my type. [hesitant] Unless, of course, you've got enough coin. [soft voice] Then, maybe something can be arranged.
quest_80305_quest_complete:
[excited] Yeah, yeah, pal, in a minute!

[mocking tone] What's the rush?
quest_80306_quest_detail:
[shouting] Hey pal, watch it!

[excited] Oh, what's this? A proper customer, eh?

[warm] Welcome to Quark's Shack. [commanding] You here for business or pleasure?

[soft voice] You see, this here is a bar of mine made for coin connoisseurs, so if you're here, then it's time to grab some quick coin and also have some fun you're at it.

[urgent] If you're looking to gamble, then speak to Agne. [whispering] She handles the bones. [mocking tone] What, you never rolled the dice before? [laughing] Nah, no need to worry about your coins, pal. [confident] You'll make back your losses in no time! [commanding] Now, if you need anything to widen your eyes and numb your thoughts, come back and see me.
quest_80306_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hey there, sweetie. [excited] Wanna play a quick game of chance with your local beauty, Agne?
quest_80306_quest_complete: [confident] The early investor reaps the most interest.
quest_80307_quest_detail:
[commanding] Enjoying yourself, boss?

Good, good. Now, you see, that was a free trial. Doesn't really matter to me if you won or not, but I did say ‘coin connoisseurs', so you really gotta pay a membership fee.

[mocking tone] Hey, hey, where're you goin' man? Come on, don't be like that. I might be willing to give you a membership card if you repay me with some favors.

See, I ordered some new goods from the Undermine for our hookahs. [urgent] This cargo is very important and valuable. I will throw in some coins, too, which you are more than welcome to keep spending in my bar, if you go and fetch my goods for me. Now, the cargo should arrive at Ratchet right around today, so if you'd get a move on, I'd really appreciate it.
quest_80307_quest_progress: [urgent] I'm running really low on my supplies, here, <name>. [shouting] Could seriously use that cargo right about now!
quest_80307_quest_complete:
Quark's tobacco?

We might have a problem.

[urgent] Wait! [soft voice] No reason to be aggressive. [pause] Listen. <Wiley throws in a few coins to dissuade you from violence with quivering little hands.>
quest_80308_quest_detail:
[hesitant] So... we may have a slight pirate “infestation” problem. [urgent] While cargo was being delivered from the Undermine, these damn pirates raided the boat and looted it. The crew escaped safely, but more importantly, the cargo was all gone!

[angry] It's a lot of wasted coin. [soft voice] Quark is expecting a big shipment, but a lot of it has either been smoked or lost to the sea. [commanding] Just try to get whatever you can back and I might be able to fudge some numbers.

[urgent] You'll find the pirates to the south, down the coastline.

Quark's waiting for that cargo, so you'd better hurry. [emphasis] Something's better than nothing.
quest_80308_quest_progress: [urgent] There's gonna be a big problem if I can't get my missing cargo shipments.
quest_80308_quest_complete:
[angry] What, pirates?! Pirates?!

[angry] Screw pirates, sweet mother of goblins!

[shouting] For crying out loud, argh, gnomish bastards!

[sigh] I guess these crates will do. [warm] I owe you one, <name>. [hesitant] Er—actually, I don't. [warm] Here, just take this membership card instead. [proud] You've earned it. [proud] You're officially a member of Quark's Shack, now. [excited] Gamble your heart away, pal.
quest_80310_quest_detail:
[angry] That damn rat. He stole from me, did he now? I'm handing him over, but before that, I want you to stare that mongrel in the eyes and tell him that he got caught. [commanding] Beat him to a pulp, and then hand him over to Odo.

After you're done, speak to The Rov. [urgent] I want you to tell him to keep watch and tighten up the security around here. Can't just go around having thieves in my own shack, ya know? [warm] When you're all done, come back to me and there'll be a reward in it for ya.
quest_80310_quest_progress: [angry] Just get him out of my sight before I give him a good smackdown!
quest_80310_quest_complete: [soft voice] Now, with that done, I have to figure out a way to recover the money I lost. [warm] Thanks for the help, pal. Stick around. [confident] You're a valuable member, now. [excited] Also, here! Can't give ya loads of cash, but drinks are on me today.
quest_80311_quest_detail:
<Ureda glances at you with dismay.> [low voice] Your skills still require some honing, and your posture betrays your arrogance. [commanding] Typical of any new apprentice who bears overconfidence before his own wits. [cold] Not that it matters to me. [soft voice] It's your own problem.

[commanding] Any aspiring mage should have his spells ready at all times and think two steps ahead. [solemn] That's why your lack of awareness should be compensated with at least something you could procure by yourself.

[pause] There is a… “mage” who resides on the bank of Southfury River, not far from Thunder Ridge. [commanding] The task you will receive from this mage might be arduous at first glance, yet it most likely will bear fruit if you put your brain into it.
quest_80313_quest_detail:
[excited] Oho, Deino send more help? Guya'jin be pleased.

[soft voice] I be Guya'jin, Witch Doctor of the Revantusk Tribe and the spiritual leader of our people. [commanding] I keep this portal to Orgrimmar stable, so if ya want to return to the Valley of Spirits at any time, ya come see Guya'jin.

[solemn] Amani'Alor be a blessing for our tribe, an ancient Zandalari temple with a deep connection to the loa. [soft voice] We be far away from our temples mon, but here, we can appeal to the local loa and maintain a connection with our loa back home.

[gentle] Ya look a little green still, mon. [pause] Why don'tcha look around and get your bearings? [commanding] Speak to me when ya be ready for ya first task. [urgent] There be a lot of work to do round here.
quest_80313_quest_complete: [soft voice] Good, good. We be having much to do, so don't go scurrying yet mon.
quest_80314_quest_detail:
[solemn] The aid of the Darkspear has been a welcome surprise. [soft voice] In a time when a troll would rather take ya eyes than see eye to eye with another tribe, this unity be a true miracle.

[pause] As a show of good will, Zol'majin will be sending ya to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. [gentle] Offer this doll to him. [solemn] It be an old troll custom, one he will understand.
quest_80314_quest_progress: [low voice] Ya mon? [urgent] Ya say ya got something for me?
quest_80314_quest_complete:
[solemn] I haven't gotten one of these in years, mon. Do ya understand the meaning of this gesture?

[soft voice] This be a voodoo doll of Warleader Zol'majin himself, given in confidence to another troll. [pause] This doll will eventually reach Vol'jin, so Zol'majin be putting his life in the hands of the Darkspear.

[solemn voice] This be a symbol of great trust between the tribes. [soft voice] This gesture may be returned in kind with time.
quest_80330_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello, young hunter. [warm] You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
quest_80334_quest_complete:
[solemn] A young <class>, I see. [warm] Yes, I will grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [warm] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

[urgent] Now, go, <class>. [soft voice] We will speak again, at a later date.
quest_80339_quest_detail: [soft voice] Hello, young hunter. [warm] You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
quest_80340_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I am Clover Spinpistol, Mountaineer and Sniper. [low voice] We may be good shots, but unfortunately us little folk aren't too suited for close combat. [excited] No worries, though! You just need to have a beast take the hits for you!

[solemn] Tinker Town's best and brightest recently made an amazing scientific breakthrough to address our less than stellar record with large animals who find us appetizing and bite-sized.

[warm] You seem like a promising marksman. [proud] Just the talent we need in our efforts to retake Gnomeregan! [commanding] To that end, I'll teach you how to use the patented G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod.

[urgent] Take this and try to use it on a Large Crag Boar. [emphasis] Make sure it's large!
quest_80340_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you tame it yet? Did it work? [hesitant] Don't worry, you can tame another one if you don't like the attitude of this particular boar.
quest_80340_quest_complete: [delight] Oh, my! [warm] Well done. [soft voice] This rod definitely requires further testing, and you can get a better choice of companion in the process.
quest_80341_quest_detail:
Haha! My, that boar sure is a BIG one, isn't it? [soft voice] I bet you'd like something more suited to a gnome, though. How about a quick-thinking, majestic Snow Leopard?

You can find them to both the south and east of here. [excited] I've recharged your G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod, so you're ready to go out there and catch a cat!

[urgent] Watch out, though. They're far more feisty than that boar! [mocking tone] Don't underestimate them or you might end up as kitty kibble!
quest_80341_quest_progress: [soft voice] Snow leopards are white and spotted to blend into the snow. [pause] They might be hard to find.
quest_80341_quest_complete: [warm] Wonderful! [excited] Now that's a pretty feline! [soft voice] Of course, in the end, I'll leave it up to you what beast you would like to tame.
quest_80342_quest_detail:
One thing I should mention is both the boar and the leopard are fierce offensive pets, but they leave a bit to be desired in defensive capabilities. [soft voice] Since our ranged weapons can pop ANY enemy with ease, what we need is something to keep them busy.

[pause] Hmm... I've got it! The Ice Claw Bear is sturdy and tenacious. [confident] When facing an angry bear, who would choose to go after a tiny gnome?

[mocking tone] Ice Claw Bears can be found east of Kharanos. [urgent] You have enough experience and skill under your belt now, so you should be able to handle one.

[warm] Once you're done, I'll give you access to the finalized Taming Rod so you can tame your own pet at will!
quest_80342_quest_progress: [urgent] Did you get an Ice Claw Bear yet?
quest_80342_quest_complete:
[excited] Well done, <name>! Marvelous! [proud] Together we've proven to those snooty dwarves that we gnomes are just as capable Mountaineers as they are! [warm] Your brilliant success is more than enough to stifle any further snickering and teasing.

[warm] For that, I thank you, <name>. [warm] As promised, here's the schematic and instructions for the G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod!

[urgent] Now get out there, find yourself a companion, and show the world Gnomeregan's best!
quest_80343_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Now that you've got your rod and all, <name>, you can tame companions of your own to help advance the cause of all gnomekind!

[hesitant] However, taming them isn't enough on its own. They also need training, and sadly, I don't have that knowledge to share. [sad] Even though you've done well under my tutelage, I can't mentor your pet! For that, you'll need to find someone else.

[excited] I know just the person for the job, too! [warm] If you're ever in Ironforge, there's a dwarf named Belia Thundergranite in the Hall of Arms. She should be able to help you out. [urgent] Be sure to tell her I sent you!

[warm] Good luck!
quest_80343_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Spinpistol sent you? That must mean her hairbrained scheme panned out after all. [warm] That wee lass you trained with actually managed to accomplish her crazy scheme of taming beasts, then? [surprised] I'll be... And you helped her? [confident] You're clearly more than meets the eye, already on your way to becoming a great <class>, I see.

[solemn] Very well. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [warm] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, but you will also be able to feed your pet as well as revive it if it falls in battle.

[gentle] Remember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. [proud] In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.
quest_80350_quest_detail: [solemn] While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the hunter trainer Thorgas. [soft voice] Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
quest_80350_quest_progress:
[excited] Ya made it! [excited] Good to hear! [chuckling] Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. [laughing] Haha! [warm] Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, <name>. [soft voice] Learning the ways of the land. [soft voice] Learning to track a bear through the mountains. [solemn] Even just surviving on wits alone takes a great deal of courage and cunning. [commanding] Think you're capable?

[hesitant] Can't say I'm sure ye've got what it takes. [warm] A gnome hunter, eh? [proud] I can see you're determined to succeed and put your own twist on the profession, though, so who am I to stop ye?
quest_80350_quest_complete:
[solemn] One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. [solemn] The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.

[soft voice] Fixated as the gnomes may be on technology and machinery, never forget that respect for nature it essential to a hunter. [warm] I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. [warm] Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. [warm] I'll train you when I can.
quest_80360_quest_detail:
[solemn] The journey from our forests in the old world to our new home here in Kalimdor was not only hard on us, but also the loa that protected us on the journey. [soft voice] So far from the forests they have roamed for millennia, they are weakened in their presence here.

[solemn] Far to the south, the Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak have maintained a connection with Kimbul despite their distance from the Gurubashi's jungles. [commanding] Seek Kimbul's power and return it to me. [solemn] I will use the power granted by the Sandfury to increase our own loa's presence and strength in these foreign lands.
quest_80360_quest_progress: [solemn] Akil'darah has blessed the winds at your back with what strength she has.
quest_80360_quest_complete: [solemn] It will take time for our loa to begin to feel as if this is their home, just as it will take time for us to accept it as ours. [soft voice] We will grow together and nurture their spirits while they safeguard our homes. [urgent] Halazzi's cunning keep your wits, until then.
quest_80366_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Hello, young ranger, you appear to be doing well!

[solemn] Our people struggles but we must endure, we must become more able than we were before.

[emphasis] There is a ranger in Alah'Thalas called Damilara Sunsorrow, she is said to be able to bend beasts to her will, such a technique would be useful to you, see if you can learn it from her.
quest_80366_quest_complete: [soft voice] Greetings, ranger. [warm] Yes, perhaps it is time for you.
quest_80370_quest_progress:
[soft voice] We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. [solemn] A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Alah'thalas for your generous actions. [low voice] Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

[gentle] If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. [warm] Wool Cloth(60)
quest_80370_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80371_quest_progress:
[solemn] As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

[gentle] A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! [warm] If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Silk Cloth(60)
quest_80371_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80372_quest_progress:
[soft voice] Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! [warm] By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Alah'thalas, I assure you!

[excited] If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Mageweave Cloth(60)
quest_80372_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80373_quest_progress:
<name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. [soft voice] As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. [urgent] We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

[warm] If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. [commanding] We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there. Runecloth(60)
quest_80373_quest_complete:
[delight] Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. [warm] Thank you again for your assistance! [warm] We'd certainly be lost without you.

[warm] With all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. [warm] Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
quest_80374_quest_progress: [soft voice] Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it. [soft voice] Runecloth(20)
quest_80374_quest_complete: [soft voice] Greetings once again, <name>! [warm] Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. [warm] For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Alah'thalas.
quest_80375_quest_progress:
[soft voice] We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. [solemn] A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Amani'alor for your generous actions. [low voice] Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

[gentle] If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Wool Cloth(60)
quest_80375_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80376_quest_progress:
[soft voice] As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. [pause] Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

[warm] A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! [commanding] If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Silk Cloth(60)
quest_80376_quest_complete: [delight] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80377_quest_progress:
[urgent] Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Amani'Alor, I assure you!

[commanding] If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Mageweave Cloth(60)
quest_80377_quest_complete: [excited] Wonderful! [warm] We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
quest_80378_quest_progress:
<name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. [solemn] As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. [urgent] We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

[warm] If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. [commanding] We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there. Runecloth(60)
quest_80378_quest_complete:
[delight] Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. [warm] Thank you again for your assistance! [proud] We'd certainly be lost without you.

With all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
quest_80379_quest_progress: [soft voice] Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it. [commanding] Runecloth(20)
quest_80379_quest_complete: [solemn] Greetings once again, <name>! [warm] Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. [proud] For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Amani'alor.
quest_80380_quest_detail:
[urgent] I've got a whole party of people to feed, but one of my rivals cut me off from all of my meat suppliers! [angry] Whoever it is must be jealous of my deccadent, fall-off-the-bone ribs and beer-battered seafood supreme. [proud] With a name like mine, I have big boots to fill.

[commanding] I'll make sure they regret crossing me by making the best barbeque anyone's ever tasted! [soft voice] What's in it for you? Well, I have a Saltcrabs family secret that I can impart to you. [warm] It'll help you turn any venue into a great place for a picnic. [urgent] Round up all of the little crab, crocolisk, and stag families and tell them to say their goodbyes, then bring me their insides. The beer I need for basting can be bought from a few vendors that you'll find on your adventures. Get whatever is cheapest.

[urgent] Hurry up, I gotta cook all of this before the party starts!
quest_80380_quest_progress: [urgent] Time's a-tickin', bub. Can't waste what's left of it before this big palooza so I can surprise the culprit with my amazing spicy crab souffle. [excited] It's a cutthroat cooking competition out here that drives people to do these crazy things, <name>, but I'm always one step ahead.
quest_80380_quest_complete: [excited] You got the goods? Sweet! [warm] I'll get cookin', but first, I promised you the Saltcrabs formula for a perfect brunch, didn't I? Well first, you set down a blanket, then you put up an umbrella! That was worth the effort, now wasn't it? [proud] Thanks for the meats, <name>. [excited] I'm gonna knock the pants off these partygoers!
quest_80382_quest_detail:
[excited] What would a beach party be without a couple of trade princes, huh? [urgent] I need big names at this event or else it'll be a flop!

[commanding] Put on your fanciest clothes and deliver these special invitations out to Trade Prince Gazlowe in Ratchet and Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

[confident] If they come, then more will be sure to follow. [soft voice] More bodies at the beach equals more gold lining my pockets, see? [warm] I'll give you something real nice in return.
quest_80382_quest_progress: Hurry up or you'll cramp my style! [excited] I don't want these guys to think I left their invites for last.
quest_80382_quest_complete:
[excited] Sweet, my party's gonna rock! [excited] I can't wait to see what kind of clout these boys bring.

[excited] If they're really high rollers, they'll buy a whole bar's worth of booze.

[warm] Thanks again for your help. [warm] Why don't you join us on this beautiful beach front? [gentle] Not looking like that, though. [gentle] You've gotta have the right stitching to kick it with me. [commanding] Take these and put them on.
quest_80383_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Do you see that dorsal fin rising out of the water? [emphasis] That's a shark.

It appears to have come too close to the shoreline which is an anomaly for this species. [pause] I'm a marine biologist by trade and I've been watching that poor creature for a while now.

There could be a number of reasons that it's trapped here, but [angry] the goblins want to kill it like a stuck pig!

They think it's a threat to people in the water, but it's probably just scared and confused.

[urgent] I can't let that happen. [emphasis] I need you to go into the water and shoo the shark away.
quest_80383_quest_progress: [soft voice] Did you know that sharks have skeletons made of cartilage and not bones?
quest_80383_quest_complete:
[excited] You did it! [warm] Now that shark can get back to its lifestyle as the apex predator in the sea instead of being strung up like a trophy which is what these goblins would have done to it.

[soft voice] I have a little memento for you as a reward. [gentle] Take good care of it, okay?
quest_80384_quest_detail:
Dese crabs, troublemakers dey are!

Cutting my nets with the claws, scaring all the fish away! Every time I chase them dey bury themselves to the sand, [sad] Lau'Tiki isn't as nimble as his younger years.

About time for some revenge, [angry] pesky shell-walkers will get what dey deserve for messin' with Lau'Tiki!

Hunt them, bring me their shells and I might let you in a little secret.
quest_80384_quest_progress: [commanding] Hunt them, bring me their shells!
quest_80384_quest_complete:
[laughing] Ahahahhah! Good job, mon! [warm] For my part of the deal...

<Lau'Tiki crack opens one of the shells and extracts something from it.>

Here's da secret, mon. [soft voice] This tiny pesky bastard might come in handy when ya tame it and feed it. Though never fully trust it, dey like nibbling on fingers.
quest_80392_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Excuse me, may I have your attention for a second?

[soft voice] My name is Lieren and you look like a seasoned traveler. [soft voice] I have a task for you if you do not mind helping me, I am quite busy with my own, I need a package taken to Quel'Danil east of here.

[soft voice] Just look for an Elf lodge there and take it to my sister. [soft voice] My sister has similar features to mine, but she is all of elvish ancestry.

[soft voice] I've attached your payment to the package, [mocking tone] now what do you say pipsqueak, will you help me out?
quest_80392_quest_progress: [soft voice] Welcome to Quel'Danil, how may I be of assistance?
quest_80392_quest_complete:
[delight] A package for me? From my sister? [excited] thank you so much. [warm] Here is your payment as promised.

[soft voice] Actually there is one more thing I would like you to help me out with...
quest_80393_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I hope it is not too much to ask for, but you look like the strong type.

The people of Quel'Danil are my family and they've been at odds with the terrible Witherbark Trolls for a long time! [urgent] I am asking you to reduce their numbers, I don't want to see any more suffering, we have all lost so much already.

[sad] Shandra'lor hosts sadistic trolls and their pet spiders, I would like you to focus on those.

Once the job is done please report to my adoptive mother Voldana. [urgent] She is deeper inside the lodge!
quest_80393_quest_progress: [soft voice] Yes, <class>? [soft voice] What brings you here?
quest_80393_quest_complete: [soft voice] You have my deepest gratitude, <class>, and of course I'll make sure to thank Loania, too. [warm] You must be curious why a human is among us. [solemn] If you are interested, then I shall tell you...
quest_80395_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey, <race>! In addition to the usual weapons in my stock, I have an opportunity for you.

[soft voice] While I was doing my run from Ratchet to the Crossroads, I saw a weird light on the mountain just south of Ratchet. [pause] There seems to be a ramp up just outside Ratchet. [urgent] Some raptors call the thing home though, so be careful.

[hesitant] Now I don't know what it is, but you adventurin' types like to dive right in when it comes to dangerous situations, right? [emphasis] It could be some HUGE deal like a demon cult or whatever for all I know, and them doing nasty stuff to Ratchet would be very bad for MY business. [warm] Consider whatever spoils you find as payment.
quest_80395_quest_progress: [soft voice] Oh my, greetings! [hesitant] Who are you?
quest_80395_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh you're an adventurer that has come to investigate the lights aren't you? [warm] Don't worry, I was merely experimenting with a special matter transmitter and it is of no danger to anyone!

[confident] Fear not, my experiment will be of use to everyone once it succeeds! [urgent] On the other hand, I have a task for you if you wish to keep this area safer!
quest_80396_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I am Kheyna Spinpistol. Mechanist, medic and killer of bad things.

[urgent] I am currently tracking a dangerous foe who threatens the lives of countless innocents. I might ask for your help in dealing with this later, but for now, I have another task for you and a generous reward if you do it well!

[solemn] The nearby Kolkar tribe is preparing for a raid on the Crossroads. I know this because I've used one of my tools, and you could say I "sneaked" into their tent and heard their Khan ordering it. This can be avoided, however. [commanding] You'll save many lives if you go down there and put an end to them all.

They can be found around the Oasis to the west. Once you're done, come back to me. If I am not here, simply touch the crystal again and I will know someone is waiting for me. [urgent] Now get out there and KILL them all!
quest_80396_quest_complete:
Wonderful. [whispering] I wonder what it felt like to have their blood splatter all over you, or what came into your mind as you heard them scream in pain and fall like the vermin they are.

[sad] I wish I could have been there to see it for myself, heh.

[solemn] Nonetheless, know that thanks to your violent deeds many lives were saved. [warm] Now, of course I'll be sure to reward you… Hmm, let's see… Yes, this will be something you can either use or sell for compensation.

[proud] I'll make sure to tell others of your deeds. [soft voice] Hopefully we'll meet again, <name>.
quest_80397_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Welcome, <class>. We don't see many adventurers up this way — and not without reason.

[solemn] The greed of the Venture Company has tainted the land itself. Every ancient tree that they fell only adds to my troubles.

[sad] The powerful sap that once nourished the trees of this forest now congeals into those awful sap beasts. [urgent] Their corrosive nature harms the delicate balance we've fought to maintain here.

[solemn] Worse still, many have recently made their way to Stonetalon Peak itself! [angry] Their corrosive sap kills the herbs I need for cooking and simple potions.

<class>, venture forth and rid the Peak of these things. [urgent] You'll find many just south of here, over the ridge that holds the old ruins. [hesitant] We've little enough use for coin up here, but perhaps a few potions might serve as payment?
quest_80397_quest_progress: [urgent] Have you rid the mountaintop of those sap beasts? [soft voice] Rest here for a moment and recover your strength.
quest_80397_quest_complete: [delight] Thank you, <name>! [warm] With the Venture Company's activities unchecked, this surely isn't the end of those sap beasts, but for now the forest is quiet and already healing. Here, take a few of my potions in thanks for your hard work. They should help you travel swiftly in this mountainous terrain.
quest_80398_quest_detail:
[soft voice] You find out that the Pounder's Mainframe is surprisingly intact. [excited] This could be valuable!

[urgent] Take it to an expert of Gnomish Engineering who might be able to do something with it.
quest_80398_quest_progress: [soft voice] Hello there, <race>, are you here for one of my inventions?
quest_80398_quest_complete:
[excited] Is that an actual intact Pounder Mainframe?! [urgent] Where did you get this?

[excited] The possibilities with this are endless! [warm] Tell you what, if you allow me to copy the data from this mainframe then I will help you build a Pounder of your own!
quest_80399_quest_detail:
Makasgar, my once faithful apprentice, has become arrogant and deserted me. [sad] He has fled north along the coast with a vast amount of dark mojo I had reserved for my future plans.

[commanding] Perhaps we can make a deal if you and your minions retrieve this artifact along with his head. [threatening] Bring me what rightfully belongs to me, and you shall receive what you seek in return.
quest_80399_quest_progress: [soft voice] What do you have there, <name>?
quest_80399_quest_complete: [solemn] Zalazane's mojo and his apprentice's head? [proud] A job well-done. [warm] Here, I've got a reward for you. [excited] Just pick which one you want.
quest_80400_quest_detail:
<The dwarf looks flustered as he mumbles under his breath.> [angry] Blast 'em buggers all to pieces...

[soft voice] Oh, hallo there. [excited] Perfect timing, my friend. Why, I'd sure as hell like yer helping hand!

So, listen up, I've had me book finished recently and was about tae get some components I needed fer ma new invention. I left me camp fer a wee spell and whaddayaknow?! [angry] Bloody troggs came over and had a carousin' with me stuff!

[sad] Alas, me book got ripped to pieces and judging by what's left of it, all 25 pages of perfectly drawn patterns and schematics were lost.

[urgent] All I care about now is me book pages returned and them mauchit troggs sufferin' in the process. [threatening] They're numpties, same as kobolds, but just like kobolds they tend to run in packs — so be careful when ye find them!
quest_80400_quest_progress:
[angry] Wreckin' me camp, stealin' me belongings, eatin' me haggis and even settin' me camp ablaze are nowhere near as horrible a crime as stealin' me bonnie book!

[threatening] Make 'em suffer worse than a gryphon with clipped wings!
quest_80400_quest_complete:
[excited] Oh, me bonnie, precious, darling book! [sad] What did those scunnered bampots dae to ye?

[warm] Thank ye, <class>, I'll never forget yer kindness.

[proud] I'll be sure to add a dedication to yer name once I put me book back together!
quest_80401_quest_detail:
[hesitant] Unfortunately, building a Pounder isn't easy. [soft voice] I will supply most of the components, but I will need you to get me some special things. [emphasis] It is up to you how you go about acquiring them.

[commanding] I need the following:

A thorium tuned servo for the chassis. [angry] I only know of one, and it's been locked up by those Scarlet fanatics. [solemn] I think the armory is where they store objects they consider heretical. [urgent] Go get it for me!

[soft voice] In addition to that, I also need a perfect core for the Pounder. [solemn] The Dark Iron golems in the Blackrock Depths make a good source. [solemn] Golem Lord Argelmach probably has one.

[urgent] The last component I need is a high quality adamantite rod used for the endoskeleton. [solemn] I believe Stratholme's forges used to make such rods in the past. [hesitant] I do not know the state of the city, but I believe the rods may still survive there.
quest_80401_quest_progress: [excited] Welcome back! [soft voice] How did it go? [urgent] Did you get the items yet?
quest_80401_quest_complete:
[excited] That's all the components! [delight] Wonderful! While you were gone, I've been busy engineering your Pounder. All that's left is to apply the components you've brought and to paint it.

[warm] I didn't do the paint job yet so you could pick a color!
quest_80407_quest_detail:
[excited] Hey!

You're <name>, right? [soft voice] I received a letter from a certain Kheyna Spinpistol. [gentle] She paid me handsomely to direct you to a crashed gnomish rocket car north west of town.

[urgent] She said you'll know what to do when you find 'it' .
quest_80407_quest_complete:
[excited] Hello again, <name>! [warm] I see that Reas succeeded in her task.

Good, good! [urgent] I have need of your aid again!
quest_80408_quest_detail:
[solemn] My search for my nemesis continues, but as that search continues, so too does the work that needs to be done. [urgent] I have needs of brains! [excited] I am currently researching an amazingly innovative technology, but it needs to be perfected for all races.

[urgent] I need more samples and I know exactly where to get them! [shouting] Far south and slightly east of Gadgetzan you will find a set of Troll ruins known as the Eastmoon Ruins! [angry] There are Ogres there. [commanding] Tear them apart violently! [urgent] They're going to attack the water reserves of Tanaris and cause a lot of people to die from thirst.

[urgent] Water is already expensive, but if the reserves are destroyed by those brutes, the price will skyrocket and most people won't be able to afford water. [solemn] Let's avoid that. [commanding] Kill them all. [urgent] Once you have them, take the brains to Reas and then come back to the crystal.
quest_80408_quest_complete: [excited] You really got 12 brains?! [shouting] Sick! [warm] Well, money is money.
quest_80409_quest_detail: [commanding] I will deal with these as instructed. [urgent] You better go back to whoever sent you.
quest_80410_quest_detail: [soft voice] Excuse me, <name>. [solemn] I received a peculiar message from the Cenarion Circle recently, but it wasn't addressed to me, it was addressed to you. <Rayne hands you a letter, as you open it, the letter only contains a few words and no signature: "It is time. Meet me inside the inn of Andorhal on the second floor.">
quest_80605_quest_progress: [soft voice] Please... [urgent] You cannot let her win!
quest_80605_quest_complete:
<Kheyna stares somberly at the head, her ocular implants contracts for a moment> [soft voice] Antnormi was like a sister to me once.

[sad] I wish this could have ended differently, but alas... We did what we had to.

[solemn] For the time being I will remain here until Chromie figures out what to do with me. [pause] I was once a Bronze dragon after all, maybe I can be one again if we find a cure.

[warm] Remember when I had you collect brains for me? [excited] That work paid off, and I've made a version of my implant that can connect to your brain without needing to drill into your skull.

[warm] It's your reward for what you've done. Take it, it'll help you.

[gentle] I also wish to introduce myself to you properly. My real name is Keridormi. [soft voice] I've never had many friends, so thank you for everything you've done for me.

[warm] Perhaps we will meet again in time. [urgent] Stay safe!
quest_80700_quest_detail:
[excited] I've been looking for you all around the city! [soft voice] Although I am more of an announcer than a mailman I was instructed to give this letter to you by well… I am not sure who he was.

[hesitant] The figure's face was covered and his voice didn't seem familiar at all. [solemn] He said you will understand when you read it.

[soft voice] I am not one to pry, <name>, but be more careful, [urgent] I wouldn't let the guards know I associate myself with those kinds of people.
quest_80700_quest_progress: [urgent] Just take it off my hands before the guards think we're doing something shady.
quest_80700_quest_complete: [soft voice] Here's the letter, I hope I won't have to do this again.
quest_80701_quest_detail:
Burn this after you've read it.

<name>, [soft voice] I dearly hope this letter finds you in good health, I wish I could've delivered the message in person but you must understand that we like to keep secrecy at hand.

[solemn] I am not sure if you're aware of what our organisation does, or who we entirely are, but we have discovered valuable information and we might need your help.

[urgent] In the envelope you will find a ring, keep it at hand while you come visit us, it will be the sign you've accepted our mission and that the letter was burnt.

Until we meet,
Mathias Shaw.
quest_80701_quest_progress: [gentle] How can I help you, stranger?
quest_80701_quest_complete:
[soft voice] Ah, my ring.

It seems you've made it, [hesitant] apologies for the secrecy but we must be careful, even our walls have ears that do not belong to the organisation.
quest_80702_quest_detail:
[urgent] My agents have reported that a Scarlet caravan has started moving through various towns.

From what we know they have already gone to Lakeshire, Darkshire, Menethil and Southshore.

[solemn] My only assumption is that whoever took over the Crusade after the events that transpired the Scarlet Monastery, Hearthglen and Stratholme has realised they've been running short on men.

[commanding] I want you to go and speak to the people of Lakeshire. The locals should have at least seen something.
quest_80702_quest_progress: [soft voice] How is your task going?
quest_80702_quest_complete:
[solemn] So we were right, this would've been valuable information if we didn't already receive another report.

Sorry about that, <name>. [urgent] I will be needing your help once more.
quest_80703_quest_detail:
[laughing] Yeah bub that's all I know, now I don't say I deserve any kind of compensation for the information but it will highly be appreciated.

<Kixxle holds open his palm but you refuse to pay.>

[mocking tone] Fine then, go on and follow the road to that bridge, Thandol Span or whatever, I hope those Scarlets get you for being such a prick!
quest_80703_quest_progress: [commanding] The Scarlet Crusade must be put to an end.
quest_80703_quest_complete:
[angry] So this is all you could salvage from the idiots that willingly murdered our caravan, eh?

[low voice] I’ll take him to the dungeon, good job.
quest_80704_quest_detail:
[solemn] We've been trying to no avail to interrogate the young lad you brought back, <name>. [sad] He simply wouldn't talk, me and the other guards tried to persuade him as best as we could.

[commanding] Considering you were there to put an end to their masquerade, I'd assume you'd have a better chance to draw some information out of him.

[warm] Credits given where credits are due, you did a great job putting piece to piece together and finding them.

[urgent] Take whatever approach you'd like, just see it done.
quest_80704_quest_progress: [angry] The figure in front of you is displeased at your sight and is practically tearing you apart in their mind.
quest_80704_quest_complete:
[solemn] You are at an impasse, not sure how to proceed. Given the circumstances you must make the best out of what you have. While contemplating the matter you take a wide look around the room, noticing that Stoutfist and the other guards left some means of approach to you. It's time for you to decide how to approach the interrogation of the prisoner.

The coffee mug on the table tells you it'd be best to persuade him. The iron maiden next to him gives you other ideas.
quest_80707_quest_detail: [solemn] You've extracted all the information you could get from Vladeus. [soft voice] Deciding you're done with him you let him rest and think about your next actions.
quest_80708_quest_detail:
My boys made preparation for the prisoner to reach Stormwind. [solemn] His fate will be decided there since he’s part of their jurisdiction.

[warm] You were of great help and I am sure you want to poke around this thing even further. [hesitant] I might have a lead for you, not sure how much it will help though.

[soft voice] Under the Cathedral District’s Chapel there’s a priest in red robes. [solemn] The intel I got from Shaw’s men says that his name is Brother Crowley and was sent by the Scarlet Crusade inside the city as an ambassador of sorts.

[angry] His mission was to recruit the willing to fight in the name of the Light or whatever stupid lie these Scarlets are telling to themselves.

[soft voice] In any case, Crowley hasn’t been that active. [urgent] We are not sure if he’s the one to recruit these blokes but it’s worth a try.
quest_80708_quest_complete:
[angry] Bold accusation, <race>, I almost feel offended.

[soft voice] I fear it was not me, things would’ve been simpler. [commanding] I assume you got a name from your prisoner. [solemn] Tell me what happened.
quest_80709_quest_detail:
[solemn] Abbendis must be stopped and you will be one of the thorns in her side and how better should you do it if not from the inside?

[soft voice] While I hold no skill in the arts of the Arcane, a dear friend of mine who, just like me, would love to see her fall has provided me in the past with a few scrolls that could change one’s appearance.

[gentle] I am more than happy to offer you one if you were to tell nobody of it. [whispering] Let’s just say the scrolls were for something more meaningful, yet desperate times call for desperate measures.

[urgent] Use this when close to Tyr’s Hand, claim to be one of the disciples of the caravan you destroyed and claim your team was slain by the ogres of Arathi.
quest_80709_quest_complete:
[soft voice] We’ve been expecting at least a handful of new recruits, not just one.

[commanding] Explain yourself immediately.
quest_80710_quest_detail:
[urgent] Ready for your first assignment?

[soft voice] Your armor looks shabby and your blade dull but if you’re not able to pull up your own weight you’re not worth the trouble of the Light.

[commanding] Travel the Plaguelands, slay any undead in your path and bring me their brains. [solemn] Their brains are essential for something the High General has planned, simply do your job and ask no questions.

[shouting] Go you fool, the Light waits for nobody, go on and claim your glorious purpose.
quest_80710_quest_progress: [soft voice] Don’t worry yourself with details, do as you were told.
quest_80710_quest_complete:
[solemn] Perfect condition, if anything this rotten could be called something other than disgusting.

[angry] Blasted Scourge, I hope the High General is right.

[urgent] Now onto your next task, recruit.
quest_80711_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Your next errand is to simply collect a few things here and there, nothing special.

[urgent] You will find these while fighting Elementals and plants in some of the actual dangerous zones of the world, but I am more than sure you will succeed if you truly are chosen by the Light.

[warm] Bring me Savage Fronds and Core of the Elements, fifty of each, it will be a great help in what we wish to achieve.

[solemn] When and if you return you will officially be a member and I will give you a map as to where to find the entrance for the secret training spot.

[solemn] May the Light bless your poor soul. [warm] If you return we will embrace you as a sibling, if you do not we will not mourn for you even for a second.
quest_80711_quest_progress: [soft voice] It’s a simple task, kill and collect, [commanding] what more do you want?
quest_80711_quest_complete:
[solemn] Welcome back, brother and may the Light bless us both in the days to come.

[warm] Here’s your insignia and here’s the map for the entrance, the High General will be very pleased to have you.

[proud] For the Scarlet Crusade, for the Light and for Lordaeron!
quest_80723_quest_progress: [whispering] Zwinker...[pause] Yes, I can see that Lord Varimathras sent you.
quest_80723_quest_complete:
[soft voice] My name is Zinge, <class>.

[pause] Show me what you've brought and I shall help you as I can, if such is my lord's command.
quest_80724_quest_detail:
[soft voice] I did perform a few precursory tests on the substance you have with you. All I have been able to discern is that the potion contains Peacebloom and Ghost Hair.

[hesitant] But that cannot answer for the catatonic state it forces upon undead.

[solemn] It is my hypothesis that this concoction has been tampered with some manner of higher spellcraft, and that is beyond my abilities to solve.

[pause] There is only one who can give us the answers we need. [solemn voice] He dwells at the centre of Brightwater Lake, east of Brill.

[commanding] Approach him with great reverence and measure your words accordingly.
quest_80724_quest_complete:
[solemn] If your tale and the effects of this potion are true, you were right to come to me.

[commanding] This is a weapon that should never lay in the hands of the Scarlet Crusade. [soft voice] As for what it is, you will have to indulge me momentarily.
quest_80725_quest_detail:
[solemn] I sometimes long for Dalaran and of the days I once lived as no more than a mere student of the arcane arts.

[sad] When the Scourge shackled me to their dominion, my old memories were the only tether that kept me from losing myself utterly.

[soft voice] I do not intend to burden you with my life's story, <name>, but I already know what this vial is and how it was made, yet I need you to do me a favor before I tell you. [commanding] Think of it as an equivalent exchange.

[urgent] Go to the decadent town of Ambermill: Behind its town hall I buried a locket and sealed it with magic.

[pause] I will give you a scroll that will erase its warding spell, retrieve the locket, and return it to me. [solemn] Then we shall talk.
quest_80725_quest_complete:
[solemn] You had to battle a mage for it?

I presume he failed to speak his name as you slew him, but that ought to be no concern of ours.

[soft voice] You fulfilled your end of the bargain, <name>, and it is now my turn to repay the debt.
quest_80726_quest_detail:
[solemn] The potion brewed by the Scarlets that you retrieved is known as the Draught of Dormant Death, or Mortudiant as we scholars prefer.

[soft voice] It was first conceived during the Second War, in Dalaran, to aid in countering the unhallowed might of Gul'dan's death knights.

[low voice] It can only be concocted with a specific alchemical implement commonly used in transmutation known as the Philosopher's Stone. [sad] Which, unfortunately, I neither possess nor know how to emulate.

[solemn] For now, you should return to your masters in the Undercity with what you've learned. [pause] I will keep the potion and see whether I can learn anything else.
quest_80728_quest_progress:
[solemn] Yes, the Banshee Queen forewarned me of your arrival. Do you have the uniform at hand?

It might make amends for the unfortunate feelings I hear you roused in her.
quest_80728_quest_complete: [solemn] That will suffice. [pause] Lay it here for a moment. [low voice] It will not take me long.
quest_80729_quest_detail:
[solemn] As you may have divined, we contrive to infiltrate you into the ranks of the Scarlet Crusade.

[soft voice] Upon the uniform you've brought me I placed an illusion charm, as well as a few greater cloaking wards to keep the enchantment from easy detection.

[pause] All that is left is for you to introduce yourself as a novice to the recruiters in Tyr's Hand.

One such recruiter should be Mavel Brightwood.

[urgent] I wish you luck, <name>. [whispering] Have your wits about you and find out what you can of their meddlesome alchemists.
quest_80729_quest_complete: [soft voice] Ah, another recruit, what took you so long to get here?
quest_80730_quest_detail:
[solemn] The SI:7 have means of communication that reach us quite fast and believe it or not they are very reliable.

[pause] Sparing you any further details you should know that a dwarven caravan that was meant to reach Aerie Peak never made it out of the Wetlands.

[sad] The caravan lays in ruins and you can only find the mutilated husks of what used to be dwarves.

[soft voice] Our agents already poked around the zone but failed to find anything, they are currently trying to localize these newly recruited Scarlet zealots.

[hesitant] I'm not very sure how much of a detective you believe yourself to be, but I ask you to take a second look, maybe they missed something.

[commanding] If you find the recruits, keep in mind that we aren't sure what manner of persuasion the Scarlets used to brainwash them, spare as many as you can and take them to Menethil.
quest_80730_quest_progress: [urgent] Now do you want to buy something or just bother me?
quest_80730_quest_complete:
[urgent] Listen here pal, I am trying to make a living, so you either buy something or scram!

[commanding] Of course unless you got something else to talk about but make it quick!
quest_80740_quest_detail:
<name>, the Lunar Festival needs you! [urgent] During the celebration a sneaky satyr snuck in and stole our most special firework. [soft voice] It was a special kind of firework I managed to get from the Goblins of Booty Bay. [solemn] He claims he managed to buy this off some traveling merchant that claimed he was from all the way to Pandaria.

[solemn] Its beauty would cover the entire sky of Moonglade in the form of a dragon serpent. [commanding] You must retrieve it! [solemn] It was supposed to be our greatest surprise for this year's Lunar Event.

[urgent] If the revelers are to be believed this satyr came at the behest of Lorgus Jett. [threatening] A thievling cultist that hides in the Blackfathom Deeps. [commanding] Retrieve my prize and I will offer you, yours!
quest_80740_quest_complete: [excited] Oh, it's you! [warm] And you got it back. [solemn] Elune herself thanks you for your kindness. [delight] Here's a surprise for you.
quest_80745_quest_detail:
[solemn] The Mid-Autumn Festival is upon us, a time to celebrate unity and joy under the moonlit sky. [soft voice] You’ve been chosen to take part in the ancient lantern-lighting ceremony, a tradition that fills the night with glowing blessings.

[gentle] Head to the riverbank, place your lantern on the waters, and watch as it drifts, carrying your wishes for peace and prosperity. [warm] The spirits of the water will guide your light, spreading warmth and hope through the night.

[solemn] Return once the lantern has set sail, and you'll be rewarded for your participation in this sacred event.
quest_80745_quest_progress: [soft voice] What a beautiful moonlit night!
quest_80745_quest_complete:
[solemn] The lanterns have drifted far, carrying your blessings to the world.

[warm] May the light you’ve set forth bring peace and joy to you and yours during this festival.

[delight] Take these mooncakes as a token of our gratitude.
quest_80755_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Yes, yes, I understand why Liott sent you to me. Without that incantation, you would have had quite the struggle taming all but the most indiscriminate of beasts. [excited] Now you may tame living creatures the world over!

[solemn] But you must know that is not enough. [emphasis] You must realize that the true power of the creatures you turn to your whims lies in bestowing them the talents you observe in the wild. [pause] It is not enough to simply sic a wild animal upon your foes.

[urgent] If you wish to tap into the true potential of your pets, then speak to me once again. [commanding] I will spare no detail in enlightening you in the ways of the beast master.
quest_80755_quest_complete:
[solemn] I will now grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. [warm] Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

[urgent] Now, go. Gather your beasts and turn them to the cause of the Dark Lady.
quest_8367_quest_detail:
[solemn] Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor! [commanding] The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters. We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.

[urgent] Go forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch! [shouting] For Honor! [shouting] For the Horde!
quest_8962_quest_detail:
<class>, listen closely. [solemn] Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

Mor Grayhoof, our most prominent druid, had many close friends amongst the Cenarion Circle, some of which have fallen to the silithid. [urgent] I need you to retrieve some Druidical Remains from the silithid that inhabit the environs of Hive'Regal in southeastern Silithus.
quest_8965_quest_detail:
<class>, listen closely. [solemn] Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

[soft voice] An ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. [urgent] Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
quest_8988_quest_detail:
<class>, listen closely. [solemn] Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

[soft voice] An ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. [urgent] Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
quest_41749_quest_detail:
[soft voice] Could I spare a moment with you? [soft voice] You look like the tough type ready to burst into action, seeking the thrill of adventure and the smell of gold and riches. [soft voice] As it stands, you are exactly the type of person I'm looking for. [soft voice] You see, any self-respecting goblin has many contacts when it comes to possible revenue; some more legal than others. [soft voice] Many of my contractors are of the latter and one particular group is interested in something you don't get your hands on everyday.

[soft voice] To the souththeast, just shy of the great falls coming from Loch Modan is an old mining facility, they call it the Dragonmaw Retreat nowadays. [soft voice] Inside, are equally ancient golems said to roam the unstable halls, still stuck in old protocols. [excited] If you're able to bring me a runestone they are powered by, I'll fetch you a fair price for it!
quest_41973_quest_complete: <Gordnak inspects the letter, a smile crossing his face.> [soft voice] Zalwan huh? [pause] Been a few months since I heard from him, [surprised] shocked he's still alive with all that stuff going on in Tel'Abim, [sad] no wonder he wants out.
quest_1796_quest_detail:
[solemn] The first item I will aid you in creating is a robe. [soft voice] You will gather the items for me, and we will put them together. Afterwards, assuming you succeed, you will have the first of many items that will make you more powerful and aid you in your struggles.

[pause] To start, you must have crafted Robes of Arcana. [gentle] A tailor can make this for you, or perhaps you can purchase one from someone else--I'd be most impressed if you could make it yourself--but regardless, bring me the robes, and we shall go from there.
quest_5056_quest_detail:
[solemn] In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. [urgent] Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow <race>.

Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. [soft voice] Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.

[commanding] Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.
quest_40302_quest_complete:
[excited] You found it!

Oh my, I think it's hatching <name>! Quick [pause] what a beautiful little baby tu-- it's not a baby?!

<The turtle seemed to have gotten a growth spurt and stares at you> . [sad] I think those Nagas used their magic on this poor baby turtle, it seems to believe you are its parent, there goes my chance to have a talking turtle in the Faire.

[warm] Well, enjoy your new companion friend, and visit us from time to time, I really wonder if it will ever speak.
quest_41624_quest_progress: [solemn] Bear in mind that without the materials, we may not continue.
quest_5921_quest_complete:
"And so it begins. Father Cenarius. And so it begins."

Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

"[solemn] The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. [commanding] I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"
quest_821_quest_complete:
Haha... [laughing] I never thought I'd make more of this stuff ever again.

[warm] You've stirred in me a great sense of nostalgia, <name>. [soft voice] Kind of reminds me of the last time I made a batch of trogg brew. [warm] Thank you. The memories warm my stomach.
quest_3923_quest_progress: [shouting] Mind your head! I don't want it to get in the way of my work!
quest_5021_quest_detail:
"[urgent] The package must be delivered... delivered before I'm trapped here!"

[whispering] The cries of a panicked woman feel almost like a whisper floating through the house. [solemn] Cowered in the upstairs corner is the apparition of a woman. [soft voice] She does not seem to be fully cognizant of her surroundings, and she is only vaguely aware of you.

[hesitant] "Are you here to deliver my package? [urgent] Please, before it gets much worse! [sad] I was going to ride out of here. [sad] It should still be by my horse... or am I too late?"
quest_5922_quest_complete:
"And so it begins. Father Cenarius. And so it begins."

Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

"[solemn] The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. [commanding] I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"
quest_8055_quest_detail:
[solemn] Battle gear gives you power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots. They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.

[commanding] You must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate. [urgent] Go to Zul'Gurub. Take the Paragons of Power I need. Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside. [threatening] Bring them to me. [solemn] Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.
quest_8985_quest_detail:
<class>, [solemn] listen closely. [pause] Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

[soft voice] Isalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. [urgent] I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
quest_41706_quest_detail:
[solemn] Nature be with you, traveler. [soft voice] How peculiar to find another like-minded soul here on this island. [hesitant] I premused only Olmir and I were anchored at these cliffs. [solemn] Let me introduce myself: [soft voice] My name is Methendra Owltalon, I am a Druid of the Cenarion Circle on a mission for my Shan'do Staghelm. [solemn] In his endless wisdom, he sensed a terrible darkness permeating from this isle, one he felt last during the Third War on Kalimdor. [soft voice] In our short time here I noticed suspicious behavior in the local wildlife. [urgent] Regardless of the harsh living conditions, they portray an unusual amount of aggression and frequent clawing at their environment. [solemn] Something is plaguing them, and it is up to us to find out why.

[urgent] Put the aching animals out of their pain and retrieve the essences of their agony. [warm] Hopefully they will shine a light on what is happening to them.
quest_41797_quest_detail:
[sad] Duskwood grows more dangerous with each passing day. Either its the rabid worgen, wandering dead or thieving cutthroats - there is always something out for your life out here. [solemn] In the end, one may wonder why we're all still here. The answer is simple: these woods are our home, and we're not letting these monstrosities take them from us.

[soft voice] Still, me being here weighs heavy on the hearts of my friends, on Barbara's more than others'. [solemn] She is the fletcher of Lord Amberwood, the ruling noble of Northwind north of Stormwind. [sad] I haven't seen her in a long time, let alone written to her about my well-being. [sad] She must be worried sick about me, and it shames me deeply. [gentle] If you have a moment to spare, could you deliver this letter to her? [solemn] In it are things written I should've said to her a long time ago, so I'm entrusting you with a very important task. [warm] If you could do that for me, I'd be eternally grateful to you.

[urgent] The quickest way to Northwind is by passing through the Stormwind Harbor.
quest_41807_quest_complete:
<Oglethorpe adjusts his goggles and inspects the materials with exaggerated precision> Ooooh, yes! The powder's potent, the framework's solid, and the gizmo's got just the right amount of whirrrr. [excited] Excellent work! These will do nicely—no duds, no rust, no strange gooey residue. Always a good sign!

Now stand back, friend—way back—and prepare to witness engineering brilliance in action! [proud] I shall now craft... the BOMB OF THE AGES!

...Heh. Just, uh—[hesitant] quick question before I start the final assembly.

You're not planning to use this in town, are you? Or on, say... anyone I know? Or me?
quest_8363_quest_progress: [solemn] You've shown you're more than capable of taking on an Abyssal Duke, <name>. [warm] I'm always one to promote good habits. [urgent] Bring me more signets and I'll give you a reward. Abyssal Signet(3)Suggested Players [5]
quest_40315_quest_detail:
If Ansirem Runeweaver is correct, then Alarus must be stopped at all costs. To reforge the key to enter the crypt we will require a few items from the souls lingering within the ruins around Karazhan.

First, we will need a Mark of Karazhan, an object magically enchanted with the ley energy of the tower. It is said that the twins Andreon and Rothynn were both granted one upon being accepted into the tower guard. Whilst Andreon's whereabouts are unknown, Rothynn's spirit still haunts the caverns of the Master's Cellar.

Finally, there is Groundskeeper Jacoby, one who still to this day lives and tends to the grounds. A man who only appears when not a living soul is looking, only to flee and hide when the living linger. It is from him that the key itself will be collected, so hunt him down.

When everything is collected, I can begin to infuse the key with the power it once held, to allow access to the Karazhan Crypt.
quest_41573_quest_detail:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at that legwear you’ve put on your body gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
quest_42020_quest_complete: [solemn] "A gift from my brother. You have traveled far and wide to get to me; you have my deepest gratitude. [warm] To think my older brother put so much trust in my dream—it pleases me. [proud] I will do this weapon great justice."
